Job Description : 
 Full Stack Java & Angular Developer
 Strong hands-on experience in Java 17/21 and Spring Boot development.

 Strong understanding of secure coding practices and dependency/framework vulnerability upgrades.
 Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
 Candidate should be proactive, quality-focused, and capable of working independently on complex technical issues. 
 We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Java & Angular Developer with strong experience in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, SQL, REST APIs, automated testing, and application security .
The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise applications, troubleshooting production and development issues, implementing enhancements, and ensuring high-quality, secure, and maintainable code. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Analyze, troubleshoot, and debug application issues across backend, frontend, and database layers.
Develop clean, maintainable, scalable, and high-quality code following established coding standards.

Develop and maintain RESTful APIs following industry best practices, including appropriate HTTP methods, status codes, exception handling, validation, security, and API design principles.
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular .
Perform Angular version upgrades/migrations when required, particularly to address security vulnerabilities, framework updates, and technical dependencies .
Write comprehensive unit tests and maintain the required minimum 90% code coverage .
Troubleshoot and maintain automated tests using JUnit for Java applications and Jest for Angular applications.
Develop, debug, and optimize SQL queries, functions, stored procedures, and database-related code .
Investigate and resolve complex issues by identifying root causes rather than implementing temporary fixes.
Follow secure coding practices and application security standards.
Work with Spring Security and Apigee JWT/token-based authentication .
Collaborate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.
Clearly communicate technical issues, root causes, solutions, and implementation approaches to relevant stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.
 Required Technical Skills 
 Backend Java & Spring Boot 
Strong hands-on experience with Java .
Strong understanding of Java 17 and Java 21 .
Ability to work with current Java versions and adapt to future Java version upgrades.
Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot .
Good understanding of Spring Framework concepts and application development.
Strong knowledge of REST API development and best practices .
Experience with exception handling, validation, logging, API versioning, and error handling.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
 Frontend – Angular 
Strong hands-on experience with Angular , including modern Angular versions.
Experience with Angular 22 or equivalent recent Angular versions.
Strong understanding of Angular architecture, components, services, routing, forms, and dependency injection.
Ability to perform Angular version upgrades/migrations .
Ability to assess and implement framework/dependency upgrades required due to security vulnerabilities and technology updates .
Strong experience with Jest for Angular unit testing.
 Testing & Code Quality 
Strong experience with JUnit and Java unit testing.
Experience maintaining 90% or higher code coverage .
Strong understanding of unit testing best practices, mocking, test isolation, and maintainable test cases.
Hands-on experience with Jest for frontend testing.
Strong understanding of SonarQube/code quality standards .
Ability to write clean code that minimizes Sonar issues, code smells, vulnerabilities, and maintainability problems.
Good understanding of code review and quality assurance practices.
 Database – SQL 
Strong hands-on experience with SQL .
 SQL functions and stored procedures are mandatory. 
Ability to write, optimize, troubleshoot, and debug SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
Strong debugging skills for identifying issues across application and database layers.
 Security 
Good understanding of Spring Security .
Experience with JWT-based authentication and authorization .
Hands-on understanding of Apigee JWT/token-based security .
Understanding of secure REST API implementation and authentication best practices.
Awareness of security vulnerabilities and the importance of keeping application frameworks and dependencies up to date.
 Core Competencies 
 Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills .
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong attention to code quality and development standards.
Ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Ability to work independently on complex technical issues.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to clearly explain technical problems and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong ownership and accountability for assigned work.
Good collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within a development team.
 Mandatory Skills 
 Java 17/21 | Spring Boot | Angular | Angular 22 | REST APIs | JUnit | Jest | SQL | SQL Functions | Stored Procedures | SonarQube | Spring Security | JWT | Apigee | Debugging & Troubleshooting 
 Preferred Experience 
Experience working on enterprise-scale applications.
Experience handling application/framework upgrades driven by security vulnerabilities.
Experience working with CI/CD and automated quality gates.
Experience in production issue analysis and root-cause investigation.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

title: Sr ETRM Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 This role will be based in Cyber Hub Gurugram. We are looking for an experienced senior ETRM/full-stack developer with strong hands-on experience in commodity trading systems, enterprise application development, and oil and power markets. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets. Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM application vendor or within a commodity trading organization is highly desirable. The role will be part of the Trading Systems Specialist team, supporting the growth of our commercial energy trading business across Europe and North America. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Middle Office, Trade Management, and Supply and Logistics teams, as well as IT and external application vendors. A key responsibility will be to independently contribute to the design, architecture and development of our in-house power trading systems, taking ownership from business requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment and ongoing support. 

 Roles Responsibilities 

 ETRM Development and Application Management 
 Drive the design, development and delivery of C/ETRM enhancements. Analyze business requirements, propose technical solutions and independently deliver application developments. Develop, maintain, debug and optimize application code, database components and supporting services. Automate application processes, operational tasks and business controls. Provide technical support to business users and troubleshoot application issues. Maintain technical documentation and work with vendors to resolve defects and improve system functionality. 

 In-House Power Trading Systems Development 
 Contribute to the architecture, design and development of in-house power trading systems. Translate trading requirements into scalable technical solutions covering trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement and reporting. Work closely with power trading stakeholders to understand market requirements and operational workflows. Independently drive technical initiatives from requirements gathering through design, development, testing and implementation. Develop integrations with power market platforms, exchanges, scheduling systems and external data providers. 

 Full-Stack Application Development 
 Develop enterprise backend applications and services using Java and Spring Boot. Design, develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices. Develop modern frontend applications using React, Angular or equivalent frameworks. Integrate frontend applications with backend services and relational databases. Apply software engineering best practices covering application architecture, performance, security and maintainability. 

 System Integration, Cloud and Automation 
 Develop and maintain integrations between ETRM and enterprise applications, including ERP, planning and scheduling systems. Design and support APIs, data pipelines and automated workflows. Work with relational databases, SQL, data modelling and Python scripting. Develop and support application and data workloads on AWS and/or Azure. Support workflow orchestration using tools such as AWS MWAA (Apache Airflow). Use API testing and documentation tools such as Postman and Swagger. Support system monitoring, performance optimization and operational reliability. 

 Business Support and Project Delivery 
 Support daily trading, middle-office and operational reporting requirements. Work closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to resolve technical and operational challenges. Manage application enhancements, releases and vendor upgrades. Support technical testing, UAT and production deployments. Manage technical issues and vendor escalations. Follow established change management, release management and incident management processes. 

 Job Requirements 

 Education 
 Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related technical discipline. 

 Experience 
 Minimum 7+ years of relevant professional experience in software development, ETRM/CTRM systems or enterprise application development. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets - essential. Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM vendor or commodity trading organization is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience independently delivering application development and integration projects. 

 Behavioral Skills 
 Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables end-to-end. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and deliver sustainable solutions. Ability to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technical solutions. Demonstrated capability to design and build solutions rather than relying solely on vendor support. Strong communication, stakeholder management and collaboration skills. High attention to detail, proactive approach and strong delivery focus. 

 Technical Skills 
 Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms. Familiarity with AWS MWAA / Apache Airflow. Experience with Docker, containerization and automated deployments. Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana or Zabbix. Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA and Change Management processes. Strong understanding of ETRM/CTRM applications and end-to-end commodity trading processes. Minimum 3+ years of power market experience. Understanding power trading workflows, including trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement, pricing and risk management. Knowledge of physical commodity trading, freight, logistics and supply operations. Experience with ETRM platforms such as Amphora Symphony, Endur, RightAngle or equivalent is desirable. 

 Knowledge 
 Experience using AI-powered development tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot. Experience designing or implementing in-house ETRM/CTRM or power trading solutions. Exposure to power exchanges, market operators, balancing mechanisms and market data providers. Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools.

Planning and Design - Works with the product team and stakeholders to refine and document requirements. - Estimates effort for planning purposes. - Designs and documents scalable frontend architecture: component structure, state management, caching and module boundaries. - Contributes to a shared design system and reusable UI component library. - Applies user experience (UX) principles and techniques to create simple, intuitive, accessible and consistent software.

Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.

title: Senior D2C Manager
description:
**Category:**
Fashion / Accessories / Beauty / Lifestyle

**Location:**
Bangalore (On-site)

**Experience:**
4-5 years

**Mandatory Business Scale Experience:**
Must have managed or significantly owned a D2C business generating a minimum monthly revenue of ₹4–5 Cr.

About The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven
**Senior D2C Manager**
to own and scale Monrow's Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) business.

The role involves end-to-end ownership of the D2C revenue engine, bringing together performance marketing, customer acquisition, website conversion, retention, customer experience and profitability.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of D2C business economics, experience scaling consumer brands and the ability to translate marketing investments and customer insights into sustainable revenue growth.

This is not a pure performance marketing, CRM or website management role. We are looking for someone who understands the complete D2C ecosystem and can connect growth functions to business revenue and profitability.

What You'll Own

D2C Revenue & P&L Ownership

* Own the overall D2C revenue strategy, business plan and profitability.
* Drive monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Optimise CAC, LTV, AOV, CVR, contribution margin and customer payback.
* Develop revenue forecasts, budgets and growth plans with leadership and finance.
* Identify growth opportunities across acquisition, conversion, retention and repeat purchases.
* Drive commercial decisions around pricing, promotions, product mix and discounting.

Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition

* Lead acquisition strategy across Meta, Google and other relevant digital channels.
* Own performance marketing budgets, CAC, ROAS and acquisition efficiency.
* Experience managing ₹2 Cr+ annual Meta and Google budgets is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrate the ability to deliver approximately 3X+ net ROAS at meaningful scale.
* Build experimentation frameworks across creatives, audiences, campaigns, offers and landing pages.
* Explore opportunities through influencers, creators, affiliates, referrals and organic acquisition.
* Align acquisition strategies with revenue targets, product availability and profitability.

Website & Conversion Optimisation

* Own Monrow's D2C website as a key revenue-generating channel.
* Improve conversion rate, average order value and revenue per visitor.
* Identify friction across discovery, navigation, product pages, merchandising, cart and checkout.
* Lead CRO initiatives, A/B testing and website experimentation.
* Collaborate with technology, design and creative teams to improve the shopping experience.
* Use website analytics and customer behaviour to improve conversion and maximise revenue.

Customer Retention & Lifetime Value

* Own the customer lifecycle and retention strategy.
* Drive repeat purchases, reactivation and customer lifetime value.
* Develop customer segmentation and cohort-based growth strategies.
* Lead lifecycle marketing across WhatsApp, email, SMS and other relevant channels.
* Build strategies for second purchases, cross-selling, upselling and win-back campaigns.
* Improve retention without excessive dependence on discounts.

Product, Merchandising & Inventory Alignment

* Work with product and merchandising teams to identify high-performing products and revenue opportunities.
* Use customer insights and sales data to influence assortment, pricing and merchandising.
* Analyse product-level conversion, demand patterns and customer preferences.
* Align campaigns and promotions with inventory availability.
* Improve product discovery, recommendations and merchandising on the website.

Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence

* Build and maintain a comprehensive D2C business dashboard.
* Track revenue, CAC, ROAS, AOV, CVR, repeat rate, LTV, contribution margin and profitability.
* Analyse customer cohorts, acquisition sources and retention performance.
* Identify growth opportunities and revenue leakages through customer journey analysis.
* Work with finance on budgets, forecasts and business profitability.
* Establish regular performance reviews and data-led decision-making.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead teams across performance marketing, CRM, CRO and D2C operations.
* Establish clear KPIs, ownership structures and performance targets.
* Collaborate with brand, creative, product, merchandising, inventory, finance and technology teams.
* Balance brand-building initiatives with commercial growth objectives.
* Build scalable processes that improve execution efficiency and reduce founder dependency.

What We're Looking For

Mandatory Requirements

* 4-5 years of overall experience in D2C, consumer businesses, fashion, beauty or lifestyle.
* **Must have managed or significantly owned a D2C business generating a minimum monthly revenue of ₹4–5 Cr.**
* Strong experience in end-to-end D2C business management and revenue growth.
* Demonstrated ownership or significant influence over D2C P&L and profitability.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing and its impact on revenue and contribution margins.
* Experience managing significant Meta and Google budgets; ₹2 Cr+ annual budget exposure preferred.
* Understanding of CAC, ROAS, AOV, CVR, LTV, retention, contribution margin and payback.
* Experience across customer acquisition, website conversion, CRM and retention.
* Strong understanding of website analytics, CRO and customer behaviour.
* Ability to use data to influence product, pricing and merchandising decisions.
* Experience managing teams and collaborating across business functions.
* Strong commercial acumen, analytical thinking and ownership mindset.

Do Not Apply If

* Your experience is primarily in marketplace management or operations.
* You have worked exclusively in performance marketing without broader D2C business ownership.
* Your experience is limited to CRM, retention or website management.
* You have not managed or significantly influenced a D2C business generating ₹4–5 Cr in monthly revenue.
* You have limited exposure to P&L, contribution margins and commercial decisions.
* Your role has been purely executional, with limited accountability for business outcomes.

The Person We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can confidently say:

**"Give me the D2C revenue target and P&L, and I'll identify where the next ₹5 Cr of profitable growth will come from."**

Someone who can seamlessly move between:

Performance Marketing → Customer Acquisition → Website Conversion → Product Mix → Customer Cohorts → Retention → LTV → Contribution Margin → Revenue → P&L.

You don't see performance marketing, website, CRM and merchandising as separate functions. You see them as interconnected drivers of one unified D2C growth engine.

Imagine You've Joined Monrow

**First 90 Days**

* Understand Monrow's D2C business, consumer, product portfolio and unit economics.
* Audit acquisition, website conversion, retention and overall funnel performance.
* Evaluate marketing budgets, channel efficiency and customer acquisition quality.
* Analyse customer cohorts, repeat behaviour and product performance.
* Identify immediate revenue and profitability opportunities.
* Establish dashboards, KPIs and a 12-month D2C growth roadmap.

**Within 6 Months**

* Take complete ownership of the D2C revenue engine.
* Establish scalable acquisition, conversion and retention strategies.
* Improve CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, repeat rate and contribution margins.
* Strengthen experimentation, website experience and customer conversion.
* Improve alignment between marketing, product, merchandising and inventory.
* Build and strengthen the D2C growth team.

**Within 1 Year**

* Build a predictable, scalable and profitable D2C business.
* Deliver significant revenue growth while improving contribution margins.
* Establish strong customer acquisition and retention capabilities.
* Improve customer lifetime value and reduce dependency on paid acquisition.
* Build a data-led organisation with clear revenue and P&L accountability.

Why Join Monrow?

* Own a high-impact mandate across D2C Growth, Revenue and Consumer Experience.
* Work directly with the Founder and senior leadership team.
* Have significant autonomy to build and scale the D2C business.
* Work alongside leaders with experience at Versace, Anita Dongre and Myntra.
* Build and lead a high-performing D2C growth team.
* Opportunity to grow into broader business leadership responsibilities as Monrow scales.

We're building more than a brand. We're building a team of people who love solving meaningful problems, taking ownership and creating lasting impact.

If building a profitable, scalable D2C business excites you, we'd love to hear your story.

How To Apply

Kindly email your resume along with a brief overview of your relevant experience to:

sakshi.y@monrow.in

Please also mention:

**Name | Current CTC | Expected CTC | Notice Period | Most Recent Monthly D2C Revenue Managed | Annual Performance Marketing Budget Managed | D2C P&L Ownership (Yes/No)**

We are looking for experienced cyber security professionals to strengthen our Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Detection, Digital Forensics, and Cyber Defence teams. Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more areas such as SOC operations, incident response, DFIR, threat hunting, SIEM/XDR engineering, or security operations and must hold at least one current and valid certification from the mandatory certification list below.

**Required Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional experience combined with the mandatory security certification may also be considered.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Penetration testing.**
Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.
  
  
**Threat hunting.**
Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.
  
  
**Adversary simulation and purple teaming**
. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.
  
  
**Automation.**
Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.
  
  
**Reporting.**
Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
**Experience.**
3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.
  
  
**Endpoint and network depth.**
You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.
  
  
**Tooling and scripting.**
You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  
  
**AI awareness.**
You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.
  
  
**Practical credentials.**
Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.
  
  
**GOOD TO HAVE**

* An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd
* Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to
* Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements
* GCP and Kubernetes attack paths
* Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

**WHY JOIN US**
**High autonomy**
You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.
  
  
**Builder culture**
Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.
  
  
**Perks And Benefits**

* Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction
* Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development
* Competitive compensation with equity ownership
* Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget
* A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

title: Member of Technical Staff, Cekura (Bangalore, In-Person)
description:
Read This First
  
  
We work with unusual intensity: in-person in Bangalore, six days a week, long days, most weekends. That's how we've chosen to build, because in our market speed decides who wins. We say this up front because we want people who feel pulled in, not talked into it. If you want a 9-to-5 (no judgment), this isn't your role.
  
  
**What You Get In Exchange**

* Top-of-market cash. Extraordinary hours deserve more than an average salary.
* Meaningful equity. Significant grants, employee-friendly terms, and liquidity opportunities as we raise.
* No commute tax. Support to live near the office, plus dinner there every night.
* Founders in the trenches. We work the same schedule we ask of you.
* A decade of growth in two years. You'll ship more and own more than anywhere else.

**About Cekura**
Cekura (YC F24) builds evals and improvement for voice AI, covering both voice agents and the speech-to-speech models behind them.
  
  

* Voice agents. Teams test before launch, monitor production calls, and improve continuously. When something fails, Cekura reproduces it in simulation, fixes it, tests the fix, and raises a PR. The platform covers simulation, LLM evaluation, red-teaming, drift monitoring, and benchmarking across Vapi, Retell, Pipecat, LiveKit, ElevenLabs and more.
* Speech-to-speech models. We give labs benchmarks, data, and RL environments to improve turn-taking, interruptions, naturalness, and tool use in live conversations.

Customers include Five9, HighLevel, Twin Health, PwC, Deloitte, Jobber, and Jotform. HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR are defaults. We're growing fast and backed by top investors.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll build the core of Cekura: simulation engines, evaluation systems, benchmarks, RL environments, self-improvement loops, and observability pipelines. We don't split "software engineer" from "AI engineer." The best problems sit where real-time voice infrastructure, LLM evaluation, RL training, and speech analysis meet.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Simulation engine. Simulate thousands of realistic conversations across voice, chat, and phone, with control over personas, interruptions, noise, and edge cases.
* Agent evaluation. Build LLM evaluators, metrics, red-teaming, drift detection, and the autonomous loop that detects, reproduces, fixes, tests, and ships a PR.
* Speech-to-speech research. Work with labs to find where models fall short of human conversation, then build the benchmarks, datasets, reward signals, and RL environments that close the gap.
* Applied audio. Turn the paralinguistic layer (emotion, tone, silences, hesitations, overlaps) into structured signals, so models are judged on how things are said, not just what.
* Real-time voice infra. SIP, WebRTC, STT/TTS, Twilio, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat. Latency and barge-in are first-class problems.
* Ship end-to-end and shape the team. Own what you build from design to production, and set the standards a growing team inherits.

**About You**

* A strong generalist who wants to work across systems and AI, not stay in one lane.
* A strong coder in Python, TypeScript, or Go, with experience in distributed systems, real-time infra, LLM products, or model training and evaluation.
* You've run production systems and care about reliability, latency, and correctness.
* Sharp instincts about where LLMs and speech models fail, and how to build reliable systems on them.
* You like ambiguity, move fast, communicate clearly, and raise the bar around you.
* You read the first section twice and you're still here.
* Bonus: ex-founder or aspiring one.

Nice to Have
  
  

* LLM evals, agent frameworks, or AI observability.
* Voice AI stack experience (Twilio, SIP, WebRTC, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat, STT/TTS).
* RL for language or speech models, benchmark building, or speech-to-speech models.
* Early-stage startup experience or open-source work.

This Is Not for You If
  
  

* You want a narrow role, a fixed stack, or to work only on models or only on infra.
* You need rigid process or heavy structure.
* You're optimizing for work-life balance right now.
* You don't want to work in-person in Bangalore.

Why Cekura

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Spaulding Ridge is an advisory and IT implementation firm. We help global organizations get financial clarity into the complex, daily sales, and operational decisions that impact profitable revenue generations, efficient operational performance, and reliable financial management.
  
  
At Spaulding Ridge, we believe all business is personal. Core to our values is our relationships with our clients, our business partners, our team, and the global community. Our employees dedicate their time to helping our clients transform their business, from strategy through implementation and business transformation.
  
  
**What You Will Do And Learn**
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join Spaulding Ridge’s Data Solutions practice. You will work directly alongside client business users and technical teams to understand their workflows, uncover high-value problems and build solutions they use in day-to-day operations.
  
  
Working across Snowflake, data engineering, APIs, analytics, applications and AI-enabled workflows, you will take solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment and adoption. You will test assumptions with users, make pragmatic engineering decisions and measure results against agreed business outcomes. This includes identifying where conventional automation, AI assistance or agent-based approaches best fit the problem.
  
  
This is a manager-grade technical leadership role with sustained responsibility for architecture, coding and troubleshooting. You will guide engineers and own technical delivery, partnering with engagement leadership on overall scope, staffing, project budgets and client commitments. Client work may include Office of the CFO workflows such as reconciliation, financial reporting, planning and variance analysis, alongside other enterprise use cases.
  
  

* Work closely with end users to observe workflows, investigate pain points and agree priorities, success measures and a practical first release, including when requirements are unclear.
* Build working prototypes quickly, demonstrate them to users and iterate on feedback. Decide which ideas to develop, change or stop before committing to production delivery.
* Design and implement solutions across source systems, ingestion, Snowflake, transformation, semantic layers, APIs and user-facing applications. Personally code and debug critical components.
* Own Snowflake architecture decisions covering data models, warehouse configuration, ingestion, role-based access, data sharing and environments. Optimize performance, reliability and running costs.
* Build reliable pipelines and transformation models, with data quality checks, reconciliation and governed metrics. Deliver reporting and analytics where they support the client’s workflow.
* Develop applications and APIs with authentication, secure data access, logging and error handling. Build workflows that help users investigate issues, make decisions and take action.
* Build and integrate LLM-enabled applications and tool-using agents where they improve client outcomes. Apply retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise data access and workflow orchestration where appropriate, choosing the simplest effective solution.
* Establish appropriate controls for AI workflows, including context management, tool permissions, human approvals, evaluation, tracing and failure recovery. Test accuracy and task completion against representative examples, and monitor cost and response time.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Snowflake CoCo or equivalents, for coding, testing, debugging and documentation. Review generated output, protect client information and remain accountable for engineering quality.
* Take solutions into production through testing, CI/CD, monitoring and operational documentation. Resolve rollout issues and establish a clear support and ownership handover.
* Support user adoption and measure results with client teams against agreed baselines, such as manual effort, processing time, reliability and cost. Use findings to improve the solution.
* Lead technical priorities, estimates, dependencies and risks; communicate trade-offs to stakeholders and raise scope or delivery issues early. Coach engineers through design and code reviews.
* Contribute technical discovery, scoping and demonstrations to proposals. Turn repeatable solutions into tested accelerators, application components, reusable agent tools and reference architectures for the practice.

**Essential Qualifications**
We are looking for depth in Snowflake and data engineering, demonstrated application-building ability, practical AI engineering experience and sound technical delivery judgment. Candidates should be able to explain what they have built, how they tested it and how it performed in use.
  
  

* 10+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience, including hands-on software or data engineering and delivery of production solutions for clients or business stakeholders. This refers to overall experience, not years working with AI or agent frameworks.
* Strong hands-on Snowflake and SQL experience, including data modeling, ingestion, access controls, performance and cost optimization, and production implementation.
* Experience building reliable data pipelines and transformation models using dbt or comparable tools, with appropriate orchestration, testing and reconciliation.
* Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript and a relevant back-end framework. Proven ability to deliver a usable application across the interface, API and data layers. Deep expertise in every front-end framework is not required.
* Experience building APIs and integrations using REST, JSON and secure authentication such as OAuth, with appropriate authorization and error handling.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing, integrating and testing an LLM-enabled application or tool-using agent workflow connected to business data or systems. Working knowledge of prompt and context design, structured outputs, tool calling and RAG, including when these approaches are appropriate.
* Experience building and evaluating agent-based workflows using an established SDK, framework or platform. Understand execution state, tool access, limits, retries, error handling and human approvals. Be able to test grounding, task completion and failure scenarios.
* Practical experience using at least one AI-assisted development tool, including reviewing generated code, validating changes through tests and protecting client data and credentials.
* Hands-on use of Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and environment management. Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting production solutions.
* Ability to apply data quality, privacy, security and audit requirements in engineering decisions, and to design reusable datasets and consistent business metrics for analytics.
* Experience working directly with users, translating ambiguous problems into practical solutions and iterating on feedback. Ability to understand business rules, exceptions and approval requirements, working with functional specialists where needed.
* Experience leading technical delivery and mentoring engineers, including estimating work, managing technical risks and explaining technical choices to business and engineering audiences.
* A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in the following areas would be valuable:
  
  

* Experience delivering solutions for the Office of the CFO is strongly preferred, particularly in at least one area such as financial close and reconciliation, management reporting, FP&A and variance analysis, or working capital. Familiarity with the relevant data, business rules, controls and approval workflows is more important than breadth across all finance functions.
* Relevant Snowflake certification, such as SnowPro Core or an advanced architecture or data engineering certification; experience with Snowpark, Cortex, Streamlit, Native Apps or Apache Iceberg.
* Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI applications or agents in production, including retrieval quality, evaluation datasets and continuous improvement based on user feedback.
* Experience developing multi-agent workflows, reusable agent skills or tools, custom agent harnesses, or integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP). Ability to explain when the additional complexity is justified.
* Experience introducing agent-assisted engineering practices into a delivery team, including reusable project context, automated test generation and review workflows, with evidence of improvements in delivery speed or quality.
* Delivery experience with a BI or analytics platform such as Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, Looker or Omni, including semantic models and governed metrics.
* Experience with integration or orchestration platforms such as Fivetran, Matillion, Airflow, Boomi, MuleSoft or Workato; or interoperability with Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP application hosting, containers, serverless services or infrastructure as code.
* Exposure to ERP, CRM, operations or other enterprise workflows, and to the governance, service management or compliance requirements relevant to those environments.

**Spaulding Ridge’s Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace**
When we engage the expertise, insights, and creativity of people from all walks of life, we become a better organization, we deliver superior services to clients, and we transform our communities and world for the better.
  
  
At Spaulding Ridge, we believe our team should reflect the rich diversity of society and we take seriously the responsibility to cultivate a workplace where every bandmate feels accepted, respected, and valued for who they are. We do this by creating a culture of trust and belonging, through practices and policies that support inclusion, and through our employee led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs): CRE (Cultural Race and Ethnicity), Women Elevate, PROUD and Mental Wellness Alliance.
  
  
The company is committed to offering Equal Employment Opportunity and to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Spaulding Ridge and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to our VP of Human Resources, Cara Halladay (challaday@spauldingridge.com). Requests for reasonable accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

title: CFD Sr. Analyst/Engineer
description:
Background
  
  
Currently, we are seeking qualified CFD Sr. Analyst candidates for modeling Dishwashing, Laundry, and Cooking Systems.
  
  
Their main responsibility will be to provide CFD analyses to support engineering teams in the product development process for new project initiatives, architecture development, and cost-reduction actions for current production.
  
  
As a CFD Sr. Engineer, you will apply computational fluid dynamics expertise, primarily using Ansys solutions such as Fluent, Icepak, Adjoint, and Ensight, to drive innovation in appliance design across refrigeration, cooking, laundry, and dishwashing systems. You will optimize airflow, thermal performance, noise characteristics, and efficiency across product lines.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and execute CFD simulations using Ansys Fluent, CFX, Icepak, or Mechanical to support appliance system design and performance validation.
* Model various refrigeration, cooking, laundry, or dishwashing systems and optimize thermal-fluid behavior within components such as evaporators, ducts, fans, heating elements, and moisture zones.
* Employ advanced techniques like adjoint-based optimization for flow shaping and pressure reduction, enhancing performance metrics (e.g., velocity uniformity and pressure drop).
* Conduct aeroacoustics simulations to assess and mitigate noise in appliance environments.
* Handle preprocessing (geometry and meshing – structured, unstructured, dynamic), solver setup, and post-processing of results using tools like Fluent Meshing, SpaceClaim, and Ensight.
* Validate CFD models against experimental or prototype testing to ensure fidelity and guide design adjustments.
* Document methodologies and findings clearly; present results and recommendations to multidisciplinary teams, including product, design, and R&D engineers.
* Innovate CFD workflows (e.g., automation and high-fidelity setups) to reduce iteration time and improve insight quality.

**Qualifications**
**What You Need to Succeed (Minimum):**

* Master’s degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive, Thermal, or a similar discipline.
* Proven 6+ years of experience using Ansys CFD tools in product development.
* Solid understanding of heat transfer, multiphase flow, turbulence, and related fluid dynamics principles.
* Proficiency in meshing strategies and handling complex geometry using Ansys DesignModeler, SpaceClaim, etc.
* Experience with dynamic meshing (e.g., moving frames and rotating components) or multiphase modeling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities, with the ability to support cross-functional teams and present complex results clearly.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python.
* Exposure to software such as ModeFrontier.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; fluency in English.
* Experience with multiphysics coupling, HPC clusters, or adjoint optimization workflows.
* Strong collaboration skills and a self-reliant, solution-oriented approach.

**Preferred**

* 6 or more years of experience using Ansys Fluent, Fluent Meshing, SpaceClaim, and Ansys meshing techniques.
* Experience in CFD simulation of turbulent fluid flow, convective heat transfer, etc.
* Industry experience in automotive, aerospace, HVAC, or similar high-complexity fields.
* PTC Creo modeling experience.
* Fluency in English.

Performance Indicators
  
  

* Accuracy of CFD predictions validated against physical testing.
* Speed and efficiency in delivering simulation-based recommendations.
* Reduction in prototyping needs through robust simulation workflows.
* Effectiveness in communicating insights and driving design improvements.

, application and file migrations; AD consolidation and multi-forest migration; Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migration; cutover and validation.

VPNs, hybrid connectivity, segmentation, load balancing concepts, Microsoft Defender, vulnerability management and security uplift programs.

title: Senior IT Engineer (Microsoft 365)
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on
**Senior IT Engineer**
to take ownership of One Retail Group's Microsoft 365 environment, cybersecurity, global IT estate and employee technical support.
  
  
Based in our
**Bengaluru office**
, you will support approximately 100 colleagues across the UK, India, China and UAE. We are bringing IT operations in-house and need someone who can independently own and improve our environment as we transition away from an outsourced provider.
  
  
**This is not a traditional helpdesk role, nor is it a purely strategic infrastructure role.**
You should be comfortable both managing Intune and security policies and troubleshooting an employee's laptop. We need practical judgement, root-cause investigation, clear communication and responsibility for the outcome.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Microsoft 365, Identity & Security**

* Own Microsoft 365 administration across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.
* Administer Entra ID, identities, permissions, groups, MFA and Conditional Access.
* Manage and improve Intune enrolment, configuration, compliance, application deployment and device security.
* Manage Defender, endpoint protection, encryption, patching and security alerts.
* Take operational responsibility for preventing and responding to phishing, compromised accounts, ransomware and data loss, including monitoring, escalation, recovery testing and clear incident procedures.
* Review access, identify vulnerabilities, coordinate incident responses and test backup and recovery arrangements.
* Keep the environment secure, efficient, cost-effective and appropriately documented.

**Global Devices & Employee Support**

* Manage our Windows and macOS laptop estate from procurement and setup through support, replacement and disposal.
* Provide responsive IT support across international offices, diagnosing hardware, software, application and connectivity problems.
* Own technology onboarding and offboarding, including provisioning, account access and secure equipment returns.
* Maintain accurate device and asset records and consistent configuration standards.
* Work with HR and local office teams to coordinate practical support and equipment delivery.

**IT Policies & Governance**

* Develop, maintain and implement practical IT policies and procedures covering information security, acceptable use, device management, access controls, data protection and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Ensure policies are consistently applied across our international offices without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Automate repetitive IT tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and appropriate AI-assisted tools, while retaining responsibility for security and quality.
* Identify root causes and permanently reduce recurring tickets and manual work.
* Review Microsoft licences and SaaS subscriptions for unnecessary costs.
* Improve documentation, support processes, employee experience and business continuity.

**Bring IT Ownership In-House**

* Help transition IT operations from our external provider, reviewing existing configuration, access and documentation.
* Take long-term ownership of Microsoft 365, Intune, device management, security and technical support.
* Work closely with HR, Finance, leadership and other teams on business application access and technical issues.
* Collaborate with our separate software, data engineering and Business Central specialists; this role does not own development of those systems.

**Essential**
**What We're Looking For**

* Strong practical experience in IT infrastructure or systems engineering, ideally 5+ years in hands-on roles.
* Proven Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender and endpoint management experience.
* Experience with Conditional Access, MFA, device compliance and secure administration.
* Confident supporting Windows and macOS, including general networking, DNS, Wi-Fi and VPN troubleshooting.
* Track record of independently resolving complex issues and supporting employees.
* Clear written and spoken English, sound technical judgement and a proactive, service-minded approach.
* Comfortable working from our Bengaluru office five days per week, with sufficient working-hours overlap to support our UK-based colleagues.
* Willing to provide occasional out-of-hours support for critical IT incidents, security emergencies or planned maintenance, recognising that we operate across multiple international time zones. This is not a routine 24/7 on-call role; any out-of-hours arrangements will be agreed in advance, with appropriate time off in lieu.

**We value evidence of independent ownership and practical problem-solving more than certifications alone.**
**Highly Desirable**

* Intune implementation, Windows Autopilot and Microsoft 365 Business Premium.
* PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, IT automation and AI-assisted workflows.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, security incident response and information protection.
* Supporting multiple countries, managing IT assets and licensing, and transitioning from an outsourced IT provider.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications (such as MD-102, MS-102 or SC-300).

**What Success Looks Like**
Within six months, you will have taken clear ownership of our Microsoft environment and global support operations. Devices will be securely managed, employees will receive reliable support, onboarding and offboarding will be consistent, and security controls and recovery processes will be tested and documented.
  
  
You will have reduced recurring issues, automated useful processes and helped establish a reliable, secure and cost-effective in-house IT function. This is a chance to own and improve a global business's IT environment, not simply operate one part of a large corporate IT department.

title: Siebel Administrator
description:
The Senior Siebel Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and support of Oracle Siebel CRM environments across the enterprise. This role ensures the stability, security, availability, and performance of critical CRM applications while supporting upgrades, integrations, cloud initiatives, and disaster recovery activities. The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert for Siebel infrastructure and administration, partnering with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions that support business operations.
  
  
How will you do it
  
  

* Administer and support Oracle Siebel CRM environments across development, testing, and production environments.
* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Oracle Siebel applications on both Windows and Linux platforms.
* Lead and support Siebel upgrades to current releases, preferably Siebel 25.x and newer versions.
* Configure and maintain Siebel Gateway clustering, multi-mode Application Interface (AI) load balancing, and related infrastructure components.
* Monitor system performance and execute performance tuning activities across Siebel Servers, Application Object Managers (AOMs), Application Interface (AI), Gateway Servers, Tomcat servers, and supporting infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, infrastructure, and integration issues, including EAI component crashes through analysis of FDR reports, component logs, and system logs.
* Perform system administration activities including application configuration, component management, parameter configuration, and environment maintenance.
* Support and troubleshoot Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions for routine administrative activities using Windows batch jobs, Linux cron jobs, and scripting tools.
* Install, configure, upgrade, and support BI Publisher integrations with Oracle Siebel environments.
* Design, support, and execute Disaster Recovery (DR) setup, testing, and validation activities.
* Manage and support Siebel deployments hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and other cloud platforms.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and database teams to ensure system reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor environment health, proactively identify issues, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and support knowledge articles.

What we look for
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Oracle Siebel CRM in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience installing and supporting Oracle Siebel on Windows and Linux platforms.
* Experience performing Siebel upgrades, migrations, and patching activities, preferably on recent Siebel versions.
* Strong knowledge of Siebel architecture including Gateway Server, Enterprise Server, Application Interface (AI), AOMs, and Tomcat environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Siebel Gateway clustering and load-balanced environments.
* Strong experience with Siebel performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and tuning.
* Experience troubleshooting EAI component failures and analyzing system logs and diagnostic reports.
* Experience supporting SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
* Experience automating administrative processes through scripting, Windows batch jobs, and Linux cron jobs.
* Experience designing, supporting, and testing disaster recovery solutions.
* Basic Oracle Database administration knowledge, including connectivity, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing Oracle Siebel environments in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with BI Publisher installation, administration, and integration.
* Experience supporting highly available and clustered enterprise environments.
* Oracle Siebel certifications or related Oracle technology certifications.
* Experience with Linux administration and shell scripting.

title: Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Provide senior technical leadership during critical incidents, coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting, restore services within agreed priorities, and communicate clear technical status and risk.
* Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, identify corrective and preventive actions, and ensure actions are tracked through closure.
* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

title: Oracle ERP EPM Systems Admin
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The administrator reports to the VP of IT Operations.
  
  
The Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, security and operational health of ACC's Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM environments. The role is the technical owner of both platforms, covering configuration, metadata and dimension management, role design, update readiness, data flow monitoring, reporting and issue resolution, and serves as the primary bridge between Finance and Accounting and IT and as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support. The role is measured heavily by the reliability of the financial close and of the planning and consolidation cycles that depend on it.
  
  
Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time, aligned to the Finance and Accounting close and planning calendars, with extended availability during month-end, quarter-end and year-end close and budget and forecast cycles. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, supports Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update windows, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud ERP Financials modules, which may include General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Procurement, Subledger Accounting and Projects.
* Perform application configuration through Functional Setup Manager and migrate configuration between environments using configuration packages.
* Maintain enterprise structures and accounting configuration, including ledgers, legal entities, business units, chart of accounts and value sets, accounting calendars and currency setup.
* Configure and maintain approval workflows for invoices, payments, expenses, requisitions and journals, and troubleshoot workflow failures and stuck approvals.
* Support period open and close activities, resolving close-blocking errors, unposted transactions and interface exceptions, and monitor the Enterprise Scheduler for failed or long-running processes.
* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud EPM applications, which may include Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, Narrative Reporting and Enterprise Data Management.
* Own EPM metadata and dimension maintenance, keeping hierarchies aligned to the ERP chart of accounts and enterprise structures through a controlled request, validation and promotion process.
* Develop, maintain and tune business rules and calculations using Calculation Manager, including allocations, currency translation and aggregations.
* Maintain EPM forms, dashboards, task lists and valid intersections, and administer consolidation, intercompany elimination, close task management and account reconciliation processes.
* Manage EPM maintenance operations, including snapshots, Lifecycle Management artifact migration and test-to-production promotion, and automate recurring tasks using EPM Automate and/or REST APIs.
* Design and maintain ERP and EPM security to least privilege, and administer user provisioning, modification and termination in coordination with the IAM team and strictly through approved request workflow.
* Maintain single sign-on and identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID, analyze and remediate segregation of duties conflicts, and support periodic user access reviews.
* Own the Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles end to end, including readiness review, impact assessment, regression testing, user acceptance testing coordination and scheduling around close and planning calendars.
* Serve as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support for ERP and EPM, driving and escalating service requests through to resolution.
* Own the ERP-to-EPM data flow, including Data Integration / Data Management setup, mapping and validation that loaded balances tie to the general ledger.
* Monitor and troubleshoot financial integrations and data loads, including FBDI, ADF Desktop Integration, banking and payment interfaces, and integrations with the property management platform and other upstream and downstream systems.
* Build and maintain reporting using OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio, Management Reporting, Narrative Reporting and Smart View.
* Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 support for Finance and Accounting users, managing a ServiceNow ticket queue from receipt through resolution, and prioritize close-blocking and cycle-blocking issues above all other work.
* Follow change management for all production configuration, metadata and business rule changes, and support internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent control testing with access and change evidence.
* Document configuration, metadata processes, business rules and runbooks, and train Finance super users, budget holders and reconciliation preparers to reduce recurring ticket volume.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving Oracle Cloud ERP and EPM best practices and communicate relevant improvements to Finance, team members and leadership.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing financial, plan, forecast, vendor or bank data or configuration secrets to unapproved tools.
* Experience applying generative AI responsibly to documentation, test scripts, business rule and SQL development and release note analysis, with human validation before anything touches production or the financial record.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials architecture, module interaction and the accounting flow from subledger through Subledger Accounting to General Ledger.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM architecture, including cube structure, dimensionality, calculation behavior and the performance implications of metadata design.
* Working knowledge of consolidation, close management, account reconciliation and planning and forecasting processes, and how configuration affects reported results.
* Knowledge of Oracle Cloud security models for ERP and EPM and of segregation of duties principles and compensating controls.
* Working SQL skills for analysis, reconciliation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITIL-aligned incident, request and change management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between accounting language and application configuration across cultures and time zones.
* Strong project- and time-management skills, with a systematic, organized approach and high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to treat the integrity of the books as the highest priority and work calmly and accurately under close deadlines.
* Ability to say no to an unreviewed production change and explain the reasoning in terms Finance leadership will accept.
* Ability to learn new concepts and software quickly and take a proactive approach to platform enhancements.
* Ability to think logically and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Education & Experience**

* At least five years of experience administering or supporting enterprise financial systems, including at least three years with Oracle Cloud ERP Financials.
* At least two years of hands-on experience administering Oracle Cloud EPM, including Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close or Account Reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience with EPM metadata maintenance, Calculation Manager, Data Integration, Lifecycle Management and EPM Automate, and with Functional Setup Manager and configuration packages.
* Demonstrated experience managing Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles, including regression testing and user acceptance testing coordination.
* Experience supporting audit and internal control requirements is required; SOX experience and real estate, property management or student housing industry experience are preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems or a related field; equivalent work experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**CERTIFICATES & LICENSES**

* Oracle Cloud Financials Implementation Professional (General Ledger, Payables or Receivables).
* Oracle Cloud Planning Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Financial Consolidation and Close Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Account Reconciliation Implementation Professional is a plus.
* Oracle Cloud Applications Security or Enterprise Structures certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals.
* CompTIA SecAI+ (Security AI+).
* ITIL Foundation is a plus.

***EEO Statement***

In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email*
