title: Technical Consultant
description:
Job Title
  
  
Technical Consultant
  
  
**Job Description**
The Technical Consultant is responsible for playing a critical role in consulting with key clients to understand their complex, high-impact technical and business needs, offering strategic recommendations that drive significant value and align with long-term goals, working under limited supervision. The role leads the development of advanced technical solutions, including detailed design documentation, system architectures, and integration frameworks, ensuring successful end-to-end implementation and optimization. The role involves designing innovative, customized approaches to address intricate client challenges and contributing to the evolution of best-in-class methodologies.
  
  
An exciting opportunity has become available for a Technical Consultant to join the Philips Clinical Informatics business. The role will focus on implementation, remote support, troubleshooting, upgrade, and lifecycle services for
**PerformanceBridge**
and
**Advanced Visualization**
solutions used by healthcare customers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will help customers maintain reliable clinical and operational workflows by diagnosing complex applications, infrastructures, operating systems, databases, and integration issues. You will work closely with Philips customers and R&D teams to resolve escalations, improve serviceability, and reduce customer downtime.
  
  
This is a global role and requires flexibility to work any 40 hours in the week to support a 24x7 follow-the-sun operating model.
  
  
Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  

* Provide L2/L3 remote technical support to global customers for Philips PerformanceBridge and Advanced Visualization solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex software, hardware, operating system, database, network and integration issues with minimal supervision.
* Perform remote upgrades, configuration changes, health checks, and operating system security patching in line with customer change-control requirements.
* Monitor system health periodically and work proactively to prevent or minimize unplanned downtime.
* Diagnose and resolve customer issues using logs, system metrics, application behavior, service tools, and structured problem-solving methods.
* Escalate product defects and complex technical issues to R&D and engineering teams with clear evidence, reproduction steps, logs, and business impact.
* Collaborate with Engineering, and Global Support team to improve installation quality, support readiness, and future service requirements.
* Document findings, actions, root cause, customer communication, and resolution steps accurately in the relevant service systems.
* Support knowledge sharing through troubleshooting notes, best practices, lessons learned, and technical coaching for peers.
* Maintain a strong customer-first mindset while balancing technical quality, speed of resolution, compliance, and cost-effective solutions.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Relevant technical degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare IT, or a related discipline. A background in Computer Science or IT is considered an advantage.
* Overall 6+ years of professional experience, including at least 2+ years in a medical device, healthcare IT, technical service, support, engineering, or QA environment.
* Strong experience troubleshooting software-based products in production environments while working against defined SLAs.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications deployed in customer data-center, virtualized, cloud, or hybrid IT environments.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, networking concepts, and common enterprise security practices.
* Experience using Linux for log analysis, command-line troubleshooting, service management, permissions, connectivity checks, and basic system administration.
* Preferred experience in healthcare imaging or clinical informatics environments, including familiarity with radiology or cardiology workflows, DICOM, HL7, PACS, and hospital network environments.
* Practical experience with application log analysis, Windows Event Viewer, Linux shell commands, SQL queries, service/process analysis, and network troubleshooting tools.
* Understanding of backup and restore concepts, certificates, authentication mechanisms, firewalls, proxies, antivirus/security controls, and patch management practices.
* Experience preparing structured escalation packages for R&D teams, including timelines, environment details, logs, screenshots, observed behavior, and customer impact analysis.
* Experience contributing to knowledge articles, troubleshooting runbooks, operational handovers, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Flexible working hours and willingness to work in shifts to support 24x7 global customer operations.

Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Customer-first mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to issue resolution.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently isolate root causes under limited supervision.
* Strong ability to collaborate effectively with R&D teams, customer IT departments, and cross-functional stakeholders during technical escalations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including professional customer interactions, phone etiquette, and clear technical documentation.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into actionable operational plans, service actions, or technical recommendations.
* Strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Fast learner with strong curiosity and adaptability toward new technologies and platform environments.
* Self-driven, passionate, and proactive work style with a strong work ethic and willingness to support critical customer situations outside normal business hours when required.
* Strong focus on minimizing customer downtime, improving service quality, reducing repeat escalations, and maintaining high Customer Net Promoter Score (NPS) outcomes.

title: Senior System Development Engineer, Silicon, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related Information Technology (IT) field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with systems automation, and with systems design and implementation.
* 5 years of experience with technical infrastructure (e.g., deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting), and with reliability of technical infrastructure.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience working with vendors or customers.
* Experience with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools or chip design.
* Experience in working with Go, Python or C++.
* Experience in interacting with end users or product aptitude.

**About The Job**
Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters.
  
  
Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.
  
  
Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter.
  
  
The EDACloud Operations team defines processes for managing incidents to develop automation to ensure upgrades are rolled out safely and slowly. The team builds out monitoring for internal use as well as for the users to understand the state of the service, and debug when there are issues.
  
  
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in on-call activities and manage the systems within the domain and work with the primary responders to help in fixing system issues.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate technical data, and develop recommendations for systems and services, respond to tickets/bugs within team-defined service-level objectives (SLOs), and contribute to systems and services through bug reports and consultation.
* Work with customers on defining distributed systems requirements, testing procedures, and proposing solutions.
* Set up processes for planning, improving quality, best practices, and maintaining a short response time for user issues.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Microsoft Control Access - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Administer, design, and govern Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies across production and non-production environments, including policy assignments, conditions, grant controls, session controls, naming standards, and exclusion governance.
* Configure and support access controls for users, groups, roles, cloud applications, guests, workload identities, and devices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), authentication strengths, compliant or hybrid-joined device requirements, and risk-based policies.
* Manage the policy lifecycle through What If analysis, report-only mode, phased rollouts, change records, testing, approvals, rollback planning, post-change validation, and emergency-access account monitoring.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for sign-in and access issues; analyze policy evaluation details, Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, KQL queries, and Microsoft Sentinel data; and manage incident, service request, problem, and change activities in ServiceNow.
* Automate repeatable policy reporting, backup, drift detection, and administration using approved tools, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell; maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
* Lead client operational reviews and policy-design workshops; coordinate onsite and offshore activities; mentor junior staff; communicate access impacts and remediation actions; and contribute technical insights to managed-services solution design.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.

Required:

* Deep understanding of operational processes, incident resolution, change management, and compliance management; proficiency with process documentation, SLAs, reporting, and ITSM practices (ServiceNow).
* Experience leading support teams, mentoring juniors, and managing enhancement/implementation projects; able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and clients at all levels.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300); ITIL.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
* Experience with Global Secure Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Defender XDR, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot agents, or Conditional Access policy-as-code (Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Microsoft365DSC, CI/CD pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with other identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Ping) or privileged access tools used in managed services.

title: IT Simulation Engineer
description:
**About Us**
**PHINIA:**
Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.
  
  
PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY®, and HARTRIDGE™. With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 12,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 20 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. Read More
  
  
**Job Purpose**
PHINIA is seeking an IT Simulation Analyst to support, optimize, and enhance engineering simulation environments, CAE tools, and digital engineering workflows. This role ensures reliable operation of simulation applications, high‑performance compute resources, and data integration across CAD/PLM/CAE systems. The analyst will partner with Engineering, IT Infrastructure, and Application teams to enable efficient simulation processes and support PHINIA’s digital product development initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide operational support for engineering simulation tools (e.g., ANSYS, Altair Hyperworks, MATLAB/Simulink, GT‑Suite, or PHINIA‑specific applications), ensuring stability, performance, and usability.
* Support installation, configuration, version upgrades, license management, plugin integrations, and performance tuning of CAE applications across global engineering teams.
* Collaborate with engineering and CAE users to streamline simulation workflows, improve job execution reliability, reduce waiting times, and enhance model/data availability.
* Maintain and support IT components underpinning simulation workloads, including HPC clusters, compute nodes, GPU resources, job schedulers (PBS Pro), shared storage, and license servers.
* Support integration of CAE environments with CAD/PLM systems (e.g., Teamcenter) to ensure proper version control, model consistency, and simulation data governance.
* Analyze simulation job performance, queue usage, and resource bottlenecks; recommend scaling, optimization, and automation improvements for compute resources.
* Coordinate with IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Storage, and vendor teams to resolve issues, plan capacity, and evaluate opportunities for hybrid/cloud HPC adoption (Azure/AWS HPC).
* Maintain comprehensive documentation such as installation guides, system runbooks, architecture diagrams, workflows, and user best‑practice guidelines.
* Ensure CAE and simulation systems comply with PHINIA’s IT security, identity, compliance, and software licensing requirements.
* Support engineering teams in rolling out new simulation tools, capabilities, configuration updates, and digital engineering initiatives (e.g., digital twins, model-based engineering, simulation automation).
* Assist with automation of simulation workflows using scripting (Python/Shell), job orchestration improvements, template standardization, and repeatable pipelines.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to modernize simulation environments, including HPC enhancements, cloud readiness, user experience improvements, and performance monitoring.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field
* 3–6 years of experience supporting engineering simulation/CAE environments or engineering IT systems.
* Hands-on experience with one or more CAE tools (ANSYS, Altair HyperWorks, MATLAB/Simulink, GT‑Suite, etc.).
* Familiarity with HPC environments, job schedulers (PBS, SLURM), and compute/storage performance optimization.
* Understanding of CAD/PLM data flows, engineering BOM structures, and simulation data management.
* Solid technical skills in Windows/Linux environments, scripting (Python, Shell), and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of simulation licensing models (FlexLM, RLM, etc.).
* Experience working with ITIL processes for incident, change, and problem management
* CAE tool certifications (ANSYS, HyperWorks) preferred.
* Linux/Windows admin certifications — plus.
* Cloud/HPC certifications (Azure HPC, AWS HPC) — nice to have

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**VISA SPONSORSHIP**
For this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis in the country where the position is based. Only in certain circumstances, based on business need, does PHINIA provide sponsorship for employment visa status.
  
  
**NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS**
PHINIA does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or third-party vendors. Any recruitment partnership must be approved in writing by Human Resources before candidate submissions are made.
  
  
**GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT**
Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
  
  
Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review.
  
  
Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.
  
  
***Career Scam Disclaimer:***
*PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.*
Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com.

title: Business Intelligence Administrator
description:
\*\*This is a full time, contractual role for 6 months, HYBRID, with possible extension\*\*

Role - Spotfire Administrator( TIBCO Spotfire)

Duration - 6 to 8 months (With possible extension)

Work Mode - Hybrid

Locations - Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Spotfire Administrator to manage and support our TIBCO Spotfire platform across DEV, UAT, VAL, and PROD environments. The role covers platform administration, scheduled job and report management, troubleshooting, server support, upgrades, and data connectivity support, so that Spotfire stays stable, secure, and high performing for business users and report developers.

Key Responsibilities

Spotfire Administration

* Administer Spotfire Server, Web Player, and Analyst environments.
* Manage users, groups, licenses, permissions, and library folder security.
* Maintain configurations, preferences, and administrative settings.
* Monitor Spotfire services and application availability.

Scheduled Jobs and Report Management

* Monitor and troubleshoot scheduled update and report execution failures using job logs.
* Resolve caching issues and monitor resource pool utilization.
* Investigate Web Player memory issues and performance bottlenecks.

Troubleshooting and Performance Monitoring

* Analyze Server, Web Player, Action, and Audit logs and troubleshooting bundles.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents.
* Troubleshoot report loading failures, data refresh issues, and application errors.
* Identify performance bottlenecks in Information Links and data connections.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and database teams to resolve issues.

Server and Infrastructure Support

* Perform basic Linux server administration and log analysis.
* Monitor application server health and resource utilization.
* Work with infrastructure teams on maintenance, backup, and migration activities.

Upgrades and Environment Management

* Support Spotfire version upgrades and patch installations.
* Perform backups and validation before and after upgrades.
* Maintain DEV, UAT, VAL, and PROD environments.
* Conduct post-upgrade testing and support deployments and migrations across environments.

Data Connectivity and Application Support

* Troubleshoot database connectivity and data source issues.
* Support Information Links, data connections, and data refresh configurations.
* Assist report developers with data access and application-related issues.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience administering TIBCO Spotfire Server, Web Player, and Analyst.
* Strong experience in user, group, license, and permission management.
* Proven ability to analyze Spotfire logs and perform root cause analysis.
* Experience troubleshooting scheduled jobs, caching, resource pools, and Web Player performance.
* Working knowledge of Information Links, data connections, and database connectivity (SQL).
* Basic Linux administration skills.
* Experience with upgrades, patching, and multi-environment management (DEV, UAT, VAL, PROD).

Preferred Skills

* Spotfire administration certification or equivalent training.
* Exposure to other BI platforms such as Tableau or Alteryx.
* Familiarity with backup, migration, and deployment processes.
* Experience working in production support or incident management environments.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear communication and collaboration with infrastructure, database, and development teams.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a production environment.

title: Platform Engineer II - India
description:
**About The Role**
The Platform Engineering team delivers scalable, resilient, and secure foundational infrastructure that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and confidence. We champion a modern DevSecOps culture built on automation, quality, and immutability delivered entirely via code.
  
  
As a
**Platform Engineer II**
, you will serve as a cloud-native practitioner responsible for engineering, maintaining, and automating foundational self-service platform capabilities. Your primary focus will center on
**Kubernetes cluster operations**
,
**declarative GitOps pipelines**
, and
**scalable Cloud infrastructure (GCP)**
to drive developer velocity, harden security posture, and minimize time-to-market across hybrid and multi-cloud environments .
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Kubernetes Platform Operations: Deploy, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters (e.g., GKE) across non-production and production environments, ensuring cluster reliability, resource efficiency, and high availability .
* GitOps Delivery & Automation: Build, maintain, and standardize declarative continuous deployment pipelines using GitOps frameworks (e.g., ArgoCD), enabling automated drift detection, automated promotion blueprints, and self-healing deployments.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision, standardize, and maintain immutable cloud resources across Cloud platforms (GCP preferred) utilizing modular, version-controlled Terraform modules.
* Developer Self-Service Enablement: Collaborate with senior engineers and application development teams to design and implement self-service developer workflows, reducing friction in onboarding, container packaging, and environment provisioning .
* Platform Reliability & Observability: Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to monitor cluster health, node performance, and application workloads.
* Security & Governance Enforcement: Implement policy-as-code and container security standards (e.g., OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, image vulnerability scanning) to maintain a secure-by-default runtime environment.
* Operational Excellence & Incident Response: Participate in platform incident triage, conduct root cause analyses (RCAs), and build automated remediations to eliminate operational toil.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Primary Core Competencies (Required)**

* Kubernetes & Container Orchestration

+ Proven hands-on experience administering and operating production-grade Kubernetes environments..
+ Strong understanding of core Kubernetes primitives, including Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress controllers, ConfigMaps/Secrets, RBAC, CNI networking, and CSI storage volumes.
+ Experience managing containerized applications with Docker/containerd, Helm charts, and Kustomize overlays.
+ Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot cluster bottlenecks, node pool scaling, crash loops, and workload connectivity issues .

* GitOps & Declarative CI/CD

+ Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining GitOps deployment models using tools such as ArgoCD..
+ Solid understanding of declarative application specifications, Git-branching strategies (Trunk-based, Gitflow), PR-driven delivery, and automated configuration drift management.
+ Experience configuring and maintaining CI/CD systems (e.g.Argo Workflows) to build container images and execute automated testing stages .

* Cloud Platform & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

+ Hands-on proficiency with a major Public Cloud platform—Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred, or AWS—focusing on compute, networking (VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, Cloud DNS), and IAM .
+ Proficiency in writing, testing, and maintaining modular Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for cloud resource provisioning.
+ Practical understanding of cloud architecture concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and multi-region resilience .

**Supporting Technical Skills (Required)**

* Systems & Scripting: Strong working knowledge of Linux operating systems, systems administration, and proficiency in scripting/automation using Python, Bash .
* Networking Fundamentals: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/SSL certificates, HTTP/gRPC protocols, and internal load balancing.
* Collaboration & Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, document operational playbooks, and partner constructively with cross-functional development teams .

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–5 years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure.
* Policy & Security: Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) or container vulnerability scanning tools.
* Progressive Delivery: Familiarity with progressive delivery patterns such as Canary releases, Blue-Green deployments, and Argo Rollouts.

**CME Group: Where Futures are Made**
CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.
  
  
At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. title: Design Researcher Intern
description:
**Design Researcher Intern**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a curious and design-minded
**Design Researcher Intern**
who enjoys observing, analysing and understanding why certain designs work better than others. The ideal candidate should be able to look at a website, mobile application, brochure or social media creative and explain its design approach, layout structure, visual hierarchy and areas of improvement. This role is an opportunity to learn how design research works in a professional creative environment and contribute to building reusable design guidelines for different industries.

**Job Title:**
Design Researcher Intern

**Experience:**
Fresher / 0–6 months

**Employment Type:**
Internship

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Works With:**
UI/UX Designers, Graphic Designers, Developers and Account Managers

**About the Role**

This internship sits at the intersection of design thinking, research and visual communication.

You will not be expected to spend most of your time creating designs. Instead, you will learn to observe, study, analyse and explain design decisions.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys
**talking about design and understanding how it works**
.

For example, when shown a brochure, website or mobile application, you should be interested in understanding:

* **Layout structure:**
  Understand how grids, columns, spacing, alignment, typography and visual hierarchy are used.
* **Visual communication:**
  Understand how colours, images, typography and content work together to communicate a message.
* **Industry relevance:**
  Understand why a particular design approach works for its industry and target audience.
* **Room for improvement:**
  Identify design inconsistencies, usability issues and opportunities to improve the overall experience.

You will work alongside experienced designers and gradually learn to convert your research observations into practical design references and layout guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Observe, Analyse and Explain Design**

* Study different types of designs, including websites, mobile applications, brochures, advertisements and social media creatives.
* Identify what makes a design visually effective or ineffective.
* Explain design decisions, layout structures and visual approaches in simple language.
* Participate in internal design discussions and review sessions.
* Prepare short design analysis documents explaining strengths and areas of improvement.

**2. Understand Different Types of Design**

* Learn to identify the differences between UI design, UX design and graphic design.
* Understand when a project requires UI, UX, graphic design or a combination.
* Study how design approaches change depending on the medium and communication objective.
* Analyse how users interact with digital interfaces and respond to visual communication.

**3. Learn and Analyse Layout Systems**

* Research fundamental grid systems, including 12-column grids, modular grids and baseline grids.
* Understand spacing systems, alignment, white space and visual hierarchy.
* Study typography, font combinations, type scales and readability.
* Understand visual reading patterns such as F-pattern and Z-pattern.
* Analyse how content, images and CTAs are positioned across different layouts.
* Assist in documenting reusable layout references and design patterns.

**4. Research Industry-Specific Design**

* Research how different industries approach their visual communication and digital experiences.
* Study competitor websites, brochures, advertisements and social media designs.
* Collect references from leading brands, design studios and award-winning projects.
* Understand the expectations and information needs of different target audiences.
* Create industry-specific mood boards, reference collections and design inspiration libraries.
* Assist in identifying design trends and patterns across different industries.

**5. Support the Design Team**

* Assist UI/UX and graphic designers with research before the design process begins.
* Prepare reference boards, competitor analysis and visual inspiration collections.
* Help create basic wireframes and layout structures under designer guidance.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and design reviews.
* Document research findings and present observations to the design team.
* Continuously explore new design tools, platforms and visual trends.

**Verticals and Design Work You Will Explore**

You will get exposure to multiple industry verticals and learn how design approaches differ depending on the audience, business objectives and communication requirements.

**Graphic Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Brochures, print advertisements, hoardings, social media creatives, campaign visuals and brand collateral.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Visual hierarchy, typography, colour combinations, image-to-text balance and brand consistency.

**Web Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Websites, landing pages, microsites, listing pages and product pages.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Grid systems, section structures, content flow, CTA placement and responsive layouts.

**UI/UX Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Mobile applications, dashboards, forms, booking flows, enquiry journeys and checkout experiences.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Navigation, information architecture, usability, interaction patterns and user experience.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Design, Visual Communication, UI/UX Design, Fine Arts, Architecture or a related field.
* Strong interest in understanding design principles and visual communication.
* Ability to observe a design and communicate what works and what can be improved.
* Basic understanding of UI design, UX design and graphic design.
* Familiarity with fundamental design concepts such as grids, spacing, typography, alignment and visual hierarchy.
* Basic knowledge of Figma is preferred.
* Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to research, learn, explore and discuss different design approaches.
* A portfolio, academic project or personal case study demonstrating design thinking is preferred.

**Nice to Have**

* Personal design projects, redesign concepts or visual research work.
* Experience creating mood boards, reference boards or competitor analysis.
* Basic understanding of responsive web design and design systems.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Behance, Dribbble, Awwwards and Pinterest for design research.
* Knowledge of tools such as Notion, Google Sheets or Miro for organising research.
* Curiosity about emerging design trends, AI design tools and creative technologies.

**What You Will Learn**

* How to critically analyse professional designs across different industries.
* How to identify and understand different layout systems.
* How to conduct competitor and visual design research.
* How to translate research findings into practical design guidelines.
* How professional UI/UX and graphic design teams approach projects.
* How to present and communicate design decisions with confidence.
* How to build structured design reference libraries and research documentation.

**Hiring Process and How to Apply**

1. Portfolio / Work Review

Share your portfolio, academic projects or personal design explorations. We are more interested in your thinking and observations than polished final designs.

2. Design Talk-Through (20–30 Minutes)

We will show you two designs from different industries, one website and one print design.

You will be asked to:

* Identify the type of design.
* Explain the layout and visual hierarchy.
* Identify what works well and what could be improved.
* Share your observations and suggestions.

3. Research Assignment

You will be given a website from an industry vertical and asked to prepare a simple design analysis covering:

* Overall layout and grid structure.
* Typography and visual hierarchy.
* Section arrangement and content flow.
* CTA and enquiry-form placement.
* Three suggestions for improvement.

4. Final Conversation

An interaction with the Design Lead to understand your interests, learning approach, communication skills and enthusiasm for design research.

**To Apply**

Send your CV and portfolio link (if available)

title: Product Builder
description:
**Product Builder**

**Department:**
Product & Technology

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, behavioural analysis, data exploration and experimentation.
* Define clear objectives and success measures for every initiative, ensuring products deliver measurable business and customer value.
* Evaluate whether a new solution needs to be built or whether existing platforms, tools and capabilities can solve the problem.
* Identify and implement improvements across the products and systems you own.

**2. Product Design & User Experience**

* Translate complex business and advertising challenges into intuitive, user-friendly digital products and experiences.
* Lead the design process, from user journeys and wireframes through to polished interfaces and interactive prototypes.
* Apply strong UX and UI principles to create products that are simple, accessible and effective.
* Prototype and test ideas early, using feedback and evidence to validate solutions before investing in full development.
* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.
* Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving issues within your products and technical domain.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, machine learning and agentic technologies to improve products, services and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.
* Develop appropriate testing, evaluation and safeguards to ensure AI-powered solutions are reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and help colleagues understand how AI and automation can improve the way we work.

**5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively across product, design, engineering, data, media and client teams to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate product decisions, technical considerations, progress and potential challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.
* Take ownership of decisions within your area of responsibility, knowing when to act independently and when wider input is needed.
* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and encouraging best practice across product, design and engineering.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a naturally curious, commercially minded and technically strong individual who enjoys solving problems and building things.

**Product & Commercial Thinking**

* Experience taking digital products or technology initiatives from concept through to launch.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

**Design & User Experience**

* Experience designing digital products and intuitive user experiences.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and modern design tools.

**Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Strong software development experience and the ability to build and ship production-ready products.
* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Practical experience using AI tools, APIs, LLMs or agentic technologies to build products and automate workflows.
* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on with delivery.
* Curious, analytical and able to challenge assumptions.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* Enjoys learning, experimenting and continuously improving.

**How We'll Measure Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:

* **Build products that matter:**
  Deliver solutions that address genuine customer, client and business needs.
* **Create measurable impact:**
  Improve advertising performance, operational efficiency, user experience or commercial outcomes through the products you build.
* **Own delivery end to end:**
  Take initiatives from initial problem discovery through to successful production launch.
* **Raise the quality bar:**
  Deliver well-designed, reliable and scalable products that people enjoy using.
* **Make smart decisions:**
  Use evidence, commercial awareness and technical judgement to prioritise the right problems and solutions.
* **Drive innovation:**
  Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to create competitive advantage.
* **Improve how we work:**
  Help build a more effective, collaborative and innovative product and technology culture.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how an ambitious advertising technology business builds and uses technology.

You will have the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and take ideas from concept to reality. Rather than being restricted to one discipline, you will have the opportunity to work across product, design and engineering, building solutions that have a direct impact on our clients, our people and our business.

You'll be joining Navigator at an exciting stage of its growth, helping shape the technology, products and AI-powered capabilities that will define the future of travel advertising.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies and building products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Manager
description:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we’ve crossed
**$130M in Annualised Revenue**
and grown to
**over 10M users across 190+ countries**
, who have built
**12M+ applications**
on Emergent. We’re backed by
**Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.**

We’re solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by
**repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni,**
and leaders from
**Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.**

We’re hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

**The Role:**

We’re hiring a Growth Manager with a strong analytics backbone to drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle. The way you’ll do it is through data: querying it yourself, finding the insight, and turning it into interventions that move the numbers. You’ll own one growth metric end-to-end. The pace is fast and a lot is still being defined, often you’ll be the one defining it.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own one KPI (e.g. retention, top-up rate, plan upgrades, or revenue per signup) with a weekly read of what moved and why
* When a number breaks, find the root cause, the questions a standard dashboard can’t answer, size it, and say what to do about it
* Analyze user behavior across cohorts, funnels, and segments to find levers across activation, credits and top-ups, pricing and plans, and churn
* Design, run, and read experiments properly: hypothesis, sample size, holdouts, and the decision rule fixed before launch
* Work with product, pricing, CRM, and marketing to ship what the data says
* Use AI tools (LLMs, agents) to speed up your own analysis and to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2 to 4 years in growth, product, analytics, strategy, or a related role. Background is open; working hands-on with data is not
* Strong SQL skills, this is non-negotiable: you can independently query large datasets to build cohorts, funnels, and retention curves, and you validate your numbers before anyone else does
* Comfort living in data day-to-day: dashboards, product analytics tools, and spreadsheets are your home turf, and you form and test hypotheses from the data rather than waiting for someone to hand you an insight
* You’ve owned a metric and moved it, and you can show the before and after
* Working knowledge of experiment stats: significance, novelty effects, and when not to trust a result
* Comfortable using LLMs and AI tools in your day-to-day work

**Good to Have:**

* Consumer or self-serve SaaS experience
* Python

**Benefits and Perks:**

1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

Let’s build the future of software together.

title: Clinical Dietitian – Field Sales & Doctor Outreach
description:
***Know nutrition. Love the field. Earn without a ceiling.***

First Eat Right is hiring clinical dietitians with field sales or marketing experience to build our doctor referral network across Bengaluru. If you have met doctors, worked with targets and still enjoy the chase, this role pays you for every client you bring.

About us

First Eat Right is the clinical nutrition brand of FRST Healthcare Private Limited, Bengaluru (incorporated 2013). Our clinical dietitians deliver medical nutrition therapy, in clinic and by video, in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Pune. Our clinical work is led by Dr. Nafeesa Imteyaz, Founder & Chief Clinical Dietitian and former Head of Dietetics at Fortis Hospital, Bangalore.

What you will do

• Meet 10 to 12 doctors every working day across Bengaluru: cardiologists, diabetologists, endocrinologists, nephrologists, gastroenterologists, gynaecologists, physicians, paediatricians and oncologists.

• Build and grow a list of 200+ doctors, visited on a planned route and cycle.

• Present our clinical nutrition services in short, evidence-based briefs, and set up referral pathways with hospitals, nursing homes and clinics.

• Call every referred patient the same day and help them book a consultation.

• Use waiting time at OPDs to write diet plans and follow up clients on your laptop.

• Log every visit and referral in our daily tracker.

The honest part

This is a field job, not a desk job.

• Six days a week, Monday to Saturday, in the field.

• Bengaluru traffic, long waits at OPDs, and evenings that sometimes stretch when doctors run late.

• Monthly referral and revenue targets, reviewed regularly.

• Daily reporting.

If this sounds like your kind of work, read on.

What you get

• Best salary in the industry

• An incentive on every client you bring, with no upper limit

• Daily allowance (DA) and travel allowance (TA) as per industry standards

• Device and data allowance for work

• PF, ESI, gratuity and bonus as applicable

• Clinical training under our Chief Clinical Dietitian, and a clear path to Clinical Team Lead

Who should apply

• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics, Food Science and Nutrition, or Home Science with Nutrition and Dietetics

• At least 1 year in field sales, medical marketing or business development, for example in clinical nutrition, pharma, nutraceuticals, diagnostics or hospital marketing

• Comfortable meeting doctors every day and working with targets

• Fluent English; Kannada or Hindi is an advantage

• Own laptop; a two-wheeler with a valid licence is preferred

How we work

We never offer doctors gifts, payments or favours for referrals. We earn referrals through good clinical work and honest information.

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn, or email your CV to syed@firsteatright.com with the subject "Clinical Dietitian – Field Sales". For questions, call or WhatsApp +91 78990 56786.

Shortlisted candidates will have a personal interview and a test.

In 12 months we took three apps, in three unrelated verticals, from zero to over $70M in combined annual run rate. We’re one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped companies in the world.

**The role**

We’re looking for a Data Engineer, Lead to build the pipelines and data models behind our portfolio of consumer apps, from our team in Bengaluru.

This is a senior, hands-on tech lead role. Our apps span both subscription and transactional business models: consumer subscription apps with trials, paywalls and renewals, and high-spender transactional apps with VIP tiers and repeat purchases. You’ll write the pipelines, design the event schemas and models, and build the plumbing that sends predicted LTV signals back to ad platforms. Your work will be judged by one thing: whether the data is fast, correct and trusted by every team that depends on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own production batch and streaming pipelines across our portfolio of consumer apps.
* Design event schemas and tracking plans with product and engineering, and keep instrumentation clean as apps ship weekly.
* Build data models in our warehouse (e.g. BigQuery or Snowflake with dbt) for revenue, subscriptions, cohorts, retention, LTV and funnel conversion.
* Ingest and reconcile revenue data from the App Store, Google Play, Stripe and subscription platforms.
* Build attribution plumbing: MMP, SKAN and server-side event integrations, and ad-network spend and performance data.
* Build reverse ETL and conversion API integrations that send predicted LTV (pLTV) and value events to ad platforms.

description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The AML platform is the technological backbone that protects BNP Paribas Group from fraud, money‑laundering and other financial crimes. As a Senior Data Engineer you will design, build and operate high‑performance, Python services that ingest, enrich, analyze and surface AML‑relevant data. You will work side‑by‑side with data‑scientists, compliance experts and other engineers to translate regulatory requirements into reliable code.
  
  
Direct AML experience is not mandatory; strong end to end data pipeline development experience, Python, SQL expertise, a proven record of delivering large‑scale data‑intensive systems and the ability to pick up AML concepts quickly are essential.
  
  
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Develop & deliver production‑grade Python micro‑services, event‑driven workers and APIs (FastAPI/Django/Flask, Celery, asyncio) that process millions of transactions per day with low latency.

* Implement data‑quality, lineage and privacy controls (GDPR/CCPA) throughout ingestion‑to‑case‑management flows.

* Perform code reviews, mentoring and knowledge‑sharing to uplift junior developers and enforce Python best‑practice standards.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize services in production using observability stacks (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and profiling tools (Dynatrace, Py‑Spy, cProfile).
* Participate in feasibility studies for emerging technologies (graph databases, stream‑ and produce concise evaluation artefacts for the AML Architecture Committee (ITSVC).
* Implement end to end data orchestration with proper data modeling.
* Document architectural decisions, API contracts and data‑flow diagrams to keep the AML platform aligned with the target‑state design.

**Technical And Behavioral Competencies**

* Expert‑level knowledge on Python, async programming, libraries: FastAPI/Django/Flask, Celery, Pandas, NumPy, PySpark.
* Should be able to design, develop and secure REST/GraphQL services; event‑driven patterns (Kafka, Pulsar).
* Should be able to build/optimize ETL/ELT pipelines; experience with Spark/Flink
* Strong knowledge on SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph (Neo4j, JanusGraph) – modelling, indexing, performance tuning.
* Production experience on Docker, Kubernetes (helm charts), serverless functions.
* Hands on experience on Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions; IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation); automated testing (pytest, unittest).
* Should be able to write logging, metrics & tracing using (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
* Should have awareness of Secure coding, OAuth2/JWT, data‑privacy (GDPR/CCPA.
* Should have ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and compliance audiences; strong written documentation skills.
* Proven experience in globally distributed Agile squads; mentor junior team members.
* Ability & willingness to learn & work on diverse technologies (languages, frameworks, and tools)

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Exposure to ML frameworks (Scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and model‑deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with AML‑specific open‑source tools (SAR‑ML, OpenAML, custom rule engines).
* Knowledge of AML regulatory reporting standards (FAT, 5AMLD, FinCEN).
* Cloud‑architect certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect)

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level: At least 7 years
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Head of Data Engineering
description:
**About us**

We incubate viral consumer brands and scale them until they become independent companies.

In 12 months we took three apps, in three unrelated verticals, from zero to over $70M in combined annual run rate. We’re one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped companies in the world.

**The role**

We’re looking for a Head of Data Engineering to own the data platform behind our portfolio of consumer apps, from our team in Bengaluru.

This is part architect, part hands-on engineer, part team builder. Our apps span both subscription and transactional business models: consumer subscription apps with trials, paywalls and renewals, and high-spender transactional apps with VIP tiers and repeat purchases. You’ll own everything from event tracking to the warehouse to the predicted LTV signals we send back to ad platforms. Your work will be judged by one thing: whether every team trusts the data and makes faster, better decisions because of it.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the data platform end to end across our portfolio of consumer apps, and set its architecture and roadmap.
* Own event tracking and instrumentation: event schemas, tracking plans and SDKs across iOS, Android, web and backend.
* Build and run batch and streaming pipelines into a modern warehouse or lakehouse (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift, with dbt and Airflow or Dagster).
* Unify revenue and subscription data from the App Store, Google Play, Stripe and subscription platforms into one trusted source of truth.
* Own attribution and ad-network data: MMP, SKAN and server-side event integrations, and keep improving our methods as the ecosystem changes.
* Build the data foundations for LTV, retention, cohorts, funnel conversion and unit economics, and for incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling.
* Serve predicted LTV (pLTV) and value signals to ad platforms through conversion APIs and reverse ETL, in partnership with analytics and UA.
* Set the bar for data quality, testing, observability, SLAs and cost.
* Own privacy, consent and compliance for user and payment data.
* Hire, lead and grow a team of data engineers, and stay hands-on in the code.

**Who we’re looking for**

* 8+ years in data engineering, with at least 2 years leading a team or owning a data platform.
* You have built production data pipelines (e.g. Airflow, dbt, Spark) at consumer scale.
* You have built or owned the data behind LTV, retention or pLTV analytics for a consumer app.
* Strong engineering fundamentals: Python and SQL, data modeling, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS).
* Hands-on with event tracking, attribution and ad-platform integrations (MMPs, SKAN, conversion APIs).
* Experience with subscription and/or in-app purchase revenue data, and the edge cases that come with it: trials, refunds, renewals, grace periods and currencies.
* Strong quantitative and statistical background, so you understand how analysts and data scientists use what you build.
* Low ego, fast-moving and high-ownership. You care about the craft, but you care more about whether the business grows.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience at a high-growth consumer subscription, gaming or real-money gaming app with millions of users.
* Experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis or similar).
* Experience productionizing ML models such as pLTV or churn prediction.
* Experience with incrementality testing or marketing mix modeling data.
* Experience using AI and LLM tooling to speed up data engineering work.

**What you get**

* Own the data platform for a portfolio of consumer apps generating over $70M in annual run rate.
* Work across product, growth, UA and finance, from a single event schema to the pLTV signals that steer paid acquisition.
* Build and lead the data engineering team at one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped companies in the world

description:
**Role description**

**Job Title: Senior / Lead Big Data Engineer
  
Experience: 9 – 15 Years
  
Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)
  
Mode of interview: 2 Virtual+1 in-person
  
# of roles: 2
  
Notice period: Immediate to 30 Days joiners only**

We are looking for a seasoned Senior/Lead Data Engineer with 9 to 15 years of experience to architect, build, and optimize large-scale data platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex big data infrastructure, functional business domains, and enterprise AI initiatives. Beyond taking end-to-end ownership of batch data pipelines that process massive customer and behavioral datasets, you will play a key leadership role in building, mentoring, and scaling a high-performing data engineering team.

Platform Optimization & Governance
  
Performance Tuning: Proactively troubleshoot and fine-tune complex Spark and Hive/HQL jobs to reduce latency, optimize memory usage, and manage cluster resource allocation (YARN).
  
Data Quality & Reliability: Establish automated data validation frameworks, lineage tracking, and strict SLA monitoring to guarantee data accuracy and platform reliability.

Architecture & Pipeline Development

Large-Scale Data Processing: Design high-throughput data ingestion and transformation workflows for massive customer and behavioral datasets.
  
Data Modeling: Lead dimensional and relational data modeling efforts to support enterprise analytics, reporting, and downstream AI solutions.
  
Functional Alignment & Cross-Team Collaboration
  
Business & Functional Translation: Translate complex functional business requirements into scalable technical data architectures, ensuring data assets directly solve business challenges.
  
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with analytics, product, and AI teams to understand data needs and deliver reliable, analytics-ready datasets.
  
  
Qualifications & Skills
  
Educational Qualification
  
B.E. or B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience: 9 to 15 years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, with deep hands-on expertise in Hadoop-based big data ecosystems (HDFS, YARN).
  
Leadership: Proven experience leading engineering initiatives and building or mentoring technical teams.
  
Big Data Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Apache Spark (Core, Spark SQL, PySpark) and Apache Hive / HQL.
  
Programming & Querying: Strong command of Python and advanced SQL, paired with solid experience in enterprise data modeling.
  
Pipeline Engineering: Proven track record of designing and maintaining production-grade batch ETL pipelines.
  
AI & Functional Acumen: Practical experience working on data initiatives supporting AI applications, combined with strong functional business understanding.
  
Version Control: Proficient in Git for collaborative software development.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Domain Experience: Prior experience working with e-commerce platforms and processing high-volume customer/transactional datasets is an added advantage.
  
Workflow Orchestration: Hands-on experience managing complex DAGs and schedules using Apache Airflow or Oozie.
  
Infrastructure & Tuning: Deep understanding of on-premise big data platform operations and advanced performance tuning for Hive and Spark workloads.
  
Methodology: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
