title: Senior Data Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Data Engineer with strong Development DBA expertise**
to design, develop, implement, optimize, and support enterprise-scale database solutions across Relational and NoSQL database platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience managing the
**end-to-end database development lifecycle**
, from requirements gathering, data modeling, and logical/physical database design through database development, deployment, performance tuning, optimization, and production implementation.
  
  
This role requires deep technical expertise across
**PostgreSQL, Oracle, Cassandra, Couchbase, Microsoft SQL Server, and IBM Db2 LUW**
, along with experience designing and implementing database solutions in
**AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
environments.
  
  
The candidate will collaborate closely with application development teams, solution architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing database solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Database Engineering Lifecycle
* Own and drive the complete database development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering through design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and ongoing enhancements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, application teams, and solution architects to translate functional and non-functional requirements into robust database solutions.
* Develop database architecture specifications, technical design documents, data models, and implementation strategies.
* Lead database design reviews, code reviews, and technical solution assessments.
* Ensure database solutions meet enterprise standards for scalability, availability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Data Modeling and Database Design
* Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for Relational and NoSQL database platforms.
* Apply appropriate data modeling methodologies, including normalization, denormalization, indexing, partitioning, and data distribution strategies.
* Design database objects including tables, relationships, constraints, views, indexes, and other database objects.
* Develop efficient data access patterns and storage models based on application workloads and business requirements.
* Evaluate database technology choices and recommend optimal relational or NoSQL solutions based on workload characteristics.
* Define database standards, naming conventions, data integrity controls, and design best practices.
* Database Development and Engineering
* Implement database solutions across PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2 LUW, Cassandra, and Couchbase.
* Design and implement efficient transaction processing, concurrency handling, and data access mechanisms.
* Partner with application development teams to optimize database integration and application-to-database interactions.
* Build reusable database components, development frameworks, and automation utilities.
* Database Performance Engineering and Optimization
* Perform proactive and reactive database performance tuning across relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Analyze SQL execution plans, query performance metrics, database statistics, and workload characteristics to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, memory utilization, concurrency, and database configurations.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving locking, blocking, deadlocks, inefficient queries, and resource contention.
* Conduct database workload analysis, performance benchmarking, capacity planning, and scalability assessments.
* Collaborate with application teams to improve end-to-end application and database performance.
* Database Deployment, DevOps, and Automation
* Design and implement automated database deployment and release management processes.
* Integrate database schema changes, SQL scripts, and configuration updates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement database version control, schema migration, release validation, and rollback strategies.
* Utilize tools including Liquibase, Git, GitHub Actions, or equivalent enterprise DevOps platforms.
* Develop automation using Python, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform.
* Establish repeatable, auditable, and reliable database deployment processes across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Cloud Database Engineering – AWS / GCP
* Design, develop, deploy, and optimize database solutions hosted in AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform.
* Work with managed database services such as:

+ AWS: Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, DynamoDB and applicable cloud-native database services.
+ GCP: Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, and other relevant managed database offerings.

* Evaluate and implement cloud database architecture patterns for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Support database modernization and migration initiatives from on-premises infrastructure to public cloud platforms.
* Implement cloud-native database monitoring, security, configuration management, and automation practices.
* Collaborate with cloud architecture and platform engineering teams to define database provisioning and operational standards.
* NoSQL Database Engineering
* Design and optimize distributed NoSQL database solutions using Cassandra and Couchbase.
* Develop data models aligned with application access patterns, partitioning strategies, and distributed data architectures.
* Optimize Cassandra partition keys, clustering keys, replication strategies, and query patterns.
* Design Couchbase document structures, indexes, N1QL/SQL++ queries, and data access patterns.
* Understand distributed database concepts, including consistency models, replication, fault tolerance, and horizontal scalability.
* Diagnose and resolve NoSQL performance, data distribution, and application integration issues.
* Database Reliability, Security, and Production Readiness
* Engineer database solutions with appropriate availability, recoverability, resiliency, and disaster recovery considerations.
* Incorporate security requirements such as encryption, access controls, least-privilege access, and sensitive data protection into database designs.
* Support database security and compliance requirements in regulated enterprise environments.
* Conduct database production readiness assessments, deployment risk reviews, and performance validations.
* Partner with Production DBA, SRE, and infrastructure teams on production implementation, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.
* Establish monitoring, observability, and operational handoff requirements for database solutions.
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration
* Serve as a subject matter expert for database development DBA practices, and database performance optimization.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to database engineers and application development teams.
* Influence database architecture decisions, technology selection, and engineering best practices.
* Drive continuous improvements in database design, development standards, automation, and engineering productivity.
* Collaborate across architecture, application development, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, and production support teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in database engineering, database development, or Development DBA roles within enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end database development activities, from requirements analysis and logical/physical design through deployment and performance optimization.
* Strong expertise in SQL development, query optimization, database schema design, indexing, and execution plan analysis.
* Hands-on engineering experience with multiple database technologies, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, IBM Db2 LUW, Cassandra, and Couchbase.
* Deep expertise in at least two relational database platforms, with the ability to work across additional database technologies.
* Practical experience designing and optimizing NoSQL database solutions.
* Hands-on experience with database services and engineering practices in AWS and/or GCP.
* Experience implementing database changes through automated DB CI/CD pipelines and schema migration frameworks.
* Strong understanding of database internals, transaction management, concurrency, locking, indexing, partitioning, and query optimization.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in large-scale enterprise, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
* Experience with high-volume OLTP systems, mission-critical applications, and distributed database architectures.
* Experience with cloud database modernization, migration, and hybrid-cloud architectures.
* Knowledge of database replication, high availability, disaster recovery, and backup/recovery design principles.
* Experience with infrastructure automation using Terraform or similar tools.
* Familiarity with database observability and monitoring solutions.
* Experience with data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data engineering frameworks.

:**

title: Sr. Data Management Engineer
description:
**Your Job**
Koch is looking for a Senior Data Management Engineer to design, build and run enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions on TIBCO EBX. You'll own the EBX platform end to end, from developing data models and workflows to managing upgrades, releases, security and production support. You'll also help set up and stabilise a dedicated EBX instance for the business, so your work will directly shape how reliable, scalable and trusted its master data is.
  
  
**Our Team**
You will join the Data Management team, which leads MDM, Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives that give Koch companies trusted data. The team works closely with business stakeholders, architects, data stewards and infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that support business transformation.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, develop, configure, and support TIBCO EBX solutions, including data models, datasets, relationships, permissions, workflows, business rules, validation controls, and data services.
* Develop custom Java components, validation rules, triggers, services, and workflow extensions.
* Implement multi-domain MDM and Reference Data Management solutions for Product, Supplier, Customer, Finance, Asset, and other business domains.
* Design integrations between EBX and enterprise applications using REST APIs, web services, data pipelines, and batch frameworks.
* Support data migration, bulk loading, data conversion, and onboarding.
* Participate in technical design reviews and align solutions with enterprise architecture standards and development best practices.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable MDM solutions.
* Participate in discovery sessions, solution workshops, backlog refinement, and design discussions.
* Collaborate with Data Governance teams, Business Analysts, Architects, Data Stewards, and integration teams.
* Recommend implementation approaches based on business needs and long-term supportability.
* Planning & Execution
* Drive ADO/Jira stories, technical designs, development, testing, deployment support, and production releases.
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, blockers, and implementation considerations proactively.

**Run & Maintain**

* Own day-to-day EBX platform administration, repository health, workflow operations, object cache, disk capacity, log management, scheduled housekeeping, and obsolete-content cleanup.
* Manage environments, installations, configuration, application server deployments, patches, hotfixes, upgrades, and technical refreshes across development, test, and production landscapes.
* Administer core platform configuration, repository connectivity, user and role directories, audit logging, email, data services, messaging, REST services, proxy settings, security controls, failover, and performance tuning.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, service health dashboards, operational checks, capacity plans, and preventative maintenance routines.
* Lead major incident response, problem management, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and communication for production outages and recurring failures.
* Manage access, permissions, service accounts, certificates, encryption-related dependencies, audit evidence, and remediation of platform vulnerabilities.
* Own release readiness, deployment planning, rollback procedures, production validation, change records, and post-release support.
* Coordinate repository backup, recovery testing, archive management, database maintenance, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and operational resilience.
* Maintain runbooks, support procedures, environment inventories, dependency maps, architecture records, and knowledge articles.
* Provide senior technical guidance and escalation support to developers, managed service providers, infrastructure teams, and business support teams

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Experience developing on TIBCO EBX, including data models, dataspaces, workflows, business rules, permissions and data services
* Experience administering and supporting TIBCO EBX in production, including upgrades, patches, environment management and incident resolution
* Experience with Java development, including building and debugging custom components
* Experience integrating EBX through REST APIs, XML, JSON, web services, messaging, batch processes, and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including query analysis and troubleshooting
* Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and JSON
* Strong understanding of MDM, RDM, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Modelling, and Metadata Management.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Extensive experience leading enterprise MDM or RDM implementations and operating TIBCO EBX as a business-critical platform.
* Deep expertise developing custom Java solutions, extensions, services, and integrations in EBX.
* Experience with high availability, failover, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, repository management, performance tuning, and platform observability.
* Experience automating deployments, environment configuration, monitoring, health checks, and operational support activities using DevOps practices.
* Experience with ETL, data migration, and large-scale data conversion initiatives.
* Experience integrating EBX with ERP, CRM, data warehouses, Finance systems, and enterprise applications.
* Experience with Snowflake, AWS, MuleSoft, Kafka, Informatica, Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling, or comparable enterprise technologies.
* Experience implementing Supplier, Customer, Product, Finance, Asset, or Reference Data domains.
* Experience supporting global teams, managed service partners, multi-business implementations, and enterprise transformation programmes

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
  
  
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JVM)
description:
**Nexla, briefly**
Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.
  
  
**Role**
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in.
  
  
**What you'll own**

* Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
* The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.
* Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else’s.
* The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back.

*Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it.*
**The hard problem**
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.
  
  
  
  
**Must-Haves**

* 6 to 10 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications.
* Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them.
* Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC.
* You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow.
* Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar.
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka.
* Security architecture: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call.
* You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear.
* You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice.
* You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself.

*One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it.*
**How We Hire**
Four conversations, about two weeks end to end.
  
  

* **Coding.**
  Working through real code rather than a puzzle.
* **Low-level design.**
  How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend.
* **High-level design.**
  Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production.
* **Hiring Manager.**
  Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work.

**On AI in the coding round.**
Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else’s. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.
  
  
*You will hear from us either way.*
**The practical stuff**
Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams.
  
  
**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.**
  MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.**
  nexla.com/customers
* **The product in engineer terms.**
  docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.**
  Read the founder story
* **Everything else.**
  nexla.com
* Blog
* All open roles

Why Nexla? Why now?
  
  
A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.
  
  
The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.
  
  
A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.
  
  
That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.
  
  
The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

description:
**Job Description**
**We are Omnissa!**
The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere—from corporations to schools—are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That’s where Omnissa comes in.
  
  
The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work; delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth—and this is just the beginning of our journey!
  
  
At Omnissa, we’re driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us:
**Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency,**
and
**Maximize Customer Value**
—all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team.
  
  
As a global private company with over 4,000 employees, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**What is the opportunity?**
Workspace ONE is a digital workspace platform that simply and securely delivers and manages any app on any device by integrating access control, application management and multi-platform endpoint management. It is available as a cloud service or for on-premises deployment.
  
  
Our goal is to enable Workspace One-Unified End point Management platform to scale and manage billions of devices across various operating system platforms and device types.
  
  
As part of the UEM Platform team you will be involved in writing code, design and development of scalable software. You will be owning engineering initiatives and champion a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
  
  
**Success in the Role: What are the performance goals over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing?**

* You will need to produce software design and execute them for new use cases for various platform business.
* You will need to produce design to scale the current system.
* You will be regularly evaluated on the quality of the product you create and the code you write to ensure continued advancement of your technical skills in an environment that looks to expand them.
* You will have to collaboratively work across other teams, design and contribute code to their code bases.
* You will look at the product as a whole and look for code/design/architecture gaps, scalability/usability/supportability challenges and propose/implement solutions for the identified gaps.

**What type of work will I be doing? What assignments or requirements\* will I be performing on a regular basis? What are my deliverables?**

* You will work on a distributed application built on the event driven architecture.
* You will work with C#, (Asp.Net and Net Core) on the server side.
* You will work with SQL/PostgreSQL/Open Search for the database.
* You will work with Kafka/Redis/RabbitMQ for inter and intra service communications.
* You will work with Asp.Net MVC and an Angular front-end.

**What will you bring to Omnissa?**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or related field with 5 to 15 Yrs of relevant experience.
* Proficiency with C# & .NET Framework
* Understanding of distributed systems.
* Experience with object-oriented design and multi-threaded programming. Data structure and Algorithm is needed
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills & log analysis for troubleshooting.
* Demonstrable knowledge of large-scale deployments in enterprise technology environments.
* In depth knowledge on cloud computing
* Ability to write quality code, unit tests, integration tests using mocking/instrumentation.
* A high degree of “ownership” - the ability to determine what needs to be done and make it happen
* Security and compliance consciousness
* Experience with developing automated tests, such as unit tests, integration test and end to end test

**Location:**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Location Type:**
**HYBRID. NO REMOTE**
This role offers a balanced arrangement, with the expectation of working 3 days a week in our local office and the flexibility to work from home for the remaining days. It is essential that you reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the office location for the in-office workdays.

description:
**Overview**
IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research.
  
  
The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care.
  
  
The ILS & PASS science team comprises dedicated qualitative scientists and COA development scientists.
  
  
Role & Responsibilities
  
  
**The Statistical Programmer Will Be Expected To**

* Empirically develop scoring rules & program scoring algorithms for existing COA measures
* For instruments being added to IQVIA ILS library, generate standard scoring documentation, and program simulation datasets, Data Quality Evaluation (DQE), and scoring of domains on these datasets
* Implement new statistical features in the random generation of data, to simulate real-world instrument data with certain psychometric properties
* Implement new, more advanced statistical capabilities in user tools (Insights Hub, PROCore)
* Work cross-functionally with non-statisticians/psychometricians in the PACT and ILS & PASS teams
* Provide programming support for the development of new COA measures & endpoints
* Program classical and modern psychometric analyses and analyses of meaningful thresholds
* Program high frequency and continuous DHT data
* collaborate with data scientists to support algorithm validation, and verification of digital measure performance across diverse datasets and devices.

**About You**
Knowledge, skills and abilities
  
  

* Candidates must have: (a) statistical and psychometric research skills; and (b) strong computer skills, including Base SAS with macro (R skills, API experience). Connecting to databases with SAS/R, and programming with validation/QC in a regulated environment would be an advantage.
* Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality.

* Candidates should have extensive familiarity and demonstrable experience with AI tools and their application to the topics mentioned above.

* Consulting experience with pharmaceutical companies is desirable.

title: Senior Clinical Data Programmer
description:
**Role Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Senior Clinical Data Programmer SAS is responsible for data analysis and business intelligence activities related to study related clinical and operational data for the purpose of facilitating clinical data inspection and quality control, as well as operational performance control of clinical sites by creating reports, visualisations and dashboards for Clinical Data Managers (CDM), Clinical Data Reviewers (CDR), Project Managers (PM) and other clinical study stakeholders.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A graduate qualification in computer science, data science, mathematics, life sciences or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in statistical programming, business intelligence, data analysis or data science within a pharmaceutical company, CRO or EDC software provider.
* Practical experience using SAS and/or business intelligence tools (e.g. TIBCO Spotfire, Power BI), to interrogate clinical, laboratory or operational datasets is required.
* Exposure to additional analytics, RBQM, centralised monitoring or workflow automation platforms is desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**
The Senior Clinical Data Programmer SAS partners with clinical study teams and other stakeholders to define, develop, validate, deploy and maintain fit-for-purpose programming and analytics solutions, including dashboards, graphs, tables, listings and reports.
  
  

* Project/Clinical Studies
* Partner with CDMs, CDRs, PMs and other study stakeholders to define clinical, laboratory, external and operational data requirements and recommend fit-for-purpose dashboards, visualisations, listings and reports.
* Manage assigned programming deliverables from requirements gathering and specification through development, testing, deployment, maintenance and change control in accordance with applicable procedures.
* Extract, integrate, transform and analyse clinical study data from EDC, laboratory, operational and other sources using SAS and relevant technologies.
* Develop validated, reusable programs and analytical outputs that support data inspection, reconciliation, clinical and medical review, operational oversight and timely study decision-making.
* Develop and maintain analytics supporting risk-based quality management and centralised monitoring, including key risk indicators, quality tolerance limits, site performance oversight and identification of meaningful data trends and quality signals.
* Perform quality control, peer review and troubleshooting of programming deliverables, and ensure programs are appropriately validated across development, user acceptance testing and production environments.
* Conduct review sessions, present outputs and analytical findings to study stakeholders, and provide training to support effective use of the solutions.
* Maintain complete, accurate and inspection-ready project documentation, and complete timesheets and other assigned administrative responsibilities in a timely manner.
* Clinical Data Visualisation Team
* Participate actively in Clinical Data Visualisation team, project and Biometrics department meetings.
* Share technical knowledge, contribute to team learning and support the development of less-experienced colleagues.
* Collaborate effectively across functions to support consistent, high-quality study delivery.
* Software Tools
* Maintain proficiency in SAS and relevant business intelligence, clinical data visualisation, data review and analytics technologies.
* Evaluate and apply fit-for-purpose technologies such as Power BI, Spotfire, Medidata Clinical Data Studio, CluePoints, SQL, Python, R and workflow automation tools, according to project and business needs.
* Develop reusable templates, macros, standard programs and automated solutions that improve quality, consistency, scalability and delivery efficiency.
* Contribute validated programs and outputs to controlled, searchable libraries in accordance with applicable governance requirements.

* Prepare and maintain clear user requirements, specifications, test evidence and other documentation necessary to support validated and inspection-ready solutions.
* Apply approved procedures, best-practice instructions and templates for clinical data programming, analytics and visualisation activities.

* Good knowledge of clinical study data structures, EDC database schemas and clinical data review processes.
* Strong knowledge of data processing activities, including extracting, integrating, transforming, analysing and presenting data.
* Practical programming capability in SAS; experience with SQL, Python, R or similar languages is desirable.
* Working knowledge of one or more data visualisation and analytics platforms, such as Spotfire, Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.
* Experience with RBQM and centralized monitoring platforms, such as Medidata Clinical Data Studio (CDS) and CluePoints.
* Experience with clinical data review, reporting, and workflow automation tools, such as JReview and Power Automate.
* Experience gathering business and user requirements from multiple stakeholders and translating them into clear, fit-for-purpose analytical solutions.
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements, with the ability to apply SOPs, validation practices and quality control principles to daily activities.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

title: Software Engineer - UI Test
description:
**About The Team**
The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers.
  
  
The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We do manual and automated testing, including developing the test infrastructure needed. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments.
  
  
**About The Job**
**UI Test team responsibilities:**
  
  

* Feature qualification:

+ Maintains high quality bar in test processes, strategy and test execution.

* Release regression testing:


+ All released features are regression tested in every release, on a cadence that depends on the product, with both manual and automated UI testing.

* Automation:

+ New features enter the automation backlog after release and are picked up by priority. UI Automation using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright.
+ Infrastructure automation/maintenance using Python.
+ Automated test pipelines in a CI/CD system
+ Each phase of the testing life cycle is getting automated. Using AI-assisted tooling to generate test cases from product artifacts, execute them against real environments to reduce manual qualification effort.

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field
* 5-8 years of experience in software testing, UI testing and automation
* Solid understanding on data protection, storage, security, virtualization, databases, cloud, kubernetes and generative AI
* Familiarity with UI performance and accessibility testing.
* Working knowledge of microservices, API, cloud native architectures and how to test them
* Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, AI resilience. A cloud certification is an advantage.

* Good hands-on experience programming in Python or equivalent and UI automation using TestIM, Selenium, Playwright or equivalent. JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge is a plus.

* Due to the unique placement of the team, it is exposed to multiple key technologies of Rubrik products.

* Exposure to automated infrastructure creation and clean up on various platforms like VMware, Azure, AWS etc.
* Hands-on work with AI-based tools for test authoring, execution and automation.
* Automation using latest AI based tools

* Ownership opportunities: every member in the team irrespective of the designation has end-end ownership right from PRD review, test case development, interaction with key stakeholders( like Product manager, program managers, component managers and developers), execution and reporting

* Improve engineering standards around performance, testing, reliability, and maintainability.
* Debug and resolve complex issues across frontend and backend systems.

  **JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js**

  .
* Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and modern frontend development.
* Experience with React Hooks, component architecture, state management, and frontend performance optimization.
* Understanding of Next.js rendering strategies, including SSR, SSG, ISR, and client-side rendering.
* Strong backend development experience with
  **Node.js and Express.js or NestJS**

  .
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and building microservices.
* Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.

* Experience working with Git, CI/CD workflows, and cloud deployments.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design fundamentals.
* Demonstrated ownership of production features from development through deployment.

**Strongly Preferred**

Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. description:

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Role**
: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Django)
  
  
Fractal is a leading AI and analytics company that helps global enterprises turn data into decisions at scale. We are looking for a hands-on
**Senior Full Stack Engineer**
with 6+ years of experience to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade digital products across front-end, back-end, APIs, cloud, DevOps, and AI-enabled application layers. This role requires strong engineering ownership, practical design thinking, and the ability to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions in collaboration with architects, TPMs, and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Role Brief**
You will own critical feature implementation across web applications, APIs, integrations, cloud-native services, and AI-powered capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with practical participation in technical design, code quality, performance optimization, and operational excellence.
  
  
You will work closely with architects, TPMs, product managers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, designers, and peer developers to translate solution intent into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop robust, efficient, and maintainable code for critical features, ensuring both functional and non-functional requirements are met.
* Participate in system and solution design discussions, contributing practical implementation insights, technical trade-offs, and pseudo-code where needed.
* Act as a technical point of contact for day-to-day implementation issues, troubleshoot challenges quickly, and drive timely resolution.
* Enforce and improve code quality through code reviews, engineering standards, automated testing, and secure development practices.
* Collaborate closely with architects, TPMs, product teams, and platform teams to translate high-level designs and AI use cases into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
* Build and integrate AI-powered application capabilities such as copilots, intelligent assistants, summarization, search, recommendations, and workflow augmentation using LLM APIs and related services where relevant.
* Implement AI-enabled solution patterns including prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding strategies, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and quality or safety guardrails for enterprise use cases.
* Support and improve DevOps practices including build pipelines, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, release readiness, and engineering observability.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application, system, and AI feature performance in line with project objectives, reliability expectations, latency targets, and cost considerations.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, and operational considerations to support maintainability, auditability, and knowledge transfer.
* Mentor junior engineers by sharing best practices, reviewing work products, and guiding them on sound engineering approaches.
* Contribute to technical proposals, estimations, reusable assets, and implementation improvements including automation, refactoring, and component reuse.
* Maintain compliance with security, quality, governance, and audit expectations, and contribute to broader process and capability improvement initiatives within CDT.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade full-stack applications, with strong ownership of complex engineering workstreams from design through delivery.
* Strong expertise in one or more modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, along with solid command of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Strong back-end engineering experience in at least one major stack such as Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Strong understanding of system design fundamentals, design patterns, API design, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and distributed application architecture.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or similar, including schema design and query performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with modern integration patterns across services and external systems.
* Strong understanding of responsive web design, reusable component-based architecture, accessibility basics, and front-end performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing practices including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
* Working experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including deployment, configuration, observability, and support for cloud-native environments.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and modern engineering environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of DevOps and secure SDLC practices including CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, code reviews, build automation, and release quality controls.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into applications, including LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and building reliable user-facing AI features.
* Good understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, grounding strategies, prompt orchestration, and common GenAI failure modes such as hallucination and response inconsistency.
* Experience implementing evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for AI-enabled features, including response quality checks, fallback handling, latency and cost awareness, and privacy or security considerations for enterprise use cases.
* Ability to translate solution architecture into detailed implementation plans and contribute effectively to technical design discussions with architects and engineering leads.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to rapidly resolve production and implementation issues while maintaining engineering quality.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to engineering best practices, reusable assets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and client-facing delivery environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments with close collaboration across product, QA, DevOps, TPM, and architecture teams.
* Exposure to performance tuning, observability, logging, monitoring, caching, and reliability engineering practices in production systems.
* Experience contributing to reusable frameworks, shared components, internal accelerators, or broader engineering capability-building initiatives.
* Prior experience supporting estimations, technical proposals, solutioning discussions, or client-facing technical workshops.
* Exposure to AI engineering frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, model gateways, or similar ecosystems for building production-grade GenAI applications.
* Experience with LLMOps or MLOps practices such as prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, experiment tracking, workflow observability, and responsible AI controls.
* Exposure to building AI copilots, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or domain-specific GenAI solutions for enterprise products.

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**

* Own critical full-stack feature implementation and deliver high-quality solutions with minimal oversight.
* Convert architecture intent into scalable, secure, and production-ready implementations across core and AI-enabled application capabilities.
* Uphold strong engineering standards across code quality, testing, security, documentation, performance, and DevOps practices.
* Act as a dependable technical anchor by resolving implementation issues quickly and collaborating effectively across functions.
* Drive continuous improvement through reuse, automation, maintainability, mentoring, and contribution to team capability building.
* Deliver reliable AI-enabled experiences with appropriate quality, safety, observability, and cost awareness.

description:
***Job Title:***
Software Development Engineer
  
  
**About Trellix**
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.
  
  
***Role Overview:***
We are looking for a Software Engineer (2+ Years) to join our Customer Digital Experience. In this role, you will help build and improve the applications that power Trellix’s global support network. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, deploy apps to the cloud, and get hands-on exposure to emerging AI tools.
  
  
**About The Team**
Customer Digital Experience (CDX) is dedicated to designing, building, and maintaining robust platforms that power our global support operations. By driving digital transformation through specialized tool development, we deliver solutions that empower both our external customers and our internal support employees, ensuring a seamless and efficient support ecosystem across Trellix. We foster an environment grounded in Trellix’s core values:
  
  

* Open: We honor our clients' and teams' needs by being collaborative, inclusive of diverse thoughts, aware of our own biases, and receptive to feedback.
* Tenacious: We pursue goals relentlessly with a tireless quest for quality and fearless determination to drive significant achievements.
* Curious: We maintain a continuous thirst for knowledge to fuel reimagination while staying engaged and caring about the people and technology around us.
* Fun: We are easy on people and hard on performance, fostering an environment where everyone is free to be their authentic self.

**About Role:**

* Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using Python and React.js.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement software solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that meets industry standards and best practices.
* Design and optimize database queries and schemas using PostgreSQL.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues in existing applications and provide timely resolutions.
* Assist in containerizing applications using Docker and deploying to Dev, QA, Stage, and Production environments on AWS or GCP.
* Conduct unit tests, peer code reviews, and maintenance of web applications.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Gain exposure to GenAI workflows, including basic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and LLM integration.
* Work with structured and unstructured data formats, maintaining data integrity across services.
* Write and execute automated test suites to ensure the reliability and functionality of code.
* Document technical specifications and user guides to ensure effective communication and knowledge transfer.

**About You:**

* Minimum 2+ years of software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming language.
* Strong proficiency in React.js and Redux for front-end development.
* Solid hands-on experience with relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
* Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker.
* Basic exposure to or foundational understanding of GenAI concepts (RAG, LLM integrations).
* Knowledge of RESTful web services and API development.
* Knowledge of markup and data serialization formats such as JSON and XML.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and Agile/JIRA workflows.
* Understanding of software development principles and methodologies.
* Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate effectively with other developers and stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with C# .NET Core back-end development.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and caching systems (Redis).
* Familiarity with orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Understanding of message queues and event streaming tools (MQTT, Kafka, or RabbitMQ).
* Exposure to enterprise file transfer/integration tools like Globalscape.

- Familiarity with WPF or AngularJS.

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or GCP Associate).
  
  
***Company Benefits and Perks:***
We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
  
  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
  
  
***Our Commitment to You:***
At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
  
  
Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. **ethics@trellix.com**

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role
  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.
  
What you will do
  
• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
  
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
  
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
  
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
  
reproducible and version controlled.
  
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
  
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
  
how it behaves there.
  
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
  
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
  
has to be preserved.
  
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
  
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match
  
the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
  
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
  
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
  
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.
  
What we are looking for
  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
  
tools from day one.
  
Where you need depth
  
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
  
and defend.
  
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
  
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
  
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
  
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
  
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
  
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
  
to be shipped.
  
Where working knowledge is enough
  
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
  
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
  
containers.
  
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
  
monitoring and alerting.
  
Across everything
  
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
  
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
  
and careful, staged rollout.
  
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
  
written.
  
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
  
with your counterparts rather than around them.
  
Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
  
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the
  
domain to the right engineer.
  
• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
  
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
  
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
**Job Description**
As an Advanced Systems Engineer here at Honeywell, you will design, implement, and manage complex systems, driving innovation, safety, and efficiency. Work on cutting-edge projects and shape future technology solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Full-stack development: Design, develop and maintain backend services with Java/Spring Boot and Node.js, and responsive web and desktop applications with React and Electron.
* APIs & architecture: Build and integrate REST APIs, and make architecture decisions that support scalability, resilience and maintainability.
* Data & messaging: Develop data models and optimise MySQL/MongoDB queries; implement reliable event-driven integrations.
* Secure development: Implement authentication and authorisation, apply secure coding practices, and remediate application and dependency vulnerabilities.
* Quality & delivery: Write automated tests, participate in code reviews and contribute to CI/CD and Agile delivery.
* Deployment & support: Deploy and troubleshoot applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and work with RHEL and Ubuntu environments to resolve production issues.
* Technical collaboration: Translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate design decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders.

**MUST HAVE**
**Core development & user interfaces**

* Java: Hands-on backend development with Java and Spring/Spring Boot; strong concurrency, core Java, design patterns and unit testing skills.
* Node.js: Build and debug server-side services with JavaScript/TypeScript, asynchronous programming, npm and service integrations.
* React: Develop reusable, performant applications using functional components, Hooks, state management and routing.
* Electron: Build secure cross-platform desktop applications with React/JavaScript, including main/renderer processes, IPC, packaging and native integration.
* JavaScript / HTML5 / CSS3 & Responsive UI: Strong modern JavaScript, semantic HTML and maintainable CSS skills; build accessible, responsive, cross-browser interfaces using Flexbox/Grid, media queries and reusable design-system components.

**APIs & architecture**

* REST APIs: Design and implement secure RESTful services, covering resource modelling, HTTP semantics, validation, pagination, error handling, versioning, OpenAPI/Swagger, testing and lifecycle management.
* Architecture & scalability: Assess monolith/microservice trade-offs and design scalable, resilient services using clear boundaries, caching, load balancing and failure-handling patterns.

**Security & data**

* API security: Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and RBAC; validate tokens, secure authentication flows and service-to-service access, and manage secrets.
* Application security: Apply OWASP Top 10, secure coding, least privilege, dependency security and vulnerability remediation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Databases: Strong MySQL and MongoDB skills in data modelling, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, consistency and recovery; select SQL or NoSQL appropriately.

**Delivery & distributed systems**

* DevOps: Experience with Git, CI/CD, code reviews, automated unit/integration/end-to-end testing and Agile/Scrum delivery.
* Containers & orchestration: Package applications with Docker and deploy, configure, scale and troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads securely.
* Event-driven systems: Understand Kafka or RabbitMQ, producers/consumers, partitioning, ordering, retries, dead-letter queues, delivery semantics, idempotency and schema evolution.
* Operating systems: Hands-on experience working with RHEL and Ubuntu operating systems.

**Problem solving & communication**

* Solve ambiguous production and business problems, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to diverse stakeholders.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* IEC 62443: Experience with secure product development under IEC 62443-4-1 and IEC 62443-4-2, including threat modelling, security verification, vulnerability management and secure updates.
* Advanced event-driven architectures: Hands-on design of highly available, loosely coupled Kafka/RabbitMQ systems for low-latency, high-volume real-time processing.
* C++: Strong OOP, STL, memory management, multithreading and debugging skills with modern C++ (C++11/14/17+).
* Shell scripting: Automate Linux/Unix tasks using Bash/Shell, grep, awk and sed, with robust error handling.
* Ansible: Automate configuration and deployments using playbooks, roles, inventories, templates and Ansible Vault.

**Qualifications**
**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* 8+ years of software development experience.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: IAM Operations - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Manager in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber Operate team, you will help clients manage identity and access management (IAM) operations across enterprise platforms, customer applications, and third-party tools. You will lead day-to-day delivery of user identity and access lifecycle activities, helping maintain a secure, compliant, and efficient access environment. You will work with client and cross-functional teams to strengthen access governance, operational controls, and service delivery while supporting the development of team members.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead day-to-day user access administration across applications, platforms, and systems, including provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, access modifications, and joiner, mover, leaver activities.
* Validate access requests for completeness, approvals, and policy alignment; maintain user accounts, group memberships, roles, and entitlements in accordance with approved workflows and service-level targets.
* Oversee the logging, triage, categorization, prioritization, tracking, and closure of incidents, service requests, and access-related tasks using IT service management (ITSM) and ticketing tools.
* Apply standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, knowledge articles, and control requirements; maintain operational documentation, trackers, status updates, and audit evidence for access reviews and recertification activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues, coordinate with application owners, infrastructure, security, and service delivery teams, and escalate complex issues to senior team members or tool administrators within defined thresholds.
* Investigate recurring access issues, entitlement mismatches, control gaps, and workflow exceptions; participate in root-cause discussions and recommend process improvements to strengthen a secure, audit-ready access administration environment.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 10 - 15 years of experience in information technology, service operations, information security support and operational governance with ITIL v4 Service Management Framework.
* 6+ years of experience in access administration, user account management, or IAM operations support.
* Basic hands-on experience with any IAM tool or platform, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, or similar solutions, used for provisioning, deprovisioning, access provisioning, access management, access management or access governance.
* Experience performing manual access administration tasks using documented procedures and approval workflows.
* Working knowledge of user provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, entitlement updates, and access review support.
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or equivalent for managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and operational tracking.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of identity and access management concepts, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, role-based access, least-privilege principles, and access recertification.
* Ability to review requests, follow process controls, and accurately execute operational tasks.
* Experience in maintaining documentation, operational logs, and status reporting.
* Good communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate with appropriate context.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Exposure to IAM, IGA, or access management tools.
* Familiarity with access request workflows, approval matrices, and security governance processes.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and policy requirements related to access administration.
* Ability to follow client information security policies and handle sensitive access tasks with accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and process discipline.
* Ability to identify issues early, troubleshoot at a basic level, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic reporting and tracking skills using standard operational tools.
* Exposure to incident/problem management concepts and recurring issue resolution.

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
