title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Onboarding
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
Aspire is the all-in-one finance platform for startups and SMEs. We are hiring a Strategy & Operations Manager to own how businesses get onboarded and verified: conversion, speed, cost and quality, across our markets. Numbers-first, hands-on, shipping every week. We bring accounts, cards, payments, expense management and accounting tools together for startups and SMEs. You will work closely with senior leaders and own a core part of the customer journey.
  
  
Onboarding is a business's first real experience of Aspire. You will shape how quickly and smoothly businesses get set up and start using the platform, working with onboarding and quality teams spread across APAC and the US, and with Product, Data and Compliance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own onboarding performance: conversion and time to verification by market. Find where businesses drop off, then design, test and ship the fixes across product, process and communication.
* Plan capacity: lead capacity and workforce planning and the productivity and quality metrics behind it.
* Automate: build the business case for onboarding automation and new tools, then deliver it with Product and Engineering.
* Improve processes: design and improve operating procedures with Compliance and Operations for a smooth, compliant customer experience.
* Run on data: define the metrics, work with Data on dashboards, and turn them into a weekly read and decisions.
* Lead projects: launches and cross-functional initiatives that touch onboarding.

**How We Work**

* You start from the data and come back with a recommendation.
* A working v1 this week beats a perfect plan next quarter.
* You are as comfortable with analysts on the floor as in a spec review with Product.
* You run several workstreams in parallel and write clearly, so work moves across time zones without extra meetings.

**Your first 90 days**
Learn the onboarding flow and the teams that run it, build a shared view of performance and capacity, ship your first improvements, and agree targets for the next two quarters.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Typically 4+ years in strategy and operations, BizOps, consulting, or ops-heavy roles at a fintech, financial services or high-growth tech company
* Experience with onboarding, KYC/KYB, risk or another ops-heavy process is a plus
* Strong with data: you build your own analysis (SQL or advanced spreadsheet modelling) and turn it into decisions
* You take problems from diagnosis to a shipped change, and move Product, Engineering and Ops without formal authority
* You use AI tools in your daily work
* Clear written English

This is not a compliance/AML review role or a people-management role.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**Why this role exists**

JustCall is building AI voice agents that do more than just have conversations. They answer calls, qualify leads, schedule appointments, update CRMs and trigger business workflows autonomously.

But for these AI agents to be truly useful, they need to work seamlessly with the tools businesses already rely on. A conversation should be able to trigger an action, update a deal, create a task or initiate the next step in a workflow without human intervention.

That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer who enjoys building integrations, connecting systems and making AI powered workflows work reliably in the real world. You'll work at the intersection of our AI infrastructure and the business applications our customers use every day, helping bring JustCall's AI capabilities into their existing workflows.

You'll build integrations where they don't exist, extend existing connectors for AI specific use cases, and develop the backend services that allow our voice agents to take meaningful actions.

**What You'll Actually Do**

* **Build AI powered integrations:**
  Connect JustCall's AI voice agent platform (AIVA) with the business tools our customers use, including CRM's, project management platforms, communication tools and custom webhook endpoints.
* **Develop integrations from scratch:**
  Build integrations when native connectors aren't available, working with REST APIs, OAuth flows, webhook handlers and event transformations.
* **Extend existing connectors:**
  Collaborate with the integrations team to customise existing connectors and support AI specific workflows that traditional integrations weren't designed for.
* **Build backend services:**
  Develop Node.js services and APIs that power agent actions, workflow execution, integration payloads and state management, using MongoDB for data storage.
* **Contribute to AI infrastructure:**
  Work on shared backend systems supporting asynchronous job processing, event pipelines, retries and fallback mechanisms to ensure workflows execute reliably.
* **Design reliable API contracts:**
  Document integration specifications, workflow behaviour, API schemas and integration contracts so other engineering teams can build on top of them.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Take ownership of development, testing, debugging and deployment while collaborating with the AI and integrations teams to deliver reliable solutions.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Strong backend fundamentals:**
  3+ years of hands on experience with Node.js and JavaScript or TypeScript, with the ability to independently design, build and ship backend services.
* **Database fundamentals:**
  Working knowledge of MongoDB, including schema design, querying, data modelling and managing state across workflows.
* **API and integration experience:**
  Comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks and third party integrations. You should be able to read API documentation, understand authentication flows and translate requirements into working integrations independently.
* **Problem solving and debugging:**
  Strong debugging instincts and the ability to trace issues across multiple systems, identify failure points and build reliable solutions.
* **Full stack familiarity:**
  Familiarity with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js), with a strong preference for backend engineering expertise.
* **Product and engineering mindset:**
  Ability to understand how a feature or integration fits into the larger product experience and translate requirements into practical engineering solutions.
* **Curiosity about AI:**
  Genuine interest in understanding how AI agents and LLM powered applications work, particularly how they interact with external systems and execute business workflows.

**The bigger picture**

JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product used by 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.

If this is the role you've been waiting to find - let's talk.

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Analytics Instrumentation
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
Analytics Instrumentation is part of the Data Engineering and Monetization (DE&M) group, focused on the collection of Product Usage and Billing event data within GitLab. We build data collection platforms that enable product teams to assess user behavior and make evidence-based choices through privacy-conscious instrumentation that captures product usage throughout the user lifecycle.
  
  
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you’ll guide the design and development of a unified data infrastructure platform that consolidates analytics instrumentation across GitLab’s engineering organization. You’ll build and maintain backend systems that give the company visibility into customer usage patterns across GitLab SaaS and Self-Managed deployment environments. That data directly informs strategic product priorities and strategies. This role offers the opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure that simplifies instrumentation for teams at GitLab, replacing the complexity of multiple language-specific software development kits with a single, unified solution that teams can rely on.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Guide the design, implementation, and evolution of a unified data collection platform using Golang, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, and NATS, with success measured by reliability, performance, and adoption across GitLab teams.
* Improve the emission, transit, and quality of instrumentation data across the system, with success measured by data quality, data integrity, and usage billing accuracy.
* Provide technical guidance for usage billing and instrumentation systems during working hours, with success measured by timely incident handling, effective root cause analysis, and reliable service restoration.
* Work across the organization with research and development teams and the enterprise data organization to deliver common solutions, with success measured by adoption across multiple stakeholders.
* Make technical choices that balance ease of use for product teams with reliability and correctness for data consumers, with success measured by platform usability and reliable downstream data.
* Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical documentation, with success measured by stronger code quality, faster technical alignment, and more maintainable systems.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Significant experience working with platform or infrastructure systems in production environments.
* Strong proficiency in the Go programming language, with experience building and maintaining production services.
* Strong backend development experience, with the ability to design and deliver scalable, reliable systems serving internal and external customers.
* Experience guiding technical design and making tradeoffs across system reliability, performance at scale, data quality, and observability.
* Experience working across team boundaries with product teams, data consumers, and other internal stakeholders.
* Familiarity with cloud native technologies and open source development practices.
* A track record of mentoring other engineers and helping teams make clear, well-documented technical choices.

**About The Team**
The Analytics Instrumentation team operates at the intersection of Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams, providing data collection infrastructure that serves engineering teams across GitLab. We’re a distributed team of generalist engineers who tackle complex problems spanning the GitLab codebase, JavaScript, Go, and Python satellite services, data pipelines, and AI tool integration. We collaborate transparently across teams, deliver measurable results through efficient iteration, and build inclusive solutions that respect user privacy. Our work enables data-informed choices and planning across the organization. We’re involved in diverse projects from event data collection and privacy compliance tools to AI-powered analytics frameworks that help GitLab teams learn more about their users.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Principal Engineer- Backend
description:
**About CodeRabbit**
CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.
  
  
We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

title: Financial Accountant
description:
**Job Title:**
Financial Accountant

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Individual Contributor

**About Convin:**

* Convin is building AI that turns customer conversations into measurable business outcomes. Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, Convin develops proprietary AI products that help B2C businesses engage customers across phone calls, WhatsApp, SMS, and website voice widgets. Convin’s AI products understand customer intent and determine the right channel, timing, message, and next action for every interaction.
* Convin helps businesses turn customer interest into qualified leads, booked appointments, renewals, and completed payments. Convin is building for two demanding B2C markets, India and the United States. In India, we serve leading EdTech, retail, and BFSI businesses. In the United States, we help home service businesses turn more inquiries into booked jobs.
* At Convin, every team contributes to solving real business problems. Whether you are building our products, taking them to market, growing customer relationships, or strengthening the organization behind them, your work will directly influence Convin’s growth and customer outcomes.
* As Convin scales, you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work across India and US markets, and help shape the products, teams, and systems behind our growth. Convin is trusted by leading brands including Physics Wallah, SBI Life, Shaadi.com, Bajaj, Niva Bupa, Aditya Birla & RBL.

**Highlights:**

* Raised $6.5 million in Series A funding in 2024
* Ranked No. 6 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups 2025 list in India
* Ranked the 19th Best Software Company in India by G2

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**1. Month-End Close and General Ledger:**
Lead the monthly book closure, ensuring complete, accurate and timely financial records.

***Core accounting***

* Record all bank transactions in the books from monthly bank statements.
* Account for all outgoing payments with appropriate classification.
* Perform monthly reconciliations of current and fixed deposit accounts.
* Compute interest on fixed deposits and record accruals.
* Record monthly provisions for expenses incurred but not yet invoiced.
* Maintain the prepaid expenses schedule and record monthly amortisation.
* Record depreciation in line with the fixed asset register.
* Classify employee travel expenses by department and record them accordingly.
* Reconcile TDS on salary, rent and professional fees with the general ledger.

***Payroll and reimbursements (maker-checker)***

* Prepare payroll and full and final settlement workings, reconcile them and record the entries, subject to independent review.
* Classify and record employee expense reimbursements, subject to independent review.

***Review and approval***

* Review and approve receipts accounting prepared by the finance executive.
* Review the finalisation of sales invoices and credit notes.
* Validate monthly recurring revenue (MRR) against invoices and approve the related revenue entries.
* Review corporate card expense entries.
* Review TDS receivable entries recorded against actual customer receipts.

**2. Statutory Compliance**

* **TDS:**
  Reconcile deductions and remit tax monthly across all applicable sections, including salary, rent, contracts, professional and technical fees, and commission; file quarterly returns and issue TDS certificates.
* **GSTR-1:**
  File outward supply details, including sales invoices and credit notes, for all state registrations.
* **GSTR-3B:**
  Reconcile output tax with input tax credit and file the monthly return along with the tax payment.
* **Provident Fund:**
  Coordinate with the PF consultants on monthly contributions, validate their computations and remit payments.
* **Professional Tax:**
  Remit professional tax and file monthly returns with the Karnataka authorities.
* **Statutory Audit:**
  Prepare schedules and supporting workings in the auditors' prescribed format for interim and year-end audits, and resolve audit observations.
* **Tax Audit and Income Tax:**
  Support the tax audit and ensure timely filing of the income tax return.
* **ROC Compliance:**
  Coordinate with the company secretarial team on filings, documentation and regulatory requirements under the Companies Act.

**3. Vendor Management and Payments**

* Track and record vendor invoices on receipt.
* Validate supporting documents, including purchase orders, agreements and confirmation of delivery or services, before releasing payment.
* Process payments in line with the approved payment cycle and manage ad hoc payment requests.
* Maintain the payables tracker to monitor payment releases and outstanding obligations.
* **Foreign Remittances:**
  Prepare Form 15CA/15CB, obtain required vendor documentation (such as TRC, Form 10F and no-PE declaration), and process remittances through the bank in compliance with RBI and FEMA regulations.

**4. MIS and Investor Reporting**

* Deliver the monthly MIS to management and investors within agreed timelines.
* Prepare the MIS presentation with supporting analyses, including payroll costs, cash burn and runway.
* Analyse month-on-month variances and address queries from management and investors.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

***Education and experience***

* B.Com / M.Com; CA Inter, CMA Inter or MBA (Finance) preferred.
* 2–5 years in accounting and compliance, ideally at a startup or SaaS company.
* Hands-on experience owning a monthly close and filing GST, TDS, PF and PT returns.

***Technical skills***

* Strong knowledge of Indian GST (multi-state registrations), TDS, EPF and Professional Tax.
* Working knowledge of Companies Act and ROC requirements, and of FEMA/RBI rules for foreign remittances (Form 15CA/15CB).
* Experience supporting statutory and tax audits.
* Proficiency in Tally, Zoho Books or a similar accounting system.
* Advanced Excel: lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations and schedules.
* Familiarity with SaaS metrics such as MRR and cash burn, and with building MIS presentations.

***Attributes***

* Deadline-driven, with a firm grip on a fixed monthly calendar.
* High accuracy and a habit of documenting workings for audit.
* Clear communication with auditors, consultants, banks and vendors.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* **Books closed -**
  Within the monthly close timeline
* **Statutory filings and payments on time -**
  100%, zero interest or late fees
* **Bank and FD reconciliations -**
  Fully reconciled monthly, no unexplained items
* **MIS delivery -**
  On schedule every month, internal and investor
* **Vendor payments -**
  Paid within agreed cycles, with complete supporting documents
* **Audit readiness -**
  Schedules delivered in auditors' format with no repeat queries

title: Data & AI Lead - Finance at Recipharm
description:
****The role****
This is a brand-new role and the first hire of its kind in our Finance team. Reporting to the Head of FP&A and Commercial Finance, you’ll shape and lead our AI-for-Finance agenda: setting the direction, building the data foundation and AI agents, and helping our Finance team move from compiling numbers to analysing them and advising the business. We’re reshaping FP&A and Commercial Finance from reporting to steering, and this role is central to that.
  
  
You’ll be a Finance professional who builds, not a pure IT profile. You’ll understand a P&L and a consolidation as well as you understand a data pipeline or an agent prompt. You’ll also be a thought partner to Finance leadership: we expect you to challenge how we work, bring ideas we haven’t thought of, and tell us where AI can, and can’t, make the biggest difference.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Shape the AI-for-Finance roadmap with Finance leadership: identify and prioritise the use cases with the most value, and recommend what to build, buy or stop.
* Challenge current processes and propose new ways of working, rather than automating what exists today.
* Own the design of the monthly finance data set, covering Group, BU and site P&L, historical data, and net sales by customer and product.
* Design standard site input templates with automated checks, so data arrives clean and consistent.
* Lead the build, testing and roll-out of AI agents across reporting, planning and commercial finance, and maintain their shared knowledge base and instructions.
* Document definitions and data lineage as you go, so everyone trusts and understands the numbers.
* Set the quality standards and controls for AI outputs, including accuracy tracking and reviewer feedback, so agents can be trusted in Board and investor reporting.
* Partner with IT on architecture, security and data protection, and with our BI and data teams on product- and customer-level data, so Finance solutions fit group standards.
* Drive AI adoption across Group and Site Finance: train, coach and support users, and build a community of practice.
* Help shape the vision and roadmap for Recipharm’s future finance systems and performance platforms, and share what works with other functions.

****Who you’ll work with****
You’ll work closely with the Head of FP&A and Commercial Finance and the CFO, the FP&A and Commercial Finance team (your main users), IT, BI and data teams, Tagetik administration and consolidation, Site Finance teams across our network, and external partners.
  
  
****What you’ll bring****

* 3-6 years’ experience across finance, FP&A systems, analytics or BI, including leading data or automation initiatives from idea to adoption.
* Advanced, hands-on experience with generative AI tools (e.g. Claude) and automation, and a clear view of where they add value in Finance.
* Advanced Excel. SQL, Python or Power Query are a plus.
* Experience with planning and ERP systems (e.g. Tagetik, SAP).
* Solid finance literacy, especially P&L and consolidation.
* A pragmatic, delivery-focused approach. You ship in small steps and document as you build.
* The confidence to influence senior stakeholders, challenge the status quo and turn a vision into a practical plan.
* Curiosity and critical thinking: you question the brief, test ideas quickly and know when not to use AI.

****Why join Recipharm****

* A rare chance to be the first Data & AI hire in a global finance team and to shape our AI-for-Finance vision from day one.
* Real backing from Finance leadership and a direct line into the CFO agenda. We have started using AI in our reporting, and you’ll decide where we take it next.
* Visible impact. Your work will change how the whole Finance team, from Sites to Group, spends its time.
* A clear path to grow beyond the role into wider finance leadership.

****Location****
This is a remote role and open for applicants with EU/UK citizenship, or with a valid work/residence permit and permanent residence in the UK, Sweden, Germany, Italy, France, Spain, Portugal or India where Recipharm has presence.
  
  
Recipharm is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) employing over 4,500 employees worldwide. Recipharm provides manufacturing services of pharmaceuticals in various dosage forms, including, sterile fill & finish, oral solid dosage and biologics; clinical trial material development and manufacturing services; and, pharmaceutical product development. Its biologics segment, ReciBioPharm, works with customers to develop and commercialise advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs): pre-clinical to clinical and commercial development and manufacture for new biological modalities, encompassing technologies based on live viruses and viral vectors, live-microbial biopharmaceutical products, nucleic acid-based mRNA and plasmid DNA production.
  
  
Recipharm manufactures several hundred different products to customers ranging from big pharma to smaller research and development companies. It operates development and manufacturing facilities in France, Germany, India, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Sweden and the US and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
  
  
For more information on Recipharm and our services, please visit www.recipharm.com and www.recibiopharm.com

title: Manager - Marketing Analytics
description:
Role Overview
  
  
As the Manager for Marketing Analytics, you will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights and marketing strategy. Your primary focus will be owning the analysis of user funnels, tracking traffic, measuring campaign performance, and building insightful dashboards to optimize our marketing spend across various channels (Brand, SEO, Performance, etc.). Additionally, you will have the opportunity to collaborate on advanced initiatives like Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Causal Inference projects to help evaluate the long-term impact and incrementality of our marketing efforts.

* Campaign Measurement & Budget Optimization : Track, analyze, and report on the performance of various marketing channels (Performance Marketing, Brand Campaigns, SEO, and other digital channels). Drive data-backed recommendations to optimize marketing budget allocation, lower CAC, and maximize ROI.
* Product & Funnel Analytics: Deep dive into traffic patterns, user funnels, and conversion rates across the redBus app and website to identify drop-offs, user friction

points, and growth opportunities.
  
  

* Events Instrumentation: Partner closely with product and engineering teams to ensure clean data collection by defining, tracking, and auditing custom user events (e.g., clicks, searches, bookings).
* User Segmentation: Build data-driven user personas and behavioral segments to power high-impact, targeted CRM campaigns and personalized marketing initiatives.
* Dashboarding & Reporting: Design, build, and maintain automated, intuitive

dashboards to monitor key marketing metrics (KPIs) and regularly present actionable findings to marketing leadership.
  
  

* Advanced Project Support: Assist the team in forward-looking projects involving

Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Causal Inference ML models to understand true marketing incrementality.
  
  

* Market Research: Conduct market and competitive research to identify emerging trends, benchmarks, and new growth avenues.

title: Lead Analyst - Strategic Modeling and Analytics-1
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Lead Analyst, Strategic Modeling & Analytics (FQO), Treasury**
**Value Proposition**

* Play a key role in a global financial modeling team that is pivotal in a top 25 US bank’s strategic decision making, capital planning and regulatory compliance.
* An opportunity to build cutting edge analytics and modeling capabilities for the bank by leveraging a blend of technical & quantitative prowess, financial acumen and excellent communication skills.

**Job Details**
Position Title: Lead Analyst, FQO, Treasury
  
  
Career Level: P3
  
  
Job Category: Manager
  
  
Role Type: Hybrid
  
  
Job Location: Bengaluru, India
  
  
**About The Team**
The FQO group is a part of the Corporate Treasury team within First Citizens Bank. This team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring Pre-Provision Net Revenue (PPNR), Balance Sheet Management (BSM) and other financial models that are consumed for First Citizens Bank’s CCAR stress testing as well as internal business/financial planning activities. FQO interacts closely with Finance and Treasury, Business units, Risk, Senior Management, and Model Risk Management (MRM) to ensure models are fit for use.
  
  
**Impact**
FQO team plays a critical role in capital planning for the bank, by developing models that project the balance sheet and net income/expenses in different economic scenarios. These serves regulatory expectations around stress testing (CCAR), as well as enable the bank to take strategic business decisions related to capital distribution, share buyback etc. Balance Sheet Management models aid in EVE calculations which are pivotal in Asset-Liability Management for the bank.
  
  
This role entails playing a lead role in the model development team, and hence contributing significantly to develop and enhance sophisticated models based on sound statistical techniques and robust data. It will involve interesting and challenging opportunities to continuously evolve the model suite and processes around model lifecycle as the bank grows rapidly and has heightened regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
**Model Data, Development & Maintenance**

* Support the Corporate Treasury team through data management, development, enhancement and maintenance of Pre-Provision Net Revenue (PPNR) and Balance Sheet Management models used for Regulatory (CCAR/DFAST) Reporting, Stress Testing, Financial Planning/Analysis etc.
* Manage data extraction, quality, reconciliation and processing at different levels of aggregation in coordination with FQO data/governance and IT teams.
* Analyze large datasets to uncover valuable insights and patterns that can aid in financial decision making and risk management.
* Support key decisions and provide support across all phases of model development including qualitative/quantitative methodology design, exploratory data analysis, variable selection, performance testing and documentation; modeling components include Deposits, Loans, Commitments and Net Interest Revenues/Expenses.
* Set up and perform ongoing monitoring as per specified frequency to ensure model is performing as per standards and perform root cause analysis or remediation as applicable.
* Support model implementation for new or re-developed models including data reconciliation, model execution logic, implementation testing, and documentation.
* Contribute to process enhancements and automation related to model development process, documentation, monitoring and production activities.
* Partner with businesses, Finance and Treasury, Risk, and Model Risk Management to ensure PPNR is contributing to a consistent and controlled approach across the end-to-end CCAR process.

**Governance & Controls**

* Engage with Model Risk Management (MRM) team to ensure models are fit for use as per bank policies and standards and resolve model findings/limitations.
* Support review and challenge process for stress test results and business overlays in collaboration with PPNR and business teams.
* Support governance team to establish and execute controls around data quality/reconciliation and model execution process.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Accountable for effective communication across Business units, MRM, Risk/Finance teams and working groups/committees including toll gate meetings, model review/challenge discussions etc.
* Manage onshore stakeholders including senior modeling leads and collaborate effectively across model development/maintenance activities.

**Skills and Qualification**
***(Functional and Technical Skills)***
**Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of US regulatory landscape including CCAR/DFAST regulations and SR 11-7 guidelines.
* Solid understanding of banking/financial products including credit, loans and deposits. Knowledge of commercial banking is a plus.
* Knowledge of Interest Rate Risk (IRR) and related concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engagement with senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines.
* Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask.

**Technical Skills**

* In-depth understanding of statistical analysis and econometric modeling including sampling, segmentation, linear/logistic regression, time series forecasting, stress testing techniques concepts/techniques etc.
* Good understanding of best practices related to data management, quality and processing for modeling purposes.
* Experience working on data extraction, quality controls and processing for modelling purposes using SQL and/or statistical programming languages.
* Experience with at least one statistical programming language such as Python, R or SAS.

**Education & Experience**

* Master's/Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance or Applied Economics and related fields.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in model development or validation for Risk or PPNR models. Exposure to regulatory modeling/stress testing is preferred.

**Accessibility Needs**
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

6–9 Years
  
  
**Team: Data Governance and Analytics
  
  
Organization: Data, AI, and Visualization (DAIV), Global Software R&D**
**About The Team**
The Data Governance and Analytics Team is part of Data, AI, and Visualization (DAIV) within our global software R&D organization. We are a diverse, distributed team with colleagues across France and the Netherlands.
  
  
We bring digital technology into our products, solutions, and services, enabling data extraction, analysis, and connectivity. We develop software that supports data governance by managing data definitions, improving data quality, and making data more usable and useful. Our work prepares the organization for the age of AI, supports data-driven design, and enables value creation from data.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep technical expertise in Python and Data Governance & Analytics (DGA) systems. In this role, you will design, build, and scale high-performance data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, and governance frameworks that empower our engineering and product teams. You will work closely with cross-functional architecture and DevOps teams to drive automated data ingestion, ensure stringent data quality, and build reliable backend services that support critical operational metrics and reporting.

* Implement and automate data governance standards, metadata tracking, and data lineage mechanisms to ensure high data integrity, security, and compliance.

* Identify opportunities to reuse existing software and simplify implementation across projects.

* Participate in code reviews and improve code readability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Investigate defects, troubleshoot software and integration issues, and improve performance where. needed.
* Maintain technical documentation and clear runbooks covering component interfaces, configuration, integration dependencies, and usage.
* Collaborate with software architects and engineers across the wider R&D organization.
* Establish strong reliability practices (logging/monitoring, retries/backoff, idempotency, concurrency controls, safe cleanup, traceability).
* Mentor engineers through code reviews, best practices, and technical leadership.
* Work effectively within an Agile Scrum / SAFe framework, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery.

* Expert-level proficiency in Python (async programming, data structures, performance optimization, and modular architecture).
* Experience developing shared Python packages or libraries used by other engineering teams.
* Ability to independently develop, test, debug, and maintain Python modules and libraries.
* Understanding of Python packaging, dependency management, error handling, and automated testing.
* Experience manipulating data, including cleaning, transforming, validating, or aggregating datasets.
* Knowledge of data analytics concepts.
* Strong foundation in SQL, relational/non-relational data modelling, and data transformation frameworks.
* Experience with data governance principles (data quality frameworks, cataloguing, lineage, and metadata management).
* Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across locations and disciplines.
* Ability to design modular, reusable, and maintainable software.
* Experience working in an agile DevOps environment.
* Experience using GitLab or GitHub for source control and collaborative development.
* Familiarity with build pipelines, test automation, and automated deployment.
* Understanding of containerization concepts, with familiarity with technologies such as Docker, K8s, Helm, etc
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum and SAFe, with experience operating effectively in sprint-based and cross-team planning environments.

* Experience operating in structured product-development environments with strong quality, compliance, and delivery expectations.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in a technical or scientific discipline.
* 6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development, data engineering, or analytics platforms.

title: AI & Digital Data Analyst
description:
At Novonesis, we believe the best business decisions are driven by meaningful insights. As digital channels, commercial platforms, and AI capabilities continue to evolve, understanding customer behaviour and measuring business impact has never been more important.
  
  
You will join the Commercial Platforms Team, part of Global Strategy & Commercial Development and a key enabler of Novonesis’ commercial excellence. We own, develop, and support the digital platforms, products, and capabilities that enable our global Commercial organization and help deliver seamless customer experiences across digital and commercial touchpoints.
  
  
Our portfolio spans Salesforce, customer-facing solutions such as web and eCommerce, commercial analytics and dashboards, and AI. Working closely with Business Areas and IT, we translate commercial needs into scalable digital solutions that simplify how our commercial teams work, provide actionable insights, and create more connected customer experiences.
  
  
As part of our AI and analytics journey, we are looking for an AI & Digital Data Analyst who can build robust measurement capabilities, transform data into actionable insights, and help establish the analytics foundation for our growing portfolio of digital and AI solutions.
  
  
**The Role & Your Impact**
As an AI & Digital Data Analyst, you will play a key role in enabling data-driven decision-making across our digital, commercial, and AI ecosystems. You will combine technical measurement implementation with advanced analytical thinking to understand customer behaviour, evaluate digital performance, and measure the adoption and value of AI solutions.
  
  
Working closely with commercial teams, product owners, developers, marketers, data specialists, and technology partners, you will ensure reliable measurement, uncover actionable insights, and help drive continuous optimization across digital experiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Measurement & Data**

description:

Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
  
  
**About The Team – Supply Chain Operations**
The Supply Chain Operations team plays a critical role in enabling the end-to-end supply chain ecosystem. We are responsible for managing key business processes and supporting the development and execution of capabilities that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and responsiveness. Our team is collaborative, data-driven, and focused on delivering value through continuous improvement and strategic planning.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst – Facility Engineering & Asset Management is an individual contributor responsible for executing data analytics, reporting, and performance monitoring activities supporting facility engineering, maintenance excellence, and asset lifecycle management across Target’s supply chain network, with a strong focus on 4-wall operations.
  
  
The role analyzes facility maintenance, asset management, and material handling equipment (MHE) data to identify performance gaps and generate actionable insights related to equipment reliability, asset productivity, maintenance optimization, and operational efficiency. Based in TII, the Analyst partners with global engineering, maintenance, operations, and technology teams to deliver accurate analytical outputs and support data-driven decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Extract, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple operational systems to generate actionable insights supporting facility engineering, maintenance, and asset management decisions.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar tools to monitor facility and equipment performance.
* Collaborate with the engineering team and ensure the system uptime is maintained at a certified level to avoid any throughput losses
* Have an understanding of the engineering aspects of asset functioning to evaluate the maintenance and spare parts details
* Track and analyze asset health, equipment reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance across distribution facilities to identify trends and opportunities.
* Monitor equipment uptime, MTBF, MTTR, preventive maintenance compliance, and maintenance costs to support reliability and maintenance optimization.
* Consolidate and analyze equipment performance, asset condition, maintenance costs, and investment data to support capital planning, engineering projects, and asset lifecycle decisions.
* Support automated reporting solutions, analytical models, and visualization capabilities while exploring AI/ML and advanced analytics to improve efficiency and insights generation.
* Partner with global engineering, maintenance, operations, and technology teams to understand requirements, validate data, resolve issues, and deliver analytical solutions.
* Independently execute assigned analytical projects and activities, ensuring data accuracy, adherence to established processes, and timely delivery of quality outputs.
* Prepare and present clear reports, performance insights, and recommendations to the global leadership team and cross-functional stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making.

**Technical Competencies**
SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Tableau or similar tools; data extraction, cleaning and validation; advanced Excel; dashboard development and KPI reporting; asset performance and maintenance analytics; reliability metrics systems and material handling equipment.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
Analytical Thinking | Problem Solving | Execution Excellence | Attention to Detail | Data-Driven Decision Making | Learning Agility | Collaboration | Stakeholder Communication | Ownership & Accountability
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, engineering analytics, supply chain operations, asset management, or related disciplines.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpreting large datasets and identifying meaningful trends.
* Understanding of data validation, data quality, and reporting processes.
* Ability to translate business requirements into analytical outputs and actionable insights.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to independently manage assigned work and meet timelines.
* Willingness to learn facility engineering, asset management, and maintenance processes in a global supply chain environment.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Exposure to facility engineering, maintenance operations, asset management, or MHE in distribution or manufacturing environments.
* Exposure to retail operations, supply chain, distribution centers, warehouse operations, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial engineering environments.
* Familiarity with CMMS/EAM platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo.
* Experience working with operational, equipment, or maintenance datasets.
* Exposure to reporting automation, predictive analytics, AI/ML, or advanced analytics.
* Exposure to working in warehouse operations

title: Growth Manager
description:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we’ve crossed
**$130M in Annualised Revenue**
and grown to
**over 10M users across 190+ countries**
, who have built
**12M+ applications**
on Emergent. We’re backed by
**Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.**

We’re solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by
**repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni,**
and leaders from
**Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.**

We’re hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

**The Role:**

We’re hiring a Growth Manager with a strong analytics backbone to drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle. The way you’ll do it is through data: querying it yourself, finding the insight, and turning it into interventions that move the numbers. You’ll own one growth metric end-to-end. The pace is fast and a lot is still being defined, often you’ll be the one defining it.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own one KPI (e.g. retention, top-up rate, plan upgrades, or revenue per signup) with a weekly read of what moved and why
* When a number breaks, find the root cause, the questions a standard dashboard can’t answer, size it, and say what to do about it
* Analyze user behavior across cohorts, funnels, and segments to find levers across activation, credits and top-ups, pricing and plans, and churn
* Design, run, and read experiments properly: hypothesis, sample size, holdouts, and the decision rule fixed before launch
* Work with product, pricing, CRM, and marketing to ship what the data says
* Use AI tools (LLMs, agents) to speed up your own analysis and to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2 to 4 years in growth, product, analytics, strategy, or a related role. Background is open; working hands-on with data is not
* Strong SQL skills, this is non-negotiable: you can independently query large datasets to build cohorts, funnels, and retention curves, and you validate your numbers before anyone else does
* Comfort living in data day-to-day: dashboards, product analytics tools, and spreadsheets are your home turf, and you form and test hypotheses from the data rather than waiting for someone to hand you an insight
* You’ve owned a metric and moved it, and you can show the before and after
* Working knowledge of experiment stats: significance, novelty effects, and when not to trust a result
* Comfortable using LLMs and AI tools in your day-to-day work

**Good to Have:**

* Consumer or self-serve SaaS experience
* Python

**Benefits and Perks:**

1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

Let’s build the future of software together.

The Senior Specialist - Market Risk Operations will support the Gas & Power trading business by providing independent market risk measurement, exposure monitoring, P&L analysis, risk reporting, and control framework oversight. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex risk metrics into meaningful business insights for senior management.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Analyse and explain daily P&L movements and key portfolio risk drivers.
* Perform risk analysis using Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and other market risk methodologies.
* Monitor trading exposures and limits in accordance with the Trading Control Framework and Manual of Authorities (MOA).
* Provide insightful risk commentary on commodity trading portfolios, particularly Gas and Power.
* Conduct ad hoc data analysis and reporting using trading risk databases and reporting tools.
* Partner with traders, business stakeholders, and technology teams to investigate and resolve risk reporting and application issues.
* Develop and maintain reporting solutions, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Lead business improvement initiatives and risk-related projects with tight delivery timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, SOX controls, Shell Control Framework, and internal policies.

**What You Bring**

* Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of market risk concepts including VaR, stress testing, sensitivity analysis, basis risk, volume risk, and currency risk.
* Knowledge of commodity markets, preferably LNG, Natural Gas, and Power trading.
* Experience working with risk management platforms such as Endur and Nucleus.
* Strong technical and analytical skills with hands-on experience in:

+ SQL and Oracle
+ Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar data visualization tools

* Ability to analyse large datasets and communicate findings effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project leadership capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting trading and risk management functions within commodity markets.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.

* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Analyst – Facility Engineering & Asset Management
description:
**About The Team – Supply Chain Operations**
The Supply Chain Operations team plays a critical role in enabling the end-to-end supply chain ecosystem. We are responsible for managing key business processes and supporting the development and execution of capabilities that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and responsiveness. Our team is collaborative, data-driven, and focused on delivering value through continuous improvement and strategic planning.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst – Facility Engineering & Asset Management is an individual contributor responsible for executing data analytics, reporting, and performance monitoring activities supporting facility engineering, maintenance excellence, and asset lifecycle management across Target’s supply chain network, with a strong focus on 4-wall operations.
  
  
The role analyzes facility maintenance, asset management, and material handling equipment (MHE) data to identify performance gaps and generate actionable insights related to equipment reliability, asset productivity, maintenance optimization, and operational efficiency. Based in TII, the Analyst partners with global engineering, maintenance, operations, and technology teams to deliver accurate analytical outputs and support data-driven decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Extract, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple operational systems to generate actionable insights supporting facility engineering, maintenance, and asset management decisions.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar tools to monitor facility and equipment performance.
* Collaborate with the engineering team and ensure the system uptime is maintained at a certified level to avoid any throughput losses
* Have an understanding of the engineering aspects of asset functioning to evaluate the maintenance and spare parts details
* Track and analyze asset health, equipment reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance across distribution facilities to identify trends and opportunities.
* Monitor equipment uptime, MTBF, MTTR, preventive maintenance compliance, and maintenance costs to support reliability and maintenance optimization.
* Consolidate and analyze equipment performance, asset condition, maintenance costs, and investment data to support capital planning, engineering projects, and asset lifecycle decisions.
* Support automated reporting solutions, analytical models, and visualization capabilities while exploring AI/ML and advanced analytics to improve efficiency and insights generation.
* Partner with global engineering, maintenance, operations, and technology teams to understand requirements, validate data, resolve issues, and deliver analytical solutions.
* Independently execute assigned analytical projects and activities, ensuring data accuracy, adherence to established processes, and timely delivery of quality outputs.
* Prepare and present clear reports, performance insights, and recommendations to the global leadership team and cross-functional stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making.

Technical Competencies
  
  
SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Tableau or similar tools; data extraction, cleaning and validation; advanced Excel; dashboard development and KPI reporting; asset performance and maintenance analytics; reliability metrics systems and material handling equipment.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Analytical Thinking | Problem Solving | Execution Excellence | Attention to Detail | Data-Driven Decision Making | Learning Agility | Collaboration | Stakeholder Communication | Ownership & Accountability
  
  
Mandatory Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, engineering analytics, supply chain operations, asset management, or related disciplines.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpreting large datasets and identifying meaningful trends.
* Understanding of data validation, data quality, and reporting processes.
* Ability to translate business requirements into analytical outputs and actionable insights.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to independently manage assigned work and meet timelines.
* Willingness to learn facility engineering, asset management, and maintenance processes in a global supply chain environment.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Exposure to facility engineering, maintenance operations, asset management, or MHE in distribution or manufacturing environments.
* Exposure to retail operations, supply chain, distribution centers, warehouse operations, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial engineering environments.
* Familiarity with CMMS/EAM platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo.
* Experience working with operational, equipment, or maintenance datasets.
* Exposure to reporting automation, predictive analytics, AI/ML, or advanced analytics.

Exposure to working in warehouse operations

: Bangalore/Mumbai, India
  
  
**Function:**
Customer Experience / Regional HUB
  
  
**Terms & Conditions:**
Full-time, permanent. Applicants must have the right to work in India.
  
  
**About Unilever**
Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
  
  
**About Ufs**
Act like a founder, accelerate your growth, stay ahead of the curve, enjoy the growth: JOIN US
  
  
Unilever Food Solutions is an independent Global Business Unit, which is the 5th largest Business Unit in Unilever. UFS is ~20% of Nutrition Business Group and operates in 76 markets with a Turnover of about €3 Bn. We have a compelling ambition: To be a €5 Bn business by 2030, becoming the leader in digital selling in the food service industry, the best solution provider for our Operators and the planet, and a Winning People Engine.
  
  
  
  
UFS operates with a different business model that has a greater emphasis on chefs and field sales to drive demand creation with operators in a Business-to-Business setting. UFS is a unique business within Unilever, with a constant focus on executional excellence and consistent productivity improvements leading to significant value creation and enabled by rich expertise in the professional food service channel.
  
  
UFS is the place where we are all striving to be Chefs supporting Chefs! At UFS we have an entrepreneurial culture with a commitment to speed, simplicity and trust, whilst having a hunger to grow – both our business and our people. UFS also proudly commits to high employee engagement every year with Univoice scores ahead of Unilever across all dimensions.
  
  
It is the place where you can be a risk taker, test and iterate, and be a trendsetter. You can think and work like an owner of your own business and be ahead of the curve. With the purpose of “We free you to love what you do” and the DNA “having empathy for the people we serve and the expertise to meet their needs 24/7” you will become a part of a “People-to-People organization.”
  
  
You will explore new opportunities, big and small, that will make our business grow faster. You will continuously learn, unlearn, relearn, and challenge yourself to accelerate your development in an end-to-end business and in end-to-end roles.
  
  
At UFS, we are committed to fostering a culture of trust and unity with our empowered One Team One Goal approach, with a passion for winning and nurturing a culture of psychological safety where people can shape their career adventures. We aim to achieve resilient performance and sustainable success, winning together as one resilient, dynamic team.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
As the Business Analyst within the UFS CX Regional Hub, you will play a critical role in driving market solution adoption and enabling data-driven decision-making across the region. Your primary responsibility will be to translate business needs into actionable insights, ensuring that global and regional digital solutions are effectively deployed and utilized by markets. You will partner with cross-functional teams to generate strategic market insights, identify growth opportunities, and provide recommendations that enhance customer experience and accelerate business performance.
  
  
**What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be**

* Drive the deployment and adoption of global and regional digital solutions across markets, ensuring alignment with business objectives and maximizing user engagement.
* Analyse market performance, customer behaviour, and solution usage data to generate actionable insights that inform strategic decisions and accelerate growth.
* Develop Regional and market level dashboards for CX reporting.
* Translate insights into clear, data-driven recommendations for market teams, influencing commercial strategies and customer experience initiatives.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and CX teams to understand business needs, prioritize requirements, and ensure solutions deliver measurable value.
* Track and report on key adoption and impact metrics, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify barriers to adoption and propose enhancements to tools, processes, and training to improve effectiveness and user experience.
* Support markets with capability building, best practice sharing, and guidance on leveraging data and solutions for business impact.

**What You Need To Succeed**
**Experiences & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in business analysis, data-driven strategy, or digital solution deployment roles.
* Proven track record in generating actionable insights from complex datasets and influencing business decisions.
* Strong understanding of digital tools, analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI), and CRM systems.
* Experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration in a matrixed organization.

**Skills**

* Strategic Thinking & Execution
* Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Business Acumen
* Power BI, Python, Spark, SQL.
* Data Visualization & Storytelling
* Digital Solution Deployment & Adoption
* Communication Skills

**Leadership**

* You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
* As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**Senior Product Analyst — super.money**

**Experience:**
3–5 years, with relevant product analytics experience

**About the role**

super.money is Flipkart's consumer fintech app, spanning UPI payments, credit and affordable commerce. We are hiring a Senior Product Analyst to be the analytical partner to our product teams: the person who tells us what users are doing, why a funnel is leaking, and whether what we shipped actually worked.

This is a product analytics role first. You will sit with PMs, design and engineering, and your work will directly shape what gets built and what gets rolled back.

**What you'll do**

* **Funnel tracking:**
  Define, instrument and monitor funnels across onboarding, payments and credit journeys. Diagnose drop-offs and size the fix.
* **Pre-post analysis:**
  Measure the impact of every launch and change, separating real movement from seasonality, mix shift and noise.
* **Experimentation:**
  Design A/B tests with PMs (hypothesis, metrics, sample size, guardrails), track them through to a clear ship / iterate / kill call.
* **Deep dives:**
  Cohort, retention and segmentation work that changes the roadmap, not just describes it.
* **Instrumentation:**
  Own northstar metric definitions. Write event specs with product and engineering so that features shipped are measurable. Create dashboards and weekly reviews for your charter. Catch anomalies before someone asks, and get to the root cause fast. Keep everyone honest via data driven analysis

**Must-haves**

* 3–5 years in analytics, with most of it in
  **product analytics**
  at a consumer app or internet company.
* Strong SQL on large event-level datasets. Comfortable working with clickstream data, event taxonomies, Metabase, BigQuery etc
* Hands-on with funnel analysis, pre-post measurement and A/B experimentation, including knowing when a result should not be trusted.
* Can define a north-star and its input metrics for a new feature from scratch, and knows which metrics are gameable or misleading.
* Communicate the answer first. Can tell a PM what to do, not just what the data says. Knows when an 80% answer in two hours beats a perfect one in two days.
* Has run the BAU side of product analytics: dashboards, metric definitions, recurring reviews, anomaly triage.
* Working knowledge of statistics: significance, confidence intervals, sample sizing, common experimentation pitfalls.
* Sanity-checks their own numbers, spots instrumentation bugs and broken event logging before presenting, and knows the data lineage well enough to say where a number can’t be trusted.

**Good to have**

* Fintech exposure (UPI, payments or consumer credit) will be strongly preferred
* Risk or business analytics experience will be a plus

**shift timings : consultant must be comfortable with afternoon and night shifts**

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Demand Planning Analysts to support a global Advanced Planning System (APS) transformation and demand planning stabilization program.

These contract professionals will collaborate with regional Demand Planning teams across EMEA, LATAM, China, Asia, and USAC business groups to execute operational demand planning activities, maintain forecast data integrity, support planning system readiness, and ensure uninterrupted planning operations throughout the deployment phase.

The ideal candidate will have strong demand planning experience, hands-on expertise with SAP APO-DP, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced global manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Forecast Planning & Maintenance**

· Manage complex product portfolios primarily driven by statistical forecasting.

· Upload, maintain, and update demand forecasts.

· Execute forecast adjustments and realignments.

· Support forecasting activities related to existing open sales orders (FDO process).

· Maintain forecast change percentages and statistical forecasting parameters.

· Compare statistical forecasts with machine learning forecasts and aggregated demand signals as needed.

· Develop and maintain accurate demand plans to support business operations.

**Demand Planning Master Data Management**

· Create, maintain, and cleanse Characteristic Value Combinations (CVCs).

· Maintain Demand Planning IDs and associated planning master data.

· Support Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) mapping activities.

· Ensure planning data integrity across systems and regional teams.

· Review Average Selling Price (ASP) changes and assess demand impacts.

· Analyze demand trends, forecast accuracy, and planning performance.

· Experience supporting complex product portfolios.

· Experience working in manufacturing, industrial, healthcare, technology, consumer goods, or related industries.

· Experience working with global demand and supply planning teams.

* **Assortment Health & Conversion Optimization:**
  Monitor portfolio health against key performance metrics (e.g., sell-through rates, stock turn, availability) and execute strategic interventions to boost conversions.

  Coordinate across business units to secure planning inputs on schedule, ensuring all plans are aligned and formally agreed upon before set deadlines.

* **Strategic Leadership:**

* **Analytics & Reporting:**
  Build, implement, and maintain robust reporting frameworks that deliver a comprehensive 360-degree view of portfolio health and business drivers.

* **Experience:**
  5–10 years of core experience in Merchandising Planning, Demand Planning, Category Planning, or Business Analytics (Retail/E-commerce experience strongly preferred).

* **Technical Skills:**
  Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, data modeling, data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), and ERP planning systems.

* **Financial & Business Acumen:**
  Strong understanding of retail math, top-down and bottom-up financial planning, OTB management, and supply chain logistics.

* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of influencing cross-functional teams and aligning senior stakeholders.

* **Problem-Solving:**
  Strong analytical capability to identify performance gaps, diagnose root causes, and propose actionable solutions.

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

description:
