title: Principal - AI & Data Science
description:
**The Role**

We are looking for a
**Principal - AI & Data Science**
to build and lead our AI/ML & Data Science function at the intersection of
**Generative AI, marketing intelligence, and programmatic media**
.

In this role, you will combine
**hands-on technical leadership**
,
**advanced marketing analytics**
, and
**AI innovation**
to design scalable solutions that power decision-making across digital and offline media channels. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to translate complex data into actionable intelligence.

**What You Will Do**

***Lead & Build***

* Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of data scientists.
* Set technical direction and best practices across modeling, experimentation, and AI adoption.
* Drive a culture of innovation, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.

***Generative AI & LLMs (Core Focus)***

* Lead the design and deployment of
  **Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)**
  solutions for marketing and media use cases.
* Apply NLP techniques such as sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and text classification to enrich marketing insights.
* Integrate GenAI into predictive workflows, reporting automation, and proactive intelligence generation.

***Advanced Marketing Analytics***

* Design and implement advanced analytics and machine learning models, including:
* Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
* Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)
* Propensity and RFM modeling
* Bayesian and non-parametric methods
* Apply experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, significance testing) to validate impact and optimize performance.

***Predictive Modeling & Optimization***

* Build predictive models to optimize revenue, audience behavior, bid strategies, and inventory performance.
* Analyze campaign and media trading data to improve eCPM, fill rates, and ROI across channels such as display, video, mobile, social, native, and advanced TV/audio.

***Data Platforms & Architecture***

* Architect scalable data pipelines integrating multiple sources across audience, pricing, and contextual datasets.
* Oversee integrations with DSPs, SSPs, DMPs, and other ad-tech platforms.
* Ensure high standards of data quality, governance, and performance.

***Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Yield, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams.
* Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights for business and client stakeholders.
* Contribute to the evolution of MADTECH.AI as a market-leading AI product.

**What We’re Looking For**

***Experience & Education***

* Master’s or Ph.D. in Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Marketing Analytics, or Predictive Modeling, with proven leadership exposure.

***Technical Expertise***

* Machine Learning: regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction.
* Ensemble methods: Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost.
* Strong experience with
  **Generative AI, LLMs, and NLP**
  in real-world applications.
* Marketing analytics frameworks: MMM, MTA, attribution modeling.
* Experimentation and statistical testing.
* Cloud platforms: AWS or GCP (model deployment and monitoring).

***You’ll Thrive If You…***

* Enjoy building at scale in a fast-growing, product-driven environment.
* Can bridge deep technical work with business impact.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Are excited to shape the future of AI-powered marketing intelligence.

**Location**

* This role is based in
  **Mysuru or Bengaluru**
  .

**About MADTECH.AI**

MADTECH.AI is the Decision Intelligence platform for mission-driven organizations and their partners.

Eliminate the burden of data wrangling, model building, data visualization, and optimization in one cost-effective AI-powered hub. By delivering sharper, on-demand insights, predictions, recommendations, and proactive problem-solving, the platform reduces data complexity empowering clients to make smarter, data-driven decisions faster and more affordably.

title: Growth Manager
description:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we’ve crossed
**$130M in Annualised Revenue**
and grown to
**over 10M users across 190+ countries**
, who have built
**12M+ applications**
on Emergent. We’re backed by
**Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.**

We’re solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by
**repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni,**
and leaders from
**Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.**

We’re hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

**The Role:**

We’re hiring a Growth Manager with a strong analytics backbone to drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle. The way you’ll do it is through data: querying it yourself, finding the insight, and turning it into interventions that move the numbers. You’ll own one growth metric end-to-end. The pace is fast and a lot is still being defined, often you’ll be the one defining it.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own one KPI (e.g. retention, top-up rate, plan upgrades, or revenue per signup) with a weekly read of what moved and why
* When a number breaks, find the root cause, the questions a standard dashboard can’t answer, size it, and say what to do about it
* Analyze user behavior across cohorts, funnels, and segments to find levers across activation, credits and top-ups, pricing and plans, and churn
* Design, run, and read experiments properly: hypothesis, sample size, holdouts, and the decision rule fixed before launch
* Work with product, pricing, CRM, and marketing to ship what the data says
* Use AI tools (LLMs, agents) to speed up your own analysis and to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2 to 4 years in growth, product, analytics, strategy, or a related role. Background is open; working hands-on with data is not
* Strong SQL skills, this is non-negotiable: you can independently query large datasets to build cohorts, funnels, and retention curves, and you validate your numbers before anyone else does
* Comfort living in data day-to-day: dashboards, product analytics tools, and spreadsheets are your home turf, and you form and test hypotheses from the data rather than waiting for someone to hand you an insight
* You’ve owned a metric and moved it, and you can show the before and after
* Working knowledge of experiment stats: significance, novelty effects, and when not to trust a result
* Comfortable using LLMs and AI tools in your day-to-day work

**Good to Have:**

* Consumer or self-serve SaaS experience
* Python

**Benefits and Perks:**

1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

Let’s build the future of software together.

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
Job Title
  
  
Principal Data Scientist
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job title:**
**Principal Data Scientist**
**Your Role**
The Principal Data Scientist combines deep commercial understanding with strong hands-on expertise in data science, machine learning, Generative AI and agentic AI. The role is accountable for turning complex performance data into trusted decisions, scalable analytics products and intelligent tools that help Business Units and Regions sense, diagnose, predict and act faster.
  
  
The role owns the performance-analytics foundation: sell-out and market data from syndicated vendors such as Circana, GfK, Nielsen and IQVIA; performance dashboards; data definitions; and the business narrative behind the numbers. It also leads the evolution beyond traditional reporting by building advanced analytical models, AI agents and conversational decision-support tools.
  
  
This is not a reporting role and not a purely technical data-scientist role. It requires someone who can build robust analytical solutions, understand the underlying data and models, and confidently influence senior commercial leaders with clear “so what / now what” recommendations.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Performance Analytics Business Partnering
* Act as the day-to-day performance analytics partner for assigned Businesses and Regions.
* Translate leadership questions into clear analytics, data-science and AI solution requirements.
* Lead analysis across market share, sell-in, sell-out, revenue, margin, price, mix, distribution, customer and channel performance.
* Support business reviews, planning cycles, forecasts and strategic discussions with fact-based insights and recommendations.
* Connect multiple performance signals to identify underlying drivers, risks, opportunities and required actions.
* Challenge assumptions constructively and translate complex analysis into concise executive narratives.
* Syndicated Data, Data Foundations and Governance
* Own the business use, interpretation and quality of syndicated market and sell-out data from Circana, GfK, Nielsen, IQVIA and other relevant vendors.
* Understand and manage data methodologies, coverage, definitions, assumptions and limitations.
* Work with Data & Technology, data engineering and external providers to integrate, validate and harmonise data in ADL and related platforms.
* Establish robust reconciliation, validation and quality-control processes to ensure performance outputs are trusted and first-time-right.
* Define common business rules, hierarchies, calculations and performance definitions across Businesses and Regions.
* Document data logic, methodologies and known limitations clearly.
* Dashboards and Analytics Products
* Own and continuously improve sell-out and commercial performance dashboards as analytics products, not static reports.
* Build scalable, reusable dashboards and automated analytical workflows using SQL, Python and modern BI tools.
* Move dashboards beyond reporting by embedding automated diagnostics, alerts, benchmarks, root-cause analysis and recommended actions.
* Lead requirements gathering, design, user testing, deployment and adoption of analytics products.
* Simplify the dashboard landscape by eliminating duplicate, manual and low-value reporting.
* Monitor solution usage, user feedback, data quality and business impact, and continuously improve the product backlog.
* Advanced Analytics and Data Science
* Analyse complex, high-volume structured and unstructured datasets using robust statistical and data-science methods.
* Develop and deploy predictive and diagnostic models for commercial performance questions, including forecasting, regression, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, price and mix analysis.
* Own the end-to-end data-science lifecycle: problem framing, data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring and improvement.
* Assess model performance, stability, explainability and business relevance before scaling solutions.
* Apply scientific rigour to distinguish correlation, decomposition and causal insight; ensure models are used appropriately in decision-making.
* Write clean, documented and reusable code, and partner with technical teams to productionise analytical solutions.
* AI, GenAI and Agentic Decision Intelligence
* Design, build and deploy AI-enabled tools, Generative AI applications and analytical agents for performance management.
* Use LLMs, retrieval-based approaches, machine learning and automation to enable users to ask business questions in natural language and receive trusted, grounded answers.
* Create agents that can monitor performance, identify deviations, retrieve relevant context, diagnose likely drivers, simulate scenarios and recommend next-best actions.
* Combine dashboards, predictive models and conversational AI into intuitive decision-support experiences.
* Rapidly prototype AI use cases, test them with users and scale successful solutions into robust products.
* Apply responsible-AI principles, including data security, access control, traceability, explainability, evaluation, bias awareness and clear human decision rights.
* Stay current on developments in AI, LLMs, agentic frameworks and data science, applying innovations pragmatically where they create measurable value.
* Technology, Deployment and Solution Architecture
* Partner with IT, data engineering, software development and platform teams to ensure analytical and AI solutions are secure, scalable, reliable and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Define technical requirements, support solution architecture, testing and production deployment.
* Establish appropriate model monitoring, version control, documentation and evaluation processes.
* Resolve data and technical issues that affect the reliability, speed or usability of analytics products.
* Balance rapid MVP delivery with sound product-engineering fundamentals.
* Adoption and Capability Building
* Drive adoption of dashboards, models and AI tools through training, coaching, clear playbooks and active engagement with business users.
* Build confidence in data, analytical methods and AI recommendations by making logic and limitations transparent.
* Help stakeholders use performance insight consistently in business reviews, planning, customer discussions and commercial decisions.
* Share best practices across Businesses, Regions and analytics teams.
* Track whether insights and AI tools lead to decisions, actions and measurable business impact.

Success Measures
  
  

* Trusted, consistent and timely sell-out and market-performance insights across Businesses and Regions.
* High adoption and demonstrable impact of dashboards, analytics products and AI-enabled tools.
* Reduced manual reporting and duplicate analytics solutions.
* Earlier identification of performance risks and growth opportunities.
* Increased use of predictive analytics, AI agents and automated diagnostics in regular business routines.
* Strong data quality, governance, model reliability and responsible-AI compliance.
* Clear evidence that analytical recommendations translate into business decisions and commercial impact.
* Positive feedback from senior Business, Regional, Sales, Marketing and Finance stakeholders.

**Experience**
**You're the right fit if:**

* Preferably 9+ years of experience in performance analytics, commercial analytics, data science, decision intelligence, business intelligence or a related field.
* Proven experience with syndicated market or sell-out data, such as Circana, GfK, Nielsen, IQVIA or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying analytics products, dashboards, predictive models or AI-enabled tools—not only consuming reports.
* Strong experience partnering with senior commercial stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.
* Experience working across multiple markets, categories or Business Units in a complex matrix organisation.
* Experience taking analytical solutions from business problem through build, deployment, adoption and measurable impact.

Technical and Analytical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level hands-on capability in Python and SQL, with strong foundations in statistics, data modelling and data quality.
* Strong practical expertise in machine learning, including regression, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection and model evaluation.
* Strong working expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, AI-agent design and evaluation.
* Experience building AI or GenAI applications, ideally including conversational analytics, intelligent assistants or agentic workflows.
* Experience with BI and visualisation tools, cloud data platforms, data lakes/ADL and enterprise data environments.
* Understanding of data governance, model governance, responsible AI, deployment and monitoring practices.

Business and Personal Skills
  
  

* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect analytical findings to performance, decisions and actions.
* Ability to turn complex data science and AI outputs into simple, compelling executive stories.
* High ownership and a builder mindset; comfortable moving rapidly from idea to MVP to scaled solution.
* Curious, pragmatic and rigorous—able to use advanced technology without over-engineering.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, Mathematics or another quantitative discipline.
* Additional education or demonstrated hands-on expertise in machine learning, GenAI, LLMs or AI-product development is strongly preferred.

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
**About Philips**
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

description:
**Description**
We are looking for an AI Consultant to help the largest global enterprises get real business value from Artificial Intelligence on AWS, as part of AWS ProServe India LLP ("ProServe India"). In this role, you will design and build Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), generative AI and agentic AI solutions that run on large volumes of enterprise data and solve a wide range of business problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building ML and DL models and agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use and agent frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. You enjoy diving deep into data, analysing it, finding root causes and designing long-term solutions. You are customer obsessed, love to learn, and want to innovate.
  
  
You will work closely with AWS customers, partners and internal teams, learning from many enterprise use cases and building on Amazon's decades of AI innovation
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the internal customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .
* Assist internal customers by being able to deliver a ML / DL project from beginning to end, including understanding the business need, aggregating data, exploring data, building & validating predictive models, and deploying completed models to deliver business impact to the organization.
* Use Deep Learning frameworks like MXNet, Caffe 2, Tensorflow, Theano, CNTK, and Keras to help our internal customers build DL models. \*Use SparkML and Amazon Machine Learning (AML) to help our internal customers build ML models.
* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data. \*Work with our Professional Services DevOps consultants to help our internal customers operationalize models after they are built.
* Assist internal customers with identifying model drift and retraining models.
* Research and implement novel ML and DL approaches, including using FPGA.
* Expertise in delivery Agentic and Generative AI solutions

**About The Team**
About AWS:
  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool and API integration, memory and guardrails, using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, LangGraph or CrewAI .
* Experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Connect, plus related data and analytics services .
* Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning and evaluating LLM-based applications .
* Proficiency in Python and MLOps/LLMOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code and observability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in customer-facing consulting roles, including turning business problems into technical solutions and presenting to technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working with and enabling partner delivery teams.
* AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, AWS Certified AI Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect .
* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics or a related field.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

Ulsoor Road, Central Bangalore

This role will be instrumental in identifying opportunities, building intelligent systems, and enhancing both customer-facing and backend operations through AI and data.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Strategy & Implementation

+ Identify high-impact AI use cases across all departments
+ Design and deploy AI solutions (predictive analytics, automation tools, optimization models)
+ Build a long-term AI roadmap aligned with business growth and project lifecycle

+ Develop AI-led tools for lead scoring, personalization, and customer engagement
+ Build chatbots, virtual assistants, and recommendation engines
+ Improve conversion funnels using predictive analytics

+ Develop predictive models for delays, cost overruns, and risk management

+ Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Construction, Design, and Leadership teams

title: Sr. Data Research Analyst II
description:
**Senior Data Research Analyst II**
As a Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II, you will operate at the intersection of data, AI, and domain knowledge. You will take ownership of complex data initiatives end-to-end, contribute to shaping how the team leverages AI and data science methods, and work closely with product and customer stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes. This role is for someone with an execution mindset who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into structured, scalable solutions.
  
  
**About our Team:-**
We are looking for a senior, growth-minded data professional to join the Data Discovery and Enrichment (DDE) team. This is a future-ready role designed for someone who brings strong analytical and data science foundations and who is ready to grow into product and customer-facing work.
  
  
**About the Role:-**
As a Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II, you will operate at the intersection of data, AI, and domain knowledge. You will take ownership of complex data initiatives end-to-end, contribute to shaping how the team leverages AI and data science methods, and work closely with product and customer stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes. This role is for someone with an execution mindset who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into structured, scalable solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities:-**
**Data & AI-Driven Discovery**

* Lead complex data discovery, enrichment, and curation initiatives with a high degree of autonomy
* Apply data science techniques and AI/ML tools to improve the quality, coverage, and scalability of data assets
* Design and implement intelligent workflows for source evaluation, entity resolution, and information extraction
* Develop and maintain taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs that power downstream products
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI tooling relevant to data enrichment and research intelligence

**Product & Customer Collaboration**

* Partner with product managers to translate data insights into product features and improvements
* Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand data needs and validate solutions
* Contribute to the product roadmap by identifying data-driven opportunities for domain growth
* Communicate findings, recommendations, and data strategies clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

**Project Execution & Team Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end delivery of data projects, from scoping and planning through execution and review
* Define and drive policies, procedures, and quality standards across the DDE team
* Mentor and support junior team members, providing technical guidance and performance feedback
* Identify and close process gaps; champion a culture of continuous improvement and execution excellence
* Work within agile or project management frameworks to deliver reliably on commitments

**Requirements:**
-
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large, complex, and multi-source datasets
* Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, entity extraction, and classification
* Data science skills: ability to prototype, analyse, and iterate on data pipelines and enrichment models
* Familiarity with relevant databases, data tools, and curation platforms
* Experience creating and maintaining taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, or ontologies
* Track record of applying QA standards rigorously and improving them over time.

**Project Management & Execution**

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex projects on time
* Experience with agile methodologies or structured project management approaches
* Execution-oriented: comfortable moving from strategy to delivery with minimal oversight
* Strong problem-solving skills; able to collect data, identify root causes, and act decisively.

**Communication & Stakeholder Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to adapt style for different audiences
* Confident engaging with customers, product teams, and senior stakeholders
* Ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business language
* Collaborative team player who also takes individual ownership

**Education & Experience**
MS degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative, information, or research-related field, with 7+ years of relevant experience. Experience in academic publishing, research intelligence, or bibliographic data is a strong advantage.
  
  
We particularly welcome candidates whose background spans data science and a domain-adjacent field (e.g. research analytics, information science, knowledge management), and who are motivated to grow into product and customer-facing responsibilities.
  
  
**Work in a Way That Works for You:-**
We promote a healthy work/life balance and provide various well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals to help you meet both your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.
  
  
**Working for You:-**
**Benefits**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free transport pick up and drop from home - office - home. Applicable for Bangalore and Chennai.

**About Business:-**
We are a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science, research, health education, interactive learning and exceptional healthcare and clinical practice.
  
  
At Elsevier, your work contributes to addressing the world's grand challenges and creating a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare, partnering for a better world. What you do every day will help advance science and healthcare to advance human progress
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: ServiceNow Technical Lead
description:
Overview:

As a **ServiceNow Technical Lead** at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.

The Opportunity:

**In this role you will:**

* Act as the technical lead for the ServiceNow platform, providing direction on solution design, configuration, development and integration.
* Take technical ownership of platform health, performance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Establish and maintain ServiceNow development, configuration and technical governance standards.
* Design, configure and develop ServiceNow solutions.
* Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow best practices, favouring standard platform capabilities and controlled configuration over unnecessary customisation.
* Assist with designing and supporting integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise applications.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and provide technical leadership during major or recurring incidents.
* Review technical solutions and developments delivered internally or by implementation partners to ensure quality, security and maintainability.
* Lead the technical planning and delivery of ServiceNow upgrades, patches and releases, including impact assessment, testing and remediation.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve platform performance, automation, security, user experience and technical debt.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, Enterprise Systems, architecture, integration and security teams to translate requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other colleagues working with the platform.

**We would love to hear from you if you:**

* Have a minimum of 8 years' experience working specifically in a ServiceNow Technical Lead, Lead Developer, Technical Consultant or equivalent senior technical ServiceNow role.
* Have strong hands-on experience designing, configuring and developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Have strong knowledge of JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting, including Business Rules, Client Scripts and Script Includes.
* Have practical experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs and ServiceNow integration patterns.
* Have experience designing and implementing secure ServiceNow access controls, including roles and ACLs.
* Have experience leading or providing technical ownership for ServiceNow platform upgrades and releases.
* Understand ServiceNow development and architecture best practices and the importance of maintaining an upgradeable, supportable platform with controlled customisation.
* Have experience troubleshooting complex ServiceNow technical and integration issues.
* Can translate business requirements into clear technical designs and solutions.
* Are comfortable reviewing and challenging technical solutions produced by developers, consultants and implementation partners.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Have strong organisational and prioritisation skills and can balance operational support, technical debt, project delivery and continuous improvement.
* Take a proactive approach to problem solving and technical risk management.
* Enjoy taking technical ownership and continually developing your knowledge of the ServiceNow platform.

**Desirable Experience**

It would be advantageous if you also have experience with:

* ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Knowledge Management.
* ServiceNow CMDB and Configuration Management.
* ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping or Event Management.
* ServiceNow Service Catalog and Employee Center.
* ServiceNow Performance Analytics and reporting.
* ServiceNow IntegrationHub and MID Server implementations.
* Identity and access integrations, including Microsoft Entra ID/SSO.
* Agile delivery using Jira equivalent tooling.
* ITIL or IT Service Management practices.
* Working alongside enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure and integration teams.
* Leading, mentoring or providing technical direction to developers and platform administrators.

**Certifications**

Relevant ServiceNow certifications would be advantageous, particularly:

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* Relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications aligned to the modules being managed

All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

title: Linux Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Linux Systems Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll be responsible for supporting and maintaining Linux-based operating systems in enterprise production environments. In this role, you ensure system availability, stability, performance, and security while meeting defined service levels.

  

**What you will do**

  

You are a hands-on technical professional who manages server operations, resolves incidents, and troubleshoots complex system issues. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you contribute to reliable service delivery, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across infrastructure environments.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* 5+ years of experience administering Linux operating systems in enterprise or production environments.
* Hands‑on experience with Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, or SUSE Linux distributions.
* Experience managing server lifecycle activities, including installation, configuration, hardening, and patching.
* Proven experience resolving incidents and troubleshooting system and performance issues under SLAs.
Intermediate English proficiency for technical documentation and collaboration with global teams.  

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Knowledge of user, permission, and security management (sudo, ACLs, SELinux).
* Experience administering common Linux services such as systemd, cron, SSH, NFS, Samba, Apache, and similar.
* Basic scripting experience for automation (Bash).
* Experience with proactive monitoring, capacity management, and operational documentation.
* RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator) or higher certification.
* Linux Administrator with ECS Experience
Preferred SAP ECS experience.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

You are technical enough to review a timing constraint file or debug a CDC violation yourself, but you also know when to step back and let your engineers solve it. Managing remote teams does not intimidate you because you have learned that clarity, trust, and rhythm matter more than proximity. You can sit in a customer call, extract what they actually need from what they say they want, and walk out with a plan your team can execute against. You think in workflows, not just deliverables. Automation, reusable frameworks, and AI-enabled tooling are not buzzwords to you, they are levers you pull to make your team faster and your subsystems more predictable. You push back when a requirement is vague or a timeline does not match reality, and you do it in a way that keeps the relationship intact.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the architecture, RTL design, integration, and front-end sign-off of DesignWare IP Subsystems from requirements through release
* Manage a local engineering team in Bengaluru, driving execution across design, verification, and implementation while coordinating with global stakeholders
* Own customer communication and requirements translation, ensuring deliverables align with what customers actually need and ship on time
* Drive front-end implementation flows including synthesis timing closure using Fusion Compiler, SpyGlass CDC/RDC checks, low-power architecture, and Formality equivalence checking
* Work hands-on when needed, reviewing RTL, debugging integration issues, authoring verification plans, or resolving critical bottlenecks in the subsystem lifecycle
* Champion AI-enabled methods, workflow automation, and reusable engineering practices to improve team productivity, quality, and cycle time across subsystem programs
* Collaborate across implementation, verification, DFT, and hardening teams to ensure clean handoffs and tape-out readiness
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your subsystems will integrate into SoCs powering AI, automotive, 5G, and IoT products used by millions of people globally
* You will shape how Synopsys subsystems are architected and delivered, setting the standard for quality, predictability, and execution velocity
* Your team will deliver subsystems that reduce customer integration risk and accelerate their time to market
* You will build a culture of automation and reuse that makes every subsequent program faster and more reliable
* Your technical judgment will prevent costly late-stage design issues and keep programs on track through tape-out
* You will mentor engineers who will go on to lead subsystem and SoC programs themselves
* Your leadership will directly influence the adoption of AI-enabled workflows and modern engineering practices across the IP organization
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 10+ years of overall experience
* 4 to 5 years managing engineering teams, ideally remote or distributed teams, with a track record of on-time delivery
* Strong hands-on ASIC or SoC front-end design experience including RTL design, IP/subsystem integration, and taking designs from architecture through front-end execution
* Deep expertise in at least one or two interface protocols such as AMBA (APB, AXI, CHI), DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, UFS, or UCIe
* Experience with front-end implementation flows including CDC/RDC checks using tools like SpyGlass or VC SpyGlass, UPF and low-power intent, design/timing constraints, and DFT handoff
* Proficiency in SystemVerilog, TCL, Perl, or Python for RTL coding, scripting, and automation
* Exposure to ASIC tape-out process, ideally at least one or two tape-outs, and understanding of how subsystems move through verification sign-off, DFT insertion, and hardening
* Exposure to AI-enabled tools and automation frameworks applied to design, verification, or execution efficiency is a plus
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can extract detailed technical requirements from high-level customer specifications and turn them into executable work packages your team understands
* You motivate engineers by giving them clarity, autonomy, and air cover when things get messy, not by micromanaging their work
* You understand verification well enough to evaluate test plans, coverage metrics, and debug strategies even if you are not writing testbenches yourself
* You can explain a complex timing closure issue or a CDC violation to a customer or executive in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* You track progress across multiple moving pieces, five programs, three customers, two tool bring-ups, and you know which one needs your attention today
* You push for automation and reuse not because it sounds good but because you have seen what happens when teams rebuild the same thing three times
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Digital IP Subsystems Team within Synopsys Solutions Group in Bengaluru. This team develops DesignWare IP Subsystem solutions that integrate multiple IP blocks into pre-verified, configurable subsystems, helping customers accelerate SoC development and reduce integration risk. The team works closely with IP design, verification, implementation, and customer engineering teams globally. Your recruiter will

**We Are**
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

**You Are**  
You understand that verification is not about writing tests, it is about building an environment where the right bugs cannot hide, and you have the scars from finding those bugs at 2am to prove it.
  
Leading a team does not mean delegating tasks, it means knowing when to step in, when to let someone struggle productively, and when to rewrite the testbench architecture because the current one will not scale. You have worked with RTL designers who swear their code is clean and architects who change the spec on Thursday, and you have learned to build verification strategies that survive both.
  
Memory protocols like DDR or LPDDR do not intimidate you. Serial interfaces, complex checkers, SystemVerilog assertions that actually mean something, these are tools you reach for without thinking. You care about functional coverage because it tells you what you have not tested yet, not because it is a metric someone asked for. At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that powers real products, with a team that takes verification as seriously as you do.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  

* Lead a team of verification engineers through full IP verification cycles, from test plan definition through coverage closure and signoff
* Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations
* Define test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions, then review and guide implementation across the team
* Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
* Extract, analyze, and drive functional coverage and code coverage metrics to closure, identifying gaps and adjusting strategy in real time
* Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and catch issues early
* Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to keep verification cycles efficient and reliable

  
**The Impact You Will Have**  

* Deliver verification signoff on IP cores that ship in millions of devices, ensuring they work correctly the first time in silicon
* Raise the bar for verification quality across the DesignWare team by mentoring engineers and evolving testbench architecture and methodology
* Catch critical bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months of schedule and customer trust
* Influence IP architecture decisions by surfacing verification insights early, when design changes are still cheap
* Help shape how the team adopts AI-assisted verification flows, improving efficiency without sacrificing rigor
* Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in IP by ensuring that what we deliver is not just feature-complete but robustly verified
* Build verification environments and strategies that other teams will reuse and learn from, multiplying your impact across the organization

**What You'll Need**  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 6+ years of hands-on verification experience
* Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
* Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow
* Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs
* Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage, and using those metrics to drive verification closure
* Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

  
**Who You Are**  

* You can explain a coverage hole to an architect in two sentences and walk out with a plan to close it
* You debug by hypothesis, not by adding print statements until something makes sense
* When a testbench is too slow or too brittle, you refactor it instead of working around it
* You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes the code pass
* You work across time zones and teams without losing context or creating confusion downstream
* You know when to push back on a design decision and when to adjust the verification plan to match reality

  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**  
You will join Synopsys' DesignWare IP Verification R&D team in Bangalore, working with a global group of experienced verification engineers who are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of IP cores that power semiconductors across the industry. This team collaborates closely with RTL designers, architects, and infrastructure engineers to deliver robust, production-ready IP.

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
Job Description

**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking an Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The administrator reports to the VP of IT Operations.

The Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, security and operational health of ACC's Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM environments. The role is the technical owner of both platforms, covering configuration, metadata and dimension management, role design, update readiness, data flow monitoring, reporting and issue resolution, and serves as the primary bridge between Finance and Accounting and IT and as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support. The role is measured heavily by the reliability of the financial close and of the planning and consolidation cycles that depend on it.

Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time, aligned to the Finance and Accounting close and planning calendars, with extended availability during month-end, quarter-end and year-end close and budget and forecast cycles. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, supports Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update windows, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.

**PRIMARY ROLE**

  

* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud ERP Financials modules, which may include General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Procurement, Subledger Accounting and Projects.
* Perform application configuration through Functional Setup Manager and migrate configuration between environments using configuration packages.
* Maintain enterprise structures and accounting configuration, including ledgers, legal entities, business units, chart of accounts and value sets, accounting calendars and currency setup.
* Configure and maintain approval workflows for invoices, payments, expenses, requisitions and journals, and troubleshoot workflow failures and stuck approvals.
* Support period open and close activities, resolving close-blocking errors, unposted transactions and interface exceptions, and monitor the Enterprise Scheduler for failed or long-running processes.
* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud EPM applications, which may include Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, Narrative Reporting and Enterprise Data Management.
* Own EPM metadata and dimension maintenance, keeping hierarchies aligned to the ERP chart of accounts and enterprise structures through a controlled request, validation and promotion process.
* Develop, maintain and tune business rules and calculations using Calculation Manager, including allocations, currency translation and aggregations.
* Maintain EPM forms, dashboards, task lists and valid intersections, and administer consolidation, intercompany elimination, close task management and account reconciliation processes.
* Manage EPM maintenance operations, including snapshots, Lifecycle Management artifact migration and test-to-production promotion, and automate recurring tasks using EPM Automate and/or REST APIs.
* Design and maintain ERP and EPM security to least privilege, and administer user provisioning, modification and termination in coordination with the IAM team and strictly through approved request workflow.
* Maintain single sign-on and identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID, analyze and remediate segregation of duties conflicts, and support periodic user access reviews.
* Own the Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles end to end, including readiness review, impact assessment, regression testing, user acceptance testing coordination and scheduling around close and planning calendars.
* Serve as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support for ERP and EPM, driving and escalating service requests through to resolution.
* Own the ERP-to-EPM data flow, including Data Integration / Data Management setup, mapping and validation that loaded balances tie to the general ledger.
* Monitor and troubleshoot financial integrations and data loads, including FBDI, ADF Desktop Integration, banking and payment interfaces, and integrations with the property management platform and other upstream and downstream systems.
* Build and maintain reporting using OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio, Management Reporting, Narrative Reporting and Smart View.
* Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 support for Finance and Accounting users, managing a ServiceNow ticket queue from receipt through resolution, and prioritize close-blocking and cycle-blocking issues above all other work.
* Follow change management for all production configuration, metadata and business rule changes, and support internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent control testing with access and change evidence.
* Document configuration, metadata processes, business rules and runbooks, and train Finance super users, budget holders and reconciliation preparers to reduce recurring ticket volume.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving Oracle Cloud ERP and EPM best practices and communicate relevant improvements to Finance, team members and leadership.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing financial, plan, forecast, vendor or bank data or configuration secrets to unapproved tools.
* Experience applying generative AI responsibly to documentation, test scripts, business rule and SQL development and release note analysis, with human validation before anything touches production or the financial record.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials architecture, module interaction and the accounting flow from subledger through Subledger Accounting to General Ledger.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM architecture, including cube structure, dimensionality, calculation behavior and the performance implications of metadata design.
* Working knowledge of consolidation, close management, account reconciliation and planning and forecasting processes, and how configuration affects reported results.
* Knowledge of Oracle Cloud security models for ERP and EPM and of segregation of duties principles and compensating controls.
* Working SQL skills for analysis, reconciliation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITIL-aligned incident, request and change management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between accounting language and application configuration across cultures and time zones.
* Strong project- and time-management skills, with a systematic, organized approach and high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to treat the integrity of the books as the highest priority and work calmly and accurately under close deadlines.
* Ability to say no to an unreviewed production change and explain the reasoning in terms Finance leadership will accept.
* Ability to learn new concepts and software quickly and take a proactive approach to platform enhancements.
* Ability to think logically and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

  

* At least five years of experience administering or supporting enterprise financial systems, including at least three years with Oracle Cloud ERP Financials.
* At least two years of hands-on experience administering Oracle Cloud EPM, including Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close or Account Reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience with EPM metadata maintenance, Calculation Manager, Data Integration, Lifecycle Management and EPM Automate, and with Functional Setup Manager and configuration packages.
* Demonstrated experience managing Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles, including regression testing and user acceptance testing coordination.
* Experience supporting audit and internal control requirements is required; SOX experience and real estate, property management or student housing industry experience are preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems or a related field; equivalent work experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**CERTIFICATES & LICENSES**

  

* Oracle Cloud Financials Implementation Professional (General Ledger, Payables or Receivables).
* Oracle Cloud Planning Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Financial Consolidation and Close Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Account Reconciliation Implementation Professional is a plus.
* Oracle Cloud Applications Security or Enterprise Structures certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals.
* CompTIA SecAI+ (Security AI+).
* ITIL Foundation is a plus.

description:
**About Us:**

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture

transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra

Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water

accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a

commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections,

manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.

Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-

Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with

industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been

named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and

purpose-driven growth.

**About The Role:**

The Account Manager – Government Business will be responsible for managing and growing

relationships with government customers across South India. The role focuses on ensuring successful

project delivery, operational monitoring, collections, customer satisfaction, contract renewals, and

identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell Solinas; product and software portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Relationship Management**

a. Serve as the primary point of contact for Municipal Corporations, Water Boards,

Sewerage Boards, and other government utility customers, ensuring strong engagement

and smooth coordination across all ongoing projects and commercial activities.

b. Build and maintain long-term relationships with key stakeholders, including Engineers,

Executive Engineers, Superintending Engineers, Chief Engineers, Commissioners, and

Board officials, to strengthen Solinas presence and drive customer success.

c. Conduct regular customer review meetings to track project performance, address

operational challenges, communicate value delivered, and identify opportunities for

contract renewals and business expansion.

d. Monitor customer satisfaction and overall account health, proactively resolving issues

and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful project outcomes and long-

term customer retention.

**2. Operations & Project Monitoring**

a. Monitor ongoing O&M contracts and service delivery performance against agreed SLAs,

ensuring high standards of execution and consistent customer satisfaction across all

deployed projects.

b. Coordinate closely with operations and field teams to ensure timely project execution,

effective resource deployment, and seamless resolution of operational challenges.

c. Maintain accurate records of project performance, customer interactions, and action

items, enabling effective account management and informed decision-making.

title: Service Engineer Warehouse
description:
Hiring: Warehouse Service Engineer – Fitness Equipment (QC & Refurbishment)

**Location:**
Chennai

**Department:**
Warehouse Operations

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Industry:**
Fitness Equipment / E-commerce

**Qualification:**
ITI / Diploma / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering

Job Overview

We are looking for a technically skilled and hands-on
**Warehouse Service Engineer**
to manage quality inspections, functional testing, troubleshooting, repairs, and refurbishment of fitness equipment received through customer returns at our warehouse.

The candidate will be responsible for inspecting returned products, identifying technical and physical defects, conducting functional tests, and determining whether products are suitable for resale, require refurbishment, or should be classified as QC Failed.

This role requires practical technical expertise, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to independently manage daily QC and refurbishment targets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Quality Inspection & Functional Testing**

* Perform daily quality checks and functional testing of customer-returned fitness equipment.
* Inspect a minimum of 50 units per day, in line with warehouse productivity targets.
* Inspect products such as treadmills, spin bikes, walking pads, massage chairs, elliptical trainers, exercise cycles, and other fitness equipment.
* Check motor performance, displays, control panels, electrical connections, sensors, belts, and mechanical components.
* Identify used, damaged, defective, and non-functional products.

**2. Refurbishment & Repair Management**

* Troubleshoot technical and mechanical issues in returned fitness equipment.
* Perform minor repairs and refurbishment wherever possible.
* Identify and recommend spare parts required to make products suitable for resale.
* Coordinate with warehouse teams for spare parts, repair materials, and technical support.
* Ensure refurbished products meet the required quality standards before approval for resale.

**3. QC Grading & Inventory Classification**

Classify products based on their physical and functional condition:

* **QC Pass / Grade A:**
  Fully functional and in acceptable condition, ready for resale.
* **QC Refurbishment Required:**
  Minor technical or physical issues requiring repair before resale.
* **QC Fail:**
  Major damage, technical failure, or products not suitable for resale.

Additional responsibilities:

* Maintain accurate QC records and update product inspection status.
* Capture product defects and damages through photographs wherever required.
* Ensure accurate grading with no discrepancies between the physical condition and QC status.

**4. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain daily QC and refurbishment reports.
* Track units inspected, QC Passed, QC Failed, and units pending refurbishment.
* Maintain SKU-wise and category-wise defect reports.
* Identify recurring product issues and highlight them to the concerned teams.
* Share daily productivity reports and pending QC updates with warehouse management.

**5. Coordination & Process Improvement**

* Coordinate with Warehouse Operations, Category, and Technical Teams to ensure smooth refurbishment operations.
* Support inventory liquidation and resale processes based on QC grading.
* Identify common product failures and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and maintenance of returned fitness equipment.
* Follow warehouse safety standards and technical inspection SOPs.

Required Technical Skills

* Good technical knowledge of electrical and mechanical fitness equipment.
* Hands-on experience in troubleshooting and repairing fitness products.
* Knowledge of motors, controllers, wiring, sensors, displays, circuit boards, and mechanical assemblies.
* Ability to identify technical defects and perform functional testing.
* Experience in product QC, repair, servicing, and refurbishment.
* Basic knowledge of spare parts identification and replacement.
* Good reporting and documentation skills.
* Basic working knowledge of MS Excel.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Daily QC Productivity:**
  Minimum 50 units inspected per day.
* **QC Accuracy:**
  Accurate product inspection and grading.
* **Functional Testing:**
  Testing of all applicable product functions.
* **QC Reporting:**
  Timely submission of daily reports.
* **Refurbishment TAT:**
  Timely completion of repairable products.
* **Defect Identification:**
  Accurate identification of technical and physical defects.
* **Resale Readiness:**
  QC-approved products must meet resale quality standards.
* **Safety & SOP Compliance:**
  Adherence to warehouse safety and QC procedures.

Educational Qualification & Experience

* ITI / Diploma / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 2–5 years of experience in servicing, repairing, or maintaining electrical and mechanical equipment.
* Experience with fitness equipment, gym equipment, treadmills, exercise cycles, and massage chairs will be an added advantage.
* Experience in e-commerce returns QC and product refurbishment will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Strong hands-on technical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently inspect, diagnose, and repair fitness equipment.
* Strong ownership and accountability towards daily QC targets.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a warehouse environment and handling multiple product categories.
* Focus on product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Important Hiring Note

This is a
**hands-on warehouse technical role**
focused on daily fitness equipment inspection, functional testing, troubleshooting, repair, QC grading, and refurbishment.

Candidates with only theoretical engineering knowledge and no practical servicing or repair experience may not be suitable for this position.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resumes or apply directly.**

A Mechanical Design Engineer working in a sewerage treatment plant (STP) is responsible for designing, selecting, and supporting the installation of mechanical equipment used to treat wastewater safely and efficiently.

5. Collect material submittal in the format provided by the client including compliance statementagainst specification, review technical submittal and prepare for the submission to client

6. Preparation of testing and commissioning procedure and check list for construction team

**EPC Projects – Only client requirements are provided (no Engineering)**

7. Prepare deliverable list for engineering and share with project team.

8. Prepare the schedule for engineering deliverables with estimated manhours

9. Sizing of mechanical equipment based on high level design provided by the process engineerbasis—pumps, blowers, HVAC, fire systems. HVAC, Fire Fighting based on the Authoritiesregulations. Should be familiar with Civil Defense codes, ASHRAE, ASTM, ASME, AWWA

10. Making the pipe and valve and diffuser sizing based on the flow rate and high-level designprovided by the process engineer.

11. Perform analysis (Surge, Stress, CFD, Structure) or get it done through third party, provide input tothird party consultants to do surge analysis, stress analysis, CFD, HAP calculations and structuralanalysis.

12. review and submit to client. (Basic knowledge about the software used to do such analysis andKnowledge about key factors for reviewing this analysis.)

13. Preparing technical data sheet for pump, valve, pipe, blower, HVAC, firefighting system, diffusers,grids.

14. Prepare the RFQ documents and share with Procurement team with Approved vendor list and withalternate vendor list.

15. Communicating with vendors for technical documents and support procurement team fortechnical points affecting commercial part.

16. Preparation of material submittal for submitting to client, reply to CRS

17. Provide technical input for drafting team to develop P&ID, detailed drawings, civil guide drawingsand shop drawings for construction

18. Review all drawings before releasing for construction, or for manufacturing

19. Making of detailed bill of quantity to purchase materials (with clear specifications and standards)20. Ensure the drafting team provide clear and detailed builder’s drawing to civil team.

**Job Description**

**1. Design Responsibilities**

• Design mechanical systems used in wastewater treatment processes.

• Prepare equipment layouts, piping layouts, and mechanical drawings.Design systems for:

o Pumps

o Blowers

o Mixers

o Screens

o Sludge handling equipment

o Aeration systems

Ensure designs meet project specifications, environmental regulations, and safety standards.

**2. Equipment Selection**

• Select suitable equipment based on plant capacity and process requirements.

• Evaluate vendor technical specifications.

• Prepare technical data sheets for equipment procurement.

• Review supplier drawings and approve them.

**3. Engineering Calculations**

Perform calculations for:

• Pump sizing

• Pipe sizing

• Flow rates

• Pressure losses

• Power requirements

• Ensure equipment efficiency and reliability.

**4. Drawings and Documentation**

Prepare and review:

• Material Submittal preparation

• Mechanical General Arrangement (GA) drawings

• Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID)

• Equipment layout drawings

• Fabrication drawings

Use software like:

o AutoCAD

o SolidWorks

o Autodesk Inventor

**5. Coordination**

Coordinate with:

o Civil engineers

o Electrical engineers

o Process engineers

o ContractorsEnsure mechanical systems integrate properly with plant structures and controls.

**6. Site Support**

Provide technical support during:

o Equipment installation

o Commissioning

o Testing

**Key Skills**

Require Mechanical system design

Knowledge of wastewater treatment processes

CAD software proficiency

Equipment sizing and selection

Understanding of piping systems

Project coordination skills
