title: Microsoft Control Access - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Administer, design, and govern Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies across production and non-production environments, including policy assignments, conditions, grant controls, session controls, naming standards, and exclusion governance.
* Configure and support access controls for users, groups, roles, cloud applications, guests, workload identities, and devices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), authentication strengths, compliant or hybrid-joined device requirements, and risk-based policies.
* Manage the policy lifecycle through What If analysis, report-only mode, phased rollouts, change records, testing, approvals, rollback planning, post-change validation, and emergency-access account monitoring.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for sign-in and access issues; analyze policy evaluation details, Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, KQL queries, and Microsoft Sentinel data; and manage incident, service request, problem, and change activities in ServiceNow.
* Automate repeatable policy reporting, backup, drift detection, and administration using approved tools, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell; maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
* Lead client operational reviews and policy-design workshops; coordinate onsite and offshore activities; mentor junior staff; communicate access impacts and remediation actions; and contribute technical insights to managed-services solution design.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
**Must Have Skills/ Project Experience/ Certifications**

* 6 -10 years total experience in IAM or cybersecurity operations, including at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Entra Conditional Access in an operational or managed services capacity.
* Expert knowledge of Conditional Access: policy design, grant and session controls, authentication strengths, continuous access evaluation, token protection, report-only mode and What If analysis, risk-based policies (Entra ID Protection), device compliance (Intune), named locations, and emergency-access account design.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity: Active Directory, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, PIM, B2B collaboration, SSO and federation (SAML, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect), and MFA/passwordless authentication.
* Solid understanding of Zero Trust and least privilege principles, and of compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53/800-207, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.
* Technological skills in automation, PowerShell scripting, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, and KQL for troubleshooting, reporting, and monitoring.
* Deep understanding of operational processes, incident resolution, change management, and compliance management; proficiency with process documentation, SLAs, reporting, and ITSM practices (ServiceNow).
* Experience leading support teams, mentoring juniors, and managing enhancement/implementation projects; able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and clients at all levels.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300); ITIL.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
* Experience with Global Secure Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Defender XDR, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot agents, or Conditional Access policy-as-code (Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Microsoft365DSC, CI/CD pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with other identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Ping) or privileged access tools used in managed services.
* Involvement in process improvement or internal training; CISSP, CISM, or CCSP certification

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Senior Manager – Human Resources**

**Company:**
Pace Active Designs

**Designation:**
Senior Manager – Human Resources

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Reporting To:**
Founder

**Location:**
Chennai

**Salary : 65-75k CTC**

**1. Job Purpose**

Pace Active Designs is looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Manager – Human Resources to independently lead and manage the complete HR function of the organisation.

The individual will be expected to take complete ownership of HR operations, responsible for developing and implementing HR policies, managing the entire employee lifecycle, driving talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, compensation and benefits, learning and development, employee relations and statutory compliance.

The role requires a proactive HR professional who can establish structured HR processes, strengthen organisational culture, improve employee productivity and work closely with management to align HR initiatives with business objectives.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. HR Strategy & Organisational Development**

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Work closely with management and departmental heads on organisational and manpower planning.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, systems and standard operating processes.
* Drive organisational effectiveness, employee productivity and workforce planning.
* Advise management on people-related matters and organisational issues.
* Build a professional, disciplined and performance-oriented work culture.

**B. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* Take complete ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process across all functions and levels.
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare recruitment plans in consultation with department heads.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies through job portals, consultants, references and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct initial screening, coordinate interviews and manage the selection process.
* Ensure timely closure of positions with the right talent.
* Manage salary negotiations, offer releases, background verification and joining formalities.
* Build a talent pipeline for critical positions.

**C. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from onboarding to separation.
* Develop and implement structured employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Ensure timely preparation of appointment letters, employment contracts and other HR documentation.
* Maintain employee personal files, records and HR databases.
* Manage confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments and employee movements.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyse employee separation trends.
* Ensure smooth and professional employee separation processes.

**D. Performance Management System**

* Design and implement an effective Performance Management System (PMS).
* Develop and monitor KRAs and KPIs in consultation with departmental heads.
* Coordinate periodic performance reviews and annual appraisal cycles.
* Facilitate performance discussions between managers and employees.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Support management in decisions relating to promotions, increments and career progression.
* Develop a performance-driven and accountability-oriented work culture.

**E. Compensation, Payroll & Benefits Administration**

* Manage monthly payroll processing, salary administration and employee benefits.
* Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursement.
* Manage attendance, leave records, overtime and employee deductions.
* Coordinate salary revisions, annual increments, incentives and bonus administration.
* Prepare and monitor manpower budgets and employee cost reports.
* Ensure proper maintenance of payroll records and compensation documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance and external payroll service providers wherever applicable.

**F. Statutory Compliance & HR Administration**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, bonus and other applicable statutory obligations.
* Ensure timely statutory returns, payments, registrations and maintenance of records.
* Coordinate statutory inspections and labour department requirements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Shops and Establishments legislation, Factories Act provisions and other employment-related regulations, as applicable to the organisation's establishments.
* Implement and monitor POSH policies and workplace safety requirements.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors and legal advisors on labour and employment matters.
* Keep management updated on regulatory changes and compliance risks.

**G. Employee Engagement & Industrial Relations**

* Develop initiatives to improve employee engagement, satisfaction and retention.
* Establish effective employee communication and feedback mechanisms.
* Address employee grievances and resolve workplace issues.
* Handle disciplinary matters, investigations and employee relations.
* Promote a healthy, transparent and collaborative work environment.
* Conduct employee engagement activities and internal communication initiatives.
* Monitor attrition and absenteeism and recommend corrective actions.
* Build a culture of discipline, ownership and mutual respect.

**H. Learning & Development**

* Identify training needs across departments.
* Prepare and implement an annual training calendar.
* Organise functional, behavioural and leadership development programmes.
* Conduct induction and orientation training for new employees.
* Develop supervisory and managerial capabilities.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and employee development outcomes.

**I. HR Systems, MIS & Process Management**

* Establish and maintain comprehensive HR policies and SOPs.
* Implement or strengthen HRMS and employee information systems.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS and management dashboards.
* Track key HR metrics including:
* Headcount and manpower cost.
* Recruitment and vacancy status.
* Employee attrition and retention.
* Attendance and absenteeism.
* Payroll and statutory compliance.
* Training hours and effectiveness.
* Performance appraisal status.
* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of employee records.
* Continuously improve HR processes and operational efficiency.

**3. Key Deliverables & Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Senior Manager – HR will be measured on:

1. Timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
2. Quality of recruitment and employee retention.
3. Effective implementation of HR policies and processes.
4. Accuracy and timeliness of monthly payroll.
5. 100% compliance with applicable statutory requirements and timelines.
6. Successful implementation of the performance appraisal system.
7. Reduction in avoidable employee attrition and absenteeism.
8. Employee engagement and grievance resolution.
9. Implementation of training and development initiatives.
10. Timely submission of HR MIS and management reports.
11. Improvement in overall workforce productivity and organisational discipline.

**4. Qualification & Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a recognised institution.
* 10–15 years of relevant HR experience, preferably with at least 4–5 years in a managerial HR role.
* Experience in independently managing the complete HR function.
* Strong experience in recruitment, payroll, statutory compliance, employee relations, performance management and HR operations.
* Experience in manufacturing, apparel, fashion, activewear, textiles or related industries is mandated
* Exposure to managing both white-collar and blue-collar workforces will be preferred.
* Good working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS and payroll systems.

**5. Key Competencies & Personal Attributes**

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Hands-on approach with the ability to independently execute HR activities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong understanding of business and organisational requirements.
* High levels of integrity, confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with maturity and fairness.
* Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.
* Proactive, approachable and solution-oriented mindset.

**6. What We Expect from the Candidate**

The selected candidate should be capable of independently managing the entire HR function at Pace Active Designs, with minimal supervision.

The individual should bring structure, discipline and professionalism to HR operations, build strong relationships with employees and management, and ensure that all HR processes are implemented effectively.

The candidate must be equally comfortable handling strategic HR responsibilities and hands-on operational activities.

**The ultimate objective is to establish a robust, efficient and people-oriented HR function that supports business growth, employee development and organisational excellence at Pace Active Designs.**

﻿

Warwick Consulting LLC is a US-based consulting organization providing specialized professional services to clients across medical devices and healthcare.

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Client Contracts & Billing Specialist to join our Chennai operations team.

The ideal candidate will independently manage client contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Purchase Orders (POs), invoicing, contract documentation, and professional email communication with US-based clients.

Maintain an organized repository of executed contracts, amendments, and supporting documentation.

Track contract validity, renewals, expiration dates, deliverables, and commercial terms.

Ensure contract documents follow approved company templates and agreed commercial terms, escalating legal or contractual concerns when necessary.

Client Invoicing & Purchase Order Management

Prepare and submit accurate client invoices based on approved timesheets, contractual billing rates, and PO terms.

Track Purchase Orders, available balances, budget utilization, and billing schedules.

Reconcile invoiced amounts against approved hours and contractual commitments.

Monitor outstanding invoices, payment due dates, and follow up on pending payments.

Coordinate invoice corrections, cancellations, and billing discrepancies with clients and internal teams.

Maintain accurate invoice trackers and monthly billing reports.

Client Communication & Coordination

Manage professional email correspondence with US-based clients regarding contracts, invoicing, POs, and documentation.

Coordinate with client procurement, finance, and accounts payable teams.

Follow up on pending contract approvals, PO issuance, invoice acceptance, and payment status.

Communicate effectively with internal operations, finance, and leadership teams.

Maintain timely and professional communication across all client interactions.

Reporting & Compliance

Maintain contract registers, invoice trackers, PO utilization reports, and accounts receivable summaries.

Prepare weekly and monthly status reports for management.

Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and proper documentation of client commercial information.

Identify discrepancies and proactively escalate potential billing or contractual issues.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

title: Project Consultant – EdTech and AI
description:
**About Central Square Foundation**
About the job Project Consultant - EdTech and AI
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech; Early Childhood Education (ECE); and Schools Governance.
  
  
Read more about our work here: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech At CSF**
CSF's EdTech initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to implement EdTech solutions and influence policy.
* Funding public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching 2.5 million learners across India.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of learning for India's children and help build an EdTech ecosystem that is evidence-driven, tech-enabled, scalable and equitable.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Central Square Foundation aims to work closely with the Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu, by providing support for the adoption and implementation of EdTech programs for the K-12 schooling system in the state. This position is a
**full-time**
assignment as part of the CSF's EdTech and AI team for this purpose. The consultant will be expected to support the execution of live projects and help start new projects by working closely with senior and junior officers in the department towards commonly aligned milestones.
  
  
﻿
**Location**
**Chennai, Tamil Nadu**
**Key Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* ﻿Engage with relevant stakeholders within DSE-TN, including state, district, block, and school-level officials, to understand implementation progress and challenges. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely execution and resolution of implementation challenges.
* Undertake school visits, lead consultations with stakeholders to identify any implementation gaps, challenges, opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations for strengthening EdTech initiatives in the state.
* Support DSE-TN in the end-to-end planning, implementation, monitoring, and scale-up of EdTech and AI education initiatives. This would include, but not limited to, developing pilot proposals whenever necessary, defining objectives, creating implementation roadmap and strategies, identifying resource requirements, aligning stakeholders, creating monitoring framework, and defining expected outcomes.
* Analyze data and glean meaningful insights for driving adoption, student engagement, EdTech platform usage, and uptake of EdTech programs by students and teachers in schools
* Coordinate with CSF internal teams, technology partners, academic institutions, and implementation agencies to drive project execution, under the supervision of the team lead
* Prepare analytical reports, progress updates, meeting notes, presentations to inform departmental decision-making.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**

* ﻿Bachelor's or equivalent degree required
* Minimum 4 years of work experience demonstrating strong project delivery
* Proficiency in English and Tamil (Written and Verbal) is mandatory
* Strong solution-oriented mindset with continuously seeking ways to move tasks forward despite challenges to achieve project goals efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to independently address and resolve issues by leveraging data, considering alternative approaches, and weighing their pros and cons meticulously
* Comfort with large-scale data, its analysis and reporting as per the audience profile
* Ability to build and maintain positive and collaborative relationships both within and outside the organisation, including with government stakeholders across hierarchies, EdTech product vendors, donor organisations, colleagues, researchers, and any other relevant stakeholders
* Ability to conduct and facilitate meetings with confidence, ensuring discussions are productive, objectives are met, and follow-ups are clearly defined.
* Ability to conduct and facilitate meetings with confidence, ensuring discussions are productive, objectives are met, and representing CSF to external audiences
* Ability to create detailed presentations, reports, and documentation that are thorough, accurate, and tailored to audience needs.
* Strong execution, planning, and organisational skills, and an ability to be able to set priorities, plan timelines and meet deadlines

**Compensation**

**Analytics & Operational Metrics**

* Extract, compile, and track performance data using Salesforce and community analytics to measure the reach and efficacy of enablement collateral and communications.
* Monitor operational adoption metrics across partner-facing systems (community visits, training completion, engagement drop-offs, certification volumes).
* Build structured monthly and quarterly dashboards to identify readiness gaps and inform leadership decisions.

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of hands-on experience in partner operations, channel enablement coordination, customer success operations, or related B2B operational support roles within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
* **Channel & Ecosystem Fluency:**
  Prior experience operating within a partner or customer ecosystem and a clear understanding of front-end operational workflows.
* **Technical Systems:**
  Direct hands-on experience administering community platforms or partner-facing systems, alongside practical experience querying data and building reports in Salesforce.
* **Execution & Ownership:**
  Demonstrated self-starter mentality with the ability to take initiative, solve problems independently, and thrive in a role where processes are evolving.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with proven ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams in different time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  Direct administrative experience with
  **Gainsight**

* **Ecosystem Tooling:**
  Familiarity with modern enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, CMS platforms) and automated workflow tools.

Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role description:**
The Senior ITS Operations & Maintenance Specialist will lead the supervision and performance monitoring of the Contractor’s operations, maintenance and training activities for the Chennai Traffic Information System, City Bus System and Traffic Management System. The role will support the Client through independent review of system performance, maintenance compliance, service levels, incidents, corrective actions, training and management reporting.
  
  
**Role accountabilities:**

* Supervise the Contractor’s O&M and training activities for the Chennai Traffic Information System, City Bus System and Traffic Management System.
* Monitor Contractor performance and verify compliance with the Contract, approved O&M manuals, maintenance schedules and applicable SLAs/KPIs.
* Review preventive, routine, corrective and emergency maintenance activities and recommend corrective actions for delays, repeated failures or non-compliance.
* Monitor system availability, uptime, incident response, restoration time, repeat failures and backlog of unresolved issues.
* Review major incident reports and Root Cause Analysis reports, and track corrective and preventive actions through closure.
* Review O&M staffing, shift arrangements, escalation procedures, tools, spares, warranties, asset records and field-support arrangements.
* Participate in trial operations, operational-readiness reviews, acceptance-related activities and O&M handover assessments, as required.
* Review and supervise training plans, training materials, SOPs and knowledge-transfer activities for Client personnel, operators and maintenance teams.
* Attend meetings with the Client and stakeholders and present O&M status, risks, non-compliances, action plans and recommendations.
* Prepare or contribute to monthly, quarterly, SLA, incident, technical and O&M performance reports.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Educational Qualification**
Mandatory
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering or Traffic Engineering, in line with the Consultant RFP.

**Preferred**

* Postgraduate qualification in Transportation Systems, Intelligent Transportation Systems, Traffic Engineering, Systems Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL (will be an advantage)

**Experience Requirements**
RFP Minimum Eligibility
  
  

* Minimum seven years of working experience in the field of Traffic Management.
* Minimum three years of working experience in an ITS-related centre.

Enhanced Recruitment Criteria
  
  

* Minimum 12 years of overall professional experience, including at least eight years in ITS, traffic management, public transport ITS or smart-mobility assignments.
* Minimum five years of direct experience in ITS operations and maintenance, O&M supervision or technical support management.
* Experience in at least three relevant ITS, Smart City, public transport, traffic-management or command-and-control projects.
* Demonstrated experience in Contractor/System Integrator management, SLA and KPI verification, incident management, preventive and corrective maintenance, operational readiness and acceptance support.
* Experience in Client-facing technical reviews, management reporting, training and knowledge transfer.

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

title: Microsoft Purview DLP/MPIP - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Provide advanced technical support for Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP), including sensitivity labels, label policies, auto-labeling, encryption, and complex issue escalation.
* Monitor and improve the health, scalability, and security of Purview DLP and MPIP configurations, clients, and connected agents; maintain secure versions and mitigate identified risks.
* Troubleshoot DLP policy and sensitivity-label deployments, label-policy and auto-labeling behavior, Endpoint DLP onboarding and agent synchronization, and alert and incident triage.
* Manage the lifecycle of DLP policies and sensitivity labels, including policy tuning, simulation mode, enforcement rollout, exception handling, change control, and reviews of Activity Explorer and Content Explorer.
* Architect automated monitoring, alerting, and remediation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, Microsoft Sentinel, and Power Automate; analyze service trends to reduce recurring issues and false positives.
* Prepare audit documentation, address identified gaps, translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for business and IT leaders, and support onboarding and training for new users and junior staff.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 6 - 10 years of experience in advanced technical support and operational leadership for
* Data Protection solutions, with hands-on experience operating Microsoft Purview DLP and MPIP.
* Strong working knowledge of sensitivity labels, label and auto-labeling policies, encryption and rights management, and DLP policies across Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints (Endpoint DLP).
* Expertise in troubleshooting, risk mitigation, and solution upgrades.Experience architecting automated monitoring and remediation solutions (PowerShell, Graph API, KQL).
* Strong compliance and audit documentation skills.
* Proven ability to mentor and train junior staff.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Experience with process optimization and service improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud security and the wider Microsoft security stack (Microsoft Defender,
* Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps).
* Experience with Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance or eDiscovery in Microsoft Purview.
* Certification: Microsoft SC-401 (Information Security Administrator) or SC-400 (Information Protection Administrator), SC-200, CISM or equivalent Security certifications (Azure / AWS / GCP).

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Platform Distribution Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Platform Distribution Architect**
to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers.

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments.

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Distribution Architecture**

* Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK.
* Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments.

**2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness**

* Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers.
* Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Design**

* Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes.
* Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies.

**4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation**

* Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows.
* Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes.

**5. CI/CD and Release Automation**

* Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration.
* Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability.

**6. Self-Service Distribution**

* Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces.
* Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers.

**7. Upgrades and Migrations**

* Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes.
* Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation.

**8. Observability and Reliability**

* Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments.

**9. Security and Compliance**

* Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code.

**10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency**

* Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations.
* Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency.

**11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership**

* Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover.
* Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews.

**What You Bring**

* **Multi-cloud architecture:**
  Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or GCP — covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security.
* **Kubernetes and containers:**
  Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* **CI/CD and release automation:**
  Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as Code:**
  Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools.
* **Deployment architecture:**
  Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation.
* **Observability and reliability:**
  Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.
* **Programming and scripting:**
  Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell.
* **Core technical fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals.

**Good to Have**

* Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries.
* Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python.
* Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture.
* Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

**Interested?**

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you.

* Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

In this role, you will own and evolve our GxP-compliant A&R integration product—part of Clinical Development Platforms—used across late-stage science teams spanning all therapeutic areas. Joining a high-performing BizDevOps team, you will collaborate closely with Product Leads, DevOps Leads, and engineers to design, build, and run integrations on MuleSoft and SnapLogic. Do you see yourself simplifying complex landscapes and creating reusable patterns that others rely on? Your work will strengthen our clinical data flows, reduce incidents through automation, and ensure robust operations that stand up to regulatory scrutiny.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Clinical Integration Leadership: Serve as an internal consultant and Clinical domain authority for IT and business partners across regions and business areas; provide guidance and consulting to clients on the best use of A&R during study execution, connecting platform capabilities to study outcomes.
* Agile Discovery and Design: Participate in business requirement gathering and design activities with business and IT collaborators as part of the scrum team; translate needs into clear integration designs and handle/update the JIRA board across requirements, configuration, validation/testing, training, and release activities.
* Delivery Excellence: Perform delivery activities through Design, Build, Test, and Deploy phases for regular releases and key platform initiatives; drive small modules in support transitions and ensure application stability when taking over BAU support of new applications.
* A&R Extensions and Configuration: Design and build extensions for A&R to accommodate custom business flows; maintain configuration specification documentation for both functional and integration configuration; assist in the preparation of system-related specifications and documentation.
* Secure, Compliant Operations: Ensure that all system security and control procedures are implemented and maintained; work with the A&R technical team on requirements and issues related to SAS API, security setup, and functional configuration; operate to GxP standards across Clinical Development Platforms.
* Work in close coordination with the Integration Platform team to revise, refresh, and support integration interfaces. Develop integration pipelines based on established architectural models and compose reusable components. Partner with the Integration DevOps Lead and vendor teams to build new integrations and coordinate current ones.
* Service Reliability and Automation: Resolve day-to-day incidents and service requests, working toward incident reduction and automation; update ServiceNow for incidents, service requests, changes, and problems; maintain application systems in operation, identifying and troubleshooting application issues to minimize downtime.
* Landscape Simplification: Generate and implement ideas to simplify and streamline the integration landscape in alignment with integration design and patterns, improving delivery speed and reliability for study execution.
* CI/CD and Change Integration: Integrate CI/CD processes into existing Change and Configuration Management scope (ServiceNow and JIRA); align delivery with the IT Service Delivery Framework to ensure traceability and control.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* 6-8 years meaningful experience in clinical development and/ or software development environment preferred, with particular emphasis on SAS related applications experience.
* End to end knowledge of clinical trial development processes and its associated system landscape.
* Knowledge and experience in integration technologies – Mulesoft, Snaplogic.
* Experience with Cloud Platforms such as AWS, AZURE
* Knowledge of SQL to write queries to help understand the integration requirements to be enabled via API led integrations. within Platform.
* Knowledge of support processes like Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and experience working in support teams.
* Atleast proven experience related to API Terminologies and API Integration – preferably Mulesoft & Snaplogic
* Excellent SQL knowledge pertaining to Relational databases including RDS, Snowflake, PostGres
* Proficiency in developing, deploying, and debugging cloud-based applications using AWS.
* Ensures following IT Service Delivery Framework adhered on AD activities.
* Ability to organize and prioritize work, meets deadlines, and work independently.
* Strong problem-solving skill
* Experience with process tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with people across the globe with diverse cultures and backgrounds.
* Experience of working in agile teams using methodologies such as SCRUM, Kanban and SAFe.
* Experience in integration of CI/CD processes into existing Change & Configuration Management scope (i.e. ServiceNow & Jira)
* Educational Requirements: Bachelor or master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science or life science related rigor with IT/CRO/Pharma experience with total of 10+ years of similar experience

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Certifications such as: Microsoft new roles-based certifications, SC-300, AZ-500,AZ-800, AZ-801, SC-100,CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, CCNP, CCNA certification a plus.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**About the Company**

Pickyourtrail is a consumer-tech travel company that enables travellers to discover, plan and book customised holidays. We combine technology, data and human insight to make travel more personalised, flexible and enjoyable.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Manager who is obsessed with growth, experimentation and finding better ways to acquire customers. You will be expected to challenge the status quo, experiment constantly and find new ways to make media, audiences, AI and creative work harder together.

**Responsibilities**

* Own performance across SEM & SMM
* Plan, launch and manage performance campaigns across Google Ads, Meta and other relevant paid platforms.
* Own campaign objectives across the funnel — acquisition, consideration, lead generation and conversion.
* Manage budgets, bidding, targeting, audiences, placements and campaign structures.
* Continuously optimise towards CPL, CAC, ROAS, revenue, conversion rate and quality of acquisition
* Work closely with analytics and business teams to understand the true economics of campaigns.
* Build a culture of experimentation
* We want someone who asks “What else can we try?”
* Develop and maintain a structured experimentation roadmap across media, audiences, creatives, landing pages.
* Run controlled tests on campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience segments, keywords, messaging, formats and creatives.
* Identify learnings from experiments and translate them into scalable growth opportunities.
* Build a clear test → learn → scale → repeat process.
* Be comfortable with experiments that fail. The expectation is to learn quickly, not avoid failure.
* Make AI part of performance marketing
* Think AI first - AI should be a daily working tool
* Use AI tools to accelerate campaign ideation, audience research, keyword discovery, competitive intelligence and performance analysis.
* Experiment with AI-assisted creative development, copy variations and creative testing.
* Explore ways to automate repetitive campaign-management and reporting tasks.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for faster testing and better decision-making.
* Stay ahead of emerging AI capabilities relevant to paid marketing.
* Think creatively about creative performance

At Pickyourtrail, we believe performance is increasingly a function of media × audience × creative.You will:

* Partner closely with the creative team to develop performance-led creative strategies.
* Translate campaign data into creative insights — what hooks, propositions, formats and visual treatments are working and why.
* Build creative testing frameworks across video, static, UGC, creator-led and other formats.
* Continuously test different hooks, headlines, CTAs, propositions, formats and storytelling approaches.
* Help move the organisation from “making more creatives” to making better-performing creatives.
* Own audience and funnel intelligence
* Analyse customer journeys across acquisition channels.
* Identify high-value audiences and opportunities for segmentation.
* Build and test retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Work with analytics to understand the quality of traffic and leads generated by different campaigns.
* Look beyond CPL/CAC to understand conversion quality, revenue, repeat behaviour and LTV.
* Work cross-functionally
* You will work closely with Marketing leadership, Brand & Creative, Product & Technology, Analytics, CRM and Sales
* The goal is to ensure paid marketing isn’t operating as an isolated function but as part of the larger growth engine.

**Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of hands-on experience in performance/digital marketing.
* Strong experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Strong understanding of SEM, paid social, audience targeting, remarketing and conversion optimisation.
* Experience managing meaningful media budgets and being accountable for performance outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills — you should be comfortable looking at numbers and figuring out what is actually driving the result.
* Demonstrated experience running experiments and A/B tests.
* Strong understanding of creative performance and digital advertising formats.
* Curiosity about AI and experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work.
* Ability to work independently and move quickly in a high-growth environment.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with creative, analytics and business teams.

**Required Skills**

* Handled large budget efficiently
* Day to day exposure of Analytics tools like Google Analytics 4, Google Trends, Power BI etc
* Understanding of Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Self-motivated attitude; one who can work alone and in team
* Ability to work in tight deadlines
* Strong analytical/ logical thinking

title: Lead ML Engineer, Wearable Biosignals
description:
Wualt is building a smart ring for women's safety and everyday wellness. The ring senses what the body is doing and, when it matters, alerts the people a wearer trusts. We are a funded, pre-launch hardware startup heading into our first field pilots in early 2027. Small team, real hardware, real users, close to the founders.

THE ROLE

Our ML is what turns a raw sensor stream into a signal someone can rely on. We are looking for one person to own that end to end: the models, the rigor, and a small team, and to carry them from research into a pilot-ready state. You would be the person the founders hand the ML function to.

EXPERIENCE WE EXPECT (please read before applying)

• 2 to 6 years working directly on physiological or sensor time-series ML. Your hands-on experience must include real biosignals: PPG, ECG, HRV, or accelerometer/IMU data. Depth here matters far more than total years.

• Solid signal-processing fundamentals: filtering, motion-artifact handling, feature extraction, and knowing why a model fails on real-world noise.

• Time-series deep learning (CNNs, Transformers, sequence models) and fluent, production-capable Python (NumPy, PyTorch or similar).

• You have taken at least one model to a deployed or shipped state on messy, real-world data, not just a clean benchmark.

• You understand honest evaluation: subject-wise splits (LOSO), leakage, calibration, and why a headline F1 can be a lie.

• This is not a fit for pure LLM or GenAI, pure computer-vision, or general data-science backgrounds with no biosignal work. We screen for the signal experience specifically.

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO DO

• Own the ML roadmap and be accountable for pilot ML readiness. Our first field pilots start early 2027; getting the models ready, on real people and on the real device, is your deliverable.

• Build and validate the physiological models: heart rate and HRV, stress and distress detection, menstrual-cycle phase, and signal quality.

• Own the on-device and cloud ML path and work shoulder to shoulder with firmware (edge inference on the ring) and the app and cloud teams.

• Set and hold the bar for rigor: ground-truth datasets, leakage-free evaluation, and no claim about what the product can do that you cannot defend with data.

• Lead and mentor the ML and science team, and raise the whole function's standard, not just your own output.

BONUS

• Wearables, health-tech or femtech experience.

• On-device or embedded ML (we run on an nRF-class MCU, so edge inference matters).

• A patent, a publication, or a personal project that shows you can't stop thinking about biosignals.

WHAT YOU GET

• Full ownership of the ML function at a company that is weeks, not years, from putting its product on real people.

• Hardware you can hold, a pilot on a real timeline, and a direct line to the founders.

• Competitive salary.

title: AI architect
description:
**Purpose of the role**

Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. This role is the bridge between the AI Lab’s technical capabilities and the investment team’s business requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Design the Databricks lakehouse architecture: medallion schema (bronze/silver/gold), Delta table design, Unity Catalog governance, and vector store configuration.
* Build and maintain the API integration layer: Addepar REST API (ingestion and reverse push), Capital IQ API, eVestment/Mercer feeds, email ingestion (Outlook Graph API), and operating division ERP connectors.
* Design the serving infrastructure: Databricks SQL dashboards, Streamlit/Genie chat interface, REST API endpoints for Addepar and external systems, alert engine, and scheduled report distribution.
* Implement the security and governance framework: Azure Active Directory integration, Unity Catalog role-based access control, encryption (Azure Key Vault), data lineage tracking, and audit trail for IC governance.
* Design the regulated entity isolation architecture (Zone A / Zone B) ensuring Nama Financing customer data stays within the SAMA-compliant perimeter.
* Manage the Databricks workspace: compute cluster sizing, job scheduling, cost optimisation, and capacity planning.
* Attend daily standups with the investment team to understand analytical requirements and translate them into technical specifications for the data engineer and ML engineer.
* Review and approve all code deployments, data model changes, and infrastructure modifications.
* Plan the platform’s extension from the Investment Division to the five operating divisions (Waves 2–5).
* Evaluate and recommend technology decisions: vendor selection, open-source vs commercial tools, build vs buy.

**Qualifications and experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data engineering and platform architecture, with at least 3 years on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
* Experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Active Directory.
* Demonstrated experience building API integrations with financial data providers (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv, or similar).
* Understanding of data governance frameworks, RBAC implementation, and regulatory data requirements (financial services preferred).
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM deployment for enterprise applications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or equivalent.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment operations strongly preferred.

title: Architect
description:

* Design robust end to end data architectures that leverage Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark to deliver secure and scalable analytics platforms that support critical business decisions and long term growth outcomes.
* Develop reusable Python and PySpark components that standardize data ingestion transformation and validation patterns so that teams can accelerate delivery while maintaining consistency and quality across projects.

* Collaborate with data engineers data analysts and application teams to translate complex functional requirements into pragmatic technical designs that align with enterprise standards and business priorities.
* Optimize Databricks SQL queries and cluster configurations to improve performance manage costs and ensure efficient use of compute resources across multiple data and analytics workloads.

* Establish and document data engineering and coding standards for Python PySpark and SQL so that project teams can follow clear guidelines that support maintainability security and traceability.
* Review solution designs and implementation artifacts to identify architecture risks performance bottlenecks and security gaps and then propose concrete improvements that can be implemented with minimal disruption.
* Guide teams in implementing monitoring logging and alerting across Databricks and Azure resources so that issues can be detected early and resolved before they impact business users and partners.

* Contribute to innovation initiatives by evaluating new Azure and Databricks features and proposing pilot implementations that can simplify data platforms improve sustainability and enhance societal impact of analytics solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Require extensive hands on experience designing and implementing data platforms with Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark including building scalable batch and near real time data pipelines that support analytics and reporting.
* Require strong proficiency in Python programming for data processing reusable library development and automation with a proven ability to write clean modular and testable code for large scale systems.
* Require demonstrated expertise in Azure DevOps including repository management branching strategies pipeline as code and release automation tailored to data engineering and analytics workloads in hybrid environments.

* Require experience in designing secure data solutions with proper access control data masking and compliance alignment to protect sensitive information and maintain organizational trust.
* Nice to have experience integrating Databricks with broader Azure data services such as data lake storage event based ingestion and downstream visualization platforms to create cohesive end to end solutions.
* Nice to have background working in hybrid work models with distributed teams using collaborative tools and agile practices to coordinate design discussions backlog refinement and delivery planning.
* Nice to have exposure to modern data governance practices metadata management and data quality frameworks to ensure data produced by the platform can be trusted by decision makers and society facing services.

Preferred Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional

title: Product Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Product Architect**
to own the architecture and technical evolution of its enterprise AI platform.

You will shape how core platform capabilities are designed, how the platform scales and how it operates reliably in production. Working closely with Product and Engineering teams, you will make critical architecture decisions, translate customer and business needs into reusable platform capabilities, and drive technical improvements from concept through release.

This is a hands-on leadership role with significant decision-making authority and accountability for product outcomes. You will combine architectural depth, engineering expertise and a strong understanding of enterprise AI to influence the platform's technical direction.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Core Platform Architecture**

* Define service boundaries, APIs and shared architectural patterns across agent design, runtime, knowledge and governance.
* Make day-to-day architecture decisions and recommend changes that influence the platform's technical direction.

**2. Platform Capability Design**

* Shape platform capabilities in partnership with Product, using roadmap priorities, product usage, production performance and customer feedback.
* Translate recurring customer and business requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
* Establish measurable outcomes to assess the impact of new capabilities.

**3. Proofs of Concept and Technical Validation**

* Lead time-boxed POCs to validate new platform capabilities and high-risk architectural decisions.
* Define success criteria and test solutions using representative enterprise workloads.
* Use evidence and results to decide what to build, refine or discontinue.

**4. Production Scale and Reliability**

* Define measurable targets for platform capacity, latency, availability and cost.
* Guide Engineering and QA teams in benchmarking, performance testing and failure-recovery validation.
* Ensure releases meet performance and security requirements.

**5. Technical Execution and Ownership**

* Prototype critical platform changes and review technical designs and code.
* Resolve cross-team technical blockers and drive architecture decisions through implementation.
* Follow capabilities from design through release and use production insights to guide continuous improvement.

**What You Bring**

* **Architecture at production scale:**
  Experience architecting a live product operating at substantial scale. You can explain actual peak concurrency, throughput or workload volumes, the architectural decisions you owned and the outcomes measured.
* **Enterprise product experience:**
  Experience owning core architecture for products used by external enterprise customers. You understand how to evolve shared capabilities across releases while addressing tenant isolation, integration and auditability.
* **Recent architecture ownership:**
  Ability to demonstrate a substantial product design or redesign undertaken within the past 12 months, including the trade-offs made and the resulting production impact.
* **Applied enterprise AI:**
  Experience designing and delivering AI capabilities for real-world enterprise use cases. You understand how to evaluate quality, latency and cost, and when to apply rules, guardrails or human approvals.
* **Hands-on technical depth:**
  Ability to prototype, review code and troubleshoot distributed systems using any programming language.
* **Technical leadership and accountability:**
  Experience driving technical decisions across teams and demonstrating ownership of product outcomes.

**Experience:**
Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building products for regulated industries.
* Familiarity with SaaS and customer-hosted deployment models.
* Experience applying AI-assisted engineering practices with appropriate review and testing gates.

**Our Commitment**

title: DevSecOps Full Stack Security Engineer
description:
The Full Stack DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for designing, engineering, and delivering security products and platforms from concept through production. The role develops end-to-end solutions spanning front-end applications, back-end services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data pipelines, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
The engineer will apply AI and machine learning (AI/ML), where appropriate, to create intelligent automation for security use cases such as vulnerability triage, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows. The role also embeds secure development practices, Zero Trust principles, and DevSecOps controls throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  
  
Working closely with security, product delivery, DevSecOps, and platform engineering teams, this individual will translate security needs and product roadmaps into scalable, reliable, and maintainable engineering solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack security products, including user interfaces, APIs, web services, data layers, and cloud-based components.
* Apply AI/ML and AI-assisted technologies, where appropriate, to automate security processes and improve areas such as vulnerability triage, risk assessment, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows.
* Develop clean, secure, well-tested, maintainable code following secure coding principles and software engineering best practices.
* Participate in solution architecture, design, and code reviews, ensuring Zero Trust principles and DevSecOps controls are incorporated into product design and implementation.
* Collaborate with security, DevSecOps, product delivery, and platform engineering teams to translate product roadmaps and security requirements into technical deliverables.
* Design and implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using technologies such as Tekton, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Build.
* Integrate security scanning and other security controls into software development and deployment pipelines.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to improve performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality while following organizational security and responsible-use standards.
* Evaluate and prototype relevant emerging technologies across AI, cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, deployment guidance, and operational runbooks.
* Apply Agile development practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Demonstrate curiosity and continuous learning by evaluating new tools, frameworks, engineering practices, and opportunities to apply AI to security and software engineering challenges.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of full-stack software engineering experience, preferably developing cloud-native applications, security products, developer platforms, or DevSecOps solutions.
* Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as Angular, React, and TypeScript, with hands-on experience in one or more back-end technologies such as Java/Spring Boot or Python.
* Experience designing and developing APIs, web services, and data-driven applications.
* Experience with relational or cloud-based data technologies such as PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps technologies such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Tekton, Google Cloud Build, Docker, Artifactory, and Terraform, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with a major cloud platform. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and BigQuery is preferred; relevant experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) is also applicable.
* Understanding of secure software development practices, including secure coding, vulnerability management, application security, and integrating security scanning into CI/CD workflows.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC), containerization, and cloud-native application delivery.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences and collaborate across security, product, and engineering teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing security products, security automation, or self-service security platforms.
* Experience applying AI/ML, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled APIs to software engineering or cybersecurity use cases.
* Experience with vulnerability management, vulnerability prioritization, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and DevSecOps principles.
* Experience with Kubernetes or managed Kubernetes platforms such as GKE.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering productivity tools.

**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**

**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle

* CI/CD and Change Integration: Integrate CI/CD processes into existing Change and Configuration Management scope (ServiceNow and JIRA); align delivery with the IT Service Delivery Framework to ensure traceability and control.

* Knowledge and experience in integration technologies – Mulesoft, Snaplogic.

* Strong problem-solving skill
* Experience with process tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with people across the globe with diverse cultures and backgrounds.
* Experience of working in agile teams using methodologies such as SCRUM, Kanban and SAFe.
* Experience in integration of CI/CD processes into existing Change & Configuration Management scope (i.e. ServiceNow & Jira)

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* ITIL practices (organisational change, incident and problem management and others)
* Experience in GxP or SOx regulated environment
* Passion for learning, innovating and delivering valuable software to people.
