title: Technical Lead- Platform Engineering
description:
**Technical Lead – Platform Engineering**
***Where Growth Never Stops***
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*
*When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens.*
**About The Department**
The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for the global IIoT platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS), providing architectural guidance and technical direction across software development teams.
* Own and evolve the end-to-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performing cloud-native solutions using Azure services, including Azure IoT Hub, cloud messaging, data storage, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
* Guide technical design and development across Java, Node.js, C#, REST APIs, microservices, and real-time data processing technologies, ensuring seamless integration between industrial equipment, Edge devices, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
* Establish engineering standards, development practices, and architecture principles that promote maintainability, scalability, software quality, and security.
* Mentor and develop software engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform operational excellence and maintain availability of 99.9% or greater through effective monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup validation, failover strategies, resilience testing, and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resource utilization to balance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud operating costs.
* Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and industrial cybersecurity principles, including IEC 62443, while partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Partner with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software and Edge developers, data engineers, automation engineers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Support technical estimation, solution reviews, project and release planning, and clearly communicate technical strategies, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, and engineering practices, and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap for IIoT, digital services, and industrial automation.
* Drive continuous improvements that enhance platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, engineering productivity, and overall customer value.

**You bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications are preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, industrial digital solutions, or related technology domains.
* 3+ years of demonstrated technical leadership experience, providing architectural direction and guiding engineering teams in the delivery of enterprise software or cloud platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud platforms using Microsoft Azure.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Edge computing, industrial automation, manufacturing technologies, or connected equipment solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and technology principles, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile development environments and structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Strong systems thinking, critical thinking, and complex problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues and drive effective solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technology alternatives, understand system dependencies, and make sound architectural and technical decisions.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence engineering teams, coordinate resources, and work effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working effectively in global, cross-functional, and multicultural environments.
* A collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement mindset with a strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and customer value.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
  
  
For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

title: IAM Operations - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Manager in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber Operate team, you will help clients manage identity and access management (IAM) operations across enterprise platforms, customer applications, and third-party tools. You will lead day-to-day delivery of user identity and access lifecycle activities, helping maintain a secure, compliant, and efficient access environment. You will work with client and cross-functional teams to strengthen access governance, operational controls, and service delivery while supporting the development of team members.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead day-to-day user access administration across applications, platforms, and systems, including provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, access modifications, and joiner, mover, leaver activities.
* Validate access requests for completeness, approvals, and policy alignment; maintain user accounts, group memberships, roles, and entitlements in accordance with approved workflows and service-level targets.
* Oversee the logging, triage, categorization, prioritization, tracking, and closure of incidents, service requests, and access-related tasks using IT service management (ITSM) and ticketing tools.
* Apply standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, knowledge articles, and control requirements; maintain operational documentation, trackers, status updates, and audit evidence for access reviews and recertification activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues, coordinate with application owners, infrastructure, security, and service delivery teams, and escalate complex issues to senior team members or tool administrators within defined thresholds.
* Investigate recurring access issues, entitlement mismatches, control gaps, and workflow exceptions; participate in root-cause discussions and recommend process improvements to strengthen a secure, audit-ready access administration environment.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 10 - 15 years of experience in information technology, service operations, information security support and operational governance with ITIL v4 Service Management Framework.
* 6+ years of experience in access administration, user account management, or IAM operations support.
* Basic hands-on experience with any IAM tool or platform, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, or similar solutions, used for provisioning, deprovisioning, access provisioning, access management, access management or access governance.
* Experience performing manual access administration tasks using documented procedures and approval workflows.
* Working knowledge of user provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, entitlement updates, and access review support.
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or equivalent for managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and operational tracking.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of identity and access management concepts, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, role-based access, least-privilege principles, and access recertification.
* Ability to review requests, follow process controls, and accurately execute operational tasks.
* Experience in maintaining documentation, operational logs, and status reporting.
* Good communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate with appropriate context.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Exposure to IAM, IGA, or access management tools.
* Familiarity with access request workflows, approval matrices, and security governance processes.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and policy requirements related to access administration.
* Ability to follow client information security policies and handle sensitive access tasks with accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and process discipline.
* Ability to identify issues early, troubleshoot at a basic level, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic reporting and tracking skills using standard operational tools.
* Exposure to incident/problem management concepts and recurring issue resolution.

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: Senior Supplier Operations Manager
description:
**Are you Senior Supplier Operations Manager looking for an innovative role?**
**Do you enjoy being part of a team that works with a diverse range of technology?**
**About our Team: -**
Platform Ops is a fast growing team within Data Ops with a key focus on the managing the services and data that are part of the new research data platform that is organized following the principles of the data mesh.
  
  
The supplier operations management team is responsible for managing the services the data products that fuel products like Scival, Scopus, Reaxys and many other commercial offering.
  
  
The supplier operations management team is responsible for managing both internal and external partners that supply data into the data platform. Key role is performance management, agreeing goals, monitoring performance, resolving incident and leading continuous improvement initiatives. The team maintains a knowledge base on our services, documenting SLAs, Workflow description, instructions.
  
  
**About the Role: -**
As Data Ops is set-up as a separate team to support our platform transition, an exciting role will be opened that sits at the heart of our new data use cases.
  
  
One initial key Operational efficiency goal will be to develop a full end to end view, underpinned by reporting and supported by clear visualizations of all our data asset processes, to a granularity that helps to support automation and transparency in our processes, as multiple teams and capabilities are dependent on this data to maintain a high speed of content onboarding. This work takes place as part of the ongoing (digital) transformation of our back-office and will support automation in our content sourcing and customer support. The data developed will support e-mail automation, proactive alerting and outlier management, escalation workflows, and providing tracking data to support our customers in meeting their needs. Work takes place in an agile framework and the data development manager will act both as analyst but will also be asked to act as product owner for a data squad that collaborates to improve our assets and processes. The expectation is that this role actively contributes to the way Data Ops will structure the continuous improvement and data development function.
  
  
Next to operational efficiency, the data development role will be supporting RDP in (cross-) domain initiatives as operations lead to foster collaboration, guide delivery and ensure Operational expertise is applied where needed and prioritized. Work will be done in multi-disciplinary squads to ensure that data is onboarded and processed according to agreed metrics. A rounded understanding of the strategic goals of RDP and the individual domains will ensure value added contributions and continuous, iterative improvement toward those goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
-
  
  
**Supplier Performance Management**

* Independently manage and monitor operational performance of assigned suppliers across data workflows (e.g., data ingestion, enrichment, validation, transformation, reporting and quality control).
* Track SLA adherence, turnaround times, quality scores, defect rates, and productivity metrics.
* Lead monthly performance review meetings with suppliers and present insights to internal stakeholders.
* Identify performance gaps and drive corrective and preventive action plans.
* Proactively escalate risks impacting service continuity, data accuracy, or timelines.
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned suppliers.

**Data Analytics & Reporting**

* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards to track supplier KPIs and operational health.
* Analyze large operational datasets to identify trends, inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Conduct structured root cause analysis for recurring data quality or delivery issues.
* Prepare and publish structured monthly supplier performance reports with clear executive summaries and actionable insights.
* Support demand forecasting and supplier capacity planning through data-driven analysis.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Ensure supplier adherence to contractual obligations, data governance standards, and security policies.
* Monitor compliance with data privacy and information security requirements.
* Maintain structured governance cadence, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Support performance documentation required for commercial reviews and renewals.

**Project & Product Alignment**

* Support supplier onboarding, transitions, and scope changes.
* Manage defined operational improvement initiatives (automation, standardization, workflow optimization).
* Collaborate closely with internal domain functional teams to understand evolving requirements and ensure supplier outputs align with business and customer expectations.
* Translate business and product requirements into measurable supplier performance metrics.
* Track milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications using structured project management approaches.

**Continuous Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes within supplier workflows.
* Partner with internal teams to implement system or workflow enhancements.
* Drive productivity improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives.
* Promote a data-driven and customer-focused culture of operational excellence.

**Requirements:**
-
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 5–6 years of experience in operations, data operations, or shared services environment.
* Experience managing external vendors or global suppliers in a matrixed organization preferred.
* Strong exposure to data lifecycle management, data processing environments, or analytics-driven operations.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations, Analytics, or Business Management (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience collaborating with Product and Technology teams is a plus.

**Technical & Analytical Skills**
**Data & Reporting**

* Advanced Excel (Power Query, complex formulas, Pivot Tables)
* Power BI (dashboard development, DAX, data modeling, automated reporting)
* Tableau reporting and dashboard development (good to have)
* Strong data analysis and interpretation capability
* Experience working with large datasets and operational metrics
* Root cause analysis methodologies (5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.)

**Project Management**

* Experience leading cross-functional operational initiatives
* Understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies
* Risk, issue, and dependency management
* Experience with MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools
* Process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart)

**Systems & Platforms**

* Workflow management platforms
* SharePoint or similar collaboration tools

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present complex data insights in a clear, structured, and compelling manner
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability
* Product-oriented thinking with strong awareness of customer impact
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
* Governance-oriented mindset with high attention to detail
* Ability to operate effectively in a global, fast-paced environment
* Proactive and results-driven approach

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification
* Lean / Six Sigma
* Power BI or Data Analytics certification

**Work in a way that works for you: -**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
  
  
**Working for you: -**
**Benefits**
At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India-Chennai)

**About Us:**
-
  
  
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Google Cloud Non-Relational Database Engineer
description:
Google Cloud non-relational database engineer is sought to design, implement, and manage database systems on the Google Cloud Platform. This role requires expertise in non-relational database technologies (Mongo, Firestore, Bigtable, Memorystore for Redis, Memorystore for Valkey, Neo4j), cloud-native architecture, in depth knowledge of Google Cloud Backup and Recovery, and experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services. A strong background in NoSQL and experience with database migrations, Data modeling, and Performance optimization, monitoring tools are also essential.
  
  

* NoSQL Database Engineering, part of Hosting Engineering department involves engineering new versions of NoSQL Databases, evaluate security patches, provide L3 support, technology management, GRC etc.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and maintain production-grade infrastructure using Terraform . Ensure all cloud resources are version-controlled and deployed via automated pipelines.
* Observability & Reliability: Set up comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting using the Dynatrace. Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets.
* Developer Enablement: Build internal tooling and documentation to help application developers self-serve their infrastructure needs while maintaining compliance and governance.
* Cost Optimization: Monitor cloud consumption and implement cost-saving strategies such as Committed Use Discounts (CUDs) and rightsizing of compute resources.
* Data Security & Protection: Enforce security best practices using IAM roles, Workload Identity, and Organization Policy Service and ensure RTO & RPO requirements are met.
* Implement secure authentication between the AI Client (e.g., an agentic loop) and the MCP Server. Use GCP IAM Workload Identity and OAuth2 to ensure agents operate within strict permission boundaries.
* Implement end-to-end tracing to monitor the flow from the AI Agent → MCP Server → GCP Data Source.
* Experience with architecting and engineering of High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions for NoSQL Databases
* Inter-personnel skills working with other team members in same and across organization
* Writing and assisting developers with Terraform, Blueprints, and APIs
* Create and maintain CI/CD Pipelines
* Deliver Database features to customers through Github Repo Enhancemnts
* Strong understanding of SRE principles, including the implementation and management of SLOs and Error Budget
* Expertise in developing observability dashboards to visualize app-to-database dependencies, enabling side-by-side health monitoring and accelerated incident resolution.
* Integrate GCP database logs with Dynatrace to centralize observability, configure DQL-based anomaly detection and provide deep-dive analysis for cloud-native workloads.
* Designing and implementing non-relational database solutions on GCP, including choosing appropriate services like . Mongo, Firestore, Bigtable, Memorystore, or Neo4j
* Managing and maintaining database infrastructure, including provisioning, configuration, and Optimizing database performance through query tuning, indexing, and capacity planning.
* Migrating existing on-premises databases to Google Cloud Platform, ensuring data integrity and minimal downtime.
* Developing and maintaining logical and physical data models for non-relational databases.
* Implementing and maintaining security best practices for database systems on GCP, including access controls and encryption, Peach dashboard, and Cycode.
* Monitoring database performance, identifying and resolving issues, and providing support for database-related problems using Dynatrace, Query Insights, and System insights.
* Writing, code reviewing, deploying Terraform code and maintaining service module repositories.
* Designing and maintaining Miro board diagrams/workflow for several ongoing projects.
* Requires a bachelor’s or foreign equivalent degree in computer science, information technology or a technology related field
* Minimum of 7 years of overall IT experience
* 3 years of experience database administration or engineering.
* Strong knowledge in GCP non-relational databases like Mongo Atlas, Neo4j AuraDB, Firestore, Bigtable, Memorystore for Redis, and Memorystore for Valkey. GCP Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification preferred.
* Experience with Cloud Run and Cloud Functions for event-driven architectures.

Skills
  
  

* CI/CD & DevOps, Terraform, VS Code, Github, Python, Cloud Run

title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB-D).
* Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
* Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
* Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching.
* Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
* Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
* Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
* Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
* Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents.
* Support database and workload migrations from on-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.

**Technical Skills**

* OCI Exadata / ExaDB-D, Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c & 23ai, Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata Patching, AWR/ASH, Performance Tuning, OCI Networking, Linux, Backup & Recovery, DR, Database Migration.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
* Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
* Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
* Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications

title: Sr. Analyst, Data Engineering
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
  
  
The Role:
  
  
The Sr Analyst Data Engineering will participate in the incremental development of the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and loading or extracting of data into the Warehouse. The role will participates throughout the project life cycle, from planning to production implementation, with emphasis on Data analysis, data modeling, and follow through to production.
  
  
Your Contribution:
  
  

* Optimize design considering cost, quality, manufacturability, sustainability, and environmental requirements.

Your Qualifications and Skills:
  
  

* 6 to 8 years of experience in ETL Design, Development, and populating data warehouses from heterogeneous OLTP sources such as Oracle R12 ERP system and other Cloud Technologies.
* At least 3 years of experience with Pentaho Data Integration and Snowflake.
* Extensive expertise on Databases, data acquisition, ETL strategies and tools, and technologies using Pentaho DI and Snowflake.
* Experience designing complex ETLs extracting data through XML files, Json, RDBMS, and Flat file sources.
* Strong programming skills, relational database skills with expertise in Advanced SQL and PL/SQL Oracle DB, Snowflake, MySQL, NoSQL DBs, etc.
* Ability to analyze poorly performing queries/ETL mappings and provide suggestions to tune them.
* Exposure to Standard support ticket management tools.
* Mastery in Business Intelligence and Data warehousing concepts and methodologies.
* Extensive experience in data analysis and root cause analysis with proven problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities.
* Understanding of software engineering principles and skills working on Unix/Linux/Windows Operating systems, Version Control, and Office software.
* Experience with scripting languages like Python, Shell, JavaScript, HTML5 is essential.
* Broad understanding of multiple existing and next-generation Business intelligence tools and technologies.
* Experience with React.js and Node.js is an advantage.

At Logitech, we empower collaboration and foster play through a flexible hybrid work model that supports productivity and connection from anywhere. Our strength lies in our people and our inclusive culture, where diversity is valued and differences celebrated. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay! If you believe you’re a great fit, we encourage you to apply. We’d love to meet you!

CS is a SaaS platform that field service businesses rely on every day. This is not a ticket-handling role. You will be the expert Linux troubleshooter the team escalates to, the owner of our Disaster Recovery design and execution, and a hands-on technical lead who mentors engineers, leads major incidents, and drives improvement projects from idea to production. You will work closely with the Cloud Architect, turning architecture direction into working, documented, and tested systems.

**Cloud-**
Google Cloud Platform: Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud LoadBalancing, Cloud DNS
  
  
**OS Linux**
servers across the estate (Ubuntu / Debian / RHEL family)
  
  
**Containers**
Docker, Kubernetes on GKE
  
  
**Web & App**
Nginx, Apache, application servers
  
  
**Data**
Self-managed database servers (MySQL / PostgreSQL) with replication and backups
  
  
**IaC & Scripting**
Terraform, Bash / Shell, Python
  
  
**Practice**
Disaster Recovery, observability, CI/CD, change management, documentation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Disaster Recovery: Design, Build and Own
  
  
■ Classify services by business criticality and agree RPO / RTO targets with engineering and business stakeholders.
  
  
■ Design and implement the DR architecture on GCP: cross-region standby, snapshot and image policies, database replicas, DNS and load balancer failover, GKE workload recovery.
  
  
■ Build DR infrastructure with Terraform so the recovery environment can be recreated from code, not memory.
  
  
■ Write and maintain DR runbooks and playbooks plan and lead failover drills at least twice a year, report findings and close the gaps.
  
  
■ Own the backup strategy for servers and databases and prove it with scheduled, documented restore tests.
  
  
**Linux Expertise & Escalation Troubleshooting**
■ Act as the final escalation point for complex production issues across OS, network, web, application and database layers.
  
  
■ Deep-dive performance problems: CPU scheduling, memory and OOM behaviour, disk and filesystem I/O, network stack, file descriptors and kernel parameters (sysctl).
  
  
■ Use advanced tooling such as strace, perf, tcpdump, lsof, sar, iostat, ss, eBPF-based tools to find root cause.
  
  
■ Define and maintain Linux build, hardening and patching standards for the whole estate.
  
  
**Incident Leadership & Reliability**
■ Lead major incidents as incident commander: coordinate, communicate status and drive to resolution.
  
  
■ Run blameless post-incident reviews, write RCAs and make sure corrective actions are completed.
  
  
■ Define SLIs / SLOs for key services design and own the observability stack (metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards) and reduce alert noise.
  
  
■ Design and improve the on-call process, escalation paths and runbook coverage.
  
  
**Cloud, Containers & Platform (GCP / GKE)**
■ Design and operate GKE clusters: node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, network policies, ingress, upgrades with minimal disruption.
  
  
■ Introduce and maintain Helm / GitOps practices for consistent, reviewable deployments.
  
  
■ Design GCP networking and IAM following least privilege own GCP cost optimisation and right-sizing.
  
  
**Web, Application & Database Platforms**
■ Tune Nginx and Apache for performance and security: reverse proxy, TLS, caching, rate limiting, high availability.
  
  
■ Partner with developers on application server performance, capacity and release readiness.
  
  
■ Design database high availability and failover plan and execute upgrades and migrations with low or zero downtime lead capacity planning.
  
  
**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**
■ Write reusable Terraform modules, manage remote state and bring manually built infrastructure under code.
  
  
■ Build automation in Python and Shell that removes toil contribute to CI/CD pipelines and configuration management (e.g. Ansible).
  
  
■ Own change management: peer-reviewed, tested and reversible changes to production.
  
  
**Security & Compliance**

■ Support security audits and customer due diligence questionnaires with accurate evidence and documentation.
  
  
**Leadership, Mentoring & Documentation**

■ Strong hands-on GCP experience (AWS/Azure experience transferable).

■ Deep knowledge of Nginx and Apache and application server stacks.
  
  
■ Database operations (MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL): replication, HA, failover, backup/restore, performance basics.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog & Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment
* Data Catalog & Governance Platform Management
* Catalog Administration & Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata & Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies
* Domain Data Governance & Stewardship Enablement
* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise platforms across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. **Position Summary**
Level: Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

* Configure and support Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Portfolio Management modules, including Project Foundation, Project Financials, Project Execution, Project Costing, Project Billing, and Project Contracts, based on project scope.
* Participate in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design discussions, and configuration activities to support client and business needs.
* Execute testing and deployment activities, including unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, defect triage, cutover planning, and hypercare.
* Develop and support reporting, reconciliations, and data activities, including Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence dashboards, BI Publisher reports, file-based data import, and integration support.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams across Finance, Procurement, Time and Labor, and Human Capital Management to deliver managed services and ongoing application support.

The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.

Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements

is collaborating with

Data Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description**
Define the data requirements and structure for the application. Model and design the application data structure, storage and integration.
  
  
**Must Have Skills**
Data Science
  
  
**Good To Have Skills**

**Summary**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and DevOps & MLOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.
  
  
Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
  
  
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps
  
  
Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC
  
  
Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
  
  
Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production
  
  
Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
  
  
Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
  
  
Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production
  
  
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
  
  
Minimum of 3 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
  
  
Minimum of 3 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
  
  
Minimum of 1 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
  
  
Minimum of 1 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
  
  
Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
  
  
Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
  
  
Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL
  
  
Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  
  
Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
  
  
Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams
  
  
Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
  
  
MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)
  
  
As a Data Architect, a typical day involves defining the data requirements and structuring the data for various applications. This role includes designing and modeling the data architecture to ensure efficient storage and seamless integration across systems. The position requires a thoughtful approach to organizing data assets to support application functionality and scalability, while collaborating with different stakeholders to align data strategies with business needs.

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of data architecture standards and best practices.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business units to ensure data requirements are met effectively.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities.

* Good To Have Skills: Snowflake Data Warehouse, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling techniques and database design principles.
* Experience with data integration and data storage solutions.
* Ability to analyze complex data requirements and translate them into scalable data architectures.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering tools.

title: Data Scientist II, AWS - Quick
description:
**Description**
Amazon Quick Suite is an enterprise AI platform that transforms how organizations work with their data and knowledge. Combining generative AI-powered search, deep research capabilities, intelligent agents and automations, and comprehensive business intelligence, Quick Suite serves tens of thousands of users. Our platform processes thousands of queries monthly, helping teams make faster, data-driven decisions while maintaining enterprise-grade security and governance. From natural language interactions with complex datasets to automated workflows and custom AI agents, Quick Suite is redefining workplace productivity at unprecedented scale.
  
  
We are seeking a Data Scientist II to join our Quick Data team, focusing on evaluation and benchmarking data development for Quick Suite features. Our mission is to engineer high-quality datasets that are essential to the success of Amazon Quick Suite. From human evaluations and Responsible AI safeguards to Retrieval-Augmented Generation and beyond, our work ensures that Generative AI is enterprise-ready, safe, and effective for users at scale.
  
  
As part of our diverse team—including data scientists, engineers, language engineers, linguists, and program managers—you will collaborate closely with science, engineering, and product teams. We are driven by customer obsession and a commitment to excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will leverage data-centric AI principles to assess the impact of data on model performance and the broader machine learning pipeline. You will apply Generative AI techniques to evaluate how well our data represents human language and conduct experiments to measure downstream interactions.
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities Include**

* Design and develop comprehensive evaluation and benchmarking datasets for Quick Suite AI-powered features
* Leverage LLMs for synthetic data corpora generation; data evaluation and quality assessment using LLM-as-a-judge settings
* Create ground truth datasets with high-quality question-answer pairs across diverse domains and use cases
* Lead human annotation initiatives and model evaluation audits to ensure data quality and relevance
* Develop and refine annotation guidelines and quality frameworks for evaluation tasks
* Conduct statistical analysis to measure model performance, identify failure patterns, and guide improvement strategies
* Collaborate with ML scientists and engineers to translate evaluation insights into actionable product improvements
* Build scalable data pipelines and tools to support continuous evaluation and benchmarking efforts
* Contribute to Responsible AI initiatives by developing safety and fairness evaluation datasets

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
**About AWS**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of data scientist experience
* 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
* 1+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
* Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
* Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
* Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
* Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADCI MAA 15 SEZ

title: Voyage Optimization Analyst
description:
Job Description

Job Description (JD) – Voyage Performance Analyst

Position Title
**Voyage Performance Analyst**

Location - Chennai (Work from Office)

Role Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented
**Voyage Performance Analyst**
with a strong marine background to support vessel voyage monitoring, performance analysis, and operational optimization. The role involves analyzing vessel performance data, monitoring KPIs, managing voyage efficiency initiatives, and providing fact-based recommendations to improve operational and fuel performance across the fleet.

The ideal candidate will have sailing experience as a
**2nd Officer or 3rd Officer**
on commercial vessels and possess a passion for data analytics, vessel optimization, and emerging technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Voyage Performance Monitoring & Analysis

* Monitor vessel voyage performance and operational efficiency through daily and monthly performance reviews.
* Analyze voyage data, fuel consumption trends, weather impacts, speed-performance relationships, and operational KPIs.
* Provide fact-based recommendations to optimize vessel performance, fuel efficiency, and voyage execution.
* Support vessel voyage management by identifying performance deviations and recommending corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain vessel performance reports, dashboards, and analytical insights for internal stakeholders.

Reporting & KPI Management

* Prepare and distribute monthly performance reports and fleet performance summaries.
* Track and report key operational and performance indicators (KPIs).
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting across vessels and fleets.
* Support benchmarking activities and monitor fleet performance against predefined targets.

Project Management & Operational Support

* Execute performance improvement and optimization projects efficiently.
* Participate in new initiatives related to vessel performance, digitalization, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate willingness to take ownership of assigned projects and adapt to new challenges.
* Contribute to daily departmental activities and support service delivery requirements.

Stakeholder Management

* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal teams, vessel crews, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Act as a key point of contact for vessel performance, fuel consumption analysis, and voyage optimization discussions.
* Support customers and operational teams with data-driven insights and reporting requirements.

Technology & Innovation

* Utilize performance monitoring systems, analytical tools, and reporting platforms to drive operational improvements.

title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - BA4
description:
**Purpose of the role**
To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.
* Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank’s funding and liquidity management capabilities.

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise

title: Specialist, FAO
description:
**Job Title**
Specialist, FAO
  
  
Concentrix is a technology-enabled global business services company specializing in customer engagement and improving business performance. We partner with ambitious, progressive executives around the world to future-proof their business and stay ahead of the competition and meet customer expectations.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient MIS Executive with 3 to 4 years of dedicated experience in Finance & Accounting Outsourcing (FAO) domain. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing complex financial data ecosystems, generating high-impact Management Information System (MIS) reports, and creating client-ready dashboards. This role requires strong database querying capabilities using SQL, interactive data visualization via Power BI, and the skill to formulate comprehensive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and professional executive presentations (PPT). Exceptional communication skills are mandatory to act as a bridge between operations teams and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Role And Key Responsibilities**

* MIS & Financial Reporting: Extract, clean, compile, and analyze large datasets from multiple accounting systems to generate daily, weekly, and monthly operational and financial MIS reports.
* SLA & Performance Tracking: Design, monitor, and update Service Level Agreement (SLA) frameworks and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) unique to FAO lifecycles (e.g., P2P, O2C, R2R).
* Dashboard Development: Build, publish, and maintain interactive business intelligence dashboards using Power BI to visualize operational metrics, data trends, and productivity analysis.
* Database Management: Write optimized SQL queries, subqueries, and join in pulling clean datasets from structured databases, ensuring data architecture integrity.
* Executive Presentations: Translate complex analytical insights into structured, impactful, and client-ready PowerPoint (PPT) presentations for performance reviews and stakeholder updates.
* Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate proactively with cross-functional finance teams, operational managers, and international clients to address reporting requirements and deliver variance analysis statements.

**Key Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong foundational knowledge of FAO core metrics, corporate accounting flows, and billing reconciliations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, and automated updates).
* Solid hands-on knowledge of SQL (writing queries, understanding table relationships, and structural data extraction).
* Expert level in Microsoft Excel (macros, pivots, advanced lookup logic) and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with an ability to clearly explain complex data analytics to non-technical business leaders.
* Minimum of 3 to 4 years of solid, relevant professional experience operating as an MIS Analyst or Executive strictly within an FAO or shared service business framework.
* Bachelors degree in commerce (B.Com), Business Administration (BBA), Information Technology (B.Sc IT / BCA), or a related data-centric field.

**Job Summary**
Architect role in a global organization focused on designing and optimizing scalable data and analytics solutions using Azure DevOps Python Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to create reliable platforms that turn data into actionable insights and support sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design robust end to end data architectures that leverage Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark to deliver secure and scalable analytics platforms that support critical business decisions and long term growth outcomes.
* Develop reusable Python and PySpark components that standardize data ingestion transformation and validation patterns so that teams can accelerate delivery while maintaining consistency and quality across projects.
* Implement Azure DevOps based continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that automate build test and deployment stages to improve release reliability and reduce operational risk for data products.
* Collaborate with data engineers data analysts and application teams to translate complex functional requirements into pragmatic technical designs that align with enterprise standards and business priorities.
* Optimize Databricks SQL queries and cluster configurations to improve performance manage costs and ensure efficient use of compute resources across multiple data and analytics workloads.

title: AI architect
description:
**Purpose of the role**

Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. This role is the bridge between the AI Lab’s technical capabilities and the investment team’s business requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Design the Databricks lakehouse architecture: medallion schema (bronze/silver/gold), Delta table design, Unity Catalog governance, and vector store configuration.
* Build and maintain the API integration layer: Addepar REST API (ingestion and reverse push), Capital IQ API, eVestment/Mercer feeds, email ingestion (Outlook Graph API), and operating division ERP connectors.
* Design the serving infrastructure: Databricks SQL dashboards, Streamlit/Genie chat interface, REST API endpoints for Addepar and external systems, alert engine, and scheduled report distribution.
* Implement the security and governance framework: Azure Active Directory integration, Unity Catalog role-based access control, encryption (Azure Key Vault), data lineage tracking, and audit trail for IC governance.
* Design the regulated entity isolation architecture (Zone A / Zone B) ensuring Nama Financing customer data stays within the SAMA-compliant perimeter.
* Manage the Databricks workspace: compute cluster sizing, job scheduling, cost optimisation, and capacity planning.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
