title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases - Redshift, Teradata etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
The Core Engineering
  
  
The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

****What We Do****
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
  
  
The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
  
  
Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
  
  
**Our Impact**
The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
  
  
**Why join the team**

* Tool & Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.

title: Platform Engineer- Azure
description:
**Platform Engineer (Azure)**

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced Azure Platform Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure infrastructure, cloud platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and identity and security management.

The role involves taking end-to-end ownership of the Azure cloud platform, including infrastructure, deployment pipelines, development and testing environments, security, and operational monitoring. The ideal candidate should have strong experience designing, implementing, and managing secure, scalable Azure environments using Bicep, Azure DevOps, Docker, and Microsoft Entra ID.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring someone who can independently manage the complete cloud infrastructure lifecycle, automate deployments, troubleshoot configuration issues, and ensure platform reliability, security, and performance.

**Work Schedule:**
The selected candidate will be required to work in Australian business hours.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage end-to-end Azure cloud infrastructure, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Key Vault, Azure Front Door, WAF, virtual networks, private endpoints, and private DNS.
* Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep, ensuring infrastructure deployments are automated, consistent, and scalable.
* Manage Azure infrastructure security through managed identities, network isolation, least-privilege access, and secure secrets management.
* Own the complete deployment lifecycle using Azure Developer CLI (azd), including environment configuration, Bicep parameters, and application settings.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps YAML pipelines or GitHub Actions.
* Manage Docker and Linux container builds, including container images with native dependencies.
* Build, configure, and maintain development, testing, demonstration, and sandbox environments.
* Manage Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, service principals, application permissions, admin consent, certificates, and secret rotation.
* Ensure secure authentication and authorization using managed identities and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Monitor and maintain cloud infrastructure using Azure Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerting, and health monitoring.
* Manage infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, performance optimization, and Azure cloud costs.
* Troubleshoot deployment failures, infrastructure configuration issues, and application connectivity problems.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and security compliance evidence.
* Collaborate with application engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between the cloud platform and application services.

**Qualifications Required:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Azure infrastructure and cloud platform engineering.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably using
  **Bicep**
  . Experience with Terraform or ARM templates is also acceptable, provided the candidate is comfortable working with Bicep.
* Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:
* Azure Container Apps or AKS.
* Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
* Azure Key Vault.
* Azure Front Door and Web Application Firewall (WAF).
* Virtual Networks (VNet), Private Endpoints, and Private DNS Zones.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including App Registrations, Service Principals, Managed Identities, App-only permissions, Delegated Permissions, and Admin Consent.
* Experience with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines or GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation.
* Strong understanding of Docker, Linux containerization, and container image builds.
* Hands-on experience with Azure CLI, Azure Developer CLI (azd), and PowerShell or Bash scripting.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js to troubleshoot application configurations and make minor code-level changes.
* Experience managing cloud deployments, environment configurations, secrets, and application settings.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, network isolation, identity management, and access controls.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Ability to independently own cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, and platform operations.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to work in Australian business hours.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Dataverse environment management, Managed Environments, and PAC CLI.
* Knowledge of Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environments and Lifecycle Services (LCS).
* Experience with Microsoft Graph app-only access and SharePoint tenant administration.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI workspace administration.
* Knowledge of FinOps and Azure cost management.
* Experience working in consultancy or software product environments.
* Exposure to security assessments, penetration testing remediation, Essential Eight, or ISO 27001.

You will manage EC2 and other core infrastructure components, support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, and implement and maintain security and compliance controls.

* Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized services and container orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Strong backend development experience, with the ability to independently implement new features and functionality in microservices
  
* Ability to develop backend functionality involving access control, metrics ingestion and multi-tenancy

* Understanding of platform reliability, maintainability, security and continuous improvement
  
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions and contribute beyond assigned development tasks

* Ability to propose and justify technical improvements constructively
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience developing frontend features and functionality, particularly around multi-tenancy and dashboard sharing

**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Technical Lead, AWS & AI-First Engineering (Horizontal) – Provider Payments**
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Experience:**
8-12 years
  
  
**Role type:**
Horizontal technical leader across Provider Engineering Pods (influence-based; direct reports not required)
  
  
**About The Role**
Provider Payments platforms process high-volume, high-stakes financial transactions for healthcare. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who raises the engineering bar across multiple Provider Engineering Pods rather than within a single team. You will set standards, shape architecture, mentor engineers, ensure trusted payment data flows into the analytics layer, and make AI-assisted engineering a repeatable, measurable way of working across pods.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Lead across pods**

* Act as the horizontal technical authority across Provider Engineering Pods, setting engineering standards and reference patterns that teams actually adopt.
* Influence architecture decisions and roadmaps through credibility, clear communication, and hands-on contribution rather than reporting lines.
* Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads, and build a culture of technical ownership and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Engineering to turn business outcomes into sound technical direction.

**Architect and build on AWS**

* Lead AWS architecture, application modernization, and cloud-native engineering for Provider Payments platforms.
* Design and build solutions using EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Drive microservices, event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and API-first design.
* Modernize legacy applications into scalable, resilient AWS-based architectures.
* Build highly available platforms for high-volume transactional and payment workloads, with strong security, authentication, authorization, observability, and operational readiness.

**Engineer hands-on**

* Contribute directly in .NET Core / .NET 6+, C#, and ASP.NET Core, building REST APIs and distributed systems.
* Work across SQL Server and NoSQL stores, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Apply Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD as everyday tools.

**Enable payment data and analytics on Snowflake**

* Design reliable data flows from transactional and event-driven systems on AWS into Snowflake for payment analytics, reporting, and reconciliation.
* Guide data modeling, ingestion patterns, and data quality so payment data is accurate, auditable, and secure (PHI/PCI-aware).
* Keep Snowflake performance and cost under control, and set shared patterns that pods reuse.

**Make AI-first engineering real**

* Promote and operationalize AI/GenAI-assisted engineering across coding and code reviews, test generation, documentation, troubleshooting and incident analysis, observability and operations, and developer productivity.
* Build reusable AI agents, skills, and engineering automation that multiple pods can share.
* Define and track metrics (for example cycle time, review turnaround, test coverage, incident resolution time) so AI adoption delivers measurable productivity gains, not just tool familiarity.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 8-12 years of software engineering experience, with deep hands-on AWS expertise.
* Strong modern .NET (.NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core / C#) engineering skills.
* Proven experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems at scale.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience: data modeling, ingestion from AWS sources, and performance and cost awareness.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership: setting standards, mentoring, and influencing architecture without formal authority.
* Demonstrated AI-assisted engineering adoption that went beyond personal use of Copilot or ChatGPT and delivered repeatable, measurable team-level improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration skills.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Domain exposure to Provider Payments, Claims, Payment Integrity, Revenue Cycle Management, or healthcare financial platforms.
* Track record of large-scale cloud modernization.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Professional/Associate, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent).

**Leadership Profile**

* Strong technical ownership and a bias toward outcomes
* Architectural judgment and the ability to influence roadmaps
* Coaching mindset and a growth orientation
* Collaborative, credible, and effective across pods without relying on authority
* Customer and business-outcome focus

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* Shared engineering standards and reference architectures adopted across multiple pods
* Visible modernization progress on priority Provider Payments workloads
* Trusted, well-modeled payment data flowing into Snowflake for reconciliation and reporting
* A working library of reusable AI agents and skills with measurable productivity gains
* Stronger resiliency, observability, and operational readiness on critical payment flows
* Mentored engineers and tech leads growing into broader ownership

**Key hiring combination:**
Deep AWS + strong modern .NET + Snowflake + microservices/event-driven architecture + hands-on leadership + AI-first engineering mindset + ability to influence horizontally across Provider Engineering Pods.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

Technology

* Design and build scalable services and APIs with clear contracts, idempotency, retries, and failure isolation, and take features from user stories and acceptance criteria to production in an agile SDLC

* Evaluate and monitor AI features with prompt versioning, evaluation sets, tool-call accuracy, task success, cost, latency, and human review gates
* Build RAG, memory, ontology, and document capabilities, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evaluation, and structured knowledge extraction
* Protect retrieval and AI inputs with document access control, PII/PCI redaction, and defenses against prompt injection, while following security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage branching and release practices, review code thoroughly, keep pipelines healthy, resolve root causes, mentor engineers, and improve cloud-native automation where it helps

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building distributed, data-intensive or platform systems in production; knowledge of and/or experience with insurance processes, regulatory requirements and industry standards is a plus
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong programming in Python, Java, Scala or similar, and strong SQL, with experience of microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP; experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and/or GitOps is a plus
* Solid distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breakers, consistency, structured logging, distributed tracing and correlation IDs; experience with Temporal, Camunda, AWS Step Functions, and/or Cadence is a plus
* Experience with streaming (Kafka, Kinesis or Event Hubs) and distributed data processing (Spark, Flink or Beam), and with data modelling for SQL and NoSQL stores; experience with Delta Lake, Iceberg, and data governance and/or metadata management is a plus
* Hands-on experience with LLM-based applications including at least one production or serious prototype using RAG (chunking, embeddings, vector search) or agents with tool calling; experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, and LLM evaluation and/or observability tools is a plus
* Working knowledge of ontologies or knowledge graphs, and of data science and ML basics (Python data stack, model evaluation, how models are deployed and monitored); experience with Neo4j, MongoDB, GraphDB, JSON-LD, SHACL, Cypher, SPARQL, and/or Gremlin is a plus
* Hands-on CI/CD experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines (Jenkins file, shared libraries) with automated test, scan and release stages, and Git workflows with pull requests; experience with SonarQube, dependency and container scanning, SAST/DAST, and/or Artifactory or Nexus is a plus
* Strong code review experience, both providing and receiving reviews, as well as applying standards for correctness, security, testing and readability
* Additional depth in AI/ML platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude API, MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, or SageMaker is a plus

title: Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

title: Senior Security Architect/Engineer (HIPAA & SOC 2)

We are hiring a Senior Security Architect/ Engineer to build and own the HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance programs end to end. You will design the security architecture that protects patient and customer data, stand up continuous monitoring for data leakage, and harden our systems against intrusion and penetration attempts. This is a hands-on senior role: you will set things up from scratch where needed, not just maintain what exists. You will report to CTO and work closely with engineering, DevOps, legal and leadership.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and own the HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance programs end to end.
* You will design the security architecture that protects patient and customer data, stand up continuous monitoring for data leakage, and harden our systems against intrusion and penetration attempts.
* This is a hands-on senior role: you will set things up from scratch where needed, not just maintain what exists.
* Compliance program (HIPAA and SOC 2)
* Build and lead the HIPAA security program: risk assessments, Security Rule administrative, physical and technical safeguards, and Breach Notification Rule readiness.
* Drive SOC 2 Type I and Type II readiness across the Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and others as in scope).
* Write and maintain security policies, standards and procedures, and map controls across HIPAA, SOC 2 and related frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, HITRUST).
* Own audit preparation: evidence collection, control testing, gap remediation, and acting as the main contact for external auditors.
* Manage Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and vendor security reviews for any third party that handles PHI.
* Implement a compliance automation platform (e.g. Vanta, Drata, Secureframe) for continuous control monitoring.

* Define identity and access management standards: SSO, MFA, least privilege, privileged access management and quarterly access reviews.
* Set encryption standards for PHI and sensitive data at rest and in transit, including key management.
* Review designs and embed security into the SDLC through threat modeling, secure code review, SAST, DAST and dependency scanning.
* Data leak prevention and monitoring
* Deploy and tune Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls across email, endpoints, cloud storage and SaaS apps.
* Classify data and maintain an inventory of where PHI and confidential data lives and flows.
* Stand up centralized logging, SIEM and alerting (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Datadog, Elastic) with detection rules for exfiltration and anomalous access.
* Monitor cloud security posture (CSPM) and fix misconfigurations such as public buckets and over-permissive roles.
* Hands on Experience in Azure Purview and Sentinel
* Penetration and intrusion prevention
* Run the vulnerability management program: scanning, prioritization, patch SLAs and tracking to closure.
* Plan and oversee annual third-party penetration tests and internal red-team exercises; own remediation.
* Configure and manage WAF, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, network segmentation and firewall rules.
* Harden infrastructure and container baselines against CIS Benchmarks
* Incident response
* Build and test the incident response plan, including tabletop exercises at least twice a year.
* Lead investigation and containment of security incidents and data breaches.
* Coordinate HIPAA breach notification with legal within required timelines.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in information security, with 5+ years in a security architect or senior security engineering role.
* Proven track record of taking at least one organization through a successful SOC 2 Type II audit.
* Hands-on experience implementing HIPAA Security Rule controls in a healthcare, health-tech or PHI-handling environment.
* Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and its native security services.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services.
* Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.

**Desirable:**

* 5+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

description:
**The Opportunity**
The Data Engineer at our client will be responsible for building and maintaining our data infrastructure to support reporting, analytics, and data science initiatives. * Strong programming in Python, Java, Scala or similar, and strong SQL, with experience of microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP; experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and/or GitOps is a plus
* Solid distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breakers, consistency, structured logging, distributed tracing and correlation IDs; experience with Temporal, Camunda, AWS Step Functions, and/or Cadence is a plus
* Experience with streaming (Kafka, Kinesis or Event Hubs) and distributed data processing (Spark, Flink or Beam), and with data modelling for SQL and NoSQL stores; experience with Delta Lake, Iceberg, and data governance and/or metadata management is a plus

What You'll Do

* Mentor engineers and analysts by sharing patterns, reviewing designs, creating reference implementations, and helping teams adopt consistent reporting practices.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering reporting, BI, analytics engineering, enterprise data, or cloud data platform solutions.
* Deep hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, refresh management, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience working with Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and modern cloud-based data environments.
* Strong SQL skills, including experience designing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, semantic-layer design, data warehousing, lakehouse concepts, and governed business metrics.
* Experience building dashboards, paginated reports, embedded analytics, shared semantic models, or customer-specific reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer review, CI/CD, automated deployments, and environment management.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production reporting issues involving data accuracy, refresh failures, business logic, security, performance, or platform capacity.

And It's Great to Have
  
  

* Experience with Databricks or similar lakehouse platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Embedded, or advanced Azure analytics services.
* Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Power BI Performance Analyzer, deployment pipelines, or related performance and modeling tools.
* Experience designing multi-tenant, customer-specific, or embedded reporting solutions at enterprise scale.
* Experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, orchestration tools, copilots, or AI-assisted workflows to automate reporting engineering processes.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* ABC's reporting solutions follow scalable, consistent patterns that support growing data volumes, customer needs, and analytical workloads.
* Power BI models, reports, refreshes, and data flows are reliable, measurable, debuggable, and production-ready.
* Teams move faster because reusable models, templates, documentation, and validation checks reduce repeated manual work.
* Reporting engineering practices become more consistent across teams through standards, reference implementations, mentoring, and practical enablement.
* Stakeholders have greater confidence in the accuracy, performance, usability, and reliability of ABC's reporting solutions.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases - Redshift, Teradata etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

The Core Engineering
  
  
The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

****What We Do****
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
  
  
The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
  
  
Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
  
  
**Our Impact**
The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
  
  
**Why join the team**

* Tool & Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.
* Autonomy: You’ll have significant autonomy in designing and writing solutions to help our stakeholders deliver for the firm’s clients.
* Creativity: You’ll be encouraged to suggest improvements to products and to propose ways, in which we can add value for our stakeholders.
* Interpersonal Communication: You’ll engage with data producers and consumers across all areas of the business to understand their requirements and to propose solutions tailored to their needs.
* Training: Your manager will support your professional development, allowing you time for training at work, helping you learn and grow within the organization, and providing opportunities for increasing responsibility.

****Responsibilities****

* In an Agile environment manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis to coding, testing, UAT, implementation and maintenance
* Develop high level/detailed technical designs, testing strategies, and implementation plans
* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Understand and respond to business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Identify opportunities for cross-divisional collaboration and reuse of common solutions
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI-powered automations, prompt engineering concepts.

****Skills & Experience We Are Looking For****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
* Hands-on software development experience preferably in Java, C/C++, Python, or Scala, exposure to RDBMS and NoSQL datastores
* Strong programming and problem-solving skills
* A clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design and core programming concepts
* Strong full-stack technical design and development skills and experience
* Comfortable with multi-tasking, managing multiple stakeholders and working as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills including experience speaking to technical & business audiences and working globally
* Interest in finance

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

title: Siebel Techno / Functional Consultant
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Siebel Engineer**
to lead the technical data migration and integration effort from our legacy Oracle Siebel environment to Salesforce. You will act as the crucial bridge between our legacy on-premises system and our new cloud architecture, working alongside Salesforce Architects, business analysts, and functional teams to ensure seamless data integrity and zero-downtime cutover.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Mapping & Transformation: Analyze the legacy Siebel data model (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Service Requests, Assets) and map it to standard and custom Salesforce objects. Define data cleansing and transformation rules.
* Legacy Extraction: Leverage Siebel EIM (Enterprise Integration Manager), EAI, and SQL/PL-SQL to extract large, complex datasets from the Siebel database securely.
* ETL & Data Loading: Develop, optimize, and execute ETL processes utilizing tools like Informatica, Jitterbit, or MuleSoft, eventually loading and validating data via the Salesforce Data Loader.
* System Integration: Design and implement transitional integrations and APIs (REST/SOAP) between the remaining Siebel modules and Salesforce during the phased migration.
* Documentation: Prepare comprehensive Technical Design Documents (TDD), Data Dictionary, and Data Strategy/Mapping Documents for stakeholder review and approval.
* Testing & Validation: Conduct comprehensive data reconciliation, unit testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure data parity between Siebel and Salesforce.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Overall 10+ years of experience with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Siebel CRM development, configuration, and administration (Workflows, Business Services, eScript, and EIM).
* Migration Experience: Proven track record of executing at least 2 full end-to-end data migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce.

description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.
  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.
  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement.
