title: IAM Operations - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Manager in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber Operate team, you will help clients manage identity and access management (IAM) operations across enterprise platforms, customer applications, and third-party tools. You will lead day-to-day delivery of user identity and access lifecycle activities, helping maintain a secure, compliant, and efficient access environment. You will work with client and cross-functional teams to strengthen access governance, operational controls, and service delivery while supporting the development of team members.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead day-to-day user access administration across applications, platforms, and systems, including provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, access modifications, and joiner, mover, leaver activities.
* Validate access requests for completeness, approvals, and policy alignment; maintain user accounts, group memberships, roles, and entitlements in accordance with approved workflows and service-level targets.
* Oversee the logging, triage, categorization, prioritization, tracking, and closure of incidents, service requests, and access-related tasks using IT service management (ITSM) and ticketing tools.
* Apply standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, knowledge articles, and control requirements; maintain operational documentation, trackers, status updates, and audit evidence for access reviews and recertification activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues, coordinate with application owners, infrastructure, security, and service delivery teams, and escalate complex issues to senior team members or tool administrators within defined thresholds.
* Investigate recurring access issues, entitlement mismatches, control gaps, and workflow exceptions; participate in root-cause discussions and recommend process improvements to strengthen a secure, audit-ready access administration environment.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 10 - 15 years of experience in information technology, service operations, information security support and operational governance with ITIL v4 Service Management Framework.
* 6+ years of experience in access administration, user account management, or IAM operations support.
* Basic hands-on experience with any IAM tool or platform, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, or similar solutions, used for provisioning, deprovisioning, access provisioning, access management, access management or access governance.
* Experience performing manual access administration tasks using documented procedures and approval workflows.
* Working knowledge of user provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, entitlement updates, and access review support.
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or equivalent for managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and operational tracking.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of identity and access management concepts, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, role-based access, least-privilege principles, and access recertification.
* Ability to review requests, follow process controls, and accurately execute operational tasks.
* Experience in maintaining documentation, operational logs, and status reporting.
* Good communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate with appropriate context.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Exposure to IAM, IGA, or access management tools.
* Familiarity with access request workflows, approval matrices, and security governance processes.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and policy requirements related to access administration.
* Ability to follow client information security policies and handle sensitive access tasks with accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and process discipline.
* Ability to identify issues early, troubleshoot at a basic level, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic reporting and tracking skills using standard operational tools.
* Exposure to incident/problem management concepts and recurring issue resolution.

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: IAM Operations Manager – IGA & PAM
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on IAM manager to lead the team that runs and continuously improves our identity governance and privileged access services, built on Saviynt. Based in India and supporting a global organization, you will lead IAM analysts, engineers, and contract and managed-service resources, while remaining the go-to authority for Saviynt IGA and PAM. You will make sure every identity is provisioned, reviewed, and removed accurately and securely, that our access controls stand up to audit, and that identity issues are traced and fixed from the HR system through Saviynt to Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and downstream applications. This is an end-to-end service ownership and people leadership role, and a minimum of 3 years of hands-on Saviynt experience is required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop the IAM operations team, setting priorities, assigning ownership, and managing delivery across IGA, PAM, SSO, and Joiner-Mover-Leaver workstreams.
* Own the operation, configuration, and health of the Saviynt identity governance platform, including connectors, reconciliation and provisioning jobs, workflows, rules, and analytics.
* Run employee and contractor Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes driven from the authoritative HR system, including birthright access, mover reviews, and timely revocation for every leaver.
* Own Saviynt PAM operations, onboarding servers and privileged, administrative, and service accounts, and operating vaulting, password rotation, and Just-in-Time access.
* Replace standing privilege with controlled, time-bound access, and govern dormant, orphaned, and unowned privileged accounts.
* Plan, launch, and close User Access Review and Privileged Access Review campaigns, tracking revocations and remediation to closure.
* Keep identity data accurate across HR, Saviynt, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and the ITSM platform, resolving duplicate, orphaned, and mismatched identities at the source.
* Onboard applications into IGA, PAM, and SSO, defining entitlements, roles, workflows, and provisioning interfaces, and build repeatable onboarding frameworks.
* Govern Microsoft Entra ID SSO integrations using SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth, and SCIM, together with MFA and Conditional Access.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence and respond to internal and external audit requests, including SOX in-scope application reviews.
* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for identity platforms, leading troubleshooting to root cause and managing Saviynt support cases and professional services.
* Direct contract and managed-service resources against agreed service levels, build cross-skilling and coverage within the team, and maintain runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Report service performance, metrics, risks, and roadmap priorities to Identity & Cloud Security leadership and the CISO.

**Core Competencies**

* Deep, hands-on mastery of Saviynt identity governance and privileged access, backed by strong analytical troubleshooting across connected systems.
* Proven people leadership, with the ability to build, coach, and motivate a blended team of employees, contractors, and managed-service partners.
* Sound, controlled judgment in an environment where an incorrect lifecycle or privileged-access action creates business, audit, or security risk.
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management, with the ability to secure decisions from HR, application owners, and infrastructure teams and to explain technical issues in business terms.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on Saviynt experience (mandatory), covering connectors, provisioning and reconciliation jobs, workflows, rules, access requests, and certification campaigns.
* 8+ years of experience in identity and access management or cybersecurity, including substantial hands-on IGA and PAM delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading IAM operations or engineering teams, including prioritizing work, coaching staff, and directing contract or managed-service resources.
* Saviynt PAM (CPAM) experience strongly preferred, or experience with a comparable enterprise PAM platform.
* Strong practical experience across at least two of IGA, PAM, and SSO, with sufficient knowledge to govern the third.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including Conditional Access, MFA, and privileged roles.
* Experience with SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, REST APIs, and LDAP integrations.
* Experience with HR-driven identity lifecycle using Dayforce or a comparable HR system, and with Freshservice or a comparable ITSM platform.
* Experience running access certification campaigns and producing defensible audit evidence, with familiarity with SOX, ISO 27001, or NIST access controls.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Saviynt certifications or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate are a plus.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and experience working with teams and stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC time zones.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - IV**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
This role provides expert-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases, and directs business assessment and requirements analysis for hardware and operating systems, while architecting complex data integration and driving system performance and scalability improvements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides expert level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products. Ensures that expected application performance levels are achieved.
* Ensures the viability of IT deliverables. Recommends development options, including design, build/buy, and vendor purchase. Conducts testing, including functionality, technical limitations, and security.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Provides subject matter expertise in software development methodology and development architecture standards. Mentors and trains staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues and recommends enterprise-wide improvements.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad and deep understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems. Is well versed on the latest technologies and tools supporting software development in the industry.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Architect and guide integration of complex data flows across distributed services, APIs, and platforms to enable reliable, secure, and seamless enterprise-level interoperability.
* Drive performance and scalability enhancements by proactively analyzing system behavior, optimizing database architecture, and implementing high-efficiency design patterns.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in application development, system architecture and database management.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) or Master’s degree (M.E./M.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proficiency in Android, iOS, Nodejs, Typescript, ECS, Kubernetes
* Understanding of Material Design (Android) and Human Interface Guidelines (iOS)
* ServiceNow platfrom knowledge (Integration skills, app engine and flow design, servicenow scripting and Glide API, jave Proficiency

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SAP CRM Technical Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Hypersoft Technologies Limited is a publicly traded software products and professional IT services company delivering financial and business applications, consultancy services, and custom software development across multiple platforms. The organization specializes in client/server software development, turnkey database solutions, and rapid web and Windows application development, supported by experienced development and support teams. Hypersoft focuses on completing projects on time and to high quality standards, emphasizing long-term relationships, responsiveness, and reliability as a trusted partner. The company serves diverse market segments including securities management, manufacturing and ERP systems, business process reengineering, textiles, retail, legacy system conversion, online accounting, BPO, and VoIP-based call center solutions. In addition, Hypersoft offers packaged solutions for areas such as stock broking, portfolio management, HR and payroll, inventory and fixed asset management, medical and hospital management, supply chain and service call management, and e-retail.

**Role Description**
This contract role for a SAP CRM Technical Consultant is based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work arrangement, combining on-site presence with some work-from-home flexibility. The consultant will design, develop, and implement SAP CRM technical solutions aligned with client business processes and organizational requirements. Daily responsibilities include configuring SAP CRM modules, developing custom components, managing middleware integrations, and ensuring data consistency across related SAP systems. The role involves gathering and analyzing business requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and providing consulting support throughout the solution lifecycle, including testing, issue resolution, and optimization. The consultant will collaborate with cross-functional teams, prepare technical documentation, and may support user training, upgrades, and ongoing enhancements to improve system performance and user experience.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to analyze and map Business Process requirements and translate them into effective SAP CRM solutions.
* 10+ years of Strong hands-on experience with SAP CRM, including configuration, customization, and integration with other SAP modules.
* Proficiency in SAP CRM Technical areas such as development (ABAP or relevant SAP technologies), UI components, and enhancement frameworks.
* Experience working with Middleware for SAP CRM, including integration, data exchange, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
* Background in Consulting, with skills in requirement gathering, stakeholder communication, solution design, and client-facing delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Knowledge of SAP ECC or S/4HANA integration, CRM data models, and performance optimization is beneficial.
* Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and experience working in hybrid or distributed project environments.

description:
**About Flutter Entertainment**
Flutter Entertainment is the
**world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator**
with
**15.9 million**

**$16.4 billion**
in 2025. We have a

**TIME**
as one of the
**World’s Best Companies 2025**
— a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  
  
Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing
**portfolio of brands**
across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.
  
  
**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**
Our office in the heart of
**Hi-Tech City**
, Hyderabad, serves as
**Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).**
Now home to 1,000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics.
  
  
Our Values define us. They are -
**Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day.**
They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.
  
  
With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our
**communities**
with the talent and passion of our
**colleagues**
.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Flutter Technology is seeking a skilled AI & Automation Enablement Engineer to support the practical adoption and technical execution of our underlying AI & Automation product suite. This role is focused on rapid technical prototyping, pattern development, and enabling Flutter Functions to realise measurable value from platforms like Flutter Assistant, AI Hub, Claude and Workato.
  
  
You will work as part of a small, high-velocity Enablement team based across multiple time zones, primarily responsible for developing technical proof-of-concepts, creating reusable AI & Automation architectural patterns, and resolving complex technical blockers. This is a hands-on technical role for individuals who excel at rapid prototyping and enjoy operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and practical business value.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong technical expertise across automation and AI platforms, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with Product Strategy, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Prototyping & PoC Development: Design, develop, and execute Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) for complex, high-priority AI & Automation initiatives, demonstrating technical feasibility and value potential by building functional prototypes that combine Automation platforms, AI services, and enterprise integrations, including secure MCP servers and agent integrations.
* Complex Technical Problem-Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across multi-platform solutions, ensuring successful validation of new AI and Automation patterns.
* Reusable Pattern & Blueprint Creation: Create reusable technical blueprints and architectural patterns for solutions, including AI agent workflows, multi-platform orchestration, and intelligent automation.
* Pattern Documentation & Standards : Develop and maintain comprehensive Pattern Documentation, ensuring clarity and completeness, while establishing technical best-practice guidelines and standards for automation development.
* Platform Feature Testing & Validation: Conduct hands-on technical testing and validation of new platform features (Workato, Flutter Assistant, AI Hub, Claude) to understand capabilities and limitations, evaluating emerging AI and Automation technologies to determine viability and strategic fit for Flutter.
* AI-Assisted Delivery: Use AI coding and agentic tools in day-to-day development, testing, documentation and support, and help evolve the team’s AI-driven ways of working to improve speed, quality and reliability.
* Product Feedback & Platform Input: Provide technical feedback to Product Managers on platform capabilities and feature requirements based on hands-on exploration and testing.
* Architecture Collaboration & Standards Alignment : Partner with Architecture peers to ensure patterns adhere to established technical standards, security, and governance requirements.
* Pattern Handover & Implementation Support: Facilitate seamless Pattern Documentation & Handover to Delivery teams, providing technical context and support during implementation while acting as a technical advisor for troubleshooting guidance.
* Requirements Translation & Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with Business Analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Adoption Championing & Continuous Improvement: Champion the adoption of newly enabled technical patterns within the wider engineering community, collecting and analysing feedback from Delivery teams to continuously improve pattern quality and usability.
* On-Call Rota: Participate in an on-call rota to provide out-of-hours support for the platforms the team owns.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Technical Expertise & Execution: Deep technical knowledge with the ability to design and build complex AI and Automation solutions independently.
* Rapid Prototyping: Excels at quickly building functional PoCs and iterating based on feedback and technical constraints.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex, multi-system technical challenges.
* Collaboration & Communication: Works effectively across teams in multiple time zones and articulates technical solutions clearly to diverse audiences.
* Continuous Learning: Demonstrates curiosity and commitment to staying current with rapidly evolving AI and automation technologies.
* Quality & Standards: Maintains high standards for code quality, documentation, and technical best practices.
* AI-First Mindset: Applies AI tools to how they build, test and troubleshoot, and shares what works with the team.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* 3-5 years in a hands-on technical role (e.g., Automation Engineer, Solutions Developer, Integration Engineer, AI Engineer) with experience in enterprise automation or AI implementation.
* Strong prototyping experience, with a demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into functional technical solutions rapidly.
* Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise automation/integration platforms such as UiPath, Workato, Blue Prism, Power Automate, or similar tools.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, VBA).
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP (AWS preferred) and enterprise system architecture.
* Experience building or integrating with APIs, and an understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and how they give AI agents secure access to enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of identity and access management (for example OAuth2, SSO and user-level authentication and permissions) is beneficial, as secure access underpins most of our integrations.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD principles.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban).

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs .
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.
* Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness.
* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* Free Meals, Cab Allowance , and a Home Office Setup Allowance.
* Employer PF Contribution , gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards .

**WHY CHOOSE US**
Flutter is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.
  
  
We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.
  
  
If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences, and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

title: Fintech - Technical Consultant, Officer
description:
**Consultant – Offshore Fintech - Technical Consultant (Officer)**
**Charles River Development | Engineering / Professional Services**
**Role Summary**
Consultants – Offshore support the technical implementation of the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS) by contributing to configuration, development, integration, and testing activities across client implementations.
  
  
This role requires a solid understanding of investment management systems, hands‑on technical skills, and the ability to work effectively within project teams to implement client requirements under established solution designs and guidance. Consultants collaborate closely with senior consultants, project managers, and global delivery teams to help deliver stable, production‑ready solutions and support client readiness for go‑live.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking implementation professionals with foundational to intermediate experience in financial technology delivery, ideally within capital markets or investment management environments. The ideal candidate brings
**08-12 Years of relevant industry experience**
, gained within a consulting firm, financial institution, or financial software provider.
  
  
Candidates should have hands‑on experience contributing to Front, Middle, or Back Office implementations, possess strong technical fundamentals, and demonstrate the ability to learn CRIMS functionality and capital markets workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a
**Consultant – Offshore (Officer)**
, you will:
  
  

* Contribute to platform’s technical implementations across Front, Middle, and Back Office workflows under guidance
* Assist in analyzing and translating business and technical requirements into CRIMS configurations and components
* Configure and develop application components based on established designs and standards
* Support system testing activities, including functional, integration, and regression testing
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues with support from senior team members
* Ensure configurations and deliverables meet quality, stability, and operational standards
* Participate in go‑live readiness activities and provide implementation support post‑deployment
* Follow CRD SDLC, documentation standards, and delivery best practices
* Collaborate effectively with global delivery teams and stakeholders

**What We Value**
Consultants (Offshore) are expected to demonstrate:
  
  

* Experience contributing to Investment Management or Capital Markets system implementations
* Strong problem‑solving skills with attention to detail and quality
* Ability to work effectively in structured delivery environments
* Willingness to learn product functionality, domain concepts, and delivery processes
* Clear communication and collaboration skills within project teams

**Technical Skills & Experience**
Working knowledge and hands‑on exposure to the following is expected:
  
  
**Programming & Development**

* Core Java (working proficiency)
* Snowflake and/or SQL Server (querying, joins, basic performance analysis)
* ETL - Pentaho, Talend
* AI usage

**Data & Reporting**

* Exposure to ETL or data processing tools (e.g., Pentaho, Talend) – Talend preferred
* Basic experience with reporting tools such as SSRS

**Cloud & Platforms**

* Exposure to any one or more cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
* Familiarity with cloud‑based deployments is a plus
* Snowflake exposure is beneficial but not mandatory

**Integration & Market Data**
(good to have)
  
  

* Awareness of industry interfaces (e.g., FIX, SWIFT)
* Exposure to market and reference data providers (e.g., Bloomberg, MSCI) is a plus

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline
* Strong foundation in:

+ Object‑oriented programming
+ Databases and SQL concepts
+ Enterprise application fundamentals
+ Agentic and Gen AI efficient Usage

* Exposure to financial systems, data integration, or distributed systems is desirable
* Relevant certifications are a plus:

+ Azure / AWS fundamentals
+ Technical or financial certifications
+ Progress toward CFA is an advantage

**Experience Requirements**

* 08-12 years of relevant professional experience in financial technology or enterprise software
* Hands‑on experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Application configuration or development
+ System integration and data processing
+ Reporting or analytics support
+ Capital markets or investment management platforms (good to have)

**About Charles River Development**
Charles River Investment management System in a platform that provides many Front-Office functions including Portfolio Management, Order Management and Execution, Compliance, Performance & Attribution, Modelling, Scenario Analysis, and Wealth Management.
  
  
We are part of the State Street Bank. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies in the world. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
AVP, Web Engineer III will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. etc leveraging latest AI tools and capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and track measurable team goals (delivery, quality, reliability, and productivity metrics) and drive continuous improvement.
* Communicate delivery status, technical decisions, and trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership; escalate risks with mitigation plans.
* Stay current on emerging technologies and evaluate adoption opportunities, while ensuring strong proficiency and stability in the existing stack.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 4+ years in software engineering and 2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role. or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of relevant experience

* Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event-driven systems), and building mission-critical services with high availability and performance.

* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with
**4+ years**
in software engineering and

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front-end and back-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge-sharing across teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**

**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. **Qualifications**

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

**Purpose of the Role:**

The Systems Engineer will contribute to the design, development, and integration of complex medical devices, working across various engineering disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, software, and embedded systems. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the seamless integration of subsystems, managing system-level requirements, and supporting verification and validation activities. This position will take ownership of project delivery both internal and external, ensuring high-quality engineering outcomes and adherence to regulatory standards such as FDA Design Controls. **empathy, long-term view, agility, and unity—form**

* Proven experience in collaborating with PMOs and global teams on system projects
* Strong technical background in system design, circuit board development, and compliance with regulatory standards

**Skills**

* Comfortable working in Agile SCRUM and stage-gate environments, ensuring collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet project objectives

title: Staff Test Lead
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Test Manager to lead our testing strategy, manage testing activities, and ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in test planning, automation, and quality assurance while working in Agile and DevOps environments to test components, feature and or feature set. This role requires exceptional leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills to drive automated testing excellence across projects
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
In this role, you will
  
  

* Own and deliver medium-sized quality engineering tasks while mentoring and helping team members in Power System Domain which includes Energy Management Systems, Market Management Systems
* Make technology choices at individual level and analyse impact
* Apply principles of SDLC and methodologies like Lean/Agile/XP, CI, Software and Product Security, Scalability, Documentation Practices, refactoring and Testing Techniques
* Integrate project testing with continuous-integration process
* Create effective scenarios and tests following best practices like Behavior Driven Development (BDD ) and Test Driven Development (TDD)
* Work with fellow team members to diagnose bugs and formulate solutions
* Provide expertise in the quality engineering, test planning and testing methodology for a software project
* Develop and executes maintainable automation tests for acceptance, functional, and regression test cases

**Test Strategy & Management**

* Define and implement the overall testing strategy, frameworks, and best practices to ensure software quality.
* Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and test automation strategies for complex software solutions.
* Oversee functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across multiple projects.
* Ensure test environments, data, and tools are effectively managed for smooth test execution.

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, analysts, and testers to enhance their skills and capabilities.
* Collaborate with development, product, and business teams to align testing with project goals and timelines.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and proactive issue resolution within the testing team.
* Manage test resources, schedules, and risk assessments to ensure timely quality project delivery.

**Automation & Performance Testing**

* Advocate and implement test automation strategies to increase efficiency and coverage.
* Work with DevOps teams to integrate continuous testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Oversee performance, security, and load testing to identify potential system vulnerabilities.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Establish and enforce QA standards, best practices, and compliance guidelines in line with industry benchmarks.
* Ensure defect tracking, root cause analysis, and continuous feedback loops are in place.
* Provide regular test reports, metrics, and insights to stakeholders to support informed decision-making.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software testing & quality assurance, with at least 5+ years in a lead role.
* Strong expertise in test management, automation, and performance testing tools (e.g., Selenium, HP Quick Test Professional, JMeter, LoadRunner, Cypress).
* Understand test frameworks, automation techniques, and testing methodologies (Katalon/Selenium)
* Java technology background, ability/familiarity to code at least in Core Java
* Ability to write scripts (one of bash/ksh, python or groovy)
* Experience using CI tools (Jenkins, TeamCity, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and CI/CD methodologies.
* Understand Jbehave/Cucumber framework, Java languages and different design patterns
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Electrical Utilities industry domain or other regulated industries is a plus.
* Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, CSM, SAFe Agile, or PMI-ACP are advantageous.
* Exposure to AI-driven testing, RPA (Robotic Process Automation), and security testing is a plus.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Analyst-Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 1.5 to 2.5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.
  
  
**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Please note that our firm has adopted a COVID-19 vaccination requirement for employees who work onsite at any of our U.S. locations to safeguard the health and well-being of all our employees and others who enter our U.S. offices. title: Junior AI Functional Consultant
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Job Overview**
The Junior AI Functional Consultant is embedded with the Business Units to support the identification, analysis, documentation, ROI computation, data validation, and delivery of AI-enabled business solutions. The role works across business stakeholders, product teams, technical teams, and project leadership to convert business needs into clear, testable, and traceable solution requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth analysis of business processes, workflows, and data to map opportunities for automation by leveraging process mining and task mining tools (e.g., Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, Minit, Apromore, ServiceNow)
* Analyze business processes, workflows, pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Support stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and requirements-gathering meetings.
* Document business, user, functional, non-functional, data, security, reporting, and adoption requirements.
* Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, scope diagrams, data mappings, use cases, and prototypes.
* Assist in identifying, assessing, and prioritizing AI and automation use cases.
* Support feasibility assessments covering business value, data readiness, technical complexity, risk, and adoption readiness.
* Translate business requirements into solution requirements in collaboration with technical teams.
* Support proof-of-concept activities by documenting hypotheses, expected outcomes, test scenarios, and findings.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint reviews, testing, defect triage, demonstrations, and release-readiness activities.
* Maintain requirements traceability, assumptions, decisions, dependencies, risks, and change records.
* Support user acceptance testing and validation of delivered functionality.
* Prepare meeting notes, action items, status reports, presentations, user guides, and client-facing deliverables.

**Essential Job Functions**
**Business Analysis**

* Gather and document stakeholder needs.
* Analyze current-state and future-state processes.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, exceptions, and business rules; develop clear and testable requirements.

**AI Use-Case Analysis**

* Evaluate use cases such as document processing, content generation, summarization, classification, search, recommendation, prediction, and workflow automation.
* Help define success measures, business outcomes, assumptions, risks, constraints, and data needs.

**Product and Delivery Support**

* Support backlog creation and prioritization.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and maintain assigned work items.
* Assist with testing, demonstrations, release documentation, and value tracking.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare presentations, decision summaries, meeting outputs, and workshop materials.
* Communicate technical concepts in accessible business language.
* Support client and internal stakeholder sessions under guidance.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, consulting projects, or business-analysis assignments.
* Basic knowledge of business analysis, product development, and software development concepts.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, presentation, and facilitation abilities.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Interest in AI, Generative AI, automation, responsible AI, and digital transformation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with user stories, acceptance criteria, process models, use cases, prototypes, and data models.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Platform, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, or process-mining tools.
* Basic familiarity with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, or Azure AI Foundry.
* Awareness of prompt engineering, user acceptance testing, traceability, risk management, and change management.

**Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training**
Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.
  
  

* Business analysis, stakeholder analysis, and requirements elicitation
* User stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability
* Process mapping, BPMN fundamentals, data modeling, and analysis basics
* Software Development Life Cycle and Product Development Life Cycle
* Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Azure DevOps
* Functional and non-functional requirements, testing, defect management, and UAT
* AI, machine learning, Generative AI, prompt engineering, and responsible AI
* Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI services, Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and Power BI
* Process mining and Task mining tools and methodology (using MS process mining, Celonis, Apromore, etc.)
* AI use-case discovery, prioritization, feasibility, and value assessment
* Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams, SharePoint, consulting communication, and workshop facilitation

**Pre-Joining Capstone**
Convert a business problem into an AI use-case assessment, requirements package, process model, prioritized product backlog, test approach, and stakeholder presentation.
  
  
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**

**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS

* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements

* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

title: Senior System Integrator – UAV / Drone Systems
description:
**Company: Drogo Drones Pvt. Ltd. (Drogo Aerospace)**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Experience: 8–10 Years**

**Department: Research & Development / UAV Systems Engineering**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Position: Senior System Integrator**

**About Drogo Aerospace**

Drogo Aerospace is a drone technology company specializing in the design, development, manufacturing, integration, and testing of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for defence, surveillance, agriculture, and industrial applications.

We are looking for an experienced Senior System Integrator to lead the integration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of advanced UAV platforms, including multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, and hybrid drone systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. UAV System Integration**

* Lead end-to-end integration of UAV hardware, software, avionics, propulsion, and communication systems.
* Integrate flight controllers, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, ESCs, motors, servos, sensors, telemetry modules, and payloads.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability between electrical, electronic, mechanical, and software subsystems.
* Oversee integration of multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, and hybrid UAV platforms.

**2. Avionics & Flight Control Systems**

* Configure, integrate, and troubleshoot flight control systems using ArduPilot, PX4, Mission Planner, and QGroundControl.
* Integrate autopilot systems, navigation sensors, communication links, and ground control stations.
* Support flight controller calibration, parameter tuning, and system-level validation.
* Troubleshoot hardware-software interface issues.

**3. Testing & Validation**

* Develop and execute system integration testing procedures, including bench testing, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and ground testing.
* Conduct system-level verification and validation before flight trials.
* Analyze flight logs, telemetry data, and system performance to identify technical issues.
* Support flight testing, failure analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensure system reliability, safety, and operational readiness.

**4. Electrical & Electronic Integration**

* Supervise wiring harness design, power distribution, PCB integration, and electrical subsystem connectivity.
* Integrate batteries, power management systems, propulsion controllers, and communication equipment.
* Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system architecture documents.
* Diagnose electrical faults, signal interference, and communication failures.

**5. System Architecture & Documentation**

* Collaborate with design, embedded software, mechanical, avionics, and flight-testing teams.
* Prepare system architecture diagrams, interface control documents (ICDs), integration plans, and test reports.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and integration checklists.
* Support design reviews, engineering change management, and product development activities.

**6. Team Leadership & Project Coordination**

* Lead and mentor system integration engineers and technicians.
* Coordinate integration activities across multiple UAV development projects.
* Identify technical risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
* Ensure timely completion of integration milestones while maintaining quality and safety standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 8–10 years of relevant experience in system integration, preferably within UAV, aerospace, defence, avionics, or robotics industries.
* Strong understanding of UAV architecture, avionics, flight control systems, and communication protocols.
* Hands-on experience integrating complex electromechanical and embedded systems.
* Experience with CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, and other communication interfaces.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical, electronic, and embedded system integration issues.
* Experience with UAV ground testing, flight testing, and system validation.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and system interface documentation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with fixed-wing, VTOL, hybrid, and long-endurance UAV platforms.
* Familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4, MAVLink, Mission Planner, and QGroundControl.
* Knowledge of GNSS/RTK, telemetry, RF communication, and payload integration.
* Experience with propulsion systems, including electric, internal combustion, and hybrid configurations.
* Familiarity with defence UAV development and mission-critical systems.
* Knowledge of DGCA UAV regulations, type certification processes, and applicable aerospace quality standards.
* Experience with system-level troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement.
* Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
