title: Cluster Head
description:
**Cluster Head: Job Description**

**Role summary**  
The Cluster Head is responsible for the complete running of a group of branches in one region: branch operations, the branch teams, sales and local marketing. They spend most of the week travelling between branches and report on performance every week.

The company is a gold buying and financial services brand, part of an established group, growing across Telangana, Hyderabad and Andhra Pradesh.

**Job title:**Cluster Head

**Department:** Sales and Operations

**Location:** Base branch in the assigned cluster, with daily travel across it

**Reports to:** Head of Operations

**Dotted line** Head of Marketing, for marketing activity and sales performance

**Team:** Typically 6-8 Branch Managers and their branch staff

**Experience:** 4+ years, including team leadership

**Travel** City clusters: every branch weekly. District clusters: every branch at least every two weeks

**Employment:** Full-time, permanent

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Branch operations**

* Run day-to-day operations at every branch in the cluster: opening and closing, cash, gold stock and customer documentation
* Make sure every branch follows company process for gold testing, valuation, KYC and payments
* Carry out surprise checks of cash and gold stock, and close audit findings on time
* Keep branches staffed, clean, secure and to brand standards
* Escalate security, fraud or compliance issues the same day

**2. Team leadership**

* Lead the Branch Managers in the cluster and, through them, all branch staff
* Hire, onboard and train staff with HR; plan rosters and leave cover across branches
* Set monthly targets for each branch and each staff member, and review them one-to-one every month
* Coach teams on customer handling, valuation conversations and closing
* Handle performance and discipline issues with HR

**3. Sales**

* Own monthly sales and gold purchase targets for the cluster and for each branch
* Track daily branch numbers and act within the week on any branch below target
* Improve walk-in conversion and bring back repeat customers
* Work with the telecalling team so every lead is called, followed up and brought to a branch
* Build local relationships with businesses and community groups that send referrals

**4. Marketing**

* Plan the cluster’s monthly local marketing calendar with the Marketing team
* Run BTL activity: canopies, society and market activations, temple and festival events, pamphlets and local tie-ups
* Keep branch signage, branding and in-store material up to date
* Support digital campaigns: gather customer reviews, share local updates for social media, track leads by source
* Spend the cluster’s marketing budget as approved and report cost per lead and cost per customer
* Report competitor offers and local customer insights

**5. Reporting and MIS**

* Maintain daily sales and footfall reports for every branch
* Send a weekly cluster report: sales against target, footfall, leads and conversion, marketing activity and spend, audit points and staffing
* Prepare a monthly cluster review presentation for the Head of Operations and the Head of Marketing
* Keep a log of every branch visit with the actions agreed
* Spot trends in the data and recommend what to change

**6. New branch launches**

* Support site checks, set-up and staffing for new branches in the cluster
* Run pre-launch and launch marketing with the Marketing team, and track each new branch to target

**7. Franchise branches**

* Oversee sales performance and brand standards at franchise branches in the cluster
* Act as the day-to-day contact for franchise partners

**Qualifications and experience**

*Required*

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or PG diploma in sales, marketing or retail management is a plus
* 4+ years in retail sales, branch operations or field sales
* At least 2 years leading a team, ideally across more than one branch, outlet or territory
* Hands-on experience running local marketing or BTL activity
* Strong reporting skills: MS Excel or Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, charts) and PowerPoint
* Fluent Telugu and English
* Own two-wheeler or four-wheeler and a valid driving licence; ready to travel daily within the cluster
* Lives in, or will relocate to, the cluster’s base town

*Preferred*

* Experience in gold buying, gold loans, jewellery retail, NBFC or banking
* Has opened a new branch or turned around a weak one
* Works with a CRM or sales dashboard
* Basic knowledge of gold purity testing and valuation
* Hindi

**Skills**

* **Team leadership:** leads people across several sites, sets clear targets and follows up fairly
* **Sales:** reads the numbers quickly, finds why a branch is behind and fixes it
* **Marketing:** plans local campaigns and knows what each one brought in
* **Reporting:** produces accurate reports on time, turns data into clear recommendations, presents with confidence
* **Integrity:** handles cash, gold and customer data honestly

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

* How many total years of experience do you have in retail sales, branch operations, or field sales?
* How many years have you led a team? How many branches/outlets and how many people did you manage?
* Are you fluent in Telugu and English (speaking, reading, writing)?

title: HR Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Executive to manage day-to-day HR operations and support the complete employee lifecycle. The ideal candidate should have good communication and interpersonal skills, a strong understanding of HR processes, and the ability to handle multiple HR responsibilities efficiently.

The candidate will be responsible for recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, attendance management, employee engagement, HR documentation, employee relations and compliance-related activities.

**Key Responsibilities**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

* Handle end-to-end recruitment for IT and Non-IT positions.
* Understand hiring requirements and coordinate with respective department managers.
* Source candidates through job portals, professional networks, employee referrals and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews and schedule technical interviews.
* Coordinate with candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Manage offer rollouts, salary negotiations and candidate follow-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.

2. Employee Onboarding & Offboarding

* Manage the complete employee onboarding process, including documentation and joining formalities.
* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters and other employment-related documents.
* Coordinate with IT and Admin teams to arrange employee access, systems and workspace.
* Conduct employee induction and explain company policies and procedures.
* Manage exit formalities, resignation acknowledgements, exit interviews and full-and-final coordination.
* Ensure proper handover and documentation before employee separation.

3. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management

* Maintain and update employee records, personal files and HR databases.
* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including confirmation, probation reviews, transfers, promotions and separations.
* Prepare and maintain HR letters, employee certificates and other official documents.
* Handle employee queries related to HR policies, attendance, leave and workplace procedures.
* Ensure employee information is maintained confidentially and accurately.

4. Attendance, Leave & Performance Management

* Monitor employee attendance, login/logout timings, working hours and leave records.
* Manage attendance and productivity monitoring tools.
* Track employee absenteeism, late logins, early logouts and attendance discrepancies.
* Coordinate with team leaders and managers regarding attendance-related issues.
* Maintain leave balances and ensure leave approvals follow company policies.
* Support performance review cycles, probation assessments and employee confirmation processes.

5. Employee Relations & Engagement

* Act as a point of contact for employees regarding HR-related concerns.
* Address employee grievances and coordinate with management for appropriate resolutions.
* Organise employee engagement activities, celebrations and team-building initiatives.
* Support employee retention initiatives and maintain a positive workplace environment.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify employee feedback and improvement areas.

6. HR Policies & Statutory Compliance

* Implement and communicate HR policies and company procedures.
* Ensure HR documentation and processes comply with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax and other statutory documentation and compliance activities, as applicable.
* Maintain statutory records and employee-related compliance documents.
* Assist in updating employee handbooks, HR policies and internal procedures.

* Coordinate with the payroll team for monthly attendance, leave and employee data.

title: Manager Strategy
description:
About Allen Career Institute

Allen Career Institute was founded on April 18, 1988, in Kota, Rajasthan, by Rajesh Maheshwari, who began by teaching eight students out of a small rented space. His brothers Govind, Naveen and Brajesh Maheshwari joined him over time, and the institute has been run as a family-led organisation since its founding. Allen was named in memory of the founders' father, Laxmi Narayan Maheshwari.

From its early years, Allen distinguished itself by offering coaching across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology under one roof, rather than focusing on a single subject.

This model helped establish Kota as India's best-known hub for competitive exam coaching, and Allen grew alongside it into one of the country's largest test preparation institutions, known primarily for its IIT-JEE and NEET coaching programmes.

Allen has since expanded well beyond its original Kota campus, operating classroom centres across multiple cities in India and building out a digital learning arm, Allen Online, alongside brands such as Doubtnut and Allen Intelli Brain. The company has also attracted institutional investment, including backing from Bodhi Tree Systems, and continues to explore opportunities for expansion and business transformation.

It is this next phase, spanning organic expansion, digital growth and inorganic opportunities such as partnerships, investments, acquisitions and capital market initiatives, that the Strategy Team supports directly.

Role Overview

Allen Career Institute is looking for a high-calibre Manager – Strategy to drive and support high-impact strategic initiatives across organic and inorganic growth.

The role requires a professional with 4-8 years of experience, combining strong strategic thinking, financial acumen and execution capabilities, with hands-on exposure to M&A transactions and Capital markets.The individual will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across strategy, finance, product, operations and business functions. The position will involve evaluating strategic opportunities, supporting investment and transaction-related decisions, developing financial models and translating complex business problems into actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate should have a strong academic background, preferably from a Tier 1 undergraduate institution, and prior experience in investment banking, M&A, transaction advisory, corporate finance, strategy consulting or similar analytical and financial roles.

This is a high-ownership role offering direct exposure to senior leadership and the C-Suite, with the opportunity to contribute to Allen's long-term growth and strategic direction.

Key Responsibilities

● Hands-on capital markets experience (mandatory) – equity fundraising, public or private issuances, investor materials and financial disclosures, or SEBI-regulated transactions.

● Hands-on M&A experience – e.g., target evaluation, due diligence, valuation and deal execution.

● Drive strategic projects linked to business growth, market expansion, operating performance and inorganic growth opportunities.

● Conduct detailed market research, competitor benchmarking, sector analysis and opportunity assessments to identify potential growth avenues.

● Build and evaluate financial models, business models, valuation models, scenario analyses and investment business cases.

● Evaluate potential acquisitions, partnerships, investments and expansion opportunities from strategic and financial perspectives.

● Develop data-backed insights and strategic recommendations to support key business and leadership decisions.

● Prepare and present leadership presentations, investment notes, strategy decks, financial analyses and decision support materials.

● Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across finance, product, operations and business teams to drive strategic initiatives.

● Track market trends, competitive activity, capital market developments and sector opportunities relevant to Allen's growth priorities.

● Take ownership of high-priority strategic initiatives, ensuring structured execution, stakeholder alignment and timely delivery.

● Support the C-Suite and senior strategy leadership on critical business decisions and long-term strategic planning.

Candidate Requirements

Must-Have Criteria

● 4–8 years of full-time work experience in a relevant strategic, financial, or consulting role.

● Hands-on experience in M&A as well as capital markets.

● Strong academic background, preferably from a Tier 1 undergraduate institution.

● Strong analytical, problem-solving and structured thinking abilities.

● Demonstrated proficiency in financial analysis, financial modelling, valuation and business case preparation.

● Experience evaluating investment opportunities, strategic transactions or business growth initiatives.

● Ability to work with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

● Strong ownership mindset, execution orientation and bias for action.

● Excellent communication, presentation and business-writing skills.

Ideal Candidate Profiles

Candidates should ideally come from one of the following backgrounds:

●
**Investment Banking Professionals:**
3–5 years of experience in M&A, fundraising, capital markets, deal execution, valuation or transaction advisory.

●
**CA Professionals:**
Qualified Chartered Accountants with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Big 4 Deals, M&A, transaction advisory, corporate finance or capital markets.

●
**Strategy & Consulting Professionals:**
Professionals with 3–5 years of experience in strategy consulting or corporate strategy, with meaningful exposure to financial modelling, M&A and capital markets.

●
**Corporate Finance / M&A Professionals:**
Candidates with experience in corporate development, investment evaluation, acquisitions, fundraising, financial structuring or strategic transactions.

Additional Preferred Experience

● Prior experience working on end-to-end M&A transactions, including deal evaluation, due diligence, valuation and execution.

● Exposure to capital markets, fundraising, investor interactions or capital structuring.

● Experience in growth strategy, market entry, business transformation or investment evaluation.

● MBA from a top-tier institute is an added advantage but not mandatory.

● Experience working with senior leadership, promoters, founders or C-suite stakeholders.

Designation

● Experience: 4–8 years.

● Potential Designations: Manager – Strategy, AVP, Associate – Level 3 or equivalent, depending on the candidates current designation and organisational structure.

Role Highlights

● Direct exposure to the C-Suite and senior leadership.

● Opportunity to work on high-impact organic and inorganic growth initiatives.

● Involvement in M&A, capital markets and strategic investment decisions.

● High ownership and visibility across critical business initiatives.

● Opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth and expansion of one of India's leading education institutions.

description:

* Understand observability, telemetry, and site reliability engineering (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK) to ensure platform visibility and proactive alerting.
* Can navigate complex technical discussions with enterprise clients, translating high-level business requirements into resilient, secure, and modular software architectures.
* Bring an automation-first mindset with strong ownership, combining high-level strategic architecture vision with the ability to dive deep into code, pipelines, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: Senior Specialist-Accounts Payable
description:
**Job Description**
**Title:**
Senior Specialist – Accounts Payable & Automation
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Work arrangement:**
5 days in the office
  
  
**About Upstox**
At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**The Role: Senior Specialist – Accounts Payable & Automation**
We’re looking for someone to own Accounts Payable end to end and make it faster, more accurate, and largely automated. You’ll run day-to-day AP on SAP, keep vendors paid correctly and on time, and lead the automation of invoice intake, tracking, reconciliation, and payments. Reporting to the Head of Finance / Financial Controller, you’ll be the person who turns a manual process into a well-oiled, controlled machine.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Own the full procure-to-pay cycle on SAP, from invoice receipt, 3-way matching, and booking to payment runs, and drive month-end, quarter-end, and year-end AP closing.
* Build and run invoice tracking and AP dashboards covering ageing, outstanding payables, payment run status, and exceptions, and escalate bottlenecks before they become problems.
* Manage domestic and foreign vendor payments with tight maker-checker controls, including FEMA/RBI compliance, Form 15CA/15CB, Section 195 and DTAA withholding, equalisation levy, and reverse charge GST.
* Ensure TDS and GST compliance across vendor payments (deductions, deposits, returns, 26AS/AIS and GSTR-2A/2B reconciliations), own daily and monthly bank reconciliations, and support statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Lead AP automation from requirement to go-live, partnering with Tech, Product, and IT on SAP integrations, OCR invoice capture, RPA bots, and workflow tools, while documenting SOPs and keeping controls strong.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–7 years of experience in Accounts Payable / finance operations, ideally running AP at scale with high invoice volumes; experience in financial services, broking, fintech, or another high-volume business is a plus.
* Working knowledge of SAP FI (with MM integration for P2P), covering vendor master, invoice posting, payment runs, and reporting.
* Sound knowledge of TDS and GST as they apply to vendor payments, plus hands-on experience with foreign remittances, Form 15CA/15CB, Section 195, and DTAA.
* Must have: working proficiency in Python and SQL, with real examples of scripts or queries used to automate finance tasks, and a track record of leading at least one AP or finance automation project end to end.
* Familiarity with RPA (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Power Automate), OCR/invoice capture, and workflow tools, along with advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI or Tableau is a bonus.
* CMA / MBA (Finance), or B.Tech / B.E. with strong AP and Indian tax compliance experience; a process-minded, controls-first approach and the ability to lead a team through closes and audits.

**Why This Role Rocks**
This isn’t a role for keeping the lights on; it’s for rebuilding how AP works at one of India’s fastest-growing fintechs. You’ll own the outcome, automate what’s broken, and see your impact on every vendor payment that goes out the door.
  
  
By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information (“PI”). I accept Upstox’s Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

The team prepares Loan Review Forms, Preliminary Underwriting/ Cash Flow Models, and Asset Summary Reports that help in determining whether Barclays should proceed with each. transaction; and the loan amount, loan structure and spreads to be charged. title: Loss Prevention Officer
description:
**Company Description**
Inorbit Malls (India) Private Limited, a subsidiary of K. Raheja Corp, is recognized as a pioneer of modern mall culture in India, having opened its first mall in Malad, Mumbai in 2004. The company now has a strong national presence with operating malls in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Vadodara, Cyberabad, Hubballi, and a recently launched mall in Visakhapatnam. Inorbit Malls serve as one-stop destinations for food, fashion, and entertainment, offering a comprehensive retail and leisure experience to diverse customer groups. The organization has received more than 100 awards, including India’s Most Trusted Mall by Brand Trust Report 2014. It is regularly acknowledged at national and international forums for its commitment to consumer engagement and community connection.
  
**Role Description**
The Loss Prevention Officer role is a full-time, on-site position based at Inorbit Mall in Navi Mumbai. The role involves monitoring retail areas, entrances, exits, and back-of-house zones to deter theft, fraud, and other security incidents. The Loss Prevention Officer will use surveillance systems and physical patrols to identify potential risks, observe suspicious activity, and intervene in line with company protocols. Responsibilities include conducting incident investigations, preparing accurate reports, coordinating with mall management, tenants, and local authorities when required, and ensuring compliance with safety and security procedures. The role also involves assisting in emergency response, supporting crowd management during peak hours or events, and maintaining a visible, approachable presence to promote a safe environment for customers, retailers, and team members.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Retail Loss Prevention and Prevention, with experience identifying, reducing, and reporting shrinkage or security risks in a retail or mall environment.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, report writing, and the ability to interact professionally with customers, tenants, and colleagues.
* Candidates should possess Physical Security skills, including access control, patrolling, incident response, and adherence to safety and security protocols.
* Candidates should possess Surveillance skills, including effective use of CCTV systems, observation, situational awareness, and evidence documentation.
* Relevant experience in mall, retail, hospitality, or facility security is preferred.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure, make sound decisions, and handle confidential information responsibly.
* Basic knowledge of emergency procedures, first aid, and coordination with law enforcement or emergency services is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma or equivalent; additional security or loss prevention certifications are beneficial.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for supervising and coordinating all civil construction activities to ensure the project is executed safely, within budget, on schedule, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. The role requires close coordination with contractors, consultants, project management teams, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of a large-scale redevelopment project.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supervise and monitor day-to-day civil construction activities to ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of civil works.
* Review construction drawings, technical specifications, and method statements before commencement of work.
* Monitor project progress and ensure activities are completed within the approved schedule and budget.
* Inspect ongoing civil works to ensure compliance with quality standards, applicable codes, and project specifications.
* Verify site measurements, quantities, and completed work for contractor billing and progress certification.
* Ensure proper execution of RCC works, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, finishing works, and external development activities.
* Coordinate with Architectural, Structural, MEP, and BIM teams to resolve design and construction-related issues.
* Monitor material quality, workmanship, and construction methods to ensure compliance with approved quality plans.
* Conduct regular site inspections and identify non-conformities, ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements during all construction activities.
* Review and verify Requests for Inspection (RFI), Material Inspection Requests (MIR), and other quality documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports highlighting construction status, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with the Planning and Project Controls teams to monitor project milestones and identify potential delays.
* Assist in resolving technical queries, site issues, and design changes in coordination with consultants and contractors.
* Monitor contractor productivity and ensure adherence to contractual obligations and project timelines.
* Support testing, commissioning, snagging, punch list closure, and final handover activities.
* Maintain accurate site records, inspection reports, material records, and as-built documentation.
* Ensure effective coordination among all project disciplines to achieve timely and quality project delivery.
* Perform any other engineering and site management duties assigned by the Project Manager or Construction Manager.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Civil Engineering
* Minimum 8+ years of experience in relevant field.

**About Us**
Hill International, with more than 4,400+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .
  
  
Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.
  
  
Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .
  
  
**Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled**

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Own Manastu Space’s IT end to end:
**infrastructure, cloud, compute, devices, security and data protection**
.
**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**
, and
**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**
. Be
**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**
, and
**establish SOPs for all IT operations**
.

**Role Overview**

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.
* **Identity, devices and security:**
  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

**Company:**
AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited

**Location:**

Software Engineer – Tech Lead

**About Us**

AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited is a space-tech company developing commercial software solutions for professional customers. We work with high ownership, fast feedback, and high standards as we prepare for customer delivery.

**About Role**

We're hiring an IT and Network Administrator to run day-to-day IT for the organization and take full ownership of our Microsoft 365 environment.

You'll own identity and access, onboarding and offboarding, the office network, and the endpoints and tools the team relies on. This is a hands-on, high-trust role. You'll start by learning our setup and grow into owning the whole M365 suite and the org's IT function.

**What You'll Do**

Administer Microsoft 365 across the org: user accounts, licensing, Exchange/email, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, and the admin and security settings behind them.

Own identity and access in Entra ID (Azure AD): accounts, groups, roles, MFA, and conditional access.

Own onboarding and offboarding end to end: provision accounts, licenses, access, and devices for new joiners; and on exit, revoke access cleanly, recover accounts and data, and wipe or reassign devices.

Manage endpoints and devices (Intune or similar): enrollment, policies, and updates.

Run the office network and connectivity: LAN, Wi-Fi, switches, routers, VPN, and the everyday troubleshooting that keeps people working.

Be the first line of IT support for the team, and keep asset and license inventory in order.

Work with the Infrastructure & Security Lead on access controls, hardening, and compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

Solid IT / systems administration experience in a Windows environment, supporting real users.

Networking fundamentals you can stand on: LAN and Wi-Fi, switches and routers, VPN, DNS and DHCP basics, and methodical troubleshooting.

Hands-on with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD): at minimum user and license management, and ready to own the full suite.

Experience with onboarding and offboarding or identity lifecycle: provisioning and, just as importantly, cleanly deprovisioning access.

Exposure to endpoint / device management (Intune or another MDM).

Dependable, security-minded, and genuinely good with people. This role is trusted with access and is customer-facing inside the company.

Willing to learn and take ownership: you want to own M365 and grow the IT function, not just close tickets.

**Nice to Have**

Microsoft certifications (e.g. MS-102, MD-102, AZ-104).

Depth in Intune / endpoint management.

Scripting to automate the repetitive parts of onboarding and offboarding (PowerShell / Microsoft Graph).

Exposure to security or compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001.

Help-desk or ticketing experience in a growing team.

**How We Work**

Small, hands-on team. You'll own your domain with real autonomy and work closely with the person moving into full-time infrastructure and cloud security. Direct communication, high trust, and short paths from problem to fix.

* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or comparable AI capabilities.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Title: Performance Marketing Manager**

**Looking for: Mid- Senior | Senior**

**Ace Blend | Mumbai | Meta Ads & Google Ads**

**Department: Marketing**

**Experience: 4–6 years**

**Location: Mumbai (Work from Office)**

**Employment Type: Full-time Reporting to: Head of Marketing / Marketing Director**

**Role Overview**

The Performance Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing and scaling paid media campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads. This role requires end-to-end ownership of campaign performance, from strategy and audience research to creative testing, budget allocation, conversion optimization and reporting.

The candidate should have hands-on experience in D2C, e-commerce or consumer brands, with a strong understanding of the full customer acquisition funnel and performance metrics such as ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR and conversion rate.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Performance Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute comprehensive performance marketing strategies across Meta Ads and Google Ads to achieve business revenue and customer acquisition targets.
* Own the paid media strategy across the entire customer journey, including awareness, consideration, acquisition, retargeting and repeat purchases.
* Plan monthly and quarterly media budgets, campaign calendars and growth forecasts in alignment with business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to scale campaigns, enter new audience segments and improve marketing efficiency.
* Collaborate with the marketing and e-commerce teams to align paid media strategies with product launches, promotional campaigns and seasonal sales.

**2. Meta Ads Management (Facebook & Instagram)**

* Independently manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns, including prospecting, retargeting, catalog sales, Advantage+ Shopping and conversion campaigns.
* Develop audience segmentation strategies using interest-based, broad, lookalike and custom audiences.
* Build and manage full-funnel campaigns to acquire new customers and drive repeat purchases.
* Conduct continuous A/B testing of ad creatives, copy, hooks, formats, landing pages, audiences and campaign structures.
* Work closely with the creative team to develop high-performing ad concepts, UGC, product videos, static ads and reels.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize bidding strategies, placements, frequency, budgets and audience targeting.
* Manage Meta Pixel, Conversions API and event tracking to ensure accurate attribution and campaign optimization.
* Identify creative fatigue, audience saturation and declining campaign efficiency, and implement corrective measures.

**3. Google Ads Management**

* Plan, execute and optimize campaigns across Google Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display and YouTube Ads.
* Develop keyword strategies, search campaigns and negative keyword lists to capture high-intent customers.
* Manage product feed optimization and Google Merchant Center for e-commerce campaigns.
* Optimize campaigns based on search intent, audience behavior, product profitability and conversion performance.
* Develop remarketing strategies across Google Display, YouTube and other eligible placements.
* Continuously test ad copy, headlines, extensions, bidding strategies and landing pages to improve campaign performance.
* Monitor search terms, impression share, quality score, CPC and conversion rates to identify opportunities for growth.

**4. Budget Management & Revenue Growth**

* Own and manage paid media budgets, ensuring efficient allocation across platforms, campaigns and product categories.
* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly spends against budgets, revenue targets and business priorities.
* Drive improvements in customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), cost per acquisition (CPA) and overall marketing efficiency.
* Identify profitable campaigns and scale them while maintaining sustainable acquisition costs.
* Work with the finance and business teams to develop revenue forecasts, marketing budgets and performance projections.
* Monitor contribution margin and product-level profitability when making budget allocation decisions.

**5. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting**

* Set up and maintain reliable conversion tracking, pixels, tags and analytics integrations across marketing platforms.
* Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager and other relevant tools to monitor performance.
* Build and maintain dashboards to track campaign performance, marketing spend, revenue and acquisition efficiency.
* Analyze key performance indicators, including:
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
* Click-Through Rate (CTR)
* Cost per Click (CPC)
* Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Analyze attribution discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams to improve measurement accuracy.

**6. Creative Strategy & Conversion Optimization**

* Collaborate with the design, content and video teams to create performance-focused ad creatives.
* Develop creative testing roadmaps, including new concepts, messaging angles, product benefits, offers and formats.
* Translate campaign insights and customer behavior into clear creative briefs.
* Identify winning creative formats and messaging strategies and develop repeatable testing frameworks.
* Analyze landing page performance and work with the e-commerce team to improve website conversion rates.
* Recommend improvements to product pages, checkout journeys, promotional offers and landing page experiences.
* Stay updated on platform trends, emerging ad formats and evolving performance marketing best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related field.
* 4–6 years of relevant experience in performance marketing, preferably within D2C, e-commerce, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty or lifestyle brands.
* Proven hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns with significant media budgets.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience targeting, conversion tracking and attribution.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency.
* Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager and Google Merchant Center.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable strategies.
* Experience working with creative teams to develop and test performance-led ad creatives.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with Shopify or another e-commerce platform.
* Experience in scaling a D2C brand through paid acquisition.
* Familiarity with server-side tracking, Meta Conversions API and marketing attribution tools.
* Experience with creative testing frameworks and UGC-led performance campaigns.
* Understanding of customer retention, cohort analysis, LTV and contribution-margin-based marketing.
* Experience managing multiple product categories and balancing acquisition with profitability

* Plan and execute influencer campaigns for content creation, brand awareness and conversions.
* Negotiate rates, manage contracts, briefs, timelines and deliverables, and keep cost efficiency in check.

*Campaign Development & Execution:*

* Analyse performance across organic, paid and creator channels to identify improvements and optimise.

*Analytics & Reporting:*

* Track and evaluate social performance across organic, paid and influencer activity.

*Collaboration & Partnerships:*

**Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated experience running creator and influencer campaigns end to end, from sourcing and negotiation to performance measurement.
* Strong knowledge of organic social, platform best practices, short-form video and current trends.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to optimise spend and performance.

* Excellent project management, organisation and budget management skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across teams, agencies and creators.
* Experience with email and display advertising, or international markets (US, UK, CA, AU), is a plus.
* Prior experience mentoring or leading junior team members is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**

At Group Bayport, you’ll work in a dynamic, innovative environment where your contributions directly impact growth. You’ll own a multi-brand social portfolio across international markets, work with talented professionals, and take on meaningful challenges as you help shape the future of our brands.

title: Social Media & Creative Brand Manager
description:
At Heather Grey Collective, we believe that great design deserves equally compelling storytelling.

We are looking for a
**Social Media Manager & Creative Designer**
who thrives at the intersection of
**strategy, design, and digital storytelling**
. Someone who can think like a strategist, create like a designer, and communicate like a storyteller.

This is a hybrid creative role for someone who understands both the visual and strategic sides of building a brand. From conceptualising campaigns and designing engaging content to managing social media platforms and analysing performance, you will shape how Heather Grey Collective is seen, experienced, and remembered in the digital world.

Working closely with our design, sales, and marketing teams, you will translate our work in fashion, hospitality, team wardrobes, and product design into a distinctive and contemporary brand narrative.

Key Responsibilities

**01. Social Media Strategy & Brand Building**

* Develop and execute a cohesive social media strategy aligned with Heather Grey's brand identity and business objectives.
* Build content calendars, campaign concepts, and platform-specific communication strategies.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand awareness, engagement, and organic growth.
* Create compelling narratives around our design philosophy, collections, collaborations, and projects.

**02. Creative Direction & Content Design**

* Conceptualise and design visually engaging content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and other relevant platforms.
* Create high-quality social media graphics, carousels, reels, stories, presentations, and digital campaign assets.
* Translate design projects, product launches, and behind-the-scenes processes into compelling visual stories.
* Maintain a consistent visual language while exploring fresh, innovative creative directions.
* Collaborate with internal teams on photography, videography, styling, and content production.

**03. Content Creation & Storytelling**

* Write engaging captions, campaign narratives, and brand-led content that reflects Heather Grey's creative voice.
* Develop original content ideas that balance aesthetic appeal with strategic communication.
* Showcase the thinking, craftsmanship, and innovation behind our team wardrobe and product solutions.
* Adapt storytelling to suit different audiences, from creative communities to hospitality brands and business decision-makers.

**04. Social Media Management & Growth**

* Manage day-to-day publishing, scheduling, community engagement, and platform optimisation.
* Monitor social media trends, emerging formats, and digital best practices.
* Track performance metrics, audience insights, and campaign effectiveness.
* Use analytics to continuously refine content strategies and improve engagement, reach, and brand visibility.

**05. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with design, business development, and leadership teams to align creative communication with business goals.
* Support brand campaigns, global partnerships, launches, and marketing initiatives.
* Take ownership of projects from initial concept and creative development through execution and performance review.

Qualifications & Skills

* **2–5 years of relevant experience**
  in social media management, graphic design, content creation, or creative brand marketing.
* Strong visual design sensibility with a keen eye for typography, composition, colour, and contemporary aesthetics.
* Proficiency in
  **Adobe Creative Suite**
  (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, or equivalent design tools.
* Working knowledge of video editing and motion content tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut.
* Experience developing social media strategies and managing brand accounts across multiple platforms.
* Strong copywriting, communication, and visual storytelling skills.
* Understanding of social media analytics, engagement metrics, and content optimisation.
* Ability to independently conceptualise, design, execute, and manage creative campaigns.
* Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and emerging digital design technologies is an advantage.
* Experience in fashion, lifestyle, hospitality, design, or B2B brand communication is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Marketing, Media, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who is as comfortable building a content strategy as they are designing a beautiful carousel.

A creative thinker who understands that social media is not just about posting consistently, but about building a distinctive brand identity through thoughtful design, meaningful storytelling, and measurable impact.

Someone who brings
**a designer's eye, a strategist's mind, and a storyteller's instinct**
to everything they create.

Role Details

**Position:**
Social Media Manager & Creative Designer

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Company:**
Heather Grey Collective

* **To Apply:**
  Share your CV, portfolio, and examples of social media accounts, campaigns, or creative projects you have worked on.

title: Social Media Manager
description:

About This and That Digital

This and That Digital is a creative and performance-driven digital marketing agency working with brands across fashion, luxury jewellery, healthcare, lifestyle, and other industries.

We are looking for a proactive, creative and hands-on Social Media Manager who can independently manage multiple client accounts and take complete ownership of day-to-day social media execution.

This is not a role limited to creating content calendars or planning strategies. We need someone who can manage the entire social media process, from generating ideas and creating content briefs to coordinating shoots, capturing content, managing edits, handling client approvals, and ensuring everything is published on time.

* Manage day-to-day publishing across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor account activity, engagement, comments, messages, and content performance.

**2. Content Creation & Smartphone Editing**

  **Instagram Edits and CapCut**
  .
* Understand framing, camera angles, lighting, transitions, music, text overlays, and video pacing.
* Capture quick and spontaneous content during client visits whenever required.
* Have previously shot and edited social media content independently, rather than only coordinating with a videographer or editor.

**3. Team & Shoot Coordination**

* Work closely with the videographer, video editor, and other creative team members.
* Prepare clear content briefs and communicate creative requirements.
* Coordinate professional shoots, client visits and production schedules.
* Follow up on editing, design, revisions, and pending deliverables.
* Ensure content is reviewed, approved, and published according to schedule.
* Take ownership of the complete content process, from ideation to publishing.

**4. Client Coordination & Reporting**

* Communicate with clients for content requirements, feedback, and approvals.
* Coordinate revisions and ensure deliverables are completed on time.
* Track content performance, engagement, and account growth.
* Prepare regular social media reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve content quality and social media performance.
* Stay updated with relevant platform features, formats, and content trends.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

* Minimum 3 years of professional experience in social media management.
* Experience independently managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Experience working with different industries and brand categories.
* Strong content ideation, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Must have personally shot social media content using a smartphone.
* Must have hands-on experience editing Reels using Instagram Edits, CapCut, or similar applications.
* Good understanding of mobile videography, framing, lighting and video composition.
* Practical knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Meta Business Suite.
* Experience using Canva and social media scheduling tools.
* Understanding of social media analytics and reporting.
* Strong organisational, coordination and time-management skills.

What We're Looking For

* Someone who takes initiative and doesn't wait for instructions for every task.
* Someone who can consistently generate fresh ideas for different brands.
* Someone who can manage multiple accounts, deadlines and deliverables.
* Someone who takes ownership of work from ideation to execution.
* Someone who can coordinate confidently with clients and the creative team.
* Someone who is punctual, organised, proactive, and accountable.
* Someone who is willing to visit client locations and participate in shoots.

Work Details

* Location: Mumbai suburbs.
* Working hours: 11 AM–8 PM.
* Working days: Monday to Saturday, with alternative Saturdays off.
* Reports directly to the Founder.
* Immediate joining preferred.

Portfolio & Proof of Work — Mandatory

A relevant portfolio is compulsory.

Your application must include:

* Social media accounts you have personally managed.
* Examples of content calendars or campaigns you have executed.
* Reels and videos you have personally shot and edited using your smartphone.
* Examples demonstrating your content ideation and creative execution.

Clearly identify the accounts you managed and the content you personally shot and edited.

**Applications without a relevant portfolio and proof of hands-on content creation will not be considered.**

title: Culture Marketing Manager - Events
description:
The Culture Marketing Manager – Events is responsible for translating Red Bull India’s broader Music & Dance strategy into high-quality, culturally credible and scalable event experiences across the country. Working closely with the Music and Dance Managers, the role will manage the end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of culture events, bringing together agencies, production partners, venues and internal teams to ensure ideas are executed to the highest standards of consumer experience, brand expression, operational excellence and commercial discipline. The role will also strengthen the way Red Bull delivers events at scale — building stronger processes, partner ecosystems, production capabilities and learnings that enable the Culture Marketing team to do more, better and more efficiently.
  
  
**All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:**
**Event portfolio and End-to-End Event Ownership**
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned Music, Dance and Culture events, translating the strategic and creative direction into clear execution strategies, plans and outstanding consumer experiences. Manage the full event lifecycle from briefing and concept development through planning, production, live execution and post-event evaluation. Develop and manage comprehensive project plans covering timelines, budgets, production, suppliers, venues, stakeholders, risk management and critical milestones. Act as the central point of accountability for delivery, ensuring multiple internal and external stakeholders remain aligned and that projects consistently meet Red Bull’s standards for quality, brand expression and consumer experience. Anticipate challenges early, make informed trade-offs and proactively solve issues to protect the quality and impact of the event.
  
  
**Production & Operational Excellence**
Own the production architecture for assigned events, spanning venues, technical production, staging, set design, infrastructure, logistics, staffing, safety and on-ground operations. Build and manage high-performing production agency and vendor ecosystems, ensuring partners are held accountable for quality, efficiency, innovation and delivery. Establish robust processes, templates and ways of working that improve consistency and allow successful event formats to be replicated and scaled across markets and event types. Proactively identify operational, logistical, financial and safety risks and put mitigation plans in place well ahead of execution. Continuously raise the bar on event production, identifying new technologies, formats, production solutions and operational approaches that can enhance the consumer experience while improving efficiency.
  
  
**Industry Relationships**
Build and manage a strong network of agencies, production partners, vendors, venues and third-party event stakeholders that can support Red Bull’s growing Culture Events portfolio. Develop relationships beyond individual projects, creating a trusted partner ecosystem that gives Red Bull access to stronger capabilities, ideas, talent and execution opportunities. Serve as the key delivery interface between Red Bull and external partners, ensuring clarity of expectations, accountability, timelines and quality across projects. Work closely with the Music and Dance Managers on relevant industry relationships, ensuring strong continuity between cultural strategy, partner engagement and flawless execution. Strengthen Red Bull’s reputation as a premium, credible and innovative partner within the music, dance and broader culture event ecosystem.
  
  
**Business Planning and Budget Management**
Annual Business Plan Development: Collaborate with the dance and music managers to lead and implement an annual business plan that aligns with Red Bull’s broader marketing goals. Budget Preparation and Oversight: Work closely with the team to prepare the annual budget for music and dance projects, ensuring all financial aspects are clearly outlined and agreed upon. Project Tracking: Implement robust tracking systems for project and budget management, ensuring timely reporting of any deviations and making necessary adjustments to stay within budget. Financial Accountability: Maintain financial discipline by closely monitoring project expenditures and reporting on budget performance to relevant stakeholders.
  
  
**Innovation & Local Relevance**
Continuously identify emerging consumer trends, cultural shifts and new opportunities that strengthen Red Bull's connection with local communities. Lead the development of innovative event concepts rooted in regional culture while creating mechanisms to test, learn and scale successful ideas nationally. Encourage experimentation across regional teams, capturing best practices and transforming successful local initiatives into national programs. Partner closely with Media Network and Brand teams to ensure every major culture events are amplified through digital content, creator collaborations and social storytelling, extending consumer engagement beyond the physical event. Drive continuous innovation in event branding, activation tools and execution templates to improve scalability, operational efficiency and premium consumer experience.
  
  
**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**

* Recognized Post Graduation Course in Marketing / Events Marketing
* 7-8 years’ work experience preferably in the events marketing business.
* Passionate, Enthusiastic, strong communication and interpersonal skills, must believe and Live the brand.
* Self-starter, fast-paced, ability to multitask, plan ahead
* Analytical-minded and creative
* Events marketing experience, preferably with an agency or brand
* Interested in upcoming trends and keeps up with fast changing consumer behavior (especially among younger audiences)
* Experience in research process management.

As FlexiLoans enters the next orbit of growth, we are looking for people with the passion and hunger to make a dent in the MSME ecosystem. **What you will work on:**

* Manage Information Security Management System (ISMS) compliance, including conducting risk assessments, audits, and continuous improvements

**Qualification and Experience:**

**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**

**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**

**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**

**establish SOPs for all IT operations**

**Role Overview**

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.

  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

title: IT & Network Administrator (Microsoft 365)
description:
**IT & Network Administrator (Microsoft 365)**

**Company:**
AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited

**Location:**
Mumbai, India | On-Site

**Type:**
Full-Time

**Reports To:**
Software Engineer – Tech Lead

**About Us**

AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited is a space-tech company developing commercial software solutions for professional customers. We work with high ownership, fast feedback, and high standards as we prepare for customer delivery.

**About Role**

We're hiring an IT and Network Administrator to run day-to-day IT for the organization and take full ownership of our Microsoft 365 environment.

You'll own identity and access, onboarding and offboarding, the office network, and the endpoints and tools the team relies on. This is a hands-on, high-trust role. You'll start by learning our setup and grow into owning the whole M365 suite and the org's IT function.

**What You'll Do**

Administer Microsoft 365 across the org: user accounts, licensing, Exchange/email, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, and the admin and security settings behind them.

Own identity and access in Entra ID (Azure AD): accounts, groups, roles, MFA, and conditional access.

Own onboarding and offboarding end to end: provision accounts, licenses, access, and devices for new joiners; and on exit, revoke access cleanly, recover accounts and data, and wipe or reassign devices.

Manage endpoints and devices (Intune or similar): enrollment, policies, and updates.

Run the office network and connectivity: LAN, Wi-Fi, switches, routers, VPN, and the everyday troubleshooting that keeps people working.

Be the first line of IT support for the team, and keep asset and license inventory in order.

Work with the Infrastructure & Security Lead on access controls, hardening, and compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

Solid IT / systems administration experience in a Windows environment, supporting real users.

Networking fundamentals you can stand on: LAN and Wi-Fi, switches and routers, VPN, DNS and DHCP basics, and methodical troubleshooting.

Hands-on with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD): at minimum user and license management, and ready to own the full suite.

Experience with onboarding and offboarding or identity lifecycle: provisioning and, just as importantly, cleanly deprovisioning access.

Exposure to endpoint / device management (Intune or another MDM).

Dependable, security-minded, and genuinely good with people. This role is trusted with access and is customer-facing inside the company.

Willing to learn and take ownership: you want to own M365 and grow the IT function, not just close tickets.

**Nice to Have**

Microsoft certifications (e.g. MS-102, MD-102, AZ-104).

Depth in Intune / endpoint management.

Scripting to automate the repetitive parts of onboarding and offboarding (PowerShell / Microsoft Graph).

Exposure to security or compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001.

Help-desk or ticketing experience in a growing team.

**How We Work**

Small, hands-on team. You'll own your domain with real autonomy and work closely with the person moving into full-time infrastructure and cloud security. Direct communication, high trust, and short paths from problem to fix.
