At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The India team is an integral part of Bank of America’s Global Risk Organization, providing model validation, governance, and analytics support to strengthen the Model Risk Management framework and ensure effective oversight across the model lifecycle.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Market Risk Model Risk Management (MRM) team provides independent oversight and validation of market risk models used across a broad range of asset classes, including interest rates, foreign exchange, commodities, inflation, equity, credit, and mortgage products. The team is responsible for assessing model conceptual soundness, regulatory compliance, implementation accuracy, and ongoing performance in line with the Bank's Model Risk Management framework and evolving regulatory expectations, including SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 principles.
  
  
The team validates key market risk models, including Value-at-Risk (VaR), Risk Not in VaR (RNIV), Incremental Risk Charge (IRC), FRTB, Stress Testing, and CCAR market risk models. Responsibilities span the full model lifecycle, including model development review, challenger analysis, benchmarking, outcome analysis, and model risk assessment.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration with Front Office, Global Risk Analytics (GRA), Finance, Product Valuation Group (PVG), Market Risk, and Regulatory stakeholders to ensure robust model governance, effective challenge, and adherence to regulatory standards for model risk management.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Conduct independent validation of market risk models across major asset classes including Interest Rates, Foreign Exchange, Inflation, Equities, Commodities, Credit, and Mortgages, covering methodologies such as VaR, RNIV, IRC/CRM, FRTB, Stress Testing, and CCAR.
* Assess model conceptual soundness and regulatory compliance through comprehensive review of model assumptions, methodology, mathematical framework, empirical evidence, data quality, implementation, limitations, and intended use.
* Design and execute independent challenger analyses and testing, including benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stress testing, back-testing, outcome analysis, and quantitative assessments to identify, measure, and articulate model risks.
* Evaluate model governance and controls in alignment with the Bank's Model Risk Management framework and regulatory expectations, including SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance.
* Prepare high-quality validation reports and technical documentation that clearly communicate validation findings, model limitations, risk assessments, recommendations, and approval decisions to senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Partner with key stakeholders across Front Office, Global Risk Analytics (GRA), Market Risk, Finance/PVG, Audit, and other control functions to provide effective challenge, discuss validation outcomes, and establish appropriate compensating controls and remediation plans.
* Manage a portfolio of market risk models throughout the model lifecycle, including periodic validations, periodic reviews, ongoing performance monitoring, model-change assessments, issue management, and closure of regulatory and validation action items.
* Monitor emerging regulatory requirements and industry best practices to ensure market risk models remain fit for purpose and compliant with evolving expectations for model risk management and capital adequacy.
* Contribute to strategic MRM initiatives aimed at enhancing validation methodologies, strengthening model governance, improving testing frameworks, and increasing efficiency through analytics and automation.

**Requirements\***

* Strong background in quantitative finance, model validation, model development, or model risk management, preferably within Market Risk.
* Solid understanding of financial markets, derivative valuation/pricing, risk modeling, statistics, and quantitative methodologies.
* Knowledge of market risk models such as VaR, RNIV, IRC/CRM, FRTB, Stress Testing, and CCAR is preferred.
* Familiarity with the model lifecycle, model governance, performance assessment, and regulatory expectations (e.g., SR 11-7, SR 26-2).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative skills with the ability to independently challenge model methodologies and assumptions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and commitment to high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across Front Office, Risk, Finance, and control functions.
* Proficiency in Python, C++, or R and experience with quantitative tool development is a strong plus.
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CQF, or CFA are advantageous.
* Master's degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or Computer Science.

**Education-**
Masters or Ph.D. degree in Statistics and/or Mathematics and/or Financial Mathematics and/or Physics etc
  
  

* Educational institutes: Top tier – IITs, NITs, Indian Statistical Institutes etc.
* Certifications (preferred but not mandatory): FRM, CQF etc.

**Experience Range-**
7-10 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Solid understanding of financial markets, derivative valuation/pricing, risk modeling, statistics, and quantitative methodologies.
* Ability to independently review model assumptions, methodology, and performance
* Knowledge of model lifecycle management, model risk, and regulatory expectations (e.g., SR 11-7, SR 26-2)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn, strong work ethic, effective challenge mindset, and stakeholder management skills.

**Desired Skills**

* Programming experience in Python, C++, R, or other quantitative languages
* Experience with market risk models such as VaR, RNIV, IRC/CRM, FRTB, Stress Testing, or CCAR
* Experience with quantitative tool development, automation, and large-scale data analysis
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CQF, or CFA
* Experience working in a global financial institution or model risk management environment

**Work Timings**
12 PM – 9 PM IST
  
  
**Job Location**
Mumbai, Powai

Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Manager – Manufacturing

* **Company:** Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL)
* **Location:** Vasai East, Palghar (manufacturing plant), with regular visits to our head office in Goregaon East, Mumbai
* **Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of HR experience in a manufacturing organisation (mandatory)
* **Reports to:** CEO & Director – Operations
* **Employment type:** Full-time, on-site
* **CTC:** ₹6 **– ₹9** LPA, based on experience *(fill in before posting)*

About Fluidteq Systems

Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL) is a Mumbai-based precision engineering company that makes instrumentation tube fittings, valves and manifolds. Founded in 2004, we have manufactured in-house on CNC machines since 2008.

We have supplied over 5 million fittings to Indian Railways coach and locomotive factories and to metro projects. We are an approved vendor to EIL, ONGC and ADNOC, and hold ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications. Our customers are in railways, metro, oil & gas, power and defence, in India, the UAE, Qatar, Italy and Indonesia.

We are now expanding into a new 45,000 sq ft integrated manufacturing facility, and we need an HR leader who can grow the team with it.

About the role

You will own the complete HR function — from hiring a CNC operator on Monday to closing payroll and statutory filings at month-end. This is a hands-on role in a lean, growing company: you will do the work yourself, build the systems, and be the person both employees and management trust.

Your first-year priorities: a reliable hiring pipeline for the shop floor, clean and compliant payroll, and HR practices fully aligned with India's new Labour Codes.

Key responsibilities1. Shop-floor and blue-collar hiring

* Hire CNC and VMC operators and setters, conventional machinists, QC inspectors, assembly, packing and dispatch staff, helpers and material-handling labour.
* Build steady sourcing channels: ITIs, polytechnics, local placement agencies, labour contractors, employee referrals, walk-in drives and job apps such as Apna, WorkIndia and Indeed.
* Organise practical trade tests with Production and QC — machine operation, drawing reading, and use of verniers, micrometers and gauges.
* Keep a ready pipeline of pre-screened operators so no critical machine sits idle for want of manpower.
* Run apprentice and trainee hiring under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

2. Recruitment across all levels

* Recruit for engineering, quality, production, PPC, purchase, sales and marketing, accounts and admin — from trainee to manager level.
* Write job descriptions, post on LinkedIn, Indeed and Naukri, and manage recruitment consultants.
* Screen resumes, shortlist, run telephonic and first-round interviews, and coordinate panel interviews with department heads.
* Run reference and background checks, negotiate offers, and issue offer and appointment letters.
* Track hiring metrics: time-to-fill, offer-to-join ratio, cost per hire and 90-day attrition.
* Own onboarding: joining documents, UAN and ESIC enrolment, safety induction and a first-week plan.

3. Payroll and wage administration

* Run end-to-end monthly payroll for staff and workers: biometric attendance, leave, shifts, overtime, incentives, deductions and arrears.
* Structure wages to meet the Code on Wages definition of "wages", including the 50% cap on excluded allowances.
* Apply Maharashtra minimum wages and VDA revisions on time.
* PF: monthly ECR filing, UAN and KYC upkeep, transfers and claims support — including the revised ₹25,000 EPF wage ceiling effective 17 September 2026.
* ESIC: employee registration, monthly contributions, accident reporting and benefit-claim support.
* Maharashtra Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund deductions and filings.
* Coordinate salary TDS and employee tax declarations with Accounts.
* Calculate statutory bonus, gratuity, leave encashment and overtime at twice the ordinary rate.
* Complete full-and-final settlements within the timelines set by the Code on Wages.
* Issue payslips and keep wage registers and records up to date.

4. Statutory compliance — Labour Codes and Maharashtra law

* Lead FSPL's move from the old labour laws to the four Labour Codes in force since 21 November 2025 — the Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Social Security and OSH Code — and the Central Rules notified in May 2026.
* Track Maharashtra's state rules under the Codes and update our practices as they are finalised.
* Manage factory registration and licence compliance under the OSH Code, including for our new facility, and liaise with the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH).
* Issue appointment letters to every employee, as the OSH Code requires.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and returns, digitally wherever permitted.
* Enforce working-hour, weekly-off, overtime and leave rules, and arrange annual health check-ups for eligible workers.
* Manage contract labour: verify contractors' registration, wage payments, PF and ESIC, and meet our duties as principal employer.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
New Business Developer (Existing Customers) – Job Description Oct 16, 2026 · @Akshit Parmar The New Business Developer (Existing Customers) brings in bookings from people who have already bought from us: repeat purchases, referrals from their family and friends, and introductions to new projects. Success is measured in bookings and referral leads from the existing customer base, backed by a disciplined weekly contact schedule. How this works for a real estate developer Our customers rarely buy every year; most buy a home once or twice in a lifetime. So this role does not wait for reorders. It earns business from existing customers in five ways: Source What it looks like Typical timing Referrals Buyers introduce family, friends, colleagues and neighbours. This is the largest and most reliable source. Any time; strongest at possession, registration and the first year after moving in Upgrade A buyer moves to a bigger home as the family grows, or from an older project to a new one. 5+ years after purchase Investment and second homes A buyer adds a second unit to rent out or hold, or buys for children or parents. When their first unit has appreciated; at each new launch Pre-launch access Past buyers get first access and a loyalty offer before a project opens to the public. 4–8 weeks before each launch Societies and communities Residents and committee members of our completed and redevelopment projects introduce neighbouring buildings and societies. After handover, once the society is satisfied Untitled Page 1 of 7Untitled The nurturing work matters as much as the selling. A buyer who felt looked after through construction and possession refers others; one who felt ignored does not. This role keeps in touch at every stage, while our CRM team handles payments, paperwork and possession. Role summary Title: New Business Developer (Existing Customers) Department: Sales, based at head office with regular client meetings and site visits Reports to: Managing Director, with a weekly review Works with: CRM team (post-booking service), Sales Coordinator and telecallers (lead handling and site visit scheduling), sales executives, marketing (launch campaigns), accounts Purpose: turn our past buyers into a steady source of new bookings, through referrals, repeat purchases and pre-launch sales, while keeping every customer relationship warm. This is a selling role. You meet customers, present our projects, and close bookings from the existing customer base, with support from the Sales Coordinator on scheduling and paperwork. Responsibilities Selling to existing customers 1. Meet past buyers who show interest in upgrading, investing or buying for family; present the right project and close the booking. 2. Run the pre-launch programme for every new project: invite past buyers first, hold private previews, and book them before public launch. 3. Ask every customer for referrals at the right moments, and personally follow up every referral lead within 24 hours. 4. Work with society committees and residents of our completed and redevelopment projects to get introductions to neighbouring buildings. Nurturing relationships 1. Keep the customer database: every buyer, their unit, family details, investment profile, last contact and next reason to call. Page 2 of 7Untitled 2. Contact every customer at least once a quarter, and at each key moment: construction milestones, possession, registration, possession anniversary, new launches. 3. Host customer events: possession ceremonies, site tours of new projects, festival gatherings, resident meet-ups. 4. Listen for problems and pass them to the CRM team; follow up until the customer confirms they are resolved. 5. Collect customer feedback at possession and once a year after, and share testimonials and video stories with marketing (with the customer's permission). Weekly 1. Plan the week's calls and meetings from the database. 2. Share the weekly report by Monday 10 am: contacts made, meetings, referral leads, site visits, bookings and booking value. 3. Review the week with the MD: deals in progress, upcoming triggers, customers at risk of going cold. Not part of this role New enquiries from portals, ads and walk-ins (telecallers and sales team). Payments, agreements, registration and possession paperwork (CRM team). Pricing beyond the approved loyalty and referral offers (MD approval). KRAs and KPIs A home purchase takes months, so bookings alone can't tell us week to week whether the role is working. Performance is measured on two levels: results (bookings, referrals, revenue), reviewed monthly and quarterly, and activity (contacts, meetings, follow-ups), reviewed weekly. Activity is what produces results six months later. The result this role drives can be broken down as: \text{Bookings value} = \text{Customers contacted} \times \text{Meeting rate} \times \text{Conversion to booking} \times \text{Average booking value} The same applies to referrals: referral leads received × conversion to booking. Growth comes from improving any one of these numbers, so each is tracked separately. Page 3 of 7# KRA (result expected) KPI (how it is measured) Reviewed Starting target 1 Bookings from the existing customer base Number and value of bookings from past buyers and their referrals; share of total company bookings Monthly, quarterly Set with the MD after month 1 from the database size 2 Referral engine running Referral leads received per month; % of customers contacted who gave a referral; referral leads converted to site visits and bookings Monthly Referral rate rising each quarter 3 Pre-launch sales % of a new project's launch-window bookings that come from past buyers and referrals Per launch Set per launch 4 Every customer kept in touch % of the database contacted (connected call or meeting) in the quarter; % of key moments (possession, anniversary, launch) with no contact Weekly, quarterly 100% contacted each quarter; 0 moments missed 5 Meetings that lead to business Customer meetings and site visits per week; % of meetings converting to a booking Weekly Set after month 1 6 Follow-up discipline % of planned calls and follow-ups not done; % done late; referral leads not called within 24 hrs Weekly −10% or better Untitled Page 4 of 7How activity scores work. Weekly scores are the percentage of planned work not done, or not done on time. If 40 calls were planned and 30 were made, the score is −25%. The aim is −10% or better. Incentive. Variable pay is linked to bookings value from existing customers and referrals (KRAs 1–3), with a qualifying minimum on the activity scores (KRAs 4–6). The customer database You will own the database of everyone who has bought from us and plan every contact from it. Calls are planned around life and project events, not a fixed sales cycle. Who is in it 1. Every past buyer, across all our projects. 2. Current buyers in under-construction projects. 3. Society members and committees from our redevelopment projects. 4. Referral leads received from any of the above. What it records # KRA (result expected) KPI (how it is measured) Reviewed Starting target 7 Customer satisfaction Satisfaction score at possession and annually; customer issues passed to CRM and resolved within agreed time Quarterly Score rising; 0 issues open beyond 7 days 8 Clean, current database % of customer records with verified phone, email and profile; % with a next contact date Monthly ≥95% 9 Reporting on time Weekly report shared by Monday 10 am; % weeks late Weekly 0 weeks late Untitled Page 5 of 7Reasons to call New launch or pre-launch: first access and a loyalty offer. Construction milestones: progress update and photos for current buyers. Possession and registration: congratulate, collect feedback, ask for referrals. Anniversary of possession: a courtesy call, then ask whether they know anyone looking. Upgrade signals: bought 5+ years ago, family has grown, children settling down. Investors: when their property has appreciated, share the gain and our next project. How a call goes 1. Ask for a few minutes of their time. 2. Mention their home and ask how things are. 3. Listen more than you talk. 4. End with one request: a meeting, a visit to a new project, or the name of someone who is looking. Column What goes in it Name, phone, email Contact details, verified Type Past buyer / Current buyer / Society member / Referral lead Project and unit What they bought Booking and possession dates For timing the key moments Buyer profile End-user or investor; family stage; likely budget for a next purchase Satisfaction Last feedback score and any open issue Next reason to call From the list below Next contact date Set after every contact Last outcome Not reachable / Spoke / Interested / Meeting booked / Booked / Referral given Referrals given Names and status of each referral Untitled Page 6 of 7Untitled Who we are looking for 5–8 years in real estate sales or relationship management, with a record of closing residential bookings; experience with referral or loyalty programmes preferred. Confident meeting families, investors and senior professionals; builds trust over a long relationship. Comfortable presenting projects, pricing and payment plans, and closing. Organised enough to run a large contact schedule; comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and a CRM. Fluent in English, Hindi and the local language. Lives within easy travel of the office and our projects. Tools you will use: customer database, CRM and tele-calling software, weekly report, project presentations and price lists. First 90 days Month 1: learn every project, our history with past buyers and the referral and loyalty offers. Month 1: build the customer database from all past bookings; verify contacts and fill in profiles. Month 1: meet the CRM team and agree how customer issues are passed and closed. Month 2: contact every past buyer at least once; record interest and referrals. Month 2: run the first customer event or pre-launch preview. Month 3: first referral and repeat bookings; agree quarterly targets with the MD from the month 1–2 numbers

Job Summary

Conifer builds compact axial flux motors and powertrains that work without rare-earth magnets. As Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, you will lead the mechanical design of our motors across both automotive and non-automotive projects, from concept to high volume production release. On the automotive side, this means powertrains for two-wheelers and small mobility. On the non-automotive side, it means industrial motors for pumps, fans and similar equipment.

This is a lead design role with a strong cost and manufacturing lens. We expect you to know what a part should cost before a supplier quotes it, to design parts that suppliers can make at volume without surprises, and to release drawings at the standard large OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers work to. You will work closely with the electromagnetic design, manufacturing, supply chain and quality teams.

Mandatory Requirements

1. **Motor manufacturing experience:**
    Minimum 8 years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in electric motor design or product engineering and exposure to high volume production (around 5,000 motors per month or more).
2. **Part costing capability:**
    Can independently build a component should-cost, covering raw material, process-wise conversion cost, wastage, tooling and finishing.
3. **Manufacturing and DFM expertise:**
    Strong understanding of motor component manufacturing processes, material selection, tolerances and supplier DFM, so that designs are commercially viable and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the mechanical design of our axial flux motors across automotive projects (two-wheeler and small mobility powertrains) and non-automotive projects (industrial motors for pumps, fans and similar equipment).
* Design and detail mechanical components and assemblies for axial flux motors: housings, covers, shafts, rotor discs and stator assemblies, bearing and seal arrangements, and mounting interfaces.
* Build a should-cost for every part you design, and use it to guide design choices and to support supply chain in supplier discussions.
* Design for cost from the first concept, not as a cost-down exercise after release.
* Run DFM and DFA reviews with suppliers (die casting, machining, stamping, forging, moulding, surface treatment) before drawings are released, and close their feedback into the design.
* Release 2D drawings the way large OEMs and Tier 1s do: complete GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, material and finish callouts, critical-to-quality characteristics, and clean revision control.
* Select materials and processes by weighing performance, cost and supplier availability.
* Lead value engineering on existing parts to hit target cost.
* Own BOMs and engineering changes for mechanical parts.
* Lead design reviews and DFMEA, sign off drawings before release, and work with the analysis team on structural and thermal checks.
* Set the design and drawing standards that mechanical work at Conifer follows.
* Support prototype builds, validation, first article reviews, and root cause work on production or supplier quality issues.
* Help take designs from prototype quantities to high volume production with the manufacturing team.

Qualifications & Experience

* BE / BTech in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
* 8+ years of mechanical design experience, with at least 5 in electric motor design or product engineering in a high volume manufacturing setup
* Has taken a product from concept to production release as the design owner
* Proficient in 3D CAD and 2D drawing release. We use Onshape in house, and experience on SolidWorks, Creo or CATIA carries over well
* Strong GD&T (ASME Y14.5 or ISO) and tolerance stack-up skills
* Working knowledge of motor construction: laminations, windings, magnets, bearings, insulation and housings
* Hands-on understanding of high pressure die casting, CNC machining, stamping, forging and surface treatments
* Able to break a part cost down process by process and defend the numbers in front of a supplier

Preferred Skills & Attributes

* Experience with axial flux motors, or with 2W / 3W EV traction and hub motors
* Background at an automotive OEM or Tier 1, with exposure to APQP, PPAP and DFMEA
* Exposure to industrial motor standards such as IEC and NEMA frame sizes
* Experience with FEA for structural or thermal checks
* Knowledge of the motor component supplier base in India
* Comfortable spending time on the shop floor and at supplier sites
* Clear, structured communicator who can work across functions

Why Join Us

* **High ownership:**
   Your designs and cost calls go straight into the product and into production.
* **New motor technology:**
   Work on axial flux motors that do not depend on rare-earth magnets, an area very few teams in India are building in.
* **Design to production:**
   See your parts through from the first sketch to the production line in Pune.
* **Range of work:**
   Work on both automotive and non-automotive projects built on the same core motor technology.
* **Small, engineering-first team:**
   Work directly with the people who design, build and test the motor.
* **Fast growth:**
   In a startup your work is visible, and you learn quickly across mechanical, electrical and manufacturing.

title: AdvaRisk - QA Lead - Automation Testing
description:

* Passion for results and excellence.

* Straightforward and professional.
* Good communicator.

* A do-it-yourself orientation, consistent with the company's "roll-up-the-sleeves" culture.
* Proactive.

title: Electronics Engineer – Embedded Systems, Motor Control & Power Electronics
description:
About Denovo

Denovo Bioinnovations is a deep-tech, R&D-driven medical technology company focused on developing next-generation surgical instruments, advanced electromechanical systems and innovative healthcare technologies.

Our engineering capabilities span precision mechatronics, embedded electronics, motorised surgical instruments and advanced medical device development.

As we expand our technology platform and develop next-generation medical technologies, we are looking for a passionate and technically strong Electronics Engineer with expertise in embedded systems, motor control, power electronics and hardware development.

Position: Electronics Engineer – Embedded Systems, Motor Control & Power Electronics

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Joining:**
Immediate / 15 days preferred

**Reporting To:**
Head – R&D

Key Responsibilities

**1. Embedded Systems & Motor Control**

* Design, develop and implement embedded control systems for advanced electromechanical products.
* Develop motor control systems for DC and BLDC motors, precision actuators and motion control applications.
* Implement closed-loop control systems using encoders, position feedback, speed control and torque management.
* Develop and optimise PID-based control algorithms and motor drive architectures.
* Integrate motors, encoders, sensors, motor drivers and embedded controllers.
* Implement motion control, precision positioning, actuator feedback and synchronisation systems.
* Troubleshoot motor performance, current consumption, torque limitations, thermal issues and control instability.

**2. Electronics Hardware & PCB Design**

* Design and develop electronic circuits and PCB assemblies for advanced medical and electromechanical systems.
* Develop motor driver circuits, power management systems, battery management systems (BMS) and control electronics.
* Design analogue and digital circuits, signal conditioning systems, sensor interfaces and communication interfaces.
* Work on schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, circuit simulation and hardware debugging.
* Develop electronic protection circuits, power distribution architectures and system-level hardware interfaces.
* Ensure reliability, manufacturability and performance of electronic subsystems.

**3. Power Electronics & High-Frequency Systems**

* Design and develop power electronic circuits and high-frequency electronic systems.
* Work on switching power converters, DC-DC converters, MOSFET/IGBT-based circuits and gate driver architectures.
* Understand high-frequency signal generation, power conversion, output regulation and electrical isolation.
* Develop voltage and current sensing, power monitoring and protection circuits.
* Work on impedance measurement, signal acquisition and feedback-based control systems.
* Support the development and integration of advanced power delivery and energy control architectures.
* Perform power stage characterisation, thermal evaluation and performance optimisation.

**4. Embedded Firmware Development**

* Develop embedded firmware using STM32 and other ARM-based microcontrollers.
* Write efficient and reliable embedded C/C++ code for real-time control applications.
* Implement firmware for motor control, sensor acquisition, actuator operation and system monitoring.
* Work with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN and USB.
* Develop fault detection, system diagnostics, watchdog mechanisms and safety interlocks.
* Perform firmware debugging, optimisation and hardware-software integration.

**5. Sensors, Instrumentation & Feedback Systems**

* Develop electronic interfaces for sensors, transducers and measurement systems.
* Implement real-time acquisition and processing of voltage, current, temperature, position and other relevant parameters.
* Work on analogue front-end circuits, signal conditioning and measurement accuracy.
* Develop feedback and control architectures for dynamic electrical and electromechanical systems.
* Integrate sensing and monitoring systems into embedded hardware and firmware.

**6. Testing, Validation & Troubleshooting**

* Conduct electronics hardware testing, debugging and performance validation.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, electronic loads and other laboratory instruments.
* Perform motor characterisation, current measurement, thermal testing and power electronics evaluation.
* Support electrical safety, EMC and pre-compliance testing.
* Participate in design verification, validation and reliability testing.
* Prepare technical documentation, test reports and engineering records.

**7. Product Development & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware and R&D teams.
* Participate in product architecture, design reviews, prototyping and system integration.

title: Endocrinologist
description:
Endocrinologist — Metabolic & Hormone Health

**ALIV Regenerative Wellness | Pune / Mumbai**

About the role

Most of what walks into ALIV is endocrine at the root. The founder who has plateaued at 92kg despite doing everything right. The CEO whose Mounjaro stopped working at month seven. The 48-year-old whose energy fell off a cliff and whose thyroid panel came back “normal.” The woman with PCOS who has been told to lose weight by three doctors without one of them explaining how.

These are not people in disease management. They are high-functioning, well-resourced, and usually have a drawer full of normal-range reports. They need someone who reads metabolic and hormonal data at a level most OPDs don’t have time for, and who can design a path forward rather than reassure and discharge.

That’s this role. You’ll own the endocrine and metabolic layer of ALIV’s clinical practice — diagnostics, interpretation, protocol design, and the long arc of monitoring that actually produces change.

Reporting & team

* **Reports to:**
  Medical Director (Dr. Rajesh Tandulwadkar)
* **Works alongside:**
  Dr. Sunita Tandulwadkar (reproductive endocrine and women’s health overlap), functional medicine and regenerative physicians, nursing team, nutrition and client relations
* **Cross-functional:**
  Operations, research

Core responsibilities

**1. Metabolic and weight management**

* Lead the clinical layer of ALIV’s fat loss protocols — the largest service line, and the one most often endocrine at root
* Manage GLP-1 and dual-agonist therapy end to end: initiation, titration, plateau management, side-effect handling, and the harder question of what happens when it stops working
* Work up metabolic dysfunction properly: insulin resistance, HOMA-IR, fasting insulin, metabolic syndrome, prediabetes and type 2 diabetes
* Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease — a standing ALIV vertical with a clear endocrine driver
* Preserve muscle and metabolic rate through a deficit; prevent the rebound that brings most clients back

**2. Thyroid and adrenal**

* Full thyroid assessment and management, including the clients whose panels sit inside the reference range but whose physiology clearly doesn’t
* Autoimmune thyroid disease, subclinical hypothyroidism, and the judgment of when to treat and when not to
* Adrenal and cortisol-axis assessment, including rhythm rather than single points
* Distinguish genuine endocrine pathology from the physiology of chronic stress — and say so plainly in either direction

**3. Hormone optimisation**

* Male and female hormone assessment and management across the midlife transition
* Testosterone, estradiol, progesterone, DHEA-S, SHBG, free fractions — interpreted in context, not in isolation
* PCOS and reproductive-endocrine work, in collaboration with Dr. Sunita
* Perimenopause and menopause management, including the risk–benefit conversation clients rarely get honestly
* Bone health and body composition as downstream markers

**4. Energy, fatigue and performance**

* Work up the high-functioning client whose energy has dropped and whose standard panels are unremarkable
* Thyroid, adrenal, gonadal, mitochondrial and nutrient contributors assessed as a system rather than a checklist
* Sleep, circadian alignment and recovery as endocrine inputs, not lifestyle advice

**5. Protocol design and the regenerative interface**

* Build the endocrine layer of integrative protocols spanning nutrition, supplementation, movement, sleep, stress and targeted therapeutics
* Advise on where IV therapies, peptides and targeted supplementation fit — and, importantly, where they don’t
* Screen every protocol for endocrine contraindications and interactions before it goes to the client
* Set re-test intervals and read trajectory over time rather than single snapshots

**6. Clinical safety and compliance**

* Enforce ALIV’s compliance posture: no cure claims, no guaranteed outcomes, no diagnose/treat/cure/prevent language
* Refer to standard-of-care management without hesitation when that’s what the client needs
* Maintain accurate documentation per Indian medical regulation
* Prescribe within approved indications; where something is used off-label, the client understands that clearly and in writing

**7. Client experience**

* Deliver unhurried consultations — closer to a private medical office than an OPD
* Explain endocrine physiology to intelligent, time-poor non-clinicians without dumbing it down or burying them
* Hold the long relationship. Metabolic and hormonal change is measured in quarters, and clients stay for the physician

Required qualifications

* **MBBS + MD (General Medicine) + DM (Endocrinology)**
  or
  **DNB (Endocrinology)**
* **Active NMC / State Medical Council registration**
  in India
* **3–5 years post-super-speciality clinical experience**
* Strong command of obesity and metabolic medicine, including current GLP-1 and dual-agonist therapeutics
* Confident interpretation of advanced metabolic, thyroid and hormone panels beyond reference-range reading

Preferred qualifications

* Significant
  **obesity medicine or bariatric**
  practice experience
* Experience in
  **private, corporate or executive health**
  settings — a different consultation rhythm than government or teaching hospitals
* Interest or training in
  **functional, integrative or longevity medicine**
* Familiarity with
  **peptide therapeutics**
  and their endocrine implications
* Experience with
  **continuous glucose monitoring**
  in non-diabetic optimisation
* Published, taught or presented in endocrinology or metabolic health

Who this role is for

**Mindset more than CV.**
This matters as much as the credential:

* You see “within normal limits” as a population statement, not an individual verdict — and you can defend that position with evidence rather than intuition
* You hold a high evidentiary bar in a field full of overreach. You know what the data supports, what it doesn’t yet, and you say which is which
* You’re comfortable telling a well-paying client that their problem is sleep and alcohol, not their thyroid. ALIV would rather lose the sale than sell the wrong protocol
* You’re rigorous about where endocrinology ends. You refer early and cleanly, and you treat that as doing the job right
* You read papers and update your position. This field moves fast and most of what moves is marketing
* You’re collaborative with the clinical leads, the founder, and the wider team — no territoriality
* You’re allergic to hype. You don’t oversell, you don’t underdeliver, and no client leaves with an expectation you can’t stand behind

We are seeking an experienced Dynatrace Observability Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, operating and optimising Dynatrace across complex enterprise environments. You will work across modern observability, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, cloud and on-premises monitoring, translating telemetry into actionable insights that improve application availability, performance, reliability and end-user experience.

Configure and manage Real User Monitoring (RUM), analyse user journeys and Core Web Vitals including LCP, INP and CLS, and resolve instrumentation and communication issues.

* Deploy and operate Dynatrace within Kubernetes environments, monitoring clusters, nodes, namespaces, workloads, pods, containers and services. Support observability across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Correlate metrics, logs, traces, events and business telemetry, applying observability approaches such as RED and USE to improve root-cause analysis

Define and monitor SLIs, SLOs and error budgets, supporting proactive reliability improvements and incident, problem and performance management.
* Configure actionable alerting, anomaly detection and notifications while reducing unnecessary alert noise and supporting enterprise incident-management processes. Build operational and management dashboards using Dynatrace Query Language (DQL) for application, infrastructure, Kubernetes, user experience, SLI/SLO and incident insights.
* Use Dynatrace APIs and integrations such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty and webhooks to support automation and operational workflows. Provide Dynatrace expertise during production incidents, major incidents and performance investigations, identifying root causes across applications, middleware, Kubernetes, infrastructure, databases, networks and external dependencies

**Who You Are**

* You bring 7+ years of overall IT experience, ideally across application, infrastructure, middleware, DevOps, SRE or observability domains, with 3+ years of strong hands-on Dynatrace experience in enterprise environments. You have practical experience with OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator, DynaKube and Kubernetes observability.

* You have Linux troubleshooting capability and understand networking fundamentals including DNS, proxies, firewalls, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and application connectivity. Advanced DQL, Dynatrace APIs and automation, OpenTelemetry SDK/instrumentation, Java/JVM observability, ServiceNow integration and CI/CD knowledge would be advantageous.

Relevant Dynatrace certifications would also be an advantage. You will contribute to production reliability and observability maturity while collaborating with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams.
  
  
You will also gain exposure to advanced observability practices involving OpenTelemetry, automation, SLI/SLO management, distributed tracing, DQL and complex production troubleshooting.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
The scope of this role provides opportunities to deepen capabilities in:
  
  

* Enterprise-scale Dynatrace architecture and platform management.

* OpenTelemetry architecture, including Collector pipelines, OTLP and telemetry instrumentation.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer – New Product Development (NPD)
description:
**Company Description**

Rasoi Robotics Private Limited is a pioneering robotics and FoodTech company focused on transforming commercial kitchen operations through automation and intelligent kitchen equipment.

Our vision is to empower restaurant entrepreneurs and commercial kitchen operators with technology-driven solutions that simplify kitchen operations, improve efficiency, ensure consistency, and reduce dependency on skilled manpower.

We are developing next-generation automated kitchen equipment by combining mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and product innovation.

Role Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong
**Mechanical Design Engineer – New Product Development (NPD)**
to join our product development team at Pimpri, Pune.

The candidate will be primarily responsible for mechanical CAD design, 3D modelling, assembly design, and preparation of detailed engineering drawings for the development of innovative kitchen automation equipment.

The role involves translating product concepts, sketches, and functional requirements into detailed mechanical designs, developing component and assembly models, and supporting the development of new products from concept through prototyping and manufacturing.

We are looking for someone with strong hands-on CAD skills, sound mechanical engineering fundamentals, and a keen interest in designing and developing physical products and mechanical systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop detailed 3D CAD models of mechanical components, parts, and assemblies for new product development.
* Create and manage mechanical assemblies, ensuring proper fit, clearances, alignment, and functionality.
* Prepare detailed 2D engineering drawings, manufacturing drawings, and assembly drawings with appropriate dimensions and tolerances.
* Design mechanical components, sheet metal parts, fabricated structures, enclosures, brackets, fixtures, and mounting arrangements.
* Translate product concepts, sketches, and functional requirements into detailed mechanical CAD designs.
* Assist in designing mechanical mechanisms involving motors, shafts, gears, bearings, actuators, and other mechanical components.
* Develop and refine designs based on engineering feedback, prototype testing, and functional requirements.
* Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles to ensure practical and manufacturable designs.
* Coordinate with vendors, fabricators, and manufacturing partners for component development and fabrication.
* Support prototype development, assembly, testing, and design improvements throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Maintain CAD models, engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and product design documentation.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in mechanical CAD design, product design, or mechanical product development.
* **Strong hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks is mandatory**
  , including 3D part modelling, parametric modelling, assembly design, and 2D engineering drawings.
* Experience in designing mechanical components, assemblies, sheet metal parts, and mechanical structures.
* Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional tolerances, fits, and clearances.
* Practical knowledge of manufacturing processes such as sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, and CNC manufacturing.
* Understanding of mechanical components, materials, fasteners, bearings, shafts, gears, and motion transmission systems.
* Ability to translate product concepts and functional requirements into detailed mechanical designs.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a hands-on approach to engineering.

Preferred Qualifications & Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with other 3D CAD tools such as Creo, CATIA, or Autodesk Inventor would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with engineering simulation and analysis software such as ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation, or Autodesk Fusion Simulation for structural analysis, stress analysis, and basic thermal analysis.
* Internship or project experience in New Product Development (NPD), mechanical product design, or hardware engineering.
* Exposure to the complete product development cycle, including concept development, CAD modelling, prototyping, testing, and design iterations.
* Experience with prototype development, fabrication, and working with manufacturing vendors.
* Exposure to automation equipment, robotics, or electromechanical systems.
* Experience in FoodTech, commercial kitchen equipment, food processing machinery, or industrial equipment would be an added advantage.

Experience & Eligibility

* Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant professional experience in Mechanical Design, CAD Design, or New Product Development (NPD) are encouraged to apply.
* Final-year engineering students in their last semester and recent graduates/freshers are also eligible to apply, provided they have completed
  **at least two relevant internships with companies involved in New Product Development (NPD), mechanical product design, or hardware engineering**
  .
* Candidates must demonstrate strong hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks, supported by practical projects, internship experience, or a portfolio of CAD designs.

Location & Employment

* **Location:**
  Pimpri, Pune, Maharashtra
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time
* **Work Mode:**
  On-site

title: Sr. Enterprise Application Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
Sr. Enterprise Systems Engineer
  
  
**Sr. Enterprise Applications Engineer**
OpenGov is seeking a Sr. Enterprise Applications Engineer to lead the design and integration of our core business systems - spanning IT, identity, and GTM-adjacent platforms. You will own complex, cross-functional systems and integrations end-to-end: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and emerging AI tooling, using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs to connect systems that don't naturally talk to each other, and will partner with our Business Systems team on integrations that touch Salesforce via its API. This role goes beyond execution - it includes architectural decision-making, long-term system design, and mentorship of other engineers, with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office, onsite 4 days a week, working closely with US and India-based Enterprise Technology teams.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
Experience - 7+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
  
  
Education - BE/B.tech in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience
  
  

* Design and build API-based integrations between enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and third-party services, using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs and event-driven workflows.
* Partner with the Business Systems team on integrations that touch Salesforce via API - this role works through the Salesforce API, not Salesforce development (no Apex, LWC, or Flow work).
* Own complex, cross-functional systems and automations end-to-end - requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and long-term maintenance.
* Architect and continuously improve onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle workflows for users, applications, and assets, with a focus on scalability and auditability.
* Define and enforce access control models across cloud systems, ensuring least-privilege access and alignment with security best practices.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues, providing root-cause analysis and durable fixes.
* Partner with stakeholders across GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to scope and prioritize systems integration initiatives.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-native tools and workflows to improve efficiency across the enterprise systems stack.
* Mentor other engineers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and raising overall technical quality.
* Author and maintain high-quality technical documentation, system diagrams, and SOPs.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Siebel Administrator
description:

How will you do it
  
  

* Administer and support Oracle Siebel CRM environments across development, testing, and production environments.

* Monitor environment health, proactively identify issues, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and support knowledge articles.

What we look for
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Oracle Siebel CRM in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience installing and supporting Oracle Siebel on Windows and Linux platforms.
* Experience performing Siebel upgrades, migrations, and patching activities, preferably on recent Siebel versions.
* Strong knowledge of Siebel architecture including Gateway Server, Enterprise Server, Application Interface (AI), AOMs, and Tomcat environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Siebel Gateway clustering and load-balanced environments.
* Strong experience with Siebel performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and tuning.
* Experience troubleshooting EAI component failures and analyzing system logs and diagnostic reports.
* Experience supporting SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
* Experience automating administrative processes through scripting, Windows batch jobs, and Linux cron jobs.
* Experience designing, supporting, and testing disaster recovery solutions.
* Basic Oracle Database administration knowledge, including connectivity, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing Oracle Siebel environments in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with BI Publisher installation, administration, and integration.
* Experience supporting highly available and clustered enterprise environments.
* Oracle Siebel certifications or related Oracle technology certifications.
* Experience with Linux administration and shell scripting.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Digital Platform Engineer**
We're looking for a Senior Digital Platform Engineer to join a team that keeps our digital pricing and quoting landscape running, evolving and improving it. You will work across multiple applications rather than living in just one stack, which means real variety. The core system is Conga Smart CPQ which aid our business counterparts in building solutions for our customers, thus the role has a tangible impact on how well we are doing as a company.
  
  
This role sits deliberately at the intersection of support and configuration. You'll need to be equally comfortable troubleshooting a live issue under pressure and having a structured approach to configuring/extending the applications capability. Good teamwork and clear communication are central to how this team works. The team is a bridge for business ideas/needs, translated into high performance processes in the CPQ journey.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Own day-to-day support, testing and validation across the CPQ business applications, both vendor-supplied and in-house data exchange.
* Design, build, configure and maintain application features and fixes, to support business requests and platform enhancements.
* Diagnose and resolve incidents, balancing speed for urgent issues with rigor for root-cause fixes.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements, working closely with both technical and business-facing colleagues.
* Maintain clear documentation and structured ways of working so knowledge doesn't live only in your head.
* Continuously look for ways to improve reliability, performance and maintainability across the application landscape and connected processes.
* Bring your ideas to the table, on technical approach, how we work, what we should fix or build next, to help grow our consolidated knowledge and expertise.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business administration or a comparable field
* Typically 6 to 9 years of relevant experience, of which several years in a senior or lead specialist capacity within a business application, CPQ, pricing or quoting environment
* Hands-on experience administering and configuring a CPQ, pricing or quoting platform.
* Direct experience with Conga CPQ (formerly PROS Smart CPQ) is a strong advantage
* Demonstrated ability to own a functional area end to end, from clarifying the business need to designing, configuring, testing and documenting the solution
* Proven ability to translate functional business requirements into concrete technical configuration and solution designs and to explain the reasoning back to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience as an escalation point for complex functional and technical issues, including root cause analysis, workaround design and permanent fix recommendations
* Experience in coordinating across system and team boundaries to maintain processes that span multiple applications
* Experience working with globally distributed stakeholders and being effective in a setup with colleagues and business users in other time zones and regions

**Preferred Experience**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM, particularly around the sales and quoting process
* Solid understanding of integration patterns and technologies, for example REST APIs and file-based data exchange, including the ability to read API documentation and challenge integration designs
* Data modelling skills, including the ability to reason about data structures, their relationships and the downstream impact of changes
* Familiarity with pricing concepts such as price lists, discount structures, approval flows, and rule-based product configuration
* Experience working with external vendors or system integrators and guiding them to provide quality services
* Experience guiding or mentoring less experienced colleagues, without formal line management responsibility and ability to generate reusable documentation
* Background from a global product organisation or a consulting and systems integration environment

Personal capabilities
  
  

* Strong analytical problem solver who breaks ambiguous business challenges into clear, workable solutions
* Confident communicator who engages business users on their terms and technical colleagues on theirs.
* Structured and self-driven, able to extract potential decisions from incomplete information in a landscape with multiple stakeholders.
* Takes ownership beyond the immediate task and raises risks and process gaps proactively
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

Team and culture
  
  
You'll be part of a team of internal and external colleagues with a mix of technical and business backgrounds and clear line of sight to your manager. We run a flat hierarchy, where everyone is expected to speak up, challenge and contribute their ideas regardless of title or seniority. I would rather hear a half-formed idea early than a polished one too late. The expectation is that you bring your thinking, put it on the table and let's grow and learn together.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Role:**
Regional Sales Manager

**Locations:**
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Surat, Bhopal, Jaipur

**Work mode:**
Field-based, mostly at client sites in your territory

**Reports to:**
Zonal Leader

**Team:**
5 Sales Executives report to you

**Working days:**
6 days (Sunday off)

**Contract duration:**
12 months (Extendable)

**About the Role**

Our client records skilled manual work with lightweight wearable cameras at partner businesses (factories, hospitals, hotels, workshops, and shops), and pays those businesses for every hour recorded. This footage is used to train robotics and physical AI.

As a Regional Sales Manager, you will own one territory in your city, lead a team of 5 Sales Executives, and personally sign the largest businesses in your area.

What You Will Do

**Sell to large businesses**

* Win large and mid-sized partners (factories, hospitals, hotels, labs) by meeting owners, plant heads, and administrators.
* Pitch the business value: productivity insights, workstation safety analysis, and a route into automation programmes.
* Work longer sales cycles: repeat visits, safety and site approvals, and getting the decision-maker to say yes.
* Stay the main point of contact for every business you sign, through recording and payments.

**Lead your team**

* Hire, train, and lead 5 Sales Executives who sign small shops and workshops across your territory.
* Run a short daily team meeting and a weekly review against targets.
* Split your territory so no two people on your team approach the same business.
* Make sure every business your team signs is genuine and recorded correctly in our app.

**Report and improve**

* Share weekly numbers with your Zonal Leader: businesses signed, hours recorded, and gaps by business type.
* Flag what is working and what isn't in the pitch, pricing, or process.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must have**

* 5–8 years in B2B field sales.
* At least 1–2 years leading a field sales team of 4 or more people.
* A track record of closing deals that needed sign-off from an owner, plant head, or senior administrator.
* Comfort on the shop floor: shifts, supervisors, contract labour, safety audits.
* Fluency in the local language of your city, plus English.
* Your own two-wheeler or car, and willingness to be in the field most days.

**Good to have**

* Experience in industrial automation, machinery or tools, safety equipment, industrial chemicals, facility management, or hospital and lab equipment.
* Existing relationships with industrial associations or business owners in your city.

description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Full-stack Developer to join VOPA's technology team and take end-to-end ownership of building, scaling, and maintaining high-impact digital products. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work across frontend, mobile, backend, databases, and production systems to build reliable technology serving millions of learners and thousands of schools. The role involves designing and developing scalable backend services using Python/FastAPI, building web and mobile experiences using React/React Native, designing APIs and database architectures, and solving complex production and performance challenges. You will work with large-scale data, high-traffic systems, low-end devices, unreliable networks, and AI/ML-powered assessment solutions. As a Senior Full-stack Developer, you will also contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions, review code, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate directly with the CTO. We are looking for an engineer who can work independently, understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical decisions, debug systematically, and take ownership of delivering solutions from conception through production. Responsibilities: - Own features end-to-end from React/React Native interfaces to APIs, databases, and production deployment. - Design and build scalable backend services using Python/FastAPI. - Build reliable web and mobile experiences for low-end devices and unreliable networks. - Design APIs, database schemas, indexes, and data flows handling millions of records. - Debug complex production issues across frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure. - Improve system performance during high-traffic assessment periods. - Integrate AI/ML services, including handwriting recognition and speech assessment pipelines. - Review code and mentor junior engineers. - Work directly with the CTO on architecture and engineering decisions. - Take ownership of problems and drive them through to completion. Requirements: - 4+ years of strong software engineering experience. - Strong experience with React / React Native. - Strong backend engineering fundamentals; Python/FastAPI, Django, or Flask preferred. - Production experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or comparable databases. - Strong understanding of APIs, authentication, caching, database indexing, and performance. - Ability to systematically debug unfamiliar systems. - Ability to quickly understand and contribute to an existing codebase. - Proven experience personally owning and shipping meaningful production features. - Comfortable using AI coding tools while being able to explain and defend the code you ship. - React Native / Android production experience. - Redis, queues, and asynchronous processing. - Docker and basic Kubernetes debugging. - Offline-first applications and synchronization. - High-traffic or large-scale systems. - CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. - AI/ML inference integration. - EdTech, or public-sector technology, democratizes education. Company Summary VOPA works in the education and mental health domains in Maharashtra. It has impacted 3 million users via the digital learning ecosystem, VSchool! Vowels of the People Association was founded in 2018 with the goal of building technology-driven solutions that strengthen education and mental health systems. The organisation began as a small team working with underserved communities in Maharashtra. Over time, it grew into a multidisciplinary team designing large-scale digital platforms in collaboration with state governments and institutions. VOPA works closely with government departments, educators, and communities to develop solutions that are scalable, practical, and grounded in real needs. Today, VOPA's platforms reach millions of learners across the state and have established VOPA as a trusted partner in public digital infrastructure. We build open-source, frugally engineered platforms designed for low-bandwidth environments, older devices, and large-scale government deployment. All our systems are designed based on field research and community engagement. We test, iterate, and adapt based on real-world evidence. We work directly with government departments, educators, and communities. Solutions are co-designed, not imposed. Why Join Us VOPA is a mission-driven organisation committed to building meaningful solutions for social challenges. The organisation fosters a collaborative work culture where young professionals from diverse backgrounds work together to build technology systems that create real-world impact. VOPA has received the Great Place to Work certification for multiple consecutive years.

title: Software Engineer II (Full stack)
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
At PUMA, technology plays a critical role in enabling exceptional consumer, digital, and business experiences across global markets. Our engineering teams build and operate the platforms, products, and services that power PUMA's digital ecosystem, supporting consumers, business users, and operational teams worldwide.
  
  
As part of the Engineering organization, you will contribute to the development and evolution of modern digital platforms and applications that support key business capabilities across eCommerce, consumer engagement, retail, merchandising, supply chain, data, and enterprise domains. The organization embraces cloud-native architecture, engineering excellence, automation, AI-assisted development, and a product-centric mindset to deliver scalable and impactful solutions.
  
  
As a Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will build and maintain modern web applications and backend services that power business-critical and consumer-facing experiences. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Architects, Data Engineers, and fellow engineers to deliver intuitive, scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions while contributing to engineering best practices across the organization.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, and maintain modern web applications and supporting backend services that power business-critical and consumer-facing experiences.
* Drive the technical design and delivery of complex frontend features and end-to-end user journeys.
* Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable UI architectures, components, and shared libraries using React and TypeScript.
* Collaborate with backend, platform, data, and architecture teams to deliver integrated and scalable solutions.
* Build and enhance backend APIs and microservices required to support frontend experiences and business workflows.
* Optimize application performance, accessibility, reliability, security, and overall user experience.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive improvements in observability and operational excellence.
* Partner closely with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to deliver impactful business outcomes.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
* Leverage automation, AI-assisted engineering tools, and modern development practices to improve development productivity and quality.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards, development processes, and platform capabilities.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 5-7 years of experience designing, building, and operating modern web applications and full-stack software solutions.
* Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frontend engineering practices.
* Experience building scalable, responsive, and high-performing web applications with a strong focus on user experience and accessibility.
* Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, frontend design patterns, and design-system-driven development.
* Hands-on experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs, microservices, and backend services.
* Good understanding of backend development using Java, Spring Boot, API design, and microservices architecture.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, caching technologies, and cloud-native applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience building AI-powered and conversational user experiences using frameworks such as Google Conversational Commerce Kit (CCK), Vercel AI SDK, CopilotKit, LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, or similar agentic application frameworks.
* Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool calling, streaming interactions, conversational experiences, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns within modern web applications.
* Familiarity with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of application performance optimization, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Experience owning medium-to-large features and contributing to technical design discussions and engineering best practices.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.
