title: Support Engineer
description:
**Support Engineer (L1)**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Full-time - Permanent / On-site**

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer- reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

title: Incident Manager II
description:
**Role Summary**
The Incident Manager II owns end-to-end incident lifecycle management for customer production environments. The role combines 24x7 monitoring with major incident command and process governance (IM). It is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll act as incident commander on Sev-1/Sev-2 events and mentor Level 1 team members.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitoring and Detection
* Monitor site health, alerts, dashboards, and automation systems across customer sites around the clock.
* Triage incoming alerts and tickets. Validate severity, deduplicate, and standardize ticket subjects with specific issue details.
* Tune alert thresholds and reduce noise by working with engineering on alert quality, severity standards, and root-cause fixes.
* Be the first point of contact for customer and site issues via ticketing queues (Salesforce, SRE, GM).
* Incident Response and Command
* Act as incident manager for Sev-1/Sev-2 production incidents. Open the bridge, assign roles, and drive resolution.
* Align technical, engineering, product, QA, and site teams on live production issues.
* Make sure tickets reach the right owning pod rather than sitting in the queue.
* Keep production issues and staging issues (QA) separate, with clear function boundaries.
* Decide on escalation paths and use judgment on severity changes, workarounds, and rollbacks.
* Communication and Stakeholder Management
* Send timely, structured updates (initial, periodic, resolution) to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.
* Escalate through the defined matrix, using all communications and escalations channels.
* Run customer-facing and internal incident calls with clear, concise status.
* Process and Governance
* Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and severity definitions.
* Enforce process adherence on ticket hygiene, handoffs, shift transitions, and SLA compliance.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including automation of repetitive monitoring tasks and better alerting and tooling.
* Team Mentoring (Level 2)
* Mentor and coach L1 Incident Managers. Review their work and run knowledge sessions.
* Act as shift lead or duty manager when needed. Plan coverage and handle shift handovers.
* Partner with technical, Engineering, QA, Product, and Customer Success on cross-functional improvements.
* Contribute to onboarding and training programs.

**Experience**

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About Pluang**

Pluang is Indonesia's leading multi-asset investment platform, offering products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure — so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $120M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we're one of Indonesia's fastest-growing fintechs.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to own the analytics layer behind Pluang's product decisions. You will work directly with Product Managers across our asset classes — Global Stocks, Crypto and Indonesian Equities — to define how we measure success, find where users drop off or thrive, and turn data into clear product recommendations.

This is a product role, not a reporting role. We want someone who frames the right question before running the query, works independently through ambiguous problems, and brings a point of view to the table. You will have high ownership and a direct line of sight from your analysis to what ships. You will use AI tools like Claude as a core part of how you work, to take analysis deeper and faster than traditional approaches allow.

**What You'll Do**

**Shape Product Decisions with Data**

* Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, guardrails and North Star measures for features and product lines.
* Frame ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and drive them end to end: from hypothesis to recommendation.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap discussions — size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and flag what the data does and does not support.
* Present insights clearly to product, design, engineering and leadership audiences.

**Own Product Health and Funnels**

* Build and maintain funnels across key investor journeys: onboarding and KYC, funding, first trade, repeat trading and retention.
* Run cohort, retention and engagement analyses to understand how different investor segments behave across asset classes.
* Track feature adoption and post-launch performance, and turn findings into concrete next steps for the product team.
* Set up dashboards and alerts that let PMs self-serve on day-to-day metrics, so analysis time goes to deeper questions.

**Drive Experimentation**

* Design A/B tests with PMs: hypotheses, sample sizes, success criteria and test duration.
* Analyse results rigorously, call out biases and noise, and give a clear ship / iterate / stop recommendation.
* Help build a consistent experimentation practice across product teams.

**Strengthen the Analytics Layer**

* Work hands-on in BigQuery and Mixpanel (and similar tools) to query, model and interpret product and user behaviour data.
* Define event tracking and instrumentation requirements with PMs and engineers, and ensure data is reliable before decisions are made on it.
* Work closely with the Data Engineering team, who own pipelines and infrastructure, so the right data is available for product questions.

**Use AI for Deeper, Faster Analysis**

* Use AI tools such as Claude as a core part of your workflow: to explore data, write and review SQL and Python, test hypotheses and surface patterns faster.
* Go deeper than manual analysis allows: synthesise user feedback at scale, root-cause metric movements, and model scenarios quickly.
* Check AI-generated output rigorously: the logic, the data and the numbers must hold up before they inform a decision.
* Build reusable AI-assisted workflows and share them, so PMs and the wider team can answer more questions themselves.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* 3–4 years of experience in product analytics, ideally embedded within a product team rather than a central data or BI function.
* Experience in fintech, with a strong preference for brokerage, trading or investment platforms.
* Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, event-level datasets.
* Hands-on experience with funnel, cohort, retention and experimentation analysis.
* Structured problem-solving: able to break an open-ended question into a clear analytical approach without step-by-step direction.
* A track record of high ownership — analyses you drove to a decision, not just delivered.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn findings into a crisp recommendation.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) in your analytical work, with good judgement on when to rely on their output and when to verify it.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GCP / BigQuery and Mixpanel, or equivalent product analytics tools (Amplitude, CleverTap, Looker, Metabase).
* Python or R for deeper statistical analysis.
* Understanding of retail investing journeys — KYC, funding, order placement, portfolio and P&L.
* Exposure to Indian/US/Indonesian equities or Crypto markets.
* Experience working with distributed teams across countries.
* Personal interest in investing and financial markets.

**Why Join Pluang?**

* Competitive compensation package and performance-based incentives.
* Direct impact: your analysis shapes what ships across a multi-asset investing platform.
* High ownership and close work with Product, Engineering, Design and leadership.
* Exposure to global and Indonesian investing products and financial markets.
* Learning and development opportunities with strong mentorship and career growth.
* Flexible policies that support work-life balance and employee well-being.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Click here to find out!*

title: Consultant
description:
Role: Consultant

Mode of Work: On-site (5 Days)

Department: Research & Consulting

Employment Type: Permanent

**Role Summary**

**The Consultant is responsible for delivering high-quality research and consulting solutions by leading end-to-end project execution across syndicated research, custom research and Go-to-Market (GTM) engagements. The role requires hands-on expertise in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy.**

**The Consultant will present insights and strategic recommendations to clients, ensure client satisfaction, develop proposals and drive new and repeat business. Additionally, the role involves leading and mentoring a team of analysts, strengthening research methodologies and contributing to organizational growth through strategic insights and industry best practices.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Research Project Management & Delivery**

**• Lead and oversee multiple research projects, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.**

**• Define project scope, objectives, research methodologies and execution plans.**

**• Lead market sizing and opportunity assessment studies, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Available Market (SAM) and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM), using top-down and bottom-up approaches.**

**• Develop market forecasts through clearly defined assumptions, demand drivers, scenario analysis and validation of primary and secondary research findings.**

**• Develop actionable GTM strategies covering customer segmentation, target market prioritisation, competitive positioning, pricing and distribution channels.**

**• Conduct hypothesis building, model mapping and data validation.**

**• Perform sanity checks, proofread deliverables and develop strategic recommendations.**

**• Ensure alignment of deliverables with client expectations.**

**• Maintain communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating feedback to refine deliverables.**

**2. Client Engagement**

**• Develop compelling client proposals, including responses to RFPs and tenders for government bodies.**

**• Present research findings to prospective clients and generate repeat business.**

**• Build strong client relationships to support long-term partnerships.**

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

**• Build and manage a high-performing team of Research Associates, Analysts and Senior Analysts.**

**• Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.**

**• Provide mentorship, skill enhancement and career development opportunities.**

**• Encourage a positive work culture centred on collaboration and innovation.**

**4. Research Innovation & Best Practices**

**• Integrate industry best practices into research methodologies.**

**• Use advanced analytics, automation and data-driven insights to improve research quality and efficiency.**

**• Introduce innovative techniques for data collection, analysis and reporting.**

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

**• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing or a related field.**

**• 4+ years of experience in Market Research, Consulting or Business Strategy.**

**• Demonstrated hands-on experience in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy, with the ability to explain methodologies, assumptions and resulting client recommendations.**

**• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies.**

**• Excellent client handling, presentation and business development capabilities.**

**• Proven leadership skills, with experience in managing teams.**

**• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management abilities.**

**• Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools and data analytics platforms.**

title: Marketing Associate : Restaurant
description:
About the job

Minimalist Hotels is a premier boutique lifestyle hotel brand operating 10+ properties with 200+ keys across 4 cities. Designed for the modern aesthetic traveler, we combine thoughtful design, contemporary hospitality, and vibrant culinary experiences.Our F&B portfolio features 6 signature outlets across our distinct dining brands:

FIKA: Our chic, cozy cafe concept focusing on artisanal coffees, fresh bakes, and relaxed day-long dining.

Cabami (Cafe and Bar by Minimalist): Our high-energy hybrid lounge offering handcrafted cocktails, small plates, and elevated evening experiences.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic, data-driven F&B Marketing Executive to oversee marketing, brand visibility, and footfall generation across all 6 of our F&B outlets (FIKA & Cabami). Working closely with the F&B Head, you will execute multi-channel campaigns, manage aggregator platforms (Zomato/Swiggy), organize outlet events, and drive both direct dining and online delivery revenue while keeping brand aesthetics sharp and consistent.

Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities:

1. Brand Governance & Digital Touchpoints

Brand Document Adherence: Maintain brand consistency across all 6 outlets in line with Minimalist Hotels' brand design and tone guidelines (Brand Doc).

F&B Website Management: Update and manage website listings for FIKA and Cabami—including digital menus, outlet locations, working hours, and active offers.

2. Paid Ads, Creatives & Campaign Management

Campaign Execution & Creatives: Plan and launch Meta Ads and Google local campaigns using high-quality visuals, reels, and graphic assets to drive restaurant walk-ins.

Promotions & Offers: Develop seasonal offers, happy hour promos, daily specials, and festival menus to boost footfalls and average order value (AOV).

3. Food Aggregators & Local SEO

Zomato & Swiggy Profiles: Manage restaurant listings, upload updated menus, ensure high-res dish photos, and maintain active banner placements for FIKA and Cabami outlets.

In-App Advertising: Run cost-per-click (CPC) campaigns and sponsored listings on Zomato and Swiggy to maximize delivery orders and visibility.

Google My Business (GMB): Manage GMB pages for all F&B outlets, publish regular updates, post food photos, and actively monitor and respond to guest reviews.

4. Direct Marketing & Guest Database

Data Collection: Drive customer data collection across all outlets using digital feedback systems, Wi-Fi popups, and table top QR codes.

WhatsApp Campaigns: Design and broadcast target-segmented WhatsApp marketing drives to promote seasonal menu drops, live events, and loyalty offers.

5. Food Shoots & Menu Updates

F&B Shoots: Organize and execute high-concept food and beverage photo/video shoots with chefs, bartenders, and content creators for upcoming launches.

Menu Management: Coordinate with the culinary team for regular menu updates, proofreading, design formatting, physical printing, and digital menu publishing.

6. Collaborations, Events & Market Research

Influencer & Brand Collabs: Partner with food bloggers, lifestyle influencers, and complementary lifestyle brands to amplify brand reach.

Event Execution (with F&B Head): Co-plan, market, and execute outlet events such as live music sessions, mixology workshops, weekend brunches, and pop-ups alongside the F&B Head.

Market Intelligence: Continuously track competitor dining trends, cocktail menus, promotional strategies, and pricing across target cities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Outlet Footfalls & Revenue: Increase in dining cover counts, table reservations, and delivery sales volume across FIKA and Cabami.

Ad ROAS & Performance: Return on Ad Spend for Zomato/Swiggy ads and Meta campaign conversions.

Customer Database Growth: Monthly growth rate of compliant customer contacts captured via in-restaurant initiatives.

Direct Channel Engagement: Open and conversion rates on WhatsApp broadcasts and click-through rates (CTR) on performance ads.

GMB & Aggregator Ratings: Rating improvements and response rates across Swiggy, Zomato, and Google Reviews.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 1–3 years in F&B, hospitality, or restaurant group marketing.

Platform Mastery: Hands-on experience with Zomato Partner Center, Swiggy Owner App, Meta Ads Manager, GMB, and WhatsApp Business API tools.

Design & Aesthetic Eye: Basic proficiency in Canva or Adobe Suite to quickly customize promotional creatives matching Minimalist Hotels' aesthetic standards.

Collaborative Spirit: Comfortable working directly on-ground alongside the F&B Head, outlet managers, chefs, and creative teams.

If interested share your resume to revenue@minimalisthotels.com

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

title: Lead, Quality
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Quality Lead plays a critical role in supporting the day-to-day activities of the Aircover Quality program from the Airbnb India (ACC) site. This role sets the standard for excellence in Quality across the Aircover organization and requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can operate credibly across both partner-facing and internal audiences.
  
  
Reporting to the Aircover Quality Manager, the QA supports quality performance across the entire partner QA network. Within this remit and without being dedicated to any single team the QA also supports the internal Aircover Claims Experience (ACE) and Service Recovery team, along with their respective stakeholders.
  
  
Across both, the QA partners with internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, through transaction monitoring, calibration, root cause analysis, business case development, and reporting, ensuring all assigned work is completed within deadlines. The QA also provides Quality support for new Aircover launches and products, helping stand up monitoring and quality guardrails as the program evolves (e.g., new coverage, customer segmentation).
  
  
As an ambassador of our brand, you will uphold the highest customer service standards, championing excellence and process optimization across teams and time zones.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Support and monitor the performance of the partner QA team, ensuring their transaction monitoring and audits align with agreed Aircover quality standards, targets, and methodologies.
* Conduct spot checks / audit-the-auditor reviews on partner QA outputs and report findings and recommendations to the QA Lead and partner stakeholders.
* Lead and participate in calibration sessions with the partner QA teams and internal teams to ensure scoring consistency and shared understanding of quality forms and guidelines.
* Analyze, report, and present quality transaction monitoring findings to inform program, regional, and site-level performance.
* Identify trends and propose action plans to drive continuous improvement based on QA and Ops dashboard results.
* Provide recommendations related to Product, Policy, Process, and People to the appropriate stakeholders, and track/review submitted recommendations monthly with the internal QI team.
* Work with partner QA leads and internal stakeholders to close performance gaps, strengthen coaching quality, and improve first-time-right resolution.
* Conduct executive escalation root cause analysis in line with targets, providing Product, Policy, Process, and People recommendations to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Proactively and on request, design and lead deep-dive projects to enhance service quality and reduce recurrence of high-severity incidents.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders, Aircover QAs, and frontline specialists to gain insight into deep dives and executive escalations.

**New Launches & Products**

* Provide Quality support for new Aircover launches and product rollouts, including pre-launch readiness and post-launch event QA support.
* Help define and stand up quality forms, sampling methodologies, and monitoring guardrails for new coverage, tools, or customer segments.

**Cross-Functional & Program Support**

* Identify opportunities to improve the Quality program (e.g., quality forms/guides, sampling methodologies).
* Potentially represent Quality in cross-functional forums such as OCM, BPI, and Training, providing project support.
* Engage in ongoing Aircover training, work on a minimum of one claim each month, and stay current with best practices.

**Your Expertise**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* 7 plus experience in Quality Assurance, Customer Experience, Claims Operations, or a related operational field.
* Experience supporting, managing, or governing Quality programs within Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) environments.
* Strong track record of conducting root cause analyses, identifying trends and opportunities, presenting insights to stakeholders and leadership, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience developing and leveraging quality reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools to inform decision-making (e.g., Tableau, Google Sheets, Excel, Salesforce, or similar platforms).
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Product, Policy, Operations, Training, and other business partners.
* Experience supporting large-scale process improvements, program launches, or operational projects is highly preferred.

**Your Skills**

* Deep expertise in Aircover Claims Support: Specialist behavioral expectations and a thorough understanding of Aircover processes, policies, and products (e.g., Aircare, HDP, HLI).
* Partner/Stakeholder Management: Ability to support and influence a BPO partner QA function and internal stakeholders, driving alignment without direct authority.
* Analysis & Research: Strong ability to comprehend, analyze, and investigate cases, workflows, and documentation; proficient in root cause analysis, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Excellence & Accountability: Consistently set and uphold the highest standards for work quality while holding yourself and others accountable.
* Collaboration: Skilled at working across cross-functional and cross-site teams to drive alignment and improvements.
* Presenting & Influencing: Distill complex ideas into clear, concise insights and engaging, digestible reports and presentations.
* Coaching & Feedback: Objectively assess performance, provide constructive feedback, and tailor coaching to different audiences.
* Solving Problems: Quickly identify root causes and hidden issues, using logical reasoning and available resources to develop effective solutions.
* Calibration & Consistency: Facilitate calibration and maintain scoring consistency across internal and partner QA teams.
* Time Management & Prioritization: Efficiently prioritize high-impact work while staying organized across multiple responsibilities.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹1,610,000—₹2,110,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

description:
**Company Description**
Unite Trades & Technologies (UTNT) specializes in material export and technical instruments, serving scientific and industrial communities worldwide. With over 20 years of experience in scientific and laboratory instruments, the team provides integrated solutions, supply, installation, verification, and ongoing maintenance. UTNT designs and delivers monitoring solutions and instrumentation for research and applications in environment, hydrology, water quality, agriculture, glaciology, geotechnical engineering, cryosphere studies, and more. The company focuses on long-term partnerships, offering dedicated technical services to help clients streamline complex instrumentation setups. Backed by strong technical expertise and a professional, efficient team, UTNT supports comprehensive technical business operations for customers and partners.

**Role Description**
The Test Engineer – Electronics Hardware & Operation role is a full-time, on-site position based in Gurugram. The Test Engineer will plan, design, and execute tests for electronic hardware and related systems used in scientific and monitoring instruments. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and reviewing test cases, performing functional and regression testing, documenting test results, and identifying, analyzing, and reporting defects. The role involves collaborating with design, production, and service teams to validate hardware performance, support troubleshooting, and ensure instruments meet quality, safety, and operational standards. The Test Engineer will also assist in test procedure optimization, test tool selection, and continuous improvement of testing processes.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in test engineering, including experience with electronic hardware and instrumentation.
* Ability to design and manage test cases and test plans, with hands-on experience in test execution.
* Practical knowledge of testing methodologies, including functional testing for hardware and integrated systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with laboratory and scientific instruments used in environmental, hydrology, or related applications is an advantage.
* Proficiency with measurement tools, test equipment, and basic diagnostic software used for hardware validation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and clear documentation practices.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical findings effectively.
* Willingness to work on-site in Gurugram and support field installations or validations when required.
* Validate and test custom PCBs, sensors, and data logging devices against technical specifications.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot hardware failures down to component level.
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, board layouts, and component datasheets.
* Utilize standard lab equipment including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and variable power supplies.
* Analyze communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485 and analog signals.
* Should know basic programming in C/C++.
* Measure current usage in low power device states / deep sleep modes.
* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.

title: BCM-BA - TechnoFunctional-CapitalMarket-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
* Support business readiness, change management, and operational transition activities.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Analyze and document Front-to-Back trade lifecycle processes across Capital Markets and Treasury functions.
* Support initiatives involving trade capture, lifecycle management, confirmations, settlements, securities processing, reconciliations, collateral management, corporate actions, accounting, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

**Domain Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Treasury, or Financial Markets.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
* Good knowledge of:

+ Trade Capture & Processing
+ Confirmations
+ Settlements
+ Securities Processing
+ Reconciliations
+ Collateral Management
+ Corporate Actions
+ Regulatory & Operational Controls

* Exposure to Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, or Operations functions.

**Asset Class Knowledge**
Experience in one or more:
  
  

* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Money Markets
* Interest Rate Products
* Credit Products
* Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps)

**Platforms & Technology**

* Experience working on Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, enhancement, migration, or support programs.
* Exposure to platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+
+ Finastra Solutions
+ FIS Quantum
+ Broadridge
+ MarkitSERV
+ Front Arena
+ Other Capital Markets, Treasury, or Post-Trade platforms

* Experience supporting integration, data migration, and platform modernization initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies.
* Experience performing data mapping, reconciliation, and data validation activities.
* Understanding of APIs, interfaces, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience reviewing system impacts across multiple applications and data sources.
* Familiarity with Jira, Agile, Scrum, and related delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting reporting solutions and business data validation

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and project deliverables.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently drive requirements and solution discussions.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience supporting Capital Markets platform implementation, consolidation, or migration programs.
* Exposure to regulatory transformation initiatives and reporting requirements.
* Knowledge of financial market interfaces and messaging standards including SWIFT, FIX, MQ, XML, APIs, and ISO 20022.
* Experience working with investment banks, broker-dealers, custodians, exchanges, asset managers, or financial market infrastructures.
* Familiarity with trade and reference data management, reconciliation processes, and operational controls.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant Capital Markets certification is advantageous.
* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, Financial Services Technology, or related consulting environments.
* Proven experience supporting business analysis, platform implementation, transformation, migration, or regulatory change programs.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, Capital Markets, or Project Delivery are desirable.
* Experience working with global banks, broker-dealers, custodians, asset managers, exchanges, or financial institutions is preferred.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Who we are**
  
  
  
As a global law firm our work spans jurisdictions, cultures, and languages – and so do our people.
  
  
  
  
Our culture is collaborative and inclusive — where diverse perspectives are recognised and valued. Where performing to your highest ability, unlocks equal access to opportunities to learn, thrive and grow.
  
  
  
  
We combine deep legal expertise and commercial intelligence to grow, transform, protect, and defend our clients' businesses, across every critical moment.
  
  
  
  
We operate in the sectors and regions that matter to our clients. With forward-thinking insights and innovative, tech-enabled solutions that combine deep knowledge of their sectors and markets.
  
  
  
  
You’ll build connections and work with colleagues as one global team. You’ll unlock opportunities for clients, across borders, cultures, legal and commercial disciplines.
  
  
  
  
Join us to work with colleagues as one global team – empowering each other to be exceptional and create advantage for our clients.
  
  
  
  
Our India team is a well-established and integral part of the firm’s global operations, delivering high-value support across a wide spectrum of functions. With over 800 business professionals based in Gurugram and Hyderabad, we’ve been driving operational excellence and innovation for more than 15 years.
  
  
  
  
We contribute to global success in areas such as Information Technology, Finance, Human Resources, Risk & Compliance, Legal Support, Research & Knowledge, Document Production, Virtual Executive Assistance, Programme Management, Client & Market Development, and Continuous Improvement

**Job Description**

**The Role**

The broad scope of the role involves managing successful operation of Account Closing and Management Reporting Processes

**Who you will work with**

Onshore Finance team across Clifford chance offices Wider Finance team in Delhi office
  
  
Onshore Finance team across Clifford chance offices.

**What you will be responsible for**

In this role you will work in Record to Report team and your responsibility it is to manage, improve and support the end-to-end finance process.

**What you will do**

* In this role you will work in Record to Report team and your responsibility it is to manage, improve and support the end-to-end process. You will be the owner for a select set of financial processes which includes :
* Review of the General Ledger Analysis including P&L analysis, calculating Accruals and Prepayments, analysis of direct and indirect costs, entity consolidation, cost allocation.
* Review of Trial Balances and Variance analysis before GL close.
* Review the Income Analysis: Calculating, reconciling, recording and reporting the Income based on Work in progress and Provisions.
* Ensuring the timely recording of all month end items and closure of GL books as per the agreed KPIs.
* Managing timely and accurate Bank & Inter Office reconciliations.
* Monthly review of Balance Sheet account reconciliations, analysis of the open aged items and suggesting the resolution for the same.
* Validation and distribution of regular Management reports, KPIs and all ad- hoc reports as required.
* Ensuring compliance with rules and Internal Audit recommendations.
* You will work with Financial Controllers to set and maintain service levels and to deliver a high standard of output whilst managing expectations within the confines of the
  **Finance**
  system.
* You will need to establish a structure so that all work is completed in a controlled, accurate, timely and consistent way to ensure data integrity and quality; in accordance with standard policies and ensuring that statutory requirements for all offices are met.
* You will work with the supervisors to aid the development of the skills of each team, aiding the career development of your staff.
* You will be responsible for conducting trainings, refreshers and updating documentation & controls.
* You will aid to the development of the skills of the team, aiding the career development of your members by sharing regular feedbacks, regular catch up. You will be responsible for Appraisal process of your team.
* You will be responsible to guide your functional teams and share the best practices in your process.
* You will be responsible for sharing the progress reports, dashboards of the Projects with the Management.
* You will identify areas of risk to the financial integrity of transactions and recommend safeguard against financial loss or miss-statement.
* You will recommend processing improvements to maximize efficiency without jeopardizing financial control or compliance with Clifford Chance policy and Statutory requirements.
* You will identify & recommend new Finance work that can be transitioned to the Delhi Office and lead transitions as & when required.
* You will keep processes and transactions Audit ready.

**Qualifications**

**Your Experience**

**Personal Success Characteristics**

* Proven ability to handle complexity of the Finance Processes.
* Strong problem solving, trouble shooting and analytical skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meeting timelines.
* Highly motivated and creative, bringing fresh ideas to the table.
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
* Positive attitude and dedication.
* Organizational and Strategic thinking.
* Comfortable working in a team as well as on your own.

**Skills & Experience**

* Qualified CA with 6+ years/MBA with 8+ years of experience with experience of working in an MNC
* Experience of ORACLE & HFM.
* Proficient in MS Office Suite: Word, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Certification in Lean and/or Certification in / Working Knowledge of IFRS will be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**

**Equal opportunities**
  
  
  
At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.
  
  
  
  
We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age. This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.
  
  
  
  
We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.
  
  
  
  
Our goal is to deliver an equality of opportunity, an equality of aspiration and an equality of experience to everyone who works in our firm.
  
  
  
  
Find out more about our inclusive culture here.

title: Global Finance Data Governance Director
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As the Global Finance Data Governance Senior Manager, you will play a critical role in strengthening the integrity, reliability, and availability of BCG’s global finance data. You will help ensure that Finance systems and reporting solutions provide trusted, high-quality data that supports decision-making, compliance, and operational excellence.
  
  
As part of the Global Finance Excellence team, you will lead the development of a scalable Finance data quality capability, working across global, regional, and local teams. You will partner with the Finance Product Portfolio, Enterprise Data, Technology, Data Owners, and Data Stewards to establish consistent standards, make data quality measurable, and address issues at their source. You will also help ensure Finance data is ready to support emerging AI and automation opportunities.
  
  

* Develop and lead consistent data quality standards and validation rules across Finance, consolidating fragmented practices into scalable global approaches.
* Establish a global framework for measuring and reporting data quality through meaningful KPIs and actionable scorecards.
* Identify complex data quality challenges, determine root causes, and prioritize sustainable improvements.
* Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Product Owners, and Technology teams to strengthen controls, processes, and data definitions.
* Connect measurement and remediation to track improvements, identify emerging risks, and continuously improve data quality.
* Translate AI and automation data requirements into Finance data quality priorities and define what “AI-ready” data means.
* Apply hands-on AI and automation capabilities to improve data quality through intelligent validation, monitoring, and anomaly detection.
* Influence senior and cross-functional partners to build alignment around Finance data priorities, standards, and improvement initiatives.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 8+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on data quality or data management work, preferably in a Finance context
* Bachelor’s or higher degree, preferably in mathematics, statistics, data science or Finance/ Accounting
* Deep knowledge of data quality frameworks, controls, validation approaches, and related business processes.
* Hands-on AI/ML experience, including prototyping, building, or deploying AI-powered solutions.
* Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, Python, Tableau, dbt, or similar tools.
* Ability to translate data and AI requirements into practical data quality priorities and solutions.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of BCG's Global Finance Excellence team and work closely with colleagues across global, regional, and local Finance teams. You will partner with Finance Product, Enterprise Data, Technology, and Finance Data Owners and Data Stewards across domains such as supplier, worker and organization, client, and cost center data.
  
  
You will also collaborate with BCG's AI and emerging technology teams and engage senior business partners across functions to advance Finance data quality priorities.
  
  
Additional info

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
About the job

**Company Description:**
FutureMBBS partners with leading universities across Europe to help students pursue MBBS degrees abroad. With 22 partner universities in 9 countries, the organization focuses on offering high-quality medical education opportunities and advisory support. Over 900 students have already been successfully placed, reflecting FutureMBBS’s commitment to reliable guidance and student success. The team works closely with universities and students to simplify admissions, align expectations, and ensure a smooth transition to international medical programs. This environment offers professionals the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to global access to education.

**Role Description:**
The Product Designer (UI/UX) at FutureMBBS will take ownership of designing and improving digital experiences across web and mobile platforms used by prospective medical students.This is a product-focused role for someone who can take a problem from concept through to release. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to understand user and business needs, identify opportunities, develop thoughtful solutions, and turn them into intuitive, scalable product experiences.This is not a role focused only on creating polished screens or executing predefined designs. We are looking for someone who can understand an underlying problem, think independently, explore multiple solutions, make informed design decisions, collaborate closely with developers, and follow the work through to a real product release.

**Role:**

* Own product design problems from discovery and ideation through design, implementation, and launch.
* Translate user needs and business objectives into intuitive, user-centred product experiences.
* Conduct user research, interviews, surveys, usability testing, and other research activities where appropriate.
* Map user journeys, workflows, and information architecture to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs for web and mobile experiences.
* Develop and maintain reusable components and scalable design systems.
* Work closely with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented as intended.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Validate design decisions through user feedback, usability testing, and product data.
* Iterate on designs based on insights, feedback, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure consistency across visual design, interaction patterns, accessibility, and overall brand experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve user flows, usability, engagement, and conversion.
* Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

* 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Product Design, UI/UX Design, or a similar role, preferably in software, SaaS, technology, or other product-driven companies.
* Strong Product Design and Design Thinking skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured, user-centred solutions.
* Proven experience taking products or features from problem definition through design and into real-world release.
* Strong UX Research and User Research skills, including gathering user insights, conducting interviews or surveys, usability testing, and incorporating feedback into design decisions.
* Strong Visual Design skills, with an understanding of typography, colour, layout, hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive design.
* Strong proficiency in Figma and modern design and prototyping workflows. Experience with tools such as Sketch or Adobe XD is a plus.
* Experience creating and working with component-based design systems, reusable UI components, and scalable design patterns.
* Ability to think beyond individual screens and design solutions that can scale across an entire product.
* Experience working closely with developers and cross-functional teams, with a practical understanding of how designs translate into working software.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to independently evaluate options and make informed design decisions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain and defend design decisions to product, engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to take ownership of design problems rather than simply executing predefined requirements.
* A portfolio demonstrating real-world product design work, shipped features, and end-to-end design processes is required.
* Candidates should be able to discuss the problems they solved, the decisions they made, what was ultimately shipped, and where possible, the impact or results after launch.
* Experience in EdTech or student-facing products is a plus, but not mandatory.
* A Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field is beneficial; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**What Success Looks Like in this role:**

You will be successful in this role if you can take an ambiguous product problem, understand the user and business context, independently develop and evaluate solutions, collaborate with engineering to bring the solution to life, and ultimately measure what happened after launch.We care more about how you think, what you have shipped, and the impact of your work than simply how polished your portfolio looks.

With multiple employee-run Business Resource Group communities and world-class benefits such as health insurance, parental leave, and space-available travel, United is a one-of-a-kind place to work. Come join our team and help us make a positive impact on the world.
  
  
**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
The
**UX Designer**
will be an integral part of the
**CoreUX IKC design team**
, creating thoughtful, intuitive, accessible, and scalable digital experiences across United's customer-facing ecosystem, including
**united.com, the United app, and mobile web experiences**
.
  
  
This role combines strong
**product and interaction design capabilities**
with knowledge of
**design systems, modern Figma workflows, design tokens, prototyping, research, accessibility, and emerging AI-enabled design practices**
.
  
  
At its core, this role will transform unmet user needs and business opportunities into successful product experiences while helping evolve the shared design foundations that enable United's digital products to scale consistently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product & Experience Design: Collaborate with product managers, researchers, developers, business stakeholders, and other designers to understand customer and business needs and translate them into intuitive digital product experiences.
* User-Centered Design: Apply user-centered and systems-thinking approaches to transform complex customer journeys and unmet needs into simple, effective, and scalable solutions.
* Interaction & UI Design: Create user flows, journey concepts, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs that clearly communicate design intent and demonstrate strong interaction and visual design thinking.
* Research & Analytics: Conduct and leverage qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, customer feedback, competitive analysis, and product analytics to identify pain points, validate concepts, and inform design decisions.
* Testing & Iteration: Build prototypes, conduct usability testing, gather feedback, and continuously iterate designs based on research findings, business requirements, usability insights, and analytics.
* Design Systems: Contribute to the evolution and adoption of United's design system by creating and applying reusable components, patterns, guidelines, and scalable design foundations.
* Variables & Design Tokens: Understand and apply Figma Variables and design-token concepts, including color, typography, spacing, themes, and other foundations, to support consistency and scalability across digital products.
* Advanced Prototyping: Use Figma's advanced prototyping capabilities to create realistic, interactive experiences for validating customer journeys, product concepts, and complex interactions.
* AI-Enabled Design: Explore and apply AI-powered tools and emerging design workflows to accelerate ideation, prototyping, content exploration, research synthesis, and design iteration while maintaining appropriate design quality and oversight.
* Accessibility: Design experiences aligned with WCAG accessibility standards and work with design and engineering partners to incorporate accessibility throughout the design process, from foundational styles and components through final product experiences.
* Responsive & Multi-Platform Design: Create responsive experiences and understand how components and interaction patterns need to adapt across desktop, mobile web, and native application environments.
* Design-to-Development Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to understand technical constraints and ensure design specifications, component behavior, responsive patterns, and interactions are translated effectively into production.
* Data-Informed Design: Use analytics and product performance data to understand the effectiveness of design solutions and identify opportunities for continued improvement.
* Design System Adoption & Consistency: Help teams appropriately use established design-system components and patterns while identifying opportunities for new or improved patterns when existing solutions do not adequately address customer needs.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Clearly communicate design concepts, rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations to designers, engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* Design Quality: Maintain a high level of craft and attention to detail across interaction design, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, responsive behavior, accessibility, and overall experience quality.

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**
**Qualifications**
What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or 4 years of relevant professional experience in place of a degree, or equivalent proven work experience.
* 3+ years of UX, Product Design, Interaction Design, or related industry experience.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating the design process as well as final outcomes, including examples such as sketches, workflows, user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, interaction models, high-fidelity UI, and shipped experiences.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, Auto Layout, prototyping, libraries, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Experience creating and working with reusable components and design systems.
* Working knowledge of Figma Variables, design tokens, styles, themes, and scalable design-system concepts.
* Strong understanding of interaction design, responsive design, common UX patterns, information hierarchy, user behavior, and user-centered design principles.
* Experience conducting or partnering on user research and usability testing, and the ability to translate research insights into design decisions.
* Familiarity with quantitative product data and the ability to use analytics and customer feedback to evaluate and improve experiences.
* Ability to create sophisticated, polished UI designs from concept through execution while maintaining consistency with established design standards.
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards and applying accessibility principles to digital product design.
* Understanding of how design decisions translate into HTML/CSS, responsive layouts, components, and front-end implementation. Coding expertise is not required, but strong technical literacy and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers are expected.
* Experience with or demonstrated interest in AI-assisted design, generative AI, and AI-enabled prototyping workflows.
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions, customer problems, trade-offs, and the rationale behind proposed solutions.
* Strong verbal, written, visual, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with product managers, developers, researchers, designers, and business stakeholders in a collaborative environment.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment, manage multiple priorities, and remain receptive to feedback.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to solve complex problems creatively and effectively.
* Maintain a consistent user-centered perspective while balancing customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, accessibility, and scalability.
* Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship.
* Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on large-scale consumer digital products across web and mobile platforms.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Java & AWS) (Remote, Full-Time) [AS314]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
