We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Cloud Engineer (Backend / DevOps-leaning), you will take responsibility for designing, building and maintaining AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. This is an ongoing, long-term opportunity focused on reliable cloud infrastructure and its supporting delivery processes.

  

You will manage EC2 and other core infrastructure components, support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, and implement and maintain security and compliance controls.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop, maintain and improve AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Strengthen and improve existing IaC configurations, infrastructure reliability and platform maturity
  
* Own, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines, primarily using GitHub Actions, with Jenkins integrations where applicable
  
* Implement and improve software supply-chain security processes, including Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), container image signing and verification
  
* Improve AWS monitoring, alerting and operational visibility across the platform
  
* Manage Docker-based container deployments and orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Support ECS Anywhere deployments running across self-managed EC2 instances
  
* Work with AWS services, including EC2, ECS, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* Develop and enhance backend microservices, primarily written in Java
  
* Implement new backend features and functionality supporting role-based access control (RBAC)
  
* Develop backend capabilities for metrics ingestion and processing
  
* Implement backend functionality supporting multi-tenancy
  
* Manage application deployments, troubleshoot infrastructure issues and resolve CI/CD pipeline failures independently
  
* Support cloud and on-premises deployment environments, including opportunities to improve consistency between them
  
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, performance, security and delivery quality
  
* Contribute to cloud cost optimisation while maintaining a cloud-agnostic approach and avoiding unnecessary vendor lock-in
  
* Identify technical gaps, propose improvements and contribute proactively to product and platform development
  
* Collaborate with other engineers, share technical knowledge and challenge technical decisions constructively
  
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, reviewing and taking ownership of generated code and integrations
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 5 years of senior-level hands-on experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering or DevOps, with the ability to independently own infrastructure and backend development work
  
* 5 years of strong practical experience with AWS infrastructure and core services, including EC2, ECS, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* 3 years of experience with Java-based backend services, or relevant backend development expertise applicable to Java microservices
  
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Proven experience designing, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions. Equivalent experience with GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins is acceptable where transferable expertise can be demonstrated
  
* Knowledge and practical experience of software supply-chain security, including SBOMs, signed container images and image verification
  
* Experience implementing and maintaining cloud monitoring and alerting solutions
  
* Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized services and container orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Strong backend development experience, with the ability to independently implement new features and functionality in microservices
  
* Ability to develop backend functionality involving access control, metrics ingestion and multi-tenancy
  
* Experience troubleshooting production infrastructure, deployment pipelines and backend services
  
* Understanding of platform reliability, maintainability, security and continuous improvement
  
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions and contribute beyond assigned development tasks
  
* Strong collaboration, knowledge-sharing and problem-solving skills
  
* Ability to propose and justify technical improvements constructively
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience developing frontend features and functionality, particularly around multi-tenancy and dashboard sharing
  
* Experience integrating metrics visualisations using native frontend graphing libraries, including migrating dashboards from Grafana
  
* Experience with Kubernetes deployments across on-premises and cloud environments
  
* Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and secure SDLC practices
  
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation (FinOps) and cloud-agnostic infrastructure

Define the Al/ML architecture. Own the end-to-end design of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, serving and monitoring. Make sure the platform is scalable, maintainable, secure and able to evolve without rewrites.

title: Deputy Vice President - Security Engineering & Architecture
description:
**Role Purpose:**
The Security Engineering & Architecture Lead will lead the design, governance and continuous evolution of the organization cyber security architecture, engineering standards and control framework. The role is accountable for ensuring that security requirements are embedded across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, data environments and emerging technologies.

The role will act as the principal security architecture authority, enabling secure business transformation through risk-based security solutions, regulatory compliance, technology resilience and alignment with enterprise security strategy.

**Role Accountability**

**A. Security Architecture, Standards & Design Governance**

1. Define and maintain security reference architectures for network, cloud, applications, identity, data, payment platforms, APIs and digital channels.
2. Establish security design standards, approved patterns and reusable engineering blueprints aligned to enterprise risk, regulatory and internal control requirements.
3. Lead security design reviews for major initiatives, technology changes, outsourcing arrangements and third-party integrations before production go-live.
4. Own security architecture for cardholder data environments, transaction-processing systems and regulated technology platforms.

**B. Security Controls, Engineering Roadmap & Hardening**

1. Translate security control frameworks into implementable technology requirements across infrastructure, applications, cloud, identity and data environments.
2. Govern security engineering roadmaps across endpoint security, IAM/PAM, data protection, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, telemetry and cloud security.
3. Establish security baseline configurations and hardening standards, and drive enforcement through architecture reviews, automation and compliance checks.
4. Define and govern cryptography, encryption, tokenization, key management and certificate management standards across enterprise technology platforms.

**C. Secure-by-Design, Threat Modelling & Automation**

1. Drive threat modelling for critical applications, integrations and platforms, ensuring risks are documented, prioritized and tracked to closure.
2. Partner with enterprise architecture, IT, platform and engineering teams to embed security-by-design into SDLC, infrastructure builds and cloud deployments.
3. Drive adoption of automated security engineering practices, including policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security checks and automated baseline compliance.

**D. Governance, Exceptions & Continuous Improvement**

1. Maintain the security exceptions register, including expiry dates, compensating controls, risk acceptance and closure mechanisms.
2. Partner with SOC, vulnerability management and incident response teams to convert threat intelligence, incidents and recurring control failures into improved architecture patterns.
3. Ensure security architecture inputs are embedded into enterprise architecture forums, technology design authorities and change governance processes.
4. Lead security engineering teams and vendors, ensuring delivery quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and adherence to approved standards.

**Measures of Success**

1. Approved security architecture patterns are available and used across key technology domains.
2. Major technology changes are security-reviewed before go-live with clear risk decisions.
3. Security design gaps reduce across cloud, infrastructure, applications, APIs, identity and data platforms.
4. Critical payment, digital and regulated platforms follow defined security architecture standards.
5. Security exceptions reduce through better design standards, compensating controls and closure tracking.
6. Security baselines and hardening standards are translated into implementable engineering requirements.
7. Architecture decisions, control mappings and exceptions remain documented and audit-ready.

**Technical Skills**

1. Application, API & DevSecOps Security Architecture
2. Cyber Resilience & Crisis Strategy Leadership
3. Database, Infrastructure & Network Security Architecture
4. Program Strategy, Portfolio Governance & Executive Reporting
5. Security & AI Governance, & Policy Interpretation
6. Security Architecture Governance & Secure Design Assurance
7. AI/ML, GenAI & Emerging Technology Security Architecture
8. Security Engineering, Tooling & Platform Integration

**Exposure to below mentioned Technologies / Frameworks / Methodologies**

1. SABSA
2. TOGAF
3. NIST CSF
4. ISO 27001 / ISO 27002
5. CIS Controls
6. NIST SSDF
7. STRIDE / PASTA threat modelling
8. Security reference architectures
9. Architecture review boards
10. GRC platforms
11. Cloud security guardrails
12. DevSecOps security standards
13. Infrastructure-as-code scanning tools
14. SAST / DAST / SCA tools

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree / B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security or related engineering discipline;

Additional academic exposure, Executive education or equivalent experience in security architecture, enterprise architecture or technology risk preferred.

**Preferred Industry:**
BFSI, payments, banking, NBFC, fintech, large regulated enterprises with complex cloud, API, digital platform and customer data environments.

title: Principal Consultant- Sustainability
description:
**Job Description**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
WSP's International ESG Advisory team is seeking an experienced International Social and Environmental Specialist to support our international lender advisory and ESG due diligence business. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership on environmental and social risk management across infrastructure, renewable energy, mining, industrial, agribusiness, transport and urban development projects globally.
  
  
You will play a leading role in:
  
  
**Technical Delivery**

* Leading major international Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD), Social Impact Assessment (SIA), Human Rights and Social Risk Assessments.
* Directing the identification, assessment and management of social risks and impacts throughout project development, construction and operation.
* Providing expert advice on complex social issues including:

+ Land acquisition and involuntary resettlement;
+ Livelihood restoration;
+ Stakeholder engagement;
+ Labour and working conditions;
+ Human rights and supply chain risks;
+ Community health, safety and security;
+ Gender equality, social inclusion and vulnerable groups.

* Developing and reviewing:

+ Social Management Plans;
+ Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs);
+ Livelihood Restoration Plans (LRPs);
+ Labour Management Plans;
+ Stakeholder Engagement Plans;
+ Human Rights Assessments and Relevant Management Plans;
+ Gender Action Plans and Equal Opportunities Action Plans.

* Defining corrective action plans, monitoring measures and verification approaches to support compliance with lender requirements and international good practice.

**ESG and Lender Advisory**

* Acting as a trusted advisor to clients seeking alignment with IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, EBRD Environmental and Social Requirements, World Bank Environmental and Social Framework, ADB SPS and other international ESG frameworks.
* Supporting lenders and developers through project financing processes, including pre-financial close due diligence, construction monitoring and operational ESG reviews.
* Providing strategic advice on social performance, responsible sourcing, labour rights and human rights due diligence.

**Project and Client Leadership**

* Managing multidisciplinary project teams and the successful delivery of complex international assignments across multiple geographies.
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, financial institutions and development partners.
* Supporting business development activities, including proposal preparation, client engagement and technical leadership in bids and tenders.
* Identifying growth opportunities in social sustainability, responsible business conduct and ESG advisory services.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in social sciences, development studies, anthropology, sociology, geography, environmental management, international development or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Significant professional experience in social sustainability, social performance, ESG advisory or international development.

**Technical Expertise**
Demonstrated expertise in several of the following:
  
  

* Social Impact Assessment (SIA);
* Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD);
* Land Acquisition and Resettlement;
* Livelihood Restoration;
* Human Rights Due Diligence;
* Labour and Working Conditions;
* Gender Equality and Social Inclusion;
* Stakeholder Engagement and Community Development;
* Social Performance Monitoring;
* ESG and Sustainable Finance advisory.

**International Standards**
Strong project finance / lender advisory background and working knowledge of:
  
  

* IFC Performance Standards;
* Equator Principles EP4;
* EBRD Environmental and Social Requirements;
* World Bank Environmental and Social Framework;
* ADB Environmental and Social Framework/Safeguards;
* UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights;
* OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**
**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**
*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Location:**

**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce-related Service Desk tickets
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required
* Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies

description:

Analyze & design rules for the fraud monitoring systems (Hunter, Credit Bureau) to control key fraud risk metrics like FPR, ADR, VDR etc.

8. Automation & Process Optimization - Build and maintain rule engines and decisioning systems to streamline fraud prevention workflows and reduce manual interventions.
9. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting - Ensure adherence to RBI, DPSC, and internal fraud governance standards through timely reporting and audit readiness.

**Measures of Success**

1. AFPR, ADR, VDR

3. Experience with AI/ML Model Development.
4. Strong understanding of Fraud and ACS Systems like Hunter, Falcon /WIBMO/NPCI platforms
5. Functional Knowledge

7. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including RBI’s EWS and DPSC guidelines.

9. Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Role: Business Analyst**

**You should apply if you have:**

• A sharp, curious mind - you instinctively ask why a number moved, where exactly it moved, and what it's costing the business, instead of just reporting it

• 2–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Operations/Strategy Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar in e-commerce, D2C, consumer internet, or any fast-moving business where you've worked with real operational data

• Comfort with data - you can pull and slice data with SQL and Excel/Sheets, and turn it into a clear answer

• A structured way of breaking down messy, ambiguous problems into hypotheses, analysis, and a recommendation

• Ownership - you don't stop at 'I shared the analysis'; you follow through with teams until the fix is in and the metric has moved

• An AI-first way of working - you use LLMs and other AI tools to move faster, automate the boring parts, and prototype ideas

• Hunger to learn new domains fast - we'll give you a detailed knowledge transfer on how our business and operations run; the curiosity

and drive to master it need to come from you

**You should not apply if you:**

• Want a pure reporting role - here you're expected to interpret the numbers, take a view, and drive action on them

• Are looking to run day-to-day operations - this is an analytics and intelligence role that informs the business, not an ops role

• Need every problem to be perfectly defined before you start - much of this role is figuring out what the problem actually is

• Treat your job as done once a dashboard or deck ships - we care about whether the metric moved

**Skills Required:**

**Must-Have**

• SQL: comfortable writing queries to pull, join, and analyze operational data

• Excel / Google Sheets: strong enough to model, slice, and sanity-check numbers quickly

• Structured Problem Solving: breaking an ambiguous problem into hypotheses, data, root cause, and recommendation

• Business Sense: connecting an operational metric to revenue, margin, cost, or customer experience

• Communication: turning complex analysis into a simple story - what happened, why, impact, and what to do next

• Ownership & Follow-through: working across teams until an action actually reaches closure

**Good to Have**

• Experience in e-commerce operations - across D2C, quick commerce, marketplaces, or consumer internet

(a strong plus, not a requirement)

• A BI tool such as Power BI, Metabase, Tableau, or Looker

• Exposure to operations data such as logistics, inventory, fulfilment, or customer support

• Basic Python for scripting and automation

• Experience using AI tools or vibe coding to automate analysis and build quick internal tools

**What will you do?**

**Be the Go-To for Business Numbers**

• Own reporting and dashboards across key business and operational areas - the single trusted source of truth teams rely on

• Give each function the right data cuts to make their day-to-day decisions

**Monitor and Catch Problems Early**

• Closely track key business and operational KPIs so you're the first to know when something breaks - a delivery delay, a spike in cancellations or RTO, a drop in availability

• Build early-warning indicators and flag anomalies to the right teams before they turn into escalations

**Dig into Root Causes**

• Investigate why metrics move - across products, customers, geographies, partners, and processes - and quantify the impact

• Take problems from insight to root cause to a clear recommendation

**Solve Core Business Problems (Initial Focus: Fulfilment, Logistics & Inventory)**

• Fulfilment and courier allocation - which location and partner should serve which order

• Inventory availability - reducing stockouts and excess stock

• COD and RTO risk - spotting risky orders and pin codes early

• Cancellations and customer experience - understanding what drives them and where automation can help

• Vendor performance - giving procurement a data-backed view of when to rely more on a vendor and when to de-risk

• Your scope will broaden across the business as you grow into the role

**Turn Insights into Projects and Track Them to Impact**

• For every recommendation, define the baseline, target KPI, owner, and timeline upfront

• Bring the right teams together, drive the action, and check afterwards whether the change actually moved the metric

• Maintain a clear view of open projects - status, risks, and expected versus actual impact

**Build Smarter Ways of Working**

• Use AI tools and automation to replace manual reporting and analysis wherever you can

• Help shape lightweight rule-based tools and automations that make decisions faster and more consistent

**Communicate with Leadership and Functional Heads**

• Present business health, risks, and project impact to founders and function leads

• Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives

**How we'll set you up:**

• A structured knowledge transfer on how Nutrabay's business and operations work end to end - order flow,

fulfilment, logistics, inventory, customer support, and procurement

• Hands-on walkthroughs with the teams who run each function day to day

• Real problems from week one, with guidance from the Business Intelligence & Strategy lead

• A clear path to growing into broader ownership of business intelligence as you build domain depth

**The Mandate:**

Everything operations for an e-commerce business. You'll work across fulfilment, logistics, inventory, customer

experience, and procurement to find what's broken, fix it, and make the whole operation run smarter and faster. Prior

experience in e-commerce operations is a big plus, but not a must - we'll train you on the rest.

**Work Experience:2–4 years of experience**

**Working days:Monday – Friday**

**Location:Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)**

Perks:

• Friendly atmosphere

• High learning & personal growth opportunity

• Flexible timings

• Diverse work environment

**Why Nutrabay:**

We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing-and-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.

Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing. We have built a complex and high-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million.We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.

title: Senior costing engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Trisquare Switchgears is a manufacturing enterprise that combines innovative production, pioneering engineering solutions, and comprehensive services to meet diverse customer requirements. The company focuses on smart, technology-driven solutions and has engineered and constructed many of India’s largest grid-connected PV power plants, delivering reliable and cost-effective outcomes. With a strong presence across India, Trisquare emphasizes reliability, customer delight, profitable growth, and shorter delivery lead times. The organization values innovation, imagination, and a transformative attitude toward building power and moving the world, offering team members the chance to help change the way markets operate.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Costing Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India, responsible for overseeing and optimizing project and product costing for switchgear and electrical panels. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing material, labor, and overhead costs; preparing detailed cost estimates and budgets; and evaluating quotations from suppliers and contractors to ensure cost-effectiveness and compliance with technical specifications. The Senior Costing Engineer will bid preparation, pricing strategies, and profitability analysis, while maintaining up-to-date costing databases and documentation aligned with company standards and industry best practices.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong background in cost estimation, cost control, and budgeting for engineering, or manufacturing projects, preferably in switchgear, electrical, or solar sectors.
* Proficiency in cost analysis tools, MS Excel, and relevant ERP or costing software to build and maintain detailed cost models and reports.
* Solid understanding of engineering drawings, technical specifications, bills of materials (BOM) & industrial procurement processes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced qualifications or professional certifications in costing or project management are a plus.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to interpret complex technical and financial data.
* Experience in a senior or lead costing role within an EPC or manufacturing environment, with a track record of driving cost optimization and supporting profitable growth.

**Title: BI Lead**

**About [Circles – Jetpac]:**

Jetpac, from Circles, is the coolest tech startup you will find, dedicated to making Travel super convenient and 100% hassle free. If you think you've got the guts, the smarts, and the hustle to join us, then keep reading!

**Job Overview**

We're looking for a
**BI Lead**
to build and own the data backbone that powers every decision at Jetpac. This role demands someone who's equally strong technically and commercially: hands-on with SQL, data models and dashboards, but also strategic enough to shape how the company measures growth. You'll own the single source of truth for our metrics and partner closely with marketing, product, finance and leadership. If you're someone who gets a kick out of turning messy data into crisp answers, and can tell CAC from LTV from cohort retention in your sleep, you'll fit right in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Ownership**

* Define and drive Jetpac's BI and reporting roadmap in line with business priorities
* Own the company's core metrics framework (revenue, orders, CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, churn) and be the single source of truth for them
* Set standards for metric definitions, data quality and governance across teams
* Prioritise incoming data requests and balance quick answers with long-term infrastructure

**Data Modelling & Infrastructure**

* Design and maintain scalable data models and a clean semantic layer in the data warehouse
* Build and own ETL/ELT pipelines from product, payments, marketing, CRM and support sources
* Partner with engineering to improve event tracking, data collection and pipeline reliability
* Set up monitoring and checks to catch data issues before stakeholders do

**Dashboards & Reporting**

* Build and maintain self-serve dashboards for leadership, marketing, product, finance and operations
* Deliver weekly and monthly business reviews with clear, actionable insights
* Automate recurring reports and reduce manual effort across teams
* Make data accessible and easy to use for non-technical stakeholders

**Analytics & Insights**

* Run deep dives on acquisition, conversion funnels, cohorts, pricing and retention
* Support marketing with attribution, channel performance and budget allocation analysis
* Partner with product on A/B test design, measurement and readouts
* Use data to craft compelling narratives around what's working, what's not, and what's next

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with marketing, product, finance, CRM and customer support teams to understand their data needs
* Work with leadership to translate business questions into analysis and metrics
* Coordinate with engineering on data availability and new tracking requirements

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Present insights, growth hypotheses and recommendations to leadership
* Maintain a clear data dictionary and documentation of metrics, models and dashboards
* Track and communicate key decisions on definitions and data changes

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics or data roles
* Expert-level SQL and strong experience with data modelling (dimensional modelling, star schemas)
* Hands-on experience building dashboards in at least one major BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase)
* Experience with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field
* Strong understanding of e-commerce or consumer-app metrics: funnels, cohorts, CAC, LTV, retention
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in a tech startup or high-growth DTC brand
* Background in travel, telecom or fintech verticals is a strong plus
* Familiarity with eSIM or digital telco space is a bonus

**Desired Skills**

* Proficiency in Python for analysis and automation
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as GA4, Posthog or Amplitude
* Familiarity with marketing data sources and MMPs like AppsFlyer or Branch
* Knowledge of A/B testing, statistics and experiment design
* Strong data storytelling and visualisation skills

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and excellent performance-based incentives.
* Flexible work arrangements with remote or hybrid options.
* Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative global team.
* Career growth and professional development opportunities

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to own the analytics layer behind Pluang's product decisions. You will work directly with Product Managers across our asset classes — Global Stocks, Crypto and Indonesian Equities — to define how we measure success, find where users drop off or thrive, and turn data into clear product recommendations.

This is a product role, not a reporting role. We want someone who frames the right question before running the query, works independently through ambiguous problems, and brings a point of view to the table. You will have high ownership and a direct line of sight from your analysis to what ships. You will use AI tools like Claude as a core part of how you work, to take analysis deeper and faster than traditional approaches allow.

**What You'll Do**

**Shape Product Decisions with Data**

* Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, guardrails and North Star measures for features and product lines.
* Frame ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and drive them end to end: from hypothesis to recommendation.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap discussions — size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and flag what the data does and does not support.
* Present insights clearly to product, design, engineering and leadership audiences.

**Own Product Health and Funnels**

* Build and maintain funnels across key investor journeys: onboarding and KYC, funding, first trade, repeat trading and retention.
* Run cohort, retention and engagement analyses to understand how different investor segments behave across asset classes.
* Track feature adoption and post-launch performance, and turn findings into concrete next steps for the product team.
* Set up dashboards and alerts that let PMs self-serve on day-to-day metrics, so analysis time goes to deeper questions.

**Drive Experimentation**

* Design A/B tests with PMs: hypotheses, sample sizes, success criteria and test duration.
* Analyse results rigorously, call out biases and noise, and give a clear ship / iterate / stop recommendation.
* Help build a consistent experimentation practice across product teams.

**Strengthen the Analytics Layer**

* Work hands-on in BigQuery and Mixpanel (and similar tools) to query, model and interpret product and user behaviour data.
* Define event tracking and instrumentation requirements with PMs and engineers, and ensure data is reliable before decisions are made on it.
* Work closely with the Data Engineering team, who own pipelines and infrastructure, so the right data is available for product questions.

**Use AI for Deeper, Faster Analysis**

* Use AI tools such as Claude as a core part of your workflow: to explore data, write and review SQL and Python, test hypotheses and surface patterns faster.
* Go deeper than manual analysis allows: synthesise user feedback at scale, root-cause metric movements, and model scenarios quickly.
* Check AI-generated output rigorously: the logic, the data and the numbers must hold up before they inform a decision.
* Build reusable AI-assisted workflows and share them, so PMs and the wider team can answer more questions themselves.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* 3–4 years of experience in product analytics, ideally embedded within a product team rather than a central data or BI function.
* Experience in fintech, with a strong preference for brokerage, trading or investment platforms.
* Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, event-level datasets.
* Hands-on experience with funnel, cohort, retention and experimentation analysis.
* Structured problem-solving: able to break an open-ended question into a clear analytical approach without step-by-step direction.
* A track record of high ownership — analyses you drove to a decision, not just delivered.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn findings into a crisp recommendation.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) in your analytical work, with good judgement on when to rely on their output and when to verify it.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GCP / BigQuery and Mixpanel, or equivalent product analytics tools (Amplitude, CleverTap, Looker, Metabase).
* Python or R for deeper statistical analysis.
* Understanding of retail investing journeys — KYC, funding, order placement, portfolio and P&L.
* Exposure to Indian/US/Indonesian equities or Crypto markets.
* Experience working with distributed teams across countries.
* Personal interest in investing and financial markets.

**Why Join Pluang?**

* Competitive compensation package and performance-based incentives.
* Direct impact: your analysis shapes what ships across a multi-asset investing platform.
* High ownership and close work with Product, Engineering, Design and leadership.
* Exposure to global and Indonesian investing products and financial markets.
* Learning and development opportunities with strong mentorship and career growth.
* Flexible policies that support work-life balance and employee well-being.

Click here to find out!*

title: Quick-Commerce Manager
description:
**Quick Commerce Growth**

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a hands-on Quick Commerce Growth Manager to scale our business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and emerging Q-commerce platforms.

This is not a general e-commerce or marketplace role. You will own the operational levers that directly influence Q-commerce growth: assortment, purchase-order fulfilment, fill rate, in-stock availability, dark-store availability, replenishment, advertising, visibility and catalogue readiness.

The right candidate enjoys working with numbers, solving availability issues and following actions through to closure. You should be equally comfortable analysing SKU-level performance, coordinating with internal teams and working with platform account managers.

**What You’ll Own**

**Channel growth and execution**

* Own day-to-day growth and business execution across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and new Q-commerce channels.
* Build channel-wise growth plans covering sales, assortment, availability, advertising, visibility and expansion.
* Identify and act on platform, category, city and dark-store-level growth opportunities.

**Assortment and SKU performance**

* Manage a focused assortment based on demand, availability and sell-through.
* Track fast movers, slow movers, stock-outs and underperforming SKUs.
* Drive new product launches, category expansion and SKU-level sell-through.
* Recommend assortment additions, removals and channel-specific packs based on data.

**Availability and fulfilment**

* Forecast demand for priority SKUs and share replenishment inputs with supply chain, warehouse and planning teams.
* Track and improve fill rate, PO fulfilment, OSA, dispatch adherence and dark-store availability.
* Flag stock-out risks early and follow up with relevant teams until resolution.
* Investigate availability gaps across platforms, cities and dark stores.

**Platform growth levers**

* Coordinate advertising, visibility slots, platform campaigns, pricing corrections and promotional opportunities.
* Monitor ad performance and recommend changes based on sales, ROAS and SKU availability.
* Work closely with platform account managers and internal stakeholders to close growth and operational actions.

**Catalogue and launch readiness**

* Maintain catalogue accuracy across titles, images, attributes, pricing, tags and product content.
* Ensure new SKUs are catalogue-ready, correctly listed and live on time.
* Track catalogue, pricing and listing issues through to closure.

**Reporting and decision-making**

* Maintain weekly dashboards covering sales, growth, SKU performance, fill rate, PO fulfilment, availability, advertising and open actions.
* Convert data into clear recommendations and next steps - not just reports.
* Run structured weekly reviews with owners, deadlines and closure tracking.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Non-negotiable**

* 2–4 years of experience in Quick Commerce, marketplace growth, category operations or key account management.
* Direct, hands-on exposure to at least one Q-commerce platform such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes or BB Now.
* Working knowledge of Q-commerce metrics, including fill rate, PO fulfilment, OSA, replenishment, stock availability, advertising and visibility.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, trackers and basic performance dashboards.
* Evidence of personally owning execution and follow-ups - not only preparing reports or coordinating from the sidelines.

**Preferred background**

**Experience working with Q-commerce or category operations in FMCG, beauty, fashion, jewellery, apparel, electronics or a consumer-focused D2C brand.**

**You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You**

* Enjoy going deep into SKU-level and platform-level data.
* Spot problems early and follow them through to closure.
* Balance commercial growth with operational discipline.
* Communicate clearly with supply chain, warehouse, finance, marketing and platform teams.
* Work well in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
* Take ownership without waiting for repeated instructions.

**Success in This Role Will Be Measured By**

* Q-commerce revenue growth
* Fill rate and PO fulfilment
* OSA and priority-SKU availability
* SKU sell-through and assortment productivity
* On-time launch of new SKUs
* Advertising and visibility performance
* Speed of catalogue and pricing issue resolution
* Expansion across platforms, cities and categories
* Quality of reporting, recommendations and action closure

**Who Should Not Apply**

**This role may not be the right fit if your experience is limited to Amazon, Flipkart or D2C website operations without meaningful exposure to Q-commerce execution.**

**We are specifically looking for candidates who have worked directly on Q-commerce availability, fulfilment, assortment, platform growth or category operations.**

title: Decision Intelligence Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The Decision Intelligence Lead, within the Operations Intelligence & Analytics organization, drives the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of executive analytics solutions that translate Global Operations initiatives into measurable business outcomes. This role transforms complex operational data into actionable insights delivered through dashboards, scorecards, and interactive applications that improve decision-making, performance, and efficiency across the enterprise.
  
  
As a key partner to leaders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other Global Operations functions, the Decision Intelligence Lead operates with a product-oriented approach to analytics, overseeing solutions from strategy and requirements through deployment and continuous enhancement. The ideal candidate combines expertise in business intelligence, modern data platforms, and advanced analytics with the ability to translate business needs into scalable, user-centric solutions that influence executive strategy and operational performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Build and own the product roadmap, including the executive insights dashboard, data-rich executive summaries, and balanced scorecard reporting.
* Apply product strategy, management and UX principles to design scalable and intuitive data products with the user in mind.
* Develop decision intelligence products within Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including semantic models, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and executive summaries that provide actionable insights into the health and performance of the global operations network.
* Build interactive scenario planning applications, incorporating predictive models to support trade-off analysis and forward-looking decision-making.
* Automate repeatable data extraction, preparation and transformation workflows using Python and SQL.
* Integrate ERP data from SAP, Oracle and additional disparate data sources into cohesive, consumable decision intelligence products.
* Apply predictive analytics and AI/ML techniques, where appropriate, to enhance operational forecasting, risk identification, scenario simulation, and decision support capabilities.
* Use standard DevOps tools, including GitHub, Confluence, and Jira, throughout the product development lifecycle.

* Bachelor's degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; Master's degree preferred.

title: Ecommerce Category Manager
description:
**Company:**
Nutristar

**Department:**
E-commerce / Business Operations

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time Onsite (Pitampura, Delhi)

About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven and analytical professional to manage Nutristar's e-commerce category operations. The person will be responsible for deciding which products deserve maximum visibility on the website, identifying high-performing and high-margin products, optimizing product assortment, and coordinating with brands and vendors to ensure competitive sourcing and product availability.

The ideal candidate should have strong business acumen, analytical thinking and an understanding of e-commerce business dynamics. This is a business-oriented role that goes beyond routine website management.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Website & Category Management**

* Manage day-to-day website merchandising and category operations.
* Decide product placements, rankings, banners, recommendations and visibility across website categories.
* Identify products that deserve higher visibility based on sales performance, margins, demand and conversion rates.
* Optimize product listings, collections, filters, sorting and category pages.
* Ensure new launches, trending products and promotional products receive appropriate visibility.

**2. Business & Product Performance Analytics**

* Analyze product-wise sales, revenue, gross margins, conversion rates and inventory movement.
* Identify best-selling, high-margin and high-potential products.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and recommend corrective actions.
* Track category-level performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability.
* Use Excel/Google Sheets to build reports, dashboards and business performance trackers.
* Make data-backed decisions on product visibility, pricing and assortment.

**3. Vendor & Brand Coordination**

* Coordinate with existing brands and vendors for product sourcing, availability and commercial negotiations.
* Identify new brands and products that can add value to Nutristar's portfolio.
* Negotiate better margins, pricing, promotional support and commercial terms.
* Coordinate for new product launches, stock replenishment and inventory availability.
* Build strong vendor relationships to ensure competitive sourcing and better business opportunities.

**4. Category Growth & Business Development**

* Identify emerging trends and products in the health, fitness and sports nutrition industry.
* Evaluate new product opportunities based on market demand, competition and profitability.
* Plan category-wise promotional activities and product campaigns.
* Work closely with marketing, performance marketing, operations and technology teams.
* Continuously improve category revenue, contribution margins and overall business performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in e-commerce, category management, product merchandising or business operations.
* Strong commercial understanding and business acumen.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.
* Ability to interpret sales, margin, conversion and inventory data.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation and communication skills.
* Understanding of online merchandising, product assortment and category growth.

**Preferred:**
Experience in D2C, marketplaces, sports nutrition, health supplements, FMCG or retail e-commerce.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Category-wise revenue growth.
* Gross margin and contribution improvement.
* Product visibility and conversion rate improvement.
* Growth in sales of high-margin products.
* New product and brand onboarding.
* Vendor commercial improvements.
* Reduction in out-of-stock instances.
* Improvement in overall category performance.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Someone who doesn't just manage what appears on the website but understands
*why a particular product should be visible, how much business it can generate, what margins it delivers and where the next growth opportunity lies.*

The candidate should have an ownership mindset and be comfortable making commercial decisions backed by data.

title: Programme Analyst – Clean Energy
description:
Finovista is seeking a Programme Analyst to support the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of clean energy and clean cooking initiatives. The role involves programme research, data analysis, stakeholder coordination, progress tracking, documentation, and reporting.

The ideal candidate will have relevant sector experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with government agencies, financial institutions, development partners, technology providers, and implementation teams.

**About the Programme**

The programme aims to strengthen the clean cooking ecosystem by supporting the adoption and deployment of clean energy solutions. It involves coordination with technology providers, financial institutions, government departments, Microfinance Institutions (MFIs), and local implementation partners.

Key areas include demand generation, deployment planning, capacity building, quality assurance, after-sales support, affordability, and the development of sustainable delivery models. The programme also seeks to create livelihood opportunities, particularly for women entrepreneurs, through partnerships with local institutions and community networks.

**Role Overview**

The Programme Analyst will support programme planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting. The role requires collecting and analysing programme data, tracking targets and deliverables, preparing reports and presentations, coordinating with stakeholders, and identifying implementation challenges. The candidate will contribute to evidence-based decision-making and help ensure that programme activities are completed effectively and on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Programme Planning and Implementation:**
  Support the preparation of work plans, activity schedules, implementation plans, and programme documentation.
* **Research and Data Analysis:**
  Collect, organise, and analyse programme data, sector information, market trends, and stakeholder inputs to support programme decisions.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Coordinate with government departments, State Rural Livelihood Missions, MFIs, financial institutions, technology providers, implementation partners, and other stakeholders.
* **Demand Generation and Deployment:**
  Support demand assessment, outreach, adoption, and deployment of clean energy and clean cooking solutions through institutional and community-level channels.
* **Monitoring and Reporting:**
  Track programme indicators, targets, milestones, and deliverables. Maintain updated records and prepare regular progress reports.
* **Communication and Outreach:**
  Support information, education and communication (IEC) activities, awareness campaigns, stakeholder meetings, and dissemination of programme updates.
* **Partnership Support:**

Job Title: Software Engineer II- Backend & Applied AI

**Location:**

Gurgaon/ Full Time]
**Department:**

Engineering

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to build the ultra-low-latency, event-driven systems that power our core platform, and to build the next-generation AI layer on top of them.

You will operate at the intersection of correctness, latency, and scale. You won't just be building faster pipelines; you will be building systems that reason. In this role, you will bridge classical distributed systems (Kafka, Redis, microservices) with modern AI inference layers, deploying Applied AI and Agentic workflows over high-throughput operational data.

If you are an engineer who cares more about
*why a system fails*

than
*why it works*

, and you prefer staring at flame graphs and Kafka consumer lag over building purely greenfield CRUD apps, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do

* **Architect High-Scale Backend Systems:**

  Design and re-architect critical pipelines around event-driven processing to drive down processing times (e.g., from T+2 to T+0).
* **Optimize for Performance:**

  Radically reduce DB CPU utilization through query optimization, table partitioning, and Redis-backed caching strategies. Eliminate redundant queries and decouple databases to remove shared bottlenecks.
* **Build Applied AI & Agentic Workflows:**

  Develop LLM-powered workflows and RAG pipelines for transaction intelligence and anomaly detection.
* **Design Autonomous Agents:**

  Build agents utilizing tool-use, function calling, and multi-step reasoning that can dynamically decide when to query SQL versus retrieving from a vector store.
* **Modernize Legacy Architecture:**

  Lead the migration of legacy microservices (e.g., PHP to Java/Spring Boot) to cut latency and unblock future scaling.
* **Evaluate & Monitor:**

  Implement strict evaluation harnesses for AI retrieval quality (precision@k, MRR) and end-to-end agent reliability. Set up comprehensive dashboards and alerting (Grafana) for strict SLAs.
* **Develop Reusable Frameworks:**

  Design generic rule engines and auxiliary services to offload processing from core operational hot-paths.

What We Are Looking For

**Experience:**

4+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in healthtech or healthcare industry

**Core Backend Stack:**

* Deep expertise in
  **Java**

  and
  **Spring Boot**

  .
* Strong experience with Event-Driven Architecture using
  **Kafka**

  (or ActiveMQ).
* Proficiency in database architecture and caching:
  **MySQL**

  (optimization, partitioning) and
  **Redis**

  .
* Solid understanding of Microservices architecture and handling concurrency (producer-consumer patterns, worker-pools).

**Applied AI / ML Stack:**

* Proficiency in
  **Python**

  and
  **FastAPI**

  for AI service layers.
* Hands-on experience with
  **LLMs**

  , Prompt Engineering, and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic).
* Experience building
  **RAG**

  pipelines and working with
  **Vector Databases**

  (e.g., pgvector).
* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks like
  **LangChain**

  and
  **LlamaIndex**

  .

**Tooling & DevOps:**

* Kubernetes, Docker, Linux.
* Strong testing practices using JUnit and Mockito (aiming for 95%+ coverage on critical paths).

Observability and monitoring using Grafana.

**Who You Are**

* **A First-Principles Thinker:**

  You know that prompts and models are the easy part of AI; you focus on the real engineering challenges of latency, cost, evaluation, and reliability.
* **A Performance Nut:**

  You are comfortable reading slow query logs and flame graphs to squeeze out every millisecond of latency.
* **An Owner:**

  You take full ownership of the reliability, latency, and cost of the systems you ship.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**The role**
Join
**SITA Lab**
, where we explore emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into working solutions that could change how air transport operates.
  
  
You will work with airports, airlines, SITA teams, technology partners and start-ups to identify difficult industry problems, rapidly explore potential solutions, and build real-world prototypes and pilots.
  
  
Modern AI and agentic development tools have fundamentally changed how we engineer software. We expect our engineers to use AI extensively to research, design, build, test and evolve solutions. Your value is not measured by how many lines of code you personally write, but by how effectively you turn ideas into high-quality working systems.
  
  
As Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across SITA Lab initiatives and help evolve how the Lab itself engineers software in an AI-native environment.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Explore
  
  

* Investigate emerging technologies and assess how they could solve real problems in aviation.
* Work directly with customers and subject-matter experts to understand operational problems, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* Rapidly evaluate technologies, start-ups, open-source projects, APIs, models and platforms.
* Lead technical discovery, experimentation and design-thinking activities.
* Turn loosely defined ideas into hypotheses that can be tested with working software.

Engineer
  
  

* Design and build prototypes, proofs of concept and pilot solutions, moving from idea to working system quickly.
* Use modern AI-assisted and agentic software-development techniques throughout the engineering lifecycle.
* Decompose complex engineering objectives into tasks that can be effectively executed by people and AI agents.
* Provide agents with the appropriate context, requirements, constraints, architecture and acceptance criteria.
* Build the tests, evaluations and observability needed to verify AI-generated solutions rather than trusting generated output.
* Integrate APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, AI models and existing SITA capabilities into end-to-end solutions.
* Move comfortably between languages, frameworks and platforms rather than being constrained by a single technology stack.

Lead
  
  

* Own technical direction and architecture for Lab initiatives from initial experiment through customer pilot.
* Make pragmatic engineering decisions that balance experimentation speed, quality, security and maintainability.
* Establish effective patterns for collaborative engineering between people and AI agents.
* Review and challenge designs and implementations produced by both engineers and AI agents.
* Mentor engineers in architecture, engineering judgement and effective use of AI development tools.
* Identify when an AI-generated solution is superficially plausible but fundamentally wrong.
* Decide when to prototype rapidly and when a solution requires production-grade engineering controls.

Deliver responsibly
  
  

* Ensure solutions have appropriate automated testing, security controls, observability and documentation.
* Apply secure engineering practices when using AI agents, particularly around credentials, customer data, tool access and external systems.
* Define appropriate operating boundaries and human approval points for autonomous systems.
* Work within SITA architecture, security and AI-governance requirements while maintaining the pace expected from an innovation Lab.

Influence
  
  

* Demonstrate new technologies and solutions to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate across SITA, customers, industry groups, open-source communities and technology partners.
* Help transfer successful Lab experiments into SITA product and operational environments.

**Who You Are**
You are an experienced engineer who is excited rather than threatened by the changing nature of software engineering.
  
  

* You have excellent software-engineering fundamentals and architectural judgement.
* You are an active and sophisticated user of AI-assisted and agentic development tools.
* You can demonstrate examples where AI materially changed the way you engineered or delivered software.
* You understand that using an AI coding agent effectively requires much more than writing prompts.
* You know how to provide agents with context, constraints and acceptance criteria, and how to validate their output.
* You can quickly understand an unfamiliar repository, technology or domain.
* You are comfortable allowing an agent to implement something you could implement yourself, and equally comfortable taking control when engineering judgement requires it.

title: Jr. Unity game developer
description:

**CloudPlayXP creates innovative technology-driven engagement solutions for corporate events, brand activations, exhibitions and experiential marketing. We develop interactive games, digital experiences and hardware-integrated engagement solutions that bring technology and people together.**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for a creative and technically proficient Unity Game Developer who can conceptualise, develop and deploy engaging 2D and 3D games for interactive experiences.**

**The candidate should have strong programming skills and the ability to develop complete games, including gameplay mechanics, visuals, animations, scoring systems and user interfaces. They should also be comfortable integrating games with external hardware such as joysticks, physical buttons, cameras, sensors and gesture-tracking devices.**

**We are looking for someone who can turn creative ideas into fully functional, visually appealing and engaging gaming experiences.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Game Development**

**\* Develop interactive 2D and 3D games using Unity.**

**\* Build game mechanics, gameplay logic, levels, animations, scoring systems and user interfaces.**

**4. Camera & Gesture-Based Gaming**
