**\* Implement hand tracking, body tracking, gesture recognition and motion-based gameplay.**

**\* Explore technologies that allow players to interact with games through physical movements and gestures.**

**\* Work with computer vision technologies to create innovative interactive experiences.**

**5. Backend & Leaderboard Integration**

**\* Develop game scoring systems, player registration and session management.**

**\* Integrate leaderboards, real-time score updates and player rankings.**

**\* Work with APIs, databases and backend systems to store and retrieve player information and game data.**

**\* Implement multiplayer and competitive gaming features wherever required.**

**6. Testing & Deployment**

**\* Test, debug and optimise games across different hardware configurations.**

**\* Deploy games on PCs, interactive kiosks, LED screens, projection systems and other event-based installations.**

**\* Ensure reliable performance and stability during live event deployments.**

**\* Provide technical support during installations and live events whenever required.**

**Technical Skills Required**

**\* Strong proficiency in Unity 3D and C# programming.**

**\* Experience in developing complete 2D and 3D games.**

**\* Understanding of game mechanics, physics, animation and UI development.**

**\* Knowledge of hardware integration and external device communication.**

**\* Experience working with APIs, JSON and database integration.**

**\* Understanding of game optimisation, debugging and deployment.**

**Additional Skills (Preferred)**

**\* Knowledge of OpenCV, MediaPipe or similar computer vision technologies.**

**\* Experience with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, sensors and serial communication.**

**\* Familiarity with camera-based gesture recognition and motion tracking.**

**\* Knowledge of Blender or other 3D modelling software.**

**\* Experience with multiplayer gaming and real-time leaderboard systems.**

**\* Familiarity with Unreal Engine or TouchDesigner will be an added advantage.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

**\* Someone passionate about gaming, technology and interactive experiences.**

**\* A creative problem-solver who can independently develop games from concept to execution.**

**\* Someone who enjoys experimenting with hardware, sensors and new interaction technologies.**

**\* A self-driven individual who can take ownership of projects and deliver functional solutions.**

**\* Someone comfortable working in a fast-paced, creative and technology-driven environment.**

**Application Requirement: Candidates must share a portfolio or demonstrate games and interactive applications they have personally developed. Practical project experience and problem-solving ability will be given preference over academic qualifications.**

title: Senior Software Engineer (Provider/Business Unit Portals)
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Provider/Business Unit Portals team, you will build and operate the Provider and Business Unit Portals. The former is built to service managed service providers (MSPs) and resellers who administer Bitwarden organizations on behalf of separate, external customers. The latter is is built for a single company's own administrators to manage multiple Enterprise organizations that all belong to that same company (e.g., different business units, subsidiaries, or departments). Both portals give administrators a single, centralized experience for creating and managing multiple Bitwarden Enterprise organizations at scale. This is a
**hands-on role**
. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code to further the enablement of Enterprise governance.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
End-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, performant services and applications to support the Provider and Business Unit Portals. You are accountable for these services end to end, including the parts you did not personally write.
  
  
**Engineering Standards and Automated Quality:**
Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them.
  
  

* Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries: Maintain clean service boundaries and design resilient APIs so the Provider and Business Unit Portals can evolve independently of the core platform. Own the technical direction and record the reasoning behind significant decisions.
* Technical Mentorship: Grow the engineers around you. Pair on hard problems, give substantive design feedback, and mentor them to grow,
* Codebase Health: Contribute to performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability. Identify technical debt, articulate its cost, and sequence pragmatic refactoring alongside delivery.
* Operational Stewardship: Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production.
* Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Security, and the other teams' engineers to design and validate solutions before implementation begins.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* Overall Experience: 5+ years building and operating production Enterprise software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding features end to end as an individual contributor.
* Technical Stack - Expertise:
* Expertise in C# / .NET, with strong working proficiency in TypeScript / Angular or Rust and a willingness to build depth in the other.
* Technical Stack - Experience:
* Relational database design, optimization, and SQL Server
* Writing, consuming, and using SDKs / APIs
* AI-assisted development - preferably Claude Code
* Technical Stack - Familiarity:
* MVC design pattern for interaction with our Admin Portal
* Entity Framework or adjacent ORM with implementations of Postgres, MySQL, and SQLite
* Migration Judgement: A track record of running incremental modernization inside a live codebase, such as framework upgrades, strict-typing rollouts or state-management migrations, without halting feature delivery or fragmenting the codebase into two competing styles.
* T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards).
* Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies.
* Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.
* Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
  
  
**If you enjoy being hands-on, solving hard engineering problems, and having a genuine influence on how products are built, we'd love to hear from you.**

* Design the communications architecture across line-of-sight radio, cellular and satellite links, including loss-of-link behaviour.
* Specify and deliver the shore control station for monitoring, mission planning, video and remote takeover.
* Agree command, feedback and failsafe interfaces for propulsion, steering and onboard systems with the Manager – Electrical, Controls & Systems Integration.
* Agree sensor and antenna placement, power and cooling with the Manager – Platform Integration.
* Test in simulation and hardware-in-the-loop, then plan and lead autonomy trials from harbour to coastal, including trial safety arrangements and emergency stop.

**Essential**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Robotics, Control or Aerospace Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  10–15 years in total, including at least 5 years hands-on with autonomous or unmanned systems (USV, UUV, UAV, UGV, autonomous vehicles or robotics), or with defence command-and-control and sensor systems.
* **Ownership:**
  Has personally owned at least one autonomy or navigation system from design through to field trials.
* **Technical knowledge:**
  Working knowledge of sensor fusion, GNSS/INS, radar and AIS, real-time embedded Linux or ROS/ROS 2, radio and network links, and CAN, Ethernet and NMEA 2000 interfaces.
* **Trials:**
  Has planned and taken part in field trials of autonomous or unmanned systems, including safety arrangements.

**Desirable**

* Experience with marine or maritime unmanned systems, and working knowledge of COLREGs.
* Experience with simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Exposure to functional safety, cyber security or classification society rules for autonomous vessels.
* Experience of managing technology partners or subcontractors on a development programme.
* Experience on defence or government development programmes.

**Skills and personal attributes**

* Systems thinker who can see the whole vessel, not only the autonomy software.
* Hands-on and comfortable working at the build yard, on the quayside and at sea.
* Takes safety seriously and makes sound go/no-go decisions under time pressure.
* Clear written and spoken communication with engineers, partners, management and customers.
* Plans and delivers to milestones in a fast-moving programme.

**Typical candidate backgrounds**

Unmanned-systems and drone companies; defence electronics and C4I organisations; autonomous-vehicle and robotics firms. Former service officers with relevant unmanned-systems or sensor-integration experience are also welcome to apply.

**Working conditions**

* Based in New Delhi, with frequent travel and extended stays at the build yard and coastal trial sites.
* Sea trials involve work on small craft, outdoors and sometimes outside normal working hours.

description:

We are looking for an
**engineering leader who remains technically hands-on**
.

The ideal candidate should:

title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an engineer to develop and optimize firmware for embedded platforms, working closely with hardware and cross-functional teams. The role involves end-to-end development, performance tuning, and enabling intelligent features on edge devices with a focus on efficiency and reliability. You will contribute to solving complex system-level challenges and building scalable, high-quality solutions across our connected IoT products wearables, smart locks, video-calling displays, sensing devices, and soundboxes, spanning bare-metal, FreeRTOS, and embedded Linux targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop embedded firmware and software using Embedded C, C++, and Python.
* Develop bare-metal and FreeRTOS drivers and application logic across MCU (ESP32-C6/P4, STM32-class) and embedded Linux (Quectel SC60 Yocto BSP) targets.
* Work on microcontrollers, peripherals, and hardware interfaces.
* Bring up new boards from scratch - read and interpret schematics, verify signals and power rails, and develop firmware directly against the design.
* Develop and integrate communication interfaces like UART, SPI, I2C, USB, PCIe, and Ethernet.
* Implement device connectivity and cloud communication - Wi-Fi, BLE, LTE/cellular, MQTT - including onboarding, provisioning, and OTA/FOTA flows.
* Debug and troubleshoot embedded systems using tools like debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD.
* Develop functional and unit tests, validate firmware functionality, and automate the same (including hardware-in-the-loop).
* Analyze system performance and optimize code for memory, power, and real-time constraints.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle: design, coding, testing, and debugging.
* Create prototypes to validate design concepts.

**Required Qualifications (Must-Have)**

* 1–3 years of experience in embedded software/firmware development.
* Strong programming skills in Embedded C, C++, and Python.
* Hands-on experience with FreeRTOS and working experience with Linux/RTOS.
* Bare-metal firmware development (no OS) - direct register access, startup code, and peripheral drivers.
* Good understanding of embedded systems architecture.
* Experience with hardware interfaces like UART, SPI, I2C, USB, PCIe, and Ethernet.
* Strong understanding of memory management and real-time constraints.
* Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics and component datasheets, and develop firmware directly against the board design.
* Strong hardware debugging skills - able to root-cause issues at the hardware/firmware boundary using an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, multimeter, and JTAG/SWD.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with development tools like compilers, debuggers, and version control (Git).
* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Working experience or understanding of RTOS variants like Zephyr, VxWorks, FreeRTOS.
* Working experience or understanding of BSP development.
* Working experience or understanding of Linux distributions and build environments (Yocto/Buildroot).
* ESP-IDF and the ESP32 ecosystem (ESP32-C6, ESP32-P4, etc.).
* Media/streaming pipelines — GStreamer, WebRTC, or MIPI camera/audio interfaces.
* Cellular connectivity (LTE/4G, PPP, dual-SIM/GSM).
* Cloud IoT integration — AWS IoT / KVS, MQTT provisioning, S3/OTA, mTLS.
* BLE peripheral/GATT development and sensor fusion (IMU, plantar/pressure sensing).
* Understanding of bootloaders, firmware update mechanisms, and OTA/FOTA.
* Experience with low-power embedded and battery-operated devices.
* Exposure to AI/ML deployment on edge/embedded devices.
* Familiarity with tools such as GDB, JTAG, Git, CMake, Make, Ninja, or similar development tools.
* Familiarity with CI, unit testing, or on-device (hardware-in-the-loop) test automation.

* Own platform-wide architecture standards and design principles, leading architecture reviews and technical design discussions across all product teams.

**Must Have Criteria**

* Exposure to healthcare technology, dental-domain applications, or other data-intensive regulated verticals.
* Experience driving platform architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with Node.js in a polyglot backend environment.

* Platform-wide technical ownership with direct influence over architecture decisions across all product areas serving thousands of dental practices.

* Opportunity to shape engineering culture and standards at a fast-growing medical AI SaaS company in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.
* Flexible scheduling and strong support for continuous learning and professional growth.

title: National Manager – Institutional Business
description:
1. Role Purpose

The National Manager – Institutional Business will lead the development, acquisition and management of institutional partnerships for BUURTZORG India across Kolkata and Hyderabad. The role will build a sustainable institutional business channel through hospitals, rehabilitation centres, nursing homes, insurance service providers and corporates. The objective is to generate business through both services delivered within partner institutions and referrals for home healthcare services.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Institutional partnerships – hospitals, rehabilitation centres and nursing homes

• Identify, approach, negotiate and secure institutional tie-ups in Kolkata and Hyderabad with hospitals, rehabilitation centres, nursing homes and other relevant healthcare institutions.

• Develop partnerships for BUURTZORG services delivered inside partner institutions, as well as referrals of patients requiring nursing, caregiving, rehabilitation, post-hospitalisation support and other home healthcare services.

• Build relationships with hospital management, administrators, medical superintendents, clinical teams, discharge coordinators and other relevant decision-makers.

• Develop institution-wise engagement plans, referral pathways and mutually agreed commercial arrangements.

• Ensure each tie-up has a clear scope of services, operating model, responsibilities, escalation matrix and agreed performance expectations.

B. Insurance service provider empanelment

• Identify and establish relationships with insurance service providers, TPAs and other relevant organisations for BUURTZORG empanelment.

• Coordinate empanelment documentation, service information, commercial discussions, compliance requirements and follow-up.

• Work towards enabling eligible BUURTZORG services through empanelled networks, in line with agreed terms and applicable requirements.

• Maintain relationships with empanelment, network, claims and operational teams to support activation and continuity.

C. Corporate partnerships

• Identify and secure tie-ups with corporates for employee, family and other patient healthcare services.

• Develop corporate relationships that generate demand for services at institutional premises, where applicable, and referrals for home healthcare services.

• Engage HR, administration, employee wellness and other relevant stakeholders to understand needs and propose suitable service arrangements.

• Coordinate proposals, presentations, commercial terms, implementation plans and ongoing account reviews.

D. Partnership onboarding and operationalisation

• Work closely with the respective Location Heads and B2B Regional Heads to onboard each institution and operationalise the partnership.

• Coordinate development, communication and implementation of institution-specific SOPs, service workflows, referral processes and escalation protocols.

• Ensure operational readiness before activation, including role clarity, service coverage, contact points, documentation and reporting mechanisms.

• Monitor initial implementation, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the relevant teams

E. Account management and business development

• Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective institutions, insurance service providers and corporate accounts. Confidential – Internal Role Document

• Manage relationships after signing to support activation, service utilisation, patient referrals, satisfaction and long-term retention.

• Conduct periodic account reviews and identify opportunities to expand the scope and volume of business.

• Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, proposals, negotiations, tie-ups, onboarding status and business generated.

• Represent BUURTZORG India in relevant institutional meetings, networking forums and partnership discussions.

F. Commercial coordination and performance

• Work with the CEO and relevant internal teams on partnership proposals, pricing, commercial terms and business cases.

• Coordinate with operations, finance and location teams on service delivery, billing, collections and resolution of account-level issues.

• Track institutional partnership performance and highlight gaps, risks and opportunities for improvement. • Ensure commitments made to partners are aligned with BUURTZORG's service capabilities, operating standards and commercial objectives.

G. Process standardisation and reporting

• Support standardisation of institutional business processes across Kolkata and Hyderabad while accounting for local operating requirements.

• Ensure partnership documentation, onboarding checklists, SOPs, review formats and reporting practices are maintained.

• Submit periodic updates to the CEO on pipeline, tie-ups, onboarding, activation, referrals, business performance and key challenges.

• Share learnings and successful practices across locations to improve institutional acquisition and account management

3. Working Relationships

The National Manager will report directly to the CEO and work in close coordination with:

• Location Heads in Kolkata and Hyderabad for local execution, service readiness and institutional account coordination.

• B2B Regional Heads for institutional onboarding, relationship management, referral activation and operationalisation.

• Operations and clinical teams for service feasibility, staffing, quality, SOP implementation and escalation management.

• Finance and administrative teams for commercial documentation, billing, collections and partner-related processes

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The primary KPI will be the number of institutional tie-ups secured, reviewed and measured quarterly. Performance will be assessed across the institutional partnership categories and geographies relevant to the role

5. Qualifications and Experience

• Graduate or postgraduate qualification in business administration, healthcare management, marketing or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience in institutional sales, healthcare business development, strategic partnerships, key account management or a related B2B role.

• Experience engaging with hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centres, insurance/TPA networks or corporate clients will be an advantage.

• Strong relationship-building, negotiation, presentation, communication and commercial skills.

• Ability to work across locations and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Comfort with business reporting, pipeline tracking, documentation and basic commercial analysis

6. Core Competencies

• Institutional relationship development and stakeholder management. • Business development, negotiation and closure orientation.

• Understanding of healthcare services and institutional operating environments.

• Execution discipline and ability to translate agreements into operationally active partnerships.

• Cross-functional coordination, problem-solving and follow-through.

• Clear written and verbal communication, presentation and reporting skills

7. Role Expectations and Authority

• Own the institutional business development pipeline and drive tie-ups across Kolkata and Hyderabad.

• Lead institutional discussions and negotiations within commercial and operational guidelines approved by the CEO.

• Coordinate with Location Heads and B2B Regional Heads to ensure signed partnerships are properly onboarded and operationalised.

• Escalate exceptions, non-standard commercial commitments, service-capacity constraints and material partner issues to the CEO.

• Maintain accurate and timely reporting of progress, outcomes and risks

8. General The role requires travel to Hyderabad and other locations as necessary for institutional meetings, partnership development, onboarding and business reviews. The position is based in Kolkata and carries national responsibility for institutional business across the designated operating locations

title: Senior Manager
description:
Job Description

Sr. Manager – Fundraising & HNI Engagement

**Location:**
Kolkata

About the Organization

Kolkata Gives is a charitable organization that serves as a philanthropic platform connecting credible NGOs with willing donors, particularly for fundraising initiatives and disaster-related relief efforts.

The organization bridges the gap between credible NGOs and individuals, families and institutions who wish to contribute to meaningful social causes but may lack access to reliable information and trusted implementation partners.

Kolkata Gives focuses on enabling high-impact giving by facilitating strategic partnerships, mobilising philanthropic resources and supporting NGOs working towards sustainable social impact and during natural calamities and humanitarian emergencies.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager – Fundraising & HNI Engagement will be responsible for driving the organization's fundraising strategy and resource mobilisation efforts, with a strong focus on developing and managing relationships with High Net-worth Individuals (HNIs), Ultra High Net-worth Individuals (UHNIs), corporate leaders, family offices, philanthropists and institutional donors.

The role requires a proven fundraising professional with a demonstrated track record of mobilising multi-crore contributions and building long-term philanthropic relationships.

The incumbent will be responsible for identifying and cultivating prospective donors, developing strategic fundraising opportunities, securing significant philanthropic commitments and building a sustainable resource mobilisation pipeline for Kolkata Gives and its partner NGOs.

This is a high-ownership role requiring strong networking capabilities, commercial acumen, relationship management skills and the ability to engage influential individuals and decision-makers to translate philanthropic intent into measurable social impact.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a comprehensive fundraising and resource mobilisation strategy aligned with the organization's growth plans and annual fundraising objectives.
* Drive multi-crore fundraising initiatives through HNIs, UHNIs, family offices, corporate leaders, philanthropists and institutional donors.
* Build, nurture and manage a strong network of prospective and existing donors, ensuring sustained engagement and long-term partnerships.
* Identify potential high-value donors and develop customised engagement strategies based on their philanthropic interests, priorities and giving capacity.
* Conceptualise and present compelling fundraising proposals, philanthropic initiatives and cause-based giving opportunities.
* Lead donor acquisition, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship processes to secure significant contributions.
* Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, business houses, family foundations and other philanthropic institutions.
* Work closely with partner NGOs to understand their funding requirements and translate their programmes into credible, compelling fundraising opportunities.
* Drive fundraising campaigns, donor events, networking initiatives and exclusive philanthropic engagements.
* Ensure effective donor communication, reporting, transparency and accountability to strengthen donor confidence and retention.
* Establish a robust fundraising pipeline, monitor conversion ratios and track fundraising performance against agreed targets.
* Work closely with the leadership team and relevant committees to strengthen the organization's resource mobilisation capabilities.

Professional Experience

* Minimum 8–12 years of progressive experience in fundraising, resource mobilisation, philanthropy, institutional partnerships or HNI relationship management.
* **Prior experience in a similar fundraising leadership role, with a proven track record of successfully mobilising multi-crore funds, is mandatory.**
* Demonstrated success in cultivating and converting relationships with HNIs, UHNIs, corporate promoters, business leaders, family offices and institutional donors.
* Proven ability to independently manage large fundraising mandates and secure significant philanthropic commitments.
* Strong understanding of the philanthropic ecosystem, donor behaviour, charitable giving and CSR funding landscape.
* Experience in developing fundraising strategies, donor acquisition plans, partnership proposals and long-term resource mobilisation pipelines.
* Established professional networks and the ability to engage senior business leaders, philanthropists and influential stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple fundraising initiatives and deliver against ambitious targets.

Qualifications and Education

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Social Work, Development Studies, Public Relations or a related discipline.
* Additional qualifications in fundraising, philanthropy, development management or relationship management would be an advantage.

Fundraising and Resource Mobilisation

* Conceptualise and lead fundraising campaigns, initiatives and programmes to mobilise substantial philanthropic resources.
* Develop compelling funding proposals, presentations, impact narratives and investment cases for prospective donors.
* Explore and develop opportunities through corporate philanthropy, family foundations, CSR partnerships and institutional giving.
* Work closely with NGOs to identify fundable projects and present credible, outcome-oriented opportunities to donors.
* Lead negotiations, funding discussions and donor commitments through to successful closure.
* Ensure appropriate follow-through on funding commitments and timely coordination of contributions.

Donor Stewardship and Governance

* Ensure a high standard of donor engagement, transparency, communication and accountability.
* Coordinate with partner NGOs to facilitate appropriate utilisation reporting, impact updates and donor feedback.
* Ensure fundraising processes and donor commitments adhere to applicable legal, regulatory and organizational governance requirements.
* Work with internal teams and committees to ensure due diligence, documentation and appropriate monitoring of contributions.
* Strengthen donor confidence through credible impact reporting and consistent communication.

Performance Management and Reporting

* Establish and monitor measurable fundraising KPIs, including funds mobilised, donor acquisition, donor retention, pipeline value and conversion rates.
* Prepare periodic fundraising performance reports for the leadership team and relevant committees.
* Track progress against annual fundraising targets and proactively identify opportunities to bridge gaps.
* Maintain accurate donor databases, fundraising forecasts and pipeline reports.

What the Organization Offers

* An opportunity to play a pivotal role in strengthening the philanthropic ecosystem in Kolkata and beyond.
* Direct engagement with leading business leaders, HNIs, UHNIs and prominent philanthropists.
* The opportunity to build and lead high-value fundraising initiatives with measurable social impact.
* A dynamic, growth-oriented environment offering significant ownership and the opportunity to shape the organization's resource mobilisation strategy.
* The satisfaction of connecting meaningful philanthropic contributions with credible grassroots initiatives and organizations.

title: Process Design Engineer - Piping
description:
**Location:**
Kolkata

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years

**Qualification:**
B.E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking for an experienced Process Design Engineer with strong expertise in piping engineering, plant layout, pipe stress assessment and piping support structures for industrial process facilities. The role covers engineering design and coordination from front-end engineering design (FEED) through detailed design and construction support, with emphasis on safe, practical and code-compliant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and review plant layouts, equipment arrangements, plot plans and piping routes for high-pressure, high-temperature, cryogenic and utility services.

• 
Prepare and check piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), pipe-sizing calculations, piping general arrangement (GA) drawings, isometrics and bills of materials (BOMs).

• 
Select and verify piping materials and specifications based on design pressure, temperature, fluid service and corrosion considerations.

• 
Design and detail pipe supports, including shoes, guides, anchors, spring hangers, trunnions and dummy legs; optimize support arrangements for constructability and performance.

• 
Perform or review piping flexibility and stress analyses, including sustained, thermal expansion, operating and occasional loads; verify equipment nozzle loads and support reactions.

• 
Coordinate the design of pipe racks, sleeper structures, equipment platforms and skids with civil and structural engineers, including relevant loading and support interfaces.

• 
Develop and review 2D/3D piping models, identify clashes and resolve design interfaces with Process, Equipment, Civil/Structural and Instrumentation teams.

• 
Support engineering deliverables through FEED, detailed engineering and construction; address technical queries and design modifications as required.

• 
Ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable safety requirements and relevant engineering codes and standards, including ASME B31.1/B31.3, ASTM, API, AISC and IBC, as applicable.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• 
B.E. / B.Tech degree in Mechanical Engineering.

• 
Minimum 8 years of relevant piping and plant-design experience, preferably with EPC contractors or engineering consultancies serving oil and gas, refinery, petrochemical, chemical, power or other process industries.

• 
Demonstrated experience in piping layouts, engineering drawings, stress evaluation, pipe-support design and multidisciplinary design coordination.

Technical Software & Standards

• 
3D plant design and modelling: AutoCAD Plant 3D, AVEVA PDMS/E3D or Intergraph SmartPlant 3D (SP3D).

• 
2D drafting and design coordination: AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.

• 
Piping stress and flexibility analysis: CAESAR II and/or AutoPIPE.

• 
Structural/support analysis and detailing: STAAD.Pro, SAP2000 and/or Tekla Structures.

• 
Model review and clash coordination: Navisworks Manage; working knowledge of applicable piping and structural codes.

Preferred Credentials

• 
Relevant training or certifications in industry design tools such as AutoCAD Plant 3D, Autodesk Inventor, CAESAR II or AVEVA PDMS/E3D.

India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. **Required Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in Linux System Administration & Storage
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (preferred)

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* In-depth knowledge of networking concepts: DNS, DHCP, SSH, TCP/IP, SMTP, IP, Iptables/Firewalld

description:

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Controllership organization within Finance COE responsible to monitor day-to-day accounting activities involved in Synchrony business. Controllership mostly covers General accounting, Client accounting, Reconciliations, Closing & Reporting, System maintenance, Governance related sub-processes. Every process contributes to quarterly & annual financial close process and ensure that we have accurate external reporting.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
This role will be responsible general accounting activities for Synchrony’s online deposit platform (Retail Bank), secure card deposit product, and other deposits. This includes daily balancing of cash activity, suspense clearing, month-end close and analysis, and month-end reconciliations. The role is also responsible for completing various accounting tasks including month end close activities, recording manual journal entries (MJE), reconciliations, assist with FR2900 reporting, quarterly reporting deliverables and other general accounting responsibilities as assigned. This role will also assist in various cross-functional and multi-stakeholder projects affecting the above-mentioned activities. In addition, this role would be required to drive meetings, dashboard reporting and assist with management reporting. In this role, you will gain accounting, quarter close management, and reporting Finance experiences, as well as influence in a matrix environment Leadership experiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Completion of daily balancing/tasks for all assigned accounts and monitoring of aged items in accordance with assigned thresholds
* Research/follow up on all reconciling items for assigned accounts with strong root cause/action plans documented and escalation to process owners when needed
* Perform cash in bank balancing, including resolution of variances, and preparation of the month-end reconciliation
* Research and resolve transaction suspense generated by the treasury system (REVAL)
* Support FR2900 reporting by validating cash in bank balances
* Detailed knowledge of process flow of assigned accounts and Blackline balancing procedures
* Identify process improvement opportunities for assigned accounts and ensure implementation of small to medium scale improvements
* Month-end responsibilities including journal entry preparation and reconciliations in accordance with SYF standards
* Support of Governance initiatives such as job aid reviews, updates, and testing
* Support of internal and external audits and internal control reviews
* Support ad-hoc reporting requests
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance minimum of 4+ years of accounting experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of accounting experience.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent organization and follow up skills
* Excellent communication skills – both oral and written
* Ability to execute in a fluctuating environment
* Demonstrated commitment to quality and customer service
* Ability to lead small projects to completion
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP
* Strong Microsoft Office skills
* Proven ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience in financial services industry
* Demonstrated team player with collaborative, facilitation and influencing skills
* Experience working in a fast-paced, changing environment
* Strong background in accounting practices and procedures
* Fiserv, Oracle GL, T-Recs, Blackline knowledge
* Prior Banking Experience would be an added advantage

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance minimum of 4+ years of accounting experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of accounting experience.

**Work Timings: 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

**Company Description**
DTDC Express Limited is one of India’s leading integrated express logistics companies, providing domestic and international delivery services. Core Responsibilities
  
  

* ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)

Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
  
  
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
  
  
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
  
  

* Modern ABAP Development & Clean Design

Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
  
  
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
  
  
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
  
  

* Data Modeling, Reporting & Semantic Enablement

Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
  
  
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
  
  
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.

Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
  
  

* Tool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
* Retrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
* Deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low

Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
  
  

* Quality Engineering & Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)

Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
  
  
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors: offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
  
  
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs: authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
  
  

* Observability, Reliability & Operations

Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
  
  
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows: retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
  
  
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
  
  

* Integration & End to End Delivery

Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
  
  
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
  
  
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented, with high ownership and tight cross-functional collaboration. Engineers get real autonomy, flexible scheduling, and strong support for growth.

It is one of the most active builders in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.

**Position Overview**

This is a horizontal platform leadership role spanning all product areas. The role drives technical direction, architecture standards, and engineering excellence across a cloud-native SaaS platform serving thousands of dental practices across North America. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering depth with the ability to set and enforce platform-wide standards across multiple teams and products. Leadership is earned through technical authority, execution excellence, and the ability to solve genuinely hard distributed systems problems.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own platform-wide architecture standards and design principles, leading architecture reviews and technical design discussions across all product teams.
* Act as technical authority for business-critical systems — reviewing complex designs and critical code paths, and identifying technical risks early across the platform.
* Contribute hands-on to the implementation of critical backend services, scalable APIs, and cloud-native components on AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway).
* Drive containerization, infrastructure automation, and observability improvements — including monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing — in partnership with DevOps.
* Lead performance tuning, scalability initiatives, and troubleshooting for high-throughput production systems across all product domains.
* Champion AI-assisted development practices — evaluating emerging tools and driving adoption across engineering teams while maintaining code quality and security standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams through technical depth and execution, influencing technology decisions without relying on hierarchy.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience building and shipping enterprise-grade, large-scale SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in Python and Django/Django REST Framework, building high-performance REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js and TypeScript for frontend architecture in a full-stack or platform context.
* Proven AWS architecture experience across ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM at production scale.
* Demonstrated track record solving complex scalability, performance, and reliability challenges in distributed, event-driven systems.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong command of PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch — including query optimization, caching strategies, and data modeling.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience architecting and operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms handling large-scale transactional and analytical workloads.
* Exposure to healthcare technology, dental-domain applications, or other data-intensive regulated verticals.
* Experience driving platform architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with Node.js in a polyglot backend environment.
* Active interest in evaluating and adopting emerging AI/ML tooling to accelerate engineering productivity.

**What We Offer**

* Platform-wide technical ownership with direct influence over architecture decisions across all product areas serving thousands of dental practices.
* High-autonomy environment with tight cross-functional collaboration — ship fast and see real-world impact quickly.
* Opportunity to shape engineering culture and standards at a fast-growing medical AI SaaS company in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.
* Flexible scheduling and strong support for continuous learning and professional growth.

**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.

**Additional skills requirements:**

title: Graphic Designer (AI Template Architecture)
description:
**About the Role**

NextNeural Canvas automates the production of on-brand social media creatives by transforming a company's existing product data and brand assets into ready-to-publish images and videos. We are seeking a forward-thinking Graphic Designer to build a template library. You will design dynamic templates engineered for the programmatic swapping of logos, text hierarchies, and media assets across multiple brand identities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Template Architecture:**

  Design highly adaptable, responsive layout templates for both static image and short-form video content.
* **Dynamic Asset Placement:**

  Create intelligent variations for different brand asset constraints—mapping out multiple layout logic paths for logo positions, variable text lengths, and image/video spatial zones.
* **AI-Native Design Structuring:**

  Ensure all design structures are optimized for an AI-driven platform where final assets are dynamically injected by the software, requiring strict attention to safe zones and scaling rules.
* **Motion & Video Layouts:**

  Design structural layouts for video generation, defining exactly how text, static logos, and overlays interact with moving background imagery.
* **Quality Assurance:**

  Stress-test template constraints to guarantee that generated outputs remain aesthetically polished regardless of the specific client brand data injected into the system.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Design System Expertise:**

  Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality social media creative design, with specific examples of template creation or brand systems.
* **AI & Automation Fluency:**

  Deep comfort utilizing AI design tools and a strong conceptual understanding of how to design for automated, generative, or programmatic platforms.
* **Technical Proficiency:**

  Advanced skills in Figma, Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator. Experience with variable-data design or programmatic creative platforms is a significant advantage.
* **Systematic Thinking:**

  Ability to design in terms of constraints, variables, and flexible containers rather than focusing solely on single, static artboards.
* **Analytical Mindset:**

  A first-principles approach to problem-solving, anticipating how varying aspect ratios, extreme text limits, and contrasting brand colors will interact within the structural frameworks.

**Engagement & Compensation**

This role can be structured flexibly: either as a defined one-time project to deliver the initial batch of templates, or as a part-time monthly retainer for ongoing template library expansion, optimization, and platform testing.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your portfolio, specifically highlighting any experience with template systems, variable asset design, or AI-integrated creative workflows. Include a brief note on your preferred engagement model (project vs. retainer) and your expected rates.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.

If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

title: Study Abroad Counsellor

Magma Engineering & MRO is our newest vertical, built to act as an extended in-house engineering arm for factories. We deliver end-to-end solutions across precision engineering, machining, fabrication, and maintenance, from design to final delivery. Backed by a robust ecosystem of in-house capabilities and captive control over advanced machining and fabrication facilities, we operate across CNC, VMC, deep-hole drilling, honing, turn-milling, heavy fabrication, and precision inspection systems.

Position Overview

The NPD Engineer will drive the development of new products and precision-engineered components, from initial customer requirements and concept definition through design, prototype development, testing, validation, and transfer to production.

The individual will work closely with the Senior Manager – Manufacturing Engineering, CAD/CAM & Process Engineering, Quality, Production, and Business Development teams to ensure that new products are technically sound, manufacturable, cost-effective, and ready for repeatable production.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Design & Product Development

* Translate customer requirements, application needs, performance expectations, and technical specifications into product design inputs.
* Develop new component and product designs, modify existing designs, and prepare or review 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings.
* Select suitable materials, manufacturing methods, fits, tolerances, and design features in coordination with Manufacturing Engineering.
* Maintain design intent, drawing standards, part numbering, revision control, and engineering change records.

2. Design for Manufacturing & Technical Feasibility

* Conduct Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews to identify cost, quality, tolerance, and process risks.
* Review GD&T, critical-to-quality characteristics, tolerance stack-ups, material specifications, and functional requirements.
* Coordinate with the Senior Manager – Manufacturing Engineering to confirm machine capability, process route, tooling, fixtures, and inspection feasibility.
* Identify design improvements that simplify manufacturing, reduce cycle time, improve reliability, and optimize product cost.

3. Prototype & Sample Development

* Plan and coordinate prototype builds, sample machining, fabrication, assembly, and trial activities.
* Work with CAD/CAM and Process Engineering to release design data and support machining programs, tooling, fixtures, and process prove-out.
* Monitor prototype progress, resolve design-related issues, and incorporate engineering changes based on trial results.
* Maintain prototype records, sample status, design iterations, and development milestones.

4. Testing, Validation & Customer Approval

* Define or coordinate product testing and validation requirements based on customer specifications and intended application.
* Coordinate dimensional inspection, material verification, functional testing, and other validation activities with Quality and Metrology.
* Support preparation of FAI / FAIR, inspection reports, test records, technical submissions, and customer approval documents, as applicable.
* Review test and inspection feedback, close design-related non-conformities, and ensure approved changes are reflected in controlled design documents.

5. Production Transfer & Engineering Change Control

* Prepare the approved design package for production release, including drawings, BOM, specifications, revision status, and development history.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering to ensure process plans, tooling, fixtures, inspection requirements, and work instructions align with the released design.
* Support initial production runs and resolve design-related issues during ramp-up and stabilization.
* Manage engineering changes through documented review, approval, implementation, and communication to affected functions.

6. Cost, Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Support product cost estimation by providing design, material, tolerance, and development inputs.
* Identify opportunities for value engineering, material optimization, standardization, and component simplification.
* Use structured problem-solving and root cause analysis to address design-related failures, rework, and customer feedback.
* Maintain accurate and traceable NPD documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of the product development process.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Business Development to understand customer requirements and clarify technical expectations.
* Coordinate with the Senior Manager – Manufacturing Engineering and CAD/CAM & Process Engineering throughout feasibility, prototype, and production readiness.
* Work with Quality, Production, Purchase, and Stores to align material, inspection, tooling, and supplier requirements.
* Communicate project progress, technical risks, pending decisions, and milestone status to the project owner.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of mechanical product and component design and engineering drawing practices.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, or Siemens NX; ability to prepare and interpret 2D drawings.
* Sound understanding of GD&T, fits and tolerances, tolerance stack-up, material selection, and engineering specifications.
* Practical knowledge of DFM, DFA, prototype development, manufacturing processes, and production readiness.
* Ability to coordinate design validation, testing, FAI / FAIR, engineering changes, and technical documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, project coordination, and cross-functional working skills.
* Exposure to precision machining, CNC manufacturing, aerospace, defence, automotive, or industrial components will be preferred.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on product development engineer capable of converting customer needs into robust, manufacturable products. The individual should be comfortable coordinating across design, machining, quality, and production teams, and taking ownership of development activities through successful production handover.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in product development, mechanical design, component engineering, or manufacturing-led NPD.
* Experience in 3D CAD modelling, engineering drawings, GD&T, prototype development, and design change management is preferred.
* Experience with precision-engineered components, CNC machining, aerospace, defence, automotive, or industrial products will be an advantage.

What We Offer

* Salary is negotiable for the right candidate.
* Opportunity to build and develop new products within a growing engineering and MRO vertical.
* Access to advanced engineering, machining, fabrication, and precision inspection capabilities.
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Magma is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
