title: Manufacturing Excellence Specialist
description:
KOEL Fluid Dynamics Business Unit (earlier known as La-Gajjar Machineries Private Limited) , is a premier provider of water pumping solutions and now a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited (KOEL). Founded in 1935 in Ahmedabad by the visionary Mr. Laljibhai J. Gajjar, the company has evolved into an international leader through its renowned brand, Varuna Pumps. Our commitment to technical innovation led to the introduction of India's first oil-based submersible pumps in 1991, and we have since expanded our portfolio to include over 1,000 models of energy efficient submersible pumps and motors.

**Manufacturing Excellence Specialist-Sanand**

Job Summary: We are seeking a driven Manufacturing Excellence Specialist to lead operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and plant expansion initiatives at our Sanand pump manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, and Kaizen alongside hands-on project management experience across CapEx execution, machine/assembly layout design, and industrial civil projects to eliminate waste, optimize manpower, and elevate plant productivity across machining, winding, assembly, and testing operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Operational Excellence & Lean Transformation:

• Drive plant-wide continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma frameworks to eliminate non-value-added activities, reduce manufacturing lead times, and maximize Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

• Champion Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) pillars and shop-floor Kaizen events across core pump manufacturing cells—including CNC/VMC machining, rotor/stator winding, press shop, assembly lines, and hydraulic/electrical testing bays.

• Deploy lean tools such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), SMED (quick changeover), Poka-Yoke (mistake-proofing), Standardized Work, and Kanban/cellular flow to improve throughput and reduce internal rejection/rework.

CapEx Lifecycle & Equipment Project Management

• Manage the end-to-end CapEx lifecycle for capacity additions, new product introductions (NPI), and process automation—covering technical specification, CapEx requisition, vendor evaluation, procurement coordination, machine buy-off, installation, and commissioning.

• Track project budgets, schedules, and ROI milestones while ensuring strict adherence to ISO quality standards, safety norms, and Kirloskar Group EHS guidelines.

Facility Expansion, Layout Design & Civil Execution

• Play a direct role in brownfield and greenfield facility expansion plans, designing lean shop-floor layouts (using AutoCAD) that optimize material flow from raw castings/stampings to finished pump dispatch.

• Oversee industrial civil and infrastructure projects—including machine foundations, testing sump/pit construction, EOT crane installations, shop-floor flooring, and utility upgrades— coordinating closely with civil contractors, maintenance, and safety teams.

Manpower Optimization & Line Balancing

• Conduct time-and-motion studies, line balancing, and capacity analyses across assembly and machining lines to drive manpower optimization and improve output per person-hour. • Identify opportunities for low-cost automation (LCA), material-handling improvements, and ergonomic workstations to reduce operator fatigue and boost line efficiency.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Education: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Production Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.

• Experience: 8–10 years of proven experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Operational Excellence within pumps, electric motors, industrial machinery, or precision engineering/automotive component manufacturing.

**Core Competencies:**

• Strong command of Lean Manufacturing methodologies (5S, VSM, SMED, Poka-Yoke, Line Balancing) and Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred).

• Practical, hands-on experience implementing TPM and facilitating shop-floor Kaizen programs.

• Demonstrated track record in CapEx budgeting and procurement, plant layout engineering (AutoCAD proficiency), and industrial civil project execution.

• Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills (MS Excel, Minitab, MS Project).

• Effective cross-functional collaboration, contractor management, and shop-floor leadership skills.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Job Description — Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO**

**the EleFant | Ahmedabad | Full-Time**

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad (Work from Office)

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**Department:**
Founder's Office

**About the EleFant**

At the EleFant, we're on a mission to change the way India interacts with toys.

We are building India's play membership platform, giving children access to a wide variety of toys, books and play experiences through convenient memberships, doorstep delivery and exchanges.

Featured on Shark Tank India, the EleFant is growing rapidly, and we are looking for people who enjoy building, solving problems and taking ownership.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**highly organized, proactive and dependable Executive Assistant**
who can work directly with the Founder & CEO.

This is not a traditional secretarial role limited to scheduling meetings and managing calendars.

The person will be responsible for organizing the founder's priorities, ensuring timely follow-ups, coordinating with teams, managing communication and driving closure of action items.

**The primary objective is simple: Free up the founder's time while ensuring that nothing important falls through the cracks.**

The ideal candidate is someone who can anticipate requirements, bring structure to multiple moving priorities and get things done with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Calendar, Schedule & Time Management**

* Manage the founder's daily calendar, meetings, appointments and commitments.
* Prioritize meetings based on business importance and urgency.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings with teams, investors, partners and other stakeholders.
* Prepare daily schedules, meeting agendas and necessary briefing notes.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and meeting logistics when required.
* Ensure effective utilization of the founder's time by reducing unnecessary meetings and interruptions.

**2. Follow-Up & Action Closure**

* Maintain a central tracker of all action items arising from meetings, emails, WhatsApp and discussions.
* Assign clear owners, deadlines and follow-up dates.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution.
* Escalate delays, unresolved issues and critical matters appropriately.
* Maintain a daily dashboard of pending, urgent, overdue and completed tasks.
* Ensure closure evidence is recorded rather than simply marking tasks as completed.

**We need someone who follows up until work is completed, not someone who simply reminds people once.**

**3. Email, WhatsApp & Communication Management**

* Help organize and prioritize important emails and messages.
* Draft professional emails, follow-ups, meeting notes and business communications.
* Coordinate communication with investors, franchise partners, vendors and internal teams.
* Track important commitments made through email and WhatsApp.
* Ensure timely responses and prevent important conversations from being missed.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion.
* Obtain approval before sending significant external communication on behalf of the founder.

**4. Meeting Management & Execution**

* Prepare agendas for important management meetings.
* Collect required data and updates from teams before reviews.
* Record minutes of meetings, key decisions and action points.
* Maintain ownership and deadlines for all agreed action items.
* Track commitments made in leadership and departmental reviews.
* Ensure every meeting results in clear next steps and execution.

**5. Business Reporting & Founder Dashboard**

* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, HR and Technology teams.
* Collect daily and weekly performance reports.
* Prepare concise founder-level summaries highlighting key achievements, concerns and pending decisions.
* Identify missing information, overdue deliverables and inconsistencies in reporting.
* Maintain structured MIS, trackers and dashboards.
* Use Excel, Google Sheets and AI tools to improve reporting efficiency.

**6. Investor, Franchise & External Stakeholder Coordination**

* Schedule and coordinate investor meetings, franchise discussions and strategic partnerships.
* Track investor communications, documentation requirements and follow-ups.
* Maintain organized records of investor discussions and pending commitments.
* Coordinate with Finance and Legal teams for documentation and information requests.
* Assist with investor presentations, business proposals and data-room organization.
* Ensure timely follow-up on important external business opportunities.

**7. Special Projects & Founder's Priorities**

* Support ongoing strategic initiatives and special projects.
* Conduct basic research and prepare summaries for founder review.
* Coordinate cross-functional tasks requiring multiple departments.
* Track progress on priority projects and highlight execution bottlenecks.
* Assist in organizing business presentations, events and leadership engagements.
* Take ownership of administrative and coordination responsibilities so the founder can focus on growth and strategic decisions.

**8. Confidentiality & Professional Judgment**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of business, financial and personnel-related information.
* Exercise discretion while handling sensitive discussions and communications.
* Understand which matters can be handled independently and which require founder approval.
* Demonstrate maturity, reliability and professionalism in all interactions.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, CEO's Office Associate or similar role.
* Prior experience supporting founders, CEOs or senior leadership preferred.
* Excellent organizational, multitasking and time-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English and Hindi.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools for research, drafting and productivity.
* Experience managing task trackers, dashboards and meeting coordination.
* Ability to work with multiple teams and follow up confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

**What We Are Looking For**

Someone who:

* Takes ownership without being constantly reminded.
* Is comfortable following up with senior people.
* Can distinguish urgent tasks from genuinely important priorities.
* Is proactive rather than reactive.
* Has excellent follow-through and attention to detail.
* Can work independently while keeping the founder informed.
* Is comfortable with technology and AI-enabled workflows.
* Brings solutions, not just updates.
* Understands that the role requires flexibility, discretion and accountability.

**Who May Not Be the Right Fit?**

* Someone looking only for a traditional calendar and travel management role.
* Someone who needs detailed instructions for every small task.
* Someone uncomfortable following up with senior executives.
* Someone who records tasks but does not ensure closure.
* Someone who struggles with Excel, business reporting or technology.
* Someone who cannot manage multiple priorities in a dynamic startup environment.

**Why Join the EleFant?**

* Work directly with the Founder & CEO.
* Gain exposure to business strategy, fundraising, operations and leadership decisions.
* Learn how a fast-growing consumer startup operates.
* Take ownership of meaningful responsibilities.
* Build skills that can lead to future opportunities within the Founder's Office or business operations.
* Be part of a company working to transform how children experience play.

**Apply**

Interested candidates can share their CV at hr@theelefant.ai with the subject:

**Application – Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO**

**the EleFant | Discover. Play. Return. Repeat.**

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Director of Engineering**
**About The Role**
Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements.
  
  
This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery.
  
  
This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership**




+ Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
+ Directly manage 5–10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
+ Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
+ Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
+ Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
+ Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability

**Healthcare Domain Leadership**




+ Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences
+ Guide teams building on and integrating with EMR/EHR platforms or any strong compliance domain experience.

**AI & Innovation**




+ Drive adoption of AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation across projects, including healthcare-specific AI use cases
+ Build reusable AI accelerators and frameworks to improve delivery efficiency
+ Enable teams to leverage AI-assisted development tools
+ Partner with leadership to define and execute AI-driven service offerings

**Delivery Ownership**




+ Own end-to-end delivery across multiple US client projects
+ Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality
+ Implement strong execution frameworks (Agile, sprint discipline, milestone tracking)
+ Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

**Stakeholder & Relationship Management**




+ Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 5 customers, including five blue-chip accounts requiring direct interaction with client CIOs & CTOs and proactive expectation management
+ Act as the key interface between US clients, engineering teams, and the CEO
+ Build genuine personal relationships with clients and client executives (C-level and senior officers) relationship-building and client management skills are mandatory
+ Participate in all monthly and quarterly business review meetings as a member of the leadership team
+ Travel to the US frequently (2–3 times per year) for client meetings, executive reviews, and relationship development
+ Communicate technical and healthcare-domain concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
+ Build strong client relationships and ensure high satisfaction

**Resource Management**




+ Allocate and optimize engineering resources across projects
+ Ensure the right skills are aligned to the right work
+ Drive high utilization while supporting team growth and development
+ Partner with HR and leadership on hiring and capacity planning
+ Own hiring and establish a structured training and academy program to keep building a new pipeline of talent

**Operational & Financial Excellence**




+ Own delivery metrics including velocity, quality, utilization, and timelines
+ Maintain a strong focus on delivery efficiency and project margins
+ Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization
+ Support business growth through better delivery capability and client outcomes

**Qualifications**




+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
+ 15–20 years of experience in software engineering and delivery management within a software services or product development environment
+ Demonstrated experience delivering software for US healthcare clients providers, payers, MedTech, or digital health companies
+ Strong understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain, including EMR/EHR ecosystems, interoperability (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA/PHI compliance, and clinical and operational workflows
+ Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software projects for US-based clients
+ Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and AI-assisted development practices
+ Must already be a heavy, daily user of AI tools in their own work — hands-on, everyday AI use is expected from day one (mandatory)
+ Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
+ Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, product management, and operations
+ Experience managing US-based team members remotely from India (mandatory)
+ Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills — proven ability to build and retain high-performing teams (mandatory)
+ Exceptional relationship-building and client management skills, including comfort engaging directly with C-level client executives (CEOs, CIOs) (mandatory)
+ Willingness and ability to travel to the US 2–3 times per year (valid passport required; US visa or visa eligibility strongly preferred)
+ Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project)
+ PMP, SAFe, or other relevant certifications preferred

**Key Competencies**




+ Strategic thinking and planning
+ Team management and people leadership
+ Relationship-building with team members, clients, and senior client executives
+ US healthcare domain fluency and client empathy
+ Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills
+ Effective communication and stakeholder management
+ Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
+ Financial and budget management expertise
+ Risk management and conflict resolution

**What Success Looks Like — Your First 12 Months**
**We have clear expectations for this role. Here is what we expect the first year to look like:**
**First 30 Days**




+ Develop a clear understanding of the organization, our projects, and where we stand today
+ Understand the finances of the company and our overall operating picture
+ Complete introductions across the teams and build a foundational understanding of how we work
+ Get assigned to a blue-chip customer and begin understanding what we are doing and what the priorities are
+ Begin improving the weekly and monthly reporting to that customer
+ Put together a plan to completely take over that account from the existing team member and reduce the existing leader's responsibilities

**By 60 Days**




+ Take ownership of our innovation pipeline assess how you would run it and get to know the current team members
+ Establish how we measure the productivity we gain from AI, and how we demonstrate those gains to end customers as clear proof of value

**By 90 Days**




+ Move into our tier-2 projects and optimize weekly and monthly reporting, customer satisfaction, regular touch-bases and updates to the leadership team, and resource planning
+ Complete a resource assessment — what we have, and what we need to hire or replace
+ Define how to accelerate the innovation pipeline to produce more qualified leads, proofs of concept (POCs), and proofs of value (POVs), in closer alignment with the sales and marketing teams

**By 12 Months**




+ A well-oiled engineering and delivery organization
+ Approximately 65% overall margin across the entire portfolio
+ A bench maintained at approximately 15%, also used for innovation and POC/POV projects
+ Measurable outcomes delivered from the innovation pipeline
+ Heavy, pervasive use of AI across the team every team member actively using AI in their daily work

title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Business Development Executive – School Sales**

**Spark School AI**

· North, West & South India · Full-time · Multiple openings

* **Location:**

  Any city in North, West or South India, for example Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Lucknow or Chandigarh (North); Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune or Indore (West); Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai or Kochi (South). You'll be based in your home city, with regular school visits across nearby cities and towns in your region
* **Experience:**

  2+ years in sales (field, B2B or institutional sales preferred; education is a plus)
* **Reports to:**

  Founder and CEO
* **Travel:**

  60 to 70% of the week out of office within your region, mostly day trips to schools in and around your base city, with occasional overnight stays to nearby cities. Occasional trips to Ahmedabad (head office) for training and reviews

**About Spark School AI**

Spark School AI builds AI tools that help schools and teachers teach better. Our flagship product,
**SparkSchool, is a Teaching OS**

: one AI-powered operating system for how a school plans, teaches and tracks learning. Alongside it we build
**Mentori**

, an AI learning app for teachers and learners.

We are working towards building the best AI platform for schools, and our goal is to build India's finest AI edtech company. We are a small, founder-led team in Ahmedabad, and you'll work directly with the founder from day one.

**The role**

You take SparkSchool to schools, in person. You find the right schools, meet principals, directors and coordinators on their campus, run first demos of the Teaching OS, and bring schools to the point of a pilot. You'll plan your own weekly routes across your base city and nearby cities, and every school you sign is one you opened yourself.

This is a real sales role with a clear path. Strong Executives move up to Business Development Specialist and own a territory and larger deals.

**What you'll do**

* Build a target list of private schools (CBSE, ICSE, IB and state board) in your base city and nearby cities, and plan weekly visit routes
* Schedule and make 8 to 10 school visits a week: walk-ins, referral meetings and booked appointments
* Meet principals, trustees, academic heads and owners, and run a short SparkSchool demo
* Understand each school's needs, budget and decision process, then follow up until a pilot or a clear "no"
* Set up and support school pilots with the founder and the onboarding team
* Log every visit, call and next step in the CRM the same day
* Share what you learn in the field (objections, competitors, pricing feedback) with the founder every week
* Attend education events, school expos and association meetings to build local relationships

**What success looks like**

* **First 30 days:**

  you know the product and pitch well, have built your city lists, and are visiting at least 8 schools a week
* **By 90 days:**

  you hold 25+ qualified school conversations, have 3 to 5 live pilots started, and have closed your first paid school
* **By 6 to 12 months:**

  you close schools on your own across several cities and are ready for the Specialist role

**You'll do well here if you**

* Have 2+ years of sales experience, ideally in field or B2B sales (edtech, publishing, school ERP, smart classes, training or similar)
* Are comfortable walking into a school without an appointment and getting a meeting
* Speak confidently in English and the local language of your region (Hindi in the North; Gujarati, Marathi or Hindi in the West; Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam in the South), and present well in front of principals
* Can explain technology simply to non-technical people
* Plan your week well and follow up without being chased
* Have a two-wheeler (or car) and a valid driving licence, and are ready to travel to nearby cities
* Are a graduate in any field. A B.Ed., BBA or MBA is welcome but not required

**What you get**

* Fixed pay, plus a travel allowance and uncapped incentives
* Direct mentoring from the founder on school sales and closing
* A clear path to promotion: Executive, then Specialist, then Manager
* Real ownership in an early-stage AI company that is building the Teaching OS for Indian schools, where your results are visible from the first month

description:

**Website - www.eacengineer.com**

**Email- hr@eacengineer.com**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with experience in pressure vessel and heat exchanger manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment.

* Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs).

* Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability.

* Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements.

* Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records.

* Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing.

* Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code.

* Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed.

* Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable.

* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation.

* Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form).

* Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released.

* Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework.

* Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements.

* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

* 5-8 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing.

* Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment.

* Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements.

* Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability.

* Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection.

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility.

* NDT Level II certification in applicable methods.

* Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI.

* Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation.

* Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of Third-Party Risk Manager based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The position is primarily responsible for leading the central Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team with delivery of TPRM lifecycle across the in-scope third party population, with particular focus on Group’s most critical third-party relationships, covering inherent risk assessment, due diligence, onboarding, continuous monitoring and offboarding, and provides input to the scoping methodology. Also, have to play role of technical lead on the practical application of the TPRM Framework, sets the operating rhythm with User Departments and specialist functions, resolves technical and operational matters independently, and escalates contentious or high exposure matters to Head of QICA.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate TPRM Framework into operating procedures, templates and working instructions for the central TPRM team, and into practical guidance for User Departments where they have a role in the process,
* Provide expert advice to divisions and to first- and second-line functions on the practical application of third-party risk requirements, including assessment approach, evidence standards and risk disposition, and builds strong working relationships with User Departments and the relevant specialist functions
* Secure the engagement and commitment of divisional leadership to applying the TPRM Framework, building buy-in, addressing resistance and agreeing realistic timelines so that divisions complete the assessment of their critical third parties as planned, escalating to the Head of QICA where commitment cannot be secured,
* Act as a consulted party to the framework owner on the scoping methodology, providing subject matter input on scoping criteria, thresholds and auto-triggers, and using assessment outcomes to identify where the scoping rules may need recalibration,
* Provide structured, evidence-based feedback to the framework owner on the design, calibration and practicability of the TPRM Framework, drawing on the team’s operational experience.
* Drive the continuous improvement of the central TPRM operating approach and supports the progressive extension of coverage across the third-party population, adjusting ways of working as scope, volumes and risk exposure evolve,
* Lead the design, implementation and ongoing development of the technology solution supporting TPRM, working with the framework owner and IT, and identifies opportunities to simplify, automate and improve the efficiency of third-party risk activities,
* Prepare the analysis, evidence and reporting used by the Head of QICA to provide clarity and assurance to executive and governance stakeholders on the status of the third-party control environment, and attend such forums as subject matter expert where required,
* Plan and prioritize the team’s workload on a risk-based basis, set assessment standards, turnaround times and key performance indicators for the team, monitors performance against them and takes corrective action where required,
* Manage team capacity and resourcing against the assessment pipeline, flagging shortfalls and re-prioritizing where required,
* Provide technical coaching so that the team develops genuine depth in third party risk assessment and evidence evaluation,
* Ensure a complete and reconciled inventory of in-scope third parties is maintained, including risk classification, relationship owner, contract references and key dates,
* Direct the team’s execution of Inherent Risk Assessments for third parties handed over to the central team following scoping, obtaining operational input from User Departments and specialist input where required, raises the tier where the assessment warrants it, and submits the rationale to the framework owner for sign-off where the outcome supports a lower tier,
* Direct the execution of due diligence proportionate to the assessed level of risk, securing specialist input from functions such as, but not limited to, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, the Data Protection Office and Procurement where required, and personally leads the most complex or highest-exposure assessments,
* Determine from the outcome of the risk assessment and due diligence, which risk mitigations need to be secured contractually, and communicate these requirements to the User Department, Procurement and Legal, who remain responsible for drafting, negotiating and agreeing the contract terms
* Provide the final check that all prerequisite lifecycle stages are complete and formally closed before a third party is onboarded, and escalates deviations,
* Oversee the support provided to User Departments in performance review cycles and in the structured offboarding of third parties, including data return or destruction, access revocation and record closure,
* Ensure the TPRM system record is maintained so that assessments, evidence, approvals and decisions are complete, current and audit-ready,
* Direct the delivery of training and awareness for User Departments and relationship owners on their third-party risk responsibilities,
* Own the response to Internal Audit recommendations relating to third party management, ensuring they are addressed on time and to the required specification,
* Acts as the first escalation point for the team and for User Departments on complex or disputed third party matters, resolve these independently wherever possible, and escalate contentious, high-exposure or precedent-setting matters to the Head of QICA with a clear recommendation.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 5 years of job-related work experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 4 years of job-related work experience.

**Job Specific Skills/ Essentials**

* Practical understanding of due diligence evidence (audited financials and credit reports, SOC 2 / ISO certifications, DPIAs and data processing agreements, sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, modern slavery and ESG disclosures).

* Experience of managing, coaching and quality assuring the work of others in a risk, control or assurance environment
* Professional certification in risk, audit, compliance or third party / vendor risk management (e.g. CRMA, CIA, CRISC, CTPRP) or qualified accountant with a Big 4 background and / or experience in a large, multinational organisation,

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer – Playwright & TypeScript
description:
**Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India | Currently Remote, Future Hybrid | Full-time | 3–5 Years' Experience**

**Own and improve the automation framework behind a growing UK healthcare technology platform.**

Script Assist develops sophisticated SaaS software connecting clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK.

Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with interconnected workflows covering consultations, prescribing, repeat requests, medicine availability, dispensing and fulfilment.

This creates substantial engineering complexity.

Our applications must work reliably across multiple organisations, different configurations, user roles, permissions and connected services. A seemingly small application change can introduce unexpected behaviour somewhere else in the platform.

As we continue developing the product, dependable automated testing is essential to maintaining quality and supporting confident software releases.

**We're looking for a genuinely hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to help shape how we test this technology.**

You will take meaningful technical ownership of our
**Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript automation framework**
, improving its architecture, reliability, maintainability and integration with our engineering workflows.

This is not simply a role for someone who can write automated test scripts. We need an engineer who understands why automation becomes unreliable, how to structure it properly and how to improve its effectiveness across a growing software platform.

**Why this role is technically interesting**

• 
**Framework ownership.**
You'll influence how our Playwright test automation is structured, maintained and extended, rather than simply following an existing pattern.

• 
**Complex multi-tenant SaaS.**
You'll help automate workflows across multiple clinics, pharmacies, applications, organisational configurations and user roles.

• 
**Challenging reliability problems.**
You'll tackle flaky tests, asynchronous workflows, test-data contamination, unreliable selectors, permissions and difficult-to-reproduce failures.

• 
**Impact across engineering.**
Your work will help developers identify regressions earlier, improve CI/CD feedback and give the team better evidence when making release decisions.

• 
**Technical leadership without losing the coding.**
You'll review automation code, help other engineers improve and contribute directly to the framework and important test scenarios.

• 
**Real-world healthcare operations.**
You'll work on technology supporting significant volumes of complex, interconnected healthcare activity.

**What you'll own and deliver**

• 
**Playwright framework architecture:**
Design, extend, refactor and maintain a robust end-to-end test automation framework using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript.

• 
**Automated regression coverage:**
Develop reliable E2E, functional and integration tests across clinic, pharmacy and patient-facing applications.

• 
**Reusable test infrastructure:**
Create effective Page Object Model (POM) abstractions, custom fixtures, utilities, authentication helpers and test-data management approaches.

• 
**Test reliability and isolation:**
Resolve flaky tests, race conditions, state leakage, brittle locators, synchronisation issues and failures caused by parallel execution.

• 
**API and permissions testing:**
Combine UI automation with REST API validation, including testing role-based access and organisational data boundaries.

• 
**CI/CD integration:**
Improve automated test execution in development and release pipelines, including reporting, diagnostics, traces and efficient regression runs.

• 
**Engineering collaboration:**
Work closely with QA engineers and developers to investigate defects, review test code, identify quality risks and improve testing practices.

• 
**Continuous improvement:**
Evaluate automation tools and AI-assisted development techniques, validating their output rather than relying on generated code without scrutiny.

**The experience we're looking for**

• Approximately
**3–5 years of professional software testing experience**
, with a substantial proportion spent writing automated test code.

• Strong, recent, hands-on
**Playwright automation experience using TypeScript or JavaScript**
.

• Demonstrable experience
**building, extending or materially improving an automation framework**
, rather than only adding individual test cases.

• Practical knowledge of Playwright Test, reusable fixtures, Page Object Model design, reliable locators, web-first assertions and test isolation.

• Experience diagnosing intermittent failures and improving automated test stability.

• Working knowledge of REST API testing, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated test reporting and debugging tools.

• The ability to explain technical decisions, identify trade-offs and write understandable, maintainable automation code.

• Confidence reviewing other engineers' work and supporting less experienced QA colleagues.

We're interested in practical engineering ownership, not simply somebody who has held a senior title.

**Experience that would make you particularly interesting**

We'd be especially interested in candidates who have worked on:

• 
**Multi-tenant B2B SaaS:**
Applications serving different organisations with separate permissions, configurations and workflows.

• 
**Complex end-to-end testing:**
Business processes spanning multiple applications, services or asynchronous events.

• 
**Scalable test architecture:**
Reusable fixtures, parallel execution, test-data isolation and maintainable automation design.

• 
**CI/CD reliability:**
Improving the speed, diagnostic value and consistency of automated testing.

• 
**Technical guidance:**
Reviewing automation code, establishing better practices or helping other QA engineers develop.

Healthcare experience is beneficial but not required.

**What success looks like**

You'll be able to take an unreliable or difficult-to-maintain area of our automated testing and make it measurably better.

That could mean reducing flaky test failures, improving test isolation, making regression runs more useful, simplifying a framework that has become unnecessarily complicated, or introducing reliable coverage for important workflows.

You'll help us move towards automation that engineers trust, understand and can extend confidently.

**The environment and working arrangement**

You'll work with colleagues supporting a UK healthcare technology business, combining independent technical problem-solving with close collaboration across QA and development.

We're currently operating remotely, with future hybrid working planned in Ahmedabad. Candidates must be willing and able to attend the Ahmedabad office when this is introduced.

The position requires UK-aligned working hours, including evening working in India. The exact schedule will be explained during recruitment.

**How we assess candidates**

Our recruitment process focuses on real engineering ability:

1.    Apply through LinkedIn and complete the eligibility questions.

2.    Complete a practical Playwright automation assessment covering test implementation, debugging, reliability and framework design.

3.    The strongest candidates proceed directly to a technical interview with our senior QA automation colleague.

If you've worked as a
**Senior Test Automation Engineer, Senior QA Engineer, SDET or Software Development Engineer in Test**
, and enjoy both writing code and improving automation architecture, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

Apply through LinkedIn and help build dependable test automation for a complex, growing healthcare SaaS platform.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).

The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last Mile) to implement company safety policies, ensure compliance with all local and regional regulations, and maintain a secure, healthful work environment. title: Travel Consultant
description:
Location: Coimbatore (full-time, in-office)

Compensation: ₹25,000–₹40,000/month

Experience: Open - we hire for taste and precision, not years on a CV

About LocoTrails

We design custom holidays for discerning Indian families across 60+ destinations worldwide. Our clients are accomplished people in their 40s and 50s who have done the obvious trips and now want something considered the right villa in Tuscany, the chef who actually cooks for you in his home, the guide who knows which gallery to skip. We run roughly 30-40 trips a month. Each one is built from scratch.

We've grown almost entirely through word of mouth. That works because every itinerary that leaves our desk has to be defensible in its choices, its sequencing, and down to the last line item in the costing sheet.

About the role

A Travel Consultant at LocoTrails owns the craft of the trip. You take a client brief sometimes a vague one, sometimes painfully specific and translate it into an itinerary that feels inevitable once they read it. That means understanding who the client actually is (not just where they want to go), matching them to experiences they'd never have found themselves, choosing the hotel that fits their temperament rather than the one with the best photos, and working hand-in-glove with our DMCs across the world to make it real.

It's a role for someone who reads a five-star hotel's website and notices that the lobby lighting is wrong for the kind of guest we send. Someone who, when the costing sheet has a ₹2,400 discrepancy, doesn't shrug. Someone who can hold a client's confidence on a call without sounding like a brochure.

What you'll own

* Client discovery and persona mapping. Understanding what kind of traveller this family actually is - their pace, their tolerances, their unspoken expectations and translating that into design choices.
* Itinerary curation. Deciding the rhythm of the trip, the sequence of cities, the right length in each, and which experiences earn their place.
* Hotel and vendor selection. Choosing properties and partners that fit the client, not just the destination. This is taste work. Generic luxury isn't the answer.
* DMC coordination. Briefing our destination partners with enough specificity that they design for
  *this*
  client, not a template. Pushing back when their suggestions are lazy.
* Proposal writing. Producing proposals that read like they were written for one family, because they were.
* Costing. Building and maintaining costing sheets that are precise to the rupee. Margins are flexible by design which is exactly why the arithmetic and the structure cannot be.
* What we're looking forTaste. You can articulate why one hotel is right and another, equally rated, is wrong. You have opinions about places, food, design, and pacing and you can defend them.
* Obsessive attention to detail. Numbers reconcile. Names are spelled correctly. Flight times are checked twice. Visa requirements are confirmed, not assumed.
* Strong written English. Proposals are part of how clients judge us. Your writing should be clean, considered, and free of travel-brochure clichés.
* Comfort with HNI/UHNI clients. Or the maturity and curiosity to develop it quickly. You can hold a conversation with a 58-year-old CEO without either deferring or overreaching.
* Structured thinking. You build costing sheets that other people can read. You document decisions. You don't leave loose ends.
* Genuine curiosity about the world. You read, you travel when you can, you pay attention. You know that Lisbon and Porto are different propositions and you can say why.

What we're not looking for

* Anyone who treats travel as a transactional product
* Tour-package-shop instincts (lowest quote wins, more cities = more value)
* People who confuse luxury with taste

Compensation and growth

₹25,000–₹40,000/month base, with meaningful upside for candidates who bring genuine experience designing premium travel. This is a role with real ceiling, the consultants who grow into senior positions at LocoTrails become trusted designers our clients ask for by name.

You'll be working directly alongside the founder on real trips from week one. There is no shadow period or busywork phase. The work starts immediately and so does the learning.

Location: Work From Home/Remote
  
  
Job Type: Part-Time
  
  
Compensation: Fixed (Telecalling Basis)
  
  
  
About the Role
  
  
I am looking for a persuasive, energetic, and target-driven Outbound Telecaller to join my team. You will be responsible for reaching out to pre-generated leads provided by the company, understanding their requirements, pitching our value proposition, and convincing them to schedule a one-on-one meeting (online via Zoom/Google Meet or offline in-person) with the Principal Strategic Business Consultant.

Pitching & Persuasion: Clearly explain our products/services, identify the prospect’s pain points, and spark interest in a consultation.
  
  
Appointment Scheduling: Convince qualified prospects to book a confirmed online (video call) or offline (in-person) meeting with the Principal Strategic Business Consultant.
  
  
Calendar & Follow-Up Management: Coordinate calendars, send meeting invites/location details, and make reminder calls to minimize "no-shows."
  
  
CRM & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of every call, lead status, and customer feedback in our Excel sheet.
  
  
Target Achievement: Meet the provided call volume targets and confirmed meeting quotas.
  
  
  
Qualifications & Skills
  
  
Communication: Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills. Required Languages: English, Tamil is Mandatory] Good to have (optional): Hindi and Kannada.
  
  
Persuasion: Strong ability to handle objections politely, build quick rapport, and close for an appointment without sounding pushy.
  
  
Experience: [0–2 years] of experience in telecalling, telesales, customer service, or appointment setting (Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome to apply).
  
  
Tech-Savvy: Basic proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business, and calendar tools (Google Calendar/Calendly).
  
Attitude: Self-motivated, resilient against rejection, and comfortable working in a target-oriented environment.
  
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Fixed part time compensation on achieving the tele calling quota and database of provided lead.
  
Work from home/Remote.
  
Flexible working hours.

Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks).

Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform.

Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics.

**Good To Have**

Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka.

Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines).

Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd).

Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS.

Active contributions to open-source software.

1. Backend & Microservices Engineering:

Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).

Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).

Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

2. Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management:

Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.

Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).

Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

3. Data Infrastructure & Orchestration:

Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.

Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).

Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns.

Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms.

4. Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD

Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform).

Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm.

Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines.

5. Observability & Reliability Engineering

Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks.

Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

title: Technical Sales Manager – Hybrid Solar & BESS
description:
Job Title

**Technical Sales Manager – Hybrid Solar & BESS**

Job Summary

We are seeking a leadership-driven 
**Technical Sales Manager**
 to scale our commercial footprint for 
**Hybrid Solar PV**
 and 
**Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)**
 across Kerala and neighboring regions, based out of 
**Cochin**
. In this role, you will own the regional techno-commercial lifecycle and lead a high-performing team of engineers and sales executives. You will serve as the strategic bridge between our engineering division, executive client stakeholders, and the regional sales pipeline, ensuring strict alignment with 
**KSEB (Kerala State Electricity Board) regulations**
, CEA standards, and advanced financial optimization models.

Key Responsibilities

**A. Team Leadership & Pipeline Management**

* **Lead, mentor, and manage a regional team**
   of sales executives and pre-sales engineers to meet and exceed regional revenue and capacity targets.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews, evaluate team performance metrics, and provide tactical coaching on complex solution-selling strategies.
* Identify, pitch, and secure high-value accounts across massive energy-consuming segments in Kerala (e.g., tier-1 manufacturing plants, hospitals, commercial complexes, textiles, and data centers).
* Coordinate cross-functionally with internal Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) teams to oversee smooth project handovers and ensure execution timelines match customer commitments.

**B. Techno-Commercial Strategy & Financial Modeling**

* Oversee the analysis of high-resolution client load profiles and multi-year utility bills to validate optimized solar-plus-storage capacities.
* Model advanced financial mechanics leveraging 
  **Time-of-Day (ToD) / Time-of-Use (ToU)**
   tariff arbitrage, peak shaving, and demand-charge reductions.
* Review comprehensive techno-commercial proposals, including detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs), Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), and layout designs.
* Construct and present complex investment models highlighting Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS), NPV, payback matrices, and tax optimization strategies such as 
  **Accelerated Depreciation (AD)**
  .

**C. Regulatory Compliance & Technology Advisory**

* Maintain a deep, actionable understanding of evolving 
  **KSEB guidelines**
  , state-specific Open Access policies, and net-metering/gross-metering frameworks.
* Ensure all proposed system topologies align perfectly with the technical standards dictated by the 
  **Central Electricity Authority (CEA)**
   for grid synchronization.
* Act as the subject matter expert on battery storage technologies, confidently defending choice of battery chemistries (primarily Lithium Iron Phosphate / LFP), C-rates, Depth of Discharge (DoD), degradation curves, and stationary storage safety regulations (
  **IS/IEC standards**
  ).

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **Education:**
   B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, or Renewable Energy Engineering. An MBA or post-graduate degree in management is a strong advantage.
* **Experience:**
   6–10+ years of overall experience, with 
  **at least 2+ years of proven experience managing and leading technical sales or engineering teams**
  .
* **Domain Expertise:**
   Prior background specifically leading business development or solution architecture in the Indian Solar PV, BESS, power electronics, or industrial power infrastructure space.
* **Technical Tools:**
   Strong understanding of simulation platforms (e.g., 
  **PVSyst, Helioscope, AutoCAD**
  ) to properly review and validate engineering designs before client presentations.
* **Market Acumen:**
   Robust familiarity with the South Indian power ecosystem, power distribution frameworks, and power quality requirements (harmonics, voltage dips, and seamless backup transitions).

Key Skills & Competencies

* **People Management:**
   Demonstrated ability to build, retain, and inspire technical teams to deliver on high-stakes corporate targets.
* **Consultative Solution Selling:**
   Proven ability to convert technical, data-heavy storage metrics into intuitive, financial value propositions for corporate decision-makers.
* **Regulatory & Market Agility:**
   Quick to interpret and capitalize on shifting state and central clean energy mandates, policies, and utility updates.
* **Leadership & Communication:**
   Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and high-stakes closing capabilities.
* **Mobility:**
   Willingness to travel extensively across Kerala and surrounding regions for industrial site inspections and executive client briefings.

Compensation & Benefits

* **Base Salary:**
   Highly competitive fixed monthly CTC, structured in line with management-level industry benchmarks.
* **Incentives:**
   Performance
  **-linked sales incentives**
   directly tied to regional margin targets, milestone accomplishments, and project closures.
* **Allowances:**
   Full corporate standard travel, fuel, and client-engagement expense reimbursements.

title: Dietitian
description:
About Fitittude Fitness

Fitittude Fitness is a women’s online fitness brand offering live home workouts and personalised nutrition support through our 90 Days Fit Mom Challenge. Our approach focuses on home-cooked meals, sustainable habits, and weight management without weight-loss supplements.

We are looking for a qualified, caring, and organised Dietitian to guide clients and support them throughout their fitness journey.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct initial consultations to understand clients’ dietary habits, health history, lifestyle, and fitness goals.

- Prepare personalised meal plans based on nutritional needs, food preferences, regional food culture, and budget.

- Provide appropriate nutrition support for women, including postpartum and breastfeeding clients.

- Conduct daily client follow-ups through assigned WhatsApp groups, calls, and messages.

- Review meal updates, answer nutrition queries, and help clients follow their plans consistently.

- Monitor weight, measurements, dietary adherence, and progress; adjust plans when needed.

- Coordinate with dietitian assistants, trainers, and the administration team.

- Maintain accurate consultation notes, diet status, follow-up records, and portal updates.

- Complete diet plans within assigned timelines and submit daily work reports.

- Maintain client confidentiality and identify concerns requiring medical referral.

Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, Clinical Nutrition, or a related field.

- Sound knowledge of women’s nutrition, balanced meal planning, and sustainable weight management.

- Experience in online nutrition counselling or client management is preferred.

- Strong communication, listening, and motivational skills.

- Ability to communicate in English and at least one regional language: Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Telugu, or Hindi.

- Comfortable using WhatsApp, spreadsheets, and client management portals.

- Good organisation, punctuality, teamwork, and follow-up discipline.

What We Offer

- Company-provided accommodation.

- Practical experience supporting women from different regions and food cultures.

- A collaborative workplace with opportunities for professional growth.

How to Apply

Send your CV at - 8330080173

title: Veterinary Surgeon
description:
**Company Description**
Treat Unusual Veterinary Hospital is a dedicated animal care facility serving the Haripad community with a focus on compassionate, high-quality veterinary services. The hospital provides medical, surgical, and preventive care for a variety of companion animals, emphasizing accurate diagnosis and individualized treatment plans. Team members work collaboratively in a clinical environment that values animal welfare, client education, and professional integrity. The hospital seeks individuals who are committed to continuous learning and who want to contribute to a supportive, patient-centered veterinary practice.

**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site role at Treat Unusual Veterinary Hospital in Haripad involves working closely with veterinary professionals to support daily clinical operations. Responsibilities may include assisting with animal intake and handling, maintaining clean and safe treatment areas, supporting basic animal care procedures under supervision, and helping prepare equipment and supplies for examinations and minor treatments. The role also includes interacting with clients in a respectful and informative manner, scheduling appointments, and accurately maintaining records as directed. Team members are expected to follow hospital protocols, adhere to safety and hygiene standards, and contribute to a positive and collaborative workplace environment.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to provide attentive, compassionate care to animals and assist with handling and restraint in a safe, humane manner.
* Strong basic organizational and time-management skills to support clinical workflows and maintain a clean, orderly environment.
* Clear, professional communication skills for interacting with clients, colleagues, and supervising veterinarians.
* Comfort with learning and following veterinary procedures, hospital protocols, and documentation practices.
* Willingness to work on-site full time in Haripad, including potential weekend or holiday shifts as needed.
* Basic computer literacy for managing appointments and records; prior experience in a veterinary or healthcare setting is an advantage.
* Commitment to animal welfare, ethical conduct, and continuous professional development; relevant certifications or vocational training in animal care are a plus.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
**Company Description**
Cks medvana is a healthcare provider dedicated to delivering patient-centered medical services to the local community in and around Thalappally. The organization focuses on high-quality, evidence-based care with an emphasis on rehabilitation, recovery, and overall well-being. Interdisciplinary collaboration is encouraged to ensure that each patient receives comprehensive, individualized treatment. Team members are supported with a professional environment that values integrity, respect, and continuous learning. The physiotherapy department plays a key role in helping patients restore function, reduce pain, and improve quality of life.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Physiotherapist role based in Thalappally. The Physiotherapist will assess patients’ physical conditions, including strength, mobility, balance, and pain levels, and develop individualized treatment plans aligned with clinical best practices. Daily responsibilities include administering therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, electrotherapy and other modalities, instructing patients in home exercise programs, and monitoring progress over time. The role involves maintaining accurate clinical documentation, collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals, and educating patients and caregivers on injury prevention, post-operative care, and lifestyle modifications. The Physiotherapist will also contribute to quality improvement initiatives and uphold all safety, ethical, and regulatory standards within the practice.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Relevant academic background such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physiotherapy from an accredited institution; valid professional registration or license as required by local regulations.
* Clinical skills in patient assessment, treatment planning, manual therapy, therapeutic exercise prescription, and use of rehabilitation modalities for musculoskeletal, neurological, and post-surgical conditions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with patients, families, and multidisciplinary team members, with the ability to explain treatment plans and progress clearly and respectfully.
* Solid organizational and documentation abilities, including maintaining accurate patient records, managing caseloads effectively, and adhering to clinical protocols and infection control standards.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical practice, patient confidentiality, and professional conduct, along with openness to continuous learning, evidence-based practice, and participation in training or workshops.
* Prior experience in a hospital, clinic, or rehabilitation center is preferred; familiarity with community-based or outpatient physiotherapy services in similar settings is an advantage.

title: Occupational Therapist
description:
**Company Description**
IAN Institute of Rehabilitation & Research is a comprehensive multi-specialty hospital dedicated to rehabilitation services for children with diverse disabilities. With over a decade of experience, the institute provides patient-centered care in physical, mental, and neurological rehabilitation. A multidisciplinary team of doctors, therapists, and rehabilitation experts focuses on conditions such as Cerebral Palsy, Autism, Down syndrome, genetic disorders, and other physical and neurological issues. The institute offers state-of-the-art facilities designed to support effective, evidence-based rehabilitation and improved quality of life for children and their families.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time Occupational Therapist role is an on-site position based in Thrissur. The Occupational Therapist will assess children with developmental, physical, and neurological conditions and design individualized treatment plans to improve functional independence in daily activities. Responsibilities include conducting detailed evaluations, implementing therapy sessions, monitoring progress, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of doctors and rehab professionals. The role involves educating families and caregivers on home-based strategies, documenting clinical findings, and participating in case discussions and program development. The therapist is expected to maintain high standards of ethical practice, remain current with clinical guidelines, and contribute to a supportive, child-centered environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong competence in Occupational Therapy and Rehabilitation, including assessment, treatment planning, and delivery of pediatric rehabilitation services.
* Foundational understanding of Medicine as it relates to pediatric and neurological conditions, enabling effective collaboration with medical professionals.
* Experience or training in Pediatrics, with a focus on developmental, physical, and neurological disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, Autism, and Down syndrome.
* Excellent Communication skills for interacting with children, families, and multidisciplinary teams, and for providing clear education and guidance to caregivers.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy from a recognized institution; valid professional registration or licensure as required by local regulations.
* Prior clinical experience in pediatric or neuro-rehabilitation settings is highly desirable.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team-based environment and adapt interventions to diverse patient needs.
* Commitment to evidence-based practice, continuous learning, and maintaining accurate clinical documentation.
