title: Project Manager
description:
Project ManagerLocation: Kochi Openings: 1

**Role Purpose**

**The Project Manager will be responsible for end-to-end project execution with strong ownership of project cost control, timelines, and profitability in industrial automation projects including PLC, SCADA, panels, instrumentation, testing, and commissioning.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop detailed project schedules (engineering, procurement, panel fabrication, FAT, SAT, commissioning).
* Track milestones and ensure on-time delivery as per contract.
* Identify schedule risks early and implement corrective actions.

2. Cost Control & Budget Management

* Prepare and manage project budgets (materials, manpower, travel, subcontracting).
* Track actual vs budgeted and control overruns.
* Ensure profit margins are maintained as per project approval.
* Approve and monitor variation orders / scope changes with commercial impact.

3. Resource & Vendor Management

* Plan and optimize engineering and site manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with procurement for timely material delivery at optimal cost.
* Manage vendors, panel builders, system integrators, and subcontractors.
* Verify vendor invoices against work completion.

4. Client & Stakeholder Coordination

* Act as the single point of contact for clients on project execution matters.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide progress & cost reports.
* Manage expectations and resolve execution-related issues professionally.

5. Risk Management & Compliance

* Identify technical, commercial, and schedule risks.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and contractual requirements.
* Manage claims, delays, and penalties proactively.

6. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain project documentation: schedules, cost sheets, BOQs, change logs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports.
* Support finance team for billing, revenue recognition, and collections.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Automation Engineering.
* MBA in Project Management

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–10 years of experience in industrial automation project execution.
* Proven track record in:
* Cost control & budgeting
* Schedule management
* Multi-discipline automation projects (PLC, SCADA, panels, field instruments).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on with:
* MS Project / Primavera
* Excel-based cost tracking & MIS
* ERP systems

**Behavioural & Leadership Skills**

* Strong ownership mindset (cost & time driven).
* Excellent planning and negotiation skills.
* Ability to handle pressure, deadlines, and multi-site projects.
* Clear communication with clients and internal team

title: Site Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Position: Sr. Engineer - Site Operations

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Department: Engineering & Production

Industry: Architectural Metal Works / Construction / Engineering

Employment Type: Full-time

ABOUT VINTON ENGINEERING

Vinton is a leading Architectural Metal Works (AMW) company specializing in translating architectural design intent into high-quality, precision-engineered metal solutions. We work closely with architects, designers, and premium clients to deliver complex, design-driven metal works that combine aesthetics, engineering, and craftsmanship.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Sr. Engineer - Site is responsible for coordinating and monitoring site installation activities for architectural metal works projects. This role ensures execution complies with approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.

Key focus areas include site installation quality, schedule adherence, resource utilization, safety compliance, and seamless coordination between factory production and site installation teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Study approved drawings, installation details, and project specifications.

 - Coordinate and monitor day-to-day site installation activities for architectural metal works.

 - Allocate installation manpower according to project priorities and monitor daily productivity.

 - Liaise with factory and dispatch teams to ensure timely delivery of fabricated components to the site.

 - Ensure availability of necessary materials, tools, equipment, and lifting arrangements.

 - Resolve technical issues and installation challenges in coordination with engineering and project teams.

 - Monitor the alignment, level, dimensions, fitment, and finishing of installed components.

 - Coordinate with Quality Control to rectify defects and ensure compliance with safety standards.

 - Prepare and submit daily site progress reports and track progress against project milestones.

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

 - Ability to read and interpret engineering and installation drawings.

 - Strong knowledge of architectural metal works, installation processes, alignment, levelling, and site safety practices.

 - Proven skills in manpower coordination, site progress monitoring, reporting, and problem-solving.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple teams.

 - Attention to detail, commitment to quality, and flexibility to travel to project sites as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

 - B.Tech / B.E. or Diploma (Polytechnic) in Mechanical or Civil Engineering.

 - 2+ years of experience in site supervision, preferably in fabrication, production, construction, or engineering project environments.

title: Tech S and T- TechStrategy-Manager-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title Strategy Manager**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 10+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 10+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

+ Business Continuity Management
+ Disaster Recovery
+ Backup & Recovery Controls
+ Incident Management

* Evaluate cybersecurity programs, security governance, access management, encryption controls, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Conduct reviews of digital banking, e-wallet, payment gateway, middleware, and critical banking applications.

* Nine to twelve years of relevant experience in IT and Cyber security audit and advisory experience
* Experience within banks, regulators, consulting firms or other financial institutions.
* Demonstrable experience leading IT and Cyber security audits and remediation programs
* Experience managing teams and engaging with executive management, Board committees, regulators and senior client stakeholders.

**Job Title: SAP Ariba Transformation Source to Settle Enablement Testing Specialist**
**Function: Supply Chain Services**
**Type of Role: Contractor**
**About Supply Chain Services**
The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a Better Working World. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS), is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.
  
  
This position is within the Source to Settle Enablement (S2SE) team of SCS. S2SE's purpose is to build optimal source to settle solutions to drive financial success for EY and their clients. S2SE is responsible for managing key lifecycle activities from purchase requisitions to AP processing.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY is undergoing a S2P Gold Standard transformation, scaling a next‑generation digital solutions and operating model across the S2P lifecycle, with AI and data at the core. This includes an implementation of SAP/Ariba Procurement Suite at the core of the digital transformation.
  
  
The SAP Ariba Transformation S2SE Testing Specialist will define, plan and manage testing for business transformation solutions across S2SE, business stakeholders, suppliers, and technology teams. This role will help confirm that business, functional, integration, security and user experience requirements are met before deployment, while supporting quality outcomes and reducing business risk to ensure test scripts integrate appropriately across SCS, EY Business and Finance processing.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As the S2SE Testing Specialist, you will manage end-to-end testing activities for transformation initiatives, including test planning, design, execution, defect management, user acceptance testing, readiness reporting and hyper-care support. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate requirements, manage risks and support go-live readiness.
  
  

* Develop test scenarios, scripts and cases aligned to business requirements, process documentation and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate testing across SIT, functional, end-to-end, regression, UAT and security access phases.
* Track testing progress, document evidence, monitor risks and support timely resolution of blockers.
* Log, track and manage defects using approved tools, including triage support, fix validation and escalation of critical issues.
* Collaborate with EY business users, Finance and SCS/S2SE teams to prepare, execute and track UAT activities, including objectives, responsibilities and sign-off.
* Produce status reports, dashboards and leadership updates covering progress, defects, risks and go-live readiness.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test governance and defect management processes.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders in a complex transformation environment.
* Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impacts and recommend practical improvements.
* Inclusive and collaborative working style, with the ability to engage effectively across global and cross-functional teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in software/application testing for transformation, technology, or enterprise application programs.
* 5+ years of experience leading testing activities for large-scale transformation programs, including test planning, test execution, defect management, UAT coordination, and testing status reporting.
* Experience working with cross-functional business stakeholders and technology teams across onshore and offshore delivery models.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication and change leadership

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, ERP, Procure to Pay or SAP Ariba environments. Emphasis on S2P platform experience including SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing Suite, Ariba SLP, Ariba Risk, Ariba Buying, Ariba Invoicing and Ariba Business Network.
* Experience with HP ALM, Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail or equivalent test management tools.
* Experience in Agile, hybrid or large-scale transformation delivery environments.
* Testing, Agile or project management certification, such as ISTQB, SAFe, PMP or equivalent.
* Microsoft Project to develop and manage plans
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Microsoft Visio
* Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
* Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization.
* Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a collaborative professional who brings structure, quality discipline and practical judgment to complex transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams, managing ambiguity and helping stakeholders make informed decisions that support successful delivery.

**1. Job Overview**

We are looking for a friendly, confident, and student-oriented Academic Counsellor to guide prospective students in choosing the right educational and professional training programs.

The selected candidate will be responsible for handling student enquiries, understanding individual learning and career goals, explaining course offerings, and guiding students throughout the admission process.

The role involves regular communication with prospective students through phone calls, WhatsApp, emails, and direct interactions. The Academic Counsellor will also coordinate with the sales and academic teams to ensure a smooth admission experience while achieving assigned monthly counselling and admission targets.

* **Program Recommendations:** Understand students' interests, educational backgrounds, and career aspirations to recommend suitable programs.
* **Enquiry Management:** Handle incoming enquiries, respond to student queries, and maintain consistent follow-up communication.
* **Admission Support:** Guide students through the complete admission process, including registration, documentation, fee payment, and enrolment formalities.

* **Student Support:** Address basic student concerns and direct academic or technical queries to the appropriate internal teams.
* **Reporting:** Submit daily work reports, enquiry updates, follow-up details, and admission performance reports as required by management.
* **Service Excellence:** Maintain professional communication and provide a positive, supportive experience throughout the student journey.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent diploma in any discipline.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, counselling, and presentation skills.
* Confidence in handling student enquiries, questions, and objections.
* Ability to understand student requirements and recommend suitable educational programs.
* Good listening, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize enquiries, and manage time efficiently.
* Basic computer proficiency, including MS Office, Google Workspace, and CRM systems.
* Prior experience in academic counselling, student admissions, customer support, or other customer-facing roles is an advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are welcome to apply.
* Willingness to work from the office on a full-time basis.

**4. Performance Expectations**

The selected candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly admission and counselling target achievement.
* Enquiry-to-admission conversion rate.
* Quality and effectiveness of student counselling.
* Timely follow-ups and enquiry management.
* Accuracy of student records and CRM updates.
* Student satisfaction and service quality.
* Admission documentation and onboarding coordination.
* Daily reporting, attendance, and punctuality.
* Coordination with academic and sales teams.

**5. Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

* A student-first mindset with a genuine interest in helping learners.
* Patience and empathy when interacting with students and parents.
* Confidence in communicating and explaining educational opportunities.
* A positive attitude towards targets and performance expectations.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
* Professionalism, accountability, and a willingness to take initiative.
* Enthusiasm to learn, develop counselling skills, and grow within the organization.

**6. Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive salary with monthly performance-based incentives.
* Structured training and career development opportunities.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Performance-based career growth and advancement opportunities.
* Opportunities to participate in educational events, workshops, and company initiatives.

**Join INFERA AIBI CAMPUS and help students make informed decisions about their education and career opportunities.**

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a frontend developer with a designer's eye to build Sarvam's web experiences. You'll start with our marketing website: the homepage, product and use-case pages, interactive demos and calculators. You'll write production code, build reusable UI systems and turn rough ideas into polished interfaces, working closely with design, marketing and product engineering.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Build the interface, not just the mockup. Write production-ready Astro and React components with thoughtful layouts, typography and responsive behaviour. Own the implementation from first prototype to the final browser-sized detail.
* Build a UI system that holds together. Create reusable components, layout primitives and shared styles with clear APIs and sensible variants. Make the next page easier to build without turning every component into a 40-prop puzzle.
* Make it feel right. Build interactions, transitions and animations that make interfaces clearer and more enjoyable. Think through keyboard use, loading, empty and error states, reduced motion and what happens when the happy path isn't so happy.
* Prototype in code. Explore alternative layouts and interactions with designers, test ideas in the browser and refine the details together. You should be comfortable suggesting a better implementation, not waiting for every pixel and breakpoint to be specified.
* Build the useful bits properly. Develop interactive demos, calculators and forms; connect thm to APIs and content. Handle state, validation, asynchronous behaviour and failures. Keep accessibility, performance, metadata and measurement working as part of what you ship.
* Own the engineering quality. Make sound choices about component structure, rendering and hydration. Debug browser and performance issues, write appropriate tests, review code and check preview deployments. Ship maintainable changes that work beyond your own laptop.
* Astro, React, TypeScript and CSS are at the core of the work. We use GitHub for code review and Railway for development and pull-request previews. Sanity, ImageKit and PostHog support content, media and measurement. You'll work with engineering on staging and production releases.

****Requirements****

* Have built and shipped interfaces you're proud to put your name on. Show us the actual thing, what you coded and the decisions you made. A live link beats a paragraph of adjectives.
* Have strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React experience. You can work effectively in Astro and reason about component composition, state, rendering and browser behaviour.
* Have a good eye for visual design and the CSS skills to act on it. You care about spacing, type, hierarchy, responsive layouts and interaction details, and can turn that judgement into working code.
* Can work across design and engineering. You're comfortable starting from a rough brief, prototyping options and discussing trade-offs with designers. You can also take an established design and implement it faithfully.
* Can debug an unfamiliar frontend, integrate APIs and use Git, pull requests and automated checks confidently. You understand accessibility and web performance, and handle credentials and user data responsibly.
* Use AI coding tools with judgement. Let them help you move faster. Read the diff, test the result and be able to explain what you're shipping. 'The model wrote it' isn't a debugging strategy.
* Ask good questions when the brief is fuzzy. Explain trade-offs, suggest a practical way forward and use evidence before declaring that something needs fixing.

****Bonus points that are not dealbreakers****

* You've built for B2B SaaS, developer tools or AI products.
* You've built component libraries, design systems or interactive prototypes that other people actually use.
* You've worked with animation, SVG, Canvas or other techniques that make complex ideas easier to explore on the web.
* You've used a headless CMS such as Sanity, or worked on technical SEO and analytics integrations without letting them take over the frontend.

****How to apply****
Skip the generic cover letter. Send us a couple of interfaces or web projects you've built, with a short note on what you personally designed and coded. Pick one and walk us through a component, interaction or tricky engineering decision. Code samples are welcome where you can share them.
  
  
If there's a side project you're weirdly proud of, we'd like to see that too.
  
  
****Why Sarvam?****
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
  
  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Power Apps Technical Lead — Power Pages & Dataverse
description:
Avanade is the world’s leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7,000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft’s Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results.
  
  
Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60,000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165,000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is looking for a Power Apps Technical Lead to own the technical design and build of applications on the Microsoft Power Platform — with Power Pages and Dataverse at the centre of the role. This is a hands-on lead position: you will set the technical direction, make the design calls, write the harder parts of the code yourself, and lead a team of developers through delivery.
  
  
The role is deliberately weighted towards Power Pages and front-end engineering. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Liquid as they are with a Dataverse security model — because externally facing portals are where those two worlds meet, and where most Power Platform projects run into trouble.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical design of Power Platform applications — solution architecture, Dataverse data model, security model, integration approach and front-end design — and document the decisions behind them.
* Lead the design and development of Power Pages sites: site structure and templates, web pages and web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, page and table permissions, authentication providers and external user access.
* Build rich, responsive front-end experiences on Power Pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap — custom components, client-side validation, dynamic behaviour and integration with the Dataverse Web API.
* Design and build applications in Power Apps — model-driven and canvas apps — including forms, views, business rules, client scripting and app-level performance considerations.
* Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, keys, calculated and rollup fields, business rules, and a security model built on roles, teams, business units and row/column-level security.
* Develop server-side extensions where required — plug-ins and custom APIs in C#/.NET — and integrate with external systems through REST APIs and the Dataverse Web API.
* Build custom controls with the Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) using TypeScript and React where out-of-the-box components fall short.
* Lead the development team day to day — task breakdown, technical guidance, code reviews, unblocking developers and holding the quality bar on what ships.
* Own ALM and release practice: solution layering and management, environment strategy, source control, deployment pipelines and configuration/data migration between environments.
* Set and enforce engineering standards — coding conventions, naming, reusable components, performance patterns, accessibility and security practices for public-facing sites.
* Translate functional requirements into technical designs with the functional and business analyst teams, and challenge requirements where a simpler or more sustainable approach exists.
* Own non-functional quality: performance and page-load optimisation for portals, caching, scalability, accessibility (WCAG) compliance and security hardening of externally exposed sites.
* Support estimation, sprint planning and technical risk identification, and give realistic delivery input to project and client leadership.
* Engage client technical stakeholders directly — design walkthroughs, technical discussions and issue resolution — and represent the technical position credibly.
* Mentor developers on the team, and contribute reusable components, templates and accelerators back to the practice.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 6 - 9 years of overall application development experience, with substantial recent delivery on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Strong hands-on experience building applications with Power Apps — model-driven and/or canvas — taken through to production.
* Deep, demonstrable Power Pages (or Power Apps Portals) experience: web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, table and page permissions, web roles, authentication and external-facing site delivery.
* Strong front-end web development skills — HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design and Bootstrap — with the ability to build custom UI rather than only configure out-of-the-box components.
* Deep Dataverse expertise: data modelling, relationships, business rules, and a genuine command of the security model — roles, teams, business units, and row- and column-level security.
* Experience with the Dataverse Web API and REST integration patterns, including authentication and error handling.
* Server-side development capability in C#/.NET — plug-ins, custom APIs and custom workflow activities.
* Experience with Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) and TypeScript for custom control development.
* Solid ALM discipline: solution management, environment strategy, source control (Git) and automated or repeatable deployments.
* Proven experience as a technical lead — owning design decisions, running code reviews, guiding developers and being accountable for technical quality on an engagement.
* Ability to work directly with clients and functional teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and push back constructively where needed.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across the full stack — browser, portal runtime, Dataverse and integrations.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Microsoft certifications: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), PL-600 (Solution Architect) or PL-200.
* Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular or Vue) and build tooling.
* Experience delivering high-traffic or public-facing portals, including SEO, CDN and caching considerations.
* Familiarity with Azure services that commonly support Power Platform solutions — Azure Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus or Azure AD B2C for portal authentication.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 first-party apps built on Dataverse.
* Accessibility experience — WCAG 2.1/2.2 conformance and assistive-technology testing.
* Experience with automated testing for Power Platform solutions (unit tests for plug-ins, UI test automation).
* Experience in a global delivery / SI environment working with distributed teams.
* Prior contribution to reusable components, frameworks or practice accelerators.

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SCT-Tech Enablement - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front-end and back-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge-sharing across teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**

* Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and pipeline ownership

* Experience with big-data / data-lake technologies (e.g. columnar/table formats, data-lake query engines)

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer with strong expertise in network security, routing, and enterprise network infrastructure.

· The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, and Cisco networking technologies.

· This role requires an independent contributor who can effectively manage tasks and ensure secure, reliable network operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Network Security**

* Manage and maintain network security infrastructure including Palo Alto and Cisco ASA firewalls.
* Implement and monitor security policies, firewall rules, NAT configurations, and VPNs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex security and connectivity issues.
* Ensure compliance with security standards and best practices.

**Web Application Security**

* Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions for protecting applications against threats, including DDoS attacks and bot traffic.
* Configure WAF rules, rate limiting, and security policies to enhance application security and optimize performance.

**Network Infrastructure**

* Design, implement, and support Cisco-based LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments.
* Manage switching, wireless, and WAN connectivity across enterprise networks.
* Monitor network performance and ensure high availability and reliability.

**Routing & Switching**

* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols including BGP and EIGRP.
* Perform routing optimization and traffic engineering for improved performance.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in network engineering.
* 3+ years of experience managing network security using Palo Alto and Cisco ASA.
* Strong experience with Cisco LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments (minimum 3 years).
* Deep understanding of routing protocols such as BGP and EIGRP.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in networking and security domains.
* Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Palo Alto certifications.
* Experience with network monitoring and logging tools.
* Exposure to cloud networking is a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Self-motivated and capable of working as an individual contributor.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Good communication and documentation abilities.

PLUS - Desired to have: Cloudflare WAF experience

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability.
  
  
The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
  
  
Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards.
  
  
Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices.
  
  
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
  
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
  
  
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
  
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
  
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
  
  
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
  
  
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
  
  
Problem Solving:

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
  
  
Continuous Learning:

Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

title: Engineer II - Cloud Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
At LPL, observability is how a Tier 1 financial firm earns trust at midnight — and Engineer 2 Monitoring engineers spend their day in the dashboards, alerts, and incident channels that make that trust real. You'll grow into observability depth across CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (with the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow inside the Monitoring pod within Foundations, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring close at hand. If you want to learn observability at a Tier 1 financial firm with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Monitoring Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level observability engineer in the Monitoring pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support the implementation and operations of LPL's CCOE observability platform across our multi-account landing zone and the hybrid on-premises footprint. The stack spans AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch), Grafana / Prometheus (including Amazon Managed Prometheus and Managed Grafana where appropriate), Dynatrace, the legacy ELK stack where it still exists, and ServiceNow for ITSM and incident ticketing. You partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring, and you partner closely with the Support team on incident response and the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod on the observability paved road for application teams. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in dashboards, alerts, Terraform, and incident response — primarily as a primary on-call responder with support from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, SLO definitions, and runbooks across the CCOE observability stack: CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (and the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow ITSM
* Implement Terraform and Helm changes against the observability paved road; consume the private Terraform module library and raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared observability modules and reference dashboards
* Partner with the Support team on incident response: tune alert routing into ServiceNow, execute runbooks, and feed lessons from incidents back into durable monitoring improvements
* Pair with senior engineers and AVPs in the Monitoring pod on noisy alert chains, missing-signal investigations, and SLO refactors; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day observability work: AI-assisted alert triage, dashboard drafts from natural-language intent, summary of recent telemetry during incidents via MCP-backed agents, and runbook generation for known incident classes
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Working knowledge of an enterprise observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting — across AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch) and at least one of Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace (or comparable APM), or the ELK stack

**Core Competencies**

* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description

**Preferences**

* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day-to-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

LPL Global Business Services, LLP - PRIVACY POLICY

title: Cloud Automation Architectured
description:
Job description:

Job Title: Cloud Automation Architect

Location: Hyderabad

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Role

We are looking for a senior automation architect who does not just write scripts — someone who builds production-grade automation frameworks from the ground up. You will own the full lifecycle: infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, self-healing, and monitoring. If you have spent years turning manual, fragmented ops into reliable, repeatable systems — this is built for you.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

What You Will Be Responsible For

Ansible Automation Design and maintain enterprise-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Automate OS patching, configuration drift correction, security hardening, and compliance enforcement across AWS, Azure, VMware, and REST-integrated environments. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post-provisioning configuration.

AWS Cloud Automation Architect serverless and event-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well-Architected standards.

Kubernetes & Helm Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies.

Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps — with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in.

Security & Compliance Automation Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end.

Observability & Auto-Remediation Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry-driven triggers. Build self-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly.

ITSM Integration Integrate automation into SymphonyAI-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

What We Are Looking For

• 8+ years of hands-on infrastructure automation experience in enterprise environments

• Expert-level Ansible engineering — advanced Jinja2 templating, dynamic inventory, custom module development

• Strong Kubernetes and Helm expertise — chart authoring, multi-environment lifecycle management

• Deep Terraform knowledge — reusable module design, remote state, CI/CD integration

• Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting

• Solid AWS architecture knowledge — serverless patterns, IAM design, multi-account networking

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Bonus Points

GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux · OPA / Gatekeeper / Conftest · Multi-account AWS automation · Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd) · IaC testing with Molecule, Terratest, Checkov, or tfsec · AWS cost optimization automation

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Why Join

• Own automation end to end — not just a piece of it

• Replace reactive, manual operations with intelligent, self-healing systems

• Work across cloud, security, infrastructure, and platform engineering

• Build patterns and frameworks the entire engineering org will adopt

• Directly reduce MTTR, improve security posture, and accelerate cloud maturity

Please share your resume and LinkedIn i'd as well

Looking forward to your response

title: Lead Information Security Compliance Manager

* Review product features and internal architecture to assess against compliance requirements.
* Identify and evaluate risks, including oversight and monitoring of our risk program in relation to product features.
* Stay abreast of global regulatory trends and translate them into actionable insights and requirements for product teams.
* Identify automation opportunities to enhance the review process in partnership with security and legal teams, incorporating minimum requirements that all capabilities must meet.

title: Senior Security Architect/Engineer (HIPAA & SOC 2)
description:
We are hiring a Senior Security Architect/ Engineer to build and own the HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance programs end to end. You will design the security architecture that protects patient and customer data, stand up continuous monitoring for data leakage, and harden our systems against intrusion and penetration attempts. This is a hands-on senior role: you will set things up from scratch where needed, not just maintain what exists. You will report to CTO and work closely with engineering, DevOps, legal and leadership.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and own the HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance programs end to end.
* You will design the security architecture that protects patient and customer data, stand up continuous monitoring for data leakage, and harden our systems against intrusion and penetration attempts.
* This is a hands-on senior role: you will set things up from scratch where needed, not just maintain what exists.
* Compliance program (HIPAA and SOC 2)
* Build and lead the HIPAA security program: risk assessments, Security Rule administrative, physical and technical safeguards, and Breach Notification Rule readiness.
* Drive SOC 2 Type I and Type II readiness across the Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and others as in scope).
* Write and maintain security policies, standards and procedures, and map controls across HIPAA, SOC 2 and related frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, HITRUST).
* Own audit preparation: evidence collection, control testing, gap remediation, and acting as the main contact for external auditors.
* Manage Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and vendor security reviews for any third party that handles PHI.
* Implement a compliance automation platform (e.g. Vanta, Drata, Secureframe) for continuous control monitoring.
* Security architecture
* Design secure, zero-trust architecture across cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), applications, networks and endpoints.
* Define identity and access management standards: SSO, MFA, least privilege, privileged access management and quarterly access reviews.
* Set encryption standards for PHI and sensitive data at rest and in transit, including key management.
* Review designs and embed security into the SDLC through threat modeling, secure code review, SAST, DAST and dependency scanning.
* Data leak prevention and monitoring
* Deploy and tune Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls across email, endpoints, cloud storage and SaaS apps.
* Classify data and maintain an inventory of where PHI and confidential data lives and flows.
* Stand up centralized logging, SIEM and alerting (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Datadog, Elastic) with detection rules for exfiltration and anomalous access.
* Monitor cloud security posture (CSPM) and fix misconfigurations such as public buckets and over-permissive roles.
* Hands on Experience in Azure Purview and Sentinel
* Penetration and intrusion prevention
* Run the vulnerability management program: scanning, prioritization, patch SLAs and tracking to closure.
* Plan and oversee annual third-party penetration tests and internal red-team exercises; own remediation.
* Configure and manage WAF, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, network segmentation and firewall rules.
* Harden infrastructure and container baselines against CIS Benchmarks
* Incident response
* Build and test the incident response plan, including tabletop exercises at least twice a year.
* Lead investigation and containment of security incidents and data breaches.
* Coordinate HIPAA breach notification with legal within required timelines.
* Leadership and culture

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in information security, with 5+ years in a security architect or senior security engineering role.
* Proven track record of taking at least one organization through a successful SOC 2 Type II audit.
* Hands-on experience implementing HIPAA Security Rule controls in a healthcare, health-tech or PHI-handling environment.
* Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and its native security services.
* Proficient in Microsoft Purview (data classification, sensitivity labels, DLP policies, compliance management) and Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM/SOAR, KQL detection rules, threat hunting, automated playbooks).
* Practical experience deploying DLP, SIEM, EDR and vulnerability management tools.
* Strong grasp of network security, IAM, encryption, and application security (OWASP Top 10).
* Experience leading incident response for real security events.
* Ability to explain risk clearly to non-technical leaders and write audit-ready documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: Lead/Architect, Enterprise Resilience Consultant - BCP
description:
**The Opportunity**
As an Enterprise Resilience Consultant, you will support MassMutual’s ability to prepare for, respond to, and recover from events that could disrupt important business services, operations, technology, suppliers, facilities, or employees. You will contribute to the execution of enterprise resilience activities, including business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery coordination, emergency preparedness, crisis response support, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role supports the Head of Enterprise Resilience and is based in Hyderabad, India. The position is intended for a developing resilience professional who will support enterprise initiatives under the direction of senior team members, contribute to program execution, maintain high-quality documentation, track actions and risks, prepare stakeholder materials, and help embed resilience practices across the organization.
  
  
**The Team**
The Office of Enterprise Resilience helps MassMutual reduce disruption risk and maintain important operations through planning, testing, response coordination, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The team partners with business, technology, risk, operations, procurement, legal, compliance, security, facilities, and supplier management teams to strengthen enterprise preparedness and resilience outcomes.
  
  
In this role, you will support cross-functional work that is detail-oriented, time-sensitive, and connected to customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, and MassMutual’s purpose. You may assist with resilience reviews, exercises, incident-related assessments, stakeholder updates, and management reporting.
  
  
**The Impact**

* Support enterprise resilience program activities by maintaining plans, trackers, issue logs, evidence repositories, meeting materials, and status updates.
* Assist with business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery, emergency preparedness, and third-party resilience activities by gathering inputs, reviewing documentation, tracking actions, and escalating gaps or overdue items.
* Coordinate resilience exercises, plan validations, workshops, and stakeholder meetings by preparing agendas, materials, attendance records, notes, action items, and follow-up communications.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to collect and validate resilience information (such as BIAs, DR Plans, etc.), including critical functions, dependencies, recovery strategies, contingency procedures, testing evidence, supplier documentation, and remediation updates.
* Prepare reporting and analysis that provide visibility into resilience posture, open issues, testing progress, program health, and emerging risks.
* Support incident and disruption response activities by helping assess potential impacts, document decisions, coordinate updates, track follow-up actions, and maintain records through recovery or closure.
* Identify opportunities to improve process consistency, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, and reporting routines while staying aligned with enterprise standards.

**The Minimum Qualifications**

* 5 - 7+ years of experience in business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery, emergency management, enterprise risk management, third-party risk management, technology risk, operations, or related program execution.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Experience supporting program management, risk assessments, control reviews, plan maintenance, testing, issue tracking, action-item management, or stakeholder reporting.
* Strong knowledge of implementing AI-enabled solutions, including identifying use cases, supporting adoption, evaluating operational impacts, and aligning implementation activities with business, risk, and governance requirements.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in risk, technology, operations, compliance, procurement, legal, business continuity, disaster recovery, or supplier management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Experience preparing written communications, status updates, meeting materials, summaries, trackers, or reporting deliverables for stakeholders.
* Ability to work flexible hours when needed to support time-sensitive resilience activities, global stakeholders, significant incidents, exercises, or critical deliverables.

**The Ideal Qualifications**

* Experience supporting resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, emergency preparedness, third-party resilience, or operational risk programs in insurance or financial services.
* Understanding of operational resilience, business continuity planning, disaster recovery, emergency response, dependency mapping, incident response, supplier risk, or issue management practices.
* Experience with Archer, ProcessUnity, Jira, SharePoint, continuity planning tools, workflow management tools, supplier risk platforms, reporting platforms, or similar systems.
* Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, metrics, meeting materials, governance updates, management reporting, or executive-ready summaries.
* Knowledge of resilience-related regulatory expectations or industry practices, such as ISO 22301, FFIEC guidance, DORA, NIST, or similar frameworks.
* Professional certification such as CBCP, MBCP, CRISC, CISA, CISM, PMP, or equivalent experience.
* Ability to translate complex resilience, risk, and operational information into clear actions, owners, timelines, and stakeholder-ready insights.

**What You Can Expect At MassMutual**
MassMutual offers meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. In this role, you can expect:
  
  

* Clear responsibilities that connect to enterprise resilience, customer outcomes, and business continuity.
