title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.

**What We Look For**

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

title: Platform Engineer
description:

**Job Summary**

The Platform Engineer at T-Mobile designs, builds, and maintains the hybrid cloud infrastructure that powers T-Mobile's platforms and services. This role focuses on scalability, reliability, and automation across both on-prem and multi-cloud environments (AWS and Azure).

Building upon foundational platform engineering and DevOps experience, the Platform Engineer leads automation initiatives, develops Infrastructure-as-Code solutions, and optimises CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable delivery. The role requires hands-on expertise in hybrid infrastructure, monitoring, observability, and data integration, along with strong collaboration skills across engineering and architecture teams.

Through technical ownership and collaboration, this position directly supports T-Mobile's cloud transformation and drives operational excellence in the platforms that enable developers and critical business systems to thrive.

**Key Responsibilities: Platform Operations & Support**

* Own day-to-day operations of hybrid infrastructure supporting T-Mobile's platform services.

* Ensure uptime, performance, and security across on-prem, AWS, and Azure environments.

* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, configuration, and deployment issues impacting platform reliability.

* Lead patching, updates, and configuration management with minimal oversight.

* Participate in on-call rotation and drive improvements in incident response and postmortem practices.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

* Design, develop, and maintain automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to increase operational efficiency.

* Implement and manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent frameworks.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for platform infrastructure and environment deployments (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins).

* Establish documentation standards and reusable modules for consistent automation delivery.

**Hybrid Cloud Environment Engineering**

* Architect, provision, and maintain compute, networking, and storage services across AWS, Azure, and on-prem environments.

* Engineer hybrid connectivity solutions and optimize data flow between datacenters and cloud resources.

* Manage shared platform services such as container registries, configuration management, and identity systems.

* Partner with DevOps, SRE, and application teams to deliver stable, scalable platform environments.

Data, Messaging & Caching (DML Operations)

* Execute and optimize DML operations within Postgres, Oracle, and Cassandra environments under existing organizational DDL structures.

* Develop and maintain integrations with Kafka for event-driven data pipelines, message publishing, and asynchronous workloads.

* Implement caching strategies (Redis, in-memory caches) to reduce query latency and improve application performance.

* Support database performance tuning, data ingestion, and transformation activities aligned with enterprise governance standards.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

* Develop and manage observability solutions leveraging Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or ELK.

* Implement proactive monitoring, log analysis, and metrics-based alerting for early issue detection.

* Lead efforts in automation for self-healing, scaling, and performance tuning.

* Collaborate with SREs to improve mean time to resolution (MTTR) and overall platform reliability.

Collaboration, Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Contribute to Agile delivery teams, collaborating with developers and architects to deliver infrastructure enhancements.

* Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance in automation, monitoring, and hybrid design.

* Advocate for DevOps and automation best practices across engineering teams.

* Stay informed on emerging tools and cloud-native practices that improve reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Linux and Windows Server administration within hybrid environments.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, and IAM.

* Advanced scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate platform operations.

* Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar).

* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Working knowledge of DML operations in relational (Postgres, Oracle) and NoSQL (Cassandra) databases.

* Understanding of Kafka event streaming concepts, including producers, consumers, and topic management.

* Familiarity with caching mechanisms such as Redis or Memcached for improving data access performance.

* Working knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.

* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, security principles, and zero-trust models.

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a bias for action and automation.

* Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Collaborates seamlessly in Agile, cross-functional environments.

* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and adaptability in dynamic, fast-paced settings.

* Mentors junior engineers and contributes to a culture of learning and operational excellence.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

**Why This Role Matters**

The Platform Engineer plays a key role in building and operating T-Mobile's hybrid infrastructure and platform services. They ensure operational efficiency, performance, and scalability through automation and continuous improvement, including optimised data handling, event-driven integrations, and caching strategies.

By combining platform engineering with DML and messaging expertise, the Platform Engineer enables reliable, efficient, and scalable systems that support T-Mobile's mission to innovate faster and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**Company Description**
Shimnit New Fire Engineers Pvt. Ltd. (SNF) is a strategic joint venture between Shimnit India Pvt. Ltd. and New Fire Engineers Pvt. Ltd., dedicated to advancing fire safety in the mobility sector. The company designs and manufactures automatic Fire Detection and Suppression Systems for buses and commercial vehicles, using modern technology to address current and emerging fire risks. SNF solutions are purpose-built for automotive environments, ensuring seamless integration and reliable performance in demanding real-world conditions, including conventional and electric mobility. All systems are developed to meet stringent regulatory standards such as AIS-135 and incorporate DRDO-tested components, backed by rigorous validation and testing. With over 50 years of combined expertise, SNF focuses on strong engineering, OEM integration, and continuous innovation to make mobility safer, more reliable, and future-ready.

The Design Engineer will work on the design and development of fire detection and suppression systems for buses and commercial vehicles, ensuring compliance with automotive and safety standards. This full-time, hybrid role is based in Vasai, with some flexibility for work from home. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating and reviewing CAD models and engineering drawings, collaborating with mechanical and electrical teams on product design, and supporting prototyping, testing, and design validation. The role also involves optimizing designs for manufacturability and reliability, preparing technical documentation, and coordinating with OEMs and internal stakeholders to integrate systems into various vehicle platforms. The Design Engineer will be expected to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support innovation in next-generation fire safety solutions.

* Experience managing major infrastructure features from development through phased production deployment.
* Ability to break complex problems into simple parts and reuse existing solutions.
* SRE approach: examining logs and metrics to investigate failures, set SLOs, and boost reliability.
* Experience building systems that perform reliably with limited operational intervention.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

* Proficiency in statistical programming and data manipulation

title: Staff Software Engineer - Golang
description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.

**About the Role**

As a
**Staff Software Engineer**
on Human Agentic Fabric

team you will act as a senior technical leader architecting, designing, and building highly scalable, resilient distributed systems. In this role, your typical day involves leading significant hands-on backend software development in Java and GoLang, designing event-driven microservices capable of handling massive daily transaction volumes, and collaborating cross-functionally with Product Management and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, set architectural vision, advocate for best practices across teams, and mentor engineers to build high-performance cloud security systems at global scale.

**About the Team**

You will join a high-velocity, collaborative engineering team based in Pune, India, working in close partnership with our US-based engineering teams. We are passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges across a modern, multi-tenant SaaS platform built on cloud-native microservices hosted in AWS. Our team fosters a culture of technical rigor, continuous innovation, mutual trust, and ownership, empowering every engineer to make a lasting impact on our core product offerings.

**Roadmap for Success**

* 30 days: Complete SailPoint engineering onboarding, configure your development environment, and gain a thorough understanding of the IdentityNow multi-tenant microservices architecture and deployment pipelines. Shadow team members during sprint ceremonies, review architectural documentation, and deliver your first backend code contribution in Java or GoLang following SailPoint’s testing and CI/CD standards.
* 60 days: Partner with Product Management, technical leads, and engineering peers to define technical specifications and architectural designs for upcoming high-throughput service capabilities. Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end microservice enhancements, establishing robust unit and integration test coverage.
* 90 days: Independently drive the technical design and execution of complex service components across Java and GoLang codebases. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries and event-streaming pipelines (Kafka, Redis), and lead constructive peer code reviews.
* 6 months: Define and drive forward-looking technical roadmaps for your service domain, reducing system latency and scaling services to support rapid customer growth. Participate in the engineering on-call rotation to support platform reliability, diagnose complex production escalations, and partner with services teams to review solution architecture.
* 1 year: Serve as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) on distributed systems design, asynchronous workflows, and microservice scalability across the organization. Establish design patterns and coding guardrails across teams, champion AI-assisted engineering practices, and actively mentor junior and mid-level engineers to elevate technical excellence across the Pune engineering hub.

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 8+ years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade software products
* 5+ years of hands-on experience developing software in Java, with demonstrated experience leading engineering initiatives and setting technical direction
* Hands-on proficiency and professional experience developing scalable services in GoLang
* 2+ years of experience architecting and developing web applications and microservices in a high-scale, distributed cloud environment
* Solid hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies (such as MySQL, Postgres, DynamoDB, Aurora, and Hibernate or other ORM frameworks)
* Proven experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures utilizing messaging systems and queues (such as Apache Kafka and Redis)
* Strong background in automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS)
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills with a proven track record of mentoring engineers and driving cross-functional alignment

**AI-assisted engineering:**

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.

**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**The Tech Stack**

* Languages: Java, GoLang
* Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
* Event Streaming & Caching: Apache Kafka, Redis
* Databases: DynamoDB, Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL
* CI/CD & Build Tools: Jenkins, CloudBees, Git, Maven, Gradle

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* **Competitive Compensation**
* **Paid Leave:**

  Competitive vacation policies alongside paid company holidays to help you recharge.
* **Comprehensive Healthcare:**

  Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance options
* **Career Growth Opportunities**
* Plus so much more!

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Software Engineer (Data & AIML)
description:
**About Maersk**
Maersk is building the next generation of digital capabilities for the global supply chain.
  
  
We are re-architecting our platform with a data-first approach — building a trusted, scalable and reusable data foundation for current and future supply-chain use cases.
  
  
On top of this foundation, we will build ML models, intelligence, recommendations, GenAI and agentic AI to help customers and teams make better and faster decisions.
  
  
A key part of this vision is data democratization — making trusted and contextualised data easy to discover, understand and use across teams, products, models and AI agents.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Data, AI/ML, GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer to help design and build this platform from the ground up.
  
  
This role combines data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML and architecture. You will build reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions and work closely with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams and supply-chain experts.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and build scalable data and AI architecture for data-intensive systems.
* Build trusted data foundations and reusable data products from multiple sources.
* Build reliable batch, streaming and near-real-time data pipelines based on business needs.
* Enable data democratization and self-service access to trusted data.
* Build capabilities for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, security and observability.
* Establish common business context and semantics so data can be effectively used by applications, ML models, GenAI and AI agents.
* Develop and productionise ML solutions for prediction, forecasting, risk, anomaly detection, recommendations and optimisation

Build production-grade GenAI/LLM solutions using approaches such as RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling.
  
  

* Build agentic AI solutions that can reason over trusted data, use tools and APIs, provide recommendations and take actions.
* Design appropriate guardrails, access controls, monitoring and human oversight for AI and agentic solutions.
* Build reusable APIs, services and workflows that connect data, applications and AI capabilities.
* Use platforms such as Pipedream or similar workflow tools where they add value.
* Make architecture and technology decisions considering scalability, reliability, security, performance and cost.
* Establish strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD and observability.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews.
* Mentor engineers and help establish engineering and architecture standards

**About You**
We are looking for someone with strong engineering, data and AI fundamentals who can build production-ready systems.
  
  
You should have:
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related field.
* Experience designing and building scalable, distributed and data-intensive systems.
* Experience contributing to or owning architecture and technical design for data or AI platforms.
* Strong programming skills in Java and Python. Experience with Scala, Kotlin or similar languages is a plus.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, distributed systems and data processing.
* Experience building data pipelines, data products or data platforms at scale.
* Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, Flink or equivalent.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases
* Good understanding of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage and observability.
* Hands-on experience taking ML models from development to production, including deployment, monitoring and evaluation.
* Experience with GenAI/LLMs and building practical, production-ready applications.
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling and LLM evaluation.
* Experience or strong exposure to AI agents and agentic workflows.
* Understanding of AI security, guardrails, access control and human oversight.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD and production operations.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* A platform mindset — focused on building reusable capabilities rather than oneoff solutions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in logistics, shipping, transportation or supply chain.
* Experience with real-time and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with MLOps and model monitoring.
* Experience with production RAG, AI agents or agent orchestration.
* Experience with MCP or similar agent/tool integration patterns.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic models or entity resolution.
* Experience with Pipedream or similar workflow/integration platforms.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience leading technical design or architecture for large-scale platforms.

**Why This Role**
This is a greenfield opportunity to help build the foundation for the next generation of supply-chain intelligence at Maersk. Our vision is: Data Foundation → Data Products & Context → ML & Intelligence → Recommendations → GenAI → Agentic AI The data foundation is the core layer, providing trusted, reusable and contextualised data to products, ML models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
  
  
The goal is to build a platform where new data and AI capabilities can be developed faster, reused across multiple use cases and scaled across the supply chain without repeatedly rebuilding the underlying foundation. You will help shape the architecture, data foundation, engineering practices and AI capabilities that will enable future digital supply-chain experiences at Maersk.
  
  
Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

* Assist with VAT registrations, deregistrations, and maintenance of tax authority records.

* Support system enhancements, testing activities, and implementation of new VAT compliance technologies.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and process improvement initiatives.
* Execute key controls within the European VAT compliance framework.
* Maintain evidence supporting SOX control performance and audit requirements.
* Perform documented reconciliations and review procedures in accordance with internal control standards.
* Analyze VAT trends, variances, and anomalies.
* Prepare monthly compliance and KPI reporting for management.
* Review transactional data and tax determination outcomes.
* Support root cause analysis of VAT issues and recommend corrective actions.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Commerce, or related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in VAT/GST/indirect tax compliance.
* Experience supporting European VAT compliance activities.
* Previous experience with VAT compliance software is a must.
* Strong understanding of VAT return preparation, reconciliations, and compliance processes.
* Experience working in multinational or shared service environments.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Knowledge of ERP systems (QAD/SAP/Oracle).

We are looking for a Linux Server & System Administrator with 2+ years of hands-on experience in Linux server administration, installation, configuration, security hardening, Apache Web Server management, firewall configuration, and user access management.

The candidate should be capable of independently setting up, securing, monitoring, and maintaining Ubuntu Linux servers and troubleshooting routine production server issues.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Linux Server Administration & Setup

● Installation, configuration, and maintenance of Ubuntu Linux servers.

● Server provisioning, network configuration, hostname, static IP, DNS, and SSH setup.

● User and group management, file permissions, sudo privileges, and package management using APT.

● Disk, filesystem, storage, service, process, and scheduled task management.

● Routine server maintenance, updates, and security patching.

B. Linux Security & Access Management

● Implementing Linux security policies and server hardening best practices.

● Managing user permissions, sudo access, password policies, and least-privilege access.

● Configuring secure SSH access, key-based authentication, and restricting root login.

● Managing authorized users and restricting unauthorized access to critical directories and services.

● Monitoring authentication logs and identifying suspicious login activities.

C. Apache Web Server Management

● Installation, configuration, and maintenance of Apache HTTP Server.

● Configuring Virtual Hosts, document roots, website directories, and hosting multiple websites.

● SSL/TLS certificate installation, HTTPS configuration, and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.

● Managing Apache modules, services, access/error logs, and troubleshooting website issues.

● Basic Apache security hardening and directory access restrictions.

D. Firewall & Network Security

● Configuring and managing Linux firewalls using UFW and basic iptables.

● Managing inbound/outbound traffic, port restrictions, and IP-based access control.

● Configuring firewall rules for SSH, HTTP, HTTPS, and application-specific services.

● Restricting unnecessary open ports and allowing access only from authorized IP addresses where required.

● Monitoring firewall rules and troubleshooting network connectivity issues.

E. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Maintenance

● Monitoring CPU, RAM, disk space, network utilization, uptime, and running processes.

● Managing system services using systemctl and monitoring logs using journalctl and /var/log/.

● Troubleshooting Apache, SSH, firewall, network, and general Linux server issues.

● Performing routine server health checks and root cause analysis.

● Maintaining server configuration documentation and following change management procedures.

F. Backup & Recovery

● Basic backup and restoration of Linux servers and configuration files.

● Knowledge of rsync, tar, and scheduled backups using cron.

● Monitoring backup completion and maintaining basic recovery procedures.

G. VMware / Virtualization

● Basic knowledge of VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.

● Understanding virtual machine creation, resource allocation, virtual networking, storage, and snapshots.

3. Required Technical Knowledge

Category Commands / Tools

Linux Administration ls, cd, cp, mv, mkdir, rm

User & Permissions chmod, chown, useradd, usermod, passwd, sudo

Monitoring top, free, df, du, uptime

Networking ping, ip, ss, hostname, traceroute

Services & Logs systemctl, journalctl, grep, tail

Firewall & Security ufw, iptables, ssh

Apache apache2ctl, a2ensite, a2dissite, a2enmod

Package Management apt, dpkg

Backup & SSL rsync, tar, cron, certbot, openssl

4. Candidate Requirements

● Minimum 2+ years of practical Linux Server Administration experience.

● Strong hands-on knowledge of Ubuntu Linux Server setup and configuration.

● Practical experience in Apache Web Server installation, Virtual Hosts, and SSL configuration.

● Knowledge of firewall management using UFW/iptables and Linux security hardening.

● Experience with SSH security, user permissions, sudo access, and access control.

● Understanding of networking, DNS, IP addressing, ports, and troubleshooting.

● Experience in server monitoring, log analysis, backup, and routine maintenance.

● Good troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

The candidate must have hands-on experience in Linux server setup, Apache configuration, SSL implementation, firewall management, SSH security, user access management, and server troubleshooting.

· **Aggregator & Discovery Platforms:** Own and scale performance partnerships with healthcare aggregators and discovery portals including Practo, Justdial, Sulekha, Lybrate, and other strategic listing/aggregator tie-ups.

**Role Overview:**

Every SFL enrolment starts with a parent searching nearby, for example "badminton coaching near me" or "football academy in Powai". This role makes SFL the first answer in those searches, on Google, Google Maps and AI search, and turns that visibility into trial bookings and enrolments. You will own organic search end to end: local SEO, technical SEO, content and reporting.

**Job Duties:** The duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following -

**Local SEO & Google Business Profiles - Top Priority:**

* Own Google Business Profiles for all 60+ centres - set-up, verification, categories, sport-wise services, photos, posts, Q&A and timings.
* Make name, address and phone consistent across the website, GBP, Justdial, Google Maps and other listings.
* Build a review engine with centre heads and pre-sales team - review asks after trials and milestones, response SLAs, and review count and rating targets per centre.
* Track local-pack and Maps rankings for each centre for "[sport] coaching/academy near me" and "[sport] + [neighbourhood]" searches.
* Launch GBP and local listings for every new centre before it opens.

**Centre and Sports Pages:**

* Build and maintain a unique page for each centre, by city, sport and area, with real photos, coaches, batch timings, fees or trial offer, reviews, FAQs and local landmarks.
* Avoid template pages that differ only by address. Each page must answer what a parent in that area actually asks.
* Add structured data (LocalBusiness, SportsActivityLocation, FAQ, Event) across centre, tournament and event pages.

**Technical SEO:**

* Run regular site audits (crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals) and get fixes shipped with the tech team.
* Make sure mobile page speed and usability are strong. Most parent searches happen on phones.
* Own SEO requirements for new launches - pages, tournaments, SFL TV and app landing pages.

**Content for Parent Search Intent:**

* Build a keyword and content plan around what parents search - best age to start a sport, benefits for kids, how to choose an academy, what happens at a trial, fees and schedules.
* Brief and edit writers (in-house, freelance or AI-assisted) with a hard quality bar - original, expert - reviewed by coaches, no thin or generic content.
* Build tournament, league and SGL TV pages that capture event and "near me" search demand.
* Earn quality backlinks through PR, school and society partnerships, sports bodies, tournaments and local media.

**AI Search and New Surfaces:**

* Make sure SFL shoes up correctly in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers for youth sports coaching in our cities.
* Keep entity information consistent (brand, centres, sports, reviews) across the web so AI engines describe SFL accurately.

**Conversion, Analytics & Reporting:**

* Work with Tech on organic landing-page conversion - forms, WhatsApp and call CTAs, trial booking flow and page speed.
* Set up and maintain tracking across Google Search Console, GA4 and LeadSquared so organic leads and enrolments are attributed correctly.
* Report monthly on organic enrolments and cost per organic enrolment, at centre level for local SEO and topic level for content, against competitor benchmarks.
* Lead each report with the single highest-leverage fix for the next month.
* Track competitors' search visibility in each micro-market and close the gaps.

**What we are looking for:**

**Must have -**

* 4-6 years in SEO, with at least 2 years owning outcomes (leads or revenue) for a multi-location or local-service business.
* Proven local SEO results - managed Google Business Profiles at scale (20+ locations) and moved local-pack rankings.
* Strong technical SEO - can run an audit, write clear tickets for developers, and verify fixes.
* Data-driven - Confident with Google Search Console, GA$ and Looker Studio, and comfortable tying SEO to CRM outcomes.
* Hands-on with SEMrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and a local rank tracker.
* Excellent Command on English Language - verbal & written, and the ability to brief writers and push work through Tech and Ops. Teams.

**Good to have -**

* Experience in EdTech, Kids, Healthcare, Fitness, Real Estate or other Parent or Local-Services Categories.
* Experience with AI search optimization (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity).

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Mobile Developer – Flutter (Android, iOS & Web)**

**Company:**
IRISS, Inc.

**Department:**
E Sentry Systems

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Required:**
3–5 Years

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRISS

**About IRISS**

IRISS is a global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide.

Headquartered in the United States, with manufacturing operations in Bradenton, Florida, and a global presence across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS develops innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected.

Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, improve reliability, and protect their people.

At the heart of everything we do is our guiding principle:
**We Humanize Safety.**

We are committed to developing advanced, intuitive technologies that empower people and transform how industries approach safety and reliability.

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Mobile Developer (Flutter)**
to join our E Sentry Systems team in Bengaluru, India.

This position will play an important role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality applications across Android, iOS, and Flutter Web platforms.

Our applications support industrial technicians in commissioning sensors, conducting inspections, and monitoring critical asset data, often in environments with limited or no network connectivity.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Flutter developer with strong Dart programming skills, experience building production-ready mobile applications, and the ability to troubleshoot native Android and iOS functionality.

You will collaborate closely with firmware engineers, backend developers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to develop reliable, scalable applications that integrate with connected hardware and industrial monitoring technologies.

This is a
**hands-on development role**
requiring ownership of application features from initial design and implementation through testing, deployment, and post-release support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Mobile Application Development**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain production-ready Flutter applications for Android, iOS, and web platforms.

* Deliver application features end to end, including user interfaces, state management, data persistence, networking, native integrations, and deployment.

* Apply Clean Architecture principles using feature-based modules and clear separation of presentation, domain, and data layers.

* Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable Flutter components.

* Implement state management solutions using Bloc and Riverpod.

* Translate Figma designs into responsive, accessible, and visually consistent interfaces.

* Optimize application performance across smartphones, tablets, and web browsers.

**Hardware Integration & Connectivity**

* Develop mobile applications that communicate with connected devices using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Near Field Communication (NFC), and related technologies.

* Integrate mobile applications with firmware systems and real-time sensor data streams.

* Implement reliable connectivity workflows that manage disconnections, timeouts, incomplete data, and device communication errors.

* Support sensor commissioning, inspection workflows, and industrial asset monitoring applications.

* Collaborate with firmware and hardware engineering teams to troubleshoot device integration issues.

**Offline Functionality & Data Management**

* Develop offline-first application workflows that operate reliably with limited or unavailable network connectivity.

* Implement local data persistence using SQLite, Drift, Isar, Hive, or comparable technologies.

* Develop synchronization mechanisms that maintain data integrity and resolve conflicts when connectivity is restored.

* Integrate REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, token refresh, secure credential storage, and reliable network communication.

* Implement appropriate error handling, retries, backoff strategies, and security measures.

**Android, iOS & Flutter Web Development**

* Develop and troubleshoot platform-specific functionality using Kotlin for Android and Swift for iOS.

* Implement Flutter platform channels and native plugins when required.

* Resolve platform-specific challenges involving application lifecycle events, permissions, background execution, and memory management.

* Manage Android build configurations, Gradle, R8/ProGuard, and platform-specific dependencies.

* Support iOS provisioning, signing, entitlements, CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, and App Store requirements.

* Develop and optimize Flutter Web applications, including navigation, deep linking, browser compatibility, rendering performance, and initial load times.

**Testing, Deployment & Application Performance**

* Develop and maintain unit, widget, golden, integration, and end-to-end automated tests.

* Conduct testing across supported devices, operating systems, and web environments.

* Maintain application build configurations, signing, release pipelines, and deployment processes.

* Support Google Play Store, Apple App Store, and web application releases.

* Implement CI/CD workflows using Codemagic, GitHub Actions, Fastlane, or comparable tools.

* Monitor application stability, crash reports, and production performance.

* Use Flutter DevTools to investigate performance issues, memory leaks, inefficient widget trees, and rendering problems.

* Troubleshoot production defects and implement verified corrective solutions.

**Agile Development & Collaboration**

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend developers, firmware engineers, and other technical stakeholders.

* Break development requirements into clearly defined, achievable tasks.

* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.

* Maintain high standards for code quality, documentation, application reliability, and long-term maintainability.

* Communicate development progress, technical challenges, and potential delivery risks.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3–5 years of professional mobile application development experience**
  , including at least
  **3 years developing and delivering Flutter applications into production**
  .

* Strong proficiency in
  **Flutter and Dart**
  , including asynchronous programming, streams, futures, isolates, generics, extensions, and null safety.

* Hands-on production experience with
  **both Bloc and Riverpod**
  state management solutions.

* Strong understanding of Clean Architecture, dependency inversion, repositories, use cases, and feature-based application design.

* In-depth knowledge of Flutter's widget, element, and render object trees, rendering lifecycle, widget keys, and performance optimization.

* Strong UI/UX development skills, including responsive layouts, typography, accessibility, animation, and accurate implementation of Figma designs.

* Experience developing and deploying
  **Flutter Web applications**
  .

* Practical Android development and debugging experience using
  **Kotlin**
  , including lifecycle management, permissions, foreground services, WorkManager, and build tools.

* Practical iOS development and debugging experience using
  **Swift**
  , including background execution, provisioning, signing, and native dependencies.

* Experience developing Flutter plugins or platform channels for native device functionality.

* Experience with local databases such as Drift/SQLite, Isar, or Hive, including schema management and migrations.

* Strong experience integrating REST APIs, authentication systems, secure storage, and reliable networking.

* Experience with automated Flutter testing frameworks such as flutter\_test, Mockito, Mocktail, bloc\_test, golden\_toolkit, alchemist, or integration\_test.

* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Codemagic, GitHub Actions, Fastlane, or comparable tools.

* Experience profiling and optimizing application performance using Flutter DevTools.

* Familiarity with navigation frameworks such as go\_router or auto\_route, including deep linking and push notifications.

* Experience with dependency injection using get\_it, injectable, Riverpod providers, or comparable solutions.

* Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.

* Strong analytical thinking, debugging capabilities, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing applications that integrate with
  **Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), NFC, sensors, or connected hardware devices**
  .

* Familiarity with industrial IoT applications, device commissioning, or asset monitoring technologies.

* Experience developing mapping, floor plan visualization, or indoor positioning features.

* Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Cloud Messaging, and Remote Config.

* Experience developing shared Flutter design systems or reusable component libraries.

* Knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and Flutter localization.

* Contributions to open-source Flutter projects or published packages on pub.dev.

* Experience integrating LLM-powered application features, including streaming responses, latency management, and error handling.

* Experience developing reliable offline-first mobile applications for field-based users.

Technology Environment

The successful candidate will work with modern mobile development technologies and tools supporting connected industrial applications.

**Mobile & Web Development**

* Flutter
* Dart
* Kotlin
* Swift
* Flutter Web

**Architecture & State Management**

* Clean Architecture
* Bloc
* Riverpod
* Feature-Based Modules
* Dependency Injection

**Data & Connectivity**

* REST APIs
* Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
* NFC
* SQLite / Drift
* Isar / Hive
* Offline Synchronization

**Testing & Performance**

* flutter\_test
* bloc\_test
* Mockito / Mocktail
* Golden Testing
* Integration Testing
* Flutter DevTools

**DevOps & Deployment**

* GitHub Actions
* Codemagic
* Fastlane
* Google Play Console
* Apple App Store Connect

**Collaboration & Development**

* Git
* Agile / Scrum
* Figma
* CI/CD Workflows

**What We're Looking For**

We are seeking a technically strong, detail-oriented developer who takes ownership of application development from design through release and monitoring.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently, making sound architectural decisions, and troubleshooting complex mobile application issues.

You should have a strong understanding of Flutter development and the ability to diagnose and resolve native Android and iOS problems without relying solely on AI-generated code.

We value developers who care about application performance, interface quality, maintainability, and the overall user experience.

This position offers opportunities for continued professional development and potential growth into technical leadership.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Deliver high-quality application features within agreed sprint timelines.

* Maintain stable, reliable applications across Android, iOS, and web platforms.

* Ensure critical application workflows are supported by appropriate automated testing.

* Identify and resolve defects before they impact customers.

* Maintain efficient, reliable deployment pipelines with minimal manual intervention.

* Deliver intuitive mobile experiences that support industrial technicians and connected-device workflows.

* Continuously improve application performance, reliability, and code maintainability.

**Why Join IRISS?**

At IRISS, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies that improve industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational performance worldwide.

You'll work with collaborative engineering teams developing connected technologies that support technicians and critical infrastructure operations.

As part of a growing global organization with a startup mindset, your ideas and contributions will have a meaningful impact on the products we develop.

We value initiative, practical problem-solving, technical expertise, and individuals who take ownership of their work.

**Join IRISS and help us advance our mission: We Humanize Safety.**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn by submitting an updated resume highlighting their Flutter development experience, production Android and iOS applications, Flutter Web projects, and native mobile integration skills.

Candidates with experience developing BLE/NFC-enabled applications, offline-first mobile solutions, or industrial IoT technologies are especially encouraged to apply.

description:

* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve code quality and engineering maturity.
* Support hiring and technical interviews for iOS roles.
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with product managers, designers, QA, and backend teams to define requirements, estimates, and delivery timelines.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take ownership of deliverables and ensure timely, high-quality releases in a fast-paced environment.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in iOS application development, with at least 2 - 4 years in a senior or lead role.
* Expert-level proficiency in Swift and deep understanding of iOS SDKs.
* Strong hands-on experience with SwiftUI and UIKit for building production-grade user interfaces.
* Proven experience in iOS SDK / framework development and maintaining reusable components.
* Strong expertise in MVVM, Clean Architecture, and modern iOS design patterns.
* Extensive experience writing unit tests and UI tests using XCTest and XCUITest.
* Experience with CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager (SPM) for dependency management.
* Solid understanding of multithreading, memory management (ARC), and performance optimization.
* Proven experience integrating RESTful APIs and applying networking best practices.
* Hands-on experience setting up or managing CI/CD pipelines for iOS applications.
* Proficiency with Git, Xcode, and iOS debugging and profiling tools (Instruments, LLDB).
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in service-based or client-driven organizations with multiple stakeholders.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience publishing and maintaining SDKs or internal frameworks used across multiple products or teams.
* Experience leading end-to-end delivery of large-scale iOS applications.
* Exposure to cross-platform architectures or shared business-logic layers.
* Experience with mobile security, data encryption, and secure API integration.
* Prior experience building or scaling an iOS team from the ground up.

**What We Offer**

* High-ownership leadership role in shaping the iOS platform and SDK ecosystem.
* Opportunity to build scalable mobile products and reusable SDK platforms.
* Strong influence on architecture, tooling, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented engineering culture.
* Competitive compensation and leadership growth opportunities.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
**About the role**
We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead Tesco's Mobile Platform team. This team owns the React Native platform, the shared libraries and tooling, and the Mobile CI/CD behind our mobile estate, which serves millions of customers and colleagues every day. Product app teams across Tesco build on what you provide, so your success shows up in their work: a reliable, well-documented platform, shorter and safer release cycles, fewer inconsistencies between apps, and quicker onboarding.
  
As a Software Development Manager, you are a Senior Engineering Team Leader at Tesco. You balance delivery for customers with the needs of the business and the growth of your people, and you stay hands-on. Your proficiency with foundational computer science and software engineering is taken as a given, and you bring proven technical depth and breadth across teams. You will work closely with the Head of Software Development, the senior engineer (SDE3) who sets the platform's technical direction, Lead Product Managers, and Lead UI/UX Designers, turning platform strategy into dependable delivery.
  
Mobile experience is essential for this role. You must have built, shipped, and run native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) in production at real scale. React Native or JavaScript skill on its own is not enough. We need someone who knows the mobile platform properly: app lifecycle, on-device performance, release and signing, and the app store processes.
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
What the team ownsThe React Native mobile platform, built on the Expo ecosystem (EAS, Expo Router), with the shared libraries, common patterns, and app scaffolding that app teams depend on, including how Tesco Digital Design System (DDS) components are pulled in.
  
The model for scaling React Native across many teams, including micro-app and super-app patterns (for example Module Federation with Re.Pack) where they fit.
  
Mobile CI/CD and release infrastructure: build, signing, test automation, distribution, store deployment, and over-the-air updates (EAS Update) for iOS and Android.
  
Developer experience: documentation, examples, a contribution model, migration tooling, and support for the teams that consume the platform.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesDelivery and platformLead the platform engineering team and own the processes and standards that help development succeed and keep improving.
  
Build and evolve the React Native platform and its shared libraries, and treat Mobile CI/CD as a product: fast, reliable pipelines, automated quality gates, application signing, and straightforward App Store and Google Play deployment.
  
Turn the platform direction you agree with the HOSD and the SDE3 into roadmaps, commitments, and shipped work, and make it easier for other teams to build on the platform through documentation, onboarding, and support.
  
Build platform capabilities for performance, scalability, accessibility (AA), and security from a single React Native codebase, and own incident response and root cause analysis.
  
Stakeholders and directionWork with product stakeholders to turn their needs into platform features, and with the HOSD, the SDE3, Lead PMs, and Lead Designers to keep the roadmap aligned.
  
Build agreement within the team on how to approach a solution, and clear the blockers in its way.
  
Use agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) where they genuinely help, and expect the team to use specs, skills, and agents across development, documentation, and testing.
  
People and capabilitySet clear objectives and career paths, review colleague performance, and act on it.
  
Build strong teams, spot and grow talent, and give the team room to innovate.
  
Raise the hiring bar through mentoring, interviewing, and sharing what you know with the wider engineering community.
  
  
  
**You will need**
QualificationsMobile engineering experience (essential): hands-on experience building and shipping native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) to the App Store and Google Play, and running them in production. This is a firm requirement. We want real mobile platform depth, not web engineers moving across through React Native.
  
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.
  
At least 10 years in software engineering at enterprise or product companies, including time leading or managing engineers, with a good part of it spent on mobile.
  
A track record of building platforms, shared libraries, or developer tooling that other teams use (strongly preferred).
  
Technical SkillsDeep mobile platform fundamentals (essential): hands-on native iOS (Swift or Objective-C) and/or Android (Kotlin or Java), covering app lifecycle, on-device memory and performance, threading, and native module development, which underpin your React Native work.
  
Four or more years building React Native apps with the Expo ecosystem (Expo SDKs, Expo Router, EAS), with a solid grasp of JSI, native modules, and bridging to native iOS and Android.
  
Strong JavaScript and TypeScript (modern ES6 and later), and strong React principles, Hooks, Context API, and component lifecycles.
  
Experience designing and building large front-end or platform systems and shared libraries used by many teams, with sound state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or MobX) and caching.
  
Mobile CI/CD depth: Git and GitHub, CI pipelines, EAS build and submit, application signing, over-the-air updates (EAS Update), and a thorough understanding of the iOS and Android deployment lifecycles and store guidelines (App Store, Google Play).
  
Performance profiling for production apps (Android and iOS profilers), packaging and build tooling (Webpack, Babel), and dependency and release management for shared libraries.
  
Integrating mobile apps with backend APIs (GraphQL or REST), and accessibility to AA standards.
  
Testing frameworks: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, and Appium.
  
Confident use of agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) across development, documentation, and testing, plus familiarity with MCP integrations and deep linking.
  
Process and Soft SkillsComfortable with Agile methods (Scrum or Kanban), and with JIRA, Confluence, and well-formed epics, stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
Able to apply different delivery processes and knows when each one fits.
  
A self-starter who takes ownership, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
Well organised, with good time management.
  
Clear written and verbal communication.
  
What we offerRelocation help: a professional service to secure the work permits and other documents you need.
  
Learning opportunities: certified technical training and platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, and O'Reilly.
  
A learning culture, with good opportunities to develop your career in your chosen field or in something new.
  
Varied projects to work on, with something new always in the pipeline.
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
  
 
  
When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.
