title: Senior Mobile Engineer - IoT / Connected Products
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on
**Senior Mobile Engineer with real connected-product / IoT experience**
to build and take long-term technical ownership of the mobile experience behind Pro Breeze connected products.
  
  
Based from our
**Bengaluru office**
, you will work with teams across the UK, India, China and other markets, helping us build a high-quality software experience around a growing range of connected consumer products.
  
  
**This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who has personally shipped production mobile applications that connect to real physical products. Please do not apply if your experience is primarily standard mobile apps, websites or dashboards without device connectivity.**
This is not a narrow development role where requirements are fully specified and handed over as tickets. We need someone who can take a broad product objective, understand the underlying problem, shape a practical solution, build it, test it properly and support it in production.
  
  
You will help us build, improve and scale the mobile experience across a growing range of connected products, working closely with product development, design, customer experience and our teams in China.
  
  
You should be highly comfortable using
**modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools**
to work significantly faster, while still taking full responsibility for security, reliability, maintainability and the quality of what is released.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build and Own the Mobile Experience**

* Build, maintain and continuously improve our connected-product mobile app across iOS and Android.
* Turn product ideas and rough briefs into clear, reliable customer-facing software.
* Build consistent and intuitive experiences across different connected appliances.
* Own functionality including accounts, device onboarding, pairing, product control, notifications, support journeys and analytics.
* Take responsibility for App Store and Google Play releases and ongoing compatibility.

**Connected Products & IoT**

* Integrate mobile applications with real connected consumer products using technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE and third-party IoT platforms.
* Build reliable onboarding, pairing and device-control experiences.
* Diagnose real-world connectivity and device-control problems across different phones, networks, products and environments.
* Work with product development and our China teams when issues cross between the mobile app, connected-device platform, firmware and physical product.
* Help evaluate technical approaches that improve reliability, customer experience and development speed.
* Test extensively against real devices rather than relying only on emulators or ideal conditions.

**AI-Native Engineering**

* Use modern coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as part of your normal engineering workflow.
* Use AI to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation without lowering engineering standards.
* Know when generated code is wrong, unsafe or unnecessarily complex and be able to correct it.
* Continuously improve how agentic development can allow a small engineering team to deliver at high speed.

**Production Ownership & Quality**

* Own features from initial problem through implementation, testing, release and production support.
* Investigate root causes rather than repeatedly patching symptoms.
* Build reliable error handling, logging, monitoring and analytics into the application.
* Write maintainable software and avoid unnecessary complexity or rewrites.
* Take security, authentication, customer data and connected-device reliability seriously.
* Make sensible technical trade-offs rather than automatically building the most complex solution.

**Cross-Functional Working**

* Work directly with senior leadership, product development, design, customer experience and our China teams.
* Explain technical issues and trade-offs clearly in plain English.
* Challenge requirements where there is a safer, simpler or better solution.
* Work independently and take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

**Essential**
**What We’re Looking For**

* Already operating at Senior Mobile Engineer level, with strong evidence of independently owning production software.
* Strong professional experience shipping mobile applications to both iOS and Android.
* Personally shipped at least one production mobile application that connects to or controls real physical devices.
* Hands-on experience with BLE, Wi-Fi or comparable connected-device technologies.
* Experience debugging issues involving both mobile software and physical devices.
* Strong experience with APIs, authentication, push notifications, application state and production monitoring.
* Experience releasing and maintaining applications through the Apple App Store and Google Play.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and the judgement to design maintainable systems.
* Regular, meaningful use of modern AI-assisted development tools.
* Comfortable working from our Bengaluru office five days per week.

We care more about evidence of ownership, technical judgement and what you have actually shipped than simply the number of years on your CV.
  
  
**Highly Desirable**
Experience in some of the following areas would be particularly valuable:
  
  

* Consumer IoT platforms and mobile SDKs
* Mobile device provisioning and onboarding
* IoT cloud platforms
* Connected-device protocols
* OTA firmware update workflows
* Cross-platform mobile development such as React Native or Flutter
* Native iOS or Android development
* Consumer appliances or other mass-market connected products
* Working closely with embedded or firmware engineers
* Connected-device security and authentication

You do
**not**
need to be an embedded hardware or firmware specialist. We are primarily looking for someone who can own the mobile/software side of the connected-product experience and work effectively with specialists where deeper embedded expertise is required.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
You will help us build a high-quality, differentiated connected-product experience that Pro Breeze can own and evolve over time.
  
  
You will take technical ownership of the mobile experience, improve how customers connect to and control products, and create reliable software that can scale with a growing connected-product range.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of an important customer-facing product rather than becoming one developer within a large engineering organisation.

title: Engineering Manager
description:

We are looking for a CJA Developer to build and maintain features across a React Native mobile app and a React web app, with a focus on Adobe Customer Journey Analytics integration. You will work in a TypeScript codebase, write tested and maintainable code, and handle health data responsibly in line with security, privacy, and HIPAA requirements. \*\*Required Skills\*\*
  
  

* JavaScript and TypeScript.
* REST API integration and state management using React Query.
* Adobe Analytics experience, ideally Adobe Experience Platform or Customer Journey Analytics, or strong general web and mobile analytics event tracking experience that is transferable.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a frontend developer with a designer's eye to build Sarvam's web experiences. You'll start with our marketing website: the homepage, product and use-case pages, interactive demos and calculators. You'll write production code, build reusable UI systems and turn rough ideas into polished interfaces, working closely with design, marketing and product engineering.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Build the interface, not just the mockup. Write production-ready Astro and React components with thoughtful layouts, typography and responsive behaviour. Own the implementation from first prototype to the final browser-sized detail.
* Build a UI system that holds together. Create reusable components, layout primitives and shared styles with clear APIs and sensible variants. Make the next page easier to build without turning every component into a 40-prop puzzle.
* Make it feel right. Build interactions, transitions and animations that make interfaces clearer and more enjoyable. Think through keyboard use, loading, empty and error states, reduced motion and what happens when the happy path isn't so happy.
* Prototype in code. Explore alternative layouts and interactions with designers, test ideas in the browser and refine the details together. You should be comfortable suggesting a better implementation, not waiting for every pixel and breakpoint to be specified.
* Build the useful bits properly. Develop interactive demos, calculators and forms; connect thm to APIs and content. Handle state, validation, asynchronous behaviour and failures. Keep accessibility, performance, metadata and measurement working as part of what you ship.
* Own the engineering quality. Make sound choices about component structure, rendering and hydration. Debug browser and performance issues, write appropriate tests, review code and check preview deployments. Ship maintainable changes that work beyond your own laptop.
* Astro, React, TypeScript and CSS are at the core of the work. We use GitHub for code review and Railway for development and pull-request previews. Sanity, ImageKit and PostHog support content, media and measurement. You'll work with engineering on staging and production releases.

****Requirements****

* Have built and shipped interfaces you're proud to put your name on. Show us the actual thing, what you coded and the decisions you made. A live link beats a paragraph of adjectives.
* Have strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React experience. You can work effectively in Astro and reason about component composition, state, rendering and browser behaviour.
* Have a good eye for visual design and the CSS skills to act on it. You care about spacing, type, hierarchy, responsive layouts and interaction details, and can turn that judgement into working code.
* Can work across design and engineering. You're comfortable starting from a rough brief, prototyping options and discussing trade-offs with designers. You can also take an established design and implement it faithfully.
* Can debug an unfamiliar frontend, integrate APIs and use Git, pull requests and automated checks confidently. You understand accessibility and web performance, and handle credentials and user data responsibly.
* Use AI coding tools with judgement. Let them help you move faster. Read the diff, test the result and be able to explain what you're shipping. 'The model wrote it' isn't a debugging strategy.
* Ask good questions when the brief is fuzzy. Explain trade-offs, suggest a practical way forward and use evidence before declaring that something needs fixing.

****Bonus points that are not dealbreakers****

* You've built for B2B SaaS, developer tools or AI products.
* You've built component libraries, design systems or interactive prototypes that other people actually use.
* You've worked with animation, SVG, Canvas or other techniques that make complex ideas easier to explore on the web.
* You've used a headless CMS such as Sanity, or worked on technical SEO and analytics integrations without letting them take over the frontend.

****How to apply****
Skip the generic cover letter. Send us a couple of interfaces or web projects you've built, with a short note on what you personally designed and coded. Pick one and walk us through a component, interaction or tricky engineering decision. Code samples are welcome where you can share them.
  
  
If there's a side project you're weirdly proud of, we'd like to see that too.
  
  
****Why Sarvam?****
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
  
  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Product Solution Engineer, Product Support
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
In this role, you will act as the first line of engineering defense: driving manual APK releases and OTA deployments, managing third-party integrations, triaging live production crashes, and debugging partner outages. You will bridge the gap between core developers, external integration partners, and operations to maximize developer bandwidth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Production Incident Management & Debugging: Triage, investigate, and diagnose production issues across custom POS terminals, headless apps, and integrated merchant hardware. Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to conduct initial Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and escalate actionable bug reports to core engineering.
* Partner & Vendor Integration Support: Act as the technical point of contact for external partners and hardware vendors (e.g., transit authorities, oil merchants). Assist third-party engineering teams with SDK onboarding, client configuration updates, and end-to-end integration debugging.
* Log Analysis & Outage Investigation: Capture, inspect, and analyze system, device, and network logs during active vendor downtime or transaction failures to pinpoint points of failure across devices, SDKs, and backend services.
* Release & Deployment Management: Coordinate manual APK release processes and custom Over-The-Air (OTA) updates for production terminals operating outside the standard Google Play ecosystem.
* Support Tooling & Automation: Develop lightweight scripts, utilities, and internal tools to automate repetitive diagnostic tasks, log parsing, configuration pushes, and reporting workflows.
* Monitoring & Metrics: Track app crash rates, operational health metrics, and transaction telemetry across deployed fleets to proactively spot anomalies before they impact merchants.

**Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience
* Proven success working in a fast-paced production support environment
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in writing, with a successful track record of responding to and resolving customer issues
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to effectively work and collaborate with cross-functional teams
* Possess the ability to understand business problems and provide data, solutions, or information related to business requirements

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on Android Foundation: Practical experience building or maintaining at least one Android application. Must have a working understanding of the Android lifecycle, basic app architecture, and debugging workflows.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Hands-on proficiency using adb, reading Android Logcat, analyzing stack traces, and inspecting network traffic/API payloads (REST APIs, HTTP status codes, JSON).
* Scripting & Tooling: Ability to write basic scripts (Python, Shell, or Bash) to parse logs, automate routines, or interact with APIs.
* Understanding of Constrained Environments: Familiarity with Android development constraints (working with XML layouts, memory limits, and background execution). Experience with custom Android builds, AOSP, or devices lacking Google Play Services is a strong plus.
* Communication & Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical issues clearly to third-party partners (e.g., Hitachi), merchant teams, and internal engineering leads.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in fintech, POS terminal development, payment gateways, or payment SDK integrations (e.g., card payment rails, UPI, transit/NCMC implementations).
* Familiarity with hardware/software payment certification lifecycles (L1, L2, L3 certifications across RuPay, Visa, Mastercard).
* Exposure to fleet device management, soundboxes, or smart payment hardware deployments.

**Additional Information**
PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
  
  
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
  
  
Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. title: Software Engineer (Java, React, Wireless)
description:
Cisco Wireless, a division of Cisco Networking, is a cloud and on-prem managed IT company and leader in Wi-Fi, wireless and security. Our intuitive platform enables organizations of all sizes to deliver customer and employee experiences at scale. To provide best-in-class technologies to our customers, we've created an outstanding company culture for our employees. One where a diverse set of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences craft our work and fuel our evolution. One that is collaborative, flexible, and inclusive and provides employees with the autonomy to develop technology that's accessible and secure for everyone.
  
Cisco Wireless Software Engineers breathe life into our on-prem, cloud-managed network-attached devices, which include wireless controllers, Access Points. We use real-time telemetry from thousands of deployed networks spanning the globe to continuously improve the performance and stability of our products. We are passionate about building real products that our customers love.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As part of the Team, you would define, develop, validate and automate the features that help the customer to manage the wireless networks. The team member is entrusted to understand the functionality, how it can be presented to the customer in a meaningful and efficient manner, implement it. As part of this, the engineer is expected to collaborate with various teams including PM, cross functional teams and TMEs.
  
  
The engineer is expected to design and implement the features defined on time with quality.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree with 4+ years of experience Or Masters degree with 2+ years of experience.
* Java, ReactJS
* Python
* Proficient in usage of AI
* Networking Knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Expertise in Cypress
* Wireless Domain knowledge
* Database design and query optimisation.
* Quick Learner

#wirelesshiring
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Software Engineer - UI Test
description:
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers.

The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We do manual and automated testing, including developing the test infrastructure needed. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

**UI Test team responsibilities:**

* Feature qualification:
* + The UI Test team qualifies new features from the end-user point of view (UI) for all Rubrik products before rolling out to production. We make sure every feature adheres to the quality standards and integrates well with the rest of the product.
  + Maintains high quality bar in test processes, strategy and test execution.
* Release regression testing:
* + All released features are regression tested in every release, on a cadence that depends on the product, with both manual and automated UI testing.
* Automation:

  + New features enter the automation backlog after release and are picked up by priority. UI Automation using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright.
  + Infrastructure automation/maintenance using Python.
  + Automated test pipelines in a CI/CD system
  + Each phase of the testing life cycle is getting automated. Using AI-assisted tooling to generate test cases from product artifacts, execute them against real environments to reduce manual qualification effort.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field
* 5-8 years of experience in software testing, UI testing and automation
* Solid understanding on data protection, storage, security, virtualization, databases, cloud, kubernetes and generative AI
* Familiarity with UI performance and accessibility testing.
* Working knowledge of microservices, API, cloud native architectures and how to test them
* Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, AI resilience. A cloud certification is an advantage.
* Deep experience in driving complete test life cycle (test planning, execution, automation) and release qualification. Test management using TestRail or equivalent is a plus.
* Good hands-on experience programming in Python or equivalent and UI automation using TestIM, Selenium, Playwright or equivalent. JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge is a plus.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding or testing assistants in test authoring, debugging or automation, and sound judgment about the quality of their output.
* Hands on experience in creating, triaging and maintaining automated test pipeline using Jenkins, GitHub or similar CI/CD tools
* Strong written and verbal communication, including documentation that others can pick up without a handoff.

**Key differentiating factors:**

* Due to the unique placement of the team, it is exposed to multiple key technologies of Rubrik products.
* This opportunity is not just another manual testing or automation role, key factor is the exposure and opportunity to learn core technologies of data protection, storage, security, anti ransomware, Virtualization(Hyper-V, VMware), Databases (SQL, Oracle, Mongo, DB2), cloud technologies (Azure, Google, AWS), Kubernetes, and cutting edge features involving Generative AI etc.
* Exposure to automated infrastructure creation and clean up on various platforms like VMware, Azure, AWS etc.
* Hands-on work with AI-based tools for test authoring, execution and automation.
* Automation using latest AI based tools
* Every team member is given equal opportunity to lead releases on a rotational basis giving them opportunities to learn the release process and develop their leadership skills.
* Ownership opportunities: every member in the team irrespective of the designation has end-end ownership right from PRD review, test case development, interaction with key stakeholders( like Product manager, program managers, component managers and developers), execution and reporting

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About the AI Platform Team**

The AI Platform team is one of Rippling's highest-priority engineering investments and sits at the center of the company's broader AI strategy. The team is building the foundational infrastructure that powers AI capabilities across Rippling's entire product ecosystem, including HR, Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Workforce Management. Rather than building standalone chatbots or simple LLM integrations, the team focuses on creating deeply integrated AI systems that understand Rippling's rich business context, permissions model, workflows, and enterprise data.

The team is developing core platform capabilities such as AI agents, workflow automation engines, evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, data pipelines, and self-healing systems that can identify issues, surface insights, and help automate complex enterprise workflows. These systems operate with real business context, approvals, permissions, and auditability requirements, enabling customers to safely delegate operational tasks while maintaining control and governance.

One of the unique aspects of Rippling AI is that it is built directly on top of Rippling's unified data model and permission system. The platform can reason across HR, IT, Payroll, and Finance data while respecting access controls and providing verifiable outputs. The team is solving challenging problems around agent orchestration, workflow execution, reliability, permissions, evaluations, observability, data quality, and scalable AI infrastructure.

This is an ideal environment for engineers who enjoy building large-scale backend and platform systems, working through ambiguity, and owning products end-to-end. Engineers on the team are highly hands-on, spend the majority of their time coding, and have the opportunity to shape how AI becomes a core part of enterprise software. The role offers significant ownership, visibility, and a strong path toward Staff-level engineering scope over time.

**What you will do:**

* Build foundational AI platform systems that support Rippling’s broader AI strategy across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, recruiting, compliance, and internal workflows.
* Work as a deeply hands-on Senior Software Engineer, with around 60% of time expected to be spent coding, debugging, reviewing code, and owning implementation.
* Contribute to the design and build-out of AI platform capabilities such as background agents, automated workflows, evaluation systems, data pipelines, and model quality feedback loops.
* Help build systems that allow AI agents to automate repetitive enterprise workflows with the right permissions, controls, approvals, and auditability.
* Work on platform systems that support self-healing and self-improving workflows, where AI can detect negative product signals and help identify root causes.
* Partner with Staff Engineers, Product, Infra, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders to convert ambiguous product/platform problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Own well-defined to moderately ambiguous components end-to-end — from design and implementation to testing, launch, monitoring, and iteration.
* Participate actively in design discussions, code reviews, debugging, production support, and operational improvements.
* Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend/platform systems that can support Rippling’s product ecosystem.

**What’s exciting about this role:**

* This is not a generic chatbot or lightweight LLM wrapper role. The team is building core AI platform infrastructure that can make Rippling’s product surface more autonomous, context-aware, and self-improving.
* Engineers will get exposure to AI agents, automated enterprise workflows, self-healing systems, and custom intelligence layers built around Rippling-specific product context.
* The role offers strong learning, ownership, and growth opportunities for engineers who want to work at the intersection of backend/platform engineering and AI infrastructure.
* This is a strong opportunity for a high-potential Senior Engineer to grow toward Staff-level scope over time.
* Rippling AI is a high-priority company initiative, and the team needs strong Senior Engineers who can add meaningful hands-on execution capacity.
* The AI Platform team is lean and supports a broad set of internal engineering and product stakeholders, creating a need for engineers who can ramp quickly and contribute with high ownership.
* The team needs builders who are strong in backend/platform engineering and are comfortable working on scalable production systems.
* The systems being built involve complex areas such as workflows, permissions, approvals, data quality, reliability, evaluations, and automation.
* Generic LLMs do not fully understand Rippling’s proprietary workflows, policy logic, query language, company data, and permissions, so the team needs engineers who can help build AI infrastructure around Rippling’s real product context.
* The team moves fast, and candidates need to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities, and rapid iteration.
* Coding is a core expectation for this role; this cannot be filled by someone who is not actively hands-on.
* Start by owning meaningful components within AI Platform initiatives such as background agents, workflow automation, evaluations, data pipelines, or self-healing systems.
* Grow from owning individual components to owning larger services, workflows, or platform modules end-to-end. Build depth in Rippling’s product context, AI platform systems, infrastructure, and internal engineering patterns.
* Partner closely with Staff Engineers and senior technical leaders to learn how larger architecture and platform decisions are made. Increase influence through high-quality coding, strong debugging, reliable execution, thoughtful design input, and ownership after launch.
* Over time, grow toward Staff-level expectations by taking on more ambiguous problems, mentoring other engineers, and influencing broader technical direction.
* Become a trusted engineer who can independently deliver scalable, reliable, production-grade systems with limited hand-holding. Ability to ramp quickly into Rippling’s AI platform, codebase, product context, and internal systems.
* Strong hands-on coding contribution, with approximately 60% of time spent coding and implementation-focused work.
* Ability to independently own features, components, services, or workflows from design to production. Delivery of reliable, scalable, maintainable backend/platform systems.
* Strong execution quality across coding, testing, debugging, observability, and operational ownership.
* Ability to work well with Product, Infra, Platform, Staff Engineers, and other engineering stakeholders.
* Strong engineering fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design, distributed systems, concurrency, and production debugging.
* Demonstrated curiosity and learning agility around AI agents, LLM infrastructure, automation systems, evaluation loops, and data/ML infrastructure.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
* Positive contribution to team quality through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and mentoring junior engineers where needed.

**What you need to have:**

* 5–8 years of overall software engineering experience, preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or product engineering.
* Strong hands-on coding ability; 60% coding is non-negotiable. Must be comfortable writing production-quality code, reviewing code, debugging issues, and owning implementation details.
* Strong programming knowledge in one or more backend/general-purpose languages such as Python, Java, Go/Golang, C++, Scala, Kotlin, or C#.
* Language should not be the only filter — coding fundamentals, system design depth, distributed systems exposure, and ability to build production-scale systems are more important.
* Experience building and operating scalable backend/platform systems in production.
* Good understanding of system design, API design, databases, data modeling, concurrency, observability, and production troubleshooting. Ability to independently own well-defined to moderately ambiguous technical problems from design to execution, launch, and iteration.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced product engineering environment with changing priorities and high ownership.
* Strong collaboration skills with Product, Infra, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders. Good product judgment and ability to understand how engineering decisions impact customers and business outcomes.
* Ability to contribute to design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and team quality.
* For AI Platform specifically, practical curiosity or exposure to AI agents, LLM infrastructure, agentic workflows, ML/data infrastructure, inference pipelines, evaluations, automation systems, or adjacent AI systems is a strong plus.

**What would be nice to have:**

* Prior experience in a high-growth or hyper-growth startup / product-led technology company.
* Recent hands-on exposure to AI agents, LLM tooling, AI infrastructure, automation platforms, evaluation systems, or data/ML pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of Python for AI/ML infrastructure, automation, agents, scripting, evaluations, or data pipelines.
* Strong SQL knowledge for querying, data-heavy systems, analytics, workflow systems, reporting, and enterprise intelligence use cases.
* Experience with Go, Java, C++, or Scala in backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments.
* Exposure to TypeScript / JavaScript if the role involves full-stack, internal tooling, dashboards, or product surface ownership.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, background automation, reliability platforms, internal tools, or developer productivity platforms.
* Exposure to permissions, approvals, auditability, compliance, or security-sensitive workflows.
* Prior exposure to fintech, HR tech, payroll, benefits, compliance, IT, enterprise SaaS, or workflow-heavy platforms.
* Clear evidence of learning quickly, taking ownership, and operating well in ambiguous environments.

**Technical Skills:**

* 5–8 years of strong software engineering experience Preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or product engineering.
* 60% hands-on coding is non-negotiable Candidate must be actively writing, reviewing, debugging, and owning production code. This is not a coordination-only or design-only role.
* Strong coding ability in at least one backend/general-purpose language
* Preferred languages: Python, Java, Go/Golang, C++, Scala, Kotlin, or C#. Scalable backend/platform systems exposure
* Should have worked on production systems involving APIs, databases, reliability, observability, debugging, and scale.
* Ownership mindset Should be able to independently own features/components end-to-end, work through moderate ambiguity, and drive execution without constant hand-holding.
* Strong learning agility and AI/platform curiosity For AI Platform, candidate should show practical curiosity or exposure to AI agents, LLM infrastructure, automation systems, ML/data infra, inference, evaluations, or adjacent AI systems.

title: Platform Software Engineer - GoLang, Kubernetes (4 - 8 yrs)
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Our team is engineering a next-generation platform infrastructure to enable agentic, closed-loop network automation and orchestration for service providers and large enterprise networks. You will play a crucial role in driving and building the Kubernetes (K8s) infrastructure that powers our next-generation software solutions. On our team, you will gain hands-on experience building robust, highly scalable, and reliable distributed systems that make modern infrastructure seamless and efficient. See what becomes possible when deep technical expertise meets innovation, as we architect the resilient solutions that transform how we work, live, learn, and play.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a software developer on our team, you will be a driving force behind crafting user-friendly, reliable software and tools for our next-generation SaaS platform infrastructure. You will balance expanding our software capabilities with hardware compatibility considerations while having the opportunity to influence key development decisions. We offer diverse opportunities across Development, Security, and Test& Quality. You are a collaborative communicator with strong organizational skills and a passion for solving sophisticated challenges. Driven and resourceful, you excel at managing your time, streamlining processes, and delivering high-quality results on schedule. Join us to apply your problem-solving skills and contribute to innovative software solutions that make a significant impact.

* Platform Engineering: Design, implement, and scale multi-region Kubernetes clusters across private and public cloud infrastructure.
* Automation& CI/CD: Build robust automation pipelines and tooling for cluster provisioning, upgrades, patching, and configuration management.
* Security& Compliance: Implement and enforce strict security baselines and vulnerability management across all container environments.
* Technical Leadership: Participate in technical design reviews and drive architectural decisions that shape the future of our next-generation infrastructure.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of professional work experience.
* Strong grasp of software development fundamentals.
* Proficiency in coding, testing, and debugging.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience designing and delivering complex software solutions.
* Proficiency in Go, Python, or Java.
* Experience building, operating, or extending Kubernetes-based platforms or distributed systems.

* Proficiency in Linux, networking fundamentals, and operating system principles.
* Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, web application development, and distributed system design.
* Programming expertise in Go, Java, or Python, with a strong focus on Kubernetes and open-source.
* Solid understanding of software design, algorithms, and clean coding practices.
* Experience using AI-powered tools to enhance development efficiency and streamline workflows.
* Familiarity with computer networking and cybersecurity best practices.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Manager
description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming outstanding products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This, in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. We are, in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We’re looking for a talented individual who is passionate about crafting, implementing, and operating AI solutions that have a direct and measurable impact on Apple Sales and its customers. We’re seeking a visionary Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)/QE Engineering Manager to own and test end-to-end application workflows using AI. This role will focus on implementing and maintaining QE frameworks, instrumentation, and workflows that help us understand how well our applications perform, where they fail, and how they improve over time. This role will operate in both capacities, to augment existing AI roadmap, as well as innovate and trailblazing new frontier tech projects, crafting AI experiences that reduce time to insights and catalyze decision making.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a QE manager, you will build and lead a team of engineers as a part of a global horizontal Quality Engineering group focused on a breadth of technologies and applications including very highly scalable distributed applications, No-SQL platforms, internal search platforms, end customer facing websites and services, critical security systems, machine learning and anomaly detection systems, software-load balancing, among others. Build, develop, innovate, and retain a hard-working team of quality engineers and build an environment where they can thrive and succeed. Act as a role model for your team when it comes to getting things done and exceeding expectations. Your skills in relationship management and partnership should be outstanding as this role requires to quickly understand and respond to peer teams’ needs and work with management and engineering leadership, developers, quality engineers, project managers, and multi-functional teams who take ownership in building outstanding scalable solutions. You will work in a fast-paced software development environment and continuously enhance our automation infrastructure to move towards continuous deployment where every code change is thoroughly tested and considered ready to be deployed. You will be the quality DRI on product features. To be successful, you will need to supervise and communicate release readiness, identify any gaps, and consistently assess new and innovative ways to improve automation solutions. While the primary role is leading/managing employees, you should have deep technical knowledge of distributed systems and cloud computing, platform as a service, and microservices architecture. We expect that you have strong experience working with short release cycles, do not hesitate to code, and actively participate in design and code reviews.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years in Quality roles testing and automating large scale customer-facing systems with sophisticated distributed integrations
* 3+ years managing quality engineers responsible for qualifying features through the complete software development life cycle
* Ability to act as a leader to increase efficiency through process improvements and automation, increase test coverage through automation, reduce customer-impacting defects, make informed risk-based decisions, and improve chances of success and promote software testing standards and mentor engineers in the team
* Ability to build, drive and support automation test strategy. Dedication to delivering great software and releasing it quickly, efficiently, and with growing quality. (white box + black box, automation, functional, performance, stress testing)
* Excellent knowledge of QE automation architecture, methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Hands on in automating functional, system and integration tests. Experience in tools like Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber-JVM, Appium for API, Web, iOS and MacOS platforms.
* Experience creating multiple test frameworks from scratch. Experience in Java or Python, familiar with databases, SQL, and scripting languages.
* Understanding of REST and RESTful services.
* Applied knowledge of GenAI, micro-services, recommendation systems, and context engineering.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation concepts such as Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and experience with different LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)
* Experience with CI/CD or release validation workflows, deployment process and code quality checking tools.
* Knowledge of project management, and productivity tools such as Wrike and Miro.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.
* Able to balance competing priorities, long-term projects, and ad hoc requirements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, constantly evolving business environment.
* Working across global teams to ensure alignment of product development.
* We're looking for someone with an eagerness and ability to learn new skills and solve dynamic problems in an encouraging and expansive environment.
* Ability to collaborate and influence multi-functional teams within your area of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Collaborate with multi-functional and globally distributed teams

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Highly organised, creative, motivated, and passionate about achieving results.
* Creative thinker and strong problem solver with meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
* An enthusiasm for user-focused design & high-quality products.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate close interaction with development teams, management, and other teams within Apple

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

description:

**What we offer:**
------------------

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

**Group Summary:**
------------------

Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Job title:**

Engineer Functional Software

  

**Job Introduction:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Automotive Software Developer with strong expertise in Model-Based Development (MBD) using MATLAB/Simulink, Stateflow, and TargetLink. The candidate will be responsible for developing, software build, validating, and testing automotive embedded software features on ECU Test Bench.

**Major Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop automotive embedded software using Model-Based Design (MBD) methodologies.
* Analyze software requirements and translate them into executable models and software components.
* Create, maintain, and enhance MATLAB/Simulink and Stateflow models for control applications.
* Perform auto-code generation using TargetLink and support software integration activities.
* Ensure compliance with coding guidelines, modeling standards, and project-specific requirements.
* Integrate generated code into target ECU
* Perform software functional testing and debugging
* Conduct static and dynamic verification activities
* Support software releases and configuration management activities.
* Perform ECU bench testing and debugging using laboratory test setups.
* Perform trace analysis and debugging using Vector CANoe, CANalyzer and CANape

**Knowledge and Education:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering required (Electrical, electronics preferred).
* Knowledge on AUTOSAR.
* Knowledge on SDLC.
* Knowledge on ASPICE.
* Knowledge on ISO26262.

**Work Experience:**

  

* 4 to 6 years of experience on functional software development.
* Experience on MIL and SIL testing
* Experience on Performing Static Analysis checks.
* Experience on Model based development, MXAM, MAAB.
* Powertrain experience preferred.

**Skills and Competencies:**

  

* Good Analytical skill.
* Debugging skill.
* **Tools**: MATLAB (Simulink and State flow), Targetlink, Embedded coder, Simulink Test, GitHub and Vector Tools (Canoe, CanAnalyzer and CanApe).
* Knowledge on Powertrain components

Maintains safe work practices, complies with Magna H&S requirements, and participates in training and hazard reporting.

----------------------------------

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
------------------------------------

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. Job Description: Senior BFF / Integration API Developer

  

Role: Senior Backend for Frontend (BFF) / Integration API Developer

  

Experience: 8–10 years

  

Role Type: Senior Developer

  
  

An experienced Senior BFF / Integration API Developer to design, develop, and deliver backend-for-frontend services and enterprise integration APIs supporting digital onboarding journeys. The role will focus on orchestrating existing enterprise APIs and backend services to provide secure, performant, and channel-optimized services for frontend applications.

Design and develop Backend for Frontend (BFF) services supporting digital onboarding journeys across web and mobile channels.

title: Senior Python Engineer Systems and Edge Computing
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

**Job Description**

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research.

**How will you make an impact**

We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with 6–10 years of software engineering experience and substantial hands-on Python development. You will build backend services, system automation and device-management capabilities connecting scientific instruments, IoT gateways and edge devices. The role combines software design with practical Linux systems engineering, secure deployment, diagnostics and operational ownership across device, network and application layers.

**What will you do**

* Design, develop and maintain modular Python services, APIs, command-line tools and automation libraries for device orchestration, process execution, configuration and data handling.
* Manage IoT and edge-device lifecycles, including discovery, secure onboarding, provisioning, inventory, configuration, health monitoring and controlled decommissioning.
* Integrate instruments, sensors and gateways through vendor SDKs, REST or gRPC APIs and messaging protocols such as MQTT; validate commands, telemetry and device state.
* Automate deployment and version tracking of applications and containers on Linux edge systems; support-controlled software and firmware updates with compatibility checks, staged rollout and rollback or recovery.
* Troubleshoot failures across Python code, operating-system services, networking, containers and hardware interfaces; implement structured logging, metrics, alerts and diagnostic collection.
* Develop unit, integration and system tests using pytest, mocks, simulators and physical devices; integrate validation and deployment workflows into CI/CD.
* Apply secure engineering practices, including device authentication, certificate and secret management, least-privilege access, dependency scanning and auditable change records.
* Collaborate with firmware, hardware, QA, DevOps and product teams on requirements, interfaces and release readiness; mentor engineers and maintain deployment guides, runbooks and onboarding documentation.
* Work effectively within an Agile Scrum / SAFe framework, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery.

**Required Skills**

* Strong production Python development with object-oriented design, reusable modules, exception handling, concurrency, API integration, file operations and structured data such as JSON, YAML and CSV.
* Familiarity on development experience in C/C++ integration, PowerShell, BDD/Robot Framework, hardware-in-the-loop testing or scientific and regulated product environments.
* Hands-on systems engineering on Linux, including processes, services, permissions, resource usage, shell scripting and network diagnostics; ability to support Windows integration where needed.
* Practical experience deploying, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting physical IoT devices, industrial gateways or edge-computing systems, beyond cloud-only application development.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MQTT and HTTP-based communication, with an understanding of device connectivity, authentication and offline recovery.
* Experience building Python backend services with FastAPI, Flask or equivalent, and integrating databases or local persistence for configuration, telemetry and operational state.
* Hands-on Git and CI/CD experience, plus automated testing, mocking and dependency/environment management for reproducible execution across development and deployed systems.
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, technical documentation and cross-functional communication; ability to own implementation through deployment and operational support.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs or comparable ARM/x86 edge platforms; familiarity with device drivers, BSPs and hardware/software compatibility.
* Exposure to Azure IoT or AWS IoT services, Kubernetes/k3s, Ansible or equivalent device and deployment orchestration tools.
* Experience deploying AI inference workloads at the edge, or integrating LLM services for diagnostics and automation with validation and appropriate human controls.

title: Software Engineering Technical Leader | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.

We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Architectural Vision& Complex Problem Solving:** Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership& Project Governance:** Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap& Strategy:** Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature& Framework Delivery:** Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:** Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security& Reliability by Design:** Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling& Security Architecture:** Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability& Proactive Risk Resolution:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations& SRE Governance:** Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:** Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness& Metrics:** Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping& Stakeholder Negotiation:** Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC& Agile Excellence:** Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship& Engineering Culture:** Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).
  
  
Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
  
Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines.
  
  
Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.
  
  
Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer

title: Senior Software Engineer – Power Systems Dynamics
description:
Consulting Services, a part of GE Vernova, has offices in multiple countries and offers our global clients (external & internal GE) a wide range of solutions across the entire spectrum of power generation, delivery, and utilization. Our Power Systems Engineering team utilizes their deep knowledge of connected power grid planning, design, operation, and life-cycle management, to offer customized solutions to our global clients. Our Power Economics team offers analyses focused on the understanding and the study of the financial and physical operation of the electric power systems including generation and grid planning, system optimization, asset valuation, competitive power markets and energy policy implications. Over 700 entities worldwide use our suite of software tools to assess the economics, performance, and reliability of interconnected power systems. We also offer a full range of educational courses through our Power Systems Engineering Course.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer – Power Systems Dynamics will contribute to the development, enhancement, and support of dynamic simulation capabilities within GE Vernova’s Positive Sequence Load Flow (PSLF) software platform. This role focuses on dynamic modeling of power system equipment and controls, transient stability analysis, numerical simulation methods, and the investigation of complex power system behavior. The ideal candidate will have strong software development skills and a solid understanding of power system dynamics and stability analysis. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with power system engineers and software developers to design, implement, test, and validate dynamic models and simulation algorithms, addressing emerging industry challenges such as renewable energy integration, inverter-based resources, HVDC systems, and large loads. Through this work, you will help deliver reliable, high-performance simulation capabilities and support the continued evolution of one of the industry’s leading power system analysis platforms.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain dynamic models for power system equipment and controls, including synchronous machines, excitation systems, governors, power system stabilizers, inverter-based resources (IBRs), and other user-defined models for the GE Vernova’s PSLF software package.
* Develop and enhance dynamic simulation algorithms and core software functionality to support accurate and efficient power system stability analysis.
* Analyze dynamic simulation results to understand system behavior, assess the impact of different equipment and control strategies, and identify root causes of unexpected or incorrect simulation results.
* Investigate and resolve software issues related to dynamic models, numerical solution methods, simulation convergence, and overall simulation performance.
* Implement and validate new dynamic modeling capabilities to address evolving power system requirements, including renewable energy integration, inverter-based resources, HVDC systems, and large loads such as data centers.
* Develop and maintain interfaces and capabilities for integrating user-defined dynamic models, including models developed using DLLs and other supported technologies.
* Work closely with customers, power system engineers, and internal teams to define requirements, develop new functionality, and address challenging technical problems.
* Participate in industry working groups and standards organizations related to power system dynamics, equipment modeling, and stability analysis, as needed.
* Contribute to software testing, model validation, regression testing, and performance improvements to ensure the accuracy and reliability of PSLF dynamic simulation capabilities.
* Participate in sales and marketing activities, including technical demonstrations, customer presentations, and support for product evaluations.
* Provide technical support and consulting services to internal and external customers using power system dynamics and stability analysis tools and methodologies.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum 8 years of exp overall in Power Systems & Programming languages.
* Minimum 3 year of experience using commercial-grade power system simulation or stability analysis software, in the electric power industry or an academic setting.
* Fundamental understanding of power system dynamics, transient stability, and the behavior of electrical equipment and control systems.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Demonstrated knowledge of power system generation, transmission, operations, and control.
* Design and develop software modules for short circuit analysis in power systems, including algorithms, data models, and user interfaces
* Cognizant of various standards like IEC 60909, IEC 61363, IEEE 141/IEEE 551/ANSI C37, and G74 along with their norms and methodologies
* Demonstrated understanding of dynamic modeling of power system equipment, including synchronous machines, excitation systems, governors, power system stabilizers, and inverter-based resources.
* Knowledge of transient stability analysis, numerical integration methods, differential and algebraic equations, and numerical solution techniques.
* Experience developing, debugging, and validating dynamic models and simulation algorithms.
* Experience with C, C++, Python, or C# programming.
* Knowledge of user-defined dynamic models, DLL development, or integration of external models with power system simulation software.
* Familiarity with renewable energy technologies, inverter-based resources, HVDC systems, and their dynamic behavior.
* Experience with software testing, debugging, performance optimization, and regression testing.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and develop effective solutions to challenging software and power system problems.
* Passion for working in an open, collaborative, and supportive environment where colleagues share knowledge and help each other solve technical challenges.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers and colleagues.
* Six Sigma or Lean capabilities.
  

  
  

Note:

  

**To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years’ experience required for any role based within the USA.** **For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

title: Senior IP/Sub System Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description:

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in verification, verifying digital logic at Register-Transfer Level (RTL) level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
* Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).
* Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem in the networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
* Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) accelerators or vector processing units.
* Experience with verification techniques and the full verification life-cycle.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.
  
  
In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. You will collaborate closely with design and verification engineers in active projects and perform verification.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Plan the verification of digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
* Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology. Verify designs with SystemVerilog Assertions and industry leading formal tools.
* Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
* Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
* Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

title: Senior System Development Engineer, Silicon, Google Cloud
description:
