### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related Information Technology (IT) field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with systems automation, and with systems design and implementation.
* 5 years of experience with technical infrastructure (e.g., deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting), and with reliability of technical infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience working with vendors or customers.
* Experience with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools or chip design.
* Experience in working with Go, Python or C++.
* Experience in interacting with end users or product aptitude.

**About the job**
-----------------

Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters.  
  
Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.  
  
Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter.

  

The EDACloud Operations team defines processes for managing incidents to develop automation to ensure upgrades are rolled out safely and slowly. The team builds out monitoring for internal use as well as for the users to understand the state of the service, and debug when there are issues.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

* Participate in on-call activities and manage the systems within the domain and work with the primary responders to help in fixing system issues.

title: AI Solution Developer
description:
At Novonesis, we are committed to shaping a more sustainable future through biology. Digital innovation plays a critical role in achieving that ambition, helping us create better customer experiences, smarter commercial processes, and more effective ways of working.

You will join the Commercial Platforms Team, part of Global Strategy & Commercial Development and a key enabler of Novonesis’ commercial excellence. We own, develop, and support the digital platforms, products, and capabilities that empower our global Commercial organization and help deliver seamless customer experiences across digital and commercial touchpoints.

Our portfolio spans Salesforce, customer-facing digital solutions, web and eCommerce platforms, commercial analytics and dashboards, and AI. Working closely with Business Areas and IT, we translate commercial needs into scalable digital solutions that simplify how our commercial teams work, provide actionable insights, and create more connected customer experiences.

As part of our growing AI capability, you will help build the next generation of commercial AI solutions that transform how information, insights, and processes are delivered across the organization.

**The Role & Your Impact**

As an AI Solution Developer, you will build and deliver AI-powered solutions that improve commercial workflows, increase access to information and insights, and enable our global commercial teams to create stronger customer experiences.

You will turn business requirements and technical designs into working AI agents, automations, integrations, and workflows. Beyond development, you will take ownership of testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to ensure solutions remain reliable and valuable after launch.

Working closely with the AI Technical Lead, Salesforce Product Owners, process and data analysts, Business Areas, IT teams, and external partners, you will contribute directly to Novonesis’ AI transformation journey.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Development**

* Build AI agents and solutions based on approved requirements, technical designs, and standards.
* Develop prompts, instructions, grounding approaches, actions, and orchestration logic for AI agents.
* Create workflows and automations that connect AI capabilities with commercial business processes.
* Deliver solutions through short, iterative development cycles while maximizing reuse of existing components and patterns.

**Integration & Data**

* Connect AI solutions securely to enterprise data and business systems such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and SAP.
* Build and maintain integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies.
* Work with both structured and unstructured data sources and approved grounding repositories.

**Testing, Deployment & Operations**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI evaluation tests.
* Debug and troubleshoot agents, workflows, and integrations.
* Deploy solutions and monitor performance in production environments.
* Diagnose incidents, resolve defects, and continuously improve reliability, usability, and performance.
* Enhance live solutions as business requirements, technology, and user needs evolve.

**Quality & Collaboration**

* Implement security, data-access, responsible AI, and engineering requirements.
* Maintain clear technical documentation to support ongoing maintenance and enhancement.
* Collaborate closely with the AI Technical Lead on solution design, technical reviews, and release readiness.
* Contribute to technical estimations and identify when specialist expertise is required.

This is a hands-on development role with a strong focus on execution, learning, and continuous improvement. Initially, you will work closely with experienced specialists while progressively taking ownership of solution components and end-to-end deliveries.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-5 years of professional experience in software development, automation, data engineering, or AI solution development.
* Hands-on experience building AI, Generative AI, or agent-based solutions.
* Experience with modern development technologies including Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, SQL, and Git.
* Experience developing integrations, workflows, and automations across applications and data sources.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, grounding/RAG techniques, AI testing approaches, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to understand technical designs and collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with one or more of the following is considered a strong advantage:

* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Microsoft Foundry
* Salesforce Agentforce
* Microsoft Power Platform
* UiPath or similar enterprise automation platforms
* Salesforce, Microsoft 365, or SAP integrations
* CI/CD practices
* AI evaluation frameworks
* Monitoring and production support of AI solutions

**Who You Are**

You are a curious and pragmatic developer who enjoys translating ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical capabilities with a genuine interest in solving business challenges.

You are:

* **Hands-on** : You enjoy building, experimenting, and solving technical challenges directly.
* **User-focused** : You understand the business process behind the technology and strive to improve user outcomes.
* **Fast and thorough** : You work iteratively while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and testing.
* **Collaborative** : You build strong partnerships across technical and business teams.
* **Accountable** : You take ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle, from concept to ongoing operational excellence.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd 2026

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Front-End Engineer, Website Platform
description:
**About MyAdvice** 
**MyAdvice is an established, profitable company with a long history in the markets we serve. We have made a fast, deep shift toward AI-enabled solutions and operate with the urgency and standards of a startup. We are fast-moving and aggressive. We need results-oriented people on our team who will never be satisfied with the status quo and will work hard toward continuous improvement.**


What we do. MyAdvice provides an AI-powered system that reduces manual work and cost while helping clients grow revenue. The Success Center, powered by Mya, unifies growth activity across channels and automates workflow execution.

Our mission. We make it easy to profitably grow your business.

How we work. GREAT means Gritty, Resourceful, Expert, Accountable, and Tenacious. We expect hard work, extreme ownership, and extreme accountability. We are willing to do the difficult work required to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients and our colleagues.“We are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect. But we are going to chase it because, in the process, we will catch excellence.” — Vince Lombardi  
  
**The opportunity**  
We're hiring the front-end owner of a new website platform: the engineer responsible for everything a client, a marketer and a patient actually see and touch.  
  
MyAdvice powers the websites of thousands of medical, dental and legal practices. Today those sites live on a fragmented legacy stack, each one built and patched by hand. We're replacing all of it with one platform built on Next.js and Payload, where a new client site is provisioned in minutes, and we're building a generative AI pipeline that will design, lay out and populate it.  
  
The back end of that platform has owners: multi-tenancy, the data model, provisioning and infrastructure. What it needs now is someone who owns the experience layer as seriously as they do. That means the editor people build pages in, the component library every site is assembled from, the theming system that makes each site look bespoke from one codebase, and the rendering and performance work that decides whether those sites get found.  
  
Two things make this job unusual, and you should know both before you apply.  
  
We are building our own editor, not configuring someone else's. Payload's admin is built for developers, and there is no client-ready page builder we can drop in. We evaluated the off-the-shelf options and decided against them. So the editor is ours to build, over Payload's native blocks schema, working inside the framework's admin internals. This is the deep end of Payload, and it is the hardest and most consequential front-end work on the platform. Thousands of practice staff who use Elementor, Divi or Gutenberg today will land in what you build.  
  
The AI generates configuration, never code. One framework, one component set, unlimited variation through data. The pipeline emits schema-validated JSON: a token set, a section composition, per-block style properties. Your component library and token system are the vocabulary that output is written in, which means the quality ceiling of every generated site is set by what you build.  
  
Every improvement you make ships to every site at once. A 200ms LCP win is not one page, it is the whole fleet.  
  
You'd join a small, Website Platform team: a platform engineer on the application and infrastructure layer, a full-stack builder, a senior architect who knows our existing systems deeply and advises across the project, and our AI engineering group on the generation pipeline. You'd report to our VP of Engineering.  
  
**What you'll own**

* The editor. Our own editing experience, built over Payload's native blocks schema, that non-technical marketers and delivery staff can move fast in without being able to break a site. Drag and drop, live preview, undo, validation, and guardrails that hold. This is product engineering inside a framework's internals, and it is the centre of this role.
* The component library. The blocks every site is assembled from: heroes, provider directories, location maps, before-and-after galleries, review carousels, forms. Typed, accessible, tested, documented, and composable enough that the AI pipeline can assemble them as reliably as a person can.
* The theming system. One codebase, per-tenant design tokens, genuinely distinct sites, zero per-tenant code. You'll own the token vocabulary and the mechanism that applies it. You'll also hold the line that keeps it working: tokens rather than per-block overrides, no escape hatch for custom CSS, new variants earning their place through review rather than accumulating.
* Rendering and performance. The Next.js App Router rendering strategy, covering server components, static generation, caching and revalidation, and Core Web Vitals across the whole fleet. You measure before you claim, and you set the performance budgets that keep new work from regressing.
* SEO in the markup. Semantic HTML, metadata, and valid schema.org structured data for practices, providers and locations. These sites exist to be found.
* Accessibility. WCAG 2.1 AA as a floor, not an aspiration. Healthcare websites serve patients of every ability, accessibility failures are a legal risk for our clients, and contrast and a11y checks are a gate that generated output has to pass before it ships.
* Rendering what the AI generates. The pipeline produces a layout and content as data. Your components and editor turn that into a site a practice will put its name on. You'll work with our AI engineers on the contract between the two, and make sure a generated page can always be opened, understood and fixed by a person.
* Handling patient media correctly. Before-and-after imagery is protected health information, and it flows through the upload path and gallery components you build. You'll be responsible for getting consent state, access control and provenance right in the front end, with our architect and compliance work behind you.
* The front-end quality bar. Testing strategy covering unit, component, visual regression and end-to-end, front-end CI checks, code review standards, and the patterns the rest of the team follows.

**What you'll work within**  
Two constraints are worth stating plainly, because they shape the work and we would rather you know now.  
The page schema is frozen early and deliberately. It is the one commitment on this platform that is expensive to reverse, so it gets locked in the first phase and changes after that are rare and deliberate. You'll be building a large component library inside a schema you cannot casually reshape.  
We also expect to work with an external build partner during the build phase, who will contribute code and then exit. Part of this role is reviewing what they produce and owning it afterwards, which is a real responsibility and also a fast way to see the whole surface of the platform.  
  
**What we're looking for**

* We care about what you have shipped and can show us, not what is listed in your skills section. Specifically:
* 5+ years building production front ends, with React and TypeScript as your daily tools. You've shipped and maintained real applications, not prototypes.
* Next.js in production, ideally the App Router. You can explain when you'd render on the server, statically or on the client, and you've lived with the caching consequences.
* You've built custom editing or admin UI inside a framework you didn't write. Payload admin components, Sanity Studio customisation, Strapi admin plugins, a custom canvas over a CMS data model, or comparable depth elsewhere. We want evidence you can work inside someone else's framework internals rather than only on top of a clean API. This is the requirement we weigh most heavily.
* You've built a component library or design system that other engineers used. You've designed component APIs, versioned them, documented them, and dealt with the requests to bend them.
* You've rendered UI from data. Server-driven UI, a block or schema-based renderer, layouts described as JSON rather than written as JSX. You understand what makes a component set composable by a machine rather than only by a person.
* Measured performance work. You've moved a Core Web Vital, whether LCP, INP or CLS, and can tell us the before, the after, and what you changed.
* Accessibility you can demonstrate. Keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA used correctly, and testing with real assistive technology, not just a passing Lighthouse score.
* You test your front end. Component tests with Jest or Vitest and Testing Library, plus end-to-end or visual regression tests with Playwright, Cypress or similar, are part of how you ship.
* Enough back end to be dangerous. You're comfortable reading and writing Node.js and working against a headless CMS or API, even if the server isn't your main job.
* You raise the bar around you. Code review, patterns, documentation, mentoring.
* AI-native. You use Cursor, Claude or similar to build faster, and you own the judgment about what is safe to ship to a live fleet.
* Overlap with US colleagues. Comfortable working 2pm to 11pm IST with real-time collaboration.

**Things that would make us especially excited**

* Payload specifically, or depth in another headless CMS such as Strapi, Sanity, Contentful or Directus.
* You've built a page builder, a visual canvas, or editing tools used by non-technical people at scale.
* Design-token systems or theming engines serving many brands from one codebase.
* Schema.org structured data and technical SEO at scale.
* Experience with regulated or sensitive media, whether HIPAA, consent management, or access-controlled assets.
* Migrating sites off WordPress or another legacy stack.
* Integrating LLM-generated content or layouts into a real product.
* Open-source front-end contributions we can read.

Missing several of these is fine. Depth in the fundamentals, and evidence you've owned something real, matter more than a full checklist.  
  
**How we hire**  
A short written assessment and a recorded walkthrough of front-end code you're proud of, in your own words.  
A conversation with our VP of Engineering about what you've built and how you think.  
A technical session with the team: a front-end exercise in TypeScript and React, and a discussion of how you'd approach the editor and theming problems.  
We move quickly and tell every candidate where they stand.  
  
**Position Details**  
Compensation: Open to discussion  
Position Type: Full-time  
Work Location: Bangalore (Bengaluru), India  
Travel: May require occasional local or nation travel (less than 5% of the time, if at all).  
Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer (90% at desk, 10% of time walking); Ability to lift up to 30lbs and use typical office equipment (computer, keyboards, printer, etc.).  
  
**Benefits**  
Employer contributed medical insurance (100% premium covered by the company)  
Provident Fund (PF) contributions as per policy  
Leave Policy: 12 Sick/Casual Leaves + 18 Annual Leaves + 10 Company Holidays  
Flexible Schedules + Early Out Fridays!  
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free mental health support, financial/legal consultations and more  
Tuition Reimbursement Program (up to 1 lakh annually) + Executive Mentorship Program  
Ongoing personalized coaching and career development support  
Casual Dress (non-client facing roles) and Fun Work Environment  
Weekly Core Value Award, Project Fantastic (client collaboration) and more!

title: Development Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Development Support Engineer**

**Department: IT**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Development Support Engineer to provide day-to-day support across the software development lifecycle. You will triage and reproduce incoming issues, fix defects in existing services, assist with testing and deployments, and take on small development tasks under the guidance of senior engineers. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for someone with a solid programming foundation who wants to grow into a full backend or full-stack engineering position. You will learn our platforms end-to-end, gain exposure to cutting-edge technology including AI-assisted development tooling and AI-driven product features, and act as the first line of technical response for the systems we run.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Triage, reproduce, and document incoming bug reports and escalations from internal teams and customers.

* Fix low- to medium-complexity defects in existing services and applications with guidance from senior engineers.

* Take on routine development tasks, including small feature enhancements, configuration changes, and code cleanup.

* Support build, release, and deployment activities across development, staging, and production environments.

* Monitor application logs, dashboards, and alerts, and escalate issues with clear diagnostic detail.

* Prepare test data, environment setups, and sandbox instances for the development team.

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues.

* Participate in code reviews, stand-ups, and sprint ceremonies to build familiarity with team standards and practices.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.

**Work Experience:**

* 2 years of experience in software development, technical support, or a related technical role.

* Experience on projects demonstrating hands-on coding will be considered.

* Exposure to a team development workflow using version control and issue tracking is an advantage.

description:
Locations: **Mumbai, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Your team**

  
  

Join our growing ServiceNow Centre of Excellence and Innovation (CoEI), where people, process and technology come together to deliver effective, scalable solutions across the enterprise. Working with global business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects and technology teams, you will help evolve the platform, strengthen delivery practices and support digital transformation.

  
  

**Your role and impact**

  
  

We are seeking a collaborative ServiceNow Developer to join our Centre of Excellence and Innovation. In this role, you will configure, develop, test and deploy secure, scalable and maintainable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will translate business requirements into well-engineered technical solutions, working closely with Enterprise Architects, business stakeholders and delivery partners to ensure development aligns with platform architecture, governance and ServiceNow best practices. You will also support platform upgrades, troubleshoot and resolve incidents and defects, and contribute to the adoption of emerging capabilities such as UI Builder and Now Assist.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**

  
  

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Design, configure, develop, test and implement scalable ServiceNow solutions, including workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, UI policies, access controls, catalogue items and platform administration.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, IT teams and delivery partners to translate requirements into solutions aligned with platform architecture, governance and change-control standards.
* Integrate ServiceNow with third-party systems and applications using appropriate integration frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Provide application support by monitoring ticket queues, troubleshooting incidents and defects, performing root-cause analysis, and supporting platform upgrades and performance optimisation.
* Guide developers, administrators and delivery partners in applying reusable patterns, development standards and ServiceNow best practices.
* Apply knowledge across ServiceNow architecture and modules including Information Technology Service Management (ITSM), Information Technology Operations Management (ITOM), Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) and Customer Service Management (CSM), while evaluating emerging capabilities such as UI Builder, Now Assist and artificial intelligence-powered workflows to improve platform value.
  

  

**Your experience**

  
  

* 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions, with strong knowledge of platform architecture, JavaScript, application programming interfaces (APIs), integrations, security, governance, scalability and maintainability.
* Experience translating business requirements into solution designs and technical architectures, including architecture review and design assurance.
* Working knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes and ServiceNow products such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and CSM.
* Experience in application or IT support, with strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities in a customer-focused environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to take initiative, collaborate effectively and balance business value, technical constraints and risk.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD) and relevant Implementation Specialist certification(s).
* Experience with platform strategy, modernisation or digital transformation initiatives, with exposure to Now Assist, AI Agents, AI Specialists or related intelligent automation capabilities.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**About Arcitech.ai**
---------------------

Arcitech.ai is an AI-native business automation company. We design, build and manage custom production software for enterprises across the US, UAE and India, in manufacturing, mining, pharma, education, hospitality and contact centres. We also build AI products including ProSchool.ai, Haire.ai and BPObox. Most of our client relationships are long-term development and managed-services engagements, so account management is central to how we grow.

**The Role**
------------

You'll own a portfolio of custom software development accounts end to end. You'll understand what each client needs, translate it into clear requirements for our development team, and make sure it's delivered on time and to the client's satisfaction.

On your accounts, you act as the product owner. You lead the discovery calls, own the requirements through the full development lifecycle, and keep the client and the engineering team aligned at every stage.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Discovery & requirements: Run discovery calls with clients to understand their business, workflows and goals. Turn these into clear, prioritised requirements for the development team.
* Product ownership: Own the requirements on your accounts from kickoff to go-live and beyond. This includes clarifying scope, prioritising the backlog, managing change requests, and reviewing deliveries against what the client asked for.
* Delivery coordination: Work daily with PMs, developers, testers and tech leads so that what's built matches what's needed, and lands when it was promised.
* Client reporting: Send weekly and monthly progress reports to every client, on time, in clear business language.
* Issue handling: Acknowledge client issues immediately and log them in Zoho Desk. Update clients daily on open items and escalate early when anything stalls.
* Proposals & SOWs: Turn client requirements into estimates, proposals and SOWs the same day, using our standard templates. You'll validate scope and resourcing with tech leads.
* Account growth: Identify new phases, change requests and renewals inside your accounts, and bring in our sales team.
* New account onboarding: Take over newly won accounts, confirm all project documents and contacts are in place, and start the reporting cycle.
* Process improvement: Improve templates, workflows and response times, including through AI tools.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 4–6 years in account management, product ownership, business analysis, project management or delivery management on **custom software development** engagements. This should be at an IT services or software development company.
* Hands-on experience running discovery or requirement-gathering sessions with clients and writing requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, scope documents.
* A proven track record of managing several client accounts at once through the full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, sprints, QA, UAT, deployment and support.
* Solid understanding of how custom software is scoped and delivered: scope, change requests, resourcing, timelines and dependencies.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You'll work directly with US and UAE clients.
* Strong attention to detail with documents, numbers and structured templates.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk/Projects, Jira, Hubstaff or similar tools, and comfort using AI assistants daily.
* You close loops without being chased and escalate early.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience preparing proposals, estimates or SOWs for software projects.
* Experience on retainer or managed-services accounts.
* Exposure to AI, automation, ERP integration or cloud projects.

**This role is not for you if**: your experience is mainly in product SaaS or marketing agencies rather than custom development, or you can't commit to evening hours on some days.

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  
  

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**
----------------------------------------

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

title: Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering

**The Opportunity**

We’re seeking a Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering to set AI-enabled engineering direction across platform and product. This role focuses on practical patterns and tooling - including agent-based approaches - that improve how teams build, test, release and operate software. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, operations and Risk, InfoSec and compliance to embed AI responsibly in production with the right controls and operational readiness. A key part of the remit is delivering AI-enabled improvements across Product Control and Valuation control workflows such as IPV, price testing and breaks and exceptions. You’ll also strengthen developer experience through better tooling, automation and self-service. Success means scalable patterns that teams adopt easily with measurable improvements in quality, productivity, reliability and risk outcomes.

**What you'll be doing**

* Set AI-enabled engineering patterns and agent-based tooling approaches that improve SDLC outcomes across teams
* Embed AI capabilities into production services with appropriate controls, operational readiness and explainability where relevant
* Strengthen developer experience through developer tooling, CI/CD optimisation, test automation, observability standards and self-service enablement
* Standardise evaluation of AI proof of concepts then run pilots with clear measures across quality, productivity, reliability and risk
* Industrialise successful pilots into reusable components, templates, accelerators and golden path implementations for squads to adopt
* Govern architecture and technical design through reviews and trade-offs across resilience, performance, maintainability, security, cost and pace
* Embed secure-by-default delivery by automating IT controls and evidence capture in engineering patterns and CI/CD pipelines
* Advance AI-enabled delivery in Product Control and Valuation controls including audit-ready evidence capture, lineage, approval trails and repeatable checks
* Establish data quality and reconciliation patterns to validate valuation inputs, detect anomalies and automate reconciliations to reduce manual effort

**What we're looking for**

* Bring substantial hands-on software engineering experience within complex enterprise or financial-services environments
* Demonstrate experience operating as a senior technical individual contributor such as Senior Technical Lead, Principal Engineer or Lead Developer

title: Senior Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Senior Mobile Application Developer**

Company: Lark Finserv Private Limited

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 4–6 Years

Technology: Flutter, Dart, Android and iOS

**About Lark Finserv:**

Lark Finserv Private Limited is a Noida-based fintech that makes credit against investments simple. We run a Digital Lending Application and act as a Loan Service Provider (LSP): we never lend ourselves. Loans are sanctioned by RBI-regulated NBFCs

and banks, including Bajaj Finance and DSP Finance.

Lark Money is our consumer app. It lets investors pledge mutual funds and stocks to get a credit line in minutes, without selling their investments. The same platform also powers mutual fund distributors and partners through our Edge, Vault, Grid and OS products.

The company is led by a team with 20–30+ years each in capital markets and wealth, from Standard Chartered, Edelweiss, Angel One, JP Morgan, Nomura and BSE.

**Role summary:**

You will own the Lark Money Flutter codebase end to end, from architecture to Play Store and App Store releases. Every customer journey runs through this app: onboarding, KYC, pledging securities, drawing funds, repayments and account servicing. You will work closely with product, design, backend and our lending partners' integration teams to ship fast without compromising security, compliance or reliability.

**Key responsibilities:**

• Build, maintain and scale the Lark Money app on Flutter (Dart) for Android and iOS from a single codebase.

• Own app architecture: state management, modular structure, navigation, dependency injection and clean separation of UI, domain and data layers.

• Ship customer journeys end to end: sign-up, KYC and eKYC, consent-based portfolio fetch (CAS / Account Aggregator), lien marking and pledging of mutual funds and shares, eSign and eMandate, drawdown, repayment and statements.

• Integrate REST APIs, partner SDKs and webviews from lending partners, depositories, RTAs (CAMS, KFintech), payment gateways and verification

providers.

• Embed security by default: secure storage, SSL pinning, root/jailbreak detection, obfuscation, session handling and protection of personal and financial data, in line with RBI digital lending guidelines.

• Run the release pipeline: CI/CD, build flavours, Play Store and App Store submissions, staged rollouts, OTA-safe versioning and hotfixes.

• Instrument the app with analytics, crash reporting and performance monitoring; use funnel data to improve conversion and drop-offs.

• Keep the app fast and stable: startup time, frame rendering, app size, offline and poor-network handling, and a crash-free session rate above 99.5%.

• Write unit, widget and integration tests; review code and set coding standards.

• Work with product and design to turn Figma flows into polished, accessible UI, and

push back with better options where needed.

• Contribute to the embed / SDK roadmap so partners can offer Lark Money journeys

inside their own apps.

**Must-have skills and experience:**

• 3–6 years of mobile development, with at least 2 years building production Flutter apps.

• At least one live app on both Play Store and App Store that you built or significantly owned (please share links).

• Strong Dart: async programming, streams, isolates, null safety.

• Hands-on with at least one state management approach at scale (Bloc/Cubit, Riverpod or Provider) and clean architecture.

• REST API integration, JSON serialisation, error handling, retries and token-based authentication.

• Platform channels and native integration on Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) for SDKs Flutter cannot handle directly.

• Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Cloud Messaging, Remote Config) or equivalents.

• Git, code reviews and CI/CD (Codemagic, GitHub Actions, Fastlane or similar).

• Mobile security basics: secure storage, certificate pinning, obfuscation, safe handling of PII.

• Clear ownership: you ship, you monitor, you fix.

**Why join us:**

• Own the core product: Lark Money is our only client-facing app, so your work reaches every customer directly.

• Build in a fast-growing category: loans against mutual funds and stocks are still underused in India, and we aim to lead it.

• Learn from founders with decades in capital markets, backed by top lending partners and a strong advisory board.

• Small team, high ownership, quick decisions, and a seat at the table on product direction.

**How to apply:**

Interested candidates are requested to share:

• Updated resume highlighting relevant Flutter development experience.

• Links to live applications published on Google Play Store and Apple App Store that they have developed or significantly contributed to.

• Brief details of their role and technical contributions to these applications.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Contract Type:**
 Full Time; Permanent
  
**Location:**
 Noida, India
  
  
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce-related Service Desk tickets
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The HCL Now Solution Architect defines and architects customer solutions across the HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud portfolio, guiding engagements end-to-end from initial opportunity through go-live and into steady-state operation. The role combines deep cloud-native architecture expertise with hands-on delivery ownership: understanding stakeholder requirements, designing scalable and secure solutions, maintaining architectural standards, controlling cloud cost and risk, and resolving issues throughout the customer lifecycle. Solution Architects typically support multiple concurrent engagements across the HCL Software product portfolio — including HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL CDP, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL iControl, Mosaic, Mosaic Vibe Studio, and others.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Assess customer IT landscapes and design end-to-end cloud-native architectures meeting business, security, and scalability requirements.
* Define migration roadmaps and architecture blueprints; drive solution standardization and templatization for reuse.
* Architect data and analytics components (pipelines, storage, reporting) to meet customer data-driven requirements.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support Sales in scoping HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud opportunities and lead technical discovery with customers.
* Deliver Product Cloud Workshops and act as the customer's trusted technical contact from opportunity through go-live.

**Delivery, Onboarding & Automation**

* Guide deployments on HCL SoFy; templatize onboarding procedures and drive automation with DevOps/CloudOps.
* Apply AI-driven DevOps practices to automate delivery pipelines, monitoring, and operations.
* Mentor delivery engineers and provide technical oversight to keep implementations aligned to architectural intent.

**Cost, Performance & Risk Management**

* Own cost modeling and FinOps-driven cloud cost optimization; monitor sizing and resolve bottlenecks.
* Support performance, scaling, and DR testing; identify and mitigate architecture risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Feed recurring QC issues and customer learnings back to Product and DevOps teams.
* Stay current on cloud-native trends and HCLSoftware roadmaps; build reusable reference architectures for the practice.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record designing and delivering complex customer solutions in public and hybrid cloud architectures, ideally in a customer-facing or professional-services context.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying workloads on at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), with Architect-level (or equivalent) certification strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes and containerization (Docker), including implementation, setup, infrastructure, networking, and security on cloud.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, DB2, Oracle, or Aerospike.
* Solid, practical understanding of modern networking and interconnection options, security architecture, and global compliance and security standards.
* Deep understanding of design and integration patterns, and of solution standardization and templatization.
* Solid understanding of core AI concepts (ML fundamentals, generative AI, LLMs) and their application to cloud solutions.
* Proven implementation experience with HCLSoftware products — e.g., HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL CDP, HCL iControl, or HCL MyXalytics — or a comparable enterprise software portfolio, including migrating, upgrading, and onboarding these products.
* Understanding of data migration strategy and the ability to work with product teams on execution.
* Business and technically savvy, with big-picture vision and the ability to articulate the solution vision to both internal and external audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and analytical/problem-solving skills, with a keen, continuous-learner mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience with architecture design tools such as Visio, Draw.io, or Lucidchart.
* Prior experience with cloud migration factories, migration tooling, or "as-a-service" delivery models.
* Experience in a presales or solution-consulting capacity, including proposal and estimation support.
* Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability/monitoring tooling.

**Travel**

Approximately 15% travel required (+/-).

You own outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.

This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time-to-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.

* 10+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.

* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.

15 years full time education

title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering
  
  
Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level
  
  
**Role summary**
This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux.
  
  
Team and mission
  
  
The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments.
  
  
Role at a glance
  
  
**Primary Focus**
Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering
  
  
**Target database**
Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities
  
  
**Platforms**
Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability
  
  
**Database areas**
XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability
  
  
**ODAC scope**
ODP.NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components
  
  
**Client drivers**
python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC
  
  
**Test coverage**
Functional, integration, compatibility, upgrade, patch, system, stress, performance and resiliency
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Design and develop production-scale database schemas, data generators, workload drivers, and application logic using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript or Node.js, C/C++, and C# as appropriate.
  
  

* Create highly automated end-to-end test suites that simulate large enterprise applications, high concurrency, long-duration operation, mixed workloads, and very large databases.
* Review Oracle Database 26ai feature designs and translate functional and architectural requirements into test strategies, coverage matrices, test specifications, and reusable automation.
* Validate Oracle Database 26ai vector and AI capabilities, including vector data types, vector indexes, similarity search, hybrid vector and text scenarios, embedding workflows, concurrency, correctness, performance, and upgrade compatibility.
* Develop comprehensive coverage for XDB and XML processing, JSON data management and APIs, and Oracle Text indexing, search, synchronization, security, and mixed-workload interoperability.
* Test ODAC and ODP.NET components across Windows and Linux, including platform-appropriate ODP.NET Core, Managed, and Unmanaged provider scenarios, connection management, pooling, transactions, data type mappings, high availability, security, and framework integration.
* Build a consistent cross-driver test matrix for python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C, and JDBC to validate feature parity, protocol behavior, data type support, error handling, failover, performance, and backward compatibility.
* Exercise client and server combinations across Windows and Linux, including installation, configuration, networking, TLS, authentication, character sets, file systems, process and memory behavior, and operating-system-specific regressions.
* Test Release Updates, one-off patches, client upgrades, rolling maintenance, database upgrades, and mixed-version scenarios while preserving data correctness and service availability.
* Execute tests on standalone databases, multitenant CDB and PDB environments, RAC and ASM clusters, Data Guard configurations, Exadata, and cloud or Autonomous Database environments as applicable.
* Develop monitoring and diagnostics for database, operating system, network, application, and client layers; analyze traces, dumps, logs, wait events, execution plans, memory usage, and performance profiles.
* File high-quality defects with reproducible evidence, isolate failures to the responsible layer, collaborate with development teams on root cause, and verify fixes across platforms and client stacks.
* Enhance test frameworks based on customer escalations and field defects, and participate in feature reviews, certification exercises, documentation reviews, and quality readiness assessments. Core technical scope

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C and JDBC

Installation, networking, security, resource behavior and lifecycle operations
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Strong Oracle Database development experience with SQL, PL/SQL, schema and physical design, transaction processing, concurrency, diagnostics, and performance tuning.

* Experience with source control and continuous integration practices, such as Git, build pipelines, automated regression execution, and artifact management.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Expert Oracle Design/Development/Principal DBAs (OR) Lead/Principal Oracle DB Developers with sound

Oracle DB Application Development cum DBA Full-Life cycle experience ranging from 4-12 years.
  
  

* Oracle Database 23ai or 26ai, AI Vector Search, machine learning or embedding-based applications, and performance evaluation of AI-assisted database workloads.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Contract Type:**
 Full Time; Permanent
  
**Location:**

**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce-related Service Desk tickets
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required
* Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies
* Practical Salesforce administration experience including users, permissions, security, objects, fields, configuration and Flow
* Experience working with integrations and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP
* Experience using Git and working within a structured deployment or CI/CD process
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable technical or administrative activities
* Strong engineering and problem-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.
* Data management and relational database knowledge, including data formats, joins and ETL concepts
* Strong understanding of Salesforce development, deployment and platform best practices

Study Group is a leading international education provider that is dedicated and passionate about helping students around the world, creating a brighter future and reaching their full potential. Our global network of offices and university partnerships ensure that students receive the best educational services available. Its all-in-one platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of dental practices rely on it daily to grow revenue and improve patient care.

* Proven AWS architecture experience across ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM at production scale.
* Demonstrated track record solving complex scalability, performance, and reliability challenges in distributed, event-driven systems.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience architecting and operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms handling large-scale transactional and analytical workloads.
* Exposure to healthcare technology, dental-domain applications, or other data-intensive regulated verticals.
* Experience driving platform architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with Node.js in a polyglot backend environment.
* Active interest in evaluating and adopting emerging AI/ML tooling to accelerate engineering productivity.

**What We Offer**

* Platform-wide technical ownership with direct influence over architecture decisions across all product areas serving thousands of dental practices.
* High-autonomy environment with tight cross-functional collaboration — ship fast and see real-world impact quickly.
* Opportunity to shape engineering culture and standards at a fast-growing medical AI SaaS company in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.

Master's Degree
