title: Senior Software Engineer (JVM)
description:
### **Nexla, briefly**

Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.

**Role**  
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in.

**What you'll own**

* Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
* The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.
* Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else's.
* The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back.

*Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it.*

**The hard problem**  
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.  
  
**Must-Haves**

* 6 to 10 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications.
* Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them.
* Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC.
* You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow.
* Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar.
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka.
* Security architecture: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call.
* You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear.
* You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice.
* You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself.

*One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it.*

**How we hire**  
Four conversations, about two weeks end to end.

* **Coding.** Working through real code rather than a puzzle.
* **Low-level design.** How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend.
* **High-level design.** Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production.
* **Hiring Manager.** Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work.

**On AI in the coding round.** Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else's. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.

*You will hear from us either way.*  
  
**The practical stuff**  
Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams.

**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.** MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.** nexla.com/customers
* **The product in engineer terms.** docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.** Read the founder story
* **Everything else.** nexla.com · Blog · All open roles

### **Why Nexla? Why now?**

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

**India**

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Fusion ERP Integration Developer for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India, hired through Revantage India.

The Senior Oracle Fusion ERP Integration Developer leads the design, development and support of integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and enterprise applications using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). The role owns technical delivery from requirements through production, establishes integration standards and mentors engineers while partnering with finance, procurement and technology teams to ensure accurate, secure and reliable data exchange.

Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.

**PRIMARY ROLE**

  

* Lead integration design and delivery for Oracle Fusion Financials and Procurement, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets and Cash Management.

* Establish reusable standards for integration design, authentication, logging, error handling, retries and deployment.

* Monitor integration service levels and improve transaction reliability, processing timeliness and recovery performance.
* Support scheduled on-call coverage for critical production events, financial close and business-continuity needs, including US nights, weekends and US and India holidays.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

  

* Advanced hands-on knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud and integration patterns for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials or Procurement and procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and record-to-report processes.
* Experience with the Oracle ERP Cloud Adapter, FBDI, application import jobs and BI Publisher extracts.
* Strong proficiency in REST and SOAP APIs, SQL, XML, JSON, XSLT and complex data transformations.
* Ability to design synchronous, asynchronous, scheduled and event-driven integrations and select patterns appropriate to business requirements.
* Experience designing high-volume integrations with validation, reconciliation, duplicate prevention and robust recovery.
* Working knowledge of OAuth, certificates, access controls and secure management of integration credentials.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across OIC execution, API responses, data validation and ERP import errors.

description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

Senior Software Engineer – Data Engineering (3-5 Years Experience)

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) | Bengaluru | 3-5 Years**

**About The Role**
------------------

Myntra Data Platform (MDP) powers the data foundation behind analytics, experimentation, personalization, machine learning, and critical business decisions across Myntra.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – Data Engineering** who is passionate about building scalable data platforms and production-grade data pipelines. You will work on large-scale batch and near real-time data processing systems, drive data quality and reliability, and contribute to the evolution of Myntra's modern lakehouse architecture.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals combined with hands-on expertise in **Apache Spark, SQL, Python, ETL development, workflow orchestration, data modeling, and modern data platforms** .

You will collaborate with platform, analytics, product, and engineering teams to build highly reliable and scalable data solutions that power business-critical use cases across the organization.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Data Pipeline Engineering**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data processing.
* Build reliable data ingestion, transformation, validation, and publishing workflows.
* Develop reusable components and frameworks to improve engineering productivity.
* Implement incremental processing, backfills, retries, and failure recovery mechanisms.
* Ensure data pipelines meet reliability, scalability, and performance requirements.

### **Apache Spark & Big Data Processing**

* Build and optimize large-scale data processing jobs using Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
* Develop production-grade transformations, aggregations, and data enrichment pipelines.
* Analyze Spark execution plans and optimize jobs for performance and cost.
* Troubleshoot issues related to partitioning, joins, data skew, shuffles, and memory utilization.
* Follow engineering best practices for efficient distributed processing.

### **Data Modeling & Warehousing**

* Design and implement scalable data models for analytics and reporting.
* Build curated datasets supporting business intelligence and downstream applications.
* Apply dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, star schemas, and SCDs.
* Translate business requirements into reusable and maintainable data models.

### **Workflow Orchestration**

* Develop and manage workflows using Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Define task dependencies, scheduling strategies, retries, and monitoring mechanisms.
* Improve operational visibility and reliability of data workflows.
* Support self-service capabilities for pipeline onboarding and deployment.

### **Lakehouse & Data Platform Engineering**

* Build and operate workloads on Databricks and Spark-based platforms.
* Work with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or similar storage formats.
* Optimize storage layouts, partitioning strategies, compaction, and metadata management.
* Contribute to platform capabilities that simplify data consumption and processing.

### **Data Quality & Governance**

* Implement automated data quality validations and monitoring frameworks.
* Develop checks for freshness, completeness, schema validation, and consistency.
* Ensure proper metadata management, lineage tracking, and discoverability.
* Follow data governance and security best practices.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Monitor pipeline health, SLAs, performance, and cost metrics.
* Investigate production issues and perform root cause analysis.
* Improve platform stability through automation and continuous optimization.
* Participate in on-call support and incident management when required.

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code.
* Participate in code reviews and design discussions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* **3-5 years** of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering.
* Strong experience with **Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL** .
* Proficiency in **Python** and strong coding fundamentals.
* Excellent knowledge of **SQL** and query optimization techniques.
* Experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with **Apache Airflow** or similar workflow orchestration tools.
* Good understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts.
* Experience working with **Databricks** , Hadoop, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Familiarity with **Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Parquet** .
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of software engineering best practices, CI/CD, and version control systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working with **Kafka** or other streaming technologies.
* Exposure to near real-time data processing architectures.
* Experience with dbt or similar SQL transformation frameworks.
* Knowledge of modern lakehouse architectures and cloud-native data platforms.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and lineage concepts.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and data engineering automation.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* SQL
* Python
* Apache Spark / PySpark
* Spark SQL
* Apache Airflow
* Kafka
* ETL / ELT Development
* Data Modeling
* Data Lakehouse Architecture
* Databricks
* Delta Lake / Iceberg
* Distributed Data Processing
* Performance Optimization
* Data Quality & Monitoring

title: Principal Clinical Database Programmer (eCOA Study Builder)
description:
**About Parexel**

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Principal Database Programmer (eCOA Study Builder / Designer) specializing in electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions to join our team in a **Remote/Hybrid/On-site(Hyderabad or Bengaluru)** capacity. As a Principal Database Programmer (eCOA Study Builder / Designer), you will provide technical expertise for the design, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance of eCOA solutions used in clinical trials that help advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, regulatory compliance, and clinical data accuracy. You'll translate protocols, assessment schedules, and licensed instrument requirements into compliant participant, caregiver, and clinician-facing questionnaires, schedules, and workflows, collaborate with sponsors and cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to eCOA study delivery from design through closeout. Responsibilities include configuring and testing eCOA studies in approved platforms and supporting their integration with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through translating protocols into compliant eCOA studies, configuring and testing them, and supporting EDC integration. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Principal Database Programmer (eCOA Study Builder / Designer) can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design, set up, maintain, revise, and close out eCOA studies by interpreting protocols, schedules of assessments, eCOA specifications, and licensed instrument requirements
* Configure questionnaires, screens, field properties, code lists, schedules, branching logic, rules, reminders, alerts, notifications, and study settings in the approved eCOA platform, applying established naming conventions and build standards
* Coordinate the initial eCOA configuration and controlled push to EDC, maintaining alignment among the eCOA configuration, EDC draft, and applicable CRF versions
* Assess and implement approved protocol amendments, production revisions, translations, and study maintenance changes while protecting data integrity and traceability
* Perform technical quality control of eCOA configurations against approved specifications and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test evidence, defect triage, and resolution
* Coordinate deployment readiness and support post-production troubleshooting and controlled implementation of approved corrections
* Collaborate with Clinical Database Programming, Data Management, eCOA Clinical Data Analysis, COA Science, and Clinical Operations to finalize eCOA requirements and resolve design issues
* Lead or participate in design and build meetings, communicate configuration status, identify risks and dependencies, and manage scope, timeline, and resourcing changes across multiple projects
* Serve as a technical contact for sponsors and vendors on eCOA design, specification, testing, and deployment topics, as assigned
* Create and maintain eCOA specifications, configuration records, test evidence, and other study artifacts in accordance with SOPs, Work Instructions, ICH-GCP, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Provide role-relevant training, coaching, and technical guidance to project teams and less-experienced study designers, and contribute to standards, reusable libraries, and continuous improvement

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring:**

  

* Strengths in questionnaire design, eCOA study configuration, and technical quality control
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* The ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams and communicate technical design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with eCOA platforms such as Medidata Designer eCOA, EDC systems such as Medidata Rave, and validated clinical systems

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, computer science, health informatics, clinical research, or a related discipline
* Proven experience with eCOA, ePRO, or eDiary
* Strong clinical research industry experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical setting
* Experience with EDC systems and an understanding of eCOA-to-EDC configuration dependencies and data flow
* Knowledge of questionnaire design, schedules, branching logic, reminders, notifications, translations, version management, and participant workflows
* Knowledge of SOPs, Work Instructions, system life-cycle methodologies, ICH-GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, and other applicable local and international regulatory requirements
* Experience with technical quality control, UAT, defect management, change control, and validated clinical systems
* Experience supporting global studies, sponsors, and cross-functional project teams
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis, risk identification, and decision-making in ambiguous situations
* Proficient presentation and system-demonstration skills
* Written and oral fluency in English

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Hands-on experience configuring an eCOA platform such as Medidata Designer eCOA, or comparable study-design technology
* Experience with Medidata Rave EDC

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

**3. Cloud Networking & Connectivity**

**4. Cloud Security & Governance**

* Establish Azure governance and security using Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

* Build reusable modules for networking, identity, security, compute, storage, and shared services.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and delivery using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and GitHub Actions.

* Architect AWS compute platforms using EC2, Auto Scaling, EKS, ECS, Fargate, and Lambda.
* Design event-driven and serverless architectures using Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS.
* Implement container image management using Amazon ECR.
* Define workload placement, scalability, and resource right-sizing strategies.

**7. Data, Storage, Backup & Disaster Recovery**

* Design AWS storage and data architectures using S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, and Glue.
* Establish encryption, lifecycle management, replication, versioning, and data protection standards.
* Define Multi-AZ and Multi-Region architectures, backup strategies, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Implement AWS Backup, Elastic Disaster Recovery, and Route 53 failover with defined RTO/RPO objectives.

**8. Observability, Reliability & FinOps**

* Implement cloud monitoring using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, X-Ray, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Establish Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights integrations.
* Apply SRE principles, automated alerting, and operational excellence practices.
* Drive cloud cost optimization using AWS Cost Explorer, Budgets, Cost and Usage Reports, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, and Reserved Instances.
* Establish tagging standards, cost allocation, and FinOps governance.

**9. Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Collaborate with security, compliance, infrastructure, and application engineering teams.
* Develop reference architectures, reusable blueprints, and cloud platform accelerators.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design validations, and technical assessments.
* Guide engineering teams and partners in implementing production-ready AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud solutions.

* Strong experience in AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud architecture.
* Expertise in AWS Control Tower, Organizations, Landing Zone Accelerator, and Azure Landing Zones.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong knowledge of AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, and cloud identity architecture.

* Experience with cloud security, governance, compliance, and enterprise-scale architectures.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), containers, serverless, and cloud-native services.

Preferred Certifications

  Navigating global regulations (GDPR, COPPA) and implementing robust Digital Rights Management (DRM) systems like Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady to protect intellectual property.

  Serving as the connective tissue between software engineers, product managers, marketing teams, and content creators to ensure project success.

**Areas of Deep Expertise**

* **Streaming Media Infrastructure:**
  Deep understanding of video ingestion, encoding pipelines, adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming, and minimizing glass-to-glass latency for live events.
* **Gaming Ecosystems:**
  Knowledge of game engine integrations (Unity, Unreal Engine), cross-platform multiplayer architecture, anti-cheat mechanisms, and the shift toward cloud gaming platforms (like Xbox Cloud Gaming or PlayStation Plus).
* **Data Analytics & User Experience:**
  Utilizing Quality of Service (QoS) and Quality of Experience (QoE) metrics to reduce churn, optimize recommendations, and maximize viewer/player engagement.

**Technical & Infrastructure Skills**

  Deep knowledge of video codecs (
  **AV1, HEVC/H.265, H.264, VVC**

* **Streaming Protocols:**
  Mastery of industry-standard delivery protocols including
  **WebRTC, SRT, LL-HLS, and MPEG-DASH**
  to achieve low to ultra-low latency.
* **Content Delivery Networks (CDNs):**
  Expertise in configuring, routing, caching, and optimizing global CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly) for high-concurrency live events.
* **Gaming Infrastructure:**
  Understanding of multiplayer networking architecture, authoritative game servers, matchmakers, tick rates, and anti-cheat systems.
* **Cloud & Edge Computing:**
  Architecture experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) utilizing specialized media services (e.g., AWS Elemental) and edge compute to reduce player/viewer ping.
* **Digital Rights Management (DRM):**
  Implementation of multi-DRM ecosystems including
  **Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady**
  alongside watermarking technologies.

**Product & Monetization Skills**

  Deep familiarity with
  **SSAI (Server-Side Ad Insertion)**
  and
  **CSAI (Client-Side Ad Insertion)**
  , programmatic advertising, and VAST/VMAP protocols.
* **Gaming Economics:**
  Understanding of live-ops, virtual economies, microtransactions (DLCs, battle passes, gacha mechanisms), and player retention loops.

  Designing flexible billing configurations across multi-tiered monetization models:
  **FAST (Free Ad-Supported TV), AVOD, SVOD, and Hybrid models**
  .

  Tracking and diagnosing critical Quality of Experience (QoE) and Quality of Service (QoS) telemetry such as
  **Video Start Time (VST), buffering ratios, bitrate drops, frame drops, and round-trip time (RTT)**
  .
* **Behavioral Analytics:**
  Utilizing data platforms to track player/viewer engagement metrics, churn prediction patterns, and content consumption habits.

* **Regulatory Frameworks:**
  Navigating global content, data, and youth regulations like
  **GDPR, COPPA, and CCPA**
  .
* **Accessibility Standards:**
  Ensuring platform compliance with regulatory mandates like the
  **CVAA**
  (Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act) for closed captioning and audio descriptions.

**Education Background**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering (with a focus on digital signal processing/video), or a highly quantitative, related technical field.**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
  
  
**The Role:**
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
  
  
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

DTPE is responsible for advancing secure, scalable, governed, and resilient data platform capabilities spanning hybrid-cloud infrastructure, compute, storage, streaming, orchestration, data governance, privacy, quality, and platform engineering services.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth, people leadership, operational excellence, and a passion for building scalable platforms that serve enterprise-wide customers.

Technical & Platform Leadership:

* Drive architecture and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-efficient platform services.
* Partner closely with architects, principal engineers, and product stakeholders to define technical roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Lead platform modernization initiatives across hybrid-cloud environments, cloud-native architectures, container platforms, and developer self-service capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices covering scalability, resiliency, observability, automation, security, and performance.

title: Software Engineering Technical Leader | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
**Meet the Team**
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architectural Vision & Complex Problem Solving:**
Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership & Project Governance:**
Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap & Strategy:**
Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature & Framework Delivery:**
Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:**
Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security & Reliability by Design:**
Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling & Security Architecture:**
Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability & Proactive Risk Resolution:**
Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations & SRE Governance:**
Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:**
Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness & Metrics:**
Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping & Stakeholder Negotiation:**
Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC & Agile Excellence:**
Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship & Engineering Culture:**
Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).
  
  
Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
  
Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines.
  
  
Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.
  
  
Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Provide senior technical leadership during critical incidents, coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting, restore services within agreed priorities, and communicate clear technical status and risk.
* Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, identify corrective and preventive actions, and ensure actions are tracked through closure.
* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

title: Databricks Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
The Data Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end Financial Data Mart from source ingestion and bronze-layer structures through silver-layer transformation and gold-layer business-ready data products for Optum Insight
  
  
This role provides hands-on architecture leadership across complex, multi-source data environments and establishes the data models, integration patterns, transformation logic, and SQL designs that Data Engineering teams implement.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in modern cloud data architecture with the ability to set technical direction, collaborate with engineering and business stakeholders, and translate complex Finance and business requirements into scalable, reusable data products.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and design of enterprise data products, spanning ingestion, transformation, integration, modeling, and consumption
* Design data solutions across bronze, silver, and gold layers using modern medallion and lakehouse architecture principles
* Define how data from multiple source systems and tables is joined, transformed, standardized, and curated into business-ready data products
* Develop detailed logical and physical data models, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, integration patterns, and complex SQL designs for Data Engineers to implement
* Partner closely with Data Engineers while maintaining clear accountability for what and how the data product should be architected
* Evaluate source-system structures, data relationships, grain, keys, dependencies, data quality requirements, and transformation complexity when developing architecture
* Apply the appropriate modeling technique based on business problems rather than relying on a prescriptive modeling methodology such as star schema
* Design scalable solutions on Databricks and Azure, or comparable modern cloud data platforms considered relevant
* Establish reusable architecture and data-modeling patterns that improve consistency, scalability, maintainability, and engineering velocity across data products
* Perform architecture and design reviews and provide technical guidance to Data Engineering teams
* Work with Product, Finance, Analytics, Engineering, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into implementable data-product designs
* Identify architecture risks, data dependencies, integration challenges, and performance considerations early in the product lifecycle
* Serve as a senior technical leader capable of driving architecture decisions and resolving complex design issues across teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience
* 10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data modeling, data warehousing, business intelligence, or related enterprise data disciplines
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in data architecture and data modeling, including responsibility for designing solutions implemented by Data Engineering teams
* Solid experience designing end-to-end data products, from source ingestion through curated, consumption-ready data layers
* Experience architecting cloud data solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Experience working with large, complex enterprise datasets and integrating data across multiple operational systems
* Deep understanding of medallion architecture, including bronze, silver, and gold data layers
* Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including relational, dimensional, normalized, denormalized, and domain-oriented approaches
* Solid understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, data pipelines, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data governance
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, transformations, aggregations, reconciliation, and multi-source data integration
* Demonstrated ability to design data solutions using Databricks; solid experience with Databricks or equivalent modern data platforms may also be considered
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction and design guidance to Data Engineers and other senior technical contributors
* Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex data architecture concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Required Software & Technical Tools**
The successful candidate should have solid hands-on architecture and design experience with modern enterprise data platforms and technologies, including:
  
  

* Cloud & Data Platforms

+ Databricks: solid experience with Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, and scalable data-product design
+ Microsoft Azure: Experience architecting enterprise data solutions using Azure services
+ Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2): Experience designing cloud data-lake storage structures and ingestion patterns
+ Azure Data Factory and/or equivalent orchestration technologies
+ Experience with Apache Spark / PySpark concepts and distributed data processing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing data products supporting Finance, Accounting, Billing, Financial Reporting, or Financial Operations
* Healthcare industry experience is beneficial but not required
* Experience operating in large, highly regulated enterprise environments
* Experience with data governance, lineage, data quality, security, and enterprise architecture standards
* Understanding of enterprise financial data, including concepts such as general ledger, revenue, billing, accounts receivable/payable, financial hierarchies, or financial reporting

**Leadership Expectations**
This is a high technical-leadership role. The Data Architect is expected to set architecture direction rather than simply review designs produced by others.
  
  
The role should be comfortable moving between detailed data design and senior-level technical discussions, including reviewing SQL and data models, resolving cross-system integration decisions, guiding Data Engineers, and communicating architecture trade-offs to Product, Engineering, Finance, and business leaders.
  
  
**Data Architecture & Modeling**

* Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, aggregations, reconciliation logic, and performance considerations
* Solid knowledge of bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture
* Data modeling across relational, dimensional, normalized, denormalized, and domain-oriented models
* Ability to define logical and physical data models, data-product structures, source-to-target mappings, data contracts, transformation rules, and integration patterns
* Experience designing solutions involving multiple source systems, complex relationships, large data volumes, and historical data
* Familiarity with data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, ERwin, Lucidchart, Visio, or equivalent

**Engineering & DevOps**

* Working knowledge of Git and modern source-control practices
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub for version control, CI/CD, deployment, and engineering collaboration
* Understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code, automated deployments, and DataOps/DevOps practices is preferred
* Ability to review and provide architecture guidance on SQL, notebooks, data pipelines, and engineering implementation

**Data Governance & Quality**

* Understanding of metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, data classification, access controls, and data-quality frameworks
* Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, or comparable governance/catalog platforms preferred
* Understanding of data privacy, security, retention, and regulatory requirements within large enterprise environments

**Domain Knowledge**

* Finance domain experience
* Candidates should ideally demonstrate experience designing enterprise data products supporting one or more of the following areas:

+ General Ledger and financial accounting
+ Revenue and revenue recognition
+ Billing and Accounts Receivable
+ Accounts Payable
+ Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
+ Financial reporting and management reporting
+ Cost and profitability analysis
+ Financial close and reconciliation
+ Chart of Accounts and financial hierarchies
+ Customer, vendor, contract, and product master data
+ Transactional and financial master/reference data

* Experience integrating financial data from platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle ERP/eBusiness Suite, PeopleSoft, or comparable enterprise financial platforms is highly desirable
* Healthcare industry knowledge is a plus, particularly experience with healthcare financial, billing, claims, provider, member, clinical, or operational data

**Leadership & Communication Skills**
This role requires significant technical leadership, with responsibility for setting design direction for Data Engineers and influencing architecture decisions across teams.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Own architecture decisions for complex enterprise data products from ingestion through business consumption
* Provide clear technical direction to senior Data Engineers, developers, analysts, and other architects
* Lead architecture and design reviews and ensure engineering implementations align with approved designs
* Serve as the technical authority for complex data-modeling, integration, transformation, and architecture decisions
* Translate complex Finance and business requirements into scalable technical data designs
* Communicate architecture decisions, alternatives, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs effectively to both technical and executive stakeholders
* Influence across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Architecture, Security, and Data Governance organizations
* Facilitate technical discussions and drive teams toward decisions when multiple design approaches are available
* Challenge designs constructively and establish reusable architecture patterns rather than creating one-off solutions
* Mentor senior engineers and architects and help raise the organization's overall data architecture maturity
* Balance strategic architecture thinking with sufficient hands-on technical depth to examine SQL, data models, source structures, and transformation logic
* Operate effectively in a matrixed enterprise environment with multiple business and technology stakeholders

* Modernization initiatives underway (SAP S/4, cloud migration, data platform modernization, AI transformation).
* Ability to influence enterprise operating models and standards across a global organization.
* Chance to mature an EA practice from the ground up.

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
The IT Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor role in the Global IT organization, based in India, with significant enterprise influence and visibility. This role serves as a visible change agent that drives business and technology innovation and alignment across Solventum’s global enterprise. The role is expected to operate as a strategic leader within the federated Enterprise Architecture team, drive technology asset management as a strategic imperative, own ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes and tooling, and help deliver a unified 3-year enterprise technology roadmap that reduces duplication, increases organizational transparency and agility, and accelerates business growth and transformation. Over time, this role may expand into formal people leadership as the Enterprise Architecture capability matures in India.
  
  
This role facilitates EA team activities including defining, documenting, and governing the enterprise IT architecture. The Enterprise Architect leads architecture consulting efforts to investigate and align technology solutions with business strategies, evaluates new and emerging technologies, creates architectural blueprints and target-state definitions, and assures technology solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture direction. The Architect also leads through influence in Architecture Review Board activities that shape technology innovation, govern technology adoption globally, and drive consistent architecture definition across technology domains.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities Include**

* Architecture Governance: Coordinate, create, publish, and measure adoption of architectural artifacts, including standards, policies, principles, reference architectures, and target-state definitions across technology domains and technology asset classes.
* Architecture Reviews: Facilitate Architecture Review Board activities ensuring responsive processes, rightsizing architecture reviews, and strengthening engagement of technical teams, business leaders, and program/project managers.
* Technology Asset Management Leadership: Lead technology asset management as a strategic imperative by establishing governance, lifecycle standards, CMDB data quality, ownership models, and decision processes that improve visibility, reduce risk, and enable rationalization across Solventum’s technology portfolio.
* undefined
* ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management Ownership: Own and continuously improve ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes, data standards, workflows, reporting, and tooling adoption to ensure accurate application inventory, business capability alignment, lifecycle status, technology risk visibility, and actionable portfolio insights.
* undefined
* undefined
* Technology Architecture Definition: Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures for enterprise technology assets including applications, data and integrations, infrastructure, security systems, and shared platforms. Establish architecture patterns, principles, and roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy and create an integrated, scalable technology landscape.
* undefined
* Technology Lifecycle Management: Conduct research, assess and evangelize new technologies where appropriate, and drive lifecycle management for implemented technologies. Partner with business, product, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to guide modernization, standardization, consolidation, retirement, and investment decisions.
* undefined
* undefined
* Delivery Leadership: Lead architecture delivery through influence by coordinating architects, platform teams, and cross-functional stakeholders in the creation and publication of detailed architectural artifacts and technical solutions. As the capability matures, this role may expand to include formal people leadership responsibilities for architects or architecture delivery teams.

**Your Skills And Expertise**
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher AND ten (10) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

OR
  
  

* High School Diploma/GED AND fourteen (14) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND
  
  
In addition to the above requirements, the following skills and experiences are also required:
  
  

* Enterprise Architecture experience, which includes business, application, data, technology, and security architecture domains, with demonstrated ability to define architecture direction and translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.
* Architecture experience managing architecture review boards, conducting architecture reviews, administering technology governance and portfolio management practices, and driving technology innovation and emerging and AI technology adoption.
* Agile and/or waterfall project management experience
* Experience with one or more of the following technologies or platforms: ServiceNow CMDB and Application Portfolio Management, SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce.com, SAP BTP/Datasphere, MuleSoft, Snowflake, AWS and Azure Cloud, Zscaler, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
  
  

* Technology Governance Expertise: Proven ability to design and govern end-to-end target states, roadmaps, and capability models that align strategy to execution.
* Technology Architecture and Asset Management Expertise: Expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman), modeling standards, and modern architecture practices including cloud-native, event-driven, microservices, API-first, agentic operating models, and data-centric architectures.
* undefined
* ServiceNow APM Process Ownership: Experience managing technology lifecycles and architecture portfolios using platforms such as ServiceNow CMDB, Application Portfolio Management (APM), and related governance and observability solutions.
* undefined

* Written and verbal communication skills and ability to evangelize and translate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Problem solving and analytical abilities to assess current IT landscape, identify gaps, and develop optimal solutions.

title: AI Ops- Data Analyst
description:
Total Number of Openings
