Are you a designer and problem-solver who can shape the next generation of delivery excellence at Slack? Are you someone who thrives translating ambiguous customer needs into elegant, workable solutions in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment? We want to talk to you!

Slack is looking for an Solution Architect on the Solution Design team to join our global project delivery organization supporting enterprise customer implementations. We need someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and technically fluent — someone who shapes the right solution for each Enterprise customer, working within the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, and who helps unlock the full value of the Slack platform (including Slack AI) through thoughtful design.

  

You'll design, validate, and document solutions for Enterprise customers across use cases, teams, and geographies — balancing customer needs, platform capabilities, and delivery feasibility.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own solution design across the Discover, Define, and Design stages of the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, translating customer requirements into clear, buildable solution designs
* Evaluate and recommend the right mix of out-of-the-box Slack/Slack AI capabilities (search & summaries, huddle notes, Workflow Builder, native Slackbot capabilities, Agentforce integrations) versus custom configuration, always favoring the simplest viable path

* Identify integration points with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce) and design cross-cloud solutions that keep Slack at the center of the customer's workflow
* Support post-launch adoption by ensuring the solution design accounts for change management and long-term platform maturity

**What you should have**

* 8-10+ years of solution design, architecture, or technical consulting experience, preferably in SaaS and/or professional services
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale solutions involving collaboration, workflow, or integration platforms
* Working knowledge of (or ability to quickly ramp on) the Salesforce Delivery Methodology and Slack/Slack AI product capabilities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and competing requirements to land on the right design
* Excellent communication skills for translating technical design decisions to both customer stakeholders and delivery teams
* Hands-on familiarity with integration patterns and API-based architecture, ideally including Salesforce products
* A collaborative mindset — comfortable partnering with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customers to reach a shared design
* Natural curiosity, a love of learning, and a habit of sharing design knowledge and patterns with others
* Familiarity with Salesforce products and how they integrate with Slack (e.g., Agentforce, Sales/Service Cloud notifications) is a plus, though not required

-

Slack is the collaboration hub of choice for companies of all sizes worldwide — ensuring the right people stay in the loop, key information stays at their fingertips, and teams stay connected, now increasingly powered by Slack AI.

  
  

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer -AI Operations
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an exceptional Senior AI Engineer with 6-8 years of experience to architect and deliver enterprise-grade AI systems at scale, with primary focus on Amazon Bedrock and Microsoft Azure AI Foundry - the two leading managed cloud AI platforms. This is a staff-level individual contributor position for engineers who can drive technical strategy, mentor cross-functional teams, and translate the latest advances in generative AI into high-impact production systems.

You will operate as a principal builder and technical authority across our most ambitious AI initiatives: multi-agent orchestration pipelines, RAG-powered knowledge systems, LLM fine-tuning workflows, and cloud-native AI infrastructure. You will own decisions that reach millions of users and set the engineering benchmark for AI excellence across the organization.

This role intentionally avoids SageMaker-centric workflows in favor of the latest serverless and managed AI services - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon Nova, Amazon S3 Vectors, Microsoft Foundry, and Azure AI Agent Service - enabling faster iteration, lower infrastructure overhead, and access to frontier models.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & AI Architecture**

* Own end-to-end architecture of cloud-native AI systems on AWS and Azure, from raw data ingestion through LLM serving, evaluation, and continuous monitoring.
* Establish AI engineering standards, model governance frameworks, and cloud design patterns adopted across multiple product teams.
* Lead critical cross-platform design decisions: when to use AWS Bedrock vs. Azure AI Foundry, which foundation model best fits performance and cost constraints, and when to fine-tune vs. prompt-engineer.
* Evaluate and rapidly prototype with emerging AWS and Azure AI capabilities (Amazon Nova 2, Bedrock Reinforcement Fine-Tuning, Azure GPT-5-Codex, Foundry Agent Service) to keep the organization at the frontier.
* Drive technical design reviews, architecture critiques, and risk assessments for high-stakes AI deployments.

**AWS** **Amazon Bedrock & Generative AI Engineering**

Architect enterprise applications using Amazon Bedrock as the primary LLM serving and orchestration platform

* - leveraging the full model catalog including Amazon Nova 2 (Lite, Pro, Sonic, Omni), Anthropic Claude, Mistral Large 3, and Amazon Bedrock Marketplace models.
* Build production multi-agent systems using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: design agent boundaries with Policy controls, implement episodic Memory for long-horizon reasoning, and configure AgentCore Gateway for secure tool integrations with Salesforce, Slack, and internal APIs.
* Implement browser-based workflow automation agents with Amazon Nova Act, achieving 90%+ task reliability for form filling, data extraction, QA testing, and enterprise UI automation workflows.
Design and deploy RAG pipelines using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with Amazon S3 Vectors as the primary vector store* - supporting up to 2 billion vectors per index with 100ms query latencies at up to 90% lower cost than specialized vector databases.
* Apply Amazon Bedrock Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for domain-specific model customization, achieving up to 66% accuracy gains over base models without requiring labeled datasets or deep ML expertise.
* Leverage Amazon Bedrock Model Distillation to create task-specific models that run up to 500% faster and cost 75% less, with minimal accuracy trade-off.
* Implement Amazon Bedrock Intelligent Prompt Routing and Prompt Caching to reduce inference costs by up to 30% while maintaining response quality.
* Apply Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for responsible AI enforcement: content filtering, hallucination prevention, PII redaction, and compliance controls across all production LLM endpoints.
* Develop and manage Kiro-based agentic development workflows: context-aware, session-persistent autonomous agents for coding and operational task automation.

**AZURE** **Microsoft Foundry & Azure AI Engineering**

* Build and deploy intelligent applications on Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio), the unified platform for model access, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agent deployment at enterprise scale.
* Integrate and orchestrate frontier models through Foundry Models: Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1 (1M token context), o3 / o4-mini reasoning models, GPT-5-Codex for multimodal code reasoning, Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1), and Mistral Large 3.
* Design and operate multi-agent systems using Microsoft Agent Framework (Semantic Kernel + AutoGen runtime), building stateful long-running agents deployed via Hosted Agents and published to Microsoft 365 Copilot with one-click.
* Build agentic workflows with Azure AI Agent Service, connecting agents to enterprise data via Azure AI Search (RAG), line-of-business APIs through Azure API Management, and real-time data through Azure Event Hubs.
* Leverage Microsoft Foundry Control Plane for fleet-wide agent observability, governance, policy enforcement, and compliance auditing across all deployed AI agents.
* Implement Deep Research agents in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service as composable, programmable research engines embedded in multi-agent workflows and enterprise applications.
* Use Foundry Tools (unified suite of prebuilt AI capabilities for audio, video, image, document, and text) to accelerate development of intelligent agents without rebuilding common AI tasks.
* Apply Azure AI Foundry Model Router to dynamically route prompts to the optimal model (GPT-4.1, o4-mini, Phi-4) at runtime, minimizing costs while preserving quality SLAs.
* Configure NSP-protected private deployments using VNETs, private endpoints, and BYO Key Vault connections for regulated-industry AI workloads on Foundry.

**Cross-Platform Infrastructure & MLOps**

Architect AWS-native training infrastructure using EC2 Trainium3 UltraServers (Trn3) - AWS's 3nm AI chip delivering 4x performance over Trn2

* - for large-scale model training and inference at lower cost.
* Build and manage containerized model serving on Amazon EKS with Karpenter autoscaling, integrated with Triton Inference Server for multi-model, multi-framework inference optimization.
* Implement fully serverless inference using AWS Lambda Managed Instances for on-demand LLM endpoint invocations without infrastructure provisioning.
* Establish IaC-driven ML platform provisioning using AWS CDK (Python) and Azure Bicep/Terraform, ensuring all AI environments are version-controlled, reproducible, and auditable.
Design cross-cloud observability stacks: Amazon CloudWatch + AWS X-Ray on AWS; Azure Monitor + Application Insights on Azure* - with unified dashboards for model drift detection, latency SLOs, and cost alerting.
* Implement MLflow (serverless via SageMaker AI integration or self-hosted on EKS) for experiment tracking, model versioning, and lifecycle management across both AWS and Azure workloads.
* Champion cloud cost optimization: AWS Spot instance strategies and Bedrock Intelligent Prompt Routing for AWS workloads; Azure Developer Training tier and Serverless API pay-as-you-go for Azure workloads.

**Evaluation, Safety & Responsible AI**

Define and own the organization's AI evaluation framework

* - automated pipelines measuring model accuracy, fairness, bias, toxicity, hallucination rate, and safety across both AWS Bedrock and Azure Foundry deployments.
* Lead red-teaming, adversarial robustness testing, and jailbreak analysis using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and Azure AI Content Safety before every production launch.
* Establish model risk management: model cards, prompt audit trails, production monitoring dashboards, and incident response runbooks for AI systems.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and the AI Ethics board to meet regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, SOC 2 Type II).

**Mentorship & Organizational Influence**

* Serve as principal technical mentor for mid and junior AI engineers: conducting code reviews, architecture design sessions, and cloud platform enablement workshops.
* Represent the team at executive forums, customer briefings, and external AI conferences.
* Partner with Product, Research, Data Science, and Platform Engineering to align AI roadmap with business objectives and cloud investment strategy.
* Drive org-wide knowledge sharing via internal tech talks, open-source contributions, technical blog posts, and AWS/Azure certification mentorship programs.
* Lead technical hiring: define role requirements, design AI cloud-focused interview loops, and make recommendations for senior and staff-level candidates.

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer**

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

SES has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer. You will be part of a team responsible for

* Portal software design, governing scalable architectural improvements along with team productivity, scalability, simplification and quality improvements
* Driving architectural alignment and long-term technical strategy across multiple teams.
* Leading feature refinements and ensuring end-to-end delivery of high-quality, reliable solutions.
* Enabling predictable delivery through strong architectural judgment and technical mentorship.
* Ensuring long-term maintainability, operational excellence, and system health.
* Partnering closely with product, platform, and external stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
* Leading the team using Agile principles to ensure clarity, focus, and delivery alignment
* Preparing and guiding the team through PI Planning and sprint commitments
* Maintaining hands-on involvement in coding, design, and problem-solving
* Guiding the team in following best coding standards, engineering practices and effective use of AI
* Improving team productivity, code quality, and technical excellence

  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS**

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical leader and key contributor within an engineering team, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. The role requires strong expertise in system architecture, application design, performance optimization, CI/CD practices, and modern software development methodologies. The candidate will provide architectural direction, guide technical design and implementation, mentor engineering teams, and drive Agile execution to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery of business outcomes. Primary Responsibilities will include the following.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture:** Provide hands-on technical leadership while defining scalable, maintainable, and resilient solution architectures that align with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long-term technology strategy.
* **Requirement Analysis & Feature Refinement:** Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and stakeholders to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, define solution scope, identify dependencies, and drive end-to-end feature delivery.
* **Hands-on Engineering & Design:** Actively contribute to solution design, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving while guiding the team in delivering high-quality software solutions.
* **Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards:** Establish and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, coding standards, CI/CD practices, and AI-assisted engineering practices through design reviews, code reviews, and technical governance.
* **Quality, Performance & Operational Excellence:** Ensure solutions meet quality, security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance expectations while driving production readiness and post-release stability.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration & Integration:** Collaborate with architecture, platform, DevOps, QA, product teams, vendors, and other engineering teams to align technical direction, manage integration contracts, and ensure seamless delivery.
* **Risk, Dependency & Delivery Management:** Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks, architectural challenges, cross-team dependencies, and delivery impediments to ensure predictable execution.
* **Mentorship & Technical Capability Development:** Coach and mentor engineers, foster technical excellence, strengthen engineering practices, and drive Communities of Practice (CoP) to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
* **Agile Delivery & Continuous Improvement:** Lead technical execution within Agile teams by improving estimation accuracy, delivery predictability, engineering productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Innovation & Technology Enablement:** Evaluate and adopt modern technologies, architectural patterns, automation, and AI-driven development practices to improve engineering efficiency and accelerate business value delivery.

  

**Key Focus Areas**

* **Portal System Software:** Drive scalable, observable, high-quality software development and delivery.
* **Team-Level Software Delivery:** Drive high-quality, maintainable, and reliable software development within the team, ensuring timely and predictable delivery aligned with sprint and PI objectives.
* **Implementation Excellence:** Ensure solutions are designed and implemented with strong emphasis on code quality, testability, reusability, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* **Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs):** Ensuring the system is fully monitored, reliable, secure, performant, and maintainable.
* **Operational Readiness:** Support production readiness by incorporating monitoring, logging, resiliency, and supportability considerations into development.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Drive ongoing improvements in development practices, Agile execution, team productivity, and technical maturity.

**COMPETENCIES**

* **Communication**: Clearly articulates complex technical concepts through concise documentation and presentations, effectively influencing stakeholders, customers, and vendors.
* **Architectural Judgment & Problem Solving:** Demonstrates strong analytical thinking to evaluate trade-offs, drive sound decisions, and resolve complex technical challenges.
* **Technical Leadership & Collaboration:** Leads with ownership while working autonomously and collaborating effectively across cross-functional, matrixed teams.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or related technology – advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in the software industry, including 2+ years as a Technical Lead and 2+ years as an Architect, along with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and building scalable APIs and microservices.
* Good development experience with Java / Spring Boot / Go / Node.js / NGINX / Rabbit MQ
* Nice to have development experience in React.js
* Good experience in Architecting and Designing Large scale applications
* Experience in CI/CD and AWS deployments (EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB)
* Strong experience with system observability, monitoring and production support.
* Advanced knowledge of software development lifecycles; expert knowledge in Agile and Lean methods.
* Ability to support architectural suggestions and bring up a high available and scalable system.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize work, coordinate with onsite stakeholders and well organized.
* Flexibility in working with technologies and platforms.
* A commitment to excellence, best practices, and the continuous improvement of our products, code base, processes, and tools.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

**Job Title: Development Support Engineer**

**Department: IT**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Development Support Engineer to provide day-to-day support across the software development lifecycle. You will triage and reproduce incoming issues, fix defects in existing services, assist with testing and deployments, and take on small development tasks under the guidance of senior engineers. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for someone with a solid programming foundation who wants to grow into a full backend or full-stack engineering position. You will learn our platforms end-to-end, gain exposure to cutting-edge technology including AI-assisted development tooling and AI-driven product features, and act as the first line of technical response for the systems we run.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Triage, reproduce, and document incoming bug reports and escalations from internal teams and customers.

* Fix low- to medium-complexity defects in existing services and applications with guidance from senior engineers.

* Take on routine development tasks, including small feature enhancements, configuration changes, and code cleanup.

* Support build, release, and deployment activities across development, staging, and production environments.

* Monitor application logs, dashboards, and alerts, and escalate issues with clear diagnostic detail.

* Prepare test data, environment setups, and sandbox instances for the development team.

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues.

* Participate in code reviews, stand-ups, and sprint ceremonies to build familiarity with team standards and practices.

* Understanding of object-oriented programming fundamentals and the habits behind clean, readable code.

* Basic SQL and relational database concepts — queries, joins, and reading an existing schema.

* Familiarity with REST APIs and tools such as Postman or Swagger.

* Git fundamentals: branching, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.

* Exposure to .NET (C#) or Node.js/TypeScript backend development.

* Awareness of CI/CD concepts and automated build pipelines.

* Administer and support a production self-hosted Elastic Stack environment.

* Perform cluster health monitoring, troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance optimization.

* Execute platform upgrades, patching activities, and lifecycle management.
* Implement and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.

Observability Engineering

* Configure anomaly detection jobs and rule-based alerting to proactively identify issues.
* Collaborate with application teams to define meaningful operational metrics and alert thresholds.

Application Performance Monitoring (APM)

* Monitor application performance, latency, throughput, and error rates.
* Analyze distributed traces to identify bottlenecks and performance concerns.
* Develop Kibana dashboards that provide actionable performance insights for engineering teams.
* Support adoption of OpenTelemetry standards and best practices.

Platform Reliability Optimization
  
  

* Optimize Elasticsearch cluster performance and resource utilization.
* Monitor index growth, storage consumption, and ingestion rates.
* Support infrastructure hosting Elastic clusters, including servers, storage, and platform resources.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce platform costs.
* Assist with future migrations and integrations supporting hybrid deployment models.

description:
**Mobile Automation Engineer (SDET – Appium/Python)**

**Role overview**

We are hiring a Mobile Automation Engineer (SDET) with 4+ years of experience in Appium (Python) on iOS and Android. You will develop and maintain automated tests for our mobile applications, strengthen the existing Python/Appium framework, and integrate suites into CI/CD. The stack centres on PyTest for execution and Allure for clear, shareable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Framework & design**

* Extend and maintain the mobile automation framework (Appium + Python, PyTest).
* Apply POM (or similar) for reusable, readable tests.
* Improve stability, parallel execution, and cross-platform coverage where needed.

**Automation development**

* Build and maintain UI, regression, and end-to-end automated tests using PyTest (markers, fixtures, ordering/dependencies as the suite requires).
* Implement reliable waits, error handling, and logging.
* Publish and maintain Allure reports (and related HTML summaries); keep attachments, history, and environment details useful for triage.
* Handle flows that span more than one mobile app when the scenario requires it.

**Mobile platforms**

* Run and debug on Android (ADB, logs) and iOS (Xcode, simulator/device).
* Investigate failures across OS versions, devices, and network conditions.

**CI/CD**

* Integrate and maintain automated tests in CI/CD (Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps or similar).
* Wire PyTest runs and Allure report generation/artifacts into pipelines; triage failures and improve job reliability.

**Collaboration & quality**

* Work with dev, QA, and product on scope, coverage, and release readiness.
* Participate in code reviews and follow team automation standards.
* Use Allure and execution metrics to track reliability and run time.

**Required skills & qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in CS, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5 years in test automation with strong mobile focus.
* Python and Appium (mandatory).
* PyTest (fixtures, markers, reporting plugins) and Allure report setup and usage.

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**  
  
Salesforce is looking for a versatile generalist engineer to join the Trailhead Engineering team. Trailhead is the fun way to learn Salesforce and the next-generation learning platform to empower our customers, partners, and employees. Explore our app and site at trailhead.Salesforce.
  
  
The Salesforce Trailhead team is responsible for the innovation of the Salesforce digital experience globally, leveraging best-in-class technology and systems—including Salesforce's platform. Salesforce continues to grow rapidly, and our digital experience ensures that visitors, prospects, customers, and trailblazers can connect with Salesforce content and capability in a seamless and engaging manner.
  
  
Ready to bring your engineering expertise to Salesforce? Do you place a high value on being part of a company that emphasizes equality, diversity, innovation, and doing the right thing for ourselves, our community, and our customers? The Trailhead team is looking for an enthusiastic generalist software engineer who is passionate about writing clean, efficient code, mastering web fundamentals, owning infrastructure, and leveraging modern AI developer tools.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Build and maintain end-to-end web applications, robust APIs, and microservices supporting global Trailblazer Community collaboration products.
* Own and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and AWS, optimizing pipelines and CI/CD workflows for efficient delivery.
* Leverage cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving.
* Participate in defining architecture and design considerations for re-use, code management, security, performance, scalability, and accessibility.
* Work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, and UX designers to build features our Trailblazers will love and adopt.
Operate effectively in a hybrid engineering model, taking ownership of code quality, automated testing, and release management.  

**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience. Infrastructure & CI/CD: Solid hands-on understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. Strong experience setting up, maintaining, and automating CI/CD pipelines.
* Web Basics & Frontend: Deep understanding of web fundamentals (HTTP/HTTPS, REST principles, browser rendering, DOM, security basics like CORS/CSRF).
* API Building & Backend: Proven experience designing, building, and consuming scalable APIs and microservices with clean architectural patterns.
* Core CS Fundamentals: Strong grasp of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithm design, system performance, and database fundamentals (PostgreSQL/MySQL).
* Generalist Mindset: Ability to jump across full-stack systems, troubleshoot end-to-end problems, and quickly adapt to new stacks and toolings.
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with clarity of thought to effectively pitch technical solutions.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AI-Native / Pro-AI Workflows: Active experience using AI-driven tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to boost developer productivity, write code, run code reviews, or design system solutions.
* Experience with containerization and deployment platforms (Docker, Heroku, or Kubernetes).
* Practical knowledge of test-driven development (TDD), automated testing frameworks, and accessibility standards.
* Familiarity or prior experience with modern web frameworks (e.g., Ruby on Rails, Node.js/Express, or Python) and relational datastores.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
RSG Research is hiring for its portfolio company, **Bay6.ai**, and we’re looking for

**Introduction :** Bay6.ai is an innovative company at the forefront of AI technology, building intelligent products and conversational experiences that transform how organizations interact with their data and workflows.

**Enterprise AI Platform for Automation & Insights | Bay6**

As a Fullstack Engineer you will design and build production-grade, user-facing AI experiences that customers love using. If you are a hands-on, results-driven engineer with deep web development chops and a passion for shipping polished AI-powered interfaces, we want to hear from you.

In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of immersive conversational AI experiences end-to-end—from pixel-perfect, responsive frontends to the backend services and LLM integrations that power them. You will partner with product, design, and AI engineers across the globe to translate ambiguous requirements into production code, extending existing systems where it makes sense rather than rebuilding from scratch, and helping to raise the bar for engineering quality across the team.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Architect, design, and build full-screen conversational AI experiences from the ground up, including streaming chat interfaces, real-time UI state, and rich response rendering.
* Make smart, defensible technology choices when selecting and applying frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or comparable), balancing speed of delivery against long-term maintainability.
* Design and extend backend services in Node.js and Express, including REST APIs, authentication, streaming endpoints (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets), and integrations with LLM providers.
* Integrate large language model APIs into customer-facing products, handling token streaming, error recovery, retries, tool use, and conversation state.
* Ensure new features integrate cleanly with existing backend systems and frontend codebases.
* Own the end-to-end quality of the user experience, including performance, accessibility, responsiveness, error states, and overall polish.
* Write clean, testable, well-documented TypeScript across the stack, and advocate for engineering best practices in code review, system design, and architecture discussions.
* Collaborate closely with product, design, AI engineers, and other development partners to refine requirements and deliver on aggressive timelines.
* Proactively identify and resolve technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and UX issues, escalating tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team’s technical direction, documentation, and engineering standards.

**Required Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years of professional fullstack web development experience shipping production software.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) or building AI/ML-powered features into customer-facing applications.
* Comfort and experience architecting and building rich, full-screen web experiences from scratch, with a strong eye for UX, accessibility, and visual polish.
* Deep experience with at least one major modern frontend framework (React strongly preferred; Angular, Vue, or Svelte also valuable), including state management and component architecture.
* Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express (or comparable), including REST API design, authentication, streaming responses, and integration with third-party services.
* Demonstrated experience building real-time or streaming user interfaces (chat, dashboards, collaborative tools, or similar) and a solid grasp of conversational UX patterns.
* Proven ability to architect non-trivial features end-to-end with minimal supervision and make pragmatic technology choices under ambiguity.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, designers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and own delivery from concept to production.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 7–10 years of full-stack development experience?
* How many years of hands-on experience do you have with React.js?
* How many years of experience do you have with Node.js and Express.js?
* Have you independently handled frontend and backend development for a project?
* Have you worked with OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs? For how many years?
* Have you implemented streaming responses using SSE or WebSockets?

Experience:

* LLM API: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
===========================

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**
===============

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**
=======================================

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

===========================

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
============================

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.**

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This position is Hybrid with 2 to 3 days from Hyderabad office.**  
  
**What You’ll Do**

Lead software architecture and modernization

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

Stay deeply hands-on in code

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.

Design strong domain models and APIs

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.

Modernize application foundations

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

Improve data access and integration design

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

Raise the bar for code quality and testing

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

Create reusable engineering patterns

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

What This Is Not

This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.

This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

**What You Bring**

Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.

Credible hands-on implementation depth

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.

Service transformation and architecture judgment

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

Production reliability and performance expertise

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

Software design and refactoring depth

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

Data and integration depth

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

Strong testing and code-quality discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

Principal-level technical leadership

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.

Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.

Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.

**What Success Looks Like**

Modernization advances without destabilizing the business

Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.

Critical software becomes easier to change

Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.

Architecture decisions become executable

Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.

Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle

Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.

AI expands engineering leverage

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.

**Why This Matters**

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.

This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. * Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience developing production-grade firmware for bare-metal systems or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
* Expert-level proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or later) and modern CMake build systems using VSCode / Kiro IDE.
* Strong familiarity with ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, or similar modern microprocessor architectures, specifically those featuring advanced secure enclaves/TrustZone.

**Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Modern C++)**

**Location:** Hyderabad (Manikonda office)

**Department:** Engineering

**Position Overview** We are seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize high-performance, secure firmware for our next-generation hardware platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level hardware interactions, high-level architectural design, and strict payment industry compliance.

Our engineering culture prioritizes safety, deterministic execution, ultra-low latency, and transactional security. You will leverage modern C++17 to build robust, zero-overhead abstractions—completely eliminating legacy, error-prone C patterns. You will own the end-to-end automation pipeline, ensuring software quality via cross-compilation, advanced **ISTO**-compliant hardware tracing, and secure **EMV** transaction workflows.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **EMV Protocol Implementation & Compliance:** Design, optimize, and maintain EMV Contact (L1/L2) and Contactless kernels. Implement highly secure, zero-allocation APDU parsing pipelines and cryptographic wrappers that comply with strict payment network certifications.
* **Modern Driver Architecture:** Design and maintain peripheral drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, DMA, NFC/RFID interfaces) utilizing C++17 compile-time design patterns (if constexpr, template polymorphism) to eliminate runtime overhead.
* **Advanced Trace & Debugging (ISTO):** Leverage **ISTO** standards (e.g., IEEE-ISTO Nexus 5001 Global Embedded Processor Debug Interface) for non-intrusive trace, performance analysis, and root-cause debugging of bare-metal applications without impacting timing behaviour.
* **Resource & Memory Management:** Author deterministic, zero-heap applications using custom allocators, placement new, and RAII wrappers to guarantee zero memory leaks and block-free execution during time-critical payment processing.
* **Firmware Virtualization & Simulation:** Build and manage cross-compilation toolchains targeting custom architectures. Set up and run automated test suites inside QEMU / Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments for EMV regression testing.
* **Sanitizer Instrumentation:** Instrument code and debug complex runtime issues using memory, thread, and undefined behavior sanitizers (ASan, TSan, UBSan) integrated directly into CI/CD pipelines.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies** To be successful in this role, you must be able to demonstrate deep expertise in the following areas during our technical assessment:

**1. EMV & Secure Systems Engineering**

* Demonstrated experience developing embedded software compliant with **EMVCo** specifications, ISO 7816, or ISO 14443 standards.
* Understanding of secure elements, payment cryptography (RSA, DES/3DES, AES), and side-channel attack mitigation in a bare-metal environment.

**2. Advanced C++17 Concepts**

* Deep understanding of non-owning memory types (std::string\_view) and explicit error-handling models without heap usage (std::optional, std::variant) to handle complex payment state machines safely.
* Expert utilization of type-safe hardware mapping tools (std::byte) and strict safety enforcements ([[nodiscard]]).

**3. Low-Level Memory & Concurrency Management**

* Strong knowledge of disabling non-deterministic language features (e.g., building with -fno-exceptions and -fno-rtti) while preserving architectural safety.
* Mastery of thread synchronization using lightweight, lock-free hardware atomics (std::atomic) over heavy mutexes to prevent priority inversions during synchronous I/O operations.

**4. Simulation, DevOps, and Tooling**

* Hands-on experience interpreting complex stack traces, utilizing **ISTO** tracing protocols, and debugging target-specific binaries running under emulators (QEMU).
* Experience writing and optimizing automated test configurations for CI/CD environments (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).

We are converting our drone video and image analytics MVP into a multi-tenant SaaS platform, with GA. The Python Developer (AI/ML) builds the production services around our models: GPU-based inference, media processing pipelines, and the APIs that let tenants submit drone imagery and video and receive reliable results. You will turn research-grade scripts from the MVP into scalable, observable, cost-efficient services.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Inference services: Build and maintain Python services (FastAPI) that serve computer-vision models (detection, segmentation, classification, and tracking) on GPU infrastructure, with batching, queueing, and autoscaling.

2. Model packaging and serving: Containerize models and serve them with Triton, TorchServe, or ONNX Runtime/TensorRT. Support model versioning, A/B rollout, and rollback.

3. Media pipelines: Implement ingestion-to-inference workflows for large images, orthomosaics, and video, including frame extraction, tiling, geotagging with EXIF/XMP and telemetry, post-processing, and result aggregation. Use FFmpeg, OpenCV, and GDAL/rasterio.

4. Async processing: Build job orchestration on queues and workers (Celery, SQS/Kafka, or Ray) with retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling.

5. Multi-tenant ML: Enforce tenant isolation in data access, model usage, and results. Support per-tenant quotas, usage-metering hooks (inference minutes and GPU seconds), and per-tenant model configuration.

6. Performance and cost: Profile and optimize latency, throughput, and GPU utilization using mixed precision, quantization, and batching. Track cost per inference.

7. MLOps: Contribute to training-to-production pipelines: dataset versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow or W&B), model registry, automated evaluation, and drift or quality monitoring.

8. Quality: Write unit, integration, and load tests. Validate model outputs against agreed accuracy and confidence thresholds with QA and data scientists.

9. Security and compliance: Follow secure coding practices, secrets management, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit logging in support of SOC 2.

10. Migration: Port MVP inference code and models to the new platform, and verify result parity for existing customers.

11. Collaboration: Work with the Drone Data Architect, Tech Architect, full-stack, DevOps/SRE, and Business Analyst on API contracts, result schemas, and SLAs. Participate in code reviews and sprint ceremonies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years of professional Python development; strong in typing, async I/O, packaging, and testing (pytest).
* 2+ years deploying ML or computer-vision models to production (PyTorch or TensorFlow).

title: Python Developer (AI/ML)
description:
**Role Summary:** We are converting our drone video and image analytics MVP into a multi-tenant SaaS platform, with GA.The Python Developer (AI/ML) builds the production services around our models: GPU-based inference, media processing pipelines, and the APIs that let tenants submit drone imagery and video and receive reliable results. You will turn research-grade scripts from the MVP into scalable, observable, cost- efficient services.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Inference services: Build and maintain Python services (FastAPI) that serve computer-vision models (detection, segmentation, classification, and tracking) on GPU infrastructure, with batching, queueing,and autoscaling.)

2. Model packaging and serving: Containerize models and serve them with Triton, TorchServe, or ONNX Runtime/TensorRT. Support model versioning, A/B rollout, and rollback.

3. Media pipelines: Implement ingestion-to-inference workflows for large images, orthomosaics, and video, including frame extraction, tiling, geotagging with EXIF/XMP and telemetry, post-processing, and result aggregation. Use FFmpeg, OpenCV, and GDAL/rasterio.

4. Async processing: Build job orchestration on queues and workers (Celery, SQS/Kafka, or Ray) with retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling.

5. Multi-tenant ML: Enforce tenant isolation in data access, model usage, and results. Support per- tenant quotas, usage-metering hooks (inference minutes and GPU seconds), and per-tenant model configuration.

6. Performance and cost: Profile and optimize latency, throughput, and GPU utilization using mixed precision, quantization, and batching. Track cost per inference.

7. MLOps: Contribute to training-to-production pipelines: dataset versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow or W&B), model registry, automated evaluation, and drift or quality monitoring.

8. Quality: Write unit, integration, and load tests. Validate model outputs against agreed accuracy and confidence thresholds with QA and data scientists.

9. Security and compliance: Follow secure coding practices, secrets management, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit logging in support of SOC 2.

10. Migration: Port MVP inference code and models to the new platform, and verify result parity for existing customers.

11. Collaboration: Work with the Drone Data Architect, Tech Architect, full-stack, DevOps/SRE, and Business Analyst on API contracts, result schemas, and SLAs. Participate in code reviews and sprint ceremonies.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

4+ years of professional Python development; strong in typing, async I/O, packaging, and testing (pytest). 2+ years deploying ML or computer-vision models to production (PyTorch or TensorFlow).

Experience with FastAPI or Flask, REST/gRPC APIs, and PostgreSQL.

Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes; GPU workloads (CUDA basics, NVIDIA drivers/runtime).

Experience with OpenCV, NumPy, and video/image processing at scale.

Cloud experience on AWS or Azure (S3/Blob, queues, container services, GPU instances).

Git, CI/CD, and code-review discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Detection and segmentation frameworks (YOLO, Detectron2, MMDetection, SAM) and object tracking.

Model optimization with ONNX, TensorRT, or quantization.

Geospatial tooling (GDAL, rasterio, GeoPandas, PostGIS) and drone data formats.

Distributed processing with Ray, Spark, or Dask.

Monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and usage-based billing integrations.

Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and MLflow or Kubeflow.

Utility, telecom, or infrastructure inspection domain experience.

**Key Deliverables:**

Production-ready GPU inference services and model-serving components.

Reliable media ingestion, processing, and asynchronous job workflows.

Tenant-isolated ML execution with usage-metering hooks and model configuration.

Observable, tested, and cost-aware services that support migration from the MVP to the GA platform.

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.
  
  
**Required Skills**
['AI', 'API', 'LLM', 'REST', 'SQL', 'database']
  
  
Additional Information

description:

**AI-native platforms, application architecture, platform core services, and cloud DevOps infrastructure**

* DevOps Strategy & Cloud Architecture: Defining and driving end-to-end cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated multi-environment deployment frameworks.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps & Release Engineering: Architecting and optimizing resilient CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions/Jenkins), container security scanning, automated quality gates, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
* Application Architecture & System Standards: Defining application design patterns, API-first specifications, microservices standards, and data modeling practices for enterprise-grade SaaS products.
* Kubernetes, Observability & Reliability: Designing highly available, fault-tolerant containerized environments using Kubernetes, alongside enterprise-grade observability, telemetry, and automated alerting frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Cross-Pod Technical Governance: Partnering closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, and DevOps/SRE teams to review architecture proposals, resolve technical trade-offs, and enforce best-in-class engineering standards.
* Client & Executive Technical Advisory: Stepping into high-stakes enterprise technical discussions with client architects, CTOs, and CIOs to present platform capabilities, integration architectures, and security postures.
* Mentorship & Technical Direction: Mentoring senior engineers and tech leads, driving RFCs (Requests for Comments), and fostering an engineering culture anchored in clean craftsmanship and architectural rigor.

**We are the perfect match if you...**

* Have 12–15 years of progressive experience across Platform Engineering, Software Architecture, Application Architecture, and Cloud/DevOps infrastructure in high-scale SaaS environments.
* Possess hands-on architectural experience with AI-based systems, including LLM integrations, modern retrieval pipelines, model serving, vector databases, or MLOps frameworks.
* Bring proven expertise designing enterprise-scale Application Architectures and foundational Platform Core Services (APIs, asynchronous messaging, caching, workflow engines, and distributed databases).
* Have deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and building production-grade infrastructure from scratch.
* Are highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and modern DevSecOps/CI-CD automation pipelines.
* Are proficient in modern backend languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and can evaluate system design trade-offs from first principles.
* Understand observability, telemetry, and site reliability engineering (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK) to ensure platform visibility and proactive alerting.
* Can navigate complex technical discussions with enterprise clients, translating high-level business requirements into resilient, secure, and modular software architectures.
* Bring an automation-first mindset with strong ownership, combining high-level strategic architecture vision with the ability to dive deep into code, pipelines, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.

title: Platform Architect
description:

IDfy builds mission-critical SaaS products that power identity verification, background screening, and fraud prevention for the world's most trusted companies. With over 300 million verified profiles, IDfy has 1,300+ clients globally. IDfy's three platforms—
**OnboardIQ**
,
**OneRisk**

**Privy**

**Principal Platform Architect**
