**AI-native platforms, application architecture, platform core services, and cloud DevOps infrastructure**
. You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems design, LLM/AI model orchestration, enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines, and high-throughput reliability to power our mission-critical SaaS ecosystem.
  
  
**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like...**

* Architecting AI-Native Platforms: Designing end-to-end architectures for AI-driven platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, model inference pipelines, and intelligent workflow automation across products.
* Core Platform Services Design: Owning the blueprints and shared capabilities for platform core services (identity, orchestration, messaging, event buses, telemetry, and data access layers) to ensure seamless inter-service communication and reuse.
* DevOps Strategy & Cloud Architecture: Defining and driving end-to-end cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated multi-environment deployment frameworks.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps & Release Engineering: Architecting and optimizing resilient CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions/Jenkins), container security scanning, automated quality gates, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
* Application Architecture & System Standards: Defining application design patterns, API-first specifications, microservices standards, and data modeling practices for enterprise-grade SaaS products.
* Kubernetes, Observability & Reliability: Designing highly available, fault-tolerant containerized environments using Kubernetes, alongside enterprise-grade observability, telemetry, and automated alerting frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Cross-Pod Technical Governance: Partnering closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, and DevOps/SRE teams to review architecture proposals, resolve technical trade-offs, and enforce best-in-class engineering standards.
* Client & Executive Technical Advisory: Stepping into high-stakes enterprise technical discussions with client architects, CTOs, and CIOs to present platform capabilities, integration architectures, and security postures.
* Mentorship & Technical Direction: Mentoring senior engineers and tech leads, driving RFCs (Requests for Comments), and fostering an engineering culture anchored in clean craftsmanship and architectural rigor.

**We are the perfect match if you...**

* Have 12–15 years of progressive experience across Platform Engineering, Software Architecture, Application Architecture, and Cloud/DevOps infrastructure in high-scale SaaS environments.
* Possess hands-on architectural experience with AI-based systems, including LLM integrations, modern retrieval pipelines, model serving, vector databases, or MLOps frameworks.
* Bring proven expertise designing enterprise-scale Application Architectures and foundational Platform Core Services (APIs, asynchronous messaging, caching, workflow engines, and distributed databases).
* Have deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and building production-grade infrastructure from scratch.
* Are highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and modern DevSecOps/CI-CD automation pipelines.
* Are proficient in modern backend languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and can evaluate system design trade-offs from first principles.
* Understand observability, telemetry, and site reliability engineering (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK) to ensure platform visibility and proactive alerting.
* Can navigate complex technical discussions with enterprise clients, translating high-level business requirements into resilient, secure, and modular software architectures.
* Bring an automation-first mindset with strong ownership, combining high-level strategic architecture vision with the ability to dive deep into code, pipelines, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
We're hiring someone to join our founding team and grow into running operations. Today our COO runs ops himself. You'll start at his side, then take it over piece by piece.

Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and we run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts.

Our promise to clients is simple: you get the output, we handle the ops. We're growing fast, and you're the person who keeps that promise as we do.

We want someone hungry. Early in your career is fine, as long as you've already run something real on your own

What you'll own:

Operations, end to end. Not all on day one. All of it within a year:

Delivery. Every client project, from kickoff to final batch. Timelines, staffing, client updates. Nothing ships late without the client hearing it from you first.

Scoping. New projects arrive rough. You turn them into a plan: who we need, what it costs, how long it takes, what could break.

The contributor network. Recruiting, vetting, onboarding, and keeping our best people engaged. You know who's good, who's free and who's about to drop off.

Quality. Guidelines, review layers, feedback loops. You catch problems before the client does, and no project depends on a single reviewer.

Money flow. Contributors paid on time, every cycle. Invoices that match the work. Numbers that reconcile.

Systems. Trackers, SOPs, dashboards. You turn what lives in the founders' heads into processes that run without them.

The team. You lead delivery, QA and community, and you hire as we grow.

Whatever's broken. If it has no owner, it's yours.

title: Assistant Vice President - QA - Counterparty Credit Risk
description:
Join us as an Assistant Vice President - QA - Counterparty Credit Risk at Barclays Quantitative Analytics Team where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences. You will be responsible for developing best in class credit risk models using industry leading model development frameworks & methodologies, work in a global quant team, with regulators across the world and cutting-edge technology.
  
  
To be successful as an Assistant Vice President - QA - Counterparty Credit Risk ,you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* You must have knowledge of the following in CCR – IMM Models, SA-CCR, CVA, BASEL Framework, Monte Carlo Simulation, Exposure / Collateral Modelling, PFE (Potential Future exposure), EPE , EPPE, Derivatives Pricing, Greeks, Risk Factor Modelling (Interest Rates, Equities, Credit, Commodities etc.), Back-testing, Numerical Analysis, SR 11/7, SS1/23. SS12/13 etc.
* Hands on coding experience (as a full-stack developer / agile developer etc.
* Preferable language is Python, C/C++ etc).
* Hand on experience in Model Development and/or Model Validation (core development experience preferred).
* Experience in Stress Testing/Scenarios Modelling), Statistical Modelling (preferably for Wholesale credit book), Regulators and regulatory frameworks, Stakeholders – Model Owners, Audit, Validation.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with end-to-end model development , experience on coding languages like Python OR C++, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role is based out of Mumbai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, implement, and support mathematical, statistical, and machine learning models and analytics used in business decision-making
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design analytics and modelling solutions to complex business problems using domain expertise.
* Collaboration with technology to specify any dependencies required for analytical solutions, such as data, development environments and tools.
* Development of high performing, comprehensively documented analytics and modelling solutions, demonstrating their efficacy to business users and independent validation teams.
* Implementation of analytics and models in accurate, stable, well-tested software and work with technology to operationalise them.
* Provision of ongoing support for the continued effectiveness of analytics and modelling solutions to users.
* Demonstrate conformance to all Barclays Enterprise Risk Management Policies, particularly Model Risk Policy.
* Ensure all development activities are undertaken within the defined control environment.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
DOW has an exciting and challenging opportunity for an
**Azure Data Platform Engineer**
**on the Enterprise Data & Analytics Data Platform**
team.
**This is a position within our Enterprise Data & Analytics Organization.**
The role will align to Dow's Design your Day approach and allows employees to work remotely but will also require onsite work based on project work and role needs. The selected candidate will be expected to live a commutable distance from our IT Hub in Mumbai (IN) at a frequency to be agreed upon by the employee and their leader.  As an
**Azure Data Platform Engineer**
specializing in data and analytics solutions, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data platforms and analytics solutions on the Azure cloud platform to enable business objectives and accelerate Dow's digital transformation. Your primary focus will be on managing and organizing data within Databricks Unity Catalog, which is a centralized metadata repository for storing and discovering data assets in an organization. You will develop and implement data integration processes, data pipelines, and data transformation workflows using Databricks Unity Catalog. You will be using Azure DevOps, PowerShell, Python, and Azure Cloud resources along with implementing complete CI/CD pipelines. The Azure Data Platform Engineer will work with a cross-functional team that includes Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Design, deploy, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure and data platform services, including Databricks, Storage Accounts, V-Net/Networking, SQL Servers, Function Apps, and API Management.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Bicep, enabling standardized and repeatable deployments across Development, Test, and Production environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including Git repositories, branching strategies, release processes, and automated deployments.
* Support the configuration, administration, and operational management of Azure Databricks and associated platform components, including Unity Catalog and integration with Azure services.
* Develop automation and operational solutions using PowerShell, with working knowledge of Python and SQL for platform administration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application, architecture, networking, and security teams to design and implement secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-based solutions.
* Implement DevOps, cloud security, configuration management, and change management best practices, ensuring solutions align with company IT architecture and security standards.
* Continuously improve platform automation, reusable IaC libraries, technical documentation, operational procedures, and engineering best practices, while providing technical guidance to team members and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to thrive in challenging situations and solve complex problems.
* Manage own work effort in multiple projects with little supervision.
* Interested about emerging technologies with the ability to quickly learn and exploit cutting edge offerings to achieve business objectives.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A minimum of a bachelor's degree in IT discipline or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
* Recent experience designing and deploying in Microsoft Azure’s Environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* DevOps Tools: Git, Azure DevOps Pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes optional)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Bicep
* Coding & Scripting: PowerShell (Python and SQL basics)
* Cloud: Azure
* Azure Services: Databricks, Databricks Workspace, V-Net, Networking, Azure SQL Server, Function Apps, Storage Accounts, API Management
* Databricks: Unity Catalog, Databricks platform concepts
* DevOps Practices: CI/CD, repository structure, branching strategy, deployment automation
* Security & Governance: Cloud security, DevOps security, Change Management, Configuration Management

Good to have skills -
  
  

* Data Governance: Microsoft Purview, Databricks Unity Catalog
* Programming & Data: Basic Python, SQL, and Apache Spark knowledge
* Containerization & Security: Docker, Kubernetes, Azure/DevOps security and governance concepts

**Additional Notes**

* Relocation assistance is not available with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.
  
  
**Required Skills**
['AI', 'API', 'LLM', 'REST', 'SQL', 'database']

**Principal Platform Architect**

**12–15 years**
of engineering depth to lead the architectural vision across IDfy’s core platform foundations. In this strategic technical leadership role, you will define and execute the technology blueprint spanning
**AI-native platforms, application architecture, platform core services, and cloud DevOps infrastructure**
. You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems design, LLM/AI model orchestration, enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines, and high-throughput reliability to power our mission-critical SaaS ecosystem.
  
  
**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like...**

* Architecting AI-Native Platforms: Designing end-to-end architectures for AI-driven platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, model inference pipelines, and intelligent workflow automation across products.
* Core Platform Services Design: Owning the blueprints and shared capabilities for platform core services (identity, orchestration, messaging, event buses, telemetry, and data access layers) to ensure seamless inter-service communication and reuse.
* DevOps Strategy & Cloud Architecture: Defining and driving end-to-end cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated multi-environment deployment frameworks.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps & Release Engineering: Architecting and optimizing resilient CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions/Jenkins), container security scanning, automated quality gates, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
* Application Architecture & System Standards: Defining application design patterns, API-first specifications, microservices standards, and data modeling practices for enterprise-grade SaaS products.
* Kubernetes, Observability & Reliability: Designing highly available, fault-tolerant containerized environments using Kubernetes, alongside enterprise-grade observability, telemetry, and automated alerting frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Cross-Pod Technical Governance: Partnering closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, and DevOps/SRE teams to review architecture proposals, resolve technical trade-offs, and enforce best-in-class engineering standards.
* Client & Executive Technical Advisory: Stepping into high-stakes enterprise technical discussions with client architects, CTOs, and CIOs to present platform capabilities, integration architectures, and security postures.
* Mentorship & Technical Direction: Mentoring senior engineers and tech leads, driving RFCs (Requests for Comments), and fostering an engineering culture anchored in clean craftsmanship and architectural rigor.

**We are the perfect match if you...**

* Have 12–15 years of progressive experience across Platform Engineering, Software Architecture, Application Architecture, and Cloud/DevOps infrastructure in high-scale SaaS environments.
* Possess hands-on architectural experience with AI-based systems, including LLM integrations, modern retrieval pipelines, model serving, vector databases, or MLOps frameworks.
* Bring proven expertise designing enterprise-scale Application Architectures and foundational Platform Core Services (APIs, asynchronous messaging, caching, workflow engines, and distributed databases).
* Have deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and building production-grade infrastructure from scratch.
* Are highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and modern DevSecOps/CI-CD automation pipelines.
* Are proficient in modern backend languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and can evaluate system design trade-offs from first principles.
* Understand observability, telemetry, and site reliability engineering (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK) to ensure platform visibility and proactive alerting.
* Can navigate complex technical discussions with enterprise clients, translating high-level business requirements into resilient, secure, and modular software architectures.
* Bring an automation-first mindset with strong ownership, combining high-level strategic architecture vision with the ability to dive deep into code, pipelines, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: Analyst, Client Consulting - AI
description:

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

**Job Description**

Client Consulting Analysts play a critical role in supporting Visa’s clients by applying analytical solutions to business challenges in the payments and financial services industry. The role involves leveraging data science, analytics, and business consulting expertise to deliver actionable insights and drive portfolio growth, profitability, and operational efficiency. * Support business development initiatives and contribute to portfolio optimization, product launches, and customer loyalty strategies.

* 2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).

* Experience planning, organizing, and managing end-to-end projects with diverse cross-functional teams.

* Hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or comparable AI capabilities.
* Experience delivering digital solutions for HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Total Rewards, or Shared Services.

* Problem Solving: Diagnoses complex technical and business issues and implements sustainable solutions that prevent recurrence.

* The ability to accommodate with international time zone is essential

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Java & AWS) (Remote, Full-Time) [AS314]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Cloud Engineer (Backend / DevOps-leaning), you will take responsibility for designing, building and maintaining AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. This is an ongoing, long-term opportunity focused on reliable cloud infrastructure and its supporting delivery processes.

  

You will manage EC2 and other core infrastructure components, support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, and implement and maintain security and compliance controls.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop, maintain and improve AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Strengthen and improve existing IaC configurations, infrastructure reliability and platform maturity
  
* Own, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines, primarily using GitHub Actions, with Jenkins integrations where applicable
  
* Implement and improve software supply-chain security processes, including Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), container image signing and verification
  
* Improve AWS monitoring, alerting and operational visibility across the platform
  
* Manage Docker-based container deployments and orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Support ECS Anywhere deployments running across self-managed EC2 instances
  
* Work with AWS services, including EC2, ECS, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* Develop and enhance backend microservices, primarily written in Java
  
* Implement new backend features and functionality supporting role-based access control (RBAC)
  
* Develop backend capabilities for metrics ingestion and processing
  
* Implement backend functionality supporting multi-tenancy
  
* Manage application deployments, troubleshoot infrastructure issues and resolve CI/CD pipeline failures independently
  
* Support cloud and on-premises deployment environments, including opportunities to improve consistency between them
  
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, performance, security and delivery quality
  
* Contribute to cloud cost optimisation while maintaining a cloud-agnostic approach and avoiding unnecessary vendor lock-in
  
* Identify technical gaps, propose improvements and contribute proactively to product and platform development
  
* Collaborate with other engineers, share technical knowledge and challenge technical decisions constructively
  
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, reviewing and taking ownership of generated code and integrations
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 5 years of senior-level hands-on experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering or DevOps, with the ability to independently own infrastructure and backend development work
  
* 5 years of strong practical experience with AWS infrastructure and core services, including EC2, ECS, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* 3 years of experience with Java-based backend services, or relevant backend development expertise applicable to Java microservices
  
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Proven experience designing, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions. Equivalent experience with GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins is acceptable where transferable expertise can be demonstrated
  
* Knowledge and practical experience of software supply-chain security, including SBOMs, signed container images and image verification
  
* Experience implementing and maintaining cloud monitoring and alerting solutions
  
* Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized services and container orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Strong backend development experience, with the ability to independently implement new features and functionality in microservices
  
* Ability to develop backend functionality involving access control, metrics ingestion and multi-tenancy
  
* Experience troubleshooting production infrastructure, deployment pipelines and backend services
  
* Understanding of platform reliability, maintainability, security and continuous improvement
  
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions and contribute beyond assigned development tasks
  
* Strong collaboration, knowledge-sharing and problem-solving skills
  
* Ability to propose and justify technical improvements constructively
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience developing frontend features and functionality, particularly around multi-tenancy and dashboard sharing
  
* Experience integrating metrics visualisations using native frontend graphing libraries, including migrating dashboards from Grafana
  
* Experience with Kubernetes deployments across on-premises and cloud environments
  
* Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and secure SDLC practices
  
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation (FinOps) and cloud-agnostic infrastructure

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Own Manastu Space’s IT end to end:
**infrastructure, cloud, compute, devices, security and data protection**
.
**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**
, and
**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**
. Be
**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**
, and
**establish SOPs for all IT operations**
.

**Role Overview**

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.
* **Identity, devices and security:**
  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.

title: Sr Technical Account Manager
description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**

**Technical Account Manager (TAM)**
is a trusted technical advisor and primary account contact for key Dynatrace customers, accountable for platform success, adoption, and long-term value in complex, large-scale environments. This is a senior, enterprise-focused role that combines technical depth, business understanding, and account management. The TAM owns the overall technical relationship and is the single point of accountability between the customer and Dynatrace.
  
  
The TAM is the named owner of a defined set of Success deliverables, including platform health reviews, support case management, change window coverage, version lifecycle planning, and enhancement request advocacy, scaled to the customer’s support tier. The role is not support-centric or project-limited. It requires strong technical judgment, executive presence, and ownership across long-running engagements, and it operates at the highest tier of the Dynatrace Success offering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Success Planning: Maintain a success plan tied to customer business objectives and manage end-to-end service delivery.
* Technical Advisory: Act as primary technical authority on architecture, platform health reviews, and guidance through platform transitions and modernization.
* Adoption & Optimization: Drive adoption through enablement plans, new use cases, and best practices.
* Consumption & Value: Monitor usage and consumption and recommend actions that deliver measurable outcomes.
* Executive Engagement: Deliver QBRs and executive checkpoints that align Dynatrace capabilities to business goals.
* Risk & Escalation: Identify and escalate risks before they impact the customer.
* Internal Advocacy: Represent the customer across Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
* Operational Excellence: Run environment evaluations and new-release reviews, coordinate customer events (e.g., Dynadays, workshops), and help establish a Dynatrace center of excellence and governance model.
* Support Case Reviews: Review open and recent cases to spot trends, speed resolution, prevent recurrence, and act as the escalation point.
* Enhancement Requests: Guide customers in submitting feature requests and advocate for their prioritization with Product Management.
* Change Window Support: Provide coverage during planned changes, upgrades, and migrations.
* After-Hours & Event Support: Provide planned on-call coverage for critical moments such as major retail events and product launches, with reasonable advance notice.
* Cadenced Meetings: Lead recurring account and success meetings (weekly at Signature tier).

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Deep, hands‑on technical expertise with the Dynatrace platform and enterprise observability architectures.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to define, communicate, and manage success plans, including clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes aligned to customer objectives.
* Strong understanding of modern application stacks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud‑native technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Proven ability to operate independently as a senior technical advisor in high‑visibility customer situations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to executive audiences.
* Strong capability to coordinate and influence cross‑functional teams (Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales) without direct authority.
* Experience proactively identifying and managing program risks, escalation paths, and recovery plans in complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to balance strategic planning and hands‑on execution in high‑ambiguity, high‑visibility customer situations.
* Skilled in executive‑level program communication, including status reporting, expectation setting, and outcome‑based progress reviews (e.g., QBRs, steering meetings).
* Track record of driving accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and outcomes are delivered as planned.
* Demonstrated experience delivering within a structured, tiered customer success or support framework, with the ability to adapt engagement depth, meeting cadence, and deliverable scope to match contracted service levels.
* Experience owning case management and escalation resolution on behalf of enterprise customers, including trend analysis, cross-team coordination, and driving cases to closure within agreed SLAs.
* Proven ability to support customers through high-stakes production changes, upgrades, and maintenance windows, including cutover planning, real-time issue response, and post-change validation.
* Hands-on experience integrating observability platforms with ITSM and CMDB tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), with a solid understanding of how enterprises change management processes operate in production environments.
* Prior experience acting as a long‑term technical owner for strategic accounts (Preferred).
* History of influencing outcomes across teams without formal authority (Preferred).
* Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving role definitions (pilot or transformation experience) (Preferred).

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**

* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.

title: MuleSoft Integrations Lead
description:
**Company Description**
The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.
  
  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Integration Team Lead is responsible for team activities concerning the design, development, and maintenance of the company's integration architecture. While strong proficiency in MuleSoft based integration architecture is highly valued, this role encompasses a broader, modern integration technology landscape, including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps. This role acts as a subject matter expert on API-led and event-driven integration patterns, ensuring that all corporate systems integrations are scalable, reliable, and secure. The manager-as-engineer works closely with various cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and leads the development team to deliver high-quality integration solutions.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibility**
Integration Architecture & Delivery:
  
  
Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Mentoring**
Manage, mentor, and guide a team of integration engineers (including direct reports), fostering a collaborative, agile, and high-performance engineering culture.
  
  
**Collaboration & Requirements Engineering**
Partner with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business workflows, translate them into comprehensive integration designs, and manage delivery timelines.
  
  
**Best Practices & Standards**
Enforce strict coding standards, robust code review processes, API governance, and comprehensive automated testing guidelines within the team.
  
  
**DevOps & Platform Operations**
Oversee automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD), environment management, and proactive monitoring/alerting across all core integration platforms.
  
  
**Incident & Problem Management**
Guide the team in resolving critical integration-related incidents, performing root-cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent preventative fixes.
  
  
**DECISION-MAKING POWER**

* Owns technical and operational decisions related to the company's core integration, event streaming, and API platforms (including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API/AI Gateways, and automation tools).
* Defines task delegation, prioritization, and sprint planning within the Integration Team.
* Recommends integration architectural standards and platform governance policies to the Integration Competency Center Manager.

**Who Are We Looking For**

* Brings several years of hands-on experience in software development, systems engineering, and IT operations in general.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in software development or integration engineering, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or coordinator role.
* In-depth, hands-on experience with APIs (designing, developing, deploying, and managing APIs across their entire lifecycle).
* In-depth knowledge and practical experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and modern event-driven streams.
* Strong practical knowledge and experience with enterprise integration tools:
* Enterprise iPaaS: Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, CloudHub, API Manager).
* Event Streaming: Experience with Apache Kafka / Confluent Platform (producers, consumers, streaming concepts, topic management).
* API Gateways: Experience with Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, and Kong Metering and Billing.
* Automation & Lightweight iPaaS: Practical knowledge of n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps.
* DevOps & Agile Methods:
* Confident experience with modern DevOps methods and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
* Solid understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or scaled agile frameworks like SAFe).
* Familiarity with Waterfall project methodologies where hybrid planning is required.
* Proactivity and Autonomy: Ability to work independently and responsibly, proactively proposing optimizations for existing processes and systems.
* Team Spirit & Leadership: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with proven experience in team management, fostering team cohesion, and resolving conflict.
* Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Curiosity & Growth Mindset: Openness to learning and adopting emerging technologies.

**Qualifications**
**ELIGIBLITY**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* Proven experience in enterprise-grade integrations, platform operations, and technical team leadership.

**Additional Information**

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Own Manastu Space’s IT end to end:
**infrastructure, cloud, compute, devices, security and data protection**
.
**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**
, and
**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**
. Be
**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**
, and
**establish SOPs for all IT operations**
.

**Role Overview**

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.
* **Identity, devices and security:**
  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

Some positions may accept other degree subjects where you can demonstrate strong technical ability, and some may require a 2:1.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

title: SRE Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Reliability Engineer - DevSecOps
  
  
**Department**
: Markets IT - APS
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Corporate and Institutional Banking has an active IT ecosystem with its own IT backbone that involves a large workforce of IT employees working for DEV, Testing and Support projects.
  
  
CIB ITO Production ensures the provision of industrialized and digital production services. The objective is to offer innovative products and services to its customers in a performing, global and secured environment in order to speed up delivery and time to market. CIB ITO Production manages operational risk by running stable and robust IT production platforms. CIB ITO production hosts critical service delivery scope comprising of Global Markets, Global Banking, Client & Employee, ALM&T, Regulatory & Control IT and BP2S.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Senior Reliability Engineer is a technical powerhouse responsible for the stability and evolution of the DevSecOps platform. Unlike a traditional support role, this position requires a
**strong engineering mindset**
. The primary objective is to ensure production stability by treating every failure as a bug that requires a permanent code-based or architectural fix. The successful candidate will be a tech enthusiast who is equally comfortable navigating the nuances of AI-driven tools (Open Code, MCP) and the depths of the DevSecOps toolchain, ensuring that the platform is not just "running," but is resilient, scalable, and automated.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Root-Cause Engineering: Lead the investigation of complex production failures. Move beyond "restarting services" to identify the fundamental cause of issues and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
* Platform Stability & Coding: Proactively write and deploy code to enhance platform reliability. Use a development mindset to automate manual interventions and resolve technical debt within the toolchain.
* AI Operationalization: Support and optimize MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and internal AI-driven use cases. Understand the nuances of AI-specific configurations and keywords to ensure these services are performant and stable.
* Advanced Tool Administration: Provide expert-level administration and optimization of the DevSecOps stack, specifically Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Cloudbees Jenkins.
* Pipeline & Security Orchestration: Ensure the seamless integration of SonarQube, NexusIQ, and Fortify within the CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security gates are automated and reliable.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Manage platform components using Ansible, Kubernetes, and Docker, ensuring that environment configurations are versioned and reproducible.
* Toil Reduction: Identify repetitive manual tasks and engineer automation to reduce the ticket volume by the agreed target, shifting the team's focus from reactive support to proactive engineering.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Mentorship: Guide junior engineers in adopting a "Reliability First" mindset and improving their capabilities for production fixes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Dev and Sec teams to refine the DevSecOps roadmap and integrate new tools (e.g., GitHub migration).
* Lifecycle Management: Participate in the strategic planning for tool upgrades and capacity management to ensure the platform scales with business growth.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Inquisitive Nature: A natural curiosity to ask "Why?" until the actual root cause is found. A refusal to accept "it's working now" as a completed task.
* Tech Enthusiasm: A passion for exploring new technologies and the drive to apply them to real-world production problems.
* Ownership & Accountability: A strong sense of ownership over the stability of the platform and the courage to take the lead in applying critical fixes.
* Analytical Rigor: Ability to decompose complex system failures into manageable engineering tasks.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(**
**Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Development Mindset: Strong proficiency in Python and Shell Scripting for production automation. Ability to read and modify code to apply fixes.
* DevSecOps Mastery: Admin-level knowledge of Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Cloudbees Jenkins. Experience with GitHub is highly preferred.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in a production environment.
* Automation Frameworks: Proficiency in Ansible or similar framework for configuration management.
* Security Tooling: Familiarity with the operational side of SonarQube, NexusIQ, and Fortify or their market competitors.
* AI Awareness: Ability to manage and troubleshoot AI-enabled infrastructure, with a conceptual understanding of LLM interaction and Open Code environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Excellent Communications
* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* Ability to understand, explain & support change
* Attention to detail / rigor

**Education Level:**
Graduate & Above
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore (KA)
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.
