title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* 3+ years of managing IT technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADSIPL - Maharashtra

title: Sr Technical Account Manager
description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
The
**Technical Account Manager (TAM)**
is a trusted technical advisor and primary account contact for key Dynatrace customers, accountable for platform success, adoption, and long-term value in complex, large-scale environments. This is a senior, enterprise-focused role that combines technical depth, business understanding, and account management. The TAM owns the overall technical relationship and is the single point of accountability between the customer and Dynatrace.
  
  
The TAM is the named owner of a defined set of Success deliverables, including platform health reviews, support case management, change window coverage, version lifecycle planning, and enhancement request advocacy, scaled to the customer’s support tier. The role is not support-centric or project-limited. It requires strong technical judgment, executive presence, and ownership across long-running engagements, and it operates at the highest tier of the Dynatrace Success offering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Success Planning: Maintain a success plan tied to customer business objectives and manage end-to-end service delivery.
* Technical Advisory: Act as primary technical authority on architecture, platform health reviews, and guidance through platform transitions and modernization.
* Adoption & Optimization: Drive adoption through enablement plans, new use cases, and best practices.
* Consumption & Value: Monitor usage and consumption and recommend actions that deliver measurable outcomes.
* Executive Engagement: Deliver QBRs and executive checkpoints that align Dynatrace capabilities to business goals.
* Risk & Escalation: Identify and escalate risks before they impact the customer.
* Internal Advocacy: Represent the customer across Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
* Operational Excellence: Run environment evaluations and new-release reviews, coordinate customer events (e.g., Dynadays, workshops), and help establish a Dynatrace center of excellence and governance model.
* Support Case Reviews: Review open and recent cases to spot trends, speed resolution, prevent recurrence, and act as the escalation point.
* Enhancement Requests: Guide customers in submitting feature requests and advocate for their prioritization with Product Management.
* Change Window Support: Provide coverage during planned changes, upgrades, and migrations.
* After-Hours & Event Support: Provide planned on-call coverage for critical moments such as major retail events and product launches, with reasonable advance notice.
* Cadenced Meetings: Lead recurring account and success meetings (weekly at Signature tier).

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Deep, hands‑on technical expertise with the Dynatrace platform and enterprise observability architectures.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to define, communicate, and manage success plans, including clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes aligned to customer objectives.
* Strong understanding of modern application stacks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud‑native technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Proven ability to operate independently as a senior technical advisor in high‑visibility customer situations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to executive audiences.
* Strong capability to coordinate and influence cross‑functional teams (Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales) without direct authority.
* Experience proactively identifying and managing program risks, escalation paths, and recovery plans in complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to balance strategic planning and hands‑on execution in high‑ambiguity, high‑visibility customer situations.
* Skilled in executive‑level program communication, including status reporting, expectation setting, and outcome‑based progress reviews (e.g., QBRs, steering meetings).
* Track record of driving accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and outcomes are delivered as planned.
* Demonstrated experience delivering within a structured, tiered customer success or support framework, with the ability to adapt engagement depth, meeting cadence, and deliverable scope to match contracted service levels.
* Experience owning case management and escalation resolution on behalf of enterprise customers, including trend analysis, cross-team coordination, and driving cases to closure within agreed SLAs.
* Proven ability to support customers through high-stakes production changes, upgrades, and maintenance windows, including cutover planning, real-time issue response, and post-change validation.
* Hands-on experience integrating observability platforms with ITSM and CMDB tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), with a solid understanding of how enterprises change management processes operate in production environments.
* Prior experience acting as a long‑term technical owner for strategic accounts (Preferred).
* History of influencing outcomes across teams without formal authority (Preferred).
* Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving role definitions (pilot or transformation experience) (Preferred).

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**

* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

description:

**Join our team!**
  
  
The Data Scientist will work in teams addressing statistical, machine learning and data understanding problems in a commercial technology and consultancy development environment. In this role, you will contribute to the development and deployment of modern machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods for finding structure in large data sets.
  
  
**As a Digital Technology Specialist, you will be responsible for:**

* Share and discuss findings with team members.

* Present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Measure and communicate business impact of deployed solutions.

* Prototype new approaches and technologies.
* Contribute to AI strategy, governance, and responsible AI practices.

**Fuel your passion!**

Technical Skills
  
  
  

* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

* Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, and model explainability.

* Familiarity with AI agents and autonomous workflows.
* Industry knowledge in domains such as healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, or telecommunications.

* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams.
* Strategic mindset with a focus on business outcomes.
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset.

Success Metrics
  
  
A successful modern Data Scientist:
  
  
  

* Delivers measurable business value from AI and analytics initiatives.
* Builds scalable and production-ready ML/AI solutions.
* Improves operational efficiency through data-driven automation.
* Drives adoption of AI technologies across the organization.
* Maintains high standards of governance, security, and responsible AI.

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

What’s in this for you?

* Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from data warehousing to AI;

**Responsibilities**
What’s involved?

This role will work in close partnership with the US Data Engineering team to drive enterprise-wide data initiatives to completion.

We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Corporate Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Sr.Technical Analyst – Process Mining and Modeling is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the technical delivery and lifecycle management of global process-mining and process-modeling solutions from technical intake through operational adoption. Working from defined business problems and requirements established with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role, this position translates business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions using SAP Signavio, SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning systems, and related data platforms. The analyst owns the technical data foundation, solution design, configuration, technical validation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of process-mining and process-modeling solutions. The role partners closely with process owners, the business-facing process-mining role, and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, actionable, secure, and sustainable, while the business-facing role owns business interpretation, improvement action planning, and value realization across General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical intake, solution design, estimation, and delivery planning for global process-mining and process-modeling initiatives, building on business opportunities and requirements defined with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role.
* Partner with the business-facing process-mining role, Process Owners, and data owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements, data definitions, KPI logic, analytical acceptance criteria, and traceable solution designs.
* Design, build, and validate the data foundation required for process mining, including source-data preparation, event logs, connectors, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls across SAP S/4HANA, ERP, and related data platforms.
* Configure and deliver SAP Signavio process-mining and process-modeling solutions, including process discovery, process analysis, and BPMN-based modeling where applicable, to produce reliable and actionable insights from approved business requirements.
* Provide strong technical leadership for workstreams and delivery partners by making solution decisions, setting technical direction, managing technical risks and dependencies, and ensuring quality across implementation activities.
* Lead technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement across the solution lifecycle; coordinate business validation and user acceptance with the business-facing process-mining role and Process Owners.
* Enable adoption through clear technical documentation, solution walkthroughs, capability guidance, and operational support. Partner with the business-facing process-mining role to support improvement outcomes, while maintaining clear D&T ownership of technical readiness, reliability, and sustainability.
* Establish and apply reusable technical standards, delivery practices, architecture principles, data-quality controls, release practices, and governance expectations for process-mining and modeling solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.
* Global Collaboration: Experience delivering global solutions with teams across regions and time zones.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and partner effectively with process owners, business-facing process-mining practitioners, data owners, and technical delivery partners while maintaining clear technical ownership

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Data Specialist 1
description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are**
Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise helps us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build, and operate their assets more safely, sustainably, and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Data Specialist is responsible for processing field survey data and producing accurate charts, maps, and project reports in accordance with project specifications and Data Centre priorities. Working closely with the Data Centre Manager, Geophysicists, Surveyors, and Project Managers, this role ensures the timely execution of data archival, retrieval, and drafting workflows while maintaining strict data quality standards. Additionally, the Data Specialist I collaborates with field Party Chiefs on survey instructions and report content, supports continuous improvements to charting processes, and partners with IT to uphold data security, backup protocols, and system requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Verification & Planning Review survey data received from the field for completeness and quality and collaborate with the Data Centre Manager to define processing and drafting requirements and establish project processing plans.
* Multi-Sensor Data Processing & QC Perform onshore and offshore processing and Quality Control (QC) of vessel-acquired navigation, bathymetry, and specialized survey datasets, including ROV, AUV, Multibeam, Positioning, and Pipeline inspection/installation data.
* Data Integrity & Integration Manage the overall integrity of project datasets, including integrating third-party and as-built survey data.
* Drafting & Charting Execute drafting and mapping deliverables for assigned projects in strict compliance with Fugro charting standards.
* Technical Reporting & Standards Ensure the accuracy of processed survey outputs and technical data submitted for final project reports, while actively preparing and reviewing standard processing procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration Liaise closely with Geophysicists, Project Supervisors, Staff Surveyors, Party Chiefs, and Project/Business Line Managers (BLMs/PMs) to align on survey instructions, data quality, database needs, and workflow improvements.
* Data Archival & Security Maintain organized short- and long-term archives of survey results, charts, and reports, and coordinate with the IT-Manager on data backups, security audits, and software/hardware/networking requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum of 4–8 years of relevant experience.
* Analytical thinker with a proactive, agile approach to troubleshooting data and workflow challenges.
* Dedicated team player with a strong client-centric mindset focused on delivering accurate, timely project outcomes.
* Self-motivated professional who takes initiative, acts with confidence, and delivers results independently under minimal supervision.
* Strong communicator who promotes open dialogue across the organization, empowers and connects others with positive energy, and leads with passion, trust, and respect.

**What We Offer**
Fugro provides a positive work environment as well as projects that will satisfy the most curious minds. We also offer great opportunities to stretch and develop yourself. By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. Which should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye, and your can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.
  
  
**Our View On Diversity, Equity, And Inclusion**
At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge, and talents gives us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behavior, and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together create a safe and livable world’ – and to each other.
  
  
**HSE Responsibilities**
Responsible for ensuring the safety of self and others at the site. Prevent damage to equipment and assets. Responsible for following all safety signs/procedures/ safe working practices. Responsible for using appropriate PPE’s Responsible for participating in mock drills. Entitled to refuse to undertake any activity considered unsafe. Responsible for filling up of hazard observation card, wherever a hazard has been noticed at site. Responsible for safe housekeeping of his workplace. To stop any operation that is deemed unsafe. To be able to operate a fire extinguisher in case of fire. To report an incident as soon as possible to the immediate supervisor and the HSE manager. To complete HSE training as instructed to do so.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.
* Document recurring data issues and recommend process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting workflows.
* Support consistent CRM practices across NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other approved platforms.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with Growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership.
* Communicate data quality issues and follow up on corrective actions.
* Guide CRM users on data entry standards and opportunity management procedures.
* Ensure stakeholders follow established CRM data quality requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales Operations, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of experience working with CRM systems.
* Experience in CRM data entry, cleanup, auditing, or quality assurance.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on corrective actions.
* Availability for at least 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

Desired Qualifications

* Experience with NetSuite CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including:
* Filtering and sorting large datasets.
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and other lookup functions.
* Pivot tables.
* Data validation and cleanup.
* Understanding of sales pipeline stages, forecasting, lead attribution, and opportunity ownership.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, accounting, or advisory organizations.
* Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and reporting tools.
* Experience using AI, automation, or data analysis tools to improve data quality and operational workflows.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.

description:

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role::**
At PUMA, technology plays a critical role in enabling exceptional consumer, digital, and business experiences across global markets. Our engineering teams build and operate the platforms, products, and services that power PUMA's digital ecosystem, supporting millions of consumers and internal users worldwide.
  
  
As part of the Engineering organization, you will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of scalable platforms and services that enable business capabilities across eCommerce, consumer engagement, merchandising, supply chain, retail operations, data, and enterprise functions. The organization embraces modern engineering practices, cloud-native architecture, automation, AI-assisted development, and a product-centric mindset to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
As a Software Engineer (Backend), you will design, build, and operate production-grade backend systems, APIs, and distributed services that support critical business and consumer-facing applications. You will work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Data Engineers, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions while contributing to technical excellence and engineering best practices across the organization.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs, microservices, and backend services that support digital products and business platforms.
* Lead the technical design and implementation of complex software solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and high performance.

* Build and integrate systems using modern cloud-native architectures, distributed systems patterns, and event-driven technologies.
* Develop and optimize data-intensive applications leveraging databases, caching solutions, messaging platforms, and search technologies.
* Drive improvements in application performance, reliability, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, technical discussions, and engineering best practices across teams.
* Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to accelerate delivery and innovation.
* Leverage modern engineering tools, automation, and AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and software quality.

Participate in production support, incident management, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure system stability and availability.
  
  
**YOUR TALENT:**

* 4+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend applications and distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and microservices-based architectures.
* Experience developing scalable, reliable, and secure backend services that support business-critical applications.
* Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, data structures, and clean coding practices.
* Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Experience working with caching technologies such as Redis and event-streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Experience building and deploying cloud-native applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AI/ML-powered applications, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG-based systems, AI-assisted engineering tools, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Familiarity with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of distributed systems concepts, scalability, resiliency, observability, and performance optimization.
* Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or similar technologies.
* Experience implementing and supporting monitoring, logging, tracing, and operational excellence practices for production systems.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and modern software delivery methodologies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, architects, data engineers, and software engineers in Agile teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to troubleshoot and solve complex technical problems.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

description:

By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

title: Engineer I, Enterprise Application Engineering
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**Developer - Azure (Integrations, Data Factory, Function App, Logic App, Insights)**
**What You Will Be Doing**
You'll build and run the Azure integration layer that connects Dynamics 365 to the rest of Cencora for the PRISM program. That means designing the message flows, writing the Functions and Logic Apps that move and transform data, defining the JSON contracts between systems, and keeping all of it healthy in production once it ships. You'll sit in the D365 Center of Excellence, work day to day with the PRISM delivery teams and our AMS partner, and own your integrations end to end: design, build, test, deploy, and support.
  
  
PRISM runs on a global ERP footprint across 25+ countries, so the integrations you build carry real order, finance, and compliance data at scale. Reliability, observability, and clean error handling matter more here than clever code.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**

* Design and build event-driven and batch integrations between Dynamics 365 F&O, Power Platform, and enterprise systems using Azure Service Bus (queues, topics, subscriptions, dead-lettering), Azure Function Apps, and Azure Logic Apps including JSON paramters/objects.
* Build and maintain Azure Data Factory and Synapse pipelines for data movement, transformation, and reconciliation, including batch loads, incremental loads, and data-quality checks.
* Define and govern JSON payload contracts and message schemas; version them, document them, and enforce them through validation at the integration boundary.
* Implement error handling, retry, idempotency, and dead-letter patterns; instrument integrations with Application Insights and Azure Monitor so failures are visible before the business reports them.
* Integrate with Power Platform components (Dataverse, Power Automate, model-driven and canvas apps) where PRISM processes span D365 and Power Apps.
* Own integrations through the full lifecycle in Azure DevOps: user stories, design, build, unit and integration testing, CI/CD deployment across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production, cutover, and hypercare.
* Support data conversion and migration activities: mock loads, technical validation, and reconciliation between source and target systems.
* Provide L3 support for production integrations, work root cause with Problem Management, and hold the AMS partner to agreed fixes and timelines.
* Write technical design documents, runbooks, and integration specifications that another engineer can pick up without a walkthrough.
* Review designs and code from other developers, including vendor teams, and push back when a design creates technical debt or won't scale.

**What Should Your Background Look Like**
Experience and education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years in software or integration engineering, with at least 2 years building production integrations on Azure.
* Delivered at least one enterprise ERP or CRM integration program end to end (design through go-live and hypercare). Dynamics 365 F&O or CE experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience working in a SAFe Agile or Scrum delivery model with Azure DevOps for backlog, pipelines, and release management.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Azure Service Bus: topics, subscriptions, sessions, dead-letter handling, message ordering, and duplicate detection.
* Azure Function Apps in C#/.NET (Python acceptable) including durable functions, triggers, bindings, and secure configuration through Key Vault and managed identities.
* Azure Logic Apps (Standard and Consumption), including custom connectors, B2B/EDI scenarios, and workflow error handling.
* Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines: pipeline design, data flows, parameterization, triggers, and monitoring.
* JSON schema design, payload mapping and transformation, and REST/OData API development and consumption.
* SQL and Azure SQL Database, including performance tuning for high-volume integration and staging tables.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics (KQL) for diagnostics and alerting.
* Git-based source control, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Skills**

* Power Platform integration: Dataverse APIs, Power Automate cloud flows, custom connectors, and the Dataverse/D365 F&O dual-write and virtual entity patterns.
* Dynamics 365 F&O data entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), recurring integrations, and business events.
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI for integration reporting and data lineage.
* Kingswaysoft or SSIS for migration and batch scenarios.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare, or other regulated environments where audit trails and data integrity are non-negotiable.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), DP-203 (Data Engineering), or PL-400 (Power Platform Developer).

**How You Work**

* You explain technical trade-offs to product owners and business analysts in plain language and don't hide behind jargon.
* You document as you build, not after.
* You're comfortable working across time zones with US-based stakeholders and a distributed delivery team, including some overlap with US Eastern hours for design sessions and cutovers.
* You treat production support as part of engineering, not someone else's problem.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Less than 2 years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, software development, or a related field required. Certification in cloud platforms, programming languages, or equivalent preferred.

Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Mesh Security builds a platform that maps and defends how modern organizations actually get attacked — across cloud, SaaS, identity, and AI. Under the hood it's a serious distributed system: data pipelines ingesting security signals from dozens of cloud and SaaS integrations over a streaming backbone, a detection engine evaluating events as they arrive, a security graph that computes every customer's attack surface and attack paths in near real time, and LLM-powered AI pipelines that enrich, classify, and reason over it all — running as multi-tenant SaaS on AWS.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Architect to own the technical direction of this platform. This is a hands-on role: you'll make the big architecture calls and still write code in the critical paths.

This is an on-site position at our Pune office — we have a fully work-from-office culture.

What you'll do

- Graph at scale — evolve how attack surface and attack paths are modelled, computed, snapshotted, and queried as customers and data grow

- Data pipelines — own the architecture for ingesting, normalizing, and streaming high-volume security data from dozens of fast-changing third-party sources

- Scale — design the multi-tenancy, reliability, and cost model that lets the platform grow in tenants, integrations, and data volume without losing coherence

- AI — define how LLM enrichment and agentic workflows plug into the platform: reliability, evaluation, and cost patterns, with our AI/ML engineers

- Set the engineering bar: design reviews, standards, mentoring senior engineers

What we're looking for

- 12+ years in backend/distributed systems; several as architect or tech lead of a production multi-tenant SaaS platform

- Deep streaming/event-driven and batch processing experience at high data volumes

- Strong data modelling chops; graph databases (Neptune/Neo4j) or large-scale graph computation a big plus

- Production depth on AWS: multi-tenancy, reliability, cost at scale

- Shipped systems, not just diagrams — you still write code

Production LLM/agentic experience or a security background is a plus.

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The
**Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)**
is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by
**Java**
,
**Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**
,
**distributed microservices**

.
  
  
The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & System Architecture
* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient Java/Spring Boot microservices capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.
* Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience
* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.

* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture

* Experience: Minimum 12+ years of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least 4–6 years in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies**
**Java & Core Technologies**

* Master-level proficiency in Java (11, 17, 21+), JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**

* Deep architectural and development expertise with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration.
* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**

* Extensive experience with Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) and message streaming platforms (Apache Kafka).
* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**

* Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL solutions (MongoDB).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (Redis).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**

* Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift
* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**

* Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack.

**Security & Quality Engineering**

* Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.

* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).

title: Salesforce Architect
description:
Own the technical design and architecture behind customer project delivery. You will define scalable Salesforce solution patterns, review technical approaches, standardise implementation practices, and ensure customers go live cleanly with minimal post-delivery issues. You will also act as the technical bridge between Delivery, Engineering, Product, and implementation teams.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

Own solution design, technical reviews, and architecture decisions across Salesforce implementations.

Review technical approaches and validate solution feasibility, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Standardise recurring customisations into reusable templates, accelerators, and implementation patterns.

Define and maintain Salesforce best practices and enforce them through technical reviews.

Design standardised approaches for Salesforce upgrades and complex customer implementations.

Identify product gaps and translate them into clear technical requirements for Engineering and Product teams.

Promote reusable and repeatable implementation patterns across the Conversive platform.

Conduct technical reviews as coaching sessions to raise the technical capability of O&I specialists.

Mentor junior specialists and interns during their initial implementations.

Create solution architecture diagrams and technical design documents for major projects.

Conduct at least one technical knowledge-sharing session each month.

Own the technical quality and reliability of solutions delivered to customers.

Stay current with Salesforce releases, API deprecations, platform changes, and emerging implementation practices.

Proactively recommend solutions and improvements rather than only identifying technical issues.

**What will qualify you for this role?**

**Must-Have:-**

10–12 years of experience in software delivery, with at least 5 years designing solutions on the Salesforce platform.

Deep knowledge of Salesforce data model, standard/custom objects, governor limits, sharing and security model, and declarative-first architecture.

Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and Salesforce REST, Bulk, and Streaming APIs.

Strong experience with Salesforce Managed Packages, including installation, upgrades, namespace constraints, and upgrade-related challenges.

Experience designing solutions for multi-tenant ISV products deployed across multiple customer Salesforce orgs.

Proven ability to convert recurring custom requirements into reusable templates, accelerators, or product capabilities.

Experience conducting technical reviews and providing clear, constructive feedback to technical and delivery teams.

Strong documentation skills, including solution design documents, gap specifications, and architecture diagrams.

**Strongly Preferred:-**

Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect certification, or relevant domain certifications such as Integration Architecture, Data Architecture, Sharing & Visibility, or Platform Developer II.

Experience working with another CRM such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.

Experience with CTI/telephony integrations such as RingCentral, Twilio, Genesys, or Talkdesk.

Experience with messaging channels including WhatsApp Business API and web chat.

Practical experience designing LLM-based agent solutions, including knowledge bases, conversation routing, journey orchestration, and context management across agents.

Exposure to regulated-industry requirements such as healthcare data handling, HIPAA, consent management, and messaging opt-out compliance.

Key Traits:-

Strong architectural judgment with a practical, delivery-focused approach.

Comfortable challenging one-off solutions and advocating for scalable standards.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Able to influence technical decisions without relying solely on authority.

Passionate about mentoring, knowledge sharing, and raising engineering standards.

Customer-focused with strong ownership of solution quality and reliability.

Proactive in identifying risks, proposing solutions, and improving implementation practices.

As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Technical practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise-scale D365 F&O technical solutions spanning across custom development, integrations, data migrations, and reporting collaborating with cross-functional and global teams to translate client functional and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and high-quality deliverables.
