title: Apache Cassandra Architect
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a seasoned Apache Cassandra Architect to enhance our production Java application by integrating Apache Cassandra support. Currently, our application operates on PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, and MySQL. The successful candidate will ensure low latency and high availability through Cassandra's multi-region capabilities. You will review ongoing work, define the target architecture, and guide our engineering team to ensure a smooth transition and implementation.
  
  

* Role: Apache Cassandra Architect
* Location: All Persistent Locations
* Experience: 11 to 15 Years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Review the existing Cassandra data model and recommend improvements to achieve latency, availability, and scalability goals.
* Define the multi-region architecture, including replication strategy, consistency levels, failover behavior, and capacity planning.
* Establish best practices for the Java data access layer, focusing on DataStax Java Driver configuration, load balancing, retries, and query patterns.
* Identify and mitigate risks such as hot partitions, large partitions, tombstones, and consistency anomalies.
* Design zero-downtime, no-data-loss migration strategies from RDBMS to Cassandra, including CDC, dual-write, and shadow-read approaches.
* Guide the design of customer-run migration and verification tooling.
* Define performance testing approaches and target benchmarks across regions.
* Recommend operational practices for customer deployments, including compaction, repair, monitoring, and backup/restore strategies.
* Document architecture decisions and mentor the engineering team through design reviews and code reviews.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 11 to 15 years of experience in Software Architecture, Distributed Systems, Database Engineering, and Enterprise Platform Development.
* 8+ years of hands-on production experience with Apache Cassandra, including architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning at scale.
* Deep expertise in Cassandra data modeling, partition key design, clustering strategies, denormalization techniques, and query-driven schema design.
* Strong experience designing and managing multi-region Cassandra deployments for low-latency, high-availability environments.
* Extensive knowledge of replication strategies, consistency levels, topology design, failover mechanisms, and disaster recovery planning.
* Proven experience integrating Cassandra into applications originally built on relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and CockroachDB.
* Strong expertise in zero-downtime migration methodologies including CDC, dual-write patterns, shadow reads, cutover planning, and validation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Apache Cassandra operational best practices including compaction, repair, backup, restore, monitoring, and capacity management.
* Deep knowledge of Cassandra performance optimization including tombstone management, hotspot avoidance, partition sizing, read/write optimization, and cluster tuning.
* Extensive experience with DataStax Java Driver, including driver configuration, load balancing policies, retry policies, connection management, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of distributed system concepts including consistency models, quorum mechanisms, partition tolerance, fault tolerance, and eventual consistency.
* Experience designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant backend systems.
* Strong knowledge of Java-based backend systems and enterprise application architectures.
* Experience with Spring Boot, Tomcat, or similar Java application frameworks.
* Familiarity with Cassandra Storage-Attached Indexes (SAI) and advanced Cassandra capabilities.
* Experience with IBM CDC, change data capture frameworks, and enterprise data migration platforms.
* Familiarity with Kafka and event-driven architectures for data synchronization and migration workloads.
* Experience deploying and managing Cassandra on Kubernetes environments.
* Exposure to managed Cassandra offerings such as DataStax Astra and Amazon Keyspaces.
* Experience leveraging Agentic AI coding tools and AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity and modernization efforts.
* Proven consulting experience with the ability to rapidly assess environments, identify risks, and provide actionable architectural guidance.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience mentoring engineering teams and establishing long-term engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently while driving architecture decisions and technical strategy.
* Demonstrated success delivering high-performance, highly available, and scalable distributed data platforms in enterprise environments.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

title: Salesforce Architect -Financial Services Cloud
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service & Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security & Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps & Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
The Salesforce Architect should be able to:
  
  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.
* Strong hands-on experience with OmniStudio.
* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:
  
  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience
* Strong architecture experience across complex Salesforce implementations
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
* Strong implementation and architecture experience with Financial Services Cloud
* Experience leading architecture for medium to large enterprise Salesforce programs

* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Working proficiency in Python.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).

* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.

If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
AVP, Web Engineer III will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform in micro services architecture using
**Spring Frameworks, in memory data grid, micro-front ends, React JS, responsive design**

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**4+ years**
in software engineering and

We are seeking a forward-thinking and technically strong
**Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Technical Architect**
to lead the design, modernization, and integration of scalable digital experience platforms. This role acts as the

for client engagements, with deep knowledge of AEM as a Cloud Service, composable and headless architectures, modern authoring models, and high-performance delivery patterns such as Edge Delivery Services with Universal Editor. **Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect robust, secure, and scalable AEM solutions across Sites, Assets, Content Fragments, Experience Fragments, Headless CMS, GraphQL/OpenAPI integrations, and Edge Delivery Services-enabled experiences.
* Act as the CMS technology SME, helping clients navigate platform capabilities and recommending the most effective solutions.

* Assess when to use traditional AEM Sites, headless/composable delivery, document-based authoring, or Edge Delivery Services depending on client needs, migration complexity, performance goals, and operating model.
* Define modernization roadmaps for AEM 6.5, AMS, and AEM as a Cloud Service estates, including phased adoption of Universal Editor, Edge Delivery Services, content modeling, and API-first delivery.

**Client Engagement & Innovation**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients on CMS solutions, providing trusted guidance and making proactive recommendations—not just reacting to requests.

* Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and client stakeholders.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Oracle Billing and Revenue Management (BRM) professional**
to provide senior technical and operational leadership across business-critical billing operations.
  
  
You will be responsible for the stability, availability and performance of the Oracle BRM ecosystem, covering rating, billing, invoicing, payments, collections and associated revenue-critical processes.
  
  
The role combines deep Oracle BRM expertise with billing assurance, Dynatrace-led observability, Oracle Database performance management, telecom system integration, incident and problem management, automation, service transition and continual service improvement
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the stability, availability and performance of the Oracle BRM platform in a 24x7 production environment.Administer and troubleshoot Oracle BRM Connection Manager (CM), Data Manager (DM) and associated BRM processes
* Monitor rating, billing, invoicing, collections, payments, General Ledger (GL) and scheduled activities.Manage BRM configuration, including pin.conf, configuration objects and multi-schema environments
* Troubleshoot opcode, PCM and process-level failures.Govern pre-bill checks, bill-run execution and post-bill validation.Investigate failed transactions, billing exceptions and discrepancies that could create revenue leakage

* Build and maintain operational dashboards covering BRM availability, host health, critical processes, resource utilisation and dependent services.Use OpenTelemetry or compatible custom metrics and log collection where additional operational or business-level telemetry is required.Troubleshoot SQL/PL-SQL and analyse long-running SQL, locking, database waits and performance issues.Work with DBA teams on indexing, partitioning and database performance optimisation
* Diagnose end-to-end telecom integration issues across Siebel → FMW/AIA → BRM and OSM → BRM
* Lead P1/P2 technical recovery for critical billing incidents, coordinating cross-domain troubleshooting, root cause analysis and corrective or preventive actions.Build automation using Shell/Bash, Perl/Python and SQL/PL-SQL for sanity checks, process monitoring, batch validation, reconciliation and recurring operational activities
* Lead technical knowledge transfer, shadow/reverse-shadow activities, transition readiness and early-life support.Mentor L2/L3 engineers and collaborate with Billing, Revenue Assurance, CRM, Middleware, Database and Infrastructure teams

**Who You Are**
You bring strong hands-on experience with
**Oracle BRM and telecom billing operations**
, together with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues across applications, databases and integrated systems.
  
  
**Core skills:**

* Oracle Billing and Revenue Management (BRM),Connection Manager and Data Manager
* Rating and billing,Invoicing, collections and payments,Billing utilities,Opcode troubleshooting,pin.conf
* CDR/EDR processing,Oracle Database,SQL/PL-SQL,AWR/ASH,Linux/Unix,Shell/Bash,Dynatrace

**Additional relevant skills:**

* PDC,ECE,OCOMC,BI Publisher,Control-M,OpenTelemetry
* CI/CD,Kubernetes awareness
* Revenue Assurance,ITIL/SRE practices,C/C++ or Java-based BRM integrations,Perl/Python scripting

You are comfortable leading complex production troubleshooting, working across technical domains and using evidence from application, infrastructure and database telemetry to identify root causes and improve service reliability.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
This role offers the opportunity to:
  
  

* Work with a business-critical Oracle BRM and telecom billing environment.Develop experience across end-to-end billing operations, revenue assurance and integrated telecom platforms
* Work across Oracle BRM, Dynatrace, Oracle Database, Linux/Unix and automation technologies.Contribute directly to platform reliability, billing accuracy, proactive monitoring and operational efficiency
* Collaborate across Billing, Revenue Assurance, CRM, Middleware, Database and Infrastructure teams.Take ownership of complex incidents, service improvements, automation and technical transition activities

* Oracle BRM platform engineering and advanced production troubleshooting

* OpenTelemetry and custom operational telemetry.Oracle Database performance analysis using AWR/ASH and SQL execution plans

title: Scrum Master
description:
Your role
  
  
**About Us**
Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873. It manufactures industrial tools and equipment. The Atlas Copco Group is a global industrial group of companies headquartered in Nacka, Sweden.
  
  
At Global IT Hub, we are more than a technology organisation. We are a community of innovators, problem-solvers, and digital pioneers dedicated to accelerating Atlas Copco Group’s business potential through world-class technology solutions. Join us to shape the future of digital transformation, work on global challenges, and create impact for businesses and customers worldwide.
  
  
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to join the CODA team and support predictable delivery of advanced analytics and AI capabilities. CODA is the group-wide data analytics solution for Group Reporting, bringing together Sales, Finance and ESG data, and providing trusted, transparent and near real-time insights across the business, via Power BI tools and AI initiatives.
  
  
As CODA has grown into a multi-product solution, the number of parallel workstreams, dependencies and locations have made dedicated delivery management essential. The Delivery Manager translates the CODA roadmap into realistic plans, tracks progress, supports a consistent agile way of working, and helps align work to available capacity.
  
  
The Product Owner remains accountable for priorities, scope and business value. The Delivery Manager works through facilitation and influence, raising risks, constraints and dependencies early so they can be resolved promptly; enabling delivery.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Planning**
Turn quarterly and annual CODA roadmaps into living delivery plans, sequencing topics, sizing work with the team, and identifying dependencies across products and neighboring teams.
  
  
Ensure that the planning is realistic, takes teams past performance and future capacity into account.
  
  
Track sprint-by-sprint progress, identify slippage early, and bring options to the Product Owner before issues escalate.
  
  
Follow up on commitments, chase open actions, unblock delivery where possible, and escalate unresolved issues.
  
  
Maintain delivery updates for stakeholder reporting, including status, timing changes and reprioritization.
  
  
**Way of Working**
Facilitate and improve scrum ceremonies where needed, including stand-ups, refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
  
  
Keep refinement focused on story readiness, dailies short and blocker-driven, and ensure the functional backlog feeds into sprint planning.
  
  
Support alignment of ways of working across the merged teams and two CODA streams.
  
  
Ensure team members actively participate in retrospectives, the retrospectives result in meaningful actions, and the actions are actively monitored.
  
  
Identify practical improvements to ways of working, keeping the approach manageable as products expand and the team grows.
  
  
**Resource & Capacity Planning**
Support capacity planning behind the roadmap, keeping individual workload visible and realistic.
  
  
Flag over-capacity early and propose adjustments such as resequencing, rebalancing, adding capacity or descoping.
  
  
Plan around known constraints, including regional leave patterns and month-end close periods.
  
  
Highlight resourcing gaps and raise recommendations to the Product Owner early enough to act.
  
  
To succeed, you will need
  
  
Strong project or delivery management experience in large projects with parallel workstreams and multiple products and stakeholders.
  
  

* Proven ability to build delivery plans, track progress, and manage dependencies, risks and escalations to resolution.
* Hands-on scrum master experience, including ceremonies, team coaching, backlog readiness and estimation quality.
* Experience in resource and capacity planning.
* Confidence working with distributed teams and influencing delivery without line-management authority.
* Scrum Master or equivalent agile certification is an added asset
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable
  
  

* Understanding of group finance, including month-end close and its impact on delivery priorities.
* Experience in projects relating data, analytics or finance-related with parallel workstreams and multiple products and stakeholders, is considered an advantage.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Databricks, Azure and modern analytics delivery, sufficient to challenge estimates and understand dependencies.
* Working knowledge of JIRA or Azure DevOps for backlog, sprint and capacity management, and reporting that can be drawn from them.
* Effective use of AI to improve ways of working.

In return, we offer
  
  
In return, we offer
  
  

* The opportunity to contribute to a major Group Reporting transformation initiative.
* Exposure to stakeholders across the Group.
* A collaborative and international working environment.
* The chance to make a lasting impact on the future reporting landscape of Atlas Copco Group.

At Global IT Hub, we believe exceptional talent drives exceptional transformation. As a strategic partner for next-generation digital transformation, we empower our people to innovate boldly, collaborate globally, and turn ideas into solutions that create lasting business value. Join a team where learning never stops, innovation is part of our DNA, and your contribution helps shape the future of a global industry leader.
  
  
Job location
  
  
Hybrid
  
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco Group - Global IT Hub, in Pune, India.

title: Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential. Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use.
  
  
This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**Job Description: Scrum Master (SAFe)**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Team:**
IT Department
  
  
**Reports to:**
Ralph Michelot
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and passionate
**Scrum Master**
to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential.
  
  
Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use. This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead all SAFe and Scrum events, including Program Increment (PI) Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Iteration Planning, Iteration Reviews, and Retrospectives, ensuring they are productive and stay within their timebox.
* Coach and Mentor: Act as an Agile coach for the team, providing guidance on SAFe, Scrum, and Lean principles. Help the team embrace a mindset of relentless improvement.
* Remove Impediments: Proactively identify and remove blockers or obstacles that are preventing the team from achieving its goals. Shield the team from external distractions.
* Support the Product Owner: Assist the Product Owner with backlog management, ensuring that goals, scope, and product domain are understood by everyone on the team.
* Foster a Collaborative Culture: Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, and there is an emphasis on collaboration and problem-solving.
* Track and Radiate Information: Utilize tools like Jira to track team progress, manage metrics (like velocity and cycle time), and communicate this information to stakeholders to ensure transparency.
* Drive SAFe Adoption: Guide the team in its role within the Agile Release Train (ART) and ensure its alignment with the overall program objectives.

**What You'll Bring: Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-5+ years of experience in a Scrum Master role for a software development team.
* SAFe Experience: At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Certification: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification is required.
* Agile Tools: Proficiency with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar platform.
* Excellent Skills: Strong communication, facilitation, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.
* Servant Leadership: A deep understanding of the servant-leader role and a passion for empowering teams.

**Nice-to-Haves: Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience participating in a large-scale Agile transformation.
* Advanced SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Advanced Scrum Master - SASM).
* Knowledge of other Agile approaches like Kanban and XP.
* Previous experience as a software developer, QA engineer, or business analyst.

title: AdvaRisk - QA Lead - Automation Testing
description:
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the end-to-end test automation strategy, defining the roadmap, frameworks, tooling and standards for UI, API, backend and integration testing.
* Lead, mentor and manage the QA team, owning delivery, prioritization, test coverage and quality outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering, product, data science/ML and client service teams to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test data, traceability and release-level quality reports.
* Triage defects, assess business and customer impact, and coordinate defect prioritization with relevant teams.
* Test AI/ML model integrations end to end, including request/response contracts, preprocessing and post-processing, timeout/retry behavior, failure handling and fallback paths.
* Build model-focused test suites using representative and edge-case datasets; assess output correctness against agreed reference labels or acceptance criteria, and track metrics such as precision/recall where applicable.
* Validate LLM-enabled workflows for groundedness, consistency, hallucination risks, prompt/input sensitivity and regression when prompts, models or versions change; use defined evaluation criteria rather than subjective checks alone.
* Check model-service latency, throughput, rate limits, availability, version compatibility and behavior under malformed, incomplete or unexpected inputs.
* Perform end-to-end, system integration and regression testing across UI, backend services, APIs, databases and third party/model services.
* Establish performance baselines and report findings with actionable recommendations for capacity and scalability improvements.
* Plan and execute performance, load, stress, spike and endurance tests; analyze throughput, latency, concurrency, resource utilization and bottlenecks.
* Work with developers to reproduce issues, verify fixes and prevent regressions throughout the release cycle.
* Own test-suite execution in non-production environments and integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience testing web applications across UI, backend services, APIs, databases and end-to-end workflows.
* Strong QA fundamentals with substantial hands-on automation experience using Python; able to design, build, maintain and scale automation frameworks rather than only execute existing scripts.
* People leadership experience, including leading, mentoring and driving the output of a team of 3 or more QA engineers.
* Strong API testing and debugging skills, including REST APIs, response/schema validation, authentication, error handling and service-to-service integration.
* Experience with performance-testing tools such as JMeter, Locust, k6 or equivalent, and ability to interpret results and identify bottlenecks.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML model evaluation and integration testing; able to define test datasets, expected outcomes, thresholds and regression checks in collaboration with data science/ML engineers.
* Familiarity with testing LLM-based features, including prompt/version regression, groundedness and response-quality evaluation, structured-output validation and safe failure handling.
* Comfortable validating data and service behavior using SQL, logs, metrics and traces; familiarity with CI/CD-based automated test execution is an advantage.
* Good understanding of front-end technologies and browser-based testing, including JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Pytest, Robot Framework, Selenium, Cypress or equivalent; experience with API automation is essential.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and participating in sprint planning, refinement, reviews and release readiness.
* A strong quality mindset and a track record of promoting automation-first, risk-based testing and continuous quality improvement.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work across engineering, product, QA and AI/ML teams to define and deliver quality outcomes.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Be excited by and have a positive outlook to navigate ambiguity.
* Passion for results and excellence.
* Team player.
* Must be able to get the job done by working collaboratively with others.
* Inquisitive and analytical mind; out-of-the-box thinking.
* Prioritize among competing opportunities, balancing consumer needs with business and product priorities, and clearly articulate the rationale behind product decisions.
* Straightforward and professional.
* Good communicator.
* Maintain high energy and motivate the team.
* A do-it-yourself orientation, consistent with the company's "roll-up-the-sleeves" culture.
* Proactive.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. description:

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Cloud Engineer (Backend / DevOps-leaning), you will take responsibility for designing, building and maintaining AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. This is an ongoing, long-term opportunity focused on reliable cloud infrastructure and its supporting delivery processes.

  

You will manage EC2 and other core infrastructure components, support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, and implement and maintain security and compliance controls.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop, maintain and improve AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Strengthen and improve existing IaC configurations, infrastructure reliability and platform maturity
  
* Own, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines, primarily using GitHub Actions, with Jenkins integrations where applicable
  
* Implement and improve software supply-chain security processes, including Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), container image signing and verification
  
* Improve AWS monitoring, alerting and operational visibility across the platform
  
* Manage Docker-based container deployments and orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Support ECS Anywhere deployments running across self-managed EC2 instances
  
* Work with AWS services, including EC2, ECS, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* Develop and enhance backend microservices, primarily written in Java
  
* Implement new backend features and functionality supporting role-based access control (RBAC)
  
* Develop backend capabilities for metrics ingestion and processing
  
* Implement backend functionality supporting multi-tenancy
  
* Manage application deployments, troubleshoot infrastructure issues and resolve CI/CD pipeline failures independently
  
* Support cloud and on-premises deployment environments, including opportunities to improve consistency between them
  
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, performance, security and delivery quality
  
* Contribute to cloud cost optimisation while maintaining a cloud-agnostic approach and avoiding unnecessary vendor lock-in
  
* Identify technical gaps, propose improvements and contribute proactively to product and platform development
  
* Collaborate with other engineers, share technical knowledge and challenge technical decisions constructively
  
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, reviewing and taking ownership of generated code and integrations
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 5 years of senior-level hands-on experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering or DevOps, with the ability to independently own infrastructure and backend development work
  
* 5 years of strong practical experience with AWS infrastructure and core services, including EC2, ECS, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB and Lambda
  
* 3 years of experience with Java-based backend services, or relevant backend development expertise applicable to Java microservices
  
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Proven experience designing, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions. Equivalent experience with GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins is acceptable where transferable expertise can be demonstrated
  
* Knowledge and practical experience of software supply-chain security, including SBOMs, signed container images and image verification
  
* Experience implementing and maintaining cloud monitoring and alerting solutions
  
* Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized services and container orchestration using ECS and/or Kubernetes
  
* Strong backend development experience, with the ability to independently implement new features and functionality in microservices
  
* Ability to develop backend functionality involving access control, metrics ingestion and multi-tenancy
  
* Experience troubleshooting production infrastructure, deployment pipelines and backend services
  
* Understanding of platform reliability, maintainability, security and continuous improvement
  
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions and contribute beyond assigned development tasks
  
* Strong collaboration, knowledge-sharing and problem-solving skills
  
* Ability to propose and justify technical improvements constructively
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience developing frontend features and functionality, particularly around multi-tenancy and dashboard sharing
  
* Experience integrating metrics visualisations using native frontend graphing libraries, including migrating dashboards from Grafana
  
* Experience with Kubernetes deployments across on-premises and cloud environments
  
* Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and secure SDLC practices
  
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation (FinOps) and cloud-agnostic infrastructure

**Job Title: Senior AWS Cloud Engineer**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled
**Senior AWS Cloud Engineer**
with 7+ years of hands-on experience in designing, implementing, automating, and managing enterprise-scale AWS infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), networking, security, DevOps, and multi-account environments.

This role requires a hands-on engineer who can design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions, drive automation initiatives, troubleshoot complex infrastructure challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a managed services environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AWS Infrastructure & Architecture**

* Design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure.
* Implement and optimize AWS networking, compute, storage, databases, and cloud-native services.
* Design and manage enterprise multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower.
* Develop cloud architecture documentation, reference architectures, and technical design specifications.
* Ensure infrastructure follows AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and enterprise standards.

**2. Infrastructure Automation & DevOps**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and GitHub Actions.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and routine operations.
* Develop automation scripts and solutions using Python, AWS Lambda, and other relevant technologies.
* Implement standardised and reusable infrastructure components across environments.

**3. Security, Networking & Compliance**

* Implement enterprise-grade security controls, IAM policies, encryption, and AWS KMS key management.
* Design and troubleshoot complex AWS networking environments, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPNs, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Implement security monitoring, auditing, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.
* Work with security teams to ensure alignment with organizational security policies and industry best practices.
* Support security assessments, infrastructure audits, and remediation activities.

**4. Containers & Cloud-Native Services**

* Design, deploy, and manage containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS.
* Implement scalable microservices infrastructure and container orchestration solutions.
* Optimize containerized workloads for availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.

* Monitor and optimize AWS infrastructure using Amazon CloudWatch, Datadog, and other observability tools.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, deployment, and performance issues across development and production environments.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement long-term corrective and preventive measures.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* Identify opportunities for cloud cost optimization, operational efficiency, and infrastructure improvements.

* Collaborate with development, networking, security, and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions.

* Support technical solution design, infrastructure cost estimation, and migration planning for business requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure and engineering.
* Proven experience managing complex enterprise AWS environments, preferably within managed services or multi-account organizations.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, S3 Glacier, CloudFront, Route 53, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, hybrid connectivity, routing, DNS, and network security.
* Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and multi-account governance.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS Developer Tools.
* Proficiency in Python scripting and infrastructure automation.
* Strong understanding of AWS security, encryption, KMS, IAM, auditing, and compliance.
* Experience implementing monitoring and observability using Datadog and CloudWatch.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization.

**Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional preferred.
* Additional AWS certifications in DevOps, Security, or Networking are an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with serverless architectures using AWS Lambda and the Serverless Framework.
* Working knowledge of AWS services such as SQS, SNS, SES, and DynamoDB.
* Experience with AWS security and governance services, including CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub, and GuardDuty.
* Familiarity with AWS migration strategies and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Experience with code scanning, infrastructure security scanning, and compliance automation.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews and evaluating emerging cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with AI-powered development and productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools is a plus.
* Interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve cloud infrastructure management, DevOps workflows, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across technical teams.
* Proactive mindset with a strong focus on automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

description:
**Role Summary**
The
**Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)**
is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by
**Java**
,
**Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**
,
**distributed microservices**
, and
**event-driven architectures**
.
  
  
The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & System Architecture
* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient Java/Spring Boot microservices capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.
* Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience
* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across OpenShift, Kubernetes
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture
* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.
* Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship
* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
**Experience & Education**

* Experience: Minimum 12+ years of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least 4–6 years in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies**
**Java & Core Technologies**

* Master-level proficiency in Java (11, 17, 21+), JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**

* Deep architectural and development expertise with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration.
* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**

* Extensive experience with Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) and message streaming platforms (Apache Kafka).
* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**

* Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL solutions (MongoDB).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (Redis).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**

* Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift
* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**

* Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack.

**Security & Quality Engineering**

* Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. * Solid understanding of data modelling, lakehouse architecture, and analytics‑ready data design.

* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical mindset.
* Effective communicator across technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Mentors junior engineers and promotes engineering best practices.
* Champions engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Cloud or data engineering certifications (AWS / Databricks) are desirable.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Data Design & Architecture
* Own logical and physical data design for curated, conformed, and consumption‑ready datasets.
* Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data models (dimensional, domain‑oriented, lakehouse patterns).
* Contribute to data architecture decisions aligned with Barclays cloud, security, and governance standards.

* Design and develop end‑to‑end data pipelines using:
* AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch)
* Apache Spark (PySpark) for large‑scale batch and streaming processing
* Databricks for lakehouse‑based transformations and analytics enablement
* Build robust ingestion, transformation, and curation pipelines handling structured and semi‑structured data.
* Ensure pipelines are performance‑optimised, cost‑efficient, and resilient.
* Orchestration & Automation
* Develop and manage workflows using Apache Airflow.
* Implement and operate Airflow pipelines on Astronomer, following enterprise scheduling, monitoring, and alerting standards.
* Embed CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment controls for data workloads.
* Data Quality, Governance & Controls
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls, and lineage.
* Ensure compliance with Barclays data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit, risk, and control processes through well‑documented and traceable data solutions.
* Stakeholder & Delivery Responsibilities
* Work closely with product owners, business analysts, architects, and MI/reporting teams.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers.
* Support production releases, incident analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.

* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

title: GM - Vodacom Cloud Portfolio Mgr
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology transformation leader to drive large-scale, complex multi-cloud and ICT transformation programmes across Vodacom Business and external customers. This role is responsible for shaping and leading cloud transformation initiatives from pre-sales through to operational delivery, ensuring successful business outcomes, governance compliance, commercial performance, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strategic leadership across cloud migration, modernisation, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud programmes while working closely with senior stakeholders, customers, vendors, and delivery teams. They will influence programme direction, realise business benefits, and promote delivery excellence across the organisation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead complex customer-facing ICT and cloud transformation programmes from inception through to in-life operations
* Develop programme roadmaps, delivery strategies, and operating models that support customer and business objectives
* Build strong partnerships with stakeholders across Vodafone, Vodacom Business, customers, and external suppliers
* Provide strategic leadership to large matrix teams operating across multiple organisations and geographies
* Shape and influence large bids, pre-sales engagements, delivery approaches, and transformation strategies
* Lead programme responses for Pre-Qualification Questionnaires (PQQs) and Request for Proposal (RFP) submissions
* Present cloud transformation solutions, delivery strategies, and service offerings to senior customer stakeholders
* Take ownership of programme governance, compliance, quality standards, and delivery frameworks
* Establish and manage programme budgets, milestones, contractual commitments, and financial performance
* Drive revenue growth, margin improvement, and programme value realisation through effective commercial management
* Identify, assess, and manage programme risks, issues, dependencies, and recovery plans
* Utilise programme evaluation techniques, root-cause analysis, and performance metrics to improve delivery outcomes
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives, operational efficiencies, and delivery best practices

Mentor and support project and programme professionals, fostering capability development across the organisation
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Extensive experience leading large-scale, complex, multi-tower ICT transformation programmes
* Proven success delivering customer-facing transformation initiatives within enterprise environments
* Demonstrated experience managing programme recovery, turnaround activities, and performance improvement initiatives
* Strong pre-sales experience, including client engagement, bid leadership, PQQ responses, and RFP development
* Deep understanding of programme and project management methodologies across the full delivery lifecycle
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing programme financials, budgets, revenue, margins, and business outcomes
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience building collaborative environments across customers, partners, suppliers, and internal teams
* Strong conflict resolution, decision-making, coaching, and mentoring capabilities
* Expertise in public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Experience leading large-scale cloud migrations and modernisation programmes covering infrastructure, applications, databases, and security
* Understanding of hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, and data centre transformation strategies
* Knowledge of cloud landing zones, cloud governance frameworks, cloud operating models, and Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) approaches

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead strategically important cloud and infrastructure transformation programmes across diverse industries
* Exposure to complex multi-cloud environments spanning Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI
* Opportunity to influence executive-level decision-making and customer transformation agendas
* Experience working with global stakeholders, customers, and technology partners
* Ability to shape delivery standards, governance practices, and organisational capability development
* Participation in large-scale transformation programmes with significant commercial and operational impact

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced multi-cloud transformation and migration leadership
* Enterprise cloud governance and cloud operating model design
* Commercial leadership, programme financial management, and business value realisation
* Executive stakeholder management and strategic consulting techniques
* Complex programme recovery and transformation delivery methodologies
* Enterprise cloud networking and hybrid connectivity architecture concepts
* Large-scale organisational change and transformation management practices

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

title: Director - Tech Architecture
description:
**Dir - Enterprise Architecture - IN**
The role is responsible for aligning the overall technology strategy and solutions with the business goals and objectives of the organization. They focus on the holistic view of the enterprise, considering various aspects such as business processes, information systems, applications, data management, and technology infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Their main role is to design and maintain the architecture that enables the organization to meet its strategic objectives.
* They work closely with stakeholders, including business leaders, IT teams, and solution architects, to ensure that technology initiatives are inline with the organization's overall vision.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* 8+ Years Required; 10+ Years Preferred

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

**Career Level**
10IC
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior AI Developer to build and ship production-grade agentic and RAG-based AI systems. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time is spent writing code, designing agent workflows, and getting features into production. You'll also help set technical direction and mentor others along the way.
  
  
You'll work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn messy, real-world problems into reliable, scalable AI solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered agentic systems and RAG pipelines into production.
* Build multi-agent and tool-using workflows using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.
* Develop RAG pipelines: retrieval, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation.
* Work with agent interoperability and tooling standards such as A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol).
* Build and expose backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI or Flask).
* Deploy and operate agents in production (we use Amazon Strands and AgentCore for build and deployment).
* Set up practical evaluation and monitoring for agents and RAG quality, latency, and cost.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.
* Mentor other developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with product and stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Strong Python skills and experience building backend services with FastAPI or Flask.
* Hands-on experience building LLM applications — prompt design, RAG, or agent workflows.
* Experience with an agent/LLM framework such as LangChain or LangGraph (or a willingness to ramp up quickly if you've used similar tools).
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/context integration — or closely related agent-tooling experience and the ability to pick it up quickly.
* Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
* Experience deploying applications to production and keeping them running (serving, basic monitoring, debugging).
* Comfortable with a cloud platform (AWS preferred, since our stack is AWS-based).
* Solid fundamentals with version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD.
* Good communication and a collaborative, team-first approach.

**Qualifications - Nice To Have**

* Experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, OpenSearch).
* Exposure to A2A, Amazon Strands, or AgentCore — or similar agent/deployment tooling.
* Familiarity with evaluation and observability for LLM apps (e.g., LangSmith).
* Awareness of responsible AI practices: privacy, security, and safe/guardrailed agents.

Related Skills
  
  
Application Programming Interface (API) Development/Integration, Automation, Communication, Consultative Communication, Containerization, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Influence, Organizational Savviness, Problem Solving, Prototyping, Relationship Management, Scalability/Reliability, Software Development Life Cycle, Systems Design/Analysis
