title: Salesforce Architect -Financial Services Cloud
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service & Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security & Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps & Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
The Salesforce Architect should be able to:
  
  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.
* Strong hands-on experience with OmniStudio.
* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:
  
  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience
* Strong architecture experience across complex Salesforce implementations
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
* Strong implementation and architecture experience with Financial Services Cloud
* Experience leading architecture for medium to large enterprise Salesforce programs

We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. title: Lead Engineer
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.
  
  
We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.
  
  
**Polyglot Full Stack Developer (Lead) Experience**
***Pune, India (GCC) — on-site / hybrid as applicable***
*8–10 years Team Leadership*
*Must have led a team of 5–6 developers Employment Type*
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team — and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.
* Lead and mentor a team of 5–6 developers — assigning work, conducting code reviews, unblocking issues, and owning delivery quality and timelines.
* Own system design and architecture decisions for new features and services, balancing scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Build and maintain backend services in Java and Python, and frontend applications using React JS.
* Apply AI/ML concepts and tools where relevant to enhance product features or internal tooling.
* Containerize applications with Docker and support deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Design efficient, well-structured SQL schemas and queries; optimize database performance.
* Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand.
* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.
* Proven experience leading a team of 5–6 developers, including mentoring, code review, and delivery ownership.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development.
* Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development.
* Working proficiency in Python.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).
* Practical experience with Docker for containerization.
* Solid working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong SQL skills — schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Demonstrated ability to design scalable, maintainable systems (system design fundamentals: caching, load balancing, microservices, API design, etc.).
* Proficiency with Git and standard branching/collaboration workflows.
* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.
* A polyglot mindset — genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.
* Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms.

**What We're Looking For**
Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.
  
  
*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*
Why Join Us?
  
  
**Benefits**
At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:
  
  

* Health and Wellness:

+ Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.

* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.

* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.

description:
**Job Title:**
DevSecOps Engineer
  
  
**Department:**
DevOps / Platform Engineering
  
  
**Reports To:**
Devops Lead
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to embed security throughout our Azure-based SDLC, working within our existing DevOps toolchain and infrastructure. The role combines the platform and automation depth of our DevOps engineering practice with the security methodology defined by AZT's DPE Security function — Threat Modelling, SCA, SAST, DAST, IAST, CSPM and RASP.
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role. The immediate priority is standing up and operationalising Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) across our pipelines and environments, in parallel with ongoing responsibility for CI/CD, infrastructure automation and container platform support. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable scripting an Azure pipeline, tuning a Kubernetes deployment, and configuring a security scanning tool against a running application.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* DevSecOps Tooling & Pipeline Security — priority: DAST
* Lead the rollout of Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST): select/configure tooling, integrate scanning into CI/CD, and establish scan cadence (manual, scheduled, and build-triggered).
* Design DAST test coverage for AuthN/AuthZ flaws, session-management vulnerabilities, configuration issues and insecure workflows across web, API and microservice applications.
* Own reporting and remediation workflows for DAST findings, working with development teams to prioritise and close out vulnerabilities.
* Support and extend the wider DevSecOps pipeline: Threat Modelling / security architecture review, Software Configuration Analysis (SCA) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST) at build time.
* Evaluate and pilot Interactive Application Security Testing (IAST) where suited to the application stack in use.
* Contribute to Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) — monitoring Azure configuration, compliance and vulnerabilities — and to Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) for production workloads.
* Act as a shared-responsibility partner alongside Development, Security and Operations: automate security checks in the pipeline, harden deployment configurations, and keep systems patched and up to date.
* GitHub Enterprise & CI/CD
* Administer and optimise GitHub Enterprise (or Azure DevOps) to support development teams; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / YAML pipelines) for build, test, security-scan and release stages.
* Manage build agents (Linux and Windows), Git repositories, branching strategies (GitFlow / trunk-based) and Personal Access Token (PAT) governance.
* Lead migration of source repositories from GitLab, Bitbucket, SVN and other platforms into GitHub Enterprise, ensuring data integrity, security and minimal downtime.
* Implement security best practice within the GitHub Enterprise ecosystem (branch protection, secret scanning, access control).
* Cloud Infrastructure (Azure)
* Operate and improve Azure infrastructure: VMs/VMSS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Application Service Environment (ASE), Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Storage (Blob/File), Data Factory.
* Manage networking and security controls: VNETs, NSGs, Private Endpoints/Private Link, Application Gateway and WAF, Key Vault.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Crossplane, Terraform or ARM templates; use Packer for image creation and Ansible for configuration management.
* Containers & Microservices
* Manage AKS clusters, pod deployment and scaling, Helm charts, Istio service mesh, Flannel networking and ingress controllers.
* Support containerisation practices (Docker) and container registries (Harbor, Amazon ECR, Azure ACR).
* Automate deployment using Argo CD and integrate deployment automation with the broader CI/CD toolchain.
* SDLC Toolchain & Binary Management
* Manage binary repositories (Nexus) and support migration from legacy tools (e.g. Artifactory) as part of platform modernisation.
* Work across the full SDLC toolchain cluster: build/package management, container registries, deployment automation and monitoring.
* Scripting & Automation
* Develop automation using Bash/Shell, PowerShell and Python (preferred) across Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell and REST APIs.
* Build scripts and tooling to automate security checks, infrastructure changes and repetitive operational processes.
* Databases
* Support Azure SQL administration, performance tuning, backup/restore and on-premises-to-Azure migration.
* Support NoSQL platforms — MongoDB (PaaS and VM-hosted) and Azure Cosmos DB.
* Monitoring & Observability
* Maintain dashboards and alerting in Dynatrace (primary platform), Grafana, Kibana (ELK), Azure Monitor/Log Analytics and Application Insights.
* Support incident management, log analysis, troubleshooting and performance monitoring across environments.
* Collaboration
* Work in agile teams using Jira for issue tracking and Confluence for documentation; contribute to agile ceremonies and continuous improvement.
* Partner with development, operations and security teams to understand needs, provide solutions, and troubleshoot toolchain issues.
* Provide training and support on best practice within GitHub Enterprise and the wider DevSecOps toolchain.

**DevSecOps Methodology — Practices Covered by This Role**
The table below reflects AZT's DevSecOps approach: security integrated continuously across the SDLC rather than concentrated at the end. DAST is the current priority delivery focus.
  
  
**Practice (SDLC Stage)**
**Scope & Focus**
Threat Modelling (Plan / Design)
  
  
Identify threats against architecture components — user interfaces, data flows, data processes, data storage. Rate and prioritise remediation. Supported by AZT's global Threat Modelling service.
  
  
Software Configuration Analysis — SCA (Develop)
  
  
Detect vulnerabilities in open-source dependencies; produce SBOMs and check licence attribution/compliance. Typically bundled with SAST tooling (GHAS).
  
  
Static Application Security Testing — SAST (Build)
  
  
Analyse source code for vulnerabilities before runtime, without executing the application. Performed once code is feature-complete; earliest and cheapest point to fix defects (shift-left).
  
  
Dynamic Application Security Testing
  
  
Simulate real-world attacks against the running application: crafted requests, response analysis, and detection of AuthN/AuthZ flaws, session-management issues, misconfiguration and insecure workflows. This is a priority project for AZT Ireland and the primary near-term focus of this role.
  
  
Interactive Application Security Testing — IAST (Test)
  
  
Agent/sensor-based testing that combines SAST- and DAST-style visibility across code, data flow, requests/responses and configuration; traces exploitable vulnerabilities back to source. Suited to web, mobile, microservice and API-based applications; tool selection depends on the application stack in use.
  
  
Cloud Security Posture Management — CSPM (Release / Deploy)
  
  
Continuous monitoring of cloud configuration, compliance and vulnerabilities across cloud services and resources; unifies visibility across providers into a single console.
  
  
Runtime Application Self-Protection — RASP (Operate / Monitor)
  
  
Embedded security agents that monitor application behaviour and block attacks in real time at the application layer, complementing network-level controls.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
* Proven DevOps/DevSecOps experience with a strong focus on the GitHub Enterprise ecosystem and CI/CD pipeline creation (GitHub Actions).
* Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure services listed above, and with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, or Crossplane).
* Practical experience with at least one application security testing practice (SAST, DAST or IAST); willingness and ability to lead DAST implementation specifically.
* Experience with Kubernetes (AKS), Helm and container registries (Nexus, Harbor, ECR or ACR).
* Strong scripting ability (Python preferred; Bash/PowerShell) and comfort with Azure CLI/REST APIs.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Grafana or the ELK stack.
* Experience working in agile teams using Jira and Confluence.
* Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills, and sound understanding of security best practice and compliance standards.

**Preferred**

* Certifications in DevOps and/or security-related fields.
* Prior involvement in a DAST or broader application-security-testing rollout.
* Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, and cloud-to-cloud or on-prem-to-cloud database migrations.
* Experience with repository migration (GitLab, Bitbucket, SVN → GitHub Enterprise).
* Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) tooling.

**Good To Have**

* Having a basic understanding or exposure to AI tools would be a plus.
* Familiarity with basic AI tools is considered an advantage.
* Basic knowledge or experience with AI tools will be beneficial.
* Exposure to AI tools, even at a basic level, is a value-add.A fundamental grasp of AI tools will be an added benefit.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior AI Engineer**

**Location: Pune, India (Work from Office)**

**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

As an AI Engineer you will be an essential part of the modelling team, developing analytics solutions to meet business and user requirements. Conduct exploratory data analysis, build and integrate models into the solution pipeline. Ensure solution robustness and scalability across multiple clients, while constantly exploring advanced modelling techniques for optimal efficacy. This is an exciting role that offers tremendous learning and growth opportunities in a dynamic data-driven environment.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**

* Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports.
* Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
* Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems.
* Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
* Filter and “clean” data by reviewing computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code problems.
* Work with management to priorities business and information needs.
* Work with Data Engineer to build the data science infrastructure.
* Deliver on time with high quality.
* Trouble Shooting and debugging skills for faster data defect fixing.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* Master’s/B Tech degree with a major in quantitative field (Statistics, Predictive Analytics, Economics, Mathematics etc.)
* 4 plus years of experience in implementing AI/ML solutions.
* 2+ years of experience in OpenCV, Object detection, image processing and classification.
* 2+ years of experience with frameworks like YOLO, Faster R-CNN, Computer vision models etc.
* Good understanding of AI/ML modelling techniques and implementation experience.
* Experience with ML, Deep Learning, TensorFlow, Python, NLP.
* Exposure to Image classification models, Diffusion models, Voice assistants and chat bots is a big plus.
* Knowledge of basic algorithms, object-oriented and functional design principles, and best-practice patterns.
* Experience in REST API development, NoSQL database design, and RDBMS design and optimizations.
* Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrate excellent interpersonal and organizational skills and be a good team player.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

  + Microsoft Azure

**5. Generative AI Orchestration & Vector Search**

  + LangChain

  + Semantic Kernel
* Support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures

**8. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to productionize models

**9. Documentation & Operational Excellence**

Establish best practices for AI platform operations and reliability.

title: Director - Tech Architecture
description:
**Dir - Enterprise Architecture - IN**
The role is responsible for aligning the overall technology strategy and solutions with the business goals and objectives of the organization. They focus on the holistic view of the enterprise, considering various aspects such as business processes, information systems, applications, data management, and technology infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Their main role is to design and maintain the architecture that enables the organization to meet its strategic objectives.
* They work closely with stakeholders, including business leaders, IT teams, and solution architects, to ensure that technology initiatives are inline with the organization's overall vision.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* 8+ Years Required; 10+ Years Preferred

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

**Career Level**
10IC
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior AI Developer to build and ship production-grade agentic and RAG-based AI systems. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time is spent writing code, designing agent workflows, and getting features into production. You'll also help set technical direction and mentor others along the way.
  
  
You'll work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn messy, real-world problems into reliable, scalable AI solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered agentic systems and RAG pipelines into production.
* Build multi-agent and tool-using workflows using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.
* Develop RAG pipelines: retrieval, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation.
* Work with agent interoperability and tooling standards such as A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol).
* Build and expose backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI or Flask).
* Deploy and operate agents in production (we use Amazon Strands and AgentCore for build and deployment).
* Set up practical evaluation and monitoring for agents and RAG quality, latency, and cost.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.
* Mentor other developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with product and stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Strong Python skills and experience building backend services with FastAPI or Flask.
* Hands-on experience building LLM applications — prompt design, RAG, or agent workflows.
* Experience with an agent/LLM framework such as LangChain or LangGraph (or a willingness to ramp up quickly if you've used similar tools).
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/context integration — or closely related agent-tooling experience and the ability to pick it up quickly.
* Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
* Experience deploying applications to production and keeping them running (serving, basic monitoring, debugging).
* Comfortable with a cloud platform (AWS preferred, since our stack is AWS-based).
* Solid fundamentals with version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD.
* Good communication and a collaborative, team-first approach.

**Qualifications - Nice To Have**

* Experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, OpenSearch).
* Exposure to A2A, Amazon Strands, or AgentCore — or similar agent/deployment tooling.
* Familiarity with evaluation and observability for LLM apps (e.g., LangSmith).
* Awareness of responsible AI practices: privacy, security, and safe/guardrailed agents.

Related Skills
  
  
Application Programming Interface (API) Development/Integration, Automation, Communication, Consultative Communication, Containerization, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Influence, Organizational Savviness, Problem Solving, Prototyping, Relationship Management, Scalability/Reliability, Software Development Life Cycle, Systems Design/Analysis

title: Principal Engineer — Python is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

title: Specialist, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis
description:
**Job Description**
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Specialist, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis to join our US LDI Quants team within Investment Management Division. This role is located in Pune, Maharashtra - HYBRID.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* The US Quants Team interacts with various teams on a day-to-day basis, primarily the Client Team and Portfolio Managers and is often the conduit between various teams/workflows. These teams often rely on the Quant Team to provide analysis which will be delivered to clients and impact trading decisions. The team is also expecting significant growth in the coming years and so are looking for highly skilled, detail-oriented and motivated candidates to support its growing business.
* This will be an individual contributor role. The analyst will be expected to provide quantitative support across a number of areas including investment and pension liability modelling, solution design, portfolio monitoring, risk and performance analysis.
* The analyst will also be expected to support day to day processes such as maintaining custom liability benchmarks, preparing bespoke client reports, developing/ enhancing existing tools (Excel/ Python) etc.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* 3 - 5 years’ work experience in a similar or related role with a top tier firm. Example roles include as a quant developer/programmer, data scientist, investment quant and/or fixed income/derivative analysis within financial services, investment bank, asset manager, or consulting firm.
* The candidate will require a high level of quantitative and computational financial skill and ability to solve extremely complex problems for our US LDI clients. They will ideally hold a primary degree in a quantitative science with experience in programming. They will preferably have additional quant-orientated qualifications or progress towards investment designation (e.g., CFA, actuarial science).
* Ideal candidates would have strong work experience and relevant knowledge/skill in a number of the following areas:
* Sound programming knowledge with relevant on-the-job experience
* Understanding of present value calculations, interest rate and credit spread risk
* Familiarity with fixed income, derivative markets and hedging techniques
* Ability and desire to apply numerical skills in the workplace. Candidate with mathematics, statistics, or engineering background is preferred.
* Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Candidate will need to work with US and Pune team members simultaneously.
* Understanding of US Pensions and related risk management techniques is a plus
* The candidate should have strong verbal and written communication as they will need to articulate their thought process in any given task and set these out via email/messaging or video call. The candidate should be fluent in English and is expected to work closely with US and Pune team members. They should be deadline driven, have a strong work ethic and be committed to meet the deadlines.

**About Us**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

**Job Description**
As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. **Your Responsibilities**

* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.

* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.
* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.
* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.
* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.
* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.
* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.
* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.
* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.
* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.
* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

title: Senior Java Backend Developer
description:
**Company: INVERX PVT LTD**

**Location Pune, India (Full-Time)**

**Position: Senior Java Backend Developer :**Hands-on Backend Engineering & Technical Ownership

**Experience:** Level 4–5 Years

**Department:** Engineering / Technology

**Role Focus:** Hands-on technical ownership Backend Engineering Microservices & Distributed Systems

**Tech Stack:** Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Docker

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

INVERX is looking for a skilled and hands-on Senior Java Backend Developer with 4–5 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend applications. The candidate should have strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, database management, and distributed systems. The role requires someone who can take ownership of backend modules, make sound technical decisions, guide junior developers, and contribute to architecture and engineering best practices. This is a hands-on engineering role with strong technical ownership, not a managerial position. KEY

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot; build secure, reliable, and high-performance RESTful APIs; write clean, reusable, maintainable, and testable code; apply object-oriented design principles and design patterns; participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards.
* Microservices & Distributed Systems: Design and implement microservices-based applications; understand service-to-service communication and distributed system challenges; implement retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and idempotency; handle distributed transactions and data consistency; contribute to scalable and fault-tolerant architectures.
* Database Management: Design and optimize relational database schemas; work with MySQL or PostgreSQL; develop efficient queries and troubleshoot performance issues; use Hibernate and JPA effectively; understand indexing, transactions, connection pooling, and query optimization.
* Messaging & Caching: Work with Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ; understand asynchronous processing and event-driven architecture; use Redis for caching and performance optimization; handle message retries, failures, and duplicate processing.
* Security & Reliability: Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms; understand Spring Security, JWT, and OAuth2; follow secure coding practices; handle API validation, exception handling, and sensitive data protection.
* Testing & Quality: Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito; identify and resolve bugs and performance bottlenecks; maintain code quality; ensure reliability through appropriate testing practices.
* Deployment & Monitoring: Work with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker; support production troubleshooting, logging, and monitoring.
* Technical Ownership: Take ownership of assigned backend modules; guide and mentor junior developers; review technical designs and implementation approaches; coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and product teams; identify technical risks and recommend practical solution.

**MANDATORY TECHNICAL SKILLS**

1. Core Java Core Fundamentals: Strong understanding of Core Java, object-oriented programming, and SOLID principles. Java Programming: Collections Framework, Generics, exception handling, and Java 8+ features. Concurrency: Multithreading and concurrency; understanding of thread safety, synchronization, and concurrent utilities. JVM: JVM fundamentals, memory management, and garbage collection.

2. Spring Ecosystem Framework: Spring Boot and Spring Framework; Spring MVC and REST API development. Data & Core: Spring Data JPA and Hibernate; Dependency Injection and Inversion of Control. Security & Validation: Spring Security fundamentals, exception handling, and validation.

3. Microservices Architecture: Microservices architecture and design principles; REST-based service communication. Platform: Service discovery and configuration management fundamentals; API versioning and gateway concepts. Reliability: Fault tolerance and distributed system fundamentals.

4. Databases & Caching Relational Databases: MySQL or PostgreSQL; SQL query writing and optimization; database indexing and transactions. ORM: Hibernate and JPA. Redis: Redis fundamentals.

5. Messaging Messaging Systems: Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ. Concepts: Asynchronous processing and event-driven architecture fundamentals. Reliability: Message delivery, retries, and failure handling.

6. Development Tools Tooling: Git and GitHub/GitLab; Maven or Gradle; IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse; Postman. Testing & Containers: JUnit and Mockito; Docker fundamentals.

**PREFERRED / GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS**

* Java & Security: Strong experience with Java 17 or later; advanced Spring Security and OAuth2.
* Messaging & Patterns: In-depth Kafka concepts, including partitions, consumer groups, offsets, and delivery guarantees; Saga pattern, Outbox pattern, and Change Data Capture (CDC).
* Advanced Tech: Advanced Redis usage; gRPC, GraphQL, or WebSockets; reactive programming with Project Reactor; Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
* Cloud & Observability: Kubernetes fundamentals; AWS or other cloud platforms; observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing.
* Target Domains: Experience in FinTech, payment systems, financial applications, or SaaS platforms.

**ARCHITECTURE & SYSTEM DESIGN EXPECTATIONS**

* Design scalable and maintainable backend services. Understand monolithic and microservices architectures, and explain synchronous versus asynchronous communication.
* Design APIs with performance, security, and reliability in mind. Understand database scaling and caching strategies.
* Identify bottlenecks in high-traffic applications and handle concurrency and data consistency challenges.
* Explain common distributed system patterns such as Saga, Circuit Breaker, Retry, and Idempotency.
* Participate in technical design discussions and architecture reviews.

**PRODUCTION ENGINEERING & TROUBLESHOOTING**

* Investigate and resolve production issues; analyze application logs, exceptions, and stack traces.
* Identify memory leaks, thread contention, and performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot slow APIs and database queries.
* Understand application monitoring and health checks; handle failure scenarios in distributed services.
* Contribute to root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.

**OWNERSHIP & COLLABORATION**

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned backend modules and break down requirements into technical tasks.
* Support junior developers through technical guidance; review pull requests and suggest improvements.
* Maintain coding standards and engineering practices.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical decisions and risks clearly.
* Balance delivery timelines with code quality and maintainability.

**Senior Java Backend Developer — Evaluation, Growth & Calibration**

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a good understanding of backend engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to independently design and implement backend features.
* Practical experience building production-ready applications and debugging complex application issues. **Good communication and collaboration skills.**
* Willingness to learn and adopt new technologies.
* A hands-on mindset with technical ownership. CANDIDATE EVALUATION CRITERIA
* Core Java: Collections, OOP, JVM, multithreading, concurrency, and memory management.
* Spring Boot: REST APIs, dependency injection, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
* Database: SQL, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
* Microservices: Service communication, fault tolerance, and distributed system concepts. Messaging & Caching: Kafka/RabbitMQ and Redis. System Design: Ability to design scalable and reliable backend systems.
* Problem Solving: Coding, debugging, and practical engineering challenges.
* Technical Ownership: Code reviews, ownership, mentoring, and technical decision-making.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 4–5 years of professional backend development experience, with strong practical experience in Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience developing REST APIs and backend services, and working with relational databases. Exposure to microservices and distributed systems.

**CAREER & ROLE GROWTH**

Own important backend modules and services; contribute to system architecture and technical decisions. Lead implementation of complex backend features and mentor junior engineers. Improve application scalability, reliability, and performance. Grow into broader technical responsibilities.

**WHY JOIN INVERX?**

Work on challenging backend engineering problems and contribute to scalable, production-grade applications. Work with modern backend technologies and architectures. Take ownership of important technical components. Collaborate with a team focused on engineering quality and innovation. Grow technically and professionally.

**HIRING CALIBRATION**

For this 4–5 years experience level, the title Senior Java Backend Developer represents a hands-on technical ownership role. The candidate is expected to independently own backend modules, review code and guide junior developers, contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, and take responsibility for implementation quality and production reliability. Full people-management experience, Kubernetes expertise, advanced cloud architecture, and organization-wide architecture ownership are preferred but not mandatory.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Java Backend Developer with 4–5 years of experience who can independently develop scalable backend applications, contribute to system design, solve production engineering challenges, and guide junior developers. The ideal candidate should have strong Core Java and Spring Boot expertise, practical microservices experience, sound database knowledge, and a clear understanding of distributed systems.

title: Salesforce Architect -Financial Services Cloud
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
**The Salesforce Architect should be able to:**  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.
* Strong hands-on experience with OmniStudio.
* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
**Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:**  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience
* Strong architecture experience across complex Salesforce implementations
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
* Strong implementation and architecture experience with Financial Services Cloud
* Experience leading architecture for medium to large enterprise Salesforce programs

description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Tracking & Web Analytics Specialist to manage and optimize the digital data infrastructure across our global e-commerce platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring the accurate capture, processing, and cataloging of online behavioral data to provide robust, accessible metrics for web analytics experts and business stakeholders. The Specialist acts as the bridge between business insight needs and technical tracking implementation, with a strong focus on data quality, privacy compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

The primary goal of this role is to establish and maintain robust digital tracking to transform raw website activity into continuous performance metrics for e-commerce improvement.

**1. Tracking Setup & Implementation**

* Define, implement, and rigorously test new tracking events, metrics, and dimensions across our e-commerce platforms.
* Serve as the technical liaison between the business/analytics teams and the IT development teams for all tracking implementation projects.
* Maintain the official tracking plan, ensuring it is consistently updated to reflect changes and new features on the website.

* Safeguard the end-to-end data pipeline, ensuring the digital data quality is monitored daily, and setting the standards for the overall organization.

* Act as a critical thinker towards new tracking requests, prioritizing them based on resource availability and anticipated business value.
* Advise business teams on selecting the most appropriate events and conversion metrics for effective tracking and campaign measurement.

* Cloud Data Environments: Experience with cloud-based data warehouses like Google BigQuery or other similar platforms (Snowflake, AWS Redshift).

* Experience: 3-6 years of professional experience focused on analytics implementation, tracking, and tag management.

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Proactivity & Drive: Highly proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn.
* Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration: Able to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams (IT, Marketing, Product).
