title: Sr. Enterprise Application Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Sr. Enterprise Systems Engineer

**Sr. Enterprise Applications Engineer**

OpenGov is seeking a Sr. Enterprise Applications Engineer to lead the design and integration of our core business systems - spanning IT, identity, and GTM-adjacent platforms. You will own complex, cross-functional systems and integrations end-to-end: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and emerging AI tooling, using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs to connect systems that don't naturally talk to each other, and will partner with our Business Systems team on integrations that touch Salesforce via its API. This role goes beyond execution - it includes architectural decision-making, long-term system design, and mentorship of other engineers, with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership.

This role is based in our Pune office, onsite 4 days a week, working closely with US and India-based Enterprise Technology teams.

**Position Responsibilities**

Experience - 7+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience

Education - BE/B.tech in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

* Design and build API-based integrations between enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and third-party services, using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs and event-driven workflows.
* Partner with the Business Systems team on integrations that touch Salesforce via API - this role works through the Salesforce API, not Salesforce development (no Apex, LWC, or Flow work).
* Own complex, cross-functional systems and automations end-to-end - requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and long-term maintenance.
* Architect and continuously improve onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle workflows for users, applications, and assets, with a focus on scalability and auditability.
* Define and enforce access control models across cloud systems, ensuring least-privilege access and alignment with security best practices.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues, providing root-cause analysis and durable fixes.
* Partner with stakeholders across GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to scope and prioritize systems integration initiatives.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-native tools and workflows to improve efficiency across the enterprise systems stack.
* Mentor other engineers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and raising overall technical quality.
* Author and maintain high-quality technical documentation, system diagrams, and SOPs.

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities

### Integration Architecture

* Bulk APIs

* Streaming APIs

### Data Architecture

### Security Governance

* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security

### DevOps Environment Strategy

* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.

title: CIS PROGRAM MANAGEMENT
description:
Job Description

**Transition and Transformation Program Manager - Cloud, Infrastructure and Security Services**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi-workstream technology transformation programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data centre and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for strategy, roadmap, governance and integrated delivery from discovery and architecture through build, migration, testing, acceptance, go-live, hypercare and value realization, including M&A integration, divestiture or separation where applicable.

**Role Information**

**Details**

**Role**

Transition and Transformation Program Manager

  

**Practice**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services

  

**Location**

Pune

  

**Employment Type**

Full-time

  

**Experience**

15+ years overall IT experience, including 10+ years leading complex transformation, cloud/infrastructure implementation, migration, transition or program delivery

  

**Reporting**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services leadership / assigned program leadership

**Role Purpose**
================

Provide end-to-end leadership for large transformation programs involving multiple projects, service towers, vendors and geographies. The Program Manager aligns business outcomes, architecture, commercial commitments and delivery capacity; establishes decision rights and stage gates; and ensures that technology change is implemented, accepted, stabilized and transitioned into a sustainable operating model.

**Key Accountabilities**
========================

**Transformation Strategy and Mobilization**
--------------------------------------------

* Own the transformation charter, target outcomes, roadmap, delivery model, business case, benefits, funding, critical success measures and executive governance.
* Lead discovery and assessment across estates, applications, infrastructure, cloud readiness, security, operating model, service performance, technical debt, dependencies and regulatory constraints.
* Convert solution and contractual commitments into an integrated program covering architecture, engineering, migration factories/waves, service transition, organizational change and benefits realization.
* For M&A, divestiture or carve-out programs, govern Day-1 readiness, interim/TSA services, separation or integration roadmaps, data and identity boundaries, vendor dependencies and exit milestones.

**Architecture, Build and Implementation Governance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Govern target architecture and design authority across cloud landing zones, hybrid infrastructure, connectivity, identity, security, resilience, backup/DR, observability, automation and ITSM integration.
* Coordinate program increments and workstreams for platform build, environment provisioning, configuration, integration, remediation, application/workload migration and decommissioning.
* Ensure security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience and non-functional requirements are embedded in design and validated before production use.
* Establish stage gates and assurance reviews for discovery, design approval, build completion, test readiness, migration readiness, service acceptance and program closure.

**Testing, Migration and Go-Live**
----------------------------------

* Own the integrated assurance strategy across functional, integration, security, performance, resilience, backup/restore, disaster recovery, operational readiness and user/business acceptance.
* Govern migration-wave planning, pilots, rehearsals, cutover runbooks, change approvals, command-centre arrangements, go/no-go decisions, rollback strategy and executive communications.
* Manage cross-program defects, dependencies and readiness risks, ensuring objective acceptance evidence and accountable sign-off by business, technology, security and operations.
* Lead go-live and hypercare governance, using agreed stability and service measures to control exit into steady-state operations.

**Program Governance, Commercial Control and Value**
----------------------------------------------------

* Establish steering committees, design authorities, delivery forums, PMO controls, reporting cadence, decision rights, escalation routes and integrated RAID management.
* Own budget, forecast, resource demand, supplier performance, contractual milestones, change control, contingency, cost risk and program-level financial reporting.
* Align customer executives, account leadership, architects, engineering teams, application owners, security, operations, legal, procurement and delivery partners.
* Track benefits and transformation outcomes, including modernization, automation, cloud adoption, resilience, security posture, service quality, operating-model improvement and cost optimization.
* Ensure closure includes accepted deliverables, as-built and operational documentation, CMDB/asset updates, knowledge transfer, residual-risk ownership, lessons learned and benefits handover.

**Required Experience**
=======================

* 15+ years in IT, including 10+ years leading large and complex transformation or program delivery across cloud, infrastructure, security, network, workplace or data-centre domains.
* Proven leadership of end-to-end implementation and migration programs spanning discovery, architecture, build, testing, cutover, hypercare and operational acceptance.
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, multiple suppliers, distributed delivery teams, executive sponsors and business-critical production change.
* Experience in outsourcing/managed services transformation; M&A integration, divestiture, carve-out or TSA exit experience is advantageous where relevant.

**Technical and Functional Skills**
===================================

* Cloud and hybrid platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP and private cloud; infrastructure modernization, landing zones, network, identity, workplace, security, observability, backup and disaster recovery.
* Program and portfolio governance, architecture assurance, migration factory/wave management, quality management, commercial control, benefits realization and executive reporting.
* Understanding of security and compliance controls, Zero Trust, IAM, vulnerability management, SOC integration, data protection and operational resilience.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI and Microsoft 365.

**Qualifications and Certifications**
=====================================

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or Business Management; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional is advantageous.
* Azure, AWS or GCP certification is desirable; security/governance certification is beneficial.

**Behavioral Competencies and Selection Criteria**
==================================================

* Executive presence, commercial judgement and the ability to simplify complex technical and delivery matters for senior audiences.
* Decisive, transparent and accountable leadership across ambiguity, pressure and competing priorities.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution and supplier-management capabilities.
* Can evidence leadership of a large transformation from discovery and target-state design through implementation, migration, acceptance, stabilization and measurable business outcomes.

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.

title: Lead Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** :

At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running.

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Pune, India, as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer — where you'll work on both new product development and sustaining engineering for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide.

If solving complex engineering problems with software excites you, this is an opportunity to build real embedded products, work closely with software, hardware, systems, and test engineers, and see your work come together in the complete product - become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Lead the design and development of embedded software subsystems, platform capabilities, and major technical efforts for new products and significant product enhancements.
* Own subsystem-level technical direction, including requirements, architecture, interfaces, design decisions, integration strategy, technical risks, and overall technical quality.
* Break down complex subsystem work into features and executable tasks, guide estimates and sequencing, identify dependencies and risks, and help engineers manage and maintain their work in Azure DevOps.
* Lead technical, architecture, and design reviews; communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly and ensure actions are carried through implementation, integration, verification, and release.
* Guide and mentor engineers through technical coaching, design feedback, peer reviews, and difficult problem solving without formal supervisory responsibility.
* Solve complex embedded software, hardware/software integration, and system-level problems while remaining hands-on with development, debugging, testing, and root-cause analysis where needed.
* Collaborate with global technical and feature leads and cross-functional teams to align subsystem plans, schedules, estimates, risks, interfaces, and sprint execution.
Strengthen engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1 and evaluate technologies, tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches that improve product and engineering capability.  

**Who You Are:**

You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks.

You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes.

You grow from hardships and negative experiences

You partner with others to get work done.

You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences.

Korn Ferry Competencies: Nimble Learning, Manages Ambiguity, Being Resilient, Collaborates, Demonstrates Self-awareness

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science from an engineering school required.
Minimum of eight (8) years of applicable experience  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* Demonstrated experience leading embedded software subsystems or major technical efforts from requirements and architecture through integration, verification, and release
* Advanced proficiency in C/C++, with experience in modular embedded software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, UML, and real-time, multi-threaded systems
* Experience defining subsystem architecture and interfaces, making technical tradeoffs, and leading architecture, design, and technical reviews
* Experience breaking down complex technical work, guiding estimates and sequencing, managing dependencies and risks, and supporting sprint execution using Azure DevOps or a similar tool
* Experience mentoring and technically guiding engineers, reviewing their work, and developing technical depth without relying on formal authority
* Experience with embedded Ethernet, TCP/IP networking, and embedded communication or industrial protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART/SCI, I²C, HART, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFIBUS, or PROFINET
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex embedded software, hardware/software integration, and system-level problems and communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs across global teams
Experience with requirements-based development and secure software development lifecycle practices; familiarity with IEC 62443-4-1, continuous integration, test automation, or AI-assisted engineering tools is preferred  

**Why Join Our Team?**

We're building the next generation of Liquid Analysis products around a highly visible program with significant market potential. It's real embedded engineering across software, electronics, sensors, communications, automation, cybersecurity, and test. We're also growing the software team around it, so people joining now can influence not only the products, but architecture, automation, engineering practices, AI, and how the team works.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

**Clarity Quality Speed.** We want curious people who jump in, learn fast, communicate openly, ask questions, challenge constructively, work through disagreements, and then align and move. Development and test are partners, and quality belongs to the whole engineering team.

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com.

  

**WHY EMERSON**

**Our Commitment to Our People**

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

**ABOUT EMERSON**

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

title: Salesforce Architect -Financial Services Cloud
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
**The Salesforce Architect should be able to:**  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.
* Strong hands-on experience with OmniStudio.
* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
**Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:**  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience
* Strong architecture experience across complex Salesforce implementations
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
* Strong implementation and architecture experience with Financial Services Cloud
* Experience leading architecture for medium to large enterprise Salesforce programs

title: AI/ML Architect (10-12 Years)
description:
The Role

You will own the Al/ML architecture of the Eigenwave platform(An incubator company of skeps), from data foundations and model development to production serving, monitoring and governance. You will design the intelligent systems that sit inside a multi-lender financing platform, such as credit decisioning, fraud detection, lender-offer matching and personalisation, and make sure they are accurate, explainable and safe to run on real money.

This is a hands-on architecture role. You have taken machine learning products from experiment to production at scale, and you stay close to the code: reviewing designs, prototyping, and unblocking data scientists and engineers on the critical path. You will also guide how Al is adopted across the product and engineering organisation.

What You'll Do

Define the Al/ML architecture. Own the end-to-end design of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, serving and monitoring. Make sure the platform is scalable, maintainable, secure and able to evolve without rewrites.

Build ML for lending and payments. Architect solutions for credit risk scoring, fraud and anomaly detection, loan eligibility and offer matching across multiple lenders, and personalisation for merchants and customers.

Design LLM and GenAl capabilities. Lead RAG pipelines, Al agents, document intelligence and conversational assistants, with strong guardrails for accuracy, privacy and responsible use.

Own MLOps and model lifecycle. Set up CI/CD.for models, experiment tracking, a model registry, automated retraining, drift detection and observability, so models stay reliable after release.

Integrate with the core platform. Expose Al/ML services to the Node.js and Python microservices through well-designed REST APIs and event-driven pipelines, with idempotency and graceful failure handling for transactional workloads.

 What You'll Do

Define the Al/ML architecture. Own the end-to-end design of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, serving and monitoring. Make sure the platform is scalable, maintainable, secure and able to evolve without rewrites.

Build ML for lending and payments. Architect solutions for credit risk scoring, fraud and anomaly detection, loan eligibility and offer matching across multiple lenders, and personalisation for merchants and customers.

I• Design LLM and GenAl capabilities. Lead RAG pipelines, Al agents, document intelligence and conversational assistants, with strong guardrails for accuracy, privacy and responsible use.

Own MIOps and model lifecycle. Set up CI/CD for models, experiment tracking, a model registry, automated retraining, drift detection and observability, so models stay reliable after release.

Integrate with the core platform. Expose Al/ML services to the Node.js and Python microservices through well-designed REST APls and event-driven pipelines, with idempotency and graceful failure handling for transactional workloads.

Own security, risk and compliance. Be accountable for data protection, access controls auditability, explainability and fairness of models that make financial decisions. Partner with legal and compliance on regulatory expectations for digital lending and certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI-DSS

Partner across teams. Work with engineering managers, tech leads, data scientists, product managers, UX designers and business stakeholders to define priorities and tie Al work to measurable business outcomes.

 What You Bring

10-12 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years designing and deploying

AI/ML solutions in production, with a strong focus on architecture and design.

Built products from scratch. You have taken end-to-end Al-enabled products to production in a startup or product organisation and lived with the consequences.

Strong ML foundations. Python with scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, XGBoost/LightGBM.

Pandas and NumPy. Solid grounding in model evaluation, bias and fairness, and explainability.

LLMs and GenAl. Prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, with frameworks such as LangChain or Llamalndex.

MLOps. Experience with Mlflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, SageMaker or equivalent, including model versioning, monitoring and automated pipelines.

Data and distributed systems. Data pipelines at scale using SQL and NoSQL stores, Spark and Kafka or similar, event-driven design, and idempotency and failure handling for transactional systems.

Server-side and API skills. Node.js and Python services, RESTful APls in Express or EastAPl, microservice design, and the ability to review and challenge an architecture.

Cloud and DevOps. AWS (preferred), Azure or GP, including managed Al/ML services, plus Docker, Kubernetes, Git workflows and CI/CD.

Security and privacy mindset, with experience protecting sensitive data and owning risk trade-offs in a regulated or data-sensitive domain.

Collaboration and mentoring. You work well with product managers, data scientists and UX designers, and you grow the people around you.

title: Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
  
  
The Digital Transformation practice is part of the Global Solutions Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura
  
  
**Practice Overview**
Ankura Consulting Group is recognized as one of the five fastest-growing consulting companies, with 2,500 employees across 32 offices in 4 continents. The Company provides services to its client on expert witness, bankruptcy and corporate restructuring, litigation support, forensic accounting, geopolitical risk assessment, and general management consulting services. Ankura Consulting Group's headquarters is based in Washington, USA.
  
  
Ankura's Digital Transformation practice helps clients modernize their organizations by leveraging data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. Within this practice, our Competitive Intelligence capability helps clients turn market, pricing, and customer data into decisions that grow revenue, protect margin, and strengthen enterprise value.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Director to lead the design and hands-on delivery of Competitive Intelligence solutions across multiple client engagements. This is a builder role, not a strategy-only role: the ideal candidate has personally built pricing models, elasticity curves, and forecasting pipelines — writing the queries, building the models, and validating the numbers. The Director will combine that hands-on technical depth with delivery ownership, solution design, and team leadership, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders while remaining able to get into the data personally when engagements demand it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Personally build and validate pricing, elasticity, and demand models - using tools such as Python or R, SQL, and statistical/econometric or machine learning techniques.
* Define and own the solution design for Competitive Intelligence engagements, including dynamic and elastic pricing models, competitor and market monitoring, and customer/segment analytics.
* Lead delivery of pricing and market intelligence programs for clients, tying each initiative to measurable business outcomes (revenue, margin, operating efficiency, working capital).
* Design, build, and continuously recalibrate price elasticity models by SKU, segment, and geography — including cross-elasticity and scenario simulation — to support data-driven pricing and promotion decisions.
* Build or directly oversee the technical build of competitor price/promotion scraping and monitoring pipelines, supplier and sourcing intelligence feeds, and demand/supply forecasting models.
* Apply and evaluate machine learning and AI techniques (e.g., demand forecasting models, customer segmentation/clustering, propensity and churn models, NLP-based market signal extraction) where they improve on traditional analytics.
* Establish reference architectures, delivery standards, and best practices for Competitive Intelligence solutions built on the firm's Enterprise Data Platform.
* Estimate, plan, and govern delivery across multiple client engagements and workstreams.
* Partner with client stakeholders to align Competitive Intelligence roadmaps with business objectives and timelines.
* Mentor, coach, and develop data scientists, analysts, and technical leads, staying hands-on enough to review code, models, and analysis rather than only reviewing slides.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for analytical rigor, accuracy, scalability, and time-to-value.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities, including hands-on proof-of-concept analysis, solution design, technical estimates, and client pitches.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, market/competitive intelligence, or advanced analytics, with significant leadership responsibility — including recent, genuinely hands-on technical work, not purely oversight.
* Bachelors in Engineering, computer science preferred.
* Certification in cloud platform or relevant data platforms
* Demonstrated, hands-on track record of having personally built dynamic pricing, price elasticity, demand forecasting, or revenue management models — able to speak to the data, methodology, and code, not just the resulting recommendations.
* Proficiency in a data science/analytics stack such as Python or R, SQL, and common ML/statistics libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels), sufficient to build or debug models directly.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and AI techniques relevant to pricing and market intelligence — forecasting, clustering/segmentation, propensity modeling, and increasingly, LLM-based tools for market/text signal extraction.
* Comfort working directly in data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), including writing and reviewing data pipelines, not only architecting them.
* Demonstrated ability to estimate, plan, and govern complex delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and security principles as they relate to market and pricing data.
* Excellent communication skills and experience in senior, client-facing roles, including presenting to executive audiences — balanced with genuine willingness to be in the data day-to-day.
* Consulting experience in a front-ending, client-facing role: understanding and clarifying client requirements, setting and managing expectations, proactively anticipating needs and risks, and communicating clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong business acumen and results-oriented mindset, with a track record of connecting hands-on analytics work to business outcomes.
* Preferred to have experience leading multi-team or multi-vendor delivery models.
* Preferred to have experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies.
* Preferred to have a graduate degree or equivalent depth in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, data science, or similar).
* Cloud or platform certifications (any major provider) is preferred.
* Must be fluent in English.

title: Founding Engineer - Voice AI
description:
**Company Description**

We’re building self-healing voice agents for enterprise customer support within ixigo. The system has to know when it’s failing, why it’s failing, and how to fix itself before a human notices. This fellowship sits at the intelligence layer behind that work.

**Job Description**

We need a founding engineer to own the voice AI product end to end: the cascaded pipeline that turns a phone call into a real-time conversation. This is not a research role and not a generic backend role. It is the person who understands, at the millisecond level, why a voice agent feels slow, where the latency actually lives across the STT, LLM, and TTS legs, and how to claw it back without breaking conversation quality.

You will have access to real production call traces and a live traffic testing ground from day one. Decisions you make ship to real customer-facing calls within days, not quarters.

**What you'll own**

* The end-to-end latency budget across the cascaded pipeline (STT finalization, LLM prefill and generation, TTS time-to-first-byte), with a target of sub-1-second end-to-end response time
* Diagnosing and fixing cross-cutting bottlenecks that touch multiple pipeline legs at once, for example, prompt size and cache-hit rate degrading prefill time, network payload, and throughput contention simultaneously
* Evaluating and integrating STT/LLM/TTS providers (including in-region India options) against the latency and quality bar, and building the abstraction layer that keeps us model-agnostic and provider-swappable
* Turn detection, interruption and barge-in handling, filler audio, and retry logic, the mechanics that make a bot feel like it is actually listening
* Instrumentation and tracing across the full call lifecycle so every latency regression is diagnosable from data, not guesswork
* Making the build vs. buy call on pipeline components as the product scales beyond the current reference customer

**Non-negotiable**

You have hands-on, production experience optimising a cascaded voice pipeline or voice harness, meaning STT, LLM orchestration, and TTS stitched together into a live conversational system, not a single-model or text-only pipeline. You can talk concretely about where latency hides in each leg, what trade-offs you made between accuracy and speed, and what broke when you pushed the system harder. If your voice AI experience is limited to calling a hosted conversational API (Twilio Voice, a managed voicebot platform) without touching the pipeline internals, this is not a fit, regardless of years of experience elsewhere.

**Other requirements**

* 3-5 years minimum building and operating production systems at scale, with real on-call or ownership experience, not just feature delivery
* Strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, network I/O, profiling, and the instinct to measure before optimizing
* Comfortable working with ambiguous, partially-specified problems and real production data rather than clean specs
* Direct, low-ego communication. You will get short, blunt feedback and are expected to push back with data when you disagree

**Strong nice-to-haves**

* Experience with WebRTC, telephony infrastructure (SIP/PSTN), or real-time audio streaming
* Familiarity with prompt caching mechanics and how prefill cost scales with context length
* Experience in a founding or very early-stage (pre-seed to seed) environment where you owned a system with no safety net

Direct involvement with customers on technical requirements and solution design is an important and integral part of your work.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**Role:**
Software Development Engineer II – Backend

**Function:**
Backend Engineering / Platform Engineering

**Location:**
Aerocity, Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Broadcast Media, Online Media, Media Production

**About Company**

The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

Active since 2006 and headquartered in Delhi, it is owned by Reliance Broadcast Network Limited. It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan.

Its digital platform extends the brand into curated music, lifestyle, and news content across web and mobile. The culture is vibrant and creativity-driven, bridging radio and digital media for urban and rural audiences alike.

**Position Overview**

This role sits at the core of the company's platform engineering effort, building the backend services that power content delivery, discovery, personalization, and playback across audio, video, news, short-form content, and microdrama. The engineer will own features end-to-end — from API design through production operations — and directly influence the reliability and scale of systems serving high-volume audience traffic. Strong collaboration with frontend, mobile, and product teams is central to the role.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable backend services and REST/GraphQL APIs for the company's media products, owning implementation from design through deployment and monitoring.
* Build and maintain reliable integrations across content, catalog, audio/video playback, news, microdrama, search/discovery, and recommendation-adjacent workflows.
* Improve API performance, caching strategies, data access patterns, resiliency, and service observability across production systems.
* Diagnose and resolve complex bugs and production incidents with minimal supervision; participate in on-call and incident management processes.
* Partner with frontend and mobile teams on API contracts, BFF integrations, and end-to-end product delivery.
* Review code and provide actionable feedback that raises engineering quality and long-term maintainability.
* Contribute reusable components, technical documentation, and backend standards; evaluate trade-offs across correctness, performance, cost, security, and time to market.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 3–5 years of professional experience building backend systems or distributed applications.
* Production-level proficiency in Go, Java, Node.js, or Python for backend service development.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming REST APIs within a microservices architecture.
* Experience designing and maintaining SQL and/or NoSQL data models and debugging service-level performance issues.
* Working knowledge of authentication, authorization, API security, and secure coding practices.
* Demonstrated ownership of production features, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

**Nice to Have**

* Production experience with Go and/or Node.js specifically.
* Experience implementing BFF services, API composition, GraphQL federation, or channel-specific API contracts.
* Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud observability platforms.
* Prior experience at a product-based consumer, media, entertainment, or content platform company.
* Experience with multimedia platforms, CDN workflows, content management, metadata pipelines, news feeds, or microdrama applications.

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of backend systems serving 40M+ weekly listeners across web and mobile.
* Exposure to a full-stack media platform spanning audio, video, news, short-form content, and microdrama.
* Collaborative engineering culture with strong cross-functional partnerships across product, frontend, and mobile teams.
* Onsite role at Aerocity, Delhi — one of the city's most accessible commercial hubs.

title: Senior Python Backend Developer
description:
**Company Description**
Surepass Technologies simplifies enterprise user onboarding through real-time ID verification APIs, digital KYC, document OCR, and a wide range of plug-and-play verification services. Known for low downtime, easy integration, and rapid partner onboarding, enterprises can start using Surepass APIs in their apps and websites in under an hour. The company serves diverse industries including banking, finance, lending, insurance, trading, gaming, and ride hailing, helping them reduce onboarding time and operational costs. Surepass offers comprehensive solutions for identity, merchant, asset verification, and user onboarding, backed by AI-driven OCR capabilities. The company focuses on high-quality APIs with competitive pricing and a strong commitment to reliability and compliance.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Python Backend Developer will design, build, and optimize backend services and APIs that power Surepass’s real-time verification and onboarding products. This full-time, on-site role in New Delhi involves developing scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems, integrating with third-party services, and maintaining robust database structures. The developer will collaborate closely with product, frontend, and DevOps teams to define requirements, implement new features, and improve existing services. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean and testable Python code, conducting code reviews, troubleshooting production issues, and enhancing system reliability and uptime. The role also includes contributing to architecture decisions, performance tuning, and documentation to support rapid enterprise integration and compliance needs.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Back-End Web Development and Software Development for building scalable, secure APIs and services.
* Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), preferably with Python for production-grade systems.
* Hands-on experience with Databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), including schema design, optimization, and data security.
* Experience with API design (REST/JSON), microservices architecture, and integration with external services.
* Knowledge of performance optimization, caching strategies, and handling high-traffic, low-latency applications.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g., Docker), and monitoring tools.
* Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and contribute to technical best practices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
**Summit Lake Data + AI (SLD) is a boutique Databricks and Anthropic consulting partner.**

We help US organizations build modern data platforms and put AI into production, with an

onshore and offshore delivery team working as one.

**THE ROLE**

You are the
**senior, hands-on engineer who leads the design and build of Databricks lakehouses for our clients**
setting platform standards, delivering the medallion and governance layers, and mentoring the

team. You work closely with the Principal Architect and are the technical anchor on your accounts.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Design and build end-to-end lakehouse solutions on Databricks, bronze/silver/gold medallion across client engagements.
* Stand up and govern Unity Catalog (access, lineage, PII masking) and CI/CD with Databricks Asset Bundles, Git, and Workflows / Lakeflow.
* Build ingestion from enterprise sources (Salesforce, QuickBooks/Accounting Seed, UKG, T&E systems, files) via Lakeflow Connect, Auto Loader, ADF or AWS Glue, or partner connectors, using Lakehouse Federation for fast interim delivery while pipelines mature.
* Optimize Spark / Delta pipelines for performance and cost (serverless, right-sizing, cluster policies).
* Partner with analytics engineers to expose gold models to Power BI and Genie.
* Act as a client-facing technical lead: translate requirements into architecture and present to US stakeholders.
* Set and document engineering standards; mentor junior engineers; contribute to reusable SLD
* accelerators.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* 6+ years in data engineering, including 3+ hands-on with Databricks in production.
* Deep Spark / PySpark, advanced SQL, and Delta Lake; fluent in medallion architecture.
* Hands-on Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows / Lakeflow, Asset Bundles, and Git-based CI/CD.
* Strong cloud experience on Azure or AWS (either is fine, Databricks runs on both); Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) a strong plus.
* Proven end-to-end implementations and client-facing / consulting experience (US-client exposure a plus).
* Excellent English communication; comfort with ambiguity and multiple concurrent engagements.
* Based in India and willing to overlap with US business hours.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Databricks certification preferred, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional ideal; Azure
* (DP-700) or AWS data / solutions-architect certs also a plus.
* Azure or AWS Databricks specifics, networking, Unity Catalog metastore setup, identity.
* Experience with Salesforce / QuickBooks / UKG data or PE portfolio-company reporting.
* Exposure to Mosaic AI or GenAI data workflows.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong data modeling and solution design skills and can independently lead complex engineering efforts from requirements through production implementation.
  
  
Advanced Data Engineering
  
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL.
* Develop robust ingestion, transformation, and publishing processes supporting batch and, where appropriate, near-real-time data workloads.
* Engineer reusable frameworks and patterns that improve development consistency, reliability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
* Design solutions capable of processing large and complex datasets while maintaining appropriate performance and scalability.
* Troubleshoot complex data pipeline, transformation, performance, and integration issues.
* Optimize Databricks workloads for processing efficiency, reliability, and cost.

Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering
  
  
  

* Develop enterprise data solutions leveraging Databricks Lakehouse architecture and Delta Lake.
* Design and maintain structured data layers that move data from raw ingestion through validated, curated, and business-consumption layers.
* Implement scalable transformation patterns using Spark SQL, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.
* Apply Databricks engineering capabilities such as Unity Catalog, workflows/jobs, Delta tables, and data governance controls where appropriate.
* Support performance tuning, workload optimization, monitoring, and production support for Databricks-based solutions.
* Partner with platform and architecture teams to establish repeatable Databricks engineering standards and development patterns.

Advanced Data Modeling
  
  
  

* Design scalable logical and physical data models supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and downstream data products.
* Develop dimensional models, fact and dimension structures, curated analytical datasets, and reusable semantic-ready data structures.
* Translate complex operational source data into intuitive business-oriented models.
* Establish appropriate grain, keys, relationships, historical handling, and business rules within analytical data models.
* Balance normalization, dimensional modeling, and denormalized analytical structures based on workload and consumption needs.
* Partner with BI and analytics teams to optimize models for Power BI and other analytical consumers.

Data Quality & Governance
  
  
  

* Build automated data validation and reconciliation capabilities into engineering pipelines.
* Establish controls for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity.
* Implement appropriate monitoring, exception handling, logging, and alerting.
* Partner with data governance teams to improve metadata, lineage, documentation, and ownership of enterprise data products.
* Ensure engineering solutions comply with applicable security, privacy, and enterprise data-management standards.

Technical Leadership
  
  
  

* Serve as a senior technical resource for complex data engineering and modeling initiatives.
* Lead technical design discussions and recommend appropriate engineering approaches.
* Perform code and design reviews and help establish development standards and engineering best practices.
* Mentor data engineers and provide guidance on Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, data modeling, and performance optimization.
* Identify opportunities to simplify legacy processes and modernize existing data solutions.
* Collaborate effectively across onshore/offshore engineering, analytics, architecture, product, and business teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence engineering, or related disciplines.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing production solutions using Databricks and Apache Spark.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and strong experience with Python/PySpark.
* Strong hands-on experience with Delta Lake and modern lakehouse engineering patterns.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing complex ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data structures.
* Experience designing solutions for large-volume enterprise datasets.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and optimize complex SQL, Spark, and data-processing workloads.
* Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and production support processes.
* Experience working with source-to-target mappings and translating business requirements into technical data solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently own technical solutions while collaborating within distributed global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance.
* Experience with Databricks workflow orchestration and production deployment patterns.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and object storage, particularly Microsoft Azure environments.
* Experience supporting Power BI and enterprise semantic/reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices for data engineering.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, relational databases, SaaS platforms, file-based sources, and other enterprise data sources.
* Experience modernizing legacy ETL or traditional data warehouse workloads into Databricks/lakehouse architecture.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata management, access controls, and data governance practices.
* Databricks certifications are a plus.

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate:**

* Technical ownership: Takes responsibility for solutions from design through production support.
* Engineering judgment: Selects pragmatic solutions based on scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, and cost.
* Problem solving: Can independently investigate complex data and platform issues and drive them to resolution.
* Quality mindset: Treats data quality, reconciliation, observability, and documentation as core engineering requirements.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across business, analytics, architecture, BI, and engineering teams.
* Technical leadership: Raises the capabilities of the broader engineering team through mentoring, standards, reusable patterns, and design guidance.
* Business orientation: Understands that successful data engineering is measured by the usability and reliability of the resulting data products, not simply by pipeline completion.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**A Successful Senior Data Engineer Will:**

* Deliver reliable, scalable, production-ready Databricks data solutions.
* Reduce complexity by creating reusable engineering patterns rather than one-off pipelines.
* Improve the performance and maintainability of enterprise data workloads.
* Produce well-designed data models that simplify downstream analytics and reporting.
* Improve data trust through automated validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and documentation.
* Provide senior-level technical direction to other engineers while remaining highly hands-on.
* Help advance the Enterprise Intelligence organization toward a more standardized, governed, and scalable lakehouse architecture.

**Required Qualifications**

* BE with 3-6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence engineering, or related disciplines.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing production solutions using Databricks and Apache Spark.

title: Off Campus Drive - Non Engg - Batch 2027
description:
**Bain & Company**
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 67 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
**Bain Capability Network**
Bain Capability Network was established in 2004 in New Delhi and now has nodes in India, Warsaw and Mexico. We are an expert client delivery (ECD) team at Bain and Company that collaborates closely with global leadership and clients, offering expertise across various industries and capabilities. We offer three delivery model archetypes- offshore, on-site and hybrid for seamless integration with case teams and practice areas. From developing Intellectual Property to delivering end-client solutions, we house dedicated teams across all industries, including Consumer Products, Retail, FS, Healthcare etc. and specialise in core capabilities such as Private Equity, Pricing, Corporate Finance and Strategy, Data and Insights, etc.
  
  
**Reports to: Associate/Project Leader**
As an you will be an active member of the team, learning how to make businesses more valuable and helping our clients achieve sustainable competitive advantage. You will be responsible for generating specific industry & company insights to support global Bain case teams, client development teams and industry practices. Analysts are also responsible to generate hypotheses using various tools and techniques, including expert primary or secondary industry research, developing analytical models, translating data into meaningful insights, creating presentations, etc.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Comprehend client needs and challenges for adapting to case expectations. Show ability to resolve discrete issues and/or drive consensus
* Identify and apply the relevant analytical tools for own work stream and ensure zero-defect analysis.
* Understand the client business/industry to generate and screen realistic solutions based on a blend of research and analysis. Communicate data, knowledge and insight to the entire team.
* Effectively structure communication of insights from own work stream and ensure a logical flow of relevant information in presentations. Deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team leaders/managers
* Consistently seek and provide actionable feedback in all interactions.
* Only applicable for the UG Batch of 2026-27

description:
**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent

**Title: Data Architect**
**Department: Client Service Platform**

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. We achieve this by working together and supporting one another across our global business. Join our team and be part of something bigger.
  
  
**Department Description**
Platform Design & Solutions (PDS) is the architecture and technical governance body across Client Servicing Platforms (CSP). The Data Architecture and Ownership capability within PDS defines data models, migration architectures, certified data products, and data standards supporting client servicing, reporting, and investment operations globally.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The
**Data Architect (Grade 4)**
is a foundational data engineering and data modeling specialist responsible for translating business requirements and data domain definitions into physical and logical schema designs, Snowflake data pipelines, and certified Data Product interfaces.
  
  
Working under the mentorship of the Data Architecture Lead and alongside senior data architects, you will play a crucial role in modernising CSP's data estate — specifically supporting the strategic migration from the legacy on-premise Client Reporting Database onto
**Snowflake**
.
  
  
You will map source-to-target data flows, author dimensional and relational data models, maintain technical data dictionaries, and validate data product contracts across client reporting, sales and assets, and distribution datasets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Modeling & Schema Design**

* Design and maintain logical and physical data models for CSP data domains using ERwin, ER/Studio, or dbt semantic models.
* Develop star-schema, snowflake-schema, and normalized table structures in Snowflake optimized for query performance and data sharing.
* Author comprehensive source-to-target mapping specifications, documenting transformation logic, business rules, and data cleansing requirements.

**Snowflake Data Migration & Pipeline Architecture**

* Partner with delivery engineers to design ingestion and transformation pipelines moving data from legacy Oracle databases (CRDB) to target Snowflake tables.
* Write and optimize complex SQL transformations, views, and stored procedures in Snowflake.
* Assist in establishing data reconciliation, automated data validation checks, and regression scripts to guarantee zero data loss during cutover.

**Data Product Specification & Documentation**

* Define technical specifications for certified Data Products: table schemas, JSON/Avro payloads, API contracts, and update cadences.
* Document detailed data dictionary entries, column definitions, and data lineage in enterprise catalogues (Collibra).
* Work with downstream consuming teams (reporting analysts, Salesforce developers, Tableau dashboard creators) to ensure data products meet functional requirements.

**Governance & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure all database designs adhere to Fidelity’s enterprise naming conventions, data classifications, and retention policies.
* Assist in classifying sensitive personal data (PII) and configuring masking policies or row-level access controls in Snowflake.

**Experience And Qualifications Required**
**Knowledge:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Senior Data Engineering in an enterprise data warehouse environment.
* Strong practical working knowledge of Snowflake (virtual warehouses, clustering, staging, zero-copy cloning, time travel).
* Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
* Solid understanding of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball dimensional modeling, Inmon relational modeling, Data Vault).
* Experience writing source-to-target mappings and participating in large-scale database migrations.

**Skills:**

* Advanced SQL proficiency — ability to write performant analytical queries, window functions, and complex joins.
* Familiarity with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, dbdiagram.io) and version control (Git).
* High attention to detail, structured thinking, and a passion for data accuracy and documentation.
* Excellent team collaboration skills, eager to learn and grow under senior architectural mentorship.

**Feel rewarded:**

It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. title: Lead, Master Data Management and Governance
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
12
  
  
**The Role**
Lead, Master Data Management and Governance
  
  
**The Team**
S&P Global advances essential intelligence through world-leading data, benchmarks and insights. As Lead of Master Data Management and Governance within our Internal Data Fabric (Enterprise360) team, you'll define how the operational data that runs our business is mastered, governed and certified — so that people and AI agents across the business are working from a foundation of trusted data.
  
  
In this role you will define, operate and continuously improve how our most important enterprise entities, reference data and business definitions are mastered, described, certified and trusted across the organization. You will own the governance model that sits on top of our Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI estate, while leveraging a sophisticated ecosystem of supporting applications – an enterprise data catalog (data.world, with Unity Catalog and Fabric IQ as sub-catalogs), a knowledge-graph backed ontology (RDF) for semantic and reference data standardization, and automated data quality monitoring (Anomalo). You will lead the stewardship community that certifies data within the data catalog, and connect certification to our automated metadata generation path so that definitions are written once, reviewed by the data owner, and reused everywhere.
  
  
**The Impact**
The Lead, Master Data Management and Governance will be instrumental in making our data trustworthy, discoverable and ready for AI. By establishing a single, certified meaning for key entities and metrics this role will reduce conflicting definitions, remove duplicated effort across teams, and ensure analytics, Power BI reporting and agentic AI solutions are built only on data that has been defined, owned and quality-checked. The work has downstream impact on our customers and colleagues alike, enabling faster, more confident decisions and a stronger foundation for enterprise-grade AI.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Own a high-impact, enterprise-wide capability: Take accountability for master data and certification across the Internal Data Fabric, a role with visibility across technology leadership, data owners and business stakeholders.
* Work at the intersection of governance and AI: Gain hands-on experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, knowledge graphs and automated metadata generation in a live enterprise environment.
* Shape how meaning is managed: Directly influence how business definitions, ontology and certification are designed so that people and AI agents can find, understand and trust our data.
* Strong learning and growth opportunities: Collaborate closely with Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Governance and engineering colleagues, and grow as a leader of both a stewardship community and a specialist team.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the Internal Data Fabric master data management strategy, roadmap, and execution- including the critical business entities, reference data and hierarchies to be mastered and the systems of record for each.
* Design and operate the data governance and stewardship model: roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths and operating cadence for data owners and data stewards.
* Drive data certification through the enterprise data catalog (data.world), working with stewards and owners to ensure data, metrics and reports are defined, described and signed off as expected before they are certified for consumption.
* Integrate certification with the metadata generation path, so that generated descriptions, classifications and ownership are proposed automatically, reviewed and approved by stewards, and published back to the data catalog with a clear audit trail.
* Partner with internal teams on the enterprise data catalog implementation (data.world) and lead its integration with the Unity Catalog and Fabric IQ sub-catalogs, keeping technical, business and quality metadata consistent and ensuring metadata flows in a single, well-defined direction.
* Govern the enterprise ontology (RDF graph): set modeling standards, manage change and release of concepts and relationships, and ensure business definitions are authored once and referenced everywhere, rather than redefined locally.
* Define and maintain entity resolution and golden-record rules for mastered entities, working with data engineers to implement them in the gold tier of the Databricks medallion architecture.
* Define data quality rules, thresholds and certification criteria, and use data quality tooling (Anomalo) and/or mechanisms to monitor coverage, detect anomalies and surface quality results and certification state in the data catalog.
* Establish and enforce data standards for naming, descriptions, data types, reference codes and classification, aligning internal dictionaries with Enterprise Data Architecture standards and the EDA Style Guide.
* Manage the decertification and recertification path, including how owners and consumers are notified and triggering appropriate workflows when certified data degrades.
* Define and report governance KPIs and Power BI dashboards covering certification coverage, steward activity, metadata completeness, data quality trends and issue resolution.
* Partner with Enterprise Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, Security and business data owners to embed governance into onboarding, data product design and delivery.
* Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the team, establishing best practices and operating principles; ultimately accountable for the quality, integrity and trustworthiness of mastered and certified data.
* Lead and develop a team of data governance and master data specialists, and coach the wider steward community.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Key qualifications:**

* Experience: 8+ years in data management, master data management or data governance, including experience leading or coordinating a team or cross-functional governance effort.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.
