title: Manager - MLOps
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organisations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager – ML Ops to lead the design, development and operation of reliable, scalable and production ready machine learning platforms and workflows. The role will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers and client stakeholders to take models from experimentation to production and ensure they remain reliable, efficient, secure and well monitored.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in MLOps and cloud-native engineering, understands the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, and can lead a team while remaining hands-on in architecture, implementation and technical problem solving. Exposure to LLMOps and the deployment of Generative AI applications will be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development and implementation of end-to-end MLOps platforms, processes and deployment pipelines for machine learning solutions.
* Build and manage automated workflows for model training, testing, validation, packaging, deployment, versioning and rollback.
* Establish CI/CD and CT pipelines for ML systems, enabling repeatable releases across development, staging and production environments.
* Deploy and operate models at scale using containerization and orchestration technologies; ensure availability, performance, scalability and reliability.
* Set up monitoring for model performance, data quality, model drift, service health, latency and resource utilization, and drive timely remediation.
* Partner with data science and AI teams to productions models, improve experimentation-to-production workflows and establish reusable engineering standards.
* Build and maintain feature pipelines, data and model registries, metadata tracking, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management capabilities.
* Drive cloud infrastructure and platform practices across environments, with a focus on security, access control, cost optimization and operational resilience.
* Define and implement best practices for infrastructure such as code, observability, logging, alerting, incident management, and disaster recovery.
* Evaluate and adopt relevant tools, frameworks and architectural patterns to improve the MLOps ecosystem and developer productivity.
* Support production deployments of Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including model serving, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version management and operational controls, where applicable.
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of ML Ops and platform engineers; set technical direction, review designs and code, and contribute to hiring.
* Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and ensure successful delivery of engagements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 4–8 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, ML engineering or MLOps, with substantial hands-on experience in productionising machine learning systems.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, experimentation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
* Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation, Develop scalable ML pipelines.
* Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry, Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML EZE Paas/Saas
* Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components.
* Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated ML workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Kubeflow or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and their ML and infrastructure services.
* Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling and managing containerised workloads.
* Experience with model serving and lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, KServe, Seldon or equivalent platforms.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL, APIs and software engineering practices such as version control, testing, code reviews and documentation.
* Understanding of monitoring and observability tools and practices for applications, infrastructure, data pipelines and deployed models.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Helm or Ansible.
* Good understanding of security, networking, access management and cost optimisation in cloud-based production environments.
* At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, managing delivery and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and manage stakeholder expectations.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLMOps and production deployment of Generative AI applications, including LLM serving, evaluation, observability and performance optimisation.
* Exposure to vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and orchestration frameworks used in GenAI applications.
* Experience with feature stores, data orchestration and streaming technologies such as Feast, Airflow, Kafka or Flink.
* Experience working with financial services, banking, fintech or other regulated environments.
* Exposure to model governance, auditability, explainability and model risk management requirements.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or MLOps certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with team leadership and delivery ownership.
* Comfort working in a consulting and product-oriented environment with multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements.
* Willingness to take ownership of platform reliability and production outcomes, not just initial deployment.

title: Manager Privilege Access Development
description:
**Role Purpose:**
The PAM Development SME will design, develop and enhance privileged access and identity management solutions that support secure and scalable access controls. The role is accountable for strengthening access governance through automation, integration and technology optimization. The role will act as the technical authority for PAM platform development and access management engineering.

**Role Accountability**

PAM Configuration, Integration & Automation

1. Develop, configure and maintain PAM integrations with directories, MFA, ticketing systems, monitoring platforms and target systems.
2. Automate onboarding of privileged accounts, credential rotation, account discovery and policy enforcement using scripts, APIs and platform capabilities.
3. Customize workflows for approvals, just-in-time access, access expiry, session recording and privileged access request processes.
4. Build and maintain connectors for databases, network devices, servers, cloud services, applications and other platforms as per the PAM roadmap.

Platform Engineering, Troubleshooting & Release Management

1. Troubleshoot PAM platform issues, connector failures, credential rotation errors, access workflow failures and integration defects.
2. Manage PAM platform upgrades, patches and configuration changes with testing, impact assessment, rollback planning and controlled deployment.
3. Implement monitoring and alerting for PAM platform health, integration failures, rotation issues, service availability and critical control failures.
4. Support performance tuning, configuration optimization and technical stability of PAM platform components.

Documentation, Evidence & Operational Support

1. Maintain technical configuration documentation, connector details, integration designs, runbooks and knowledge transfer materials for operations teams.
2. Produce technical evidence and reports for audits, control testing, privileged access reviews and compliance assessments.
3. Support PAM operations teams with technical guidance, issue resolution, root cause analysis and remediation of recurring platform problems.
4. Partner with PAM leads, IAM teams, infrastructure teams, application owners and vendors to deliver secure and scalable privileged access capabilities.

**Measures of Success**

1. PAM integrations with directories, MFA, ticketing and target systems are delivered as per roadmap.
2. Privileged account onboarding, rotation and policy enforcement become faster through automation.
3. Connectors for critical platforms are stable, tested and operationally usable. PAM workflow customizations support approvals, just-in-time access and session recording requirements.
4. Platform issues, connector failures and rotation errors are resolved within agreed timelines.
5. PAM upgrades and configuration changes are implemented with testing, rollback and minimal disruption.
6. Technical documentation, runbooks and evidence reports remain complete and audit-ready.

**Technical Skills**

1. PAM Platform Engineering & Integration
2. Authentication, Federation & Conditional Access
3. Identity, Access & Privilege Controls
4. Access Risk, SoD, Monitoring & Audit Compliance
5. Database Access & Privileged Data Access Controls

**Exposure to below mentioned Technologies / Frameworks / Methodologies:**

1. CyberArk
2. BeyondTrust
3. Delinea
4. HashiCorp Vault
5. PAM APIs
6. SCIM
7. SAML / OIDC
8. REST APIs
9. Python / PowerShell
10. ServiceNow integration
11. Connector development
12. Credential rotation automation
13. PAM HA / DR
14. Platform monitoring

**Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree / B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Identity & Access Management, Cyber Security or related discipline.

**Preferred Industry:**
BFSI, payments, banking, fintech, large enterprises with PAM engineering, IAM integrations, automation, directory services and privileged access platforms.

title: Quality Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
Quality is not a phase in our development process. It is engineered from day one.

This is not a traditional testing role. We’re looking for engineers who can automate everything possible, leverage AI to accelerate quality, and partner closely with developers to ship reliable software at startup speed.

If you enjoy solving engineering problems, building automation frameworks, and using AI to transform Quality Engineering, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Excellent analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**AI-Driven Quality Engineering**

* Test case generation

* Defect analysis and root cause identification

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.
  
  
The Role
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You’ll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
* Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
* Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
* Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

What you’ll bring
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:
  
  

* Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
* Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
* Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
* Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
* Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
* Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs
* Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution

Helpful experience
  
  

* Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
* Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
* Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
* Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
* Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus
* Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**The role**

Join **SITA Lab**, where we explore emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into working solutions that could change how air transport operates.

You will work with airports, airlines, SITA teams, technology partners and start-ups to identify difficult industry problems, rapidly explore potential solutions, and build real-world prototypes and pilots.

Modern AI and agentic development tools have fundamentally changed how we engineer software. We expect our engineers to use AI extensively to research, design, build, test and evolve solutions. Your value is not measured by how many lines of code you personally write, but by how effectively you turn ideas into high-quality working systems.

As Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across SITA Lab initiatives and help evolve how the Lab itself engineers software in an AI-native environment.

**What you will do**

Explore

* Investigate emerging technologies and assess how they could solve real problems in aviation.
* Work directly with customers and subject-matter experts to understand operational problems, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* Rapidly evaluate technologies, start-ups, open-source projects, APIs, models and platforms.
* Lead technical discovery, experimentation and design-thinking activities.
* Turn loosely defined ideas into hypotheses that can be tested with working software.

Engineer

* Design and build prototypes, proofs of concept and pilot solutions, moving from idea to working system quickly.
* Use modern AI-assisted and agentic software-development techniques throughout the engineering lifecycle.
* Decompose complex engineering objectives into tasks that can be effectively executed by people and AI agents.
* Provide agents with the appropriate context, requirements, constraints, architecture and acceptance criteria.
* Build the tests, evaluations and observability needed to verify AI-generated solutions rather than trusting generated output.
* Integrate APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, AI models and existing SITA capabilities into end-to-end solutions.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Provider/Business Unit Portals)
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Provider/Business Unit Portals team, you will build and operate the Provider and Business Unit Portals. The former is built to service managed service providers (MSPs) and resellers who administer Bitwarden organizations on behalf of separate, external customers. The latter is is built for a single company's own administrators to manage multiple Enterprise organizations that all belong to that same company (e.g., different business units, subsidiaries, or departments). Both portals give administrators a single, centralized experience for creating and managing multiple Bitwarden Enterprise organizations at scale. This is a **hands-on role**. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code to further the enablement of Enterprise governance.

#### **WHAT YOU WILL DO**

End-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, performant services and applications to support the Provider and Business Unit Portals. You are accountable for these services end to end, including the parts you did not personally write.

**Engineering Standards and Automated Quality:** Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them.

* **Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries:** Maintain clean service boundaries and design resilient APIs so the Provider and Business Unit Portals can evolve independently of the core platform. Own the technical direction and record the reasoning behind significant decisions.
* **Technical Mentorship:** Grow the engineers around you. Pair on hard problems, give substantive design feedback, and mentor them to grow,
* **Codebase Health:** Contribute to performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability. Identify technical debt, articulate its cost, and sequence pragmatic refactoring alongside delivery.
* **Operational Stewardship:** Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration:** Partner closely with Product, Design, Security, and the other teams' engineers to design and validate solutions before implementation begins.

#### **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* **Overall Experience:** *5+ years* building and operating production Enterprise software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding features end to end as an individual contributor.
* **Technical Stack - Expertise:**
* Expertise in *C# / .NET,* with strong working proficiency in *TypeScript / Angular or Rust* and a willingness to build depth in the other.
* **Technical Stack - Experience**:
* Relational database design, optimization, and SQL Server
* Writing, consuming, and using SDKs / APIs
* AI-assisted development - preferably Claude Code
* **Technical Stack - Familiarity:**
* MVC design pattern for interaction with our Admin Portal
* Entity Framework or adjacent ORM with implementations of Postgres, MySQL, and SQLite
* **Migration Judgement:** A track record of running incremental modernization inside a live codebase, such as framework upgrades, strict-typing rollouts or state-management migrations, without halting feature delivery or fragmenting the codebase into two competing styles.
* **T-Shaped Engineering Mindset:** Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards).
* **Secure Coding:** Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.
* **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* **Problem-Solving:** Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

#### **Why Join Us?**

* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

**If you enjoy being hands-on, solving hard engineering problems, and having a genuine influence on how products are built, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Back End Developer
description:
Hiring: Senior Backend Engineer – SaaS Platform & Distributed Systems

**Company:**
Crenovent Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Product:**
REFEOS – Revenue Fabric Execution Operating System

**Experience:**
2-5 years

**Location:**
India On-site

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role:**
Individual Contributor – Hands-on Engineering

About REFEOS

We are building REFEOS, an AI-native Revenue Execution Operating System designed to help enterprises manage and execute revenue operations through connected data, intelligent automation, and AI-driven decision-making.

Our platform brings together CRM integrations, enterprise data management, revenue intelligence, sales pipeline management, forecasting, customer lifecycle management, business process automation, and AI agents.

REFEOS supports three modes of operation: traditional UI-based workflows, human-in-the-loop AI-assisted execution, and autonomous AI-driven execution.

We are looking for a
**strong, hands-on Senior Backend Engineer**
who can build the underlying services that make this platform secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready.

This is not a role focused on maintaining basic CRUD APIs. It requires engineering complex business logic, distributed workflows, data integrations, and enterprise-grade backend architecture.

What You Will Build

You will work across several core engineering areas:

**1. Backend Services & APIs**

* Design, develop, and maintain production-grade backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, Python, and FastAPI.
* Build REST APIs, service-to-service integrations, background workers, and event-driven workflows.
* Implement complex business logic across customer onboarding, subscriptions, billing, entitlements, user management, revenue operations, and automation.
* Establish reliable API contracts, versioning, error handling, and service interoperability.

**2. Enterprise Data Platform & Integrations**

* Develop scalable data ingestion, transformation, synchronization, and reconciliation services.
* Integrate enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and other business applications.
* Implement OAuth-based integrations, webhooks, incremental synchronization, credential management, and API rate-limit handling.
* Build canonical data models, identity resolution, data validation, lineage, and source-to-target mapping.
* Design reliable data pipelines with idempotency, retry handling, checkpointing, and conflict resolution.

**3. Distributed Systems & Workflow Execution**

* Build asynchronous processing services, background jobs, event-driven components, and workflow orchestration.
* Implement durable execution, transactional outbox patterns, idempotency, retries, compensation, and recovery from partial failures.
* Design services capable of handling concurrency, high transaction volumes, and distributed failure scenarios.
* Ensure consistency and correctness across multiple independently deployed services.

**4. Database Engineering & Performance**

* Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, schemas, relationships, transactions, indexes, and queries.
* Work with Prisma, SQLAlchemy, and database migration frameworks.
* Implement Redis-based caching, rate limiting, and appropriate state-management patterns.
* Troubleshoot database contention, slow queries, concurrency defects, and performance bottlenecks.

**5. Security, Authorization & Multi-Tenancy**

* Implement secure authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and tenant-aware service boundaries.
* Work with JWT, OAuth 2.0, service identities, and enterprise identity integrations.
* Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, database operations, caches, and background jobs.
* Implement audit trails, secure secret handling, least-privilege access, and fail-closed authorization.
* Ensure backend authorization is enforced independently of frontend permissions.

**6. AI-Native Platform Integration**

* Build backend services supporting AI agents, intelligent workflows, and autonomous execution.
* Integrate AI execution with enterprise data, access permissions, approvals, and business rules.
* Implement reliable execution records, human approval checkpoints, usage tracking, and recovery mechanisms.
* Ensure AI-driven actions remain authorized, auditable, and operationally safe.

**7. Engineering Quality & Production Reliability**

* Write clean, modular, maintainable, and thoroughly tested code.
* Develop unit, integration, contract, security, and end-to-end tests.
* Diagnose and correct existing architectural and code-quality issues.
* Implement structured logging, error monitoring, health checks, and operational diagnostics.
* Work with DevOps on containerized deployments, CI/CD, Kubernetes, AWS, and Azure.
* Deliver code with reproducible tests, rollback considerations, and verifiable acceptance evidence.

Required Technical Skills

**Programming and Backend Frameworks**

* Strong production experience with
  **TypeScript / Node.js / Express.js or Python / FastAPI**
  , with practical ability to contribute across both stacks.
* Strong knowledge of asynchronous programming, API architecture, middleware, and modular service design.
* Experience with ORM frameworks such as Prisma or SQLAlchemy.

**Databases**

* Advanced PostgreSQL and SQL skills.
* Database schema design, transactions, indexing, query optimization, and migrations.
* Redis caching and distributed-state patterns.

**System Architecture**

* Microservices and distributed systems.
* REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, event-driven architecture, and message queues.
* Concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and transaction consistency.
* Secure multi-tenant SaaS application design.

**Cloud & Development Practices**

* Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Git, GitHub, CI/CD workflows, and production release practices.
* Automated testing, debugging, API documentation, and performance optimization.

**Security**

* OAuth 2.0, JWT, API authentication, authorization, and RBAC.
* Tenant isolation, secure credential handling, and service-to-service security.

Good to Have

* Experience integrating Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise SaaS applications.
* Familiarity with Rust-based services or performance-critical execution components.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, event sourcing, transactional outbox, and distributed saga patterns.
* Knowledge of graph-based data systems, identity resolution, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience integrating LLMs, AI agents, or AI orchestration services with production applications.
* Familiarity with observability, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and reliability engineering.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

What We Expect

We are looking for an engineer who can take a business requirement and deliver a working, tested backend capability—not simply write code against a predefined API specification.

You should be able to:

* Translate complex requirements into coherent technical designs.
* Independently implement complete backend services, including database changes, APIs, background processing, integrations, and tests.
* Debug failures spanning multiple services and databases.
* Identify architectural flaws and implement sustainable corrections instead of temporary patches.
* Understand existing codebases, maintain backward compatibility, and improve code quality.
* Use AI-assisted development productively while retaining full responsibility for code correctness, security, and testing.
* Demonstrate ownership of delivered software through technical evidence and working implementations.

Who Should Apply?

Candidates with 6+ years of meaningful backend development experience, including substantial hands-on ownership of production services.

We particularly value candidates who have independently built and deployed complex SaaS backends, enterprise integrations, or distributed systems.

Prior startup or product-engineering experience is valuable, especially where engineers have taken responsibility for architecture, implementation, testing, and production debugging.

**This is a hands-on engineering position, not a coordination-only, frontend-focused, or purely architectural role.**

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
About the role

As an Agentic AI Engineer at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that do real work: researching cases, analysing data, calling tools and APIs, and automating multi-step workflows for our products and for lenders and fintech partners. You will own agents end to end, from prompt and tool design through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. You will work closely with our data science, data engineering, and product teams, and help set how Hudson Data builds with AI.

This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India.

Responsibilities

• Design and build LLM-based agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, call APIs and databases, and complete multi-step tasks reliably.

• Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over structured and unstructured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking.

• Design clear tool interfaces (function calling, MCP servers) that connect agents to internal systems, data warehouses, and third-party services.

• Build evaluation harnesses: test sets, automated and LLM-as-judge evals, regression tests, and red-teaming, so agent quality is measured, not guessed.

• Take agents to production with solid engineering: APIs, background jobs, retries, cost and latency controls, logging, tracing, and monitoring.

• Put guardrails in place: permissions, human-in-the-loop review, prompt-injection defences, PII handling, and audit trails suitable for financial-services clients.

• Choose the right model for each job across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models), balancing quality, cost, and latency.

• Work with data scientists to combine agents with predictive models, for example agents that investigate fraud alerts or explain credit decisions.

• Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring the useful ideas into our stack.

Required qualifications

• 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year building applications on top of LLMs.

• Strong Python, with experience building production backend services and APIs (FastAPI or similar).

• Hands-on experience building agents or LLM workflows: function/tool calling, structured outputs, prompt design, and at least one orchestration approach (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or your own).

• Experience with RAG and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant).

• Experience evaluating LLM systems and improving them based on measured results.

• Solid SQL and comfort working with real, messy business data.

• Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), Docker, Git, and CI/CD.

• Ability to own problems end to end and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related field.

• Experience building MCP servers or integrating agents with enterprise systems.

• Experience with observability tools for LLM apps (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, OpenTelemetry).

• Background in fintech, lending, credit risk, fraud, or another regulated industry.

• Experience fine-tuning or serving open-weight models.

• Open-source contributions or public projects with agents or LLMs.

How to apply

Apply on our careers site: https://career.hudsondata.com/careers/agentic-ai-engineer-1004

title: Oracle AI Agent Studio Engineer
description:
**Oracle AI Agent Studio Engineer**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for Oracle AI Agent Studio Engineers with 2–4 years of experience in Oracle Fusion and demonstrable hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) or agent tooling.

The role involves building and configuring AI agents natively within Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, working alongside functional leads who will own the process design.

As this is an emerging skill area, we are looking for candidates with strong Oracle Fusion fundamentals and genuine hands-on experience building with LLMs, rather than requiring extensive experience specifically in Agent Studio.

Selected candidates will be deployed on an Oracle Fusion engagement for a Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) client in the Middle East, building AI agents across Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance processes.

This is an offshore role based in Gurugram, working remotely with client teams in the UAE.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agent Design & Build

* Configure agents, agent teams, and topics in Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio based on process designs provided by functional leads.
* Write and refine agent instructions, prompts, and guardrails, and optimize them against evaluation sets.
* Configure retrieval over approved documents and knowledge sources for agents requiring policy or process context.

2. Tools & Integration

* Build the agent tool layer, including Fusion business object and REST API tools, document tools, and integrations exposed through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Register and configure external tools, including through Model Context Protocol (MCP), where approved.
* Handle tool errors, timeouts, and fallbacks to ensure predictable agent behaviour.

3. Security & Controls

* Configure agent access and least-privilege tool permissions.
* Maintain the entitlement and autonomy record for each agent.
* Apply human-in-the-loop approval steps for actions involving posting, payments, or changes to master data.

4. Testing & Evaluation

* Build and execute evaluation sets and test scenarios for every change.
* Log defects and refine prompts and tool definitions.
* Treat tool output and retrieved content as data and test agents against prompt-injection scenarios.

5. Deployment & Collaboration

* Work with functional leads to validate agent output against business rules before UAT.
* Support the promotion of agent configurations across environments.
* Document final configurations for handover.
* Prepare agent design notes, prompt and tool catalogues, test evidence, and runbooks.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* **Oracle Fusion:**
  2–4 years of experience working on Oracle Fusion, with working knowledge of at least one pillar – SCM, Procurement, Financials, or HCM.
* **Fusion APIs:**
  Hands-on experience with Fusion REST APIs, JSON payloads, authentication, and tools such as Postman.
* **Fusion Security:**
  Understanding of roles, privileges, and data access within Oracle Fusion.
* **LLM / Agent Experience:**
  Practical experience building with LLMs, prompts, RAG, or agent frameworks, demonstrated through project work, POCs, or a portfolio.
* **Written Communication:**
  Strong written English, as the role involves writing precise agent instructions and test cases.
* **Testing & Evaluation:**
  Comfortable building test scenarios and evaluating non-deterministic outputs.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio or Oracle AI Agents delivery.
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) development experience.

title: Manager - MLOps
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organisations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager – ML Ops to lead the design, development and operation of reliable, scalable and production ready machine learning platforms and workflows. The role will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers and client stakeholders to take models from experimentation to production and ensure they remain reliable, efficient, secure and well monitored.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in MLOps and cloud-native engineering, understands the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, and can lead a team while remaining hands-on in architecture, implementation and technical problem solving. Exposure to LLMOps and the deployment of Generative AI applications will be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development and implementation of end-to-end MLOps platforms, processes and deployment pipelines for machine learning solutions.
* Build and manage automated workflows for model training, testing, validation, packaging, deployment, versioning and rollback.
* Establish CI/CD and CT pipelines for ML systems, enabling repeatable releases across development, staging and production environments.
* Deploy and operate models at scale using containerization and orchestration technologies; ensure availability, performance, scalability and reliability.
* Set up monitoring for model performance, data quality, model drift, service health, latency and resource utilization, and drive timely remediation.
* Partner with data science and AI teams to productions models, improve experimentation-to-production workflows and establish reusable engineering standards.
* Build and maintain feature pipelines, data and model registries, metadata tracking, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management capabilities.
* Drive cloud infrastructure and platform practices across environments, with a focus on security, access control, cost optimization and operational resilience.
* Define and implement best practices for infrastructure such as code, observability, logging, alerting, incident management, and disaster recovery.
* Evaluate and adopt relevant tools, frameworks and architectural patterns to improve the MLOps ecosystem and developer productivity.
* Support production deployments of Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including model serving, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version management and operational controls, where applicable.
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of ML Ops and platform engineers; set technical direction, review designs and code, and contribute to hiring.
* Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and ensure successful delivery of engagements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 4–8 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, ML engineering or MLOps, with substantial hands-on experience in productionising machine learning systems.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, experimentation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
* Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation, Develop scalable ML pipelines.
* Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry, Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML EZE Paas/Saas
* Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components.
* Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated ML workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Kubeflow or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and their ML and infrastructure services.
* Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling and managing containerised workloads.
* Experience with model serving and lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, KServe, Seldon or equivalent platforms.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL, APIs and software engineering practices such as version control, testing, code reviews and documentation.
* Understanding of monitoring and observability tools and practices for applications, infrastructure, data pipelines and deployed models.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Helm or Ansible.
* Good understanding of security, networking, access management and cost optimisation in cloud-based production environments.
* At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, managing delivery and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and manage stakeholder expectations.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLMOps and production deployment of Generative AI applications, including LLM serving, evaluation, observability and performance optimisation.
* Exposure to vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and orchestration frameworks used in GenAI applications.
* Experience with feature stores, data orchestration and streaming technologies such as Feast, Airflow, Kafka or Flink.
* Experience working with financial services, banking, fintech or other regulated environments.
* Exposure to model governance, auditability, explainability and model risk management requirements.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or MLOps certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with team leadership and delivery ownership.
* Comfort working in a consulting and product-oriented environment with multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements.
* Willingness to take ownership of platform reliability and production outcomes, not just initial deployment.

title: Decision Intelligence Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The Decision Intelligence Lead, within the Operations Intelligence & Analytics organization, drives the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of executive analytics solutions that translate Global Operations initiatives into measurable business outcomes. This role transforms complex operational data into actionable insights delivered through dashboards, scorecards, and interactive applications that improve decision-making, performance, and efficiency across the enterprise.
  
  
As a key partner to leaders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other Global Operations functions, the Decision Intelligence Lead operates with a product-oriented approach to analytics, overseeing solutions from strategy and requirements through deployment and continuous enhancement. The ideal candidate combines expertise in business intelligence, modern data platforms, and advanced analytics with the ability to translate business needs into scalable, user-centric solutions that influence executive strategy and operational performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Build and own the product roadmap, including the executive insights dashboard, data-rich executive summaries, and balanced scorecard reporting.
* Apply product strategy, management and UX principles to design scalable and intuitive data products with the user in mind.
* Develop decision intelligence products within Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including semantic models, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and executive summaries that provide actionable insights into the health and performance of the global operations network.
* Build interactive scenario planning applications, incorporating predictive models to support trade-off analysis and forward-looking decision-making.
* Automate repeatable data extraction, preparation and transformation workflows using Python and SQL.
* Integrate ERP data from SAP, Oracle and additional disparate data sources into cohesive, consumable decision intelligence products.
* Apply predictive analytics and AI/ML techniques, where appropriate, to enhance operational forecasting, risk identification, scenario simulation, and decision support capabilities.
* Use standard DevOps tools, including GitHub, Confluence, and Jira, throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; Master's degree preferred.
* 8+ years of experience in data science, business intelligence, or analytics, with deep expertise in modern BI architecture and tools.
* Expertise in Power BI, including proficiency in DAX for building measures, KPIs, and time-intelligence calculations; broad experience in other tools such as Spotfire and Qlik.
* Highly proficient in Python (e.g., pandas, NumPy) and SQL, with hands-on experience data wrangling across disparate sources.
* Hands-on experience developing front-end/interactive applications using low-code and full-code frameworks such as Power Apps, Plotly Dash, or React.js.
* Experience leveraging DevOps and collaboration platforms, including GitHub, Confluence, and Jira, to support agile delivery, version control, documentation, and product lifecycle management.
* Strong executive communication, data storytelling, product strategy, and UX design skills, with a demonstrated ability to transform complex data into intuitive user-centric analytics products.
* Previous experience with unified analytics and lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric or Databricks, and familiarity with broader cloud data ecosystems (AWS, Snowflake).
* Experience working within large matrixed organizations, understanding business workflows and leveraging data from enterprise ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Previous experience supporting global supply chain, manufacturing, quality, or regulatory operations in a complex enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with native GenBI capabilities (e.g., Copilot in Power BI/Fabric) and GenAI application development process.
* Practical experience across the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, model selection, training and validation, deployment, and performance monitoring/retraining, using frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, or equivalent.
* Relevant Microsoft Fabric, cloud or data engineering certifications such as MS DP-600 or MS DP-700.

description:

* Strong communication skills across technical, business, and senior leadership audiences.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts and influence architecture and investment decisions.
* Experience working in large enterprise environments with security, privacy, and governance requirements.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We're looking for a Java engineer who builds with AI as well as with code. You'll design and build scalable, secure Java services. You'll also add AI features to those services, such as LLM-powered workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents. And you'll use AI coding tools to speed up how the team delivers.

This role suits someone with deep backend engineering skills who has already shipped AI features to production, or is clearly on the way there. We are not looking for someone who only experiments with AI.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Core engineering
  + Design, build and maintain high-performance microservices using Java 17+ and Spring Boot
  + Build and use REST, GraphQL and event-driven APIs (Kafka) that are secure, observable and resilient
  + Own features end to end: design, code, test, deploy and support in production
  + Write clean, testable code and keep code quality and test coverage high
* AI building
  + Build LLM-powered features into enterprise apps using Spring AI, LangChain4j or provider SDKs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI and others)
  + Design and run RAG pipelines. This covers splitting documents into chunks, building embeddings, working with vector stores (pgvector, Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone) and tuning how results are retrieved and ranked
  + Build agent workflows that use tools and function calls, and connect them to internal systems, for example through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  + Write, version and test prompts. Set up evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, groundedness, latency and cost
  + Build in safeguards: PII/PHI redaction, content filters, protection against prompt injection, and human review where it's needed
  + Monitor AI features in production and tune them for token use, response time and reliability
* AI-assisted engineering
  + Use AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot) in daily development, testing, refactoring and documentation, and share good practices with the team
  + Find chances to automate engineering work with AI, such as generating tests, triaging code reviews, and summarizing incidents
* Collaboration and leadership
  + Work with product, data science, architecture and security teams to turn business problems into AI solutions
  + Mentor other engineers in modern Java and AI development
  + Help shape team standards for responsible AI, architecture and engineering practice
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Java and backend
  + 8+ years of hands-on Java work, with strong knowledge of Java 11/17+, multithreading, collections and the JVM
  + Experience with microservices, REST APIs and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  + Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, or Azure or GCP), Docker and Kubernetes
  + Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and test frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers)
  + Proven solid with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security and JPA/Hibernate
  + Proven solid with SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis)
* AI skills

  + Hands-on experience building apps with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini or similar) through APIs
  + Knowledge of responsible AI principles, data privacy and secure AI design
  + Good understanding of embeddings, vector search, RAG and prompt engineering
  + Understands the limits of LLMs, including hallucination, context limits, non-deterministic output and cost, and knows how to design around them
  + Familiar with agent concepts: tool and function calling, planning, memory and multi-agent orchestration

  Ways of working

  + Proven solid problem-solving and system design skills
  + Proven clear communicator who can explain AI trade-offs to people without a technical background
  + Proven curious and keeps up with the fast-moving AI field

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS ML Specialty, or Oracle Java certification
* Experience with MCP servers, Copilot Studio or other agent platforms
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, OpenTelemetry)
* Experience in healthcare, with an understanding of HIPAA, PHI handling and regulated environments
* Basic ML knowledge: model fine-tuning, classic ML and NLP
* Working knowledge of Spring AI and/or LangChain4j. Python experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex
* Proven event-driven or reactive programming (Spring WebFlux)
* Public work: GitHub projects, AI side projects, blog posts or talks.

architecture and technical design discussions. - Refactor legacy code where required without affecting existing

customers.

API and Integration Development - Integrate with external platforms using REST and SOAP APIs. - Work with API

authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, API keys and access tokens. - Handle pagination, rate limits, retries and

API failures. - Design and consume webhooks. - Analyse API requests, responses and error messages. - Develop data

mapping and transformation logic between different platforms. - Ensure integrations are idempotent and do not create

duplicate transactions. - Maintain compatibility with third-party API changes and version upgrades.

Production Troubleshooting - Investigate production incidents using application logs, database records and monitoring

tools. - Identify root causes instead of applying temporary fixes. - Analyse performance issues, memory problems,

connection pool exhaustion and slow database queries. - Troubleshoot intermittent API, webhook, scheduler and

queue-related failures. - Provide technical findings to support, QA and operations teams. - Implement permanent

corrective and preventive actions. - Participate in critical incident resolution when required.

Database Development - Design and maintain MySQL database structures. - Write and optimise SQL queries. - Create

appropriate indexes and analyse execution plans. - Handle large-volume data processing efficiently. - Identify

duplicate, inconsistent or incomplete records. - Work safely with production data and database migrations. -

Understand transactions, locking, isolation levels and concurrency.

Code Quality and Reviews - Review code written by other developers. - Identify defects, security issues, performance

risks and maintainability concerns. - Enforce coding standards and engineering best practices. - Write unit and

integration tests. - Ensure adequate test coverage for critical workflows. - Participate in pull-request reviews and

release validation. - Mentor junior and mid-level developers.

Performance and Scalability - Design systems that can process high-volume orders and API transactions. - Improve

scheduler, batch and queue-processing efficiency. - Identify memory, CPU, thread and database bottlenecks. - Design

asynchronous processing where appropriate. - Ensure that services fail safely and recover correctly. - Support

horizontal and vertical scaling decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with product analysts, business analysts, QA engineers and support

teams. - Understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions. - Clarify technical feasibility,

dependencies and risks. - Support QA in preparing technical and integration test scenarios. - Provide technical

estimates and implementation plans. - Communicate delays, risks and blockers clearly.

### **Requirements**

- Work from the Noida office - Participate in production incident resolution when necessary - Collaborate with teams

working on customer-facing integrations - Follow secure development and data-handling practices

5 Days Working (Monday to Friday)

Near Sector 62 Metro Station, Noida

Positive and Healthy Work Environment

in software engineering and

* Lead performance tuning, scalability initiatives, and troubleshooting for high-throughput production systems across all product domains.
* Champion AI-assisted development practices — evaluating emerging tools and driving adoption across engineering teams while maintaining code quality and security standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams through technical depth and execution, influencing technology decisions without relying on hierarchy.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience building and shipping enterprise-grade, large-scale SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in Python and Django/Django REST Framework, building high-performance REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js and TypeScript for frontend architecture in a full-stack or platform context.
* Proven AWS architecture experience across ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM at production scale.
* Demonstrated track record solving complex scalability, performance, and reliability challenges in distributed, event-driven systems.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong command of PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch — including query optimization, caching strategies, and data modeling.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience architecting and operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms handling large-scale transactional and analytical workloads.
* Exposure to healthcare technology, dental-domain applications, or other data-intensive regulated verticals.
* Experience driving platform architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with Node.js in a polyglot backend environment.
* Active interest in evaluating and adopting emerging AI/ML tooling to accelerate engineering productivity.

**What We Offer**

* Platform-wide technical ownership with direct influence over architecture decisions across all product areas serving thousands of dental practices.
* High-autonomy environment with tight cross-functional collaboration — ship fast and see real-world impact quickly.
* Opportunity to shape engineering culture and standards at a fast-growing medical AI SaaS company in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.
* Flexible scheduling and strong support for continuous learning and professional growth.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
(ref:hirist.tech)
