title: Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)
  
  
**Department:**
Technology
  
  
**Reports to:**
CTO
  
  
**Required experience:**
8+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India-Remote
  
  
**Company Introduction**
As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021- 2025) with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4.4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Genea is looking for a Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming) to lead the team building Genea Video, our cloud-native video solution built directly into the Genea security platform alongside access control and visitor management. Genea Video lets customers connect compatible RTSP cameras through the Genea Gateway (an on-site NVIDIA Jetson appliance that runs AI at the edge) or stream supported Axis cameras straight to the cloud. Customers can then watch live view and recorded playback, build camera walls, search across every camera with AI, and see the door and badge event behind every clip. You will own the engineering of this video streaming pipeline end to end, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search, and participate in the full SDLC from system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid engineering role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, building high quality, high performance software alongside a great team.
  
  
**What you would do, day-to-day?**

* Lead and grow the team building Genea Video, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search.
* Have a keen eye on code quality, with scalability, maintainability and readability in mind.
* Have a solution-oriented mindset and design high-load, low-latency video streaming systems that scale across thousands of cameras and locations.
* Estimate and delegate work across streaming, edge (Genea Gateway) and web/mobile client workstreams.
* Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team’s goals.
* Drive the design, strategy, and execution of video projects that support the Genea Video roadmap, including live view, recorded playback, camera walls, clip export and camera management.
* Lead the architecture of the video pipeline: RTSP ingest through the Genea Gateway, Axis Camera-to-Cloud streaming, transcoding, adaptive delivery, storage and retention.
* Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams working on Genea Video.
* Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for engineering and operational excellence, including stream reliability, latency, uptime and cost per camera. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessing goals and improving deliveries.
* Lead SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features, such as AI-powered search and security automations, and to fix prior mistakes.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and the Access Control and Visitor Management teams to link video to door and badge events and deliver one unified platform experience.
* Implement a data-driven approach to execution to drive transparency, and partner with DevOps and Support to keep video services reliable around the clock.

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture.
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies such as Go, Python or C++.
* Hands-on experience with video streaming technologies and protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS/DASH and RTMP, and with video codecs such as H.264 and H.265.
* Experience building or managing media pipelines for live and recorded video: ingest, transcoding, adaptive bitrate delivery, recording, storage and retention (for example, with FFmpeg or GStreamer).
* Experience with edge computing and on-device AI/computer vision. Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded platforms is a plus.
* Understanding of IP camera ecosystems (RTSP, ONVIF, Axis) and VMS/NVR concepts, and of video security use cases such as video linked to access control events.
* Experience designing for low latency, high throughput and cost-efficient storage, with observability for stream health (uptime, latency, dropped frames).
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript-based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc. Experience building browser-based video players and live view/playback interfaces is a plus.
* Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
* Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable.
* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
* Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call.
* Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed.
* Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
* Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies.
* Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels.
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious.
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.

**Competencies**

* Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

* Familiarity with containerized and cloud-native environments: Kubernetes, Docker, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure,
* or GCP).Ability to read and write scripts or queries in at least one of: Python, Bash, SPL, DQL, KQL, LogQL, PromQL, or equivalent.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

* Work with Azure Synapse Analytics and relational databases.

* Schema design and data warehouse development.

* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer**
The Senior Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer leads Hillenbrand's Exchange Online, Teams and Microsoft 365 collaboration services across a large, global enterprise. The role focuses on standardization, security, cost optimization and resilience. It drives consolidation of acquired and legacy environments into a single Microsoft 365 tenant, directs managed service providers, and owns eDiscovery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead engineering, architecture and operations for Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive, including the small on-premises Exchange footprint.
* Own mail flow and messaging: domains, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, permissions, and secure mail relay for applications and devices.
* Lead tenant and domain consolidation toward one tenant, including assessment, migration, coexistence and cutover.
* Manage Microsoft 365 licensing: assign, reclaim and consolidate SKUs and add-ons (Teams Phone, Audio Conferencing, Teams Premium, Teams Rooms) and report cost savings.
* Administer Teams on the Microsoft side: Direct Routing and Calling Plans, policies, call quality and Teams Rooms, coordinating with the telephony team and carriers.
* Own eDiscovery in Microsoft Purview: holds, searches, exports and case management, in partnership with Legal and HR.
* Contribute to Defender for Office 365 and DLP: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing and anti-spam policies, policy tuning and incident follow-up with the security team.
* Share ownership of Entra Connect and hybrid identity sync with the data center team.
* Support retention, sensitivity labels, audit logging, guest and external sharing controls, and mailbox and Teams lifecycle management.
* Direct and hold accountable managed service providers for Microsoft 365 and messaging operations.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, automation and AI to improve efficiency and produce reporting on licenses, mail flow, Teams usage and call quality.
* Define and report KPIs for mail delivery, Teams quality, license utilization, security posture and project progress.
* Partner with identity, infrastructure, network, security, application and service-desk teams, and with ServiceNow for incident, change and CMDB processes.
* Maintain standards, runbooks and documentation, and participate in a light on-call rotation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of enterprise experience with Exchange (Online and hybrid) and Microsoft 365.
* Deep knowledge of mail flow and messaging security: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, connectors, transport rules, Autodiscover and mailbox permissions.
* Proven M&A experience: tenant-to-tenant migrations, domain and mail-flow consolidation, and legacy rationalization.
* Hands-on Teams administration, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans and meeting rooms.
* Experience with eDiscovery and compliance tooling (Microsoft Purview or equivalent).
* Strong PowerShell and Microsoft Graph skills, plus working knowledge of Entra ID, Entra Connect and hybrid identity.
* Experience managing managed service providers to defined service levels.

title: Full Stack Mobile Application Developer
description:
Lynky Tech – Now Hiring

Position : Full Stack Mobile Application Developer

Location: R.S. Puram, Coimbatore

Employment Type: Full-Time, In-Office

Reports To: Founder

Preference: Immediate Joiner

About Lynky Tech

Lynky Tech builds done-for-you AI automation systems and AI-first platforms for businesses across India and the UAE, from jewellery and manufacturing to real estate and services.

We work on clearly scoped, fixed-timeline engagements that deliver real value in weeks, not quarters. We are a small, founder-led team, so you will work directly with the founder from day one.

About the Role

You will build and deliver mobile applications for real clients across jewellery, manufacturing, education and real estate.

The role involves developing cross-platform mobile applications using React Native or Flutter, along with the backend systems that support them.

You will use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day. You are responsible for reviewing, testing and understanding everything you build before it is delivered.

You will work directly with the founder from our R.S. Puram, Coimbatore office.

A Typical Day

- Pick up tasks from the project board, discuss the approach with the founder and start development.

- Build app screens and workflows using AI coding tools, reviewing and refining the generated code.

- Develop or fix backend APIs, database queries, WhatsApp integrations and payment integrations.

- Test builds on real mobile devices and fix issues.

- Share test builds with the project coordinator or client.

- Prepare releases, including building, signing, uploading and tracking store or client feedback.

Key Responsibilities

- Build mobile applications using React Native or Flutter for Android and iOS, from requirements to Play Store and App Store release.

- Develop backend systems using Node.js or Python APIs with PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

- Implement authentication features such as OTP/password login, user roles and secure payment gateway integrations.

- Integrate WhatsApp Business API workflows, notifications, voice input and calling features.

- Build AI-powered features within applications, including LLM integrations, voice assistants and simple AI agents.

- Deploy and maintain production backends, manage environments, monitor applications and resolve post-launch issues.

- Work with the project coordinator, participate in client demonstrations when required and document technical workflows.

- Review all AI-generated code, test applications on real devices and ensure that everything delivered is properly understood and tested.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30

- Learn the technology stack, repositories and client projects.

- Deliver small fixes and features on live applications.

- Understand and complete the release process.

Days 31–60

- Own one feature from development to completion, covering both app and backend.

- Work with the founder for reviews.

- Handle client feedback directly.

Days 61–90

- Lead a small application or major module from initial requirements to store release.

- Take ownership of production support.

Requirements

- 1–3 years of experience in mobile application development.

- Must have successfully published or shipped mobile applications. Candidates should be ready to share their apps or source code.

- Strong knowledge of React Native or Flutter.

- Good knowledge of at least one backend language: Node.js or Python.

- Experience with PostgreSQL or MongoDB, REST APIs, Git and basic deployment.

- Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to review and verify generated code.

- Good communication skills in English and Tamil.

- Ability to communicate delays or challenges at an early stage.

- Must be based in Coimbatore or willing to relocate before joining.

Nice to Have

- Experience publishing applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

- Experience with WhatsApp Business API, payment gateways or voice integrations.

- Knowledge of LLM APIs, RAG or AI agents.

- Basic knowledge of Docker, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as AWS, Railway or Vercel.

This Role Is Not Suitable For Candidates Who

- Do not have any shipped mobile application or portfolio to demonstrate.

- Use AI-generated code without reading, understanding or testing it.

- Prefer working only on frontend or only on backend development.

- Are looking for a work-from-home opportunity.

Hiring Process

1. CV review and a short phone screening.

2. A short practical development task involving a small application and API. This is the main assessment for the role.

3. Final discussion with the founder, followed by a decision within a few days.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on the role and experience.

- Opportunity to work with modern AI and software technologies.

- Access to premium AI coding tools required for the role.

- Startup environment with a flat structure and direct access to the founder.

- Real ownership and responsibility for the applications you build.

- ESOPs and other long-term benefits for long-term employees.

- In-office work at R.S. Puram, Coimbatore, alongside the founder and team.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

9+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or large-scale data platforms.

Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in the modern Python ecosystem (FastAPI, uv, async I/O, typing).

Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks).

Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform.

Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with pipeline orchestrators such as Dagster, Celery, or Apache Airflow.

Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics.

**Good To Have**

Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka.

Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines).

Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd).

Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS.

Active contributions to open-source software.

**Roles and Key Responsibilities:**

1. Backend & Microservices Engineering:

Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).

Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).

Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

2. Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management:

Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.

Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).

Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

3. Data Infrastructure & Orchestration:

Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.

Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).

Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns.

Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms.

4. Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD

Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform).

Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm.

Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines.

5. Observability & Reliability Engineering

Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks.

Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

* Retrieval & Agentic Systems: Build and optimize RAG pipelines, tool-use/agentic workflows, and orchestration layers that let models reason over legal documents and take multi-step actions reliably.
* Prompt & System Design: Design and iterate on prompts, context strategies, and system architecture to maximize accuracy, consistency, and cost-efficiency across use cases.
* Model Integration & Evaluation: Integrate best-fit foundation models (proprietary and open-source) into the product through the team’s harnesses, running structured evals to measure output quality, latency, and cost trade-offs before and after release.
* Production Reliability: Own the AI layer end-to-end in production, monitoring, guardrails, fallback logic, and observability to ensure outputs meet legal-grade accuracy and reliability standards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, and legal domain experts to translate ambiguous workflow problems into well-scoped AI features, and to validate outputs against professional legal standards.

**Qualifications**

* AI/LLM Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building applications or systems on top of LLMs and other AI models, in production settings.
* Harness & Eval Building: Demonstrated experience building model harnesses or evaluation infrastructure: test suites, benchmark runners, or scaffolding used to systematically compare and validate model behavior.
* Applied Systems Skill: Practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic/tool-use frameworks, prompt engineering, and orchestration across multiple models or providers.
* Software Engineering Fundamentals: Strong backend/software engineering skills, with the ability to design and ship robust, well-tested production systems.

title: AI Engineer – LLM / VLM
description:
**About Opkey**
Opkey is the leading Cloud Application Lifecycle Management (CALM) platform for Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Coupa, and more. It cuts the costs and risks that drag down implementations and ongoing change, helping you go live on time, get more from your cloud app investments, and reach AI readiness faster. Opkey's 20+ AI agents manage all five phases of the cloud application lifecycle—Define, Design, Configure, Test and Train.
  
  
Whether it’s a new implementation, a platform update, or business‑as‑usual change, Opkey handles it all: updates validated in hours, self‑healing tests, end‑to‑end integrations assured, configurations synced, and training updated in real time—all delivered in a single unified platform instead of a patchwork of disconnected tools.
  
  
Powered by Argus, a domain‑specific AI model trained on decades of expertise and terabytes of enterprise application data, Opkey automates configuration, testing, change impact analysis, and training across these applications—cutting manual effort by 80%, enabling 30% faster go‑lives, and slashing downtime risk by 92%
  
  
**About The Opportunity**

* We are hiring an AI Engineer to fine-tune, train, and evaluate large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for production use. You will own models end to end: data, training, evaluation. The role suits someone who solves hard problems from first principles and understands why techniques work, not just how to run them.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Fine-tune open-weight LLMs and VLMs for domain-specific tasks.
* Apply full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA, adapters).
* Run post-training and alignment: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), instruction tuning, and preference optimization (DPO, RLHF/PPO, GRPO).
* Build data pipelines: collect, clean, deduplicate, filter and synthesize text and image-text training data.
* Design evaluation: task benchmarks, LLM-as-judge setups, human eval, and regression suites that catch quality drops.
* Train efficiently on multi-GPU setups using distributed training (DeepSpeed, FSDP), mixed precision and gradient checkpointing.
* Debug training failures such as loss spikes, divergence, overfitting, catastrophic forgetting and hallucination, and find the root cause.
* Optimize models for inference through quantization (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF), distillation and serving with vLLM or TGI.
* Read and reproduce recent research papers, and turn promising ideas into working experiments.
* Track experiments rigorously and share findings clearly with engineering and product teams.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Must-Have**

* 2–3 years in machine learning or deep learning.
* Shipped at least one fine-tuned model to production or a real user-facing use case.
* Strong AI fundamentals and Problem solving.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics or a related field (or equivalent hands-on work).

**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
  
  
This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
  
  
The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
  
  
We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
* Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.
* One reasoning, tool-use, preference, or reinforcement-learning dataset they created or used: how correctness was established, how contamination was prevented, and how reward hacking or low-quality traces were detected.
* The exact denominator, dataset split, and review method behind any quality or business-impact metric on their resume.
* A difficult production incident or model-quality regression, how they isolated the cause, and the evidence that confirmed the fix.
* A code sample, design document, experiment report, publication, or other artifact that makes their contribution verifiable. Confidential details may be redacted.
* We do not require a PhD, publications, or prior domain experience. We do require depth, honesty about individual contribution, and the ability to turn claims into technical evidence.

title: Gemini Agent Platform AI Engineer
description:

Digital & Technology – HAP

Senior Manager, HAP
  
  
**Scope:**
Global
  
  
**Terms & Conditions:**
Full-time, permanent. Applicants must have the right to work in India.
  
  
**About Unilever**
Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
  
  
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Gemini Agent Platform AI Engineer will help accelerate the adoption of Google Cloud, Gemini and agent-based artificial intelligence technologies across Unilever.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong product engagement dimension. You will partner with product and engineering teams to understand their existing applications and technology landscape, identify opportunities to migrate or modernize solutions onto Google Cloud, and help define and engineer the target solutions.
  
  
Alongside application migration and modernization, you will design and build artificial intelligence and intelligent agent solutions using Google's technology ecosystem. A key part of the role will be developing reusable engineering components, patterns and implementation approaches that can support multiple enterprise use cases.
  
  
You will work across the complete development lifecycle, from discovery and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement, helping teams turn ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative environment where engineers, architects and product teams work together to solve meaningful problems, experiment with emerging technologies and shape how Google and artificial intelligence capabilities are adopted at enterprise scale.
  
  
Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing applications, technical requirements and modernisation needs, and identify appropriate opportunities to adopt Google Cloud technologies.
* Support the migration and modernisation of applications onto Google Cloud, working with product teams and architects to define target architectures and practical engineering approaches.
* Design, develop and deploy artificial intelligence applications and intelligent agent solutions using Google Gemini and Google Cloud technologies.
* Take solutions through the complete engineering lifecycle, from experimentation and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Build reusable components, frameworks and engineering patterns that accelerate future artificial intelligence and Google Cloud implementations.
* Develop integrations between intelligent agents, enterprise applications, application programming interfaces and data sources.
* Design solutions that securely connect artificial intelligence models with trusted enterprise information and services.
* Build and orchestrate workflows involving artificial intelligence models, software tools, business applications and cloud services.
* Evaluate technical approaches based on engineering feasibility, scalability, reliability, security, operational readiness and cost.
* Apply strong software engineering practices across source control, automated testing, deployment automation, version management and release processes.
* Implement appropriate security, identity and access management, monitoring, observability and responsible artificial intelligence practices.
* Evaluate and improve the quality, reliability and technical performance of artificial intelligence and agent-based solutions.
* Work closely with architects, product teams and engineering partners to convert business requirements and early prototypes into production-ready solutions.
* Create clear technical documentation, reusable implementation guidance and engineering standards that enable other teams to adopt proven solutions and patterns.
* Support rapid experimentation and proof-of-concept development while ensuring successful solutions have a clear path towards production and scale

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong software engineering experience with the ability to design, develop and productionise cloud-based applications.
* Hands-on experience designing, developing and deploying solutions on Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, covering solution design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and production operations.
* Experience developing applications using generative artificial intelligence or large language models.
* Understanding of intelligent agent concepts, including tool use, orchestration, grounding and context management.
* Experience with cloud-native application architectures, application programming interfaces and integration patterns.
* Experience with modern software engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, continuous integration and automated deployment.
* Ability to understand existing application architectures and define appropriate approaches for migration and modernisation onto Google Cloud.
* Ability to engage effectively with product, architecture and engineering teams and translate business and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to take prototypes and early-stage solutions through engineering into secure, scalable, reliable and production-ready solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on development experience with Google Gemini and Vertex AI.
* Experience developing cloud or artificial intelligence solutions using Python.
* Experience with Google technologies and frameworks for building intelligent agents.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, semantic retrieval and vector search.
* Experience with artificial intelligence evaluation, monitoring, observability and responsible artificial intelligence controls.
* Experience creating reusable artificial intelligence components, engineering frameworks or platform capabilities.
* Experience with application migration and modernisation on Google Cloud.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers and serverless architectures.
* Experience with enterprise application integration and application programming interfaces.
* Experience working across global, cross-functional product and engineering teams.
* Experience working with external technology or delivery partners.

**Additional Information**

* This role operates with a global scope and will involve close collaboration with product teams, architects, platform teams and engineering partners.
* Success in this role means being equally comfortable in an engineering discussion and in a product conversation. You will need to understand how an application works today, identify how Google technologies can improve or modernize it, translate that into a practical engineering approach, and then help turn that approach into a working solution.
* The role therefore requires more than knowledge of individual Google services. It requires an understanding of how applications are designed, developed, migrated, secured, deployed, operated and continuously improved within an enterprise environment.

**At Unilever, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We**
welcome applicants from all walks of life and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive/succeed. All applicants will receive fair and respectful consideration, and we actively support the growth and development of every employee.
  
  
**Unilever Is An Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Persons With Disabilities.**

All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent—please verify before proceeding.

description:

Headquartered in the United States, with manufacturing operations in Bradenton, Florida, and a global presence across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS develops innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected.

Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, improve reliability, and protect their people.

At the heart of everything we do is our guiding principle:
**We Humanize Safety.**

We are committed to developing advanced, intuitive technologies that empower people and transform how industries approach safety and reliability.

IRISS is seeking an experienced and innovative
**Generative AI Engineer**
to join our technology team in Bengaluru, India.

This position will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications that transform complex enterprise data into meaningful, actionable business insights.

You will help build a conversational analytics platform that enables users to ask questions in natural language and receive accurate, secure, and understandable answers through dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.

Working closely with backend engineers, frontend developers, and technical stakeholders, you will develop AI services involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural-language-to-SQL generation, and enterprise data integration.

The ideal candidate has strong Python development skills, practical experience deploying generative AI applications, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and secure, scalable software architecture.

This is a
**hands-on engineering position**
focused on developing production-ready AI applications within a multi-tenant SaaS and IoT environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade generative AI applications and conversational analytics solutions.

* Build end-to-end conversational AI workflows involving natural-language understanding, contextual retrieval, SQL generation, query validation, and response generation.

* Integrate commercial and open-source large language models through platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, and Hugging Face.

* Develop and optimize prompts, model orchestration workflows, and AI response validation mechanisms.

* Implement multi-turn conversational experiences with contextual memory and reliable conversation-state management.

* Evaluate AI model performance and improve response accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Data Integration**

* Design and implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources.

* Develop contextual retrieval mechanisms that provide accurate, relevant information while maintaining tenant isolation.

* Integrate vector search technologies such as OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB.

* Build natural-language-to-SQL capabilities that translate business questions into validated database queries.

* Implement safeguards to enforce data-access policies, query restrictions, and enterprise security requirements.

* Collaborate with data engineering and application development teams to integrate AI capabilities with existing systems.

**Python Development & AI Microservices**

* Design and maintain modular, secure, and production-ready AI service architectures.

* Integrate AI services with existing backend applications, frontend interfaces, and enterprise analytics platforms.

* Develop automated tests and validation procedures to ensure application quality and reliability.

* Maintain technical documentation, architecture decision records, and development standards.

**AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain AI applications and supporting services within AWS environments.

* Work with AWS technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, Kendra, Lambda, ECS, EC2, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.

* Support containerized application deployment using Docker and established CI/CD pipelines.

* Monitor application performance, infrastructure efficiency, response latency, and operational reliability.

* Identify and implement improvements to scalability, system availability, and infrastructure utilization.

**AI Performance, Security & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop evaluation and monitoring capabilities to measure AI response quality, SQL accuracy, latency, and user feedback.

* Implement security controls that protect enterprise information and enforce multi-tenant data isolation.

* Support responsible AI development through appropriate validation, access controls, and data governance practices.

* Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

* Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable AI-driven analytics experiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5+ years of overall relevant professional experience**
  , including at least
  **3 years developing and deploying AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, or chatbots**
  .

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong hands-on
  **Python development experience**
  , including API or microservice development using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.

* Demonstrated experience integrating
  **large language models (LLMs)**
  using OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Hugging Face, or comparable platforms.

* Practical experience developing
  **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)**
  solutions using embeddings, vector search, and contextual retrieval pipelines.

* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, model orchestration, AI output validation, and conversational workflows.

* Hands-on experience with AWS services supporting AI applications, such as Bedrock, Kendra, OpenSearch, ECS, Lambda, and CloudWatch.

* Working knowledge of SQL, database query validation, enterprise data security, and multi-tenant architectures.

* Experience with Docker, Git-based CI/CD workflows, and microservice architectures.

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and technical communication skills.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with backend, frontend, data engineering, and product development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as
  **LangChain, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel**
  .

* Experience developing agent-based AI workflows and advanced conversational applications.

* Experience integrating AI microservices with
  **Angular frontend applications and .NET backend systems**
  .

* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana.

* Knowledge of enterprise data governance, role-based access controls, AI security, and compliance frameworks.

* Experience with AI evaluation methodologies, response-quality monitoring, or automated testing frameworks.

* Contributions to open-source AI projects or experience developing custom LLM integrations.

**Technology Environment**

The successful candidate will work with technologies commonly used in modern generative AI and enterprise application development.

Experience with comparable technologies is welcome; candidates are not expected to have worked with every tool listed.

* Python 3.10+
* FastAPI
* .NET and Python microservices

* OpenAI
* Anthropic
* Amazon Bedrock
* Hugging Face
* LangChain
* Haystack
* Semantic Kernel

* FAISS
* Pinecone
* ChromaDB

* AWS Lambda
* Amazon ECS and EC2

* Docker
* GitHub Actions
* AWS CDK

* Angular

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on engineer who enjoys building practical AI solutions that solve real business problems.

The successful candidate should be comfortable developing production-ready generative AI applications, working with enterprise data, and integrating AI capabilities into existing software platforms.

You should have a strong understanding of how to balance AI innovation with security, reliability, scalability, and performance.

We value individuals who take ownership of their work, collaborate effectively across technical teams, and continuously look for opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of the solutions they develop.

* Deliver reliable conversational AI solutions that transform natural-language business questions into accurate, actionable insights.

Your contributions will help shape the future of conversational analytics and AI-powered insights within our growing SaaS and IoT technology ecosystem.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn by submitting an updated resume highlighting their experience in generative AI development, Python programming, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and AWS cloud technologies.

Candidates with experience developing production-ready conversational AI applications, enterprise analytics platforms, or secure multi-tenant SaaS solutions are especially encouraged to apply.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Cekura (Bangalore, In-Person)
description:
Read This First
  
  
We work with unusual intensity: in-person in Bangalore, six days a week, long days, most weekends. That's how we've chosen to build, because in our market speed decides who wins. We say this up front because we want people who feel pulled in, not talked into it. If you want a 9-to-5 (no judgment), this isn't your role.
  
  
**What You Get In Exchange**

* Top-of-market cash. Extraordinary hours deserve more than an average salary.
* Meaningful equity. Significant grants, employee-friendly terms, and liquidity opportunities as we raise.
* No commute tax. Support to live near the office, plus dinner there every night.
* Founders in the trenches. We work the same schedule we ask of you.
* A decade of growth in two years. You'll ship more and own more than anywhere else.

**About Cekura**
Cekura (YC F24) builds evals and improvement for voice AI, covering both voice agents and the speech-to-speech models behind them.
  
  

* Voice agents. Teams test before launch, monitor production calls, and improve continuously. When something fails, Cekura reproduces it in simulation, fixes it, tests the fix, and raises a PR. The platform covers simulation, LLM evaluation, red-teaming, drift monitoring, and benchmarking across Vapi, Retell, Pipecat, LiveKit, ElevenLabs and more.
* Speech-to-speech models. We give labs benchmarks, data, and RL environments to improve turn-taking, interruptions, naturalness, and tool use in live conversations.

Customers include Five9, HighLevel, Twin Health, PwC, Deloitte, Jobber, and Jotform. HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR are defaults. We're growing fast and backed by top investors.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll build the core of Cekura: simulation engines, evaluation systems, benchmarks, RL environments, self-improvement loops, and observability pipelines. We don't split "software engineer" from "AI engineer." The best problems sit where real-time voice infrastructure, LLM evaluation, RL training, and speech analysis meet.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Simulation engine. Simulate thousands of realistic conversations across voice, chat, and phone, with control over personas, interruptions, noise, and edge cases.
* Agent evaluation. Build LLM evaluators, metrics, red-teaming, drift detection, and the autonomous loop that detects, reproduces, fixes, tests, and ships a PR.
* Speech-to-speech research. Work with labs to find where models fall short of human conversation, then build the benchmarks, datasets, reward signals, and RL environments that close the gap.
* Applied audio. Turn the paralinguistic layer (emotion, tone, silences, hesitations, overlaps) into structured signals, so models are judged on how things are said, not just what.
* Real-time voice infra. SIP, WebRTC, STT/TTS, Twilio, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat. Latency and barge-in are first-class problems.
* Ship end-to-end and shape the team. Own what you build from design to production, and set the standards a growing team inherits.

**About You**

* A strong generalist who wants to work across systems and AI, not stay in one lane.
* A strong coder in Python, TypeScript, or Go, with experience in distributed systems, real-time infra, LLM products, or model training and evaluation.
* You've run production systems and care about reliability, latency, and correctness.
* Sharp instincts about where LLMs and speech models fail, and how to build reliable systems on them.
* You like ambiguity, move fast, communicate clearly, and raise the bar around you.
* You read the first section twice and you're still here.
* Bonus: ex-founder or aspiring one.

Nice to Have
  
  

* LLM evals, agent frameworks, or AI observability.
* Voice AI stack experience (Twilio, SIP, WebRTC, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat, STT/TTS).
* RL for language or speech models, benchmark building, or speech-to-speech models.
* Early-stage startup experience or open-source work.

This Is Not for You If
  
  

* You want a narrow role, a fixed stack, or to work only on models or only on infra.
* You need rigid process or heavy structure.
* You're optimizing for work-life balance right now.
* You don't want to work in-person in Bangalore.

Why Cekura
  
  

* The hardest problems in voice AI, worked on alongside the labs building the models.
* A 12-person engineering team post-seed: early enough to matter, funded enough to move fast.
* Direct work with founders and a highly technical team.
* Top-of-market pay, meaningful equity, all meals at the office, and relocation support.

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
  
  
This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
  
  
The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
  
  
We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
* Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.
* One reasoning, tool-use, preference, or reinforcement-learning dataset they created or used: how correctness was established, how contamination was prevented, and how reward hacking or low-quality traces were detected.
* The exact denominator, dataset split, and review method behind any quality or business-impact metric on their resume.
* A difficult production incident or model-quality regression, how they isolated the cause, and the evidence that confirmed the fix.
* A code sample, design document, experiment report, publication, or other artifact that makes their contribution verifiable. Confidential details may be redacted.
* We do not require a PhD, publications, or prior domain experience. We do require depth, honesty about individual contribution, and the ability to turn claims into technical evidence.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.  
What you will do  

* Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,

and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.  

* Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering

leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is  
reproducible and version controlled.  

* Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature

flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us  
how it behaves there.  

* Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established

application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that  
has to be preserved.  

* Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they

live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match  
the existing ones.

* Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and

much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.  

* Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis

through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.  
What we are looking for  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the  
tools from day one.  
Where you need depth  

* Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe

and defend.  

* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error

handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.  

* Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a

language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.  

* Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers  
to be shipped.  
Where working knowledge is enough  

* Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
* Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and

containers.  

* Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production

monitoring and alerting.  
Across everything  

* Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
* Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,

and careful, staged rollout.  

* Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is

written.  

* Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work

with your counterparts rather than around them.  
Nice to have

* Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,

wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the  
domain to the right engineer.  

* Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
* AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
* Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.
