title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
**Salesforce Solution Architect**

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable Salesforce solutions for enterprise clients. This is a highly consultative and hands-on architecture role focused on translating business requirements into robust technical solutions while ensuring successful project delivery.

You will act as the primary solution owner across projects, working closely with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and technical leads to define architecture, guide implementation, and maximize platform capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for solution design, architecture governance, integration strategy, and ensuring all Salesforce implementations adhere to best practices for scalability, security, and maintainability.

**To be considered for this position, individuals must:**

* Have 10–15 years of experience in the technology industry, with at least 6–8 years focused on Salesforce solution design, implementation, and architecture.
* Demonstrate proven experience leading 2–3 full lifecycle Salesforce implementations from discovery through deployment.
* Have strong experience working directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct workshops, and define solution approaches.
* Be comfortable leading technical teams and guiding architecture decisions across multiple projects.
* Possess strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, integrations, and enterprise solution design.
* Demonstrate experience making architecture trade-offs for greenfield implementations, Salesforce org consolidation, and legacy CRM modernization.
* Have led technical design reviews, architecture decisions, and resolution of complex cross-system dependencies.
* We operate on a hybrid model. While we offer flexibility, candidates must be willing to relocate if a specific project demands it.
* Be ready to join immediately.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Solution Architecture & Design Excellence**

* Lead discovery workshops and solution-design discussions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Design scalable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom platform implementations.
* Create solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, data models, integration designs, and technical documentation.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate balance of declarative and programmatic solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance to Technical Leads and development teams.
* Multi-org architecture, scalability, licensing implications, and long-term technical debt.
* Define end-to-end solution architecture, including non-functional requirements for performance, availability, observability, maintainability, and data residency.
* Document architecture decision records, assumptions, constraints, design options, and traceability from requirements to solution components.

**2. Delivery Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own the overall solution architecture and delivery approach across concurrent Salesforce projects.
* Work closely with Technical Leads, Developers, Business Analysts, and Project Managers to ensure successful project outcomes.
* Conduct solution reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices and governance standards.
* Support estimation activities, roadmap planning, risk management, and delivery governance.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them maximize the value and capabilities of the Salesforce platform.
* Translate business requirements into solution options, effort estimates, delivery dependencies, technical risks, and phased implementation roadmaps.
* Lead technical design walkthroughs, proof-of-concepts, critical design sign-offs, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* Mentor technical leads and developers; raise engineering standards through design and code-review guidance.

**3. Integration, Governance & Platform Strategy**

* Design secure and scalable integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise applications.
* Define enterprise data models, security frameworks, sharing structures, and governance standards.
* Establish reusable solution patterns and architecture standards across projects.
* Review deployment strategies and release plans to support successful project delivery.
* Support pre-sales, solutioning, and proposal discussions where architectural expertise is required.
* Own integration patterns and interface contracts for synchronous/asynchronous APIs, events, middleware, retries, monitoring, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Define data migration strategy covering profiling, cleansing, deduplication, mapping, loading, validation, reconciliation, and cutover/rollback.
* Design Salesforce security using least privilege, sharing architecture, identity/SSO, access controls, and data protection requirements.
* Guide DevOps and release governance including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, environments, deployment, and production readiness.
* Plan integration and solution testing, performance validation, hypercare transition, and post-go-live technical stabilization.

**Technical Skills & Education**

* **Educational Background:**
  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with a strong preference for candidates from Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related Engineering backgrounds.
* **Core Salesforce Mastery:**
  10–15 years of overall experience with strong expertise in Salesforce architecture, integrations, and enterprise solution design.
* **Platform Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of object modelling, security architecture, governor limits, Flow, Apex, LWC, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* **Architecture & Integration:**
  Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms, and external applications.
* **Data Architecture & Migration:**
  Expertise in master data, data quality, large-volume data handling, migration patterns, and Salesforce data limits.
* **Security & Identity:**
  Experience with role hierarchy, sharing, permission sets, SSO/OAuth, integration security, and secure design.
* **Engineering Governance:**
  Ability to review Apex/LWC designs, asynchronous processing, test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and platform limits.
* **Architecture Deliverables:**
  Proven ownership of HLD/LLD, integration specifications, architecture decisions, NFRs, migration strategy, and cutover design.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, and AI-powered Salesforce capabilities.
* Exposure to MuleSoft or other middleware technologies.
* Experience working on enterprise digital transformation programs.
* Active involvement in Salesforce communities, user groups, or industry events.
* Experience with Revenue Cloud/CPQ, quote-to-cash, contract lifecycle management, and ERP integrations such as SAP or NetSuite.
* Exposure to event-driven architecture, enterprise integration platforms, and Salesforce platform observability.
* Experience assessing practical AI/Agentforce use cases, governance, data access, and human-in-the-loop controls.

**Other Attributes**

* Self-motivated solution leader with strong ownership and accountability.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders.
* A natural analytical thinker and problem solver who enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively, explain trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and make evidence-based architecture recommendations.
* Strong commercial awareness of delivery effort, technical risk, solution maintainability, and client value.

**Required Certifications**

* **Mandatory**
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PD1)

title: Manager – Autonomy, Navigation
description:
**Position**

Manager – Autonomy, Navigation, Communications & Shore Control

**Programme**

Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV)

**Reports to**

Program Manager – ASV

**Location**

ARI, Okhla, New Delhi, with extended periods at shipyard and coastal trial sites in India

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Experience**

10–15 years, including at least 5 years hands-on with autonomous or unmanned systems

**Travel**

Frequent domestic travel to the build yard and trial sites; occasional travel to suppliers

**Role purpose**

The Manager – Autonomy, Navigation, Communications & Shore Control is responsible for the complete lifecycle of autonomy suite for the ASV, right from Concept Design and also responsible for finalization of Autonomy requirement for the ASV, selection of sensor suite, selection of OEMs/ suppliers, plan for installation, integration and trials. He/ she will be responsible for everything that makes the vessel autonomous: the navigation and perception sensors, the autonomy computer and software, the communication links, the shore control station and the safe conduct of autonomous trials. The role holder is the single technical authority for autonomy on the programme, works closely with ARI’s team, and holds technology partners to account where they supply parts of the autonomy solution.

**Key responsibilities**

* Define the autonomy, navigation, communications and shore-control architecture, including manual, remote and autonomous modes and the handover between them.
* Select and integrate navigation and perception sensors.
* Own the autonomy software: path planning, collision avoidance, mission management and fail-safe behaviour. Where a partner supplies it, own the partner technically.
* Design the communications architecture across line-of-sight radio, cellular and satellite links, including loss-of-link behaviour.
* Specify and deliver the shore control station for monitoring, mission planning, video and remote takeover.
* Agree command, feedback and failsafe interfaces for propulsion, steering and onboard systems with the Manager – Electrical, Controls & Systems Integration.
* Agree sensor and antenna placement, power and cooling with the Manager – Platform Integration.
* Test in simulation and hardware-in-the-loop, then plan and lead autonomy trials from harbour to coastal, including trial safety arrangements and emergency stop.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Robotics, Control or Aerospace Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  10–15 years in total, including at least 5 years hands-on with autonomous or unmanned systems (USV, UUV, UAV, UGV, autonomous vehicles or robotics), or with defence command-and-control and sensor systems.
* **Ownership:**
  Has personally owned at least one autonomy or navigation system from design through to field trials.
* **Technical knowledge:**
  Working knowledge of sensor fusion, GNSS/INS, radar and AIS, real-time embedded Linux or ROS/ROS 2, radio and network links, and CAN, Ethernet and NMEA 2000 interfaces.
* **Trials:**
  Has planned and taken part in field trials of autonomous or unmanned systems, including safety arrangements.

**Desirable**

* Experience with marine or maritime unmanned systems, and working knowledge of COLREGs.
* Experience with simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Exposure to functional safety, cyber security or classification society rules for autonomous vessels.
* Experience of managing technology partners or subcontractors on a development programme.
* Experience on defence or government development programmes.

**Skills and personal attributes**

* Systems thinker who can see the whole vessel, not only the autonomy software.
* Hands-on and comfortable working at the build yard, on the quayside and at sea.
* Takes safety seriously and makes sound go/no-go decisions under time pressure.
* Clear written and spoken communication with engineers, partners, management and customers.
* Plans and delivers to milestones in a fast-moving programme.

**Typical candidate backgrounds**

Unmanned-systems and drone companies; defence electronics and C4I organisations; autonomous-vehicle and robotics firms. Former service officers with relevant unmanned-systems or sensor-integration experience are also welcome to apply.

**Working conditions**

* Based in New Delhi, with frequent travel and extended stays at the build yard and coastal trial sites.
* Sea trials involve work on small craft, outdoors and sometimes outside normal working hours.

title: Deputy Vice President - Security Engineering & Architecture
description:
**Role Purpose:**
The Security Engineering & Architecture Lead will lead the design, governance and continuous evolution of the organization cyber security architecture, engineering standards and control framework. The role is accountable for ensuring that security requirements are embedded across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, data environments and emerging technologies.

The role will act as the principal security architecture authority, enabling secure business transformation through risk-based security solutions, regulatory compliance, technology resilience and alignment with enterprise security strategy.

**Role Accountability**

**A. Security Architecture, Standards & Design Governance**

1. Define and maintain security reference architectures for network, cloud, applications, identity, data, payment platforms, APIs and digital channels.
2. Establish security design standards, approved patterns and reusable engineering blueprints aligned to enterprise risk, regulatory and internal control requirements.
3. Lead security design reviews for major initiatives, technology changes, outsourcing arrangements and third-party integrations before production go-live.
4. Own security architecture for cardholder data environments, transaction-processing systems and regulated technology platforms.

**B. Security Controls, Engineering Roadmap & Hardening**

1. Translate security control frameworks into implementable technology requirements across infrastructure, applications, cloud, identity and data environments.
2. Govern security engineering roadmaps across endpoint security, IAM/PAM, data protection, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, telemetry and cloud security.
3. Establish security baseline configurations and hardening standards, and drive enforcement through architecture reviews, automation and compliance checks.
4. Define and govern cryptography, encryption, tokenization, key management and certificate management standards across enterprise technology platforms.

**C. Secure-by-Design, Threat Modelling & Automation**

1. Drive threat modelling for critical applications, integrations and platforms, ensuring risks are documented, prioritized and tracked to closure.
2. Partner with enterprise architecture, IT, platform and engineering teams to embed security-by-design into SDLC, infrastructure builds and cloud deployments.
3. Drive adoption of automated security engineering practices, including policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security checks and automated baseline compliance.

**D. Governance, Exceptions & Continuous Improvement**

1. Maintain the security exceptions register, including expiry dates, compensating controls, risk acceptance and closure mechanisms.
2. Partner with SOC, vulnerability management and incident response teams to convert threat intelligence, incidents and recurring control failures into improved architecture patterns.
3. Ensure security architecture inputs are embedded into enterprise architecture forums, technology design authorities and change governance processes.

title: Manager - MLOps
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organisations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager – ML Ops to lead the design, development and operation of reliable, scalable and production ready machine learning platforms and workflows. The role will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers and client stakeholders to take models from experimentation to production and ensure they remain reliable, efficient, secure and well monitored.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in MLOps and cloud-native engineering, understands the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, and can lead a team while remaining hands-on in architecture, implementation and technical problem solving. Exposure to LLMOps and the deployment of Generative AI applications will be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development and implementation of end-to-end MLOps platforms, processes and deployment pipelines for machine learning solutions.
* Build and manage automated workflows for model training, testing, validation, packaging, deployment, versioning and rollback.
* Establish CI/CD and CT pipelines for ML systems, enabling repeatable releases across development, staging and production environments.
* Deploy and operate models at scale using containerization and orchestration technologies; ensure availability, performance, scalability and reliability.
* Set up monitoring for model performance, data quality, model drift, service health, latency and resource utilization, and drive timely remediation.
* Partner with data science and AI teams to productions models, improve experimentation-to-production workflows and establish reusable engineering standards.
* Build and maintain feature pipelines, data and model registries, metadata tracking, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management capabilities.
* Drive cloud infrastructure and platform practices across environments, with a focus on security, access control, cost optimization and operational resilience.
* Define and implement best practices for infrastructure such as code, observability, logging, alerting, incident management, and disaster recovery.
* Evaluate and adopt relevant tools, frameworks and architectural patterns to improve the MLOps ecosystem and developer productivity.
* Support production deployments of Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including model serving, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version management and operational controls, where applicable.
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of ML Ops and platform engineers; set technical direction, review designs and code, and contribute to hiring.
* Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and ensure successful delivery of engagements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 4–8 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, ML engineering or MLOps, with substantial hands-on experience in productionising machine learning systems.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, experimentation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
* Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation, Develop scalable ML pipelines.
* Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry, Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML EZE Paas/Saas
* Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components.
* Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated ML workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Kubeflow or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and their ML and infrastructure services.
* Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling and managing containerised workloads.
* Experience with model serving and lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, KServe, Seldon or equivalent platforms.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL, APIs and software engineering practices such as version control, testing, code reviews and documentation.
* Understanding of monitoring and observability tools and practices for applications, infrastructure, data pipelines and deployed models.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Helm or Ansible.
* Good understanding of security, networking, access management and cost optimisation in cloud-based production environments.
* At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, managing delivery and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and manage stakeholder expectations.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLMOps and production deployment of Generative AI applications, including LLM serving, evaluation, observability and performance optimisation.
* Exposure to vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and orchestration frameworks used in GenAI applications.
* Experience with feature stores, data orchestration and streaming technologies such as Feast, Airflow, Kafka or Flink.
* Experience working with financial services, banking, fintech or other regulated environments.
* Exposure to model governance, auditability, explainability and model risk management requirements.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or MLOps certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with team leadership and delivery ownership.
* Comfort working in a consulting and product-oriented environment with multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements.
* Willingness to take ownership of platform reliability and production outcomes, not just initial deployment.

description:
Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Kapzo Healthcare Private Limited | Founding Team | India**

About Kapzo

Kapzo is building a technology-driven healthcare commerce platform with a simple ambition: make medicines and healthcare essentials accessible to everyone, faster and more conveniently.

We are building a hyperlocal healthcare delivery ecosystem connecting customers, pharmacies and delivery partners through technology.

We are now looking for an exceptional technology entrepreneur to join us as
**Co-Founder & CTO**
and take ownership of our technology vision.

This is not a conventional employment opportunity.

We are looking for a technology leader who wants to build a company from the ground up, take meaningful ownership and participate in the long-term value creation of Kapzo.

The selected candidate will join the founding leadership team with a capital investment commitment of ₹10–15 lakh towards the company's growth and technology development.

* Full-time founding commitment.
* No monthly salary until institutional funding is secured.
* Initial capital investment of ₹10–15 lakh.
* Founder equity participation, with the percentage and vesting terms mutually agreed and contractually documented upfront.
* Equity issuance structured around the first institutional funding milestone, subject to applicable law.
* Proposed appointment to the company's Board of Directors with voting rights, subject to corporate approvals and legal requirements.
* The existing founder retains the controlling founder and CEO position.

**Technology & Product**

* Define and execute Kapzo's long-term technology strategy.
* Own product architecture, scalability, security and engineering standards.
* Lead development of customer, pharmacy, delivery partner and administrative platforms.
* Build reliable, scalable and high-performance systems.

* Establish development processes and technical standards.
* Own technology hiring and engineering culture.
* Manage infrastructure, deployment, cloud costs and technical operations.

* Participate in board-level discussions and decisions.
* Contribute to fundraising, investor discussions and technology due diligence.
* Build technology as a long-term competitive advantage for Kapzo.

* Strong hands-on software engineering and system architecture experience.
* Experience building and scaling consumer-facing products.
* Strong expertise in backend architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure and mobile/web applications.
* Experience leading engineering teams or founding technology ventures.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and execution capabilities.
* Financial capacity and willingness to make the proposed ₹10–15 lakh capital commitment.
* Ready to commit full-time without salary until institutional funding.

**Experience in healthcare technology, e-commerce, hyperlocal delivery or marketplace platforms will be an advantage.**

Technology environment

Our current product technology includes Flutter, Next.js and NestJS. We are looking for someone capable of evaluating, improving and scaling the existing architecture.

Why Kapzo?

* Become part of the founding leadership team.
* Build a meaningful healthcare technology business.
* Participate in long-term company ownership.
* Lead technology and engineering strategy.
* Work directly with the founder and participate in board-level governance.

Application

If you are an ambitious technology leader who wants to transition from building products for other companies to building your own company, we would love to hear from you.

3. Your technical leadership experience.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SCT-Tech Enablement - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front-end and back-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge-sharing across teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: A&R IT Platform Integration Engineer - MuleSoft/Snaplogic
description:
GCL: C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to engineer integrations that accelerate clinical development and bring medicines to patients faster? In this role, you will own and evolve our GxP-compliant A&R integration product—part of Clinical Development Platforms—used across late-stage science teams spanning all therapeutic areas. You will work at the intersection of science and technology, turning business needs into secure, scalable, API-led integrations that improve speed, quality, and confidence in study execution.
  
  
Joining a high-performing BizDevOps team, you will collaborate closely with Product Leads, DevOps Leads, and engineers to design, build, and run integrations on MuleSoft and SnapLogic. Do you see yourself simplifying complex landscapes and creating reusable patterns that others rely on? Your work will strengthen our clinical data flows, reduce incidents through automation, and ensure robust operations that stand up to regulatory scrutiny.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Clinical Integration Leadership: Serve as an internal consultant and Clinical domain authority for IT and business partners across regions and business areas; provide guidance and consulting to clients on the best use of A&R during study execution, connecting platform capabilities to study outcomes.
* Agile Discovery and Design: Participate in business requirement gathering and design activities with business and IT collaborators as part of the scrum team; translate needs into clear integration designs and handle/update the JIRA board across requirements, configuration, validation/testing, training, and release activities.
* Delivery Excellence: Perform delivery activities through Design, Build, Test, and Deploy phases for regular releases and key platform initiatives; drive small modules in support transitions and ensure application stability when taking over BAU support of new applications.
* A&R Extensions and Configuration: Design and build extensions for A&R to accommodate custom business flows; maintain configuration specification documentation for both functional and integration configuration; assist in the preparation of system-related specifications and documentation.
* Secure, Compliant Operations: Ensure that all system security and control procedures are implemented and maintained; work with the A&R technical team on requirements and issues related to SAS API, security setup, and functional configuration; operate to GxP standards across Clinical Development Platforms.
* Work in close coordination with the Integration Platform team to revise, refresh, and support integration interfaces. Develop integration pipelines based on established architectural models and compose reusable components. Partner with the Integration DevOps Lead and vendor teams to build new integrations and coordinate current ones.
* Service Reliability and Automation: Resolve day-to-day incidents and service requests, working toward incident reduction and automation; update ServiceNow for incidents, service requests, changes, and problems; maintain application systems in operation, identifying and troubleshooting application issues to minimize downtime.
* Landscape Simplification: Generate and implement ideas to simplify and streamline the integration landscape in alignment with integration design and patterns, improving delivery speed and reliability for study execution.
* CI/CD and Change Integration: Integrate CI/CD processes into existing Change and Configuration Management scope (ServiceNow and JIRA); align delivery with the IT Service Delivery Framework to ensure traceability and control.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* 6-8 years meaningful experience in clinical development and/ or software development environment preferred, with particular emphasis on SAS related applications experience.
* End to end knowledge of clinical trial development processes and its associated system landscape.
* Knowledge and experience in integration technologies – Mulesoft, Snaplogic.
* Experience with Cloud Platforms such as AWS, AZURE
* Knowledge of SQL to write queries to help understand the integration requirements to be enabled via API led integrations. within Platform.
* Knowledge of support processes like Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and experience working in support teams.
* Atleast proven experience related to API Terminologies and API Integration – preferably Mulesoft & Snaplogic
* Excellent SQL knowledge pertaining to Relational databases including RDS, Snowflake, PostGres
* Proficiency in developing, deploying, and debugging cloud-based applications using AWS.
* Ensures following IT Service Delivery Framework adhered on AD activities.
* Ability to organize and prioritize work, meets deadlines, and work independently.
* Strong problem-solving skill
* Experience with process tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with people across the globe with diverse cultures and backgrounds.
* Experience of working in agile teams using methodologies such as SCRUM, Kanban and SAFe.
* Experience in integration of CI/CD processes into existing Change & Configuration Management scope (i.e. ServiceNow & Jira)
* Educational Requirements: Bachelor or master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science or life science related rigor with IT/CRO/Pharma experience with total of 10+ years of similar experience

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* ITIL practices (organisational change, incident and problem management and others)
* Experience in GxP or SOx regulated environment
* Passion for learning, innovating and delivering valuable software to people.
* Experience with dynamic dashboards (e.g. PowerBI)
* Experience in Python programming
* Knowledge of using/creating build tools and CI/CD (maven, ant, gradle, Sonar or similar tools)
* Experience working with GITHub, Automated Testing tools
* Experience delivering or developing workshop material, training, gap analyses, or requirements gathering sessions with business and system collaborators

**Why AstraZeneca**

Your contribution will be visible and valued—our culture blends ambition with patience, encourages smart risks, and recognizes collective achievements, reflecting how much we appreciate long-term commitment and impact.

title: Senior SDET
description:
**About the Company**

Backbase powers the financial experiences of many of the world's leading banks. Our engagement banking platform helps banks unify customer data, orchestrate journeys, and deliver personalized experiences across digital channels.

**About the Role**

About the role We are building the Customer Lifetime Orchestrator — an omni-channel marketing and customer engagement platform that helps banks engage end customers and influence financial behaviour. As Senior SDET, you own quality for this domain together with the engineering team: test strategy, automation completeness, and the team's ability to execute effectively. This is a hands-on test design and automation role — not a downstream QA handoff. You will partner with Product, UX, and full-stack engineers (web, mobile, backend, AI-assisted features) to shift quality left and scale automation.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute test strategy and test plans per release (scope, risks, schedule, entry/exit criteria).
* Co-author acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios with Product; act as quality gatekeeper before releases.
* Build and maintain Playwright web E2E tests for real-world customer journeys across engagement channels.
* Govern mobile E2E strategy (Android/iOS) with engineers; use device-farm/matrix testing.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD with GitHub Actions (smoke, regression, quality gates).
* Manage test environments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Use Grafana (or similar) to analyse test results and improve feedback loops.
* Combine automation with exploratory and manual testing for edge cases; reduce flakiness and improve parallelization.
* Coach engineers on TDD, BDD, contract tests, synthetic data, and shift-left practices.
* Advocate AI-assisted testing (generation, visual regression, maintenance).

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years as SDET or hands-on QA with an automation-first mindset.
* Strong test planning and acceptance-criteria design with Product/UX.

**Required Skills**

* Playwright (web), Espresso (Android), XCUITest (iOS).
* Java and JavaScript/TypeScript; Angular SPA, mobile, microservices.
* API testing (REST, Postman, RestAssured or equivalent).
* CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), BDD/Gherkin, web and mobile E2E.
* Cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Docker/Kubernetes.
* Device/browser farms (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or equivalent).
* Git/GitHub, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
* Non-functional testing (performance, security, accessibility, localization).
* Excellent communication in distributed teams (India, Vietnam, Europe).

**Preferred Skills**

* Digital banking, martech, or campaign/engagement management.
* Performance testing (k6, Gatling, JMeter).
* SaaS or enterprise software testing experience.
* AI/ML product testing; XRay, CucumberStudio, SonarCloud, security tooling.

title: Tosca Automation Lead / Architect
description:
**Experience:**
10+ years

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office (5 days a week)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Tosca Automation Lead / Architect to design, build, and lead test automation for SAP S/4HANA and related applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca, SAP Fiori / web-based SAP applications, reusable automation design, Tosca LiveCompare, DEX Server execution, qTest integration, reporting, and Playwright with AI-assisted automation. The candidate will help improve automation coverage, execution reliability, visibility, and release readiness.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the automation strategy, framework design, standards, and roadmap for SAP S/4HANA and related applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable Tosca automation for functional, end-to-end, integration, and regression testing.
* Use Tosca LiveCompare to assess SAP changes, identify impacted test cases, and support risk-based regression selection.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot distributed test execution using Tosca DEX Server, including execution planning, agents, scheduling, and results monitoring.
* Integrate Tosca with qTest and other relevant tools for test management, execution tracking, defect management, CI/CD, and reporting.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for automation coverage, execution status, pass/fail trends, defects, failures, risks, and release readiness.
* Create reusable Tosca modules, components, test data approaches, and templates to support repeatable testing across stores, locations, and configuration variations.
* Assess SAP Fiori and web-based SAP application behavior and select appropriate Tosca automation approaches.
* Lead automation planning for regression cycles, releases, and deployment waves; coordinate with SAP functional, QE, and business teams.
* Review automation assets, troubleshoot failures, improve stability, and establish standards for maintainability, reuse, and execution efficiency.
* Evaluate Playwright-based automation and help define where Tosca and Playwright are best suited, including integration into the broader QE approach.
* Apply AI-assisted testing capabilities with Playwright, including AI-supported test design and generation, script creation, failure analysis, locator recovery or self-healing where appropriate, and agentic workflows.
* Evaluate opportunities to connect AI-driven workflows with MCP, LLM-based tools, or other approved AI capabilities while maintaining human review, security, and traceability.
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Engineering / test automation, including substantial hands-on Tosca experience.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale automation using Tricentis Tosca.
* Practical experience with Tosca LiveCompare for change-impact analysis and regression test selection.
* Experience configuring and supporting Tosca DEX Server and distributed execution.
* Experience integrating Tosca with qTest and other test management, defect tracking, CI/CD, or reporting tools.
* Experience developing automation dashboards and reports and interpreting execution and quality metrics.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA testing and SAP Fiori or other web-based SAP applications.
* Strong knowledge of test strategy, automation architecture, reusable design, regression testing, test data, defect management, and release readiness.
* Experience with Playwright and an understanding of how to design and maintain web automation.
* Practical exposure to AI-assisted automation with Playwright or other AI-enabled testing workflows.
* Ability to lead a team, communicate with technical and functional stakeholders, and explain automation decisions clearly.

***Why QualiZeal?***

* **Award-Winning Workplace**
  : Certified as a
  *Great Place to Work®*
  and recognized by ET NOW as the
  *Best Organization for Women*
  in 2025.
* **Proven Engagement:**

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Associate-Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve:
**TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.**

title: MES Consultant – PSI Métal Quality Management
description:
**MES Consultant – PSI Métal Quality Management**

**Experience:**
5–8 years

**Role Purpose**

The MES Consultant will analyze, configure, develop, implement, and support Manufacturing Execution System solutions for steel quality management, with a primary focus on PSI Metals Quality and Deviation Management.

The role combines strong steel manufacturing process knowledge with hands-on Oracle PL/SQL expertise and supports global rollout projects, system integration, production support, and continuous improvement.

**Key Accountabilities**

Functional and Solution Delivery

• Analyze business requirements and translate steel quality-management processes into functional MES solution designs.

• Configure PSI Metals Quality and Deviation Management functions, including inspection, non-conformance, traceability, certification, rework, and sample-management processes.

• Facilitate workshops with business, quality, production, and IT stakeholders to validate requirements, process flows, and solution scope.

• Prepare functional specifications, process models, configuration documentation, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.

• Coordinate and support system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, including defect analysis and resolution follow-up.

• Support deployment, cutover, user training, hyper care, and continuous improvement to ensure effective solution adoption.

**Technical Delivery and Application Support**

• Develop and maintain Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, queries, and reports.

• Perform data analysis, troubleshooting, database optimization, and SQL performance tuning for large production environments.

• Design, implement, monitor, and troubleshoot interfaces between PSI Metals and external applications.

• Delivery system enhancements, bug fixes, controlled deployments, technical documentation, and

knowledge transfer.

• Support incident, problem, change, release, and production-support processes in line with agreed service levels and governance controls.

• Contribute to global rollout waves across heterogeneous IT landscapes, initially in Europe.

• Support ServiceDesk and BAU Teams for our 24/7 Application as Domain expert in critical incidents.

**Project and Stakeholder Responsibilities**

• Act as expert when required, review solution and project documentation, and guide resolution of technical issues.

• Present the work done and its value to business value to clients and stakeholders.

• Provide clear inputs for effort and cost estimates and work with delivery teams to optimize value.

• Contribute technical content to statements of work and support procurement and legal teams with contractual documentation.

• Work effectively across global, multicultural teams and manage priorities independently under demanding deadlines.

**Mandatory Qualifications and Experience**

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, Computer Applications, Computer Science, or a comparable discipline.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience in MES consulting, implementation, development, or application support.

• Strong end-to-end understanding of steel manufacturing and steel quality processes.

• Hands-on experience with quality control, inspection, non-conformance, deviation, traceability,

certification, rework, and sample-management processes.

• Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development skills, including troubleshooting and performance tuning.

• Experience in requirements analysis, solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.

• Customer-facing communication and workshop facilitation skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

• Hands-on knowledge of PSI Metals Quality, Deviation, Rework, and Sample Management modules.

• Understanding of the PSI Metals data model, factory model, service framework, integration concepts, configuration, and customization.

• Experience with another Level 3 MES platform used in steel manufacturing, such as SMS, Danieli, ABB

Ability, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Siemens Opcenter, GE Digital Proficy, or a comparable custom solution.

• Knowledge of Linux, Java, Oracle database administration, monitoring, APIs, middleware, or message-based integration.

• Experience with Power BI, Qlik, or Azure/cloud data-integration solutions.

• Experience in global rollouts, Agile or Waterfall delivery, ITIL processes, commercial estimation, or technical presales.

• Additional European language skills are an advantage.

**Behavioural Competencies**

• Structured analytical thinking and a strong problem-solving mindset.

• Ability to translate between business processes and technical solutions.

• Clear communication, stakeholder management, and collaborative working style.

• Ownership, adaptability, and the ability to priorities independently.

• Commitment to quality, security, documentation, and continuous improvement.

**Personality and Working Style**

• Open-minded and culturally aware, with the ability to work effectively within the Indian team and collaborate respectfully with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders from different countries and cultural backgrounds.

• Inspires confidence through strong expertise and consistently exceeds expectations with a proactive, collaborative, and value-focused working style.

• A clear, confident, and respectful communicator who listens actively, adapts communication to the audience, and shares information transparently.

• A reliable team player who contributes constructively, supports colleagues, builds trust, and works toward shared project goals.

• Maintains professional, constructive, and solution-oriented behavior throughout changing and demanding project phases.

• Takes end-to-end ownership of assigned responsibilities, keeps tasks, commitments, risks, and dependencies under control, and communicates progress or concerns early.

• Works proactively and independently, anticipates issues, proposes practical solutions, and seeks alignment when decisions or escalation are required.

• Demonstrate adaptability, resilience, accountability, and sound judgement when priorities, timelines, or project conditions change.

**Success Measures**

• Solutions meet agreed business requirements, quality standards, and delivery milestones.

• Incidents and defects are resolved within agreed service levels, with effective root-cause prevention.

• Interfaces, database components, and production services operate reliably and perform efficiently.

• Documentation, testing evidence, and knowledge transfer are complete and reusable.

• Stakeholders report strong collaboration, transparency, and solution adoption.

**What We Offer**

A modern, dynamic, and fast-paced environment with opportunities for professional growth.

• Highly skilled colleagues in a multicultural and international organization.

• A strong focus on personal development, knowledge exchange, continuous improvement, and teamwork.

• Close collaboration with the business as a respected and valuable technology partner.

**Working Conditions**

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

• Domestic and international travel is required based on project milestones and business needs, including travel to European locations.

• The role requires planned working-hour overlap with Central European Time while remaining aligned with India Standard Time.

• Expected availability to join within 60 days.

Unit No. 15, Ground Floor, E Wing, Phase - I, Akshar Business Park, Sector - 25, Vashi- 400703.

Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (work from office, full-time)

Experience: 4–6 years (minimum 4) managing custom software development accounts

Reports to: Director of Sales

Salary: ₹10–15 LPA fixed + monthly performance incentives

Hours: Day shift. Evening hours are mandatory on some days to overlap with US clients.

**About Arcitech.ai**
---------------------

Arcitech.ai is an AI-native business automation company. We design, build and manage custom production software for enterprises across the US, UAE and India, in manufacturing, mining, pharma, education, hospitality and contact centres. We also build AI products including ProSchool.ai, Haire.ai and BPObox. Most of our client relationships are long-term development and managed-services engagements, so account management is central to how we grow.

**The Role**
------------

You'll own a portfolio of custom software development accounts end to end. You'll understand what each client needs, translate it into clear requirements for our development team, and make sure it's delivered on time and to the client's satisfaction.

On your accounts, you act as the product owner. You lead the discovery calls, own the requirements through the full development lifecycle, and keep the client and the engineering team aligned at every stage.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Discovery & requirements: Run discovery calls with clients to understand their business, workflows and goals. Turn these into clear, prioritised requirements for the development team.
* Product ownership: Own the requirements on your accounts from kickoff to go-live and beyond. This includes clarifying scope, prioritising the backlog, managing change requests, and reviewing deliveries against what the client asked for.
* Delivery coordination: Work daily with PMs, developers, testers and tech leads so that what's built matches what's needed, and lands when it was promised.
* Client reporting: Send weekly and monthly progress reports to every client, on time, in clear business language.
* Issue handling: Acknowledge client issues immediately and log them in Zoho Desk. Update clients daily on open items and escalate early when anything stalls.

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

OpenGov’s Professional Services (PS) team delivers configurable, scalable solutions to state and local governments using Government App Builder (GAB) — OpenGov’s proprietary low-code/no-code application development platform.

As a Business Application Developer III, you will design, configure, and enhance customer or business specific applications using platform capabilities, configuration, data modeling, workflow automation, and limited scripting.

You will split your time between:

* Designing and configuring business applications using Government App Builder
* Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to translate business processes into scalable, automated solutions

This role is ideal for a technically strong problem solver who understands data modeling, workflow logic, and business process design — but does not require heavy full-stack engineering in frameworks such as React, NodeJS, or Java. You will play a key role in delivering high-impact solutions that modernize government operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Configuration & Solution Design**

* Partner with customers and implementation teams to understand operational workflows and system requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable application designs within Government App Builder.
* Configure entities, forms, fields, validations, permissions, dashboards, and reports.
* Apply structured configuration standards to ensure usability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Participate in validation sessions and backlog refinement to align configuration with scope.

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design structured data models including entity relationships and cross-table references.
* Apply data modeling best practices including normalization, denormalization trade-offs, and referential integrity.
* Configure field-level validations and data constraints to ensure data quality.
* Support data migrations including field mapping, data transformation, and validation of imported records.
* Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and recommend corrective design patterns.

**Workflow & Process Automation**

* Configure approval workflows, routing logic, conditional triggers, and status transitions.
* Implement task assignments, notification rules, and automation components.
* Translate documented decision trees and business rules into platform logic.
* Optimize workflows for compliance, accountability, and audit transparency.
* Ensure scalability of workflows across departments and user roles.

**Business Rule Implementation & Light Scripting**

* Implement conditional logic using platform configuration tools.
* Write limited JavaScript (or similar scripting) for:
* Complex validations
* Calculations and derived fields
* Conditional routing
* Data transformation logic
* Maintain clean, reusable logic patterns without overengineering or heavy custom code.

**Integrations & Interoperability**

* Configure and validate integrations between Government App Builder and external systems (e.g., ERP, financial systems).
* Support API-based, file-based, event-based or scheduled data exchange patterns.
* Design field mappings and transformation logic to ensure data consistency across systems.
* Document integration patterns and reusable configuration standards.

**Embedded Delivery Support**

* Serve as a technical configuration specialist within active customer implementations.
* Partner with Project Managers and Implementation Consultants to deliver configured solutions on time and within scope.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues during UAT and go-live phases.
* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to Customer Success teams.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Contribute technical effort estimates for configuration and automation tasks.
* Manage work across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Ensure timely delivery of configured applications within broader project timelines.
* Maintain high standards of quality, documentation, and responsiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Total 5 to 9 years of work experience, including
  **3+ years of experience in low-code/no-code platforms**
  (e.g., Appian, Microsoft Power Apps, Mendix, ServiceNow, etc.) or enterprise application configuration roles.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts like entity relationships, referential integrity, normalization, and denormalization.
* Experience designing and implementing business workflows and approval automation.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or similar scripting language for implementing business rules.
* Ability to translate complex business processes into structured, configurable application logic.
* Experience with integrations (REST APIs, file-based transfers, event based workflows or batch processes).
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and embedding outputs into larger application workflows.
* Strong understanding of security standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Strong analytical thinking with systems and process-improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven success working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in GovTech or public-sector workflows (budgeting, grants management, procurement, capital planning, permitting, capital project management etc.).
* Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing implementation roles.
* Familiarity with security concepts such as role-based access control and data governance practices.

**Why Join OpenGov Professional Services**

You will help modernize government operations by designing configurable, scalable applications that replace spreadsheets, manual workflows, and disconnected systems. As part of our Professional Services team, you will:

* Build impactful solutions without heavy custom engineering overhead.
* Shape best practices for Government App Builder implementations.
* Collaborate with the platform engineering team for improving and enhancing the platform for required capabilities.
* Work with mission-driven teams serving state and local governments.
* Develop expertise in workflow automation, structured data modeling, and enterprise configuration at scale.

This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. **ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions
