title: Designer - UX
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

United's Digital Technology team designs, develops, and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

**Our Values**

At United Airlines, we believe that inclusion propels innovation and is the foundation of all that we do. Our Shared Purpose, **“Connecting people. Uniting the world.”**, drives us to be the best airline for our employees, customers, and everyone we serve. We can only achieve that with a truly diverse and inclusive workforce.

Our team spans the globe and brings together diverse individuals working with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation.

With multiple employee-run Business Resource Group communities and world-class benefits such as health insurance, parental leave, and space-available travel, United is a one-of-a-kind place to work. Come join our team and help us make a positive impact on the world.

**Job Overview and Responsibilities**

The **UX Designer** will be an integral part of the **CoreUX IKC design team**, creating thoughtful, intuitive, accessible, and scalable digital experiences across United's customer-facing ecosystem, including **united.com, the United app, and mobile web experiences**.

This role combines strong **product and interaction design capabilities** with knowledge of **design systems, modern Figma workflows, design tokens, prototyping, research, accessibility, and emerging AI-enabled design practices**.

At its core, this role will transform unmet user needs and business opportunities into successful product experiences while helping evolve the shared design foundations that enable United's digital products to scale consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product & Experience Design:** Collaborate with product managers, researchers, developers, business stakeholders, and other designers to understand customer and business needs and translate them into intuitive digital product experiences.
* **User-Centered Design:** Apply user-centered and systems-thinking approaches to transform complex customer journeys and unmet needs into simple, effective, and scalable solutions.
* **Interaction & UI Design:** Create user flows, journey concepts, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs that clearly communicate design intent and demonstrate strong interaction and visual design thinking.
* **Research & Analytics:** Conduct and leverage qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, customer feedback, competitive analysis, and product analytics to identify pain points, validate concepts, and inform design decisions.
* **Testing & Iteration:** Build prototypes, conduct usability testing, gather feedback, and continuously iterate designs based on research findings, business requirements, usability insights, and analytics.
* **Design Systems:** Contribute to the evolution and adoption of United's design system by creating and applying reusable components, patterns, guidelines, and scalable design foundations.
* **Variables & Design Tokens:** Understand and apply **Figma Variables and design-token concepts**, including color, typography, spacing, themes, and other foundations, to support consistency and scalability across digital products.
* **Advanced Prototyping:** Use Figma's advanced prototyping capabilities to create realistic, interactive experiences for validating customer journeys, product concepts, and complex interactions.
* **AI-Enabled Design:** Explore and apply **AI-powered tools and emerging design workflows** to accelerate ideation, prototyping, content exploration, research synthesis, and design iteration while maintaining appropriate design quality and oversight.
* **Accessibility:** Design experiences aligned with **WCAG accessibility standards** and work with design and engineering partners to incorporate accessibility throughout the design process, from foundational styles and components through final product experiences.
* **Responsive & Multi-Platform Design:** Create responsive experiences and understand how components and interaction patterns need to adapt across desktop, mobile web, and native application environments.
* **Design-to-Development Collaboration:** Partner closely with engineering teams to understand technical constraints and ensure design specifications, component behavior, responsive patterns, and interactions are translated effectively into production.
* **Data-Informed Design:** Use analytics and product performance data to understand the effectiveness of design solutions and identify opportunities for continued improvement.
* **Design System Adoption & Consistency:** Help teams appropriately use established design-system components and patterns while identifying opportunities for new or improved patterns when existing solutions do not adequately address customer needs.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Clearly communicate design concepts, rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations to designers, engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* **Design Quality:** Maintain a high level of craft and attention to detail across interaction design, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, responsive behavior, accessibility, and overall experience quality.

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Bachelor's degree or **4 years of relevant professional experience** in place of a degree, or equivalent proven work experience.
* **3+ years of UX, Product Design, Interaction Design, or related industry experience.**
* A strong portfolio demonstrating the **design process as well as final outcomes**, including examples such as sketches, workflows, user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, interaction models, high-fidelity UI, and shipped experiences.
* Strong proficiency in **Figma**, including components, Auto Layout, prototyping, libraries, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Experience creating and working with **reusable components and design systems**.
* Working knowledge of **Figma Variables, design tokens, styles, themes, and scalable design-system concepts**.
* Strong understanding of **interaction design, responsive design, common UX patterns, information hierarchy, user behavior, and user-centered design principles**.
* Experience conducting or partnering on **user research and usability testing**, and the ability to translate research insights into design decisions.
* Familiarity with quantitative product data and the ability to use **analytics and customer feedback** to evaluate and improve experiences.
* Ability to create sophisticated, polished UI designs from concept through execution while maintaining consistency with established design standards.
* Familiarity with **WCAG accessibility standards** and applying accessibility principles to digital product design.
* Understanding of how design decisions translate into **HTML/CSS, responsive layouts, components, and front-end implementation**. Coding expertise is not required, but strong technical literacy and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers are expected.
* Experience with or demonstrated interest in **AI-assisted design, generative AI, and AI-enabled prototyping workflows**.
* Ability to clearly articulate **design decisions, customer problems, trade-offs, and the rationale behind proposed solutions**.
* Strong verbal, written, visual, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with product managers, developers, researchers, designers, and business stakeholders in a collaborative environment.
* Ability to thrive in a **fast-paced, iterative environment**, manage multiple priorities, and remain receptive to feedback.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to solve complex problems creatively and effectively.
* Maintain a consistent **user-centered perspective** while balancing customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, accessibility, and scalability.
* Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship.
* Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualifications.
* Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on **large-scale consumer digital products** across web and mobile platforms.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining an **enterprise-scale design system**.
* Experience using **Figma Variables and tokens** to support themes, modes, responsive experiences, or multiple digital platforms.
* Familiarity with the relationship between **design tokens, Figma libraries, coded components, and engineering implementation**.
* Experience collaborating with developers around **component libraries or documentation environments**.
* Experience using **AI tools within UX/design workflows** for ideation, prototyping, research synthesis, content creation, or workflow acceleration.
* Experience designing complex customer journeys involving multiple touchpoints, states, edge cases, and responsive behaviors.
* Experience using research, experimentation, usability insights, and analytics to demonstrate the **customer or business impact of design decisions**.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)
  
  
**Department:**
Technology
  
  
**Reports to:**
CTO
  
  
**Required experience:**
8+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India-Remote
  
  
**Company Introduction**
As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021- 2025) with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4.4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Genea is looking for a Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming) to lead the team building Genea Video, our cloud-native video solution built directly into the Genea security platform alongside access control and visitor management. Genea Video lets customers connect compatible RTSP cameras through the Genea Gateway (an on-site NVIDIA Jetson appliance that runs AI at the edge) or stream supported Axis cameras straight to the cloud. Customers can then watch live view and recorded playback, build camera walls, search across every camera with AI, and see the door and badge event behind every clip. You will own the engineering of this video streaming pipeline end to end, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search, and participate in the full SDLC from system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid engineering role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, building high quality, high performance software alongside a great team.
  
  
**What you would do, day-to-day?**

* Lead and grow the team building Genea Video, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search.
* Have a keen eye on code quality, with scalability, maintainability and readability in mind.
* Have a solution-oriented mindset and design high-load, low-latency video streaming systems that scale across thousands of cameras and locations.
* Estimate and delegate work across streaming, edge (Genea Gateway) and web/mobile client workstreams.
* Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team’s goals.
* Drive the design, strategy, and execution of video projects that support the Genea Video roadmap, including live view, recorded playback, camera walls, clip export and camera management.
* Lead the architecture of the video pipeline: RTSP ingest through the Genea Gateway, Axis Camera-to-Cloud streaming, transcoding, adaptive delivery, storage and retention.
* Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams working on Genea Video.
* Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for engineering and operational excellence, including stream reliability, latency, uptime and cost per camera. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessing goals and improving deliveries.
* Lead SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features, such as AI-powered search and security automations, and to fix prior mistakes.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and the Access Control and Visitor Management teams to link video to door and badge events and deliver one unified platform experience.
* Implement a data-driven approach to execution to drive transparency, and partner with DevOps and Support to keep video services reliable around the clock.

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture.
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies such as Go, Python or C++.
* Hands-on experience with video streaming technologies and protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS/DASH and RTMP, and with video codecs such as H.264 and H.265.
* Experience building or managing media pipelines for live and recorded video: ingest, transcoding, adaptive bitrate delivery, recording, storage and retention (for example, with FFmpeg or GStreamer).
* Experience with edge computing and on-device AI/computer vision. Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded platforms is a plus.
* Understanding of IP camera ecosystems (RTSP, ONVIF, Axis) and VMS/NVR concepts, and of video security use cases such as video linked to access control events.
* Experience designing for low latency, high throughput and cost-efficient storage, with observability for stream health (uptime, latency, dropped frames).
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript-based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc. Experience building browser-based video players and live view/playback interfaces is a plus.
* Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
* Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable.
* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
* Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call.
* Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed.
* Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
* Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies.
* Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels.
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious.
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.

**Competencies**

* Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

**Perks & Benefits**
✨ Work Your Way: Enjoy a flexible working environment that suits your lifestyle.
  
  
✨ Time Off: 24 days of PTO and 10 holidays to unwind and pursue your passions.
  
  
✨ Comprehensive Leave Options: Including maternity, paternity, adoption, wedding, and bereavement leaves to support you during important life events.
  
  
✨ Health & Safety First: Benefit from family health insurance and personal accident coverage beyond your CTC.
  
  
✨ Top Workplace Honors: Celebrated as a Top Workplace from 2021 to 2025.
  
  
✨ Balanced Workweek: Embrace a balanced life with our 5-day work schedule

title: Senior Technical Architect
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced
**Technical Architect**
/
**Senior Technical Architect**
to lead the architecture and technical direction of our platform. This role is ideal for a hands-on technology leader who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, mentoring teams, and building scalable cloud-native products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Architecture**

* Define and own the overall technical architecture for MADTECH.AI's cloud-native multi-tenant SaaS platform. Design scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available distributed systems capable of supporting enterprise workloads.
* Architect multi-tenant solutions with tenant isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), feature management, licensing, subscription management, and usage metering.
* Define architecture principles, engineering standards, technical guidelines, design patterns, and best practices.
* Establish architecture governance through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), design reviews, technical standards, and governance processes.
* Drive technical decision-making and evaluate architectural trade-offs across engineering initiatives.
* Lead technology evaluations and recommend modern technologies aligned with business strategy.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives while reducing technical debt and improving long-term maintainability.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Design and implement enterprise-grade cloud-native architectures on AWS.
* Architect cloud-native applications leveraging services such as: Amazon EKS, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Redshift, DynamoDB, SNS/SQS,EventBridge, CloudFront, WAF, ElastiCache, Secrets, Cognito, CloudWatch, etc.,
* Build highly available, fault-tolerant, disaster recovery-ready architectures across cloud environments.
* Design scalable infrastructure supporting high availability, business continuity, disaster recovery, and automated failover.
* Optimize cloud architecture for scalability, reliability, security, operational excellence, and cost efficiency.

**Application Engineering**

* Lead architecture and design of modern cloud-native microservices-based applications.
* Define API-first architecture principles and service-oriented design standards.
* Establish engineering standards for Python, React, Node.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, and modern backend technologies.
* Define reusable software architecture patterns, coding standards, and engineering governance.
* Guide engineering teams in building highly maintainable, extensible, testable, and performant applications.
* Establish secure API lifecycle management, versioning, documentation (OpenAPI), OAuth2 authentication, rate limiting, and API governance.
* Drive adoption of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven architecture, CQRS, and scalable integration patterns where appropriate.

**Data Engineering & Analytics**

* Architect enterprise-scale cloud-native data platforms supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Design modern Data Lake, Lakehouse, and analytical data warehouse architectures.
* Architect scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming pipelines, and reverse ETL solutions.
* Design robust enterprise data models optimized for analytics, AI workloads, reporting, and self-service analytics.
* Work with PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, NoSQL databases, Redis, and distributed data stores.
* Optimize large-scale analytical workloads for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Enable high-performance data access supporting AI, reporting, and advanced marketing analytics.

**Integration & iPaaS**

* Design scalable enterprise integration frameworks using REST APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and asynchronous processing.
* Build reusable integration services and connectors using iPaaS principles.
* Lead integrations with MarTech, AdTech, CRM, CDP, ERP, and third-party marketing platforms.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient integration architectures.
* Establish API lifecycle management, integration governance, versioning strategies, and developer standards.
* Design reusable connector frameworks supporting rapid onboarding of new data sources and destinations.

**AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Partner with AI/ML teams to integrate predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities throughout the platform.
* Design AI-native application architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and intelligent workflows.
* Architect scalable AI orchestration frameworks using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and modern AI tooling where appropriate.
* Design AI governance frameworks covering model deployment, observability, security, scalability, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.
* Support deployment and lifecycle management of production AI models through scalable MLOps practices.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and drive adoption where they create measurable business value.

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure platform architecture follows Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles.
* Design secure authentication, authorization, RBAC, encryption, secrets management, secure API practices, and identity management.
* Implement cloud security best practices across AWS services.
* Collaborate with Security teams to meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and other regulatory compliance requirements.
* Drive threat modeling, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, and security architecture reviews.
* Promote secure coding practices and proactive risk mitigation across engineering teams.

**DevOps & Engineering Excellence**

* Champion CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), automated testing, deployment automation, and release management.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and modern deployment pipelines.
* Drive Platform Engineering initiatives to improve developer experience through self-service infrastructure, reusable platform components, and internal developer tooling.
* Improve platform observability using OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, and New Relic.
* Define Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), operational metrics, and platform reliability standards.
* Lead architecture reviews, design documentation, performance optimization, capacity planning, and engineering governance.

**Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, technical leads, and senior engineers.
* Drive architecture strategy and long-term technology roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Guide solution design, technology selection, and architectural trade-offs.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering Leadership, AI/Data Science, DevOps, Security, and Customer Success teams.
* Participate in product roadmap planning and strategic technology decisions.
* Lead architecture review boards, technical governance forums, and engineering design reviews.
* Mentor engineers on software architecture, cloud-native design, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.
* Represent engineering in executive discussions, customer technical engagements, and strategic architecture planning.
* Foster a culture of innovation, engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in solution/application architecture.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale multi-tenant B2B SaaS platforms.
* Strong experience designing cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and scalable system design.
* Strong programming knowledge in Python and experience with modern frontend technologies such as React.
* Expertise in REST APIs, GraphQL, API Gateway, and integration architecture.
* Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake, and NoSQL databases.
* Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks and large-scale data platforms.
* Experience working with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration.
* Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience implementing secure application architecture and cloud security best practices.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make pragmatic architectural trade-offs between scalability, reliability, security, performance, cost, time-to-market and maintainability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional) or equivalent certification.
* Experience with Marketing Analytics, MarTech, AdTech, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), or Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
* Exposure to AI/ML platforms, LLMs, Generative AI, and MLOps.
* Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis.
* Familiarity with observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or Datadog.
* Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum product organizations.

**Why Join MADTECH.AI?**

* Build a cutting-edge AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence platform.
* Solve large-scale data, analytics, and cloud engineering challenges.
* Work alongside experienced AI, Data Science, Product, and Engineering leaders.
* Influence product architecture and technology strategy from the ground up.
* Be part of a fast-growing, innovation-driven global SaaS organization.

**About MADTECH.AI**

MADTECH.AI is the Decision Intelligence platform for mission-driven organizations and their partners.

Eliminate the burden of data wrangling, model building, data visualization, and optimization in one cost-effective AI-powered hub. By delivering sharper, on-demand insights, predictions, recommendations, and proactive problem-solving, the platform reduces data complexity empowering clients to make smarter, data-driven decisions faster and more affordably.

Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, U.S.A. with global capability centers in Mysuru and Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, MADTECH.AI proudly offers platform support and Professional Services staffed with proven specialists who save clients money, time and achieve transparent, accountable performance while delivering extraordinary value.

**Media Architect (Streaming and Gaming).**

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Roadmap Guidance:**
  Aligning product development with current and future industry trends (e.g., cloud gaming, interactive streaming, AI-driven personalization).
* **Technical Architecture Review:**
  Advising on content delivery networks (CDNs), video encoding/decoding (like AV1, HEVC), low-latency streaming protocols (WebRTC, LL-HLS), and cloud infrastructure optimized for massive scale.
* **Monetization Strategy:**
  Evaluating and optimizing revenue models, including AVOD (ad-supported), SVOD (subscription), TVOD (transactional), free ad-supported streaming TV (FAST), and gaming microtransactions.
* **Compliance & Digital Rights:**
  Navigating global regulations (GDPR, COPPA) and implementing robust Digital Rights Management (DRM) systems like Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady to protect intellectual property.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Serving as the connective tissue between software engineers, product managers, marketing teams, and content creators to ensure project success.

**Areas of Deep Expertise**

* **Streaming Media Infrastructure:**
  Deep understanding of video ingestion, encoding pipelines, adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming, and minimizing glass-to-glass latency for live events.
* **Gaming Ecosystems:**
  Knowledge of game engine integrations (Unity, Unreal Engine), cross-platform multiplayer architecture, anti-cheat mechanisms, and the shift toward cloud gaming platforms (like Xbox Cloud Gaming or PlayStation Plus).
* **Data Analytics & User Experience:**
  Utilizing Quality of Service (QoS) and Quality of Experience (QoE) metrics to reduce churn, optimize recommendations, and maximize viewer/player engagement.

**Technical & Infrastructure Skills**

* **Video Engineering & Pipelines:**
  Deep knowledge of video codecs (
  **AV1, HEVC/H.265, H.264, VVC**
  ) and processing pipelines (transcoding, rendering, packaging).
* **Streaming Protocols:**
  Mastery of industry-standard delivery protocols including
  **WebRTC, SRT, LL-HLS, and MPEG-DASH**
  to achieve low to ultra-low latency.
* **Content Delivery Networks (CDNs):**
  Expertise in configuring, routing, caching, and optimizing global CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly) for high-concurrency live events.
* **Gaming Infrastructure:**
  Understanding of multiplayer networking architecture, authoritative game servers, matchmakers, tick rates, and anti-cheat systems.
* **Cloud & Edge Computing:**
  Architecture experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) utilizing specialized media services (e.g., AWS Elemental) and edge compute to reduce player/viewer ping.
* **Digital Rights Management (DRM):**
  Implementation of multi-DRM ecosystems including
  **Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady**
  alongside watermarking technologies.

**Product & Monetization Skills**

* **Video Monetization Tech (AdTech):**
  Deep familiarity with
  **SSAI (Server-Side Ad Insertion)**
  and
  **CSAI (Client-Side Ad Insertion)**
  , programmatic advertising, and VAST/VMAP protocols.
* **Gaming Economics:**
  Understanding of live-ops, virtual economies, microtransactions (DLCs, battle passes, gacha mechanisms), and player retention loops.
* **Subscription Architecture:**
  Designing flexible billing configurations across multi-tiered monetization models:
  **FAST (Free Ad-Supported TV), AVOD, SVOD, and Hybrid models**
  .

**Data & Performance Analytics**

* **QoE & QoS Management:**
  Tracking and diagnosing critical Quality of Experience (QoE) and Quality of Service (QoS) telemetry such as
  **Video Start Time (VST), buffering ratios, bitrate drops, frame drops, and round-trip time (RTT)**
  .
* **Behavioral Analytics:**
  Utilizing data platforms to track player/viewer engagement metrics, churn prediction patterns, and content consumption habits.

**Compliance & Industry Standards**

* **Regulatory Frameworks:**
  Navigating global content, data, and youth regulations like
  **GDPR, COPPA, and CCPA**
  .
* **Accessibility Standards:**
  Ensuring platform compliance with regulatory mandates like the
  **CVAA**
  (Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act) for closed captioning and audio descriptions.

**Education Background**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering (with a focus on digital signal processing/video), or a highly quantitative, related technical field.**

**Core Professional Experience**

* **15+ years of total software engineering or infrastructure experience, with a minimum of 5+ years specifically architecting large-scale media, streaming, or multiplayer gaming ecosystems.**
* **Proven track record of operating at scale: Experience designing systems that have successfully handled millions of concurrent viewers or players (e.g., major live sports events, viral game launches, global OTT rollouts).**
* **Cross-Domain Mastery: Direct experience bridging the gap between video pipelines (ingestion to playback) and gaming systems (live-ops, low-latency telemetry).**

title: Principal Architect
description:
**What will you own?**

* Own the architecture of RockED’s full stack: Node.js backend services, React web apps, React Native mobile apps, data layer and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable, resilient, maintainable systems with clear service boundaries, API contracts and data models.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, and document key decisions and trade-offs so the whole team understands the “why.”

**Zero-to-one builds and system evolution**

* Build new systems and products from scratch, from first design to production rollout.
* Lead major system redesigns and migrations, evolving the platform without disrupting users.
* Pay down tech debt strategically, knowing when to refactor, when to rebuild and when to leave it alone.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Write production code across the stack every week. This isn’t a “slides and diagrams” architect role.
* Build core business logic, APIs and data pipelines, and design relational database schemas for integrity, security and fast retrieval.
* Own features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring.

**Performance and user experience at scale**

* Make our apps fast, from API response times and database query optimisation to mobile app performance and front-end rendering.
* Build with the end user in mind: smooth, reliable and responsive experiences on every device.
* Set up observability (logging, monitoring and tracing) so problems are caught before users notice them.

**AI-native architecture**

* Define how AI fits into the platform, including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents and intelligent features that make learning more personal.
* Prototype quickly, measure honestly, and take AI from hackathon idea to production-grade feature.
* Lead AI-assisted development in engineering: AI coding tools, automated testing and code review.

**Technical influence and standards**

* Build agreement on architecture decisions through clear thinking and strong communication, not authority.
* Explain complex trade-offs simply to engineers, product managers and leadership alike.
* Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, and raise the technical bar across the team.
* Work closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well-built products and shape the technical roadmap.

**What do you bring?**

* 10–13 years of software engineering experience, with significant time at high-growth, product-based startups.
* Proven experience building systems from zero to one and leading major architecture and design changes.
* Prior work on B2C applications where performance and user experience mattered.

**Technical depth (must-have)**

* Extensive hands-on expertise in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem: Node.js on the backend; React and React Native on the frontend.
* Strong command of relational databases: schema design, query optimisation, indexing and data integrity.
* Solid system design: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design (REST/GraphQL) and caching strategies.
* Strong engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), code quality and secure coding practices (OWASP).
* Experience with Sequelize, MongoDB and AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3).
* Experience with mobile-first products and app performance tuning.

**AI expertise (must-have)**

* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and AI APIs.
* A forward-looking view of where AI is heading, and how to architect for it.
* Daily use of AI tools in your own engineering workflow.

**Who you are**

* Geeky and curious: you read engineering blogs for fun, try every new tool, and are always learning.
* A builder at heart: you’d rather ship than talk about shipping.
* An influencer, not a manager: you lead through expertise and earn trust through good decisions.
* A clear communicator: you make complex ideas simple and trade-offs obvious.
* Experimental and resilient: you try bold ideas, learn quickly from what doesn’t work, and see things through to completion.

**Why leaders choose RockED**

* Architect at the source: shape the technical foundation of a platform used across the US automotive industry.
* An AI-first playground: leadership backing to experiment with and ship AI features, plus regular AI hackathons. [Add hackathon highlights and AI projects.]
* A real seat at the table: work directly with RockED's founders and US leadership. Your voice shapes company strategy, not just engineering execution.
* A proven business to scale: 10,000+ dealerships, 60,000+ learners and 11M+ lesson completions. You'll be scaling a business with established product-market fit.
* Global leadership exposure: lead across US and India teams, and build your profile as a leader of global product engineering.
* A team worth leading: engineers from IIT and ISB, and alumni of Adobe, Microsoft, Walmart and more, in a culture of high ownership and fast decision-making.
* Room to grow with the company: as RockED scales, so does the scope of this role.
* Care for you and your family: health and insurance coverage, fully sponsored by RockED.

You’ve watched a system catch fire and brought it back with grit and caffeine.

If you’ve fought fires in production, debugged chaos at 3 AM, and still wanted more - you’re our kind of engineer.

title: EY-GDS Consulting-AI And DATA- AI Architect-Senior Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS**
**– Senior Manager – AI & Data Architect- BAT**
As part of our EY-GDS, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior Manager (AI Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven pre-sales & delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading consulting firm as well as a part of growing consulting practise.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Value Engineering & Consultative Selling**

* Partner with C‑suite and senior business leaders to understand strategic priorities and identify AI-led transformation opportunities that deliver clear business value.
* Shape, articulate, build future architecture, and present compelling value propositions, solution narratives, and business cases for AI/GenAI/Agentic AI engagements.
* Domain experience from Consumer &Retail , Telecom / Media, Manufacturing & Industrial sectors, Oil & Gas
* Drive account teams in pursuit cycles, contributing to RFP responses, solution design, storyline decks, and client presentations.
* Lead client discovery and ideation workshops to define AI use cases, roadmap, and ROI frameworks.
* Drive consultative selling by helping clients understand where AI can meaningfully impact operations, customer experience, finance, and industry‑specific value chains.

**AI Architecture, Design & Solutioning**

* Architect end‑to‑end AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across Azure (Azure AI, Azure OpenAI), AWS (SageMaker), and GCP (Vertex AI).
* Leverage leading AI platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB), and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Design architecture patterns for enterprise AI systems—including RAG, autonomous agent workflows, LLMOps, and scalable cloud-native deployments.
* Work with data engineering and data science teams to define data models, pipelines, and ML development workflows using Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake, Spark, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

**Delivery Oversight & Technical Leadership**

* Oversee delivery of AI/GenAI projects to ensure architecture integrity, engineering quality, and alignment to business value commitments.
* Act as the technical escalation point during delivery, guiding solution teams and ensuring adherence to best practices.
* Review detailed solution designs, code, and architectural artifacts to maintain technical rigor.
* Mentor and coach architects, AI engineers, and delivery teams on solution design, coding standards, and engineering excellence.

**Innovation, Prototyping & Thought Leadership**

* Drive the development of POVs, accelerators, prototypes, and demos using Azure AI, OpenAI, NVIDIA AI, and related technologies.
* Create industry-specific and horizontal reference architectures, reusable assets, and solution frameworks.
* Represent the practice in client discussions, internal leadership forums, and external industry events on AI strategy and innovation.

**Engineering & Build (Selective / Hands-on as Needed)**

* Lead by example with hands‑on prototyping when required; write and review high-quality, testable code in Python and other languages.
* Guide teams in adopting modern practices for MLOps/LLMOps, DevOps, observability, and secure deployment.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Extensive pre‑sales and consultative experience with the ability to diagnose business problems, frame value propositions, and connect AI capabilities to measurable business impact.
* 16+ years of professional experience, including 5–8 years architecting and deploying enterprise‑scale AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions on cloud or on‑prem environments.
* Experience in working & managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Strong RFP/RFI leadership experience, including solution shaping, writing technical sections, and conducting client-facing architecture and value engineering workshops.
* Deep expertise in designing AI solutions using microservices and cloud-native architectures, with strong understanding of Agentic AI, AI-ready data, and enterprise-scale LLM solution patterns (RAG, agents, orchestration).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proven experience defining MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps architectures, including model lifecycle automation, observability, governance, and responsible AI.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML solutions on Azure, AWS, and/or GCP, with strong understanding of platform-native services (Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex/Gemini).
* Strong experience using and orchestrating LLMs across cloud platforms—OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Gemini AI, vector DBs, and agent frameworks.
* Solid background in data modeling, SQL, and modern data architectures (Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse).
* Strong foundational understanding of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
* Advanced programming skills in Python (and optionally PySpark) for prototyping, validation, and reference implementations.
* Experience integrating enterprise‑grade security, identity, and authentication into AI/ML and LLM-based applications.
* Proven expertise deploying AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes, Web Apps, Databricks, or similar cloud-native platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps toolchains—Git, MLflow, feature stores, CI/CD, batch inference, real-time endpoints.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and related DevOps tooling.
* Working knowledge of Responsible AI principles, governance, model risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade, production-ready architectures and guiding delivery teams through implementation.
* Strong understanding of data strategy, cloud-native engineering, analytics modernization, and platform-driven transformation.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Project and client management skills.
* Experience in solutioning and pre-sales engagements.
* Exposure to data mesh principles and domain-oriented data product design.
* Familiarity with data fabric architectures and multi-cloud data strategies.
* Familiarity with real-time analytics

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Platform Architect
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
The FlashBlade team builds the industry’s most innovative, high-performance, and highly available portfolio of products that are designed for the most demanding mission critical applications. While we deliver a hardware storage array, over 90% of our engineering staff are software engineers. Our customers are the most important part of our business and they love FlashBlade for its simplicity of management, the constant flow of new and exciting upgrades, and ability to live on the cutting edge of technology while never taking downtime, ever. FlashBlade enables our customers to leverage the agility of the public cloud for both traditional IT and cloud-native applications. You’ll architect, implement, and optimize core services that span on-premises arrays and cloud deployments—delivering seamless storage experiences to enterprises around the globe. If you thrive on solving hard problems, influencing technical direction, and driving innovation end-to-end, this is the role for you.
  
  
**What You And Your Team Will Be Doing…**

* Own the platform software architecture for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs across FlashArray and FlashBlade, from concept and ERD/PRD review through bring-up, validation, manufacturing handoff and GA.
* Define and drive the platform security architecture, including Platform Root of Trust (PRoT), UEFI Secure Boot, Platform Firmware Resilience (PFR), TPM, measured boot, device identity and attestation, and boot drive encryption.
* Extend the secure boot chain of trust across firmware, bootloaders, kernel, Purity software and devices (BMC, NICs, HBAs, drives). Work with the security team on key management, the signing infrastructure and the production vs. development provisioning flows.
* Drive the post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness roadmap for platform firmware and boot, and keep us aligned with industry frameworks such as OCP Security / SAFE, NIST SP 800-193 and NIST SSDF.
* Architect secure, resilient firmware update and lifecycle flows: fw\_update\_tool, factory images, manufacturing provisioning and lock, RMA and re-provisioning, and non-disruptive hardware upgrades.
* Lead early hardware bring-up and debug for new CPUs, chipsets, PCIe switches, NICs and add-in cards. Partner with silicon vendors (Intel, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell and others) and with ODM/JDM partners.
* Shape the long-term direction for unifying hardware-adjacent management layers (chassis manager, HAL, BMC interfaces) across FlashArray and FlashBlade.
* Review hardware designs, ERDs and requirements so that platform software, diagnostics and manageability are designed in from day one, not bolted on later.
* Work with BMC Firmware, Kernel IO, Diags, Systems Networking, Hardware, Manufacturing, Security and Program Management teams in Bengaluru, Silicon Valley and Prague.
* Own root-cause analysis for the hardest platform, boot and security escalations, from internal test through customer field issues.
* Write the design documents and architectural reviews that set standards for the org. Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across teams.

**What You’ll Need To Bring To This Role...**

* 15+ years of experience in platform, system or firmware software for servers, storage, networking or other enterprise systems.
* A proven track record as the technical lead or architect on multiple NPI programs taken from bring-up to production.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in platform security: UEFI Secure Boot, hardware root of trust, TPM 2.0, measured boot, and code-signing and key-management workflows. Experience with Intel PFR, Caliptra, OpenTitan or a similar RoT is a strong plus.
* Strong understanding of the x86 boot flow (BIOS/UEFI, bootloaders, Linux kernel boot), plus experience working with BIOS vendors and silicon reference code.
* Solid knowledge of BMC and out-of-band management (IPMI, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, SPDM).
* Strong knowledge of hardware interfaces and system architecture: PCIe Gen5/Gen6, I2C/SMBus, SPI, eSPI, CPLD/FPGA interactions, CPU/NUMA architecture.
* Strong Linux systems programming and kernel/driver experience. Expert-level C, plus proficiency in Python and shell.
* Excellent debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries using JTAG, logic and protocol analyzers, serial consoles, crash dumps and boot logs.
* Experience working directly with silicon vendors, ODM/JDM partners and manufacturing teams.
* Proven ability to lead and influence through technical credibility across distributed teams without direct authority.
* Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
* Good to have: knowledge of PQC algorithms and migration, Common Criteria / FIPS certification, OCP standards, and ARM-based platforms.
* Storage experience is desirable but not required.
* You are flexible, accountable and a strong communicator who thrives in a globally distributed team.

**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
  
  
**Accommodations And Accessibility**
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
  
  
**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
  
  
Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
  
  
**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Senior Deep Learning Research Engineer
description:

title: Member of Technical Staff, Cekura (Bangalore, In-Person)
description:
Read This First
  
  
We work with unusual intensity: in-person in Bangalore, six days a week, long days, most weekends. That's how we've chosen to build, because in our market speed decides who wins. We say this up front because we want people who feel pulled in, not talked into it. If you want a 9-to-5 (no judgment), this isn't your role.
  
  
**What You Get In Exchange**

* Top-of-market cash. Extraordinary hours deserve more than an average salary.
* Meaningful equity. Significant grants, employee-friendly terms, and liquidity opportunities as we raise.
* No commute tax. Support to live near the office, plus dinner there every night.
* Founders in the trenches. We work the same schedule we ask of you.
* A decade of growth in two years. You'll ship more and own more than anywhere else.

**About Cekura**
Cekura (YC F24) builds evals and improvement for voice AI, covering both voice agents and the speech-to-speech models behind them.
  
  

* Voice agents. Teams test before launch, monitor production calls, and improve continuously. When something fails, Cekura reproduces it in simulation, fixes it, tests the fix, and raises a PR. The platform covers simulation, LLM evaluation, red-teaming, drift monitoring, and benchmarking across Vapi, Retell, Pipecat, LiveKit, ElevenLabs and more.
* Speech-to-speech models. We give labs benchmarks, data, and RL environments to improve turn-taking, interruptions, naturalness, and tool use in live conversations.

Customers include Five9, HighLevel, Twin Health, PwC, Deloitte, Jobber, and Jotform. HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR are defaults. We're growing fast and backed by top investors.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll build the core of Cekura: simulation engines, evaluation systems, benchmarks, RL environments, self-improvement loops, and observability pipelines. We don't split "software engineer" from "AI engineer." The best problems sit where real-time voice infrastructure, LLM evaluation, RL training, and speech analysis meet.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Simulation engine. Simulate thousands of realistic conversations across voice, chat, and phone, with control over personas, interruptions, noise, and edge cases.
* Agent evaluation. Build LLM evaluators, metrics, red-teaming, drift detection, and the autonomous loop that detects, reproduces, fixes, tests, and ships a PR.
* Speech-to-speech research. Work with labs to find where models fall short of human conversation, then build the benchmarks, datasets, reward signals, and RL environments that close the gap.
* Applied audio. Turn the paralinguistic layer (emotion, tone, silences, hesitations, overlaps) into structured signals, so models are judged on how things are said, not just what.
* Real-time voice infra. SIP, WebRTC, STT/TTS, Twilio, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat. Latency and barge-in are first-class problems.
* Ship end-to-end and shape the team. Own what you build from design to production, and set the standards a growing team inherits.

**About You**

* A strong generalist who wants to work across systems and AI, not stay in one lane.
* A strong coder in Python, TypeScript, or Go, with experience in distributed systems, real-time infra, LLM products, or model training and evaluation.
* You've run production systems and care about reliability, latency, and correctness.
* Sharp instincts about where LLMs and speech models fail, and how to build reliable systems on them.
* You like ambiguity, move fast, communicate clearly, and raise the bar around you.
* You read the first section twice and you're still here.
* Bonus: ex-founder or aspiring one.

Nice to Have
  
  

* LLM evals, agent frameworks, or AI observability.
* Voice AI stack experience (Twilio, SIP, WebRTC, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat, STT/TTS).
* RL for language or speech models, benchmark building, or speech-to-speech models.
* Early-stage startup experience or open-source work.

This Is Not for You If
  
  

* You want a narrow role, a fixed stack, or to work only on models or only on infra.
* You need rigid process or heavy structure.
* You're optimizing for work-life balance right now.
* You don't want to work in-person in Bangalore.

Why Cekura
  
  

* The hardest problems in voice AI, worked on alongside the labs building the models.
* A 12-person engineering team post-seed: early enough to matter, funded enough to move fast.
* Direct work with founders and a highly technical team.
* Top-of-market pay, meaningful equity, all meals at the office, and relocation support.

description:
**SOFTWARE ARCHITECT**

**We are looking for a Software Architect to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**

**Position Snapshot:**

  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**

*As a Software Architect, you will join the engineering team powering Nespresso Digital Commerce business.**You will work in a direct-to-customer context with significant volumes and traffic and a very rich feature offering, being part of a large development organization with direct impact to the online business.*

*As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the development team, working very close to design and product teams. You will guide and promote optimal use of process and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within the area of expertise.*

**In This Role, You Will:**

  

* Work closely with the Product Owner and the Lead Designer to provide technical expertise, advising on best technology solutions, translating the business vision into technical vision.
* Estimate development effort for new projects and report progress of developments, to both technical and non-technical communities.
* Lead the design and documentation of software solutions, using commercetools as a composable commerce platform.
* Work with the development team to ensure the quality and its alignment to the Nespresso strategy.
* Recommend, set up and follow development best practices inside the software development teams and ensure their adoption.
* Contribute to the availability and evolution of the Continuous Integration solution (including quality and Security checks) in collaboration with the teams running the service.
* Assist others in resolving complex technical problems and investigating the root cause of problems and recommend smart (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, timely) solutions.
* Responsible for ensuring that all solutions within their technology area are delivered and maintained secure and compliant with internal standards and external regulations.
* Participate in peer reviews of deliverables and carry out formal and informal reviews of technical designs, standards, documentation and/or implementations.
Participate in the Nespresso software architecture community.  

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* More than 10 years of experience in the relevant area of expertise. Ideal experience of 3-5 years as a developer, 2-3 years as a software architect.
* Hand on experience working in the development of eCommerce solutions based on commercetools.
* Previous experience in code inspection, review, and code quality check.
* Experience of resolving technical issues, including those involving 3rd parties.
* Effectively communicates in English at different levels in the organization.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Have a deep understanding of agile methods and processes
* Have experiences working in a global environment and with virtual teams
* Ability to understand the long-term ("big picture”) and short-term perspectives of situations.
* Experience of successfully leading technical evaluations.

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.

You will have an opportunity to develop a deep understanding of how GS interacts with some of the most dynamic and liquid markets in the world.

Design, build and maintain high performance, low latency trading platform which can evolve and adapt to changes in our fast-paced, global business environment.

Manage work to balance the short-term needs of the business with strategic enhancements.

Understand global market structure, regulations and exchange requirements.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelor/Master’s degree in STEM with 3 to 6 years of experience developing software architecture in C/ C++

Strong track record of designing, developing and maintaining reliable trading components and critical infrastructure

A deep passion for technology and software development

Sound understanding of multi-threaded application design and development and experience with lock-free data structures

Professional experience working with distributed systems

Experience in low latency messaging, TCP/UDP tuning, Linux latency tunings is preferred

Excellent communication skills

Experience with statistics and data-science methodologies

Experience building and maintaining high-performance research infrastructure for large data inputs

  

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. description:
**Position:** HVAC Design Engineer  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 years in HVAC design/engineering  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

We are seeking a technically strong HVAC Design Engineer to support end-to-end design and engineering for commercial, residential, industrial, and/or institutional projects. The role involves HVAC system design, load calculations, equipment selection, drawing preparation, coordination with multidisciplinary teams, and technical support during execution. Typical responsibilities include heat-load and ventilation calculations, duct/piping layouts, equipment selection, BOQ preparation, and coordination with architectural, structural, electrical, and plumbing teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform cooling and heating load calculations, ventilation calculations, air quantity calculations, static pressure, pressure-drop, and pump-head calculations using approved methods and software.
* Design HVAC systems, including chilled-water systems, VRF/VRV systems, AHUs, FCUs, ventilation, exhaust, pressurization, and related mechanical systems.
* Select and size HVAC equipment such as chillers, AHUs, FCUs, pumps, cooling towers, fans, ducts, diffusers, and piping components.
* Prepare HVAC layouts, duct layouts, chilled-water piping layouts, schematics, plant-room layouts, GA drawings, fabrication/shop drawings, and equipment schedules.
* Prepare BOQs, bills of materials, technical specifications, design basis notes, calculation sheets, and vendor comparison documents.
* Coordinate HVAC designs with architects, structural, electrical, plumbing, fire-protection, and project teams to ensure clash-free and buildable designs.
* Review vendor drawings, technical submittals, equipment datasheets, and shop drawings for compliance with project requirements.
* Support procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities by providing technical clarification and design support.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable standards, client specifications, statutory requirements, and good engineering practices, including ASHRAE, ISHRAE, NBC, and SMACNA where relevant.
* Participate in design reviews, client/consultant meetings, site visits, and coordination meetings as required.

Required Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in HVAC design, engineering, consultancy, contracting, or MEP design.
* Working knowledge of HVAC design principles, psychrometrics, heat-load estimation, duct sizing, pipe sizing, and equipment selection.
* Hands-on proficiency in AutoCAD; experience with Carrier HAP, TRACE, or equivalent load-calculation software is desirable.
* Familiarity with Revit MEP/BIM workflows is an added advantage.
* Understanding of HVAC standards and codes, including ASHRAE, ISHRAE, NBC, and SMACNA.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple project deliverables and work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

The engineer will handle complex L2/L3 incidents, contribute to platform improvements, and serve as a reliable technical contributor within NTT DATA's EPM managed services practice supporting clients across US, APAC, and EMEA geographies.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Own end-to-end patch management operations for SCCM-managed and Intune-managed endpoints across client accounts.
* Configure and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday cycles.
* Manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) rings, feature update policies, and quality update deferrals in Intune.
* Perform patch impact analysis, rollback planning, and emergency patching for zero-day vulnerabilities.
* Generate and present patch compliance dashboards and exception reports to delivery leads and client stakeholders.
* Coordinate with security teams to address Qualys/vulnerability scan findings within SLA timelines.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, patch management, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM

-----------------------------------

**Team: Data Governance and Analytics**

### **About the team**

The Data Governance and Analytics Team is part of Data, AI, and Visualization (DAIV) within our global software R&D organization. We are a diverse, distributed team with colleagues across France and the Netherlands.

We bring digital technology into our products, solutions, and services, enabling data extraction, analysis, and connectivity. Our work prepares the organization for the age of AI, supports data-driven design, and enables value creation from data.

### **About the role**

### **We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep technical expertise in Python and Data Governance & Analytics (DGA) systems. In this role, you will design, build, and scale high-performance data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, and governance frameworks that empower our engineering and product teams. You will work closely with cross-functional architecture and DevOps teams to drive automated data ingestion, ensure stringent data quality, and build reliable backend services that support critical operational metrics and reporting.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and scaling of robust data ingestion pipelines, data models, and analytics backends using **Python**.
* Implement and automate data governance standards, metadata tracking, and data lineage mechanisms to ensure high data integrity, security, and compliance.
* Build capabilities supporting data extraction, processing, analysis, connectivity, and governance.
* Implement data validation and transformation logic to improve consistency, quality, and usability.
* Develop clear interfaces that enable other teams to integrate and reuse Python components.
* Identify opportunities to reuse existing software and simplify implementation across projects.
* Structure Python code into maintainable modules and packages with appropriate dependency management.
* Collaborate with architects to define component interfaces, dependencies, and integration approaches.

* Participate in code reviews and improve code readability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Investigate defects, troubleshoot software and integration issues, and improve performance where. needed.
* Maintain technical documentation and clear runbooks covering component interfaces, configuration, integration dependencies, and usage.
* Collaborate with software architects and engineers across the wider R&D organization.
* Establish strong reliability practices (logging/monitoring, retries/backoff, idempotency, concurrency controls, safe cleanup, traceability).
* Mentor engineers through code reviews, best practices, and technical leadership.
* Work effectively within an **Agile Scrum / SAFe framework**, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery.

**Required Skills**

* Expert-level proficiency in **Python** (async programming, data structures, performance optimization, and modular architecture).
* Experience developing shared Python packages or libraries used by other engineering teams.
* Ability to independently develop, test, debug, and maintain Python modules and libraries.
* Understanding of Python packaging, dependency management, error handling, and automated testing.
* Experience manipulating data, including cleaning, transforming, validating, or aggregating datasets.
* Knowledge of data analytics concepts.

* Strong foundation in SQL, relational/non-relational data modelling, and data transformation frameworks.
* Experience with data governance principles (data quality frameworks, cataloguing, lineage, and metadata management).

* Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across locations and disciplines.
* Ability to design modular, reusable, and maintainable software.
* Experience working in an agile DevOps environment.

* Experience operating in structured product-development environments with strong quality, compliance, and delivery expectations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in a technical or scientific discipline.
* 6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development, data engineering, or analytics platforms.

description:
