Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the role**

This role is the custodian of Global Finance global control framework and ensures that the global impact of any change is assessed and validated for its global implications before final update and application across Finance. This requires investigating and testing the use of SAP system reports to complete controls and finding an optimal solution for issues raised by those applying controls.

**Key responsibilities**

* Manage internal control framework tools to standardize, simplify, and strengthen the Haleon Finance control framework, and provide guidance for non-standardized processes.
* Own the end-to-end testing approach for the manual business controls assurance ensuring the quality standards meets our expectations.
* Day-to-day contact person for management and SOx testing vendor, ensuring alignment and clear expectations for the testing approach, documentation standards, timelines and deliverables.
* Monitor vendor performance including performing detailed quality assurance to ensure alignment to standards and validate completeness and accuracy of testing, escalating concerns where required.
* Manage relations with External Auditors and other third parties (e.g., GEC, ABAC, SEC) in relation to the control’s framework.
* Prepare global training materials and communications, and provide these to SOx testers, CoE team members, and key personnel on risks and controls and key risk topics.
* Maintain the resource centre (intranet page), helpdesk facilities, and other tools with relevant up-to-date information for in-house customers (e.g., SOX/IBM testers, finance controllers, finance directors) to access independently.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing, quality and coverage through automation analytics or refined scoping. Continue to strengthen FRMC overall assurance maturity as well as internal processes making these more efficient and/or effective over time.
* Supports business project through impact assessing controls against upcoming changes and providing guidance on what is required ensure a robust control environment post go-live.
Keep abreast of developments in controls framework management and propose continuous improvement initiatives.  

**Qualifications and skills**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Qualified Accountant (CA or equivalent) or CIA qualified, with some post-qualification experience (PQE) or other
* 5+ years of experience in finance, Internal Control, Auditing
* Solid foundational knowledge in finance, with growing expertise in processes, systems, and business context.
* Able to analyse straightforward problems using standard methodologies and contribute to projects with guidance from senior colleagues.
Collaborative team player who supports peers, provides informal guidance to new team members, and operates effectively under direction in a structured environment.  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-26

-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. ------------

The Urban Designer I/ Urban Planner I will support multidisciplinary teams in the planning, design, analysis, and delivery of projects ranging from public realm improvements, streetscapes, parks, campuses, transit-oriented developments, mixed-use districts, new towns, and large-scale masterplans to strategic infrastructure and regional planning projects. * Take ownership of work and design under the supervision of Senior Landscape Architects & Urban Designers
* Work on a program for the project and proactively advise Senior team members of any issue which affects the efficient completion of the project.
* Set out / agree design standards and parameters with senior team members.
* Responsible for completion of specifically assigned tasks to time and cost.
* Assist in preparing design studies, reports, presentations, technical documentation, and client deliverables.

* Support the production of high-quality graphics, diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentation materials.

* Understand the project workflow and assess for any possible enhancements & integration of new software & automation.
* Assist to achieve design & workflow innovation within the scope of projects.
* Assist in developing innovative, sustainable and resilient design solutions aligned with project objectives.

**About you**
-------------

  

* A Master's degree in Urban Design/ Planning from universities of National or International repute is a must.
* Bachelor's degree holders in Urban Design/ Planning or Architecture will be considered, if they can showcase relevant experience in Urban / Planning Project Stages. Including Design, Documentation , Policy work and site implementation.

* Experience level of 2-5 years required for the Urban Designer / Planner
* Must have relevant experience delivering Urban Design / Public Realm / Planning projects. Should be able to explain the projects over all & their specific involvement. Experience in global market regions will be considered an additional advantage.

* Must be conversant of the evolving standards of the profession primarily with respective to collaborative and multi-disciplinary design.

* Capable of working on own initiative or as part of a larger multidisciplinary team.
* Have a logical and organized approach to project delivery and able to follow instructions and guidance by senior team members.
* Able to identify and communicate concerns of the project/team to immediate Line Manager.
* Able to discuss career goals and aspirations. Having the ability to structure & work on independent subject research will be considered an additional advantage.
* Willingness to share information and knowledge with team members.

**Reward & benefits**

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. title: Director, SoC Design Verification and Virtual Platform Quality
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description**

**About the Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a differentiated verification strategy at the intersection of **semiconductor Design Verification, SystemC modeling, Virtual Platforms, and pre-silicon software development**.

This leader will define and execute a reuse-first verification strategy spanning **SystemC transaction-level models, RTL, IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform-level validation**. The objective is to create a traceable verification asset chain that grows from loosely timed SystemC models through approximately timed models and RTL, rather than rebuilding independent verification environments at each stage.

The position is part of Renesas’ Software First, Simulation First engineering organization. The team develops reusable SystemC/TLM models and integrated Virtual Platforms that enable software development, verification, validation, and product evaluation before silicon availability. Design Verification is the quality and release gate that ensures these virtual products faithfully represent the intended silicon behavior.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the verification strategy for **SystemC models, RTL designs, reusable IP, subsystems, SoCs, and Virtual Platforms**.
* Lead and develop a global Design Verification organization, including verification leads, engineers, external partners, and project-specific teams.
* Establish a common verification architecture that supports reuse of test intent, stimulus, sequences, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, coverage models, and regression infrastructure across SystemC and RTL.
* Develop scalable **SystemVerilog/UVM environments**, including protocol adapters and TLM bridges that connect pin-level UVM interfaces to SystemC/TLM models.
* Establish functional-equivalence and timing-correlation methodologies between SystemC LT/AT models and RTL implementations.
* Define common verification plans, feature identifiers, test intent, functional and code coverage goals, closure criteria, maturity classifications, and sign-off requirements.
* Make verification sign-off an explicit release gate for customer- and software-facing Virtual Platform deliveries.
* Drive verification planning and execution from the IP level through subsystem, chip-top, SoC, and full-platform integration.
* Establish a risk-based verification approach that balances reusable UVM environments, Python/C++ tests, software-driven validation, formal techniques, and project schedules.
* Lead verification of configurable and parameterized IP models across supported configurations, interfaces, and operating modes.
* Build CI/CD-based regression systems for automated compilation, simulation, coverage collection, result analysis, release evidence, and quality reporting.
* Partner with architecture, RTL design, SystemC modeling, software, validation, methodology, and Product Group teams to define requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Lead complex debug and root-cause analysis across models, adapters, RTL, testbenches, firmware, and platform-level environments.
* Evaluate and adopt verification technologies that improve quality, reuse, coverage closure, simulation efficiency, and engineering productivity.
* Own staffing, organizational development, program planning, partner engagement, execution tracking, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting for the DV function.

**Leadership Profile**

The successful candidate will:

* Set a clear technical and organizational direction while maintaining delivery accountability.
* Balance verification rigor, reuse, schedule, risk, and business priorities.
* Build durable methodology without allowing methodology development to block critical product execution.
* Develop strong technical leaders and create clear accountability across IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform verification.
* Promote collaboration across RTL, SystemC, software, validation, architecture, and product organizations.
* Establish a culture of measurable quality, evidence-based sign-off, disciplined debug, automation, and continuous improvement.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in semiconductor IP, subsystem, or SoC Design Verification.
* Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed verification teams and multiple concurrent programs.
* Deep expertise in **SystemVerilog and UVM**, including verification architecture, reusable environments, constrained-random testing, assertions, scoreboards, functional coverage, and coverage closure.
* Strong knowledge of RTL design and simulation, computer architecture, embedded processors, interconnects, memory systems, interrupts, clocks, reset, and peripheral interfaces.
* Proven experience defining verification plans and delivering IP or SoC verification through sign-off.
* Experience leading complex debug across RTL, testbench, firmware, interfaces, and system-level environments.
* Experience with regression automation, verification metrics, CI/CD, revision control, and release-quality governance.
* Strong program-management capabilities, including effort estimation, staffing, schedules, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence architects, design teams, software organizations, Product Groups, executives, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience verifying **SystemC/TLM-2.0 models** or integrating SystemC models into RTL verification environments.
* Experience creating TLM-to-signal adapters, UVM/SystemC bridges, DPI interfaces, or mixed-language simulation environments.
* Knowledge of SystemC loosely timed and approximately timed modeling, functional equivalence, timing correlation, and performance verification.
* Experience with Python- or C++-based verification and running common tests against both SystemC and RTL implementations.
* Familiarity with common SoC protocols and peripheral interfaces such as AMBA AXI/AHB/APB, NoC, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I²C/I3C, eSPI, UART, GPIO, and memory controllers.
* Experience with formal verification, emulation, FPGA prototyping, software-driven verification, or post-silicon validation.
* Experience verifying configurable or parameterized IP and automating configuration-space coverage.
* Familiarity with Virtual Platforms, virtual prototyping, embedded-software enablement, Digital Twin technologies, and pre-silicon application validation.
* Experience with commercial simulation, debug, coverage, VIP, regression-management, and formal-verification tools from providers such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA.
* Experience building verification teams, developing technical leaders, managing engineering partners, and establishing reusable methodology across multiple projects.

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.  
  
With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  
  
At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.

Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.

title: Advanced Data Engineer
description:
Category: Data & AI

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department:** Manufacturing and Supply Chain Data Engineering, Enterprise AI

**Company:** Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)

Bengaluru, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

  

As Advanced Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations that let Novo’s manufacturing and supply chain teams put AI to work. You will design, deploy and run production-grade data pipelines and products end to end, turning complex data into AI-ready datasets for forecasting, optimisation, automation and self-service insight. Your work gives the business data it can trust and use today, so teams can make faster, better-informed decisions across a global scope.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* Typically 5+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering, with proven ownership of production-grade data solutions.
* Strong hands-on skills in SQL, Python, Spark, data modelling and distributed data processing.
* Practical experience with Azure Databricks, including notebooks, orchestration, Workflows, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
* Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing and infrastructure as code.
* Working knowledge of data quality, observability, metadata, lineage, role-based access controls and secure engineering practices.
* The ability to solve complex engineering problems independently, within defined architecture and platform guardrails.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work across product, business and technology teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

  

* Experience in supply chain systems, such as planning, logistics or warehousing.
* Cloud or Databricks certifications.
  

**What you’ll do**

  

You will own data pipelines and products from design to day-to-day operation, and raise the engineering standard around you while you do it.

  

* Design, build, test, deploy and support scalable data pipelines, data models and integration flows using Azure, Databricks, GitHub, SQL, Python and Spark.
* Build and maintain Databricks solutions with notebooks, Jobs and Workflows, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables or Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, and Unity Catalog.
* Translate product and business requirements into maintainable technical solutions, contributing to estimation, design reviews and delivery planning.
* Build data quality rules, automated tests, lineage, monitoring and alerts into the development lifecycle, and use infrastructure as code and CI/CD for repeatable, secure and controlled changes.
* Optimise Spark workloads, storage, orchestration and compute for performance, reliability and cost, and apply enterprise security, privacy, governance and compliance requirements, including GxP controls where relevant.
* Investigate incidents and recurring defects, find the root cause and put preventive improvements in place.
* Contribute reusable components, standards and documentation, and support less-experienced engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

  

You will join the Manufacturing and Supply Chain Data Engineering team within Enterprise AI at Novo, working with a global scope. You will collaborate closely with Manufacturing and Supply Chain Lines of Business, AI Foundation, Enterprise Platform teams and other IT colleagues to deliver scalable, production-grade, AI-ready data platforms that the business can trust and use.

  

**What you can expect here**

  

You will be trusted to own your work and supported to perform at your best. You will grow through hands-on work on production-grade data platforms, learning from experienced colleagues and sharing what you know through code reviews and reusable patterns. Your voice counts: you will help shape engineering standards and the direction of AI-ready data across manufacturing and supply chain.

  

**Start now**

  

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the data foundations behind AI in manufacturing and supply chain, apply for the Advanced Data Engineer role 26 Nov 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Engineer II, AI Automation
description:
Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let’s push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide.
  
  
**How You’ll Help Us Connect the World:**  
As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and run the LLM-powered and agentic systems that are changing how we work. You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster—from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails.
  
This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
  
  
**You Will Make an Impact By:**  

* Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams.
* Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines—with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices.
* Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions.
* Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows.
* Developing and extending AI coding-assistant tooling for engineering teams, including Claude Code skills and plugins, custom agents, and reusable prompt templates.
* Designing evaluation frameworks and guardrails for AI-generated output, using golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites so quality is measured, not assumed.
* Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops.
* Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds.
* Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization.
* Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs.
* Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows.
* Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
* Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning.

**Required Qualifications for Consideration:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building LLM-powered applications that run in production.
* Track record of taking AI features from prototype to production, with measurable impact on quality, speed, or cost.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
* Practical experience building RAG systems: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector), hybrid search, and re-ranking.
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and guardrail techniques: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and mitigation of hallucination and prompt injection.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Strong Python skills, including asyncio, type hints, and testing with pytest.
* Experience designing REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Experience with async, event-driven pipelines and queues (e.g., Celery, Kafka, Redis), plus working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of secrets management (e.g., Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), role-based access control, and dependency and container scanning (e.g., Snyk, Trivy).
* Experience with observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse) for tracing, metrics, and cost tracking of LLM applications.
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably AWS.

**You Will Excite Us If You:**  

* Have experience building AI for IT operations or customer support
* Are experienced in reducing LLM cost and latency at scale through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and context compression
* Have applied AI tooling to large C/C++ codebases.
* Have exposure to telecom or 4G/5G RAN, or a strong interest in learning the domain

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern
description:
About us

Srishti Enterprises delivers turnkey interiors, auditorium and acoustic works, and technical systems (electrical automation, AV, CCTV, fire alarms, networking, building management) for government, institutional and commercial clients across India, including CPWD, SBI, IIT Bombay and Petronet LNG. We now have a new project starting in Bengaluru. On this project we are trying out new software, including AI tools, to help our site team work better.

Software is easy to build. Getting a busy site team to use it every day is hard. That is your job.

What you will do

- Be on our site at Channenahalli, Magadi Main Road, Bengaluru, every working day

- Sit with the site engineer, store keeper and supervisors. Learn how the site really runs day to day

- Get them onto the new system and help them when they get stuck

- Set up the project's data in the system

- Spot what is broken or confusing, and fix it yourself or report it clearly to our tech team

- Write small scripts and setups that save the site team time

- Join a short daily call with our tech team and send a weekly update

Example week: one supervisor keeps going back to paper for a daily task. You find out why, fix the setup with our tech team, and by Friday he is using the system for it.

You are a good fit if you

- Are in your final year or recently graduated (Computer Science, IT, or Civil with real coding work)

- Can write basic Python or JavaScript and are comfortable with spreadsheets

- Can build a working prototype in hours using AI tools like Claude, and keep up with what is new in AI

- Can talk easily with site staff in Hindi and English (Kannada is a big plus)

- Like being out in the field more than sitting at a desk all day

- Can reach Channenahalli (Magadi Main Road, west Bengaluru) daily, 5 days a week, 11 am to 6 pm

Nice to have

- Any exposure to construction, a site visit, or a civil engineering project

- Duration: 3 to 6 months, starting 8 Dec 2026

- Stipend: Rs 30,000 per month

- Location: on site, Channenahalli, Magadi Main Road, Bengaluru

- Strong work can turn into a full-time role

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Bengaluru-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk
  

**Summary**

The Core Engineering Shared Services AI team operates as an internal forward-deployed AI engineering function, embedding with The Core business teams to identify priority workflows, prototype agentic AI solutions, and productionize cloud-native applications that deliver measurable business impact. This hands-on role combines client-facing problem discovery, rapid engineering execution, production AI architecture, and structured transition to receiving teams that will operate and extend the solutions over time.

As an AI Application Engineer, you will work directly with internal business and engineering partners to convert ambiguous operating problems into secure, reliable AI products. You will define where agents should act, where they should assist, and where human approval or control gates are required, then design and deliver solutions that are adopted in real workflows and can be supported in production.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Rapid Prototyping & Application Delivery: Lead the design, build, deployment, and operationalization of cloud-native AI applications, using modern software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing to accelerate reliable delivery.
* Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Partner with business and engineering teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities, translate requirements into cloud-optimized architectures, and define scalable data models and technical specifications.
* Forward-Deployed AI Engineering: Embed with The Core business teams to map workflows, identify pain points, assess agentic automation opportunities, define control and approval boundaries, iterate with users, and drive adoption through pilots, feedback loops, and measurable outcomes.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

### **The Role**

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Cool things you'll do**

You'll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You'll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.

### **What you'll do**

* Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
* Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
* Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
* Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

### **What you'll bring**

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:

* Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
* Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
* Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
* Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
* Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
* Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs
* Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution

Helpful experience

* Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
* Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
* Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
* Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
* Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus
* Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:

=========================

**Title:****Data Architect**

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. We achieve this by working together and supporting one another across our global business. Join our team and be part of something bigger.

**Department Description**

Platform Design & Solutions (PDS) is the architecture and technical governance body across Client Servicing Platforms (CSP). The Data Architecture and Ownership capability within PDS defines data models, migration architectures, certified data products, and data standards supporting client servicing, reporting, and investment operations globally.

**Purpose of the Role**

The **Data Architect (Grade 4)** is a foundational data engineering and data modeling specialist responsible for translating business requirements and data domain definitions into physical and logical schema designs, Snowflake data pipelines, and certified Data Product interfaces.

Working under the mentorship of the Data Architecture Lead and alongside senior data architects, you will play a crucial role in modernising CSP's data estate — specifically supporting the strategic migration from the legacy on-premise Client Reporting Database onto **Snowflake**.

You will map source-to-target data flows, author dimensional and relational data models, maintain technical data dictionaries, and validate data product contracts across client reporting, sales and assets, and distribution datasets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modeling & Schema Design**

* Design and maintain logical and physical data models for CSP data domains using ERwin, ER/Studio, or dbt semantic models.
* Develop star-schema, snowflake-schema, and normalized table structures in Snowflake optimized for query performance and data sharing.
* Author comprehensive source-to-target mapping specifications, documenting transformation logic, business rules, and data cleansing requirements.

**Snowflake Data Migration & Pipeline Architecture**

* Partner with delivery engineers to design ingestion and transformation pipelines moving data from legacy Oracle databases (CRDB) to target Snowflake tables.
* Write and optimize complex SQL transformations, views, and stored procedures in Snowflake.
* Assist in establishing data reconciliation, automated data validation checks, and regression scripts to guarantee zero data loss during cutover.

**Data Product Specification & Documentation**

* Define technical specifications for certified Data Products: table schemas, JSON/Avro payloads, API contracts, and update cadences.
* Document detailed data dictionary entries, column definitions, and data lineage in enterprise catalogues (Collibra).
* Work with downstream consuming teams (reporting analysts, Salesforce developers, Tableau dashboard creators) to ensure data products meet functional requirements.

**Governance & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure all database designs adhere to Fidelity’s enterprise naming conventions, data classifications, and retention policies.
* Assist in classifying sensitive personal data (PII) and configuring masking policies or row-level access controls in Snowflake.

**Experience and Qualifications Required**

**Knowledge:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Senior Data Engineering in an enterprise data warehouse environment.
* Strong practical working knowledge of **Snowflake** (virtual warehouses, clustering, staging, zero-copy cloning, time travel).
* Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
* Solid understanding of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball dimensional modeling, Inmon relational modeling, Data Vault).
* Experience writing source-to-target mappings and participating in large-scale database migrations.

**Skills:**

* Advanced SQL proficiency — ability to write performant analytical queries, window functions, and complex joins.
* Familiarity with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, dbdiagram.io) and version control (Git).
* High attention to detail, structured thinking, and a passion for data accuracy and documentation.
* Excellent team collaboration skills, eager to learn and grow under senior architectural mentorship.

**Feel rewarded:**

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

This role will deliver data engineering projects across MCT business units, own the day-to-day health of the division's Microsoft Fabric environment, and drive operational excellence so that delivered solutions consistently meet agreed quality, reliability, and service levels.

The Senior Data Engineer will build the data foundation that MCT's AI initiatives depend on, working independently to move priorities from requirements through production while collaborating closely with business stakeholders, BI analysts, and IT teams to turn enterprise and ERP data into trusted, reusable, AI-ready data products.

**Responsibilities**

**Data Engineering Delivery**

* Design, build, test, and deploy ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from ERP and business systems into Microsoft Fabric
* Implement and maintain a medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) using Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse
* Develop data transformations using PySpark notebooks, SQL, and Data Factory pipelines
* Build curated, governed datasets and Power BI semantic models that serve reporting, analytics, and AI use cases
* Prepare AI-ready data for solutions built on Azure AI Foundry, including agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and planning/control tower initiatives
* Translate business requirements into data models, source-to-target mappings, and technical designs

**Fabric Environment Ownership**

* Maintain the MCT Fabric environment, including workspaces, Lakehouses, Warehouses, pipelines, and semantic models
* Manage source control and CI/CD using Git and Azure DevOps across development, test, and production
* Apply standards for naming, workspace structure, access, security, and data quality
* Monitor capacity usage and performance and recommend optimizations

**Operational Excellence**

* Work independently with limited day-to-day direction, proactively manage priorities, and escalate risks or decisions when needed
* Monitor pipelines and data refreshes against agreed SLAs; triage and resolve incidents and data quality issues
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive fixes
* Maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and support handoff materials for delivered solutions
* Build reusable templates, frameworks, and patterns that can be shared across MCT business units
* Provide overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours for collaboration and issue resolution

**Success Criteria**

* Data engineering projects delivered on time and to agreed scope and quality
* A stable, well-governed Fabric environment with reliable pipelines that meet SLAs
* A trusted medallion data foundation that accelerates MCT AI and analytics projects
* Reusable, documented patterns adopted across multiple business units
* Clear communication of progress, risks, and issues to technical and nontechnical stakeholders

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 5–8 years of hands-on data engineering experience, with ownership of production pipelines end to end
* Strong understanding and execution of ETL/ELT concepts, data modeling, and data warehousing
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or closely related Azure data services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks)
* Advanced SQL and Python/PySpark skills
* Exposure to at least one modern cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Experience with Git-based source control and CI/CD practices
* Experience monitoring and supporting production data workloads
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and drive work from requirements through production
* Ability to work onsite in Bangalore, India

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and implementing medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry or preparing data for AI/ML and generative AI solutions
* Experience with ERP data, especially Oracle, Salesforce, or SAP S/4HANA
* Power BI semantic modeling and DAX
* Microsoft certification such as DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer)
* Experience in a Center of Excellence or shared-services model supporting multiple business units
* Background in industrial, manufacturing, or B2B environments

**What You Will Gain**

* Ownership of the data foundation for a divisional AI program with visible business impact
* Hands-on work with Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry
* Close collaboration with U.S. AI and technology leadership
* Career growth toward Lead Data Engineer, Data Architect, and technical leadership roles

title: Data Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional data engineer to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel  
  
Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by building and maintaining the data sources that power all of our decision making. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They know and love working with data engineering tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to build the right data pipelines to answer key business questions. They will build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. They will also be required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will work on unifying fragmented data pipelines, building robust data models, and ensuring reliable data lineage across multiple product areas. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams to develop data solutions that drive innovation and operational excellence.  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in big data technologies, strong data modeling and problem-solving skills, and a track record of delivering scalable, maintainable data systems. If you’re excited by the challenge of shaping data platforms that support real-world hardware, software, and operations, this is the role for you.  
  
A day in the life  

* Architect and implement scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines and infrastructure to support analytics, reporting, and business operations.
* Design and enforce data modeling standards, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure consistency, re-usability, and quality across systems.
* Lead design and code reviews, driving engineering best practices across data development, documentation, testing, and monitoring.
* Build data platforms and frameworks that support both batch and real-time processing, enabling flexible, efficient analytics at scale.
* Implement secure and compliant data solutions that meet internal and external regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR).
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies to improve data platform performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements, define solution architectures, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team hiring and onboarding

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with SQL
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
* Experience mentoring team members on best practices

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience operating large data warehouses

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

Lead a Python-first data engineering function, owning production-grade codebases and frameworks for a Databricks Lakehouse platform, while setting direction for pipeline architecture, data modelling and performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build production Python ETL/ELT pipelines, reusable packages, schema validation and testing frameworks (pytest, CI/CD).

* Write performant Python using OOP, generators, decorators and concurrency (multiprocessing/asyncio); profile, debug and optimize pipeline code.

* Set Python engineering standards for reviews, packaging/versioning, logging and exception handling.

* Design Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion pipelines on Databricks using Delta Lake, Structured Streaming, Auto Loader and Unity Catalog.

* Own dimensional modelling (star/snowflake, SCD); write/review advanced T-SQL, MERGE/upsert logic and execution-plan-based tuning.

* Partner on ETL/ELT, orchestration and cost/performance decisions; mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 8–12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years in technical leadership or mentoring.

* Strong Python: OOP, generators, decorators, concurrency, exception handling, pytest and production pipeline frameworks.

* Hands-on Databricks: Delta Lake (ACID, time travel, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM), Structured Streaming, Auto Loader and Unity Catalog.

* Spark performance tuning, data skew, cluster sizing/autoscaling and cost optimization.

* Dimensional modelling: star/snowflake, SCD Types 1/2/3, fact/dimension grain and conformed dimensions; working knowledge of Data Vault and

Kimball/Inmon.

* Advanced T-SQL, indexing and query tuning; Medallion architecture and ETL/ELT and batch/streaming trade-offs.

* Orchestration using Databricks Workflows, Airflow or ADF on Azure or AWS.

**Good to Have & Education**

* PCEP/PCAP or equivalent Python certification; Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.

* Data governance/compliance (GDPR/HIPAA), FinOps and experience leading/mentoring 3+ engineers.

* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Strong stakeholder communication and ability to explain technical trade-offs and own enterprise-scale design decisions

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineering Technical Leader | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Architectural Vision& Complex Problem Solving:** Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership& Project Governance:** Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap& Strategy:** Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature& Framework Delivery:** Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:** Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security& Reliability by Design:** Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling& Security Architecture:** Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability& Proactive Risk Resolution:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations& SRE Governance:** Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:** Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness& Metrics:** Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping& Stakeholder Negotiation:** Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC& Agile Excellence:** Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship& Engineering Culture:** Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).

title: Senior Python Engineer Systems and Edge Computing
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

**Job Description**

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research.

**How will you make an impact**

We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with 6–10 years of software engineering experience and substantial hands-on Python development. You will build backend services, system automation and device-management capabilities connecting scientific instruments, IoT gateways and edge devices. The role combines software design with practical Linux systems engineering, secure deployment, diagnostics and operational ownership across device, network and application layers.

**What will you do**

* Design, develop and maintain modular Python services, APIs, command-line tools and automation libraries for device orchestration, process execution, configuration and data handling.
* Manage IoT and edge-device lifecycles, including discovery, secure onboarding, provisioning, inventory, configuration, health monitoring and controlled decommissioning.
* Integrate instruments, sensors and gateways through vendor SDKs, REST or gRPC APIs and messaging protocols such as MQTT; validate commands, telemetry and device state.
* Automate deployment and version tracking of applications and containers on Linux edge systems; support-controlled software and firmware updates with compatibility checks, staged rollout and rollback or recovery.
* Troubleshoot failures across Python code, operating-system services, networking, containers and hardware interfaces; implement structured logging, metrics, alerts and diagnostic collection.
* Develop unit, integration and system tests using pytest, mocks, simulators and physical devices; integrate validation and deployment workflows into CI/CD.
* Apply secure engineering practices, including device authentication, certificate and secret management, least-privilege access, dependency scanning and auditable change records.
* Collaborate with firmware, hardware, QA, DevOps and product teams on requirements, interfaces and release readiness; mentor engineers and maintain deployment guides, runbooks and onboarding documentation.
* Work effectively within an Agile Scrum / SAFe framework, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery.

**Required Skills**

* Strong production Python development with object-oriented design, reusable modules, exception handling, concurrency, API integration, file operations and structured data such as JSON, YAML and CSV.
* Familiarity on development experience in C/C++ integration, PowerShell, BDD/Robot Framework, hardware-in-the-loop testing or scientific and regulated product environments.
* Hands-on systems engineering on Linux, including processes, services, permissions, resource usage, shell scripting and network diagnostics; ability to support Windows integration where needed.
* Practical experience deploying, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting physical IoT devices, industrial gateways or edge-computing systems, beyond cloud-only application development.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MQTT and HTTP-based communication, with an understanding of device connectivity, authentication and offline recovery.
* Experience building Python backend services with FastAPI, Flask or equivalent, and integrating databases or local persistence for configuration, telemetry and operational state.
* Hands-on Git and CI/CD experience, plus automated testing, mocking and dependency/environment management for reproducible execution across development and deployed systems.
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, technical documentation and cross-functional communication; ability to own implementation through deployment and operational support.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs or comparable ARM/x86 edge platforms; familiarity with device drivers, BSPs and hardware/software compatibility.
* Exposure to Azure IoT or AWS IoT services, Kubernetes/k3s, Ansible or equivalent device and deployment orchestration tools.
* Experience deploying AI inference workloads at the edge, or integrating LLM services for diagnostics and automation with validation and appropriate human controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience delivering connected products or engineering platforms through the full development lifecycle in an Agile, globally distributed team.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a frontend developer with a designer's eye to build Sarvam's web experiences. You'll start with our marketing website: the homepage, product and use-case pages, interactive demos and calculators. You'll write production code, build reusable UI systems and turn rough ideas into polished interfaces, working closely with design, marketing and product engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build the interface, not just the mockup. Write production-ready Astro and React components with thoughtful layouts, typography and responsive behaviour. Own the implementation from first prototype to the final browser-sized detail.
* Build a UI system that holds together. Create reusable components, layout primitives and shared styles with clear APIs and sensible variants. Make the next page easier to build without turning every component into a 40-prop puzzle.
* Make it feel right. Build interactions, transitions and animations that make interfaces clearer and more enjoyable. Think through keyboard use, loading, empty and error states, reduced motion and what happens when the happy path isn't so happy.
* Prototype in code. Explore alternative layouts and interactions with designers, test ideas in the browser and refine the details together. You should be comfortable suggesting a better implementation, not waiting for every pixel and breakpoint to be specified.
* Build the useful bits properly. Develop interactive demos, calculators and forms; connect thm to APIs and content. Handle state, validation, asynchronous behaviour and failures. Keep accessibility, performance, metadata and measurement working as part of what you ship.
* Own the engineering quality. Make sound choices about component structure, rendering and hydration. Debug browser and performance issues, write appropriate tests, review code and check preview deployments. Ship maintainable changes that work beyond your own laptop.
* Astro, React, TypeScript and CSS are at the core of the work. We use GitHub for code review and Railway for development and pull-request previews. Sanity, ImageKit and PostHog support content, media and measurement. You'll work with engineering on staging and production releases.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Have built and shipped interfaces you're proud to put your name on. Show us the actual thing, what you coded and the decisions you made. A live link beats a paragraph of adjectives.
* Have strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React experience. You can work effectively in Astro and reason about component composition, state, rendering and browser behaviour.
* Have a good eye for visual design and the CSS skills to act on it. You care about spacing, type, hierarchy, responsive layouts and interaction details, and can turn that judgement into working code.
* Can work across design and engineering. You're comfortable starting from a rough brief, prototyping options and discussing trade-offs with designers. You can also take an established design and implement it faithfully.
* Can debug an unfamiliar frontend, integrate APIs and use Git, pull requests and automated checks confidently. You understand accessibility and web performance, and handle credentials and user data responsibly.
* Use AI coding tools with judgement. Let them help you move faster. Read the diff, test the result and be able to explain what you're shipping. 'The model wrote it' isn't a debugging strategy.
* Ask good questions when the brief is fuzzy. Explain trade-offs, suggest a practical way forward and use evidence before declaring that something needs fixing.

**Bonus points that are not dealbreakers**
==========================================

* You've built for B2B SaaS, developer tools or AI products.
* You've built component libraries, design systems or interactive prototypes that other people actually use.
* You've worked with animation, SVG, Canvas or other techniques that make complex ideas easier to explore on the web.
* You've used a headless CMS such as Sanity, or worked on technical SEO and analytics integrations without letting them take over the frontend.

**How to apply**
================

Skip the generic cover letter. Send us a couple of interfaces or web projects you've built, with a short note on what you personally designed and coded. Pick one and walk us through a component, interaction or tricky engineering decision. Code samples are welcome where you can share them.

If there's a side project you're weirdly proud of, we'd like to see that too.

**Why Sarvam?**
---------------

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
As an Advanced Systems Engineer here at Honeywell, you will design, implement, and manage complex systems, driving innovation, safety, and efficiency. Work on cutting-edge projects and shape future technology solutions.

  

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
------------------------

* 8+ years of software development experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Full-stack development:** Design, develop and maintain backend services with Java/Spring Boot and Node.js, and responsive web and desktop applications with React and Electron.
* **APIs & architecture:** Build and integrate REST APIs, and make architecture decisions that support scalability, resilience and maintainability.
* **Data & messaging:** Develop data models and optimise MySQL/MongoDB queries; implement reliable event-driven integrations.
* **Secure development:** Implement authentication and authorisation, apply secure coding practices, and remediate application and dependency vulnerabilities.
* **Quality & delivery:** Write automated tests, participate in code reviews and contribute to CI/CD and Agile delivery.
* **Deployment & support:** Deploy and troubleshoot applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and work with RHEL and Ubuntu environments to resolve production issues.
* **Technical collaboration:** Translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate design decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders.

**MUST HAVE**
-------------

**Core development & user interfaces**
--------------------------------------

* **Java:** Hands-on backend development with Java and Spring/Spring Boot; strong concurrency, core Java, design patterns and unit testing skills.
* **Node.js:** Build and debug server-side services with JavaScript/TypeScript, asynchronous programming, npm and service integrations.
* **React:** Develop reusable, performant applications using functional components, Hooks, state management and routing.
* **Electron:** Build secure cross-platform desktop applications with React/JavaScript, including main/renderer processes, IPC, packaging and native integration.
* **JavaScript / HTML5 / CSS3 & Responsive UI:** Strong modern JavaScript, semantic HTML and maintainable CSS skills; build accessible, responsive, cross-browser interfaces using Flexbox/Grid, media queries and reusable design-system components.

**APIs & architecture**
-----------------------

* **REST APIs:** Design and implement secure RESTful services, covering resource modelling, HTTP semantics, validation, pagination, error handling, versioning, OpenAPI/Swagger, testing and lifecycle management.
* **Architecture & scalability:** Assess monolith/microservice trade-offs and design scalable, resilient services using clear boundaries, caching, load balancing and failure-handling patterns.

**Security & data**
-------------------

* **API security:** Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and RBAC; validate tokens, secure authentication flows and service-to-service access, and manage secrets.
* **Application security:** Apply OWASP Top 10, secure coding, least privilege, dependency security and vulnerability remediation throughout the development lifecycle.
* **Databases:** Strong MySQL and MongoDB skills in data modelling, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, consistency and recovery; select SQL or NoSQL appropriately.

**Delivery & distributed systems**
----------------------------------

* **DevOps:** Experience with Git, CI/CD, code reviews, automated unit/integration/end-to-end testing and Agile/Scrum delivery.
* **Containers & orchestration:** Package applications with Docker and deploy, configure, scale and troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads securely.
* **Event-driven systems:** Understand Kafka or RabbitMQ, producers/consumers, partitioning, ordering, retries, dead-letter queues, delivery semantics, idempotency and schema evolution.
* **Operating systems:** Hands-on experience working with RHEL and Ubuntu operating systems.

**Problem solving & communication**
-----------------------------------

* Solve ambiguous production and business problems, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to diverse stakeholders.

**GOOD TO HAVE**
----------------

* **IEC 62443:** Experience with secure product development under IEC 62443-4-1 and IEC 62443-4-2, including threat modelling, security verification, vulnerability management and secure updates.
* **Advanced event-driven architectures:** Hands-on design of highly available, loosely coupled Kafka/RabbitMQ systems for low-latency, high-volume real-time processing.
* **C++:** Strong OOP, STL, memory management, multithreading and debugging skills with modern C++ (C++11/14/17+).
