title: Manager_Transmission Network 2nd Line Operations Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Transmission Network Operations professional to provide second-line NOC support across multi-vendor Access Transmission networks supporting Mobile (UK) and Enterprise (Ireland) services.

The role focuses on advanced network troubleshooting, incident and fault resolution, change management, network performance and service restoration across IP and transmission technologies including **BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave**. You will work across equipment from vendors including **Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE, ADVA, Huawei, Tellabs, Alcatel and Marconi**, while collaborating with first-line operations, field teams, network planning, design, provisioning and equipment vendors.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Provide second-line NOC operational support for Access Transmission networks in a multi-vendor environment covering Mobile (UK) and Enterprise (Ireland) services.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex transmission network faults and incidents, supporting resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Manage **incidents, faults and network changes**, including detailed analysis and service restoration.
* Support networks using **BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave** technologies.
* Operate and troubleshoot equipment across vendors including **Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE Microwave, ADVA, Huawei, Tellabs, Alcatel, Marconi and Timepictra**.
* Collaborate with design teams on Line-of-Sight blocked cases, tree-lopping requirements and network re-routing scenarios.
* Test new software releases in a laboratory environment before deployment to the live network.
* Support **FSI, SSI and new vendor/product onboarding**, including ADVA, Ericsson Microwave, Cisco 540 and Nokia IXR routers.
* Prepare technical **Methods of Procedure (MOPs)** for network configurations and operational processes, and provide knowledge transfer and training to first-line Transmission Operations teams.
* Work with equipment vendors including Cisco, SIAE, Ericsson, Chronos and Penta on critical faults and software or hardware issues, supporting escalation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Support legacy network decommissioning involving Marconi, Alcatel, Tellabs, Tarana, Timepictra and Siemens Microwave equipment, alongside the IP-fication of sites.
* Carry out software upgrades, hardware changes, configuration changes and configuration restoration across network infrastructure.
* Manage new network elements within **EMS/NMS** platforms and troubleshoot Microwave-related faults.
* Maintain configuration backups for Cisco, Tellabs, Alcatel, ADVA and Nokia equipment.
* Monitor the performance of network elements and circuits for errors, alarms and service outages, implementing appropriate preventive and corrective actions.
* Analyse logs and technical evidence to determine root causes for critical network outages.
* Plan network change activities relating to configuration and commissioning of telecommunications equipment.
* Collaborate with Network Planning teams on project roll-outs, capacity enhancements, circuit resiliency and new-site integrations.
* Provide technical support to field engineers during service-restoration activities.
* Conduct network health checks and produce operational reports to identify potential or emerging faults before they impact services.
* Develop and improve procedures for alarm analysis and fault elimination in collaboration with first-line Operations teams.
* Work with **Cramer** and provisioning teams to maintain accurate network data.
* Participate in regular customer and equipment-vendor reviews covering critical cases and network outages.

**Who you are**
---------------

You have practical experience in telecommunications network operations, ideally within a second-line NOC or Transmission Operations environment, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex network incidents.

You bring relevant knowledge or experience across:

* **IP networking:** BGP, IS-IS and MPLS.
* **Optical and transmission technologies:** SDH, DWDM and OTN.
* **Microwave transmission networks** and associated troubleshooting.
* Multi-vendor network equipment, particularly technologies from **Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE, ADVA, Huawei and Tellabs**.
* Advanced second-line troubleshooting, fault isolation and service restoration.
* Incident, fault and change management processes within an operational network environment.
* Network performance monitoring, alarm analysis and preventive fault management.
* Root Cause Analysis through network logs, alarms and technical evidence.
* Software upgrades, hardware changes, configuration management and restoration.
* EMS/NMS management and network configuration backup processes.
* Creation and execution of technical MOPs.
* Collaboration with first-line NOC teams, field engineers, design, network planning, provisioning, customers and technology vendors.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, multi-vendor Access Transmission networks supporting Mobile and Enterprise services. You will gain exposure to network modernisation, new technology onboarding, IP-fication, legacy network decommissioning, software upgrades and network resiliency initiatives while collaborating across design, planning, field operations and vendor teams.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

The role provides opportunities to deepen and broaden expertise in:

* Advanced IP and Transmission network troubleshooting.
* BGP, IS-IS and MPLS in operational telecommunications environments.
* SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave technologies.
* Cisco 540 and Nokia IXR routing platforms.
* Multi-vendor network operations and vendor escalation management.
* New technology and vendor onboarding.
* Laboratory testing and controlled software deployment.
* Network change planning, commissioning and technical MOP development.
* Root Cause Analysis and proactive network-health management.
* Network modernisation, IP-fication and legacy infrastructure decommissioning.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Senior Manager, Data Engineering, provides people leadership and deep technical direction for the Visa Client Exchange Cloud Platform and Clean Rooms, a strategic FY27 priority. The role leads the engineering journey from pilot to production, enabling secure, scalable, privacy-preserving data collaboration and reliable data exchange across on-premises and cloud environments.

Providing technical guidance across the Frontier Agentic Squad’s and extending platform leadership coverage across multiple region, this leader translates business priorities into architecture decisions, engineering roadmaps, and dependable production services. Success is measured through business opportunities enabled, platform reliability, delivery quality, and the growth and independence of engineering teams.

This is a technically engaged management role requiring the credibility to challenge designs, review critical code, guide complex incident resolution, and develop technical leads without becoming a delivery bottleneck. The Senior Manager partners with Product, Architecture, Operations and Infrastructure (O&I), Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to balance customer commitments, security, privacy, cost, and sustainable execution.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Own the technical roadmap and production delivery of VCDEP Clean Rooms and the cloud platform, aligned to customer and business outcomes.
* Guide architecture across AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost.
* Oversee high-volume data exchange between on-premises and cloud platforms, ensuring data quality, interoperability, and failure recovery.
* Embed privacy, security, query governance, and data lifecycle controls into platform design and operation.
* Drive operational excellence through clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, and tested disaster recovery.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, security remediation, and safe platform upgrades.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineers and technical leads, fostering inclusion, accountability, and technical excellence.
* Provide technical leadership across squads, clarify ownership, resolve disagreements, and reduce single-person dependencies.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Operations, Security, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to manage priorities, risks, and delivery commitments.
* Lead responsible adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows, with human oversight and measurable improvements in productivity and quality.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8+ years of relevant work experience and a bachelor’s degree, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.
* Experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale data platforms or distributed systems, including production ownership, coaching, performance development, and cross-team technical guidance.
* Demonstrated technical depth in cloud architecture and data engineering, with substantial experience in at least one of AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks and the ability to evaluate cross-platform integration trade-offs.
* Experience designing and operating high-volume data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and distributed processing systems, including data validation, performance optimization, failure recovery, and idempotent processing.
* Working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review production code and guide testing, API design, version control, CI/CD, and secure development practices.
* Experience implementing secure data access, encryption, auditability, and data lifecycle governance in partnership with security, risk, privacy, or compliance teams.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and establishing monitoring, operational documentation, incident response, and reliability improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical leads, delegate ownership, resolve disagreements, and influence teams outside direct reporting lines.
* Experience translating business needs into technical roadmaps and measurable outcomes, with clear communication of architectural trade-offs and individual versus team contributions.
* Digital fluency and the ability to evaluate AI-assisted engineering workflows for usefulness, quality, security, and appropriate human oversight.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for data engineering solutions.
* Experience scaling self-service platform capabilities, establishing multi-squad operating models, and leading geographically distributed teams in a matrixed organization.
* Experience deploying AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows with demonstrated productivity or quality improvements and effective security, review, and audit controls.

description:

***Where Growth Never Stops***
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*

Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens.*
**About The Department**
The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for the global IIoT platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS), providing architectural guidance and technical direction across software development teams.
* Own and evolve the end-to-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performing cloud-native solutions using Azure services, including Azure IoT Hub, cloud messaging, data storage, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
* Guide technical design and development across Java, Node.js, C#, REST APIs, microservices, and real-time data processing technologies, ensuring seamless integration between industrial equipment, Edge devices, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
* Establish engineering standards, development practices, and architecture principles that promote maintainability, scalability, software quality, and security.
* Mentor and develop software engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform operational excellence and maintain availability of 99.9% or greater through effective monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup validation, failover strategies, resilience testing, and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resource utilization to balance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud operating costs.
* Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and industrial cybersecurity principles, including IEC 62443, while partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Partner with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software and Edge developers, data engineers, automation engineers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Support technical estimation, solution reviews, project and release planning, and clearly communicate technical strategies, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, and engineering practices, and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap for IIoT, digital services, and industrial automation.
* Drive continuous improvements that enhance platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, engineering productivity, and overall customer value.

**You bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications are preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, industrial digital solutions, or related technology domains.
* 3+ years of demonstrated technical leadership experience, providing architectural direction and guiding engineering teams in the delivery of enterprise software or cloud platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud platforms using Microsoft Azure.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Edge computing, industrial automation, manufacturing technologies, or connected equipment solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and technology principles, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile development environments and structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Strong systems thinking, critical thinking, and complex problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues and drive effective solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technology alternatives, understand system dependencies, and make sound architectural and technical decisions.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence engineering teams, coordinate resources, and work effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working effectively in global, cross-functional, and multicultural environments.
* A collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement mindset with a strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and customer value.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*

Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. * Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: CTO & Cofounder
description:
Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Kapzo Healthcare Private Limited | Founding Team | India**

About Kapzo

Kapzo is building a technology-driven healthcare commerce platform with a simple ambition: make medicines and healthcare essentials accessible to everyone, faster and more conveniently.

We are building a hyperlocal healthcare delivery ecosystem connecting customers, pharmacies and delivery partners through technology.

We are now looking for an exceptional technology entrepreneur to join us as
**Co-Founder & CTO**
and take ownership of our technology vision.

The opportunity

This is not a conventional employment opportunity.

We are looking for a technology leader who wants to build a company from the ground up, take meaningful ownership and participate in the long-term value creation of Kapzo.

The selected candidate will join the founding leadership team with a capital investment commitment of ₹10–15 lakh towards the company's growth and technology development.

**Important engagement terms:**

* Full-time founding commitment.
* No monthly salary until institutional funding is secured.
* Initial capital investment of ₹10–15 lakh.
* Founder equity participation, with the percentage and vesting terms mutually agreed and contractually documented upfront.
* Equity issuance structured around the first institutional funding milestone, subject to applicable law.
* Proposed appointment to the company's Board of Directors with voting rights, subject to corporate approvals and legal requirements.
* The existing founder retains the controlling founder and CEO position.

What you will own

**Technology & Product**

* Define and execute Kapzo's long-term technology strategy.
* Own product architecture, scalability, security and engineering standards.
* Lead development of customer, pharmacy, delivery partner and administrative platforms.
* Build reliable, scalable and high-performance systems.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the engineering team.
* Establish development processes and technical standards.
* Own technology hiring and engineering culture.
* Manage infrastructure, deployment, cloud costs and technical operations.

**Business & Strategic Leadership**

* Work directly with the founder on company strategy.
* Participate in board-level discussions and decisions.
* Contribute to fundraising, investor discussions and technology due diligence.
* Build technology as a long-term competitive advantage for Kapzo.

Who should apply?

* Graduated from IIT, BITS Pilani or another reputed Tier-1 engineering institution.
* 5–12 years of relevant technology experience preferred.
* Strong hands-on software engineering and system architecture experience.
* Experience building and scaling consumer-facing products.
* Strong expertise in backend architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure and mobile/web applications.
* Experience leading engineering teams or founding technology ventures.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and execution capabilities.
* Financial capacity and willingness to make the proposed ₹10–15 lakh capital commitment.
* Ready to commit full-time without salary until institutional funding.

**Experience in healthcare technology, e-commerce, hyperlocal delivery or marketplace platforms will be an advantage.**

Technology environment

Our current product technology includes Flutter, Next.js and NestJS. We are looking for someone capable of evaluating, improving and scaling the existing architecture.

Why Kapzo?

* Become part of the founding leadership team.
* Build a meaningful healthcare technology business.
* Participate in long-term company ownership.
* Lead technology and engineering strategy.
* Work directly with the founder and participate in board-level governance.

Application

If you are an ambitious technology leader who wants to transition from building products for other companies to building your own company, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply with:

1. Your LinkedIn profile or CV.
2. A brief description of products or platforms you have built.
3. Your technical leadership experience.
4. Your interest in joining as a capital-contributing cofounder.

**Let's build something meaningful.**

*Please note: This is an investment-backed, unpaid founding opportunity until institutional funding, not a salaried CTO position. Investment, equity and board appointment are subject to due diligence and definitive legal documentation.*

Remote Flash enables software updates to be delivered directly to Caterpillar products without requiring a technician to physically access the machine, helping reduce service effort, improve equipment uptime, and accelerate deployment of software improvements.
  
  
The Remote Flash Team Manager will lead an engineering team responsible for the architecture, development, integration, validation, and deployment of the next generation of remote software update capabilities. The role combines strong people leadership with software and systems engineering leadership across connected products, embedded systems, cloud/back-office services, and Caterpillar product programs.
  
  
The team is entering an important technology transition. The Remote Flash roadmap includes NexGen platforms, 5G integration, enhanced flashing of control ECMs, orchestration of multi-component updates, and continued support for legacy equipment.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
People and Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team globally.
* Establish clear technical objectives, ownership, priorities, and engineering expectations.
* Build capability in embedded software, connected systems, cloud integration, systems engineering, DevSecOps, validation, and remote software update technologies.
* Develop technical leaders and create career growth opportunities within the team.
* Foster an engineering culture focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, quality, and continuous improvement.

Remote Flash Engineering
  
  

* Lead engineering delivery of Caterpillar's Remote Flash capabilities across connected products.
* Drive development of next-generation remote software update architecture, including NexGen & 5G Radio.
* These capabilities are reflected in the current Remote Flash roadmap and architecture work.
* Ensure solutions account for Caterpillar's diverse equipment population, embedded controllers, communication technologies, machine architectures, and legacy products.
* Guide engineering decisions involving update orchestration, rollback and recovery, software compatibility, cybersecurity, diagnostics, telemetry, and deployment reliability.
* Drive system-level design and integration across on-machine software and enterprise/back-office systems.

Delivery and Operational Excellence
  
  

* Own execution of engineering roadmaps from requirements through development, integration, validation, release, and production support.
* Establish measurable engineering and operational KPIs for quality, reliability, deployment success, cycle time, and customer impact.
* Improve engineering practices through automation, CI/CD, automated validation, modern source control, and effective use of engineering data.
* Use field performance and failure data to identify systemic issues and continuously improve Remote Flash reliability.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Partner with product groups, embedded controls teams, connectivity teams, enterprise software teams, cybersecurity, digital product organizations, dealers, and external engineering partners.
* Translate product and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities.
* Lead technical trade-off and prioritization discussions involving architecture, cost, schedule, risk, and long-term maintainability.
* Communicate technical strategy, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to engineering and business leadership.

What You Have
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading engineering or software development teams.
* Experience delivering complex distributed, embedded, connected-product, or cloud-integrated systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through architecture, development, integration, validation, and production deployment.
* Strong technical problem-solving and systems-thinking skills.
* Experience working across organizations and influencing technical decisions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with embedded Linux, embedded controllers/ECMs, telematics, connected products, or IoT systems.
* Experience with OTA or remote software update systems.
* Experience with update orchestration, A/B software deployment, bootloaders, rollback/recovery, software signing, or secure software distribution.
* Experience with cloud-connected vehicle, machine, industrial, or edge-computing architectures.
* Experience with Agile software development, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevSecOps.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
* Experience with construction, mining, industrial, automotive, or other complex connected equipment.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Software is becoming an increasingly important part of Caterpillar products. The ability to safely update software remotely at scale reduces equipment downtime and support cost while allowing Caterpillar to deliver improvements more rapidly.
  
  
This manager will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for making remote software updates a reliable, scalable capability across current and future Caterpillar products.
  
  
Job Location - Chennai
  
  
Relocation - Domestic
  
  
5 days work from office
  
  
**Posting Dates**
November 12, 2026 - November 25, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.

* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).

title: Platform Distribution Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Platform Distribution Architect**
to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers.

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments.

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Distribution Architecture**

* Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK.
* Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments.

**2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness**

* Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers.
* Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Design**

* Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes.
* Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies.

**4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation**

* Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows.
* Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes.

**5. CI/CD and Release Automation**

* Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration.
* Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability.

**6. Self-Service Distribution**

* Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces.
* Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers.

**7. Upgrades and Migrations**

* Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes.
* Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation.

**8. Observability and Reliability**

* Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments.

**9. Security and Compliance**

* Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code.

**10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency**

* Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations.
* Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency.

**11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership**

* Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover.
* Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews.

**What You Bring**

* **Multi-cloud architecture:**
  Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or GCP — covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security.
* **Kubernetes and containers:**
  Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* **CI/CD and release automation:**
  Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as Code:**
  Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools.
* **Deployment architecture:**
  Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation.
* **Observability and reliability:**
  Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.
* **Programming and scripting:**
  Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell.
* **Core technical fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals.

**Good to Have**

* Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries.
* Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python.
* Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture.
* Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

**Interested?**

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you.

* Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering**
**GCL: F**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to define the enterprise standard for data engineering and turn strategy into measurable outcomes that accelerate insights to patients? In this role, you will establish the main direction for data engineering across AstraZeneca. You will be responsible for building and scaling a distributed service that provides trusted, high-quality, secure, and cost-efficient data products at enterprise scale.
  
  
You will own the end-to-end build of our data engineering capability. This includes driving visibility and lineage, automated quality controls, FinOps governance, performance SLAs/SLOs, and regulatory compliance across crucial information domains. Working as part of a varied community of specialists, you will connect strategy to execution, partnering across business technology groups to standardize how data is acquired, transformed, orchestrated, and delivered for impact. Can you turn a long-term architecture into reusable accelerators that dozens of teams embrace and love?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy aligned to our 2030 Data Strategy; translate vision into a capability model, adoption roadmap, service tiers, and maturity milestones that build measurable business value.
* Build and lead a focused, high-performing team of specialists; set direction on technology perfection across acquisition, storage, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, CI/CD, and containerization using Snowflake, Fivetran, Dbt, DataOps.live, and SnowPark Container Services. Govern the standardization of end-to-end data engineering solutions aligned with enterprise architecture; establish enterprise practice as a foundational pillar of data management.
* Champion automation across the lifecycle—impact analysis, design, build, test, deploy—leveraging AI code generation (for example, Snowflake Cortex Code and GitHub Copilot) to increase velocity and quality while reducing defects and time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
* Embed governance-as-code and preventative controls; design pipelines and patterns that achieve close to zero cost leakage on cloud infrastructure, and uplift performance metrics including latency, reliability, and quality through clear SLAs/SLOs.
* Operate and scale a federated service across business technology groups; enable alignment, capability uplift, and reuse via onboarding kits, templates, and self-service accelerators.
* Partner with leaders across data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise/domain/solution architecture; liaise with procurement, finance, legal, quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor partners to ensure compliant, secure, and value-driven delivery.
* Drive adoption through education, enablement, and community practices; measure success through standardization, automation readiness, turnaround time to business value, capability maturity, and adoption velocity.
* Proactively raise, handle, and mitigate risks; ensure alignment to regulatory requirements (including privacy, GxP, SOx, and HIPAA as applicable) without slowing delivery.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Preferably 15+ years in data engineering leadership roles at an enterprise capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience in data engineering capability involving data acquisition, data storage, data ingestion, data transformation, data orchestration, CI/CD, containerization.
* Extensive practical experience engaging with Open table standards (for ex, Iceberg) and Open technical catalogs (for ex, Snowflake Horizon).
* Extensive practical experience handling Structured, Semi-Structured and Unstructured data assets and engineering.
* Mandatory (Must Have) Skills – Snowflake, Fivetran DBT, DataOps.live, SnowPark Container technology, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon, Snowflake Cortex software (CoCo), AWS S3.
* Optional (Nice to Have) Skills – Databricks, Snaplogic, Apache Polaris, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, AWS Redshift, Docker, Kubernetes, MWAA, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Expertise with modern data architectures, cloud data platforms and data engineering lifecycle implementation and practices.
* Solid understanding of metadata, lineage, security classification, FinOps, and SLA/SLO frameworks.
* Confirmed leadership in large-scale, federated, global technology environments.
* Ability to influence, educate, and lead change across technical & business teams.
* Background in regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare) with Data Privacy, HIPAA, GxP & SOx.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Track record establishing new capabilities from scratch and scaling globally.
* Experience defining enterprise service tiers, maturity models, and adoption programs.
* Proven leadership developing talent and hard-working technical teams.
* Strong collaborator management and collaboration across matrixed environments.
* A forward-thinking approach combined with a commitment to taking initiative and delivering tangible outcomes.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our outstanding and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here you will build from scratch with a collective of inclusive self-starters who share ideas, challenge with grit, and make bold thinking real. We bring unexpected teams into the same room—engineers, scientists, analysts, and partners—using brand-new data and AI tools to turn complexity into practical insights that help patients sooner. You will work at the heart of our information transformation. u will have the autonomy to set direction and the community support to deliver it. You will balance ambition with care while scaling solutions across a worldwide information ecosystem.
  
  
Lead the enterprise backbone supporting data engineering and watch your strategy translate into faster, trusted insights for patients—step forward and build what comes next.

12-Nov-2026

03-Dec-2026

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. title: AI architect
description:
**Purpose of the role**

Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. This role is the bridge between the AI Lab’s technical capabilities and the investment team’s business requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Design the Databricks lakehouse architecture: medallion schema (bronze/silver/gold), Delta table design, Unity Catalog governance, and vector store configuration.
* Build and maintain the API integration layer: Addepar REST API (ingestion and reverse push), Capital IQ API, eVestment/Mercer feeds, email ingestion (Outlook Graph API), and operating division ERP connectors.
* Design the serving infrastructure: Databricks SQL dashboards, Streamlit/Genie chat interface, REST API endpoints for Addepar and external systems, alert engine, and scheduled report distribution.
* Implement the security and governance framework: Azure Active Directory integration, Unity Catalog role-based access control, encryption (Azure Key Vault), data lineage tracking, and audit trail for IC governance.
* Design the regulated entity isolation architecture (Zone A / Zone B) ensuring Nama Financing customer data stays within the SAMA-compliant perimeter.
* Manage the Databricks workspace: compute cluster sizing, job scheduling, cost optimisation, and capacity planning.
* Attend daily standups with the investment team to understand analytical requirements and translate them into technical specifications for the data engineer and ML engineer.
* Review and approve all code deployments, data model changes, and infrastructure modifications.
* Plan the platform’s extension from the Investment Division to the five operating divisions (Waves 2–5).
* Evaluate and recommend technology decisions: vendor selection, open-source vs commercial tools, build vs buy.

**Qualifications and experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data engineering and platform architecture, with at least 3 years on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
* Experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Active Directory.
* Demonstrated experience building API integrations with financial data providers (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv, or similar).
* Understanding of data governance frameworks, RBAC implementation, and regulatory data requirements (financial services preferred).
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM deployment for enterprise applications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or equivalent.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment operations strongly preferred.

title: Knowledge Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Knowledge Architect**
to own the architecture and evolution of its enterprise knowledge plane — the foundation that enables AI agents and products to understand, retrieve and use enterprise information reliably.

You will shape how information is ingested, processed, represented, secured, retrieved, evaluated and reused across Purple Fabric and its related platforms.

This is a hands-on architecture role combining enterprise knowledge systems, RAG, semantic and graph technologies, data governance and production engineering. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to turn complex knowledge requirements into scalable, reusable platform capabilities.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Knowledge-Plane Architecture**

* Define the architecture, boundaries and interfaces across ingestion, parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector search, semantic and graph structures, retrieval, reranking and citations.
* Guide the evolution of the knowledge plane across enterprise AI use cases.

**2. Knowledge Representation**

* Design flexible models for documents, entities, relationships, provenance and semantic context.
* Determine when vector, relational, graph or hybrid approaches are appropriate.

**3. Retrieval Quality**

* Define architecture for RAG, hybrid search, self-query, reranking and context assembly.
* Establish measurable retrieval and evaluation criteria to assess knowledge coverage, relevance, completeness and answer quality.

**4. Knowledge Lifecycle and Governance**

* Own versioning, refresh, deletion, lineage, access-control propagation and tenant isolation.
* Address data residency, retention and policy enforcement throughout the knowledge lifecycle.

**5. Scale, Performance and Cost**

* Define measurable targets for ingestion throughput, indexing and search latency, storage growth, retrieval quality and cost.
* Guide benchmarking, capacity planning and performance optimisation.

**6. Reusable Platform Capabilities**

* Translate recurring Purple Fabric, MSOCK and customer requirements into reusable knowledge capabilities and adapters.
* Support integrations with customer-managed and external knowledge stores where appropriate.

**7. Proofs of Concept and Technical Execution**

* Prototype high-risk knowledge architecture decisions.
* Review implementations, troubleshoot retrieval and data issues, and use evidence to guide what should be built, refined or retired.

**What You Bring**

* **Production knowledge and RAG architecture:**
  Experience architecting a live enterprise knowledge, search, RAG or semantic platform, with the ability to explain actual data volumes, query characteristics, quality metrics and design decisions.
* **End-to-end ingestion and retrieval expertise:**
  Strong understanding of document processing, metadata, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, citations and real-world failure modes.
* **Semantic and graph modelling:**
  Ability to model entities, relationships, ontologies, semantic structures and provenance, and understand when graph-based approaches add value.
* **Evaluation discipline:**
  Experience defining coverage, retrieval relevance, grounding, completeness and answer-quality evaluations beyond subjective demonstrations.
* **Enterprise governance:**
  Understanding of access controls, tenant isolation, PII, lineage, retention, auditability and customer-hosted or data-residency requirements.
* **Hands-on engineering:**
  Ability to prototype using Python, Java or equivalent, review APIs and data models, troubleshoot pipelines and work directly with engineering teams on production issues.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with MongoDB Atlas Search, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, pgvector, Azure AI Search, Neo4j or other vector, graph and search technologies.
* Exposure to code and software knowledge graphs, ontology-driven systems or engineering knowledge platforms.
* Experience with multi-cloud, customer-hosted and regulated-enterprise deployments.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, knowledge-tool integration, evaluation frameworks and AI-assisted engineering.

**Interested?**

If you have built and evolved enterprise knowledge platforms in production and want to shape how AI systems access and use enterprise knowledge, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

title: Technical Lead- Platform Engineering
description:
**Technical Lead – Platform Engineering**
***Where Growth Never Stops***
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*

Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens.*
**About The Department**
The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for the global IIoT platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS), providing architectural guidance and technical direction across software development teams.
* Own and evolve the end-to-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer-facing applications.
* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performing cloud-native solutions using Azure services, including Azure IoT Hub, cloud messaging, data storage, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
* Guide technical design and development across Java, Node.js, C#, REST APIs, microservices, and real-time data processing technologies, ensuring seamless integration between industrial equipment, Edge devices, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
* Establish engineering standards, development practices, and architecture principles that promote maintainability, scalability, software quality, and security.
* Mentor and develop software engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform operational excellence and maintain availability of 99.9% or greater through effective monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead disaster recovery, business continuity, backup validation, failover strategies, resilience testing, and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure and resource utilization to balance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud operating costs.
* Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices and industrial cybersecurity principles, including IEC 62443, while partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Partner with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software and Edge developers, data engineers, automation engineers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Support technical estimation, solution reviews, project and release planning, and clearly communicate technical strategies, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, and engineering practices, and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap for IIoT, digital services, and industrial automation.
* Drive continuous improvements that enhance platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, engineering productivity, and overall customer value.

**You bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications are preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, industrial digital solutions, or related technology domains.
* 3+ years of demonstrated technical leadership experience, providing architectural direction and guiding engineering teams in the delivery of enterprise software or cloud platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud platforms using Microsoft Azure.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Edge computing, industrial automation, manufacturing technologies, or connected equipment solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and technology principles, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile development environments and structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Strong systems thinking, critical thinking, and complex problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues and drive effective solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technology alternatives, understand system dependencies, and make sound architectural and technical decisions.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence engineering teams, coordinate resources, and work effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working effectively in global, cross-functional, and multicultural environments.
* A collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement mindset with a strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and customer value.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth.
