title: ServiceNow SOMT Data Modeller
description:
**Role: ServiceNow SOMT Data Modeller**

**Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hydrabad or Pune (1 – 2 days on-site per week)**

**Duration: 12 months**

**Responsibilities**

• Review existing models and define customer-facing service (CFS), resource-facing service (RFS) and resource specifications at the appropriate level of detail for each service journey.

• Distinguish service types, resource types, operational instances, characteristics and fulfilment tasks. Justify modelling choices through lifecycle, identity, ownership and reuse needs.

• Create model diagrams, a data dictionary and characteristic definitions covering types, allowed values, mandatory fields, cardinalities, relationships and validation rules.

• Define catalogue relationships and decomposition mappings with the architect and developers, including characteristic propagation and any required quantity or dependency rules.

• Map incoming TMF641 data, manually captured supplier information and fulfilment results to order records, service inventory and outbound TMF638-style notifications.

• Specify stable service identifiers, supplier references, source-of-truth ownership and lifecycle changes for Create, Cease, bounded MACDs, amendments and cancellations.

• Align lightweight service inventory and CMDB relationships with assurance needs. Identify the minimum approved resource representation and assess later inventory extensions separately.

• Version models and mappings, assess changes to existing payloads and workflows, and prepare representative data with positive, invalid, missing-value and duplicate cases.

• Support catalogue configuration, model verification and client-led testing. Reconcile data discrepancies and hand over editable models, mapping rules and operational field guidance.

**Essential experience and skills**

* Practical telecom service-catalogue, fulfilment or inventory modelling experience, including implementable models rather than only conceptual enterprise diagrams.
* Working knowledge of the TM Forum product, service and resource (PSR) concepts and SID principles, including CFS/RFS specifications, resource specifications and their instances.
* Hands-on familiarity with ServiceNow catalogue and inventory configuration, or demonstrable experience translating telecom service models into a ServiceNow implementation.
* Ability to produce source-to-target mappings, characteristic dictionaries, entity relationships, cardinalities and validation rules that developers and testers can use directly.
* Understanding of TMF641 payloads, TMF638 service representations and the relationship between catalogue definitions, order data, operational inventory and CMDB records.
* Experience modelling identifiers, state transitions, model versions and reconciliation across initial fulfilment and subsequent service changes.
* Ability to run detailed workshops with service designers, architects, business analysts and Build teams, and explain the operational consequences of modelling decisions.

**Desirable experience**

* ServiceNow CMDB, CSDM or TSOM experience, including identification, reconciliation and service-to-resource relationships.
* Offnet broadband, customer-premises equipment, satellite access or provider-specific service modelling experience.
* TMF633 service-catalogue concepts, schema validation, data profiling or scripts to check model and mapping consistency.

Expected deliverables

* Versioned service/resource specification models, relationship diagrams, a characteristic dictionary and decomposition mappings.
* API and manual-input mapping matrices, inventory identity and lifecycle rules, and reconciliation criteria.
* Representative test data, validated catalogue configuration and model walkthroughs for developers, testers and support teams.

title: SAP Business Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Business Analyst with strong business analysis and SAP process knowledge to work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, technical teams, and project managers. The candidate will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, understanding end-to-end business processes, identifying process gaps, and translating business needs into functional requirements and actionable user stories.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in requirement gathering, AS-IS and TO-BE process mapping, BRD/FRD preparation, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, stakeholder coordination, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The candidate will act as a bridge between business and technical teams to ensure successful delivery of SAP solutions aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners, and end users to gather, analyze, validate, and document business requirements.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirement-gathering workshops, and business discussions to understand business needs and operational challenges.
* Analyze existing business processes and document AS-IS and TO-BE workflows, identifying gaps, dependencies, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Work closely with SAP functional consultants and technical teams to understand SAP functionalities and translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions.
* Prepare and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), use cases, process flows, and other functional documentation.
* Create detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and maintain requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Perform fit-gap analysis to identify differences between existing business processes and standard SAP functionalities, recommending suitable solutions.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including SAP functional consultants, developers, QA teams, Product Owners, and Project Managers, to ensure requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
* Facilitate requirement reviews, walkthroughs, and stakeholder meetings to validate business requirements and obtain necessary approvals.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support backlog management, requirement prioritization, change request management, and impact analysis.
* Develop UAT test scenarios and test cases based on approved business requirements and coordinate UAT execution with business users.
* Validate SAP functionalities against business requirements, track defects, coordinate with technical and functional teams for resolution, and facilitate retesting and business sign-off.
* Maintain requirement documentation, process flows, issue logs, and project-related deliverables throughout the SDLC.
* Support SAP implementation, enhancement, rollout, migration, and integration projects.
* Provide post-implementation support by coordinating with business and technical teams to resolve functional issues and ensure smooth business operations.

title: Business Analyst
description:
About Firstsource

Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.

**Job Description – Business Analyst**

**Job Title**

Business Analyst

**Department**

Product & Delivery

**Location**

Remote

**Employment Type**

Full-Time, Permanent

**Experience Required**

Minimum 6 Years

**Key Focus**

Requirements Engineering & Voice AI Solution Delivery

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and delivery-focused Business Analyst to join a growing product organization building next-generation conversational AI solutions for the financial services industry. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business, compliance, engineering, and client stakeholders — translating regulated, domain-heavy business needs into clear, actionable requirements for a voice AI platform. You will own requirement lifecycle activities across discovery, design, delivery, and post-launch iteration, and help shape a product that operates at the intersection of generative AI, contact-center telephony, and stringent regulatory obligations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements Engineering & Business Analysis**

* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for conversational AI, voice, and contact-center automation solutions through workshops, interviews, and process observation.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process models that engineering and QA can act on without ambiguity.
* Author and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and requirement traceability matrices across the full delivery lifecycle.
* Partner with product managers and delivery leads to groom, refine, and prioritize the backlog based on customer impact, regulatory obligation, and technical feasibility.
* Support UAT planning, scenario definition, defect triage, and business sign-off activities.

**Domain & Regulatory Alignment**

* Map US financial-services regulatory requirements (FDCPA, Regulation F, SCRA, TCPA, PCI-DSS, state-level consent laws) into functional and non-functional specifications.
* Partner with compliance officers and legal counsel to validate call flows, mandatory disclosures, consent language, and verbatim script requirements.
* Author disposition-code taxonomies, exception handling flows, and cease-and-desist processing rules aligned with regulatory intent.
* Ensure that requirements support audit trail capture, transcript retention, and post-call compliance monitoring end-to-end.
* Identify prohibited practices and design guardrails for third-party disclosure, reverse PII, and hallucination prevention.

**Solution Design & Integration Analysis**

* Analyze and document integration requirements across core collection platforms, telephony infrastructure, payment gateways, and CRM systems.
* Define data flows, API contracts, event schemas, and integration edge cases in partnership with solution architects and integration leads.
* Contribute to conversation flow design, dialog modeling, intent taxonomies, and negotiation logic (including waterfall offer sequencing and settlement rules).
* Analyze failure modes and design graceful fallback paths, including warm transfer to human agents, retry policies, and system-outage playbooks.
* Support solution feasibility assessments, gap analyses, and vendor evaluations where third-party components are in scope.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management**

* Serve as a trusted partner to product owners, engineering leads, compliance officers, QA leads, and client stakeholders across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Translate ambiguous or evolving business needs into structured, testable specifications that unblock delivery.
* Drive requirement clarifications during sprint execution and change control activities.
* Present analysis findings, trade-off assessments, and decision options clearly to senior leadership and client-facing forums.
* Contribute to release planning, go-live readiness, change management, and hypercare transition documentation.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in technology-led product, platform, or transformation delivery.
* Demonstrated experience delivering requirements for conversational AI, IVR, contact-center automation, or voice-enabled applications.
* Strong working knowledge of US collections regulation (FDCPA, Regulation F, TCPA) and payment-data handling standards (PCI-DSS).
* Proven ability to author BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows (BPMN/UML), and traceability matrices at production quality.
* Hands-on experience with agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) and requirement management tooling (JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Aha! or equivalent).
* Working understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, and written communication skills, with the ability to move fluidly between business and technical audiences.
* CBAP, PMI-PBA, IIBA-AAC (Agile Analysis), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.

description:
PharmaACE is a growing Global Healthcare Consulting Firm, headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Our expert teams of Business Analysts, based across the US, Canada, Europe, and India, provide Analytics and Business Solutions using our worldwide delivery models for a wide range of clients. Our clients include established, multinational BioPharma leaders and innovators, as well as entrepreneurial firms on the cutting edge of science. Our wealth of therapeutic area experience cuts across Oncology, Immuno- science, CNS, CV-Met, and Rare Diseases. We support our clients' needs in Primary Care, Specialty Care, and Hospital business units, and we have managed portfolios in the Biologics space, Branded Pharmaceuticals, Generics, APIs, Diagnostics, and Packaging & Delivery Systems.

**Role Summary**

The Project Manager leads end-to-end delivery of AI and Gen AI initiatives for Field Medical and Medical Affairs clients. The role turns client needs (MSL effectiveness, medical insights generation, scientific engagement planning, and KOL/HCP intelligence) into well-scoped projects, manages cross-functional teams of analysts, data scientists, and engineers, and ensures solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with medical, privacy, and AI governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Client engagement and scoping:

* Work with Medical Affairs, Field Medical Excellence, and Medical Insights leaders to understand objectives, define use cases, and translate them into scope, success criteria, and project plans.

Use case portfolio:

* Shape and prioritize AI/Gen AI use cases such as LLM-based insight extraction from MSL interaction notes, insight theme clustering and trend detection, KOL identification and segmentation, next-best-engagement recommendations, pre-call planning assistants, and medical content summarization.

Project delivery

* Own timelines, budgets, resourcing, risks, and dependencies across proofs of concept, pilots, and production rollouts. Run Agile ceremonies and status governance.

Team leadership

* Lead and mentor analysts, data scientists, and engineers. Review deliverables for analytical rigor, clinical relevance, and client readiness.

Data and platform coordination

* Coordinate access to and integration of field medical data sources such as Veeva CRM / Medical CRM, medical information requests, congress and publication data, and third-party KOL databases.

Responsible AI and compliance:

* Make sure solutions follow medical-commercial separation, privacy (HIPAA/GDPR), client AI governance, and validation standards. Set up human-in-the-loop review, model evaluation, and hallucination and bias checks for Gen AI outputs.

Value realization:

* Define KPIs (insight quality and coverage, MSL time saved, engagement reach, adoption) and report impact to client stakeholders.

Stakeholder communication:

* Prepare steering committee updates, executive readouts, and demos. Manage expectations and change requests.

Business development:

* Support proposals, solution design, effort estimates, and capability presentations for new Field Medical AI opportunities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Master's, MBA, PharmD, or PhD preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in pharma/life sciences analytics or consulting, with at least 3–5 years managing analytics or AI projects.
* Direct experience with Medical Affairs or Field Medical (MSL) analytics, such as MSL effectiveness, medical insights, or KOL mapping.
* Working understanding of AI/ML and Gen AI concepts: LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NLP, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Veeva CRM / Vault, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification is a plus

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Combines medical domain understanding with practical AI delivery experience.
* Structures ambiguous problems into clear scope, milestones, and deliverables.
* Communicates confidently with senior Medical Affairs leaders and technical teams.
* Manages risk proactively, especially around data access, compliance, and AI output quality.
* Builds and develops high-performing, client-focused teams.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional data engineer to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel  
  
Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by building and maintaining the data sources that power all of our decision making. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They know and love working with data engineering tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to build the right data pipelines to answer key business questions. They will build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. They will also be required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will work on unifying fragmented data pipelines, building robust data models, and ensuring reliable data lineage across multiple product areas. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams to develop data solutions that drive innovation and operational excellence.  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in big data technologies, strong data modeling and problem-solving skills, and a track record of delivering scalable, maintainable data systems. If you’re excited by the challenge of shaping data platforms that support real-world hardware, software, and operations, this is the role for you.  
  
A day in the life  

* Architect and implement scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines and infrastructure to support analytics, reporting, and business operations.
* Design and enforce data modeling standards, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure consistency, re-usability, and quality across systems.
* Lead design and code reviews, driving engineering best practices across data development, documentation, testing, and monitoring.
* Build data platforms and frameworks that support both batch and real-time processing, enabling flexible, efficient analytics at scale.
* Implement secure and compliant data solutions that meet internal and external regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR).
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies to improve data platform performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements, define solution architectures, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team hiring and onboarding

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with SQL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Engineer for S&P EDO
description:
**Description**

  
  

Role purpose

The Senior Data Engineer will migrate and validate batch data workloads from AWS Databricks to Azure Databricks. The role focuses on notebook and job conversion, Databricks Asset Bundles, data movement, Unity Catalog integration and automated deployment across environments.

Key responsibilities

* Assess source notebooks, jobs, libraries, SQL scripts, schedules, parameters, cluster configurations and upstream or downstream dependencies.

* Refactor Python, PySpark and SQL workloads for Azure Databricks while preserving business logic, data contracts and operational behavior.

* Convert deployment assets to Databricks Asset Bundles and implement environment specific configuration for development, test and production.

* Migrate data and metadata from S3 based patterns to ADLS Gen2 and Unity Catalog aligned structures using approved migration methods.

* Update secrets, service connections, file paths, storage access, libraries and integrations to use Azure platform services and managed identities.

* Implement or migrate scheduled batch workflows, job dependencies, retries, notifications and operational logging.

* Support Unity Catalog object creation, ownership, grants, external locations, storage credentials and workspace bindings under architect guidance.

* Build unit checks and reconciliation utilities for schema, row counts, aggregates, checksums and business rules.

* Resolve defects found during system integration testing and user acceptance testing. Provide evidence for release and cutover decisions.

* Document migrated components, operating instructions, known constraints and support procedures.

Required experience and skills

* 5+ or more years in data engineering with strong hands on delivery experience in Databricks and Spark based platforms.
* Experience designing and implementing Genie Spaces in Databricks, including semantic modeling, governance, and optimization of natural language query responses.

  Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to leverage Databricks Genie for AI-driven reporting, data discovery, and decision-making across large-scale data platforms.

* Advanced Python, PySpark and SQL skills, including debugging and optimization of batch workloads.

* Experience with Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Azure Key Vault and Entra based access patterns.

* Working knowledge of AWS Databricks, S3, IAM roles and cross cloud migration considerations.

* Practical experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Git based development and CI CD pipelines.

* Knowledge of Unity Catalog objects, privileges, external locations and governed data access.

* Experience with automated data validation and source to target reconciliation.

Preferred experience

* Experience migrating Databricks workloads between cloud providers.

* Experience with Delta Sharing and downstream Power BI or Fabric consumption.

* Exposure to Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar automation tools.

* Databricks Data Engineer or Azure Data Engineer certification.

Measures of success

* Migrated workloads reproduce approved source business results and meet agreed acceptance measures.

* Deployment packages promote consistently through environments with traceable evidence.

* Migration defects are resolved quickly without creating avoidable design exceptions.

* Technical documentation supports cutover, operations and knowledge transfer.

Qualifications and professional expectations

* Bachelor degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to work across customer, partner and delivery teams.

* Strong ownership, attention to detail and disciplined documentation of decisions, evidence and unresolved risks.

* Ability to work effectively in a distributed delivery model and support planned release activities when required.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Why this role matters**

Every AI agent, scorecard, and dashboard we deliver is only as good as the data underneath it. As a Data Engineer, you’ll build that foundation: the pipelines, connectors, indexes, vector stores, and data marts that make our AI products accurate, grounded, and auditable.

**What you’ll do**

* Design and build ingestion pipelines for structured data, unstructured content such as documents and PDFs, and metadata
* Build reusable connectors to enterprise systems, catalogs, content repositories, and licensed third-party sources via APIs
* Model and build raw-to-mart data layers serving both analytics and AI use cases
* Implement metadata extraction, enrichment, and search indexing, including semantic and vector indexes for RAG
* Set up and manage the vector databases and knowledge repositories that power LLM agents
* Build data quality rules, profiling, scoring outputs, and exception handling
* Register lineage and maintain source registries, version tracking, and refresh controls
* Design data stores for signals, findings, audit trails, and user feedback loops
* Apply security and governance controls, including RBAC, PII and sensitivity flagging, and approved data handling
* Support SIT and UAT data validation, defect fixes, and production releases

**What you bring**

* Strong Python and SQL, with solid dimensional and normalized data modeling
* Hands-on experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Azure/AWS data services
* Pipeline orchestration and transformation with Spark, Airflow, ADF, dbt, or similar
* REST API integration, JSON handling, and incremental or CDC ingestion patterns
* Data quality frameworks and pipeline testing practices
* Git and CI/CD for data workloads

**Bonus points for**

* RAG data preparation: chunking, embeddings, and vector databases (Azure AI Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or similar)
* Unstructured content processing, including text extraction, OCR, and document parsing
* Metadata management, data catalogs, ontologies, or knowledge graphs such as Neptune
* Experience supporting LLM or agentic applications with grounded, traceable data
* Life sciences data exposure and experience handling regulated data
* Azure Data Engineer, Databricks, AWS, or Snowflake certification

The Escalation Manager role acts as individual contributor incident commander to manage critical customer issues by engaging the required resources in a timely manner. The manager handles the issues in a hands-on capacity by balancing authoritative and collaborative operational modes based on the situation.

The Escalation Manager will build strong relationships with customers, Support teams across all cloud products, Engineering teams (Site Reliability, Customer-Centric Engineering, Technology Communications, and Readiness), CSIRT, Sales, Consulting, QA, Program Management, and Product Management.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of interacting with customers, working with executives, responding to issues and incidents, working hands-on with the team, and handling stress and ambiguity.

Building upon foundational platform engineering and DevOps experience, the Platform Engineer leads automation initiatives, develops Infrastructure-as-Code solutions, and optimises CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable delivery. Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

* Lead efforts in automation for self-healing, scaling, and performance tuning.

* Collaborate with SREs to improve mean time to resolution (MTTR) and overall platform reliability.

Collaboration, Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance in automation, monitoring, and hybrid design.

* Advocate for DevOps and automation best practices across engineering teams.

* Stay informed on emerging tools and cloud-native practices that improve reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

title: Support Engineer III, BXT
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Benefits Experience and Technology (BXT) builds a workplace for Amazonians to invent and deliver on behalf of customers by supporting employees’ financial, education, health, and wellness needs with benefits that optimize value and are easy to discover, enroll, and access.  
  
As a member of the BXT Support Tools and Automation (STA) team, you will work to build tools to help improve our benefits administration process that will look to make the benefits experience more seamless for Amazonians.  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, relishes working with big data technologies, and enjoys the challenge of complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time.  
  
The ideal candidate will be motivated, have strong attention to detail, and will model Amazon Leadership Principles. A familiarity with AWS technologies including S3, Glue, LakeFormation, Redshift as well as other no-SQL solutions which form the foundation of these systems is an asset.  
  
Support Engineer 3 in the BXT STA team will contribute as the first line of engineering support team working in close collaboration with product support and software engineering teams owning business critical services. You will own issues to resolution on behalf of the Amazonians, including coordination, customer communication, and tracking tasks to complete resolution. Support Engineer 3 will contribute to development of processes and mechanisms in support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services driving employee benefits experience. A successful Support Engineer 3 will have broad array of technical and functional skills, take initiative to identify areas of improvement, implement best practices in providing technical support, and think big to proactively mitigate issues using innovative solutions. As a Support Engineer 3 you will have opportunity to work with senior engineers in a multi functional team and advance your career to next level and ownership of critical software systems. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, relishes working with big data technologies, and enjoys the challenge of complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time.  
  
The ideal candidate will be motivated, have strong attention to detail, and will model Amazon Leadership Principles. A familiarity with AWS technologies including S3, Glue, LakeFormation, Redshift as well as other no-SQL solutions which form the foundation of these systems is an asset.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Work closely with multiple data platform teams focused on data engineering, analytics, orchestration and ETL tools, to build highly scalable systems and manage operations.
* Interface with globally dispersed data consumers to maintain overall health and stability of systems.
* Work closely with multiple engineering teams and product teams to implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
* Possess good technical knowledge in Infrastructure, Operational Excellence, System Tuning, and Monitoring.
* Participate in design reviews for complex systems.

* Document frequently occurring issues and report them to SMEs.

Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems  
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent

2+ year of experience with at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, Python, Ruby or similar  
2+ year of experience writing SQL queries including but not limited to using joins, aggregate functions and window functions  
  
A day in the life  
You start your day reviewing incoming cases and prioritizing based on urgency and complexity. You might spend the morning deep-diving into a multi-system issue, using scripting and diagnostic tools to isolate the root cause. After resolving the case, you document your findings so the broader team can learn from them. In the afternoon, you join a project meeting focused on automating a repetitive operational task, then spend time mentoring a newer team member through a tricky troubleshooting scenario. Our team is dedicated to delivering reliable, high-quality support that keeps Amazon's systems performing at their best. title: Principal IT Technologist - Product Analyst
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Data Platform & Services (DPS) value stream is responsible for managing enterprise data assets, data and analytics platforms, data governance, data quality, system integrations, and advanced analytics capabilities across the organization. Within DPS, the Enterprise Data Governance team delivers metadata management services through the Enterprise Data Catalog (Atlan), enabling consistent data discovery, lineage visibility, business glossary management, and governance at scale. This team partners with business and technology stakeholders to improve data transparency, trust, accessibility, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data ecosystems.
  
  
As a Principal Product Analyst, you will lead metadata integration and governance initiatives that strengthen enterprise data management capabilities. This role serves as a key partner to business stakeholders, data stewards, architects, and engineering teams to design, implement, and optimize metadata management solutions using Atlan and related technologies. You will drive requirements analysis, integration strategy, governance enablement, and operational excellence to improve data transparency, lineage, accessibility, and decision-making across the enterprise.  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Lead metadata integration initiatives using Atlan and related governance technologies across enterprise platforms.
* Design and implement integrations between metadata repositories, relational databases, Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) pipelines, business intelligence platforms, and external systems.
* Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements for data governance, metadata management, and integration solutions.
* Maintain the technical roadmap for metadata connectors, governance capabilities, and platform enhancements while aligning priorities with stakeholders.
* Validate metadata quality, data lineage accuracy, and governance coverage to support enterprise data governance policies.
* Monitor and troubleshoot integration pipelines, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to resolve technical issues.
* Partner with data stewards, architects, product managers, and development teams to establish and maintain critical business and technical metadata.
Develop technical documentation, testing strategies, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

title: Technical Product Manager - Platform UI, Officer
description:
**Charles River Development | Platform UI Framework**

**Who We’re Looking For**

* We are seeking an Associate Technical Product Manager to lead roadmap execution for foundational user interface capabilities within the Charles River and Alpha Platforms.
* This role is ideal for a technically minded product professional with 9+ years of experience across product management, business analysis, quality assurance, software development, UX, or related technology disciplines who is curious, hands-on, and comfortable using modern tools to solve problems independently. We are looking for someone fluent in generative AI tools, modern web technologies, APIs, data, and user experience, and who naturally looks for faster and better ways to get work done.
* You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technology directly. For example, rather than defaulting to a PowerPoint presentation, you might use AI-assisted tools to quickly create a more compelling interactive presentation. Rather than requesting a new report, you might use an available API and tools such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot to prototype a simple web application that answers the question.
* Rather than manually analyzing a large set of product feedback, you might use an LLM to help identify themes and then validate the results yourself.
* We are looking for someone who combines this builder mindset with strong product judgment, an understanding of user experience, and the ability to lead product discovery and execution in a complex enterprise environment.
  

  

**Why This Role Is Important to Us**

* You will join the Platform UI Framework team within the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market-leading SaaS platform that powers front-to-back investment workflows for some of the world’s largest financial institutions.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Support sales, professional services, and client support activities to improve the client experience and inform future product investments.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 9+ years of experience in technical product management, business analysis, platform engineering, UX, software development, or a related technology role within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong understanding of product management practices, including discovery, requirements definition, user stories, prioritization, roadmaps, iterative delivery, and stakeholder management.
* Strong interest in user experience and interaction design, with the ability to understand complex workflows and identify opportunities to simplify them.
* Technical fluency with modern web applications, including familiarity with React, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, web services, and cloud-based applications.
* Demonstrated ability to use generative AI and AI-assisted tools as part of everyday work, including research, analysis, prototyping, communication, coding, and problem solving.
* Comfort using tools such as VS Code, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, command-line utilities, APIs, and browser developer tools to explore ideas and solve problems independently.
* Ability to create lightweight prototypes, scripts, visualizations, or web applications to explore a product idea or answer a business question. Production-level software engineering experience is not required.

* Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and apply them pragmatically.

Charles River Investment management System in a platform that provides many Front-Office functions including Portfolio Management, Order Management and Execution, Compliance, Performance & Attribution, Modelling, Scenario Analysis, and Wealth Management.

description:
**Company Description**
The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.
  
  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Integration Team Lead is responsible for team activities concerning the design, development, and maintenance of the company's integration architecture. While strong proficiency in MuleSoft based integration architecture is highly valued, this role encompasses a broader, modern integration technology landscape, including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps. This role acts as a subject matter expert on API-led and event-driven integration patterns, ensuring that all corporate systems integrations are scalable, reliable, and secure. The manager-as-engineer works closely with various cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and leads the development team to deliver high-quality integration solutions.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibility**
Integration Architecture & Delivery:
  
  
Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Mentoring**
Manage, mentor, and guide a team of integration engineers (including direct reports), fostering a collaborative, agile, and high-performance engineering culture.
  
  
**Collaboration & Requirements Engineering**
Partner with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business workflows, translate them into comprehensive integration designs, and manage delivery timelines.
  
  
**Best Practices & Standards**
Enforce strict coding standards, robust code review processes, API governance, and comprehensive automated testing guidelines within the team.
  
  
**DevOps & Platform Operations**
Oversee automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD), environment management, and proactive monitoring/alerting across all core integration platforms.
  
  
**Incident & Problem Management**
Guide the team in resolving critical integration-related incidents, performing root-cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent preventative fixes.
  
  
**DECISION-MAKING POWER**

* Owns technical and operational decisions related to the company's core integration, event streaming, and API platforms (including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API/AI Gateways, and automation tools).
* Defines task delegation, prioritization, and sprint planning within the Integration Team.
* Recommends integration architectural standards and platform governance policies to the Integration Competency Center Manager.

**Who Are We Looking For**

* Brings several years of hands-on experience in software development, systems engineering, and IT operations in general.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in software development or integration engineering, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or coordinator role.
* In-depth, hands-on experience with APIs (designing, developing, deploying, and managing APIs across their entire lifecycle).
* In-depth knowledge and practical experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and modern event-driven streams.
* Strong practical knowledge and experience with enterprise integration tools:
* Enterprise iPaaS: Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, CloudHub, API Manager).

* API Gateways: Experience with Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, and Kong Metering and Billing.
* Automation & Lightweight iPaaS: Practical knowledge of n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps.
* DevOps & Agile Methods:
* Confident experience with modern DevOps methods and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
* Solid understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or scaled agile frameworks like SAFe).
* Familiarity with Waterfall project methodologies where hybrid planning is required.
* Proactivity and Autonomy: Ability to work independently and responsibly, proactively proposing optimizations for existing processes and systems.
* Team Spirit & Leadership: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with proven experience in team management, fostering team cohesion, and resolving conflict.
* Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Curiosity & Growth Mindset: Openness to learning and adopting emerging technologies.

**Qualifications**
**ELIGIBLITY**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* Proven experience in enterprise-grade integrations, platform operations, and technical team leadership.

title: Platform Architect
description:
IDfy is Asia's leading TrustStack, trusted by the best. With global expertise and enterprise-grade tech, we're solving trust challenges, making compliance easy, fraud detection smarter, and onboarding seamless.
  
  
IDfy builds mission-critical SaaS products that power identity verification, background screening, and fraud prevention for the world's most trusted companies. With over 300 million verified profiles, IDfy has 1,300+ clients globally. IDfy's three platforms—
**OnboardIQ**
,
**OneRisk**
, and
**Privy**
—come together to form one seamless solution enabling trust.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on
**Principal Platform Architect**
with
**12–15 years**
of engineering depth to lead the architectural vision across IDfy’s core platform foundations. In this strategic technical leadership role, you will define and execute the technology blueprint spanning
**AI-native platforms, application architecture, platform core services, and cloud DevOps infrastructure**
. You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems design, LLM/AI model orchestration, enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines, and high-throughput reliability to power our mission-critical SaaS ecosystem.
  
  
**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like...**

* Architecting AI-Native Platforms: Designing end-to-end architectures for AI-driven platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, model inference pipelines, and intelligent workflow automation across products.
* Core Platform Services Design: Owning the blueprints and shared capabilities for platform core services (identity, orchestration, messaging, event buses, telemetry, and data access layers) to ensure seamless inter-service communication and reuse.
* DevOps Strategy & Cloud Architecture: Defining and driving end-to-end cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated multi-environment deployment frameworks.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps & Release Engineering: Architecting and optimizing resilient CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions/Jenkins), container security scanning, automated quality gates, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
* Application Architecture & System Standards: Defining application design patterns, API-first specifications, microservices standards, and data modeling practices for enterprise-grade SaaS products.
* Kubernetes, Observability & Reliability: Designing highly available, fault-tolerant containerized environments using Kubernetes, alongside enterprise-grade observability, telemetry, and automated alerting frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Cross-Pod Technical Governance: Partnering closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, and DevOps/SRE teams to review architecture proposals, resolve technical trade-offs, and enforce best-in-class engineering standards.
* Client & Executive Technical Advisory: Stepping into high-stakes enterprise technical discussions with client architects, CTOs, and CIOs to present platform capabilities, integration architectures, and security postures.
* Mentorship & Technical Direction: Mentoring senior engineers and tech leads, driving RFCs (Requests for Comments), and fostering an engineering culture anchored in clean craftsmanship and architectural rigor.

**We are the perfect match if you...**

* Have 12–15 years of progressive experience across Platform Engineering, Software Architecture, Application Architecture, and Cloud/DevOps infrastructure in high-scale SaaS environments.
* Possess hands-on architectural experience with AI-based systems, including LLM integrations, modern retrieval pipelines, model serving, vector databases, or MLOps frameworks.
* Bring proven expertise designing enterprise-scale Application Architectures and foundational Platform Core Services (APIs, asynchronous messaging, caching, workflow engines, and distributed databases).
* Have deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and building production-grade infrastructure from scratch.
* Are highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and modern DevSecOps/CI-CD automation pipelines.
* Are proficient in modern backend languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and can evaluate system design trade-offs from first principles.
* Understand observability, telemetry, and site reliability engineering (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK) to ensure platform visibility and proactive alerting.
* Can navigate complex technical discussions with enterprise clients, translating high-level business requirements into resilient, secure, and modular software architectures.
* Bring an automation-first mindset with strong ownership, combining high-level strategic architecture vision with the ability to dive deep into code, pipelines, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.
  
  
**Required Skills**
['AI', 'API', 'LLM', 'REST', 'SQL', 'database']
  
  
Additional Information

title: AI Presales Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**

**AI Presales Solutions Architect — Agentic AI, India & APAC**

*Company: Intellect Design Arena | Platform: Purple Fabric (Agentic AI) |Region: India & APAC*

**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is Intellect's agentic AI platform, and this role exists to make it the default choice for enterprise buyers across India and APAC. That means owning the regional GTM motion end to end — but it also means being in the room when a CTO or lead architect starts asking how the agent orchestration actually works, how the platform handles evaluation and guardrails, or how it integrates into their existing stack. This role does not work as a pure narrative-and-relationships play. The person needs enough hands-on fluency in agentic AI and LLM-based systems to hold that conversation directly, then walk straight into the CXO's office and reframe the same substance as a transformation story.

**This is the core differentiator for this hire**
: equal credibility with a business sponsor and a technical evaluator, in the same deal, often the same week.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Market Penetration & Strategic Evangelism**

* **Establish Platform Preference:**
  Align GTM motions with local market priorities through leadership discussions and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive & Technical Engagement:**
  Lead conversations with priority prospects across both the CXO layer and the technical evaluation team — shaping the transformation agenda with sponsors while fielding architecture, security, and integration questions from their engineering and platform teams without needing an SME to translate.
* **Brand Visibility:**
  Drive thought leadership and regional presence through masterclasses, roundtables, and industry events — speaking with authority on agentic AI, not just platform positioning.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Partner with Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure consistent messaging, solution articulation, and unified GTM alignment across all client and partner interactions.

**Partner-Led GTM Acceleration & Ecosystem Enablement**

* **Scale Partner Initiatives:**
  Drive partner-led GTM initiatives to expand regional adoption and platform positioning.
* **Playbook Development:**
  Build structured partner GTM playbooks covering positioning, use cases, deployment models, and industry narratives — grounded in real agentic AI implementation patterns, not generic templates.
* **Partner Enablement:**
  Lead enablement programs, including technical onboarding, deployment orientation post-VDA sign-off, and bootcamps focused on opportunity identification and value mapping.
* **Success Frameworks:**
  Establish partner success metrics to improve adoption consistency, integrating domain and technical SMEs into engagements for contextual depth.

**Client Adoption & Strategic Engagement Excellence**

* **Engagement Frameworks:**
  Drive structured engagement frameworks to accelerate enterprise adoption and long-term platform positioning.
* **Strategic Roadmaps:**
  Lead maturity-aligned engagement sessions and build account-level roadmaps tied to client transformation priorities.
* **Adoption Journeys:**
  Own the client journey from discovery through PoC scoping and technical validation, ensuring both executive alignment and engineering sign-off before deals progress.

**Sales Excellence, Strategic Assets & Team Enablement**

* **Empower the Field:**
  Equip regional teams with winning narratives and the technical grounding to defend them under questioning.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain and evolve the Purple Fabric Sales Kit — pitch decks, demos, architecture diagrams, case studies, and industry narratives.
* **Sales Readiness:**
  Run enablement sessions that build both pitching confidence and technical objection handling — architecture, data privacy, model behavior, integration effort.
* **Feedback Loops:**
  Implement post-engagement client feedback mechanisms to continuously refine assets and messaging.

**Adoption Acceleration & Strategic Continuity Governance**

* **Value Discovery:**
  Lead structured bootcamps and demonstration sessions to identify relevant agentic AI use cases, providing roadmap clarity beyond the first meeting.
* **Execution Guidance:**
  Deliver prioritized use-case recommendations and phased execution guidance, integrating SMEs for contextual depth.
* **Strategic Oversight:**
  Maintain visibility of engagement progression across priority accounts, driving the transition from exploratory discussion to PoC or implementation.

**GTM Capability & Team Leadership**

* **Build the Function:**
  Build, scale, and lead a regional GTM function that is technically credible, not just relationship-driven.
* **Operational Rhythm:**
  Define role charters, engagement models, and operating rhythm for the regional GTM team.
* **Mentorship & Readiness:**
  Coach team members to handle executive-facing and technical-facing conversations with equal confidence; build structured onboarding for new hires.
* **Culture & Discipline:**
  Set narrative and technical communication standards, and foster cross-functional collaboration.

**Must-Have**

* **10+ years**
  in Go-To-Market, presales, or solution consulting for AI/ML-based products or platforms — this is a hard requirement. Generic enterprise software or B2B SaaS presales without an AI/data platform component will not meet the bar.
* **Technical depth in AI systems:**
  working knowledge of how LLM-based and agentic systems are actually built and evaluated — agent orchestration, RAG, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails, and how these integrate into enterprise architectures (APIs, data pipelines, security/compliance layers).
* **Dual-mode fluency:**
  demonstrated ability to run a CXO transformation conversation and a technical deep-dive with an engineering or architecture team in the same sales cycle, without relying on a technical SME to carry the room.
* **Executive presence:**
  proven track record engaging C-level executives and guiding enterprise digital transformation conversations.

**Strongly Preferred**

* **Agentic AI presales experience specifically**
  — having sold, positioned, or architected agentic (multi-agent, autonomous workflow) AI platforms, not just traditional ML or analytics tools.
* Direct exposure to enterprise buyers evaluating agentic AI in regulated industries (BFSI, insurance, wealth management) across India or APAC.

**Also Important**

* **Regional Expertise:**
  Deep understanding of the enterprise technology landscape across India and the broader APAC region.
* **Partner Ecosystems:**
  Experience building and scaling partner-led GTM motions and enablement programs.
* **Leadership:**
  Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

description:
**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hardworking and passionate
**Senior Customer Success Engineer**
who is customer obsessed and wants to help our customers during their cloud transformation journey. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to our customers to help ensure efficient Palo Alto Networks’ public cloud security adoption, and to accelerate business value and ROI. In this role, you will work closely with customer Security Architects, Security Engineers, InfoSec and DevOps teams within mid-to-large enterprises to implement best in class cloud security solutions.

From day one, you will roll up your sleeves and hit the ground running and bring all of your experience to the team to increase customer satisfaction, value, retention, and expansion of our footprint. Most importantly, you have a positive, “can do” attitude and a passion for delivering technical solutions in a fast-paced environment.

**Your Impact**

* Ensure customers are maximizing their return on investment by rapidly implementing and operationalizing Palo Alto Networks solutions to achieve their business and security objectives
* Assist customers in implementing custom integrations and workflows to ensure Palo Alto Networks solutions are fully integrated into their security operations center
* Be the first line of defense in solving customer support requests, and coordinating and prioritizing timely resolutions with engineering teams
* Serve as a customer advocate in influencing product roadmap and improvements

**Job Overview**
----------------

Senior Java Developer is a position responsible for establishing, designing, and implementing scalable, high-performance application systems and services in close coordination with the Business and Technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to provide strong technical leadership, drive hands-on system analysis and architecture, and lead programming activities to expand and modernize the Onboarding Management & Coordination (OMC) technology platform.

A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs

* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise

* Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Platform Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting-edge generative AI application design and production-grade cloud infrastructure. In this role, you won't just be "vibe coding" prompts—you will be architecting, securing, and scaling our enterprise AI agent infrastructure. The ideal candidate lives at the intersection of MLOps, DevOps, and Platform Engineering, with deep technical expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD. You will own the infrastructure that powers our multi-agent orchestration systems, ensuring they are robust, reproducible, and seamlessly integrated into our deployment pipelines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect AI Agent Infrastructure: Design, provision, and maintain the cloud foundations required for enterprise AI agents using Vertex AI Agent Builder (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Maintain a strict IaC philosophy, ensuring 100% of the platform’s infrastructure—from Agent Engine runtimes to VPCs and Cloud Storage Data Stores—is declared and managed via Terraform.
* Automate Everything: Build, optimize, and maintain robust, secure GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated agent testing, deployment, and configuration pinning.
* Data & Grounding Management: Configure and optimize data ingestion pipelines (Vertex AI Search, Data Stores) to ground agents effectively on enterprise data.
* Security & IAM Governance: Own the complex IAM structures, Service Accounts, and cryptographic Agent Identities required to secure agent tool-calling and enterprise data access.
* Observability & Cost Optimization: Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing loops for agent reasoning, while keeping a sharp eye on token spend and runtime costs. Core Technical Requirements Must-Haves
* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.
* CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of configuring complex GitLab pipelines, utilizing runners, environment staging, caching, and automated testing blocks.
* Core GCP Architecture: Solid understanding of baseline GCP infrastructure, including GKE, Cloud Run, VPC/Shared VPC networking, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), and Cloud Storage.
* Scripting & Orchestration: Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for Agent ADK work) or Go.

**Core Technical Requirements**
Must-Haves
  
  

* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.
* CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of configuring complex GitLab pipelines, utilizing runners, environment staging, caching, and automated testing blocks.
* Core GCP Architecture: Solid understanding of baseline GCP infrastructure, including GKE, Cloud Run, VPC/Shared VPC networking, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), and Cloud Storage.
* Scripting & Orchestration: Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for Agent ADK work) or Go

Nice-to-Haves
  
  

* Experience with LLM frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Google's native Agent SDK.
* Familiarity with vector databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, or pgvector).
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect or Professional DevOps/MLOps Engineer certifications
