title: Data architect
description:
Join us as a
**Data Architect**
Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Strong experience in AWS data engineering (S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, IAM).
* Advanced Python development skills for data engineering.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Apache Spark / PySpark.
* Proven experience with Databricks (development, optimisation, notebooks, jobs).
* Hands‑on experience with Apache Airflow and Astronomer.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience with CI/CD, Git‑based version control, and DevOps practices for data platforms.

**Data & Platform Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of data modelling, lakehouse architecture, and analytics‑ready data design.
* Experience implementing data quality, validation, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Familiarity with metadata, lineage, and data governance concepts.

**Banking / Enterprise Experience (Preferred)**

* Experience working in financial services or regulated environments.
* Understanding of risk, controls, and non‑functional requirements (resilience, security, audit).

**Leadership & Behaviours (AVP Expectations)**

* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical mindset.
* Effective communicator across technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Mentors junior engineers and promotes engineering best practices.
* Champions engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Cloud or data engineering certifications (AWS / Databricks) are desirable.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Data Design & Architecture
* Own logical and physical data design for curated, conformed, and consumption‑ready datasets.
* Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data models (dimensional, domain‑oriented, lakehouse patterns).
* Contribute to data architecture decisions aligned with Barclays cloud, security, and governance standards.
* Data Engineering & Development
* Design and develop end‑to‑end data pipelines using:
* AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch)
* Apache Spark (PySpark) for large‑scale batch and streaming processing
* Databricks for lakehouse‑based transformations and analytics enablement
* Build robust ingestion, transformation, and curation pipelines handling structured and semi‑structured data.
* Ensure pipelines are performance‑optimised, cost‑efficient, and resilient.
* Orchestration & Automation
* Develop and manage workflows using Apache Airflow.
* Implement and operate Airflow pipelines on Astronomer, following enterprise scheduling, monitoring, and alerting standards.
* Embed CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment controls for data workloads.
* Data Quality, Governance & Controls
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls, and lineage.
* Ensure compliance with Barclays data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit, risk, and control processes through well‑documented and traceable data solutions.
* Stakeholder & Delivery Responsibilities
* Work closely with product owners, business analysts, architects, and MI/reporting teams.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers.
* Support production releases, incident analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Vice President, Model Risk Management

**Job Description**
We are seeking a future team member for the role of
**VICE PRESIDENT**

**MODEL RISK MANAGEMENT**
team in

. This role supports the independent validation of models used across the firm and may align to one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Credit Risk Modeling (Wholesale or Retail portfolios), 2) Operational Risk, 3) Capital Stress Testing

**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead and execute independent model validations in accordance with enterprise model risk management standards for model validation, by setting the scope of a validation effort.
* Define the scope, validation approach, and testing strategy for assigned models, including conceptual review, data assessment, methodology evaluation, outcomes analysis, benchmarking, implementation review, and performance monitoring assessment.
* Assess the conceptual soundness, assumptions, limitations, and fitness for purpose of models, and identify circumstances under which model performance or usefulness may deteriorate.
* Develop clear, well-supported validation conclusions and communicate model strengths, weaknesses, limitations, and risks through high-quality technical documentation and validation reports.
* Provide effective challenge to model developers and stakeholders on model design, assumptions, methodology, performance, and model use.
* Review analyses, calculations, and documentation prepared by junior team members to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and adherence to validation standards.
* Complete required training, disclosures, attestations, and certifications within deadlines.
* Demonstrate curiosity and willingness to embrace emerging AI capabilities to support BNY’s AI-first strategy, including the development and adoption of AI agents and digital employees.

To be successful in this role, we are seeking the following:
  
  

* Master's Degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline, including engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, econometrics.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in model validation, model development, or quantitative risk management within financial services.
* Strong understanding of model risk management principles and applicable regulatory guidance, such as SR 11-7, SR – 26 –2, SR 15-18, CCAR, Basel, CECL, IFRS9, EMIR, PRA SS1/23, etc.
* Possess a strong analytical background with a solid theoretical foundation coupled with advanced computational programming, technical documentation, and communications skills.
* Experience of working with PD / LGD / EAD models, Wholesale and retail credit risk, Scorecards / rating models, Stress testing / scenario models, Portfolio risk concepts (default, migration, concentration, provisioning, economic capital, RWA).
* Must have experience with complex quantitative modelling, numerical analysis, and computational methods using programming languages (such as Python, R, C++, Java, MATLAB, SAS) as well as mathematical/statistical software packages.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and digital agents (i.e. BNY's patented AI Agent - Eliza) to enhance analytical workflows, improve productivity, and deliver high-quality outputs.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
* “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

description:

10IC

We're looking for a Senior AI Developer to build and ship production-grade agentic and RAG-based AI systems. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time is spent writing code, designing agent workflows, and getting features into production. You'll also help set technical direction and mentor others along the way.
  
  
You'll work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn messy, real-world problems into reliable, scalable AI solutions.

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/context integration — or closely related agent-tooling experience and the ability to pick it up quickly.
* Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
* Experience deploying applications to production and keeping them running (serving, basic monitoring, debugging).
* Comfortable with a cloud platform (AWS preferred, since our stack is AWS-based).
* Solid fundamentals with version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD.

These teams often rely on the Quant Team to provide analysis which will be delivered to clients and impact trading decisions. The team is also expecting significant growth in the coming years and so are looking for highly skilled, detail-oriented and motivated candidates to support its growing business.

* The analyst will also be expected to support day to day processes such as maintaining custom liability benchmarks, preparing bespoke client reports, developing/ enhancing existing tools (Excel/ Python) etc.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* 3 - 5 years’ work experience in a similar or related role with a top tier firm. Example roles include as a quant developer/programmer, data scientist, investment quant and/or fixed income/derivative analysis within financial services, investment bank, asset manager, or consulting firm.
* The candidate will require a high level of quantitative and computational financial skill and ability to solve extremely complex problems for our US LDI clients. They will ideally hold a primary degree in a quantitative science with experience in programming. They will preferably have additional quant-orientated qualifications or progress towards investment designation (e.g., CFA, actuarial science).
* Ideal candidates would have strong work experience and relevant knowledge/skill in a number of the following areas:
* Sound programming knowledge with relevant on-the-job experience
* Understanding of present value calculations, interest rate and credit spread risk
* Familiarity with fixed income, derivative markets and hedging techniques
* Ability and desire to apply numerical skills in the workplace. Candidate with mathematics, statistics, or engineering background is preferred.
* Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Candidate will need to work with US and Pune team members simultaneously.
* Understanding of US Pensions and related risk management techniques is a plus
* The candidate should have strong verbal and written communication as they will need to articulate their thought process in any given task and set these out via email/messaging or video call. The candidate should be fluent in English and is expected to work closely with US and Pune team members. They should be deadline driven, have a strong work ethic and be committed to meet the deadlines.

We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.
* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.
* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.
* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.
* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.
* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.
* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.
* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.
* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.
* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.
* Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows.

**Java**
,
**Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**
,
**distributed microservices**

**event-driven architectures**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & System Architecture
* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient Java/Spring Boot microservices capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.

* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture

* Experience: Minimum 12+ years of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least 4–6 years in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.

**Java & Core Technologies**

* Master-level proficiency in Java (11, 17, 21+), JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

* Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift
* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

* Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack.

title: Senior SRE
description:
**Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)**
at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles.
  
  
SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems – we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages.
  
  
Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage system(s) uptime across cloud-native (AWS, GCP) and hybrid architectures.
* Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meet security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK).
* Build CI/CD pipelines for build, test and deployment of application and cloud architecture patterns, using platform (Jenkins) and cloud-native toolchains.
* Build automated tooling to deploy service requests to push a change into production. Build runbooks that are comprehensive and detailed to manage detect, remediate and restore services.
* Solve problems and triage complex distributed architecture service maps. On call for high severity application incidents and improving run books to improve MTTR
* Lead availability blameless postmortem and own the call to action to remediate recurrences.

**What Experience You Need**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent job experience required
* 5-7 years of experience in software engineering, systems administration, database administration, and networking.
* 2+ years of experience developing and/or administering software in public cloud
* Experience in monitoring infrastructure and application uptime and availability to ensure functional and performance objectives.
* Experience in languages such as Python, Bash, Java, Go JavaScript and/or node.js
* Demonstrable cross-functional knowledge with systems, storage, networking, security and databases
* System administration skills, including automation and orchestration of Linux/Windows using Terraform, Chef, Ansible and/or containers (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Proficiency with continuous integration and continuous delivery tooling and practices
* Cloud Certification Strongly Preferred

**What Could Set You Apart**
An ability to demonstrate successful performance of our Success Profile skills, including:
  
  

* DevSecOps - Uses DevSecOps operational practices and applies engineering skills to improve resilience of products/services. Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, modifies complex programs/scripts and integrated software services. Contributes to the selection of the software development methods, tools, and techniques. Applies agreed SRE standards and tools to achieve a well-engineered result. Participates in reviews of own work and leads reviews of colleagues' work.
* Operational Excellence - Develops work plans for short-term assignments of moderate complexity, typically contained within their own function. Consistently monitor and measure systems against key metrics to ensure availability of systems. Continuously seeks new ways of working to make processes run smoother and faster.
* Systems Thinking - Uses knowledge of best practices and how systems integrate with others to improve one’s own work and the work of less experienced colleagues. Builds and maintains an understanding of technology trends and uses knowledge to identify factors that achieve the defined expectations of systems availability.
* Technical Communication/Presentation - Articulates complex messages and the impacts to stakeholders to build support and agreement. Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to tailor to specific audiences. Work with others to achieve results and proactively address sources of conflict and emotion with focus on the best solution for Equifax.
* Troubleshooting - Applies a methodical approach to routine and moderately complex issue definition and resolution. Initiates and monitors actions to investigate and resolve problems in systems, processes and services. Determines problem fixes/remedies. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies. Analyzes patterns and trends.

description:

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Job Description

As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. **Your Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.

* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.

* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.

* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.

* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.

* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.

* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.

* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.

* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.

* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.

* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.

* Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows.

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, and safe deployment of AI agents.

* Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or vector search, and integration of AI services through APIs.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.

* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.

* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.

* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.

* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.

* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.

* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.

* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.

* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

* Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes ...

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

* Company volunteer and donation matching program.

* Employee Assistance Program.

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.

* On-demand digital course library for professional development.

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.*

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team — and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.

* Lead and mentor a team of 5–6 developers — assigning work, conducting code reviews, unblocking issues, and owning delivery quality and timelines.

* Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.

* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

* Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand.

* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.

* Proven experience leading a team of 5–6 developers, including mentoring, code review, and delivery ownership.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development.

* Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development.

* Working proficiency in Python.

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).

* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.

* A polyglot mindset — genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

* Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines.

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

* Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms.

**What We're Looking For**

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Cloud DevOps Engineer with hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, automation, CI/CD and observability. You will independently manage and improve cloud infrastructure across development and operational environments, with particular focus on Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI Services, AWS, AKS/EKS, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring.

The role combines cloud engineering and DevOps with operational responsibilities including incident, problem, change, release and deployment management. You will work closely with development teams to automate delivery, troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, improve reliability and support secure, scalable cloud environments.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Maintain and continuously improve cloud and DevOps infrastructure, including continuous integration infrastructure, build platforms, test systems and development environments.
* Manage cloud infrastructure end to end, including monitoring, reporting, networking, DNS and security.
* Build and manage Kubernetes clusters, including Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), with the ability to set up clusters from scratch.
* Set up and script cloud environments using infrastructure-as-code and automation practices.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
* Establish continuous delivery tooling and procedures covering build servers, automated deployment and configuration management.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible and relevant cloud-native technologies such as AWS CloudFormation.
* Support software rollouts across development, test and production environments.
* Partner with development teams on infrastructure, scalability, security and automation requirements.
* Configure and support Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, including networking, firewall, API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services.
* Configure and support APIs through the Apigee platform.
* Monitor applications and infrastructure using tools such as Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana and Datadog.
* Perform log analysis, including Fluentd-based logging, to identify and resolve application and infrastructure issues.
* Apply ITIL practices across incident resolution, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and deployment.

**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
The role is the technical lead for production operations within an international L1/L2/L3 organisation. They operate an existing AWS platform, understand its components and dependencies, and personally diagnose and resolve complex incidents. They work with the SDM, L1/L2, Build teams and specialist experts. The SDM organises and manages the service; L3 owns technical diagnosis and resolution. The role requires a hands-on Production/SRE profile with proven AWS expertise in production, an end-to-end view of the business application and its flows, and a high level of autonomy from the start to secure operations and prepare transitions.
  
  
Incidents and Service Restoration
  
  

* Provide L3 support for complex incidents escalated by L2.
* Handle P1/P2 incidents in the crisis bridge and provide technical diagnosis.
* Investigate applications and flows end to end: front/back end, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, middleware, networking, data and AWS services.
* Analyse and correlate logs, metrics, events and changes to locate failures.
* Understand business consequences and prioritise recovery actions.
* Perform appropriate fixes or recovery operations, engage the required experts and verify service restoration.

Prevention and Operability
  
  

* Lead RCA, document causes and define measures to prevent recurrence.
* Define probes, metrics, thresholds and preventive checks based on component and flow knowledge.
* Challenge Build teams on operability, configurations, observability, resilience and production risks.
* Support the operational acceptance of new components.

Automation and Knowledge Transfer
  
  

* Define and evolve technical standards and operating practices.
* Standardise and automate recurring operations.
* Structure runbooks, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Guide L1/L2 and strengthen their autonomy.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Observability: direct use of Elastic/Kibana and CloudWatch for monitoring, investigation and correlation.
* Applications: front/back end, REST APIs/API Gateway, microservices, data flows and dependencies.
* Messaging and events: SQS, EventBridge and understanding of interactions with Kafka/Confluent.
* AWS infrastructure: EC2, Auto Scaling, IAM, S3/EFS, VPC, Route 53, ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway and cross-account traffic.
* Databases: PostgreSQL/Aurora investigation in a production context.
* Automation: Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and Bash/Python scripting.
* Containers: strong Kubernetes/EKS troubleshooting and end-to-end application understanding.
* Data exchange: production data exchange, ideally AWS Transfer Family/SFTP, including exchange and dependency troubleshooting.
* Lambda: hands-on Lambda operations and troubleshooting of interactions with other services.
* Preferred: AS2, Docker/Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD. Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry can complement observability. Kafka/Confluent skills can be developed with support from the existing team.

Certifications
  
  

* Mandatory: AWS certification, supported by significant and recent AWS production experience.
* Preferred: Kubernetes certifications and advanced or professional AWS certifications.

**Required Experience**

* Significant, recent AWS production experience.
* Operation of business-critical applications and personal handling of major P1/P2 incidents.
* Deep expertise in at least one core component, ideally one or two, combined with broad production support coverage and end-to-end understanding of dependencies.
* Transfer Family and Lambda are particularly sought; strong production data exchange experience on another solution remains relevant.
* Experience assembling, operating and troubleshooting multiple cloud services, including in startup environments. A smaller platform may be relevant if its dependencies and operational challenges are comparable.
* Must confirm personal incident actions, architecture and flow understanding, observability tools used and preventive practices, and be able to explain decisions and ask relevant operability questions.
* A background focused only on Build, architecture, lift and shift, infrastructure or CI/CD is insufficient.
* A mainly Azure profile does not meet AWS requirements. AWS expertise is needed from the start; this assignment is not for learning AWS fundamentals.
* Autonomy, production reflexes, analytical thinking, technical decision-making, clear communication and awareness of business impact.
* Professional English is required. French is optional.

**Total Experience Expected: 08-10 years**

BE/B.Tech

title: Global Cybersecurity Senior Specialist – App Assurance
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

**Application Assurance Governance**

  

* Support the definition, maintenance, and continuous improvement of application assurance governance processes across BCG's application and product landscape.
* Help establish secure SDLC expectations, application security standards, and control requirements for product and engineering teams.
* Partner with application developers, product owners, architects, security champions, and engineering teams to improve application security posture across the enterprise.
* Track application security risks, recurring control gaps, remediation trends, and governance exceptions across application environments.
* Maintain application security coverage data, assurance metrics, and governance records to support risk reporting and decision-making.
* Share practical observations and improvement opportunities with security architecture and application security leadership.

**SAST, SCA, and Secure Engineering Enablement**

  

* Support SAST and SCA governance processes, including scan coverage, finding triage, risk prioritization, and remediation tracking.
* Partner with development teams to improve secure coding practices and reduce recurring vulnerabilities across application codebases.
* Develop, deliver, and improve application security trainings for developers, product teams, security champions, and engineering partners.
* Contribute to the security champions program by supporting enablement content, recurring knowledge-sharing, and secure development guidance.
* Guide teams on dependency risk, open-source component governance, software supply chain security, and remediation of vulnerable libraries.
* Support integration of SAST, SCA, and related security tooling into CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows.
* Help teams interpret security findings, understand risk context, and apply practical remediation guidance without slowing delivery unnecessarily.

**DevSecOps and Risk Management**

  

* Support DevSecOps initiatives that embed security controls, automation, and measurable assurance into product delivery processes.
* Identify and implement security automation opportunities across SDLC workflows, CI/CD pipelines, reporting, governance, and remediation tracking.
* Advise teams on CI/CD security, secure pipeline configuration, secrets handling, cloud-native application security, and container security.
* Provide guidance on container hardening, Kubernetes security considerations, and secure deployment patterns.
* Support secure adoption of low-code and no-code platforms by applying practical guardrails, assurance expectations, and risk-based controls.
* Collaborate with security architects, code review specialists, DevOps teams, and engineering partners to strengthen enterprise application security practices.
* Coordinate with DAST and penetration testing teams to incorporate relevant findings into broader application assurance governance and remediation activities.
* Escalate sustained remediation gaps, recurring control issues, and material application security risks through appropriate ISRM governance channels

What You'll Bring

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in application security, secure engineering, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity assurance.
* Experience working in enterprise technology environments with security governance and vulnerability management processes.
* Experience partnering with product, engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to remediate application security risks.
* Experience supporting secure SDLC, SAST, SCA, DevSecOps, or application security governance activities.
* Experience contributing to developer security training, security champions programs, or secure engineering enablement initiatives.

**Technical Proficiency:**

  

* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, AI threats, SANS Top 25, secure coding, threat modeling, and application security risk management.
* Hands-on experience with SAST and SCA tools, findings analysis, vulnerability prioritization, and remediation tracking.
* Understanding of software supply chain security, open-source dependency management, and secure build practices.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD security, DevSecOps practices, security automation, and secure engineering workflows.
* Familiarity with modern application environments, including APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud services, containers, Kubernetes, and low-code or no-code platforms.
* Knowledge of container hardening, Kubernetes security, cloud-native security patterns, and secrets management practices.
* Hands-on knowledge of DAST, penetration testing methods, and application exploitation techniques, with the ability to interpret findings and guide remediation.
* Awareness of AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and security tooling integration across DevOps environments.

**Certifications:** Certifications such as CSSLP or relevant cloud security certifications are helpful.

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of BCG’s Information Security Risk Management team, working with security architects, application security specialists, cybersecurity professionals, DevSecOps partners, and engineering teams who help protect BCG’s applications and information systems.

You will collaborate closely with product owners, application developers, security champions, infrastructure teams, system owners, DAST and penetration testing teams, and technology leaders across global BCG teams. Together, you will help teams strengthen secure development practices, improve application assurance governance, mature DevSecOps practices, and build security into products and platforms from design through delivery.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Translating application security requirements into practical engineering guidance.
* Building trusted relationships with product and development teams while maintaining clear governance expectations.
* Explaining SAST, SCA, DevSecOps, secure coding, and application risk topics in clear business and engineering language.
* Connecting findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, penetration testing, and secure code reviews into a coherent risk picture.
* Managing priorities across governance support, tooling adoption, automation, trainings, remediation timelines, and delivery needs.
* Using structured reasoning and sound analysis to work through ambiguity.
* Sharing practical recommendations that help teams take action on security findings.
* Applying privacy-by-design and zero trust principles to application security decisions.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

The Digital Transformation practice is part of the Global Solutions Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura

**Practice Overview**

Ankura Consulting Group is recognized as one of the five fastest-growing consulting companies, with 2,500 employees across 32 offices in 4 continents. The Company provides services to its client on expert witness, bankruptcy and corporate restructuring, litigation support, forensic accounting, geopolitical risk assessment, and general management consulting services. Ankura Consulting Group's headquarters is based in Washington, USA.

Ankura's Digital Transformation practice helps clients modernize their organizations by leveraging data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. Within this practice, our Competitive Intelligence capability helps clients turn market, pricing, and customer data into decisions that grow revenue, protect margin, and strengthen enterprise value.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Director to lead the design and hands-on delivery of Competitive Intelligence solutions across multiple client engagements. This is a builder role, not a strategy-only role: the ideal candidate has personally built pricing models, elasticity curves, and forecasting pipelines — writing the queries, building the models, and validating the numbers. The Director will combine that hands-on technical depth with delivery ownership, solution design, and team leadership, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders while remaining able to get into the data personally when engagements demand it.

**Responsibilities**

* Personally build and validate pricing, elasticity, and demand models - using tools such as Python or R, SQL, and statistical/econometric or machine learning techniques.
* Define and own the solution design for Competitive Intelligence engagements, including dynamic and elastic pricing models, competitor and market monitoring, and customer/segment analytics.
* Lead delivery of pricing and market intelligence programs for clients, tying each initiative to measurable business outcomes (revenue, margin, operating efficiency, working capital).
* Design, build, and continuously recalibrate price elasticity models by SKU, segment, and geography — including cross-elasticity and scenario simulation — to support data-driven pricing and promotion decisions.
* Build or directly oversee the technical build of competitor price/promotion scraping and monitoring pipelines, supplier and sourcing intelligence feeds, and demand/supply forecasting models.
* Apply and evaluate machine learning and AI techniques (e.g., demand forecasting models, customer segmentation/clustering, propensity and churn models, NLP-based market signal extraction) where they improve on traditional analytics.
* Establish reference architectures, delivery standards, and best practices for Competitive Intelligence solutions built on the firm's Enterprise Data Platform.
* Estimate, plan, and govern delivery across multiple client engagements and workstreams.
* Partner with client stakeholders to align Competitive Intelligence roadmaps with business objectives and timelines.
* Mentor, coach, and develop data scientists, analysts, and technical leads, staying hands-on enough to review code, models, and analysis rather than only reviewing slides.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for analytical rigor, accuracy, scalability, and time-to-value.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities, including hands-on proof-of-concept analysis, solution design, technical estimates, and client pitches.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, market/competitive intelligence, or advanced analytics, with significant leadership responsibility — including recent, genuinely hands-on technical work, not purely oversight.
* Bachelors in Engineering, computer science preferred.

* Certification in cloud platform or relevant data platforms
* Demonstrated, hands-on track record of having personally built dynamic pricing, price elasticity, demand forecasting, or revenue management models — able to speak to the data, methodology, and code, not just the resulting recommendations.
* Proficiency in a data science/analytics stack such as Python or R, SQL, and common ML/statistics libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels), sufficient to build or debug models directly.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and AI techniques relevant to pricing and market intelligence — forecasting, clustering/segmentation, propensity modeling, and increasingly, LLM-based tools for market/text signal extraction.
* Comfort working directly in data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), including writing and reviewing data pipelines, not only architecting them.
* Demonstrated ability to estimate, plan, and govern complex delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and security principles as they relate to market and pricing data.
* Excellent communication skills and experience in senior, client-facing roles, including presenting to executive audiences — balanced with genuine willingness to be in the data day-to-day.
* Consulting experience in a front-ending, client-facing role: understanding and clarifying client requirements, setting and managing expectations, proactively anticipating needs and risks, and communicating clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong business acumen and results-oriented mindset, with a track record of connecting hands-on analytics work to business outcomes.
* Preferred to have experience leading multi-team or multi-vendor delivery models.
* Preferred to have experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies.
* Preferred to have a graduate degree or equivalent depth in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, data science, or similar).
* Cloud or platform certifications (any major provider) is preferred.
* Must be fluent in English.

Job Description – UI/UX Designer

**Company:** GammaMoney Private Limited  
**Job Title:** UI/UX Designer

**Work Mode:** Work From Office

About GammaMoney

GammaMoney is a FinTech and Lending Technology company providing technology-driven solutions to NBFCs, Lending Service Providers (LSPs), Microfinance Institutions (MFIs), Direct Selling Agents (DSAs), and other lending businesses.

Our platform aims to simplify and streamline digital lending operations through technology solutions covering customer onboarding, KYC, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), underwriting, disbursement, Loan Management Systems (LMS), collections, reporting, and analytics.

We are looking for a creative and user-focused UI/UX Designer who can help us build intuitive, functional, and visually appealing digital products.

Role Overview

The UI/UX Designer will be responsible for designing and improving user interfaces and experiences across GammaMoney's web-based and mobile applications.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of user-centred design principles, visual hierarchy, usability, and interaction design. The candidate should be able to translate business and product requirements into practical design solutions while working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders.

This role requires a balance of creative thinking, technical understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to design complex product workflows in a simple and user-friendly manner.

Key Responsibilities1. UI Design

* Design clean, modern, responsive, and visually appealing user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Create high-fidelity UI designs, layouts, screens, dashboards, forms, and interactive components.
* Maintain consistency in typography, colours, spacing, icons, buttons, and other visual elements.
* Develop and maintain reusable UI components and design systems.
* Ensure designs follow usability, accessibility, and responsive design principles.

2. UX Research & Design

* Understand product requirements, user needs, and business objectives before initiating the design process.
* Create user journeys, user flows, information architecture, and wireframes.
* Identify usability challenges and suggest improvements to existing product interfaces.
* Conduct basic user research, competitor analysis, and usability testing.
* Convert complex workflows into simple, intuitive, and easy-to-navigate user experiences.
* Incorporate feedback and continuously improve the overall user experience.

3. Prototyping & Design Documentation

* Develop interactive prototypes to demonstrate user interactions and product functionality.
* Prepare wireframes, mockups, and design specifications for development teams.
* Ensure proper documentation of design components, interactions, and screen behaviour.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.
* Review developed interfaces and identify discrepancies between designs and actual implementation.

4. Product & Dashboard Design

* Design user-friendly dashboards, admin panels, and data-driven interfaces.
* Create interfaces for fintech and digital lending workflows, including onboarding, KYC, loan applications, underwriting, disbursement, loan management, and collections.
* Design tables, data visualisations, reports, filters, forms, and other functional product elements.
* Ensure complex financial and operational information is presented clearly and effectively.
* Improve existing product screens based on user feedback and business requirements.

5. Graphic & Visual Design

* Create supporting visual assets, icons, illustrations, and graphics for digital platforms.
* Design website banners, landing page visuals, and product-related creatives whenever required.
* Maintain consistency with the company's overall visual identity and branding.
* Work on presentations and other design-related requirements as needed.

6. Collaboration & Coordination

* Work closely with Product Managers, Business Teams, Developers, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in product discussions and understand functional requirements.
* Communicate design decisions and explain the reasoning behind proposed solutions.
* Coordinate with developers throughout the design and implementation process.
* Manage multiple design tasks and ensure timely delivery without compromising quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Design, UI/UX, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field (preferred).
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, or a similar role.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto-layout, prototyping, and design systems.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator or equivalent design tools.
* Understanding of user-centred design principles and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, user flows, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
* Knowledge of responsive web and mobile application design.
* Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, visual hierarchy, alignment, and spacing.
* Ability to interpret product requirements and translate them into practical design solutions.
* Good communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently as well as within a team.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working on SaaS products, fintech platforms, financial applications, or enterprise dashboards.
* Understanding of complex data-driven interfaces and admin panels.
* Familiarity with usability testing and basic UX research methodologies.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and frontend development concepts.
* Experience working with design systems and developer handoff processes.
* Understanding of accessibility and WCAG design principles.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* **Design Quality:** Visual consistency, creativity, usability, and accuracy of designs.
* **Timely Delivery:** Completion of assigned design tasks within agreed timelines.
* **User Experience:** Ability to create intuitive and easy-to-use interfaces.
* **Design Accuracy:** Alignment between approved designs and final developed products.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to identify design and usability issues and provide effective solutions.
* **Collaboration:** Coordination with product, development, and business teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** Accuracy in layouts, spacing, typography, responsiveness, and design components.
* **Initiative & Innovation:** Proactive suggestions for improving existing products and design processes.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real-world FinTech and digital lending products.
* Exposure to end-to-end product design and development.
* Direct collaboration with product and technology teams.
* A dynamic startup environment with opportunities to learn and grow.
* Opportunity to contribute to products used by lending businesses and financial institutions.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share:

* Updated Resume/CV.
* Portfolio showcasing relevant UI/UX projects.
* Links to live projects or prototypes, if available.

**Work Location:** Sector 48, Gurgaon, Haryana.

Only candidates comfortable with working full-time from the Gurgaon office should apply.

description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Title** : Lead Technology Analyst – SAP BASIS & Data Integration

  

**Experience:** 10+ years

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly accomplished **Lead SAP Basis & Data Integration** with **10+ years of deep technical experience** to lead the architecture, health, performance, and data integration strategy across our enterprise SAP landscape.

In this role, you will act as the principal bridge between core SAP systems, modern cloud data architectures, and data-driven business insights. Beyond deep-dive SAP HANA and BASIS administration, you will drive modern data provisioning strategies ( **SAP SLT, SDI, SDA, SAP BTP, and SAP Datasphere** ) and contribute to **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** involving data extraction, replication, and system landscape optimization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* **10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP BASIS, SAP HANA, and Data Integration tools ( **SLT, SDI, SDA** ).
* Proven track record in **S/4HANA transformations** , leading data provisioning and replication strategies.
* Good to have knowledge of **SAP BTP** , **SAP Datasphere** , and third-party tools like **SNP Kyano** .
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related fields.
* Relevant SAP certifications in HANA Administration or Data Integration are preferred.

### **Must-Have Skills & Tools**

* **Core Expertise:** SAP BASIS Architecture, SAP HANA Administration, SAP SLT, SAP SDI, SAP SDA, SAP BTP, SAP Datasphere, SNP Kyano.
* **Tools & Platforms:** SAP HANA Cockpit, HANA Studio, Web IDE, Database Explorer, DP Agent, SAP Solution Manager, CTS+/ChaRM.
* **Architectural Mastery:** Enterprise replication topologies, custom ABAP transformation rules, multi-tier flowgraphs, federated virtualization, latency optimization, and S/4HANA migration data pipelines.
* **Leadership & Core Traits:** Strategic problem-solving, advanced analytical troubleshooting, cross-functional stakeholder management, and a strong commitment to mentoring junior and mid-level engineering staff.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Data Provisioning (SLT / SDI / SDA)**

* Architect real-time **SLT replication** , including custom ABAP transformation rules, table partitioning, and latency tuning.
* Demonstrate expert-level execution of table reload strategies, trigger management, and logging table synchronization during SLT source system refreshes or system copy activities.
* Configure **SDA remote sources** for federated querying across heterogeneous databases.
* Deploy and manage **DP Agents** , adapters, and complex **SDI flowgraphs** for ETL and data ingestion.
* Act as the final escalation lead for replication failures, DP Agent issues, and schema synchronization issues.

**2. S/4HANA Transformation & Cloud Integration**

* Lead data replication and provisioning architectures for **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** .
* Leverage tools like **SNP Kyano** for optimized data migration, transformation, and landscape optimization.
* Build and govern hybrid data integration pipelines connecting core SAP systems to **SAP BTP** and **SAP Datasphere** .

**3. Core BASIS & HANA Administration**

* Oversee end-to-end SAP BASIS operations, multi-tenant HANA governance, upgrades, and system copies.
* Manage transport systems (TMS, CTS+, ChaRM) to ensure stable, zero-downtime release management.
* Maintain system availability, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) readiness.

**4. Optimization, Security & Leadership**

* Perform expert troubleshooting for **HANA memory, CPU bottlenecks, thread locks, and SQL tuning** .
* Implement HANA security roles, SSL/TLS pipeline encryption, and firewall concepts.
* Establish technical SOPs, operations runbooks, and mentor team members in technical best practices.

**About Company**

The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its all-in-one platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of dental practices rely on it daily to grow revenue and improve patient care.

The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented, with high ownership and tight cross-functional collaboration. Engineers get real autonomy, flexible scheduling, and strong support for growth.

It is one of the most active builders in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.

**Position Overview**

This is a horizontal platform leadership role spanning all product areas. The role drives technical direction, architecture standards, and engineering excellence across a cloud-native SaaS platform serving thousands of dental practices across North America. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering depth with the ability to set and enforce platform-wide standards across multiple teams and products. Leadership is earned through technical authority, execution excellence, and the ability to solve genuinely hard distributed systems problems.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own platform-wide architecture standards and design principles, leading architecture reviews and technical design discussions across all product teams.
* Act as technical authority for business-critical systems — reviewing complex designs and critical code paths, and identifying technical risks early across the platform.
* Contribute hands-on to the implementation of critical backend services, scalable APIs, and cloud-native components on AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway).
* Drive containerization, infrastructure automation, and observability improvements — including monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing — in partnership with DevOps.
* Lead performance tuning, scalability initiatives, and troubleshooting for high-throughput production systems across all product domains.
* Champion AI-assisted development practices — evaluating emerging tools and driving adoption across engineering teams while maintaining code quality and security standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams through technical depth and execution, influencing technology decisions without relying on hierarchy.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience building and shipping enterprise-grade, large-scale SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in Python and Django/Django REST Framework, building high-performance REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js and TypeScript for frontend architecture in a full-stack or platform context.
* Proven AWS architecture experience across ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM at production scale.
* Demonstrated track record solving complex scalability, performance, and reliability challenges in distributed, event-driven systems.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong command of PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch — including query optimization, caching strategies, and data modeling.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience architecting and operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms handling large-scale transactional and analytical workloads.
* Exposure to healthcare technology, dental-domain applications, or other data-intensive regulated verticals.
* Experience driving platform architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with Node.js in a polyglot backend environment.
* Active interest in evaluating and adopting emerging AI/ML tooling to accelerate engineering productivity.

**What We Offer**

* Platform-wide technical ownership with direct influence over architecture decisions across all product areas serving thousands of dental practices.
* High-autonomy environment with tight cross-functional collaboration — ship fast and see real-world impact quickly.
* Opportunity to shape engineering culture and standards at a fast-growing medical AI SaaS company in a largely under-digitized healthcare vertical.
* Flexible scheduling and strong support for continuous learning and professional growth.

description:
