Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
  
  
The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
AVP, Web Engineer III will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform in micro services architecture using
**Spring Frameworks, in memory data grid, micro-front ends, React JS, responsive design**
etc leveraging latest AI tools and capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and delivery of new web solutions/platforms and enhancements, partnering with product/requirements analysts, QA, and customers within an Agile delivery model.
* Own technical solutioning: translate business requirements into architecture, functional flows, and technical specifications; ensure alignment with enterprise standards.
* Provide technical leadership for mission-critical web applications/services, including hands-on guidance for complex components and integration points.
* Drive estimation and delivery planning with the team; manage technical dependencies/risks and represent engineering in project meetings and solution discussions.
* Ensure engineering excellence: code quality, performance, security, resiliency, and maintainability through reviews, standards, and best practices.
* Establish and enforce engineering practices for documentation, code reuse, refactoring, and design patterns; govern adherence across the team.
* Ensure internally developed applications meet high standards for availability, scalability, extensibility, and operational readiness (monitoring, alerting, supportability).
* Lead and coordinate a blended team (Synchrony and vendor engineers), providing direction, mentoring, and alignment on ways of working.
* Define and track measurable team goals (delivery, quality, reliability, and productivity metrics) and drive continuous improvement.
* Communicate delivery status, technical decisions, and trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership; escalate risks with mitigation plans.
* Stay current on emerging technologies and evaluate adoption opportunities, while ensuring strong proficiency and stability in the existing stack.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 4+ years in software engineering and 2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role. or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and React JS, with proven ability to lead design and implementation for complex web applications.
* Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event-driven systems), and building mission-critical services with high availability and performance.
* Experience with Micro-Frontends (preferred) and front-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost-aware design.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts/on-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with
**4+ years**
in software engineering and
**2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role**
. or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of relevant experience
  
  
**Work Timings: 2PM - 11PM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role, you will act as the principal bridge between core SAP systems, modern cloud data architectures, and data-driven business insights. Beyond deep-dive SAP HANA and BASIS administration, you will drive modern data provisioning strategies ( **SAP SLT, SDI, SDA, SAP BTP, and SAP Datasphere** ) and contribute to **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** involving data extraction, replication, and system landscape optimization.

* **10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP BASIS, SAP HANA, and Data Integration tools ( **SLT, SDI, SDA** ).
* Proven track record in **S/4HANA transformations** , leading data provisioning and replication strategies.
* Good to have knowledge of **SAP BTP** , **SAP Datasphere** , and third-party tools like **SNP Kyano** .
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related fields.
* Relevant SAP certifications in HANA Administration or Data Integration are preferred.

### **Must-Have Skills & Tools**

* **Core Expertise:** SAP BASIS Architecture, SAP HANA Administration, SAP SLT, SAP SDI, SAP SDA, SAP BTP, SAP Datasphere, SNP Kyano.
* **Tools & Platforms:** SAP HANA Cockpit, HANA Studio, Web IDE, Database Explorer, DP Agent, SAP Solution Manager, CTS+/ChaRM.
* **Architectural Mastery:** Enterprise replication topologies, custom ABAP transformation rules, multi-tier flowgraphs, federated virtualization, latency optimization, and S/4HANA migration data pipelines.
* **Leadership & Core Traits:** Strategic problem-solving, advanced analytical troubleshooting, cross-functional stakeholder management, and a strong commitment to mentoring junior and mid-level engineering staff.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Data Provisioning (SLT / SDI / SDA)**

* Architect real-time **SLT replication** , including custom ABAP transformation rules, table partitioning, and latency tuning.
* Demonstrate expert-level execution of table reload strategies, trigger management, and logging table synchronization during SLT source system refreshes or system copy activities.
* Configure **SDA remote sources** for federated querying across heterogeneous databases.
* Deploy and manage **DP Agents** , adapters, and complex **SDI flowgraphs** for ETL and data ingestion.
* Act as the final escalation lead for replication failures, DP Agent issues, and schema synchronization issues.

**2. S/4HANA Transformation & Cloud Integration**

* Lead data replication and provisioning architectures for **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** .
* Leverage tools like **SNP Kyano** for optimized data migration, transformation, and landscape optimization.
* Build and govern hybrid data integration pipelines connecting core SAP systems to **SAP BTP** and **SAP Datasphere** .

**3. Core BASIS & HANA Administration**

* Oversee end-to-end SAP BASIS operations, multi-tenant HANA governance, upgrades, and system copies.
* Manage transport systems (TMS, CTS+, ChaRM) to ensure stable, zero-downtime release management.
* Maintain system availability, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) readiness.

**4. Optimization, Security & Leadership**

* Perform expert troubleshooting for **HANA memory, CPU bottlenecks, thread locks, and SQL tuning** .
* Implement HANA security roles, SSL/TLS pipeline encryption, and firewall concepts.
* Establish technical SOPs, operations runbooks, and mentor team members in technical best practices.

title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, eBooks and reference works. We are creating technology platforms to shape the future of knowledge.

Taylor & Francis Group produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

As part of Taylor & Francis’s digital first strategy, we have been driving growth through providing access to publications through digital platforms and providing a unified experience across the body of content. We have created digital platforms to facilitate discovery and to allow users to access relevant research and information quickly and easily, wherever they are.

Taylor & Francis is building the world's leading platform connecting the network of human knowledge. We are passionate about helping researchers achieve their goals, which in turn adds new nodes to the ever-expanding graph of research information. We believe that researchers are our number one priority, so we work hard to deliver value back to them with everything we do.

Our teams are solving unique and difficult problems at scale in an energetic and hyper-growth environment. We’re growing incredibly quickly, and we need experienced technical people to help us scale.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an AI/ML Research Engineer (NLP & Knowledge Graphs) to join our Applied AI Solutions team. This is a junior-to-mid level role: the ideal candidate has around 2–4 years of hands-on experience applying NLP and machine learning (or an MSc with strong research or internship experience), and wants to grow into a research-minded engineer who can take an idea from paper to working prototype.

You will research, prototype and evaluate ways of extracting structure and meaning from scholarly content – entities, relations, topics and emerging research areas – and of representing it in knowledge graphs and ontologies that can power better discovery, search and recommendation across Taylor & Francis. You will report to the Director of Applied AI Solutions, who in turn reports to the CTO.

The Applied AI Solutions team is a small, senior, research-led group within the CTO organisation. We are the part of Taylor & Francis that works on problems that are on nobody’s product roadmap yet – discovery, peer review, research integrity and making scholarly content machine-consumable – and we turn the most promising ideas into evidence, working prototypes and business cases that Engineering and the business can adopt.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Work as part of a small, research-led team on a few strategic AI “bets” each year, each ending in a decision-grade artefact: a working prototype, the evidence behind it and a business case.
* Research, prototype and evaluate NLP approaches for extracting entities, relations and topics from scholarly articles, books and metadata.
* Help design, populate and evolve knowledge graphs, ontologies and taxonomies that represent Taylor & Francis content and the research landscape around it.
* Build and benchmark semantic and hybrid retrieval approaches, including embedding models and graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Contribute to the team’s technology radar by scouting, trialling and writing up new open-source libraries, models and tools for knowledge extraction and search.
* Build test sets, metrics and evaluation harnesses so that every claim we make about a model or tool is backed by evidence.
* Support the hand-over of graduating prototypes to Engineering teams, with clear documentation and a written definition of what “done” means.
* Present results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and contribute to papers, articles and conference submissions.

**What we’re looking for:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop NLP pipelines for tasks such as named-entity recognition, relation extraction, entity linking and disambiguation, topic modelling and classification over scholarly text, using transformer models and LLMs.
* Build, populate and query knowledge graphs in a graph database or triple store (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL stores) and evaluate their quality and coverage.
* Support the design and expansion of ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies, working with Editorial and subject-matter experts.
* Detect and track emerging topics and research areas using clustering, topic modelling and embedding-based techniques.
* Evaluate embedding models, chunking strategies, rerankers and retrieval configurations for semantic search and RAG on scholarly content.
* Create gold-standard datasets and annotation guidelines, and define metrics (e.g., precision/recall/F1, nDCG) for reproducible evaluation.
* Design and run well-controlled experiments, tracking them with tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases so results can be reproduced.
* Prototype rapidly using LLM APIs and open-source models for knowledge extraction and enrichment.
* Write clean, tested and documented Python code that other engineers can pick up and extend.
* Prepare hand-over documentation and support Engineering teams during the build phase of prototypes that graduate to production.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Editorial and other business teams to turn open-ended problems into well-posed research questions.
* Assist with vendor, model and tool comparisons, including preparing benchmark results for internal and external audiences.
* Keep up with the research literature and relevant venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, SIGIR, ISWC/ESWC) and share what is relevant with the team.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**:

**Good to have certifications**

* Neo4j Certified Professional (or equivalent graph database certification)
* DeepLearning.AI or Hugging Face NLP / LLM specialisation certificates
* Cloud ML or AI certification (e.g., AWS Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer)

**Technical Skills:**

* 2–4 years of experience applying NLP and machine learning in industry or research (or an MSc with relevant research or internship experience).
* Strong Python, including scientific libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and writing readable, tested code.
* Hands-on experience with NLP libraries and frameworks such as spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch.
* Practical knowledge of knowledge graphs and semantic technologies: property graphs and/or RDF, OWL and SKOS, with query experience in Cypher and/or SPARQL.
* Understanding of information retrieval and semantic search: embeddings, vector search (e.g., FAISS, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, pgvector), hybrid retrieval and RAG.
* Experience designing evaluation: test sets, annotation, metrics, error analysis and statistical sanity-checking of results.
* Working familiarity with LLM APIs and structured-output prompting for information extraction.
* Experience with Git, Linux, SQL and reproducible experiment environments (notebooks, virtual environments, containers).
* Ability to read research papers and reproduce their results from the paper or open-source repository.
* Experience with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) is a plus.

**Soft Skills:**

* Curious, rigorous and sceptical: comfortable saying “the evidence does not support this” and showing why.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical colleagues.
* Comfortable working under the technical direction of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined pieces of work.
* Able to manage several experiments at once and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
* A keen eye for detail and a commitment to reproducible, high-quality work.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with scholarly or scientific text and metadata (e.g., Crossref, OpenAlex, ORCID, ROR, PubMed).
* Exposure to ontology and taxonomy tooling (e.g., Protégé, PoolParty, SKOS editors).
* Exposure to LLM fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA, PEFT) or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph).
* Prior publication, conference presentation or open-source contribution.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira).

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, mathematics or a related field (or equivalent experience). Master’s degree (or PhD in progress/completed) is an advantage but not required.

 **Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 6 years in DevOps, build and release engineering, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure or related software engineering.

description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming outstanding products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This, in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. This role will operate in both capacities, to augment existing AI roadmap, as well as innovate and trailblazing new frontier tech projects, crafting AI experiences that reduce time to insights and catalyze decision making.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a QE manager, you will build and lead a team of engineers as a part of a global horizontal Quality Engineering group focused on a breadth of technologies and applications including very highly scalable distributed applications, No-SQL platforms, internal search platforms, end customer facing websites and services, critical security systems, machine learning and anomaly detection systems, software-load balancing, among others. Build, develop, innovate, and retain a hard-working team of quality engineers and build an environment where they can thrive and succeed. You will work in a fast-paced software development environment and continuously enhance our automation infrastructure to move towards continuous deployment where every code change is thoroughly tested and considered ready to be deployed. You will be the quality DRI on product features. To be successful, you will need to supervise and communicate release readiness, identify any gaps, and consistently assess new and innovative ways to improve automation solutions. While the primary role is leading/managing employees, you should have deep technical knowledge of distributed systems and cloud computing, platform as a service, and microservices architecture. We expect that you have strong experience working with short release cycles, do not hesitate to code, and actively participate in design and code reviews.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years in Quality roles testing and automating large scale customer-facing systems with sophisticated distributed integrations
* 3+ years managing quality engineers responsible for qualifying features through the complete software development life cycle
* Ability to act as a leader to increase efficiency through process improvements and automation, increase test coverage through automation, reduce customer-impacting defects, make informed risk-based decisions, and improve chances of success and promote software testing standards and mentor engineers in the team
* Ability to build, drive and support automation test strategy. Dedication to delivering great software and releasing it quickly, efficiently, and with growing quality. (white box + black box, automation, functional, performance, stress testing)
* Excellent knowledge of QE automation architecture, methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Hands on in automating functional, system and integration tests. Experience in tools like Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber-JVM, Appium for API, Web, iOS and MacOS platforms.
* Experience creating multiple test frameworks from scratch. Experience in Java or Python, familiar with databases, SQL, and scripting languages.
* Understanding of REST and RESTful services.
* Applied knowledge of GenAI, micro-services, recommendation systems, and context engineering.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation concepts such as Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and experience with different LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)
* Experience with CI/CD or release validation workflows, deployment process and code quality checking tools.
* Knowledge of project management, and productivity tools such as Wrike and Miro.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.
* Able to balance competing priorities, long-term projects, and ad hoc requirements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, constantly evolving business environment.
* Working across global teams to ensure alignment of product development.
* We're looking for someone with an eagerness and ability to learn new skills and solve dynamic problems in an encouraging and expansive environment.
* Ability to collaborate and influence multi-functional teams within your area of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Collaborate with multi-functional and globally distributed teams

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Highly organised, creative, motivated, and passionate about achieving results.
* Creative thinker and strong problem solver with meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
* An enthusiasm for user-focused design & high-quality products.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate close interaction with development teams, management, and other teams within Apple

title: Data Governance Team Lead - Telematics
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Summary**

Caterpillar is seeking an Engineering Team Leader to help build the data foundation for its connected products.

Caterpillar equipment generates large volumes of operational, engineering, diagnostic, and telematics data. Turning that data into trusted, understandable, reusable information requires more than collecting it. Data must have consistent definitions, appropriate context, clear ownership, measurable quality, discoverability, and controls governing how it is created and used.

The Engineering Team Leader - Data Governance will provide technical and project leadership for initiatives that improve the quality, governance, metadata, standardization, and usability of connected-product data.

This role will work across engineering, connectivity, digital products, data platforms, analytics, and AI teams to make Caterpillar data easier for both people and intelligent systems to discover, understand, and use appropriately.

### **What You Will Do**

### **Data Governance Leadership**

* Lead initiatives that establish consistent definitions, ownership, standards, and governance for connected-product data.
* Define and improve processes for data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, retention, and lifecycle management.
* Help establish authoritative definitions and common data models across engineering and digital systems.
* Define measurable data-quality expectations and drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues.
* Ensure business and engineering context is captured alongside technical data definitions.

### **Connected Equipment Data**

* Work with teams responsible for telematics, equipment configuration, asset characterization, and other sources of connected-product data.
* Improve consistency between data generated by machines and the information consumed by engineering, analytics, condition monitoring, digital products, and AI.
* Coordinate improvements to data configuration, validation, and deployment processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data-governance and data-quality activities.

### **Data Products and Discoverability**

* Help transform important datasets into clearly defined, reusable data products with known ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and interfaces.
* Improve metadata and cataloging so users can determine what information exists, what it means, where it originated, and how it should be used.
* Partner with enterprise data-platform and governance teams to connect engineering data with Caterpillar-wide data standards and tooling.
* Help establish data structures and governance practices that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI applications.

### **Project and Technical Leadership**

* Lead complex cross-functional data initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
* Develop project scope, priorities, roadmaps, milestones, and success measures.
* Coordinate engineers, data specialists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Identify dependencies, technical risks, and organizational barriers and drive them to resolution.
* Communicate project status, technical decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Mentor team members and strengthen data-governance and data-engineering capabilities across the organization.

### **What You Have**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or another related technical discipline.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, master/reference data, data catalogs, or data product management.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected products, industrial data, or engineering data.
* Experience with enterprise data catalogs such as Alation or comparable metadata/catalog platforms.
* Experience with data pipelines, APIs, SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, or modern data engineering.
* Experience with AI/ML data requirements and governance of data used by Generative AI and agentic systems.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and data teams.

### **Why This Role Matters**

AI and analytics are only as reliable as the data and context available to them.

This role will help create the standards, metadata, quality controls, and reusable data structures that allow Caterpillar's connected-product data to become a dependable foundation for engineering, digital products, analytics, and AI.

Location - Chennai

Relocation - Domestic

5 days work from office

**Posting Dates:**

November 12, 2026 - November 25, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

The Software Engineer actively participates in code reviews, provides technical guidance and support to junior team members, and ensures adherence to coding standards and project timelines. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, excellent programming abilities, and a commitment to delivering robust and scalable software solutions. As part of the platform team, the software Engineer is responsible for providing the Application support as well.

  

This role includes participation in an on-call rota to ensure the availability and support of critical systems operations outside of standard working hours, including nights, weekend and bank holidays.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* **Design and develop software applications**: Deliver software development tasks for Claims Guidewire platform, including Claim Center and Digital Applications, with expected quality measures and timeframe, e.g., technical design, coding, writing unit test cases (G-Unit) and unit testing, debugging and defect fixing, providing test support, release support and maintenance.

Collaborate with team members to address any issues and ensure code quality is upheld.

* **Perform testing and debugging:** Conduct unit testing and integration testing of software modules to ensure their functionality and reliability. Provide Test support during various testing phases. Debug and resolve software defects to deliver bug-free software solutions.

* **Application Production Support:** Provide Technical support for the Guidewire Application users while troubleshooting and researching issues reported in Production, perform root cause analysis and document them, respond to and resolve technical issues in a timely manner as per priority and urgency.

* **Collaborate with cross-functional team**: Work closely with stakeholders, product managers, and designers to understand business requirements and user needs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and deliver software solutions that meet customer expectations.

  

**FUNCTIONAL / TECHNICAL SKILLS**

  

* 2-4 years of development experience on Guidewire cloud platform and applications, Guidewire certification preferred

* Experience on any database Oracle / SQL Server and well versed in SQL

* Experience of working in a CI/CD setup and related tools/technologies

* In-depth understanding of the software development process, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment. Familiarity with agile methodologies

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify and resolve complex technical problems. Ability to troubleshoot issues and implement effective solutions.

* Insurance domain knowledge with Property & Casualty background preferred

**DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY/ IMPACT**

  

* Problem-solving Orientation: Demonstrating a proactive and solution-focused approach to addressing challenges and problems. Analysing issues, identifying root causes, and proposing effective solutions.

* Communication Skills: Clearly articulating ideas, requirements, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Actively listening to others, seeking clarification when needed, and fostering effective communication within the team.

* Quality Focus: Striving for excellence and consistently delivering high-quality work. Paying attention to details, following best practices, and ensuring code readability, maintainability, and robustness.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

title: LMTS - Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**

Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.

This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.

The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.

We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.

**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.  

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.  

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.

description:
Meet the Team
  
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Architectural Vision& Complex Problem Solving:** Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership& Project Governance:** Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap& Strategy:** Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature& Framework Delivery:** Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:** Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security& Reliability by Design:** Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling& Security Architecture:** Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability& Proactive Risk Resolution:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations& SRE Governance:** Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:** Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness& Metrics:** Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping& Stakeholder Negotiation:** Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC& Agile Excellence:** Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship& Engineering Culture:** Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).
  
  
Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
  
Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines.
  
  
Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.

**Job Description**

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research.

We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with 6–10 years of software engineering experience and substantial hands-on Python development. title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a frontend developer with a designer's eye to build Sarvam's web experiences. You'll start with our marketing website: the homepage, product and use-case pages, interactive demos and calculators. You'll write production code, build reusable UI systems and turn rough ideas into polished interfaces, working closely with design, marketing and product engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build the interface, not just the mockup. Write production-ready Astro and React components with thoughtful layouts, typography and responsive behaviour. Own the implementation from first prototype to the final browser-sized detail.
* Build a UI system that holds together. Create reusable components, layout primitives and shared styles with clear APIs and sensible variants. Make the next page easier to build without turning every component into a 40-prop puzzle.
* Make it feel right. Build interactions, transitions and animations that make interfaces clearer and more enjoyable. Think through keyboard use, loading, empty and error states, reduced motion and what happens when the happy path isn't so happy.
* Prototype in code. Explore alternative layouts and interactions with designers, test ideas in the browser and refine the details together. You should be comfortable suggesting a better implementation, not waiting for every pixel and breakpoint to be specified.
* Build the useful bits properly. Develop interactive demos, calculators and forms; connect thm to APIs and content. Handle state, validation, asynchronous behaviour and failures. Keep accessibility, performance, metadata and measurement working as part of what you ship.
* Own the engineering quality. Make sound choices about component structure, rendering and hydration. Debug browser and performance issues, write appropriate tests, review code and check preview deployments. Ship maintainable changes that work beyond your own laptop.
* Astro, React, TypeScript and CSS are at the core of the work. We use GitHub for code review and Railway for development and pull-request previews. Sanity, ImageKit and PostHog support content, media and measurement. You'll work with engineering on staging and production releases.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Have built and shipped interfaces you're proud to put your name on. Show us the actual thing, what you coded and the decisions you made. A live link beats a paragraph of adjectives.
* Have strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React experience. You can work effectively in Astro and reason about component composition, state, rendering and browser behaviour.
* Have a good eye for visual design and the CSS skills to act on it. You care about spacing, type, hierarchy, responsive layouts and interaction details, and can turn that judgement into working code.
* Can work across design and engineering. You're comfortable starting from a rough brief, prototyping options and discussing trade-offs with designers. You can also take an established design and implement it faithfully.
* Can debug an unfamiliar frontend, integrate APIs and use Git, pull requests and automated checks confidently. You understand accessibility and web performance, and handle credentials and user data responsibly.
* Use AI coding tools with judgement. Let them help you move faster. Read the diff, test the result and be able to explain what you're shipping. 'The model wrote it' isn't a debugging strategy.
* Ask good questions when the brief is fuzzy. Explain trade-offs, suggest a practical way forward and use evidence before declaring that something needs fixing.

**Bonus points that are not dealbreakers**
==========================================

* You've built for B2B SaaS, developer tools or AI products.
* You've built component libraries, design systems or interactive prototypes that other people actually use.
* You've worked with animation, SVG, Canvas or other techniques that make complex ideas easier to explore on the web.
* You've used a headless CMS such as Sanity, or worked on technical SEO and analytics integrations without letting them take over the frontend.

**How to apply**
================

Skip the generic cover letter. Send us a couple of interfaces or web projects you've built, with a short note on what you personally designed and coded. Pick one and walk us through a component, interaction or tricky engineering decision. Code samples are welcome where you can share them.

If there's a side project you're weirdly proud of, we'd like to see that too.

**Why Sarvam?**
---------------

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Senior Design Engineer
description:
**Your Job**

We are seeking a proficient and experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with strong expertise in CAD tools such as Siemens NX and PLM Teamcenter. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in mechanical engineering principles and demonstrate excellent conceptual design, CAD modeling and drafting skills. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and high-quality liquid-cooling products for datacenter and AI infrastructure. The candidate should be capable of deep diving into Product Lifecycle Management processes to support design, development, and release activities, ensuring design integrity and efficiency throughout the product development cycle

**Our Team**

This team has global engineering ownership across several Connector Product Lines, provides Product Design and Validation Services, designs and develops Mold & Die Tooling, Gage & Fixture, Product Testing Systems and Application Tooling services to customers and stakeholders in Datacom and Specialty Solutions Division located across the globe. The Division primarily provides products and solutions that go into Datacenter and related infrastructure that powers cloud computing, artificial intelligence, etc. The position will be part of this engineering team at Molex India Business Services.

**What You Will Do**

* Utilize Siemens NX software to conceptualize and develop new designs, 3D models and assemblies of mechanical systems, ensuring accuracy, precision, and adherence to design specifications.
* Collaborate with Supervisors and cross functional team members to interpret technical specifications and voice of customers, and convert them into detailed designs, 3D models and 2D drawings.
* Partner with Thermal/CFD engineers to iterate flow-path and cold-plate geometry using simulation results such as pressure drop, flow distribution, temperature uniformity, and hotspot margin.
* Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly principles for CNC machining, Conventional machining, brazing, welding, and sheet-metal operations.
* Lead design reviews, DFMEA, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and technical decision-making for assigned projects.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including bills of materials (BOMs), engineering change orders (ECOs), and release packages, within Teamcenter.
* Manage and organize Design and CAD files, ensuring proper version control and data integrity within Teamcenter.
* Conduct design reviews, participate in cross-functional meetings, taking the lead in providing technical insights and actions for design improvements.
* Perform tolerance analysis and verification of parts and assemblies to ensure fit, form, and function.
* Conduct design feasibility studies, identifying potential issues or constraints and proposing solutions to optimize designs.
* Conduct risk assessment and come up with solutions to mitigate impact.
* Collaborate closely with manufacturing and production teams to address design-related issues, resolve manufacturing discrepancies, and support the development of efficient manufacturing processes.
* Ability to work independently, take the lead to mentor and guide junior team members in execution of projects, meeting project timelines and quality requirements

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor of Engineering/Master of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering
* 6 to 10 years in Product Design, Development & Modification, Product Validation & Testing, Sustenance & Field Application support

* Demonstrated technical ability in taking the lead engineer role in projects and design activities
* Proven leadership skills in mentoring and guiding junior engineers
* Working knowledge of material selection, product and component manufacturing process
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes such as molding, sheet metal tooling, fabrication of components and assembly processes
* Proficient in using solid modeling software to generate 3D models & 2D drafting
* Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Good knowledge of conventional and advanced Machining, Assembly line process and Prototype techniques.
* Proficient in Siemens NX, Team Center and PLM/PDM

* Good understanding of thermal management and heat transfer.
* Experience working in a tool room will be an added advantage.

  

* Experience working in Connector or related industry
* Good knowledge and understanding of electromechanical products, components and assemblies
* Experience with New Product Development processes, including design, prototyping, and testing.

title: Sr. Manager; Data Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Senior Manager, Data Engineering, provides people leadership and deep technical direction for the Visa Client Exchange Cloud Platform and Clean Rooms, a strategic FY27 priority. The role leads the engineering journey from pilot to production, enabling secure, scalable, privacy-preserving data collaboration and reliable data exchange across on-premises and cloud environments.

Providing technical guidance across the Frontier Agentic Squad’s and extending platform leadership coverage across multiple region, this leader translates business priorities into architecture decisions, engineering roadmaps, and dependable production services. Success is measured through business opportunities enabled, platform reliability, delivery quality, and the growth and independence of engineering teams.

This is a technically engaged management role requiring the credibility to challenge designs, review critical code, guide complex incident resolution, and develop technical leads without becoming a delivery bottleneck. The Senior Manager partners with Product, Architecture, Operations and Infrastructure (O&I), Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to balance customer commitments, security, privacy, cost, and sustainable execution.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Own the technical roadmap and production delivery of VCDEP Clean Rooms and the cloud platform, aligned to customer and business outcomes.
* Guide architecture across AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost.
* Oversee high-volume data exchange between on-premises and cloud platforms, ensuring data quality, interoperability, and failure recovery.
* Embed privacy, security, query governance, and data lifecycle controls into platform design and operation.
* Drive operational excellence through clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, and tested disaster recovery.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, security remediation, and safe platform upgrades.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineers and technical leads, fostering inclusion, accountability, and technical excellence.
* Provide technical leadership across squads, clarify ownership, resolve disagreements, and reduce single-person dependencies.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Operations, Security, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to manage priorities, risks, and delivery commitments.
* Lead responsible adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows, with human oversight and measurable improvements in productivity and quality.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8+ years of relevant work experience and a bachelor’s degree, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.
* Experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale data platforms or distributed systems, including production ownership, coaching, performance development, and cross-team technical guidance.
* Demonstrated technical depth in cloud architecture and data engineering, with substantial experience in at least one of AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks and the ability to evaluate cross-platform integration trade-offs.
* Experience designing and operating high-volume data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and distributed processing systems, including data validation, performance optimization, failure recovery, and idempotent processing.
* Working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review production code and guide testing, API design, version control, CI/CD, and secure development practices.
* Experience implementing secure data access, encryption, auditability, and data lifecycle governance in partnership with security, risk, privacy, or compliance teams.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and establishing monitoring, operational documentation, incident response, and reliability improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical leads, delegate ownership, resolve disagreements, and influence teams outside direct reporting lines.
* Experience translating business needs into technical roadmaps and measurable outcomes, with clear communication of architectural trade-offs and individual versus team contributions.
* Digital fluency and the ability to evaluate AI-assisted engineering workflows for usefulness, quality, security, and appropriate human oversight.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for data engineering solutions.
* Experience scaling self-service platform capabilities, establishing multi-squad operating models, and leading geographically distributed teams in a matrixed organization.
* Experience deploying AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows with demonstrated productivity or quality improvements and effective security, review, and audit controls.
