title: Principal Physical Design CAD Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to accelerate, the ability to deliver new silicon innovations and infrastructure at scale, with quality, speed, and cost efficiency, has never been more critical. Within SCHIE, the Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) organization plays a pivotal role in enabling Microsoft's silicon strategy. MILE is responsible for end-to-end silicon design methodologies, EDA/CAD ecosystems, and the underlying compute infrastructure that powers the development of Microsoft's custom silicon portfolio - the Azure Cobalt and Azure Maia processors

We are seeking a Principal PD CAD Engineer to be the technical lead in our Physical Design Methodology & CAD team in India. In this leadership role, you will build and be responsible in defining and driving end to end physical design methodologies, with a focus on PD construction space, define CAD strategy, and flow architecture across Microsoft's silicon programs. You will partner closely with engineering teams worldwide to deliver scalable, innovative, and robust solutions that accelerate silicon development and help shape the future of Microsoft's cloud infrastructure.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build world-class Physical Design Methodologies & CAD solutions fostering innovation, technical excellence, and a growth mindset.

* Partner with engineering leaders worldwide to define and execute the long-term vision for Physical Design methodologies and CAD solutions, enabling multi-vendor solutions and successful delivery of Microsoft's next-generation silicon products.

* Drive scalable RTL-to-GDSII flows, automation frameworks, and design closure solutions that enable predictable execution and first-pass silicon success.

* Lead the AI-driven transformation of physical design methodologies, CAD flows, and engineering infrastructure by integrating advanced AI, machine learning, and automation technologies to significantly improve productivity, quality, and engineering velocity.

* Influence industry direction through deep collaboration with leading EDA vendors, driving next-generation design technologies, methodology innovation, and operational excellence across Microsoft's silicon ecosystem.

* Champion measurable improvements in quality, productivity, compute efficiency, cost optimization, and engineering effectiveness across the silicon development lifecycle.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

* 12+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience in Physical Design, CAD, EDA, or Silicon Engineering, with deep expertise in semiconductor design methodologies and workflows.

* Proven experience defining, building, and scaling CAD methodologies, automation frameworks, and engineering workflows supporting complex SoC and ASIC development programs.

* Proven success influencing and aligning stakeholders across globally distributed engineering teams to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver complex silicon programs.

* Demonstrated impact driving engineering excellence through hands on experience in methodology, automation, infrastructure, and tooling that improve productivity, quality, predictability, and time-to-market.

Other Requirements:  
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.  
  This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 15+ years of relevant experience

* Deep expertise in RTL-to-GDSII implementation and sign-off methodologies

* Experience leading Physical Design methodology and supporting multiple silicon programs.

* Experience driving AI-enabled, data-driven, or automation-focused transformation initiatives within silicon engineering workflows.

* Hands-on experience building and scaling compute infrastructure, cloud-native engineering platforms, or large-scale EDA environments.

* Strong knowledge of industry-standard EDA tools and methodologies from vendors such as Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens.

* Experience partnering with EDA vendors to influence product roadmaps, drive tool adoption, and resolve complex technical challenges.

* Strong programming and automation skills using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or similar languages.

* Experience developing silicon for datacentre, AI/ML, networking, or high-performance computing applications.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
description:
**ABOUT US**

Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.

**YOUR IMPACT**

Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Penetration testing.** Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.

**Threat hunting.** Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.

**Adversary simulation and purple teaming**. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.

**Automation.** Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.

**Reporting.** Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

**Experience.** 3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.

**Endpoint and network depth.** You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.

**Tooling and scripting.** You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

**AI awareness.** You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.

**Practical credentials.** Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd
* Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to
* Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements
* GCP and Kubernetes attack paths
* Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

**WHY JOIN US**

**High autonomy**

You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.

**Builder culture**

Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.

**PERKS AND BENEFITS**

* Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction
* Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development
* Competitive compensation with equity ownership
* Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget
* A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

description:
Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let’s push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide.
  
  
**How You’ll Help Us Connect the World:**

You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster—from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails.
  
This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
  
  
**You Will Make an Impact By:**  

* Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams.
* Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines—with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices.
* Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions.
* Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows.
* Developing and extending AI coding-assistant tooling for engineering teams, including Claude Code skills and plugins, custom agents, and reusable prompt templates.
* Designing evaluation frameworks and guardrails for AI-generated output, using golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites so quality is measured, not assumed.
* Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops.
* Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds.
* Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization.
* Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs.
* Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows.
* Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
* Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning.

**Required Qualifications for Consideration:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building LLM-powered applications that run in production.
* Track record of taking AI features from prototype to production, with measurable impact on quality, speed, or cost.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
* Practical experience building RAG systems: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector), hybrid search, and re-ranking.
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and guardrail techniques: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and mitigation of hallucination and prompt injection.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Strong Python skills, including asyncio, type hints, and testing with pytest.
* Experience designing REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Experience with async, event-driven pipelines and queues (e.g., Celery, Kafka, Redis), plus working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of secrets management (e.g., Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), role-based access control, and dependency and container scanning (e.g., Snyk, Trivy).
* Experience with observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse) for tracing, metrics, and cost tracking of LLM applications.
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably AWS.

**You Will Excite Us If You:**  

* Have experience building AI for IT operations or customer support
* Are experienced in reducing LLM cost and latency at scale through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and context compression
* Have applied AI tooling to large C/C++ codebases.

title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, eBooks and reference works. We are creating technology platforms to shape the future of knowledge.

Taylor & Francis Group produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

As part of Taylor & Francis’s digital first strategy, we have been driving growth through providing access to publications through digital platforms and providing a unified experience across the body of content. We have created digital platforms to facilitate discovery and to allow users to access relevant research and information quickly and easily, wherever they are.

Taylor & Francis is building the world's leading platform connecting the network of human knowledge. We are passionate about helping researchers achieve their goals, which in turn adds new nodes to the ever-expanding graph of research information. We believe that researchers are our number one priority, so we work hard to deliver value back to them with everything we do.

Our teams are solving unique and difficult problems at scale in an energetic and hyper-growth environment. We’re growing incredibly quickly, and we need experienced technical people to help us scale.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an AI/ML Research Engineer (NLP & Knowledge Graphs) to join our Applied AI Solutions team. This is a junior-to-mid level role: the ideal candidate has around 2–4 years of hands-on experience applying NLP and machine learning (or an MSc with strong research or internship experience), and wants to grow into a research-minded engineer who can take an idea from paper to working prototype.

You will research, prototype and evaluate ways of extracting structure and meaning from scholarly content – entities, relations, topics and emerging research areas – and of representing it in knowledge graphs and ontologies that can power better discovery, search and recommendation across Taylor & Francis. You will report to the Director of Applied AI Solutions, who in turn reports to the CTO.

The Applied AI Solutions team is a small, senior, research-led group within the CTO organisation. We are the part of Taylor & Francis that works on problems that are on nobody’s product roadmap yet – discovery, peer review, research integrity and making scholarly content machine-consumable – and we turn the most promising ideas into evidence, working prototypes and business cases that Engineering and the business can adopt.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Work as part of a small, research-led team on a few strategic AI “bets” each year, each ending in a decision-grade artefact: a working prototype, the evidence behind it and a business case.
* Research, prototype and evaluate NLP approaches for extracting entities, relations and topics from scholarly articles, books and metadata.
* Help design, populate and evolve knowledge graphs, ontologies and taxonomies that represent Taylor & Francis content and the research landscape around it.
* Build and benchmark semantic and hybrid retrieval approaches, including embedding models and graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Contribute to the team’s technology radar by scouting, trialling and writing up new open-source libraries, models and tools for knowledge extraction and search.
* Build test sets, metrics and evaluation harnesses so that every claim we make about a model or tool is backed by evidence.
* Support the hand-over of graduating prototypes to Engineering teams, with clear documentation and a written definition of what “done” means.
* Present results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and contribute to papers, articles and conference submissions.

**What we’re looking for:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop NLP pipelines for tasks such as named-entity recognition, relation extraction, entity linking and disambiguation, topic modelling and classification over scholarly text, using transformer models and LLMs.
* Build, populate and query knowledge graphs in a graph database or triple store (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL stores) and evaluate their quality and coverage.
* Support the design and expansion of ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies, working with Editorial and subject-matter experts.
* Detect and track emerging topics and research areas using clustering, topic modelling and embedding-based techniques.
* Evaluate embedding models, chunking strategies, rerankers and retrieval configurations for semantic search and RAG on scholarly content.
* Create gold-standard datasets and annotation guidelines, and define metrics (e.g., precision/recall/F1, nDCG) for reproducible evaluation.
* Design and run well-controlled experiments, tracking them with tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases so results can be reproduced.
* Prototype rapidly using LLM APIs and open-source models for knowledge extraction and enrichment.
* Write clean, tested and documented Python code that other engineers can pick up and extend.
* Prepare hand-over documentation and support Engineering teams during the build phase of prototypes that graduate to production.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Editorial and other business teams to turn open-ended problems into well-posed research questions.
* Assist with vendor, model and tool comparisons, including preparing benchmark results for internal and external audiences.
* Keep up with the research literature and relevant venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, SIGIR, ISWC/ESWC) and share what is relevant with the team.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**:

**Good to have certifications**

* Neo4j Certified Professional (or equivalent graph database certification)
* DeepLearning.AI or Hugging Face NLP / LLM specialisation certificates
* Cloud ML or AI certification (e.g., AWS Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer)

**Technical Skills:**

* 2–4 years of experience applying NLP and machine learning in industry or research (or an MSc with relevant research or internship experience).
* Strong Python, including scientific libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and writing readable, tested code.
* Hands-on experience with NLP libraries and frameworks such as spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch.
* Practical knowledge of knowledge graphs and semantic technologies: property graphs and/or RDF, OWL and SKOS, with query experience in Cypher and/or SPARQL.
* Understanding of information retrieval and semantic search: embeddings, vector search (e.g., FAISS, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, pgvector), hybrid retrieval and RAG.
* Experience designing evaluation: test sets, annotation, metrics, error analysis and statistical sanity-checking of results.
* Working familiarity with LLM APIs and structured-output prompting for information extraction.
* Experience with Git, Linux, SQL and reproducible experiment environments (notebooks, virtual environments, containers).
* Ability to read research papers and reproduce their results from the paper or open-source repository.
* Experience with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) is a plus.

**Soft Skills:**

* Curious, rigorous and sceptical: comfortable saying “the evidence does not support this” and showing why.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical colleagues.
* Comfortable working under the technical direction of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined pieces of work.
* Able to manage several experiments at once and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
* A keen eye for detail and a commitment to reproducible, high-quality work.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with scholarly or scientific text and metadata (e.g., Crossref, OpenAlex, ORCID, ROR, PubMed).
* Exposure to ontology and taxonomy tooling (e.g., Protégé, PoolParty, SKOS editors).
* Exposure to LLM fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA, PEFT) or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph).
* Prior publication, conference presentation or open-source contribution.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira).

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, mathematics or a related field (or equivalent experience). Master’s degree (or PhD in progress/completed) is an advantage but not required.

 **Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

**What we offer in return:**

* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk
  

**Summary**

The Core Engineering Shared Services AI team operates as an internal forward-deployed AI engineering function, embedding with The Core business teams to identify priority workflows, prototype agentic AI solutions, and productionize cloud-native applications that deliver measurable business impact. This hands-on role combines client-facing problem discovery, rapid engineering execution, production AI architecture, and structured transition to receiving teams that will operate and extend the solutions over time.

As an AI Application Engineer, you will work directly with internal business and engineering partners to convert ambiguous operating problems into secure, reliable AI products. You will define where agents should act, where they should assist, and where human approval or control gates are required, then design and deliver solutions that are adopted in real workflows and can be supported in production.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Rapid Prototyping & Application Delivery: Lead the design, build, deployment, and operationalization of cloud-native AI applications, using modern software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing to accelerate reliable delivery.
* Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Partner with business and engineering teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities, translate requirements into cloud-optimized architectures, and define scalable data models and technical specifications.
* Forward-Deployed AI Engineering: Embed with The Core business teams to map workflows, identify pain points, assess agentic automation opportunities, define control and approval boundaries, iterate with users, and drive adoption through pilots, feedback loops, and measurable outcomes.
* Production AI/ML Integration: Build AI applications using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt and context management, structured outputs, response validation, and evaluation harnesses required for production use.
* Cloud, DevOps & MLOps Execution: Apply cloud-native services, secure deployment patterns, observability, lifecycle management, and MLOps practices to ensure applications are scalable, resilient, cost-aware, and supportable.
* Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Document solutions, mentor receiving teams, and support clean transition of application code, integration patterns, data models, and operational practices into long-term engineering ownership.
  

**Qualifications**

* Must have: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Must have: 9+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting robust production applications.
* Must have: Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with demonstrated ability to apply sound software engineering, testing, data modelling, and system design practices.
* Must have: Proven experience translating complex business requirements into cloud-optimized application architectures, scalable data models, and technical specifications for production delivery.
* Must have: Experience operating in a forward-deployed or internal client-facing engineering model, including workflow discovery, stakeholder engagement, rapid prototyping, solution shaping, pilot execution, adoption measurement, and production handoff to receiving teams.
* Must have: Extensive experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including serverless, containerization, managed services, automated deployment, monitoring, and cloud security standards.
* Must have: Experience designing cloud-based AI solution architectures that integrate managed AI services, LLM providers, retrieval and vector search, secure data access, API gateways, event-driven workflows, identity and entitlement controls, observability, deployment automation, and cost and resilience trade-offs across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Must have: Demonstrated experience integrating LLM or AI/ML capabilities into production applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases or search indexes, prompt templates, context assembly, structured outputs, response validation, evaluation datasets, and model performance monitoring.
* Must have: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, lead cross-functional delivery, and enable receiving teams through documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.
* Preferred: Experience building agentic AI systems that decompose tasks, plan multi-step workflows, call approved tools or APIs, maintain state, enforce permission and policy checks, handle failure paths, and produce auditable action trails.
* Preferred: Experience implementing agent observability and controls, including trace capture, prompt and tool-call logging, hallucination and policy-violation checks, human-in-the-loop approvals, incident handoff, and post-action summarization.
* Preferred: Experience optimizing production AI systems through model selection and routing, prompt compression, retrieval tuning, caching, batching, streaming responses, asynchronous execution, parallel tool calls, latency budgets, cost controls, and quality regression testing.

title: Senior Customer Engineer
description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Global Customer Services Ref ID: JR-024006

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

**Senior Customer Engineer - Strata Cloud Manager (SCM)**
=========================================================

**Your Career**
---------------

The Customer Engineering (CE) team is an exciting crossroads between Global Customer Support (GCS), Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), bridging the gap between customer-facing Technical Assistance Center (TAC) teams and backend Engineering.

As a Senior Customer Engineer, you will drive technical investigations for critical customer escalations and other complex issues involving our SaaS and cloud security offerings, including Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) and Strata Logging Service.

You will partner closely with customers, TAC, and Engineering bridging the gap between customer-facing teams and our backend cloud infrastructure and Engineering. You will also leverage AI, automation, and engineering tools to improve troubleshooting efficiency and define supportability requirements to reduce recurring issues.

You are a good candidate if you thrive in cloud-native environments, have a strong troubleshooting mindset, communicate effectively under pressure, and enjoy understanding why systems behave the way they do.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* **Escalation Leadership:** Own technical investigations and resolution of critical and complex customer escalations. Coordinate troubleshooting across TAC, Engineering, and SRE, participate in live customer and internal incident bridges, and collaborate with designated incident commanders to accelerate resolution.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work directly with developers, SRE, DevOps, QA, and Product Management as an expert advisor during the design and later Product Life Cycle phases. Establish a regular cadence and process to define supportability, telemetry, and usability requirements. Maintain visibility into ongoing Engineering investigations, drive continuous product improvements and ensure effective collaboration between TAC and Engineering.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis:** Investigate issues involving SaaS infrastructure, cloud environments, backend services, APIs, security enforcement, control planes, AI gateways, and traffic flows. Analyze logs, telemetry, configurations, and system behavior to identify root causes and contribute to post-incident reviews and preventive actions.
* **AI & Agentic Workflows:** Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate troubleshooting, analyze logs, develop scripts, and automate repetitive tasks. Create tools and automation to help solve support challenges at scale, applying technical judgment to validate AI-generated outputs and follow security requirements.
* **Supportability & Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring escalation patterns, diagnostic gaps, and product limitations. Actively look for opportunities to catch problems before they escalate or become widespread.
* **Issue Reproduction & Validation:** Build or adapt cloud-based lab environments to reproduce customer issues and validate fixes when feasible. Use backend logs, telemetry, API investigations, and Engineering collaboration for issues that cannot be reproduced in a lab.
* **TAC Enablement & Knowledge Sharing:** Develop troubleshooting playbooks and AI Copilot knowledge inputs. Provide targeted training, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing sessions to enable TAC teams. This includes structured training throughout the year, as well as ad hoc sessions and Q&A (live and via Zoom). Maintain regular office hours with support teams to facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and faster issue resolution.
* **Adaptability & Initiative:** Take ownership of emerging technical challenges, adapt to evolving products and responsibilities. Champion unplanned projects that result in a better customer experience, and proactively identify opportunities to improve customer support and engineering workflows.

**The Team**
------------

Customer Engineering is a specialized technical team that is critical to our success and mission. Our technical team provides behind-the-scenes support to meet our customer’s needs. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. In fact, you’ll proactively seek them out to ensure our clients are safely supported. We value technical curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and the ability to adapt to new challenges. Our engineers are encouraged to look beyond individual incidents, challenge existing processes, and develop solutions that improve how we support customers at scale.

We’re a fast-growing, immensely successful organization because of our people and products. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, are excited by the prospect of a challenge, and feel empowered to mitigate the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are enabled by a secure digital environment.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Professional Background:** **Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Troubleshooting & Escalations:** **Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with experience investigating complex technical issues and handling critical escalations in enterprise environments. Ability to work effectively under pressure and coordinate investigations across multiple teams.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communication skills:** **Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical findings, managing customer expectations, and engaging with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders. Translating technical information for other Engineers and Executive teams is an essential part of the job.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Cloud & SaaS Knowledge:** **Understanding of enterprise SaaS architectures, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operational workflows. Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Scripting, Automation, and AI:** **Comfortable with Python, JSON, REST APIs, Linux/Unix environments, SQL, SDKs, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to automate lab deployments and build custom troubleshooting scripts. Proficiency with SOTA AI models (such as Claude and ChatGPT) in coding and engineering workflows. Experience developing AI-assisted troubleshooting workflows, automation agents, or internal engineering tools is highly desired.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **SaaS/SRE/DevOps Knowledge:** **Familiarity or experience with enterprise SaaS application backend systems, DevOps, SRE, and CI/CD pipelines is required.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Networking & Security Fundamentals:** **Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, routing, and general network troubleshooting.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** **Experience working with Technical Support, Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or Product Management to investigate and resolve complex technical issues.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Adaptability:** **Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, learning new technologies, and taking on evolving responsibilities.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **On-Call Availability:** **Willingness to participate in rotating on-call shifts and provide technical escalation support during occasional evenings and weekends. Experience with incident management processes is beneficial. Familiarity with incident management tools such as PagerDuty or FireHydrant is preferred.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **PAN-OS Expertise:** **Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products, particularly Software Firewalls, Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), Prisma AIRS/Portkey, Prisma SASE, or SD-WAN. Knowledge of core NGFW capabilities such as App-ID, User-ID, Threat Prevention, and URL Filtering across physical, virtual, and cloud-delivered environments.**

* **Familiarity with observability technologies such as Grafana, Prometheus, distributed tracing, or equivalent logging and monitoring platforms.**

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

### **The Role**

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Cool things you'll do**

You'll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You'll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.

### **What you'll do**

* Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
* Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
* Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
* Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

### **What you'll bring**

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:

* Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
* Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
* Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
* Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
* Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
* Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs
* Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution

Helpful experience

* Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
* Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
* Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
* Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
* Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus
* Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Staff Engineer - DDR IP Vfn
description:
**Date posted** 11/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19696****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/11/2026**

**We Are**
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

**You Are**  
You understand that verification is not about writing tests, it is about building an environment where the right bugs cannot hide, and you have the scars from finding those bugs at 2am to prove it.
  
Leading a team does not mean delegating tasks, it means knowing when to step in, when to let someone struggle productively, and when to rewrite the testbench architecture because the current one will not scale. You have worked with RTL designers who swear their code is clean and architects who change the spec on Thursday, and you have learned to build verification strategies that survive both.
  
Memory protocols like DDR or LPDDR do not intimidate you. Serial interfaces, complex checkers, SystemVerilog assertions that actually mean something, these are tools you reach for without thinking. You care about functional coverage because it tells you what you have not tested yet, not because it is a metric someone asked for. At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that powers real products, with a team that takes verification as seriously as you do.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  

* Lead a team of verification engineers through full IP verification cycles, from test plan definition through coverage closure and signoff
* Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations
* Define test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions, then review and guide implementation across the team
* Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
* Extract, analyze, and drive functional coverage and code coverage metrics to closure, identifying gaps and adjusting strategy in real time
* Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and catch issues early
* Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to keep verification cycles efficient and reliable

  
**The Impact You Will Have**  

* Deliver verification signoff on IP cores that ship in millions of devices, ensuring they work correctly the first time in silicon
* Raise the bar for verification quality across the DesignWare team by mentoring engineers and evolving testbench architecture and methodology
* Catch critical bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months of schedule and customer trust
* Influence IP architecture decisions by surfacing verification insights early, when design changes are still cheap
* Help shape how the team adopts AI-assisted verification flows, improving efficiency without sacrificing rigor
* Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in IP by ensuring that what we deliver is not just feature-complete but robustly verified
* Build verification environments and strategies that other teams will reuse and learn from, multiplying your impact across the organization

**What You'll Need**  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 6+ years of hands-on verification experience
* Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
* Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow
* Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs
* Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage, and using those metrics to drive verification closure
* Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

  
**Who You Are**  

* You can explain a coverage hole to an architect in two sentences and walk out with a plan to close it
* You debug by hypothesis, not by adding print statements until something makes sense
* When a testbench is too slow or too brittle, you refactor it instead of working around it
* You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes the code pass
* You work across time zones and teams without losing context or creating confusion downstream
* You know when to push back on a design decision and when to adjust the verification plan to match reality

  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**  
You will join Synopsys' DesignWare IP Verification R&D team in Bangalore, working with a global group of experienced verification engineers who are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of IP cores that power semiconductors across the industry. This team collaborates closely with RTL designers, architects, and infrastructure engineers to deliver robust, production-ready IP.
  
  
**Rewards and Benefits**  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

**Department:** Professional Services

**Level: IC –** Mid-Level

**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-Time

**Reports To:** Program Manager, Supplier Onboarding

  

**About Cleo**

Cleo is the AI-native supply chain orchestration company built on modern EDI. We help businesses orchestrate EDI, API, MFT, applications, and trading partner ecosystems with the visibility, intelligence, and control needed to keep business-critical supply chain transactions moving — from order to cash, procure to pay, and everywhere in between. Our platform, Cleo Integration Cloud, brings together integration, workflow automation, real-time monitoring, and Agentic AI intelligence so supply chain, operations, and IT teams can launch partners faster, automate transactions across business systems, resolve exceptions before they become disruptions, and gain actionable insight across the end-to-end supply chain. Trusted by 5,000+ customers across manufacturing, retail, logistics, and distribution, Cleo is headquartered in Rockford, Illinois, with offices in Chicago and Bangalore. We are a team united by one mission: to make supply chains smarter. Cleo Never Stops.

  

**The Opportunity**

As a PS Onboarding Specialist, you drive trading partners (suppliers) from first outreach to production-ready EDI connectivity for customer-sponsored onboarding programs. You are the day to-day contact for suppliers, keeping them moving through registration, testing, and go-live. Your work helps the program hit its connect-by and go-live dates.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Supplier outreach:** Execute multi-touch communication campaigns (email and phone) using the program's approved templates and tone, and track responses and escalations.
* **Registration and enablement:** Guide suppliers through testing portal or WebEDI registration, and answer questions about requirements, timelines, and process.
* **Emails, training, and onboarding:** Address inbound emails from suppliers on inquiries on the programs and products. Assist with the training, setup, and onboarding of suppliers to ensure a smooth onboarding for go-live.
* **Pipeline management:** Maintain accurate supplier status in the Supplier Onboarding Command Center and CRM. Flag at-risk suppliers early and report progress against deadlines.
* **Reporting:** Produce weekly status updates on registrations, testing pass rates, and go-live readiness for the Program Manager and customer stakeholders.
* **Escalation calls:** Run escalation calls with the customer on a weekly basis.
* **Collateral collection:** Assist in collecting the collateral needed to create the onboarding page and supplier communications.
* **Process improvement:** Identify recurring supplier roadblocks. Recommend template, FAQ, and workflow updates that reduce touches per supplier.
* **Collaboration:** Work with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Engineers, Support, and Marketing to keep messaging consistent and issues resolved quickly.

  

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 2+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or supplier/vendor management
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical requirements to non-technical audiences
* Highly organized, with a track record of managing large volumes of concurrent contacts against deadlines
* Proficiency with CRM tools, Excel/spreadsheets, and email-based workflow tracking
* Comfort adjusting tone for different audiences, from supportive to deadline-driven

  

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of EDI concepts (X12, trading partner setup, acknowledgments) or B2B integration
* Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Slack/Teams, or similar tools
* Experience in a supply chain, retail, food, or manufacturing environment
* Understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or direct procurement, supplier onboarding, and the related business processes

  

**Working Conditions**

Remote with high email and phone volume. Customers are high volume and require extra attention in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Occasional extended hours may be required.

  

**Behavior Competencies**

**Initiative & Innovation-** Ability to be proactive and develop new ideas

**Level 2: Initiative -**Takes initiatives within their area of responsibility to accelerate finding solutions. Detects problems, escalates with proposed solutions.

  

**Leadership & Management -**Ability to work within or lead a team

**Level 1: Team Oriented -**Actively cooperates with team members, shares knowledge proactively, and seeks advice when needed.

  

**Planning & Organization-** Ability to manage tasks and activities

**Level 2: Scheduling-** Determines a course of action by breaking it into smaller steps, planning and resourcing each, and adjusting for potential problems.

  

**Customer Focus-** Ability to manage relationships with customers

**Level 2: Customer Oriented-** Understands the needs of external customers and keeps them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

  

**Interpersonal Communication-** Ability to communicate effectively with people

**Level 2: Active Listening & Empathy-** Listens to others' points of view through verbal and non-verbal communication. Formulates own views while understanding others'.

  

**Achievement Focus-** Ability to achieve objectives

**Level 2: Persistence-** Meets targets and fulfills agreements even when adverse circumstances prevail. Stays focused and resourceful under pressure.

  

**Solution Finding-** Ability to analyze situations and find accurate solutions

**Level 2: Information Acquisition-** Identifies gaps in available information and provides solutions for fixing them. Takes new information into account and modifies understanding accordingly.

  

**People Focus-** Ability to account for the human factor

**Level 2: Efficiency of Staff-** Manages own stress and avoids impacting team members. Anticipates and manages potential conflicts. Champions diversity through a positive approach.

  

**AI Fluency**

Uses AI to accelerate project delivery — drafting implementation plans, summarizing customer requirements, and generating documentation faster. Can point to specific examples where AI improved turnaround time or output quality on a customer engagement.

Role-specific expectations for PS Onboarding Specialists:

* Uses AI to draft and tailor supplier outreach (email and call scripts) within the program's approved templates and tone, and to summarize long supplier email threads before follow-up.
* Uses AI to speed up weekly status reporting (registrations, testing pass rates, go-live readiness), spot at-risk suppliers earlier, and prepare for customer escalation calls.
* Uses AI to analyze recurring supplier roadblocks and propose updates to templates, FAQs, and workflows that reduce touches per supplier. •
* Reviews every AI output for accuracy and tone before it goes to a supplier or customer, and never enters confidential supplier or customer data into tools not approved under Cleo's AI Acceptable Use Policy.

  

**Why Cleo**

**Join. Grow. Lead the Future of Supply Chain.**

At Cleo we don't just manage supply chains — we orchestrate them. You'll be empowered to drive transformation, deliver excellence, and shape the future of global operations. Whether you're joining us from outside or growing within, this is your platform to lead with purpose, innovate with impact, and thrive in a culture that champions your growth.

**ABOUT DYSRUPIT**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
We are seeking a Databricks Genie AI Engineer to build the data foundation behind natural language analytics. This role enables business users to ask questions in plain language and receive trusted, governed insights through AI-enabled tools such as Databricks Genie. The ideal candidate combines strong Databricks, SQL, and semantic modelling expertise with practical knowledge of LLMs and evaluation frameworks. You will work closely with data engineers,  
platform teams, and business stakeholders to continuously improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated answers.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and maintain the semantic layer used by Databricks Genie, including table and column descriptions, synonyms, certified assets, sample questions, and metric definitions.
* Build, configure, and tune Genie Spaces to improve answer accuracy and relevance.
* Define metric views and business logic so that natural-language questions map to governed KPIs.
* Develop evaluation frameworks and regression tests to measure query accuracy and SQL quality.
* Diagnose failure modes such as ambiguous questions, incorrect joins, and misinterpreted metrics, and resolve them through schema, metadata, or instruction changes.
* Collaborate with data engineers to improve upstream data quality and data modelling.
* Support deployment, versioning, and monitoring of semantic assets in partnership with DevOps and platform teams.
* Translate business feedback into concrete changes to data models, prompts, or configuration.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Hands-on Databricks experience, including Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Genie.
* Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python and/or Scala.
* Experience with semantic modelling, metric layers, or business-friendly data abstractions.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling.
* Experience building testing and validation frameworks for analytics or AI systems.
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or retrieval  
  augmented generation (RAG).
* Experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

  

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Experience with semantic modelling tools such as dbt, LookML, or Databricks Metric Views.
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, and their integration with  
  Databricks SQL.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Government-mandated benefits plus supplemental Health Insurance
* Collaborative and professional work environment
* Career growth opportunities within a growing organization
* Remote work arrangement

**Job Description**

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research.

**How will you make an impact**

We are seeking a Python Engineer with 4–6 years of software development experience to build and maintain Python services and system automation supporting IoT and edge devices. You will implement defined features, support device setup and deployment, and troubleshoot application and connectivity issues. Working with senior engineers, you will develop practical systems knowledge and contribute to reliable software used with scientific instruments.

**What will you do**

* Develop and maintain Python modules, APIs and utilities for file processing, configuration, process execution and device communication within an established architecture.
* Configure and onboard IoT gateways or edge devices using existing tools and procedures; maintain device inventory, software versions and configuration records.
* Integrate with existing device APIs or SDKs to read telemetry, check status and exchange commands using documented interfaces.
* Support installation, container deployment and approved software updates on Linux devices; perform validation checks and follow documented recovery procedures.
* Implement input validation, error handling, logging and basic retry behaviour; handle disconnected devices and report failures clearly.
* Investigate Python errors, service failures and connectivity issues using logs and basic Linux/network tools; resolve assigned defects and escalate complex issues with useful diagnostics.
* Write unit and integration tests using pytest or unittest, mock external dependencies, and run checks through existing CI/CD pipelines.
* Follow secure coding and credential-handling practices, participate in code reviews and Agile delivery, and maintain setup guides and troubleshooting notes.

**Required Skills**

* 4–6 years of software development experience with hands-on Python coding, including functions, classes, modules, collections, exception handling and file operations.
* Experience developing or maintaining Python APIs, services or automation scripts, with working knowledge of JSON, configuration files and reusable code.
* Working Linux knowledge covering command-line tools, processes, services, permissions and logs; ability to perform basic system troubleshooting.
* Practical exposure to setting up, integrating, testing or supporting IoT devices, gateways or edge systems; willingness to work hands-on with lab hardware.
* Basic understanding of IP addressing, ports, HTTP/REST and device connectivity; familiarity with MQTT or a comparable messaging protocol.
* Experience with Git, unit testing, debugging and documenting changes; ability to deliver assigned tasks independently and seek guidance on unfamiliar system-level issues.

**Desirable Skills**

* Exposure to Docker, CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, and Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Familiarity with Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs or similar devices, or experience supporting software updates and remote diagnostics.
* Basic experience with SQL/SQLite, shell scripting, Windows or PowerShell, or Azure/AWS IoT services.
* Exposure to sensor integration, MQTT, OPC UA or Modbus; awareness of authentication, certificates and safe handling of device credentials.
* Interest in AI-enabled edge applications or experience using AI-assisted development tools, with appropriate review and testing of generated code.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience collaborating with software, hardware or QA teams in an Agile product-development environment.

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.  
What you will do  

* Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,

and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.  

* Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering

leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is  
reproducible and version controlled.  

* Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature

flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us  
how it behaves there.  

* Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established

application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that  
has to be preserved.  

* Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they

live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match  
the existing ones.

* Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and

much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.  

* Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis

through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.  
What we are looking for  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the  
tools from day one.  
Where you need depth  

* Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe

and defend.  

* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error

handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.  

* Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a

language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.  

* Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers  
to be shipped.  
Where working knowledge is enough  

* Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
* Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and

containers.  

* Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production

monitoring and alerting.  
Across everything  

* Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
* Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,

and careful, staged rollout.  

* Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is

written.  

* Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work

with your counterparts rather than around them.  
Nice to have

* Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,

wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the  
domain to the right engineer.  

* Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
* AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
* Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

description:
