**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Summary**

Caterpillar is seeking an Engineering Team Leader to help build the data foundation for its connected products.

Caterpillar equipment generates large volumes of operational, engineering, diagnostic, and telematics data. Turning that data into trusted, understandable, reusable information requires more than collecting it. Data must have consistent definitions, appropriate context, clear ownership, measurable quality, discoverability, and controls governing how it is created and used.

The Engineering Team Leader - Data Governance will provide technical and project leadership for initiatives that improve the quality, governance, metadata, standardization, and usability of connected-product data.

This role will work across engineering, connectivity, digital products, data platforms, analytics, and AI teams to make Caterpillar data easier for both people and intelligent systems to discover, understand, and use appropriately.

### **What You Will Do**

### **Data Governance Leadership**

* Lead initiatives that establish consistent definitions, ownership, standards, and governance for connected-product data.
* Define and improve processes for data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, retention, and lifecycle management.
* Help establish authoritative definitions and common data models across engineering and digital systems.
* Define measurable data-quality expectations and drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues.
* Ensure business and engineering context is captured alongside technical data definitions.

### **Connected Equipment Data**

* Work with teams responsible for telematics, equipment configuration, asset characterization, and other sources of connected-product data.
* Improve consistency between data generated by machines and the information consumed by engineering, analytics, condition monitoring, digital products, and AI.
* Coordinate improvements to data configuration, validation, and deployment processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data-governance and data-quality activities.

### **Data Products and Discoverability**

* Help transform important datasets into clearly defined, reusable data products with known ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and interfaces.
* Improve metadata and cataloging so users can determine what information exists, what it means, where it originated, and how it should be used.
* Partner with enterprise data-platform and governance teams to connect engineering data with Caterpillar-wide data standards and tooling.
* Help establish data structures and governance practices that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI applications.

### **Project and Technical Leadership**

* Lead complex cross-functional data initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
* Develop project scope, priorities, roadmaps, milestones, and success measures.
* Coordinate engineers, data specialists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Identify dependencies, technical risks, and organizational barriers and drive them to resolution.
* Communicate project status, technical decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Mentor team members and strengthen data-governance and data-engineering capabilities across the organization.

### **What You Have**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or another related technical discipline.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, master/reference data, data catalogs, or data product management.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected products, industrial data, or engineering data.
* Experience with enterprise data catalogs such as Alation or comparable metadata/catalog platforms.
* Experience with data pipelines, APIs, SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, or modern data engineering.
* Experience with AI/ML data requirements and governance of data used by Generative AI and agentic systems.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and data teams.

### **Why This Role Matters**

AI and analytics are only as reliable as the data and context available to them.

This role will help create the standards, metadata, quality controls, and reusable data structures that allow Caterpillar's connected-product data to become a dependable foundation for engineering, digital products, analytics, and AI.

You will own the end-to-end build of our data engineering capability. This includes driving visibility and lineage, automated quality controls, FinOps governance, performance SLAs/SLOs, and regulatory compliance across crucial information domains. Working as part of a varied community of specialists, you will connect strategy to execution, partnering across business technology groups to standardize how data is acquired, transformed, orchestrated, and delivered for impact. Can you turn a long-term architecture into reusable accelerators that dozens of teams embrace and love?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy aligned to our 2030 Data Strategy; translate vision into a capability model, adoption roadmap, service tiers, and maturity milestones that build measurable business value.
* Build and lead a focused, high-performing team of specialists; set direction on technology perfection across acquisition, storage, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, CI/CD, and containerization using Snowflake, Fivetran, Dbt, DataOps.live, and SnowPark Container Services. Govern the standardization of end-to-end data engineering solutions aligned with enterprise architecture; establish enterprise practice as a foundational pillar of data management.
* Champion automation across the lifecycle—impact analysis, design, build, test, deploy—leveraging AI code generation (for example, Snowflake Cortex Code and GitHub Copilot) to increase velocity and quality while reducing defects and time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
* Embed governance-as-code and preventative controls; design pipelines and patterns that achieve close to zero cost leakage on cloud infrastructure, and uplift performance metrics including latency, reliability, and quality through clear SLAs/SLOs.
* Operate and scale a federated service across business technology groups; enable alignment, capability uplift, and reuse via onboarding kits, templates, and self-service accelerators.
* Partner with leaders across data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise/domain/solution architecture; liaise with procurement, finance, legal, quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor partners to ensure compliant, secure, and value-driven delivery.
* Drive adoption through education, enablement, and community practices; measure success through standardization, automation readiness, turnaround time to business value, capability maturity, and adoption velocity.
* Proactively raise, handle, and mitigate risks; ensure alignment to regulatory requirements (including privacy, GxP, SOx, and HIPAA as applicable) without slowing delivery.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Preferably 15+ years in data engineering leadership roles at an enterprise capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience in data engineering capability involving data acquisition, data storage, data ingestion, data transformation, data orchestration, CI/CD, containerization.
* Extensive practical experience engaging with Open table standards (for ex, Iceberg) and Open technical catalogs (for ex, Snowflake Horizon).
* Extensive practical experience handling Structured, Semi-Structured and Unstructured data assets and engineering.
* Mandatory (Must Have) Skills – Snowflake, Fivetran DBT, DataOps.live, SnowPark Container technology, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon, Snowflake Cortex software (CoCo), AWS S3.
* Optional (Nice to Have) Skills – Databricks, Snaplogic, Apache Polaris, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, AWS Redshift, Docker, Kubernetes, MWAA, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Expertise with modern data architectures, cloud data platforms and data engineering lifecycle implementation and practices.
* Solid understanding of metadata, lineage, security classification, FinOps, and SLA/SLO frameworks.
* Confirmed leadership in large-scale, federated, global technology environments.
* Ability to influence, educate, and lead change across technical & business teams.
* Background in regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare) with Data Privacy, HIPAA, GxP & SOx.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Track record establishing new capabilities from scratch and scaling globally.
* Experience defining enterprise service tiers, maturity models, and adoption programs.
* Proven leadership developing talent and hard-working technical teams.
* Strong collaborator management and collaboration across matrixed environments.
* A forward-thinking approach combined with a commitment to taking initiative and delivering tangible outcomes.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. title: Financial Analyst - 1
description:
**Role Highlights:**

* Position: Financial Analyst – I
* Location: Bangalore
* Work Mode: Work from office
* Experience: Fresher or up to 1 year of relevant experience
* Education: B.Com / BBA / MBA / M.Com

**Job Description**

**As a Financial Analyst I, you will:**

* Understand the client's business, procurement processes, financial processes, systems, and data to identify potential areas of financial leakage and recovery.
* Analyze large volumes of financial and transactional data to identify unusual patterns, exceptions, discrepancies, and potential recovery opportunities.
* Apply inquisitive thinking by asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, investigating exceptions, and understanding why a particular transaction or variance occurred.
* Identify and validate opportunities such as duplicate payments, overpayments, missed credits, pricing discrepancies, discounts, rebates, vendor funding, contract compliance issues, and other financial leakages.
* Reconcile vendor statements with client Accounts Payable data to identify missing credits, unprocessed invoices, unapplied balances, and other discrepancies.
* Review agreements, invoices, purchase orders, emails, statements, and other supporting documents to validate findings and identify additional opportunities.
* Connect information across different data sources and supporting documents to identify opportunities that may not be visible from standard reports alone.
* Develop a strong understanding of each client's business and use that understanding to identify new audit opportunities and deliver measurable financial value.
* Use internal audit tools, client systems, Excel, SQL, and other analytical tools to investigate and validate findings.
* Clearly document findings, supporting evidence, calculations, and the rationale behind identified opportunities.
* Work closely with senior analysts and audit managers during new client engagements, data discovery, opportunity identification, and claim validation.
* Contribute ideas for improving audit methods, identifying new opportunities, and strengthening existing audit procedures.
* Participate actively in knowledge sharing sessions and continuously build knowledge across clients, industries, financial processes, and audit areas.

**Must have skills**

* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial and transactional data.
* An inquisitive mindset with the willingness to ask questions, investigate unusual transactions, and understand the reason behind a variance or exception.
* Ability to understand a client's business processes and connect business understanding with financial data.
* Good understanding of Accounts Payable, Procure to Pay processes, and basic accounting principles.
* Strong attention to detail while also being able to identify patterns and relationships across large volumes of data.
* Ability to work with unfamiliar data and business processes and learn quickly when working with new clients.
* Ability to communicate findings and explain the rationale behind an identified opportunity clearly.
* Ownership mindset with the ability to independently investigate an issue before reaching a conclusion.

**Good to have skills**

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Basic knowledge of SQL or other data analysis tools.
* Exposure to Accounts Payable, procurement, finance, audit, reconciliation, or financial analysis.
* Understanding of invoices, purchase orders, vendor statements, contracts, payment terms, credits, discounts, and rebates.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within agreed timelines.

**Experience**

* 0 to 1 years of relevant experience.
* Fresh graduates with strong analytical aptitude, curiosity, and an interest in financial analysis, data analysis, audit, or procurement are encouraged to apply.

title: WRB Product Accounting - Senior Manager
description:
Requisition Number: 59751

Job Location: Bangalore, IND

Global Grade: Band 6

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role is responsible for leading product accounting, reporting and financial control activities across Wealth and Retail Banking products. The role focuses on ensuring accurate revenue recognition, robust P&L accounting, completeness of product financials, timely variance analysis and high-quality business commentary. It requires strong commercial acumen across wealth, retail banking and related capital markets products, together with a disciplined risk and governance mindset to strengthen financial control, reporting integrity and stakeholder confidence.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Drive the WRB Product Accounting agenda for Wealth and Retail Banking products, ensuring accurate revenue recognition, P&L accounting and product financial reporting.
  
• Identify and address risks to P&L accuracy, product accounting outcomes, balance sheet substantiation and external reporting disclosures.
  
• Strengthen governance, control and reporting frameworks through standardised processes, disciplined review routines and clear accountability.
  
• Review product financials, variances and key drivers to provide commercially meaningful commentary for senior management and stakeholders.
  
• Promote continuous improvement in product accounting processes, controls and analytics to support scalable, accurate and decision-useful reporting.
  
**Business**  
• Build strong commercial understanding of WRB business models, product economics, customer propositions, market drivers and risk characteristics.
  
• Partner with Business Finance, Product teams, Country Finance and GCFO India Controllers to translate product performance, revenue trends and P&L movements into clear senior-management commentary.
  
• Support revenue recognition accuracy by understanding product features, fee structures, amortisation, valuation drivers, accounting treatment and relevant IFRS requirements.
  
• Use analytics and product knowledge to identify unusual revenue, cost, margin or balance sheet trends and ensure timely investigation and remediation.

**Processes**  
• Partner with Business Finance, Product, Country Finance and GCFO India Controllers to deliver accurate WRB product accounting, reporting and financial control outcomes.
  
• Run month-end and quarter-end reviews covering P&L accuracy, revenue recognition, product financials, balance sheet substantiation and variance commentary.
  
• Ensure reconciliations, substantiation, journals, adjustments and key reporting controls are completed on time, with exceptions escalated and remediated promptly.
  
• Embed Group policies, financial control standards, ACG requirements and governance expectations into day-to-day processes.
  
• Support risk reporting, process simplification, automation, transformation and new product/change reviews to strengthen control sustainability and reporting efficiency.

**People & Talent**  
• Lead by example and promote a culture of ownership, accuracy, transparency and timely escalation across product accounting and financial control activities.
  
• Build capability in WRB product accounting, revenue recognition, commercial analysis, risk management and governance through coaching, knowledge sharing and structured development.
  
• Set clear expectations for quality of review, business commentary, control evidence and stakeholder engagement, and provide timely feedback aligned to role objectives.

**Risk Management**  
• Interpret WRB product financial information to identify accounting, reporting, revenue recognition, valuation, operational and control risks. Ensure that appropriate controls, reconciliations, substantiation, escalation mechanisms and remediation actions are in place to protect P&L accuracy, reporting integrity and compliance with Group standards.

**Governance**  
• Ensure appropriate governance is followed across product accounting, reporting, transformation and change initiatives. Represent WRB Product Accounting in relevant governance forums, support prioritisation of control and reporting enhancements, and ensure changes to products, systems, processes or operating models are assessed for accounting, revenue recognition, P&L, risk and control impacts.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**  
• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  
• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  
• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**  
• WRB Business Finance and Product teams
  
• Country Finance and Regional Finance teams
  
• GCFO India Controllers and GFS teams
  
• Risk, Compliance, Operational Risk and Governance forums
  
• External Reporting, Financial Control, Product Control and Audit teams
  
• Technology, Change and Transformation teams supporting WRB reporting and controls

**Other Responsibilities**  
• Embed Here for Good and the Group’s brand and values across WRB Product Accounting. Perform responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures, including support for product governance, accounting policy implementation, financial control remediation, audit readiness, reporting transformation and other activities required to maintain accurate, well-controlled and commercially relevant product financials.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* WRB wealth and retail banking product accounting

• Revenue recognition and P&L accuracy review
  
• Financial control, reconciliations and balance sheet substantiation
  
• Risk and governance framework application
  
• Commercial business acumen and product performance analysis
  
• Stakeholder management and senior management commentary
  
• PSGL, SAP and finance reporting tools

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum 8 years of experience in financial control, product control, product accounting, operational risk.

• Experience in Wealth and Retail Banking product accounting, revenue recognition, P&L review or balance sheet substantiation is preferred.
  
• CA / CWA / CPA / ACCA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  
• Strong understanding of product accounting, IFRS reporting principles, revenue recognition, journal controls, reconciliations and financial control frameworks.
  
• Exposure to SAP and PSGL reporting tools and finance data environments.
  
• Commercial understanding of wealth and retail banking products, including structured products, derivatives, equities, fixed income, managed investments, insurance, cards, mortgages and deposits.
  
• Ability to interpret product financials, identify P&L and balance sheet drivers, investigate variances and communicate business insights clearly.
  
• Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including experience engaging senior management, country teams, product teams, finance, risk and audit stakeholders.
  
• Experience in implementing, monitoring and improving financial control, governance, risk management and audit remediation activities.
  
• Post-graduation / CA / CFA / CPA / ACCA or equivalent, with experience in finance, product accounting, financial control, risk management and reporting.

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. title: Senior Advisor, Data Science
description:
**Senior Advisor, Data Science**

Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte-scale data sets and shape brand new methodologies, tools, statistical methods, and models. What’s more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts, and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data.

**What you’ll achieve:**

As a Senior Advisor, you will lead initiatives in advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making. You will design scalable models, optimize algorithms, and collaborate across teams to deliver actionable insights. We are seeking a skilled data scientist with a proven track record of building and maintaining Machine Learning models to join our Marketing forecasting team.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Advisor** on our **Data Science** team.

**You will:**

  

* Gather and preprocess marketing data from various sources such cloud based/ on-premise databases ensuring data quality and consistency
* Develop and implement AI/ML/time series models to forecast sales demand and trend ensuring timely and accurate delivery of forecast.
* Experience in model orchestration using Airflow
* Work closely with marketing teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights.
* Create visualizations to present data findings in a clear and actionable manner.
* Work with cross-functional teams, including go to market teams, data platform team to implement data-driven solutions

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Strong foundational understanding of regression analysis, including the ability to interpret coefficients meaningfully in both statistical and business contexts, Hands-on experience building marketing mix models, with a strong understanding of marketing performance measurement
* Ability to diagnose and address multicollinearity among correlated marketing variables and understand its impact on model reliability
* Understanding how to model interaction effects to capture how different factors amplify or diminish one another
* Awareness of biases that arise from unobserved factors, such as omitted variable bias, reverse causality, or simultaneity, and familiarity with strategies to mitigate them
* Understanding of good and bad control variables in regression modeling; ability to distinguish between confounders, mediators, colliders, or post-treatment variables. Ability to identify and avoid spurious regression, familiarity with causal inference techniques and proficiency in Python, and SQL

**Desirable Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Experience with machine learning algorithms and their application in marketing and maintaining version control of artifacts (GitHub, GitLab)

description:

5 to 7 years.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design :**

* Process Assessment : Evaluate manual business processes to determine automation feasibility and ROI.
* Documentation : Author Process Design Documents (PDD) and Solution Design Documents (SDD) outlining exact technical workflows.
* Architecture Planning : Define the deployment strategy, identifying required infrastructure, bot licenses, and security protocols.

**Development & Implementation**

* Bot Construction : Develop complex attended, unattended, and hybrid bots using the Automation 360 (A360) platform.
* Cognitive Automation : Train and deploy Document Automation (formerly IQ Bot) models to extract unstructured data from PDFs and scanned documents.
* Human-in-the-Loop : Build Automation Anywhere Robotic Interface (AARI) forms to allow seamless interaction between human workers and digital bots.
* Custom Scripting : Write inline Python, JavaScript, or VBScript code blocks within A360 to handle edge cases that native actions cannot process.

**Testing & Deployment**

* Testing Protocols : Conduct rigorous Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Control Room Management : Package and deploy bots through the Automation Anywhere Control Room across Dev, QA, and Production environments.
* Error Handling : Implement global exception handling frameworks to ensure bots fail safely and alert administrators with detailed logs.

**Maintenance & Optimization**

* Production Support : Monitor live digital workforces, troubleshoot runtime errors, and resolve data-driven bot exceptions.
* Code Optimization : Refactor existing code to reduce execution runtime, optimize memory usage, and lower API consumption.

**Technical Skill Matrix**

* Control Room Administration : Configuring User Vaults, lockers, Device Pools, Workload Queues (WLM), SLA definitions, and scheduling.
* Core Package Utilization : Advanced manipulation of Excel Advanced, Loop, Terminal Emulator, Files/Folders, XML, and Window Actions.
* Recorder Mastery : Fine-tuning Object Cloning, Universal Recorder, and Image Recognition capturing across complex UI frameworks (Java, SAP, Citrix, Silverlight).
* Security & Governance : Implementation of the Credential Vault, secure handling of attributes, OAuth 2.0 integration, and audit trail analysis.
* Document Automation (IQ Bot) : Designing, training, and deploying learning instances; defining extraction fields; continuous training using validator logs.
* AARI (Robotic Interface) : Designing interactive multi-step forms, user steps, and bot steps to embed digital assistants into human desktop workflows.
* Process Discovery : Leveraging Automation Anywhere Discovery Bot to ingest user recordings, analyze process variants, and automatically generate skeleton PDDs.
* Python / JavaScript Integration : Writing clean, inline scripts executed via Python or JavaScript packages to handle complex data manipulation or math arrays.
* VBScript & Macros : Creating and invoking VBScript modules for background legacy Excel manipulation and Windows shell script tasks.
* Regular Expressions (RegEx) : Constructing advanced parsing string expressions to extract specific patterns from unstructured text or email bodies.
* Database Programming : Crafting transactional ANSI-SQL queries, executing stored procedures, handling connection strings, and processing Database Datasets.
* API Consumption : Orchestrating REST and SOAP web services, managing API authentication tokens, and parsing nested JSON or XML payloads.
* Web Elements (DOM) : Deep understanding of HTML structures, XPaths, and CSS Selectors to manually repair broken web element capture paths.
* Exception & Logging Lifecycle : Designing global multi-tier error catching modules (Try-Catch-Finally) paired with automated screenshot captures and log ingestion.
* Version Control & CI/CD : Operating Control Room Git integrations, checking code in/out, handling package dependency versions, and staging code across Dev/QA/Prod.

CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Job Title: Manager Consulting Delivery (QA)
  
  
Position: Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE
  
  
Experience: 14+ Years (minimum 5+ years leading QA/QE teams, with hands-on technical depth)
  
  
Category: Quality Engineering / Test Automation / Delivery Management
  
  
Shift: General Shift, with overlap with US onsite counterparts as required
  
  
Location: Chennai
  
  
Position ID:
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
  
  
Education Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline
  
  
Position Description:
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Manager and People Manager to lead an enthusiastic QA/QE team with strong AI awareness. Our current model is automation-heavy but still involves a lot of manual intervention. The role requires a clear understanding of the team's current technical challenges and the ability to transform it into a modern, AI-first Quality Engineering team through smarter automation and better engineering practices.
  
  
Every Advantage release must go out on time and certified, with zero escaped regression defects and no last-minute surprises. The leader we want thinks like the client and acts like the client, holding quality to the standard the customer experiences in production, and treats customer delight as the measure of success.
  
  
You will own the transformation of the QA/QE function and treat quality as an engineering discipline, building it into the pipeline, the code and the environment rather than testing it in at the end. You will drive disciplined flaky test management, faster pipelines through test sharding, parallel execution and test impact analysis, ephemeral Cloud environments that are spun up on demand and destroyed once testing is done, and a shift-left and shift-right approach in which production monitoring feeds back into test strategy. You will also strengthen performance and regression engineering so that quality improves with every release.
  
  
You will make release and investment decisions from data such as flake rate, pipeline duration, defect leakage and DORA-style delivery metrics. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and the client, translating technical quality signals into business risk and release confidence, and balance speed, quality and cost, including cloud environment spend and automation maintenance effort. You will also bring the team along, building the skills, habits and confidence it needs to work this way.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Delivery and Release Ownership
  
  

* Own on-time, high-quality delivery of Advantage releases with zero regression issues, and be accountable for the quality outcome the customer experiences.
* Think like the client and act like the client: view quality from the customer's business perspective, anticipate what matters to them and make release decisions accordingly.
* Lead release certification end to end from the QA side, owning readiness assessment, quality gates, exit criteria, go/no-go inputs and sign-off. Step into an RTE-style role when required to coordinate across teams and keep releases on track.
* Own QA planning, capacity and delivery commitments across Agile sprints, Program Increments and feature releases, ensuring smooth delivery to UAT and Production and timely resolution of client issues.

Quality Strategy and Governance
  
  

* Own the regression and performance testing strategy and its outcomes, covering scope, coverage, risk-based prioritization and continuous optimization of suites to remove redundancy and improve effectiveness.
* Define quality standards, governance and a metrics-driven improvement framework (defect leakage, regression cycle time, automation reliability, pipeline duration, defect detection effectiveness, cost of quality), and use the data to drive decisions.
* Set the direction for performance engineering, ensuring workload models, benchmarks and bottleneck analysis give early confidence in scalability and stability before release.
* Maintain clear, current documentation in Confluence, including QA strategy, release certification records, runbooks, test environment guides and lessons learned, so knowledge is shared and not held by individuals.

Technical Leadership and Transformation
  
  

* Take ownership of chronic reliability and speed issues such as flaky tests, recurring suite failures and long-running pipelines. Diagnose systemic root causes, set stabilization and optimization priorities, and hold the team accountable for sustained improvement in reliability and execution time.
* Periodically audit the automation tech stack, frameworks and tooling, assess fitness, maintainability and cost, and set the direction to upgrade or transform when it is justified. Make these decisions based on value, not change for its own sake.
* Lead the transformation of test environments from PDC to Cloud (Azure/AWS), enabling on-demand environments that are spun up for testing and destroyed once done, in partnership with DevOps and with cost optimization in mind.
* Champion AI-driven Quality Engineering across test design, automation, failure triage and maintenance, with measurable productivity and cycle-time gains.
* Drive continuous testing and quality gates in CI/CD, working with DevOps to make releases faster and more predictable.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and practices and bringing in those that improve outcomes.

Stakeholder and People Leadership

title: Director, AI and Data Analytics, Internal Audit
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
**Director, AI and Data Analytics, Internal Audit**
in
**Chennai, India.**
ARMS is undergoing a strategic transformation into an AI-native, data- and intelligence-driven function. We are looking for a Director to lead this transformation by spearheading the department's AI implementation strategy and overseeing all data science, reporting, and dashboarding efforts. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, build and mentor a high-performing team, and partner closely with audit leadership across regions to embed AI and analytics into everyday audit practice.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency in AI/ML and data engineering with the leadership maturity to manage a mixed team of managers and technical specialists, and the communication skills and executive presence to influence senior stakeholders in a global organization.
  
  
**What a typical day looks like:**
**AI Strategy & Implementation**

* Own and drive the roadmap for AI adoption across Internal Audit, identifying use cases where AI can improve audit coverage, efficiency, and risk detection.
* Lead the design, build, and deployment of AI/ML solutions (e.g., anomaly detection, natural language processing for control testing, Agentic AI implementation and optimization, generative AI for audit documentation) to meet Audit objectives and Fraud Analytics plan.
* Evaluate and pilot emerging AI tools and vendor platforms; make build-vs-buy recommendations, coordinate with various internal teams and vendor to onboard solutions
* Establish governance, risk, and quality standards for AI models used within audit (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring, usage standardization).

**Data Science, Reporting & Dashboarding**

* Lead all data science initiatives supporting annual audit planning for the department, individual audit planning, execution, and reporting.
* Own the strategy and roadmap for enterprise audit dashboards and reporting tools used by audit leadership and the broader team.
* Develop and deploy a Data-Analytics Self-service platform to ‘shift-right’ and democratize the technology usage within the team.
* Ensure data pipelines, models, and reporting infrastructure are scalable, well-documented, and maintainable.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

**Team Leadership**

* Inspire, lead and develop a highly motivated and high performing team of 4–5 resources, including 2 managers and technical individual contributors (software developers, AI engineers, data scientists/analysts).
* Set team priorities, allocate resources across competing initiatives, and manage delivery quality and timelines.
* Coach managers on individual development and growth, team development, technical direction, and stakeholder management.
* Build a strong engineering/data science culture within an audit function — balancing innovation speed with the rigor and controls expected in audit.

**Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for AI, data science, and reporting initiatives with Senior Directors across regional audit teams.
* Work with stakeholders and audit teams from Asia, India, EMEA and North/South America
* Encourage usage of shared tools, data sources, and methodologies.
* Present strategy, progress, and results to senior audit leadership and other executive stakeholders.

**AI Fluency & Enablement**

* Design and lead an AI fluency/upskilling program for the broader Internal Audit team, ensuring auditors across all levels understand how to use and interpret AI-driven tools responsibly.
* Develop training materials, workshops, and office hours to build a data- and AI-literate audit culture.
* Act as an internal evangelist and change agent for the department's broader data and intelligence transformation.

**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Finance or Operations.
* 10+ years of experience in data science, AI/ML, or advanced analytics, including 5+ years in a people leadership role managing technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading AI/ML projects from concept to production.
* Track record in data engineering, reporting/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, MSTR, Tableau, SnowFlake), and modern data science stacks (Python, SQL, ML frameworks).
* Experience managing a team with mixed skill sets (management + individual technical contributors).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical, senior stakeholders.
* Experience in Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, or a related governance function.
* Experience in manufacturing domain
* Familiarity with fraud analytics, IT audit, or regulatory/controls environments.
* Experience building AI governance frameworks (model risk, explainability, responsible AI).
* Track record of designing enablement/training programs to build data or AI fluency across a broader organization.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and teams.

**What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Health Insurance
* PTO

Position Title
**Voyage Performance Analyst**

Location - Chennai (Work from Office)

Role Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented
**Voyage Performance Analyst**
with a strong marine background to support vessel voyage monitoring, performance analysis, and operational optimization. The role involves analyzing vessel performance data, monitoring KPIs, managing voyage efficiency initiatives, and providing fact-based recommendations to improve operational and fuel performance across the fleet.

The ideal candidate will have sailing experience as a
**2nd Officer or 3rd Officer**
on commercial vessels and possess a passion for data analytics, vessel optimization, and emerging technologies.

Voyage Performance Monitoring & Analysis

* Monitor vessel voyage performance and operational efficiency through daily and monthly performance reviews.
* Analyze voyage data, fuel consumption trends, weather impacts, speed-performance relationships, and operational KPIs.
* Provide fact-based recommendations to optimize vessel performance, fuel efficiency, and voyage execution.
* Support vessel voyage management by identifying performance deviations and recommending corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain vessel performance reports, dashboards, and analytical insights for internal stakeholders.

Reporting & KPI Management

* Prepare and distribute monthly performance reports and fleet performance summaries.
* Track and report key operational and performance indicators (KPIs).
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting across vessels and fleets.
* Support benchmarking activities and monitor fleet performance against predefined targets.

Project Management & Operational Support

* Execute performance improvement and optimization projects efficiently.
* Participate in new initiatives related to vessel performance, digitalization, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate willingness to take ownership of assigned projects and adapt to new challenges.
* Contribute to daily departmental activities and support service delivery requirements.

Stakeholder Management

* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal teams, vessel crews, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Act as a key point of contact for vessel performance, fuel consumption analysis, and voyage optimization discussions.
* Support customers and operational teams with data-driven insights and reporting requirements.

Technology & Innovation

* Utilize performance monitoring systems, analytical tools, and reporting platforms to drive operational improvements.
* Support data capture, validation, modeling, and visualization activities.
* Stay updated on advancements in maritime digitalization, AI, machine learning, and vessel optimization technologies.

Required Qualifications

Education & Certifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Nautical Science, Maritime Studies, Marine Transportation, or related discipline.
* Valid
  **Second Mate (FG) Certificate of Competency**
  preferred.

Experience

* Minimum
  **3+ years of sailing experience**
  onboard commercial vessels.
* Sailing experience as
  **2nd Officer or 3rd Officer**
  .
* Recent rank experience as a
  **Navigating Officer**
  onboard.
* Experience in vessel performance monitoring, voyage management, or marine operations is preferred.

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of vessel operations, voyage execution, navigation, and fuel management.
* Knowledge of vessel performance monitoring and optimization practices.
* Experience in data collection, validation, reporting, and performance analysis.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with maritime performance systems and voyage optimization platforms is advantageous.
* Experience with data modeling and performance reporting.
* Exposure to AI/ML applications in maritime operations is a significant advantage.

description:
**Purpose of the role**
To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.

title: Lead, Liquidity Reporting
description:
**Job Summary**
This role exists to ensure the accurate, complete and timely preparation, review and submission of financial and regulatory reporting obligations. The role translates financial, accounting and regulatory data into controlled reporting outputs that support regulatory compliance, financial transparency and effective governance across the Bank.
  
  
The role is accountable for validating financial data, identifying reporting issues, maintaining reporting controls, supporting regulatory submissions and improving reporting procedures and systems. It ensures that reporting outputs are produced in line with applicable accounting standards, regulatory requirements, internal policies and documented operating procedures.
  
  
Working across Finance, Risk, Treasury, Data, Technology, Business and other control functions, the role supports coordinated reporting delivery and helps management respond to regulatory changes, audit observations, reporting quality issues and process improvement opportunities. It supports reporting compliance and control execution but does not own enterprise regulatory policy, accounting standard-setting or final regulatory interpretation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial and Regulatory Reporting Delivery**

* Prepare financial and regulatory reports that meet defined standards for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and regulatory compliance.
* Submit regulatory reporting outputs in accordance with applicable reporting calendars, submission requirements and internal governance standards.
* Analyse financial data, balances, movements and reporting drivers to support clear, controlled and explainable reporting outcomes.
* Maintain reporting documentation, working papers and evidence that support auditability, regulatory review and management oversight.

**Data Quality, Validation and Error Resolution**

* Validate source data, financial inputs and report outputs to identify errors, inconsistencies, omissions or unexplained variances.
* Perform data analysis and profiling to support reporting accuracy, completeness and root cause identification.
* Investigate reporting breaks, reconciliation differences and data quality issues to support timely correction and sustainable remediation.
* Escalate material reporting issues, recurring errors or control weaknesses through appropriate governance and risk channels.

**Controls, Governance and Risk Management**

* Maintain internal controls across reporting processes to support reliable production, review and submission of financial and regulatory reports.
* Perform risk assessments on reporting processes, controls and data dependencies to identify areas requiring management attention.
* Support audit, assurance and control reviews by providing reporting evidence, process explanations and remediation updates.
* Apply financial reporting, regulatory and compliance requirements consistently within day-to-day reporting activities.

**Regulatory Awareness and Procedure Management**

* Monitor regulatory, accounting and reporting changes that may affect financial or regulatory reporting requirements.
* Update reporting procedures, control documentation and process guidance to reflect agreed regulatory, policy or system changes.
* Provide practical guidance to stakeholders on reporting requirements, data expectations and control obligations.
* Support implementation of regulatory change into BAU reporting processes in line with governance and control standards.

**Reporting Systems and Process Improvement**

* Review reporting processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, transparency and control effectiveness.
* Implement improvements to reporting systems, procedures and workflows that reduce manual effort, rework and reporting risk.
* Use reporting systems, dashboards and analytical tools to strengthen data validation, monitoring and reporting insight.
* Support technology, automation and process change initiatives that enhance reporting quality and operational resilience.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Data, Technology, Business and control teams to obtain information required for reporting delivery.
* Engage stakeholders to resolve reporting issues, explain data movements and align on submission requirements.
* Provide clear reporting updates, issue summaries and recommendations to support decision-making and governance forums.
* Build effective working relationships that improve reporting coordination, issue resolution and process accountability.

**People Leadership**

* Team leadership: Set direction for the team, role‑modelling inclusive leadership and high standards of client focus, risk discipline and collaboration.
* Performance and conduct: Set clear expectations, remove obstacles to delivery, provide regular and constructive feedback, and reinforce expected conduct and standards.
* Coaching and development: Uplift the capability of the team by developing the skills, judgement, and experience required to perform effectively and progress in their careers over time.
* Thought Leadership and Market Positioning: Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients to strengthen strategic engagement and reinforce the Bank's market position. Partner with Industry, Product and Advisory teams to develop thought leadership content and client engagement initiatives.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Financial Accounting
* Financial Performance Analysis
* Regulatory Compliance
* Regulatory Reporting
* Risk Management

**Other Skills**

* Compliance Advisory
* Continuous Improvement
* Decision Making
* Issue Management
* Quality Orientation
* Regulatory Writing
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Talent Development

**Motivations**

* Working in a controlled finance environment where accuracy, evidence and timeliness directly support regulatory compliance.
* Translating complex financial and regulatory data into clear, reliable reporting outputs.
* Solving reporting issues through data analysis, reconciliation, stakeholder engagement and process discipline.

**Qualifications**

* Experience supporting HR, talent management, learning, workforce planning or related people processes
* Experience coordinating activities, tracking actions and preparing materials for meetings, reviews or governance forums
* Experience working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards or reporting outputs to support analysis and decision-making
* Demonstrated ability to organise information clearly, manage deadlines and maintain accurate documentation
* Ability to work collaboratively with HR and business stakeholders in a matrixed environment
* Strong written communication, attention to detail and willingness to learn talent management practices
* Business English (required)

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog & Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment
* Data Catalog & Governance Platform Management
* Catalog Administration & Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata & Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies
* Domain Data Governance & Stewardship Enablement
* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Analyst - Customer Service
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Review, enter, validate, and maintain customer sales orders, change orders, returns, cancellations, and delivery schedules in the ERP system.
* Confirm product, quantity, pricing, customer master, ship-to, requested date, incoterms, payment terms, and other order requirements before release.
* Coordinate order acknowledgements, available-to-promise checks, backorders, allocations, expedites, delivery blocks, credit holds, and exception resolution.
* Monitor orders from booking through shipment and invoicing, proactively communicating risks, revised dates, and recovery actions to internal stakeholders.
* Investigate order discrepancies, delivery failures, pricing errors, duplicate orders, and invoice issues using structured root-cause analysis.
* Maintain complete order documentation and support audit, compliance, and customer service requirements.
* Create, review, update, and validate Bills of Material for finished goods, subassemblies, kits, service parts, and configurable products.
* Ensure BOM components, quantities, units of measure, effectivity dates, revisions, alternates, substitutes, and make-or-buy indicators are accurate.
* Process Engineering Change Orders and master-data change requests in collaboration with Engineering, Product Management, Planning, and Manufacturing.
* Perform BOM comparisons, where-used analysis, revision audits, and mass-change validation to prevent obsolete, duplicate, or incorrect component usage.
* Validate material masters, item status, product hierarchy, lead times, sourcing attributes, and lifecycle states that influence order fulfillment.
* Identify BOM-related order failures and coordinate corrective action for missing components, invalid configurations, obsolete materials, or revision mismatches.
* Prepare operational reports and dashboards for order backlog, on-time delivery, fill rate, order cycle time, first-time-right rate, BOM accuracy, blocked orders, and aging exceptions.
* Use Excel, Power BI, Qlik, SQL, or ERP extracts to reconcile data, identify trends, and prioritize high-impact exceptions.
* Document standard operating procedures, controls, and data definitions; recommend automation and process improvements that reduce manual touchpoints and errors.
* Participate in user acceptance testing for ERP enhancements, product launches, master-data migrations, and process changes.
* Meet service-level agreements and contribute to team cross-training, knowledge management, and operational reviews.

**Qualifications**
Requires a high school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 1-3 years of related experience is required.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including effective listening skills. Ability to learn and understand technical terminology. Must be able to work in a fast-paced goal-oriented environment. Able to handle multiple tasks, stay organized, and focused on details. Requires limited knowledge of the organization, products, and/or services. Requires ability to navigate a computerized data entry system or other relevant applications.
