* Review, enter, validate, and maintain customer sales orders, change orders, returns, cancellations, and delivery schedules in the ERP system.
* Confirm product, quantity, pricing, customer master, ship-to, requested date, incoterms, payment terms, and other order requirements before release.
* Coordinate order acknowledgements, available-to-promise checks, backorders, allocations, expedites, delivery blocks, credit holds, and exception resolution.
* Monitor orders from booking through shipment and invoicing, proactively communicating risks, revised dates, and recovery actions to internal stakeholders.
* Investigate order discrepancies, delivery failures, pricing errors, duplicate orders, and invoice issues using structured root-cause analysis.
* Maintain complete order documentation and support audit, compliance, and customer service requirements.
* Create, review, update, and validate Bills of Material for finished goods, subassemblies, kits, service parts, and configurable products.
* Ensure BOM components, quantities, units of measure, effectivity dates, revisions, alternates, substitutes, and make-or-buy indicators are accurate.
* Process Engineering Change Orders and master-data change requests in collaboration with Engineering, Product Management, Planning, and Manufacturing.
* Perform BOM comparisons, where-used analysis, revision audits, and mass-change validation to prevent obsolete, duplicate, or incorrect component usage.
* Validate material masters, item status, product hierarchy, lead times, sourcing attributes, and lifecycle states that influence order fulfillment.
* Identify BOM-related order failures and coordinate corrective action for missing components, invalid configurations, obsolete materials, or revision mismatches.
* Prepare operational reports and dashboards for order backlog, on-time delivery, fill rate, order cycle time, first-time-right rate, BOM accuracy, blocked orders, and aging exceptions.
* Use Excel, Power BI, Qlik, SQL, or ERP extracts to reconcile data, identify trends, and prioritize high-impact exceptions.
* Document standard operating procedures, controls, and data definitions; recommend automation and process improvements that reduce manual touchpoints and errors.
* Participate in user acceptance testing for ERP enhancements, product launches, master-data migrations, and process changes.
* Meet service-level agreements and contribute to team cross-training, knowledge management, and operational reviews.

**Qualifications**
Requires a high school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 1-3 years of related experience is required.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including effective listening skills. Ability to learn and understand technical terminology. Must be able to work in a fast-paced goal-oriented environment. Able to handle multiple tasks, stay organized, and focused on details. Requires limited knowledge of the organization, products, and/or services. Requires ability to navigate a computerized data entry system or other relevant applications.

title: Regulatory Data Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Regulatory Data Consultant**
to drive regulatory data governance, standards management, and data quality initiatives across the regulatory landscape.

As a Regulatory Data consultant, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, consistency, integrity, and governance of regulatory data across global regulatory operations. You will act as a key liaison between Regulatory Affairs, Data Governance, Business Process Owners, and Technology teams to establish and maintain trusted regulatory data assets and standards.

The ideal candidate combines deep regulatory domain expertise with experience in data governance, standards management, metadata, and regulatory information management.

**Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Data Governance & Standards**

* Maintain and govern regulatory data inventories, metadata repositories, and source-to-target mappings
* Define and manage regulatory data standards, business rules, controlled vocabularies, and reference data
* Develop and maintain a centralized Regulatory Standards Library aligned with enterprise and industry standards
* Ensure consistent application and adoption of approved regulatory data standards across business functions
* Collaborate with Data Governance Councils, Business Data Stewards, and Data Owners to evolve governance practices

**Data Stewardship & Quality Management**

* Monitor regulatory data quality, completeness, consistency, and compliance metrics
* Perform data profiling, issue identification, impact analysis, and remediation coordination
* Support development and maintenance of data quality rules and controls
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for data quality issues

**Regulatory Data Product Support**

* Support regulatory data product development by identifying required entities, attributes, relationships, and standards
* Maintain data lineage, traceability, and business definitions for critical regulatory data assets
* Facilitate stewardship reviews and data health assessments
* Coordinate resolution of data exceptions and governance-related issues

**Regulatory Operations Support**

* Participate in requirements workshops and solution design discussions
* Provide subject matter expertise on regulatory data standards and governance practices
* Assess impacts of changing regulatory requirements on data models, standards, and processes
* Support inspection readiness and compliance initiatives

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Data Governance, Master Data Management, Analytics, and IT teams
* Provide regular updates on stewardship activities, risks, and compliance metrics
* Drive alignment between business and technical stakeholders

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Information Systems, or related discipline
* 8+ years of experience in Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Data Management, Data Governance, or Regulatory Information Management
* Strong understanding of

+ Regulatory Information Management (RIM)
+ Regulatory Data Governance
+ IDMP
+ Submission Data Management
+ Metadata and Data Lineage
+ Data Quality and Stewardship Practices

* Experience supporting global regulatory processes and data initiatives

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Veeva RIM
* IDMP/SPOR
* Data Governance Platforms
* Regulatory Data Modeling
* Master Data Management
* Regulatory Analytics & Reporting

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Infrastructure Project Manager - Windows Server/ESXi
description:
We are seeking a Project Manager with experience in delivering Infrastructure projects including Server, Network, Storage, Cloud, EUC & NOC Technologies.
  
  
**Experience**

* 10 to 15 years of experience in infrastructure operations/service delivery, including experience managing multi-tower teams (Windows, Hypervisor, Database, Network, Storage & Backup).
* Strong working knowledge across Windows Server, VMware/ESXi, Cisco UCS, database platforms (MSSQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/MySQL), networking, and storage/backup technologies.
* Proven experience as an Incident Manager handling critical/P1 outages, war-room coordination, and executive-level communication.
* Strong track record in RCA ownership, problem management, and driving cross-functional permanent fixes.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, and developing technical teams and leads across multiple infrastructure domains.

**Role & Responsibilities Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end infrastructure service delivery across Windows & Hypervisor (VMware/ESXi/UCS), Database, Network, and Storage & Backup tech tracks, ensuring SLA/OLA adherence and consistent service quality.
* Act as the single point of contact for all infra-related delivery matters, coordinating across L1/L2/L3 teams and track leads to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.
* Drive governance rhythms - daily operations reviews, weekly service reviews, and monthly/quarterly business reviews (MBR/QBR) with stakeholders and leadership.
* Monitor and report on key delivery metrics - SLA compliance, ticket volumes/aging, backlog health, change success rate, and capacity/resource utilization across all tracks.
* Own the infra delivery roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, budget, and resourcing plans across all technology towers.

**Incident, Problem & Escalation Management**

* Act as Incident Manager for Sev1/Sev2 critical outages, driving war-room bridges, coordinating cross-track technical teams, and ensuring timely restoration of service.
* Own the end-to-end major incident lifecycle - detection, triage, communication cadence to stakeholders/leadership, resolution, and closure.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all critical incidents, ensuring quality, completeness, and timely submission, and track permanent corrective actions to closure.
* Serve as the key escalation point for unresolved or high-impact issues across Windows, Hypervisor, Database, Network, and Storage & Backup tracks.
* Establish and continuously improve problem management practices - trend analysis, recurring incident identification, and proactive risk mitigation across the infra estate.

**Technical Governance Across Tracks**

* Provide technical oversight and governance across Windows Server, VMware/ESXi, Cisco UCS, MSSQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/MySQL, Network, and Storage/Backup (NetApp, Pure, Dell EMC, HPE, Rubrik, Cohesity, Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup) domains, partnering with L3/Architects for design decisions.
* Ensure standardization of processes, documentation (SOPs/runbooks), and best practices consistently applied across all technology tracks.
* Review and approve major changes, patching cycles, and DR/BCP plans across tracks to ensure risk is appropriately managed.
* Ensure security, compliance, and audit requirements are consistently met across all infra tracks, coordinating with Security and Compliance teams.

**People Management, Mentoring & Team Development**

* Mentor and groom infra track leads and administrators (L1/L2/L3) to progress to the next level, building a strong technical leadership bench across all tracks.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and skill-gap assessments; define individual development plans and training roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning across the infrastructure teams.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and resource planning for the infra tracks in partnership with track leads and HR.

**Customer Experience & Continuous Improvement**

* Own and improve CSAT/customer satisfaction scores for infrastructure services through proactive communication, service quality improvements, and stakeholder relationship management.
* Identify automation opportunities across all infra tracks - routine operations, monitoring, patching, and reporting - and drive execution in partnership with engineering teams.
* Drive continuous service improvement (CSI) initiatives, reducing manual effort, ticket volumes, and repeat incidents through process and tooling enhancements.
* Champion adoption of observability, self-healing, and ITSM tooling improvements to enhance operational efficiency and delivery maturity across tracks.

title: Tech Program / Project Manager
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Surfscan® division develops unpatterned wafer inspection systems that detect nanoscale particles and surface defects early in semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems monitor wafer quality across a wide range of applications, enabling faster issue identification and improved process control.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Program leadership: Own the integrated program plan from definition through delivery, including scope, milestones, dependencies, critical path, decision points, and measurable outcomes.
* Cross-functional execution: Align software, systems, electrical, algorithms, applications, and hardware teams around priorities, commitments, and release readiness.
* Product integration: Coordinate integration across High-Performance Computing (HPC) software, tool software, hardware, and processing workflows to deliver a reliable bench solution.
* Risk and issue management: Identify technical, schedule, resource, and operational risks early; drive mitigation, escalation, and replanning when conditions change.
* Product lifecycle governance: Lead the team through KLA's Product Lifecycle process, ensuring plans, evidence, risks, and cross-functional readiness are clear at key decision points.
* Release and operational readiness: Partner with marketing, supply chain, manufacturing, install, and service teams to prepare solutions for deployment, support, and scale.
* Customer readiness: Work with marketing and global customers to understand operating environments and define site-preparation and IT requirements that support successful product adoption.
* Executive communication: Use relevant metrics and concise, objective updates to communicate progress, decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business impact.
* Team leadership: Build strong working relationships, encourage ownership, resolve ambiguity, and influence multidisciplinary teams without relying on direct authority.

What You Bring
  
  

* Experience leading complex technical programs or new-product development from concept through integration, release, and customer adoption.
* Strong understanding of product architectures that combine software, computing infrastructure, hardware, processing workflows, and real-time analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated schedules, dependencies, critical paths, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Technical judgment to ask the right questions, evaluate trade-offs, and ensure plans address performance, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and serviceability.
* Ability to translate business goals and customer needs into clear program priorities and execution plans.
* Strong leadership, critical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience using meaningful indicators to communicate progress, readiness, quality, and program impact.
* Working knowledge of Agile, iterative, and waterfall development approaches, with the judgment to apply the right method to the work.

**Preferred Experience**

* Semiconductor equipment, industrial systems, scientific instrumentation, or another complex hardware-software product environment.
* Customer engagement, feedback analysis, deployment readiness, or product adoption planning.
* HPC platforms, data processing pipelines, software release systems, digital twins, replay or simulation environments.

Formal program or project management practices and tools; a PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent credential is helpful but not required.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience; or
* Master's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience; or
* Bachelor's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

Relevant experience may come from technical program management, project management, systems engineering, product development, software or hardware delivery, or a closely related field.
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

2. Monitor project progress and document outcomes aligned with ICAP objectives and UNEP performance indicators.
3. Ensure timely reporting and knowledge dissemination through reports, presentations, and multilingual communication materials (English and Tamil).

**Policy and Financing Advisory:**

1. Support the development of policies and frameworks to encourage thermally comfortable, affordable, and energy-efficient housing
2. Collaborate with financial institutions and international agencies to unlock funding for passive cooling projects and cold chain infrastructure.
3. Advocate for and implement incentives for adopting district cooling systems and cooling-as-a-service solutions.

title: Project Consultant – EdTech and AI
description:
**About Central Square Foundation**
About the job Project Consultant - EdTech and AI
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech; Early Childhood Education (ECE); and Schools Governance.
  
  
Read more about our work here: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech At CSF**
CSF's EdTech initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to implement EdTech solutions and influence policy.
* Funding public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching 2.5 million learners across India.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of learning for India's children and help build an EdTech ecosystem that is evidence-driven, tech-enabled, scalable and equitable.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Central Square Foundation aims to work closely with the Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu, by providing support for the adoption and implementation of EdTech programs for the K-12 schooling system in the state. This position is a
**full-time**
assignment as part of the CSF's EdTech and AI team for this purpose. The consultant will be expected to support the execution of live projects and help start new projects by working closely with senior and junior officers in the department towards commonly aligned milestones.
  
  
﻿
**Location**
**Chennai, Tamil Nadu**
**Key Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* ﻿Engage with relevant stakeholders within DSE-TN, including state, district, block, and school-level officials, to understand implementation progress and challenges. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely execution and resolution of implementation challenges.
* Undertake school visits, lead consultations with stakeholders to identify any implementation gaps, challenges, opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations for strengthening EdTech initiatives in the state.
* Support DSE-TN in the end-to-end planning, implementation, monitoring, and scale-up of EdTech and AI education initiatives. This would include, but not limited to, developing pilot proposals whenever necessary, defining objectives, creating implementation roadmap and strategies, identifying resource requirements, aligning stakeholders, creating monitoring framework, and defining expected outcomes.
* Analyze data and glean meaningful insights for driving adoption, student engagement, EdTech platform usage, and uptake of EdTech programs by students and teachers in schools
* Coordinate with CSF internal teams, technology partners, academic institutions, and implementation agencies to drive project execution, under the supervision of the team lead
* Prepare analytical reports, progress updates, meeting notes, presentations to inform departmental decision-making.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**

* ﻿Bachelor's or equivalent degree required
* Minimum 4 years of work experience demonstrating strong project delivery
* Proficiency in English and Tamil (Written and Verbal) is mandatory
* Strong solution-oriented mindset with continuously seeking ways to move tasks forward despite challenges to achieve project goals efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to independently address and resolve issues by leveraging data, considering alternative approaches, and weighing their pros and cons meticulously
* Comfort with large-scale data, its analysis and reporting as per the audience profile
* Ability to build and maintain positive and collaborative relationships both within and outside the organisation, including with government stakeholders across hierarchies, EdTech product vendors, donor organisations, colleagues, researchers, and any other relevant stakeholders
* Ability to conduct and facilitate meetings with confidence, ensuring discussions are productive, objectives are met, and follow-ups are clearly defined.
* Ability to conduct and facilitate meetings with confidence, ensuring discussions are productive, objectives are met, and representing CSF to external audiences
* Ability to create detailed presentations, reports, and documentation that are thorough, accurate, and tailored to audience needs.
* Strong execution, planning, and organisational skills, and an ability to be able to set priorities, plan timelines and meet deadlines

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience level
  
  
**Application Process**
﻿Interested candidates are requested to submit an updated resume tailored to the role, a brief Statement of Purpose (not exceeding 500 words) outlining how their past experience and future aspirations align with the role, and details of two references through the CSF Careers Portal by 30th November 2026.
  
  
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial HR call to discuss the role in detail and align on the next steps in the hiring process.﻿

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as an Energy Resource Manager (ERM) with the primary focus at reducing stranded capacity applying optimization techniques of space, power, cooling and network. Being a key member of the local Datacenter Operations team in the deployment planning and optimization of the IT capacity, working closely with Electrical Engineers and Critical Environment Field Service Engineer.

As a CO+I ERM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Other

**Qualifications**

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.  
What you will do  

* Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,

and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.  

* Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering

leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is  
reproducible and version controlled.  

* Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature

flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us  
how it behaves there.  

* Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established

application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that  
has to be preserved.  

* Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they

live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match  
the existing ones.

* Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and

much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.  

* Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis

through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.  
What we are looking for  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the  
tools from day one.  
Where you need depth  

* Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe

and defend.  

* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error

handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.  

* Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a

language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.  

* Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers  
to be shipped.  
Where working knowledge is enough  

* Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
* Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and

containers.  

* Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production

monitoring and alerting.  
Across everything  

* Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
* Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,

and careful, staged rollout.  

* Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is

written.  

* Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work

with your counterparts rather than around them.  
Nice to have

* Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,

wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the  
domain to the right engineer.  

* Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
* AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
* Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. Job Title: Manager Consulting Delivery (QA)  
Position: Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE  
Experience: 14+ Years (minimum 5+ years leading QA/QE teams, with hands-on technical depth)  
Category: Quality Engineering / Test Automation / Delivery Management  
Shift: General Shift, with overlap with US onsite counterparts as required  
Location: Chennai  
Position ID:  
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent  
Education Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline  
  
Position Description:  
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Manager and People Manager to lead an enthusiastic QA/QE team with strong AI awareness. Our current model is automation-heavy but still involves a lot of manual intervention. The role requires a clear understanding of the team's current technical challenges and the ability to transform it into a modern, AI-first Quality Engineering team through smarter automation and better engineering practices.  
Every Advantage release must go out on time and certified, with zero escaped regression defects and no last-minute surprises. The leader we want thinks like the client and acts like the client, holding quality to the standard the customer experiences in production, and treats customer delight as the measure of success.  
You will own the transformation of the QA/QE function and treat quality as an engineering discipline, building it into the pipeline, the code and the environment rather than testing it in at the end. You will drive disciplined flaky test management, faster pipelines through test sharding, parallel execution and test impact analysis, ephemeral Cloud environments that are spun up on demand and destroyed once testing is done, and a shift-left and shift-right approach in which production monitoring feeds back into test strategy. You will also strengthen performance and regression engineering so that quality improves with every release.  
You will make release and investment decisions from data such as flake rate, pipeline duration, defect leakage and DORA-style delivery metrics. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and the client, translating technical quality signals into business risk and release confidence, and balance speed, quality and cost, including cloud environment spend and automation maintenance effort. You will also bring the team along, building the skills, habits and confidence it needs to work this way.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

Responsibilities  
Delivery and Release Ownership  

* Own on-time, high-quality delivery of Advantage releases with zero regression issues, and be accountable for the quality outcome the customer experiences.
* Think like the client and act like the client: view quality from the customer's business perspective, anticipate what matters to them and make release decisions accordingly.
* Lead release certification end to end from the QA side, owning readiness assessment, quality gates, exit criteria, go/no-go inputs and sign-off. Step into an RTE-style role when required to coordinate across teams and keep releases on track.
* Own QA planning, capacity and delivery commitments across Agile sprints, Program Increments and feature releases, ensuring smooth delivery to UAT and Production and timely resolution of client issues.

Quality Strategy and Governance  

* Own the regression and performance testing strategy and its outcomes, covering scope, coverage, risk-based prioritization and continuous optimization of suites to remove redundancy and improve effectiveness.
* Define quality standards, governance and a metrics-driven improvement framework (defect leakage, regression cycle time, automation reliability, pipeline duration, defect detection effectiveness, cost of quality), and use the data to drive decisions.
* Set the direction for performance engineering, ensuring workload models, benchmarks and bottleneck analysis give early confidence in scalability and stability before release.
* Maintain clear, current documentation in Confluence, including QA strategy, release certification records, runbooks, test environment guides and lessons learned, so knowledge is shared and not held by individuals.

Technical Leadership and Transformation  

* Take ownership of chronic reliability and speed issues such as flaky tests, recurring suite failures and long-running pipelines. Diagnose systemic root causes, set stabilization and optimization priorities, and hold the team accountable for sustained improvement in reliability and execution time.
* Periodically audit the automation tech stack, frameworks and tooling, assess fitness, maintainability and cost, and set the direction to upgrade or transform when it is justified. Make these decisions based on value, not change for its own sake.
* Lead the transformation of test environments from PDC to Cloud (Azure/AWS), enabling on-demand environments that are spun up for testing and destroyed once done, in partnership with DevOps and with cost optimization in mind.
* Champion AI-driven Quality Engineering across test design, automation, failure triage and maintenance, with measurable productivity and cycle-time gains.
* Drive continuous testing and quality gates in CI/CD, working with DevOps to make releases faster and more predictable.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and practices and bringing in those that improve outcomes.

Stakeholder and People Leadership  

* Partner with Product Engineering, Product Management, DevOps and onsite counterparts to surface quality risks early, and escalate risks to leadership with clear mitigation options.
* Communicate quality status, delivery risks and improvement plans to senior leadership and client stakeholders through clear presentations and dashboards.
* Build and lead a high-performing QA/QE team by setting goals, coaching, developing technical depth and succession, managing performance and fostering a quality-first culture of accountability and ownership. #LI-SP40

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must-Have Skills  

* 14+ years of IT experience, with strong experience leading QA/QE teams and delivering large-scale programs (US state and local government experience preferred).
* Proven track record of release ownership and certification with consistently low regression leakage.
* Proven experience transforming a QA team into a modern, automation-first and AI-enabled Quality Engineering team.
* Strong people management skills, including team building, coaching, performance management, conflict resolution and capacity planning.
* Management skills: planning and forecasting, budgeting and cost control, risk and issue management, vendor and partner management, stakeholder and expectation management, and decision-making under pressure.
* Hands-on technical depth to guide the team on diagnosing and fixing flaky tests, unstable automation and slow CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience assessing automation tech stacks and frameworks and recommending upgrade or transformation paths.
* Large-scale test automation experience.
* Test Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright; programming and scripting in Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL.
* Test Management: Jira, Xray.
* Documentation and collaboration: Confluence, with strong skills in writing and maintaining QA strategies, process documents, runbooks, release certification records and knowledge-base content.
* CI/CD and DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub, Cloud (Azure/AWS) DevOps Pipelines.
* AI-assisted testing: GitHub Copilot, AI-powered test generation, self-healing and test optimization tools.
* Monitoring, observability and code coverage: Grafana, SigNoz, JaCoCo.
* Test data management, including data setup, masking and refresh strategies for reliable, repeatable regression runs.
* Azure fundamentals for testing environments: on-demand provisioning and teardown, and exposure to PDC-to-cloud migration.
* Performance testing: Apache JMeter, LoadRunner or Gatling, with the ability to interpret results and drive tuning recommendations.
* Regression strategy and optimization, risk-based testing and API testing (REST/SOAP).
* Agile/SAFe delivery experience, including RTE-style release coordination, risk management and stakeholder communication.
* Dashboarding and reporting tools: Power BI, Jira dashboards, for tracking quality, delivery and automation metrics.
* Presentation and reporting skills: building clear, executive-ready presentations (PowerPoint) and management reports that turn quality data into decisions.
* Excel proficiency: advanced Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charts, dashboards) for metrics analysis, capacity and cost tracking, and status reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; partner and multi-geography team management.

  
Good-to-Have Skills  

* Monitoring and observability: Splunk, Dynatrace.
* Infrastructure as Code and containers for test environments: Terraform/Bicep/ARM, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS.
* Code quality: SonarQube, CAST.
* Database testing: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, data validation.
* Accessibility testing: WCAG 2.1/2.2, AXE/Evinced Tools.
* Service virtualization.
* Leading innovation: participating in hackathons and encouraging and enabling the team to participate, turning ideas into practical improvements.
* Thought leadership: conference talks, blogs, internal communities of practice or patents.
* LLM and agentic testing, plus AI governance for data handling.
* Security testing awareness and compliance exposure (StateRAMP/NIST), since these separate government-experienced candidates.
* Contribution beyond delivery: experience with DEI practices and CSR initiatives, and similar organizational contributions.
* Cloud or testing certifications (Azure, ISTQB, SAFe).
* Experience with multi-location, multi-customer, multi-language delivery.
* Experience with enterprise ERP/government platforms (financial, procurement, HR systems), since Advantage is in that space.

Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.  
What you will do  

* Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,

and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.  

* Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering

leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is  
reproducible and version controlled.  

* Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature

flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us  
how it behaves there.  

* Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established

application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that  
has to be preserved.  

* Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they

live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match  
the existing ones.

* Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and

much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.  

* Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis

through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.  
What we are looking for  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the  
tools from day one.  
Where you need depth  

* Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe

and defend.  

* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error

handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.  

* Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a

language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.  

* Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers  
to be shipped.  
Where working knowledge is enough  

* Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
* Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and

containers.  

* Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production

monitoring and alerting.  
Across everything  

* Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
* Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,

and careful, staged rollout.  

* Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is

written.  

* Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work

with your counterparts rather than around them.  
Nice to have

* Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,

wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the  
domain to the right engineer.  

* Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
* AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
* Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.

From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.

Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.

CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.

Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.

Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.

CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.

Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.

Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.

Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.

* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.

* Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

title: Data Governance Team Lead - Telematics
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Summary**

Caterpillar is seeking an Engineering Team Leader to help build the data foundation for its connected products.

Caterpillar equipment generates large volumes of operational, engineering, diagnostic, and telematics data. Turning that data into trusted, understandable, reusable information requires more than collecting it. Data must have consistent definitions, appropriate context, clear ownership, measurable quality, discoverability, and controls governing how it is created and used.

The Engineering Team Leader - Data Governance will provide technical and project leadership for initiatives that improve the quality, governance, metadata, standardization, and usability of connected-product data.

This role will work across engineering, connectivity, digital products, data platforms, analytics, and AI teams to make Caterpillar data easier for both people and intelligent systems to discover, understand, and use appropriately.

### **What You Will Do**

### **Data Governance Leadership**

* Lead initiatives that establish consistent definitions, ownership, standards, and governance for connected-product data.
* Define and improve processes for data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, retention, and lifecycle management.
* Help establish authoritative definitions and common data models across engineering and digital systems.
* Define measurable data-quality expectations and drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues.
* Ensure business and engineering context is captured alongside technical data definitions.

### **Connected Equipment Data**

* Work with teams responsible for telematics, equipment configuration, asset characterization, and other sources of connected-product data.
* Improve consistency between data generated by machines and the information consumed by engineering, analytics, condition monitoring, digital products, and AI.
* Coordinate improvements to data configuration, validation, and deployment processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data-governance and data-quality activities.

### **Data Products and Discoverability**

* Help transform important datasets into clearly defined, reusable data products with known ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and interfaces.
* Improve metadata and cataloging so users can determine what information exists, what it means, where it originated, and how it should be used.
* Partner with enterprise data-platform and governance teams to connect engineering data with Caterpillar-wide data standards and tooling.
* Help establish data structures and governance practices that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI applications.

### **Project and Technical Leadership**

* Lead complex cross-functional data initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
* Develop project scope, priorities, roadmaps, milestones, and success measures.
* Coordinate engineers, data specialists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Identify dependencies, technical risks, and organizational barriers and drive them to resolution.
* Communicate project status, technical decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Mentor team members and strengthen data-governance and data-engineering capabilities across the organization.

### **What You Have**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or another related technical discipline.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, master/reference data, data catalogs, or data product management.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected products, industrial data, or engineering data.
* Experience with enterprise data catalogs such as Alation or comparable metadata/catalog platforms.
* Experience with data pipelines, APIs, SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, or modern data engineering.
* Experience with AI/ML data requirements and governance of data used by Generative AI and agentic systems.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and data teams.

### **Why This Role Matters**

AI and analytics are only as reliable as the data and context available to them.

This role will help create the standards, metadata, quality controls, and reusable data structures that allow Caterpillar's connected-product data to become a dependable foundation for engineering, digital products, analytics, and AI.

### **Role Summary**

Caterpillar is seeking an engineering leader to manage the team responsible for advancing **Remote Flash**, Caterpillar's capability for remotely delivering software updates to connected equipment.

Remote Flash enables software updates to be delivered directly to Caterpillar products without requiring a technician to physically access the machine, helping reduce service effort, improve equipment uptime, and accelerate deployment of software improvements.

The Remote Flash Team Manager will lead an engineering team responsible for the architecture, development, integration, validation, and deployment of the next generation of remote software update capabilities. The role combines strong people leadership with software and systems engineering leadership across connected products, embedded systems, cloud/back-office services, and Caterpillar product programs.

The team is entering an important technology transition. The Remote Flash roadmap includes NexGen platforms, 5G integration, enhanced flashing of control ECMs, orchestration of multi-component updates, and continued support for legacy equipment.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own execution of engineering roadmaps from requirements through development, integration, validation, release, and production support.

* Improve engineering practices through automation, CI/CD, automated validation, modern source control, and effective use of engineering data.

### **Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with product groups, embedded controls teams, connectivity teams, enterprise software teams, cybersecurity, digital product organizations, dealers, and external engineering partners.
* Translate product and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities.
* Lead technical trade-off and prioritization discussions involving architecture, cost, schedule, risk, and long-term maintainability.

**Required**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading engineering or software development teams.
* Experience delivering complex distributed, embedded, connected-product, or cloud-integrated systems.

Software is becoming an increasingly important part of Caterpillar products. The ability to safely update software remotely at scale reduces equipment downtime and support cost while allowing Caterpillar to deliver improvements more rapidly.

This manager will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for making remote software updates a reliable, scalable capability across current and future Caterpillar products.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

description:
