Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
Data& Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)
  
Roche India - Roche Services& Solutions
  
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
TheSenior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Product Management& Technical Requirements Elicitation
  
  

* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog& Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment

2. Data Catalog& Governance Platform Management
  
  

* Catalog Administration& Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata& Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies

3. Domain Data Governance& Stewardship Enablement
  
  

* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms

4. Data Quality Specification& Rule Design
  
  

* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines

5. Business Interfacing& Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**  

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments.(Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory).
* Technical& Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation).
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality& Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic(preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking& Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal& Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

**Note:** Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)
  
  
Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. title: Senior Lead Talent Acquisition & University Relations
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

KLA's Human Resources team drives business success by mobilizing our global talent to achieve both short- and long-term objectives. Our strategic areas of focus encompass HR business partnerships, learning and development, talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, inclusion, and HR systems and operations.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Role Overview**

The Lead – Talent Acquisition owns two equally weighted mandates for KLA India’s Global Capability Center: the end-to-end University Relations (UR) program and the lateral hiring of niche, senior and critical engineering talent. The role builds an integrated early-career and experienced-hire talent pipeline across AI/ML, High-Performance Computing (HPC), design engineering, software, R&D and corporate functions.

Working with a high degree of independence, the Lead sets the India campus and lateral hiring strategy, builds long-term partnerships with top engineering institutions, drives campus employer branding, and leads data-led campus offer and compensation analysis. The Lead acts as a trusted talent advisor to engineering leaders, HR Business Partners and Global TA, and uses analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve speed, quality and cost of hiring.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

University Relations (50%)

1. Campus Hiring Strategy & University Partnerships:

* Lead annual India campus hiring strategy for interns, graduate engineers and postgraduate hires, aligned to business workforce plans.
* Prioritise target institutions using data on talent quality, intern-to-PPO conversion, offer acceptance and return on investment for the position like AI/ML, High performance engineering, and Engineering.
* Build and sustain strategic partnerships with Tier-1 and Tier-2 institutions (IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS and other leading universities), including industry–academia projects, research collaborations and guest lectures.
* Run the full campus cycle independently – pre-placement talks, assessments, interviews, offers and engagement through to joining.
* Lead internships program, hackathons and university workshop to build the early-career pipeline and drive intern-to-full-time conversion.

2. UR Branding & Campus Employer Branding:

* Define and execute the KLA India UR branding plan with Communications and Marketing to position KLA as an employer of choice for semiconductor, AI/ML, HPC and design engineering talent.
* Run campus campaigns, technical talks, social media content, employee and intern stories, and student ambassador programs.
* Represent KLA at career fairs, tech fests, coding competitions and industry–academia events.
* Measure branding reach and engagement (career site traffic, campaign response, application conversion by campus) and refine the plan based on results and competitor benchmarks.

3. Campus Offer Analysis & Compensation Benchmarking:

* Lead annual campus pay benchmarking using salary surveys, peer company data and institutional placement reports.
* Recommend offer structures by institution tier, degree, specialisation and role family (including premium skills such as AI/ML, HPC and VLSI/design), and secure approval with Total Rewards.
* Analyse offer outcomes – acceptance, declines, reneges, competing offers and day-slot positioning – and recommend timely pay and process changes as the market moves.
* Prepare and present the annual campus compensation and offer strategy proposal to HR leadership.

B. Lateral Hiring (50%)

4. End-to-End Lateral & Critical Skills Hiring

* Own full-cycle recruitment for lateral, senior, niche and critical-skill roles across engineering, R&D, software, digital, IT and corporate functions.
* Advise hiring managers on role definition, talent availability, sourcing channels, location strategy and assessment approach.
* Implement structured assessment frameworks (competency mapping, interview calibration, selection matrices) to reduce bias and improve quality of hire.
* Ensure strong governance on time to fill, quality of hire, offer-to-join ratio and candidate experience.

5. AI/ML, HPC & Strategic Engineering Talent

* AI/ML: Build talent maps and targeted sourcing strategies for machine learning, computer vision, data science and MLOps talent, combining campus pipelines from top AI programs with lateral hiring from product and deep-tech companies.
* HPC: Develop a sourcing strategy for HPC, GPU/parallel computing, performance optimisation and distributed systems engineers, including partnerships with institutions and research labs strong in high-performance computing.
* Use external talent intelligence and market insights to advise leaders on demand–supply gaps, compensation trends and competitor hiring for these critical skill families.

C. Shared Responsibilities (Across UR & Lateral)

6. Workforce Planning & Stakeholder Partnership

* Translate global and India GCC workforce plans into actionable campus and lateral hiring plans aligned to semiconductor business priorities.
* Act as a talent advisor to engineering heads, business leaders and HR Business Partners, and influence decisions without formal authority.
* Present hiring strategy, market insights and results in quarterly business reviews and annual workforce planning.
* Partner with Global TA, Global University Relations and CoEs to align India practices with global hiring standards.

7. Data Analytics, AI Tools & Process Excellence

* Build and own hiring dashboards covering pipeline conversion, time to fill, offer-to-join ratio, quality of hire, sourcing mix, cost per hire, diversity mix and ROI by institution.
* Drive adoption and optimisation of Workday, HiredScore, recruitment automation and AI-enabled sourcing, screening, assessment and candidate engagement tools.
* Use generative AI for job postings, outreach and campus content, and pilot new HR technology with clear recommendations for scale-up.
* Standardise TA and campus processes to ensure scalability, consistency and audit readiness.
* Qualifications & Experience

Must-have

* MBA or postgraduate degree in HR / Management or equivalent from reputed University / Insititute.
* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience in an MNC, with at least 4 years in University Relations at a semiconductor, hi-tech, engineering, product or deep-tech organisation / GCC.
* Proven experience hiring niche lateral engineering talent, ideally across AI/ML, HPC and/or design engineering.
* Hands-on experience with campus compensation benchmarking, offer structuring and offer outcome analysis.
* Track record of leading employer and campus branding initiatives with measurable results.
* Strong data skills: advanced Excel and Power BI or Tableau; practical experience using AI tools in recruitment.
* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills, with confidence engaging senior leaders, global executives and external partners.

Good to have

* Established relationships with leading engineering institutions in India.
* Experience with Workday, HiredScore or similar ATS and candidate relationship platforms.
* Knowledge of the semiconductor and deep-tech talent market.
* Experience running diversity-focused campus and early-career programs.
* Experience in GCC scale-up environments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* MBA or postgraduate degree in HR / Management or equivalent from reputed University / Insititute.
* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience in an MNC, with at least 4 years in University Relations at a semiconductor, hi-tech, engineering, product or deep-tech organisation / GCC.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Job Title:**
Lead Engineer
  
  
**Function/Department:**
Technology
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Lead Engineer within our Ingestion Platform team here at Chubb, you will help rebuild how digital products are delivered to customers and partners worldwide. You will design and build the services, workflows, AI capabilities, and data pipelines that power that platform, and you will raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. As a key contributor on our team, you will own features end to end, from design through production, and who helps shape technical direction within your team. You will partner closely with architects, data scientists, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions in an insurance environment where reliability, privacy, security, and regulatory discipline are just as important as speed. With us, you will have the opportunity to directly shape core platform decisions, architect and deliver systems that scale, helping to define how we build and operate digital experiences with greater intelligence, resilience, and precision.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build scalable services and APIs with clear contracts, idempotency, retries, and failure isolation, and take features from user stories and acceptance criteria to production in an agile SDLC
* Contribute to design and architecture reviews, propose improvements to standards and tooling, and write clean, testable, observable code with strong unit, integration, and contract tests
* Integrate with internal systems and external partners through governed APIs, event streams, and webhooks, with schema versioning
* Build durable workflows and agentic AI features using tools like Temporal, Camunda, Step Functions, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or the Claude Agent SDK, including human-in-the-loop steps, tool calling, MCP, and guardrails
* Evaluate and monitor AI features with prompt versioning, evaluation sets, tool-call accuracy, task success, cost, latency, and human review gates
* Build RAG, memory, ontology, and document capabilities, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evaluation, and structured knowledge extraction
* Protect retrieval and AI inputs with document access control, PII/PCI redaction, and defenses against prompt injection, while following security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage branching and release practices, review code thoroughly, keep pipelines healthy, resolve root causes, mentor engineers, and improve cloud-native automation where it helps

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building distributed, data-intensive or platform systems in production; knowledge of and/or experience with insurance processes, regulatory requirements and industry standards is a plus
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong programming in Python, Java, Scala or similar, and strong SQL, with experience of microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP; experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and/or GitOps is a plus
* Solid distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breakers, consistency, structured logging, distributed tracing and correlation IDs; experience with Temporal, Camunda, AWS Step Functions, and/or Cadence is a plus
* Experience with streaming (Kafka, Kinesis or Event Hubs) and distributed data processing (Spark, Flink or Beam), and with data modelling for SQL and NoSQL stores; experience with Delta Lake, Iceberg, and data governance and/or metadata management is a plus
* Hands-on experience with LLM-based applications including at least one production or serious prototype using RAG (chunking, embeddings, vector search) or agents with tool calling; experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, and LLM evaluation and/or observability tools is a plus
* Working knowledge of ontologies or knowledge graphs, and of data science and ML basics (Python data stack, model evaluation, how models are deployed and monitored); experience with Neo4j, MongoDB, GraphDB, JSON-LD, SHACL, Cypher, SPARQL, and/or Gremlin is a plus
* Hands-on CI/CD experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines (Jenkins file, shared libraries) with automated test, scan and release stages, and Git workflows with pull requests; experience with SonarQube, dependency and container scanning, SAST/DAST, and/or Artifactory or Nexus is a plus
* Strong code review experience, both providing and receiving reviews, as well as applying standards for correctness, security, testing and readability
* Additional depth in AI/ML platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude API, MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, or SageMaker is a plus

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
  

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026

The team operates as an embedded strategic partner to the commercial organization, providing thought leadership and delivering AI-powered solutions to marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
**About the Opportunity**

A fast-growing quantitative proprietary trading firm in Hyderabad is looking for a Quant Researcher. The firm combines quantitative research, engineering and algorithmic trading across global markets. You’ll work in a small, founder-led team with high ownership, direct access to leadership and evidence-based reviews.

Generate, validate and improve research that survives real markets and translates cleanly into production.

* Design robust experiments: prevent leakage, ensure clean splits and document assumptions
* Stress test across regimes, sensitivity, costs/slippage, edge decay and failure modes
* Build and maintain reproducible research pipelines (data → results → documentation)
* Partner with Quant Developers to turn validated research into production specifications
* Defend your work with evidence and improve it through peer review

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong statistical reasoning and research hygiene (bias, leakage and overfitting awareness)
* Solid Python programming with clean, testable code
* Hands-on experience with real datasets and reliable data pipelines
* Experience with backtesting and performance and risk metrics (Sharpe, drawdown, CVaR, capture ratios)
* Experience with feature engineering and ML or regime-based modelling
* Clear communication of what worked, what didn’t and why
* Ability to explain your research decisions and trade-offs end to end

**Good-to-Have**

* Prior systematic trading research experience (equities, futures, options or crypto)
* Portfolio optimisation or signal-generation frameworks
* Familiarity with market microstructure or execution-aware modelling
* Distributed compute or performance optimisation
* SQL and data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks

**First 90 Days**

* Deliver at least one reproducible research study end to end
* Validate hypotheses with robustness checks and failure-mode analysis
* Set up clear handoff standards and monitoring expectations with engineering and trading

**Why Join**

* Real ownership with flat teams and low ego
* Direct access to founders from top quant trading and Big Tech backgrounds
* Research that goes into production and has a measurable impact
* A culture of evidence over opinion

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
Micron’s Data Center Workload Engineering team studies how real AI workloads use compute, memory, interconnects, and storage. We turn system-level measurements into insights that help build future Micron DRAM (DDR and LPDDR), HBM, CXL, and storage products.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Principal AI Systems Performance Engineer, you will direct experiments on AI training, inference, and agentic workloads across complete server systems. You will pinpoint where bandwidth, capacity, latency, power, and data movement restrict performance—then convert your discoveries into product requirements and guidance for engineering, product, and customer teams. Your efforts will link current measurements with the demands of future AI infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and perform controlled, representative AI experiments on current and pre-production CPU-GPU systems, evaluating memory and storage performance, power, and thermal tradeoffs.
* Profile workloads from GPU memory through system memory, CXL-attached memory, storage, and interconnects; assess performance from node to cluster scale, including efficiency, latency, utilization, scalability, and tail behavior.
* Evaluate data placement, migration, prefetching, compression, and tiering approaches for KV cache, model state, and other AI data.
* Build and validate performance models, simulations, traces, and reusable benchmarking tools to forecast future system requirements.
* Lead cross-functional projects and transform outcomes into product requirements, develop recommendations, publications, demonstrations, and customer mentorship

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of experience; master’s degree with 5 or more years; or Ph.D. with demonstrated experience in a related field.
* Hands-on experience profiling and benchmarking multi-GPU AI systems across single-node and multi-node environments.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Our Values define us. They are -
**Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day.**
They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.
  
  
With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our
**communities**
with the talent and passion of our
**colleagues**
.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Flutter Technology is seeking a skilled AI & Automation Enablement Engineer to support the practical adoption and technical execution of our underlying AI & Automation product suite. This role is focused on rapid technical prototyping, pattern development, and enabling Flutter Functions to realise measurable value from platforms like Flutter Assistant, AI Hub, Claude and Workato.
  
  
You will work as part of a small, high-velocity Enablement team based across multiple time zones, primarily responsible for developing technical proof-of-concepts, creating reusable AI & Automation architectural patterns, and resolving complex technical blockers. This is a hands-on technical role for individuals who excel at rapid prototyping and enjoy operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and practical business value.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong technical expertise across automation and AI platforms, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with Product Strategy, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Prototyping & PoC Development: Design, develop, and execute Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) for complex, high-priority AI & Automation initiatives, demonstrating technical feasibility and value potential by building functional prototypes that combine Automation platforms, AI services, and enterprise integrations, including secure MCP servers and agent integrations.
* Complex Technical Problem-Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across multi-platform solutions, ensuring successful validation of new AI and Automation patterns.
* Reusable Pattern & Blueprint Creation: Create reusable technical blueprints and architectural patterns for solutions, including AI agent workflows, multi-platform orchestration, and intelligent automation.
* Pattern Documentation & Standards : Develop and maintain comprehensive Pattern Documentation, ensuring clarity and completeness, while establishing technical best-practice guidelines and standards for automation development.
* Platform Feature Testing & Validation: Conduct hands-on technical testing and validation of new platform features (Workato, Flutter Assistant, AI Hub, Claude) to understand capabilities and limitations, evaluating emerging AI and Automation technologies to determine viability and strategic fit for Flutter.
* AI-Assisted Delivery: Use AI coding and agentic tools in day-to-day development, testing, documentation and support, and help evolve the team’s AI-driven ways of working to improve speed, quality and reliability.
* Product Feedback & Platform Input: Provide technical feedback to Product Managers on platform capabilities and feature requirements based on hands-on exploration and testing.
* Architecture Collaboration & Standards Alignment : Partner with Architecture peers to ensure patterns adhere to established technical standards, security, and governance requirements.
* Pattern Handover & Implementation Support: Facilitate seamless Pattern Documentation & Handover to Delivery teams, providing technical context and support during implementation while acting as a technical advisor for troubleshooting guidance.
* Requirements Translation & Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with Business Analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Adoption Championing & Continuous Improvement: Champion the adoption of newly enabled technical patterns within the wider engineering community, collecting and analysing feedback from Delivery teams to continuously improve pattern quality and usability.
* On-Call Rota: Participate in an on-call rota to provide out-of-hours support for the platforms the team owns.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Technical Expertise & Execution: Deep technical knowledge with the ability to design and build complex AI and Automation solutions independently.
* Rapid Prototyping: Excels at quickly building functional PoCs and iterating based on feedback and technical constraints.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex, multi-system technical challenges.
* Collaboration & Communication: Works effectively across teams in multiple time zones and articulates technical solutions clearly to diverse audiences.
* Continuous Learning: Demonstrates curiosity and commitment to staying current with rapidly evolving AI and automation technologies.
* Quality & Standards: Maintains high standards for code quality, documentation, and technical best practices.
* AI-First Mindset: Applies AI tools to how they build, test and troubleshoot, and shares what works with the team.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* 3-5 years in a hands-on technical role (e.g., Automation Engineer, Solutions Developer, Integration Engineer, AI Engineer) with experience in enterprise automation or AI implementation.
* Strong prototyping experience, with a demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into functional technical solutions rapidly.
* Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise automation/integration platforms such as UiPath, Workato, Blue Prism, Power Automate, or similar tools.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, VBA).
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP (AWS preferred) and enterprise system architecture.
* Experience building or integrating with APIs, and an understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and how they give AI agents secure access to enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of identity and access management (for example OAuth2, SSO and user-level authentication and permissions) is beneficial, as secure access underpins most of our integrations.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD principles.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban).

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs .
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.

* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards .

**WHY CHOOSE US**

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

description:

The Core Engineering
  
  
The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

****What We Do****
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
  
  
The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
  
  
Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
  
  
**Our Impact**
The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
  
  
**Why join the team**

* Tool & Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.
* Autonomy: You’ll have significant autonomy in designing and writing solutions to help our stakeholders deliver for the firm’s clients.
* Creativity: You’ll be encouraged to suggest improvements to products and to propose ways, in which we can add value for our stakeholders.
* Interpersonal Communication: You’ll engage with data producers and consumers across all areas of the business to understand their requirements and to propose solutions tailored to their needs.
* Training: Your manager will support your professional development, allowing you time for training at work, helping you learn and grow within the organization, and providing opportunities for increasing responsibility.

****Responsibilities****

* In an Agile environment manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis to coding, testing, UAT, implementation and maintenance
* Develop high level/detailed technical designs, testing strategies, and implementation plans
* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Understand and respond to business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Identify opportunities for cross-divisional collaboration and reuse of common solutions
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI-powered automations, prompt engineering concepts.

****Skills & Experience We Are Looking For****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
* Hands-on software development experience preferably in Java, C/C++, Python, or Scala, exposure to RDBMS and NoSQL datastores
* Strong programming and problem-solving skills
* A clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design and core programming concepts
* Strong full-stack technical design and development skills and experience
* Comfortable with multi-tasking, managing multiple stakeholders and working as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills including experience speaking to technical & business audiences and working globally
* Interest in finance

title: Engagement Lead - Data Science
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Engagement Lead**
-
**Data Scientist**
**Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) as part of Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) India to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. RSS is a global division operating in an agile organizational setup without extensive hierarchical structure, where all our employees lead from every seat, and inspirational leadership, and an entrepreneurial customer-centric mindset are our core values.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
As
**Engagement Lead**
, you will lead two data science sub-streams supporting commercial teams:
**Predictive AI & Optimization**
and
**Causal AI & Experimentation**
. You will own the technical direction and delivery of both. You will work directly with product owners to turn business questions into predictive, causal and optimization solutions, and you will grow a team of about 7 data scientists.
  
  
**This is a hands-on leadership role.**
You will review models and code, unblock the team quickly, and be accountable for the quality and business impact of everything the two sub-streams deliver.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead, mentor and develop Senior Data Scientists and Data Scientists across both sub-streams. Build technical depth, modular coding standards and agile delivery habits
* Lead the design, calibration and validation of Bayesian and frequentist Marketing Mix Models (MMM). Models should account for adstock, saturation, seasonality and hierarchical or geo-level effects
* Oversee multi-touch attribution (MTA) and brand performance analytics. Translate the results into practical recommendations on channel mix and spend
* Design and govern experiments, including A/B tests, quasi-experimental designs (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control) and econometric analysis, to measure the true impact of commercial initiatives
* Oversee the design and delivery of predictive models for commercial use cases. This includes classification on highly imbalanced data, anomaly detection, segmentation and time-series forecasting
* Turn predictions into decisions through optimization: budget and resource allocation, response curves, ROI/mROI analysis and scenario-planning simulations
* Rapid Prototyping & Business Value: Quickly design and build proofs of concept, prototypes and business case studies, including GenAI- and agent-based solutions where they add value, to show tangible impact
* Set the methodological standards for each sub-stream. Decide which approaches are suitable for a given problem, and explain why others are not
* Stay close to the work: review model designs, validation results and critical code, and resolve technical blockers quickly
* Present findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, so that complex model results lead to confident decisions
* Work with global cross-functional teams in an agile environment, including demos, reviews and retrospectives to keep improving deliverables
* Ensure reproducibility, documentation and peer review across all models delivered

**Who You Are**
You are an accomplished data science leader with deep expertise in both predictive modelling and causal inference. You know when a problem needs a prediction, when it needs a causal estimate, and when it needs an optimization layer on top. You lead by example, stay close to the code, and can explain complex model outputs, from an MMM posterior to a SHAP plot, in clear business terms that product owners can act on.
  
  
**Education & Certification:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Computer Science, Business Analytics or another quantitative field
* Certifications: Recognized professional certifications in Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud AI Platforms or Advanced Analytics are an advantage

**Qualifications & Technical Skillset:**

* 10+ years of experience in Data Science/Analytics, including at least 3 years leading data science teams and mentoring data scientists. You should have a proven track record of measurable business impact through predictive modelling and causal inference or experimentation, ideally in commercial or marketing analytics
* Strong hands-on expertise in predictive modelling, including classification on skewed data with imbalance handling (e.g., SMOTE, class weighting), ensemble and tree-based models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost), linear models, anomaly detection, unsupervised methods (clustering, segmentation) and time-series forecasting (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet)
* Rigorous model validation and explainability, including SHAP and precision-recall and calibration methods for imbalanced problems
* Deep expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including experimental design, A/B testing, quasi-experimental methods and econometrics
* Hands-on experience building Marketing Mix Models and multi-touch attribution models (regression-based, time-decay, Markov-chain and Shapley-value methods), using frameworks such as Google Meridian, PyMC-Marketing, Meta Robyn, LightweightMMM, Orbit, PyMC or Stan. This includes model diagnostics (convergence, priors, posterior predictive checks) and turning outputs into budget optimization, response curves and scenario simulations
* Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong experience in Spark (distributed computing), Airflow, Git, AWS, and Tableau or an equivalent tool for visualization and storytelling
* Exposure to and recent experience with GenAI tools and LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek) and coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, plus experience of building AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI

***Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs.***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:

AI that doesn't just think, but acts - forecasting market moves, surfacing answers in seconds, and freeing your teams to focus on execution when timing matters most.

Together, our six solutions turn intelligence into action, helping every team make smarter, faster decisions. Each solution focuses on the decisions that matter most, driving measurable impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
GlobalData’s Consulting Team to strengthen our Data Science team within Consumer Consulting. This is a senior, hands-on role owning quantitative workstreams — market sizing, forecasting and scenario modelling — across custom, strategy-led consulting engagements for clients spanning Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail, Automotive, Agriculture and other verticals. We are looking first for strong general analytical ability, structured thinking and consulting judgement; ability to reason clearly about data and client problems, and to pick up new tools quickly.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* 5-8+ of experience in consulting, market research, or a strongly analytical commercial role, with meaningful exposure to data modelling or market sizing work.
* Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, structured spreadsheet design) and clear comfort building or working within a data model.
* Strong general analytical and quantitative reasoning — able to work with imperfect, multi-source data, spot inconsistencies, and defend assumptions.
* Good written and verbal communication skills; able to present findings clearly, including to clients or senior stakeholders.
* Some experience — or clear potential and willingness — to review work and mentor junior consultants or analysts.
* Prior experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in day-to-day research and modelling work
* Basic familiarity with a dashboarding or data-visualisation tool (Power BI or similar) is helpful
* Exposure to any of Consumer, Foodservice, Packaging, Retail, Automotive or Agriculture sectors is a plus, but not essential — genuine interest in learning a sector matters more than prior coverage of it.

**Good To Have**

* Working knowledge of Python and/or SQL for data manipulation.
* Experience contributing to forecasting models that use macroeconomic or demographic drivers.
* Experience designing primary research instruments (surveys, discussion guides, store audits) or briefing external field agencies.
* Basic ability to read and interpret company financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, annual/quarterly filings).
* Prior exposure to using AI/automation to speed up secondary desk research or report generation.
* Key Responsibilities:
* Lead data modelling workstreams — market sizing, demand forecasting, scenario analysis — primarily in Excel, turning primary and secondary data into clear, defensible, client-ready outputs.
* Shape analytical frameworks and methodology for consulting engagements (sizing logic, driver trees, cross-checks), in partnership with Consulting Directors.
* Contribute to the design and quality review of primary and secondary research — surveys, store audits, desk research — that feeds into models and deliverables.
* Partner with clients and Consulting Directors to interpret findings and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Review and quality-control the analytical work of consultants and analysts; help set a consistent standard of rigour and structure across the team.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on a workstream basis, developing their modelling and consulting skills.
* Contribute to report writing and deliverable narratives, ensuring outputs are client-ready and consistent with GlobalData's standards.
* Use, and help the team adopt, AI tools and simple automation to speed up desk research and modelling tasks (e.g. summarising industry reports, structuring SKU or pricing data, drafting survey questions) — training and support will be provided to build this up on the job.
* Help translate model outputs into simple dashboards or visual summaries for clients and internal stakeholders, using whatever tools you're comfortable with (Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Work cross-functionally with other verticals to bring data-science thinking into broader consulting solutions and proposals

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
**About the Opportunity**

A fast-growing quantitative proprietary trading firm in Hyderabad is looking for a Quant Researcher. The firm combines quantitative research, engineering and algorithmic trading across global markets. You’ll work in a small, founder-led team with high ownership, direct access to leadership and evidence-based reviews.

**Mission**

Generate, validate and improve research that survives real markets and translates cleanly into production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research systematic signals, models and execution-aware hypotheses across markets
* Design robust experiments: prevent leakage, ensure clean splits and document assumptions
* Stress test across regimes, sensitivity, costs/slippage, edge decay and failure modes
* Build and maintain reproducible research pipelines (data → results → documentation)
* Partner with Quant Developers to turn validated research into production specifications
* Defend your work with evidence and improve it through peer review

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong statistical reasoning and research hygiene (bias, leakage and overfitting awareness)
* Solid Python programming with clean, testable code
* Hands-on experience with real datasets and reliable data pipelines
* Experience with backtesting and performance and risk metrics (Sharpe, drawdown, CVaR, capture ratios)
* Experience with feature engineering and ML or regime-based modelling
* Clear communication of what worked, what didn’t and why
* Ability to explain your research decisions and trade-offs end to end

**Good-to-Have**

* Prior systematic trading research experience (equities, futures, options or crypto)
* Portfolio optimisation or signal-generation frameworks
* Familiarity with market microstructure or execution-aware modelling
* Distributed compute or performance optimisation
* SQL and data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks

**First 90 Days**

* Deliver at least one reproducible research study end to end
* Validate hypotheses with robustness checks and failure-mode analysis
* Set up clear handoff standards and monitoring expectations with engineering and trading

**Why Join**

* Real ownership with flat teams and low ego
* Direct access to founders from top quant trading and Big Tech backgrounds
* Research that goes into production and has a measurable impact
* A culture of evidence over opinion

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Business Consulting QAS- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business

* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)
* Solid grounding in mathematical foundations including stochastic calculus, differential and integral calculus, probability, linear algebra
* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.
* Experience in model development, validation, monitoring, and audit procedures (stress testing, back testing, benchmarking) of trading book models.
* Strong coding skills in advanced Python / C++ and basic SQL
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Exposure to market risk and counterparty credit risk methodologies (VaR, ES, SVaR, CVA, PFE) and time series techniques (e.g. GARCH).
* Hands on experience with pricing model development/validation (e.g., HW1F/2F, HJM, LMM, SABR, Heston, Dupire), volatility calibration, curve bootstrapping.
* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

**What We Look For**

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics
* Regulatory knowledge in FRTB Basel, CCAR
* Professional certifications (CQF, FRM, PRM, RAI are a plus)

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.

* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.

* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.

description:
Job ID

JR116945

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron’s Data Center Workload Engineering team studies how real AI workloads use compute, memory, interconnects, and storage. We turn system-level measurements into insights that help build future Micron DRAM (DDR and LPDDR), HBM, CXL, and storage products.

  
  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

  
  

As a Principal AI Systems Performance Engineer, you will direct experiments on AI training, inference, and agentic workloads across complete server systems. You will pinpoint where bandwidth, capacity, latency, power, and data movement restrict performance—then convert your discoveries into product requirements and guidance for engineering, product, and customer teams. Your efforts will link current measurements with the demands of future AI infrastructure.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

  
  

* Develop and perform controlled, representative AI experiments on current and pre-production CPU-GPU systems, evaluating memory and storage performance, power, and thermal tradeoffs.
* Profile workloads from GPU memory through system memory, CXL-attached memory, storage, and interconnects; assess performance from node to cluster scale, including efficiency, latency, utilization, scalability, and tail behavior.
* Evaluate data placement, migration, prefetching, compression, and tiering approaches for KV cache, model state, and other AI data.
* Build and validate performance models, simulations, traces, and reusable benchmarking tools to forecast future system requirements.
* Lead cross-functional projects and transform outcomes into product requirements, develop recommendations, publications, demonstrations, and customer mentorship
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree with **at least 10 years of experience**; master’s degree with **5 or more years**; or Ph.D. with demonstrated experience in a related field.
* Hands-on experience profiling and benchmarking multi-GPU AI systems across single-node and multi-node environments.
* Understanding of transformer workloads, memory behavior, distributed systems, and agentic AI infrastructure.
* Experience with PyTorch, an AI serving platform, Python, and at least one of C, C++, CUDA, or Triton.
* Ability to lead controlled experiments and communicate results to technical and business audiences.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

  
  

* Experience with memory tiering, KV-cache management, or emerging AI workloads.
* Experience with disaggregated infrastructure or performance modeling and simulation.
* Relevant research, patents, open-source contributions, or other substantial technical work.

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Job Overview**

The Junior Machine Learning Engineer works within an Applied AI and Machine Learning delivery team to develop, test, deploy, and support AI and machine learning solutions. This early-career role is designed for candidates with strong programming and analytical foundations who want to build scalable, production-ready AI products under the guidance of senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, profiling, and validating structured and unstructured data.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, data quality issues, and potential features.
* Develop and evaluate baseline machine learning models under guidance using appropriate algorithms and metrics.
* Support use cases involving classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting, natural language processing, and Generative AI.
* Write reusable, readable, secure, and testable Python code aligned with team coding standards.
* Help convert notebooks and experiments into modular code, repeatable pipelines, APIs, or scheduled workloads.
* Assist with feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, and experiment tracking.
* Support deployment of models through APIs, containers, batch jobs, or approved cloud services.
* Help monitor model quality, data drift, model drift, latency, failures, and operational performance.
* Participate in code reviews, pair programming, Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Document datasets, experiments, assumptions, model results, dependencies, limitations, and implementation decisions.
* Identify and escalate data privacy, security, compliance, responsible AI, and model-performance risks.

**Essential Job Functions**

**Data Preparation and Exploration**

* Perform data cleaning, feature preparation, validation, and exploratory analysis.
* Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
* Document data quality findings and support corrective actions.

**Model Development**

* Build baseline machine learning models and compare performance using suitable evaluation metrics.
* Support feature engineering, error analysis, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Assist with consumption of foundation models and Large Language Models.

**Machine Learning Engineering**

* Use Git for source control and collaboration.
* Package basic applications or models using Docker.
* Support APIs, pipelines, experiment tracking, and introductory MLOps practices.

**Testing and Monitoring**

* Write unit tests and data validation checks.
* Assist in testing model behavior and production performance.
* Support logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident documentation.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related area.
* 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, research, hackathons, or personal projects.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
* Understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and continuous-learning abilities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, or Azure AI Foundry.
* Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
* Exposure to Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents, used to speed up your own development and to deliver AI-native solutions, with the judgment to review and own what they produce.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, and MLflow or similar experiment tracking.
* Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, explainability, and AI governance.

**Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training**

Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.

* Python programming and object-oriented programming
* NumPy, Pandas, data visualization, and SQL
* Statistics and probability for machine learning
* Supervised and unsupervised machine learning
* Model evaluation, feature engineering, and error analysis
* Introduction to deep learning and natural language processing
* Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG

Build and demonstrate an end-to-end machine learning solution covering data preparation, model development, evaluation, packaging, documentation, and basic deployment or inference.
