**Drone Analytics Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**

**Primary Focus**

User stories and acceptance criteria, story map, beta feedback triage.

**Technology Stack**

Jira/Confluence, Gherkin (Given/When/Then), BPMN/draw.io, Postman (API reading), basic SQL/MongoDB queries, OpenAPI.

**Role Summary**

The Business Analyst will help shape the transition of the drone analytics MVP into a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The role connects business goals, customer needs, product requirements, and technical delivery—ensuring that requirements are clear, traceable, testable, and aligned with GA readiness, customer migration, and post-launch success.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Requirements: Run workshops and interviews with stakeholders and MVP customers. Document business, functional, and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, and compliance.

2. Backlog: Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira. Keep the backlog groomed and maintain traceability from business goal to story to test case.

3. Analysis: Perform MVP-to-SaaS gap analysis. Model processes and data flows (BPMN/UML) for tenants, users, subscriptions, drone assets, and inference jobs.

4. Billing and packaging: Define plans, entitlements, usage metering (GB ingested, flight hours, inference minutes), proration, and overage rules with Product and Finance.

5. Delivery: Join sprint ceremonies. Work with the Tech Architect, Drone Data Architect, AI/ML, and UX teams to translate business rules into technical constraints.

6. Quality: Partner with QA on test strategy. Lead UAT with pilot customers and internal stakeholders.

7. Security and compliance: Support control mapping for SOC 2 and privacy requirements (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).

8. Migration and go-live: Define data mapping, cutover, and rollback criteria for MVP customers. Own the GA readiness checklist and post-GA success metrics (activation, churn, time-to-first-insight).

9. Governance: Manage requirements change control, the decision log, and risk inputs for the PM.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.
* 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with 3+ years on B2B SaaS or cloud platforms.
* Experience documenting multi-tenant systems, RBAC/SSO, or subscription billing.

* AWS or Azure fundamentals; exposure to SOC 2, GDPR, or CCPA.
* Prior experience with MVP-to-platform or customer-migration programs.
* CBAP, PMI-PBA, or CSPO/PSPO certification.

* Documented business, functional, and non-functional requirements, with traceability to backlog items and test cases.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

title: Principal IT Technologist - Product Analyst
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Data Platform & Services (DPS) value stream is responsible for managing enterprise data assets, data and analytics platforms, data governance, data quality, system integrations, and advanced analytics capabilities across the organization. Within DPS, the Enterprise Data Governance team delivers metadata management services through the Enterprise Data Catalog (Atlan), enabling consistent data discovery, lineage visibility, business glossary management, and governance at scale. This team partners with business and technology stakeholders to improve data transparency, trust, accessibility, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data ecosystems.
  
  
As a Principal Product Analyst, you will lead metadata integration and governance initiatives that strengthen enterprise data management capabilities. This role serves as a key partner to business stakeholders, data stewards, architects, and engineering teams to design, implement, and optimize metadata management solutions using Atlan and related technologies. You will drive requirements analysis, integration strategy, governance enablement, and operational excellence to improve data transparency, lineage, accessibility, and decision-making across the enterprise.  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Lead metadata integration initiatives using Atlan and related governance technologies across enterprise platforms.
* Design and implement integrations between metadata repositories, relational databases, Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) pipelines, business intelligence platforms, and external systems.
* Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements for data governance, metadata management, and integration solutions.
* Maintain the technical roadmap for metadata connectors, governance capabilities, and platform enhancements while aligning priorities with stakeholders.
* Validate metadata quality, data lineage accuracy, and governance coverage to support enterprise data governance policies.
* Monitor and troubleshoot integration pipelines, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to resolve technical issues.
* Partner with data stewards, architects, product managers, and development teams to establish and maintain critical business and technical metadata.
Develop technical documentation, testing strategies, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 14+ years of IT experience with Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, MCA, or MSc.
* Experience in Product Analysis, Data Integration, Metadata Management, Data Governance, or related data platform functions.
* 9+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Integration Analyst, Data Integration Engineer, Metadata Analyst, or similar role.
* Experience with enterprise metadata and data governance platforms such as Atlan, Collibra, Alation, or Informatica Metadata Manager.
* 7+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying RESTful APIs and integration solutions.
* Experience with SQL, data analysis, data modeling, integration technologies, cloud platforms, and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience administering and integrating Atlan within large-scale enterprise data environments.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst**  
**Drone Analytics Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**

**Primary Focus:**  
User stories and acceptance criteria, story map, beta feedback triage.

**Technology Stack:**  
Jira/Confluence, Gherkin (Given/When/Then), BPMN/draw.io, Postman (API reading), basic SQL/MongoDB queries, OpenAPI.

**Role Summary:**  
1. The Business Analyst will help shape the transition of the drone analytics MVP into a multi-tenant SaaS platform.  
2. The role connects business goals, customer needs, product requirements, and technical delivery—ensuring that requirements are clear, traceable, testable, and aligned with GA readiness, customer migration, and post-launch success.

**Key Responsibilities:**   
**1. Requirements:** Run workshops and interviews with stakeholders and MVP customers. Document business, functional, and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, and compliance.  
**2. Backlog:** Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira. Keep the backlog groomed and maintain traceability from business goal to story to test case.  
**3. Analysis:** Perform MVP-to-SaaS gap analysis. Model processes and data flows (BPMN/UML) for tenants, users, subscriptions, drone assets, and inference jobs.  
**4. Billing and packaging:** Define plans, entitlements, usage metering (GB ingested, flight hours, inference minutes), proration, and overage rules with Product and Finance.  
**5. Delivery:** Join sprint ceremonies. Work with the Tech Architect, Drone Data Architect, AI/ML, and UX teams to translate business rules into technical constraints.  
**6. Quality:** Partner with QA on test strategy. Lead UAT with pilot customers and internal stakeholders.  
**7. Security and compliance:** Support control mapping for SOC 2 and privacy requirements (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).  
**8. Migration and go-live:** Define data mapping, cutover, and rollback criteria for MVP customers. Own the GA readiness checklist and post-GA success metrics (activation, churn, time-to-first-insight).  
**9. Governance:** Manage requirements change control, the decision log, and risk inputs for the PM.

**Required Qualifications:**   
1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.  
2. 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with 3+ years on B2B SaaS or cloud platforms.  
3. Experience documenting multi-tenant systems, RBAC/SSO, or subscription billing.  
4. Strong skills in user stories, acceptance criteria, process modeling, and traceability.  
5. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, data schemas, and queue-based architectures; basic SQL.  
6. Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and a diagramming tool (Lucidchart, Visio, or draw.io).  
7. Experience with process modelling using BPMN or flow diagrams.  
8. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops with executives and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  
1. Drone, geospatial/GIS, or infrastructure inspection experience.  
2. Knowledge of computer-vision workflows (model versioning, confidence scores, human review).  
3. Experience with usage-based billing tools (Stripe Billing, Chargebee, Zuora).  
4. AWS or Azure fundamentals; exposure to SOC 2, GDPR, or CCPA.  
5. Prior experience with MVP-to-platform or customer-migration programs.  
6. CBAP, PMI-PBA, or CSPO/PSPO certification.

**Key Deliverables:**   
1. Documented business, functional, and non-functional requirements, with traceability to backlog items and test cases.  
2. Prioritized and groomed Jira backlog containing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.  
3. MVP-to-SaaS gap analysis and BPMN/UML process and data-flow models.  
4. Defined subscription plans, entitlements, usage-metering rules, proration, and overage requirements.  
5. UAT outcomes, GA readiness checklist, and MVP customer migration criteria.  
6. Decision log, requirements change-control records, and post-GA success metrics.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

description:

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron’s Data Center Workload Engineering team studies how real AI workloads use compute, memory, interconnects, and storage. We turn system-level measurements into insights that help build future Micron DRAM (DDR and LPDDR), HBM, CXL, and storage products.

  
  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

  
  

As a Principal AI Systems Performance Engineer, you will direct experiments on AI training, inference, and agentic workloads across complete server systems. You will pinpoint where bandwidth, capacity, latency, power, and data movement restrict performance—then convert your discoveries into product requirements and guidance for engineering, product, and customer teams. Your efforts will link current measurements with the demands of future AI infrastructure.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

  
  

* Develop and perform controlled, representative AI experiments on current and pre-production CPU-GPU systems, evaluating memory and storage performance, power, and thermal tradeoffs.
* Profile workloads from GPU memory through system memory, CXL-attached memory, storage, and interconnects; assess performance from node to cluster scale, including efficiency, latency, utilization, scalability, and tail behavior.
* Evaluate data placement, migration, prefetching, compression, and tiering approaches for KV cache, model state, and other AI data.
* Build and validate performance models, simulations, traces, and reusable benchmarking tools to forecast future system requirements.
* Lead cross-functional projects and transform outcomes into product requirements, develop recommendations, publications, demonstrations, and customer mentorship

---------------------------

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree with **at least 10 years of experience**; master’s degree with **5 or more years**; or Ph.D. with demonstrated experience in a related field.
* Hands-on experience profiling and benchmarking multi-GPU AI systems across single-node and multi-node environments.
* Understanding of transformer workloads, memory behavior, distributed systems, and agentic AI infrastructure.
* Experience with PyTorch, an AI serving platform, Python, and at least one of C, C++, CUDA, or Triton.
* Ability to lead controlled experiments and communicate results to technical and business audiences.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

  
  

* Experience with memory tiering, KV-cache management, or emerging AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and standardize EMIR methodology that applies consistently across all DRAM products, ensuring alignment, repeatability, and high-quality analysis outcomes
* Perform static and dynamic EM/IR analysis using RedHawk or Totem or other industry‑standard tools; identify root‑cause issues such as high‑resistance segments, insufficient via density, and decap deficiencies, and provide clear, actionable recommendations to design and layout teams.
* Actively leverage AI‑based tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks for effective Power-delivery-network (PDN) analysis.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the full EMIR flow—from netlist preparation, extraction, simulation, and debug to reporting and silicon correlation—and ensure accurate evaluation across operating modes and temperatures.
* Partner across design, timing, physical implementation, architecture, modeling, and verification teams to understand real switching behavior, develop worst‑case vectors, and standardize analysis expectations across global teams.
* Collaborate with cross-geographical teams and also EDA tool vendors to evaluate and improve EMIR methodologies, and document Best Known Methods (BKMs) to enhance consistency and correlation across DRAM teams.
* Develop and maintain dashboards to track EMIR results, monitor trends, and support signoff progression for multiple designs.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering.
* 4 - 8 years of experience in PDN / Power Integrity / EMIR analysis for advanced semiconductor or SoC designs.

You will run multiple concurrent projects end to end, from estimation and architecture through build, testing, regulatory sign-off and go-live, while keeping scope, schedule, cost and quality on track.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role. You will chair steering committees with bank CIOs, resolve microservices integration issues in architecture reviews, negotiate statements of work with systems integrators, and take AI and GPT initiatives from pilot to production in a regulated environment.

Delivery and governance

- Own 2 to 4 concurrent banking projects or programmes, typically USD 1-5 million each, across scope, schedule, cost and quality.

- Build delivery roadmaps, estimates, release plans and milestones with architecture, engineering, QA and business teams.

- Run programme governance: steering committees, status reporting, RAID logs, change control and stage-gate reviews.

- Ensure compliance with bank policies and UAE regulatory expectations, including CBUAE requirements, data residency and operational resilience.

- Own project financials: budgeting, forecasting, revenue recognition and margin protection.

Agile, vendors and resources

- Run Agile delivery using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe or hybrid models, and report velocity, predictability and cycle time.

- Manage systems integrators, product vendors and managed-service providers against SOWs, SLAs and KPIs.

- Plan and manage resource demand and supply across skills, pods and locations, including onshore and offshore teams.

Technical leadership

- Provide technical oversight on Azure-hosted, Java-based microservices platforms.

- Guide AI and GPT initiatives: Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio, retrieval-augmented generation with Azure AI Search, and intelligent document processing for KYC, onboarding and credit workflows.

- Ensure responsible AI delivery: data privacy, model governance, human-in-the-loop controls and auditability.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 10 to 15 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in project or programme management.

- Banking domain experience is mandatory: core banking, payments (SWIFT, ISO 20022, UAEFTS), cards, lending, trade finance, digital channels or regulatory reporting.

- UAE banking experience strongly preferred.

- Proven ownership of at least one project or programme of USD 1 million or more.

- Experience managing multiple projects, vendors and resources at the same time.

- Strong in governance, Agile delivery and stakeholder management.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

- Excellent written and spoken English; Arabic is an advantage.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- Azure: App Service, AKS, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Azure DevOps.

- Java: Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, REST and SOAP services.

- AI and GPT: Azure OpenAI, prompt engineering, RAG, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, responsible AI.

PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, SAFe (SPC or RTE), CSM or PSM, Microsoft Azure (AZ-305, AZ-104, AZ-400), Azure AI Engineer (AI-102) and TOGAF.

description:

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing OT Infrastructure Architect to support and enable the global Digital Factory Programme. The role will focus on designing, defining and supporting the deployment of secure, resilient and scalable IT/OT infrastructure solutions across global manufacturing sites.

The candidate should have strong expertise in both enterprise IT infrastructure and industrial OT environments, covering Compute, Hosting, Virtualisation, Network, Firewalls, Cybersecurity, Connectivity, Wireless, Edge Computing and Private 5G. The individual will work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, Cybersecurity and IT&D teams to translate Digital Factory requirements into infrastructure architectures and drive their implementation across different manufacturing environments.

A strong understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing applications, IT/OT convergence and OT cybersecurity standards is essential.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

· Define and design end-to-end IT/OT infrastructure architectures to enable Digital Factory and Smart Manufacturing capabilities across global manufacturing sites.

· Lead and support the deployment of manufacturing infrastructure covering Compute, Servers, Virtualisation, Storage, Backup, Network, Firewalls, Wireless, Connectivity and Edge Computing.

· Design secure and resilient OT network architectures, including industrial network segmentation, firewalls, remote access and IT/OT connectivity.

· Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including Industrial IoT, Private 5G, Edge Computing and cloud integration.

· Work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering and Automation teams to understand OT requirements and enable integration with industrial systems such as PLC, SCADA, MES and Historian.

· Provide technical leadership during technology selection, solution design, implementation, testing and operational handover.

Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Palo Alto PCNSE, VMware/Microsoft infrastructure certifications and ISA/IEC 62443 OT cybersecurity certifications.

· Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, Microsoft Azure Local, Windows/Linux and infrastructure platforms.

· Strong knowledge of Cisco networking, industrial LAN/WAN, wireless, network segmentation and firewall technologies such as Palo Alto.

· Understanding of industrial automation technologies, including PLC, HMI, SCADA, MES and industrial communication protocols.

· Experience with IT/OT integration, Industrial IoT, Edge Computing and Private 5G is desirable.

· Knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, particularly IEC 62443 and NIST.

· Experience leading infrastructure architecture and deployment across multiple manufacturing sites.

· Excellent stakeholder management, communication and technical leadership skills.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**Role :** QA Engineer

**Drone Analytics – Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform | MVP to GA**

**Experience:** 3–6 years in software QA with test automation.

**Stack: Playwright/Cypress, Postman/REST-assured, Pact, k6/JMeter, Stripe test clocks, FFmpeg, Docker, CI**

**Role Summary**

Own QA strategy and automation as the platform grows from MVP to GA, supporting increasing feature volume and beta adoption from January and April focus on tenant isolation, billing, media/GPU pipeline edge cases, performance, and customer migration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the test pyramid, quality gates, environments, test data, and release criteria.
* Build Playwright/Cypress UI automation and schema-validated API tests; parallelise execution in CI and add Pact contract tests.
* Automate cross-tenant access tests across UI, APIs, files, signed URLs, queues, and caches; cover SSO and RBAC permutations.
* Test billing scenarios including plan changes, proration, trials, failed payments, dunning, webhook retries, and usage metering using provider test clocks.
* Test media edge cases including corrupt, truncated, oversized, and unusual-codec files, missing telemetry, interrupted/resumed uploads, stream drops, and duplicates.
* Verify AI/GPU job lifecycle, retries, cancellation, idempotency, and golden-output correctness under GPU saturation.
* Validate MVP migration with reconciliation checks; run k6/JMeter load and soak tests against latency and error baselines.
* Triage beta defects, maintain regression packs, and report defect escape rate, flakiness, and coverage.

**Required Skills**

* 3–6 years in QA with strong automation (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium).
* API testing (Postman or equivalent); CI integration of tests.
* Performance testing basics (k6, JMeter or Locust).
* REST, JSON and browser dev tools; MongoDB/SQL queries for verification.

**Preferred Skills**

* SaaS billing/payment testing; media or data-pipeline testing with large files.
* Contract and basic security testing; testing AI products against golden sets.

**Key Deliverables**

Test strategy and release criteria; automated regression and smoke suites in CI; billing, tenancy, and pipeline edge-case packs; load-test reports; and beta quality dashboards.

**Education**

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

title: Director, Sales Analytics
description:
Hands-on Sales Analytics leader who turns Markets Sales growth opportunities into production analytics and AI/ML capabilities with clear KPI outcomes, strong governance, and senior stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Key role highlights**

* Commercial-impact role focused on measurable Sales outcomes (uplift, win-rate, pipeline velocity, wallet share, and coverage productivity).
* Hands-on expectation to code and prototype, contributing production-grade analytics/ML components (not only oversight).
* Own use-case pipeline from idea to scaled adoption, with KPI definition, testing/experimentation, and benefits tracking.
* Build on modern data/ML platforms (e.g., Databricks/Spark and Snowflake) with CI/CD, monitoring, and operational controls.
* Operate in a controlled environment with strong model governance (model risk, compliance, and controls).
* Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, Risk/Compliance, CDO/CTO, SMAD/Quants, and engineering to secure decisions and deliver outcomes.

**Purpose of the role -**
As Director - Sales Analytics, you will use data, analytics, and hands-on AI/ML to deliver measurable commercial impact across Markets Sales (e.g., revenue uplift, conversion/win rate, pipeline velocity, wallet-share growth, and coverage productivity). You will build a prioritised pipeline of high-value use cases across the opportunity lifecycle (e.g., targeting, next-best action, and coverage effectiveness) and take them from discovery through deployment and adoption using trusted data, strong model governance, and hands-on engineering. You will lead senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, Risk and Compliance, partnering with CDO/CTO, SMAD/Quants, and engineering/data teams to align priorities, secure decisions, and deliver outcomes.
  
  
  

* Key responsibilities
* Deliver Markets Sales commercial impact with hands-on analytics and AI/ML (uplift, win-rate, pipeline velocity, wallet share, coverage productivity).
* Build a prioritised use-case pipeline (targeting, next-best action, coverage effectiveness) and ship to production with KPI definition and tracking.
* Engineer end-to-end solutions, personally coding/prototyping critical components from data prep and features to modelling, productionisation, monitoring, and support.
* Operationalise analytics/ML with trusted data, model governance, and delivery controls (CI/CD, deployment, monitoring) on Databricks/Spark and Snowflake.
* Lead senior stakeholders (Sales, Product, Risk/Compliance, CDO/CTO, SMAD/Quants, engineering/data) to align priorities, secure decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Essential candidate skills
* Demonstrated ability to deliver analytics and AI/ML end-to-end, writing production-grade code from problem framing through build, deployment, and adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to engineer trusted data and features (quality, lineage, reusable metrics) using Python/SQL on Databricks/Spark and Snowflake.
* Demonstrated ability to apply engineering discipline to analytics/ML (Git, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD) to ship reliable changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise use cases with clear KPIs and run experiments that evidence commercial impact.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver at scale within governance (model risk, compliance, and controls).
* Desirable skills (optional)
* Markets Sales analytics use cases (targeting, next-best action, coverage effectiveness, pipeline) plus market data and pre/post-trade analytics; Kafka and dbt exposure a plus.
* Hands-on coding in Python, SQL, and PySpark for pipelines and production analytics/ML; Java/C++ or kdb+/q a bonus.
* MLOps in a controlled environment: MLflow, registry/versioning, CI/CD (GitLab/Jenkins), drift/performance monitoring, documentation.
* Data governance practices and tooling: data quality checks, lineage/metadata, access controls, and privacy-by-design (e.g., fine-grained controls such as Immuta or equivalent).
* Advanced analytics/AI (incl. GenAI where appropriate) for decision support, recommendations, or productivity.

**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Director Expectations**

* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.

All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  
  
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Data Specialist 1
description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are**
Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise helps us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build, and operate their assets more safely, sustainably, and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Data Specialist is responsible for processing field survey data and producing accurate charts, maps, and project reports in accordance with project specifications and Data Centre priorities. Working closely with the Data Centre Manager, Geophysicists, Surveyors, and Project Managers, this role ensures the timely execution of data archival, retrieval, and drafting workflows while maintaining strict data quality standards. Additionally, the Data Specialist I collaborates with field Party Chiefs on survey instructions and report content, supports continuous improvements to charting processes, and partners with IT to uphold data security, backup protocols, and system requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Verification & Planning Review survey data received from the field for completeness and quality and collaborate with the Data Centre Manager to define processing and drafting requirements and establish project processing plans.
* Multi-Sensor Data Processing & QC Perform onshore and offshore processing and Quality Control (QC) of vessel-acquired navigation, bathymetry, and specialized survey datasets, including ROV, AUV, Multibeam, Positioning, and Pipeline inspection/installation data.
* Data Integrity & Integration Manage the overall integrity of project datasets, including integrating third-party and as-built survey data.
* Drafting & Charting Execute drafting and mapping deliverables for assigned projects in strict compliance with Fugro charting standards.
* Technical Reporting & Standards Ensure the accuracy of processed survey outputs and technical data submitted for final project reports, while actively preparing and reviewing standard processing procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration Liaise closely with Geophysicists, Project Supervisors, Staff Surveyors, Party Chiefs, and Project/Business Line Managers (BLMs/PMs) to align on survey instructions, data quality, database needs, and workflow improvements.
* Data Archival & Security Maintain organized short- and long-term archives of survey results, charts, and reports, and coordinate with the IT-Manager on data backups, security audits, and software/hardware/networking requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum of 4–8 years of relevant experience.
* Analytical thinker with a proactive, agile approach to troubleshooting data and workflow challenges.
* Dedicated team player with a strong client-centric mindset focused on delivering accurate, timely project outcomes.
* Self-motivated professional who takes initiative, acts with confidence, and delivers results independently under minimal supervision.
* Strong communicator who promotes open dialogue across the organization, empowers and connects others with positive energy, and leads with passion, trust, and respect.

By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. Which should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye, and your can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.

At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge, and talents gives us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behavior, and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. This role functions as a mid-level engineering position. **Key Responsibilities**
The selected professional will support the delivery of Black & Veatch’s Monitoring & Diagnostic (M&D) services.
  
  
M&D services is enabled by Asset360® software which is a data‑analytics‑driven software and services platform that enables owners and operators of conventional generation, renewable generation, power distribution systems, water treatment facilities, industrial assets and similar infrastructure to monitor and enhance asset performance, reliability and health. The platform helps diagnose equipment reliability and performance issues, optimize operations, and support integrated planning and forecasting.

* Coal‑fired units

**Remote Monitoring & Diagnostics**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Support adoption and effective use of Asset360® tools and workflows.

**Plant Performance Audits & Testing**

* Pattern recognition in operational data

* Experience supporting long-duration outages, shutdowns, or major maintenance events.

title: Lead Risk Management
description:
Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can. We believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.
  
  
**About Capco**
Capco is a global business, data and technology consultancy, focused on the Financial Services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.
  
  
**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
* Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
* Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
* Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit financial risk transformation candidates into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance (FRRF) capability.
  
  
Successful candidates will
  
  

* Develop a holistic understanding of portfolio evolution across different Securitization asset verticals, regions and product types within the current portfolio.
* Produce forward-looking portfolio intelligence, identifying emerging portfolio trends, vulnerabilities and opportunities
* Provide independent challenge to portfolio strategy and portfolio construction decisions.
* Identify emerging structural risks affecting securitisation markets.
* Produce strategic portfolio intelligence, insights and recommendations that support strategic decision making by senior management
* Work collaboratively with 1LOD PM team (Credit & Asset Mgmt. Team) to evaluate strategic portfolio actions.
* Independently assess proposed portfolio optimization, hedging and de-risking initiatives.
* Analyse portfolio construction and diversification across products, asset verticals, geographies, industrial sectors and counterparties.
* Identify/complement 1LOD to detect opportunities to improve portfolio resilience, capital efficiency and risk adjusted returns.
* Portfolio Risk Measurement Architecture – Development & Ownership in collaboration with 1LOD PM team
* Conduct structured portfolio deep-dives by asset class (ABS, RMBS, CLO, SPF etc.).
* Surveillance and reporting of portfolio migration trends (ratings, delinquencies, collateral performance, covenant metrics, leverage trends, RWA utilization, structural and counterparty trends…).
* Assess early warning signals (EWS) and trigger governance escalation where required – transaction level as well as asset vertical, industrial sector, securitization product, country, and regional level.
* Undertake Quarterly Portfolio Review of third-party financing book (deck preparation, analytical inputs in liaison with 1LOD and 2LOD, SCOs, presentation to QPR Committee, minutes preparation).
* Quarterly production of Securitisation Credit Dashboard a
* Involved in advising on risk frameworks and controls, and delivering transformation across the Risk functions of our clients, in support of their Chief Risk Officers (CRO). This includes implementation of regulatory changes (e.g. Basel, IFRS9, BCBS-239, FTRB), delivery of data to support IRB and VaR modelling, and automation of risk controls, control gap assessment and control implementation.

**The Types Of Projects We Cover Are**

* Our clients are predominantly within Financial Services and look for support in delivering solutions to improve risk management practices and control frameworks. This may include Risk Assessments, Target Operating Model design and implementation, Risk Rating Methodologies and Models, Gap Analysis, data and reporting
* Gap analysis and implementation of regulatory changes and remediation of identified issues
* Identification and implementation of technology and data solutions to support credit, market, liquidity, and capital risk management processes.
* As a Risk Management SME at Capco, you may be required to communicate risk policies and processes for an organisation, develop risk models involving market, credit, liquidity, capital and/or operational risk, ensure controls are operating effectively, and provide research and analytical support.
* You will also be encouraged to support Capco in client account planning, business development and relationship building / networking within the FRRF capability and Capco Domains. This may include contributions to Capco’s Risk Management thought leadership and client campaigns.

**Skills And Expertise**
The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience and will be able to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Good knowledge of regulatory requirements around Basel, FRTB, IFRS9, BCBS-239 etc with specific focus on credit, market, liquidity and capital risks.
* Experience analysing, defining solutions and implementing regulatory change, including remediation of gaps
* Ability to evaluate the client’s current risk management processes (e.g. analyse potential impacts of key current and emerging risks, trends, reports, statistics, and relevant documentation)
* Define and implement risk management process improvements and track benefit realisation
* Experience analysing controls and conducting structured control testing – including design of control frameworks for financial risk management
* Facilitate risk conversations between different departments within organisations (e.g. client-facing businesses, credit risk, operational risk, legal, IT, finance, and operations teams)

This will be coupled with strong change management experience and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Designing solutions, delivering on client assignments and owning delivery of projects.
* Ensuring management information is provided to, and easily understood by, programme leads, senior management and client committees.
* Defining and managing monitoring processes for financial risks.
* Building assurance and control capabilities in line with regulatory expectations and risk appetite.
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholders from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and sales activities with the capability and client accounts.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.
* Develop, drive and convert a pipeline of opportunities and lead on RFP responses.
* Fulfil a key role in account and proposition development within Market Domains and Key Client Accounts, assisting senior management to increase revenue.
* Formulate propositions and solutions that meet client requirements in addition to managing and directing pursuit activity.
* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest financial services firms in the world, addressing our clients’ biggest challenges.

  2+ years
* **Primary Focus:**
  CRM Data Management, Sales Pipeline Data Quality, and Reporting
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* **Work Schedule:**
  Must maintain 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.
* **Work Arrangement:**
  Hybrid.
* **Location**
  : Mumbai

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.
* Document recurring data issues and recommend process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting workflows.
* Support consistent CRM practices across NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other approved platforms.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with Growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership.
* Communicate data quality issues and follow up on corrective actions.
* Guide CRM users on data entry standards and opportunity management procedures.
* Ensure stakeholders follow established CRM data quality requirements.

* Experience in CRM data entry, cleanup, auditing, or quality assurance.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.

Desired Qualifications

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including:
* Filtering and sorting large datasets.
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and other lookup functions.
* Pivot tables.
* Data validation and cleanup.
* Understanding of sales pipeline stages, forecasting, lead attribution, and opportunity ownership.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, accounting, or advisory organizations.
* Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and reporting tools.
* Experience using AI, automation, or data analysis tools to improve data quality and operational workflows.

* The ability to accommodate with international time zone is essential

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About the Opportunity**

At
**Taglynk**
, we partner with category-defining startups to build their core product and engineering teams. We are currently hiring a
**Senior Product Manager**
for one of our premier clients—a fast-growing, dynamic consumer healthcare startup revolutionizing how individuals and families manage their personal and family health.

Our client is building a trusted ecosystem offering high-quality, personalized healthcare options, credible medical content, and uncompromising data privacy. You will play a pivotal role in their growth journey by owning a core product charter end-to-end.

**The Role**

You will take complete ownership of one of the core product charters—defining a distinct part of the product, driving user outcomes, and steering the roadmap from problem discovery to launch alongside a dedicated squad of designers and engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Your Charter’s Direction:**
  Set the product strategy and roadmap, ruthlessly prioritize what matters now versus later, and align stakeholders on the "why."
* **Problem Before Solution:**
  Conduct deep user research, analyze behavioral data, and define sharp problem statements rather than jumping straight to feature lists.
* **Ship with the Team:**
  Author crisp PRDs and user flows that engineers and designers can execute against; stay closely embedded through grooming, build, and release.
* **Drive Outcomes, Not Output:**
  Define clear success metrics for every launch, instrument tracking, analyze post-launch learnings, and iterate rapidly.
* **Build Safe, Compliant Health Products:**
  Operate seamlessly within healthcare guardrails—covering data privacy, user consent, clinical safety, and health content standards—to design for high user trust.
* **Shape Shared Foundations:**
  Collaborate with fellow PMs across interconnected charters on shared user flows, design components, and product team best practices.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Proven Product Ownership:**
  6–8 years of experience in product management with a strong track record of owning a consumer-facing product area end-to-end.
* **AI & Agentic Product Experience:**
  Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered or agentic features to production (beyond prototypes). You know how to design around model limitations through output testing, human-in-the-loop review, and strict safety guardrails for health use cases, and you actively use AI tools in your daily workflow.
* **Technical Fluency:**
  Strong grasp of systems, APIs, and data models to debate architectural trade-offs with engineers, spot hidden complexity, and write rock-solid specs (no specific technical degree required).
* **Sharp User Judgment & Design Sense:**
  Ability to uncover the real job-to-be-done behind user requests, turn ambiguous research into decisive action, and collaborate closely with designers in Figma on fine-grained UX details.
* **Data-Driven Mindset:**
  Comfortable setting up event tracking, analyzing funnels and dashboards (e.g., Mixpanel), and letting evidence guide decisions.
* **High Ownership in Ambiguity:**
  You frame unstructured problems, make confident calls, course-correct quickly, and stay hands-on with specs and sprint grooming.
* **Crisp Communication:**
  Your PRDs, strategy docs, and stakeholder updates are concise, structured, and actionable.

**Bonus / Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in
  **Indian Healthtech**
  —specifically around personal health records (PHR), care coordination, or consumer health.
* Working familiarity with healthcare interoperability and standards such as
  **ABDM, FHIR, or SNOMED CT**
  .
* Practical understanding of
  **India’s DPDP Act**
  or broader health data privacy frameworks.
* Personal empathy for the problem space—having acted as the primary health manager for your own family or closely supported someone who does.

**Why Apply Through Taglynk?**

* **Direct Access:**
  Fast-tracked interview process directly with the founding and product leadership team.
* **Dedicated Representation:**
  End-to-end guidance, role insights, and interview prep from Taglynk’s specialist tech recruitment team.

*(To apply, share your updated resume along with a brief note on an AI or consumer product charter you’ve owned end-to-end.)*

Manage dependencies with IT and external partners.

* Data governance: Keep metric definitions, data quality, documentation, access and security consistent, working with data owners, the Data Platform and Governance team, and IT.
* Adoption and value: Plan adoption for each major product with business champions, training and feedback. Track usage and decision impact, improve or retire low-use outputs, and confirm benefits with business owners.

Data science and analytical review
  
  

* Working knowledge of hypothesis testing, sampling, bias, confidence intervals and correlation versus causation.

Data, BI and platform landscape
  
  

* Understanding of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, MLflow and Power BI.

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. MBA or master's in analytics or data science preferred.
* Experience: 6+ years in data, analytics or BI roles, including leading or coordinating a team across data engineering, BI and data science.
* Business exposure: Has worked with senior stakeholders and delivered analytics that changed a decision or process.
* Adoption: Evidence of sustained use of analytics products and their contribution to business outcomes.
* Certifications: Databricks, Azure, Power BI or data science certification is desirable.

* Sets clear priorities and standards while letting team members own delivery.
* Challenges with evidence and builds trust across Business Units through clarity and sound judgement.

6–8 years

We specialize in the design and integration of innovative IM/DD optics and silicon photonic platforms that enable customers to deploy industry-leading optical technologies within data center with unprecedented speed, capacity, and reliability. Come join us and take part in shaping S1O’s ground-breaking optical solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most advanced pluggable, and Co-packaged Optics (CPO) being developed in the industry.
  
  
You will work with Cisco's best-in-class Silicon Photonics team. Our team is responsible for driving the development and optimization of optical transceivers& modules (800G,1.6T& beyond) that seamlessly integrate with Cisco's routing, switching, and datacenter platforms, enabling customers to build scalable, high-performance networks that support emerging technologies including AI/ML workloads, and next-generation data center architectures.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Physical Design Technical Leader to guide our engineering team and drive physical implementation for Cisco's next-generation silicon photonics driver and receiver ICs, powering 100G, 200G, and 400G-per-lambda Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) and optical engine solutions. In this high-impact role, you will lead the physical design strategy and execution for high-performance silicon integrating sophisticated digital control logic, CPU subsystems, high-speed standard interfaces (UCIe), and ultra-fast transmit/receive data-paths in groundbreaking process nodes (TSMC sub-5nm/3nm/2nm).
  
  
As a Technical Leader, you will own block-level and full-chip physical implementation from synthesis through final tape-out (TO) while advising, mentoring, and scaling a team of physical design engineers. You will establish advanced physical design methodologies, drive floor-planning, place& route, low-skew clock and power distribution, multi-corner timing closure (STA), EM/IR integrity, and DRC/LVS physical verification sign-off. Additionally, you will partner closely with Architecture, Analog Front-End, Layout, and Photonic packaging teams to ensure first-pass silicon success and drive breakthrough execution across the complete product lifecycle from concept to production.
  
  
•
  
**Technical& People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and technically steer a team of physical design engineers, driving task allocations, schedule tracking, and design reviews.
  
  
•
  
**Full-Flow Ownership:** Own full-chip and hierarchical block-level RTL-to-GDSII implementation and sign-off on advanced nodes.
  
  
•
  
**Methodology& Flow Innovation:** Architect robust, automated backend flows (Innovus / Fusion Compiler, Pegasus / Calibre, Voltus / RedHawk) to boost team productivity and tapeout predictability.
  
  
•
  
**Multi-functional Collaboration:** Serve as the primary physical design communicate with Analog Design, Custom Layout, Package Co-Design, and Foundry partners.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
•
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in electrical engineering, Electronics& Communication or related field with minimum 12+ years of Industry experience
  
  
•
  
8+ years of physical design (PD) experience delivering ASIC/SoC designs in sophisticated CMOS technology nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm/2nm)
  
  
•
  
Proven experience driving the full RTL-to-GDSII flow at block and/or full-chip level-including hierarchical floor-planning, power grid design, place& route (P), clock tree synthesis (CTS), timing closure, and physical verification sign-off.
  
  
•
  
Strong proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools (Innovus/ICC2/Fusion, Tempus/PrimeTime, Voltus/RedHawk, Calibre/Pegasus etc.)
  
  
•
  
Strong scripting proficiency in Tcl, Python, Bash, or Perl for flow automation, quality of results (QoR) tracking, and efficiency improvements
  
  
•
  
Ability to lead a team of PD engineers& work collaboratively with globally dispersed multi-functional teams
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
•
  
**Education:** Master's degree (M.S. / M.Tech) in Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, or Microelectronics.
  
  
•
  
**Experience:** 12-15+ years of ASIC/SoC physical implementation experience with multiple successful tape-outs in ground-breaking process nodes (sub-5nm, 3nm, or 2nm GAA/nanosheet).
  
  
•
  
**Technical Team Leadership:** Consistent record of leading physical design project execution, defining schedules, conducting design reviews, and driving tapeout readiness for a team of PD engineers.
  
  
•
  
**Mixed-Signal& High-Speed IP Integration:** Strong experience handling floorplanning and noise isolation for sensitive mixed-signal macros, high-speed SerDes, Die-to-Die (D2D / UCIe) interfaces, CPU subsystems, and 2.5D/3D packaging environments.
  
  
•
  
**Front-End / Equivalence Flows:** Familiarity with logic synthesis (Cadence Genus / Synopsys Design Compiler) and formal equivalence checking (Cadence LEC / Synopsys Formality).
  
  
•
  
**Post-Silicon Correlation:** Experience supporting silicon bring-up and correlating pre-silicon timing/power models with post-silicon lab measurements.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering

**The Opportunity**

We’re seeking a Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering to set AI-enabled engineering direction across platform and product. This role focuses on practical patterns and tooling - including agent-based approaches - that improve how teams build, test, release and operate software. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, operations and Risk, InfoSec and compliance to embed AI responsibly in production with the right controls and operational readiness. A key part of the remit is delivering AI-enabled improvements across Product Control and Valuation control workflows such as IPV, price testing and breaks and exceptions. You’ll also strengthen developer experience through better tooling, automation and self-service. Success means scalable patterns that teams adopt easily with measurable improvements in quality, productivity, reliability and risk outcomes.

**What you'll be doing**

* Set AI-enabled engineering patterns and agent-based tooling approaches that improve SDLC outcomes across teams
* Embed AI capabilities into production services with appropriate controls, operational readiness and explainability where relevant
* Strengthen developer experience through developer tooling, CI/CD optimisation, test automation, observability standards and self-service enablement
* Standardise evaluation of AI proof of concepts then run pilots with clear measures across quality, productivity, reliability and risk
* Industrialise successful pilots into reusable components, templates, accelerators and golden path implementations for squads to adopt
* Govern architecture and technical design through reviews and trade-offs across resilience, performance, maintainability, security, cost and pace
* Embed secure-by-default delivery by automating IT controls and evidence capture in engineering patterns and CI/CD pipelines
* Advance AI-enabled delivery in Product Control and Valuation controls including audit-ready evidence capture, lineage, approval trails and repeatable checks
* Establish data quality and reconciliation patterns to validate valuation inputs, detect anomalies and automate reconciliations to reduce manual effort

**What we're looking for**

* Bring substantial hands-on software engineering experience within complex enterprise or financial-services environments
* Demonstrate experience operating as a senior technical individual contributor such as Senior Technical Lead, Principal Engineer or Lead Developer
* Build reference implementations and reusable engineering assets that squads can adopt with minimal friction
* Apply strong software engineering fundamentals across design patterns, data structures, algorithms and system architecture
* Implement AI-enabled software engineering approaches at scale including agent-based and AI tooling across build, test, release and run
* Establish end-to-end evaluation approaches from proof of concept to production with measurement frameworks and operational readiness
* Design and deliver cloud-native architectures on platforms such as GCP or AWS with scalable modular patterns
* Automate IT control compliance within products and CI/CD pipelines and operate effectively in audit-ready environments
* Partner effectively across engineering, product, architecture, operations and Risk, InfoSec and compliance with clear written and verbal communication

**Building audit-ready AI engineering**

If you want to shape how AI is applied to real production engineering problems - with the controls and evidence needed in a regulated environment - this role offers the scope to make that impact. You’ll set direction that improves developer experience and delivery outcomes across teams not just within a single squad. You’ll also help modernise valuation control workflows through automation, stronger data quality patterns and measurable operational improvements. Apply to join HSBC and help turn AI experimentation into repeatable, trusted engineering practices at scale.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

**Position Description**
------------------------

We are seeking a mid-career domain specialist embedded in Bridgenext's financial services practice, focused on the US wealth management space. Works alongside solution architects and delivery teams to bring functional depth to pre-sales pursuits and active deliveries. Brings working knowledge of US wealth platforms, data flows, and regulatory context to shape better solutions and win more deals.

  

Responsibilities:

  

* **Domain Support in Pre-Sales:** Participate in discovery calls, RFP responses, and solution workshops — contribute functional knowledge of US wealth operations to shape proposals and demos.

* **Requirements & Functional Design:** Lead business requirements gathering, write functional specs, map current-state vs. future-state workflows for wealth clients (onboarding, portfolio management, reporting, compliance).

* **Platform Knowledge:** Bring working knowledge of US wealth platforms — Tamarac (CRM, rebalancing, reporting), Salesforce FSC, Orion, Advent/APX — to inform solution design and integration strategy.

* **Data Analysis & Documentation:** Support data-related workstreams — help define data models, map data flows between custodians/platforms/reporting tools, document data quality issues and governance gaps.

* **Client Interaction:** Participate in and occasionally lead client workshops, UAT reviews, and business process walkthroughs with client stakeholders.

* **Thought Leadership:** Contribute to internal knowledge base — document domain patterns, build reusable artifacts, assist with POVs and whitepapers.

* **Delivery Involvement:** Act as a functional anchor on project teams — validate that what's being built reflects how wealth firms actually operate.

  

**Must Have Skills:**

  

* 6–9 years of experience — either from the US wealth industry (operations, compliance, technology at an RIA, broker-dealer, custodian, or wealth tech firm) or from IT services consulting serving US wealth clients.

* Solid working knowledge of the US wealth ecosystem — understands the RIA/broker-dealer distinction, custodian models (Schwab, Fidelity, Pershing), advisor workflows, and regulatory basics (SEC, FINRA, Reg BI).

* Hands-on experience with at least 2–3 of: Envestnet | Tamarac, Salesforce FSC, Orion, Black Diamond, Advent/APX, Redtail, Morningstar.

* Data awareness — understands how wealth data flows (custodial feeds, account aggregation, portfolio accounting to reporting). Can read a data model, identify gaps, and work with engineering teams on data requirements.

* Experience in at least 2–3 full project lifecycles involving US wealth clients.

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Salesforce FSC configuration or functional consulting experience.

* Familiarity with custodial data feeds and integration patterns (Plaid, Yodlee, MX).

* Understanding of GIPS, Form ADV, 13F, or other regulatory reporting.

* Awareness of AI/ML use cases in wealth — next-best-action, risk profiling, GenAI in investment research.

* CFA Level 1/2, CFP candidate, or Series 65/66.

* Familiarity with BI/reporting tools — Tableau, Power BI in a wealth context.

* Prior experience building domain knowledge bases or reusable frameworks at a services firm.

  
  

**Professional Skills:**

* Solid written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Strong team and individual player
* Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
* High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
* Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
--------------------------

The **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** is a trusted technical advisor and primary account contact for key Dynatrace customers, accountable for platform success, adoption, and long-term value in complex, large-scale environments. This is a senior, enterprise-focused role that combines technical depth, business understanding, and account management. The TAM owns the overall technical relationship and is the single point of accountability between the customer and Dynatrace.

The TAM is the named owner of a defined set of Success deliverables, including platform health reviews, support case management, change window coverage, version lifecycle planning, and enhancement request advocacy, scaled to the customer’s support tier. The role is not support-centric or project-limited. It requires strong technical judgment, executive presence, and ownership across long-running engagements, and it operates at the highest tier of the Dynatrace Success offering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Success Planning:** Maintain a success plan tied to customer business objectives and manage end-to-end service delivery.
* **Technical Advisory:** Act as primary technical authority on architecture, platform health reviews, and guidance through platform transitions and modernization.
* **Adoption & Optimization:** Drive adoption through enablement plans, new use cases, and best practices.
* **Consumption & Value:** Monitor usage and consumption and recommend actions that deliver measurable outcomes.
* **Executive Engagement:** Deliver QBRs and executive checkpoints that align Dynatrace capabilities to business goals.
* **Risk & Escalation:** Identify and escalate risks before they impact the customer.
* **Internal Advocacy:** Represent the customer across Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
* **Operational Excellence:** Run environment evaluations and new-release reviews, coordinate customer events (e.g., Dynadays, workshops), and help establish a Dynatrace center of excellence and governance model.
* **Support Case Reviews:** Review open and recent cases to spot trends, speed resolution, prevent recurrence, and act as the escalation point.
* **Enhancement Requests:** Guide customers in submitting feature requests and advocate for their prioritization with Product Management.
* **Change Window Support:** Provide coverage during planned changes, upgrades, and migrations.
* **After-Hours & Event Support:** Provide planned on-call coverage for critical moments such as major retail events and product launches, with reasonable advance notice.
* **Cadenced Meetings:** Lead recurring account and success meetings (weekly at Signature tier).

**What will help you succeed**
------------------------------

* Deep, hands‑on technical expertise with the Dynatrace platform and enterprise observability architectures.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to define, communicate, and manage success plans, including clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes aligned to customer objectives.
* Strong understanding of modern application stacks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud‑native technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Proven ability to operate independently as a senior technical advisor in high‑visibility customer situations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to executive audiences.
* Strong capability to coordinate and influence cross‑functional teams (Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales) without direct authority.
* Experience proactively identifying and managing program risks, escalation paths, and recovery plans in complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to balance strategic planning and hands‑on execution in high‑ambiguity, high‑visibility customer situations.
* Skilled in executive‑level program communication, including status reporting, expectation setting, and outcome‑based progress reviews (e.g., QBRs, steering meetings).
* Track record of driving accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and outcomes are delivered as planned.
* Demonstrated experience delivering within a structured, tiered customer success or support framework, with the ability to adapt engagement depth, meeting cadence, and deliverable scope to match contracted service levels.
* Experience owning case management and escalation resolution on behalf of enterprise customers, including trend analysis, cross-team coordination, and driving cases to closure within agreed SLAs.
* Proven ability to support customers through high-stakes production changes, upgrades, and maintenance windows, including cutover planning, real-time issue response, and post-change validation.
* Hands-on experience integrating observability platforms with ITSM and CMDB tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), with a solid understanding of how enterprises change management processes operate in production environments.
* Prior experience acting as a long‑term technical owner for strategic accounts (Preferred).
* History of influencing outcomes across teams without formal authority (Preferred).
* Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving role definitions (pilot or transformation experience) (Preferred).

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**
----------------------------------------

* Dynatrace is a leader in **unified observability** and **security** .
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with **Dynatrace Intelligence** —the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

**Note to Recruiters and Agencies** : Thank you for your interest in Dynatrace. Please note that **we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes** —do not forward them via our website or directly to Dynatrace employees. Dynatrace will not pay fees for unsolicited resumes, and any resumes received this way will be considered the property of Dynatrace.

**Benefits and work-life perks**
