title: Principal Engineer — Python is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

We are seeking an experienced **Principal Software Engineer** to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

#### **Requirements**

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles.

  
  

We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
* Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
* Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
* Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
* Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
* Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
* Deep, expert-level proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), object-oriented design, collections, memory management, and multithreading/concurrency models
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade microservices using the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
* Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Kafka and Event-Driven Architecture, including topic design, consumer groups, offset management, message serialization, and event streaming patterns
* Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs
* Strong database skills working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) including query optimization, indexing, and transactions, as well as document stores (e.g., MongoDB)
* Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, caching strategies, and resilient design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, Outbox, Retry/Backoff)
* Hands-on experience with automated unit and integration testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
* Familiarity with containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift) and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
* Exposure to Kotlin is a significant advantage
* Demonstrated technical leadership, excellent analytical and debugging skills, and strong verbal and written communication abilities
  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  
  

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**
----------------------------------------

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

title: Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Associate
description:
Locations: **Mumbai, India; Gurgaon, India**

Additional Locations: **Gurugram, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Your team**

  
  

Aladdin Data builds and supports data solutions that enable teams to organize, understand, and use data effectively across the platform. The team works across structured, unstructured, and graph data, connecting information into meaningful business domains and broader enterprise data models.

  
  

**Your role and impact**

  
  

As a Data Engineer within Aladdin Data, you will build scalable data solutions and develop strong data models that connect technology with business context. You will work across the data lifecycle, from pipeline development and modeling through performance optimization and production, while taking ownership of ambiguous technical problems and translating business concepts into effective data solutions.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**

  
  

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products.
* Design data models across structured, unstructured, and graph data.
* Organize data into well-defined business domains and connect them into a broader enterprise ontology.
* Understand business processes through data and translate business concepts into well-designed data solutions.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of data workloads.
* Independently investigate problems and own solutions from design through production.
  

  

**Your experience**

  
  

* Strong hands-on knowledge of Snowflake, including performance, warehouse utilization, cost optimization, and capabilities such as Snowpipe, Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables, and Cortex services.
* Experience building data solutions using Structured Query Language (SQL), dbt, and Python/Snowpark.
* Experience building and operating data orchestration pipelines using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing, Prefect, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, including entities, relationships, domains, and semantic models; familiarity with graph databases, knowledge graphs, and ontologies is beneficial.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity independently and understand the business context represented by the data.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases and exposure to data platforms supporting artificial intelligence, search, or retrieval-based applications is beneficial.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Data Scientist (ML) - 3 to 5 years
description:
**Job Description**
**PhonePe is seeking a highly analytical and driven Data Scientist to join our team. This role requires a minimum of one year of professional experience and a robust foundation in scalable machine learning implementations.**
**The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in designing and deploying sophisticated models and reusable ML frameworks that improve productivity and help drive strategic business initiatives.**
**Core Responsibilities**
**Framework & Platform Development: Design, build, and deploy reusable machine learning frameworks (e.g., config-driven modeling platforms) that generalize across multiple business use cases, rather than one-off model builds — enabling horizontal use cases to be onboarded without rebuilding the pipeline each time.**
**Model Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning models and frameworks across diverse environments, encompassing offline batch processing, real-time online systems, and edge computing architectures, with a strong emphasis on production deployment and operationalization.**
**Horizontal Engineering Partnership: Act as the point of contact with horizontal engineering teams building shared Data Science infrastructure such as implementing new capabilities, communicating Data Science requirements, and validating that a platform usability and maturity before rolling it out broadly to the larger data science team. Work with the Data Engineering team on communicating storage and warehousing requirements, and help create development environments usable across Data Science workflows, standardizing common pipelines rather than letting usage splinter across teams.**
**Model Deployment & Serving: Maintain working knowledge of how model deployment works internally (e.g., Docker, MLflow serving), and act as the point of contact with the engineering team that builds the platform for online scoring/model deployment, ensuring Data Science requirements are reflected in the platform's roadmap.**
**Advanced Data Quality Monitoring : Conduct rigorous analysis of complex, high-volume datasets to extract actionable insights and inform strategic business decisions. Identify problems with data ingestion, data quality, severity of issues, and downstream impact on models and workflows using the data.**
**Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define core challenges and formulate robust, data-driven solutions, including identifying where a common framework can serve multiple teams instead of a team-specific model.**
**Technical Communication: Synthesize and present complex quantitative findings, methodologies, and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical executive stakeholders.**
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
* Experience: A minimum of 3 to 5 years of professional experience in a Data Scientist or ML Engineer capacity, with a track record of deploying machine learning algorithms and/or ML frameworks into production environments.
* Core Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
* MLOps & Infrastructure: Familiarity with model lifecycle management tools (e.g., MLflow), model deployment/serving fundamentals (e.g., Docker, MLflow serving), CI/CD for ML pipelines, and modern database architectures.
* Analytical Foundations: Deep conceptual and practical understanding of traditional machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling, linear algebra, and probability theory
* Programming & Tools: Working knowledge of Java and experience with version control and CI/CD systems (Git).
* Engineering for Scale: Experience building reusable, config-driven or plugin-based systems (as opposed to single-purpose models), with an eye toward adaptability across use cases.
* Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical reasoning, with the ability to operate independently and navigate ambiguous data challenges.
* Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, tailored to diverse professional audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications & Technical Competencies**
**Candidates possessing the following supplementary skills will be given strong consideration:**

* Big Data & Distributed Computing: Deep knowledge and practical experience with PySpark and other big data processing frameworks.
* Deep Learning: Proficiency leveraging neural network frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Computer Vision: Working knowledge of Computer Vision concepts and algorithms.

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Revenue Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for monitoring, managing, and maintaining group and transient inventories to ensure the most effective and efficient balance between demand and availability in the hotel; continuing efforts to deliver outstanding guest service and financial profitability. As a
**Revenue Analyst**
, you’re not just analyzing pricing and demand to maximize revenue – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Manage inventory and pricing: Review and adjust room accommodations, rate inventory, and group cut-off dates based on demand trends
* Optimize sellout strategies: Collaborate with Front Office leadership to implement sellout strategies and ensure daily inventory balance
* Lead revenue management meetings: Conduct weekly meetings to evaluate booking trends, pricing strategies, and market opportunities
* Analyze performance and adjust strategies: Monitor key revenue reports, analyze booking pace, and refine strategies based on performance insights
* Develop pricing strategies: Establish and maintain annual transient pricing to ensure consistency across all booking channels
* Forecast revenue and demand: Prepare and refine weekly, monthly, and annual revenue forecasts to anticipate demand and maximize revenue
* Monitor market trends: Track competitor pricing, demand indicators, and market events to inform pricing and inventory decisions

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality revenue analyst role is preferred.
* Degree in Hospitality, Business, Finance, or related field.
* Strong ability to analyze data, forecast demand, and optimize pricing strategies.
* Skilled in revenue management systems (RMS), Excel, and hotel property management systems (PMS).
* Understanding of market trends, competitor analysis, and distribution channels.
* Clear and effective communication with stakeholders across departments.
* Making: Strategic thinker with a results-driven mindset.
* Prior experience in revenue management or hotel operations preferred.

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

  in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; or UGC NET-qualified with a relevant Masters degree in the respective field.

* Proven experience in teaching, training, mentoring, research, or building and deploying AI/ML solutions.

* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and developing students into industry-ready technology professionals.

* Expert-level Python programming.
* Strong proficiency with data science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
* Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Strong SQL and data handling skills.
* Understanding of MLOps practices and tools including Git, Docker, and cloud platforms such as AWS/GCP/Azure.

* Collaboration and academic leadership skills.
* Ability to simplify and explain complex technical concepts.

* Handling a team.

quality validation, and data model management across a wide range of enterprise and industrial data
  
  
sources.

deployments, and software delivery practices . The engineer will work closely with client stakeholders,
  
  
data owners, domain experts, software development teams, and solution architects to ensure high -
  
  
quality data foundations that enable successful deployment of SLB digital solutions such as OptiFlow
  
  
and OptiSite .

development.

practices.

Cognite Data Fusion .

or a related technical discipline.

related fields.

description:

We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

description:
**FDE**
is a new kind of role, for us and for the market. You’ll sit close to the client, understand how their contracting and procurement processes actually run, and build AI agents and LLM-based solutions that fix what’s broken. You’ll own it from the first conversation to production.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead AI transitions on the ground, moving client workflows from manual or legacy delivery to agent-led delivery in production.

* Measure results after go-live, tune the solution, and bring what you learn back into AOS and our transition playbooks.

* **Prompt engineering:**

You also bring:

* **Customer-facing experience:**
  You’ve worked directly with business stakeholders and can turn a business problem into a working system solution.
* **Agent building:**
  You’ve built AI agents and orchestrators, ideally deployed through to production.
* **Transition mindset:**
  You’re comfortable with change on the client side, including process redesign, user adoption and the move from pilot to steady state.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to agentic platforms such as Leah, Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow AI Agents, UiPath or similar.
* Experience with AI transformation, automation or managed-services transition programmes.

**Why join**

* Be part of a role that’s being defined right now, with real client impact from day one.
* Lead AI transitions at the intersection of AI, legal and procurement.
* Help shape AOS as it develops, with your field experience feeding directly into the platform.
* Grow with a team that’s scaling fast.

deployment.

relationships.
  
  
SLB-Private

lifecycle.

systems.

audiences.
  
  

* Collaborate closely with software developers, architects, project managers, and customer

teams.

development.
  
  

* Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and deployment

practices.
  
  

* Ensure data structures support current and future application requirements.
* Support cloud - based deployment and operational activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of deployment methodologies and standards.
* Continuous Learning & Innovation
* Stay current with new capabilities, updates, and best practices of OptiFlow, OptiSite, &

Cognite Data Fusion .
  
  

* Rapidly learn and adopt emerging platform features and deployment approaches.
* Evaluate new technologies and tools that improve deployment efficiency and data quality.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and capability development initiatives.

or a related technical discipline.

title: Siebel Techno / Functional Consultant
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Siebel Engineer**
to lead the technical data migration and integration effort from our legacy Oracle Siebel environment to Salesforce. You will act as the crucial bridge between our legacy on-premises system and our new cloud architecture, working alongside Salesforce Architects, business analysts, and functional teams to ensure seamless data integrity and zero-downtime cutover.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Mapping & Transformation: Analyze the legacy Siebel data model (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Service Requests, Assets) and map it to standard and custom Salesforce objects. Define data cleansing and transformation rules.
* Legacy Extraction: Leverage Siebel EIM (Enterprise Integration Manager), EAI, and SQL/PL-SQL to extract large, complex datasets from the Siebel database securely.
* ETL & Data Loading: Develop, optimize, and execute ETL processes utilizing tools like Informatica, Jitterbit, or MuleSoft, eventually loading and validating data via the Salesforce Data Loader.
* System Integration: Design and implement transitional integrations and APIs (REST/SOAP) between the remaining Siebel modules and Salesforce during the phased migration.
* Documentation: Prepare comprehensive Technical Design Documents (TDD), Data Dictionary, and Data Strategy/Mapping Documents for stakeholder review and approval.
* Testing & Validation: Conduct comprehensive data reconciliation, unit testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure data parity between Siebel and Salesforce.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Overall 10+ years of experience with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Siebel CRM development, configuration, and administration (Workflows, Business Services, eScript, and EIM).
* Migration Experience: Proven track record of executing at least 2 full end-to-end data migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce.
* Technical Stack: Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and middleware data integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft Anypoint, Informatica).
* Salesforce Knowledge: Solid grasp of Salesforce architecture, data models, and data manipulation capabilities.
* Soft Skills: Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical business.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Siebel CRM Certifications.
* Salesforce Certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or Data Architecture and Management Designer).
* Familiarity with Siebel Product & Pricing modules and Order Management if handling complex CPQ migrations.

description:

**Job Details**
**Senior Developer - Power Platform (Power Pages, Power Automate, Model Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, PCF Controls)**
**About The Role**
PRISM is the Power Platform solution that runs quoting, resource management, and project management for Cencora's Global Consulting Services business. You'll build and extend it: the model-driven apps consultants and resource managers work in daily, the canvas apps and PCF controls that make the experience usable, and the Power Pages portal that puts quotes and project information in front of clients.
  
  
This is a hands-on development role inside the D365 CoE. You'll work alongside our internal functional and technical team and our AMS vendor, and coordinate with Vision25 delivery teams where PRISM touches the global D365 F&O rollout.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build features across the Power Platform stack: model-driven apps, canvas apps, PCF controls, Power Automate flows, business rules, and Dataverse schema. Write PowerFX for canvas apps and formula columns, and HTML, JavaScript, and Liquid for Power Pages.
* Own the quoting, resource management, and project management capability areas from design through hypercare. That means translating user stories into working solutions, sizing work (T-shirt and ROM), and participating in sprint planning, grooming, and demos in Azure DevOps.
* Build and maintain integrations between PRISM, D365 F&O, and other systems using Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Dataverse virtual tables. Design JSON message contracts, handle errors and retries, and instrument with Application Insights so failures are visible before users report them.
* Run ALM for PRISM. Maintain the solution structure and layering, manage the Git repo and branching, and build and operate the Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that move managed solutions through QA, UAT, and Production. Handle solution upgrades and updates, hotfixes, and feature flags without breaking downstream environments.
* Run Solution Checker and Power Platform ALM best practices as part of the definition of done. Review pull requests from internal and vendor developers and hold them to the same standard.
* Support production. Work incidents and problems with the Incident and Problem Management teams, do root cause analysis, and fix the cause rather than the symptom.
* Document what you build: technical design, integration specs, deployment runbooks, and job aids the support team and end users can actually follow.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ Years experience developing on Power Platform and Dataverse, including at least two production model-driven apps you built or substantially extended.
* Demonstrated work in Power Pages (HTML, JavaScript, Liquid, web templates, table permissions, authentication) and canvas apps (PowerFX, connectors, responsive layout, delegation).
* At least one PCF control you've built and shipped, with TypeScript and React.
* Production integration experience with Azure Service Bus (topics, subscriptions, dead-lettering) and Azure Functions or Logic Apps as the middle layer. You can explain when to use event-driven versus batch and why.
* Hands-on Azure DevOps pipeline development for Power Platform: Power Platform Build Tools or Power Platform CLI, service connections, solution export/import/unpack, environment variables and connection references, and managed solution upgrades.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform ALM: solution layering, unmanaged dev and managed downstream environments, versioning, and how to unwind a bad deployment.
* Comfort in SAFe or Scrum delivery, writing and refining user stories, and demoing to product owners and business SMEs.
* Clear written and spoken communication. You'll explain technical trade-offs to product owners and architects who don't code.

**Nice to have**

* D365 F&O exposure, especially Project Operations, and experience surfacing F&O data in Dataverse through virtual tables or dual-write.
* Professional services domain knowledge: quote-to-project, resource scheduling, utilization, time and expense, revenue recognition.
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI experience for reporting on Dataverse data.
* Experience in a regulated industry (pharma, healthcare, financial services) where audit trails and data segregation matter.
* Microsoft certifications: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), PL-600 (Solution Architect), or AZ-204 (Azure Developer).

**How We Work**

* Sprints via Azure DevOps or Github
* Code review on every Pull Request
* Nothing goes to Production without passing Solution Checker, automated pipeline deployment, and UAT sign-off
* Vendor and internal developers work off the same backlog and the same standards.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 2+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or a related field required. Certification in cloud platforms, programming languages, software development, or equivalent preferred.

You will turn a backlog of requests into a focused reporting program and deliver it through our existing Databricks data platform and analytics application, building reliable data pipelines, Python services, and React reporting experiences. You will also improve AI-assisted access to analytics through MCP and natural-language querying.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will own delivery from business requirements through implementation, adoption, and ongoing reliability, while setting technical direction and guiding contributors. Success depends on both sound engineering and the ability to help leaders understand performance and make better decisions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Reporting priorities and stakeholder partnership:**

* Partner with product, engineering, and executive stakeholders to understand their business questions, the decisions reporting should support, and the value they expect.
* Own the intake process and a visible reporting backlog. Align on priorities based on business value, decision impact, data readiness, and effort; communicate delivery expectations and resolve competing requests.
* Deliver reporting across engineering performance, release health, dependencies, backlog health, and cross-product roadmaps.

**Portfolio Insight And Metric Ownership**

* Own portfolio metric definitions, working with product and engineering leaders to establish consistent, meaningful measures. Reconcile differences across source systems and team workflows, and explain where work mix, data coverage, or other limitations affect comparisons.
* Investigate trends and variances, reconcile conflicting numbers, and help leaders understand what changed, why, and whether they need to act.
* Present findings in recurring portfolio and leadership reviews, helping stakeholders interpret performance, understand risks, and identify follow-up actions.

**Reporting And Analytics Delivery**

* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, reporting models, Python APIs, and React reporting experiences on existing Databricks platform and analytics application.
* Integrate ADO, Jira, GitHub, AI-tool usage, and other operational data into reliable reporting, connecting records across systems and preserving historical accuracy as teams and organizational structures change.
* Develop and improve MCP integrations and natural-language querying so people can explore portfolio data through AI tools, with accurate answers and appropriate access controls.

**Trust, Governance, And Adoption**

* Establish reporting standards so users understand where the data comes from, how current it is, its limitations, and who owns it.
* Build automated data-quality checks, investigate discrepancies, and work with source-system owners to correct errors.
* Work with stakeholders to make reporting part of regular business reviews, gather feedback, and reduce manual reporting effort. Improve useful reports and retire those no longer needed.

**Technical Leadership And Reliability**

* Lead technical decisions for the platform and analytics application, document key design choices, review code, and guide other contributors.
* Maintain coding standards, automated tests, and deployment workflows. Balance delivery speed, reliability, and cost, and explain technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Keep the application and data pipelines running reliably, manage releases, and resolve failures and performance issues.
* And other duties as assigned.

**What To Bring**

* 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, software development, or technically hands-on portfolio analytics, with experience delivering reporting used by business leaders and owning the systems behind it.
* Strong Databricks data engineering experience, including medallion architecture, PySpark, Delta Lake, Lakeflow or equivalent managed pipelines, incremental ingestion, schema evolution, backfills, and failure recovery.
* Strong SQL and data modeling skills, including tested transformations, documented metric definitions, and reliable reporting that connects records across systems and preserves historical accuracy.
* Strong production Python skills, including maintainable packages, API integrations, FastAPI or a comparable framework, authentication, retries, rate limiting, and validation.
* Practical experience delivering React and TypeScript applications connected to backend APIs, including interactive data views, loading and error states, and frontend tests.
* Experience deploying and operating data pipelines and applications using automated deployment workflows, CI/CD, and containers. Ability to diagnose failed releases, stale data, and performance issues.
* Understanding of permissions, authentication, service identities, secrets, and secure data access across applications and APIs.
* Practical use of Claude or similar AI coding tools to develop and maintain production software, with disciplined review, testing, and verification.
* Experience using Git, code review, automated tests, and data-quality checks, and guiding other contributors through technical decisions and implementation.
* Demonstrated reporting program ownership: gathering ambiguous requirements, negotiating competing priorities, managing expectations, establishing shared standards, and driving adoption across teams.
* Strong analytical judgment and communication: reconciling conflicting numbers, explaining variances to technical and senior leadership audiences, and connecting findings to business decisions and follow-up actions.

**Nice To Have**

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
As a Business Data Analyst, you turn data into actionable answers that drive operational and tactical business decisions. You split your time between answering ad-hoc analytical questions, qualifying and delivering data requests, and providing analytical support for ongoing business projects.
  
  
You act as a trusted analytical partner to business stakeholders understanding the core problem behind their questions, ensuring existing reporting tools are utilized before pulling raw datasets, leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate delivery, and translating complex data into clear, practical insights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Problem Framing: Meet with stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge baseline assumptions, and translate broad business questions into structured analytical tasks.
* Ad-Hoc & Diagnostic Analysis: Independently run exploratory and deep-dive analyses on operational data to uncover patterns, identify root causes, and explain the "why" behind business performance trends.
* Project Analytics Support: Deliver data analyses, establish baseline metrics, and track progress for cross-functional initiatives and business projects.
* Data Request Gatekeeping & Qualification: Critically evaluate incoming requests for data extracts. Determine whether the business question can already be answered via existing Tableau dashboards or standard reports before generating custom outputs.
* Access Control & Governance: Confirm that stakeholders have appropriate data access rights and verify that a standalone extract is genuinely needed before sharing data.
* Data Extract Delivery: Write and execute verified SQL queries to extract, filter, and deliver validated datasets when existing reporting solutions do not meet the need.
* Analysis Storytelling & Visual Presentation: Build project-specific Tableau dashboards, charts, and visual decks to present analytical findings and communicate key takeaways clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* BI Handover & Industrialization: Identify recurring reporting needs arising from your analyses and work with the central Business Intelligence (BI) team to hand over requirements for production, automated, and recurring enterprise dashboards.
* AI-Assisted Efficiency: Actively leverage modern AI tools (e.g., LLMs, code assistants) to accelerate SQL query generation, debug scripts, structure ad-hoc analyses, and streamline routine analytical workflows.
* Data Quality & Validation: Inspect source data across databases and cloud platforms to ensure all analyses, extracts, and presentations are reliable, consistent, and accurate.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Information Management, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 2 to 4+ years of practical experience in a data analysis role supporting business decision-making.
* Technical Skills:

+ Strong SQL skills to independently query, join, filter, and aggregate data across relational databases and cloud environments.
+ Practical experience creating visuals and analytical dashboards in Tableau (or similar modern BI tools) to present insights.
+ Practical familiarity with AI-assisted coding and productivity tools (such as Gemini, Claude, or similar LLM assistants) to speed up analysis, query writing, and documentation.
+ Working knowledge of Python or R for exploratory analysis, statistical evaluation, or data manipulation is an advantage.

* Data Platforms: Practical familiarity with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud BigQuery) and data warehouse concepts.
* Analytical Mindset & Gatekeeping: Strong ability to frame ambiguous business problems, paired with the assertiveness to challenge requests and guide users toward existing dashboards instead of defaulting to raw data dumps.
* Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; capable of translating technical findings into plain business language and collaborating effectively with the central BI team for reporting handovers.

**What We Offer**

* A versatile analytics role balancing strategic project analysis with rapid operational problem-solving.
* Direct access to modern cloud data platforms and analytics tools (GCP BigQuery, Tableau).
* A forward-looking work culture that encourages the use of modern AI assistants to boost day-to-day productivity.
* Clear interfaces between exploratory analysis and central BI delivery.
* High autonomy and visibility across business departments.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

**People Are At Our Heart**
TVH is a global business with a family atmosphere, where people are at the center. We value clarity, mutual respect, kindness and open communication. Our people are down-to-earth, easy to work and engage with. We welcome differences and celebrate new ideas.
  
  
**About Tvh**
TVH is a parts specialist for quality parts and accessories for material handling, industrial vehicles, and construction and agricultural equipment. Working at TVH is opting for a company that excels as an international market leader and is well-known for its unstoppable craving for innovation.

**Job Description**
**Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting**
**Position Overview**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology, as we
*invent for life*
on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making, that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
  
  
Market Access Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global function encompassing long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across the product lifecycles of all assets within Human Health (Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital Specialty / Primary care). Assets include early and late-stage molecules in clinical development, companies under considerations by business development for partnering and/ or acquisition as well as currently launched products. Forecasting deliverables support division planning and decision making across multiple functional areas such as finance, manufacturing, product development and commercial. In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across divisions, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavor, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Senior Manager – Strategic Forecasting”
  
  
We are looking for a team member within strategic forecasting team based out of Pune. Robust forecasting is a priority for businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines. While forecasting of realistic potential can be arrived through both qualitative and quantitative methods, the challenge lies in selecting and deploying the right methodology. Thus, it is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement advanced analytics techniques such as Monte Carlo simulations, agent-based modeling, conjoint frameworks, NLP, clustering etc. within forecasting vertical.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Responsible for conceptualizing and delivering forecasts and analytical solutions, using both strategic as well as statistical techniques
* Drive continuous enhancements to evolve the existing forecasting capabilities in terms of value-add, risk/ opportunity/uncertainty - identify and elevate key forecasting levers/insights/findings to inform decision making
* Collaborate across stakeholders – Human Health, Finance, Research, Country, and senior leadership – to build and robust assumptions, ensuring forecast accuracy improves over time to support decision making
* Drive innovation and automation to bring in robustness and efficiency gains in forecasting/process; incorporate best-in-class statistical forecasting methods to improve the accuracy
* Communicate effectively across stakeholders and proactively identify and resolve conflicts by engaging with relevant stakeholders
* Responsible for managing team and delivery of forecasts in a timely manner with allocated resources
* Determine the optimal method for forecasting, considering the context of the forecast, availability of data, the degree of accuracy desired, and the timeline available
* Contribute in evolving our offerings through standardization/ automation of various offerings, models and processes
* Participate in selection, talent development and trainings of employees

**Qualification And Skills**

* Engineering / Management / Pharma post-graduates with 8+ years of experience in the relevant roles; with at least 8+ years of experience in pharmaceutical strategic forecasting or analytics
* Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques (expertise in Spotfire will be added advantage)
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across large and diverse functions and stakeholders
* Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of business
* Strong analytical skills; an aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking
* Hands on experience on Monte Carlo simulations and range forecasting
* Exposure/sound understanding of advanced modeling techniques like Agent based and dynamic transmission model
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to communicate effectively across all levels of stakeholders
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain and marketing functions

title: Engineer I, Enterprise Application Engineering
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**Developer - Azure (Integrations, Data Factory, Function App, Logic App, Insights)**
**What You Will Be Doing**
You'll build and run the Azure integration layer that connects Dynamics 365 to the rest of Cencora for the PRISM program. That means designing the message flows, writing the Functions and Logic Apps that move and transform data, defining the JSON contracts between systems, and keeping all of it healthy in production once it ships. You'll sit in the D365 Center of Excellence, work day to day with the PRISM delivery teams and our AMS partner, and own your integrations end to end: design, build, test, deploy, and support.
  
  
PRISM runs on a global ERP footprint across 25+ countries, so the integrations you build carry real order, finance, and compliance data at scale. Reliability, observability, and clean error handling matter more here than clever code.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**

* Design and build event-driven and batch integrations between Dynamics 365 F&O, Power Platform, and enterprise systems using Azure Service Bus (queues, topics, subscriptions, dead-lettering), Azure Function Apps, and Azure Logic Apps including JSON paramters/objects.
* Build and maintain Azure Data Factory and Synapse pipelines for data movement, transformation, and reconciliation, including batch loads, incremental loads, and data-quality checks.
* Define and govern JSON payload contracts and message schemas; version them, document them, and enforce them through validation at the integration boundary.
* Implement error handling, retry, idempotency, and dead-letter patterns; instrument integrations with Application Insights and Azure Monitor so failures are visible before the business reports them.
* Integrate with Power Platform components (Dataverse, Power Automate, model-driven and canvas apps) where PRISM processes span D365 and Power Apps.
* Own integrations through the full lifecycle in Azure DevOps: user stories, design, build, unit and integration testing, CI/CD deployment across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production, cutover, and hypercare.
* Support data conversion and migration activities: mock loads, technical validation, and reconciliation between source and target systems.
* Provide L3 support for production integrations, work root cause with Problem Management, and hold the AMS partner to agreed fixes and timelines.
* Write technical design documents, runbooks, and integration specifications that another engineer can pick up without a walkthrough.
* Review designs and code from other developers, including vendor teams, and push back when a design creates technical debt or won't scale.

**What Should Your Background Look Like**
Experience and education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years in software or integration engineering, with at least 2 years building production integrations on Azure.
* Delivered at least one enterprise ERP or CRM integration program end to end (design through go-live and hypercare). Dynamics 365 F&O or CE experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience working in a SAFe Agile or Scrum delivery model with Azure DevOps for backlog, pipelines, and release management.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Azure Service Bus: topics, subscriptions, sessions, dead-letter handling, message ordering, and duplicate detection.
* Azure Function Apps in C#/.NET (Python acceptable) including durable functions, triggers, bindings, and secure configuration through Key Vault and managed identities.
* Azure Logic Apps (Standard and Consumption), including custom connectors, B2B/EDI scenarios, and workflow error handling.
* Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines: pipeline design, data flows, parameterization, triggers, and monitoring.
* JSON schema design, payload mapping and transformation, and REST/OData API development and consumption.
* SQL and Azure SQL Database, including performance tuning for high-volume integration and staging tables.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics (KQL) for diagnostics and alerting.
* Git-based source control, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Skills**

* Power Platform integration: Dataverse APIs, Power Automate cloud flows, custom connectors, and the Dataverse/D365 F&O dual-write and virtual entity patterns.
* Dynamics 365 F&O data entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), recurring integrations, and business events.
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI for integration reporting and data lineage.
* Kingswaysoft or SSIS for migration and batch scenarios.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare, or other regulated environments where audit trails and data integrity are non-negotiable.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), DP-203 (Data Engineering), or PL-400 (Power Platform Developer).

**How You Work**

* You explain technical trade-offs to product owners and business analysts in plain language and don't hide behind jargon.
* You document as you build, not after.
* You're comfortable working across time zones with US-based stakeholders and a distributed delivery team, including some overlap with US Eastern hours for design sessions and cutovers.
* You treat production support as part of engineering, not someone else's problem.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Less than 2 years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, software development, or a related field required. Certification in cloud platforms, programming languages, or equivalent preferred.

title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**
Execute and enhance industrial data historian and execution systems by designing configuring and optimizing AVEVA PI based solutions for global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a hybrid work model. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure reliable data acquisition contextualization and analytics that improve efficiency quality and business decision making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust AVEVA PI based execution system solutions that reliably collect store and contextualize high volume time series data from diverse plant floor sources to support manufacturing insights and decision making.
* Configure and maintain AVEVA PI interfaces connectors and calculation workflows to ensure accurate data flow from control systems instruments and external applications into the historian environment with minimal downtime.
* Develop advanced PI asset models events and analytics to transform raw operational signals into meaningful metrics that improve visibility of production performance quality trends and equipment health.
* Optimize execution system architectures by reviewing data flows tag configurations and storage strategies to improve system responsiveness scalability and long term maintainability.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to capture requirements translate process needs into technical specifications and deliver AVEVA PI driven solutions that address real operational challenges.
* Build and refine operational dashboards and self service data views using PI tools so that business users can independently monitor key performance indicators and respond quickly to process deviations.
* Provide expert troubleshooting and root cause analysis for AVEVA PI incidents by examining logs data patterns and configurations then implementing durable corrective actions that strengthen overall system reliability.
* Implement governance practices for tag naming data quality validation and system documentation to maintain consistency and traceability across multiple plants and execution environments.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to align AVEVA PI components with enterprise standards for access control network segmentation and backup to protect critical operational data.
* Guide adoption of data driven practices in manufacturing and supply chain teams by explaining historian capabilities demonstrating use cases and promoting continuous improvement based on trusted data.
* Plan and execute system upgrades patches and migration activities for execution systems so that platforms remain supported secure and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Estimate effort for enhancements prepare technical design documents and track progress so that execution system deliverables are completed on time and within defined quality expectations.
* Partner with external vendors and internal experts to evaluate new AVEVA PI features complementary tools and integration patterns that can expand the value of existing execution system investments.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong background in AVEVA PI Historian with hands on experience in configuration administration and solution development across at least one complex industrial environment.
* Bring eight to twelve years of overall experience in execution systems or related industrial software with a sustained focus on data historian technologies and operational data management.
* Demonstrate practical knowledge of manufacturing or supply chain domains by understanding production workflows material movements and typical plant metrics that benefit from historian insights.
* Apply solid skills in data modeling time series analytics and performance optimization so that historian solutions remain efficient even as tag counts and data volumes grow.
* Use clear communication and documentation abilities to work effectively with process engineers planners and business analysts in a hybrid work setting spanning onsite and remote collaboration.
* Exhibit proficiency in problem solving and incident resolution for complex system interactions involving historians control systems middleware and enterprise applications.
* Show familiarity with integration approaches that connect AVEVA PI with reporting tools analytics platforms or manufacturing execution systems to create end to end digital workflows.
* Display comfort working within structured delivery frameworks and change management practices to ensure safe deployment of modifications in regulated or high criticality operations.
