title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions.

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
* Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
* Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
* Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
* Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

**Position Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
* Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
* Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* BA/BS in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred:**

* Experience with iPaaS/automation platforms (Workato or similar)
* Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
* Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
* Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Team Lead - Software Technology
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.

* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.

* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.

* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.

* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.

* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.

* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.

* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.

* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.

* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.

* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.

* Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows.

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, and safe deployment of AI agents.

* Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or vector search, and integration of AI services through APIs.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.

* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.

* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.

* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.

* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.

* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.

* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.

* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.

* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

* Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes ...

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

* Company volunteer and donation matching program.

* Employee Assistance Program.

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.

* On-demand digital course library for professional development.

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.*

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy expects employees to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation outside the office.

description:

**Polyglot Full Stack Developer (Lead) Experience**

***Pune, India (GCC) — on-site / hybrid as applicable***

*8–10 years Team Leadership*

*Must have led a team of 5–6 developers Employment Type*

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team — and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.

* Lead and mentor a team of 5–6 developers — assigning work, conducting code reviews, unblocking issues, and owning delivery quality and timelines.

* Own system design and architecture decisions for new features and services, balancing scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.

* Build and maintain backend services in Java and Python, and frontend applications using React JS.

* Apply AI/ML concepts and tools where relevant to enhance product features or internal tooling.

* Containerize applications with Docker and support deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP).

* Design efficient, well-structured SQL schemas and queries; optimize database performance.

* Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.

* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

* Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand.

* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.

* Proven experience leading a team of 5–6 developers, including mentoring, code review, and delivery ownership.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development.

* Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development.

* Working proficiency in Python.

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).

* Practical experience with Docker for containerization.

* Solid working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Strong SQL skills — schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.

* Demonstrated ability to design scalable, maintainable systems (system design fundamentals: caching, load balancing, microservices, API design, etc.).

* Proficiency with Git and standard branching/collaboration workflows.

* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.

* A polyglot mindset — genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

* Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines.

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

* Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms.

**What We're Looking For**

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

### **Why Join Us?**

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

* **Health and Wellness:**
  + Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.

  + 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.

* **Paid Time Off:**
  + Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
* **Parental Leave:**
  + 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
* **Remote Work Support:**
  + Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
* **Holidays:**

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

Success depends on both sound engineering and the ability to help leaders understand performance and make better decisions.

-----------------------------------------------------

title: US State Senior Tax Analyst
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

Join TransUnion’s U.S. State Tax team and play a key role in supporting a global, publicly traded organization operating across more than 30 countries and territories. This position offers significant exposure to senior leadership, complex multistate tax matters, and strategic initiatives, providing an exceptional opportunity to develop deep expertise in U.S. state and local taxation within a dynamic multinational environment.
  
As part of TransUnion’s award-winning Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Pune, you will contribute to a high-performing team focused on driving excellence, standardization, and innovation across the tax function. The role offers broad exposure to U.S. state income and franchise tax compliance, tax accounting (ASC 740), tax planning, tax research, and process transformation, while partnering closely with U.S.-based tax professionals to deliver high-quality business outcomes 

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The State Senior Tax Analyst will support U.S. state income and franchise tax compliance, tax accounting, tax planning, and operational tax processes while partnering closely with the U.S.-based State Tax team. This role is expected to drive quality, consistency, and efficiency in tax deliverables while contributing to the continued evolution of TransUnion’s Global Capability Centre model.

  

* Prepare state apportionment calculations and perform first-level reviews of apportionment factor outputs to support accurate state tax filings.
* Prepare and review state-specific modifications, including depreciation adjustments, state tax addbacks, Section 174 adjustments, and other jurisdiction-specific computations.
* Prepare state estimated tax payments, review payment calculations, and support payment processing through TransUnion’s treasury and banking systems.
* Perform first-level reviews of U.S. state income and franchise tax returns and related supporting workpapers.
* Support quarterly and annual ASC 740 income tax provision processes by preparing state tax calculations, deferred tax analyses, and supporting documentation.
* Perform tax account reconciliations and prepare supporting journal entries to ensure accurate financial reporting.
* Assist in researching and resolving state tax notices and inquiries from tax authorities.
* Collaborate regularly with U.S.-based State Tax team members to meet monthly, quarterly, and annual compliance and reporting deadlines
* Contribute to GCC Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives by standardizing processes and workpapers, maintaining delivery calendars, identifying and escalating exceptions, and enhancing controls and documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased utilization of tax technology tools to improve efficiency, scalability and accuracy

**Work Location & Schedule**

* This role is based in Pune, India and follows TransUnion's hybrid work model, with regular in-office collaboration as required.
* Given the close partnership with the U.S.-based State Tax team, the role requires regular overlap with U.S. Central Time working hours to support meetings, collaboration, and critical tax deadlines.
  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting is a must.
* Chartered Accountant/ CPA with exposure to U.S. State Income Tax.
* 4-6 years of experience in U.S. state income tax compliance within a Big Four accounting firm, multinational corporation, or comparable professional services environment.
* Strong understanding of U.S. Domestic/State income tax compliance, including apportionment methodologies, state modifications, and filing requirements.
* Knowledge of ASC 740 income tax accounting principles and their application in a corporate environment.
* Experience supporting tax audits, tax notices, and tax authority correspondence.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables and meeting deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical tax matters clearly to both tax and non-tax stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, IF formulas, SUMIF/SUMIFS, data analysis, and reconciliations.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as PeopleSoft or similar financial systems.
* Experience with tax compliance and tax provision software, including OneSource Tax Provision or similar tax technology platforms.
* Familiarity with tax research databases and tools used to analyze and monitor U.S. tax law developments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required for reporting, documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

  
  

TransUnion Job Title

  
  
  
Sr Analyst, Tax

title: Operations Risk Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking an operational risk analyst to join a team responsible for responding to client risk events involving Operations and Technology processes. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of operations, technology, investment management and client service. The candidate will lead the response to complex events that may affect clients, ensuring timely escalation, clear executive communication, disciplined root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation. The candidate will also create key risk metrics presentations to support regional board reporting. The ideal candidate has a high degree of personal integrity and an inquisitive mind.
  
  
**Describe the applications and business or enterprise functions the role supports:**  
Tools include Resolver GRC, PowerBI, PowerAutomate and Cursor

Global Technology and Operations encompasses account lifecycle up to the point of investment readiness and the processing, settlement and reporting of transactions and the technology and infrastructure used across the firm. Experience with comparable GRC, workflow, analytics or automation platforms is also relevant.

You will work across the first and second lines of defense, maintaining clear ownership: business and technology teams own their risks and controls, while the risk function provides independent oversight, challenge, aggregation and escalation.

**The key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Coordinate the end-to-end response to potential client impacting operational and technology events, including triage, materiality assessment, stakeholder mobilization, escalation, investigation, client-support information and closure.
* Act as the central coordinator during time sensitive events, bringing together Operations, Technology, Investment, Client Group, Legal, Compliance and Risk subject matter experts as appropriate.
* Ensure event summaries are accurate, concise and decision useful, clearly distinguishing facts, client impact, root causes, control failures, remediation, residual risk and lessons learned.
* Facilitate robust root cause and contributing factor analysis, challenge whether proposed actions address the underlying issue, and support clear ownership and timely closure of remediation.
* Provide independent risk challenge while preserving constructive relationships with first line process and control owners.
* Identify recurring themes, emerging risks and cross functional dependencies through event data, and translate them into actionable management information, KRIs and recommendations for senior governance forums.

**Job Qualifications (The ideal candidate should have the following):**

* Familiarity with General Risk and Compliance (GRC) tools & frameworks
* Proficiency in efficiency augmentation tools (PowerBi, Cursor, PowerAutomate etc)
* Highly analytical mind with a strong attention to detail
* Superior written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to multitask and prioritize
* Understanding of investment management operations and the technology control environment, including relevant IT general controls and third-party dependencies.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education:**

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in operational risk, non-financial risk, incident/event management, operations risk, technology risk, audit or controls within investment management, asset servicing, banking or another regulated financial-services environment.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Ready to take your career global?  
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a **Data Scientist** to join our ever-evolving Customer Data & Portfolio Analytics organization. In this role, you will help develop and deploy advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that drive customer growth, retention, and portfolio optimization at scale, helping to shape the future of Global Payments.

### **What you’ll own**

* **4-5 years of experience** in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related fields.
* **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.**
* **Proven experience** developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade machine learning models in production environments.
* **Experience in customer analytics**, portfolio management, commercial analytics, CRM analytics, marketing analytics, or customer lifecycle management.
* **Experience building predictive analytics solutions** such as attrition/churn models, propensity models, customer segmentation, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, customer lifetime value models, or Next Best Action frameworks.
* **Strong understanding** of machine learning, statistical modeling, feature engineering, and model validation.
* **Experience with modern data science platforms** such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS SageMaker, or similar cloud environments.
* **Familiarity with MLOps practices** including version control, model monitoring, and deployment processes.
* **Experience or exposure to AI/GenAI solutions** using LLMs, NLP, or related technologies to solve complex business problems.
* **Experience working with large-scale** customer, transaction, sales, or operational datasets.
* **Experience with experimentation**, A/B testing, uplift analysis, or impact measurement is highly desirable.
* **Strong stakeholder management**, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical approaches.
* **Financial Services, Payments, FinTech, Banking**, or related industry experience is preferred.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Independently design, train, tune, evaluate, deploy, and maintain** machine learning models in production environments.
* **Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning models** including problem definition, exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, validation, monitoring, and optimization.
* **Develop predictive models** for attrition, cross-sell propensity, dormancy prediction, Next Best Action recommendations, portfolio compression, customer segmentation, and customer value optimization.
* **Design and deploy AI-powered solutions** leveraging GenAI, LLMs, NLP, and call listening/conversational intelligence to identify customer sentiment, churn risk indicators, and growth opportunities.
* **Partner closely with cross-functional teams** including Portfolio Management & Customer Success, Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, BI, Data Engineering, and MLOps to source, validate, engineer, and operationalize data assets and model features.
* **Translate complex business challenges** into scalable analytical solutions, data pipelines, and decision-support tools that enable proactive portfolio management.
* **Drive model performance monitoring**, retraining, and continuous improvement using production data and business outcomes while aligning with enterprise data governance standards.
* **Communicate actionable insights, recommendations, and model outcomes** clearly to business and senior leadership teams to measure, track, and quantify business impact.
* **Evaluate emerging AI technologies** and establish scalable best practices across analytics use cases.
* **Drive alignment across global stakeholders** to ensure successful implementation, model adoption, and alignment with strategic objectives.

description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
===========================

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. **YOUR IMPACT**
===============

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**
=======================================

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
============================

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.**

Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

NERO AI Infrastructure Systems Private Limited | Job Description

Company - NERO AI Infrastructure Systems Private Limited

Location - Pune, Maharashtra

Department - Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

Reports To - Chief Technology Officer

Employment Type - Full-Time

ABOUT NERO

NERO is an emerging AI infrastructure company that designs, integrates, deploys, and monitors high-performance compute for AI workloads, combining GPU servers, high-speed networking, enterprise storage, power, cooling, and our own monitoring software into one ecosystem.

Our portfolio includes:

* **NERO Compute Rack:** Integrated, GPU-ready infrastructure for AI training, inference, and HPC

* **NERO Monitoring Software:** Real-time visibility into GPU, server, network, storage, power, and cooling health

* **Integration & Managed Services:** Network architecture, deployment, commissioning, monitoring, and ongoing support

We serve customers across the UAE, GCC, and international markets.

THE ROLE

We need a hands-on Network Engineer to design, deploy, integrate, and operate the networking layer of NERO's AI compute infrastructure. This isn't corporate IT: you'll work in GPU environments where throughput, low latency, redundancy, and observability are critical, alongside our hardware, software, and operations teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESNetwork Architecture & Design

* Design and maintain L2/L3 networks for GPU racks and data centers: VLANs, subnetting, routing, link aggregation, segmentation, and spine-leaf

* Configure BGP/OSPF, redundancy, and high availability; support capacity planning; prepare topology diagrams, IP schemes, and design documents

GPU & HPC Network Integration

* Configure high-speed switches, NICs, optics, and DAC/AOC/fiber across 10GbE–400GbE

* Support RoCEv2/RDMA, lossless Ethernet, and InfiniBand (with OEM specialists); tune throughput, latency, packet loss, and congestion for distributed AI training and storage traffic

Rack Integration & Commissioning

* Configure top-of-rack and management switches, server NICs, and separate production, storage, and out-of-band networks

* Set up BMC/IPMI/Redfish connectivity, cabling, labeling, and port mapping; run FAT, SAT, commissioning, and customer handover

Monitoring Software Integration

* With software engineers, enable device discovery and telemetry (SNMPv3, REST APIs, streaming telemetry) and ensure accurate interface, bandwidth, error, latency, health, uptime, and inventory data

* Test alerts, failure detection, and recovery workflows; resolve gaps between device behavior and dashboard data

Operations, Troubleshooting & Security

* Monitor network health and troubleshoot incidents (Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf3, vendor tools); run RCA, firmware upgrades, changes, and configuration backups; escalate to OEMs when needed

* Implement ACLs, firewall rules, VPNs, SSH, SNMPv3, role-based access, and hardening; support security audits

Testing & Validation

* Build lab environments and run performance, endurance, failover, and failure-recovery tests under sustained AI workloads; document test cases, findings, and fixes

Customer Deployment & Vendor Coordination

* Run site surveys, readiness assessments, and on-site/remote deployments and troubleshooting; train customers and prepare handover documents and SOPs

* Evaluate switches, NICs, and optics, support proof-of-concept testing, and manage OEM escalations (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel ecosystems)

REQUIRED SKILLS

**Area**

**Expected Knowledge**

TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, VLANs, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF, ACLs, VRFs

The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About the role

As a Senior Data Scientist at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and deploy the predictive models at the core of our products — credit risk, fraud detection, and customer decisioning models used by lenders and fintech partners. You will own models end to end: framing the problem, engineering features from large structured and unstructured datasets, training and validating models, putting them into production, and monitoring how they perform. You will work closely with engineering, product, and client teams, and help raise the modeling standards of the wider data science team.

This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India.

Responsibilities

• Build, validate, and deploy machine learning models (e.g. probability of default, first-payment default, fraud and never-pay detection, propensity, and segmentation models) from problem framing through production.

• Engineer features from large, messy datasets, including bureau, transactional, application, device, and alternative data.

• Choose the right approach for each problem, from GLMs and scorecards to gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), neural networks, and time-series methods, and justify the choice with evidence.

• Design robust validation: out-of-time and out-of-sample testing, cross-validation, reject inference, stability (PSI/CSI) checks, and bias and fairness assessment.

• Turn model outputs into business decisions: cut-off strategies, rules, and policies that balance approval rate, losses, and fraud capture.

• Partner with data engineering to productionize models and build scalable, reproducible training and scoring pipelines.

• Monitor models in production, detect drift and degradation, and lead recalibration and redevelopment.

• Write clear model documentation and present results to technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and senior leadership.

• Mentor junior data scientists and analysts, review their work, and set best practices for modeling, experimentation, and code quality.

• Keep up with new ML/AI techniques and bring the useful ones into our modeling stack.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying predictive models in production.

• Strong command of statistical modeling and machine learning: GLM/logistic regression, Random Forest, GBM, neural networks, and time series.

• Expert Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, TensorFlow or PyTorch) and strong SQL.

• Experience with big data tools such as BigQuery, Spark, Hive, or SQL Server.

• Deep understanding of model validation, performance metrics (AUC/Gini, KS, lift, precision/recall), and model risk.

• Proven ability to bring domain knowledge (financial risk, fraud, customer journey, marketing) into ML solutions.

• Ability to own problems end to end with minimal supervision and to explain complex results simply.

Preferred qualifications

• Master's degree or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.

• Experience in fintech, lending, credit risk, fraud, or insurance.

• Experience with MLOps tooling (model registries, feature stores, CI/CD for models) and cloud platforms (GCP/AWS).

• Experience with H2O, graph-based fraud detection, or working with unstructured/text data.

• Experience mentoring or leading a small team of data scientists.

How to apply

Apply on our careers site: https://career.hudsondata.com/careers/data-scientist-1002

title: Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
  
  
The Digital Transformation practice is part of the Global Solutions Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura
  
  
**Practice Overview**
Ankura Consulting Group is recognized as one of the five fastest-growing consulting companies, with 2,500 employees across 32 offices in 4 continents. The Company provides services to its client on expert witness, bankruptcy and corporate restructuring, litigation support, forensic accounting, geopolitical risk assessment, and general management consulting services. Ankura Consulting Group's headquarters is based in Washington, USA.
  
  
Ankura's Digital Transformation practice helps clients modernize their organizations by leveraging data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. Within this practice, our Competitive Intelligence capability helps clients turn market, pricing, and customer data into decisions that grow revenue, protect margin, and strengthen enterprise value.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Director to lead the design and hands-on delivery of Competitive Intelligence solutions across multiple client engagements. This is a builder role, not a strategy-only role: the ideal candidate has personally built pricing models, elasticity curves, and forecasting pipelines — writing the queries, building the models, and validating the numbers. The Director will combine that hands-on technical depth with delivery ownership, solution design, and team leadership, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders while remaining able to get into the data personally when engagements demand it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Personally build and validate pricing, elasticity, and demand models - using tools such as Python or R, SQL, and statistical/econometric or machine learning techniques.
* Define and own the solution design for Competitive Intelligence engagements, including dynamic and elastic pricing models, competitor and market monitoring, and customer/segment analytics.
* Lead delivery of pricing and market intelligence programs for clients, tying each initiative to measurable business outcomes (revenue, margin, operating efficiency, working capital).
* Design, build, and continuously recalibrate price elasticity models by SKU, segment, and geography — including cross-elasticity and scenario simulation — to support data-driven pricing and promotion decisions.
* Build or directly oversee the technical build of competitor price/promotion scraping and monitoring pipelines, supplier and sourcing intelligence feeds, and demand/supply forecasting models.
* Apply and evaluate machine learning and AI techniques (e.g., demand forecasting models, customer segmentation/clustering, propensity and churn models, NLP-based market signal extraction) where they improve on traditional analytics.
* Establish reference architectures, delivery standards, and best practices for Competitive Intelligence solutions built on the firm's Enterprise Data Platform.
* Estimate, plan, and govern delivery across multiple client engagements and workstreams.
* Partner with client stakeholders to align Competitive Intelligence roadmaps with business objectives and timelines.
* Mentor, coach, and develop data scientists, analysts, and technical leads, staying hands-on enough to review code, models, and analysis rather than only reviewing slides.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for analytical rigor, accuracy, scalability, and time-to-value.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities, including hands-on proof-of-concept analysis, solution design, technical estimates, and client pitches.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, market/competitive intelligence, or advanced analytics, with significant leadership responsibility — including recent, genuinely hands-on technical work, not purely oversight.
* Bachelors in Engineering, computer science preferred.
* Certification in cloud platform or relevant data platforms
* Demonstrated, hands-on track record of having personally built dynamic pricing, price elasticity, demand forecasting, or revenue management models — able to speak to the data, methodology, and code, not just the resulting recommendations.
* Proficiency in a data science/analytics stack such as Python or R, SQL, and common ML/statistics libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels), sufficient to build or debug models directly.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and AI techniques relevant to pricing and market intelligence — forecasting, clustering/segmentation, propensity modeling, and increasingly, LLM-based tools for market/text signal extraction.
* Comfort working directly in data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), including writing and reviewing data pipelines, not only architecting them.
* Demonstrated ability to estimate, plan, and govern complex delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and security principles as they relate to market and pricing data.
* Excellent communication skills and experience in senior, client-facing roles, including presenting to executive audiences — balanced with genuine willingness to be in the data day-to-day.
* Consulting experience in a front-ending, client-facing role: understanding and clarifying client requirements, setting and managing expectations, proactively anticipating needs and risks, and communicating clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong business acumen and results-oriented mindset, with a track record of connecting hands-on analytics work to business outcomes.
* Preferred to have experience leading multi-team or multi-vendor delivery models.
* Preferred to have experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies.
* Preferred to have a graduate degree or equivalent depth in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, data science, or similar).
* Cloud or platform certifications (any major provider) is preferred.
* Must be fluent in English.

title: AI-ML Intern
description:

Gurgaon

**Type:**
 Full-time Internship (6 - 12 Months) | Paid

**About JoshTalks AI**

At JoshTalks AI, we believe voice will become the primary interface between humans and machines. We build benchmarks, datasets, and AI systems that power some of the world's most widely used speech models.

**Our mission:**

• Enable machines to communicate as naturally as humans

• Build benchmarks and datasets that form the backbone of global speech AI progress

• Drive improvements through high-quality, diverse, real-world data — not just compute

*This is not a conventional internship. You will directly contribute to work that influences the global speech AI ecosystem.*

**Data Delivery (Cloud & Containers)**

• Deliver processed speech and audio datasets via cloud-based container pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Design and manage end-to-end data delivery workflows from raw ingestion to structured output

• Build and maintain ETL pipelines to prepare data for model training and evaluation at scale

• Ensure reliable, versioned, and reproducible data handoffs to ML training infrastructure

• Monitor pipeline health, resolve bottlenecks, and optimize throughput for large-scale data movement

**Benchmarking & Evaluation**

• Design and run evaluations for ASR and speech-to-speech systems

• Benchmark leading speech models to identify real-world strengths, weaknesses, and failure modes

• Build evaluation frameworks that guide top AI labs on model performance and improvement areas

**Modeling & Fine-Tuning**

• Fine-tune speech recognition models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec2) targeting Word Error Rates of ~5%

• Students in B.Tech/B.E. graduating in 2027 (CSE, EE, AI/ML, or related fields)

• Strong interest in speech, audio, NLP, or multimodal AI

◦ Fine-tuning speech or language models (Whisper, wav2vec2, HuBERT, etc.)

◦ Building speech-driven pipelines, classifiers, or assistants

◦ Working with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers

◦ Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container tools (Docker, Kubernetes)

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Open-source contributions, GitHub projects, Kaggle experience,

• Experience with multilingual or low-resource speech data

• Familiarity with ETL workflows, data versioning (DVC, MLflow), or orchestration (Airflow, Prefect)

It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About Pluang**

Pluang is Indonesia's leading multi-asset investment platform, offering products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure — so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $120M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we're one of Indonesia's fastest-growing fintechs.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to own the analytics layer behind Pluang's product decisions. You will work directly with Product Managers across our asset classes — Global Stocks, Crypto and Indonesian Equities — to define how we measure success, find where users drop off or thrive, and turn data into clear product recommendations.

This is a product role, not a reporting role. We want someone who frames the right question before running the query, works independently through ambiguous problems, and brings a point of view to the table. You will have high ownership and a direct line of sight from your analysis to what ships. You will use AI tools like Claude as a core part of how you work, to take analysis deeper and faster than traditional approaches allow.

**What You'll Do**

**Shape Product Decisions with Data**

* Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, guardrails and North Star measures for features and product lines.
* Frame ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and drive them end to end: from hypothesis to recommendation.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap discussions — size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and flag what the data does and does not support.
* Present insights clearly to product, design, engineering and leadership audiences.

**Own Product Health and Funnels**

* Build and maintain funnels across key investor journeys: onboarding and KYC, funding, first trade, repeat trading and retention.
* Run cohort, retention and engagement analyses to understand how different investor segments behave across asset classes.
* Track feature adoption and post-launch performance, and turn findings into concrete next steps for the product team.
* Set up dashboards and alerts that let PMs self-serve on day-to-day metrics, so analysis time goes to deeper questions.

**Drive Experimentation**

* Design A/B tests with PMs: hypotheses, sample sizes, success criteria and test duration.
* Analyse results rigorously, call out biases and noise, and give a clear ship / iterate / stop recommendation.
* Help build a consistent experimentation practice across product teams.

**Strengthen the Analytics Layer**

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Deep Learning Engineer - Vision | Defence
description:
**Role Name -**
Deep Learning Engineer
  
  
**Experience- 2-3 Years**
**Location -**
Sector 132, Noida
  
  
**About ZOID**
ZOID is a deep-tech R&D startup working on advanced technologies for the defence and aerospace sector. We build customised solutions for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers, with our strength being hands-on expertise in AI, electronics, UAVs and robotics.
  
  
**Current Projects Include**

* AI-based FOD detection software for naval air stations
* Reusable Off-board Missile Decoy for anti-ship missile defence
* GNSS-Denied Navigation Suite
* Aerial Intelligent Mapping Suite
* Vision-based Kinetic Strike Solution
* Swarming Solutions

**Role Brief**
We are looking for an Deep Learning Engineer to handle AI data operations through field data collection, image annotation, dataset QC, and test-set analysis for UAV/defence applications. The role involves working with field teams during runway/track tests and maintaining accurate, traceable datasets and test logs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the optics testing end to end (FOV, focal length and depth-of-field calculations) for detecting 3 x 3 x 3 mm objects.
* Plan and conduct optics testing including camera & lens settings (focus, motion-blur budget, exposure, gain, FPS, binning, etc).
* Build and manage the dataset, annotation and QA/QC rules, data versioning, and backup (Raid Configuration).
* Analyse the type of datasets which should be collected for any specific task.
* Develop the detection & classification model for millimetre-scale objects at high resolution.
* Optimise models for real-time inference on the GPU servers such that multiple cameras can simultaneously operate on a single GPU without any accuracy loss.
* Implement object localisation and geo-referencing of detections using RTK/GNSS and frame timestamps and validate CEP in the field.
* Maintain a model registry with regression tests so no release degrades detection performance; run the false-positive review loop with operations staff.
* Analyse why false positives are occurring and how to eliminate them?
* Recommend computation hardware (GPU, memory, storage, camera network cards) based on model and data-rate requirements.
* Apply AI methods to 3D photogrammetry data. Run segmentation, object detection and change detection, and extend the 3D processing pipeline where required. (Good to have)

**Must Have**

* Fluency in Python.
* Strong computer vision fundamentals
* Knowledge of PyTorch & implementation of object detection at high resolution and small object scale (YOLO/DETR family or equivalent).
* Dataset engineering: annotation tooling (CVAT/Label Studio), QC methods, data versioning (DVC), experiment tracking (W&B/MLflow).
* TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX, INT8 quantisation, multi-GPU inference.
* Optics knowledge: FOV, IFOV, GSD, focal length, MTF, exposure & experience with machine-vision cameras and NIR imaging (Good to have)
* Object localisation and geo-referencing: pixel-to-ground mapping, CEP estimation, working with RTK/GNSS and time-synchronised frames. (Good to have)
* 3D data handling: point clouds and meshes (Open3D, PCL, PDAL or equivalent), knowledge of 3D deep learning models (PointNet/PointNet++, KPConv or similar) for segmentation and detection on 3D models. (Good to have)
* Linux, Git and CI; comfortable deploying and debugging on field hardware.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with multi-camera systems: synchronisation, overlapping fields of view, and stitching or fusing outputs from a camera array.
* Familiarity with GigE-Vision/GenICam camera SDKs and PoE camera networks, enough to debug frame drops and timing with the software team.
* Active learning or semi-automatic labelling to cut annotation effort on large field datasets.
* Exposure to anomaly detection or unsupervised methods for finding objects that were never in the training set.
* LiDAR or depth-sensor data handling, useful for cross-checking optical detections and for AIMS 3D work.
* Understanding of EO/IR sensor behaviour beyond NIR (SWIR/MWIR), for future sensor upgrades.
* Basic Docker and model-serving experience for reproducible field deployments.

**About Xapads Media:**  
Xapads Media is a global AdTech company operating across multiple international markets. As we continue to scale our business and teams globally, we are looking for a strategic and hands-on **Sr. Manager – Talent Acquisition** to build and lead our Talent Acquisition function.

This is a leadership role with end-to-end ownership of Talent Acquisition, responsible for building a structured, scalable and technology-enabled hiring function aligned with Xapads' business growth.

**Role Overview:**  
The Sr. Manager – Talent Acquisition will own and drive the overall Talent Acquisition strategy across India and global markets.

This is primarily a TA leadership and function-building role, rather than an individual contributor position. The person will be responsible for building the overall hiring infrastructure, creating the right team structure and ensuring the TA function is scalable, data-driven, technology-enabled and aligned with business requirements.

The role will require hands-on involvement in critical, senior and leadership hiring, where direct engagement with senior talent and strong candidate closure skills are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. TA Strategy, Function Building & Leadership**

* Own the complete Talent Acquisition function and define its overall strategy and operating model.

* Build and continuously improve the TA infrastructure, processes, governance and hiring framework.

* Assess the existing TA setup and build the right team structure and resources based on hiring volumes, business priorities and market requirements.

* Establish clear hiring SLAs, accountability mechanisms and performance metrics.

* Drive a high-performance, ownership-driven culture within the TA function.

**2. Workforce Planning & Hiring Forecasting**

* Partner with business leaders to build workforce plans and hiring forecasts.

* Translate business growth plans into structured hiring requirements and recruitment plans.

* Plan for new positions, replacement hiring, attrition and critical talent requirements.

* Continuously assess hiring capacity and align TA resources with business demand.

* Build visibility around planned vs. actual hiring and future talent requirements.

**3. Global Talent Acquisition**

* Lead and scale recruitment across India and international markets.

* Build scalable global sourcing strategies and talent pipelines.

* Develop market intelligence across talent availability, compensation and hiring trends.

* Establish consistent recruitment practices across geographies while adapting to local market requirements.

**4. Recruitment Infrastructure, Technology & Automation**

* Establish Zoho Recruit as the central recruitment platform and single source of truth for the TA function.

* Build recruitment dashboards and analytics to provide visibility into the complete hiring funnel.

* Identify and implement automation across sourcing, screening, scheduling, communication, reporting and other manual processes.

* Drive adoption of relevant AI tools and emerging recruitment technologies to improve TA productivity and efficiency.

**5. Hiring Performance & Process Excellence**

* Improve overall hiring TAT, funnel efficiency and candidate conversion.

* Track position aging, source effectiveness, funnel conversion, offer acceptance and joining ratios.

* Identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve hiring outcomes.

* Continuously evaluate and improve the candidate experience and recruitment process.

**6. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership**

* Partner with business leaders, functional heads and hiring managers to understand current and future talent requirements and translate them into effective recruitment strategies.

* Act as a strategic talent advisor to the business.

* Drive stakeholder accountability around hiring timelines, feedback and decision-making.

* Provide talent market insights to support business and hiring decisions.

**7. Critical, Senior & Leadership Hiring**

* Personally lead critical, senior and leadership hiring mandates where direct engagement with senior talent is required.

* Build relationships with passive and senior candidates through direct sourcing and executive-level engagement.

* Develop targeted search strategies for difficult-to-find talent.

* Personally drive candidate engagement, assessment coordination, negotiations and closure for critical positions.

* Build strong talent networks that can support recurring leadership and niche hiring requirements.

**8. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Talent Acquisition team.

* Define recruiter roles, responsibilities, goals, productivity metrics and performance expectations.

* Build recruiter capability across sourcing, stakeholder management, market intelligence, negotiation, candidate engagement and modern recruitment practices.

* Ensure the right balance of internal resources, specialised hiring support and external recruitment partners based on business needs.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including strong team leadership experience.

* Proven ability to build and scale TA functions, including workforce planning and hiring strategy.

* Strong experience in global recruitment and handling critical, senior and niche hiring.

* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and candidate closure skills.

* Data-driven approach with experience in hiring metrics, TAT, funnel management and recruitment analytics.

* Experience with ATS, recruitment automation and AI-led hiring, with the ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on involvement when required.

If you are passionate about building high-performing Talent Acquisition functions, developing teams and creating modern, technology-enabled hiring organisations, we would love to hear from you.

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
