+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).

* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Agentic Flows
description:
**Location: Kochi or Bangalore, India (Hybrid)**  
**Permanent - Full Time**

**About Us**  
Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**Cyncly & The Power of AI**  
At Cyncly, we believe in unlocking the power of AI to deliver highly personalized and extraordinary experiences for our customers and their clients. We are on a dynamic journey of seeking exceptional talent to add critical AI models and functionality to our products used by over 17,000 customers worldwide. This is opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that fosters continuous learning and growth, where you'll work on exciting data driven projects that redefine the Spaces for Living industry. AI is reshaping private and business life at an unprecedented speed, and Cyncly is committed to leading the charge in delivering new sources of value for our customers.

**About the Role**  
We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer to build agentic front ends for our products. Most of our products currently offer UI based interaction to our customers. Given the complexity involved in the flows, traditional UI based interaction needs training for users before they can develop desired proficiency in the product. We want to build NLP based interactive UIs where AI agents make flows not only easier to learn but also provide suggestive inputs to aid design process. This role will attempt at revolutionizing UI/UX for our customers by offering them a guided flow and thereby eliminating learning curve needed for understanding complex design process.

**Key Position Responsibilities Include:**

* Design and implement agentic workflows in the frontend (multi-step AI-driven user journeys).
* Oversee development of UI components that interact with LLMs, APIs, and agent orchestration layers.
* Handle state management to ensure proper context is available to LLMs to provide decision support.
* Translate complex backend agent logic into clear, user-friendly interfaces.
* Implement real-time interactions (chat interfaces, copilots like AI-based kitchen designing, suggestions, searches, etc.).
* Ensure performance, scalability, and responsiveness of AI-powered UI flows.
* Contribute to design systems that support AI-native UX patterns.
* Define standards and guidelines for appropriate AI tool usage for building agentic flows.
* Stay current with emerging AI tools and capabilities relevant for building real-time agentic interactions.
* Work with engineering/product leadership to develop strategy and roadmap.
Monitor tool effectiveness and ROI, providing data-driven recommendations for tool selection and renewal.  

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/master’s in computer science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field.
* **AI/ML & Agentic Experience is Required.**
* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in developing AI-based solutions with 1+ years focusing on working with **LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.).**
* Exposure to **agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, etc.).**
* Experience in building **chat-based or AI-assisted interfaces and Agent UI Protocols, including JSON-based UI rendering.**
* Understanding of **prompt design and AI interaction patterns.**
* Knowledge of event-driven architecture and persistent state management in agentic loops.
* Familiarity with tool calling / function calling paradigms.
* Familiarity with setting up **MCP and multi-agent interactions.**
* Knowledge of **RAG-based solutions and text-mining** to find insights from chat histories.
* Hands-on experience with **Agent-to-Agent protocols** and communication patterns.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with Generative AI image models and Diffusion frameworks (e.g., Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, Inpainting/Outpainting).
* Familiarity with Computer Vision techniques and Segmentation models (e.g., SAM / Segment Anything, object detection, image segmentation).
Hands-on experience with Multi-Modal AI (combining text and vision) for design or visual generation workflows.  

**Working for Us**  
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Engineer II, AI Automation
description:
Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let’s push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide.
  
  
**How You’ll Help Us Connect the World:**  
As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and run the LLM-powered and agentic systems that are changing how we work. You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster—from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails.
  
This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
  
  
**You Will Make an Impact By:**  

* Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams.
* Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines—with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices.
* Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions.
* Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows.
* Developing and extending AI coding-assistant tooling for engineering teams, including Claude Code skills and plugins, custom agents, and reusable prompt templates.
* Designing evaluation frameworks and guardrails for AI-generated output, using golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites so quality is measured, not assumed.
* Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops.
* Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds.
* Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization.
* Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs.
* Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows.
* Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
* Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning.

**Required Qualifications for Consideration:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building LLM-powered applications that run in production.
* Track record of taking AI features from prototype to production, with measurable impact on quality, speed, or cost.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
* Practical experience building RAG systems: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector), hybrid search, and re-ranking.
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and guardrail techniques: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and mitigation of hallucination and prompt injection.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Strong Python skills, including asyncio, type hints, and testing with pytest.
* Experience designing REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Experience with async, event-driven pipelines and queues (e.g., Celery, Kafka, Redis), plus working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of secrets management (e.g., Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), role-based access control, and dependency and container scanning (e.g., Snyk, Trivy).
* Experience with observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse) for tracing, metrics, and cost tracking of LLM applications.
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably AWS.

**You Will Excite Us If You:**  

* Have experience building AI for IT operations or customer support
* Are experienced in reducing LLM cost and latency at scale through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and context compression
* Have applied AI tooling to large C/C++ codebases.
* Have exposure to telecom or 4G/5G RAN, or a strong interest in learning the domain

title: Senior Customer Engineer
description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Global Customer Services Ref ID: JR-024006

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

**Senior Customer Engineer - Strata Cloud Manager (SCM)**
=========================================================

**Your Career**
---------------

The Customer Engineering (CE) team is an exciting crossroads between Global Customer Support (GCS), Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), bridging the gap between customer-facing Technical Assistance Center (TAC) teams and backend Engineering.

As a Senior Customer Engineer, you will drive technical investigations for critical customer escalations and other complex issues involving our SaaS and cloud security offerings, including Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) and Strata Logging Service.

You will partner closely with customers, TAC, and Engineering bridging the gap between customer-facing teams and our backend cloud infrastructure and Engineering. You will also leverage AI, automation, and engineering tools to improve troubleshooting efficiency and define supportability requirements to reduce recurring issues.

You are a good candidate if you thrive in cloud-native environments, have a strong troubleshooting mindset, communicate effectively under pressure, and enjoy understanding why systems behave the way they do.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* **Escalation Leadership:** Own technical investigations and resolution of critical and complex customer escalations. Coordinate troubleshooting across TAC, Engineering, and SRE, participate in live customer and internal incident bridges, and collaborate with designated incident commanders to accelerate resolution.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work directly with developers, SRE, DevOps, QA, and Product Management as an expert advisor during the design and later Product Life Cycle phases. Establish a regular cadence and process to define supportability, telemetry, and usability requirements. Maintain visibility into ongoing Engineering investigations, drive continuous product improvements and ensure effective collaboration between TAC and Engineering.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis:** Investigate issues involving SaaS infrastructure, cloud environments, backend services, APIs, security enforcement, control planes, AI gateways, and traffic flows. Analyze logs, telemetry, configurations, and system behavior to identify root causes and contribute to post-incident reviews and preventive actions.
* **AI & Agentic Workflows:** Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate troubleshooting, analyze logs, develop scripts, and automate repetitive tasks. Create tools and automation to help solve support challenges at scale, applying technical judgment to validate AI-generated outputs and follow security requirements.
* **Supportability & Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring escalation patterns, diagnostic gaps, and product limitations. Actively look for opportunities to catch problems before they escalate or become widespread.
* **Issue Reproduction & Validation:** Build or adapt cloud-based lab environments to reproduce customer issues and validate fixes when feasible. Use backend logs, telemetry, API investigations, and Engineering collaboration for issues that cannot be reproduced in a lab.
* **TAC Enablement & Knowledge Sharing:** Develop troubleshooting playbooks and AI Copilot knowledge inputs. Provide targeted training, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing sessions to enable TAC teams. This includes structured training throughout the year, as well as ad hoc sessions and Q&A (live and via Zoom). Maintain regular office hours with support teams to facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and faster issue resolution.
* **Adaptability & Initiative:** Take ownership of emerging technical challenges, adapt to evolving products and responsibilities. Champion unplanned projects that result in a better customer experience, and proactively identify opportunities to improve customer support and engineering workflows.

**The Team**
------------

Customer Engineering is a specialized technical team that is critical to our success and mission. Our technical team provides behind-the-scenes support to meet our customer’s needs. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. In fact, you’ll proactively seek them out to ensure our clients are safely supported. We value technical curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and the ability to adapt to new challenges. Our engineers are encouraged to look beyond individual incidents, challenge existing processes, and develop solutions that improve how we support customers at scale.

We’re a fast-growing, immensely successful organization because of our people and products. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, are excited by the prospect of a challenge, and feel empowered to mitigate the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are enabled by a secure digital environment.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Professional Background:** **Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Troubleshooting & Escalations:** **Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with experience investigating complex technical issues and handling critical escalations in enterprise environments. Ability to work effectively under pressure and coordinate investigations across multiple teams.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communication skills:** **Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical findings, managing customer expectations, and engaging with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders. Translating technical information for other Engineers and Executive teams is an essential part of the job.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Cloud & SaaS Knowledge:** **Understanding of enterprise SaaS architectures, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operational workflows. Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Scripting, Automation, and AI:** **Comfortable with Python, JSON, REST APIs, Linux/Unix environments, SQL, SDKs, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to automate lab deployments and build custom troubleshooting scripts. Proficiency with SOTA AI models (such as Claude and ChatGPT) in coding and engineering workflows. Experience developing AI-assisted troubleshooting workflows, automation agents, or internal engineering tools is highly desired.**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **SaaS/SRE/DevOps Knowledge:** **Familiarity or experience with enterprise SaaS application backend systems, DevOps, SRE, and CI/CD pipelines is required.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Networking & Security Fundamentals:** **Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, routing, and general network troubleshooting.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** **Experience working with Technical Support, Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or Product Management to investigate and resolve complex technical issues.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Adaptability:** **Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, learning new technologies, and taking on evolving responsibilities.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **On-Call Availability:** **Willingness to participate in rotating on-call shifts and provide technical escalation support during occasional evenings and weekends. Experience with incident management processes is beneficial. Familiarity with incident management tools such as PagerDuty or FireHydrant is preferred.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **PAN-OS Expertise:** **Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products, particularly Software Firewalls, Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), Prisma AIRS/Portkey, Prisma SASE, or SD-WAN. Knowledge of core NGFW capabilities such as App-ID, User-ID, Threat Prevention, and URL Filtering across physical, virtual, and cloud-delivered environments.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Cloud Networking:** **Experience with cloud security management platforms, multi-tenant architectures, centralized policy distribution, or AI security inspection and enforcement. Familiarity with cloud networking constructs such as VPCs, VNETs, Transit Gateways, Gateway Load Balancers, Application Load Balancers, and route tables.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Familiarity with observability technologies such as Grafana, Prometheus, distributed tracing, or equivalent logging and monitoring platforms.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with cloud-based lab environments, root cause analysis (RCA), post-incident reviews, and technical enablement.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

description:
The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk
  

**Summary**

The Core Engineering Shared Services AI team operates as an internal forward-deployed AI engineering function, embedding with The Core business teams to identify priority workflows, prototype agentic AI solutions, and productionize cloud-native applications that deliver measurable business impact. This hands-on role combines client-facing problem discovery, rapid engineering execution, production AI architecture, and structured transition to receiving teams that will operate and extend the solutions over time.

As an AI Application Engineer, you will work directly with internal business and engineering partners to convert ambiguous operating problems into secure, reliable AI products. You will define where agents should act, where they should assist, and where human approval or control gates are required, then design and deliver solutions that are adopted in real workflows and can be supported in production.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Rapid Prototyping & Application Delivery: Lead the design, build, deployment, and operationalization of cloud-native AI applications, using modern software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing to accelerate reliable delivery.
* Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Partner with business and engineering teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities, translate requirements into cloud-optimized architectures, and define scalable data models and technical specifications.
* Forward-Deployed AI Engineering: Embed with The Core business teams to map workflows, identify pain points, assess agentic automation opportunities, define control and approval boundaries, iterate with users, and drive adoption through pilots, feedback loops, and measurable outcomes.
* Production AI/ML Integration: Build AI applications using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt and context management, structured outputs, response validation, and evaluation harnesses required for production use.
* Cloud, DevOps & MLOps Execution: Apply cloud-native services, secure deployment patterns, observability, lifecycle management, and MLOps practices to ensure applications are scalable, resilient, cost-aware, and supportable.
* Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Document solutions, mentor receiving teams, and support clean transition of application code, integration patterns, data models, and operational practices into long-term engineering ownership.
  

**Qualifications**

* Must have: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Must have: 9+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting robust production applications.
* Must have: Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with demonstrated ability to apply sound software engineering, testing, data modelling, and system design practices.
* Must have: Proven experience translating complex business requirements into cloud-optimized application architectures, scalable data models, and technical specifications for production delivery.
* Must have: Experience operating in a forward-deployed or internal client-facing engineering model, including workflow discovery, stakeholder engagement, rapid prototyping, solution shaping, pilot execution, adoption measurement, and production handoff to receiving teams.
* Must have: Extensive experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including serverless, containerization, managed services, automated deployment, monitoring, and cloud security standards.
* Must have: Experience designing cloud-based AI solution architectures that integrate managed AI services, LLM providers, retrieval and vector search, secure data access, API gateways, event-driven workflows, identity and entitlement controls, observability, deployment automation, and cost and resilience trade-offs across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Must have: Demonstrated experience integrating LLM or AI/ML capabilities into production applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases or search indexes, prompt templates, context assembly, structured outputs, response validation, evaluation datasets, and model performance monitoring.
* Must have: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, lead cross-functional delivery, and enable receiving teams through documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.
* Preferred: Experience building agentic AI systems that decompose tasks, plan multi-step workflows, call approved tools or APIs, maintain state, enforce permission and policy checks, handle failure paths, and produce auditable action trails.
* Preferred: Experience implementing agent observability and controls, including trace capture, prompt and tool-call logging, hallucination and policy-violation checks, human-in-the-loop approvals, incident handoff, and post-action summarization.
* Preferred: Experience optimizing production AI systems through model selection and routing, prompt compression, retrieval tuning, caching, batching, streaming responses, asynchronous execution, parallel tool calls, latency budgets, cost controls, and quality regression testing.

description:

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position:**

Assets Reservoir Engineer - Shale & Tight

  

Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for Assets Reservoir Engineer - Shale & Tight to join the ENGINE Subsurface team; this role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.  
  
Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.  
  
Assets Reservoir Engineer supports reservoir management, development planning, production forecasting, reserves and resources maturation, and value optimization for shale and tight assets. This role combines reservoir engineering, production, completion, economic, and subsurface data to generate high-quality recommendations that influence development decisions and capital allocation.

The successful candidate will work with global technical peers and cross-functional asset teams to evaluate uncertainty, improve forecast quality, identify optimization opportunities, and support asset growth. The role is expected to influence development decisions and business outcomes through direct collaboration with global asset teams and technical specialists.

Opportunities exist to leverage analytics, automation, and digital technologies to improve reservoir engineering workflows and business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop reservoir evaluations and integrated development plans that support field development and asset growth.

  

* Generate production forecasts, type curves, reserves and resources assessments, and development recommendations.

  

* Conduct reservoir surveillance, decline curve analysis, pressure analysis, and well performance evaluations to identify optimization opportunities.

  

* Evaluate development spacing, sequencing, depletion strategies, completion performance, and capital efficiency trade-offs.

  

* Integrate reservoir, production, geological, petrophysical, operational, and commercial datasets into decision-ready recommendations.

  

* Support reserves and resource maturation processes through technically robust and auditable reservoir engineering work products.

  

* Evaluate competitor performance and external analog developments to identify opportunities for value creation and risk reduction.

  

* Collaborate with Earth Science, Production Engineering, Drilling and Completions, Planning, Commercial, and Operations teams.

  

* Communicate technical recommendations and uncertainty clearly to technical and leadership audiences.

  

* Contribute to workflow improvements through automation, analytics, digital technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

* Support technical mentoring and capability building across the reservoir engineering community**.**

**About you:**

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.

**To be considered for this role, applicants should have:**

  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in petroleum engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  

* 5-10 years of reservoir engineering experience. Experience in production forecasting, development planning, reserves assessment, surveillance, and economic evaluation.

  

* Strong technical background in decline curve analysis, reservoir management, forecasting, uncertainty analysis, and development optimization.

  

* Ability to integrate technical and commercial considerations into business recommendations.

  

* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.

  

* If required by the final posting: legal authorization to work in India without company-sponsored visa support.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master's degree in petroleum engineering or a related discipline.

  

* Experience supporting shale and tight developments.

  

* Experience with reserves determination, type curve development, development planning, and portfolio optimization.

  

* Experience with analytics, machine learning, automation, or digital workflow development.

  

* Experience supporting integrated asset teams and business planning processes.

  

* Experience working with geographically distributed teams.

**Selection Criteria:**

  

* Demonstrated reservoir engineering depth in shale and tight assets, including development planning, production forecasting, well performance evaluation, economic analysis, and reserves/resource assessment.

  

* Ability to connect reservoir engineering recommendations to asset value, risk reduction, capital efficiency, and development strategy.

  

* Strong technical judgment in uncertainty framing, forecast quality assurance, type curve development, and decision-support recommendations.

  

* Proven ability to integrate large technical datasets and translate complex analysis into concise, actionable recommendations.

  

* Strong collaboration across earth science, production engineering, drilling and completions, operations, planning, commercial, and forecasting teams.

  

* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, and ability to deliver high-quality technical products under business timelines.

**What we can offer you**

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

To be a part of our success, click **APPLY** to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, eBooks and reference works. We are creating technology platforms to shape the future of knowledge.

Taylor & Francis Group produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

As part of Taylor & Francis’s digital first strategy, we have been driving growth through providing access to publications through digital platforms and providing a unified experience across the body of content. We have created digital platforms to facilitate discovery and to allow users to access relevant research and information quickly and easily, wherever they are.

Taylor & Francis is building the world's leading platform connecting the network of human knowledge. We are passionate about helping researchers achieve their goals, which in turn adds new nodes to the ever-expanding graph of research information. We believe that researchers are our number one priority, so we work hard to deliver value back to them with everything we do.

Our teams are solving unique and difficult problems at scale in an energetic and hyper-growth environment. We’re growing incredibly quickly, and we need experienced technical people to help us scale.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an AI/ML Research Engineer (NLP & Knowledge Graphs) to join our Applied AI Solutions team. This is a junior-to-mid level role: the ideal candidate has around 2–4 years of hands-on experience applying NLP and machine learning (or an MSc with strong research or internship experience), and wants to grow into a research-minded engineer who can take an idea from paper to working prototype.

You will research, prototype and evaluate ways of extracting structure and meaning from scholarly content – entities, relations, topics and emerging research areas – and of representing it in knowledge graphs and ontologies that can power better discovery, search and recommendation across Taylor & Francis. You will report to the Director of Applied AI Solutions, who in turn reports to the CTO.

The Applied AI Solutions team is a small, senior, research-led group within the CTO organisation. We are the part of Taylor & Francis that works on problems that are on nobody’s product roadmap yet – discovery, peer review, research integrity and making scholarly content machine-consumable – and we turn the most promising ideas into evidence, working prototypes and business cases that Engineering and the business can adopt.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Work as part of a small, research-led team on a few strategic AI “bets” each year, each ending in a decision-grade artefact: a working prototype, the evidence behind it and a business case.
* Research, prototype and evaluate NLP approaches for extracting entities, relations and topics from scholarly articles, books and metadata.
* Help design, populate and evolve knowledge graphs, ontologies and taxonomies that represent Taylor & Francis content and the research landscape around it.
* Build and benchmark semantic and hybrid retrieval approaches, including embedding models and graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Contribute to the team’s technology radar by scouting, trialling and writing up new open-source libraries, models and tools for knowledge extraction and search.
* Build test sets, metrics and evaluation harnesses so that every claim we make about a model or tool is backed by evidence.
* Support the hand-over of graduating prototypes to Engineering teams, with clear documentation and a written definition of what “done” means.
* Present results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and contribute to papers, articles and conference submissions.

**What we’re looking for:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop NLP pipelines for tasks such as named-entity recognition, relation extraction, entity linking and disambiguation, topic modelling and classification over scholarly text, using transformer models and LLMs.
* Build, populate and query knowledge graphs in a graph database or triple store (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL stores) and evaluate their quality and coverage.
* Support the design and expansion of ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies, working with Editorial and subject-matter experts.
* Detect and track emerging topics and research areas using clustering, topic modelling and embedding-based techniques.
* Evaluate embedding models, chunking strategies, rerankers and retrieval configurations for semantic search and RAG on scholarly content.
* Create gold-standard datasets and annotation guidelines, and define metrics (e.g., precision/recall/F1, nDCG) for reproducible evaluation.
* Design and run well-controlled experiments, tracking them with tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases so results can be reproduced.
* Prototype rapidly using LLM APIs and open-source models for knowledge extraction and enrichment.
* Write clean, tested and documented Python code that other engineers can pick up and extend.
* Prepare hand-over documentation and support Engineering teams during the build phase of prototypes that graduate to production.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Editorial and other business teams to turn open-ended problems into well-posed research questions.
* Assist with vendor, model and tool comparisons, including preparing benchmark results for internal and external audiences.
* Keep up with the research literature and relevant venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, SIGIR, ISWC/ESWC) and share what is relevant with the team.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**:

**Good to have certifications**

* Neo4j Certified Professional (or equivalent graph database certification)
* DeepLearning.AI or Hugging Face NLP / LLM specialisation certificates
* Cloud ML or AI certification (e.g., AWS Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer)

**Technical Skills:**

* 2–4 years of experience applying NLP and machine learning in industry or research (or an MSc with relevant research or internship experience).
* Strong Python, including scientific libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and writing readable, tested code.
* Hands-on experience with NLP libraries and frameworks such as spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch.
* Practical knowledge of knowledge graphs and semantic technologies: property graphs and/or RDF, OWL and SKOS, with query experience in Cypher and/or SPARQL.
* Understanding of information retrieval and semantic search: embeddings, vector search (e.g., FAISS, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, pgvector), hybrid retrieval and RAG.
* Experience designing evaluation: test sets, annotation, metrics, error analysis and statistical sanity-checking of results.
* Working familiarity with LLM APIs and structured-output prompting for information extraction.
* Experience with Git, Linux, SQL and reproducible experiment environments (notebooks, virtual environments, containers).
* Ability to read research papers and reproduce their results from the paper or open-source repository.
* Experience with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) is a plus.

**Soft Skills:**

* Curious, rigorous and sceptical: comfortable saying “the evidence does not support this” and showing why.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical colleagues.
* Comfortable working under the technical direction of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined pieces of work.
* Able to manage several experiments at once and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
* A keen eye for detail and a commitment to reproducible, high-quality work.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with scholarly or scientific text and metadata (e.g., Crossref, OpenAlex, ORCID, ROR, PubMed).
* Exposure to ontology and taxonomy tooling (e.g., Protégé, PoolParty, SKOS editors).
* Exposure to LLM fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA, PEFT) or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph).
* Prior publication, conference presentation or open-source contribution.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira).

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, mathematics or a related field (or equivalent experience). Master’s degree (or PhD in progress/completed) is an advantage but not required.

 **Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

**What we offer in return:**

* Experience with CI/CD or release validation workflows, deployment process and code quality checking tools.
* Knowledge of project management, and productivity tools such as Wrike and Miro.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.
* Able to balance competing priorities, long-term projects, and ad hoc requirements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, constantly evolving business environment.
* Working across global teams to ensure alignment of product development.
* We're looking for someone with an eagerness and ability to learn new skills and solve dynamic problems in an encouraging and expansive environment.
* Ability to collaborate and influence multi-functional teams within your area of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Collaborate with multi-functional and globally distributed teams

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications

* Creative thinker and strong problem solver with meticulous attention to detail.

In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Architectural Vision& Complex Problem Solving:** Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership& Project Governance:** Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap& Strategy:** Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature& Framework Delivery:** Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:** Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security& Reliability by Design:** Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling& Security Architecture:** Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability& Proactive Risk Resolution:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.

**Mentorship& Engineering Culture:** Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).

Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.
  
  
Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: SAP Basis Technical SME
description:
**Who We Are**

You will ensure system availability, performance, security, and stability while supporting business-critical SAP applications hosted in enterprise environments.

* Monitor and optimize SAP system performance, availability, and capacity.
* Manage transports, client administration, and SAP user/security administration.
* Troubleshoot and resolve SAP Basis-related incidents and service requests.
* Support SAP HANA and database administration activities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and security teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Execute backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support cloud and hybrid SAP environments, ensuring compliance with organizational standards.
Participate in on-call support and maintenance activities when required.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* 5+ years of SAP Basis administration experience.
* Strong experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP NetWeaver environments.
* Hands-on experience in SAP installation, upgrades, patching, and system copies.
* Experience administering SAP HANA and/or Oracle databases.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management and landscape architecture.
* Experience with performance tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
* Experience working on Linux/Unix operating systems.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident/change management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.  

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience with SAP systems hosted on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Knowledge of SAP Solution Manager and SAP Focused Run.
* Exposure to SAP BTP and cloud integration technologies.
* Experience with automation and scripting (Shell, Python, Ansible).
* SAP Basis, SAP HANA, or related SAP certifications.
* Experience working in global support or managed services environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise monitoring tools and security compliance requirements.
Knowledge of virtualization and container technologies is an added advantage.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Sr. Data Management Engineer
description:
**Your Job**

Koch is looking for a Senior Data Management Engineer to design, build and run enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions on TIBCO EBX. You'll own the EBX platform end to end, from developing data models and workflows to managing upgrades, releases, security and production support. You'll also help set up and stabilise a dedicated EBX instance for the business, so your work will directly shape how reliable, scalable and trusted its master data is.

**Our Team**

You will join the Data Management team, which leads MDM, Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives that give Koch companies trusted data. The team works closely with business stakeholders, architects, data stewards and infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that support business transformation.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, develop, configure, and support **TIBCO EBX** solutions, including data models, datasets, relationships, permissions, workflows, business rules, validation controls, and data services.
* Develop custom Java components, validation rules, triggers, services, and workflow extensions.
* Implement multi-domain MDM and Reference Data Management solutions for Product, Supplier, Customer, Finance, Asset, and other business domains.
* Design integrations between EBX and enterprise applications using REST APIs, web services, data pipelines, and batch frameworks.
* Support data migration, bulk loading, data conversion, and onboarding.
* Participate in technical design reviews and align solutions with enterprise architecture standards and development best practices.

  
**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable MDM solutions.
* Participate in discovery sessions, solution workshops, backlog refinement, and design discussions.

* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

**Run & Maintain**

* Own day-to-day EBX platform administration, repository health, workflow operations, object cache, disk capacity, log management, scheduled housekeeping, and obsolete-content cleanup.
* Manage environments, installations, configuration, application server deployments, patches, hotfixes, upgrades, and technical refreshes across development, test, and production landscapes.
* Administer core platform configuration, repository connectivity, user and role directories, audit logging, email, data services, messaging, REST services, proxy settings, security controls, failover, and performance tuning.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, service health dashboards, operational checks, capacity plans, and preventative maintenance routines.

* Own release readiness, deployment planning, rollback procedures, production validation, change records, and post-release support.
* Coordinate repository backup, recovery testing, archive management, database maintenance, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and operational resilience.
* Maintain runbooks, support procedures, environment inventories, dependency maps, architecture records, and knowledge articles.
* Provide senior technical guidance and escalation support to developers, managed service providers, infrastructure teams, and business support teams

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Experience developing on TIBCO EBX, including data models, dataspaces, workflows, business rules, permissions and data services
* Experience administering and supporting TIBCO EBX in production, including upgrades, patches, environment management and incident resolution
* Experience with Java development, including building and debugging custom components
* Experience integrating EBX through REST APIs, XML, JSON, web services, messaging, batch processes, and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including query analysis and troubleshooting
* Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and JSON
* Strong understanding of MDM, RDM, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Modelling, and Metadata Management.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Extensive experience leading enterprise MDM or RDM implementations and operating TIBCO EBX as a business-critical platform.
* Deep expertise developing custom Java solutions, extensions, services, and integrations in EBX.
* Experience with high availability, failover, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, repository management, performance tuning, and platform observability.
* Experience automating deployments, environment configuration, monitoring, health checks, and operational support activities using DevOps practices.
* Experience with ETL, data migration, and large-scale data conversion initiatives.
* Experience integrating EBX with ERP, CRM, data warehouses, Finance systems, and enterprise applications.
* Experience with Snowflake, AWS, MuleSoft, Kafka, Informatica, Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling, or comparable enterprise technologies.
* Experience implementing Supplier, Customer, Product, Finance, Asset, or Reference Data domains.
* Experience supporting global teams, managed service partners, multi-business implementations, and enterprise transformation programmes

  
At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**

title: Principal Engineer — Python is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

We are seeking an experienced **Principal Software Engineer** to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.

title: AI Productivity Solutions Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company connecting patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management.

Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with more than 48,000 employees in nearly 60 countries, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 20 on the Fortune 500, America's Most Innovative Companies #51, 11 Best GCCs to work for in India, Fortune Sector Leaders: Health Care #5, with a $254 billion. of revenue in FY26.

**About Cardinal Health International India (CHII)**

This role is part of the Information Security function for Cardinal Health International India Pvt Ltd (CHII).

Cardinal Health International India (CHII) is part of the Cardinal Heath Global Technology and Business Services (GTBS) team. CHII leverages technology to offer scalable and healthcare solutions to enhance efficiency and improve quality of care across the value chain.

Our vision is to build a world class capability center that is an intersection of tech-innovation and learning, empowering our people to build solutions which will solve healthcare’s most complex challenges.

**Position Summary**

Provides advanced technical support, diagnostics, validation, and consulting for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, enterprise search, Microsoft Graph-grounded experiences, and approved productivity AI integrations. The role operates below the architecture layer and focuses on product expertise, troubleshooting, supportability, pilots, repeatable diagnostic methods, and the development of approved skills and lightweight agents that improve the internal operations of AI Productivity & Collaboration Services.

**Strategic Purpose**

Make AI work reliably in Cardinal Health's productivity environment, and apply approved AI capabilities to improve the team's own service delivery. This role becomes a deep Microsoft Copilot product specialist and a succession feeder for broader platform architecture, while developing bounded, supportable skills and agents for internal team operations without duplicating the enterprise agent-development mandate of Enterprise Automation.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Serve as the advanced technical subject-matter expert for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Microsoft 365 search, Microsoft Graph grounding, and related productivity AI capabilities.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving licensing, identity, permissions, content access, search indexing, grounding behavior, tenant configuration, application context, and user experience.
* Develop repeatable diagnostic methods, test plans, health checks, escalation packages, known-issue records, and technical runbooks.
* Partner with Microsoft and internal platform teams on escalations, root-cause analysis, service incidents, product defects, and roadmap-related technical questions.
* Validate new Copilot capabilities, configuration changes, and pilot implementations against architecture, security, privacy, supportability, and operational-readiness requirements.
* Perform technical testing of grounded responses and search behavior, distinguishing platform, permission, indexing, retrieval, content-quality, and user-behavior causes.
* Provide technical consulting on solution feasibility, licensing dependencies, integration boundaries, support models, and implementation risks.
* Support build-to-run transition for approved productivity AI capabilities by documenting support procedures, monitoring needs, known limitations, and escalation paths.
* Create scripts, reports, and diagnostic utilities using supported administrative interfaces, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph where appropriate.
* Mentor support and engineering staff on Copilot concepts, troubleshooting methods, responsible use, and escalation practices.
* Design, configure, test, document, and maintain approved Copilot skills, declarative agents, and other lightweight agent experiences that streamline team operations, knowledge retrieval, service reporting, support triage, documentation, and recurring administrative work.
* Identify internal team processes suited to skills or agent assistance, and define requirements, data sources, permissions, success criteria, human-review controls, support ownership, and lifecycle expectations before implementation.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, templates, test cases, monitoring approaches, and runbooks for team-operated skills and agents, including change control, versioning, access management, quality review, and retirement.
* Coordinate with Enterprise Automation when a use case requires enterprise-scale deployment, complex workflow orchestration, custom connectors, broader business ownership, or capabilities beyond the team's approved operating boundary.

**Key Accountabilities and Expected Outcomes**

* Faster resolution and stronger root-cause analysis for complex Copilot, search, and grounding issues.
* Repeatable technical validation and diagnostic patterns that support teams can reuse.
* More supportable pilot-to-production transitions for productivity AI capabilities.
* Reduced dependency on the AI Platform Architect for day-to-day deep technical investigation.
* Documented, supportable skills and lightweight agents that reduce manual effort and improve consistency within AI Productivity & Collaboration Services.

**Required Technical and Professional Competencies**

* Microsoft 365 administration and support across Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 Apps, Entra ID, and Microsoft Purview concepts.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Microsoft Graph, enterprise search, grounding, permissions, identity, licensing, and support diagnostics.
* PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, reporting, logging, technical testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* ITIL incident, problem, request, change, service transition, escalation, and root-cause-analysis practices.
* Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for support teams, content owners, business stakeholders, governance partners, and leaders.
* Configuration and lifecycle management of Copilot skills, declarative agents, prompts, knowledge sources, actions, permissions, test cases, and human-review controls within approved Microsoft platforms.
* Ability to assess internal operational processes for appropriate automation, define bounded agent behavior, validate output quality, document limitations, and transition solutions into a supportable run state.

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Four or more years of related IT experience, including significant Microsoft 365, productivity, collaboration, SaaS, or enterprise support experience.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting identity, permissions, search, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 administration, or complex cloud-service issues.
* Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Azure, Security, Power Platform, ITIL, or AI-related certifications are preferred.
* Experience configuring or supporting Copilot skills, declarative agents, low-code AI solutions, or comparable productivity automation capabilities is preferred.
