The Senior Manager, Data Engineering, provides people leadership and deep technical direction for the Visa Client Exchange Cloud Platform and Clean Rooms, a strategic FY27 priority. The role leads the engineering journey from pilot to production, enabling secure, scalable, privacy-preserving data collaboration and reliable data exchange across on-premises and cloud environments.

Providing technical guidance across the Frontier Agentic Squad’s and extending platform leadership coverage across multiple region, this leader translates business priorities into architecture decisions, engineering roadmaps, and dependable production services. Success is measured through business opportunities enabled, platform reliability, delivery quality, and the growth and independence of engineering teams.

This is a technically engaged management role requiring the credibility to challenge designs, review critical code, guide complex incident resolution, and develop technical leads without becoming a delivery bottleneck. The Senior Manager partners with Product, Architecture, Operations and Infrastructure (O&I), Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to balance customer commitments, security, privacy, cost, and sustainable execution.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

* Embed privacy, security, query governance, and data lifecycle controls into platform design and operation.
* Drive operational excellence through clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, and tested disaster recovery.

* Experience implementing secure data access, encryption, auditability, and data lifecycle governance in partnership with security, risk, privacy, or compliance teams.

* Digital fluency and the ability to evaluate AI-assisted engineering workflows for usefulness, quality, security, and appropriate human oversight.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.

title: Credential Protection Senior Security Analyst 1
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 12, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759372

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**IAM Vulnerability Analyst**

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

  

**The opportunity**

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, a part of Information Security which, enables over 400,000 individuals across 140+ countries to access systems and information securely. As part of the IAM organization, the IAM Vulnerability Manager within PSSI will be responsible for coordinating the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle for vulnerabilities reported against IAM services, platforms and assets.

The role partners closely with Global Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Operations, Architecture and Service Management teams to ensure vulnerabilities are reviewed, prioritized, assigned, tracked, reported and escalated through a consistent governance model.

This position will contribute towards the execution of the IAM vulnerability management strategy through intake coordination, prioritization, ownership validation, SLA oversight, reporting, dashboarding, escalation management and continual process improvement.

We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career receiving support, coaching and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role will give you an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!

This role supports various functions, including vulnerability intake, triage, asset and owner mapping, remediation tracking, service reporting, Power BI dashboarding, escalation coordination and executive visibility across the IAM vulnerability portfolio.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Vulnerability Intake & Triage**

* Receive and review vulnerability lists reported towards IAM services and assets.
* Validate vulnerability scope, affected assets, asset owners, severity and required remediation timelines.
* Sort and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, risk exposure, impacted service, asset criticality and SLA requirements.
* Maintain an accurate vulnerability register covering ownership, status, due dates, remediation progress and risk indicators.
* Ensure vulnerability records are complete, current and aligned with organizational standards.

**Assignment & Governance**

* Assign vulnerabilities to the appropriate technical groups, including Secure Access, IDM, Directory Enablement and other IAM teams as applicable.
* Coordinate with service owners and technical leads to confirm remediation ownership and delivery accountability.
* Define and maintain governance routines for vulnerability review, follow-up, escalation and closure.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions to resolve ownership gaps, prioritization conflicts and remediation blockers.
* Ensure the vulnerability management process remains effective, repeatable and fit for purpose.

**Remediation Tracking & SLA Oversight**

* Track remediation progress across assigned technical teams and monitor adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Identify overdue vulnerabilities, recurring blockers, dependency risks and remediation delays requiring escalation.
* Coordinate with technical teams to obtain remediation updates, target dates, closure evidence and exception details.
* Monitor aging vulnerabilities and ensure appropriate management attention for high-risk or overdue items.
* Support closure validation by ensuring remediation evidence and status updates are documented appropriately.

**Reporting, Dashboards & Visibility**

* Prepare regular operational and executive-level vulnerability reports covering status, trends, SLA performance, aging, ownership and risk exposure.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into vulnerability remediation performance across IAM.
* Monitor vulnerability trends and identify recurring systemic issues that may require broader service improvement actions.
* Provide reporting to support audit, compliance, risk management and leadership reviews.
* Track remediation actions through to completion and highlight deviations from agreed remediation plans.

**Stakeholder Management & Escalation**

* Act as the primary coordination point for IAM vulnerability management within PSSI.
* Build strong relationships across Global Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, Service Management, Risk and Audit teams.
* Escalate overdue, blocked or high-risk vulnerabilities through defined management and governance channels.
* Facilitate communication between vulnerability reporting teams, technical remediation teams and leadership stakeholders.
* Promote awareness of vulnerability management expectations, ownership standards, SLA requirements and reporting processes.

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Good understanding of vulnerability management, cyber risk management and enterprise remediation governance.
* Experience coordinating security remediation activities across multiple technical teams and service owners.
* Analytical acumen and solution orientation to prioritize risk, identify blockers and recommend practical remediation governance actions.
* Experience developing management reporting, service metrics and process improvement actions.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting views using Power BI or similar reporting platforms.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically and culturally dispersed organization.
* Effective communication and analysis skills to break down complex issues, formulate solutions and influence partners at various levels of the organization, including senior management.
* Possess knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM), including Incident, Problem, Change, SLA and escalation processes.
* Good understanding of project management principles and practices.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional governance reviews and remediation status meetings.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security or related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 5 - 8 years working within Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, IT Service Management or Vulnerability Management in a global firm.
* Experience coordinating enterprise vulnerability remediation activities across multiple teams.
* Experience with vulnerability reporting, remediation tracking, SLA monitoring and escalation management.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, operational metrics and dashboards.
* Knowledge of ITSM processes and service governance practices.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Understanding of Identity and Access Management concepts and IAM service portfolios.
* Experience supporting cyber risk, infrastructure, platform or application security remediation processes.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Power BI and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation Certification.
* Understanding of NIST Cybersecurity Framework, vulnerability remediation practices and risk-based prioritization principles.
* Working knowledge of Six Sigma and Lean Principles.

description:
**About us**

  

For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders.

  

**Our Culture**

We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role will you play in our team**
---------------------------------------

Conducting risk-based due diligence on prospective and existing counterparties. The role evaluates counterparty identity, ownership and control, business activities, regulatory status, geographic exposure, reputation, sanctions exposure, and other financial-crime or integrity risks.

Manage due diligence cases from initiation through completion, document findings and risk conclusions, identify information gaps and red flags, and escalate material concerns in accordance with company policies and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. The position will work closely with business stakeholders, Law, Risk & Controls, Procurement, Operations, and other control functions to support informed and timely counterparty decisions.

This role requires strong investigative judgment, attention to detail, concise writing, and the ability to balance risk management with business needs.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conduct initial, periodic, and event-driven due diligence reviews of counterparties, including legal entities, financial institutions, vendors, intermediaries, agents, and other third parties.
* Collect, verify, and analyze corporate registration records, organizational documents, ownership information, licenses, regulatory records, tax forms, certifications, and other supporting documentation.
* Identify and document ultimate beneficial owners, controlling persons, directors, authorized signatories, and relevant affiliates.
* Analyze complex ownership and control structures, including multi-tiered entities, investment funds, trusts, partnerships, state-owned entities, and offshore structures.
* Perform sanctions, PEP, watchlist, enforcement, and adverse-media screening on counterparties and relevant associated persons.
* Conduct open-source and database research to understand the counterparty’s business model, operating history, reputation, geographic footprint, products and services, and expected relationship with the company.
* Evaluate risk factors such as jurisdiction, industry, ownership, government affiliation, sanctions nexus, regulatory history, adverse information, and the nature and purpose of the relationship.
* Assign or recommend counterparty risk ratings using established policies, procedures, and risk-rating methodologies.
* Conduct enhanced due diligence when higher-risk indicators are present, including deeper investigation of ownership, source of funds or wealth when applicable, business rationale, regulatory standing, and adverse information.
* Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported due diligence reports that summarize findings, identified risks, mitigating factors, unresolved questions, and recommended disposition.
* Identify inconsistencies, information gaps, policy exceptions, and red flags, and escalate material concerns to the appropriate Compliance, Legal, sanctions, or risk authority.
* Partner with business sponsors and relationship owners to obtain required information and resolve outstanding due diligence items.
* Maintain accurate and complete case records, supporting evidence, approvals, and audit trails in applicable workflow or case-management systems.
* Monitor review deadlines, case aging, service-level expectations, and periodic-review schedules.
* Support quality-control reviews, internal audits, regulatory examinations, management reporting, and remediation initiatives.
* Stay informed of relevant changes in sanctions, AML, anti-bribery and corruption, beneficial-ownership, and third-party-risk requirements.
  

**Internal interface**

* Law
* Risk Advisory
* Procurement
* Treasurers
* Trading
* Operations
* Supply Planning & Logistics
  

**External interface**

All 3rd party types

**Behavioral Skills**
---------------------

**Analytical judgment**

* Evaluates information in context rather than relying solely on checklist completion.
* Distinguishes relevant risk indicators from immaterial or false-positive information.
* Reaches defensible conclusions when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
* Recognizes when enhanced due diligence or escalation is warranted.
* Current postings repeatedly emphasize risk identification, credible challenge, ethical judgment, investigative ability, and escalation of higher-risk findings.

**Investigative curiosity**

* Asks effective follow-up questions.
* Traces ownership, affiliations, and adverse information across multiple sources.
* Identifies inconsistencies among documents, databases, and counterparty representations.
* Open-source research, ownership analysis, sanctions and adverse-media investigation, and documentation of findings are common features of both analyst and senior analyst roles.

**Attention to detail**

* Produces complete, accurate, and internally consistent due diligence files.
* Applies procedures and documentation standards reliably.
* Maintains a clear audit trail.
* Accuracy, completeness, quality review, file maintenance, and adherence to internal standards are prominent requirements in KYC operations and quality-control postings.

**Written and verbal communication**

* Converts complex facts into concise, decision-ready summaries.
* Clearly explains risks, mitigating factors, and recommendations.
* Communicates professionally with business stakeholders and control functions.
* Narrative drafting, risk memoranda, reporting, and cross-functional coordination feature prominently in comparable roles.

**Stakeholder management**

* Works constructively with business teams while maintaining independence and appropriate challenge.
* Follows up persistently on missing information and approaching deadlines.
* Handles sensitive or potentially contentious issues professionally.
* Comparable postings expect analysts to collaborate with relationship managers, clients, customer service, Compliance, and other stakeholders to obtain documentation and move cases through approval.

**Organization and execution**

* Manages multiple cases and deadlines in a high-volume environment.
* Prioritizes higher-risk matters and time-sensitive escalations.
* Meets service-level and quality expectations with limited supervision.
* Current roles commonly require independent work, workflow tracking, periodic-review management, and timely completion of expiring records.

**Integrity and risk mindset**

* Demonstrates sound ethical judgment.
* Protects confidential information.
* Escalates concerns transparently.
* Applies policies consistently, even when business pressure exists.

**About You**
-------------

**Skills and Qualifications**

  

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, economics, criminal justice, international affairs, legal studies, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Two or more years of experience in KYC, AML, sanctions, compliance, counterparty risk, third-party due diligence, client onboarding, fraud investigation, or a related risk function.
* Working knowledge of risk-based due diligence concepts, including legal-entity verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions, PEPs, adverse media, and enhanced due diligence.
* Experience conducting research using public records, corporate registries, regulatory websites, commercial databases, and other open-source materials.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong business writing skills and the ability to produce concise, defensible risk narratives.
* Ability to interpret policies and apply them to varied legal entities and fact patterns.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and stakeholder requests.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.

**Preferred**

* Experience reviewing corporate entities, financial institutions, investment funds, intermediaries, government-connected entities, or multinational counterparties.
* Experience analyzing complex ownership structures and identifying ultimate beneficial owners.
* Familiarity with OFAC and other major sanctions regimes, PEP screening, adverse-media research, and financial-crime red flags.
* Knowledge of AML, anti-bribery and corruption, export controls, fraud, reputational risk, or third-party-risk frameworks.
* Experience with commercial screening and research platforms such as LexisNexis, Dow Jones, LSEG World-Check, Moody’s Grid, Sayari, Bureau van Dijk Orbis, or similar tools.
* Experience with KYC workflow, case-management, procurement, or governance-risk-and-compliance systems.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, quality assurance, or remediation projects.
* ACAMS, Certified KYC Associate, Certified Global Sanctions Specialist, Certified Fraud Examiner, or comparable certification.
* Foreign-language proficiency or international research experience where relevant to the counterparty population.

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time **Senior FP&A Analyst** in **Bengaluru, India**, we’re looking for?

  

**Your future role:** The GFC Senior FP&A Analyst processes multiple financial data and provides a fair view of Alstom, regional, cluster or site performance through consistent data aggregation and appropriate financial analyses. He or She:

* Assists Operational & Commercial teams with reports and ad hoc analyses.
* Supports the Alstom, regional, cluster or site management with analytics.
* Challenges internal stakeholders to stimulate company-wide, regional, cluster or site performance.
* Identify and streamline our reporting processes, and much more.
  

We’ll look to you for:

* Ensure all financial data is collected, processed, and analysed in a timely manner.
* **Review financial data (Cash, Sales, Gross Margin (GM), Under/Over, and NPOH) for Teranga pack submissions and ensure timely correction of errors.**
* **Perform month-end closing activities, including provision calculations.**
* Manage intercompany invoicing and recharge allocations from the Region.
* Calculate hedge exposures and process related accounting entries.
* Conduct P&L foreign exchange (FX) impact analysis, including spot-rate effects.
* Maintain and enhance financial analysis and reporting systems, with a focus on standardization and process improvement.
* **Prepare actual financial results and forecasts for POH, S&A, Tender and FTE; compare results against Budget and Plan and perform detailed variance analysis.**
* Execute budgeting (TYP), forecasting (F0/LE), and monthly reporting activities for all functions within the Region, ensuring accurate system alignment.
* **Partner with Function Heads and cost center owners to review spend performance and discuss plans and forecast assumptions.**
* Support the preparation and presentation of Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with Clusters and Regional leadership teams.
* Collaborate with Regional Business Performance Analysts to ensure alignment of operational KPIs and cost targets.
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Group Consolidation teams and Cluster/Regional stakeholders.
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* **A Chartered Accountant qualification or CMA or MBA in Finance.**
* CA Inter / CMA Inter / MBA in Finance with higher relevant experience.
* **5-8 years of experience in FP&A / Corporate finance.**
* **Knowledge of SAP ERP, Excel and PowerPoint.**
* Strong Analytical and Presentation Skills.
* Fluent in English.
* Experience in long term project accounting is good to have.
* Curious, striving to learn & develop.
* Synthesis, turn complexity/multiplicity into simplicity.
* Ability to multitask with efficiency and speed.
* Good, and improving, knowledge of the Business and of Key Performance Indicators.
* Detect & Fix issues with support from the team.
* Support initiatives to improve the processes.
* Demonstrate Teamwork, Honesty, Integrity, Courage.
* Good interpersonal skills: ability to listen, accept & convince avoiding conflict.
* Ability to Work in a matrix / multi cultured Environment.
* Can do attitude and knowledge in problem solving techniques.
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from routine.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership roles in IT Finance or other areas of interest.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Project Manager
description:
**\*\*URGENT REQUIREMENT\*\***

A Civil Project Manager is a professional responsible for overseeing and managing construction projects in the civil engineering sector. This role involves coordinating all aspects of a construction project, from planning and design through to execution and completion. The primary duties of a Civil Project Manager include:

* **Project Planning**: Developing detailed plans and timelines, budgeting, and resource allocation for construction projects. This also involves assessing risks and ensuring all necessary permits and legal requirements are met.
* **Team Coordination**: Managing and supervising teams of engineers, contractors, laborers, and other staff. Ensuring clear communication and resolving conflicts or issues within the team is crucial.
* **Budget and Cost Control**: Overseeing the project’s financial aspects, ensuring that the project stays within budget. This involves estimating costs, managing expenses, and addressing any financial discrepancies.
* **Quality Control and Safety**: Ensuring that all work meets industry standards and safety regulations. The Civil Project Manager ensures quality inspections are done regularly and that safety protocols are followed to minimize risks on-site.
* **Client Communication**: Acting as the main point of contact between the client and the construction team. The Civil Project Manager provides regular updates on the progress of the project and addresses any concerns or changes the client might have.
* **Scheduling and Deadlines**: Developing a timeline for the project and making sure milestones and deadlines are met. They often use project management software to track progress.
* **Problem Solving and Risk Management**: Handling any unexpected issues or challenges that arise during the project, such as delays, design changes, or material shortages, while managing the associated risks.
* **Documentation and Reporting**: Keeping detailed records of the project's progress, budgets, and any changes or incidents that occur. This documentation may be required for legal reasons or project review.

**Education:** BTech(Civil), BE(Civil)& Diploma(Civil) with 10 years as experience as a Project Manager

To succeed as a Civil Project Manager, strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential, along with a deep understanding of construction processes and civil engineering principles.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Lead
description:
### **About Zinnov**

Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:

* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M&A decisions, and long-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data-led, execution-focused, and outcome-driven** — not opinion-heavy slideware.

At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media & Telecom, and Private Equity.

Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Why Globalization Excellence (GE)**

Zinnov’s Global Excellence (GE) practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end-to-end — from Design & Discovery to Build, Scale, and Run.

In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:

Own complex, end-to-end client journeys

Work across GCC advisory, managed services, and BOT / outsourcing models

Influence leadership decisions that shape long-term talent and operating strategies

This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.

**About the role:**

Zinnov helps global enterprises set up and scale their Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India. As part of our innovation offering, we run **open innovation programs** that help enterprises connect with the startup ecosystem — find relevant startup partners against real business challenges, running pilots, and turning them into adopted solutions.

We are looking for a **Project Lead** to run the startup-collaboration engine of the program — owning the startup journey from sourcing and selection, through pilots, to product adoption and go-to-market. This is a high-ownership and client facing role. You will be the first point of contact for founders and for the client, accountable for moving startups from first contact to a landed outcome.

**What makes it distinctive:** This role is built for someone from the **startup ecosystem**, an accelerator or incubator operator, a corporate-innovation or VC professional, or a former founder with existing founder relationships and the judgement to tell a real pilot from theatre. The ecosystem credibility is what you bring and demonstrated in the role.

**What you'll do:**

* **Bring the outside in** **perspective** - Track emerging innovation models, startup-ecosystem shifts, and what leading corporate startup programs are doing and translate that into fresh thinking for how the program evolves. Have a point of view, and challenge how things are done

* **Market Intelligence –** Scan the start-up ecosystem**,** scout, identify, and bring in startups that genuinely fit the program's technology and business challenges, drawing on your own network and building new pipeline. Quality fitment and run custom evaluation to explore synergies between start-up and the Enterprise.

* **Run the program end-to-end -** Own the operational spine day-to-day. Keep every workstream on track, and report progress and outcomes to the senior program owner and enterprise sponsors.

* **Own the startup relationship -** Be the point of contact for founders across the journey. Understand their technical and business needs and be their voice inside the program.

* **Run pilots to a result -** Scope focused, measurable proof-of-concept engagements between startups and the enterprise teams and drive them to a quantified outcome.

* **Drive product adoption and go-to-market -** Move startups from pilot to adoption — working alongside solution architects and enterprise stakeholders — and open co-sell and go-to-market opportunities where they fit.

* **Orchestrate the ecosystem -** Sit at the center of founders, mentors/advisors, enterprise sponsors, and internal Zinnov teams — matching the right startup to the right problem and holding momentum across all parties.

* **Build the outcomes narrative -** Capture and package metrics and results achieved over a time

**What you bring:**

Qualifications & Experience

* 4–9 years' experience with meaningful time in the **startup ecosystem** - Accelerator / incubator, corporate innovation or open-innovation team, VC/PE, or as a founder / early operator.

* A real, active network of startup founders and ecosystem players you can draw on from day one.

* **A point of view, and the curiosity to keep forming one.** You spot patterns across the ecosystem, form original perspectives on where innovation is heading, and can argue against them credibly with senior stakeholders.

* **Direct experience operating a corporate or platform startup program** is highly valued. You understand first-hand about program’s strategy, thesis and operations

* Demonstrated experience running structured programs — Cohorts, accelerators, pilots, or innovation challenges from start to measurable finish.

* Strong stakeholder skills: Equally credible in a founder's Slack and a GCC leader's boardroom.

* A bias for outcomes over activity, you measure success in pilots landed and business value created

* Comfortable being embedded and client-facing and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving program.

**Strong plus**

* Command of enterprise technology or a specific deep tech / AI / data domain, enough to earn credibility in a technical conversation.

* Familiarity with GCCs / global captives is welcome but not required; strong ecosystem candidates will be brought up to speed on the GCC context quickly.

* Prior consulting or client delivery experience is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like – Globalization Excellence (GE)**

* Engagements delivered end-to-end with strong quality, predictability, and stakeholder confidence.

* Teams coached to produce sharper research, stronger insights, and consistently client-ready narratives.

* Strong client trust built through clarity, cadence, and reliable delivery under tight timelines.

* Visible BD contribution through solutioning, proposals, and repeatable sales assets.

* Practice impact through reusable frameworks, thought leadership, and capability building.

**If you enjoy owning consulting engagements end-to-end, leading teams to deliver analysis-rich and client-ready outcomes and shaping solutions that influence senior stakeholders — this role offers both impact and growth.**

**Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

**A cloud-based field service management SaaS platform is Looking for:******
**Senior System Operations Engineer**
**About The Role**
CS is a SaaS platform that field service businesses rely on every day. We are looking for a Senior System Operations Engineer with 6 to 10 years of experience who will own the reliability of our production Linux estate on Google Cloud Platform. This is not a ticket-handling role. You will be the expert Linux troubleshooter the team escalates to, the owner of our Disaster Recovery design and execution, and a hands-on technical lead who mentors engineers, leads major incidents, and drives improvement projects from idea to production. You will work closely with the Cloud Architect, turning architecture direction into working, documented, and tested systems.
  
  
**Our Environment**
**Cloud-**
Google Cloud Platform: Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud LoadBalancing, Cloud DNS
  
  
**OS Linux**
servers across the estate (Ubuntu / Debian / RHEL family)
  
  
**Containers**
Docker, Kubernetes on GKE
  
  
**Web & App**
Nginx, Apache, application servers
  
  
**Data**
Self-managed database servers (MySQL / PostgreSQL) with replication and backups
  
  
**IaC & Scripting**
Terraform, Bash / Shell, Python
  
  
**Practice**
Disaster Recovery, observability, CI/CD, change management, documentation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Disaster Recovery: Design, Build and Own
  
  
■ Classify services by business criticality and agree RPO / RTO targets with engineering and business stakeholders.
  
  
■ Design and implement the DR architecture on GCP: cross-region standby, snapshot and image policies, database replicas, DNS and load balancer failover, GKE workload recovery.
  
  
■ Build DR infrastructure with Terraform so the recovery environment can be recreated from code, not memory.
  
  
■ Write and maintain DR runbooks and playbooks plan and lead failover drills at least twice a year, report findings and close the gaps.
  
  
■ Own the backup strategy for servers and databases and prove it with scheduled, documented restore tests.
  
  
**Linux Expertise & Escalation Troubleshooting**
■ Act as the final escalation point for complex production issues across OS, network, web, application and database layers.
  
  
■ Deep-dive performance problems: CPU scheduling, memory and OOM behaviour, disk and filesystem I/O, network stack, file descriptors and kernel parameters (sysctl).
  
  
■ Use advanced tooling such as strace, perf, tcpdump, lsof, sar, iostat, ss, eBPF-based tools to find root cause.
  
  
■ Define and maintain Linux build, hardening and patching standards for the whole estate.
  
  
**Incident Leadership & Reliability**
■ Lead major incidents as incident commander: coordinate, communicate status and drive to resolution.
  
  
■ Run blameless post-incident reviews, write RCAs and make sure corrective actions are completed.
  
  
■ Define SLIs / SLOs for key services design and own the observability stack (metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards) and reduce alert noise.
  
  
■ Design and improve the on-call process, escalation paths and runbook coverage.
  
  
**Cloud, Containers & Platform (GCP / GKE)**
■ Design and operate GKE clusters: node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, network policies, ingress, upgrades with minimal disruption.
  
  
■ Introduce and maintain Helm / GitOps practices for consistent, reviewable deployments.
  
  
■ Design GCP networking and IAM following least privilege own GCP cost optimisation and right-sizing.
  
  
**Web, Application & Database Platforms**
■ Tune Nginx and Apache for performance and security: reverse proxy, TLS, caching, rate limiting, high availability.
  
  
■ Partner with developers on application server performance, capacity and release readiness.
  
  
■ Design database high availability and failover plan and execute upgrades and migrations with low or zero downtime lead capacity planning.
  
  
**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**
■ Write reusable Terraform modules, manage remote state and bring manually built infrastructure under code.
  
  
■ Build automation in Python and Shell that removes toil contribute to CI/CD pipelines and configuration management (e.g. Ansible).
  
  
■ Own change management: peer-reviewed, tested and reversible changes to production.
  
  
**Security & Compliance**
■ Drive OS and cloud hardening, vulnerability remediation, secrets and certificate management.
  
  
■ Support security audits and customer due diligence questionnaires with accurate evidence and documentation.
  
  
**Leadership, Mentoring & Documentation**
■ Mentor junior and mid-level engineers: review their work, pair on incidents and grow their troubleshooting skills.
  
  
■ Own the team''s runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams and DR documentation set the documentation standard.
  
  
■ Plan and deliver improvement projects communicate clearly with engineering, support, and management.
  
  
■ Contribute to architecture discussions with the Cloud Architect and give honest, evidence-based recommendations.
  
  
**Must – Have Skills & Experience**
■ 6 to 10 years of hands-on Linux system administration/operations in production. with at least 3 years supporting a SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Expert-level Linux troubleshooting, with clear examples of complex production issues you diagnosed and permanently fixed.
  
  
■ Strong hands-on GCP experience (AWS/Azure experience transferable).
  
  
■ Production experience running Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE, including upgrades and troubleshooting.
  
  
■ Deep knowledge of Nginx and Apache and application server stacks.
  
  
■ Database operations (MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL): replication, HA, failover, backup/restore, performance basics.
  
  
■ Strong Terraform experience, including writing modules and managing state.
  
  
■ Strong Shell and good Python for automation and tooling.
  
  
■ Solid DevOps practice: Git workflows, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting design.
  
  
**■ Experience Leading Incidents And Mentoring Other Engineers.**
■ Clear communicator with strong documentation habits, able to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Good to Have**
■ Ansible or other configuration management at scale.
  
  
■ With at least 3 years supporting a SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Loki, OpenTelemetry or similar observability stacks.
  
  
■ Helm, Argo CD / Flux, Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions.
  
  
■ Redis, RabbitMQ or similar supporting services in production.
  
  
■ Proven DR experience: you have designed or substantially built a DR setup, defined RPO/RTO and run real failover tests.
  
  
■ Comfortable working with open-source tools and reading docs, source code and logs to solve problems.
  
  
■ Certifications: RHCE, Google Professional Cloud Architect / DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKS.
  
  
■ Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR controls.
  
  
**Why join us**
■ Own Disaster Recovery and reliability for a live, customer-facing SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Modern cloud stack: GCP, GKE, Terraform and open-source tooling.
  
  
■ Real influence on how the platform is built, working directly with the Cloud Architect.
  
  
■ A clear growth path towards Lead / Architect roles, with learning and certification Expert-level Linux troubleshooting,support.

title: Senior Software Integration Engineer
description:
Job Role Description
  
  
Are you passionate about architecting enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines that empower embedded software teams to deliver with speed, quality, and confidence? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.
  
  
As our new
**Senior Software Integration Engineer**
, you'll be designing and maintaining automated build, test, and deployment workflows for embedded software products that accelerate DevOps adoption across Grundfos engineering teams. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  
As a key part of the Embedded Software Integration & DevOps team, you'll create impact by driving engineering transformation by building scalable CI/CD infrastructure and automation frameworks that elevate software delivery across multiple product platforms.
  
  
Your main responsibilities include:
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines for embedded C/C++ software products, including automated build, test, validation, and deployment workflows
* Define and enforce pipeline standards, quality gates, and governance practices while building reusable templates and shared automation frameworks across product teams
* Integrate static code analysis, security scanning, unit testing, and compliance checks into delivery pipelines, implementing DevSecOps and software supply chain security practices
* Drive DevOps adoption across engineering teams by mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and leading automation initiatives organization-wide
* Develop Python-based solutions for build orchestration, deployment automation, and API integrations with DevOps and SCM platforms
* Manage cross-compilation toolchains, artifact repositories, and firmware build/packaging/deployment processes while troubleshooting complex build and dependency issues

What makes you a great fit
  
  
Above all, you're a seasoned integration engineer with deep CI/CD expertise, a DevOps-first mindset, and the ability to drive standardization and automation across multiple embedded software teams. We'd also imagine that you are/have:
  
  

* 9+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Build Engineering, DevOps, or CI/CD Automation with proven experience designing pipelines from scratch
* Strong experience supporting Embedded C software development environments including cross-compilation, toolchain management, and firmware deployment
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and implementing DevSecOps practices including software supply chain security
* Demonstrated ability to lead automation initiatives across multiple teams with excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

It's a plus if you also:
  
  

* Familiarity with tools such as Black Duck, SonarQube, Coverity, or Fortify, and experience in regulated industries with cybersecurity requirements for embedded products
* Track record of driving engineering transformation initiatives at scale

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  
**J**
**oin Grundfos, apply today!**

title: Platform Distribution Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Platform Distribution Architect**
to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers.

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments.

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Distribution Architecture**

* Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK.
* Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments.

**2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness**

* Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers.
* Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Design**

* Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes.
* Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies.

**4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation**

* Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows.
* Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes.

**5. CI/CD and Release Automation**

* Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration.
* Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability.

**6. Self-Service Distribution**

* Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces.
* Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers.

**7. Upgrades and Migrations**

* Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes.
* Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation.

**8. Observability and Reliability**

* Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments.

**9. Security and Compliance**

* Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code.

**10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency**

* Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations.
* Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency.

**11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership**

* Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover.
* Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews.

**What You Bring**

* **Multi-cloud architecture:**
  Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or GCP — covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security.
* **Kubernetes and containers:**
  Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* **CI/CD and release automation:**
  Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as Code:**
  Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools.
* **Deployment architecture:**
  Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation.
* **Observability and reliability:**
  Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.
* **Programming and scripting:**
  Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell.
* **Core technical fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals.

**Good to Have**

* Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries.
* Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python.
* Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture.
* Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

**Interested?**

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you.

* Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

title: Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
Architect role in a global organization focused on designing and optimizing scalable data and analytics solutions using Azure DevOps Python Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to create reliable platforms that turn data into actionable insights and support sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design robust end to end data architectures that leverage Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark to deliver secure and scalable analytics platforms that support critical business decisions and long term growth outcomes.
* Develop reusable Python and PySpark components that standardize data ingestion transformation and validation patterns so that teams can accelerate delivery while maintaining consistency and quality across projects.
* Implement Azure DevOps based continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that automate build test and deployment stages to improve release reliability and reduce operational risk for data products.
* Collaborate with data engineers data analysts and application teams to translate complex functional requirements into pragmatic technical designs that align with enterprise standards and business priorities.
* Optimize Databricks SQL queries and cluster configurations to improve performance manage costs and ensure efficient use of compute resources across multiple data and analytics workloads.
* Define reusable workflow orchestration patterns in Databricks Workflows that coordinate data pipelines quality checks and downstream consumption tasks to ensure predictable and observable operations.
* Establish and document data engineering and coding standards for Python PySpark and SQL so that project teams can follow clear guidelines that support maintainability security and traceability.
* Review solution designs and implementation artifacts to identify architecture risks performance bottlenecks and security gaps and then propose concrete improvements that can be implemented with minimal disruption.
* Guide teams in implementing monitoring logging and alerting across Databricks and Azure resources so that issues can be detected early and resolved before they impact business users and partners.
* Partner with product and business stakeholders to prioritize backlog items that have the highest impact on customer value operational efficiency and responsible use of data across the organization.
* Conduct architecture and design walkthroughs with peer architects and engineers to validate alignment with target reference architectures and to share best practices that raise overall engineering maturity.
* Create clear technical documentation covering solution architecture data flow diagrams security controls and operational procedures so that ongoing support and future enhancements are straightforward and well understood.
* Contribute to innovation initiatives by evaluating new Azure and Databricks features and proposing pilot implementations that can simplify data platforms improve sustainability and enhance societal impact of analytics solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Require extensive hands on experience designing and implementing data platforms with Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark including building scalable batch and near real time data pipelines that support analytics and reporting.
* Require strong proficiency in Python programming for data processing reusable library development and automation with a proven ability to write clean modular and testable code for large scale systems.
* Require demonstrated expertise in Azure DevOps including repository management branching strategies pipeline as code and release automation tailored to data engineering and analytics workloads in hybrid environments.
* Require solid understanding of data modeling performance tuning and query optimization using SQL based technologies so that complex analytical workloads remain responsive and cost efficient.
* Require experience in designing secure data solutions with proper access control data masking and compliance alignment to protect sensitive information and maintain organizational trust.

title: Product Security Lifecycle leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description**
**About The Role**
The Product Lifecycle Leader is a specialized operational leadership position responsible for the technical execution of the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations across GE Vernova Power Conversion Solutions (PCS).
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Cybersecurity Leader, you will drive the practical implementation of security requirements and ensure all NPI and OTR programs meet rigorous technical standards throughout their lifecycle. You will exercise high levels of operational judgment to manage a team of technical specialists, deploy advanced security tooling, and lead the technical response to vulnerabilities to protect our products and global supply chain.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SDLC Implementation & Governance**

* Operational SDLC: Drive the practical application and technical execution of security processes across all PCS NPI programs, ensuring development teams meet secure development requirements.
* Tooling & Automation: Deploy and maintain the necessary tools (SAST/DAST, automated gates) and technical training required for engineering teams to integrate security into their daily workflows.
* Supplier Security Operations: Execute the service supplier security maturity program (aligned to IEC 62443 2-4), managing the technical assessments and training for third-party partners.
* OTR Technical Support: Lead the technical integration of regional OTR teams into the standardized SDLC for application-level development.

**PSIRT Operations & Vulnerability Management**

* Team Leadership: Direct the daily operations, performance, and technical output of PSIRT Analysts and security specialists, acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical challenges.
* Vulnerability Management: Lead the technical intake, triage, and prioritization of vulnerabilities, providing the defensible rationale for risk thresholds and remediation paths.
* Technical Risk Execution: Direct the execution of threat modeling, penetration testing, and formal risk assessments for product releases, solving technical problems that fall outside standard parameters.
* Incident Liaison: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to ensure PSIRT findings and technical vulnerabilities are directly integrated into future design improvements.

**Innovation & Performance Tracking**

* Next-gen Tech: Champion the adoption of frontier AI-based code analysis to accelerate proactive vulnerability management and improve CI/CD security analysis.
* Operational Metrics: Track and report performance-level metrics, such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR), to measure the speed and effectiveness of the PSIRT function.
* Advisory Management: Execute the security advisory and CVE monitoring process in collaboration with Senior Cybersecurity Leader and GEV CIRT team

**Supply Chain and SBOM**

* SBOM Operations: Maintain SCA tooling and operationalize SBOM standards, ensuring 100% visibility into the source and binary components of product and system.
* Technical Response: Ensure all supply chain components are defined in GE Vernova’s vulnerability management tool allowing for rapid impact analysis when upstream vulnerabilities are detected.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: Significant experience in technical Cybersecurity Leadership, specifically SDLC implementation and PSIRT management.
* Leadership: Proven track record managing a team of technical specialists and driving adoption of new security technology/ tools.
* Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of secure development lifecycle and vulnerability management, incident response and automated security testing
* Certifications: CISM, CISSP, CSSLP, GICSP or equivalent.
* Communication: Ability to simplify technical operational risk and remediation plans for senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Desired**

* Education: Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Cybersecurity.
* Standards Knowledge: Experience applying standards such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in a practical, industrial development environment.

**Additional Information**
**What you can expect from us:**
Compensation Grade: SPB2
  
  
Relocation Assistance Provided: No
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
===========================

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**
===============

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**
=======================================

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
============================

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.**

Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

title: Inside Sales Executive (AI & Data Solutions - APAC Market)
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Inside Sales Executive to drive lead generation and business development activities for our AI, Data Analytics, and Digital Transformation services across the APAC region, primarily focusing on the Singapore market.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and reaching out to senior decision-makers, including C-level executives, IT Directors, CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Data, and other technology leaders within IT companies and enterprises.

The primary objective is to generate qualified business leads, initiate conversations with potential clients, qualify opportunities, and arrange meetings between prospective customers and our senior sales/business leadership team to explore potential AI and Data project opportunities.

The role will be performed remotely from an offshore location, requiring strong communication skills, confidence in engaging senior stakeholders, and the ability to build a consistent sales pipeline in the Singapore market.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Lead Generation & Prospect Identification**

* Identify potential customers, target companies, and business opportunities across Singapore and the wider APAC market.
* Build and maintain a database of IT companies, enterprises, financial institutions, and other potential customers.
* Research organisations to identify relevant decision-makers, including CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, IT Directors, and Heads of Data and Analytics.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, online research, company databases, networking platforms, and other prospecting channels.

**2. Outbound Calling & C-Level Engagement**

* Conduct outbound cold calls and email campaigns to prospective customers.
* Proactively reach out to C-level executives, business heads, IT leaders, and technology decision-makers.
* Introduce our AI, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Digital Transformation capabilities.
* Initiate meaningful business conversations and create interest in our technology services.
* Build relationships with senior stakeholders and identify potential business requirements.

**3. Lead Qualification & Opportunity Identification**

* Understand the prospect's business challenges, technology landscape, and potential IT requirements.
* Identify opportunities related to AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Cloud Data Platforms, and Digital Transformation.
* Qualify leads based on business needs, project potential, budget, decision-making authority, and timelines.
* Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, follow-ups, and lead status.

**4. Meeting Arrangement & Sales Pipeline Development**

* Schedule qualified business meetings between prospective customers and the internal sales/business leadership team.
* Ensure meetings are arranged with relevant decision-makers and stakeholders.
* Share meeting briefs, prospect information, business requirements, and opportunity details with the internal team.
* Conduct consistent follow-ups to convert initial conversations into meaningful business discussions.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified leads and sales opportunities.

**5. Market Research & Reporting**

* Research the Singapore IT services market and identify potential business opportunities.
* Track competitor activities, market trends, and emerging AI and Data technology requirements.
* Provide regular reports on calls made, prospects contacted, leads generated, meetings arranged, and qualified opportunities.
* Maintain CRM records and ensure timely follow-ups with prospects.

**Target Audience**
-------------------

The candidate will primarily engage with:

* CEOs, CIOs, CTOs and CDOs.
* Chief Digital Officers and Chief Technology Officers.
* IT Directors and Heads of Technology.
* Heads of Data, Analytics and AI.
* Heads of Enterprise Architecture and Digital Transformation.
* Business Development and Technology Leaders.

**Target Organisations:** IT services companies, consulting firms, banks, financial institutions, insurance companies, fintech organisations, and large enterprises across Singapore and APAC.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Telecalling, Lead Generation, B2B Sales, or Business Development within the IT industry.
* Proven experience in outbound calling, cold calling, and B2B prospecting.
* Ability to confidently communicate with senior-level executives and C-level stakeholders.
* Experience generating leads and arranging business meetings for IT services or technology solutions.
* Good understanding of IT services, AI, Data Analytics, Cloud, and Digital Transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong research, prospecting, follow-up, and relationship-building capabilities.
* Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM platforms, and lead-generation tools will be an advantage.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working independently from an offshore location.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

Performance will be measured based on:

* Number of targeted companies and decision-makers identified.
* Number of outbound calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of meetings successfully arranged with C-level and senior IT stakeholders.
* Number of sales-qualified opportunities created.
* Consistency of follow-ups and development of the sales pipeline.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

We are looking for someone who is confident, persistent, and commercially driven, with the ability to pick up the phone, approach senior executives, open business conversations, and create opportunities from scratch.

The ideal candidate should have a strong hunter mindset, be comfortable with cold calling, and possess the confidence to engage decision-makers in Singapore-based IT companies and enterprises.

**Success in this role is defined by the ability to generate quality leads, establish connections with senior decision-makers, and consistently arrange qualified business meetings that create opportunities for AI and Data projects.**

description:
