**Overview**
The Sr.Technical Analyst – Process Mining and Modeling is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the technical delivery and lifecycle management of global process-mining and process-modeling solutions from technical intake through operational adoption. Working from defined business problems and requirements established with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role, this position translates business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions using SAP Signavio, SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning systems, and related data platforms. The analyst owns the technical data foundation, solution design, configuration, technical validation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of process-mining and process-modeling solutions. The role partners closely with process owners, the business-facing process-mining role, and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, actionable, secure, and sustainable, while the business-facing role owns business interpretation, improvement action planning, and value realization across General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical intake, solution design, estimation, and delivery planning for global process-mining and process-modeling initiatives, building on business opportunities and requirements defined with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role.
* Partner with the business-facing process-mining role, Process Owners, and data owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements, data definitions, KPI logic, analytical acceptance criteria, and traceable solution designs.
* Design, build, and validate the data foundation required for process mining, including source-data preparation, event logs, connectors, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls across SAP S/4HANA, ERP, and related data platforms.
* Configure and deliver SAP Signavio process-mining and process-modeling solutions, including process discovery, process analysis, and BPMN-based modeling where applicable, to produce reliable and actionable insights from approved business requirements.
* Provide strong technical leadership for workstreams and delivery partners by making solution decisions, setting technical direction, managing technical risks and dependencies, and ensuring quality across implementation activities.
* Lead technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement across the solution lifecycle; coordinate business validation and user acceptance with the business-facing process-mining role and Process Owners.
* Enable adoption through clear technical documentation, solution walkthroughs, capability guidance, and operational support. Partner with the business-facing process-mining role to support improvement outcomes, while maintaining clear D&T ownership of technical readiness, reliability, and sustainability.
* Establish and apply reusable technical standards, delivery practices, architecture principles, data-quality controls, release practices, and governance expectations for process-mining and modeling solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.
* Global Collaboration: Experience delivering global solutions with teams across regions and time zones.

description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.
  
  
**Required Skills**
['AI', 'API', 'LLM', 'REST', 'SQL', 'database']
  
  
Additional Information

title: Fraud Analytics Expert
description:
**About VARTIS Platforms (Formerly known as LenDenClub Techserve Pvt. Ltd.)**

At VARTIS Platforms, we are a corporate group on a mission to democratize credit access and empower millions of people through cutting-edge technology. We focus on building trust and convenience, leveraging AI to drive the information revolution for smarter risk management and operational efficiency. VARTIS Platforms is profitable, rapidly scaling, and industry-recognised. Our impact has been acknowledged with top honours, including being awarded as the Best Fintech Provider by Financial Express, a testament to our product excellence, customer experience, and leadership in regulated financial technology.

**Our portfolio includes:**

**LenDenClub:** An RBI-licensed P2P marketplace that connects borrowers with lenders in a seamless digital ecosystem.

**InstaMoney:** Instant digital loans that enable quick, secure, and accessible financial support.

**NiveshGold:** India’s next-gen digital vault for wealth preservation, starting with 100% pure, insured 24K digital gold.

**UdharSaathi:** A structured working capital platform built exclusively for QR active kirana stores, pharmacies, and small retailers.

**Role Summary**

You will build the AI that stops fraud at LenDenClub before money moves: graph models that expose fraud rings, and face match and liveness models that confirm a real, present person is behind every application. You own these models from data to production.

* **Fraud rings:** model borrowers, devices, phones, bank accounts, UPI handles, addresses and IPs as one graph, and catch coordinated networks that single-application rules miss.
* **Identity:** verify that the selfie matches the KYC photo and that the face is live, not a print, replay, mask, deepfake or injected camera feed.
* **Real stakes:** your models sit in the live onboarding and disbursal flow of an RBI-regulated lender, where a miss means a loss and a false alarm means a lost genuine customer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design the entity graph: nodes, edges and features across applications, devices, bank accounts, UPI handles, contacts and addresses.
* Build GNN models (GraphSAGE, GAT, heterogeneous and temporal GNNs) for node classification, link prediction and fraud-ring detection.
* Combine GNNs with community detection (Louvain, Leiden), graph features and tabular models where they perform better.
* Build and tune face match on KYC photos (Aadhaar, PAN, DigiLocker, Video KYC captures) using ArcFace-class embeddings.
* Build passive and active liveness and presentation-attack detection against prints, replays, masks, deepfakes and virtual-camera injection.
* Measure performance by device tier, lighting and skin tone, and close gaps before they reach customers.
* Deploy low-latency inference for real-time onboarding, including on-device models (ONNX, TFLite) where needed.
* Work with risk, operations and investigation teams to label cases, explain alerts and turn confirmed fraud into training data.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 3+ years in machine learning with models shipped to production in fraud, risk, identity or a comparable adversarial domain.
* Hands-on GNN work with PyTorch Geometric or DGL on real, large, noisy graphs, not only benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on computer vision for face recognition or face anti-spoofing, with evaluation using FAR/FRR or APCER/BPCER.
* Strong Python, PyTorch and SQL; able to build features from raw event and identity data yourself.
* Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain why a cluster was flagged to an investigator and a risk head.

**Preferred Skills**

* Graph databases such as Neo4j or TigerGraph, and streaming graph updates.
* Fraud domains: mule accounts, synthetic identities, loan stacking, collusive borrower networks.
* Deepfake and injection-attack detection; familiarity with ISO/IEC 30107-3 presentation attack testing.
* Indian KYC flows: Aadhaar e-KYC, CKYC, DigiLocker and Video KYC.
* Learning with scarce, delayed labels: semi-supervised, anomaly detection, active learning.
* Model explainability for graph and vision models.
* Handling biometric data under the DPDP Act.

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* Your fraud experience is limited to rules engines or threshold tuning.
* You have only integrated third-party face match or liveness APIs, never trained or evaluated such models.
* You have worked with graphs only on academic datasets.

**What You Get**

* Ownership of fraud and identity AI for a platform with over 2 Cr users.
* Real fraud labels and investigator feedback to learn from, not synthetic benchmarks.
* Direct work with the Chief of AI, Risk and Operations leadership.
* A path to lead the fraud AI function as it grows.

title: ML Systems Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Experience:**
9–13 Years
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Notice Period:**
Immediate to 45 Days(889)
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced ML Systems Engineer to manage and maintain traditional Machine Learning models in production environments.
  
  
The role focuses on deploying predictive models, managing retraining cycles, monitoring model performance, identifying data and model drift, and ensuring reliable model operations. You will work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams to maintain the accuracy, stability, and performance of machine learning solutions.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational role involving production model management, deployment pipelines, performance tracking, and model lifecycle maintenance. The primary focus is on conventional predictive ML models rather than Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management
* Manage the deployment of trained machine learning models into production environments.
* Execute model packaging, validation, testing, and release activities through established CI/CD pipelines.
* Coordinate model retraining and deployment cycles based on business and operational requirements.
* Maintain model versions, deployment records, and associated lifecycle documentation.
* Ensure new model releases are validated before being moved into production.
* Model Monitoring & Drift Detection
* Monitor production models to ensure consistent accuracy and performance.
* Identify data drift, feature drift, and concept drift that may impact model predictions.
* Generate regular monitoring reports and highlight deviations from defined performance thresholds.
* Investigate changes in model behaviour and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Track model performance over time and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Model Validation & Performance Optimization
* Evaluate updated models against existing production models before deployment.
* Perform backtesting and champion-challenger comparisons to assess model effectiveness.
* Validate prediction quality and ensure that model changes meet expected performance standards.
* Execute optimization routines to identify suitable interventions based on model predictions.
* Support controlled model promotion and rollback activities as per approved procedures.
* Model Governance & Reporting
* Maintain model lineage, including version history, training data, baselines, and previous stable releases.
* Prepare reports covering model performance, operational costs, and resource utilization.
* Ensure model documentation and tracking records remain accurate and up to date.
* Maintain visibility into model deployment, retraining, and monitoring activities.
* Data Quality & Cross-functional Coordination
* Identify data quality issues that may affect model accuracy and production performance.
* Work with Data Engineering and Data Science teams to investigate and resolve data-related concerns.
* Communicate technical issues, operational updates, and performance findings to relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely escalation of incidents and deviations that require further investigation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong 4+yrs of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, Data Engineering, or DevOps.
* Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production.
* Practical experience with customer churn prediction models.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines for machine learning workflows.
* Understanding of model registries, version control, and model lineage.
* Knowledge of model retraining, validation, and production release processes.
* Experience identifying and monitoring data drift, feature drift, and model performance changes.
* Understanding of data processing, model evaluation, and performance reporting.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams and communicate technical updates effectively.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience in telecommunications or large-scale data environments.
* Exposure to predictive use cases such as customer churn, fraud detection, and forecasting.
* Knowledge of champion-challenger testing and backtesting techniques.
* Experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms and services.
* ML or cloud-related certifications.
* Experience working with distributed data and engineering teams.

Work Requirements
  
  

* Location: Pune.
* Work Mode: Work from Office.
* Shift: Rotational shifts, including occasional weekend and public holiday coverage.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a shift-based operational environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for regular coordination with distributed teams.

description:
**Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead**

**About Armstrong Dematic**

Armstrong Dematic is one of India's leading intralogistics and warehouse automation companies. For over 25 years, we have been powering the movement of goods across the country, helping some of India's most trusted brands run their warehouses faster, safer and more reliably. We design and deliver automated warehouse solutions using intelligent robots, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), high-speed sortation systems and advanced software platforms.

India’s leading e-commerce, FMCG, retail, automotive and pharma brands trust us with large, mission-critical automation projects. We are 700+ professionals across Nashik, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and Bengaluru. At Armstrong Dematic, you don't just build systems; you build solutions that move the nation.

**The Role**

As a Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead in our Systems Engineering function, you will lead system validation, technical reviews and risk management for large-scale warehouse automation projects. You will ensure that integrated systems (mechanical, controls and software) meet performance, safety and reliability expectations. The role requires strong ownership across FAT, SAT and system performance validation, along with mentoring junior engineers and driving first-time-right execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Review & System Validation**

•     Ensure alignment of system design with project requirements and operational expectations

•     Own the validation strategy for the complete system, including mechanical, controls and software interfaces

•     Identify design gaps early and drive corrective actions proactively

**2. Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

•     Lead system-level risk assessment including functional, operational and safety risks

•     Drive risk mitigation plans with cross-functional teams

•     Ensure closure of critical risks before system deployment

•     Continuously monitor system performance to identify emerging risks

**3. FAT / SAT Ownership**

•     Own preparation and readiness for FAT and SAT activities

•     Define, review and approve test cases for system validation

•     Lead FAT/SAT execution and ensure first-pass success

•     Analyse test results and drive improvements before final deployment

•     Ensure alignment between system performance and customer expectations

**4. Documentation & Reporting**

•     Ensure preparation and validation of acceptance test plans for the complete system

•     Maintain structured documentation for validation, risk and compliance

•     Generate technical reports and communicate findings to stakeholders

•     Ensure traceability between requirements, validation and outcomes

**5. Cross-Functional & Supplier Collaboration**

•     Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Software and Project teams

•     Drive alignment across design, execution and commissioning phases

•     Support issue resolution across the lifecycle, from design to site execution

•     Coordinate with third-party equipment suppliers to align technical specifications, interfaces and testing requirements

**6. Safety & Compliance**

•     Ensure compliance with safety standards such as ISO 13849, IEC 61508 and OSHA

•     Validate safety mechanisms including emergency stops, interlocks and fail-safe operations

•     Lead safety validation during FAT and commissioning

**7. Site Support & Commissioning**

•     Travel to project sites (>30%) for commissioning, troubleshooting and validation

•     Ensure system readiness for handover to the customer

•     Support resolution of critical site issues and performance gaps

**8. Mentoring & Capability Building**

•     Mentor junior systems engineers on validation, risk assessment and technical reviews

•     Establish best practices, checklists and validation frameworks

•     Support knowledge sharing and team capability development

**9. Continuous Improvement**

•     Drive improvements in validation processes and systems engineering practices

•     Capture learnings from projects and implement standardisation

•     Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies

**How Success Is Measured**

•     FAT/SAT first-pass success rate

•     Reduction in site issues and rework

•     Risk identification and closure effectiveness

•     System performance stability post deployment

•     On-time validation and readiness

•     Stakeholder feedback and satisfaction

**Qualifications**

•     Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics, Automation, Production or a related field

•     5+ years of experience in systems engineering or a similar field within automation or industrial projects

•     Strong understanding of warehouse automation, material handling systems and order fulfilment

•     Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and system validation

•     Knowledge of controls, system architecture and software integration

•     Proficiency in risk assessment and technical validation processes

•     Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills

title: CIS PROGRAM MANAGEMENT
description:
Job Description

**Transition and Transformation Program Manager - Cloud, Infrastructure and Security Services**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi-workstream technology transformation programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data centre and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for strategy, roadmap, governance and integrated delivery from discovery and architecture through build, migration, testing, acceptance, go-live, hypercare and value realization, including M&A integration, divestiture or separation where applicable.

**Role Information**

**Details**

**Role**

Transition and Transformation Program Manager

  

**Practice**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services

  

**Location**

Pune

  

**Employment Type**

Full-time

  

**Experience**

15+ years overall IT experience, including 10+ years leading complex transformation, cloud/infrastructure implementation, migration, transition or program delivery

  

**Reporting**

Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services leadership / assigned program leadership

**Role Purpose**
================

Provide end-to-end leadership for large transformation programs involving multiple projects, service towers, vendors and geographies. The Program Manager aligns business outcomes, architecture, commercial commitments and delivery capacity; establishes decision rights and stage gates; and ensures that technology change is implemented, accepted, stabilized and transitioned into a sustainable operating model.

**Key Accountabilities**
========================

**Transformation Strategy and Mobilization**
--------------------------------------------

* Own the transformation charter, target outcomes, roadmap, delivery model, business case, benefits, funding, critical success measures and executive governance.
* Lead discovery and assessment across estates, applications, infrastructure, cloud readiness, security, operating model, service performance, technical debt, dependencies and regulatory constraints.
* Convert solution and contractual commitments into an integrated program covering architecture, engineering, migration factories/waves, service transition, organizational change and benefits realization.
* For M&A, divestiture or carve-out programs, govern Day-1 readiness, interim/TSA services, separation or integration roadmaps, data and identity boundaries, vendor dependencies and exit milestones.

**Architecture, Build and Implementation Governance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Govern target architecture and design authority across cloud landing zones, hybrid infrastructure, connectivity, identity, security, resilience, backup/DR, observability, automation and ITSM integration.
* Coordinate program increments and workstreams for platform build, environment provisioning, configuration, integration, remediation, application/workload migration and decommissioning.
* Ensure security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience and non-functional requirements are embedded in design and validated before production use.
* Establish stage gates and assurance reviews for discovery, design approval, build completion, test readiness, migration readiness, service acceptance and program closure.

**Testing, Migration and Go-Live**
----------------------------------

* Own the integrated assurance strategy across functional, integration, security, performance, resilience, backup/restore, disaster recovery, operational readiness and user/business acceptance.
* Govern migration-wave planning, pilots, rehearsals, cutover runbooks, change approvals, command-centre arrangements, go/no-go decisions, rollback strategy and executive communications.
* Manage cross-program defects, dependencies and readiness risks, ensuring objective acceptance evidence and accountable sign-off by business, technology, security and operations.
* Lead go-live and hypercare governance, using agreed stability and service measures to control exit into steady-state operations.

**Program Governance, Commercial Control and Value**
----------------------------------------------------

* Establish steering committees, design authorities, delivery forums, PMO controls, reporting cadence, decision rights, escalation routes and integrated RAID management.
* Own budget, forecast, resource demand, supplier performance, contractual milestones, change control, contingency, cost risk and program-level financial reporting.
* Align customer executives, account leadership, architects, engineering teams, application owners, security, operations, legal, procurement and delivery partners.
* Track benefits and transformation outcomes, including modernization, automation, cloud adoption, resilience, security posture, service quality, operating-model improvement and cost optimization.
* Ensure closure includes accepted deliverables, as-built and operational documentation, CMDB/asset updates, knowledge transfer, residual-risk ownership, lessons learned and benefits handover.

**Required Experience**
=======================

* 15+ years in IT, including 10+ years leading large and complex transformation or program delivery across cloud, infrastructure, security, network, workplace or data-centre domains.
* Proven leadership of end-to-end implementation and migration programs spanning discovery, architecture, build, testing, cutover, hypercare and operational acceptance.
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, multiple suppliers, distributed delivery teams, executive sponsors and business-critical production change.
* Experience in outsourcing/managed services transformation; M&A integration, divestiture, carve-out or TSA exit experience is advantageous where relevant.

**Technical and Functional Skills**
===================================

* Cloud and hybrid platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP and private cloud; infrastructure modernization, landing zones, network, identity, workplace, security, observability, backup and disaster recovery.
* Program and portfolio governance, architecture assurance, migration factory/wave management, quality management, commercial control, benefits realization and executive reporting.
* Understanding of security and compliance controls, Zero Trust, IAM, vulnerability management, SOC integration, data protection and operational resilience.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI and Microsoft 365.

**Qualifications and Certifications**
=====================================

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or Business Management; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional is advantageous.
* Azure, AWS or GCP certification is desirable; security/governance certification is beneficial.

**Behavioral Competencies and Selection Criteria**
==================================================

* Executive presence, commercial judgement and the ability to simplify complex technical and delivery matters for senior audiences.
* Decisive, transparent and accountable leadership across ambiguity, pressure and competing priorities.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution and supplier-management capabilities.
* Can evidence leadership of a large transformation from discovery and target-state design through implementation, migration, acceptance, stabilization and measurable business outcomes.

description:

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
**The Salesforce Architect should be able to:**  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.

* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
**Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:**  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience

description:

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Dynatrace Observability Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, operating and optimising Dynatrace across complex enterprise environments. You will work across modern observability, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, cloud and on-premises monitoring, translating telemetry into actionable insights that improve application availability, performance, reliability and end-user experience.

The role involves close collaboration with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams to establish proactive observability across business-critical services.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Deploy, configure, manage and troubleshoot **Dynatrace OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube**, and onboard applications, infrastructure, middleware, Kubernetes workloads and cloud services. Configure and manage **Real User Monitoring (RUM)**, analyse user journeys and Core Web Vitals including LCP, INP and CLS, and resolve instrumentation and communication issues.
* Configure browser and HTTP **Synthetic Monitoring** for critical applications, APIs and business journeys across public and private Synthetic locations. Use **APM, PurePath, Service Flow and distributed tracing** to analyse application dependencies, failures, exceptions and performance bottlenecks.
* Deploy and operate Dynatrace within **Kubernetes** environments, monitoring clusters, nodes, namespaces, workloads, pods, containers and services. Support observability across **cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments**, including AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Correlate **metrics, logs, traces, events and business telemetry**, applying observability approaches such as RED and USE to improve root-cause analysis.
* Implement and troubleshoot **OpenTelemetry**, including the OpenTelemetry Collector, OTLP, telemetry pipelines, resource attributes, context propagation and Dynatrace integration. Define and monitor **SLIs, SLOs and error budgets**, supporting proactive reliability improvements and incident, problem and performance management.

title: Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data**

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. This role sits in the AI and Data Organisation, supporting the AI and Analytics Platform team which makes AI, ML, analytics, metrics, behavioural data and experimentation fast, governed, reliable, self-service and cost effective for every Expedia team.

As a Technical Program Manager III, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs, connecting strategic goals to clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery. You will own integrated program plans from concept through completion and make scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and critical paths visible so teams can make timely, informed trade-offs. You will raise risks and blockers early, apply sound judgment to options and trade-offs, and create clarity on ownership, decisions, and next steps. This role also strengthens portfolio visibility and operating rhythms across teams and divisions by creating practical planning and reporting mechanisms, and applying AI, automation, and reusable delivery frameworks to improve how work gets done.
  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Lead strategic program delivery. Translate business objectives and product or technical requirements into integrated plans, milestones, workstreams, and execution priorities. Drive delivery end to end, adapting plans as scope, sequencing, capacity, or context changes.
* Connect work to business outcomes: Partner with Functional Area and team leaders to assess whether proposed work supports AI and Data and Expedia Group priorities. Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before execution, and use results to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Make the portfolio visible: Maintain an accurate view of programs including commitments, status, dependencies, risks, and changes. Develop roadmaps and concise leadership updates that provide the right visibility with minimal overhead and be candid when commitments are at risk or information is unresolved.
* Enable planning and prioritization: Support quarterly planning cycles that connect team commitments to Expedia Group goals. Facilitate prioritization and trade-off discussions so leaders and teams can focus capacity on the most important outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment: Coordinate engineering, product, design, data, business, and partner teams. Build trusted working relationships and help surface and resolve program-level questions about system design, APIs, data, operating models, and delivery approaches; document decisions, owners, and their implications so teams can move forward with shared understanding.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change: Identify issues and bottlenecks early, maintain clear ownership and mitigation plans, and escalate when needed. Track cross-team dependencies and critical paths, frame trade-offs, and communicate impacts to scope, schedule, and outcomes.
* Establish effective operating mechanisms: Create or improve governance, status reporting, decision forums, team communications, and delivery practices that support transparent decisions and reliable execution without unnecessary process. Use expertise to recommend practical approaches when teams face ambiguity.
* Advance AI & Data delivery frameworks: Use appropriate AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline program planning, synthesis, reporting, risk identification, and repeatable workflows. Develop reusable program frameworks and self-service paths that help teams spend more time on high-value work. Help teams safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities, applying foundational AI/ML concepts in real product and engineering contexts and using judgment about human review, data handling, and appropriate tool use.
* Measure and improve: Define and report program and team outcomes, delivery health, and relevant performance metrics. Monitor product or capability performance after launch, identify opportunities to simplify processes, and turn insights into actionable improvements. Use data and operational insights to improve predictability, workflow, and delivery quality.
* Build trusted partnerships: Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders who have varied perspectives. Communicate technical and business concepts clearly to delivery teams, partners, senior leaders, and executives.
* Stay curious: Keep learning about the AI and Data domain, the business, emerging AI tools, and better ways of working; apply relevant learning to continually improve program delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* You have 5+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.
* You use data and metrics to make program decisions, identify trends, surface risks, and tell a clear story to technical and leadership audiences.
* You have experience operating effectively in ambiguous environments and creating structure that helps teams move forward with confidence.
* You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences and can translate complex technical or delivery topics into actionable updates and decisions.
You bring a strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams, functions, and time zones.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering complex, technical programs at scale, particularly where operational excellence, reliability, security, production readiness, or customer outcomes are central.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across teams or domains without direct authority, including communicating trade-offs and helping teams reach alignment.
* Experience establishing program metrics, dashboards, or feedback mechanisms that surface execution challenges and improve predictability and delivery performance.
* Practical experience applying AI-assisted program or engineering tools, or AI/ML concepts, to improve product capabilities, delivery workflows, risk management, or business outcomes.
* Experience with one or more of the following: data platforms, semantic or metrics layers, experimentation platforms, BI or self-service analytics, or developer-facing platform products.
* You have experience driving platform adoption or consolidation efforts across multiple customer groups and partner organizations.
* Experience supporting data governance or management capabilities such as metadata, lineage, access control, certification, or data quality.
Experience driving platform adoption or consolidation across customer groups and partner organizations, including programs supporting executive reporting, experimentation, or shared analytics at scale.  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

title: Linux Server & System Administrator
company: Policy Master Insurance Brokers Pvt Ltd.
description:
Job Description – Linux Server & System Administrator

Experience: 2+ Years

Operating System: Ubuntu Linux / Linux Server

Web Server: Apache HTTP Server

Virtualization: VMware vSphere / ESXi (Basic Knowledge Preferred)

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a Linux Server & System Administrator with 2+ years of hands-on experience in Linux server administration, installation, configuration, security hardening, Apache Web Server management, firewall configuration, and user access management.

The candidate should be capable of independently setting up, securing, monitoring, and maintaining Ubuntu Linux servers and troubleshooting routine production server issues.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Linux Server Administration & Setup

● Installation, configuration, and maintenance of Ubuntu Linux servers.

● Server provisioning, network configuration, hostname, static IP, DNS, and SSH setup.

● User and group management, file permissions, sudo privileges, and package management using APT.

● Disk, filesystem, storage, service, process, and scheduled task management.

● Routine server maintenance, updates, and security patching.

B. Linux Security & Access Management

● Implementing Linux security policies and server hardening best practices.

● Managing user permissions, sudo access, password policies, and least-privilege access.

● Configuring secure SSH access, key-based authentication, and restricting root login.

● Managing authorized users and restricting unauthorized access to critical directories and services.

● Monitoring authentication logs and identifying suspicious login activities.

C. Apache Web Server Management

● Installation, configuration, and maintenance of Apache HTTP Server.

● Configuring Virtual Hosts, document roots, website directories, and hosting multiple websites.

● SSL/TLS certificate installation, HTTPS configuration, and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.

● Managing Apache modules, services, access/error logs, and troubleshooting website issues.

● Basic Apache security hardening and directory access restrictions.

D. Firewall & Network Security

● Configuring and managing Linux firewalls using UFW and basic iptables.

● Managing inbound/outbound traffic, port restrictions, and IP-based access control.

● Configuring firewall rules for SSH, HTTP, HTTPS, and application-specific services.

● Restricting unnecessary open ports and allowing access only from authorized IP addresses where required.

● Monitoring firewall rules and troubleshooting network connectivity issues.

E. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Maintenance

● Monitoring CPU, RAM, disk space, network utilization, uptime, and running processes.

● Managing system services using systemctl and monitoring logs using journalctl and /var/log/.

● Troubleshooting Apache, SSH, firewall, network, and general Linux server issues.

● Performing routine server health checks and root cause analysis.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project

* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Director of Engineering
