title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Position: Lead / Architect Python & Data Infrastructure Engineer**

**Total experience: 9+ yrs**

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

9+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or large-scale data platforms.

Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in the modern Python ecosystem (FastAPI, uv, async I/O, typing).

Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks).

Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform.

Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with pipeline orchestrators such as Dagster, Celery, or Apache Airflow.

Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics.

**Good To Have**

Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka.

Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines).

Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd).

Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS.

Active contributions to open-source software.

**Roles and Key Responsibilities:**

1. Backend & Microservices Engineering:

Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).

Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).

Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

2. Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management:

Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.

Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).

Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

3. Data Infrastructure & Orchestration:

Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.

Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).

Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns.

Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms.

4. Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD

Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform).

Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm.

Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines.

5. Observability & Reliability Engineering

Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks.

Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

**Note: Please send Cv only, who can attend the interview weekdays, with short notice period (max 15 days only)**

**Job Location: Kochi, (work from office only) (Face to Face Interview only)**

**Employment Type: 1 Year Contract**

description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Title** : Lead Technology Analyst – SAP BASIS & Data Integration

  

**Experience:** 10+ years

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly accomplished **Lead SAP Basis & Data Integration** with **10+ years of deep technical experience** to lead the architecture, health, performance, and data integration strategy across our enterprise SAP landscape.

In this role, you will act as the principal bridge between core SAP systems, modern cloud data architectures, and data-driven business insights. Beyond deep-dive SAP HANA and BASIS administration, you will drive modern data provisioning strategies ( **SAP SLT, SDI, SDA, SAP BTP, and SAP Datasphere** ) and contribute to **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** involving data extraction, replication, and system landscape optimization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* **10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP BASIS, SAP HANA, and Data Integration tools ( **SLT, SDI, SDA** ).
* Proven track record in **S/4HANA transformations** , leading data provisioning and replication strategies.
* Good to have knowledge of **SAP BTP** , **SAP Datasphere** , and third-party tools like **SNP Kyano** .
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related fields.
* Relevant SAP certifications in HANA Administration or Data Integration are preferred.

### **Must-Have Skills & Tools**

* **Core Expertise:** SAP BASIS Architecture, SAP HANA Administration, SAP SLT, SAP SDI, SAP SDA, SAP BTP, SAP Datasphere, SNP Kyano.
* **Tools & Platforms:** SAP HANA Cockpit, HANA Studio, Web IDE, Database Explorer, DP Agent, SAP Solution Manager, CTS+/ChaRM.
* **Architectural Mastery:** Enterprise replication topologies, custom ABAP transformation rules, multi-tier flowgraphs, federated virtualization, latency optimization, and S/4HANA migration data pipelines.
* **Leadership & Core Traits:** Strategic problem-solving, advanced analytical troubleshooting, cross-functional stakeholder management, and a strong commitment to mentoring junior and mid-level engineering staff.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Data Provisioning (SLT / SDI / SDA)**

* Architect real-time **SLT replication** , including custom ABAP transformation rules, table partitioning, and latency tuning.
* Demonstrate expert-level execution of table reload strategies, trigger management, and logging table synchronization during SLT source system refreshes or system copy activities.
* Configure **SDA remote sources** for federated querying across heterogeneous databases.
* Deploy and manage **DP Agents** , adapters, and complex **SDI flowgraphs** for ETL and data ingestion.
* Act as the final escalation lead for replication failures, DP Agent issues, and schema synchronization issues.

**2. S/4HANA Transformation & Cloud Integration**

* Lead data replication and provisioning architectures for **S/4HANA transformation initiatives** .
* Leverage tools like **SNP Kyano** for optimized data migration, transformation, and landscape optimization.
* Build and govern hybrid data integration pipelines connecting core SAP systems to **SAP BTP** and **SAP Datasphere** .

**3. Core BASIS & HANA Administration**

* Oversee end-to-end SAP BASIS operations, multi-tenant HANA governance, upgrades, and system copies.
* Manage transport systems (TMS, CTS+, ChaRM) to ensure stable, zero-downtime release management.
* Maintain system availability, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) readiness.

**4. Optimization, Security & Leadership**

* Perform expert troubleshooting for **HANA memory, CPU bottlenecks, thread locks, and SQL tuning** .
* Implement HANA security roles, SSL/TLS pipeline encryption, and firewall concepts.
* Establish technical SOPs, operations runbooks, and mentor team members in technical best practices.

You will be part of the Purchasing / Procurement Operations team, reporting to the Associate Manager, Procurement Operations, and working closely with Finance, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and business stakeholders across Workday.

**About the Role**

As a **Sr. Associate Purchasing Analyst** , you will support day-to-day operations within the Source-to-Pay (S2P) workstream, with a primary focus on supplier onboarding, supplier data management, and contract routing. You will work closely with senior analysts, your manager, and cross-functional stakeholders to onboard suppliers, maintain and update supplier records, coordinate contract reviews and approval workflows, track signatures, and monitor renewal dates.
  
  
You will leverage your working knowledge of Source-to-Pay processes and familiarity with procurement and financial systems to deliver accurate, timely, and customer-focused support. You will follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain strong attention to detail, and contribute to process improvements.
  
  
A successful candidate will demonstrate accountability, a willingness to learn, openness to feedback, and flexibility as the role evolves.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Support supplier onboarding, maintenance, and data updates in alignment with Procurement Operations policies and controls.
* Support contract routing by coordinating stakeholder reviews, tracking approvals and signatures, monitoring renewal dates, and maintaining accurate contract records and documentation.
* Apply working knowledge of the end-to-end Source-to-Pay process and follow established SOPs to maintain quality, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies and SOX controls, escalating exceptions as needed.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, respond to routine queries, and support the preparation of training materials on procurement processes and tools as your expertise grows.
* Use Workday Procurement and Financial systems and reports to monitor work queues, track turnaround times, and highlight recurring issues or potential enhancements.
* Contribute to process-improvement efforts and recurring daily, monthly, and quarterly activities in support of team goals and Workday’s Core Values.
* As a secondary responsibility, review purchase requisitions for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate coding; coordinate approvals and support purchase order processing under guidance from senior team members.
* As part of this purchasing support, partner with Accounts Payable and senior analysts to help resolve straightforward invoice and receiving discrepancies, escalating complex issues as needed.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience as a Procurement Buyer, Purchasing Analyst, Supplier Master Data Analyst, or in Procurement Operations, including hands-on experience onboarding suppliers and maintaining supplier master data in enterprise systems.

**Other Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of supplier onboarding, supplier master data management, and Source-to-Pay processes, plus familiarity with procurement, financial, and contract management systems. Workday experience is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-service mindset, and the ability to collaborate across global teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks accurately.
* Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with accountability for completing assigned work.
Willingness to learn new systems and contribute to process improvements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and comfort with data and reports are expected. Experience with contract approval workflows, e-signatures, purchase requisitions, or purchase orders is a plus.  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

title: MS Dynamics365 Technical
description:
**Position Summary**
**MS Dynamics365 Technical**
Deloitte USI Consulting Services is looking for experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Technical Consultants with proven hands-on expertise in at least one full ERP implementation project.
  
  
****Summary****
As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Technical practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise-scale D365 F&O technical solutions spanning across custom development, integrations, data migrations, and reporting collaborating with cross-functional and global teams to translate client functional and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and high-quality deliverables. You will independently manage your technical workstream responsibilities while guiding and mentoring junior team members, bringing structure and expertise to every stage of the engagement. Your role spans the full project lifecyclefrom estimation and planning through build, testing, cutover, and post go-live support ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions that meet client needs and project delivery standards.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
You will lead technical integrations, reports, data migrations, and system extensions analyzing client needs and designing, building, configuring, testing, and supporting Microsoft Dynamics Finance & Operations solutions. You will manage activities across the full engagement, from requirements gathering through post go-live support, overseeing testing, deployment, and status reporting while establishing best practices that drive quality and reuse. You will proactively collaborate with project teammates, contribute innovative solutions, debug and troubleshooting technical issues, and manage client and stakeholder expectations to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.
  
  
****Qualifications Section****

* 6+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations(F&O) technical roles.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O technical tools and capabilities, including SSRS, X++, C#, Business Event Framework, Web Services, Logic Apps, Azure Data Lake, Power Platform, Data Management Framework (DMF), Workflows, Reporting, Integration patterns such as file based, dual-write, virtual entities, & OData, to design, build, test, and deploy technical solutions.
* Hands-on experience in at least one end-to-end Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations ERP implementation project in a technical role. Multiple full life cycle implementations are preferred and expected for more experienced candidates.
* Proficient with integration tools and data entities, with the ability to translate functional and integration requirements into robust, scalable technical designs. Understanding of batch processing and experience in developing enhancements.
* Experience in leading design discussions and owning solutioning using Microsoft Dynamics 365 tools. Understanding of Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for environment management, Azure DevOps for source control, build pipelines, CI/CD automation and familiarity with the cloud environments.
* Understanding of Security Architecture including roles, duties, privileges, and permission sets. Ability to design and implement custom security roles is an added advantage.
* Create and maintain technical design documents in line with delivery standards. Conduct unit testing, support test cycles and address technical defects.
* Experience with data migrations and ETL processes is preferred and would be an added advantage.
* Coordinate with Client IT and boundary systems for end-to-end testing and cutover activities.
* Capable of working independently, managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Mentor junior consultants and review their technical deliverables.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills with mature judgement.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Hands-on or experience with Copilot Agents and AI-driven extensions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience working with Dataverse for data modeling, integration, and extending Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions.

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
****Benefits To Help You Thrive****
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering**
**GCL: F**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to define the enterprise standard for data engineering and turn strategy into measurable outcomes that accelerate insights to patients? In this role, you will establish the main direction for data engineering across AstraZeneca. You will be responsible for building and scaling a distributed service that provides trusted, high-quality, secure, and cost-efficient data products at enterprise scale.
  
  
You will own the end-to-end build of our data engineering capability. This includes driving visibility and lineage, automated quality controls, FinOps governance, performance SLAs/SLOs, and regulatory compliance across crucial information domains. Working as part of a varied community of specialists, you will connect strategy to execution, partnering across business technology groups to standardize how data is acquired, transformed, orchestrated, and delivered for impact. Can you turn a long-term architecture into reusable accelerators that dozens of teams embrace and love?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy aligned to our 2030 Data Strategy; translate vision into a capability model, adoption roadmap, service tiers, and maturity milestones that build measurable business value.
* Build and lead a focused, high-performing team of specialists; set direction on technology perfection across acquisition, storage, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, CI/CD, and containerization using Snowflake, Fivetran, Dbt, DataOps.live, and SnowPark Container Services. Govern the standardization of end-to-end data engineering solutions aligned with enterprise architecture; establish enterprise practice as a foundational pillar of data management.
* Champion automation across the lifecycle—impact analysis, design, build, test, deploy—leveraging AI code generation (for example, Snowflake Cortex Code and GitHub Copilot) to increase velocity and quality while reducing defects and time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
* Embed governance-as-code and preventative controls; design pipelines and patterns that achieve close to zero cost leakage on cloud infrastructure, and uplift performance metrics including latency, reliability, and quality through clear SLAs/SLOs.
* Operate and scale a federated service across business technology groups; enable alignment, capability uplift, and reuse via onboarding kits, templates, and self-service accelerators.
* Partner with leaders across data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise/domain/solution architecture; liaise with procurement, finance, legal, quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor partners to ensure compliant, secure, and value-driven delivery.
* Drive adoption through education, enablement, and community practices; measure success through standardization, automation readiness, turnaround time to business value, capability maturity, and adoption velocity.
* Proactively raise, handle, and mitigate risks; ensure alignment to regulatory requirements (including privacy, GxP, SOx, and HIPAA as applicable) without slowing delivery.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Preferably 15+ years in data engineering leadership roles at an enterprise capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience in data engineering capability involving data acquisition, data storage, data ingestion, data transformation, data orchestration, CI/CD, containerization.
* Extensive practical experience engaging with Open table standards (for ex, Iceberg) and Open technical catalogs (for ex, Snowflake Horizon).
* Extensive practical experience handling Structured, Semi-Structured and Unstructured data assets and engineering.
* Mandatory (Must Have) Skills – Snowflake, Fivetran DBT, DataOps.live, SnowPark Container technology, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon, Snowflake Cortex software (CoCo), AWS S3.
* Optional (Nice to Have) Skills – Databricks, Snaplogic, Apache Polaris, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, AWS Redshift, Docker, Kubernetes, MWAA, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Expertise with modern data architectures, cloud data platforms and data engineering lifecycle implementation and practices.
* Solid understanding of metadata, lineage, security classification, FinOps, and SLA/SLO frameworks.
* Confirmed leadership in large-scale, federated, global technology environments.
* Ability to influence, educate, and lead change across technical & business teams.
* Background in regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare) with Data Privacy, HIPAA, GxP & SOx.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Track record establishing new capabilities from scratch and scaling globally.
* Experience defining enterprise service tiers, maturity models, and adoption programs.
* Proven leadership developing talent and hard-working technical teams.
* Strong collaborator management and collaboration across matrixed environments.
* A forward-thinking approach combined with a commitment to taking initiative and delivering tangible outcomes.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our outstanding and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here you will build from scratch with a collective of inclusive self-starters who share ideas, challenge with grit, and make bold thinking real. We bring unexpected teams into the same room—engineers, scientists, analysts, and partners—using brand-new data and AI tools to turn complexity into practical insights that help patients sooner. You will work at the heart of our information transformation. u will have the autonomy to set direction and the community support to deliver it. You will balance ambition with care while scaling solutions across a worldwide information ecosystem.
  
  
Lead the enterprise backbone supporting data engineering and watch your strategy translate into faster, trusted insights for patients—step forward and build what comes next.
  
  
**Date Posted**
12-Nov-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
03-Dec-2026
  
  
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Data Governance Team Lead - Telematics
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Caterpillar is seeking an Engineering Team Leader to help build the data foundation for its connected products.
  
  
Caterpillar equipment generates large volumes of operational, engineering, diagnostic, and telematics data. Turning that data into trusted, understandable, reusable information requires more than collecting it. Data must have consistent definitions, appropriate context, clear ownership, measurable quality, discoverability, and controls governing how it is created and used.
  
  
The Engineering Team Leader - Data Governance will provide technical and project leadership for initiatives that improve the quality, governance, metadata, standardization, and usability of connected-product data.
  
  
This role will work across engineering, connectivity, digital products, data platforms, analytics, and AI teams to make Caterpillar data easier for both people and intelligent systems to discover, understand, and use appropriately.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Data Governance Leadership
  
  

* Lead initiatives that establish consistent definitions, ownership, standards, and governance for connected-product data.
* Define and improve processes for data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, retention, and lifecycle management.
* Help establish authoritative definitions and common data models across engineering and digital systems.
* Define measurable data-quality expectations and drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues.
* Ensure business and engineering context is captured alongside technical data definitions.

Connected Equipment Data
  
  

* Work with teams responsible for telematics, equipment configuration, asset characterization, and other sources of connected-product data.
* Improve consistency between data generated by machines and the information consumed by engineering, analytics, condition monitoring, digital products, and AI.
* Coordinate improvements to data configuration, validation, and deployment processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data-governance and data-quality activities.

Data Products and Discoverability
  
  

* Help transform important datasets into clearly defined, reusable data products with known ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and interfaces.
* Improve metadata and cataloging so users can determine what information exists, what it means, where it originated, and how it should be used.
* Partner with enterprise data-platform and governance teams to connect engineering data with Caterpillar-wide data standards and tooling.
* Help establish data structures and governance practices that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI applications.

Project and Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead complex cross-functional data initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
* Develop project scope, priorities, roadmaps, milestones, and success measures.
* Coordinate engineers, data specialists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Identify dependencies, technical risks, and organizational barriers and drive them to resolution.
* Communicate project status, technical decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Mentor team members and strengthen data-governance and data-engineering capabilities across the organization.

What You Have
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or another related technical discipline.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, master/reference data, data catalogs, or data product management.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected products, industrial data, or engineering data.
* Experience with enterprise data catalogs such as Alation or comparable metadata/catalog platforms.
* Experience with data pipelines, APIs, SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, or modern data engineering.
* Experience with AI/ML data requirements and governance of data used by Generative AI and agentic systems.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and data teams.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
AI and analytics are only as reliable as the data and context available to them.
  
  
This role will help create the standards, metadata, quality controls, and reusable data structures that allow Caterpillar's connected-product data to become a dependable foundation for engineering, digital products, analytics, and AI.
  
  
Location - Chennai
  
  
Relocation - Domestic
  
  
5 days work from office
  
  
**Posting Dates**
November 12, 2026 - November 25, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations

* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmaceutical commercial data specialist who combines deep knowledge of datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG, AlphaSense etc. with strong technical skills. As the team's primary point of contact for commercial data needs, you will guide source selection, interpretation and effective use across analytics and market intelligence activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your Key Responsibilities that limited to:**

* Serve as the commercial data subject-matter expert: Act as the primary point of contact for Evaluate, IPD, DRG and other subscribed datasets, advising on coverage, definitions, methodologies, limitations and appropriate use.
* Translate business needs into data solutions: Understand requests across commercial analytics, forecasting and market intelligence; recommend suitable sources and define extraction, integration and delivery requirements.
* Democratise data access: Develop governed self-service datasets, reusable queries, workflows and documentation that help authorised team members use subscribed data independently.
* Build and automate data workflows: Use SQL, Python, Alteryx and cloud platforms such as Databricks to ingest, transform, reconcile and combine data, reducing repetitive manual extractions.
* Partner with IT on data products: Define business requirements, data models, refresh schedules, testing and rollout of scalable commercial data products.
* Establish trusted data foundations: Maintain source inventories, data dictionaries, mappings and lineage; implement quality checks and investigate discrepancies with providers and IT.
* Enable compliant use: Work with IT, procurement and data owners to ensure access, storage, integration and redistribution comply with subscription licences, vendor agreements and internal governance requirements.
* Increase subscription value and adoption: Identify overlapping assets and underused capabilities and deliver practical training and user guidance

**Essential Requirements**
**What I will bring to the role:**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical commercial data, analytics or data enablement, with a strong understanding of commercial business questions and pharma markets.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in pharmaceutical commercial datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG and IQVIA, including source selection, extraction, interpretation and reconciliation across sources.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, data transformation, validation and query optimisation, with the ability to work independently with large, multi-source datasets.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python, with the ability to understand and adapt scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation and automation.
* Practical experience with Databricks or comparable cloud data platforms, including data pipelines, curated datasets and scheduled processing; familiarity with data modelling and cloud-based analytics architectures.
* Experience partnering with IT or data engineering teams to translate business requirements into reusable data products, define acceptance criteria and support testing and adoption.
* Sound understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, access controls and licensed 3rd-party data usage; ability to enable broader access without compromising contractual or governance requirements.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and prioritisation skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts clearly and provide practical training to users.
* Desirable: Python, SQL, API-based data integration, and experience with Power BI or Qlik Sense.
* Education: Advanced degree in Management, an analytical discipline, Data Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related field.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Computer Vision )
description:
**Role :** Data Scientist (Computer Vision)

Drone Analytics – Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform

**Experience: 5***+ Years |* **2***+ Years in Computer Vision on Video or Aerial Imagery*

**Primary Focus**

Model accuracy, per-customer fine-tuning, evaluation benchmarks, drift monitoring.

**Technology Stack**

PyTorch, OpenCV, Ultralytics YOLO / RT-DETR / Detectron2, SAM, ByteTrack/BoT-SORT, SAHI, CVAT/Label Studio, DVC, MLflow, ONNX, TensorRT, Albumentations, pandas, scikit-learn.

**Role Summary**

Data Scientists own the quality of the models behind the platform’s drone video and image analytics. You will improve detection, segmentation and tracking accuracy on aerial imagery, adapt models to each customer’s domain, and build the benchmarks and monitoring that keep results trustworthy in production.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Modelling

* Train and improve object detection and instance/semantic segmentation models for drone footage (e.g. YOLO family, RT-DETR, Faster/Mask R-CNN, U-Net, SAM-assisted labelling).
* Address small and dense objects, oblique angles, scale variation with altitude, motion blur and lighting using tiling/slicing inference (SAHI), multi-scale training, mosaic and photometric augmentation, and altitude-aware sampling.
* Implement multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) with camera-motion compensation; produce persistent object IDs across frames and flights.
* Work with the Drone Data Architect to convert pixel detections to geographic coordinates using camera pose and terrain data, and quantify positional error.

2. Data and Fine-tuning

* Build versioned datasets (DVC or equivalent) with annotation guidelines, labelling QA (inter-annotator agreement), class-balance analysis and leakage-safe splits by site and flight rather than by frame.
* Select high-value samples using uncertainty and embedding diversity; run labelling in CVAT or Label Studio.
* Define a repeatable fine-tuning workflow (transfer learning, freezing strategies, LoRA/adapters where applicable) with hard guarantees that one tenant’s data never trains another tenant’s model unless explicitly permitted.

3. Evaluation and Monitoring

* Create golden test sets and report mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95, per-class precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, tracking metrics (MOTA, IDF1) and latency/throughput per model version.
* Define regression thresholds that block promotion of a model that underperforms the current production version.
* Monitor input drift (image statistics, embeddings, PSI/KS tests) and output drift (class distribution, confidence); set retraining triggers and alerts.
* Provide confidence calibration and failure-mode analysis for product and customers.

4. Optimisation and Handoff

* Export models to ONNX; support TensorRT optimisation with FP16/INT8 calibration and verify accuracy loss against benchmarks.

**Data Scientist | Drone Analytics Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**

* Hand over model artefacts, pre/post-processing specs and test sets to the Python AI/ML developer; validate MVP-to-SaaS result parity for migrating customers.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years in applied machine learning, including 2+ years in computer vision on video or aerial imagery.
* Strong PyTorch and OpenCV; experience training detection and segmentation models end to end.
* Rigorous evaluation methodology: mAP, PR curves, per-class analysis, statistical validation.
* Dataset curation, annotation tooling and augmentation pipelines.
* Python engineering practices: testing, packaging, reproducibility, experiment tracking (MLflow or W&B).
* Working knowledge of ONNX export and GPU training.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* SAHI/tiled inference, SAM or foundation-model-assisted labelling.
* Multi-object tracking and video analytics.
* Drift detection tooling (Evidently or similar).
* TensorRT quantisation; edge deployment (Jetson).
* Vision-language models for search or auto-labelling.
* Remote sensing or geospatial ML.

**Key Deliverables**

* Baseline and improved models with benchmark reports per release.
* Versioned datasets and labelling guidelines.
* Fine-tuning pipeline and tenant-isolation rules.
* Drift monitoring spec and dashboards.
* Model cards for each production model.

**Education**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related field.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. * Identify and assess analytics opportunities related to service optimization, including automation, capacity assessment, and digital workflow improvements.

title: Lead Marketing Analytics & Attribution
description:
**Role:**
Lead — Marketing Analytics & Attribution

**Reports to:**
Chief Marketing Officer

**Location:**
Noida

**Experience:**
6–10 years, with at least 3 in performance marketing analytics

**Team:**
Individual contributor initially, building a team as the function scales

**The Role:**

We spend ₹5 crore a month across 40 consumer lending brands and cannot currently state cost per disbursal by channel. Each NBFC partner runs its own CRM. Conversion data does not flow back to the ad platforms. This role builds the measurement layer that makes marketing spend accountable, and owns the number the function is judged on.

**What You Will Own**

* The marketing data layer ingesting partner CRM data into a single warehouse with a normalised schema, so performance is comparable across brands and lenders.
* Server-side tracking and offline conversion imports, so Google and Meta optimise toward funded loans rather than form fills.
* Cost per disbursal by channel, brand, lender and geography — the primary commercial metric for the function.
* Approval rate and repeat-borrower analysis by acquisition source, including cross-brand application overlap reporting.
* Dashboards that marketing, finance and the credit team all trust and use.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Deep experience with GA4, server-side GTM, and conversion APIs for Google and Meta.
* SQL fluency and hands-on work with a cloud warehouse — BigQuery, Snowflake or equivalent.
* Experience building attribution where the conversion event sits days downstream of the click, ideally in lending, insurance or another considered-purchase category.
* Comfort working with engineering teams to get data out of systems you do not control.
* A dashboard-sceptical mindset — someone who validates numbers rather than reporting them.

**Nice to Have**

* Lending, NBFC or fintech background, and familiarity with loan funnel stages through to disbursal.

**Success at Six Months**

* A single source of truth for marketing performance across all brands and lenders.
* Cost per disbursal available by channel and brand, and trusted by finance.
* Conversion data flowing back to the ad platforms, with campaigns optimising to disbursal.

  **Google Analytics 4 (GA4)**
  .

* Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong communication skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications

* Relevant academic background in Marketing, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Academic projects or certifications in GA4, GTM, or digital analytics.
* Basic exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, or other marketing platforms.

What You'll Get

* Practical exposure to real-world MarTech and website analytics.
* Hands-on learning with GA4, GTM, and Looker Studio.
* Opportunity to understand marketing attribution, event tracking, and conversion measurement.

Apply Now

aarti@rankhighly.ai

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

* Support data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with business users, architects, and project teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize data models and reporting solutions.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.
* Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail and quality.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, or other SAP functional domains.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Management Trainee
description:
**Start your career where your work helps 2 crore children learn.**

Sampark Foundation is looking for bright, curious fresh postgraduates who want to build a career while building something that matters. Hired for potential. Trained for impact.

**At a glance**

* **Engagement:**
  Full-time, fixed-term Management Trainee engagement of 11 months, from Monday, 14 December 2026 to Saturday, 13 November 2027
* **Monthly CTC:**
  Rs. 30,000 (inclusive of TDS)
* **Path to a permanent role:**
  High-performing trainees can move into a full-time role at Rs. 40,000 Monthly CTC, decided at the final review
* **Eligibility:**
  Master’s degree in any discipline; no prior full-time work experience required
* **Location:**
  On-site at Sampark Foundation, B-16, Sector 132, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
* **Working days:**
  Monday–Friday, plus the 2nd Saturday of each month, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* **Last date to apply:**
  Monday, 30 November 2026

**Your 11-month journey**

* **Days 1–15:**
  Structured induction and training at Head Office, covering the organisation, the mission, the people and the tools you will use
* **Months 1–9:**
  Hands-on work across core functions on live projects, with structured performance reviews at 3, 6 and 9 months
* **Months 10–11:**
  Specialisation and a capstone project, closing with a final review: the decision point for your full-time offer

Based on your background, interest and competency, you will be trained in one of three streams: Mastering Communication & Partnerships, Mastering Content Creation for Children, or Mastering Data Analytics & Reporting.

This is not a sit-and-watch role. We hire for potential and train for skill. You are not expected to arrive job-ready, but to be curious, learn, take ownership and grow fast.

**What you will do**

* Take on real, live projects across communications, partnerships, programs and data, starting guided and growing more independent
* Draft clear notes, decks, reports and communication for internal and external audiences
* Conduct research and analysis to support decisions, proposals, campaigns and programs
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to move work forward
* Build and maintain trackers, dashboards and reports, and keep data clean and decision-ready
* Use modern digital and AI tools to work faster and smarter, with judgment on quality and accuracy
* Own a capstone project and present it to leadership

**What we are looking for**

* A recently completed Master’s degree in any discipline. Strong academics help, but aptitude, attitude and instinct matter more than marks.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English; working proficiency in Hindi is a plus
* A sharp, analytical mind that breaks problems down and thinks clearly under ambiguity
* Natural curiosity, high learning agility and openness to feedback
* Comfort with digital tools and generative-AI workflows, with judgment on accuracy and originality
* Ownership and initiative to get things done with minimal hand-holding
* Genuine interest in education and social impact
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Noida/NCR, and able to commit to the full 11-month engagement on-site

Academic projects, internships, competitions, campus leadership and volunteering all count in your favour.

**What you will gain**

* 15 days of structured training, then continuous mentorship from senior leaders
* Real ownership of real work from early on, not errands and admin
* Clear quarterly feedback, so you always know how you are doing and how to improve
* A strong path to a permanent role at one of India’s largest education non-profits

**About Sampark Foundation**

Sampark Foundation was founded by Anupama Nayar and Vineet Nayar (Former Vice Chairman and CEO of HCL Technologies). It believes that frugal innovation, combined with relentless execution in partnership with the government, can drive large-scale change in learning outcomes.

Since 2013, our flagship Sampark Smart Shala program has transformed learning in rural government schools. It uses low-cost teaching-learning materials, audio devices with the voice mascot “Sampark Didi” and bot-enabled mobile apps that reach teachers in their classrooms. Working alongside State Education Departments, SCERTs, DIETs and block-level officials, we impact 2 crore children across nearly 2 lakh government schools in 8 states. We also train over 8.5 lakh teachers every year. Our next ambition is to reach 5 crore children across 5 lakh schools.

Visit us: https://samparkfoundation.org/

GDS Enablement Services Strategy & Operations partners with ES leadership and Service Functions to advance strategic priorities, operational excellence, and business performance. + Support pre-billing activities across Service Functions, ensuring accurate consolidation and validation of monthly billing inputs across different billing models and timely submission to Finance and Billing teams.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic
**Data Architect**
to design, develop, and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise data architectures. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in modern data platforms, cloud technologies, data modelling, data governance, and enterprise data management.

The candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, analytics teams, and technical leadership to translate business requirements into robust data architecture solutions.
