* Define and drive enterprise data architecture strategies, standards, and best practices.
* Design scalable, reliable, and high-performance data architectures for enterprise applications and analytics platforms.
* Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

* Establish data governance, data quality, metadata management, security, and compliance standards.
* Optimize data pipelines, storage, and processing for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to data engineering teams.
* Evaluate emerging data technologies and recommend suitable solutions based on business requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure alignment between business objectives and technical architecture.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Modelling.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, NoSQL databases, and distributed data systems.
* Expertise in cloud data platforms – AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, or Amazon Redshift.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data integration tools.
* Experience with Big Data technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, Kafka, or Hadoop.
* Knowledge of Data Governance, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, and Data Quality.
* Understanding of data security, access controls, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or related technology roles.
* Proven experience in designing and implementing enterprise-level data architecture solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and architectural decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience leading technical teams and driving architecture initiatives.

Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
  
  
**The Role:**
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
  
  
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.

title: Oracle ERP EPM Systems Admin
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The administrator reports to the VP of IT Operations.
  
  
The Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, security and operational health of ACC's Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM environments. The role is the technical owner of both platforms, covering configuration, metadata and dimension management, role design, update readiness, data flow monitoring, reporting and issue resolution, and serves as the primary bridge between Finance and Accounting and IT and as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support. The role is measured heavily by the reliability of the financial close and of the planning and consolidation cycles that depend on it.
  
  
Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time, aligned to the Finance and Accounting close and planning calendars, with extended availability during month-end, quarter-end and year-end close and budget and forecast cycles. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, supports Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update windows, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud ERP Financials modules, which may include General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Procurement, Subledger Accounting and Projects.
* Perform application configuration through Functional Setup Manager and migrate configuration between environments using configuration packages.
* Maintain enterprise structures and accounting configuration, including ledgers, legal entities, business units, chart of accounts and value sets, accounting calendars and currency setup.
* Configure and maintain approval workflows for invoices, payments, expenses, requisitions and journals, and troubleshoot workflow failures and stuck approvals.
* Support period open and close activities, resolving close-blocking errors, unposted transactions and interface exceptions, and monitor the Enterprise Scheduler for failed or long-running processes.
* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud EPM applications, which may include Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, Narrative Reporting and Enterprise Data Management.
* Own EPM metadata and dimension maintenance, keeping hierarchies aligned to the ERP chart of accounts and enterprise structures through a controlled request, validation and promotion process.
* Develop, maintain and tune business rules and calculations using Calculation Manager, including allocations, currency translation and aggregations.
* Maintain EPM forms, dashboards, task lists and valid intersections, and administer consolidation, intercompany elimination, close task management and account reconciliation processes.
* Manage EPM maintenance operations, including snapshots, Lifecycle Management artifact migration and test-to-production promotion, and automate recurring tasks using EPM Automate and/or REST APIs.
* Design and maintain ERP and EPM security to least privilege, and administer user provisioning, modification and termination in coordination with the IAM team and strictly through approved request workflow.
* Maintain single sign-on and identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID, analyze and remediate segregation of duties conflicts, and support periodic user access reviews.
* Own the Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles end to end, including readiness review, impact assessment, regression testing, user acceptance testing coordination and scheduling around close and planning calendars.
* Serve as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support for ERP and EPM, driving and escalating service requests through to resolution.
* Own the ERP-to-EPM data flow, including Data Integration / Data Management setup, mapping and validation that loaded balances tie to the general ledger.
* Monitor and troubleshoot financial integrations and data loads, including FBDI, ADF Desktop Integration, banking and payment interfaces, and integrations with the property management platform and other upstream and downstream systems.
* Build and maintain reporting using OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio, Management Reporting, Narrative Reporting and Smart View.
* Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 support for Finance and Accounting users, managing a ServiceNow ticket queue from receipt through resolution, and prioritize close-blocking and cycle-blocking issues above all other work.
* Follow change management for all production configuration, metadata and business rule changes, and support internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent control testing with access and change evidence.
* Document configuration, metadata processes, business rules and runbooks, and train Finance super users, budget holders and reconciliation preparers to reduce recurring ticket volume.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving Oracle Cloud ERP and EPM best practices and communicate relevant improvements to Finance, team members and leadership.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing financial, plan, forecast, vendor or bank data or configuration secrets to unapproved tools.
* Experience applying generative AI responsibly to documentation, test scripts, business rule and SQL development and release note analysis, with human validation before anything touches production or the financial record.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials architecture, module interaction and the accounting flow from subledger through Subledger Accounting to General Ledger.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM architecture, including cube structure, dimensionality, calculation behavior and the performance implications of metadata design.
* Working knowledge of consolidation, close management, account reconciliation and planning and forecasting processes, and how configuration affects reported results.
* Knowledge of Oracle Cloud security models for ERP and EPM and of segregation of duties principles and compensating controls.
* Working SQL skills for analysis, reconciliation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITIL-aligned incident, request and change management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between accounting language and application configuration across cultures and time zones.
* Strong project- and time-management skills, with a systematic, organized approach and high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to treat the integrity of the books as the highest priority and work calmly and accurately under close deadlines.
* Ability to say no to an unreviewed production change and explain the reasoning in terms Finance leadership will accept.
* Ability to learn new concepts and software quickly and take a proactive approach to platform enhancements.
* Ability to think logically and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Education & Experience**

* At least five years of experience administering or supporting enterprise financial systems, including at least three years with Oracle Cloud ERP Financials.
* At least two years of hands-on experience administering Oracle Cloud EPM, including Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close or Account Reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience with EPM metadata maintenance, Calculation Manager, Data Integration, Lifecycle Management and EPM Automate, and with Functional Setup Manager and configuration packages.
* Demonstrated experience managing Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles, including regression testing and user acceptance testing coordination.
* Experience supporting audit and internal control requirements is required; SOX experience and real estate, property management or student housing industry experience are preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems or a related field; equivalent work experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**CERTIFICATES & LICENSES**

* Oracle Cloud Financials Implementation Professional (General Ledger, Payables or Receivables).
* Oracle Cloud Planning Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Financial Consolidation and Close Implementation Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Account Reconciliation Implementation Professional is a plus.
* Oracle Cloud Applications Security or Enterprise Structures certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals.
* CompTIA SecAI+ (Security AI+).
* ITIL Foundation is a plus.

title: VP, ABF Data Operations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.
  
  
**Job Title:**
VP, Asset Based Finance (ABF) Data Operations
  
  
**Job Summary:**
Blackstone Credit & Insurance (BXCI) is seeking a seasoned Data Governance/Data Operations subject-matter expert with deep expertise in insurance-related data to own the end-to-end lifecycle of data supporting our insurance clients, who invest across the credit markets in bank loans, CLOs, corporate bonds, CMBS, RMBS, ABS, ABF, alternatives, and private credit.
  
  
Based in Bangalore, you will act as SME for the insurance platform and the day-to-day liaison for our New York and London teams. In this role, you will establish and enforce governance standards, steward data quality and transparency between internal platforms and client data needs, and run mission-critical data operations (ingestion, normalization, controls, and reporting). You will partner closely with investment, risk, technology, accounting, and compliance teams to ensure data is accurate, timely, and decision-ready—supporting portfolio construction, surveillance, valuations, and statutory and regulatory reporting in a high-performance, regulated environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
ABF Data Operations
  
  

* Operationalize key performance indicators for asset based finance deals into our central data warehouse, spanning consumer and residential, equipment and auto, commercial real estate, fund finance, and hard-asset or esoteric collateral types.
* Own the intake and normalization of originator and servicer data tapes and trustee reports—loan-level attributes, collateral stratifications, borrowing base and eligibility criteria, advance rates, and remittance detail—into standard internal models.
* Coordinate pricing and analytics feeds (Bloomberg/ICE/Markit, rating agency data, Intex) and align them with internal valuation and risk models.
* Run daily and weekly controls around asset based finance deals, including funding and advance activity, unfunded commitments, and collateral eligibility exceptions.
* Orchestrate data pipelines and APIs between warehouse (Snowflake), analytics (Intex/quant libraries), accounting (Axiom/Clearwater), and reporting (Sigma/BI).

Controls, Compliance, and Reporting
  
  

* Implement control frameworks for ABF data (pre-/post-ingestion checks, anomaly detection, duplicate prevention, referential integrity).
* Support insurer/statutory reporting (NAIC designations, SSAP 26R/43R data elements) and audit-readiness.
* Monitor covenant, borrowing base, and performance triggers; produce surveillance dashboards (delinquencies, defaults, losses, recoveries, CPR/CDR, WAL, credit enhancement and OC levels).
* Reconcile facility balances, cash and interest activity, and collateral positions against servicers, trustees, agents, and fund administrators; drive breaks to resolution with clear ownership.
* Deliver executive-ready KPIs on data quality, operational SLAs, and portfolio impacts; lead remediation programs for systemic data issues.

Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Serve as the Bangalore-based point of contact for the New York and London teams; provide daily overlapping-hours coverage, a documented handoff at the open and close of each region's day, and timely escalation of unresolved items.
* Partner with PMs, research, and risk to deliver decision-ready ABF datasets for portfolio construction, hedging, and scenario analysis.
* Work with technology to implement scalable ETL, lineage, catalog, and data-access controls; coordinate with compliance/legal on data usage (including PII when applicable).
* Interface with external trustees, servicers, originators, rating agencies, and data vendors; manage vendor SLAs and change notifications (file formats, delivery schedules).

Leadership and Change Management
  
  

* Build and mentor a high-performing ABF data ops/governance team in Bangalore; establish coverage rotations and incident response playbooks.
* Lead cross-functional projects (new deal and facility onboarding, platform migrations, new originator/servicer and vendor integrations) and manage timelines, testing, cutover, and post-implementation reviews.
* Promote data literacy across investment and operations teams; document standards and SOPs.

**Qualifications:**
Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligent and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors. In addition to strong analytical and quantitative skills, the successful candidate should have:
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM, Finance, Business, Data Management, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years in data governance/data operations, with 7–10+ years directly in asset based finance or securitized products across multiple sectors (Auto, Consumer/Marketplace, Equipment, RMBS/CMBS, CLO, fund finance, esoterics).
* Demonstrated ownership of ABF/ABS data pipelines, trustee and servicer integrations, borrowing base and waterfall inputs, and reconciliation processes at scale.
* Experience operating within a global delivery model as a subject-matter expert supporting investment and operations stakeholders in the US and/or UK.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* SQL skills necessary. Python nice to have.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake (data warehousing), Sigma or similar BI, and Alation (catalog/lineage); familiarity with workflow/orchestration tools.
* Comfort working with high-volume, inconsistent third-party file feeds—loan tapes, servicer and trustee reports—and building repeatable ingestion, mapping, and validation routines.
* Expert user of ABF/ABS analytics and data sources: Intex, Bloomberg, ICE/Markit, rating agency data (S&P, Moody’s, Fitch, KBRA, DBRS); experience integrating identifiers and factors.
* Knowledge of accounting/reporting systems and GAAP/STAT considerations for ABF portfolios nice to have.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of ABF and securitization structures and mechanics: collateral stratification, borrowing base and eligibility tests, advance rates, waterfall priorities, enhancement and triggers (OC/IC), factor updates, servicing metrics, and trustee reporting.
* Working knowledge of privately negotiated, collateral-backed transactions (warehouse lines, forward flow, SPV and facility structures) and the bespoke reporting obligations they carry.
* Familiarity with valuation and risk concepts (pricing sources, model validation, sensitivity and scenario analysis).
* Regulatory awareness relevant to buy-side ABF/ABS investors (e.g., Reg AB II data expectations, surveillance standards); audit and control requirements in a regulated environment.

The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.
  
  
Blackstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic predisposition, veteran or military status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense or stalking, or any other class or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training. All Blackstone employees, including but not limited to recruiting personnel and hiring managers, are required to abide by this policy.
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, please contact Human Resources at 212-583-5000 (US), +44 (0)20 7451 4000 (EMEA) or +852 3656 8600 (APAC).
  
  
Depending on the position, you may be required to obtain certain securities licenses if you are in a client facing role and/or if you are engaged in the following:

title: Principal Support Engineer – IBM Sterling B2Bi & Data Integration
description:
**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
The Principal Engineer (B2Bi / Data Integration) is a senior individual contributor and technical leader responsible for driving architectural decisions, platform reliability, and innovation across Precisely's Data Integration Suite (DIS) and IBM Sterling B2B Integrator (B2Bi) ecosystem. This role owns the intersection of cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes / OpenShift Container Platform), AI/ML-powered automation, and enterprise integration — providing deep technical leadership that is critical to both day-to-day operations and the long-term product roadmap. The ideal candidate brings rare, senior-level expertise and the ability to operate independently across disciplines.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Serve as the primary technical owner for IBM Sterling B2Bi, Sterling File Gateway, and the broader Data Integration Suite — driving architecture, platform stability, and roadmap direction.
* Lead the design, deployment, and operational excellence of containerized workloads on Kubernetes (K8S) and OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), including cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, and security hardening.
* Champion and deliver AI/ML-powered initiatives — including intelligent log analysis, anomaly detection, automated remediation, and operational analytics — using modern ML tooling and LLM-based workflows.
* Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns across the team; provide technical guidance and mentorship to senior and mid-level engineers.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, support, and infrastructure teams to resolve high-complexity issues, drive root-cause analysis, and translate findings into durable platform improvements.
* Lead capacity planning, performance tuning, and resiliency engineering for integration platforms across cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS) and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies; own proof-of-concepts and drive adoption of automation tooling across CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and monitoring stacks.
* Partner with customer-facing teams on critical escalations, providing authoritative technical guidance on B2Bi architecture, integration patterns, and platform best practices.
* Produce high-quality design documents, architectural decision records (ADRs), and technical runbooks for internal and external consumption.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering, with significant tenure in enterprise integration and distributed systems.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (equivalent demonstrated experience accepted).
* Deep, hands-on expertise with IBM Sterling B2B Integrator (B2Bi), Sterling File Gateway, and/or Global Mailbox — including installation, configuration, tuning, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Proven ownership of Kubernetes (K8S) and OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) at scale — cluster administration, Operators, Helm, GitOps, and platform-level observability.
* Practical AI/ML experience: building or operationalizing ML pipelines, leveraging LLM-based tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI APIs) for engineering productivity, or delivering AI-powered operational capabilities.
* Strong command of UNIX/Linux administration (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, AIX, Solaris) and shell scripting.
* Cloud platform expertise across at least two of: Azure, GCP, or AWS (EC2, S3, EMR, Redshift, or equivalents).
* Database proficiency: Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Snowflake — including schema design, query tuning, and operational support.
* Solid grounding in networking and integration protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, SFTP, AS2, SMTP, and EDI standards.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both engineering and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, and deliver in a fast-paced, distributed team environment.
* Prior experience serving as a senior technical escalation point or on-call incident commander.
* AI Skills / Knowledge

+ Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered developer tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate engineering, troubleshooting, and documentation workflows.
+ Experience applying AI/ML techniques to log analysis, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting in production environments.
+ Comfort designing or evaluating AI-augmented workflows as a first-class part of platform operations and engineering processes.

**Application and Interview Impersonation Notice:**
Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated (“Precisely”) is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators.
  
  
The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Data Center CAD Engineer

description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

**Your role at a glance**

The position for Data Center CAD Engineer will support NTT Global Data Centers' Solutions Engineering organization by developing technical drawings, layouts, and design documentation for hyperscale and enterprise data center customers. The role will collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Sales, Design, and Operations teams to develop space planning, power, cooling, and infrastructure layouts that support customer deployments across NTT's data center portfolio.

* Support Solutions Engineers in preparing customer-facing technical drawings and design packages.
* Create and update electrical single-line diagrams, mechanical layouts, and riser diagrams.
* Prepare white-space capacity plans including rack placement, power allocation, and cooling strategies.
* Coordinate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Operations, and Design teams to ensure technical accuracy of customer solutions.
* Assist with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling activities for thermal analysis and optimization.
* Review customer technical requirements and translate them into deployable infrastructure layouts.
Maintain drawing standards, revision control, and documentation quality.  

  

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

L Proficiency in AutoCAD for technical drafting and infrastructure layout development.

3-6 years of experience in CAD drafting, technical design, data center design, MEP engineering, building services engineering, or related infrastructure environments

Experience preparing electrical single-line diagrams, mechanical layouts, and equipment floor plans.

Strong understanding of data center white-space design principles. Knowledge of rack deployment planning, power distribution, cooling infrastructure, and containment strategies.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Visio.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global team environment.

Preferred Skills

Experience in data center, MEP, mission-critical facilities, or building services design.

§ Experience with Bluebeam Revu.

§ Exposure to CFD tools such as Cadence 6SigmaDCX, TileFlow, or Star-CCM+ is preferred but not required.

§ Knowledge of BIM/Revit.

§ Familiarity with hyperscale customer requirements.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

§ Bachelor’s or Technical degree in CAD Engineering, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, or related technical discipline.

§ Experience supporting customer-facing engineering, design, or pre-sales activities is preferred.

§ Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced project environment.

  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

§ Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.

§ Primarily sitting for extended periods

§ Ability walk and lead technical tours throughout data center.

Work conditions & other requirements

§ Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. title: Development Support Engineer
description:

**Department: IT**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Development Support Engineer to provide day-to-day support across the software development lifecycle. You will triage and reproduce incoming issues, fix defects in existing services, assist with testing and deployments, and take on small development tasks under the guidance of senior engineers. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for someone with a solid programming foundation who wants to grow into a full backend or full-stack engineering position. You will learn our platforms end-to-end, gain exposure to cutting-edge technology including AI-assisted development tooling and AI-driven product features, and act as the first line of technical response for the systems we run.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Fix low- to medium-complexity defects in existing services and applications with guidance from senior engineers.

* Take on routine development tasks, including small feature enhancements, configuration changes, and code cleanup.

* Support build, release, and deployment activities across development, staging, and production environments.

* Monitor application logs, dashboards, and alerts, and escalate issues with clear diagnostic detail.

* Prepare test data, environment setups, and sandbox instances for the development team.

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues.

**Work Experience:**

* Experience on projects demonstrating hands-on coding will be considered.

**Technical Skills Required:**

* Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose programming language — C#, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.

* Understanding of object-oriented programming fundamentals and the habits behind clean, readable code.

* Basic SQL and relational database concepts — queries, joins, and reading an existing schema.

* Familiarity with REST APIs and tools such as Postman or Swagger.

* Git fundamentals: branching, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.

* Comfortable on both Windows and Linux, including basic command-line usage.

* Ability to read logs, stack traces, and error messages to isolate a problem.

* Familiarity with issue tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Exposure to .NET (C#) or Node.js/TypeScript backend development.

* Basic understanding of containers and Docker.

* Awareness of CI/CD concepts and automated build pipelines.

* Fundamental exposure to a cloud platform, AWS or Azure.

* Automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, Jest, or Vitest.

* Interest in monitoring and observability tooling: dashboards, log aggregation, and alerting.

* Basic scripting for repetitive tasks.

**Soft Skills:**

* Eager to learn, comfortable asking questions, and receptive to feedback from senior engineers.

* Methodical and patient when investigating problems, and sees an issue through to resolution.

* Clear written communication when documenting issues, steps to reproduce, and fixes applied.

* Dependable follow-through on small tasks and commitments without needing reminders.

title: Energy Resource Manager (ERM)
description:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as an Energy Resource Manager (ERM) with the primary focus at reducing stranded capacity applying optimization techniques of space, power, cooling and network. Being a key member of the local Datacenter Operations team in the deployment planning and optimization of the IT capacity, working closely with Electrical Engineers and Critical Environment Field Service Engineer.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I ERM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. By enabling data center capacity through increased Infrastructure Utilization Effectiveness (IUE) and Power Harvesting (PH), you will lead the retrofit efforts to upgrade legacy datacenters and harvest capacity in our existing fleet. As a group, CO+I is focused on personal and professional development for all employees, offer trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

* Primary focus in Managing IT Allocation at the Campus/Metro level by collaborating with key stakeholders and ensuring that demands are properly allocated across the IT infrastructure.
* Familiarize with the Data Center design and manage the IT resources by performing virtual failure analysis and develop a master allocation plan to drive the operationalization of the customer capacity.
* Ensure compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
* Engage with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
* Manage programs associated with the area of responsibility.
* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
* Raise risks to the IT capacity allocation and planning. Identify power stranding and contractual inconsistencies (leased spaces).
* Ensure that the critical environment information is properly entered and maintained (tooling).
* Lead programs and projects through leadership forums aligning scope, schedule, and cost that align to our OKRs.

Service Delivery

* Manage the assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives and escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
* Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.

Data Center Work Environment

* Share best practices; assist others in learning role, process, procedures.
* Collaborate and engage with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across CO+I and engineering groups to gain program / project insights.
* Leverage and synthesize these insights to develop and operationalize solutions that mitigate our customer gaps.
* Provide mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
* Seek training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.
* Suggest ways of reducing risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.

title: Data & Enablement Manager
description:
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a hands-on pharmaceutical commercial data specialist who combines deep knowledge of datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG, AlphaSense etc. with strong technical skills. As the team's primary point of contact for commercial data needs, you will guide source selection, interpretation and effective use across analytics and market intelligence activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your Key Responsibilities that limited to:**

* Serve as the commercial data subject-matter expert: Act as the primary point of contact for Evaluate, IPD, DRG and other subscribed datasets, advising on coverage, definitions, methodologies, limitations and appropriate use.
* Translate business needs into data solutions: Understand requests across commercial analytics, forecasting and market intelligence; recommend suitable sources and define extraction, integration and delivery requirements.
* Democratise data access: Develop governed self-service datasets, reusable queries, workflows and documentation that help authorised team members use subscribed data independently.
* Build and automate data workflows: Use SQL, Python, Alteryx and cloud platforms such as Databricks to ingest, transform, reconcile and combine data, reducing repetitive manual extractions.
* Partner with IT on data products: Define business requirements, data models, refresh schedules, testing and rollout of scalable commercial data products.
* Establish trusted data foundations: Maintain source inventories, data dictionaries, mappings and lineage; implement quality checks and investigate discrepancies with providers and IT.
* Enable compliant use: Work with IT, procurement and data owners to ensure access, storage, integration and redistribution comply with subscription licences, vendor agreements and internal governance requirements.
* Increase subscription value and adoption: Identify overlapping assets and underused capabilities and deliver practical training and user guidance

**Essential Requirements**
**What I will bring to the role:**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical commercial data, analytics or data enablement, with a strong understanding of commercial business questions and pharma markets.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in pharmaceutical commercial datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG and IQVIA, including source selection, extraction, interpretation and reconciliation across sources.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, data transformation, validation and query optimisation, with the ability to work independently with large, multi-source datasets.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python, with the ability to understand and adapt scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation and automation.
* Practical experience with Databricks or comparable cloud data platforms, including data pipelines, curated datasets and scheduled processing; familiarity with data modelling and cloud-based analytics architectures.
* Experience partnering with IT or data engineering teams to translate business requirements into reusable data products, define acceptance criteria and support testing and adoption.
* Sound understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, access controls and licensed 3rd-party data usage; ability to enable broader access without compromising contractual or governance requirements.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and prioritisation skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts clearly and provide practical training to users.
* Desirable: Python, SQL, API-based data integration, and experience with Power BI or Qlik Sense.
* Education: Advanced degree in Management, an analytical discipline, Data Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related field.

* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.

* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.

* Establish and maintain a governance framework for Workforce Planning systems, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technology delivery, and user needs.
* Ensure systems support global workforce planning objectives, forecasting, scenario modelling, reporting requirements, and operational needs.
* Accountable for ensuring Workforce Planning systems deliver business value, support workforce planning processes, and meet user needs through effective product ownership and continuous improvement to shape scalable enhancements.
* Lead product discovery and continuous improvement, combining user research, process analysis, data insights and technical feasibility to shape scalable enhancements rather than isolated local customizations.
* Define business requirements and partner with Technology and Data teams to deliver effective Workforce Planning solutions. Lead product discovery and continuous improvement, combining user research, process analysis, data insights and technical feasibility to shape scalable enhancements rather than isolated local customizations.

* Support successful delivery of workforce planning outcomes with the WFP team.

* Deep knowledge of workforce planning data structures, reporting frameworks and governance principles, with the ability to ensure data quality, consistency and effective use of workforce information across the organization.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.

description:
Job Description: Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst

Position Overview

* **Job Title:**
  Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst
* **Company:**
  EisnerAmper
* **Department:**
  Growth Team
* **Business Groups:**
  Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group
* **Experience:**
  2+ years
* **Primary Focus:**
  CRM Data Management, Sales Pipeline Data Quality, and Reporting
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* **Work Schedule:**
  Must maintain 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.
* **Work Arrangement:**
  Hybrid.
* **Location**
  : Mumbai

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.
* Document recurring data issues and recommend process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting workflows.
* Support consistent CRM practices across NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other approved platforms.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with Growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership.
* Communicate data quality issues and follow up on corrective actions.
* Guide CRM users on data entry standards and opportunity management procedures.
* Ensure stakeholders follow established CRM data quality requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales Operations, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of experience working with CRM systems.
* Experience in CRM data entry, cleanup, auditing, or quality assurance.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on corrective actions.
* Availability for at least 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

Desired Qualifications

* Experience with NetSuite CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including:
* Filtering and sorting large datasets.

title: MuleSoft Integrations Lead
description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

The Integration Team Lead is responsible for team activities concerning the design, development, and maintenance of the company's integration architecture. While strong proficiency in MuleSoft based integration architecture is highly valued, this role encompasses a broader, modern integration technology landscape, including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps. This role acts as a subject matter expert on API-led and event-driven integration patterns, ensuring that all corporate systems integrations are scalable, reliable, and secure. The manager-as-engineer works closely with various cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and leads the development team to deliver high-quality integration solutions.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITY:**

Integration Architecture & Delivery:

Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.

Team Leadership & Mentoring:

Manage, mentor, and guide a team of integration engineers (including direct reports), fostering a collaborative, agile, and high-performance engineering culture.

Collaboration & Requirements Engineering:

Partner with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business workflows, translate them into comprehensive integration designs, and manage delivery timelines.

Best Practices & Standards:

Enforce strict coding standards, robust code review processes, API governance, and comprehensive automated testing guidelines within the team.

DevOps & Platform Operations:

Oversee automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD), environment management, and proactive monitoring/alerting across all core integration platforms.

Incident & Problem Management:

Guide the team in resolving critical integration-related incidents, performing root-cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent preventative fixes.

**DECISION-MAKING POWER**

* Owns technical and operational decisions related to the company's core integration, event streaming, and API platforms (including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API/AI Gateways, and automation tools).
* Defines task delegation, prioritization, and sprint planning within the Integration Team.
* Recommends integration architectural standards and platform governance policies to the Integration Competency Center Manager.

**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:**

* Brings several years of hands-on experience in software development, systems engineering, and IT operations in general.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in software development or integration engineering, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or coordinator role.
* In-depth, hands-on experience with APIs (designing, developing, deploying, and managing APIs across their entire lifecycle).
* In-depth knowledge and practical experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and modern event-driven streams.
* Strong practical knowledge and experience with enterprise integration tools:
* Enterprise iPaaS: Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, CloudHub, API Manager).
* Event Streaming: Experience with Apache Kafka / Confluent Platform (producers, consumers, streaming concepts, topic management).
* API Gateways: Experience with Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, and Kong Metering and Billing.
* Automation & Lightweight iPaaS: Practical knowledge of n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps.
* DevOps & Agile Methods:
* Confident experience with modern DevOps methods and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
* Solid understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or scaled agile frameworks like SAFe).
* Familiarity with Waterfall project methodologies where hybrid planning is required.
* Proactivity and Autonomy: Ability to work independently and responsibly, proactively proposing optimizations for existing processes and systems.
* Team Spirit & Leadership: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with proven experience in team management, fostering team cohesion, and resolving conflict.
* Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Curiosity & Growth Mindset: Openness to learning and adopting emerging technologies.

 **Qualifications**

**ELIGIBLITY**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* Proven experience in enterprise-grade integrations, platform operations, and technical team leadership.

title: Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering

**The Opportunity**

We’re seeking a Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering to set AI-enabled engineering direction across platform and product. This role focuses on practical patterns and tooling - including agent-based approaches - that improve how teams build, test, release and operate software. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, operations and Risk, InfoSec and compliance to embed AI responsibly in production with the right controls and operational readiness. A key part of the remit is delivering AI-enabled improvements across Product Control and Valuation control workflows such as IPV, price testing and breaks and exceptions. You’ll also strengthen developer experience through better tooling, automation and self-service. Success means scalable patterns that teams adopt easily with measurable improvements in quality, productivity, reliability and risk outcomes.

**What you'll be doing**

* Set AI-enabled engineering patterns and agent-based tooling approaches that improve SDLC outcomes across teams
* Embed AI capabilities into production services with appropriate controls, operational readiness and explainability where relevant
* Strengthen developer experience through developer tooling, CI/CD optimisation, test automation, observability standards and self-service enablement
* Standardise evaluation of AI proof of concepts then run pilots with clear measures across quality, productivity, reliability and risk
* Industrialise successful pilots into reusable components, templates, accelerators and golden path implementations for squads to adopt
* Govern architecture and technical design through reviews and trade-offs across resilience, performance, maintainability, security, cost and pace
* Embed secure-by-default delivery by automating IT controls and evidence capture in engineering patterns and CI/CD pipelines
* Advance AI-enabled delivery in Product Control and Valuation controls including audit-ready evidence capture, lineage, approval trails and repeatable checks
* Establish data quality and reconciliation patterns to validate valuation inputs, detect anomalies and automate reconciliations to reduce manual effort

**What we're looking for**

* Bring substantial hands-on software engineering experience within complex enterprise or financial-services environments
* Demonstrate experience operating as a senior technical individual contributor such as Senior Technical Lead, Principal Engineer or Lead Developer
* Build reference implementations and reusable engineering assets that squads can adopt with minimal friction
* Apply strong software engineering fundamentals across design patterns, data structures, algorithms and system architecture
* Implement AI-enabled software engineering approaches at scale including agent-based and AI tooling across build, test, release and run
* Establish end-to-end evaluation approaches from proof of concept to production with measurement frameworks and operational readiness
* Design and deliver cloud-native architectures on platforms such as GCP or AWS with scalable modular patterns
* Automate IT control compliance within products and CI/CD pipelines and operate effectively in audit-ready environments
* Partner effectively across engineering, product, architecture, operations and Risk, InfoSec and compliance with clear written and verbal communication

**Building audit-ready AI engineering**

If you want to shape how AI is applied to real production engineering problems - with the controls and evidence needed in a regulated environment - this role offers the scope to make that impact. * Research, understand, and advocate Akana software

### **Requirements:**

* 3+ years’ experience providing customer technical support.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or similar or relevant work experience
* Good communication skills and strong customer service orientation.
* Positive attitude - support engineers are required to be respectful, fair, gracious, and knowledgeable.
* Emphasis on team collaboration, contributing ideas with the desire to improve processes and the product.
* Strong analytics and problem-solving skills
* Able to work well under pressure and prioritise accordingly
* **Shift Requirement:** Candidate must be willing and able to work a fixed night shift on a permanent basis to support global customer and business needs. No travel is required.

* Technical knowledge of complex infrastructure
* In-depth knowledge of networks, networking protocols and web-based security
* Understanding and experience in database administration and troubleshooting
* MySQL/Oracle/Microsoft SQL/MongoDB experience is very desirable
* Familiarity with the SDLC and practices such as Git workflows, CI/CD, and microservices
* Understanding of software best practices and Agile development principles
* Hands-on experience with XML, XSLT, JSON, SOAP, REST protocols, web apps and APIs
* Strong experience in troubleshooting on Windows and Linux platforms
* Hands-on experience with scripting and programming languages (Shell, Python, Java, JavaScript)
* Experience with Salesforce and Jira is desirable
* Fast and creative thinker, quick on their feet to respond quickly to complex problems
* Experience working with a geographically dispersed virtual team.

*All employees are expected to demonstrate AI fluency appropriate to their role and level, including responsible use of AI tools, sound judgment, and adherence to company AI governance and security policy standards.*

description:

Role Overview

Maintain Windows Server and Nutanix virtual environments, troubleshoot issues, tune performance, and manage tickets using ServiceNow.

A day in the life of a Windows Server and Virtualization Engineer

* Your primary role would be to ensure effective support, maintenance, performance tuning, and virtualization activities to ensure that our business units are satisfied with the high levels of infrastructure reliability.
