description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Workday Support Engineer (L2) with hands-on experience in Workday application support, functional configuration, business processes, reporting and integrations. The role involves troubleshooting production issues, implementing configuration changes and enhancements, supporting data integrations, and managing testing, upgrades and release activities to ensure smooth application operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Application & Functional Support:** Provide L2 production support, troubleshoot functional and configuration issues, manage incidents and service requests, and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Business Process & Configuration:** Configure and maintain Workday business processes, workflows, approval routing, custom fields and system settings; implement corrections and enhancements based on business requirements.
* **Security & Reporting:** Manage security groups, user roles and access permissions; configure standard and custom reports, calculated fields and reporting requirements.
* **Integration & Data Management:** Monitor, build, enhance and troubleshoot Workday integrations; support Inbound and Outbound EIBs, data uploads, extracts, mapping and validation.
* **Change Management & Governance:** Manage configuration changes and enhancement requests, maintain functional specifications, release notes and deployment documentation, and follow change governance processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in Workday application support, functional support, administration or consulting.
* Hands-on experience in Workday configuration, business processes and workflow management.
* Knowledge of Workday security, access management and custom reporting.
* Experience with Workday integrations, EIBs and data validation.
* Exposure to functional testing, automation testing, upgrades and release management.
* Understanding of incident, problem and change management processes.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of Workday Report Writer, Calculated Fields, Core Connectors and Workday Studio.

title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions.

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
* Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
* Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
* Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
* Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

**Position Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
* Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
* Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Operations
description:
This role leads the operating practices that keep DDN's IT services dependable as the company grows. Based in Pune, the Senior Manager owns incident, change, problem, and major incident management; establishes usable service and configuration data; and works closely with infrastructure monitoring teams. The position also provides on-site leadership in India and operational coordination across APAC and EMEA, while functional reporting relationships remain with the respective team leaders.

----------------------

* Run and improve incident, major incident, change and problem management across IT, with clear ownership, escalation paths, communications and service restoration practices.

* Establish practical change assessment and approval controls, emergency change handling, post-implementation review, and meaningful service performance reporting.

-----------------------

* Use service metrics, trends, and employee feedback to focus improvements on the issues creating the most disruption.

--------------------------

* 8+ years in IT operations or service management, including 4+ years leading technical service operations or ITSM functions.
* Hands-on command of incident, major incident, change, and problem practices, preferably in a global support environment.
* Experience with an ITSM platform, service reporting, operational controls, knowledge management, and service-level management.

* Experience operating across India, EMEA, and APAC time zones and working with dotted-line stakeholders.

title: Manager-Dynatrace Observability Engineer - Pune
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Dynatrace Observability Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, operating and optimising Dynatrace across complex enterprise environments. You will work across modern observability, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, cloud and on-premises monitoring, translating telemetry into actionable insights that improve application availability, performance, reliability and end-user experience.

The role involves close collaboration with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams to establish proactive observability across business-critical services.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Deploy, configure, manage and troubleshoot **Dynatrace OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube**, and onboard applications, infrastructure, middleware, Kubernetes workloads and cloud services. Configure and manage **Real User Monitoring (RUM)**, analyse user journeys and Core Web Vitals including LCP, INP and CLS, and resolve instrumentation and communication issues.
* Configure browser and HTTP **Synthetic Monitoring** for critical applications, APIs and business journeys across public and private Synthetic locations. Use **APM, PurePath, Service Flow and distributed tracing** to analyse application dependencies, failures, exceptions and performance bottlenecks.
* Deploy and operate Dynatrace within **Kubernetes** environments, monitoring clusters, nodes, namespaces, workloads, pods, containers and services. Support observability across **cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments**, including AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Correlate **metrics, logs, traces, events and business telemetry**, applying observability approaches such as RED and USE to improve root-cause analysis.
* Implement and troubleshoot **OpenTelemetry**, including the OpenTelemetry Collector, OTLP, telemetry pipelines, resource attributes, context propagation and Dynatrace integration. Define and monitor **SLIs, SLOs and error budgets**, supporting proactive reliability improvements and incident, problem and performance management.
* Configure actionable alerting, anomaly detection and notifications while reducing unnecessary alert noise and supporting enterprise incident-management processes. Build operational and management dashboards using **Dynatrace Query Language (DQL)** for application, infrastructure, Kubernetes, user experience, SLI/SLO and incident insights.
* Use **Dynatrace APIs** and integrations such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty and webhooks to support automation and operational workflows. Provide Dynatrace expertise during production incidents, major incidents and performance investigations, identifying root causes across applications, middleware, Kubernetes, infrastructure, databases, networks and external dependencies.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You bring **7+ years of overall IT experience**, ideally across application, infrastructure, middleware, DevOps, SRE or observability domains, with **3+ years of strong hands-on Dynatrace experience** in enterprise environments. You have practical experience with **OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator, DynaKube and Kubernetes observability**.
* You understand **RUM, Synthetic Monitoring, APM, infrastructure monitoring, PurePath, Service Flow and distributed tracing**. You understand **OpenTelemetry, OpenTelemetry Collector, logs, metrics and traces**, together with SRE concepts including SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.
* You have Linux troubleshooting capability and understand networking fundamentals including **DNS, proxies, firewalls, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and application connectivity**. Advanced DQL, Dynatrace APIs and automation, OpenTelemetry SDK/instrumentation, Java/JVM observability, ServiceNow integration and CI/CD knowledge would be advantageous.
* Experience with middleware including **Oracle WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server or IIS**, and cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure or OCI**, would be beneficial. Relevant Dynatrace certifications would also be an advantage. You can deploy and configure Dynatrace, troubleshoot instrumentation, analyse telemetry, identify root causes and translate technical telemetry into actionable insights for Application, Operations and SRE teams.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

This role offers the opportunity to work with enterprise-scale Dynatrace environments across applications, infrastructure, Kubernetes, cloud and traditional data-centre technologies. You will contribute to production reliability and observability maturity while collaborating with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams.

You will also gain exposure to advanced observability practices involving OpenTelemetry, automation, SLI/SLO management, distributed tracing, DQL and complex production troubleshooting.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

The scope of this role provides opportunities to deepen capabilities in:

* Enterprise-scale **Dynatrace architecture and platform management**.
* **Kubernetes and cloud-native observability** using Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube.
* **OpenTelemetry architecture**, including Collector pipelines, OTLP and telemetry instrumentation.
* **SRE practices**, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and service reliability.
* **DQL, dashboards, Dynatrace APIs, automation and enterprise integrations**.

Advanced production troubleshooting and end-to-end root-cause analysis across complex application and infrastructure environments.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong data modeling and solution design skills and can independently lead complex engineering efforts from requirements through production implementation.

  
  

Advanced Data Engineering

* + Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL.
* + Develop robust ingestion, transformation, and publishing processes supporting batch and, where appropriate, near-real-time data workloads.
* + Engineer reusable frameworks and patterns that improve development consistency, reliability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
* + Design solutions capable of processing large and complex datasets while maintaining appropriate performance and scalability.
* + Troubleshoot complex data pipeline, transformation, performance, and integration issues.
* + Optimize Databricks workloads for processing efficiency, reliability, and cost.

Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering

* + Develop enterprise data solutions leveraging Databricks Lakehouse architecture and Delta Lake.
* + Design and maintain structured data layers that move data from raw ingestion through validated, curated, and business-consumption layers.
* + Implement scalable transformation patterns using Spark SQL, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.
* + Apply Databricks engineering capabilities such as Unity Catalog, workflows/jobs, Delta tables, and data governance controls where appropriate.
* + Support performance tuning, workload optimization, monitoring, and production support for Databricks-based solutions.
* + Partner with platform and architecture teams to establish repeatable Databricks engineering standards and development patterns.

Advanced Data Modeling

* + Design scalable logical and physical data models supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and downstream data products.
* + Develop dimensional models, fact and dimension structures, curated analytical datasets, and reusable semantic-ready data structures.
* + Translate complex operational source data into intuitive business-oriented models.
* + Establish appropriate grain, keys, relationships, historical handling, and business rules within analytical data models.
* + Balance normalization, dimensional modeling, and denormalized analytical structures based on workload and consumption needs.
* + Partner with BI and analytics teams to optimize models for Power BI and other analytical consumers.

Data Quality & Governance

* + Build automated data validation and reconciliation capabilities into engineering pipelines.
* + Establish controls for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity.
* + Implement appropriate monitoring, exception handling, logging, and alerting.
* + Partner with data governance teams to improve metadata, lineage, documentation, and ownership of enterprise data products.
* + Ensure engineering solutions comply with applicable security, privacy, and enterprise data-management standards.

Technical Leadership

* + Serve as a senior technical resource for complex data engineering and modeling initiatives.
* + Lead technical design discussions and recommend appropriate engineering approaches.
* + Perform code and design reviews and help establish development standards and engineering best practices.
* + Mentor data engineers and provide guidance on Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, data modeling, and performance optimization.
* + Identify opportunities to simplify legacy processes and modernize existing data solutions.
* + Collaborate effectively across onshore/offshore engineering, analytics, architecture, product, and business teams.

Required Qualifications

* + 7+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence engineering, or related disciplines.
* + 3+ years of hands-on experience developing production solutions using Databricks and Apache Spark.
* + Advanced proficiency in SQL and strong experience with Python/PySpark.
* + Strong hands-on experience with Delta Lake and modern lakehouse engineering patterns.
* + Demonstrated experience designing and implementing complex ETL/ELT pipelines.
* + Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data structures.
* + Experience designing solutions for large-volume enterprise datasets.
* + Demonstrated ability to diagnose and optimize complex SQL, Spark, and data-processing workloads.
* + Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and production support processes.
* + Experience working with source-to-target mappings and translating business requirements into technical data solutions.
* + Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* + Ability to independently own technical solutions while collaborating within distributed global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* + Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance.
* + Experience with Databricks workflow orchestration and production deployment patterns.
* + Experience with cloud data platforms and object storage, particularly Microsoft Azure environments.
* + Experience supporting Power BI and enterprise semantic/reporting solutions.
* + Familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices for data engineering.
* + Experience integrating REST APIs, relational databases, SaaS platforms, file-based sources, and other enterprise data sources.
* + Experience modernizing legacy ETL or traditional data warehouse workloads into Databricks/lakehouse architecture.
* + Knowledge of data lineage, metadata management, access controls, and data governance practices.
* + Databricks certifications are a plus.
* Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* + Technical ownership: Takes responsibility for solutions from design through production support.
* + Engineering judgment: Selects pragmatic solutions based on scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, and cost.
* + Problem solving: Can independently investigate complex data and platform issues and drive them to resolution.
* + Quality mindset: Treats data quality, reconciliation, observability, and documentation as core engineering requirements.
* + Collaboration: Works effectively across business, analytics, architecture, BI, and engineering teams.
* + Technical leadership: Raises the capabilities of the broader engineering team through mentoring, standards, reusable patterns, and design guidance.
* + Business orientation: Understands that successful data engineering is measured by the usability and reliability of the resulting data products, not simply by pipeline completion.
* What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Data Engineer will:

* + Deliver reliable, scalable, production-ready Databricks data solutions.
* + Reduce complexity by creating reusable engineering patterns rather than one-off pipelines.
* + Improve the performance and maintainability of enterprise data workloads.
* + Produce well-designed data models that simplify downstream analytics and reporting.
* + Improve data trust through automated validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and documentation.
* + Provide senior-level technical direction to other engineers while remaining highly hands-on.
* + Help advance the Enterprise Intelligence organization toward a more standardized, governed, and scalable lakehouse architecture.
  

  

Required Qualifications

* + BE with 3-6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence engineering, or related disciplines.
* + 3+ years of hands-on experience developing production solutions using Databricks and Apache Spark.

description:

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? Learn about our benefits designed for you to thrive at work and at home.

  
  

We boldly go.

  
  

**Where is the work:**

Field-based: Work is conducted on-site at customer locations.  

**Job Summary**

The Project Engineer – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chiller Systems is responsible for supporting the execution and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects in data centres. The role focuses on engineering coordination, site execution, technical review, installation supervision, testing, commissioning support, and documentation for HVAC, chiller, and cooling system projects. The position works closely with project managers, design teams, vendors, contractors, and customers to ensure safe, timely, and quality delivery.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

* Support execution of data centre cooling, HVAC, and chiller projects from engineering review through commissioning and handover.
* Review mechanical and HVAC drawings, P&IDs, layouts, BOQs, technical submittals, and vendor documents.
* Coordinate site activities related to chillers, CRAH/CRAC/CDU/FAN WALL units, chilled water piping, pumps, valves, AHUs, heat exchangers, controls, and associated auxiliaries.
* Monitor installation progress and ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project schedules.
* Assist in planning and coordinating material delivery, equipment installation, site readiness, and contractor activities.
* Supervise mechanical/HVAC works at site and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and project standards.
* Support testing activities such as pressure testing, flushing, leak testing, balancing, and pre-commissioning checks.
* Coordinate commissioning activities for chillers, pumps, cooling equipment, control systems, and integrated HVAC systems.
* Work with BMS/controls teams to ensure proper integration, point checks, alarms, trends, and sequence validation.
* Identify technical issues, installation gaps, and site constraints, and escalate them with recommended solutions.
* Maintain daily/weekly site progress records, engineering trackers, snag lists, and issue logs.
* Support preparation of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, commissioning records, and final handover documentation.
* Coordinate with procurement, vendors, OEMs, contractors, consultants, and operations teams for timely issue resolution.
* Ensure execution in live or critical data centre environments is carefully controlled to minimize operational risk.
  

  

**Key Deliverables**

  
  

* Engineering and site progress reports
* Material and equipment tracking logs
* Technical submittal review comments
* Installation quality checklists
* Testing and commissioning records
* Snag/punch list tracker
* As-built documentation
* O&M manual inputs
* Handover dossiers and closure documents
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* Additional training or certifications in HVAC, chiller systems, commissioning, or project execution are preferred.
* Safety certifications or EHS training will be an advantage.
  

  

**Experience**

  
  

* Typically 3–8 years of experience in HVAC/mechanical project execution, preferable experience in data center.
* Relevant experience in data centre projects, mission-critical facilities, commercial HVAC plants, or industrial cooling systems is preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to chiller systems, chilled water piping, precision cooling, and site coordination is desirable.
* Experience working in live facilities, retrofit projects, or fast-track MEP projects is an advantage.
  

  

**Technical Knowledge**

  
  

* Chillers and central cooling plants
* HVAC systems and precision cooling applications
* CRAH/CRAC /CDU /SFN systems
* Chilled water and condenser water piping systems
* Pumps, valves, strainers, and heat exchangers
* Airside and waterside balancing
* BMS/controls interface for HVAC systems
* Mechanical installation standards and QA/QC practices
* Testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning procedures
* Basic understanding of redundancy and reliability requirements in mission-critical environments
  

  

**Required Skills**

  
  

* Site execution and supervision
* Technical drawing and document review
* Coordination with vendors and contractors
* Progress tracking and reporting
* Problem identification and resolution
* Quality and safety compliance
* Communication and teamwork
* Time management and prioritization
* Basic planning and scheduling awareness
* Documentation and record keeping
  

  

**Preferred Competencies**

  
  

* Strong attention to detail
* Practical troubleshooting ability
* Ability to work in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments
* Willingness to work at project sites and coordinate across teams
* Proactive approach to site issues and follow-up
* Strong learning mindset for mission-critical cooling applications
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

* Project Manager
* Mechanical/HVAC Engineering Team
* Site Execution Team
* Commissioning Team
* BMS/Controls Team
* Electrical and MEP Teams
* OEMs and Equipment Vendors
* Contractors and Subcontractors
* Procurement, Quality, and EHS Teams
* Customer and Consultant Representatives
  

  

**Typical KPIs**

  
  

* Timely completion of assigned engineering and site activities
* Installation quality and compliance
* Snag closure performance
* Commissioning readiness
* Documentation accuracy and completeness
* Safety compliance at site
* Material coordination effectiveness
* Issue resolution turnaround time

title: Senior Development Lead - Advanced RPA
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Job Description: Senior Data Scientist – Generative AI & Agentic AI

Experience: 6–10 Years

Relevant GenAI Experience: 3+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Role: Enterprise AI / Data Science Engineering

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Generative AI Engineer with strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The candidate should have hands-on experience designing and developing enterprise-grade AI applications, building scalable APIs, integrating multiple data sources and enterprise systems, and deploying production-ready AI solutions.

The ideal candidate must possess strong Python programming skills, API development experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Science & Machine Learning

* Design, develop, and implement machine learning and deep learning models.
* Work on supervised, unsupervised, and predictive modelling techniques.
* Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and optimization.
* Apply NLP, information retrieval, classification, clustering, and statistical techniques.
* Develop and optimize end-to-end data science pipelines.

2. Generative AI & LLM Engineering

* Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications using LLMs.
* Work with models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other open-source models.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Develop advanced document processing, semantic search, embeddings, and vector search solutions.
* Implement prompt engineering, context management, token optimization, and response evaluation.
* Work with fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT where required.

3. Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems

* Design and implement autonomous AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
* Work with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel.
* Develop agent orchestration, planning, reasoning, tool calling, and memory management.
* Integrate external tools, APIs, databases, and enterprise applications with AI agents.
* Implement human-in-the-loop workflows, guardrails, and agent execution monitoring.

4. API Development & Backend Engineering

* Strong hands-on experience developing RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI/Flask.
* Develop scalable backend services to expose AI/ML models through APIs.
* Implement API integrations with third-party applications and enterprise platforms.
* Experience with authentication, authorization, OAuth2, JWT, API keys, and secure API communication.
* Work with asynchronous processing, background tasks, webhooks, and microservices.
* Design API request/response schemas, error handling, logging, and versioning.
* Experience with API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.

5. Enterprise Data & Integration

* Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, or FAISS.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, databases, data warehouses, and document repositories.
* Build data ingestion, transformation, indexing, and retrieval pipelines.
* Experience with Kafka or other event-driven architectures is an advantage.

6. Cloud, Deployment & MLOps

* Experience deploying enterprise AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and managed ML platforms.
* Containerization using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
* Experience with MLflow, model monitoring, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, latency, and infrastructure costs.

7. Responsible AI, Evaluation & Security

* Implement LLM evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, and LangSmith.
* Build evaluation pipelines for accuracy, relevance, faithfulness, and hallucination detection.
* Implement enterprise-grade security, PII masking, access control, and data privacy.
* Experience with prompt injection prevention, content filtering, and AI guardrails.
* Monitor production AI applications for quality, performance, and reliability.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Required Technical Skills

Skill Area| Required Technologies

Programming| Python, OOP, Data Structures

Data Science| NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn

Deep Learning| PyTorch, TensorFlow

GenAI / LLM| GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama

RAG| LangChain, LlamaIndex, Embeddings

Agentic AI| LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI

API Development| FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs

Databases| SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

Vector DB| FAISS, Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus

Cloud| AWS, Azure, GCP

DevOps| Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

Evaluation| RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith

Version Control| Git, GitHub, GitLab

Mandatory Requirements

* Strong hands-on Python programming and software engineering skills.
* Practical experience building and deploying enterprise-grade GenAI applications.
* Strong understanding of LLM architecture, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Hands-on experience building REST APIs using FastAPI or Flask.
* Experience integrating AI models with external APIs and enterprise applications.
* Practical knowledge of SQL and database integrations.
* Understanding of cloud deployment, Docker, and production environments.
* Ability to independently develop end-to-end AI solutions.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Advanced RPA - Agentic AI,Architecture design,Verbal Communication,Written Communication,Interpersonal Effectiveness

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

Data Analytics

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Good to Have

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Knowledge of Graph RAG and Knowledge Graphs.
* Experience with Deep Research and autonomous research agents.
* Experience with multimodal AI (text, image, audio, video).
* Experience with real-time voice AI and conversational AI systems.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience working with enterprise clients and large-scale production systems.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an engineer who is not limited to experimentation or notebook-based model development.

The candidate must be capable of taking an AI use case from requirement gathering and architecture design through development, API integration, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

The primary selection criteria will be hands-on coding capability, strong Python/API engineering, practical GenAI implementation, and enterprise solution development experience.

We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Analyst-Vulnerebility Remediation to join our team in Noida, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients. title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* **Global community:** With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

5+ years of experience in developing solutions using analytics and visualization toolsets such as Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, REACT and SAP/SAC

Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills

A trusted adviser to senior colleagues on topics like agile operations, operational redesign, lean/continuous improvement etc.

description:

Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
Data& Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)
  
Roche India - Roche Services& Solutions
  
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
TheSenior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Product Management& Technical Requirements Elicitation
  
  

* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog& Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment

2. Data Catalog& Governance Platform Management
  
  

* Catalog Administration& Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata& Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies

3. Domain Data Governance& Stewardship Enablement
  
  

* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms

4. Data Quality Specification& Rule Design
  
  

* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines

5. Business Interfacing& Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**  

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments.(Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory).
* Technical& Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation).
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality& Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic(preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking& Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal& Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

**Note:** Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)
  
  
Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Data & Enablement Manager
description:
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a hands-on pharmaceutical commercial data specialist who combines deep knowledge of datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG, AlphaSense etc. with strong technical skills. As the team's primary point of contact for commercial data needs, you will guide source selection, interpretation and effective use across analytics and market intelligence activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your Key Responsibilities that limited to:**

* Serve as the commercial data subject-matter expert: Act as the primary point of contact for Evaluate, IPD, DRG and other subscribed datasets, advising on coverage, definitions, methodologies, limitations and appropriate use.
* Translate business needs into data solutions: Understand requests across commercial analytics, forecasting and market intelligence; recommend suitable sources and define extraction, integration and delivery requirements.
* Democratise data access: Develop governed self-service datasets, reusable queries, workflows and documentation that help authorised team members use subscribed data independently.
* Build and automate data workflows: Use SQL, Python, Alteryx and cloud platforms such as Databricks to ingest, transform, reconcile and combine data, reducing repetitive manual extractions.
* Partner with IT on data products: Define business requirements, data models, refresh schedules, testing and rollout of scalable commercial data products.
* Establish trusted data foundations: Maintain source inventories, data dictionaries, mappings and lineage; implement quality checks and investigate discrepancies with providers and IT.
* Enable compliant use: Work with IT, procurement and data owners to ensure access, storage, integration and redistribution comply with subscription licences, vendor agreements and internal governance requirements.
* Increase subscription value and adoption: Identify overlapping assets and underused capabilities and deliver practical training and user guidance

**Essential Requirements**
**What I will bring to the role:**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical commercial data, analytics or data enablement, with a strong understanding of commercial business questions and pharma markets.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in pharmaceutical commercial datasets such as Evaluate, IPD, DRG and IQVIA, including source selection, extraction, interpretation and reconciliation across sources.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, data transformation, validation and query optimisation, with the ability to work independently with large, multi-source datasets.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python, with the ability to understand and adapt scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation and automation.
* Practical experience with Databricks or comparable cloud data platforms, including data pipelines, curated datasets and scheduled processing; familiarity with data modelling and cloud-based analytics architectures.
* Experience partnering with IT or data engineering teams to translate business requirements into reusable data products, define acceptance criteria and support testing and adoption.
* Sound understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, access controls and licensed 3rd-party data usage; ability to enable broader access without compromising contractual or governance requirements.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and prioritisation skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts clearly and provide practical training to users.
* Desirable: Python, SQL, API-based data integration, and experience with Power BI or Qlik Sense.
* Education: Advanced degree in Management, an analytical discipline, Data Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related field.

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
**Purpose of the Role**

To provide end-to-end business coordination and operational support for the LATAM region by driving sales tracking, distributor management, regulatory coordination, business reviews, commercial operations, tender management, marketing execution, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment to ensure achievement of regional business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Performance & Business Analytics**

* Monitor primary and secondary sales across LATAM markets.
* Support order execution, distributor onboarding, agreements, and customer code creation.
* Analyze sales deviations and drive corrective action plans with country managers.
* Track distributor inventory, stock movement, and Days of Inventory (DOI).
* Consolidate monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts.
* Support budgeting, target setting, and gap analysis exercises.

**2. Business Reporting & Strategic Support**

* Coordinate Business Review Meetings (BRM) and Leadership Review presentations.
* Consolidate commercial, regulatory, financial, and strategic updates from countries.
* Prepare management reports, executive summaries, and leadership presentations.
* Monitor strategic initiatives and action trackers.
* Support ad hoc business analysis and leadership requests.

**3. Regulatory & Product Registration Coordination**

* Track new product registrations, renewals, and filing plans.
* Coordinate with regulatory teams and consultants to resolve registration challenges.
* Manage dossier submissions and documentation follow-ups.
* Ensure alignment of commercial priorities with regulatory timelines.
* Coordinate country-specific artwork and packaging requirements.

**4. Portfolio & Business Development Support**

* Identify potential products and molecules for LATAM markets.
* Conduct market opportunity and attractiveness assessments.
* Support portfolio prioritization and business case preparation.
* Evaluate commercial potential for new product opportunities.

**5. Distributor & Country Management**

* Coordinate with country managers on business performance and market priorities.
* Drive distributor follow-ups for orders, forecasts, inventory, and execution.
* Manage local operational matters and market-specific issues.
* Track marketing, salary, and commercial debit notes.
* Coordinate commercial discussions and business requirements across markets.

**6. Commercial Operations & Finance Coordination**

* Monitor customer receivables and collections.
* Manage debit notes, provisions, reimbursements, and payment follow-ups.
* Coordinate with finance teams on commercial and payment-related issues.
* Validate business review financial data and commercial metrics.

**7. Tender & Institutional Business Management**

* Identify and evaluate tender opportunities.
* Coordinate pricing and commercial feasibility assessments.
* Support tender documentation and submission processes.
* Track tender status, outcomes, and post-award requirements.
* Liaise with distributors and internal stakeholders throughout the tender lifecycle.

**8. Marketing & Go-to-Market Execution**

* Support product scale-up initiatives across LATAM countries.
* Coordinate brand plans, launches, and marketing activities.
* Manage marketing budget tracking and activity planning.
* Monitor CRM and field force reporting compliance.
* Coordinate KOL, trademark, and medical initiative follow-ups.

**9. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Liaise with Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Commercial teams.
* Track product availability, dispatches, and operational issues.
* Coordinate NDAs, contracts, trademark, and legal documentation.
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment and governance cadence.
* Drive resolution of urgent business continuity matters.

**Requisite for the role -**

* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, International Business, Finance, or related discipline.
* 3-4 years of experience in Business Operations, Sales Operations or Regional Business Coordination. International Market exposure will be added advantage.
* Prior exposure to pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or multinational distribution markets preferred.

We’re looking for a proactive and highly organised
**Assistant Manager –**

Factory Production & Interior Project Operations
to support our growing execution and production team.

You’ll work closely with the Production Manager and cross-functional teams to ensure projects move smoothly from
**design sign-off and planning through production, procurement, site execution, quality control, and final handover**
.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys keeping multiple moving parts organised—timelines, budgets, vendors, materials, documentation, production schedules, logistics, and site coordination.

If you are detail-oriented, comfortable taking ownership, and enjoy solving execution challenges while keeping projects on time and within budget, this role is for you.

* Coordinate project kick-off activities and ensure all internal teams are aligned on deliverables and timelines.
* Monitor project progress and proactively highlight delays, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Maintain project trackers and ensure regular follow-ups with all stakeholders.

Production & Order Management

* Coordinate day-to-day production requirements across ongoing projects.
* Track orders from approved BOM / specifications through manufacturing and dispatch.
* Coordinate with production teams to allocate resources based on workload and project priorities.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure materials and finished products are available as per project timelines.

Budgeting & Cost Control

* Track actual project costs against approved budgets.
* Maintain purchase, production, vendor, transportation, and installation cost records.
* Identify potential cost variations and flag them before they impact the overall project budget.
* Support real-time cost tracking and project profitability control through accurate documentation.

* Conduct periodic factory and site-level quality checks where required.

Logistics & Inventory

* Track dispatch schedules and delivery timelines.
* Assist in maintaining project-wise inventory and material records.
* Coordinate transportation and logistics requirements for ongoing projects.
* Ensure critical materials reach the required location as per the execution schedule.

Documentation & Reporting

* Prepare regular internal project updates and progress reports.
* Maintain records related to orders, BOMs, procurement, dispatch, installation, and snag closure.
* Ensure all project information is accurate, updated, and accessible to the relevant teams.

  .
* Identify discrepancies between design requirements, BOMs, budgets, and execution requirements.
* Facilitate quick resolution of execution-related queries.
* Ensure clear communication between all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

title: Citi - Internal Audit, Summer Analyst, India – APAC, 2027
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You’re the brains behind our work.**  
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.
  
  
Citi’s Internal Audit Group is looking for Summer Analysts to join the team in Mumbai. Citi's Internal Audit division provides independent assessments of the company's governance, risk management and internal control environment for key stakeholders including the Board of Directors, senior management and Citi’s numerous regulators globally. Internal Audit is a change agent within Citi aimed to enhance the control culture of Citi worldwide and thereby support senior management decision making around the globe.
  
  
Get the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
  
Citi’s Internal Audit Summer Analyst Program is an 8-week internship opportunity in Mumbai. This Program will provide development-focused opportunities coupled with structured classroom training, mentoring and individual development.
  
  
As an Internal Audit Summer Analyst, you will face off into one of Citi’s core businesses or global functions to ensure that a sound control framework and environment is in place globally through the delivery of independent and timely assurance.
  
  
**Your time at Citi will look something like this.**  
The Internal Audit Summer Analyst program begins in April 2026 with a firmwide training program, providing Summer Analysts with an overview of Citi and an introduction to Citi’s Internal Audit Organization. The Summer Program will provide Summer Analysts with Senior and Junior Mentors, networking opportunities and Senior Speaker Events where Citi’s senior IA professionals will host discussions and answer questions about their careers and IA functions.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Xtrackers Product Specialist Analyst (Corporate Title: Associate) – Indexing Project Manager**

**Location: Mumbai or Pune**

**Role Description** :

The Xtrackers Products team is responsible for the lifecycle of ETFs, ETCs, index funds and institutional mandates, from product strategy and design through implementation, maintenance and closure. As a member of the Indexing group, you will work closely with colleagues across Indexing and Product Content Engineering, providing project and business management support. You will help coordinate initiatives across index, portfolio and strategy development, working with index providers, sales teams, active and passive portfolio managers. Your responsibilities will include maintaining the product ideation pipeline, tracking opportunities and actions, coordinating stakeholder input, supporting prioritisation discussions, monitoring progress, and ensuring effective follow-up throughout the development process. You will also support governance and operational activities, including index and data provider onboarding, due diligence, provider consultations, methodology change monitoring and index lifecycle management. In addition, you will assist with commercial discussions and provider relationship management by helping to monitor costs, maintain documentation and support decision-making. Based in India, you will be part of the global Indexing team, working closely with colleagues in Frankfurt and other locations. Through proactive communication, accurate record-keeping and effective coordination across time zones, you will help ensure transparency and continuity across the team's activities.

The Xtrackers Product Specialists and Development team is responsible for defining and implementing the Xtrackers product strategy, structuring and maintaining ETF and other passive investment solutions, and acting as product specialists for our clients and client coverage colleagues. ETFs and other passive investment solutions are data-intensive products; your role is thus crucial for the successful implementation of Xtrackers’ growth strategy, as well as the stabilization and improvement of the Xtrackers product setup. You will work in an international team spanning Germany, the UK, Luxembourg, the US, Japan, and India. The team is very diverse, with members bringing a wide range of quantitative and financial educational backgrounds and practical experiences. We look forward to welcoming our next Product Specialist to our ambitious and driven team and to jointly grow our business to the next level!

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* Support and progressively take ownership of product ideation, prioritisation, index development and product launch processes across ETFs, ETCs and institutional investment solutions, ensuring compliance with regulatory and client requirements.
* Help capture, assess, prioritise and track new opportunities in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain project plans, action trackers and status reporting, helping ensure timely delivery, clear accountability and disciplined follow-up on key initiatives and decisions.
* Manage relationships with index and data providers, including onboarding, contract administration, third-party risk management, ongoing reviews and performance monitoring.
* Coordinate index-related business processes, including index consultations, methodology changes and lifecycle events, ensuring timely input and alignment across relevant stakeholders.

* Document and maintain onboarding, quality monitoring and lifecycle related processes around index and data providers
* Establish and enhance data quality controls and best practices, helping ensure that data used across the team remains accurate, relevant, appropriately governed and cost-effective.
* Promote the effective use of Xtrackers product tools, data platforms and workflow solutions, while contributing to process automation, workflow optimisation and the centralisation of index, product and data knowledge, including through AI-enabled capabilities.

* Collaborate with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Index and data providers, Portfolio Management, Capital Markets, Operations, Technology and Sales to ensure seamless process, execution and continuous improvement.
Provide proactive support for ad-hoc initiatives and projects within the Product team.  

  

**Your Skills and Experience:**

* University degree, preferably in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Law or a related discipline
* Good knowledge and previous work experience in the asset management sector (ETFs/ ETCs a plus) and a keen interest in investment products in general
* Good negotiation skills. Prior experience in contract management or legal agreement negotiation is a plus
* Knowledge of financial market regulation and industry frameworks (e.g. UCITS, MiFID, BMR or SFDR) is beneficial.
* Understanding of product development, project coordination, business management or governance processes within a regulated environment.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Python, PowerApps or similar digital tools is advantageous.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, research, documentation or business processes.
Ability to coordinate stakeholders, monitor progress, maintain project documentation and communicate status updates clearly and concisely.  

**Personal Characteristics:**

* Highly organized, self-motivated, perseverant, detail-oriented, and accountable, with the ability to identify priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Intellectual curiosity, interest for financial markets and investing, and data-driven decision-making, coupled with creativity and interest to explore new ideas, technologies, and investment concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex discussions into clear meeting summaries, action items and management briefings

* Diligent, efficient and able to manage multiple conflicting deliverables including working under pressure while maintaining a high level of attention to detail

* Proactive in identifying and implementing process improvements and innovative solutions.
Able to thrive in an entrepreneurial setting, balancing independent work with collaboration and stakeholder engagement  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible benefits program, you will have access to:

* Best-in-class leave policy
* Gender-neutral parental leave
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender-neutral)
* Sponsorship for industry-relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family
* Comprehensive hospitalization insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and term life insurance
Complimentary health screening for employees aged 35 and above  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information: **https://www.db.com/company/company.htm**

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high-performance culture. The Project Engineer – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chiller Systems is responsible for supporting the execution and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects in data centres. The role focuses on engineering coordination, site execution, technical review, installation supervision, testing, commissioning support, and documentation for HVAC, chiller, and cooling system projects. * Coordinate commissioning activities for chillers, pumps, cooling equipment, control systems, and integrated HVAC systems.
* Work with BMS/controls teams to ensure proper integration, point checks, alarms, trends, and sequence validation.
* Identify technical issues, installation gaps, and site constraints, and escalate them with recommended solutions.

* Support preparation of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, commissioning records, and final handover documentation.

* Testing and commissioning records

**Experience**

* Typically 3–8 years of experience in HVAC/mechanical project execution.
* Relevant experience in data centre projects, mission-critical facilities, commercial HVAC plants, or industrial cooling systems is preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to chiller systems, chilled water piping, precision cooling, and site coordination is desirable.
* Experience working in live facilities, retrofit projects, or fast-track MEP projects is an advantage.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Chillers and central cooling plants
* HVAC systems and precision cooling applications
* CRAH/CRAC /CDU /SFN systems
* Chilled water and condenser water piping systems
* Pumps, valves, strainers, and heat exchangers
* Airside and waterside balancing

title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Onboarding
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
Aspire is the all-in-one finance platform for startups and SMEs. We are hiring a Strategy & Operations Manager to own how businesses get onboarded and verified: conversion, speed, cost and quality, across our markets. Numbers-first, hands-on, shipping every week. We bring accounts, cards, payments, expense management and accounting tools together for startups and SMEs. You will work closely with senior leaders and own a core part of the customer journey.
  
  
Onboarding is a business's first real experience of Aspire. You will shape how quickly and smoothly businesses get set up and start using the platform, working with onboarding and quality teams spread across APAC and the US, and with Product, Data and Compliance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own onboarding performance: conversion and time to verification by market. Find where businesses drop off, then design, test and ship the fixes across product, process and communication.

* Automate: build the business case for onboarding automation and new tools, then deliver it with Product and Engineering.
* Improve processes: design and improve operating procedures with Compliance and Operations for a smooth, compliant customer experience.
* Run on data: define the metrics, work with Data on dashboards, and turn them into a weekly read and decisions.
* Lead projects: launches and cross-functional initiatives that touch onboarding.

**How We Work**

* You start from the data and come back with a recommendation.
* A working v1 this week beats a perfect plan next quarter.

Learn the onboarding flow and the teams that run it, build a shared view of performance and capacity, ship your first improvements, and agree targets for the next two quarters.

* Typically 4+ years in strategy and operations, BizOps, consulting, or ops-heavy roles at a fintech, financial services or high-growth tech company
* Experience with onboarding, KYC/KYB, risk or another ops-heavy process is a plus
