Enterprise Technology is a global organization that delivers reliable, secure, and resilient technology services and solutions to enable an exceptional technology experience for EY people. As part of the Enterprise Technology Risk and Compliance team, the role will be part of a transformative global team that enables our strategic direction, develops, and executes the compliance and controls model for Enterprise Technology. Reporting to the Assurance & Compliance Lead, this role involves collaborating with key technology stakeholders, building a robust compliance framework, monitoring compliance processes, and providing guidance to mitigate risks, all while fostering a culture of integrity and ethical behaviour throughout the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The role will support control development and implementation across technology applications and systems to ensure adherence with EY policies, internal compliance standards, and regulatory and legal requirements.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**

* Collaborate with key stakeholders and subject matter experts in Enterprise Technology, Finance and other functional areas to ensure alignment with strategic goals and objectives.
* Identify and assess compliance risks related to technology operations and processes.
* Assist in designing and implementing controls to mitigate identified compliance risks, ensuring effective documentation.
* Collaborate with application owners and function leaders to enhance and streamline the compliance controls framework.
* Support the annual internal audit testing of business and IT general controls, System Development Life Cycle controls, application controls and IT-dependent manual controls including, but not limited to ISQM1, QC1000, Global Internal Audit, and other internal or external assessments.
* Support the remediation of compliance gaps and the implementation of improvement plans to enhance compliance posture.
* Provide subject matter expertise on technology risks and compliance controls to leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and assess their impact on technology operations and compliance strategies.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**

**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
The role requires a solid understanding of risk, controls, and assurance frameworks and processes, along with a strong perspective on the business and the internal stakeholders we serve. The successful candidate will be able to translate business needs into risk, control, and assurance requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. A long-term view of risk and assurance priorities, combined with the ability to adapt to evolving business needs, will be essential for the successful delivery of strategic initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in IT auditing, technology risk management, internal controls, or assurance activities across technology and finance processes.
* SME knowledge of ITGC, ITAC, and key business process control concepts and requirements.
* Experience with ISAE 3402, SOC1, ISQM1 or similar compliance management frameworks.
* Minimum 5 years' experience in internal audit, technology risk management, controls assurance, or related risk and controls functions within a global organization.

**Must have skills required:**
MQTT / IoT Core, CI/CD, Go, RDS or Aurora Terraform, AWS, Python
  
  
**Texecom is Looking for:******
**Job Title: Senior Platform Engineer**
**Who are we?**
Texecom Ltd is a leading manufacturer and provider of professional security products, systems, and services. Our innovative solutions are designed to protect the things you care about, wherever they are. Texecom Cloud is the approved alarm signalling platform those systems depend on. When an intruder alarm
  
  
activates, our platform is what carries that signal to a monitoring centre. It is certified against EN 50136 for alarm transmission, and it also hosts the suite of subscription digital services that sit at the core of Texecom''s future strategy. That gives the platform an unusual combination of constraints. It has to behave like critical infrastructure on availability and signalling integrity, and like a modern product platform on delivery pace. Both at once, on the same estate.
  
  
**What we need?**
We are recruiting two hands-on Senior Platform Engineers to own and advance the AWS platform on which Texecom''s cloud services are built, deployed and operated. Together you will form the core of a new India-based Platform Engineering team.
  
  
You will set the patterns that the wider engineering organisation builds on, operating as a resilient team able to cover the other''s work, so that no part of the platform depends on one person.
  
  
**How can you help us?**
As a Senior Platform Engineer at Texecom, you will be accountable for work of this kind
  
  

* Multiaccount AWS foundation. Account vending and organisational unit structure, a compliantbydefault landing zone, IAM Identity Center role modelling, and getting least privilege to hold across a growing estate.
* Security baseline. Organisationwide security tooling, including threat detection and vulnerability scanning, with findings turned into remediation rather than reports.
* Data layer. Aurora MySQL & DynamoDB at production scale: bluegreen deployment, schema migration safety and rollback, replication topology. Day-to-day database operations are part of the job, not someone else''s.
* Delivery pipelines. Pipeline architecture in Bitbucket Pipelines and AWS CodeBuild, GitOps service manifests, Step Functions deployment orchestration, and guardrails that make the safe path the easy path.
* Device and messaging estate. MQTT broker infrastructure and AWS IoT Core, carrying live traffic from a field estate of alarm panels.
* Observability and cost. Monitoring, alerting, metrics, structured logging and correlation IDs as a platform capability rather than a per-service afterthought, plus auto-scaling and right-sizing where the saving is real and the risk is understood.
* Platform tooling. Internal tooling and automation, largely in Go and Python, including credential and identity tooling used by engineering and operations.
* Golden paths, not application services. Platform Engineering builds the foundations and the paved road that development teams deploy on. Application services are owned by the teams that build them.
* Raising the floor. Training and mentoring the wider Cloud Operations team in platform engineering practice.

**The successful candidate should have**

* Deep, handson AWS. You can design an account and identity model. You have operated production RDS or Aurora and you understand what can go wrong, and how to proactively track, monitor and prevent issues.
* Terraform as your primary tool, at a level where you own modules and shared state.
* An automationfirst mindset, applied to operational toil as readily as to provisioning.
* Strong scripting and tooling skills in one or more of Python, Go, PowerShell or TypeScript, building maintainable tooling rather than throwaway scripts.
* CI/CD design rather than CI/CD usage: pipeline architecture, artefact promotion, continuous delivery, release safety and rollback, and the release patterns that make frequent change safe, including blue-green and canary releases and feature toggling.
* Security as an engineering discipline. Least privilege, secret management, blastradius reasoning, and a working understanding of regulated or compliance constrained environments. ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and NIST alignment experience is valuable.
* Architectural judgment at enterprise scale, across distributed systems: what is safe to change, in what order, and what has to be proven first.
* Production operations experience. You have been on call for a live service, led an incident through to resolution, and written up what changed afterwards.
* Experience of the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through to debug, test and operation.
* Experience of Scrum and Agile delivery, and familiarity with Atlassian tooling (Jira, Confluence).

**How you work matters as much as what you know**
We hire for behaviour as much as technical depth. The qualities below are assessed during the process, not assumed.
  
  

* You test designs before they ship. You raise the difficult question early, including on decisions that have already been agreed, and you back it with evidence.
* You get to the real problem. You clarify the requirement, and you separate out issues that have been bundled together, before you start building.
* You deliver what was agreed. You keep scope tight, note good ideas for later, and make tradeoffs visible rather than absorbing them.
* You respect shared work. You coordinate changes that affect other teams, and you resolve conflicts through conversation rather than by overriding.
* You work from evidence. When a cost, constraint or assumption matters, you verify it.
* You share what you know. Your work comes with documentation a colleague can act on, and you build knowledge across the team rather than holding it.
* You value code review. You give thorough, constructive reviews and expect the same in return. Every change is peer reviewed before it merges, including yours.
* You raise risk early and openly, including when it makes a decision harder.

**It would be an advantage if the candidate had**

* Python at production quality.
* MySQL or Aurora internals, including replication and migration tooling.
* MQTT or IoT messaging at scale.
* Test automation within delivery pipelines.
* FinOps experience: cost modelling, autoscaling economics and commitmentbased pricing.
* AWS security services at organisation scale, such as GuardDuty, Inspector and Security Hub.
* Windows as well as Linux build and packaging targets.
* CloudFormation or CDK/CDKTF, to understand and migrate existing infrastructure.

**How We Work**

* Infrastructure as Code by default. Production changes go through code, with a controlled and recorded route for the rare exceptions.
* Deployment through approved pipelines, promoting through lower environments into production.
* Structured logging with correlation IDs, as a baseline across services.
* Significant design changes are written up as RFCs and reviewed by our Design Authority. Engineers write them. The aim is visible, well-reasoned decisions, not extra process.
* Engineering standards are minimum expectations, increasingly enforced through tooling.

**How to apply for this opportunity?**

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

**About Uplers:**
Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

**Required Skills**

* Strong production Python development with object-oriented design, reusable modules, exception handling, concurrency, API integration, file operations and structured data such as JSON, YAML and CSV.
* Familiarity on development experience in C/C++ integration, PowerShell, BDD/Robot Framework, hardware-in-the-loop testing or scientific and regulated product environments.
* Hands-on systems engineering on Linux, including processes, services, permissions, resource usage, shell scripting and network diagnostics; ability to support Windows integration where needed.
* Practical experience deploying, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting physical IoT devices, industrial gateways or edge-computing systems, beyond cloud-only application development.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MQTT and HTTP-based communication, with an understanding of device connectivity, authentication and offline recovery.
* Experience building Python backend services with FastAPI, Flask or equivalent, and integrating databases or local persistence for configuration, telemetry and operational state.

* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, technical documentation and cross-functional communication; ability to own implementation through deployment and operational support.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs or comparable ARM/x86 edge platforms; familiarity with device drivers, BSPs and hardware/software compatibility.
* Exposure to Azure IoT or AWS IoT services, Kubernetes/k3s, Ansible or equivalent device and deployment orchestration tools.
* Experience deploying AI inference workloads at the edge, or integrating LLM services for diagnostics and automation with validation and appropriate human controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering connected products or engineering platforms through the full development lifecycle in an Agile, globally distributed team.

description:

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - DevOps
description:
**Job Summary**
:

We’re looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency.

You’ll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic — both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) — across a global, multi-cloud environment. You’ll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. Deep understanding of API Gateways like Envoy is a must.

This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You’ll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly — from traffic routing to deployments to production operations.

One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer — a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up.

**About the team**
:

We are the Platform & Infrastructure Engineering group at JioHotstar, the architects behind one of the planet's most high-traffic streaming ecosystems. Our infrastructure recently powered a world-record 72.5 million concurrent viewers on a single live stream, and we proudly operated nine of the ten largest streaming events ever recorded. We empower hundreds of million users with seamless access to sports and entertainment through multi-region cloud orchestration and massive CDN automation. Our engineers tackle unprecedented challenges in real-time traffic management and edge computing under extreme demand—solving problems that define the industry standard for scale, cost-efficiency, and operational excellence.

Our group is defined by a strong bias for experimentation and the agility to navigate rapidly shifting priorities. We foster deep cross-functional collaboration, prioritize deployment velocity, rapid recovery, and developer enablement, allowing product teams to ship at speed without sacrificing system integrity. This is a high-visibility environment where decisions happen in seconds and engineering solutions become global case studies. If you are driven by high-impact work that brings historic moments to life for hundreds of millions, this is where you belong.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment.
* Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility.
* Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization.
* Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes.
* Design and govern CI/CD and GitOps workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments.
* Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently.
* Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale.
* Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default.
* Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices.
* Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues.

**Skills & Attributes for success:**

* Deep, hands-on experience with Envoy API Gateway platform in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems.
* Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity.
* Good understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers.
* Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails.
* Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure.
* Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams.
* Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems.

**Preferred Education & Experience:**

* B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university.
* 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery.

title: Oracle Integration DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an Oracle Integration DevOps Engineer for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The engineer reports to the VP of IT Operations.
  
  
The Oracle Integration DevOps Engineer is the operational owner of ACC's Oracle integration landscape. Where the Oracle Integration Engineer designs and builds interfaces, this role is accountable for everything that happens to them afterwards: how they are deployed, how they are monitored, how they behave at three in the morning, and how quickly they are recovered when they fail. The engineer owns the release pipeline, the monitoring and alerting estate, the on-call response, the environment and credential lifecycle, and the operational controls and evidence around production change.
  
  
This is a run-the-platform role rather than a project-delivery role. The engineer does not own requirements gathering or new interface design; the engineer owns deployment, reliability, observability, incident response and the steady elimination of toil, and partners with the Oracle Integration Engineer at design time to ensure that what is built can actually be operated. New interfaces pass through a production-readiness review owned by this role before they go live. Software engineering effort in the role is directed at automation, tooling and pipelines rather than at business interface development.
  
  
Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time, with awareness of the Finance and Accounting close calendar and extended availability during month-end, quarter-end and year-end close. The role carries primary on-call responsibility for the integration estate, participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, executes Oracle quarterly update, release and maintenance windows, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Own and operate the release pipeline for Oracle integration and reporting artifacts, including automated build, packaging, validation, deployment and rollback across development, test and production.
* Act as release manager for integration change, scheduling and executing deployments around the Finance close and planning calendars and maintaining the integration release calendar.
* Enforce artifact governance so that no production change reaches an environment outside the pipeline, with source control, versioning and traceability from commit to deployed change.
* Own and run the automated regression and smoke test suites, executing them for every release and ahead of every Oracle quarterly update, and remediating or blocking release on failure.
* Own environment and instance lifecycle operations, including refresh coordination and scheduling, post-refresh reconfiguration, endpoint and credential re-pointing, data masking steps and verification that non-production environments are usable.
* Own the monitoring, logging, metrics and dashboard estate for all integrations, and define and report service level indicators and objectives for business-critical interfaces.
* Own alert design and tuning, maintaining actionable alerting on failure, missed schedules, latency, queue depth and unexpected volume, and continuously reducing false positives and alert fatigue.
* Serve as primary on-call responder for the integration estate, performing daily operational checks of run status, error rates, volumes and latency so that failures are detected by monitoring rather than reported by the business.
* Triage, correct and reprocess failed transactions and files, communicating impact, affected scope and expected resolution to Finance, Accounting and other affected stakeholders.
* Run incident management for integration and interface outages, including triage, mitigation, restoration, stakeholder communication during major incidents, and blameless post-incident review with corrective actions tracked to closure.
* Own problem management for the integration estate, eliminating recurring failure modes and chronic data-quality issues through engineering fixes rather than repeated manual remediation, and reporting on toil reduction.
* Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 operational support for integration incidents, managing a ServiceNow queue from receipt through resolution and prioritizing close-blocking interface issues above all other work during close.
* Monitor Oracle Integration Cloud platform health, usage, message volumes and consumption limits, plan for growth, and open, drive and escalate Oracle Support service requests through to resolution.
* Own operational credential and certificate lifecycle, including inventory, approved vault storage, automated rotation, proactive expiry monitoring and remediation of hardcoded or embedded credentials.
* Operate DevSecOps controls in the pipeline, including secret scanning and dependency and configuration checks, and treat security findings as release-blocking defects.
* Govern integration service accounts operationally in coordination with the Oracle Security Administrator and the IAM team, including periodic justification review and least-privilege verification.
* Operate and monitor the reconciliation and interface controls designed into each interface, investigate exceptions, and escalate unresolved breaks before they reach close.
* Execute change management for all production integration changes, producing documented change records, automated test evidence, rollback plans and the audit and control evidence required for internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent testing.
* Own the integration inventory and the runbook library, ensuring every production interface has a current runbook covering purpose, schedule, dependencies, known failure modes, recovery steps and business contacts.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery for the integration estate, including documented recovery expectations, catch-up and replay procedures and periodic recovery validation.
* Own the production-readiness review for new and changed interfaces, verifying that logging, error handling, retry behavior, alerting, reconciliation hooks, rollback and runbooks are delivered before go-live, and partnering with the Oracle Integration Engineer at design time so that operability is built in rather than retrofitted.
* Develop automation and tooling in Python, Bash and/or PowerShell and against Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Cloud REST APIs to eliminate repeatable deployment and operational work.
* Build controlled self-service operational tooling for Finance and support teams, such as re-run, reprocess and status-check capability, to reduce dependence on engineer intervention.
* Maintain operational standards for the estate, including logging and naming conventions, error-handling and alerting templates and deployment standards, and drive the retirement of unsupported, unmonitored and undocumented interfaces.
* Report regularly on integration estate health, including reliability, incident and problem trends, release metrics, recurring failure causes and remediation progress.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing financial, bank, vendor or personal data, credentials or integration configuration to unapproved tools.
* Experience applying AI assistants responsibly to operational work such as automation scripting, log and error analysis, runbook and post-incident documentation and release note review, with human validation before anything touches production.
* Strong knowledge of production operations and site reliability practice, including incident management, problem management, on-call response, escalation and blameless post-incident review.
* Strong knowledge of observability practice, including metrics, logging, dashboards, service level indicators and objectives, and alert design and tuning that distinguishes a page-worthy alert from noise.
* Strong knowledge of release engineering and CI/CD operation, including pipeline execution, artifact and version governance, controlled environment promotion, deployment automation and rollback design.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash and/or PowerShell, and comfort automating against REST APIs to remove operational toil.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud from an operating and troubleshooting perspective, including monitoring and tracking, error handling, reprocessing, connectivity agent behavior and platform health and consumption.
* Working knowledge of integration design patterns and of Oracle Cloud ERP data flow, sufficient to diagnose a failing interface and judge whether a proposed design can be operated and recovered.
* Knowledge of operational security practice, including secrets management, automated credential and certificate rotation, expiry monitoring, least-privilege service accounts and pipeline security gates.
* Knowledge of reconciliation and interface controls and of the change and audit evidence expected around financially significant interfaces.
* Strong SQL skills for operational analysis, reconciliation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem and change management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, including the ability to communicate impact and status clearly to Finance and Accounting stakeholders during an active incident.
* Ability to automate by default and to treat any manual production change or recurring manual remediation as a defect to be engineered away.
* Ability to reason about blast radius before making a change and to design and sequence changes that fail safely.
* Ability to remain calm, methodical and communicative during outages, close-period escalations and high-pressure production events.
* Ability to hold a release or block a go-live when operational readiness criteria are not met, and to explain the reasoning in terms stakeholders will accept.
* Ability to troubleshoot across system boundaries and drive resolution with a third party who owns the other side of an interface.
* Ability to work independently as a self-starter with a hands-on approach, and to know when to stop and ask rather than guess on a production interface.
* Strong problem-solving and data-analysis skills, with high attention to detail while multitasking and meeting multiple deadlines.

**Education & Experience**

* At least five years of experience in DevOps, site reliability engineering, platform operations or production application support, including direct accountability for the uptime of production services.
* Demonstrated experience carrying production on-call for business-critical systems, including incident response, escalation and post-incident improvement.
* Demonstrated experience operating CI/CD pipelines and release processes, including deployment automation, controlled environment promotion and rollback; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions experience is preferred.
* Hands-on experience implementing and operating monitoring, alerting and dashboards for production services, and tuning alerting over time.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience in Python, Bash and/or PowerShell, including automation against REST APIs.
* At least three years of hands-on experience operating and supporting production integrations on Oracle Integration Cloud with Oracle Cloud ERP, including monitoring, error handling, reprocessing and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with secrets management tooling, certificate and key lifecycle management and API authentication patterns including OAuth.
* Experience operating financial interfaces under reconciliation and control, including banking or payment file processing.
* Experience with infrastructure or configuration as code, such as Terraform or a comparable tool, is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit and internal control requirements is required; SOX experience and real estate, property management or student housing industry experience are preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems or a related field; equivalent work experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**CERTIFICATES & LICENSES**

* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).
* Oracle Integration Cloud Professional.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate.
* ITIL 4 Foundation; ITIL Managing Professional is a plus.
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate is a plus.

* CompTIA SecAI+ (Security AI+).

TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role
  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.
  
What you will do
  
• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
  
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
  
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
  
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
  
reproducible and version controlled.
  
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
  
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
  
how it behaves there.
  
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
  
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
  
has to be preserved.
  
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
  
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match
  
the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
  
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
  
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
  
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.
  
What we are looking for
  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
  
tools from day one.
  
Where you need depth
  
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
  
and defend.
  
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
  
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
  
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
  
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
  
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
  
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
  
to be shipped.
  
Where working knowledge is enough
  
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
  
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
  
containers.
  
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
  
monitoring and alerting.
  
Across everything
  
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
  
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
  
and careful, staged rollout.
  
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
  
written.
  
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
  
with your counterparts rather than around them.
  
Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
  
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the
  
domain to the right engineer.
  
• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
  
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
  
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
**Description**
CME Group is seeking a SRE II to begin their career in our Markets portfolio. This is an entry-level opportunity to learn how to build, operate, and scale the systems behind CME’s Globex trading platform. Our systems deliver an exceptional combination of low-latency performance and rock-solid reliability, and this role offers a unique chance to learn from the ground up.
  
  
The successful candidate will be mentored by senior engineers and will be trained on how we observe, monitor, automate, and improve Production service reliability in a supportive team environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Learn from and work alongside senior engineers to assist with building out observability, monitoring, and alerting for key services.
  
  
Shadow senior engineers as they partner with product teams to understand the reliability and scalability needs for new features.
  
  
Write and maintain basic scripts and tools to help reduce toil and improve engineering velocity.
  
  
Contribute to and learn from our culture of blameless post-mortems to drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Assist with DR (Disaster Recovery) and systems resiliency testing.
  
  
Support the migration of markets applications to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
After a period of training and mentorship, begin to shadow and then participate in the on-call rotation with direct support from senior engineers.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
A passion for technology and a strong desire to build a career in Site Reliability Engineering.
  
  
Foundational programming/scripting skills (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Bash) demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, or internships.
  
  
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with a curious mindset.
  
  
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  
  
A profound eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced trading environment.
  
  
**Desirable (Nice To Have, Not Required)**
Familiarity with cloud concepts (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure).
  
  
Good knowledge of Linux-based systems
  
  
Basic understanding of containerisation technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
  
  
An interest in metrics & monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.
  
  
Foundational knowledge of networking concepts (HTTP, TCP/IP).
  
  
An interest in financial technology and high-performance systems.
  
  
**CME Group: Where Futures are Made**
CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.
  
  
At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.
  
  
**Important Notice:**
Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. CME Group adheres to established procedures designed to maintain trust, confidence and security throughout our recruitment process. Learn more here.

description:

title: Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Provide senior technical leadership during critical incidents, coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting, restore services within agreed priorities, and communicate clear technical status and risk.
* Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, identify corrective and preventive actions, and ensure actions are tracked through closure.
* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

title: Staff/Principal Engineer Core Team
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We are looking for a Staff/Principal Engineer to join the team.
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**AI Gateway**
is the control plane of five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solve some of the most complex Engineering problems and drive it alongside a team of engineers & ML researchers.
* Build a deep, holistic understanding of the TrueFoundry platform across all components and shape the product vision and implementation.
* Act as the technical face of engineering for customer-related discussions and escalations
* Guide and unblock engineers across projects in the US region
* Partner closely with our CTO and India-based engineering team to drive system design, architecture, and implementation of complex products
* Lead technical design, critical customer problem-solving, and platform scalability initiatives end-to-end

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role designed for an engineer who loves combining world-class systems thinking with real-world execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop deep expertise across TrueFoundry’s platform stack: infrastructure, deployment systems, LLM/ML orchestration, observability, cost optimization, and more
* Drive the system architecture and design for complex, distributed, cloud-native systems
* Act as the technical point-of-contact for enterprise customer engineering needs and escalations
* Lead and participate in design reviews, code reviews, and critical incident responses
* Collaborate closely with the CTO on architectural decisions, scaling strategies, and technical roadmap prioritization
* Identify and drive technical debt cleanup, performance improvements, and resilience upgrades across the platform
* Bring a product engineering mindset, ensuring that customer needs and feedback translate into scalable engineering solutions

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years of strong backend/systems engineering experience at top technology companies or startups
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and scalable system design
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and infrastructure engineering
* Practical experience building or deploying ML/GenAI applications (or closely working with ML/DS teams)
* Skilled in programming languages such as Python, Golang, TypeScript, and Node.js
* Solid understanding of system observability, resiliency design, and SRE practices
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills — able to work with both customers and engineering teams
* Ability to think strategically while also executing hands-on when required

Perks of Working at TrueFoundry
  
  

* Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: Senior System Development Engineer, Silicon, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related Information Technology (IT) field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with systems automation, and with systems design and implementation.
* 5 years of experience with technical infrastructure (e.g., deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting), and with reliability of technical infrastructure.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience working with vendors or customers.
* Experience with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools or chip design.
* Experience in working with Go, Python or C++.
* Experience in interacting with end users or product aptitude.

**About The Job**
Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters.
  
  
Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.
  
  
Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter.
  
  
The EDACloud Operations team defines processes for managing incidents to develop automation to ensure upgrades are rolled out safely and slowly. The team builds out monitoring for internal use as well as for the users to understand the state of the service, and debug when there are issues.
  
  
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in on-call activities and manage the systems within the domain and work with the primary responders to help in fixing system issues.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate technical data, and develop recommendations for systems and services, respond to tickets/bugs within team-defined service-level objectives (SLOs), and contribute to systems and services through bug reports and consultation.
* Work with customers on defining distributed systems requirements, testing procedures, and proposing solutions.
* Set up processes for planning, improving quality, best practices, and maintaining a short response time for user issues.
