title: SRE Manager
description:
SRE and DevOps Team Engineer | 100% Remote - India
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SRE & DevOps Manager to lead the team responsible for the reliability, automation, and scale of our SaaS platform. This is a hands-on role: you will work closely with engineering leadership to improve processes, operate incident management and on-call practices, and guide and develop a team of engineers — while remaining close enough to the systems to support the team through difficult operational challenges with credibility.
  
  
You will be accountable for the availability, performance, and operational maturity of our cloud environments, and for promoting a team culture grounded in reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement. The role coordinates day-to-day across Indian Standard Time (IST) and US time zones.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of SRE/DevOps engineers. Work closely with engineering leadership to assess team needs and develop talent.
* Incident management: Oversee the incident management process end to end — on-call rotations, escalation paths, incident command, postmortems, and follow-through on root cause analysis (RCA) and preventative actions.
* Reliability practices: Define and drive SRE principles including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and observability standards across services. Champion a culture of reliability and operational excellence.
* Process improvement: Partner with engineering leadership to identify and implement process improvements across the team’s operational priorities, balancing feature delivery, reliability work, security, and cost efficiency. Guide and support the team’s day-to-day work.
* Cross-time-zone collaboration: Coordinate a distributed team and support model across IST and US time zones, ensuring effective handoffs, coverage, and communication.
* Leadership partnership: Interface with engineering leadership to align infrastructure investments with business and compliance goals. Report on team health, reliability metrics, and operational performance. Assist engineering leadership in managing the team, including department-wide initiatives and roadmap planning.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Leadership experience: 2-3 years of experience as a team lead or manager in a DevOps/SRE environment.
* Distributed teams: Proven experience leading and coordinating distributed teams across time zones, specifically IST and US, including on-call coverage and handoffs.
* Incident management: Experience running an incident management process — on-call, escalation, incident command, severity frameworks, and driving blameless postmortems and RCA to completion.
* Cloud infrastructure: Strong hands-on background across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes - GKE & EKS, managed databases, object storage, networking, IAM) with flexibility to work across multiple cloud providers.
* Platform Engineering: Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code practices (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
* Observability: Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience improving and scaling an SRE/DevOps function, on-call program, or reliability practice.
* Experience in FinTech or another regulated environment with security and compliance requirements.
* Experience optimizing data infrastructure and database operations.
* Experience improving observability across multiple cloud technologies.
* A background in designing for cost-efficiency, resilience, and security in cloud infrastructure.

**About Eltropy**
Eltropy is a rocket ship FinTech on a mission to disrupt the way people access financial services. Eltropy enables financial institutions to digitally engage in a secure and compliant way. Using our world-class digital communications platform, community financial institutions can improve operations, engagement, and productivity. CFIs (Community Banks and Credit Unions) use Eltropy to communicate with consumers via Text, Video, Secure Chat, co-browsing, screen sharing, and chatbot technology — all integrated into a single platform bolstered by AI, skill-based routing, and other contact center capabilities.
  
  
**Eltropy Values**

* Customers are our North Star
* No Fear – Tell the Truth
* Team of Owners

Eltropy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
  
  
**If you're a seasoned DevOps manager with a passion for automation, reliability, and secure cloud infrastructure — we’d love to hear from you.**
Apply now and help us build the backbone of tomorrow’s financial engagement platform.

title: Manager-Tech Ops Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible.
  
  
When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global community committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity.
  
  
Together, we’ll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day.
  
  
Join #TeamAmex and let's lead the way together.
  
  
**About Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support**
Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Express's digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem.
  
  
The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms.
  
  
Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services.
  
  
Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99.99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage.
  
  
We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability.
  
  
**How Will You Make an Impact in This Role?**

* We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering – Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms.
* This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation.
* The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices.
* You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities.
* Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement.

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 8–10 Site Reliability and Application Support Engineers, fostering technical excellence, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across Enterprise Identity platforms, including application architecture, distributed systems, authentication and authorization services, and supporting infrastructure.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert and escalation point for complex production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and system reliability challenges.
* Establish engineering standards, operational best practices, and technical development plans to strengthen team capabilities.
* Collaborate with senior engineering leaders, architects, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to influence technology strategy and operational priorities.

**Site Reliability Engineering & Production Excellence**

* Drive the adoption and maturity of SRE principles and practices across mission-critical Enterprise Identity applications and services.
* Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and operational reliability metrics aligned with business expectations.
* Lead initiatives to achieve high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and resilience across distributed application environments.
* Improve incident detection, diagnosis, and recovery through advanced monitoring, observability, automation, and operational intelligence.
* Drive measurable reductions in MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and operational toil.
* Identify systemic reliability risks and partner with engineering teams to implement sustainable architectural and application-level improvements.
* Champion capacity planning, performance engineering, resilience testing, and proactive production readiness.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Provide technical leadership during high-severity production incidents, coordinating troubleshooting, recovery, communication, and escalation activities.
* Guide engineers through complex application failures involving APIs, microservices, authentication workflows, databases, infrastructure, and downstream dependencies.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and blameless post-incident reviews, ensuring corrective and preventive actions address underlying systemic issues.
* Establish effective incident response playbooks, runbooks, escalation procedures, and operational knowledge repositories.
* Partner with Engineering and Product teams to identify recurring production defects and prioritize permanent engineering solutions.
* Ensure effective communication of production health, incident trends, risks, and remediation progress to senior leadership.

**Automation, AIOps & Operational Transformation**

* Drive an automation-first approach to production support, reducing manual intervention and repetitive operational activities.
* Lead the development and implementation of automation solutions using Python, Java, scripting frameworks, APIs, and orchestration technologies.
* Leverage AIOps, intelligent alerting, event correlation, and anomaly detection to improve operational efficiency and incident prevention.
* Promote automated diagnostics, remediation workflows, and self-healing capabilities wherever technically appropriate.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, operational tooling, and production release reliability.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted troubleshooting, incident summarization, and operational analytics to accelerate issue resolution.

**Observability, Performance & Cloud-Native Engineering**

* Drive end-to-end observability strategies across applications, APIs, microservices, and infrastructure using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting.
* Leverage technologies such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and related monitoring platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across Java/Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, containerized workloads, and distributed systems.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve application instrumentation, service dependency visibility, performance monitoring, and production diagnostics.
* Support reliability and operational excellence for applications deployed on OpenShift, Kubernetes, and other cloud-native platforms.
* Promote performance optimization, resource efficiency, scalability, and fault-tolerant application design.

**Engineering Partnership, Release Readiness & Resilience**

* Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Delivery teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure production readiness.
* Define and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs), including availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, and observability.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, release planning, and deployment readiness assessments.
* Drive operational acceptance criteria and production readiness reviews for new applications, enhancements, and integrations.
* Partner with delivery teams to implement safe deployment practices, rollback strategies, and post-release validation.
* Contribute to disaster recovery planning, failover testing, business continuity exercises, and resilience validation.
* Champion continuous improvement through engineering retrospectives, operational metrics, and reliability-focused initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education & Professional Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, or application support for large-scale enterprise applications.
* 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical, highly available applications in a 24x7 production environment.
* Strong experience troubleshooting complex distributed applications and leading technical incident resolution.

**Technical Engineering Expertise**

* Strong programming and scripting skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, or Ruby, with the ability to develop automation, diagnostic utilities, and operational tools.
* Hands-on experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications, including Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, application dependencies, HTTP/HTTPS, network fundamentals, load balancing, caching, and database connectivity.
* Experience with containerized applications and cloud-native platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of application troubleshooting, performance analysis, system diagnostics, and production debugging.
* Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management processes.

**Reliability, Observability & Automation**

* 5+ years of experience implementing or operating application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability solutions.
* Hands-on experience with one or more observability platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent tools.
* 3+ years of experience developing operational automation, scripting solutions, or automated remediation workflows.
* Demonstrated understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and toil reduction.
* Experience improving application availability, resilience, performance, and operational efficiency through engineering-driven solutions.
* Strong experience in root cause analysis, production problem management, and implementation of preventive measures.

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through high-priority production incidents and complex technical investigations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to translate technical challenges and operational risks into clear recommendations and actionable improvement plans.
* Experience collaborating across geographically distributed engineering and support teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Identity & Security Engineering**

* Experience supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), authentication, or authorization platforms.
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), Single Sign-On (SSO), and related identity protocols.
* Familiarity with API security, token lifecycle management, session management, and authentication workflows.
* Experience supporting customer-facing identity services in financial services or other highly regulated environments.

**Advanced SRE & Platform Engineering**

* Prior experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, Software Engineer, or technical lead supporting large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience designing or improving highly available, fault-tolerant, and horizontally scalable application architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift troubleshooting, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational practices.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and automation frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with resilience engineering techniques, including load testing, failover testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery validation.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, application performance management, and service dependency mapping.

**AIOps & Intelligent Operations**

* Experience implementing AIOps capabilities, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring, or intelligent incident management.
* Exposure to AI-assisted operational tooling, automated diagnostics, and self-healing architectures.
* Experience developing automation frameworks or internal tools that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational toil.

**Operational Excellence**

* Working knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including incident, problem, change, and release management.
* Experience with production readiness assessments, operational risk management, and non-functional requirements validation.
* Experience establishing reliability dashboards, operational scorecards, and measurable continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and drive cross-functional technical initiatives.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

This role exists to turn the promise of AI into everyday business value at Unilever. As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AI DevOps within HAP, you will bring hands-on expertise across the development, deployment and operation of AI, Agentic AI and automation solutions – working closely with business teams around the world to understand their challenges, recommend the right technology, build proof of concepts and minimum viable products, and guide successful solutions into production at scale. Bringing together business consulting, solution architecture and delivery expertise, you will shape how AI solutions are designed, built and run – and you will do it cost-consciously, so that every pound we invest in AI creates measurable impact. With 3.4 billion people using our products every day, the solutions you shape here reach a very long way. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.
  
  
Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with delivery partners and vendors to convert proof of concepts into scaled solutions – reviewing technical designs, challenging approaches and ensuring quality, timelines and cost deliver the best business outcome.

**Required Qualifications**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.

* Practical experience with Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering and AI solution design.
* Strong cloud and technical expertise on Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform – for example Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Cloud Functions, Databricks, SQL and data platforms, API integration and integration architecture.
* Experience working across global, cross-functional and multicultural teams.

* Experience managing external delivery partners and technology vendors, including reviewing their technical designs and challenging delivery quality and cost.
* A track record of driving technology modernization, cost optimization or FinOps initiatives.
* Business analysis and design thinking skills, used to frame problems before building solutions.

This role is based in Bangalore, India and operates with a global scope, working with colleagues and partners across time zones.
  
  
How you work matters as much as what you build. You will Focus on What Counts by prioritizing the highest-value problems; Care Deeply by building trusted partnerships with stakeholders, partners and teams; Deliver with Excellence by raising the bar on solution quality, reliability and cost-effectiveness; and Stay 3 Steps Ahead by anticipating technology shifts and emerging AI opportunities.

title: Manager SOC Incident
description:
**Role Purpose**
: The SOC Incident Analyst will monitor security events, investigate alerts and respond to cyber security incidents affecting the organization. The role is accountable for identifying threats, conducting analysis and supporting remediation activities to reduce cyber risk. The role will contribute to maintaining a robust security monitoring capability and improving the organization’s cyber defense posture.

**Role Accountability:**

**Alert Monitoring, Triage & Investigation**

1. Monitor security alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, email security, web security, identity, cloud and other monitoring platforms.
2. Perform initial triage of alerts to determine severity, validity, affected assets, user context and potential business impact.
3. Investigate incidents by correlating logs, telemetry, threat intelligence and security events to determine scope, root cause and impact.
4. Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, policy violations and potential attack patterns during investigations.

**Incident Response & Escalation Support**

1. Escalate high-severity incidents to SOC leads or incident response teams with clear evidence, impact assessment and containment recommendations.
2. Execute approved response playbooks under supervision, including IOC blocking, account disablement, endpoint isolation and access reset actions.
3. Coordinate with IT, infrastructure, application and identity teams for remediation actions such as patching, configuration changes and access corrections.
4. Maintain shift handover notes and investigation continuity to ensure open cases are tracked and acted upon without delay.

**Documentation, Tuning & Continuous Improvement**

1. Document incidents with timelines, evidence, affected systems, actions taken, escalation details and closure notes for audit and post-incident reviews.
2. Support alert tuning by providing feedback on false positives, missed detections, recurring alerts and monitoring gaps.
3. Participate in tabletop exercises, purple-team drills and SOC process improvement activities to strengthen response readiness.
4. Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attack techniques and SOC procedures to improve triage quality and investigation effectiveness.

**Measures of Success**

1. Security alerts are triaged accurately within defined timelines.
2. Incidents are investigated with clear evidence, impact assessment and escalation notes.
3. High-severity cases are escalated promptly with actionable containment recommendations.
4. Approved response playbooks are followed consistently during containment and remediation.
5. Incident records include complete timelines, artefacts, actions and closure details.
6. Shift handovers maintain continuity of open investigations.
7. Feedback from investigations helps reduce false positives and improve detection quality.

**Technical Skills**

1. Incident Response, Investigation & Crisis Handling
2. AI Security Testing, Threat Monitoring & Abuse Detection
3. Detection Engineering, Telemetry, SIEM/XDR Data & Use-Case Lifecycle Management
4. SOC Monitoring & Alert Triage & Incident Operations
5. Security Platform Operations, DLP & Automation
6. Threat, Vulnerability & Exposure Management

**Exposure to below mentioned Technologies / Frameworks / Methodologies**

1. Microsoft Sentinel
2. Splunk
3. QRadar
4. Defender XDR
5. CrowdStrike Falcon
6. Email security consoles
7. Web security consoles
8. ServiceNow SecOps
9. KQL / SPL
10. IOC analysis
11. Incident playbooks
12. Log correlation
13. Case documentation methods
14. CASB

**Qualification**
: Bachelor’s degree / B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc. / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Systems or related discipline.

**Preferred Industry**
: BFSI, payments, banking, fintech, large enterprises with SIEM / EDR monitoring, alert triage, incident handling and security operations exposure.

title: Hardware Security Analyst - Semiconductor IP
description:
**We Are:**
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
**You Are:**
You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams and helps them do security work as part of normal delivery. You listen first, write in clear language, and own your conclusions. You work well with people in different disciplines and locations without needing to be the loudest person in the room.
  
  
You are practical when information is incomplete. You explain complex topics in simple terms, stay calm when the design changes, and challenge unclear choices in a respectful way. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving work that others can use.
  
  
This is a full-time role.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead threat analysis for semiconductor IP and associated firmware: identify assets, access points, threat scenarios, and attack paths, and recommend controls in the IP versus requirements for the integrator.
* Run security analysis as part of the cybersecurity lifecycle, from planning through design, implementation, verification, and release.
* Advise product teams on cybersecurity requirements, architecture, and verification so security work is built into the existing development flow.
* Author customer-facing security integration guidance that describes the threat landscape, implemented controls, and how customers should integrate the IP.
* Review RTL, architecture, and verification intent against secure-design principles; judge whether a claimed control is implemented and testable; capture integrator recommendations where needed.
* Support in-field cybersecurity activities for the products you cover, including vulnerability assessment, incident analysis, and security advisories, working with product-team architects and corporate vulnerability response as required.
* Facilitate working sessions with cybersecurity architects and design and verification leads; keep analysis consistent across similar IP classes.
* Deliver analysis incrementally with product teams working in agile sprints: plan security work against the product backlog, adjust scope when the design changes, and keep evidence current at each milestone.
* Use Python to automate analysis, transform inventories and threat-model data, and produce repeatable reports other analysts can run and review.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research, first drafts, consistency checks, and routine tasks without handing off ownership of findings.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track analysis and incident work, keep project documentation current, and version work products through merge requests and review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams threat analysis they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Leave cybersecurity requirements and verification objectives that design and verification teams can execute.
* Produce integration guidance that customers can follow without a security specialist in the room.
* Strengthen the cybersecurity lifecycle for IP products so security work stays current as the design changes.
* Improve consistency of analysis across similar IP classes through shared working sessions and clear written conclusions.
* Help the organization respond to in-field issues with clear assessment and practical advisories.
* Raise analysis throughput with Python and agentic workflows without lowering the quality of technical conclusions.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically, 4 or more years in product cybersecurity, embedded security, digital design, digital verification, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on the required capabilities can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Practical experience performing threat modeling or threat analysis and risk assessment on real products, not only training exercises.
* Ability to identify assets, attackers, attack surfaces, and attack paths, and to map each path to a mitigation (in-product control or integration requirement).
* Comfort working without a single known end-system: analysis must cover representative integration scenarios and state assumptions clearly.
* Experience applying a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release.
* Ability to turn threat-analysis results into requirements, design guidance, verification objectives, and release evidence.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, hardware/software interfaces, memory-mapped registers, boot and debug, and on-chip interconnects.
* Ability to reason about hardware-rooted threats and firmware threats, and to read architecture, databooks, and interface specifications with the design team.
* Hands-on proficiency as a digital designer or a digital verification engineer. Either path is sufficient.
* Ability to read and discuss RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL), architecture, interfaces, and register maps with designers and verification leads.
* Ability to judge whether a claimed cybersecurity control is implemented in the design and whether it is verifiable.
* Experience delivering analysis or engineering work inside agile product teams, including re-scoping when product content changes.
* Ability to write and maintain Python for analysis and automation. This is not a software-engineering role. Scripts should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.
* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard is helpful, as is analog or mixed-signal background, semiconductor IP product experience, vulnerability handling, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is difficult.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a tool, a template, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write clearly so engineers and customers can use your work without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information and out-of-context IP, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend improvements teams can actually adopt.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as the design changes.
* You are comfortable with agile change and re-scope analysis without waiting for a late gate.

**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
You will join the cybersecurity team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. As an analyst, you are assigned to IP product teams and work in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, and firmware engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to complete analysis, guidance, and evidence through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by product teams and by customers who integrate the IP.
  
  
**Rewards and Benefits:**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer (Contractual)
description:
**Key responsibilities**

**Cloud security (AWS and GCP)**

* Design, implement and continuously audit security baselines across AWS accounts and GCP projects: IAM, networking, encryption, logging and organization-level policies.
* Run cloud security posture management and close misconfigurations before they reach production.
* Enforce least-privilege access, short-lived credentials, workload identity and strong secrets management.

**DevSecOps and pipeline security**

* Build security into CI/CD: SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container and IaC scanning, and artifact signing, with clear pass/fail gates.
* Secure infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) using policy-as-code and review standards.
* Harden Kubernetes and container workloads (EKS, GKE), images and registries.

**Detection, response and resilience**

* Own cloud logging, monitoring and alerting: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Cloud Audit Logs and Security Command Center, feeding a central SIEM.
* Lead technical triage and containment for security incidents, run post-incident reviews and drive remediation to closure.
* Maintain and test incident response runbooks and recovery procedures.

**Vulnerability and risk management**

* Run vulnerability management across infrastructure, dependencies and images, with severity-based SLAs and tracked remediation.
* Perform threat modelling and security reviews on new services and architecture changes.
* Coordinate penetration tests and act on their findings.

**Governance and enablement**

* Support compliance and audit readiness (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and applicable data-protection requirements) with automated evidence collection.
* Document standards, coach engineers on secure practices and be the go-to security partner for product and platform teams.

**Required qualifications**

* 8+ years in security engineering, DevSecOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security.
* Hands-on, production-level depth in both AWS and Google Cloud security: IAM design, VPC/network segmentation, KMS, logging, organization-level guardrails (AWS Organizations and SCPs; GCP Organization Policy).
* Strong infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform (CloudFormation or Pulumi a plus), including policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel, Checkov or similar).
* Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Cloud Build) with integrated security scanning.
* Hands-on experience with security tooling in at least four of these areas: CSPM, SAST/DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, SIEM, EDR and vulnerability scanning.
* Practical Kubernetes and container security experience (EKS and/or GKE).
* Real incident response experience: triage, containment, forensics on cloud workloads, root cause analysis and written post-incident reports.
* Proficiency in Python, Go or Bash for automation and tooling.
* Solid grasp of application and infrastructure security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, zero trust, encryption and key management.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief both engineers and leadership.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, CKS or GCSA.
* Experience in a regulated environment such as fintech or payments, including PCI DSS or SOC 2 audits.
* Experience with SOAR, security data lakes or detection-as-code.
* Experience with cloud forensics, DFIR tooling and tabletop exercises.
* Contributions to security tooling, open-source projects or published research.

title: AI Governance Sr. Associate
description:
Title : AI Governance, Senior Associate

Experience:

Total Experience: 7 - 9 years

Relevant Experience: 5 – 6 years

Location: Bangalore

Notice Period: 0 - 60 Days

Description

This individual is responsible for developing a scaled and consistent approach to: AI security controls, governance processes, risk assessments, and standards. The role requires close coordination with stakeholders across IT, Legal, Procurement, and the business units to ensure AI initiatives are evaluated for risk early, governed consistently, and supported with clear, practical standards and safeguards. The individual should be comfortable operating in an evolving regulatory and technical landscape, translating emerging AI risk concepts into practical governance structures that all stakeholders can rapidly adopt.

Key Responsibilities

AI security controls

* Develop and maintain security controls that are consistent with existing Huron standards specific to AI, including but not limited to agents, systems, models, AI-enabled tools, data handling, access, and use.
* Partner with IT and AI Business Teams to embed security requirements into AI development, procurement, and deployment workflows.
* Evaluate third-party AI tools and vendors for security and data handling risk, in coordination with the third-party risk function.
* Monitor the AI threat landscape and recommend control updates as new risks and techniques emerge.

Governance processes and standards

* Develop and maintain AI governance processes, including intake, approval, and ongoing oversight for new AI use cases.
* Draft and maintain AI security standards, policies, and playbooks, keeping them current with regulatory and technical change.
* Support the AI Governance Committee or designated AI oversight structure, coordinating review cadence and documentation.
* Develop AI governance metrics and provide regular reporting on program maturity and open items.

Risk assessments

* Conduct risk assessments of new and existing AI use cases, evaluating data sensitivity, and business impact.
* Identify and track remediation items arising from AI risk assessments, driving them to closure, with business and technical owners.
* Support due diligence on AI features embedded in existing or prospective vendor products.
* Help ensure AI risk assessments align with applicable regulatory, privacy, and industry requirements.

Stakeholder coordination

* Act as a point of contact for business units and technical teams seeking guidance on AI security and governance requirements.
* Communicate AI risk findings, standards, and process requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with Legal and Compliance on AI-related regulatory obligations and disclosure requirements.
* Build relationships across the business to help AI governance keep pace with adoption while supporting compliant innovation.

Qualifications

* 3 to 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or risk management, with meaningful exposure to AI, machine learning, and/or data governance.
* Undergraduate degree required, preferably in Information Security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* ISO 42001 Lead Auditor/ Lead Implementor Certification
* Working knowledge of AI risk concepts (model risk, data lineage, bias, explainability) and how they map to security controls.
* Familiarity with emerging AI governance frameworks and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, ISO/IEC 27090:2026, EU AI Act) and the ability to translate them into practical standards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical AI risk concepts to business stakeholders.
* Experienced in designing and implementing governance frameworks in dynamic, fast-paced environments while maintaining strong risk oversight.

Preferred Skills

* Security or AI governance certification, such as CRISC or AIGP, AAIA, AAISM, AAIR
* Experience standing up or maturing a governance program from an early stage.
* Foundational knowledge of Application Security (App Sec) frameworks (e.g. OWASP, NIST SSDF, CIS) as well as ability to integrate Secure-System Lifecycle and Design into AI workflows.
* Familiarity with GRC or risk management platforms used to track assessments and remediation items.
* Analytical problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize technical risk into a format that supports leadership decision-making.

title: Cyber Security Operations & Incident Response Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

**Role :**
Cyber Security Operations & Incident Response Specialist

**Function :**
Cyber Security / SOC / Incident Response

**Location :**
Bangalore and Kochi

**Experience :**
1+ yrs to 7+ years

**Employment Type :**
Full-Time

**Mandatory Certification :**
At least one current/valid certification listed below

**Job Summary**

We are looking for experienced cyber security professionals to strengthen our Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Detection, Digital Forensics, and Cyber Defence teams. Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more areas such as SOC operations, incident response, DFIR, threat hunting, SIEM/XDR engineering, or security operations and must hold at least one current and valid certification from the mandatory certification list below.

**Mandatory Professional Certification**

Candidates must hold at least ONE current/valid certification from the following:

* GCIH – GIAC Certified Incident Handler
* GCFA – GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst
* GCFE – GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner
* OSCP – OffSec Certified Professional
* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
* CREST certification relevant to the candidate’s cyber security specialization

**This is a mandatory eligibility requirement.**
Candidates should be able to provide certification details and evidence of current status during the recruitment and onboarding process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, investigate, triage, and respond to cyber security alerts and incidents.
* Perform incident analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis.
* Investigate alerts across SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, identity, cloud, and email security platforms.
* Conduct threat hunting and identify suspicious or malicious activity across enterprise environments.
* Support malware, phishing, ransomware, credential compromise, data-exfiltration, and unauthorized-access investigations.
* Perform digital forensic investigation and evidence analysis where required.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, SOPs, runbooks, and escalation procedures.
* Collaborate with SOC analysts, incident responders, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, network, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Support detection-rule, correlation-use-case, dashboard, and security monitoring improvements.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, investigation evidence, and operational reports.
* Participate in major-incident handling, escalation, and shift/on-call activities as applicable to the assigned role.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Security Operations**

* SOC monitoring, alert triage, event analysis, and escalation
* SIEM investigation, correlation, detection use cases, and dashboards

**Incident Response & DFIR**

* Incident handling, containment, eradication, and recovery
* Digital forensics, evidence collection, endpoint/network investigation, and threat hunting

**Security Technologies**

* Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent SIEM platforms
* Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, or equivalent EDR/XDR platforms
* Network security, firewall, NDR, identity security, cloud security, and forensic technologies

**Automation**

* KQL, SPL, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent query/scripting skills are desirable

**Required Experience**

* Relevant experience in SOC, Cyber Security Operations, Incident Response, DFIR, Threat Hunting, Security Engineering, or Cyber Defence.
* Hands-on experience investigating or responding to cyber security incidents is preferred.
* Experience in enterprise or Managed Security Services environments is desirable.
* Experience in BFSI or other regulated environments is an advantage.

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional experience combined with the mandatory security certification may also be considered.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear verbal and written communication.
* Ability to work effectively during critical incidents and under time pressure.
* Strong teamwork, ownership, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and investigation reports.

**Certification Verification**

Shortlisted candidates will be required to provide the certification name, issuing organization, certificate or credential number, and evidence that the certification is current/valid as part of the recruitment and onboarding verification process.

**Mandatory Eligibility**

**Candidates who do not hold at least one current/valid GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or relevant CREST certification will not meet the mandatory certification requirement for this position.**

title: Incident Responder
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
We are seeking a dedicated Incident Responder to join our Cyber Security Incident Response Team to investigate, analyze, and contain cyber threats. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying and mitigating security incidents, collaborating closely with internal teams to ensure swift threat containment and recovery. You will leverage your technical expertise in log analysis, intrusion detection, and digital forensics to protect our environment while helping to refine established response procedures. This role requires a self-motivated professional capable of prioritizing tasks under time constraints, participating in on-call rotations outside of standard business hours, and maintaining detailed incident documentation. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact on our security posture, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager - CSIRT.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance the efficiency of log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
* Monitor for and investigate security incidents involving AI/ML models, such as adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and model evasion
* Conduct thorough investigations into security incidents, identify root causes, and recommend remediation efforts to prevent future occurrences
* Participate in proactive threat hunting utilizing various security tools and platforms to identify vulnerabilities, suspicious activity, and potential security gaps
* Analyze suspicious files and indicators of compromise (IoCs) to understand the scope of an incident and identify compromised systems or data
* Assist in the creation, maintenance, and optimization of incident response playbooks and procedures to address evolving threats
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Security Operations, Engineering, and Legal, during active security incidents to ensure effective containment and mitigation
* Utilize internal and external threat intelligence sources to proactively identify and mitigate emerging threats before they materialize
* Work hands-on with security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms) to investigate alerts, reduce false positives, and support the continuous improvement of detection capabilities
* Perform post-incident analysis and daily reporting, providing detailed documentation of lessons learned and suggesting areas for security posture improvement

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on Security Operations (SOC) and/or Incident Response
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, incident response lifecycles, and security best practices
* Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel) for alert analysis and log correlation
* Familiarity with EDR solutions and their role in incident investigation
* Strong familiarity with digital forensics principles and techniques and enterprise forensic solutions
* Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and data analysis
* Deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber kill chain
* Understanding of AI-driven security threats, including adversarial attacks and model evasion, and the ability to leverage AI/ML tools to enhance incident response and threat hunting

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCFA, or CEH
* Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms
* Exposure to cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently under pressure
* Knowledge of how to protect against AI threats and using it in day to day work
* Experience with AI security frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS or OWASP Top 10 for LLMs

Life at Docusign
  
  
**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
  
  
If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
  
  
**AI in Our Hiring Process**
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

* Help prepare and maintain technical and procedural documentation related to SAP security processes, roles, and controls.

* Prior experience in driving innovation and automation

* Role Overview

The role will be responsible for ensuring assessments are appropriately scoped, executed, documented, and completed in accordance with internal processes and audit requirements.
* Key Responsibilities
* 1. Third-Party Risk Intake & Assessment Triage
* Review and triage completed intake forms, IRA, TPSD, assessment history, and related documentation to determine whether a third-party cybersecurity assessment is required.

* Ensure completion of assessment planning and information-gathering artifacts.
* Identify missing or incomplete information and coordinate with stakeholders/vendors for resolution.
* 2. Cybersecurity Control Assessment Management
* Initiate and action Control Assessments (CAs) based on defined processes.

* Review questionnaire responses for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with applicable controls.

* Relevant to the applicable control
* Clear and understandable
* Complete and adequately supported by evidence

* Maintain accurate assessment status and reporting information.

* Ensure appropriate cybersecurity controls are assessed based on vendor risk, service scope, data access, and business criticality.
* Support audit and compliance requirements related to third-party risk management.
* Maintain accurate assessment documentation and evidence to support internal and external audits.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the 3PCRM assessment and QA process.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Penetration testing.**
Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.
  
  
**Threat hunting.**
Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.
  
  
**Adversary simulation and purple teaming**
. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.
  
  
**Automation.**
Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.
  
  
**Reporting.**
Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
**Experience.**
3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.
  
  
**Endpoint and network depth.**
You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.
  
  
**Tooling and scripting.**
You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  
  
**AI awareness.**
You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.
  
  
**Practical credentials.**
Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.
  
  
**GOOD TO HAVE**

* An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd
* Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to
* Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements
* GCP and Kubernetes attack paths
* Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

**WHY JOIN US**
**High autonomy**
You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.
  
  
**Builder culture**
Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.
  
  
**Perks And Benefits**

* Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction
* Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development
* Competitive compensation with equity ownership
* Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget
* A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

You will have reduced recurring issues, automated useful processes and helped establish a reliable, secure and cost-effective in-house IT function. This is a chance to own and improve a global business's IT environment, not simply operate one part of a large corporate IT department.

title: SAP Security & Vulnerability - SME Manager
description:
**Job Title:**

**About Unilever**
With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.
  
  
At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

GDT is the global digital and technology engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. GDT serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end-to-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The Manager - Secure Operations is accountable for ensuring the security, compliance, resilience, and operational effectiveness of Unilever's SAP landscape. The role leads the end-to-end governance of cyber security, vulnerability management, audit assurance, access governance, and risk management across SAP platforms and associated technologies.
  
  
The role acts as the primary interface between SAP Technical Services, Cyber Security, Platform Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Internal Audit, and external partners to ensure the SAP estate remains secure, compliant, and audit-ready while enabling business continuity and operational excellence.
  
  
**Main Accountabilities**
**Secure Operations & Cyber Security Governance**

* Lead SAP Secure Operations across the global SAP landscape and supporting technologies.
* Ensure compliance with Unilever Cyber Security Standards, Policies, and Control Frameworks.
* Define and drive security governance processes, standards, controls, and assurance activities.
* Provide leadership and oversight for security-related operational activities across SAP platforms.

**Vulnerability & Exposure Management**

* Own and govern vulnerability management processes across App, Infrastructure, Cloud, and supporting platforms.
* Drive remediation of SAP Security Notes (HotNews), Qualys, Wiz, Guardium, and other cyber security findings.
* Monitor vulnerability SLAs and ensure timely remediation through effective stakeholder engagement and governance.
* Provide executive visibility of security posture, remediation progress, and residual risk.

**Audit, Assurance & Compliance**

**Cyber Risk Management**

* Govern cyber risk identification, assessment, mitigation, exception management, and risk acceptance activities.
* Drive remediation plans for identified risks through enterprise governance processes.
* Maintain visibility of risk posture and provide reporting to leadership forums.
* Ensure appropriate governance for security exceptions and compensating controls.

**Identity & Access Governance**

* Oversee Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes, privileged access governance, and periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access management controls.
* Support compliance and regulatory requirements relating to access governance.

**Performance & Reporting**

* Establish and monitor security KPIs, KRIs, compliance metrics, audit status, and operational dashboards.
* Deliver executive-level reporting and insights to senior leadership.
* Track operational performance and drive corrective actions where required.
* Provide strategic recommendations to improve security maturity and operational effectiveness.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continual service improvement initiatives across Secure Operations.
* Enhance governance processes, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies.
* Support transformation initiatives that strengthen the cyber resilience of the SAP estate.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and proactive risk management.

**Key Stakeholders**
**Internal**

* SAP Technical Services Leadership
* Cyber Security Teams
* Platform Security Team (PST)
* OneBASIS Teams
* Infrastructure & Cloud Services
* Engineering Teams
* Internal Audit
* SAP Security & Risk & Management Teams

**External**

* Deloitte
* Accenture
* IBM
* SAP
* External Auditors

**Critical Success Measures**

* Vulnerability remediation compliance against agreed SLAs
* Reduction in Critical and High security findings
* Audit observation closure within agreed timelines
* Compliance with Cyber Security Standards and Policies
* Risk reduction and exception management effectiveness
* Access governance and certification completion rates
* Security KPI and KRI performance
* Operational service stability and resilience

**Essential**
**Skills & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP Security, SAP Basis, Cyber Security, Risk Management.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management, audit assurance, governance, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience managing enterprise cyber security tools such as Qualys, Wiz, Guardium, SIEM, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Experience leading cross-functional global teams and stakeholder relationships.
* Strong analytical, governance, and executive communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive risk remediation outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Experience within large global enterprise SAP environments.
* Knowledge of Cyber Security Frameworks (NIST, ISO27001, CIS).
* Understanding of SOX, ICF, GDPR, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, SAP Security, or equivalent.

**Leadership Behaviours**

* Ownership & Accountability
* Consumer and Business Focus
* Growth Mindset
* Collaboration & Partnership

* Continuous Improvement
* Deliver with Excellence

title: Secure Product Development Engineer
description:
**Experience required- 6+ years**

**About the Role**

HCL Software is seeking a
**Secure Development Engineer**
to design secure software systems and embed security throughout how our products are developed, built, packaged, and released. This role combines ownership of
**secure architecture reviews and secure design reviews**
with
**hands-on coding, security automation, software supply chain security, SBOM management, and DevOps engineering**
.

You will work directly with product engineering, Product Security, Security Architecture, and platform teams to translate security requirements into practical designs, working code, and automated controls. You will lead reviews, identify risks, implement solutions, and verify that security improvements work in production environments.

This role requires a self-starter who can move between architecture analysis, threat modeling, secure code review, development, and CI/CD troubleshooting. You must be comfortable writing and maintaining production-quality code, implementing security fixes, and building automation across diverse product environments.

The ideal candidate combines open-source, commercial, and in-house technologies into maintainable solutions. Success means engineering teams adopt secure designs, remediate vulnerabilities effectively, and deliver software with reliable security controls and release evidence.

***Key Responsibilities***

**Secure Architecture and Design Reviews**

* Lead secure architecture reviews for new products, major enhancements, APIs, microservices, cloud deployments, and third-party integrations.
* Conduct secure design reviews before implementation, assessing authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, data flows, tenant isolation, encryption, secrets management, and failure handling.
* Perform threat modeling with engineering teams to identify attack paths, abuse cases, and security requirements.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, secure design patterns, and implementation guidance for product teams.
* Document review findings, design decisions, remediation requirements, and risk-based exceptions; verify that agreed mitigations are implemented.
* Evaluate existing architectures and recommend practical security improvements for legacy and modern environments.

**Hands-on Coding and Security Automation**

* Write, test, debug, and maintain production-quality code, security tooling, shared libraries, APIs, and automation using Python, Java, C++, or other relevant languages.
* Conduct manual secure code reviews to identify vulnerabilities, insecure implementation patterns, and deviations from approved designs.
* Implement security fixes directly or work alongside developers to remediate issues and add regression tests.
* Build automation for security testing, finding enrichment, vulnerability triage, remediation tracking, and release evidence collection.
* Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept implementations to validate security designs and proposed controls.
* Integrate open-source, commercial, and in-house tools into reliable engineering workflows.

**Hands-on DevOps and Pipeline Security Engineering**

* Build, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms.
* Integrate static analysis, software composition analysis, secrets detection, container scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning across product groups.
* Tune scanning configurations to improve finding accuracy and reduce false positives.
* Implement risk-based security gates with documented, time-bound exception workflows.
* Create reusable pipeline templates, shared libraries, and build and deployment patterns that incorporate security controls by default.
* Provision and harden infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent tooling, with hands-on work across cloud platforms, Linux, containers, Kubernetes, and artifact registries.
* Secure build runners, service identities, credentials, secrets, and artifact promotion between environments.
* Work with engineering teams to diagnose build and deployment failures and operationalize security controls across different toolchains.

**Software Supply Chain Security and SBOM**

* Automate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, validation, publication, and retention across product builds and releases, with CycloneDX preferred and SPDX supported where required.
* Ensure SBOMs accurately represent shipped artifacts and their direct and transitive dependencies.
* Integrate SBOM and software composition analysis workflows with dependency intelligence platforms to identify affected products and releases when vulnerabilities are disclosed.
* Implement artifact signing, build provenance, attestations, dependency pinning, trusted package sources, and build reproducibility improvements.
* Operate Dependency-Track or comparable tooling and automate dependency risk assessment and remediation workflows.
* Support supply chain assurance requirements and maintain evidence for product and customer attestations.

**Developer Enablement**

* Provide hands-on guidance on secure architecture, secure design, coding practices, and vulnerability remediation.
* Deliver actionable security findings within developer workflows, including pull requests, IDEs, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Maintain implementation examples, reusable security components, documentation, and engineering guidance.
* Track architecture and design review coverage, control adoption, remediation progress, and recurring security issues.
* Work with engineering leaders to close gaps and improve secure development practices across distributed teams.

**Compliance and Release Assurance**

* Automate collection of release-time security evidence for audits, customer questionnaires, contractual commitments, and regulatory reporting.
* Partner with Product Security and PSIRT on vulnerability triage, impact assessment, fix verification, and advisory support.
* Contribute to secure development lifecycle standards and translate them into implementable design requirements, code checks, and pipeline controls.
* Verify that required security reviews, remediation actions, SBOMs, and supply chain evidence are available for release decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in secure software development, application security, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with demonstrated ownership of secure architecture and design reviews.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and recent hands-on experience writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production-quality code in Python, Java, C++, or comparable languages.
* Practical experience conducting threat modeling, secure architecture reviews, secure design reviews, and manual secure code reviews.
* Demonstrated ability to translate security findings into architecture changes, code fixes, automated checks, and deployment controls.
* Hands-on experience building, operating, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and integrating security tooling into development and release workflows.
* Practical DevOps experience with Git, Linux, containers, Kubernetes, artifact registries, deployment automation, and infrastructure as code.
* Cloud platform proficiency in AWS, Azure, or GCP, including identity, networking, secrets management, and security controls.
* Experience with software composition analysis, SBOM generation and validation, dependency risk management, and software supply chain security.
* Ability to collaborate with and influence engineering teams across geographically distributed environments.
* Strong technical documentation skills, including architecture diagrams, review findings, implementation guidance, and security requirements.

**General Security Expertise**

* Strong understanding of security principles, secure development practices, common application vulnerabilities, and modern cloud and web threats.
* Working knowledge of OWASP guidance and NIST secure development practices.
* Proficiency in designing secure systems, including application and API security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and appropriate use of cryptography.
* Experience identifying security flaws in code and implementing fixes and hardening measures across diverse codebases.
* Knowledge of Linux security and container and Kubernetes hardening, including image security, workload permissions, and registry controls.
* Understanding of supply chain risks across source code, dependencies, build systems, artifacts, and release processes.
* Experience with SCA and SBOM tooling such as Mend, Trivy, Dependency-Track, or comparable technologies.
* Ability to translate vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or reverse engineering findings into preventive design and engineering improvements.
* Experience developing security automation and supporting responses to product security vulnerabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain security risks and implementation tradeoffs to developers, architects, and engineering leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a product company shipping enterprise software under contractual security obligations.
* Familiarity with SLSA, NIST SSDF (SP 800-218), and in-toto attestations.
* Experience implementing artifact signing, provenance verification, and supply chain integrity controls.
* Experience operating Dependency-Track or comparable dependency intelligence platforms at scale.
* Experience securing AI-assisted development workflows and reviewing AI-generated code.
* Certifications valued but not required: CSSLP, GWEB, cloud security certifications, or Kubernetes security credentials.Good to have Certification
