title: DevOps Lead
description:
Experience: 6 to 8 years in DevOps / Cloud / Infrastructure

Location: Hyderabad (work from office)

**About the Role**

Divami builds software for clients across web, mobile and enterprise platforms, including a growing practice building solutions with AI. Our DevOps team owns the full delivery path behind that work: environments, pipelines, cloud infrastructure, security and internal IT. As DevOps Lead you will run this team day to day, set its technical direction and raise its standard toward DevSecOps and platform engineering.

Divami is a people-first company. We hold ourselves to the highest standard of work, and we believe that standard is reached by the people doing it, so their growth, wellbeing and voice matter as much as the delivery itself. We are looking for a lead who cares about both.

**What You Will Do**

- Own the cloud and delivery stack for Dev, QA, Staging, Pre-Prod and UAT environments across projects, and manage production environments for the projects where we host and operate them.

- Support production deployments on client-managed infrastructure by guiding client teams and sharing deployment practices.

- Host and support our AI practice: in-house AI applications used for customer demos and proofs of concept, and self-hosted open-source models on AWS used for testing and experimentation.

- Design, build and review Infrastructure as Code so every environment is reproducible, versioned and auditable.

- Build and improve CI/CD pipelines with security checks built in (SAST, SCA, secrets and container scanning).

- Lead cloud security: IAM, network design, secrets management, hardening, vulnerability management and audit readiness.

- Move the team toward a platform engineering model with reusable templates, self-service environments and clear golden paths for project teams.

- Run observability, backup, disaster recovery and cost optimisation across projects.

- Oversee internal IT: manage IT assets and coordinate with IT vendors on support, procurement and issue resolution.

- Manage AI tool subscriptions used by engineering, design and QA teams: licences, access, usage and cost, and secure usage practices.

- Provide on-call support for critical issues and planned production maintenance. This is need-based, not 24x7.

- Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical guidance and skill planning. Take part in hiring and performance reviews alongside other managers.

- Document runbooks, standards and architecture so knowledge lives with the team, not with individuals.

**What You Bring**

**Must have**

- 6 to 8 years of hands-on DevOps / cloud engineering, including time as a lead or technical owner.

- Deep AWS expertise: compute, networking (VPC), IAM, storage, containers (ECS/EKS), databases, monitoring and cost control.

- Strong Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or an equivalent, plus configuration management.

- Production CI/CD experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins.

- Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes or ECS) in real delivery environments.

- Practical security knowledge: IAM hygiene, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, secure pipelines, hardening.

- Observability experience (for example Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch or ELK) and structured incident handling.

- Scripting in Bash and Python or similar.

- Working knowledge of LLMOps within the scope of AI application hosting: deploying and running open-source models (for example on GPU or CPU EC2 instances), serving and API exposure, and monitoring usage, performance and cost.

- Familiarity with IT asset management and the ability to manage vendor relationships and communication.

- Hands-on technical credibility: able to build and troubleshoot directly, and to explain the reasoning behind design choices.

- Ability to mentor and grow junior engineers with patience and respect, guiding their work without taking it over, and to build a team that people want to stay in and grow with.

- Sound judgement in balancing delivery speed with security and reliability, while holding every deliverable to the highest standard of quality, with the ability to push back with clear reasons.

- Clear communication with developers, QA and project managers.

- Comfort working in a collaborative, in-office team environment.

**Good to have**

- Working knowledge of Azure or GCP and multi-cloud design.

- Platform engineering experience (internal developer platforms, GitOps, Backstage or similar).

- Exposure to compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

- Exposure to AI-specific security and governance concerns such as data handling, API key management and responsible use of AI tools and models.

- Familiarity with AWS AI services (for example Bedrock or SageMaker) and model-serving tools (for example vLLM or Ollama).

- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Professional, Security Specialty) or Kubernetes certifications.

**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Technical Lead, AWS & AI-First Engineering (Horizontal) – Provider Payments**
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Experience:**
8-12 years
  
  
**Role type:**
Horizontal technical leader across Provider Engineering Pods (influence-based; direct reports not required)
  
  
**About The Role**
Provider Payments platforms process high-volume, high-stakes financial transactions for healthcare. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who raises the engineering bar across multiple Provider Engineering Pods rather than within a single team. You will set standards, shape architecture, mentor engineers, ensure trusted payment data flows into the analytics layer, and make AI-assisted engineering a repeatable, measurable way of working across pods.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Lead across pods**

* Act as the horizontal technical authority across Provider Engineering Pods, setting engineering standards and reference patterns that teams actually adopt.
* Influence architecture decisions and roadmaps through credibility, clear communication, and hands-on contribution rather than reporting lines.
* Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads, and build a culture of technical ownership and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Engineering to turn business outcomes into sound technical direction.

**Architect and build on AWS**

* Lead AWS architecture, application modernization, and cloud-native engineering for Provider Payments platforms.
* Design and build solutions using EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Drive microservices, event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and API-first design.
* Modernize legacy applications into scalable, resilient AWS-based architectures.
* Build highly available platforms for high-volume transactional and payment workloads, with strong security, authentication, authorization, observability, and operational readiness.

**Engineer hands-on**

* Contribute directly in .NET Core / .NET 6+, C#, and ASP.NET Core, building REST APIs and distributed systems.
* Work across SQL Server and NoSQL stores, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Apply Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD as everyday tools.

**Enable payment data and analytics on Snowflake**

* Design reliable data flows from transactional and event-driven systems on AWS into Snowflake for payment analytics, reporting, and reconciliation.
* Guide data modeling, ingestion patterns, and data quality so payment data is accurate, auditable, and secure (PHI/PCI-aware).
* Keep Snowflake performance and cost under control, and set shared patterns that pods reuse.

**Make AI-first engineering real**

* Promote and operationalize AI/GenAI-assisted engineering across coding and code reviews, test generation, documentation, troubleshooting and incident analysis, observability and operations, and developer productivity.
* Build reusable AI agents, skills, and engineering automation that multiple pods can share.
* Define and track metrics (for example cycle time, review turnaround, test coverage, incident resolution time) so AI adoption delivers measurable productivity gains, not just tool familiarity.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 8-12 years of software engineering experience, with deep hands-on AWS expertise.
* Strong modern .NET (.NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core / C#) engineering skills.
* Proven experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems at scale.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience: data modeling, ingestion from AWS sources, and performance and cost awareness.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership: setting standards, mentoring, and influencing architecture without formal authority.
* Demonstrated AI-assisted engineering adoption that went beyond personal use of Copilot or ChatGPT and delivered repeatable, measurable team-level improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration skills.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Domain exposure to Provider Payments, Claims, Payment Integrity, Revenue Cycle Management, or healthcare financial platforms.
* Track record of large-scale cloud modernization.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Professional/Associate, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent).

**Leadership Profile**

* Strong technical ownership and a bias toward outcomes
* Architectural judgment and the ability to influence roadmaps
* Coaching mindset and a growth orientation
* Collaborative, credible, and effective across pods without relying on authority
* Customer and business-outcome focus

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* Shared engineering standards and reference architectures adopted across multiple pods
* Visible modernization progress on priority Provider Payments workloads
* Trusted, well-modeled payment data flowing into Snowflake for reconciliation and reporting
* A working library of reusable AI agents and skills with measurable productivity gains
* Stronger resiliency, observability, and operational readiness on critical payment flows
* Mentored engineers and tech leads growing into broader ownership

**Key hiring combination:**
Deep AWS + strong modern .NET + Snowflake + microservices/event-driven architecture + hands-on leadership + AI-first engineering mindset + ability to influence horizontally across Provider Engineering Pods.

* IaC at scale: Design, build, and maintain reusable Terraform modules and CDK constructs for landing zones, VPC/networking, compute, databases, and security controls across multiple accounts/environments.

* Modernization: Partner with teams to decompose monoliths via the strangler‐fig pattern, carve‐outs, and data migration strategies; define microservice standards (contracts, observability, release patterns).
* CI/CD & reliability: Own build/test/release pipelines (GitHub Actions) quality gates, artifact/version promotion, rollbacks;
* Observability & ops: Standardize metrics/logs/traces with CloudWatch/Datadog codify dashboards, alerts, and runbooks. Drive cost visibility and guardrails.
* Developer experience: Ship self‐service templates, Backstage scaffolds/golden paths, and documentation that make the paved road the easiest road.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* 5+ years in DevOps/Platform/SRE roles operating production systems.
* Advanced Terraform and/or AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python); authored reusable modules/constructs and remote state strategies.
* AWS depth: VPC design (subnets, routing, NAT, TGW), ALB/NLB, ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, IAM, KMS; experience with Control Tower/Organizations/SCPs.
* Containers & GitOps: Docker image build/hardening, Kubernetes and/or ECS operations.
* Security‐first mindset: Secrets management, encryption, vulnerability scanning, image signing/SBOMs, Policy-as‐Code;
* CI/CD & testing: Pipelines with unit/integration/e2e gates, environment promotion, and rollback strategies.
* Operations: On‐call participation, incident management, and post‐incident improvement.

Nice to Haves
  
  

* Backstage or internal developer platform (IDP) experience; golden‐path templates.
* Network security (WAF, Zero‐Trust), data security (PII tokenization/DLP), or compliance program experience.
* Additional policy‐as‐code tools: AWS Config conformance packs, CloudFormation Guard, tfsec/Checkov, Snyk.
* Cost management: CUR/Cost Explorer, anomaly detection, unit economics/chargeback, Savings Plans/RI strategy.
* Certifications: AWS DevOps/Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Kubernetes CKA/CKAD.

title: Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Provide senior technical leadership during critical incidents, coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting, restore services within agreed priorities, and communicate clear technical status and risk.
* Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, identify corrective and preventive actions, and ensure actions are tracked through closure.
* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.
* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.
* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.
* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.
* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.
* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.
* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.
* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential. Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use.
  
  
This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**Job Description: Scrum Master (SAFe)**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Team:**
IT Department
  
  
**Reports to:**
Ralph Michelot
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and passionate
**Scrum Master**
to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential.
  
  
Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use. This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead all SAFe and Scrum events, including Program Increment (PI) Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Iteration Planning, Iteration Reviews, and Retrospectives, ensuring they are productive and stay within their timebox.
* Coach and Mentor: Act as an Agile coach for the team, providing guidance on SAFe, Scrum, and Lean principles. Help the team embrace a mindset of relentless improvement.
* Remove Impediments: Proactively identify and remove blockers or obstacles that are preventing the team from achieving its goals. Shield the team from external distractions.
* Support the Product Owner: Assist the Product Owner with backlog management, ensuring that goals, scope, and product domain are understood by everyone on the team.
* Foster a Collaborative Culture: Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, and there is an emphasis on collaboration and problem-solving.
* Track and Radiate Information: Utilize tools like Jira to track team progress, manage metrics (like velocity and cycle time), and communicate this information to stakeholders to ensure transparency.
* Drive SAFe Adoption: Guide the team in its role within the Agile Release Train (ART) and ensure its alignment with the overall program objectives.

**What You'll Bring: Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-5+ years of experience in a Scrum Master role for a software development team.
* SAFe Experience: At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Certification: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification is required.
* Agile Tools: Proficiency with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar platform.
* Excellent Skills: Strong communication, facilitation, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.
* Servant Leadership: A deep understanding of the servant-leader role and a passion for empowering teams.

**Nice-to-Haves: Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience participating in a large-scale Agile transformation.
* Advanced SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Advanced Scrum Master - SASM).
* Knowledge of other Agile approaches like Kanban and XP.
* Previous experience as a software developer, QA engineer, or business analyst.

title: Senior UX Engineer
description:
**Introduction To Demandbase**
Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.
  
  
As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.
  
  
**About The Role**
Demandbase is building toward an AI-first future, where intelligent, agentic experiences help customers understand what matters, make decisions, and take action faster. We are looking for a Senior UX Engineer to help make that future real.
  
  
This is a UX role with deep engineering capability, not a traditional frontend engineering role. You will start with the customer problem and use design, code, and AI to turn ideas into exceptional production experiences.
  
  
You will sit at the intersection of Design, Product, AI, and Engineering, helping us move from concept to high-quality implementation faster. Beyond building experiences yourself, you will create the workflows, patterns, tools, and guardrails that help our Design organization get better experiences into the product with greater speed and fidelity.
  
  
You will also help establish UX Engineering as a new function at Demandbase, bringing UX culture and the voice of the customer closer to our India Product and Engineering teams while partnering deeply with our US-based Design organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build polished, production-ready Demandbase AI experiences from concept through launch.
* Start with customer needs and translate design intent into thoughtful, high-quality working experiences.
* Partner closely with Design, Product, AI, and Engineering to explore and ship new agentic interaction patterns.
* Create workflows that help designers move from ideas and prototypes into production more effectively.
* Close gaps between design intent and implementation through hands-on development and structured pre- and post-launch reviews.
* Identify experience-quality issues earlier and help teams prioritize improvements faster.
* Use AI-assisted development extensively to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, and iteration.
* Create reusable components, patterns, tools, and guardrails that improve quality across teams.
* Bring strong UX craft and customer advocacy into the India Product and Engineering organization.
* Teach and mentor designers and engineers, helping establish durable AI-enabled ways of working.
* Help define what great UX Engineering looks like at Demandbase.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of exceptional UX and product judgment, with a strong understanding of customer workflows and needs.
* Strong frontend engineering skills and experience shipping complex web applications to production.
* Ability to move fluidly between design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, and production code.
* Deep experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript.
* Highly proficient with AI-assisted development tools and comfortable using AI throughout the development lifecycle.
* A builder mindset: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to make ideas real.
* Experience creating reusable systems and patterns, not only one-off implementations.
* Strong attention to usability, accessibility, performance, interaction details, and product quality.
* Strong communication and influence across Design, Product, and Engineering.
* Experience working effectively across distributed and global teams.
* A desire to help other designers and engineers become more effective builders.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* You have built AI-native, conversational, or agentic product experiences.
* You can show work where understanding the customer changed what you ultimately built.
* You have personally taken an experience from concept or Figma into production code.
* You have helped establish a UX Engineering, Design Engineering, or Design Systems practice.
* You actively experiment with AI development workflows and can explain where AI helps, where it fails, and how you validate its output.
* You have created tools or workflows that made an entire design or engineering team more effective.
* You care as much about the shipped customer experience as the original design.

**What Success Looks Like**
You will help Demandbase:
  
  

* Ship AI experiences faster with a higher quality bar.
* Catch gaps between design intent and implementation earlier.
* Build reusable interaction patterns for emerging AI experiences.
* Give designers better ways to get their work into production.
* Strengthen the partnership between Design, Product, and Engineering across the US and India.
* Bring a stronger voice of the customer into the India organization.

Most importantly, you will help ensure that as Demandbase becomes more AI-first, the experience becomes more useful, understandable, trustworthy, and human.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long-term financial well-being.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase**
At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.
  
  
**Unsolicited Submissions**
At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Platform Engineer – T-Mobile ( project)**

**Experience:**\_ **5+ years mandiatory**\_

**Job Summary**

The Platform Engineer at T-Mobile designs, builds, and maintains the hybrid cloud infrastructure that powers T-Mobile's platforms and services. This role focuses on scalability, reliability, and automation across both on-prem and multi-cloud environments (AWS and Azure).

Building upon foundational platform engineering and DevOps experience, the Platform Engineer leads automation initiatives, develops Infrastructure-as-Code solutions, and optimises CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable delivery. The role requires hands-on expertise in hybrid infrastructure, monitoring, observability, and data integration, along with strong collaboration skills across engineering and architecture teams.

Through technical ownership and collaboration, this position directly supports T-Mobile's cloud transformation and drives operational excellence in the platforms that enable developers and critical business systems to thrive.

**Key Responsibilities: Platform Operations & Support**

* Own day-to-day operations of hybrid infrastructure supporting T-Mobile's platform services.

* Ensure uptime, performance, and security across on-prem, AWS, and Azure environments.

* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, configuration, and deployment issues impacting platform reliability.

* Lead patching, updates, and configuration management with minimal oversight.

* Participate in on-call rotation and drive improvements in incident response and postmortem practices.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

* Design, develop, and maintain automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to increase operational efficiency.

* Implement and manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent frameworks.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for platform infrastructure and environment deployments (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins).

* Establish documentation standards and reusable modules for consistent automation delivery.

**Hybrid Cloud Environment Engineering**

* Architect, provision, and maintain compute, networking, and storage services across AWS, Azure, and on-prem environments.

* Engineer hybrid connectivity solutions and optimize data flow between datacenters and cloud resources.

* Manage shared platform services such as container registries, configuration management, and identity systems.

* Partner with DevOps, SRE, and application teams to deliver stable, scalable platform environments.

Data, Messaging & Caching (DML Operations)

* Execute and optimize DML operations within Postgres, Oracle, and Cassandra environments under existing organizational DDL structures.

* Develop and maintain integrations with Kafka for event-driven data pipelines, message publishing, and asynchronous workloads.

* Implement caching strategies (Redis, in-memory caches) to reduce query latency and improve application performance.

* Support database performance tuning, data ingestion, and transformation activities aligned with enterprise governance standards.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

* Develop and manage observability solutions leveraging Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or ELK.

* Implement proactive monitoring, log analysis, and metrics-based alerting for early issue detection.

* Lead efforts in automation for self-healing, scaling, and performance tuning.

* Collaborate with SREs to improve mean time to resolution (MTTR) and overall platform reliability.

Collaboration, Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Contribute to Agile delivery teams, collaborating with developers and architects to deliver infrastructure enhancements.

* Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance in automation, monitoring, and hybrid design.

* Advocate for DevOps and automation best practices across engineering teams.

* Stay informed on emerging tools and cloud-native practices that improve reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Linux and Windows Server administration within hybrid environments.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, and IAM.

* Advanced scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate platform operations.

* Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar).

* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Working knowledge of DML operations in relational (Postgres, Oracle) and NoSQL (Cassandra) databases.

* Understanding of Kafka event streaming concepts, including producers, consumers, and topic management.

* Familiarity with caching mechanisms such as Redis or Memcached for improving data access performance.

* Working knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.

* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, security principles, and zero-trust models.

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a bias for action and automation.

* Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Collaborates seamlessly in Agile, cross-functional environments.

* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and adaptability in dynamic, fast-paced settings.

* Mentors junior engineers and contributes to a culture of learning and operational excellence.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

**Why This Role Matters**

The Platform Engineer plays a key role in building and operating T-Mobile's hybrid infrastructure and platform services. They ensure operational efficiency, performance, and scalability through automation and continuous improvement, including optimised data handling, event-driven integrations, and caching strategies.

By combining platform engineering with DML and messaging expertise, the Platform Engineer enables reliable, efficient, and scalable systems that support T-Mobile's mission to innovate faster and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

**Role summary**

The Program Manager, Services runs the internal programs that make Services efficient, predictable and profitable. The role spans all four service lines — Professional Services, Content as a Service (CaaS), Managed Services and Technical Solutions — rather than a single customer engagement.

You will own portfolio-wide visibility into cost, revenue, margin and sourcing (in-house vs. outsourced); run strategic Services initiatives from charter to closure; coordinate internal response on escalations and accounts that need operational support; and build the executive narratives that leadership uses with founders, Sales and customers.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a structured operator who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a platform, a cross-functional working session and an executive deck.

**Key responsibilities**

**1) Services portfolio governance & visibility**

* Build and maintain a single source of truth across PS, CaaS, Managed Services and Technical Solutions: active programs, capacity, utilization, delivery health and risk.
* Run the Services governance cadence — weekly portfolio reviews, monthly business reviews and quarterly planning — with clear decision logs and action tracking.
* Define and standardize portfolio metrics and reporting so leadership can see issues early and act on data, not anecdotes.

**2) Program financials: cost, revenue & sourcing**

* Track Services revenue, cost and margin by service line, account and program; surface variance and its drivers.
* Maintain clear visibility into what is delivered in-house versus outsourced — vendor spend, contractor utilization and the cost/quality trade-off of each.
* Support pricing, estimation and capacity models with leadership, Finance and Presales; flag margin risk before deals are signed and during delivery.
* Prepare inputs for budgeting, forecasting and headcount planning.

**3) Strategic initiatives**

* Charter, plan and drive Services-wide initiatives end to end — e.g., AI-led delivery transformation, new service packaging, operating-model changes and tooling rollouts.
* Own initiative governance: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, RAID logs and success metrics.
* Hold cross-functional owners accountable and report progress and outcomes to leadership.

**4) Escalation & account operations support**

* Act as the program lead on escalations: assemble the right internal team, run the recovery plan, track commitments and close the loop.
* Provide operational support to accounts that need it — resourcing gaps, cross-team dependencies, commercial or scope clarity — without becoming the day-to-day delivery owner.
* Capture root causes and turn recurring issues into process or product fixes.

**5) Operational efficiency & process improvement**

* Identify inefficiencies across service functions — hand-offs, duplicated effort, tooling gaps, manual reporting — and drive measurable fixes.
* Standardize playbooks, templates, and operating rhythms across service lines.
* Partner with team leads to apply AI and automation to internal workflows (reporting, estimation, resource allocation).

**6) Executive communication & storytelling**

* Build executive presentations for founders, leadership reviews, Sales/GTM forums, and customer executive meetings.
* Turn operational data into a clear narrative: what is happening, why it matters, and what decision is needed.
* Draft briefs, business cases, and updates for Services leadership.

**Tools, cadences & metrics**

Jira, Rocketlane, Excel/Google Sheets, Salesforce (inputs), BI dashboards, Google Slides/PowerPoint, and AI assistants for analysis and drafting.

Looking for people with experience in Strategy &Operationss/PMO governance/CEO'S office Background.

Integration Interface & Protocol Engineering: Strong mandatory technical expertise in REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus integrations, covering API authentication, TLS/SSL, payload and response validation, error handling, timeout and retry mechanisms, Kafka topics, partitions, offsets and consumer lag, Webhook acknowledgement and idempotency, and Prometheus exporters, metrics and PromQL. Proficiency in PCAP, logs, traces, MIB/OID and protocol-level troubleshooting is required.
  
  
End-to-End Fault, Performance & RCA Engineering: Mandatory capability to troubleshoot end-to-end Fault and Performance flows from Network Element or Domain through EMS, interface, middleware and SNOC platforms to ITSM, including alarm generation, severity, mapping, raise and clear, correlation, duplicate, missing and delayed events and ticket flow. Must be able to troubleshoot Bulkstat, KPI, API, Kafka and Prometheus performance flows, perform source-to-SNOC reconciliation and isolate failures across source, interface, processing and SNOC layers with evidence-based technical RCA.
  
  
Project Integration Management: Lead SNOC integration from requirement intake, solution assessment and scope finalization through testing, Go-Live and HOTO
  
  
SNOC Integration Strategy & Planning Leadership: Define end-to-end integration strategy, scope, milestones, dependencies, prerequisites and execution plan for new projects and products.
  
  
Solution & Integration Architecture: Analyze OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational model to determine the right SNOC integration approach.
  
  
End-to-End Monitoring Architecture: Ensure monitoring coverage for Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Processes, Faults, Performance and Logs.
  
  
OEM Solution Assessment: Understand and technically evaluate OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational workflows before finalizing the integration approach.
  
  
Solution-to-SNOC Mapping: Map OEM solution architecture against SNOC tool capabilities and determine the right integration points, monitoring platforms and operational workflows.
  
  
Technical Risk Management: Identify integration, architecture, security and operational risks and drive mitigation before deployment.
  
  
Fault Management Architecture: Design alarm/event flow from network element to SNOC including normalization, severity, correlation, suppression, raise/clear and auto-ticketing.
  
  
Performance Management Architecture: Define KPI/counter integration through Bulkstat, APIs, Prometheus, telemetry or other performance interfaces.
  
  
Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): Drive standardization, reusable integration patterns, architecture governance, FTR improvement, defect prevention and continuous engineering transformation to accelerate technology onboarding and improve overall SNOC operational excellence.
  
  
Data Privacy & Security Enforcement: Enforce secure-by-design practices across SNOC integrations, including RBAC, API/SNMP/Kafka security, data protection and controlled access to sensitive network data.
  
  
HOTO & Operational Readiness: Ensure complete integration evidence, monitoring coverage, testing results and operational acceptance before SNOC/COG handover
  
  
Database & Backup Governance: Ensure database integration, data consistency, backup validation and recovery readiness across SNOC ecosystem platforms.
  
  
Automated Observability: Drive automation for integration validation, alarm testing, reconciliation, health checks and monitoring validation to improve FTR and reduce rework.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**

* Overall Experience: Minimum 12+ years of progressive, post-qualification experience in Project and Telecom management.
* Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior operational or engineering leadership role managing large environments and leading regulatory/compliance audits.

**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**

* Applications & Tools: OSS/NMS/EMS environment integration, HPSM(Service Manager). NNMi/Temip, NPM(Performance Management), UIM(Inventory), UHC, Prometheus, Syslog and end-to-end network management platforms.
* Containerisation & Management: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP), Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Kubernetes, and CSI frameworks.
* Integration Interfaces: End-to-End integration architectures using Rest APIs, SNMP, MIB/OID, CLI, API, Kafka, Syslog, CLI, Telemetry, Webhooks and event-driven interfaces.
* Networking & Security: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Native Core (CNE) technologies, and Ni7 architectures.
* Monitoring & Observability: Automated monitoring and alerting platforms for real-time performance degradation tracking and network fault isolation.
* Automation: API Automation, Python/Shell, Validation Scripts, Auto-Ticketing, Health Checks.
* Data Protection: Applications & tools and disaster recovery frameworks.

title: Associate - Product & AI Operations
description:
**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office, 5 days a week)

**Experience:**
1–2 Years

**Joining:**
Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred

**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Product

**About Amber**

Amber is a global student accommodation marketplace. Students use Amber to find and book housing in 80+ cities across 10 countries.

Our Product team comprises Product Managers, Designers, Analysts and AI Engineers. We want this team to operate at the level of the world's best AI-native product teams, leveraging technology, automation and AI to maximise productivity and impact.

**The Role**

You will own how the Amber Product team operates, with a clear mandate to increase team productivity and reduce the time lost to coordination, status updates and manual work.

You will own all aspects of Product Operations, including team cadences, sprint health, team rituals, onboarding and engagement.

However, you won't rely on manual processes to get things done. You will build and deploy AI-powered workflows, bots and scheduled agent runs to automate recurring work. You will remain accountable for the outcomes. If something slips, you take ownership and fix it.

We are looking for someone who thinks AI-first, takes complete ownership and enjoys building systems that make teams more effective.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Product Cadences & Processes**

* Run product cadences, including weekly product reviews, roadmap syncs, sprint reviews and Product team All Hands.
* Record decisions and action items from every meeting and track them to closure with clearly assigned owners.
* Conduct weekly sprint health checks across pods, tracking spillovers and their causes, ad-hoc work, delayed sprint closures and requirement documentation quality.
* Identify process gaps and bottlenecks, implement improvements and measure their effectiveness.

**2. AI Systems for the Product Team**

* Automate recurring operational activities, including meeting notes, action-item tracking, follow-ups, sprint health reports and reminders for delayed deliverables.
* Own the team's AI context, including shared instructions, skills, connectors and the index of product documentation used by AI agents across tools such as Claude, Notion, Jira, Slack and GitHub.
* Build AI-powered bots that can answer recurring questions such as "How does X work?" and "What is the status of Y?" with supporting evidence.
* Continuously improve these systems by identifying knowledge gaps and incorporating missing information into the bots' knowledge base.
* Drive AI adoption across the team by training members on new tools, identifying adoption gaps and addressing the underlying challenges.
* Partner with Engineering on infrastructure while owning the workflows and automations built on top of it.

**3. Productivity Metrics & Reporting**

* Define and report Product team productivity metrics on a weekly basis.
* Track metrics such as:
* Idea-to-release cycle time.
* Sprint spillover rate.
* PM hours spent on status updates and administrative work.
* Percentage of recurring queries resolved by AI bots.
* Adoption and usage of AI-powered workflows.
* Establish productivity targets in collaboration with leadership and continuously improve performance against them.

**4. People Operations for the Product Team**

* Own new-hire onboarding, including documentation, access provisioning, first-week plans and buddy assignments.
* Continuously improve the onboarding process to reduce time to productivity for new team members.
* Track team leave, holidays and availability.
* Plan team-building activities, offsites, rewards and recognition initiatives, and Product team contributions to All Hands.
* Ensure Product team SOPs and documentation in Notion remain accurate and up to date.

**5. Communication & Research Support**

* Publish Product release notes and communicate product updates across the organisation.
* Manage the administrative aspects of user interviews, including scheduling, recordings and insights documentation.
* Coordinate requests and dependencies across Product, Design, Engineering and Business teams.
* Ensure cross-functional action items are followed up and closed on time.

**What You Must Have**

* 1–2 years of experience in a Product-focused role, such as Product Operations, Associate Product Manager, Product Management or Program Management, preferably at a technology company or startup.
* Demonstrable experience automating your own work or building an internal tool using AI. You should be able to share a link or demo.
* Hands-on experience with AI agent and automation tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, Zapier or similar platforms.
* Basic understanding of APIs and scripting.
* Strong ownership mindset. You proactively follow through and close loops without needing reminders.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to create clear, concise and actionable updates.
* Comfortable working with senior Product Managers and Engineering leaders, driving accountability and following up on deadlines with tact.

**Good to Have**

* Experience working in a marketplace, consumer internet or technology-driven company.
* Familiarity with Jira, Notion, Slack automation, GitHub and Google Workspace.
* Experience organising team events, managing onboarding or building communities.
* Experience building AI-powered workflows, internal bots or agent-based automations.

**How We Will Measure Success (First 6 Months)**

* All Product team cadences run on schedule, with action items consistently tracked to closure.
* Weekly sprint health and productivity reports run with minimal manual intervention.
* At least three recurring manual processes are automated and actively used by the team.
* New hires become productive faster, with consistently positive onboarding feedback.
* Measurable improvement in Product team productivity and reduction in time spent on manual coordination and administrative work.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their CV along with either:

* A link to a workflow they have automated using AI, or
* A 2-minute video demonstrating an AI-powered workflow they have built.

Please explain what the workflow does, how you built it and how much time it saves each week.

**Email your application to:**
payal.vi@amberstudent.com

**Shortlisted candidates will be given a 48-hour take-home assignment to automate a real Product Operations workflow.**

title: Network Security Operations Lead
description:

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions.
  
  
Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
* Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
* Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
* Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
* Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

**Required**
**Position Qualifications**

* 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
* Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
* Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* BA/BS in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred**

* Experience with iPaaS/automation platforms (Workato or similar)
* Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
* Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
* Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
