title: CIS PROGRAM MANAGEMENT
description:
**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Transition and Transformation Program Manager - Cloud, Infrastructure and Security Services**
**Job Summary**
The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi-workstream technology transformation programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data centre and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for strategy, roadmap, governance and integrated delivery from discovery and architecture through build, migration, testing, acceptance, go-live, hypercare and value realization, including M&A integration, divestiture or separation where applicable.
  
  
****Role Information****
****Details****
**Role**
Transition and Transformation Program Manager
  
  
**Practice**
Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services
  
  
**Location**
Pune
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience**
15+ years overall IT experience, including 10+ years leading complex transformation, cloud/infrastructure implementation, migration, transition or program delivery
  
  
**Reporting**
Cloud Infrastructure and Security Services leadership / assigned program leadership
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Provide end-to-end leadership for large transformation programs involving multiple projects, service towers, vendors and geographies. The Program Manager aligns business outcomes, architecture, commercial commitments and delivery capacity; establishes decision rights and stage gates; and ensures that technology change is implemented, accepted, stabilized and transitioned into a sustainable operating model.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Transformation Strategy and Mobilization**

* Own the transformation charter, target outcomes, roadmap, delivery model, business case, benefits, funding, critical success measures and executive governance.
* Lead discovery and assessment across estates, applications, infrastructure, cloud readiness, security, operating model, service performance, technical debt, dependencies and regulatory constraints.
* Convert solution and contractual commitments into an integrated program covering architecture, engineering, migration factories/waves, service transition, organizational change and benefits realization.
* For M&A, divestiture or carve-out programs, govern Day-1 readiness, interim/TSA services, separation or integration roadmaps, data and identity boundaries, vendor dependencies and exit milestones.

**Architecture, Build and Implementation Governance**

* Govern target architecture and design authority across cloud landing zones, hybrid infrastructure, connectivity, identity, security, resilience, backup/DR, observability, automation and ITSM integration.
* Coordinate program increments and workstreams for platform build, environment provisioning, configuration, integration, remediation, application/workload migration and decommissioning.
* Ensure security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience and non-functional requirements are embedded in design and validated before production use.
* Establish stage gates and assurance reviews for discovery, design approval, build completion, test readiness, migration readiness, service acceptance and program closure.

**Testing, Migration and Go-Live**

* Own the integrated assurance strategy across functional, integration, security, performance, resilience, backup/restore, disaster recovery, operational readiness and user/business acceptance.
* Govern migration-wave planning, pilots, rehearsals, cutover runbooks, change approvals, command-centre arrangements, go/no-go decisions, rollback strategy and executive communications.
* Manage cross-program defects, dependencies and readiness risks, ensuring objective acceptance evidence and accountable sign-off by business, technology, security and operations.
* Lead go-live and hypercare governance, using agreed stability and service measures to control exit into steady-state operations.

**Program Governance, Commercial Control and Value**

* Establish steering committees, design authorities, delivery forums, PMO controls, reporting cadence, decision rights, escalation routes and integrated RAID management.
* Own budget, forecast, resource demand, supplier performance, contractual milestones, change control, contingency, cost risk and program-level financial reporting.
* Align customer executives, account leadership, architects, engineering teams, application owners, security, operations, legal, procurement and delivery partners.
* Track benefits and transformation outcomes, including modernization, automation, cloud adoption, resilience, security posture, service quality, operating-model improvement and cost optimization.
* Ensure closure includes accepted deliverables, as-built and operational documentation, CMDB/asset updates, knowledge transfer, residual-risk ownership, lessons learned and benefits handover.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in IT, including 10+ years leading large and complex transformation or program delivery across cloud, infrastructure, security, network, workplace or data-centre domains.
* Proven leadership of end-to-end implementation and migration programs spanning discovery, architecture, build, testing, cutover, hypercare and operational acceptance.
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, multiple suppliers, distributed delivery teams, executive sponsors and business-critical production change.
* Experience in outsourcing/managed services transformation; M&A integration, divestiture, carve-out or TSA exit experience is advantageous where relevant.

**Technical and Functional Skills**

* Cloud and hybrid platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP and private cloud; infrastructure modernization, landing zones, network, identity, workplace, security, observability, backup and disaster recovery.
* Program and portfolio governance, architecture assurance, migration factory/wave management, quality management, commercial control, benefits realization and executive reporting.
* Understanding of security and compliance controls, Zero Trust, IAM, vulnerability management, SOC integration, data protection and operational resilience.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI and Microsoft 365.

**Qualifications and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or Business Management; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional is advantageous.
* Azure, AWS or GCP certification is desirable; security/governance certification is beneficial.

**Behavioral Competencies and Selection Criteria**

* Executive presence, commercial judgement and the ability to simplify complex technical and delivery matters for senior audiences.
* Decisive, transparent and accountable leadership across ambiguity, pressure and competing priorities.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution and supplier-management capabilities.
* Can evidence leadership of a large transformation from discovery and target-state design through implementation, migration, acceptance, stabilization and measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

At Zensar, we’re
*“experience-led everything”*
. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
*Together, we shape experiences for better futures*
. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is

.
  
  
Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Director of Engineering**
**About The Role**
Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements.
  
  
This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery.
  
  
This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership**




+ Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
+ Directly manage 5–10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
+ Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
+ Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
+ Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
+ Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability

**Healthcare Domain Leadership**




+ Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences
+ Guide teams building on and integrating with EMR/EHR platforms or any strong compliance domain experience.

**AI & Innovation**




+ Drive adoption of AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation across projects, including healthcare-specific AI use cases
+ Build reusable AI accelerators and frameworks to improve delivery efficiency
+ Enable teams to leverage AI-assisted development tools
+ Partner with leadership to define and execute AI-driven service offerings

**Delivery Ownership**




+ Own end-to-end delivery across multiple US client projects
+ Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality
+ Implement strong execution frameworks (Agile, sprint discipline, milestone tracking)
+ Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

**Stakeholder & Relationship Management**




+ Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 5 customers, including five blue-chip accounts requiring direct interaction with client CIOs & CTOs and proactive expectation management
+ Act as the key interface between US clients, engineering teams, and the CEO
+ Build genuine personal relationships with clients and client executives (C-level and senior officers) relationship-building and client management skills are mandatory
+ Participate in all monthly and quarterly business review meetings as a member of the leadership team
+ Travel to the US frequently (2–3 times per year) for client meetings, executive reviews, and relationship development
+ Communicate technical and healthcare-domain concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
+ Build strong client relationships and ensure high satisfaction

**Resource Management**




+ Allocate and optimize engineering resources across projects
+ Ensure the right skills are aligned to the right work
+ Drive high utilization while supporting team growth and development
+ Partner with HR and leadership on hiring and capacity planning
+ Own hiring and establish a structured training and academy program to keep building a new pipeline of talent

**Operational & Financial Excellence**




+ Own delivery metrics including velocity, quality, utilization, and timelines
+ Maintain a strong focus on delivery efficiency and project margins
+ Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization
+ Support business growth through better delivery capability and client outcomes

**Qualifications**




+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
+ 15–20 years of experience in software engineering and delivery management within a software services or product development environment
+ Demonstrated experience delivering software for US healthcare clients providers, payers, MedTech, or digital health companies
+ Strong understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain, including EMR/EHR ecosystems, interoperability (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA/PHI compliance, and clinical and operational workflows
+ Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software projects for US-based clients
+ Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and AI-assisted development practices
+ Must already be a heavy, daily user of AI tools in their own work — hands-on, everyday AI use is expected from day one (mandatory)
+ Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
+ Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, product management, and operations
+ Experience managing US-based team members remotely from India (mandatory)
+ Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills — proven ability to build and retain high-performing teams (mandatory)
+ Exceptional relationship-building and client management skills, including comfort engaging directly with C-level client executives (CEOs, CIOs) (mandatory)
+ Willingness and ability to travel to the US 2–3 times per year (valid passport required; US visa or visa eligibility strongly preferred)
+ Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project)
+ PMP, SAFe, or other relevant certifications preferred

**Key Competencies**




+ Strategic thinking and planning
+ Team management and people leadership
+ Relationship-building with team members, clients, and senior client executives
+ US healthcare domain fluency and client empathy
+ Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills
+ Effective communication and stakeholder management
+ Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
+ Financial and budget management expertise
+ Risk management and conflict resolution

**What Success Looks Like — Your First 12 Months**
**We have clear expectations for this role. Here is what we expect the first year to look like:**
**First 30 Days**




+ Develop a clear understanding of the organization, our projects, and where we stand today
+ Understand the finances of the company and our overall operating picture
+ Complete introductions across the teams and build a foundational understanding of how we work
+ Get assigned to a blue-chip customer and begin understanding what we are doing and what the priorities are
+ Begin improving the weekly and monthly reporting to that customer
+ Put together a plan to completely take over that account from the existing team member and reduce the existing leader's responsibilities

**By 60 Days**




+ Take ownership of our innovation pipeline assess how you would run it and get to know the current team members
+ Establish how we measure the productivity we gain from AI, and how we demonstrate those gains to end customers as clear proof of value

**By 90 Days**




+ Move into our tier-2 projects and optimize weekly and monthly reporting, customer satisfaction, regular touch-bases and updates to the leadership team, and resource planning
+ Complete a resource assessment — what we have, and what we need to hire or replace
+ Define how to accelerate the innovation pipeline to produce more qualified leads, proofs of concept (POCs), and proofs of value (POVs), in closer alignment with the sales and marketing teams

**By 12 Months**




+ A well-oiled engineering and delivery organization
+ Approximately 65% overall margin across the entire portfolio
+ A bench maintained at approximately 15%, also used for innovation and POC/POV projects
+ Measurable outcomes delivered from the innovation pipeline
+ Heavy, pervasive use of AI across the team every team member actively using AI in their daily work

* Coaching mindset and a growth orientation

title: Siebel Administrator
description:
The Senior Siebel Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and support of Oracle Siebel CRM environments across the enterprise. This role ensures the stability, security, availability, and performance of critical CRM applications while supporting upgrades, integrations, cloud initiatives, and disaster recovery activities. The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert for Siebel infrastructure and administration, partnering with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions that support business operations.
  
  
How will you do it
  
  

* Administer and support Oracle Siebel CRM environments across development, testing, and production environments.
* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Oracle Siebel applications on both Windows and Linux platforms.
* Lead and support Siebel upgrades to current releases, preferably Siebel 25.x and newer versions.
* Configure and maintain Siebel Gateway clustering, multi-mode Application Interface (AI) load balancing, and related infrastructure components.
* Monitor system performance and execute performance tuning activities across Siebel Servers, Application Object Managers (AOMs), Application Interface (AI), Gateway Servers, Tomcat servers, and supporting infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, infrastructure, and integration issues, including EAI component crashes through analysis of FDR reports, component logs, and system logs.
* Perform system administration activities including application configuration, component management, parameter configuration, and environment maintenance.
* Support and troubleshoot Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions for routine administrative activities using Windows batch jobs, Linux cron jobs, and scripting tools.
* Install, configure, upgrade, and support BI Publisher integrations with Oracle Siebel environments.
* Design, support, and execute Disaster Recovery (DR) setup, testing, and validation activities.
* Manage and support Siebel deployments hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and other cloud platforms.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and database teams to ensure system reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor environment health, proactively identify issues, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and support knowledge articles.

What we look for
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of experience administering and supporting Oracle Siebel CRM in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience installing and supporting Oracle Siebel on Windows and Linux platforms.
* Experience performing Siebel upgrades, migrations, and patching activities, preferably on recent Siebel versions.
* Strong knowledge of Siebel architecture including Gateway Server, Enterprise Server, Application Interface (AI), AOMs, and Tomcat environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Siebel Gateway clustering and load-balanced environments.
* Strong experience with Siebel performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and tuning.
* Experience troubleshooting EAI component failures and analyzing system logs and diagnostic reports.
* Experience supporting SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
* Experience automating administrative processes through scripting, Windows batch jobs, and Linux cron jobs.
* Experience designing, supporting, and testing disaster recovery solutions.
* Basic Oracle Database administration knowledge, including connectivity, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing Oracle Siebel environments in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with BI Publisher installation, administration, and integration.
* Experience supporting highly available and clustered enterprise environments.
* Oracle Siebel certifications or related Oracle technology certifications.
* Experience with Linux administration and shell scripting.

title: Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog & Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment
* Data Catalog & Governance Platform Management
* Catalog Administration & Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata & Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies
* Domain Data Governance & Stewardship Enablement
* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

careers@manastuspace.com

Own Manastu Space’s IT end to end:

.
**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**
, and
**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**
. Be
**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**
, and
**establish SOPs for all IT operations**
.

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.

  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**

**IT & Network Administrator (Microsoft 365)**

**Company:**
AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited

**Location:**
Mumbai, India | On-Site

**Type:**
Full-Time

**Reports To:**
Software Engineer – Tech Lead

**About Us**

AIQ Space Ventures Private Limited is a space-tech company developing commercial software solutions for professional customers. We work with high ownership, fast feedback, and high standards as we prepare for customer delivery.

**About Role**

We're hiring an IT and Network Administrator to run day-to-day IT for the organization and take full ownership of our Microsoft 365 environment.

You'll own identity and access, onboarding and offboarding, the office network, and the endpoints and tools the team relies on. This is a hands-on, high-trust role. You'll start by learning our setup and grow into owning the whole M365 suite and the org's IT function.

**What You'll Do**

Administer Microsoft 365 across the org: user accounts, licensing, Exchange/email, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, and the admin and security settings behind them.

Own identity and access in Entra ID (Azure AD): accounts, groups, roles, MFA, and conditional access.

Own onboarding and offboarding end to end: provision accounts, licenses, access, and devices for new joiners; and on exit, revoke access cleanly, recover accounts and data, and wipe or reassign devices.

Manage endpoints and devices (Intune or similar): enrollment, policies, and updates.

Run the office network and connectivity: LAN, Wi-Fi, switches, routers, VPN, and the everyday troubleshooting that keeps people working.

Be the first line of IT support for the team, and keep asset and license inventory in order.

Work with the Infrastructure & Security Lead on access controls, hardening, and compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

Solid IT / systems administration experience in a Windows environment, supporting real users.

Networking fundamentals you can stand on: LAN and Wi-Fi, switches and routers, VPN, DNS and DHCP basics, and methodical troubleshooting.

Hands-on with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD): at minimum user and license management, and ready to own the full suite.

Experience with onboarding and offboarding or identity lifecycle: provisioning and, just as importantly, cleanly deprovisioning access.

Exposure to endpoint / device management (Intune or another MDM).

Dependable, security-minded, and genuinely good with people. This role is trusted with access and is customer-facing inside the company.

Willing to learn and take ownership: you want to own M365 and grow the IT function, not just close tickets.

**Nice to Have**

Microsoft certifications (e.g. MS-102, MD-102, AZ-104).

Depth in Intune / endpoint management.

Scripting to automate the repetitive parts of onboarding and offboarding (PowerShell / Microsoft Graph).

Exposure to security or compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001.

Help-desk or ticketing experience in a growing team.

**How We Work**

Small, hands-on team. You'll own your domain with real autonomy and work closely with the person moving into full-time infrastructure and cloud security. Direct communication, high trust, and short paths from problem to fix.

**Lead Endpoint Security Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Lead Endpoint Security Engineer provides technical leadership for the engineering, maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity technologies deployed across the enterprise endpoint environment. The role provides lead-level technical ownership and direction for endpoint security applications, agents, integrations, and supporting services, ensuring security controls remain operationally healthy, resilient, effectively configured, supportable, scalable, and performant. This engineer serves as a technical authority and escalation point for complex endpoint cybersecurity issues and provides engineering direction across the lifecycle of endpoint security technologies, from evaluation and architecture through testing, deployment, production support, optimization, and eventual retirement. The Lead Endpoint Security Engineer works closely with Cybersecurity, Endpoint Engineering, infrastructure, application, architecture, security operations, and technology partners to deliver secure and reliable endpoint protections. The role leads complex technical initiatives, establishes engineering practices and standards, provides technical guidance to other engineers, and influences decisions affecting the enterprise endpoint security architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Endpoint Security Engineering**

* Lead the engineering, configuration, deployment, maintenance, and support of enterprise endpoint cybersecurity technologies.
* Provide lead technical ownership for security agents and controls deployed across workstation, server, virtual desktop, cloud-hosted, and other supported endpoint environments.
* Provide technical direction for endpoint security architecture, technology integrations, platform upgrades, migrations, and control enhancements.
* Lead evaluation of endpoint security configurations to ensure controls operate reliably, securely, and without unacceptable impact to endpoint functionality or user experience.
* Establish engineering standards and technical requirements for the implementation, configuration, testing, and operation of endpoint cybersecurity technologies.
* Lead technical design reviews and evaluate proposed changes for security effectiveness, architectural alignment, integration dependencies, operational supportability, performance, and implementation risk.
* Partner with Endpoint Engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and device-management teams to define engineering approaches for endpoint agent and management-platform integrations.
* Evaluate current and emerging endpoint security technologies and provide technical recommendations regarding adoption, integration, enhancement, consolidation, or retirement.
* Define and monitor operational health measurements for endpoint security platforms, including agent coverage, connectivity, application health, policy compliance, version currency, telemetry availability, and remediation status.
* Identify technical debt, recurring operational issues, and architectural limitations and develop engineering solutions to increase service reliability.

* Lead root-cause analysis for significant or recurring technical issues and ensure appropriate corrective and preventative actions are implemented.
* Coordinate multi-team troubleshooting involving infrastructure, desktop engineering, application,
* Ensure appropriate regression, rollback, recovery, and failure-mode testing is performed prior to significant production deployments
* Lead interoperability and coexistence testing between endpoint cybersecurity controls such as EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, host firewall, DLP, application control, vulnerability management, privilege management, browser security, and other endpoint agents.
* Define technical go/no-go criteria for endpoint cybersecurity deployments based on security effectiveness, stability, compatibility, operational readiness, and performance.
* Partner with cybersecurity architecture and adjacent engineering teams to ensure endpoint controls integrate appropriately with broader enterprise security capabilities such as SIEM, SOAR, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, network security, and incident response.
* Maintain awareness of changes in endpoint attack techniques, operating-system capabilities, security technologies, and industry practices and translate relevant developments into engineering recommendations.
* Lead development of automation for endpoint security administration, platform-health monitoring, remediation, testing, reporting, and lifecycle-management activities.
* Provide technical input into project planning, technology roadmaps, vendor evaluations, and endpoint cybersecurity strategy.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to endpoint cybersecurity engineers and other technology professionals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in endpoint security engineering, endpoint management, cybersecurity engineering, or endpoint infrastructure engineering.
* Advanced expertise troubleshooting complex enterprise endpoint security applications, agents, integrations, and supporting services.

* Strong working knowledge of additional enterprise endpoint environments such as Windows Server, macOS, Linux, VDI, and cloud-hosted endpoints.
* Extensive experience with endpoint security technologies such as EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, host firewall, device control, DLP, application control, privilege management, browser security, or comparable endpoint controls.
* Experience operating cybersecurity technologies at scale within a large enterprise environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Extensive experience with enterprise-scale EDR/XDR platforms and Microsoft endpoint-management and security technologies.
* Experience supporting and engineering security solutions across physical endpoints, Windows Server, virtual desktop/VDI, cloud-hosted, macOS, and Linux environments.

* Experience developing automation for platform health checks, testing, engineering workflows, application maintenance, or operational remediation using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent automation frameworks.
* Experience integrating endpoint controls with SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, IAM/PAM, network security, incident response, and other enterprise security platforms.
* Experience leading security technology POCs, product evaluations, architecture reviews, and production-readiness assessments.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and control models such as NIST CSF and Zero Trust principles.
* Relevant cybersecurity, Microsoft, cloud, endpoint-management, or security-product certifications.

They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

description:

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Oracle Identity & Access Management Technical SME**
to provide senior technical leadership and end-to-end operational support for enterprise Oracle Identity and Access Management (IDAM/IAM) services.
  
  
You will work across
**Oracle Identity Manager (OIM), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), Oracle Virtual Directory (OVD), Oracle Internet Directory (OID) and Oracle WebLogic Server**
, supporting secure, highly available and resilient authentication, authorisation and identity lifecycle services.
  
  
This role requires strong L3/L4 operations and troubleshooting expertise, with responsibility for critical incident resolution, problem management, platform maintenance, performance optimisation, automation and continual operational improvement. You will also work across application, cybersecurity, infrastructure, database and network teams to resolve complex identity and access issues.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide L3/L4 operational support for OIM, OAM, OVD, OID and associated WebLogic environments, helping maintain 24x7 service availability and operational stability.Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorisation, provisioning, reconciliation, SSO and directory-related issues
* Investigate OIM provisioning workflows, connectors, adapters, scheduled tasks, reconciliation jobs and access policies.Diagnose OAM authentication flows, WebGates, authentication schemes, policies, sessions and SSO integrations
* Support OVD/OID services, including LDAP/LDAPS connectivity, adapters, directory structures and application integrations.Act as a senior technical escalation point for P1/P2 incidents affecting authentication, provisioning or application access.
* Administer Oracle IDAM and WebLogic environments, including domains, clusters, AdminServer and Managed Servers.Manage SSL/TLS certificates, keystores, truststores and secure application communication
* Plan, test and implement Oracle CPU/PSU, WebLogic and IDAM product patches across non-production and production environments.Support disaster recovery, failover, backup/recovery and platform resilience activities.
* Use Dynatrace, including PurePath, Service Flow, logs, infrastructure and JVM metrics, to investigate incidents and support performance optimisation.Work with observability teams to define IDAM-specific monitoring requirements and improve proactive detection
* Analyse JVM heap, garbage collection, JDBC connection pools, threads, application deployments, datasource failures and WebLogic runtime issues. Develop operational automation using WLST, Shell/Bash, Python and SQL, covering health checks, service validation, job monitoring and routine activities
* Improve operational runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, recovery processes and technical documentation.Lead root cause analysis and support preventive actions to reduce recurring incidents and operational effort
* Lead knowledge transfer, shadow/reverse-shadow and service transition activities into BAU.Mentor L2/L3 engineers and collaborate with architecture, cybersecurity, application, infrastructure and Oracle support teams

**Who You Are**
You bring strong hands-on experience in enterprise
**Oracle Identity and Access Management operations**
, combined with the ability to analyse complex production issues across identity, middleware, directory, database and application layers.
  
  
You have:
  
  

* Strong administration and troubleshooting experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), Oracle Virtual Directory (OVD), Oracle Internet Directory (OID) and Oracle WebLogic Server.Strong OIM knowledge covering provisioning, reconciliation, connectors, adapters, scheduled tasks, workflows and identity lifecycle processes.Strong OAM knowledge covering SSO, WebGates, authentication schemes, authorisation policies, sessions and identity-store integrations.Good understanding of LDAP/LDAPS, directory structures, OID/OVD and identity-store integrations.Strong operational knowledge of WebLogic domains, clusters, JVM, JDBC, deployments and application troubleshooting.Good Oracle Database and SQL/PL-SQL troubleshooting capability.Strong understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores, truststores, authentication and authorisation.Practical experience using Dynatrace for monitoring, troubleshooting and performance investigation.Working knowledge of WLST, Shell/Bash, Python and SQL for operational automation.

**Desirable experience includes:**

* SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and federation technologies.Oracle IAM integrations with enterprise and cloud/SaaS applications.Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.Oracle IAM or Oracle Middleware certifications.ITIL Foundation certification. CI/CD and configuration automation experience

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
This role offers the opportunity to work on
**enterprise-scale Oracle Identity and Access Management services**
spanning identity lifecycle management, authentication, SSO, directory services, WebLogic middleware, security and observability.
  
  
You will have scope to contribute to complex production troubleshooting, platform resilience, automation, performance optimisation and service improvement while collaborating across cybersecurity, architecture, infrastructure, application, database, network and observability teams. The role also provides opportunities to mentor engineers and influence operational standards and technical practices.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop skills in:
  
  

* Advanced Oracle IAM operations across OIM, OAM, OVD and OID.Enterprise SSO, identity lifecycle and access-management troubleshooting
* Oracle WebLogic performance engineering and JVM analysis.Dynatrace-based observability, PurePath and Service Flow analysis
* IAM automation using WLST, Shell/Bash, Python and SQL.Enterprise identity integrations involving LDAP/LDAPS and external identity services
* Service transition, disaster recovery and operational resilience.Technical leadership, root cause analysis and cross-functional problem solving.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Platform Engineer – T-Mobile ( project)**

**Experience:**\_ **5+ years mandiatory**\_

**Job Summary**

The Platform Engineer at T-Mobile designs, builds, and maintains the hybrid cloud infrastructure that powers T-Mobile's platforms and services. This role focuses on scalability, reliability, and automation across both on-prem and multi-cloud environments (AWS and Azure).

Building upon foundational platform engineering and DevOps experience, the Platform Engineer leads automation initiatives, develops Infrastructure-as-Code solutions, and optimises CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable delivery. The role requires hands-on expertise in hybrid infrastructure, monitoring, observability, and data integration, along with strong collaboration skills across engineering and architecture teams.

Through technical ownership and collaboration, this position directly supports T-Mobile's cloud transformation and drives operational excellence in the platforms that enable developers and critical business systems to thrive.

**Key Responsibilities: Platform Operations & Support**

* Own day-to-day operations of hybrid infrastructure supporting T-Mobile's platform services.

* Ensure uptime, performance, and security across on-prem, AWS, and Azure environments.

* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, configuration, and deployment issues impacting platform reliability.

* Lead patching, updates, and configuration management with minimal oversight.

* Participate in on-call rotation and drive improvements in incident response and postmortem practices.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

* Design, develop, and maintain automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to increase operational efficiency.

* Implement and manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent frameworks.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for platform infrastructure and environment deployments (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins).

* Establish documentation standards and reusable modules for consistent automation delivery.

**Hybrid Cloud Environment Engineering**

* Architect, provision, and maintain compute, networking, and storage services across AWS, Azure, and on-prem environments.

* Engineer hybrid connectivity solutions and optimize data flow between datacenters and cloud resources.

* Manage shared platform services such as container registries, configuration management, and identity systems.

* Partner with DevOps, SRE, and application teams to deliver stable, scalable platform environments.

Data, Messaging & Caching (DML Operations)

* Execute and optimize DML operations within Postgres, Oracle, and Cassandra environments under existing organizational DDL structures.

* Develop and maintain integrations with Kafka for event-driven data pipelines, message publishing, and asynchronous workloads.

* Implement caching strategies (Redis, in-memory caches) to reduce query latency and improve application performance.

* Support database performance tuning, data ingestion, and transformation activities aligned with enterprise governance standards.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

* Develop and manage observability solutions leveraging Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or ELK.

* Implement proactive monitoring, log analysis, and metrics-based alerting for early issue detection.

* Lead efforts in automation for self-healing, scaling, and performance tuning.

* Collaborate with SREs to improve mean time to resolution (MTTR) and overall platform reliability.

Collaboration, Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Contribute to Agile delivery teams, collaborating with developers and architects to deliver infrastructure enhancements.

* Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance in automation, monitoring, and hybrid design.

* Advocate for DevOps and automation best practices across engineering teams.

* Stay informed on emerging tools and cloud-native practices that improve reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Linux and Windows Server administration within hybrid environments.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, and IAM.

* Advanced scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate platform operations.

* Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar).

* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Working knowledge of DML operations in relational (Postgres, Oracle) and NoSQL (Cassandra) databases.

* Understanding of Kafka event streaming concepts, including producers, consumers, and topic management.

* Familiarity with caching mechanisms such as Redis or Memcached for improving data access performance.

* Working knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.

* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, security principles, and zero-trust models.

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a bias for action and automation.

* Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Collaborates seamlessly in Agile, cross-functional environments.

* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and adaptability in dynamic, fast-paced settings.

* Mentors junior engineers and contributes to a culture of learning and operational excellence.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

**Why This Role Matters**

The Platform Engineer plays a key role in building and operating T-Mobile's hybrid infrastructure and platform services. They ensure operational efficiency, performance, and scalability through automation and continuous improvement, including optimised data handling, event-driven integrations, and caching strategies.

By combining platform engineering with DML and messaging expertise, the Platform Engineer enables reliable, efficient, and scalable systems that support T-Mobile's mission to innovate faster and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Sr.Technical Analyst – Process Mining and Modeling is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the technical delivery and lifecycle management of global process-mining and process-modeling solutions from technical intake through operational adoption. Working from defined business problems and requirements established with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role, this position translates business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions using SAP Signavio, SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning systems, and related data platforms. The analyst owns the technical data foundation, solution design, configuration, technical validation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of process-mining and process-modeling solutions. The role partners closely with process owners, the business-facing process-mining role, and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, actionable, secure, and sustainable, while the business-facing role owns business interpretation, improvement action planning, and value realization across General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical intake, solution design, estimation, and delivery planning for global process-mining and process-modeling initiatives, building on business opportunities and requirements defined with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role.
* Partner with the business-facing process-mining role, Process Owners, and data owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements, data definitions, KPI logic, analytical acceptance criteria, and traceable solution designs.
* Design, build, and validate the data foundation required for process mining, including source-data preparation, event logs, connectors, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls across SAP S/4HANA, ERP, and related data platforms.
* Configure and deliver SAP Signavio process-mining and process-modeling solutions, including process discovery, process analysis, and BPMN-based modeling where applicable, to produce reliable and actionable insights from approved business requirements.
* Provide strong technical leadership for workstreams and delivery partners by making solution decisions, setting technical direction, managing technical risks and dependencies, and ensuring quality across implementation activities.
* Lead technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement across the solution lifecycle; coordinate business validation and user acceptance with the business-facing process-mining role and Process Owners.
* Enable adoption through clear technical documentation, solution walkthroughs, capability guidance, and operational support. Partner with the business-facing process-mining role to support improvement outcomes, while maintaining clear D&T ownership of technical readiness, reliability, and sustainability.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.

**Who You Are**
You bring strong hands-on experience in enterprise
**Oracle Identity and Access Management operations**
, combined with the ability to analyse complex production issues across identity, middleware, directory, database and application layers.
  
  
You have:
  
  

* Strong administration and troubleshooting experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), Oracle Virtual Directory (OVD), Oracle Internet Directory (OID) and Oracle WebLogic Server.Strong OIM knowledge covering provisioning, reconciliation, connectors, adapters, scheduled tasks, workflows and identity lifecycle processes.Strong OAM knowledge covering SSO, WebGates, authentication schemes, authorisation policies, sessions and identity-store integrations.Good understanding of LDAP/LDAPS, directory structures, OID/OVD and identity-store integrations.Strong operational knowledge of WebLogic domains, clusters, JVM, JDBC, deployments and application troubleshooting.Good Oracle Database and SQL/PL-SQL troubleshooting capability.Strong understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores, truststores, authentication and authorisation.Practical experience using Dynatrace for monitoring, troubleshooting and performance investigation.Working knowledge of WLST, Shell/Bash, Python and SQL for operational automation.

**Desirable experience includes:**

* SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and federation technologies.Oracle IAM integrations with enterprise and cloud/SaaS applications.Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.Oracle IAM or Oracle Middleware certifications.ITIL Foundation certification. CI/CD and configuration automation experience

spanning identity lifecycle management, authentication, SSO, directory services, WebLogic middleware, security and observability.

description:

We're looking for a Senior Digital Platform Engineer to join a team that keeps our digital pricing and quoting landscape running, evolving and improving it. You will work across multiple applications rather than living in just one stack, which means real variety. The core system is Conga Smart CPQ which aid our business counterparts in building solutions for our customers, thus the role has a tangible impact on how well we are doing as a company.
  
  
This role sits deliberately at the intersection of support and configuration. You'll need to be equally comfortable troubleshooting a live issue under pressure and having a structured approach to configuring/extending the applications capability. Good teamwork and clear communication are central to how this team works. The team is a bridge for business ideas/needs, translated into high performance processes in the CPQ journey.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Own day-to-day support, testing and validation across the CPQ business applications, both vendor-supplied and in-house data exchange.

* Diagnose and resolve incidents, balancing speed for urgent issues with rigor for root-cause fixes.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements, working closely with both technical and business-facing colleagues.
* Maintain clear documentation and structured ways of working so knowledge doesn't live only in your head.
* Continuously look for ways to improve reliability, performance and maintainability across the application landscape and connected processes.
* Bring your ideas to the table, on technical approach, how we work, what we should fix or build next, to help grow our consolidated knowledge and expertise.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business administration or a comparable field
* Typically 6 to 9 years of relevant experience, of which several years in a senior or lead specialist capacity within a business application, CPQ, pricing or quoting environment
* Hands-on experience administering and configuring a CPQ, pricing or quoting platform.
* Direct experience with Conga CPQ (formerly PROS Smart CPQ) is a strong advantage
* Demonstrated ability to own a functional area end to end, from clarifying the business need to designing, configuring, testing and documenting the solution
* Proven ability to translate functional business requirements into concrete technical configuration and solution designs and to explain the reasoning back to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience as an escalation point for complex functional and technical issues, including root cause analysis, workaround design and permanent fix recommendations
* Experience in coordinating across system and team boundaries to maintain processes that span multiple applications
* Experience working with globally distributed stakeholders and being effective in a setup with colleagues and business users in other time zones and regions

* Experience guiding or mentoring less experienced colleagues, without formal line management responsibility and ability to generate reusable documentation
* Background from a global product organisation or a consulting and systems integration environment

* Strong analytical problem solver who breaks ambiguous business challenges into clear, workable solutions
* Confident communicator who engages business users on their terms and technical colleagues on theirs.
* Structured and self-driven, able to extract potential decisions from incomplete information in a landscape with multiple stakeholders.

* Demonstrate practical exposure to hybrid work models by collaborating effectively with onsite and remote colleagues using standardized communication and documentation practices.
