description:
**Job Description – Membership Outreach Executive**

**Organisation:** Electronics and Computer Software Export Promotion Council (ESC)  
**Department:** Membership / RCMC  
**Designation:** Membership Outreach Executive  
**Location:** New Delhi  
**Reporting To:** Assigned Membership / RCMC Manager

**1. Role Objective**

To expand and strengthen the membership base of ESC by identifying eligible exporters, manufacturers, IT and software companies, startups and other industry stakeholders, and facilitating their enrolment in accordance with the Council's approved membership and RCMC policies.

The position will be responsible for executing membership outreach activities, generating prospective leads, facilitating applications, coordinating renewals and maintaining effective engagement with existing members.

**2. Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Membership Outreach & Acquisition**

* Identify prospective members from the electronics, IT, software, hardware and allied industries.
* Develop and maintain a structured database of potential members.
* Conduct outreach through telephone, email, meetings, industry networks and other approved communication channels.
* Execute membership drives as per targets and action plans approved by the management.
* Ensure that all prospective applicants are informed of the applicable membership policy before initiating registration.

**B. RCMC Registration & Policy Compliance**

* Facilitate RCMC applications in accordance with the Council's approved membership policy and applicable DGFT guidelines.
* Guide applicants regarding eligibility, prescribed documentation, application procedures and applicable charges.
* Ensure applications are complete and supporting documents are submitted as prescribed.
* Coordinate with the RCMC processing team for scrutiny, verification and processing.
* Ensure that no commitments regarding membership approval, fee concessions, exemptions or special benefits are made without appropriate authorisation.
* Follow the prescribed procedure for renewals, modifications and other membership-related requests.

**C. Existing Member Engagement & Retention**

* Maintain regular communication with existing members.
* Follow up on membership renewals within the prescribed timelines.
* Inform members about Council activities, trade delegations, exhibitions, international business opportunities, government initiatives and other relevant programmes.
* Coordinate with relevant divisions to address member queries and service requirements.
* Maintain records of member feedback, grievances and pending matters for appropriate resolution.

**D. Industry Networking & Institutional Outreach**

* Develop relationships with industry associations, chambers of commerce, export bodies, MSMEs, startups and relevant institutions.
* Identify membership opportunities through ESC events, exhibitions, seminars, delegations and other outreach programmes.
* Promote membership through Council-approved campaigns and communication material.
* Coordinate with the Events, PORT, INDIASOFT and other relevant divisions for lead generation and membership conversion.

**3. Policy & Administrative Compliance**

The incumbent shall strictly adhere to the following:

* All membership enrolments, renewals and related activities shall be undertaken in accordance with ESC's approved membership policy and procedures.
* All applications and supporting documents must be processed through the prescribed official channels.
* Member and applicant information shall be treated as confidential and handled in accordance with the Council's data-handling procedures.
* All communication with applicants and members shall maintain professional standards and reflect the Council's official position.
* No independent commitment or representation on behalf of the Council shall be made beyond the assigned authority.
* All activities shall be coordinated through the designated reporting manager, ensuring proper documentation and accountability.

**4. Reporting, MIS & Accountability**

* Maintain an updated membership database and CRM records.
* Record all prospective leads, outreach calls, meetings, follow-ups, applications and conversions.
* Submit weekly progress reports to the assigned manager.
* Prepare monthly reports covering membership acquisition, renewals, pending applications and lead conversion.
* Maintain a pipeline of prospective members with clear follow-up dates and action points.
* Ensure that all membership-related records are complete and available for internal review or audit.
* Work as per the responsibilities and targets allocated by the reporting manager.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance Parameter**

**Measurement**

Lead Generation

Number of qualified membership prospects generated

Membership Acquisition

Actual new memberships secured

RCMC Applications

Complete applications facilitated

Conversion Rate

Prospects converted into members

Renewal Management

Timely follow-up and renewal conversion

Outreach Activities

Calls, emails, meetings and industry engagements

Database Management

Accuracy and regular updating of CRM

Policy Compliance

Adherence to membership and RCMC procedures

Reporting

Timely submission of weekly/monthly reports

*Specific monthly and quarterly targets shall be assigned by the management based on the Council's membership growth plan.*

**6. Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Marketing or a related discipline.
* 0-1 years of experience in membership development, business development, sales, client servicing or institutional outreach.
* Strong communication, coordination and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email and CRM systems.
* Knowledge of export procedures, RCMC registration, DGFT guidelines and industry associations will be an added advantage.

**7. Performance Expectations**

The incumbent shall be expected to:

* Take ownership of the assigned membership outreach targets.
* Work against a defined monthly action plan and maintain a measurable pipeline.
* Ensure that outreach translates into actual membership registrations.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all membership-related records.
* Coordinate with the RCMC team and other divisions without bypassing the established reporting structure.
* Escalate policy-related queries, exceptions and unresolved matters to the reporting manager.
* Demonstrate initiative in identifying new membership opportunities while remaining within the Council's approved policies and procedures.

**8. Overall Responsibility**

The Membership Outreach Executive shall be responsible for supporting the Council's membership expansion strategy through structured outreach, policy-compliant enrolment, effective member engagement and measurable acquisition results.

title: SAP ABAP with Inventory Management, HANA, BW knowledge
description:
**SAP ABAP with Inventory Management, HANA, BW knowledge**

**Experience: 5–8 years**

**Location: Remote**

**Type: Contract / Fulltime**

An ABAPer with knowledge of BW, HANA, and Inventory Functional processes. S/he should know what the processes are, what each thing means, and understand concepts such as inventory movements.

Role summary

Hands-on SAP technical consultant combining ABAP development with BW / BW-4HANA data modelling, and enough Inventory Management knowledge to work directly with supply chain stakeholders. The role covers extraction, modelling and reconciliation of inventory and logistics data between ECC / S/4HANA and the reporting layer.

Responsibilities

• Develop and enhance ABAP objects — reports, BADIs, user exits, function modules, IDocs and custom extractors — with a focus on inventory and purchasing.

• Build and support BW models: InfoObjects, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, transformations, DTPs and process chains.

• Own the inventory data flow, including non-cumulative key figures and the 2LIS\_03\_BX / BF / UM extractors with marker update and compression.

• Manage delta queues, setup tables and LO Cockpit configuration; monitor and fix day-to-day load failures.

• Reconcile BW inventory reports against SAP transactions (MB5B, MB51, MMBE) and resolve discrepancies.

• Prepare technical specifications, mappings and test scripts; support UAT and hypercare.

Required

• Strong ABAP: enhancements, BADIs, user exits, debugging and performance tuning.

• Strong SAP BW 7.x / BW-4HANA modelling and delta management.

• Hands-on experience with BW inventory data — non-cumulative key figures and the 2LIS\_03 extractor set.

• Functional understanding of MM-IM: movement types, goods receipt / issue, transfer postings, special stocks and valuation.

• Ability to explain and defend stock figures to business users.

Good to have

• S/4HANA, CDS views, AMDP or MATDOC exposure.

• SAP Datasphere, SAC, or downstream platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.

• EWM, SLT / ODP, or a BW-4HANA conversion project.

• Power BI or Analysis for Office reporting.

* Reporting and insights:

* 6-8 years of experience in data management, knowledge base operations, content management or information governance.
* Minimum 4–6 years of experience leading data quality, knowledge management, or data governance functions within a mid-to-large-scale organization.

* Deep understanding of knowledge base architecture, taxonomy design, content categorization, metadata standards, tagging strategies, and information lifecycle management.

The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk

* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions

* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable

* Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies
* Practical Salesforce administration experience including users, permissions, security, objects, fields, configuration and Flow
* Experience working with integrations and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP
* Experience using Git and working within a structured deployment or CI/CD process
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable technical or administrative activities
* Strong engineering and problem-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.
* Data management and relational database knowledge, including data formats, joins and ETL concepts
* Strong understanding of Salesforce development, deployment and platform best practices

Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.

**Title: BI Lead**

**Company: Circles - Jetpac**

**Location: Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)**

**Type: Full time**

**About [Circles – Jetpac]:**

Jetpac, from Circles, is the coolest tech startup you will find, dedicated to making Travel super convenient and 100% hassle free. We're a bunch of rebels, renegades, and sometimes misfits, working together to change the Travel Universe. We grew 10x last year, with customers in >150 countries and availability in 10 different languages and currencies. At Jetpac, we take ownership and we lead! We are ambitious and resourceful Jetpac cadets, who would stop at nothing to get to the desired end outcome! If you think you've got the guts, the smarts, and the hustle to join us, then keep reading!

**Job Overview**

We're looking for a
**BI Lead**
to build and own the data backbone that powers every decision at Jetpac. This role demands someone who's equally strong technically and commercially: hands-on with SQL, data models and dashboards, but also strategic enough to shape how the company measures growth. You'll own the single source of truth for our metrics and partner closely with marketing, product, finance and leadership. If you're someone who gets a kick out of turning messy data into crisp answers, and can tell CAC from LTV from cohort retention in your sleep, you'll fit right in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Ownership**

* Define and drive Jetpac's BI and reporting roadmap in line with business priorities
* Own the company's core metrics framework (revenue, orders, CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, churn) and be the single source of truth for them
* Set standards for metric definitions, data quality and governance across teams
* Prioritise incoming data requests and balance quick answers with long-term infrastructure

**Data Modelling & Infrastructure**

* Design and maintain scalable data models and a clean semantic layer in the data warehouse

**Dashboards & Reporting**

* Build and maintain self-serve dashboards for leadership, marketing, product, finance and operations

**Analytics & Insights**

* Run deep dives on acquisition, conversion funnels, cohorts, pricing and retention
* Support marketing with attribution, channel performance and budget allocation analysis
* Partner with product on A/B test design, measurement and readouts
* Use data to craft compelling narratives around what's working, what's not, and what's next

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with marketing, product, finance, CRM and customer support teams to understand their data needs
* Work with leadership to translate business questions into analysis and metrics
* Coordinate with engineering on data availability and new tracking requirements

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Present insights, growth hypotheses and recommendations to leadership
* Maintain a clear data dictionary and documentation of metrics, models and dashboards

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics or data roles
* Expert-level SQL and strong experience with data modelling (dimensional modelling, star schemas)
* Hands-on experience building dashboards in at least one major BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase)
* Experience with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field
* Strong understanding of e-commerce or consumer-app metrics: funnels, cohorts, CAC, LTV, retention
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in a tech startup or high-growth DTC brand
* Background in travel, telecom or fintech verticals is a strong plus
* Familiarity with eSIM or digital telco space is a bonus

**Desired Skills**

* Proficiency in Python for analysis and automation
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as GA4, Posthog or Amplitude
* Familiarity with marketing data sources and MMPs like AppsFlyer or Branch

**What We Offer**

**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent

**Title: Data Architect**
**Department: Client Service Platform**
**Location: Gurgaon/Bangalore**
**Grade: 4**
**Reports To: Data Architecture Lead**
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. We achieve this by working together and supporting one another across our global business. Join our team and be part of something bigger.
  
  
**Department Description**
Platform Design & Solutions (PDS) is the architecture and technical governance body across Client Servicing Platforms (CSP). The Data Architecture and Ownership capability within PDS defines data models, migration architectures, certified data products, and data standards supporting client servicing, reporting, and investment operations globally.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The
**Data Architect (Grade 4)**
is a foundational data engineering and data modeling specialist responsible for translating business requirements and data domain definitions into physical and logical schema designs, Snowflake data pipelines, and certified Data Product interfaces.
  
  
Working under the mentorship of the Data Architecture Lead and alongside senior data architects, you will play a crucial role in modernising CSP's data estate — specifically supporting the strategic migration from the legacy on-premise Client Reporting Database onto
**Snowflake**
.
  
  
You will map source-to-target data flows, author dimensional and relational data models, maintain technical data dictionaries, and validate data product contracts across client reporting, sales and assets, and distribution datasets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Modeling & Schema Design**

* Design and maintain logical and physical data models for CSP data domains using ERwin, ER/Studio, or dbt semantic models.
* Develop star-schema, snowflake-schema, and normalized table structures in Snowflake optimized for query performance and data sharing.
* Author comprehensive source-to-target mapping specifications, documenting transformation logic, business rules, and data cleansing requirements.

**Snowflake Data Migration & Pipeline Architecture**

* Partner with delivery engineers to design ingestion and transformation pipelines moving data from legacy Oracle databases (CRDB) to target Snowflake tables.
* Write and optimize complex SQL transformations, views, and stored procedures in Snowflake.
* Assist in establishing data reconciliation, automated data validation checks, and regression scripts to guarantee zero data loss during cutover.

**Data Product Specification & Documentation**

* Define technical specifications for certified Data Products: table schemas, JSON/Avro payloads, API contracts, and update cadences.
* Document detailed data dictionary entries, column definitions, and data lineage in enterprise catalogues (Collibra).
* Work with downstream consuming teams (reporting analysts, Salesforce developers, Tableau dashboard creators) to ensure data products meet functional requirements.

**Governance & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure all database designs adhere to Fidelity’s enterprise naming conventions, data classifications, and retention policies.
* Assist in classifying sensitive personal data (PII) and configuring masking policies or row-level access controls in Snowflake.

**Experience And Qualifications Required**
**Knowledge:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Senior Data Engineering in an enterprise data warehouse environment.
* Strong practical working knowledge of Snowflake (virtual warehouses, clustering, staging, zero-copy cloning, time travel).
* Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
* Solid understanding of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball dimensional modeling, Inmon relational modeling, Data Vault).
* Experience writing source-to-target mappings and participating in large-scale database migrations.

**Skills:**

* Advanced SQL proficiency — ability to write performant analytical queries, window functions, and complex joins.
* Familiarity with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, dbdiagram.io) and version control (Git).
* High attention to detail, structured thinking, and a passion for data accuracy and documentation.
* Excellent team collaboration skills, eager to learn and grow under senior architectural mentorship.

**Feel rewarded:**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

* Conduct cybersecurity and privacy due diligence for vendors, products, and technology partners.

You'll also help set up and stabilise a dedicated EBX instance for the business, so your work will directly shape how reliable, scalable and trusted its master data is.

**Our Team**

You will join the Data Management team, which leads MDM, Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives that give Koch companies trusted data. The team works closely with business stakeholders, architects, data stewards and infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that support business transformation.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, develop, configure, and support **TIBCO EBX** solutions, including data models, datasets, relationships, permissions, workflows, business rules, validation controls, and data services.
* Develop custom Java components, validation rules, triggers, services, and workflow extensions.
* Implement multi-domain MDM and Reference Data Management solutions for Product, Supplier, Customer, Finance, Asset, and other business domains.
* Design integrations between EBX and enterprise applications using REST APIs, web services, data pipelines, and batch frameworks.
* Support data migration, bulk loading, data conversion, and onboarding.
* Participate in technical design reviews and align solutions with enterprise architecture standards and development best practices.

  
**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable MDM solutions.
* Participate in discovery sessions, solution workshops, backlog refinement, and design discussions.
* Collaborate with Data Governance teams, Business Analysts, Architects, Data Stewards, and integration teams.
* Recommend implementation approaches based on business needs and long-term supportability.
* **Planning & Execution**
* Drive ADO/Jira stories, technical designs, development, testing, deployment support, and production releases.
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, blockers, and implementation considerations proactively.

  
**Run & Maintain**

* Own day-to-day EBX platform administration, repository health, workflow operations, object cache, disk capacity, log management, scheduled housekeeping, and obsolete-content cleanup.
* Manage environments, installations, configuration, application server deployments, patches, hotfixes, upgrades, and technical refreshes across development, test, and production landscapes.
* Administer core platform configuration, repository connectivity, user and role directories, audit logging, email, data services, messaging, REST services, proxy settings, security controls, failover, and performance tuning.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, service health dashboards, operational checks, capacity plans, and preventative maintenance routines.
* Lead major incident response, problem management, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and communication for production outages and recurring failures.
* Manage access, permissions, service accounts, certificates, encryption-related dependencies, audit evidence, and remediation of platform vulnerabilities.
* Own release readiness, deployment planning, rollback procedures, production validation, change records, and post-release support.
* Coordinate repository backup, recovery testing, archive management, database maintenance, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and operational resilience.
* Maintain runbooks, support procedures, environment inventories, dependency maps, architecture records, and knowledge articles.
* Provide senior technical guidance and escalation support to developers, managed service providers, infrastructure teams, and business support teams

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Experience developing on TIBCO EBX, including data models, dataspaces, workflows, business rules, permissions and data services
* Experience administering and supporting TIBCO EBX in production, including upgrades, patches, environment management and incident resolution
* Experience with Java development, including building and debugging custom components
* Experience integrating EBX through REST APIs, XML, JSON, web services, messaging, batch processes, and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including query analysis and troubleshooting
* Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and JSON
* Strong understanding of MDM, RDM, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Modelling, and Metadata Management.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Extensive experience leading enterprise MDM or RDM implementations and operating TIBCO EBX as a business-critical platform.
* Deep expertise developing custom Java solutions, extensions, services, and integrations in EBX.
* Experience with high availability, failover, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, repository management, performance tuning, and platform observability.
* Experience automating deployments, environment configuration, monitoring, health checks, and operational support activities using DevOps practices.
* Experience with ETL, data migration, and large-scale data conversion initiatives.
* Experience integrating EBX with ERP, CRM, data warehouses, Finance systems, and enterprise applications.
* Experience with Snowflake, AWS, MuleSoft, Kafka, Informatica, Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling, or comparable enterprise technologies.
* Experience implementing Supplier, Customer, Product, Finance, Asset, or Reference Data domains.
* Experience supporting global teams, managed service partners, multi-business implementations, and enterprise transformation programmes

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

title: Microsoft Control Access - Senior Consultant
description:
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Administer, design, and govern Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies across production and non-production environments, including policy assignments, conditions, grant controls, session controls, naming standards, and exclusion governance.
* Configure and support access controls for users, groups, roles, cloud applications, guests, workload identities, and devices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), authentication strengths, compliant or hybrid-joined device requirements, and risk-based policies.
* Manage the policy lifecycle through What If analysis, report-only mode, phased rollouts, change records, testing, approvals, rollback planning, post-change validation, and emergency-access account monitoring.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for sign-in and access issues; analyze policy evaluation details, Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, KQL queries, and Microsoft Sentinel data; and manage incident, service request, problem, and change activities in ServiceNow.
* Automate repeatable policy reporting, backup, drift detection, and administration using approved tools, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell; maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
* Lead client operational reviews and policy-design workshops; coordinate onsite and offshore activities; mentor junior staff; communicate access impacts and remediation actions; and contribute technical insights to managed-services solution design.

**The team**

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**

**Qualifications**

Required:

Must have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications

* 6 -10 years total experience in IAM or cybersecurity operations, including at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Entra Conditional Access in an operational or managed services capacity.
* Expert knowledge of Conditional Access: policy design, grant and session controls, authentication strengths, continuous access evaluation, token protection, report-only mode and What If analysis, risk-based policies (Entra ID Protection), device compliance (Intune), named locations, and emergency-access account design.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity: Active Directory, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, PIM, B2B collaboration, SSO and federation (SAML, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect), and MFA/passwordless authentication.
* Solid understanding of Zero Trust and least privilege principles, and of compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53/800-207, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.
* Technological skills in automation, PowerShell scripting, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, and KQL for troubleshooting, reporting, and monitoring.
* Deep understanding of operational processes, incident resolution, change management, and compliance management; proficiency with process documentation, SLAs, reporting, and ITSM practices (ServiceNow).
* Experience leading support teams, mentoring juniors, and managing enhancement/implementation projects; able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and clients at all levels.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300); ITIL.

Preferred:

Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
* Experience with Global Secure Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Defender XDR, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot agents, or Conditional Access policy-as-code (Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Microsoft365DSC, CI/CD pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with other identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Ping) or privileged access tools used in managed services.
* Involvement in process improvement or internal training; CISSP, CISM, or CCSP certification

Education:

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. **Job ID** R-264225 **Date posted** 11/12/2026

Are you ready to define the enterprise standard for data engineering and turn strategy into measurable outcomes that accelerate insights to patients? * Embed governance-as-code and preventative controls; design pipelines and patterns that achieve close to zero cost leakage on cloud infrastructure, and uplift performance metrics including latency, reliability, and quality through clear SLAs/SLOs.
* Operate and scale a federated service across business technology groups; enable alignment, capability uplift, and reuse via onboarding kits, templates, and self-service accelerators.

* Proactively raise, handle, and mitigate risks; ensure alignment to regulatory requirements (including privacy, GxP, SOx, and HIPAA as applicable) without slowing delivery.

* Extensive practical experience engaging with Open table standards (for ex, Iceberg) and Open technical catalogs (for ex, Snowflake Horizon).
* Extensive practical experience handling Structured, Semi-Structured and Unstructured data assets and engineering.
* Mandatory (Must Have) Skills – Snowflake, Fivetran DBT, DataOps.live, SnowPark Container technology, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon, Snowflake Cortex software (CoCo), AWS S3.
* Optional (Nice to Have) Skills – Databricks, Snaplogic, Apache Polaris, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, AWS Redshift, Docker, Kubernetes, MWAA, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Expertise with modern data architectures, cloud data platforms and data engineering lifecycle implementation and practices.
* Solid understanding of metadata, lineage, security classification, FinOps, and SLA/SLO frameworks.
* Confirmed leadership in large-scale, federated, global technology environments.
* Ability to influence, educate, and lead change across technical & business teams.
* Background in regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare) with Data Privacy, HIPAA, GxP & SOx.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Track record establishing new capabilities from scratch and scaling globally.
* Experience defining enterprise service tiers, maturity models, and adoption programs.
* Proven leadership developing talent and hard-working technical teams.
* Strong collaborator management and collaboration across matrixed environments.
* A forward-thinking approach combined with a commitment to taking initiative and delivering tangible outcomes.

This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.

**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**
ELK / Loki, Grafana, Open-source tools, Prometheus, Proven DR experience:, Linux system administrator, Linux engineer, Systems Engineer, SRE, Site Reliability Engineer, Platform engineer, DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure engineer, Cloud Engineer, Linux, Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL, RedHat, GCP, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, GKE, Docker, Disaster Recovery, DR, High availability, Failover, Replication, Observability, Monitoring, Incident Management, nginx, Apache, Web Server, Reverse proxy, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Bash, Shell, Python
  
  
**A cloud-based field service management SaaS platform is Looking for:******
**Senior System Operations Engineer**
**About The Role**
CS is a SaaS platform that field service businesses rely on every day. We are looking for a Senior System Operations Engineer with 6 to 10 years of experience who will own the reliability of our production Linux estate on Google Cloud Platform. This is not a ticket-handling role. You will be the expert Linux troubleshooter the team escalates to, the owner of our Disaster Recovery design and execution, and a hands-on technical lead who mentors engineers, leads major incidents, and drives improvement projects from idea to production. You will work closely with the Cloud Architect, turning architecture direction into working, documented, and tested systems.
  
  
**Our Environment**
**Cloud-**
Google Cloud Platform: Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud LoadBalancing, Cloud DNS
  
  
**OS Linux**
servers across the estate (Ubuntu / Debian / RHEL family)
  
  
**Containers**
Docker, Kubernetes on GKE
  
  
**Web & App**
Nginx, Apache, application servers
  
  
**Data**
Self-managed database servers (MySQL / PostgreSQL) with replication and backups
  
  
**IaC & Scripting**
Terraform, Bash / Shell, Python
  
  
**Practice**
Disaster Recovery, observability, CI/CD, change management, documentation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Disaster Recovery: Design, Build and Own
  
  
■ Classify services by business criticality and agree RPO / RTO targets with engineering and business stakeholders.
  
  
■ Design and implement the DR architecture on GCP: cross-region standby, snapshot and image policies, database replicas, DNS and load balancer failover, GKE workload recovery.
  
  
■ Build DR infrastructure with Terraform so the recovery environment can be recreated from code, not memory.
  
  
■ Write and maintain DR runbooks and playbooks plan and lead failover drills at least twice a year, report findings and close the gaps.
  
  
■ Own the backup strategy for servers and databases and prove it with scheduled, documented restore tests.
  
  
**Linux Expertise & Escalation Troubleshooting**
■ Act as the final escalation point for complex production issues across OS, network, web, application and database layers.
  
  
■ Deep-dive performance problems: CPU scheduling, memory and OOM behaviour, disk and filesystem I/O, network stack, file descriptors and kernel parameters (sysctl).
  
  
■ Use advanced tooling such as strace, perf, tcpdump, lsof, sar, iostat, ss, eBPF-based tools to find root cause.
  
  
■ Define and maintain Linux build, hardening and patching standards for the whole estate.
  
  
**Incident Leadership & Reliability**
■ Lead major incidents as incident commander: coordinate, communicate status and drive to resolution.
  
  
■ Run blameless post-incident reviews, write RCAs and make sure corrective actions are completed.
  
  
■ Define SLIs / SLOs for key services design and own the observability stack (metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards) and reduce alert noise.
  
  
■ Design and improve the on-call process, escalation paths and runbook coverage.
  
  
**Cloud, Containers & Platform (GCP / GKE)**
■ Design and operate GKE clusters: node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, network policies, ingress, upgrades with minimal disruption.
  
  
■ Introduce and maintain Helm / GitOps practices for consistent, reviewable deployments.
  
  
■ Design GCP networking and IAM following least privilege own GCP cost optimisation and right-sizing.
  
  
**Web, Application & Database Platforms**
■ Tune Nginx and Apache for performance and security: reverse proxy, TLS, caching, rate limiting, high availability.
  
  
■ Partner with developers on application server performance, capacity and release readiness.
  
  
■ Design database high availability and failover plan and execute upgrades and migrations with low or zero downtime lead capacity planning.
  
  
**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**
■ Write reusable Terraform modules, manage remote state and bring manually built infrastructure under code.
  
  
■ Build automation in Python and Shell that removes toil contribute to CI/CD pipelines and configuration management (e.g. Ansible).
  
  
■ Own change management: peer-reviewed, tested and reversible changes to production.
  
  
**Security & Compliance**
■ Drive OS and cloud hardening, vulnerability remediation, secrets and certificate management.
  
  
■ Support security audits and customer due diligence questionnaires with accurate evidence and documentation.
  
  
**Leadership, Mentoring & Documentation**
■ Mentor junior and mid-level engineers: review their work, pair on incidents and grow their troubleshooting skills.
  
  
■ Own the team''s runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams and DR documentation set the documentation standard.
  
  
■ Plan and deliver improvement projects communicate clearly with engineering, support, and management.
  
  
■ Contribute to architecture discussions with the Cloud Architect and give honest, evidence-based recommendations.
  
  
**Must – Have Skills & Experience**
■ 6 to 10 years of hands-on Linux system administration/operations in production. with at least 3 years supporting a SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Expert-level Linux troubleshooting, with clear examples of complex production issues you diagnosed and permanently fixed.
  
  
■ Strong hands-on GCP experience (AWS/Azure experience transferable).
  
  
■ Production experience running Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE, including upgrades and troubleshooting.
  
  
■ Deep knowledge of Nginx and Apache and application server stacks.
  
  
■ Database operations (MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL): replication, HA, failover, backup/restore, performance basics.
  
  
■ Strong Terraform experience, including writing modules and managing state.
  
  
■ Strong Shell and good Python for automation and tooling.
  
  
■ Solid DevOps practice: Git workflows, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting design.
  
  
**■ Experience Leading Incidents And Mentoring Other Engineers.**
■ Clear communicator with strong documentation habits, able to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Good to Have**
■ Ansible or other configuration management at scale.
  
  
■ With at least 3 years supporting a SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Loki, OpenTelemetry or similar observability stacks.
  
  
■ Helm, Argo CD / Flux, Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions.
  
  
■ Redis, RabbitMQ or similar supporting services in production.
  
  
■ Proven DR experience: you have designed or substantially built a DR setup, defined RPO/RTO and run real failover tests.
  
  
■ Comfortable working with open-source tools and reading docs, source code and logs to solve problems.
  
  
■ Certifications: RHCE, Google Professional Cloud Architect / DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKS.
  
  
■ Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR controls.
  
  
**Why join us**
■ Own Disaster Recovery and reliability for a live, customer-facing SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Modern cloud stack: GCP, GKE, Terraform and open-source tooling.
  
  
■ Real influence on how the platform is built, working directly with the Cloud Architect.
  
  
■ A clear growth path towards Lead / Architect roles, with learning and certification Expert-level Linux troubleshooting,support.

description:

===================

**About the role**
  
The Product Lifecycle Leader is a specialized operational leadership position responsible for the technical execution of the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations across GE Vernova Power Conversion Solutions (PCS).

Reporting to the Senior Cybersecurity Leader, you will drive the practical implementation of security requirements and ensure all NPI and OTR programs meet rigorous technical standards throughout their lifecycle. You will exercise high levels of operational judgment to manage a team of technical specialists, deploy advanced security tooling, and lead the technical response to vulnerabilities to protect our products and global supply chain.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**SDLC Implementation & Governance**

* **Operational SDLC:** Drive the practical application and technical execution of security processes across all PCS NPI programs, ensuring development teams meet secure development requirements.
* **Tooling & Automation:** Deploy and maintain the necessary tools (SAST/DAST, automated gates) and technical training required for engineering teams to integrate security into their daily workflows.
* **Supplier Security Operations:** Execute the service supplier security maturity program (aligned to IEC 62443 2-4), managing the technical assessments and training for third-party partners.
* **OTR Technical Support:** Lead the technical integration of regional OTR teams into the standardized SDLC for application-level development.

**PSIRT Operations & Vulnerability Management**

* **Team Leadership:** Direct the daily operations, performance, and technical output of PSIRT Analysts and security specialists, acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical challenges.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Lead the technical intake, triage, and prioritization of vulnerabilities, providing the defensible rationale for risk thresholds and remediation paths.
* **Technical Risk Execution:** Direct the execution of threat modeling, penetration testing, and formal risk assessments for product releases, solving technical problems that fall outside standard parameters.
* **Incident Liaison:** Partner with Architecture and Engineering to ensure PSIRT findings and technical vulnerabilities are directly integrated into future design improvements.

**Innovation & Performance Tracking**

* **Next-gen Tech:** Champion the adoption of frontier AI-based code analysis to accelerate proactive vulnerability management and improve CI/CD security analysis.
* **Operational Metrics:** Track and report performance-level metrics, such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR), to measure the speed and effectiveness of the PSIRT function.
* **Advisory Management:** Execute the security advisory and CVE monitoring process in collaboration with Senior Cybersecurity Leader and GEV CIRT team

**Supply Chain and SBOM**

* **SBOM Operations:** Maintain SCA tooling and operationalize SBOM standards, ensuring 100% visibility into the source and binary components of product and system.
* **Technical Response:** Ensure all supply chain components are defined in GE Vernova’s vulnerability management tool allowing for rapid impact analysis when upstream vulnerabilities are detected.
  

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required**

* **Experience:** Significant experience in technical Cybersecurity Leadership, specifically SDLC implementation and PSIRT management.
* **Leadership:** Proven track record managing a team of technical specialists and driving adoption of new security technology/ tools.
* **Technical Expertise:** Deep knowledge of secure development lifecycle and vulnerability management, incident response and automated security testing
* **Certifications:** CISM, CISSP, CSSLP, GICSP or equivalent.
* **Communication:** Ability to simplify technical operational risk and remediation plans for senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Desired**

* **Education:** Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Cybersecurity.
* **Standards Knowledge:** Experience applying standards such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in a practical, industrial development environment.

title: Information Technology System Administrator
description:
Job Description – IT Systems Administrator

**Position:**
IT Systems Administrator

**Department:**
IT Operations / Infrastructure

**Experience:**
1–4 Years

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a proactive and hands-on IT Systems Administrator responsible for managing and maintaining the organization's IT assets, employee endpoints, software installations, network connectivity, and client-specific Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environments.

The individual will serve as the primary point of contact for all IT-related requirements, ensuring employees have properly configured, secure, and fully functional systems to perform their daily responsibilities. The role also involves coordinating with client IT teams, helpdesks, VDI support teams, and hardware vendors to ensure timely resolution of technical issues.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Systems and Endpoint Management

* Ensure all employee laptops and IT systems are properly configured, maintained, and functioning efficiently.
* Perform system setup, configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and preventive maintenance.
* Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, drivers, patches, and required business applications.
* Ensure all systems have the necessary security tools, including antivirus/endpoint protection, and that updates and security patches are current.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues, system performance problems, and connectivity issues.
* Manage laptop imaging, OS installation, system formatting, and device readiness for new joiners.

2. VDI Management and Client IT Coordination

* Act as the primary Point of Contact (POC) for all employee VDI-related issues.
* Coordinate VDI access requests, approvals, provisioning, configuration, and setup for client environments.
* Ensure required client-specific software, including Citrix Workspace and other VDI-related components, is installed and configured.
* Coordinate with client helpdesk, infrastructure teams, and IT support teams for VDI access, connectivity, authentication, and performance-related issues.
* Track and follow up on VDI access approvals and provisioning requests to ensure timely onboarding.
* Troubleshoot common VDI issues and escalate complex issues to the appropriate client support teams.
* Maintain records of VDI access, provisioning status, and issue resolution.

3. Hardware and Peripheral Management

* Manage all employee IT hardware requirements, including:
* Laptops and desktops
* Laptop chargers and adapters
* Keyboards and mice
* Headsets, monitors, and docking stations
* Network devices and other IT peripherals
* Diagnose hardware failures and coordinate repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Ensure employees receive the required IT equipment during onboarding and that equipment is collected during offboarding.

4. IT Asset and Inventory Management

* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all IT assets.
* Track asset allocation, ownership, serial numbers, configurations, warranty details, and lifecycle status.
* Maintain records of asset issuance, returns, transfers, repairs, and replacements.
* Conduct periodic physical asset verification and reconcile inventory records.
* Ensure proper asset tagging and documentation.
* Track software licenses, renewals, antivirus subscriptions, and other IT-related licenses.

5. Vendor and Procurement Management

* Coordinate with hardware vendors for laptop and IT peripheral procurement.
* Obtain quotations, compare specifications and pricing, and coordinate purchase orders.
* Track hardware deliveries, warranty coverage, repairs, and replacements.
* Maintain vendor relationships and ensure timely fulfillment of IT procurement requirements.
* Coordinate with internal finance and administration teams for procurement documentation and invoice processing.

6. Network and Connectivity Support

* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and network access issues.
* Assist employees with network configuration and connectivity-related problems.
* Coordinate with internet service providers and network support vendors when required.
* Ensure employees have reliable connectivity to access internal systems and client environments.

7. IT Support and Employee Assistance

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee IT-related issues.
* Provide timely support for hardware, software, operating system, application, and connectivity issues.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT infrastructure perspective.
* Maintain an IT issue/request tracker and ensure issues are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Document recurring issues, troubleshooting steps, and standard operating procedures.
* Provide guidance to employees on basic IT security, system usage, and compliance requirements.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems, laptop configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with laptop imaging, OS installation, drivers, patches, and software deployment.
* Experience with antivirus and endpoint protection solutions.
* Working knowledge of Citrix Workspace and VDI environments.
* Understanding of Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, user accounts, access provisioning, and permissions.
* Knowledge of LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and basic networking concepts.
* Experience managing hardware peripherals and troubleshooting hardware failures.
* Familiarity with IT asset management and software license tracking.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and standard enterprise productivity applications.

Preferred Skills

* Experience supporting employees working in a banking / BFSI client environment.
* Exposure to endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune, SCCM, or similar solutions.
* Knowledge of ITIL-based IT service management processes.
* Experience coordinating with enterprise client helpdesks and infrastructure support teams.
* Familiarity with information security practices, endpoint compliance, and access management.

Desired Competencies

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Hands-on approach with the ability to independently resolve day-to-day IT issues.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.
* Strong ownership and accountability for issue resolution.
* Ability to manage multiple IT requests and prioritize based on business impact.
* Good documentation and inventory management skills.
* Ability to work with internal employees, external vendors, and client IT teams.

Key Success Measures (KPIs)

* Availability and operational readiness of employee IT systems.
* Timely resolution of hardware, software, network, and VDI issues.
* Turnaround time for new employee laptop and VDI setup.
* Accuracy and completeness of IT asset inventory.
* Timely completion of software installations, antivirus updates, and security patches.
* Timely closure of IT support tickets and requests.
* Effective vendor coordination and procurement turnaround time.

**Overall Expectation:**
The IT Systems Administrator is expected to take complete ownership of Blue Spire's day-to-day IT infrastructure and end-user computing requirements, ensuring that employees have reliable, secure, and properly configured systems, with minimal disruption to their work.

description:

We are looking for a senior engineer who knows Azure networking from the ground up and still enjoys working close to the packets.

Our platform is Azure-first. Most workloads and all new build run in Azure, with a smaller on-premises estate that still matters and a limited AWS footprint. * Own hybrid connectivity across on-premises, Azure and AWS, including BGP routing, failover and overlapping address space
* Design and test disaster recovery for cloud and network services
* Deliver infrastructure through Terraform and Bicep in CI/CD pipelines
* Set up AKS networking and private connectivity between applications and platform services
* Bring automation and AI-assisted tooling into day-to-day operations
* Be the final escalation point for complex incidents across cloud and network
* Mentor engineers and lead design reviews

**What you bring**

* 10+ years in network or infrastructure engineering, including at least 5 years building and running Azure platforms. We mean real platform work, not just managing VMs.
* Hands-on design experience with hub-and-spoke or vWAN, ExpressRoute and Azure landing zones
* Strong enterprise networking: BGP, routing, segmentation and next-gen firewall policy
* Production Terraform, plus PowerShell or Python scripting
* Practical DR experience with Azure Site Recovery or multi-region designs
* Working knowledge of AWS networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect)
* End-to-end ownership of at least two large programs, such as a cloud migration, landing zone build, SD-WAN rollout or DR program
* Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI) with formal change management
* Comfort with planned weekend change windows and on-call

**Mandatory skills**

* **Cloud Network:**
  Azure hub-and-spoke or vWAN, ExpressRoute, BGP, Private Link, Private DNS, Azure Firewall or NVA
* **App Integration:**
  connecting applications and services securely, using Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus or private endpoints for app-to-app connectivity
* **BCDR:**
  designing and testing disaster recovery with Azure Site Recovery, multi-region failover and backup
* **Governance:**
  Azure landing zones, management groups, Azure Policy, RBAC, tagging and cost control
* **Automation / AI:**
  Terraform or Bicep in CI/CD, PowerShell or Python scripting, and using AI tools or AIOps to automate operations

If you have built Azure networks that real businesses depend on, we would like to hear from you.

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Associate-Software Engineering
description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
===========================

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**
===============

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**
=======================================

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
============================

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.**

Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
===========================

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with legal professionals and cross-functional partners. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**
===============

As a Vice President and hands-on Engineering Manager, you will lead an engineering team responsible for critical Legal Division applications and services. You will establish technical direction, develop engineering talent and remain close to architecture, code and delivery. You will be accountable for translating business priorities into a clear roadmap, delivering dependable solutions and ensuring that supported applications meet users’ day-to-day needs.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**
=======================================

* Lead, mentor and develop Analyst and Associate engineers while establishing clear expectations, strong engineering practices and a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Own delivery across the full software development lifecycle, including planning, spec-driven design, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement; manage priorities, dependencies, risks and commitments.
* Remain hands-on through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting and targeted implementation, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, observable, maintainable and scalable.
* Champion disciplined use of AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery while preserving engineering ownership; critically evaluate and refine AI-generated solutions for correctness, security, privacy, performance and suitability for the problem being solved.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers, engineers and control stakeholders to translate business needs into practical full-stack, data and AI-enabled solutions, and communicate technical strategy, status, risks and trade-offs clearly.
* Own the application-support model and work directly with users to resolve day-to-day needs and production issues, using incidents, operational measures and feedback to drive sustainable improvements in reliability, usability and the user experience.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a closely related technical field. Relevant experience of 7-9 years
* Substantial professional software development experience, including hands-on delivery of enterprise applications and demonstrated leadership of engineers or engineering teams.
* Deep knowledge of software engineering fundamentals, system design, distributed systems, API design, databases, automated testing, CI/CD and production operations.
* Hands-on proficiency in one or more modern programming ecosystems. Experience with Java, TypeScript / JavaScript, React and Python is particularly relevant.
* Proven ability to lead the full software development lifecycle, from problem definition and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, support and modernization.
* Experience designing and operating secure, resilient and scalable systems, ideally using cloud-native, microservices or event-driven architectures.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to challenge, test and improve AI-generated code.
* Ability to develop engineers, lead technical decisions and drive complex initiatives across teams and stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical problem solving and the ability to explain complex technical topics and trade-offs clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or another highly controlled business environment.
* Experience in onboarding and integrations with vendor SaaS platforms
* Experience with cloud migration, Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure modernization and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, search platforms, messaging, streaming or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation and prompt or context engineering.
* Experience establishing application-support practices, production-readiness standards, observability and incident-management disciplines.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* The team consistently delivers secure, reliable and maintainable solutions that meet clear specifications and business outcomes.
* Engineers grow in capability and ownership through effective coaching, meaningful technical challenges and clear standards.
* AI-assisted development measurably improves delivery effectiveness without reducing code quality, control discipline or engineering accountability.
* Users receive responsive support, recurring issues are addressed through sustainable engineering improvements and application reliability continues to improve.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
============================

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, Elasticsearch, Kafka, streaming and messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, CI/CD, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.** Technology choices vary by solution. The successful candidate is not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; deep engineering fundamentals, hands-on leadership, sound judgment and learning agility are essential.
