description:
**Job Description:**

**About ETS:**  
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

The Senior Quality Analyst is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable software solutions by designing, implementing, and executing comprehensive quality assurance strategies. This role provides technical leadership and expertise across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), partnering with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, and project teams to validate functional and non-functional requirements. The Senior Quality Analyst drives quality best practices, promotes test automation, identifies and mitigates risks, and continuously improves testing processe. This role serves as a subject matter expert in quality engineering, mentors junior QA staff, and ensures software solutions meet business objectives, regulatory requirements, and end-user expectations before release to production.

Responsibilities:

* Lead and execute testing activities for assigned applications, projects, and initiatives throughout the SDLC.
* Review and validate business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs to ensure testability, completeness, and quality standards.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, test data, and both manual and automated test scripts.
* Develop and implement test automation solutions using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent technologies.
* API testing using Postman, SOAP UI, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Collaborate with development, business, and operations teams to identify, analyze, prioritize, and resolve defects and quality issues.
* Support CI/CD pipeline integration and implement quality gates to improve release quality and deployment efficiency.
* Leverage AI-assisted testing tools and quality engineering practices to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, and test coverage.
* Assess project and product risks, applying appropriate verification and validation techniques to ensure compliance with business, technical, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor and report testing progress, quality metrics, risk assessments, defect trends, and release readiness to stakeholders and leadership.
* Create, maintain, and manage test environments, test data, and system access necessary to support testing activities.
* Ensure adherence to organizational QA standards, SDLC processes, governance requirements, and industry best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing methodologies, automation frameworks, processes, and overall software quality.
* Mentor and coach junior QA team members through knowledge sharing, test reviews, technical guidance, and professional development support.
* Maintain deep knowledge of business processes, applications, emerging technologies, and quality engineering practices to support organizational objectives.
* Uphold ethical standards and comply with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and professional responsibilities.

**Experience and Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree with extensive coursework in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired is necessary.
* Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible software QA analysis experience.
* Excellent understanding of quality assurance processes and testing methodology
* Experience with selenium, Playwright, Cypress, postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Experience with cloud platforms and devops practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted testing tools and quality engineering solutions
* Knowledge of the entire software development process (SDLC)
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Thorough knowledge of test planning and operations
* Demonstrated experience creating effective test plans and metrics
* Prior experience in conducting risk assessments
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Contract Type:** Full Time; Permanent  
**Location:** Noida, India  
  
**JOB OVERVIEW**  
  
The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow.
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling.
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies.
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies.
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk.
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice.
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards.
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO.
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce-related Service Desk tickets.
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance.
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed.
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery.
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience.
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable.
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required.
* Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies.
* Practical Salesforce administration experience including users, permissions, security, objects, fields, configuration and Flow.
* Experience working with integrations and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP.
* Experience using Git and working within a structured deployment or CI/CD process.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable technical or administrative activities.
* Strong engineering and problem-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.
* Data management and relational database knowledge, including data formats, joins and ETL concepts.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce development, deployment and platform best practices.

Lead Strategic Sourcing Analyst- Systems Analyst- Procurement Operations

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Job Summary
  
To help the Sourcing & Procurement organization maximize the value of its workflow, reporting, and procurement technology. Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will manage the intake, analysis, coordination, and delivery of system and process enhancements that improve procurement execution, visibility, compliance, and stakeholder experience.
  
The Senior Systems Analyst will serve as a connector between Procurement Operations, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders. The role will translate business needs into structured requirements, workflows, system changes, reports, automations, and operating procedures. Success requires strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, change leadership, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or fast-moving initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
  
Portfolio, Intake, and Initiative Management
  

* Orchestrate the intake process for new Procurement Operations requests, system enhancements, reporting needs, process issues, and special projects.
* Maintain a structured portfolio of active and planned initiatives, including priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, and expected outcomes.
* Develop practical workflows and governance routines that improve transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and timely delivery of procurement initiatives.
* Prepare status updates, decision materials, action logs, and executive-ready communications for Procurement leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Facilitate recurring working sessions and follow up on decisions and actions to keep initiatives moving to completion.

Systems Analysis and Process Design
  

* Gather and document business requirements for procurement workflow, ERP, spend analytics, reporting, supplier, Accounts Payable, and related systems.
* Map current and future-state processes, identify pain points and control gaps, and recommend practical improvements to reduce cycle time, rework, and manual effort.
* Translate requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, process diagrams, and configuration or development requests.
* Partner with system owners and Technology to evaluate options, clarify feasibility, manage dependencies, and support prioritization decisions.
* Help ensure system design supports Procurement policies, approval requirements, category management, data quality, auditability, and the needs of global stakeholders.

Testing, Implementation, and Adoption
  

* Coordinate testing and UAT for system enhancements, workflow changes, integrations, reports, and automations.
* Develop test scenarios, expected results, defect logs, resolution tracking, and go-live readiness assessments.
* Support implementation planning, stakeholder communications, training materials, standard operating procedures, and post-implementation adoption.
* Monitor results after implementation and confirm that changes achieve expected outcomes without introducing new operational or control issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of system functionality, business rules, process ownership, and change history.

Automation and Operational Improvement
  

* Identify repeatable, manual, and error-prone activities that can be simplified or automated through workflow, integrations, reporting, or low-code solutions.
* Partner with Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, Finance, and Technology to design and implement practical automations that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify root causes of delays, duplicate work, missing information, approval bottlenecks, and compliance risk.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and help measure the impact of changes on cycle time, quality, adoption, workload, and stakeholder experience.

Stakeholder Partnership and Change Management
  

* Build trusted relationships with Category Managers, Procurement Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Explain system and process changes clearly, tailor communications to the audience, and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities.
* Raise risks and dependencies early, facilitate resolution across teams, and maintain momentum when priorities or requirements change.
* Support the rollout of workflow tools, reporting processes, procurement controls, and other initiatives that improve how the organization operates.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Process Improvement, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in Procurement Operations, Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Project Management, Change Management, Process Improvement, or a related role.
* Experience implementing or improving workflow tools, procurement systems, ERP processes, reporting solutions, or software used across multiple teams.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes, coordinating testing and UAT, managing defects, and supporting implementation and adoption.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to structure workflows, manage multiple priorities, and deliver work to defined timelines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data manipulation, and analysis of operational data.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, learn new systems quickly, and convert business problems into practical process or technology solutions.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience with procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, invoice automation, supplier management, or contract lifecycle systems.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SQL, APIs, or other automation and data tools.
* Experience supporting procurement compliance, SOX controls, audit remediation, Accounts Payable initiatives, or policy implementations.
* Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed stakeholders and shared-service operations.
* Lean Six Sigma, PMP, CIPS, APICS, business analysis, or other relevant certification.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.

**What We Look For**

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer**
The Senior Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer leads Hillenbrand's Exchange Online, Teams and Microsoft 365 collaboration services across a large, global enterprise. The role focuses on standardization, security, cost optimization and resilience. It drives consolidation of acquired and legacy environments into a single Microsoft 365 tenant, directs managed service providers, and owns eDiscovery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead engineering, architecture and operations for Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive, including the small on-premises Exchange footprint.
* Own mail flow and messaging: domains, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, permissions, and secure mail relay for applications and devices.
* Lead tenant and domain consolidation toward one tenant, including assessment, migration, coexistence and cutover.
* Manage Microsoft 365 licensing: assign, reclaim and consolidate SKUs and add-ons (Teams Phone, Audio Conferencing, Teams Premium, Teams Rooms) and report cost savings.
* Administer Teams on the Microsoft side: Direct Routing and Calling Plans, policies, call quality and Teams Rooms, coordinating with the telephony team and carriers.
* Own eDiscovery in Microsoft Purview: holds, searches, exports and case management, in partnership with Legal and HR.
* Contribute to Defender for Office 365 and DLP: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing and anti-spam policies, policy tuning and incident follow-up with the security team.
* Share ownership of Entra Connect and hybrid identity sync with the data center team.
* Support retention, sensitivity labels, audit logging, guest and external sharing controls, and mailbox and Teams lifecycle management.
* Direct and hold accountable managed service providers for Microsoft 365 and messaging operations.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, automation and AI to improve efficiency and produce reporting on licenses, mail flow, Teams usage and call quality.
* Define and report KPIs for mail delivery, Teams quality, license utilization, security posture and project progress.
* Partner with identity, infrastructure, network, security, application and service-desk teams, and with ServiceNow for incident, change and CMDB processes.
* Maintain standards, runbooks and documentation, and participate in a light on-call rotation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of enterprise experience with Exchange (Online and hybrid) and Microsoft 365.
* Deep knowledge of mail flow and messaging security: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, connectors, transport rules, Autodiscover and mailbox permissions.
* Proven M&A experience: tenant-to-tenant migrations, domain and mail-flow consolidation, and legacy rationalization.
* Hands-on Teams administration, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans and meeting rooms.
* Experience with eDiscovery and compliance tooling (Microsoft Purview or equivalent).
* Strong PowerShell and Microsoft Graph skills, plus working knowledge of Entra ID, Entra Connect and hybrid identity.
* Experience managing managed service providers to defined service levels.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration in a multi-tenant enterprise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Teams Phone and PSTN experience (carriers, SBCs, numbering, emergency calling).
* Microsoft 365 licensing and cost optimization (EA/CSP).
* Defender for Office 365, DLP and conditional access within a Zero Trust approach.
* Tenant migration tools (such as Quest or BitTitan) and ServiceNow.

Technology Stack
  
  

* Messaging: Exchange Online, on-premises Exchange, shared mailboxes
* Collaboration and voice: Teams, Teams Phone (Direct Routing, Calling Plans), Teams Rooms, OneDrive
* Identity: Entra ID, Entra Connect, conditional access
* Security and compliance: Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview (eDiscovery, DLP, retention, labels)
* Automation and operations: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure, Intune, ServiceNow

**Who We Are**
Mold-Masters (www.moldmasters.com) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
  
  
Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. + System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.

title: Risk Consulting-Digital Risk-Manager-Tech And Cyber Audit
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY**
**– Risk Consulting – Manager - Tech & Cyber Audit**
As part of Risk Consulting, you will lead and support client engagements focused on Tecnology and Cybersecurity audits across the MENA region. You will work with banks, regulators, financial institutions and clients across other regulated sectors to review IT and Cybersecurity practices/frameworks, operating models and remediation programmes.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager – Tech & Cyber Audit to lead and execute technology audit, regulatory compliance, operational resilience, and technology risk management engagements within the financial services and other regulated sectors. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in IT audit, cybersecurity, technology infrastructure, cloud risk, operational resilience, digital banking, payment systems, and regulatory frameworks applicable to banks and financial institutions.
  
  
This role will partner with senior management, regulators, internal audit, risk management, and technology teams to assess risks, evaluate controls, ensure regulatory adherence, and drive remediation of identified issues across complex technology environments. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Regulatory Compliance & Governance**

* Lead regulatory compliance assessments against applicable banking, financial services, cybersecurity, operational resilience, and technology risk regulations.
* Perform regulatory gap assessments and compliance reviews across technology, cybersecurity, cloud, payment systems, data management, and third-party risk domains.
* Support regulatory examinations, inspections, and remediation programs.
* Track and validate remediation of regulatory findings, audit observations, and management action plans.
* Interpret new regulatory requirements and assess their impact on technology and business operations.
* Develop and maintain compliance monitoring and continuous assurance programs.

**IT Audit & Assurance**

* Lead risk-based IT audits covering:

+ IT General Controls (ITGC)
+ Application Controls
+ Cybersecurity
+ Cloud Computing
+ Infrastructure & Operations
+ Data Management
+ Payments & Digital Banking
+ Third-Party Risk Management
+ Operational Resilience
+ DevSecOps and SDLC

* Conduct walkthroughs to understand business and technology processes, identify risks, and assess control effectiveness.
* Evaluate design and operating effectiveness of controls using established audit methodologies.
* Prepare and review audit planning documents, risk assessments, testing strategies, workpapers, and audit reports.
* Present audit observations and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders.
* Lead continuous auditing and continuous monitoring activities across critical technology environments.

**Technology Risk Management**

* Perform quantitative and qualitative technology risk assessments.
* Evaluate residual risks against organizational risk appetite.
* Assess effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies and compensating controls.
* Monitor and challenge technology risk issues and remediation activities.
* Support enterprise risk and operational resilience initiatives.

**Operational Resilience & Cybersecurity**

* Assess operational resilience capabilities including:

+ Business Continuity Management
+ Disaster Recovery
+ Backup & Recovery Controls
+ Incident Management
+ Crisis Management
+ Technology Resilience

* Evaluate cybersecurity programs, security governance, access management, encryption controls, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Conduct reviews of digital banking, e-wallet, payment gateway, middleware, and critical banking applications.

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Manage audit teams and regulatory compliance professionals across multiple engagements.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members.
* Coordinate with senior business, technology, risk, compliance, and audit stakeholders.
* Prepare executive-level reporting and present findings to governance committees and leadership teams.
* Drive engagement planning, resource management, budgeting, and delivery excellence.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree in Technology, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* Nine to twelve years of relevant experience in IT and Cyber security audit and advisory experience
* Experience within banks, regulators, consulting firms or other financial institutions.
* Demonstrable experience leading IT and Cyber security audits and remediation programs
* Experience managing teams and engaging with executive management, Board committees, regulators and senior client stakeholders.

**Mobility and travel**

* Willingness and ability to travel to client locations at short notice, with an expectation of approximately 50% onsite travel.
* A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching and practical experience. We value our people and provide opportunities to shape your development through challenging assignments, knowledge exchange and collaboration. We offer:

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer (Contractual)
description:
**Key responsibilities**

**Cloud security (AWS and GCP)**

* Design, implement and continuously audit security baselines across AWS accounts and GCP projects: IAM, networking, encryption, logging and organization-level policies.
* Run cloud security posture management and close misconfigurations before they reach production.
* Enforce least-privilege access, short-lived credentials, workload identity and strong secrets management.

**DevSecOps and pipeline security**

* Build security into CI/CD: SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container and IaC scanning, and artifact signing, with clear pass/fail gates.
* Secure infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) using policy-as-code and review standards.
* Harden Kubernetes and container workloads (EKS, GKE), images and registries.

**Detection, response and resilience**

* Own cloud logging, monitoring and alerting: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Cloud Audit Logs and Security Command Center, feeding a central SIEM.
* Lead technical triage and containment for security incidents, run post-incident reviews and drive remediation to closure.
* Maintain and test incident response runbooks and recovery procedures.

**Vulnerability and risk management**

* Run vulnerability management across infrastructure, dependencies and images, with severity-based SLAs and tracked remediation.
* Perform threat modelling and security reviews on new services and architecture changes.
* Coordinate penetration tests and act on their findings.

**Governance and enablement**

* Support compliance and audit readiness (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and applicable data-protection requirements) with automated evidence collection.
* Document standards, coach engineers on secure practices and be the go-to security partner for product and platform teams.

**Required qualifications**

* 8+ years in security engineering, DevSecOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security.
* Hands-on, production-level depth in both AWS and Google Cloud security: IAM design, VPC/network segmentation, KMS, logging, organization-level guardrails (AWS Organizations and SCPs; GCP Organization Policy).
* Strong infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform (CloudFormation or Pulumi a plus), including policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel, Checkov or similar).
* Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Cloud Build) with integrated security scanning.
* Hands-on experience with security tooling in at least four of these areas: CSPM, SAST/DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, SIEM, EDR and vulnerability scanning.
* Practical Kubernetes and container security experience (EKS and/or GKE).
* Real incident response experience: triage, containment, forensics on cloud workloads, root cause analysis and written post-incident reports.
* Proficiency in Python, Go or Bash for automation and tooling.
* Solid grasp of application and infrastructure security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, zero trust, encryption and key management.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief both engineers and leadership.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, CKS or GCSA.
* Experience in a regulated environment such as fintech or payments, including PCI DSS or SOC 2 audits.
* Experience with SOAR, security data lakes or detection-as-code.
* Experience with cloud forensics, DFIR tooling and tabletop exercises.
* Contributions to security tooling, open-source projects or published research.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Penetration testing.**
Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.
  
  
**Threat hunting.**
Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.
  
  
**Adversary simulation and purple teaming**
. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.
  
  
**Automation.**
Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.
  
  
**Reporting.**
Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
**Experience.**
3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.
  
  
**Endpoint and network depth.**
You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.
  
  
**Tooling and scripting.**
You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  
  
**AI awareness.**
You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.
  
  
**Practical credentials.**
Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.
  
  
**GOOD TO HAVE**

* An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd
* Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to
* Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements
* GCP and Kubernetes attack paths
* Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

**WHY JOIN US**
**High autonomy**
You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.
  
  
**Builder culture**
Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.
  
  
**Perks And Benefits**

* Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction
* Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development
* Competitive compensation with equity ownership
* Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget
* A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

title: Incident Responder
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
We are seeking a dedicated Incident Responder to join our Cyber Security Incident Response Team to investigate, analyze, and contain cyber threats. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying and mitigating security incidents, collaborating closely with internal teams to ensure swift threat containment and recovery. You will leverage your technical expertise in log analysis, intrusion detection, and digital forensics to protect our environment while helping to refine established response procedures. This role requires a self-motivated professional capable of prioritizing tasks under time constraints, participating in on-call rotations outside of standard business hours, and maintaining detailed incident documentation. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact on our security posture, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager - CSIRT.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance the efficiency of log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
* Monitor for and investigate security incidents involving AI/ML models, such as adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and model evasion
* Conduct thorough investigations into security incidents, identify root causes, and recommend remediation efforts to prevent future occurrences
* Participate in proactive threat hunting utilizing various security tools and platforms to identify vulnerabilities, suspicious activity, and potential security gaps
* Analyze suspicious files and indicators of compromise (IoCs) to understand the scope of an incident and identify compromised systems or data
* Assist in the creation, maintenance, and optimization of incident response playbooks and procedures to address evolving threats
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Security Operations, Engineering, and Legal, during active security incidents to ensure effective containment and mitigation
* Utilize internal and external threat intelligence sources to proactively identify and mitigate emerging threats before they materialize
* Work hands-on with security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms) to investigate alerts, reduce false positives, and support the continuous improvement of detection capabilities
* Perform post-incident analysis and daily reporting, providing detailed documentation of lessons learned and suggesting areas for security posture improvement

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on Security Operations (SOC) and/or Incident Response
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, incident response lifecycles, and security best practices
* Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel) for alert analysis and log correlation
* Familiarity with EDR solutions and their role in incident investigation
* Strong familiarity with digital forensics principles and techniques and enterprise forensic solutions
* Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and data analysis
* Deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber kill chain
* Understanding of AI-driven security threats, including adversarial attacks and model evasion, and the ability to leverage AI/ML tools to enhance incident response and threat hunting

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCFA, or CEH
* Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms
* Exposure to cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently under pressure
* Knowledge of how to protect against AI threats and using it in day to day work
* Experience with AI security frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS or OWASP Top 10 for LLMs

Life at Docusign
  
  
**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
  
  
If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
  
  
**AI in Our Hiring Process**
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.

title: Senior Test Specialist - Network Security
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Security Testing SME will lead security testing and vulnerability assessment across web, API, mobile, cloud, and enterprise applications. The role requires deep expertise in **DAST, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, API security, threat modeling, and security testing governance**, with responsibility for identifying security risks, guiding remediation, and embedding security testing within the SDLC/DevSecOps lifecycle.

Lead **security testing, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT)** for web, mobile, API, and cloud-based applications.Perform and govern **DAST** using tools such as **Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, HCL AppScan, Invicti/Acunetix, or equivalent**.Assess applications against **OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CWE and CVSS**.Conduct manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities, exploitability, business impact, and potential attack paths.Define **security test strategy, test plans, methodologies, standards, entry/exit criteria, and security quality gates**.Test authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, encryption, API endpoints, and business-logic vulnerabilities.Analyze security findings, eliminate false positives, determine severity, and provide actionable remediation recommendations to development teams.Partner with development, architecture, infrastructure and DevOps teams to integrate **security testing into CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines**.Perform security reviews for REST/SOAP APIs and microservices, including authentication mechanisms such as **OAuth 2.0, JWT and API keys**.Support application threat modeling and risk-based security testing using frameworks such as **STRIDE**.Track vulnerabilities through remediation and retesting, ensuring effective closure of identified security issues.Define security-testing metrics, dashboards and governance reporting for senior stakeholders.Mentor security testers and provide technical guidance for complex vulnerability and penetration-testing scenarios.Support security audits, compliance assessments and customer security reviews.

Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)  
Web, API, Mobile & Cloud Security Testing  
OWASP Top 10, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling  
DevSecOps & CI/CD Security Integration  
Tools: Burp Suite, Veracode, Checkmarx, Qualys, Nessus, Fortify  
AWS/Azure Security

Cloud Testing,Network Security

CLOUD SECURITY,OWASP,VAPT Tool - Others,CI/CD

----------------------

**OSCP / OSWE / CEH / CISSP** or equivalent security certificationExperience establishing enterprise-level security-testing frameworks and governance.Strong stakeholder management, technical consulting and security-risk communication skills.Experience leading security assessments for large enterprise environments.

title: Threat Modeler, AVP
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a Threat Modeler. You will be responsible for supporting threat modeling activities across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, APIs, and emerging technologies. Working closely with architects, engineers, developers, and cybersecurity teams, you will help identify security risks early in the technology lifecycle and contribute to secure-by-design initiatives across the organization.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
The team you will be joining is part of the Security Architecture organization, a function that is critical to safeguarding the firm's applications, cloud environments, data, and technology services. Threat modeling enables the organization to proactively identify security weaknesses, reduce cyber risk, and incorporate security requirements into technology solutions before they are deployed.

As a
**Threat Modeler**
, you will:
  
  

* Participate in threat modeling assessments for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and technology initiatives.
* Analyze application architectures, data flows, trust boundaries, and cloud deployments to identify potential threats and security weaknesses.
* Support the development of risk mitigation recommendations and secure design guidance.
* Collaborate with application development, cloud engineering, and cybersecurity teams to improve security outcomes.
* Contribute to threat modeling standards, reusable patterns, documentation, and security awareness initiatives.

**What We Value**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Knowledge of application security, cloud security, and secure software development principles.

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Own Manastu Space’s IT end to end:
**infrastructure, cloud, compute, devices, security and data protection**
.
**Design and run**
our infrastructure in-house,
**manage every device centrally**
,
**build our IT security practice from the ground up**
, and
**give our software, simulation and AI teams the compute and tools they need**
. Be
**accountable for all IT procurement and cost**
, and
**establish SOPs for all IT operations**
.

**Role Overview**

This is the senior, hands-on owner of IT at a fast-growing deep-tech company. You will
**design**
our network, systems and cloud, run them yourself, and
**build and lead the IT team**
as we grow.

You will work closely with our
**software, simulation, AI and engineering teams**
to map what they need (compute, GPU/CPU clusters, storage, software, licences and security) and deliver it within budget. You will also own the IT budget, every licence and every vendor relationship, and
**establish the SOPs**
that let IT run consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure and systems design:**
  Design the end-to-end IT architecture and turn company-wide requirements into an approved roadmap and budget.
* **Network and infrastructure:**
  Own firewalls, Wi-Fi, switching and secure remote access (ZTNA), and fix network issues such as Wi-Fi reliability, speed and ISP redundancy.
* **Identity, devices and security:**
  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
