title: Senior Vulnerability Researcher
description:
**About Ethara AI**

Ethara AI is an Indian AI company with more than 2,000 engineers. We build reinforcement-learning environments, evaluation harnesses and post-training data for the world's leading AI labs.

About the team

Our Cyber AI team applies that expertise to security. We are building a sovereign, on-premise AI platform that finds, proves and fixes security weaknesses for Indian government departments and regulated enterprises in banking, insurance, telecom and healthcare. Models are trained in Ethara-built environments, never on client data, and every action runs under strict scope controls, human approval and full audit.

The role

Decide what the training environments must contain, and check that what the AI finds and fixes is real.

**What you'll do**

* Specify the vulnerability classes, technology stacks and attack chains the environment factory builds
* Design synthetic flaw injection so the models face realistic, unseen problems
* Review a sample of AI findings and patches every release; flag false positives and broken fixes
* Write the safe proof-of-concept policy: what may run in a sandbox, what never runs
* Mentor application security engineers and environment engineers

**Must have**

* 8+ years of vulnerability research or exploit development
* Public evidence of work: CVEs, top bug bounty rankings, CTF results, or conference talks
* Strong across web and API vulnerabilities; comfortable reading Java, PHP and .NET, the languages most government and banking systems use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven research work counts more than formal qualifications

**Nice to have**

* Reverse engineering or memory-corruption exploitation
* Experience evaluating or training AI systems for security tasks

**Eligibility**

* Indian nationality and successful police verification, as this role works on government systems and data
* Willingness to work on-site in secure client facilities; some defence work may require formal security clearance
* Agreement to Ethara's NDA and responsible-use policy: no testing outside authorised scope, and no use of our tools against anyone who has not authorised it

title: Deputy Vice President - Security Engineering & Architecture
description:
**Role Purpose:**
The Security Engineering & Architecture Lead will lead the design, governance and continuous evolution of the organization cyber security architecture, engineering standards and control framework. The role is accountable for ensuring that security requirements are embedded across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, data environments and emerging technologies.

The role will act as the principal security architecture authority, enabling secure business transformation through risk-based security solutions, regulatory compliance, technology resilience and alignment with enterprise security strategy.

**Role Accountability**

**A. Security Architecture, Standards & Design Governance**

1. Define and maintain security reference architectures for network, cloud, applications, identity, data, payment platforms, APIs and digital channels.
2. Establish security design standards, approved patterns and reusable engineering blueprints aligned to enterprise risk, regulatory and internal control requirements.
3. Lead security design reviews for major initiatives, technology changes, outsourcing arrangements and third-party integrations before production go-live.
4. Own security architecture for cardholder data environments, transaction-processing systems and regulated technology platforms.

**B. Security Controls, Engineering Roadmap & Hardening**

1. Translate security control frameworks into implementable technology requirements across infrastructure, applications, cloud, identity and data environments.
2. Govern security engineering roadmaps across endpoint security, IAM/PAM, data protection, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, telemetry and cloud security.
3. Establish security baseline configurations and hardening standards, and drive enforcement through architecture reviews, automation and compliance checks.
4. Define and govern cryptography, encryption, tokenization, key management and certificate management standards across enterprise technology platforms.

**C. Secure-by-Design, Threat Modelling & Automation**

1. Drive threat modelling for critical applications, integrations and platforms, ensuring risks are documented, prioritized and tracked to closure.
2. Partner with enterprise architecture, IT, platform and engineering teams to embed security-by-design into SDLC, infrastructure builds and cloud deployments.
3. Drive adoption of automated security engineering practices, including policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security checks and automated baseline compliance.

**D. Governance, Exceptions & Continuous Improvement**

1. Maintain the security exceptions register, including expiry dates, compensating controls, risk acceptance and closure mechanisms.
2. Partner with SOC, vulnerability management and incident response teams to convert threat intelligence, incidents and recurring control failures into improved architecture patterns.
3. Ensure security architecture inputs are embedded into enterprise architecture forums, technology design authorities and change governance processes.
4. Lead security engineering teams and vendors, ensuring delivery quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and adherence to approved standards.

**Measures of Success**

1. Approved security architecture patterns are available and used across key technology domains.
2. Major technology changes are security-reviewed before go-live with clear risk decisions.
3. Security design gaps reduce across cloud, infrastructure, applications, APIs, identity and data platforms.
4. Critical payment, digital and regulated platforms follow defined security architecture standards.
5. Security exceptions reduce through better design standards, compensating controls and closure tracking.
6. Security baselines and hardening standards are translated into implementable engineering requirements.
7. Architecture decisions, control mappings and exceptions remain documented and audit-ready.

**Technical Skills**

1. Application, API & DevSecOps Security Architecture
2. Cyber Resilience & Crisis Strategy Leadership
3. Database, Infrastructure & Network Security Architecture
4. Program Strategy, Portfolio Governance & Executive Reporting
5. Security & AI Governance, & Policy Interpretation
6. Security Architecture Governance & Secure Design Assurance
7. AI/ML, GenAI & Emerging Technology Security Architecture
8. Security Engineering, Tooling & Platform Integration

**Exposure to below mentioned Technologies / Frameworks / Methodologies**

1. SABSA
2. TOGAF
3. NIST CSF
4. ISO 27001 / ISO 27002
5. CIS Controls
6. NIST SSDF
7. STRIDE / PASTA threat modelling
8. Security reference architectures
9. Architecture review boards
10. GRC platforms
11. Cloud security guardrails
12. DevSecOps security standards
13. Infrastructure-as-code scanning tools
14. SAST / DAST / SCA tools

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree / B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security or related engineering discipline;

Additional academic exposure, Executive education or equivalent experience in security architecture, enterprise architecture or technology risk preferred.

**Preferred Industry:**
BFSI, payments, banking, NBFC, fintech, large regulated enterprises with complex cloud, API, digital platform and customer data environments.

The analyst is responsible for the day-to-day work of discovering, validating, prioritizing, and tracking remediation of vulnerabilities and exposures across managed client environments. * Validate findings to confirm exploitability and reduce false positives before remediation is dispatched.

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

  of experience in VMware Cloud Foundation knowledge across infrastructure and networking domains.

  deployment and operational experience.

* Strong understanding of
  **network security, segmentation, micro-segmentation and Zero Trust principles**
  .

* VMware/Broadcom certification aligned to VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere or NSX is preferred.
* CCNP or CCIE Enterprise/Data Centre certification is preferred.
* Cisco Data Centre or ACI certification is desirable.
* Relevant cloud, automation, security or IT service-management certifications are advantageous.

description:

title: Telematics Engineer @ Bengaluru, India
description:

Role and Responsibility.

Telematics / Connected Vehicle Engineer

Locations: Bangalore, India

Employment Type: Full-time / Contract

Experience: 5–10+ years, depending on level

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Telematics / Connected Vehicle Engineer to design, integrate, and support connected-vehicle and fleet telematics solutions.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working across vehicle hardware, embedded systems, communication networks, telematics devices, cloud platforms, APIs, and vehicle data. The role will focus on enabling reliable collection and transmission of vehicle information such as GPS/location, vehicle operating parameters, diagnostics, fault information, utilization, and vehicle health data.

Experience working with telematics solution providers, OEM connected-vehicle platforms, fleet-management solutions, or aftermarket telematics devices is highly desirable.

An additional area of interest is the use of vehicle and historical telemetry data for vehicle-health monitoring, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and failure prediction.

Key Responsibilities

Telematics & Connected Vehicle Integration

\* Design, integrate, test, and support vehicle telematics and connected-vehicle solutions.

\* Integrate telematics hardware/devices with vehicle electronic systems and cloud platforms.

\* Work with vehicle interfaces and protocols such as CAN, CAN FD, OBD-II, J1939, UDS, Ethernet and related automotive communication protocols.

\* Interface with ECUs, gateways, sensors, GPS/GNSS modules, cellular modems, and Telematics Control Units (TCUs).

\* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, embedded software, vehicle networks, cellular connectivity, cloud platforms, and applications.

Vehicle Location & Connectivity

\* Implement and support solutions for capturing and transmitting:

\* GPS/GNSS location

\* Vehicle movement and trip information

\* Mileage and utilization

\* Speed and driving events

\* Ignition and vehicle status

\* Geofencing events

\* Experience with cellular technologies such as 4G/LTE/5G, SIM/eSIM and IoT connectivity is desirable.

\* Understand challenges related to connectivity, latency, offline data storage, retransmission, and remote-device management.

Vehicle Health & Diagnostics

\* Capture and interpret vehicle diagnostic and operational information including:

\* Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs)

\* Battery/voltage status

\* Engine and powertrain parameters

\* Fuel/energy consumption

\* Temperature and sensor information

\* Vehicle mileage and operating hours

\* Component/system health indicators

\* Develop or integrate solutions for remote vehicle diagnostics and vehicle-health monitoring.

\* Work with engineering teams to translate raw vehicle signals into actionable vehicle-health information.

Telematics Platform & Cloud Integration

\* Integrate vehicle/telematics data with enterprise and cloud platforms using REST APIs, MQTT, streaming technologies, event-based architectures, and other integration mechanisms.

\* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud is desirable.

\* Work with telematics solution providers and technology partners to integrate their platforms into customer environments.

\* Support high-volume ingestion and processing of vehicle telemetry data.

\* Develop integrations between telematics platforms and fleet-management, maintenance, ERP, analytics, or other enterprise applications.

Predictive Maintenance & Analytics – Preferred

Candidates with experience applying analytics, machine learning, or AI to connected-vehicle data will be strongly preferred.

Relevant experience may include:

\* Predictive vehicle maintenance

\* Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation

\* Component failure prediction

\* Vehicle-health scoring

\* Battery-health prediction

\* Anomaly detection

\* Fault-pattern identification

\* Maintenance optimization

\* Fleet reliability analytics

Ability to work with data scientists and engineering teams to convert vehicle telemetry → health indicators → predictive insights → maintenance recommendations would be valuable.

Required Qualifications

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

\* 4+ years of experience in automotive telematics, connected vehicles, automotive embedded systems, fleet telematics, or IoT.

\* Hands-on experience integrating vehicle hardware and software systems.

\* Strong understanding of automotive communication protocols, particularly CAN/CAN FD and OBD-II.

\* Experience working with GPS/GNSS and cellular-connected devices.

\* Experience collecting and interpreting vehicle telemetry and diagnostic data.

\* Experience integrating telematics platforms using APIs and/or IoT messaging protocols.

\* Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, firmware/software, connectivity, and cloud environments.

\* Ability to work with OEMs, suppliers, telematics providers, engineering teams, and enterprise technology teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:

\* OEM connected-vehicle platforms

\* Telematics Control Units (TCUs)

\* Fleet-management systems

\* Commercial vehicle telematics

\* EV telematics and battery-health monitoring

\* Remote diagnostics

\* OTA/FOTA/SOTA systems

\* Edge computing

\* Automotive cybersecurity

\* AWS IoT / Azure IoT / Google Cloud

\* MQTT / Kafka / streaming data architectures

\* Python, C/C++, Java or similar languages

\* SQL and time-series/telemetry databases

\* Data analytics and machine learning

\* Predictive maintenance and anomaly detection

\* Vehicle digital twins

Relevant Industry Experience

Candidates may come from environments such as:

Automotive OEMs | Tier-1 suppliers | Connected-vehicle platforms | Fleet-management companies | Telematics solution providers | Commercial vehicle manufacturers | Automotive IoT companies | Mobility technology companies

What Success Looks Like

The successful engineer should be comfortable working across the complete connected-vehicle technology chain:

Vehicle / ECU / Sensors → CAN & Vehicle Network → Telematics Device / TCU → GPS & Cellular Connectivity → IoT / Cloud Platform → Data & APIs → Analytics → Vehicle Health & Predictive Maintenance

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who understands not only how to capture vehicle data, but also how to reliably transport, integrate, analyze, and convert that data into meaningful operational and maintenance insights.

title: Staff Engineer - Fabric Gateway
description:
**Who Are We?**
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
  
  
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
  
  
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Fabric Gateway team. Fabric Gateway is Postman's protocol-agnostic control plane for the agentic world: a single gateway that routes, governs, and observes how AI agents, LLMs, MCP servers, CLIs, and internal APIs discover and interact with each other—deployed in Postman's cloud, the customer's VPC, or a hybrid of both.
  
  
This role is ideal for a highly technical engineer who has built high-throughput, low-latency gateways or proxies and wants to define what that layer looks like when the callers are autonomous agents rather than applications and humans. You will shape the architecture of the data plane, control plane, registry, and policy engine, and you will own the hard problems: performance on the hot path, fail-closed security, multi-tenant isolation, and reliability across thousands of upstream providers.
  
  
As a Staff Engineer, you will operate as a force multiplier across engineering teams. You will partner closely with Platform, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and AI teams—and directly with enterprise customers—to make Fabric Gateway the trusted way organizations connect agents to their APIs.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Drive the technical vision and architecture for Fabric Gateway across its registry, control plane, data plane, and SDKs and connectors.
* Design and build a high-performance, horizontally scalable data plane that routes HTTP, gRPC, MCP, and A2A traffic with minimal added latency.
* Build the policy engine that authenticates, authorizes, classifies, and logs every agent interaction before it happens, with fail-closed behavior when policy cannot be verified.
* Own reliability features on the hot path: fallback chains, circuit breakers, health-aware routing, rate limiting, and weighted traffic distribution across LLM and API providers.
* Design secure credential brokering so upstream secrets are injected by the gateway and never exposed to agents.
* Shape the extensibility model—plugins, policy instances, and connectors—so customers and internal teams can extend the gateway safely.
* Make the gateway operable at enterprise scale across Postman-hosted, self-hosted (Kubernetes or VM), and hybrid deployments, including upgrades, configuration distribution, and multi-region data planes.
* Partner with Observability and Data teams on real-time token metering, cost controls, traces, analytics, and audit-ready logs.
* Investigate complex production and customer issues, identify root causes, and drive long-term corrective actions.
* Mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, and help raise the technical bar across the organization.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant exposure to distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep experience building or operating API gateways, reverse proxies, service meshes, or other latency-sensitive networking infrastructure (for example Envoy, NGINX, Kong, Apigee, Istio, or custom proxies).
* Strong understanding of networking and protocols, including HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, streaming responses, TLS, and connection management.
* Hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization at scale: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, mTLS, API keys, secrets management, and fine-grained policy (for example OPA or Cedar).
* Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS systems with strong isolation, and shipping software that customers run in their own environments.
* Strong programming experience in Go, Rust, Java, C++, Node.js, or similar, with a track record of performance profiling and optimization.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority.
* Strong communication skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols, or LLM provider APIs and their streaming, token, and rate-limit semantics.
* Experience building AI gateways, LLM routers, or agent infrastructure—including token metering, cost controls, prompt or response guardrails, and PII classification.
* Background in building control planes and configuration distribution systems (for example xDS-style APIs) for fleets of data-plane nodes.
* Experience with plugin or extension runtimes such as WebAssembly, Lua, or sandboxed scripting.
* Experience in security-sensitive domains: zero-trust architectures, least-privilege access, audit logging, and compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA.
* Contributions to open-source networking, gateway, or AI infrastructure projects.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Fabric Gateway sits at the center of Postman's bet on the agentic world. As enterprises deploy AI agents that act autonomously across their systems, they need infrastructure that governs what those agents can discover, what they can access, and what actions they are authorized to take. Fabric Gateway is that control layer, and it extends Postman's Private API Network and governance into an agent-first interface fabric.
  
  
Success in this role means building the gateway that security teams trust, platform teams can run at scale, and agent builders actually want to use. Every request that passes through it depends on the decisions you make about latency, policy, and reliability.
  
  
This is a high-impact Staff Engineer position for someone who enjoys solving hard distributed systems and networking problems and wants to define a new category of infrastructure from the ground up.
  
  
**What Else?**
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
  
  
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
  
  
**Our Values**
At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

MQTT / IoT Core, CI/CD, Go, RDS or Aurora Terraform, AWS, Python
  
  
**Texecom is Looking for:******
**Job Title: Senior Platform Engineer**
**Who are we?**
Texecom Ltd is a leading manufacturer and provider of professional security products, systems, and services. Our innovative solutions are designed to protect the things you care about, wherever they are. Texecom Cloud is the approved alarm signalling platform those systems depend on. When an intruder alarm
  
  
activates, our platform is what carries that signal to a monitoring centre. It is certified against EN 50136 for alarm transmission, and it also hosts the suite of subscription digital services that sit at the core of Texecom''s future strategy. That gives the platform an unusual combination of constraints. It has to behave like critical infrastructure on availability and signalling integrity, and like a modern product platform on delivery pace. Both at once, on the same estate.
  
  
**What we need?**
We are recruiting two hands-on Senior Platform Engineers to own and advance the AWS platform on which Texecom''s cloud services are built, deployed and operated. Together you will form the core of a new India-based Platform Engineering team.
  
  
You will set the patterns that the wider engineering organisation builds on, operating as a resilient team able to cover the other''s work, so that no part of the platform depends on one person.
  
  
**How can you help us?**
As a Senior Platform Engineer at Texecom, you will be accountable for work of this kind
  
  

* Multiaccount AWS foundation. Account vending and organisational unit structure, a compliantbydefault landing zone, IAM Identity Center role modelling, and getting least privilege to hold across a growing estate.
* Security baseline. Organisationwide security tooling, including threat detection and vulnerability scanning, with findings turned into remediation rather than reports.
* Data layer. Aurora MySQL & DynamoDB at production scale: bluegreen deployment, schema migration safety and rollback, replication topology. Day-to-day database operations are part of the job, not someone else''s.
* Delivery pipelines. Pipeline architecture in Bitbucket Pipelines and AWS CodeBuild, GitOps service manifests, Step Functions deployment orchestration, and guardrails that make the safe path the easy path.
* Device and messaging estate. MQTT broker infrastructure and AWS IoT Core, carrying live traffic from a field estate of alarm panels.
* Observability and cost. Monitoring, alerting, metrics, structured logging and correlation IDs as a platform capability rather than a per-service afterthought, plus auto-scaling and right-sizing where the saving is real and the risk is understood.
* Platform tooling. Internal tooling and automation, largely in Go and Python, including credential and identity tooling used by engineering and operations.
* Golden paths, not application services. Platform Engineering builds the foundations and the paved road that development teams deploy on. Application services are owned by the teams that build them.
* Raising the floor. Training and mentoring the wider Cloud Operations team in platform engineering practice.

**The successful candidate should have**

* Deep, handson AWS. You can design an account and identity model. You have operated production RDS or Aurora and you understand what can go wrong, and how to proactively track, monitor and prevent issues.
* Terraform as your primary tool, at a level where you own modules and shared state.
* An automationfirst mindset, applied to operational toil as readily as to provisioning.
* Strong scripting and tooling skills in one or more of Python, Go, PowerShell or TypeScript, building maintainable tooling rather than throwaway scripts.
* CI/CD design rather than CI/CD usage: pipeline architecture, artefact promotion, continuous delivery, release safety and rollback, and the release patterns that make frequent change safe, including blue-green and canary releases and feature toggling.
* Security as an engineering discipline. Least privilege, secret management, blastradius reasoning, and a working understanding of regulated or compliance constrained environments. ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and NIST alignment experience is valuable.
* Architectural judgment at enterprise scale, across distributed systems: what is safe to change, in what order, and what has to be proven first.
* Production operations experience. You have been on call for a live service, led an incident through to resolution, and written up what changed afterwards.
* Experience of the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through to debug, test and operation.
* Experience of Scrum and Agile delivery, and familiarity with Atlassian tooling (Jira, Confluence).

**How you work matters as much as what you know**
We hire for behaviour as much as technical depth. The qualities below are assessed during the process, not assumed.
  
  

* You test designs before they ship. You raise the difficult question early, including on decisions that have already been agreed, and you back it with evidence.
* You get to the real problem. You clarify the requirement, and you separate out issues that have been bundled together, before you start building.
* You deliver what was agreed. You keep scope tight, note good ideas for later, and make tradeoffs visible rather than absorbing them.
* You respect shared work. You coordinate changes that affect other teams, and you resolve conflicts through conversation rather than by overriding.
* You work from evidence. When a cost, constraint or assumption matters, you verify it.
* You share what you know. Your work comes with documentation a colleague can act on, and you build knowledge across the team rather than holding it.
* You value code review. You give thorough, constructive reviews and expect the same in return. Every change is peer reviewed before it merges, including yours.
* You raise risk early and openly, including when it makes a decision harder.

**It would be an advantage if the candidate had**

* Python at production quality.
* MySQL or Aurora internals, including replication and migration tooling.
* MQTT or IoT messaging at scale.
* Test automation within delivery pipelines.
* FinOps experience: cost modelling, autoscaling economics and commitmentbased pricing.
* AWS security services at organisation scale, such as GuardDuty, Inspector and Security Hub.
* Windows as well as Linux build and packaging targets.
* CloudFormation or CDK/CDKTF, to understand and migrate existing infrastructure.

**How We Work**

* Infrastructure as Code by default. Production changes go through code, with a controlled and recorded route for the rare exceptions.
* Deployment through approved pipelines, promoting through lower environments into production.
* Structured logging with correlation IDs, as a baseline across services.
* Significant design changes are written up as RFCs and reviewed by our Design Authority. Engineers write them. The aim is visible, well-reasoned decisions, not extra process.
* Engineering standards are minimum expectations, increasingly enforced through tooling.

**How to apply for this opportunity?**

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

**About Uplers:**
Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

• Plan and coordinate replication, cutover, validation and transition activities while minimising service disruption and delivery risk.

Microsoft Azure IaaS/PaaS; landing zones; Azure networking, storage, governance and security; hybrid architecture; cloud adoption and migration planning.

Windows Server 2008 R2-2019 or later; Active Directory; DNS; DHCP; Group Policy; WSUS; identity and access management.

**Virtualisation**
VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V administration, assessment, consolidation and migration experience; private cloud modernisation.

**Migration Server**
, application and file migrations; AD consolidation and multi-forest migration; Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migration; cutover and validation.

**Backup & DR**
Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, Veeam, Datto BCDR and/or Zerto; recovery architecture, testing and business continuity planning.

**Networking & Security**
VPNs, hybrid connectivity, segmentation, load balancing concepts, Microsoft Defender, vulnerability management and security uplift programs.

Microsoft 365, Intune, MDM/MAM, endpoint management, patching, monitoring and automation; Datto RMM exposure is advantageous.

HLD/LLD documentation, runbooks, estimation, technical assessments, project delivery governance and operational handover.

• Strong Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory and virtualisation capability.

• Experience leading technical workstreams and coordinating multidisciplinary delivery teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present technical recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.

• Relevant Microsoft certifications are strongly preferred. Examples include Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Windows Server, Microsoft 365 or Security certifications.

• ITIL Foundation and vendor certifications in backup, disaster recovery, virtualisation or security are advantageous.

title: Manager_Transmission Network 2nd Line Operations Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Transmission Network Operations professional to provide second-line NOC support across multi-vendor Access Transmission networks supporting Mobile (UK) and Enterprise (Ireland) services.
  
  
The role focuses on advanced network troubleshooting, incident and fault resolution, change management, network performance and service restoration across IP and transmission technologies including
**BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave**
. You will work across equipment from vendors including
**Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE, ADVA, Huawei, Tellabs, Alcatel and Marconi**
, while collaborating with first-line operations, field teams, network planning, design, provisioning and equipment vendors.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide second-line NOC operational support for Access Transmission networks in a multi-vendor environment covering Mobile (UK) and Enterprise (Ireland) services
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex transmission network faults and incidents, supporting resolution within agreed SLAs
* Manage incidents, faults and network changes, including detailed analysis and service restoration
* Support networks using BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave technologies
* Operate and troubleshoot equipment across vendors including Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE Microwave, ADVA, Huawei, Tellabs, Alcatel, Marconi and Timepictra
* Collaborate with design teams on Line-of-Sight blocked cases, tree-lopping requirements and network re-routing scenarios
* Test new software releases in a laboratory environment before deployment to the live network
* Support FSI, SSI and new vendor/product onboarding, including ADVA, Ericsson Microwave, Cisco 540 and Nokia IXR routers
* Prepare technical Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for network configurations and operational processes, and provide knowledge transfer and training to first-line Transmission Operations teams
* Work with equipment vendors including Cisco, SIAE, Ericsson, Chronos and Penta on critical faults and software or hardware issues, supporting escalation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Support legacy network decommissioning involving Marconi, Alcatel, Tellabs, Tarana, Timepictra and Siemens Microwave equipment, alongside the IP-fication of sites
* Carry out software upgrades, hardware changes, configuration changes and configuration restoration across network infrastructure
* Manage new network elements within EMS/NMS platforms and troubleshoot Microwave-related faults
* Maintain configuration backups for Cisco, Tellabs, Alcatel, ADVA and Nokia equipment
* Monitor the performance of network elements and circuits for errors, alarms and service outages, implementing appropriate preventive and corrective actions
* Analyse logs and technical evidence to determine root causes for critical network outages
* Plan network change activities relating to configuration and commissioning of telecommunications equipment
* Collaborate with Network Planning teams on project roll-outs, capacity enhancements, circuit resiliency and new-site integrations
* Provide technical support to field engineers during service-restoration activities
* Conduct network health checks and produce operational reports to identify potential or emerging faults before they impact services
* Develop and improve procedures for alarm analysis and fault elimination in collaboration with first-line Operations teams
* Work with Cramer and provisioning teams to maintain accurate network data
* Participate in regular customer and equipment-vendor reviews covering critical cases and network outages

**Who You Are**
You have practical experience in telecommunications network operations, ideally within a second-line NOC or Transmission Operations environment, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex network incidents.
  
  
You bring relevant knowledge or experience across:
  
  

* IP networking: BGP, IS-IS and MPLS
* Optical and transmission technologies: SDH, DWDM and OTN
* Microwave transmission networks and associated troubleshooting
* Multi-vendor network equipment, particularly technologies from Cisco, Nokia, Ericsson, SIAE, ADVA, Huawei and Tellabs
* Advanced second-line troubleshooting, fault isolation and service restoration
* Incident, fault and change management processes within an operational network environment
* Network performance monitoring, alarm analysis and preventive fault management
* Root Cause Analysis through network logs, alarms and technical evidence
* Software upgrades, hardware changes, configuration management and restoration
* EMS/NMS management and network configuration backup processes
* Creation and execution of technical MOPs
* Collaboration with first-line NOC teams, field engineers, design, network planning, provisioning, customers and technology vendors

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, multi-vendor Access Transmission networks supporting Mobile and Enterprise services. You will gain exposure to network modernisation, new technology onboarding, IP-fication, legacy network decommissioning, software upgrades and network resiliency initiatives while collaborating across design, planning, field operations and vendor teams.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
The role provides opportunities to deepen and broaden expertise in:
  
  

* Advanced IP and Transmission network troubleshooting
* BGP, IS-IS and MPLS in operational telecommunications environments
* SDH, DWDM, OTN and Microwave technologies
* Cisco 540 and Nokia IXR routing platforms
* Multi-vendor network operations and vendor escalation management
* New technology and vendor onboarding
* Laboratory testing and controlled software deployment
* Network change planning, commissioning and technical MOP development
* Root Cause Analysis and proactive network-health management
* Network modernisation, IP-fication and legacy infrastructure decommissioning

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

title: Senior Systems Architect
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Mavenir is looking for a passionate and self-directed senior systems engineer within its Mobile Networking division to specify and drive development of virtualized mobile core products based on its innovative virtualized platform. The ideal candidate will have a strong background architecting and specifying requirements for 3GPP based products, familiarity with NFV standards & ecosystem and passion for influencing development for a disruptive product and solution in a competitive marketplace.
  
  
The Senior Systems Engineer will be expected to innovate and think out of the box on a regular basis leveraging an innovative virtualized platform for telco applications, enhanced with Mavenir intellectual property at the intersection of virtualization, mobile networking, and data analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture, external interfaces and detailed functional description of the solution
* Perform technical evaluations of major system enhancements and major new customer requirements
* Create detailed system level functional requirements and specifications
* Monitor standards body activities to and participate (if necessary) to influence the industry with innovative vision of the company
* Identify opportunities for innovation and market disruption.
* Provide active support for, product management, pre-sales and marketing activities including technical solutions support in the RFI/RFP response.
* Provide system level technical support in customer meetings
* Work closely with engineering and QA teams to drive the timely and quality release of new products and features
* Provide guidance and leadership to junior members of the team

**Job Requirements**

* Good knowledge of 5G NFs like SMF/UPF/AMF
* Knowledge of other 5G NFs is an added advantage
* Working knowledge of SGW/PGW/MME
* Possess sound understanding of essential elements of Systems engineering including how to convey requirements to development and QA teams
* In-depth knowledge on mobile networks, especially on LTE standards in core network and the interface between radio network and core network. Additional knowledge on the RAN standards is a plus.
* Familiarity with NFV standards and ecosystem.
* Excellent inter-personal and leadership skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent presentation skills for a variety of audiences including executives, partners, and customers.
* Ability to quickly grasp and adapt to new technologies and concepts.

**Accessibility**
Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.
  
  
Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: IT Integration & Operations Expert IGTs – Azurion Eye
description:
Job Title
  
  
IT Integration & Operations Expert IGTs – Azurion Eye
  
  
**Job Description**
**IT Integration & Operations Expert IGTs – Azurion Eye**
Design, implement and standardize the technical IT activities required to support Azurion Eye, including DataHub activation, hospital connectivity, secure data transfer, cloud/on-prem integration, monitoring, remote diagnostics, software deployment and license operations.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical IT role in the transformation of IGT Systems from a hardware-centric delivery model towards a connected, software-enabled and data-driven ecosystem. You will help connect product capabilities with hospital IT environments, Philips cloud platforms, service tooling and operational monitoring, ensuring that Azurion Eye can be deployed, observed, supported and scaled in a secure and reliable way.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on technical expert who can troubleshoot complex integration issues, implement and validate operational solutions, and support time-critical technical assignments from design validation to stable operations.
  
  
**Your Role**

* In this role, you will implement and validate the technical integration between Azurion Eye, DataHub, hospital IT networks, cloud services, service tooling and remote operations capabilities.
* You will execute hands-on implementation activities such as connectivity setup, interface validation, certificate and security configuration, data flow verification, monitoring onboarding and troubleshooting of integration defects.
* You will work closely with R&D, Service, IT, Security, Quality/Regulatory, Markets and suppliers to ensure that technical solutions are secure, supportable, compliant and aligned with enterprise architecture and operational tooling.
* You will contribute to and maintain the technical operating model for observability, logging, alerting, incident diagnostics, release deployment, licensing, configuration management, access control and remote support.
* You will help operationalize short-term Azurion Eye needs, such as DataHub installation and activation, AI Workbench data transfer, remote diagnostics and operational monitoring, while contributing to technical solutions that can scale to global 24/7 operations.

**You Are a Great Fit If**

* You hold a Master’s degree in IT, computer science, engineering, healthcare technology or a related field.
* You bring 10+ years of experience in IT integration, cloud/hybrid operations, healthcare IT, platform operations or technical service operations, preferably in a regulated medical technology environment.
* You have a proven track record in implementing and validating complex IT integrations across hospital networks, enterprise platforms, cloud services, edge systems and remote service environments.
* You have a hands-on mentality and can troubleshoot technical topics involving connectivity, firewalls, certificates, identity and access, monitoring, logging, remote diagnostics, software distribution and automation.
* You have experience converting product and platform architecture into deployable integration patterns, technical runbooks, configuration standards and supportable operational procedures.
* You are comfortable working in Agile, DevOps and site reliability engineering-oriented environments, with a strong focus on automation, reliability and fast feedback loops.
* You can translate Azurion Eye technical ambitions into working integrations, deployment scripts or procedures, observability requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable operational readiness evidence.

**You Will Stand Out If You Also Have**

* Strong knowledge of IT operations and service tooling such as ServiceNow, monitoring platforms, logging solutions, CMDB, automation tooling and remote support capabilities.
* Strong experience with healthcare IT integration, hospital networks, secure connectivity, interoperability and healthcare data standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR.
* Good understanding of cloud, hybrid and on-premise architectures, including edge components, containerized applications, APIs, microservices, networking, observability, secure data transfer and remote management.
* Ability to execute technical verification, integration testing, operational acceptance testing and deployment validation in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Experience with cybersecurity requirements, vulnerability handling, access control, certificate management, incident diagnostics, change deployment, release coordination and audit-ready technical controls.

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  

* Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
* Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
* This role is an office-based role.

**About Philips**
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

description:

title: Senior System Development Engineer, Silicon, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related Information Technology (IT) field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with systems automation, and with systems design and implementation.
* 5 years of experience with technical infrastructure (e.g., deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting), and with reliability of technical infrastructure.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience working with vendors or customers.
* Experience with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools or chip design.
* Experience in working with Go, Python or C++.
* Experience in interacting with end users or product aptitude.

**About The Job**
Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters.
  
  
Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. title: Senior Python Engineer Systems and Edge Computing
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

**Job Description**

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research.

**How will you make an impact**

We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with 6–10 years of software engineering experience and substantial hands-on Python development. You will build backend services, system automation and device-management capabilities connecting scientific instruments, IoT gateways and edge devices. The role combines software design with practical Linux systems engineering, secure deployment, diagnostics and operational ownership across device, network and application layers.

**What will you do**

* Design, develop and maintain modular Python services, APIs, command-line tools and automation libraries for device orchestration, process execution, configuration and data handling.
* Manage IoT and edge-device lifecycles, including discovery, secure onboarding, provisioning, inventory, configuration, health monitoring and controlled decommissioning.
* Integrate instruments, sensors and gateways through vendor SDKs, REST or gRPC APIs and messaging protocols such as MQTT; validate commands, telemetry and device state.
* Automate deployment and version tracking of applications and containers on Linux edge systems; support-controlled software and firmware updates with compatibility checks, staged rollout and rollback or recovery.
* Troubleshoot failures across Python code, operating-system services, networking, containers and hardware interfaces; implement structured logging, metrics, alerts and diagnostic collection.
* Develop unit, integration and system tests using pytest, mocks, simulators and physical devices; integrate validation and deployment workflows into CI/CD.
* Apply secure engineering practices, including device authentication, certificate and secret management, least-privilege access, dependency scanning and auditable change records.
* Collaborate with firmware, hardware, QA, DevOps and product teams on requirements, interfaces and release readiness; mentor engineers and maintain deployment guides, runbooks and onboarding documentation.
* Work effectively within an Agile Scrum / SAFe framework, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery.

**Required Skills**

* Strong production Python development with object-oriented design, reusable modules, exception handling, concurrency, API integration, file operations and structured data such as JSON, YAML and CSV.
* Familiarity on development experience in C/C++ integration, PowerShell, BDD/Robot Framework, hardware-in-the-loop testing or scientific and regulated product environments.
* Hands-on systems engineering on Linux, including processes, services, permissions, resource usage, shell scripting and network diagnostics; ability to support Windows integration where needed.
* Practical experience deploying, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting physical IoT devices, industrial gateways or edge-computing systems, beyond cloud-only application development.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MQTT and HTTP-based communication, with an understanding of device connectivity, authentication and offline recovery.
* Experience building Python backend services with FastAPI, Flask or equivalent, and integrating databases or local persistence for configuration, telemetry and operational state.
* Hands-on Git and CI/CD experience, plus automated testing, mocking and dependency/environment management for reproducible execution across development and deployed systems.
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, technical documentation and cross-functional communication; ability to own implementation through deployment and operational support.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs or comparable ARM/x86 edge platforms; familiarity with device drivers, BSPs and hardware/software compatibility.
* Exposure to Azure IoT or AWS IoT services, Kubernetes/k3s, Ansible or equivalent device and deployment orchestration tools.
* Experience deploying AI inference workloads at the edge, or integrating LLM services for diagnostics and automation with validation and appropriate human controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience delivering connected products or engineering platforms through the full development lifecycle in an Agile, globally distributed team.

We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.

As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Architectural Vision& Complex Problem Solving:** Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership& Project Governance:** Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap& Strategy:** Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature& Framework Delivery:** Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:** Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security& Reliability by Design:** Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling& Security Architecture:** Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability& Proactive Risk Resolution:** Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations& SRE Governance:** Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:** Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness& Metrics:** Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping& Stakeholder Negotiation:** Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC& Agile Excellence:** Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship& Engineering Culture:** Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).
  
  
Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
  
Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines.
  
  
Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.
  
  
Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
