ELK / Loki, Grafana, Open-source tools, Prometheus, Proven DR experience:, Linux system administrator, Linux engineer, Systems Engineer, SRE, Site Reliability Engineer, Platform engineer, DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure engineer, Cloud Engineer, Linux, Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL, RedHat, GCP, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, GKE, Docker, Disaster Recovery, DR, High availability, Failover, Replication, Observability, Monitoring, Incident Management, nginx, Apache, Web Server, Reverse proxy, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Bash, Shell, Python
  
  
**A cloud-based field service management SaaS platform is Looking for:******
**Senior System Operations Engineer**
**About The Role**
CS is a SaaS platform that field service businesses rely on every day. We are looking for a Senior System Operations Engineer with 6 to 10 years of experience who will own the reliability of our production Linux estate on Google Cloud Platform. This is not a ticket-handling role. You will be the expert Linux troubleshooter the team escalates to, the owner of our Disaster Recovery design and execution, and a hands-on technical lead who mentors engineers, leads major incidents, and drives improvement projects from idea to production. You will work closely with the Cloud Architect, turning architecture direction into working, documented, and tested systems.
  
  
**Our Environment**
**Cloud-**
Google Cloud Platform: Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud LoadBalancing, Cloud DNS
  
  
**OS Linux**
servers across the estate (Ubuntu / Debian / RHEL family)
  
  
**Containers**
Docker, Kubernetes on GKE
  
  
**Web & App**
Nginx, Apache, application servers
  
  
**Data**
Self-managed database servers (MySQL / PostgreSQL) with replication and backups
  
  
**IaC & Scripting**
Terraform, Bash / Shell, Python
  
  
**Practice**
Disaster Recovery, observability, CI/CD, change management, documentation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Disaster Recovery: Design, Build and Own
  
  
■ Classify services by business criticality and agree RPO / RTO targets with engineering and business stakeholders.
  
  
■ Design and implement the DR architecture on GCP: cross-region standby, snapshot and image policies, database replicas, DNS and load balancer failover, GKE workload recovery.
  
  
■ Build DR infrastructure with Terraform so the recovery environment can be recreated from code, not memory.
  
  
■ Write and maintain DR runbooks and playbooks plan and lead failover drills at least twice a year, report findings and close the gaps.
  
  
■ Own the backup strategy for servers and databases and prove it with scheduled, documented restore tests.
  
  
**Linux Expertise & Escalation Troubleshooting**
■ Act as the final escalation point for complex production issues across OS, network, web, application and database layers.
  
  
■ Deep-dive performance problems: CPU scheduling, memory and OOM behaviour, disk and filesystem I/O, network stack, file descriptors and kernel parameters (sysctl).
  
  
■ Use advanced tooling such as strace, perf, tcpdump, lsof, sar, iostat, ss, eBPF-based tools to find root cause.
  
  
■ Define and maintain Linux build, hardening and patching standards for the whole estate.
  
  
**Incident Leadership & Reliability**
■ Lead major incidents as incident commander: coordinate, communicate status and drive to resolution.
  
  
■ Run blameless post-incident reviews, write RCAs and make sure corrective actions are completed.
  
  
■ Define SLIs / SLOs for key services design and own the observability stack (metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards) and reduce alert noise.
  
  
■ Design and improve the on-call process, escalation paths and runbook coverage.
  
  
**Cloud, Containers & Platform (GCP / GKE)**
■ Design and operate GKE clusters: node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, network policies, ingress, upgrades with minimal disruption.
  
  
■ Introduce and maintain Helm / GitOps practices for consistent, reviewable deployments.
  
  
■ Design GCP networking and IAM following least privilege own GCP cost optimisation and right-sizing.
  
  
**Web, Application & Database Platforms**
■ Tune Nginx and Apache for performance and security: reverse proxy, TLS, caching, rate limiting, high availability.
  
  
■ Partner with developers on application server performance, capacity and release readiness.
  
  
■ Design database high availability and failover plan and execute upgrades and migrations with low or zero downtime lead capacity planning.
  
  
**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**
■ Write reusable Terraform modules, manage remote state and bring manually built infrastructure under code.
  
  
■ Build automation in Python and Shell that removes toil contribute to CI/CD pipelines and configuration management (e.g. Ansible).
  
  
■ Own change management: peer-reviewed, tested and reversible changes to production.
  
  
**Security & Compliance**
■ Drive OS and cloud hardening, vulnerability remediation, secrets and certificate management.
  
  
■ Support security audits and customer due diligence questionnaires with accurate evidence and documentation.
  
  
**Leadership, Mentoring & Documentation**
■ Mentor junior and mid-level engineers: review their work, pair on incidents and grow their troubleshooting skills.
  
  
■ Own the team''s runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams and DR documentation set the documentation standard.
  
  
■ Plan and deliver improvement projects communicate clearly with engineering, support, and management.
  
  
■ Contribute to architecture discussions with the Cloud Architect and give honest, evidence-based recommendations.
  
  
**Must – Have Skills & Experience**
■ 6 to 10 years of hands-on Linux system administration/operations in production. with at least 3 years supporting a SaaS platform.
  
  
■ Expert-level Linux troubleshooting, with clear examples of complex production issues you diagnosed and permanently fixed.
  
  
■ Strong hands-on GCP experience (AWS/Azure experience transferable).
  
  
■ Production experience running Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE, including upgrades and troubleshooting.
  
  
■ Deep knowledge of Nginx and Apache and application server stacks.
  
  
■ Database operations (MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL): replication, HA, failover, backup/restore, performance basics.
  
  
■ Strong Terraform experience, including writing modules and managing state.
  
  
■ Strong Shell and good Python for automation and tooling.
  
  
■ Solid DevOps practice: Git workflows, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting design.
  
  
**■ Experience Leading Incidents And Mentoring Other Engineers.**
■ Clear communicator with strong documentation habits, able to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Good to Have**
■ Ansible or other configuration management at scale.

title: Platform Distribution Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is looking for a
**Platform Distribution Architect**
to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers.

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments.

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Distribution Architecture**

* Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK.
* Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments.

**2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness**

* Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers.
* Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments.

**3. Kubernetes Platform Design**

* Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes.
* Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies.

**4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation**

* Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows.
* Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes.

**5. CI/CD and Release Automation**

* Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration.
* Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability.

**6. Self-Service Distribution**

* Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces.
* Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers.

**7. Upgrades and Migrations**

* Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes.
* Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation.

**8. Observability and Reliability**

* Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments.

**9. Security and Compliance**

* Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code.

**10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency**

* Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations.
* Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency.

**11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership**

* Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover.
* Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews.

**What You Bring**

* **Multi-cloud architecture:**
  Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or GCP — covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security.
* **Kubernetes and containers:**
  Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* **CI/CD and release automation:**
  Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as Code:**
  Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools.
* **Deployment architecture:**
  Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation.
* **Observability and reliability:**
  Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.
* **Programming and scripting:**
  Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell.
* **Core technical fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals.

**Good to Have**

* Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries.
* Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python.
* Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture.
* Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

**Interested?**

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you.

* Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

title: Energy Resource Manager (ERM)
description:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as an Energy Resource Manager (ERM) with the primary focus at reducing stranded capacity applying optimization techniques of space, power, cooling and network. Being a key member of the local Datacenter Operations team in the deployment planning and optimization of the IT capacity, working closely with Electrical Engineers and Critical Environment Field Service Engineer.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I ERM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. By enabling data center capacity through increased Infrastructure Utilization Effectiveness (IUE) and Power Harvesting (PH), you will lead the retrofit efforts to upgrade legacy datacenters and harvest capacity in our existing fleet. As a group, CO+I is focused on personal and professional development for all employees, offer trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

* Primary focus in Managing IT Allocation at the Campus/Metro level by collaborating with key stakeholders and ensuring that demands are properly allocated across the IT infrastructure.
* Familiarize with the Data Center design and manage the IT resources by performing virtual failure analysis and develop a master allocation plan to drive the operationalization of the customer capacity.
* Ensure compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
* Engage with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
* Manage programs associated with the area of responsibility.
* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
* Raise risks to the IT capacity allocation and planning. Identify power stranding and contractual inconsistencies (leased spaces).
* Ensure that the critical environment information is properly entered and maintained (tooling).
* Lead programs and projects through leadership forums aligning scope, schedule, and cost that align to our OKRs.

Service Delivery

* Manage the assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives and escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.

Insight Global Consulting is seeking an experienced Program manager to lead a large-scale enterprise network transformation and refresh initiative. This leader will oversee end-to-end execution across a complex portfolio of infrastructure modernization activities spanning hundreds to thousands of locations, deployment waves, and maintenance windows.

The ideal candidate has successfully led enterprise refresh campaigns for a major client and can coordinate distributed teams across Project governance, release management, engineering, quality assurance, and implementation. Deliver a predictable, high-volume enterprise refresh campaign with strong governance, transparent reporting, and first-time quality.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

• Lead end-to-end execution of a complex, multi-workstream enterprise network transformation initiative.

• Establish the governance model, decision rights, escalation paths, reporting cadence, and performance controls.

• Drive accountability across project coordinators, release managers, consulting engineers, wireless engineers, peer review engineers, and implementation engineers.

• Lead executive reviews and communicate status, decisions, risks, financials, and required actions clearly.

• Own the integrated deployment roadmap across site classifications, geographic regions, waves, and maintenance windows.

• Coordinate site readiness, engineering package completion, peer review, release approval, implementation, validation, and closure.

• Align resource capacity with the deployment forecast and adjust staffing as volume and schedule requirements change.

• Maintain an executive communication plan that provides concise, accurate, and actionable Project visibility.

• Resolve delivery issues across organizational boundaries while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.

**Financial, Resource & Performance Management**

• Own the Project budget, forecast, resource plan, utilization, and financial performance.

• Manage workforce ramp-up and ramp-down plans across onshore and offshore delivery teams.

• Define and monitor KPIs, SLAs, quality measures, productivity indicators, and deployment health metrics.

• Drive corrective actions when performance trends fall outside plan.

**Delivery Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

• Ensure adherence to change management, release governance, documentation, security, and quality standards.

• Use lessons learned, root-cause analysis, and performance data to improve deployment efficiency and reduce rework.

• Promote consistent delivery methods and reusable playbooks across deployment waves.

• Build a culture of ownership, transparency, collaboration, and customer focus.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of Project, program or portfolio management experience leading large-scale technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading an enterprise refresh campaign for a major client, preferably across hundreds or thousands of distributed locations.

* Experience coordinating routing, switching, wireless, data center, cloud, or related infrastructure workstreams.
* Strong working knowledge of change management, CAB/CRQ processes, release governance, cutover planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience leading geographically distributed onshore and offshore teams through rapid ramp and high-volume delivery cycles.
* Proven ownership of multimillion-dollar budgets, resource forecasts, vendor performance, and financial outcomes.

description:
**Function:**
Projects / Operations/ Contractors management

**Reporting To:**
Head – Projects / COO

**About Gamlaa**

Gamlaa is India’s leading integrated biophilic solutions company, creating refined, nature-led environments across workplaces, commercial, hospitality and premium spaces. We combine design, horticulture, execution and long-term maintenance to transform spaces into living environments that elevate wellbeing and everyday experiences.

Our vision is to make biophilic design an essential part of the built environment—creating spaces that are healthier, more human and meaningfully connected to nature. Today, Gamlaa is powered by 1,500+ people, serving 1,250+ enterprise clients, delivering 5,800+ projects and managing 100Mn+ sq. ft. across India. We’re building a team that brings curiosity, ownership and craftsmanship to breathe life into spaces.

**Role Overview**

Responsible for managing the subcontractor and contractor ecosystem for Gamlaa's landscape and outdoor plant-related projects across multiple locations.

The role will oversee contractor identification, empanelment, commercial negotiations, contract management and execution monitoring to ensure landscape development and outdoor plant installation projects are delivered within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

The position will work closely with Project Management, Procurement, PCS, QA/QC and Business Development teams to ensure effective project execution and subcontractor performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Contractor & Subcontractor Development:**
  Identify, evaluate and onboard landscape contractors, subcontractors and specialist agencies across operational cities. Build a reliable vendor network based on execution capability, quality, pricing and geographical coverage.
* **Contract & Commercial Management:**
  Manage contractor empanelment, scope finalisation, BOQs, rate contracts, commercial negotiations, work orders, payment terms and contract renewals.
* **Landscape Project Execution:**
  Coordinate execution of outdoor landscaping projects, including site preparation, landscaping, plantation, irrigation systems, hardscaping and other outdoor development requirements.
* **Subcontractor Management:**
  Allocate work to subcontractors, monitor deployment and productivity, and ensure adequate manpower, equipment and resources for project execution.
* **Project TAT & Delivery:**
  Ensure timely execution and completion of projects as per agreed schedules, milestones and customer commitments.
* **Quality Assurance:**
  Ensure adherence to approved landscape designs, plant specifications, plantation standards, irrigation requirements and project quality benchmarks in coordination with QA/QC teams.
* **Cost & Budget Control:**
  Monitor project BOQs, subcontractor rates, execution costs and variations to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets.
* **Site Monitoring & Compliance:**
  Conduct periodic site reviews, contractor performance assessments and execution audits. Ensure compliance with safety standards, labour regulations and applicable statutory requirements.
* **Billing & Commercial Closure:**
  Validate subcontractor measurements, work completion certificates, bills and supporting documentation before processing payments.
* **Performance Management:**
  Establish contractor rating and performance evaluation mechanisms covering quality, cost, timelines, safety and service delivery.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with Project, Procurement, PCS, Finance and Business Development teams to ensure smooth project handover, execution and closure.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience in Landscape Projects, Horticulture, Civil / Infrastructure Projects or Outdoor Development.
* Strong exposure to contractor and subcontractor management, contract administration and project execution.
* Experience in BOQ preparation, rate analysis, commercial negotiations and vendor management.
* Understanding of landscaping, plantation, irrigation systems, hardscaping and outdoor project execution.
* Experience in managing multiple projects and contractors across different locations.
* Strong project planning, cost control and execution management skills.
* Graduate in Horticulture, Agriculture, Civil Engineering or related disciplines preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Contractor and subcontractor management
* Contract administration and commercial negotiations
* Landscape project execution
* Project planning and TAT management
* Cost control and budget management
* Quality assurance and site audits
* Multi-city vendor development
* Stakeholder management and problem-solving

title: SoC Verification Technical Lead
description:
**Alternate Job Title:**

* SoC Verification Technical Lead

**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent years in the trenches of SoC verification, where the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips six months often comes down to a verification plan you wrote in week two. You know that verification is not just about coverage numbers, it is about understanding what can actually break in silicon and making sure it does not.
  
  
Leading a team does not mean delegating and disappearing. You are in the weaveform debugger alongside your engineers when a protocol violation shows up at 2am, and you can spot a gap in a testbench architecture during a design review without needing to see the code. You have learned to read a customer's SOC spec and immediately know where the risk lives, whether it is in the interconnect, the power domain crossings, or that custom accelerator block nobody wants to talk about yet.
  
  
You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build a verification plan that actually maps to what can go wrong, and adjust as the design evolves. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building chips for AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing, and the verification strategies you build will determine whether their silicon works.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead verification execution for customer SoC, subsystem, and IP projects, from verification planning through signoff, working directly with customer engineering teams to define scope and deliverables
* Lead verification teams of 3-4 engineers, assigning tasks, reviewing testbenches and coverage reports, and mentoring engineers through complex debug scenarios
* Develop verification plans that map customer requirements to testbench architecture, coverage goals, and resource allocation, then track execution and adjust as designs evolve
* Integrate and deploy Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and third-party VIP for protocols like PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR into customer verification environments
* Debug complex multi-protocol and multi-domain SoC issues using waveform analysis, coverage analysis, and cross-functional collaboration with design, architecture, and post-silicon teams
* Identify project risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and communicate status and blockers to Synopsys management and customer stakeholders
* Drive methodology improvements across the SSG verification team, whether that is UVM reuse strategies, regression optimization, or new tool adoption

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Your verification plans and execution will directly determine whether customer chips tape out on schedule or slip quarters, affecting product launch timelines for AI accelerators, automotive SoCs, and aerospace systems
* The engineers you mentor will grow into technical leads themselves, building verification capability across Synopsys that scales to future customer engagements
* Your early identification of design risks and verification gaps will prevent costly respins and post-silicon surprises for customers building chips in 5nm and below
* The methodology improvements you drive will reduce verification cycle time and improve coverage quality across dozens of SSG projects annually
* Your direct customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt and deploy Synopsys EDA tools and IP in their verification flows
* The testbench architectures and VIP integration strategies you build will become reusable assets for future projects, compressing ramp time for new customer engagements
* Your technical leadership will help Synopsys win and retain customer relationships in high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace markets where verification complexity is a competitive differentiator

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience
* Deep technical expertise in UVM testbench development, coverage analysis, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug
* Proven experience leading verification teams through full project cycles, including resource planning, task assignment, and delivery against customer schedules
* Strong working knowledge of industry-standard protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or DDR, and how they interact in real SoC architectures
* Hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi or equivalent waveform analysis tools, and integration of third-party VIP into verification environments
* Experience with ARM-based technologies including Coresight debug infrastructure, processor architecture, or AMBA protocols is a strong plus
* Solid understanding of ASIC design flows, RTL design concepts, and how verification fits into the broader chip development process

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, hear a high-level SoC architecture description, and walk out with a verification plan that identifies the three highest-risk areas before anyone else in the room sees them
* When a regression fails at 3am and your team is stuck, you can look at the waveform, the coverage report, and the testbench code and know within 15 minutes whether it is a real bug or a testbench issue
* You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes you feel heard, and your team knows the difference
* You do not let a project drift. If a customer requirement is vague or a timeline is unrealistic, you say so early and propose a path forward that actually works
* You can explain a complex protocol violation to a customer architect, a verification coverage gap to your manager, and a UVM sequence bug to a junior engineer, and all three conversations will be clear and useful
* You stay current on verification methodology and tooling not because it is required but because you care about doing this work well, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will join the System Solutions Group (SSG), a team that delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across automotive, high-performance computing, aerospace, and defense. SSG works on everything from individual IP blocks to full turnkey SoCs, partnering with customers ranging from startups to industry leaders and government agencies. Your verification work will span subsystems and full chips, and you will collaborate closely with Synopsys architecture, design, EDA application engineering, and sales teams to deploy tool and IP solutions that solve real customer problems.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:

In recent years, they have evolved to support AI infrastructure and AGI workflows, offering services in model training, fine-tuning, and deployment—powered by their internal AI platform, ALAN, and backed by a vast talent network. They reported $300 million in revenue and reached profitability. Their growth is driven by demand for annotated training data from AI labs, including major clients like OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Meta.
  
  
**Job Description:**
Job Title: Signal Integrity and Electromagnetic Simulation Engineer
  
  
Location: Pan India
  
  
Experience:5+ yrs.
  
  
Employment Type: Contract to hire
  
  
Work Mode: Remote
  
  
Notice Period: - Immediate joiners
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
Role Overview
  
  
Responsible for developing and executing electromagnetic and signal-integrity simulation workflows for PCB designs, analyzing interconnect behavior, parasitic effects and signal quality, and generating technically validated simulation evidence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Perform electromagnetic simulations of PCB traces, vias, transmission lines, return paths and interconnect structures.
  
  
Analyze impedance, insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, coupling and signal propagation.
  
  
Perform resistance, inductance and capacitance extraction using FastHenry and FasterCap.
  
  
Use OpenEMS for full-wave electromagnetic simulations and S-parameter extraction.
  
  
Use ngspice for circuit-level transient and AC analysis incorporating extracted parasitics.
  
  
Analyse clock and high-speed digital signals, including propagation delay, skew, rise/fall time and waveform-based jitter metrics.
  
  
Develop Python-based automation and post-processing workflows using libraries such as scikit-rf, NumPy and SciPy.
  
  
Correlate simulation results with analytical calculations and trusted reference data.
  
  
Document simulation assumptions, model limitations, results and verification evidence.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Strong fundamentals in signal integrity, electromagnetic theory and high-speed PCB design.
  
  
Understanding of transmission lines, impedance matching, reflections, crosstalk and return-current paths.
  
  
Practical experience with PCB parasitic extraction and S-parameter analysis.
  
  
Experience with at least one EM simulation tool; familiarity with OpenEMS is desirable.
  
  
Knowledge of FastHenry, FasterCap and ngspice, or equivalent tools.
  
  
Python scripting for simulation automation and data analysis.
  
  
Familiarity with Touchstone files, frequency-domain and time-domain analysis.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications :**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
  
  
5+ years of relevant experience in SI, PI, electromagnetic simulation or high-speed PCB engineering.
  
  
Experience with automotive electronics, embedded systems or high-speed digital interfaces.
  
  
**About Company:**
Our client is a Palo Alto–based AI infrastructure and talent platform founded in 2018. It helps companies connect with remote software developers using AI-powered vetting and matching technology. Originally branded as the “Intelligent Talent Cloud,”enabled companies to “spin up their engineering dream team in the cloud” by sourcing and managing vetted global talent. They reported $300 million in revenue and reached profitability. Their growth is driven by demand for annotated training data from AI labs, including major clients like OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Meta.

Location: Pan India
  
  
Experience:10+ yrs.
  
  
Employment Type: Contract to hire
  
  
Work Mode: Remote
  
  
Notice Period: - Immediate joiners
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an Engineering Managerto lead the development of security-focused training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. This role owns delivery, quality, and capacity across multiple pods and is accountable to Google for throughput, task difficulty, quality standards, and on-time batch completion.
  
  
The Engineering Manager acts as the final quality gate, ensuring that vulnerability-based tasks are technically accurate, reproducible, robust against gaming, and aligned with the project’s evaluation goals. The role combines software security expertise, people leadership, client communication, delivery management, and data-driven capacity planning.
  
  
What does day-to-day look like
  
  
Own delivery, quality, and capacity across multiple pods.
  
  
Plan batches, assign work to Pod Leads, and track daily throughput against phase targets.
  
  
Ensure batches meet Google’s expectations for volume, difficulty, quality, and timelines.
  
  
Lead weekly client reporting and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.
  
  
Escalate tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and staffing constraints early.
  
  
Align with Google on scope, timelines, task volume, and difficulty changes.
  
  
Conduct final reviews of security tasks before delivery.
  
  
Calibrate Pod Leads on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task quality, and difficulty.
  
  
Run interviews and make hiring decisions against the approved JD.
  
  
Identify and promote high-performing Trainers to Pod Lead roles.
  
  
Forecast headcount needs using throughput and workload data.
  
  
Start hiring waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements.
  
  
Use dashboards and operational metrics to drive delivery and staffing decisions.
  
  
**Requirements**
Senior software security engineer with overall 10 years of experience
  
  
Experience in leading teams against measurable delivery, quality, and schedule targets.
  
  
Strong understanding of CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10 across multiple programming languages and software ecosystems.
  
  
Demonstrated experience reproducing vulnerabilities, reviewing security patches, and evaluating proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  
  
Experience designing or reviewing automated tests, verifiers, CI workflows, or reproducible technical evaluation environments.
  
  
Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.
  
  
Experience with Git, Linux, Bash, Docker, and common software security tooling.
  
  
Comfortable using dashboards, throughput metrics, quality data, and operational reports to make delivery and staffing decisions.
  
  
Experience managing or mentoring technical teams, including assigning work, reviewing output, giving feedback, and developing team leads.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risks and project status clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
  
  
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple pods, priorities, and delivery phases simultaneously.

title: Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC (Individual Contributor)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
The Agentic People Experience & Automation Hub (APEX) is the regional engine of Salesforce’s Global People Services & Operations, delivering an end-to-end hire-to-retire employee experience. Operating under Salesforce’s “Customer Zero” model, APEX leverages cutting-edge technology and AI agents to automate routine inquiries, empowering our team to focus on high-impact, complex resolution and high-touch support.
  
  
As an Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC, you sit at the strategic intersection of Tier 2 (T2) operational execution—spanning Benefits, Leave of Absence, Time Tracking, and Employee Relations—and regional project management. Beyond core case management, you will lead critical regional initiatives, incident responses, and compliance communications, collaborating closely with Benefits, Legal, Employee Success Business Partners, Employee Relations, and DET. Based in Hyderabad (hybrid), you will support ANZ, ASEAN and India, with working-hours overlap across APAC time zones and occasional regional travel as needed.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll lead through influence, coaching peers, owning projects and acting as a delegate for the Manager.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings an AI-first mindset, exceptional organizational and communication skills, and an eagerness to lead in a fast-paced environment. You are a trusted partner capable of building cross-functional relationships at all levels, managing highly confidential HR matters with complete discretion, and driving continuous operational innovation across the region.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* ES Business Operations
* Oversee daily case and inquiry handling for APAC region, covering queue health, SLAs, escalations and quality.
* Mentor and guide People Specialists on complex cases, share best practices and help maintain case quality, without formal line management
* Partner with the Manager to run team rhythms (huddles, workload allocation, coverage planning, handoffs) and act as delegate when the Manager is out of office.
* Identify trends in cases and recommend knowledge-article, process or tooling improvements.
* Act as the first point of escalation for complex T2 cases, make decisions within defined policy, and escalate high-risk or precedent-setting matters to the Manager.
* Provide regular coaching and feedback to People Specialists, and review case quality against SLA and CSAT targets.
* Use AI agents and automation to deflect routine inquiries, and feed case trends back into agent and knowledge improvements
* Project and program management (ES Business Operations)
* Plan and deliver ES initiatives end to end: scope, timelines, risks, stakeholder updates and post-launch reviews.
* Manage the APAC project pipeline and prioritization, and report status to ES leadership.
* Drive process standardization and operational readiness for new programs and policy changes.
* Act as the subject-matter reference for process and project questions within the team.
* Own delivery of assigned APAC initiatives against agreed milestones, and report progress, risks and outcomes to ES leadership
* ES compliance for ASEAN
* Support ASEAN ES compliance, including data privacy requirements, record-keeping and policy attestations, in line with local legal requirements
* Help maintain documentation, SOPs and controls so they meet local legal and company requirements.
* Run periodic quality and compliance checks, track remediation actions to closure, and work with Legal, Privacy and local HR/ER partners.
* Act as a key partner to the Global ES Compliance team, owning ASEAN inputs for audits and attestations through to closure

**You’re Our Person If...**

* 8+ years in HR operations, shared services or People Operations, including leading projects or mentoring peers with/without formal authority
* Prior experience with Workday, Peopleforce, Google Workspace and any similar HRIS is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of APAC employment practices, HR generalist and business operations, and HR compliance
* AI-First and human/agent collaboration experience and mindset
* Proven project management skills
* Sound judgment in applying HR policy to varied situations across APAC
* Strong problem-solving skills with data analysis and reporting; scripting (Google Apps Script, Python) is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills
* Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across regions
* Ability to work in a diverse work environment with ambiguity and multiple priorities
* Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion and manage multiple priorities independently

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Slack, plus reporting or analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of ASEAN employment and data privacy regulations (e.g. PDPA)
* You hold Certification in project management (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2)
* You hold Certification in process improvement (e.g. Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen)

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* SLA and CSAT performance for APAC T2 cases.
* On-time delivery of regional projects.
* Timely closure of ASEAN compliance actions.
* Stakeholder feedback.

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Lead/Associate Director
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
**The Role**
As the senior functional lead for Oracle Cloud Fusion General Ledger and the wider Record-to-Report solution, you’ll own General Ledger design decisions from end to end, configure the solution hands-on and guide a team of functional consultants through design, build, testing, migration and cutover.
  
  
You’ll work closely with senior finance stakeholders, technology teams, system integrators and program leadership across geographies. Although this role doesn’t have formal line-management responsibility, you’ll set the functional standard for the workstream and lead by example.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**

* Own the functional design of the target-state General Ledger, including enterprise structure, legal entities, chart of accounts, ledgers, currencies, ledger sets, balancing segment values and cross-validation rules.
* Lead discovery and design workshops with finance, controllership and operations teams, balancing global standardisation with local and statutory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into fit-gap assessments, configuration decisions and functional specifications, challenging unnecessary complexity.
* Design the Record-to-Report operating model, covering journals, allocations, revaluation, translation, intercompany accounting, reconciliations, controls and period close.
* Configure Oracle Fusion General Ledger and related modules through Functional Setup Manager, maintaining configuration workbooks and environment alignment.
* Partner with integration and technical teams on interface design, including File-Based Data Import, web services and Oracle Integration Cloud.
* Lead the General Ledger workstream across discovery, design, build, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, migration, cutover, go-live and Heightened Support.
* Own data migration, testing, governance, documentation, risk management and stakeholder communication across a global rollout.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements**

* Extensive experience in finance systems, including substantial hands-on Oracle Financials functional experience and recent Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials delivery. Deep configuration expertise in Oracle Fusion General Ledger, enterprise structures and intercompany, along with strong knowledge of at least any two modules of Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fusion Tax and Subledger Accounting. Experience delivering at least two full-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Financials implementations, preferably including a multi-country or global rollout.
* Proven ability to lead complex, high-volume data migration across multiple legal entities, including balance conversion, mapping and reconciliation. Strong experience leading system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect management and end-to-end financial process validation. Strong knowledge of accounting and Record-to-Report processes, including period close, intercompany, multi-currency, revaluation and consolidation.
* Experience assessing Oracle quarterly updates, managing regression testing and supporting live production environments. Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders across regions.
* Desirable experience : Banking or financial services experience, including regulatory and management reporting dependencies on the General Ledger.
* Exposure to Oracle Fusion Accounting Hub, Financial Reporting Studio, Smart View, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence and Oracle Enterprise Performance Management. Functional understanding of Oracle Integration Cloud, File-Based Data Import and Application Development Framework Desktop Integrator. Oracle Cloud Financials certification.
* Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or Commerce and/or a professional qualification such as: Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant or Master of Business Administration in Finance.
* Behavioural competencies : Leads through influence: Sets direction and standards without formal authority and earns trust across teams.
* Mature judgement: Makes sound, defensible decisions while balancing accounting, control, cost and delivery considerations. Delivery resilience: Remains effective during demanding milestones and high-priority delivery periods. Problem solver: Uses structured analysis to diagnose complex, cross-system issues. Clear communicator: Explains complex functional topics concisely to technical, finance and senior management audiences.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Lead/Architect, Enterprise Resilience Consultant - BCP
description:
**The Opportunity**
As an Enterprise Resilience Consultant, you will support MassMutual’s ability to prepare for, respond to, and recover from events that could disrupt important business services, operations, technology, suppliers, facilities, or employees. You will contribute to the execution of enterprise resilience activities, including business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery coordination, emergency preparedness, crisis response support, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role supports the Head of Enterprise Resilience and is based in Hyderabad, India. The position is intended for a developing resilience professional who will support enterprise initiatives under the direction of senior team members, contribute to program execution, maintain high-quality documentation, track actions and risks, prepare stakeholder materials, and help embed resilience practices across the organization.
  
  
**The Team**
The Office of Enterprise Resilience helps MassMutual reduce disruption risk and maintain important operations through planning, testing, response coordination, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The team partners with business, technology, risk, operations, procurement, legal, compliance, security, facilities, and supplier management teams to strengthen enterprise preparedness and resilience outcomes.
  
  
In this role, you will support cross-functional work that is detail-oriented, time-sensitive, and connected to customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, and MassMutual’s purpose. You may assist with resilience reviews, exercises, incident-related assessments, stakeholder updates, and management reporting.
  
  
**The Impact**

* Support enterprise resilience program activities by maintaining plans, trackers, issue logs, evidence repositories, meeting materials, and status updates.
* Assist with business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery, emergency preparedness, and third-party resilience activities by gathering inputs, reviewing documentation, tracking actions, and escalating gaps or overdue items.
* Coordinate resilience exercises, plan validations, workshops, and stakeholder meetings by preparing agendas, materials, attendance records, notes, action items, and follow-up communications.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to collect and validate resilience information (such as BIAs, DR Plans, etc.), including critical functions, dependencies, recovery strategies, contingency procedures, testing evidence, supplier documentation, and remediation updates.
* Prepare reporting and analysis that provide visibility into resilience posture, open issues, testing progress, program health, and emerging risks.
* Support incident and disruption response activities by helping assess potential impacts, document decisions, coordinate updates, track follow-up actions, and maintain records through recovery or closure.
* Identify opportunities to improve process consistency, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, and reporting routines while staying aligned with enterprise standards.

**The Minimum Qualifications**

* 5 - 7+ years of experience in business continuity, operational resilience, disaster recovery, emergency management, enterprise risk management, third-party risk management, technology risk, operations, or related program execution.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Experience supporting program management, risk assessments, control reviews, plan maintenance, testing, issue tracking, action-item management, or stakeholder reporting.
* Strong knowledge of implementing AI-enabled solutions, including identifying use cases, supporting adoption, evaluating operational impacts, and aligning implementation activities with business, risk, and governance requirements.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in risk, technology, operations, compliance, procurement, legal, business continuity, disaster recovery, or supplier management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Experience preparing written communications, status updates, meeting materials, summaries, trackers, or reporting deliverables for stakeholders.
* Ability to work flexible hours when needed to support time-sensitive resilience activities, global stakeholders, significant incidents, exercises, or critical deliverables.

**The Ideal Qualifications**

* Experience supporting resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, emergency preparedness, third-party resilience, or operational risk programs in insurance or financial services.
* Understanding of operational resilience, business continuity planning, disaster recovery, emergency response, dependency mapping, incident response, supplier risk, or issue management practices.
* Experience with Archer, ProcessUnity, Jira, SharePoint, continuity planning tools, workflow management tools, supplier risk platforms, reporting platforms, or similar systems.
* Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, metrics, meeting materials, governance updates, management reporting, or executive-ready summaries.
* Knowledge of resilience-related regulatory expectations or industry practices, such as ISO 22301, FFIEC guidance, DORA, NIST, or similar frameworks.
* Professional certification such as CBCP, MBCP, CRISC, CISA, CISM, PMP, or equivalent experience.
* Ability to translate complex resilience, risk, and operational information into clear actions, owners, timelines, and stakeholder-ready insights.

**What You Can Expect At MassMutual**
MassMutual offers meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. In this role, you can expect:
  
  

* Clear responsibilities that connect to enterprise resilience, customer outcomes, and business continuity.
* A collaborative environment where diverse perspectives are valued.
* Learning and development opportunities that support continuous growth and skill-building.
* Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion.
* A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship.

title: Sr. Project Construction Manager , Data Center Capacity Delivery
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budgets.  
Driving costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
  
Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
  
Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
  
Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests. - Total project quality including the assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight of the execution of the project.
  
Management of multiple stakeholders and driving the project from starting to successful handing over.  
Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
  
Recording and reporting key metrics to team members and management.
  
Concurrently managing multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
  
Operational support of installed facilities including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.  
Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.  
Travel to data center sites for electrical systems audits, mechanical system reviews, construct ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required.  
  
A day in the life  
AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences

description:

JR114256

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and standardize EMIR methodology that applies consistently across all DRAM products, ensuring alignment, repeatability, and high-quality analysis outcomes
* Perform static and dynamic EM/IR analysis using RedHawk or Totem or other industry‑standard tools; identify root‑cause issues such as high‑resistance segments, insufficient via density, and decap deficiencies, and provide clear, actionable recommendations to design and layout teams.
* Actively leverage AI‑based tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks for effective Power-delivery-network (PDN) analysis.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the full EMIR flow—from netlist preparation, extraction, simulation, and debug to reporting and silicon correlation—and ensure accurate evaluation across operating modes and temperatures.
* Partner across design, timing, physical implementation, architecture, modeling, and verification teams to understand real switching behavior, develop worst‑case vectors, and standardize analysis expectations across global teams.
* Collaborate with cross-geographical teams and also EDA tool vendors to evaluate and improve EMIR methodologies, and document Best Known Methods (BKMs) to enhance consistency and correlation across DRAM teams.
* Develop and maintain dashboards to track EMIR results, monitor trends, and support signoff progression for multiple designs.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering.
* 4 - 8 years of experience in PDN / Power Integrity / EMIR analysis for advanced semiconductor or SoC designs.
* Deep hands‑on experience with Ansys RedHawk or Totem for full‑chip EM/IR verification and PDN analysis, including setup, scenario creation, debug, and root‑cause analysis.
* Expertise in vectorless and dynamic/pattern‑based IR‑drop analysis, with strong ability to interpret current behavior, switching activity, and voltage‑sensitivity trends.
* Proven ability to identify root causes of IR‑drop issues—including switching activity, grid resistance, parasitics, routing topology—and translate analysis results into actionable design or layout fixes.
* Experience performing SoC‑level or chip‑level EMIR signoff and supporting tapeouts.
* Solid understanding of PDN interactions with circuit timing/margin, layout topology, and chip‑level power architecture.
* Ability to understand the full end‑to‑end design flow, including RTL, floorplanning, routing, extraction, EMIR, STA, and silicon correlation.
* Familiarity with Make or similar automation frameworks for EMIR rollups.
* Hands‑on experience with low‑power, multi‑voltage, power‑off, or mixed‑signal designs.
* Experience in chip‑level IR/EM analysis and driving closure across multi‑functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with power‑modeling or current‑source modeling flows (e.g., CPM).
* Scripting skills in Python/Tcl for automation and data analysis.
* Experience in improving EMIR/PI analysis flows or methodology.
* Knowledge of PnR or STA tools (FusionCompiler, PrimeTime).
* Background in circuit design with SPICE experience.

title: Fibre splicer
description:
Job Location-**Vikhroli, Mumbai**

Work schedule -**Rotational shift**

**Summary Job Description**

1. Review the assigned TT, route information and work instructions before starting restoration or planned splicing work.

2. Identify the correct cable, tube and fibre cores using available records and tests, and confirm doubtful identification before cutting or changing connections.

3. Prepare cables and fibres through controlled stripping, cleaning, cleaving and fusion splicing, protecting unaffected fibres throughout the work.

4. Arrange fibre routing, sleeves and slack correctly in joint trays; label and seal enclosures to maintain protection and traceability.

5. Perform Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR), continuity and optical power testing as applicable, including both-end testing where required.

6. Assess test results, rectify unacceptable joints or losses, and communicate unresolved technical issues to the O&M engineer.

7. Prepare splicing charts, joint details and test records linked to the circuit, location, date and TT, and submit them for network-record updates.

8. Coordinate with NOC and the client-side team during testing and restoration; report completion with evidence rather than closing service incidents independently.

9. Guide splicing technicians and labour on cable preparation, enclosure work, tool handling and safe site arrangements.

10. Check and maintain the splicing machine, cleaver, electrodes, OTDR, inverter and tool kit, and report calibration, repair or consumable needs.

11. Follow approved field safety and weather-protection arrangements; keep the work area and fibre waste controlled.

12. Submit daily progress, material consumption, pending work and equipment-condition updates, and hand over unfinished work clearly.

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹34,000.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

* Can you take backups of OTDR reports and prepare splicing charts, OTDR reports, and bi-directional reports?

Efficienergi is a young and fast-growing company redefining how Power & Energy Services are delivered in India. The role offers exposure to complex power systems across Data Centers, Industrial Facilities, Commercial Developments, Renewable Energy Projects, and Utility Networks. * Develop and validate electrical network models, including utility sources, transformers, generators, motors, UPS systems, switchgear, cables, and protective devices.
* Prepare and review technical reports, relay setting sheets, Time-Current Characteristic (TCC) curves, arc flash labels, and engineering recommendations.
* Evaluate circuit breaker ratings, equipment duty, protection settings, coordination margins, and system operating conditions.

* Review client inputs, identify data gaps, resolve technical queries, and coordinate with clients, consultants, OEMs, and internal teams.

SNOC Integration Strategy & Planning Leadership: Define end-to-end integration strategy, scope, milestones, dependencies, prerequisites and execution plan for new projects and products.
  
  
Solution & Integration Architecture: Analyze OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational model to determine the right SNOC integration approach.
  
  
End-to-End Monitoring Architecture: Ensure monitoring coverage for Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Processes, Faults, Performance and Logs.
  
  
OEM Solution Assessment: Understand and technically evaluate OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational workflows before finalizing the integration approach.
  
  
Solution-to-SNOC Mapping: Map OEM solution architecture against SNOC tool capabilities and determine the right integration points, monitoring platforms and operational workflows.
  
  
Technical Risk Management: Identify integration, architecture, security and operational risks and drive mitigation before deployment.
  
  
Fault Management Architecture: Design alarm/event flow from network element to SNOC including normalization, severity, correlation, suppression, raise/clear and auto-ticketing.
  
  
Performance Management Architecture: Define KPI/counter integration through Bulkstat, APIs, Prometheus, telemetry or other performance interfaces.
  
  
Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): Drive standardization, reusable integration patterns, architecture governance, FTR improvement, defect prevention and continuous engineering transformation to accelerate technology onboarding and improve overall SNOC operational excellence.
  
  
Data Privacy & Security Enforcement: Enforce secure-by-design practices across SNOC integrations, including RBAC, API/SNMP/Kafka security, data protection and controlled access to sensitive network data.
  
  
HOTO & Operational Readiness: Ensure complete integration evidence, monitoring coverage, testing results and operational acceptance before SNOC/COG handover
  
  
Database & Backup Governance: Ensure database integration, data consistency, backup validation and recovery readiness across SNOC ecosystem platforms.
  
  
Automated Observability: Drive automation for integration validation, alarm testing, reconciliation, health checks and monitoring validation to improve FTR and reduce rework.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**

* Overall Experience: Minimum 12+ years of progressive, post-qualification experience in Project and Telecom management.
* Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior operational or engineering leadership role managing large environments and leading regulatory/compliance audits.

**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**

* Applications & Tools: OSS/NMS/EMS environment integration, HPSM(Service Manager). NNMi/Temip, NPM(Performance Management), UIM(Inventory), UHC, Prometheus, Syslog and end-to-end network management platforms.
* Containerisation & Management: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP), Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Kubernetes, and CSI frameworks.
* Integration Interfaces: End-to-End integration architectures using Rest APIs, SNMP, MIB/OID, CLI, API, Kafka, Syslog, CLI, Telemetry, Webhooks and event-driven interfaces.
* Networking & Security: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Native Core (CNE) technologies, and Ni7 architectures.
* Monitoring & Observability: Automated monitoring and alerting platforms for real-time performance degradation tracking and network fault isolation.
* Automation: API Automation, Python/Shell, Validation Scripts, Auto-Ticketing, Health Checks.
* Data Protection: Applications & tools and disaster recovery frameworks.

**Position Summary**
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Assess Microsoft Entra ID environments and recommend cloud identity configurations across Entra ID, multifactor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), B2B, B2C, Active Directory, and related services.
* Architect, design, and implement large-scale Entra ID deployments, migrations, upgrades, proof-of-concept initiatives, and production rollouts, including tenant setup and service configuration.
* Configure external identity capabilities, including Entra B2B, External ID, cross-tenant synchronization, access reviews, entitlement management, and consumer-application sign-in and sign-up flows.
* Migrate applications and legacy identity platforms to Entra ID; prepare Active Directory environments for Entra ID and Microsoft 365 migration; configure custom identity security and compliance reporting; and support Azure Advanced Threat Protection delivery.
* Troubleshoot Entra ID services and system-level issues in multi-vendor, multi-protocol environments; document technical analysis, client communications, and resolution steps; and collaborate with client stakeholders, vendor teams, and managed-services teams.
* Use PowerShell to automate Entra ID tasks, analyze Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), and Group Policy configurations, provide internal technical training, and contribute to Microsoft identity thought leadership.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in technical consulting, client problem solving and designing and implementing Microsoft Identity solutions.

Working experience in at least one of the areas listed below.
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on technical experience enterprise-with Microsoft Identity and Access management and EMS services (Entra ID, Entra ID premium solutions, conditional access, SSO, MFA, PAM/PIM, and third party IAM solution integration with Entra) in implementation and operations. This should include designing and implementing Entra ID and its associated security features for organizations including integrations with applications.

Ideally the following technical experience:
  
  

* 2+ years of working with IAM Protocols such as WS-Fed, SAML, OpenID Connect and OAuth.
* 2+ years of hands-on technical experience implementing IAM focused security solutions for Microsoft technologies
* 2+ years of working knowledge with Azure Advanced Threat Protection.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Certifications such as: Microsoft new roles-based certifications, SC-300, AZ-500,AZ-800, AZ-801, SC-100,CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, CCNP, CCNA certification a plus.

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
