title: Principal Engineer — Python is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

We are seeking an experienced 
**Principal Software Engineer**
to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

Requirements

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

#MSSQL

title: Physical Design Technical Leader | ASIC/SoC physical design
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco’s Silicon One Optics Group (S1O) designs& delivers the high-speed optical transceivers, and platforms that power Cisco's core data center networking solutions. We specialize in the design and integration of innovative IM/DD optics and silicon photonic platforms that enable customers to deploy industry-leading optical technologies within data center with unprecedented speed, capacity, and reliability. Come join us and take part in shaping S1O’s ground-breaking optical solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most advanced pluggable, and Co-packaged Optics (CPO) being developed in the industry.
  
  
You will work with Cisco's best-in-class Silicon Photonics team. Our team is responsible for driving the development and optimization of optical transceivers& modules (800G,1.6T& beyond) that seamlessly integrate with Cisco's routing, switching, and datacenter platforms, enabling customers to build scalable, high-performance networks that support emerging technologies including AI/ML workloads, and next-generation data center architectures.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Physical Design Technical Leader to guide our engineering team and drive physical implementation for Cisco's next-generation silicon photonics driver and receiver ICs, powering 100G, 200G, and 400G-per-lambda Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) and optical engine solutions. In this high-impact role, you will lead the physical design strategy and execution for high-performance silicon integrating sophisticated digital control logic, CPU subsystems, high-speed standard interfaces (UCIe), and ultra-fast transmit/receive data-paths in groundbreaking process nodes (TSMC sub-5nm/3nm/2nm).
  
  
As a Technical Leader, you will own block-level and full-chip physical implementation from synthesis through final tape-out (TO) while advising, mentoring, and scaling a team of physical design engineers. You will establish advanced physical design methodologies, drive floor-planning, place& route, low-skew clock and power distribution, multi-corner timing closure (STA), EM/IR integrity, and DRC/LVS physical verification sign-off. Additionally, you will partner closely with Architecture, Analog Front-End, Layout, and Photonic packaging teams to ensure first-pass silicon success and drive breakthrough execution across the complete product lifecycle from concept to production.
  
  
•
  
**Technical& People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and technically steer a team of physical design engineers, driving task allocations, schedule tracking, and design reviews.
  
  
•
  
**Full-Flow Ownership:** Own full-chip and hierarchical block-level RTL-to-GDSII implementation and sign-off on advanced nodes.
  
  
•
  
**Methodology& Flow Innovation:** Architect robust, automated backend flows (Innovus / Fusion Compiler, Pegasus / Calibre, Voltus / RedHawk) to boost team productivity and tapeout predictability.
  
  
•
  
**Multi-functional Collaboration:** Serve as the primary physical design communicate with Analog Design, Custom Layout, Package Co-Design, and Foundry partners.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
•
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in electrical engineering, Electronics& Communication or related field with minimum 12+ years of Industry experience
  
  
•
  
8+ years of physical design (PD) experience delivering ASIC/SoC designs in sophisticated CMOS technology nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm/2nm)
  
  
•
  
Proven experience driving the full RTL-to-GDSII flow at block and/or full-chip level-including hierarchical floor-planning, power grid design, place& route (P), clock tree synthesis (CTS), timing closure, and physical verification sign-off.
  
  
•
  
Strong proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools (Innovus/ICC2/Fusion, Tempus/PrimeTime, Voltus/RedHawk, Calibre/Pegasus etc.)
  
  
•
  
Strong scripting proficiency in Tcl, Python, Bash, or Perl for flow automation, quality of results (QoR) tracking, and efficiency improvements
  
  
•
  
Ability to lead a team of PD engineers& work collaboratively with globally dispersed multi-functional teams
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
•
  
**Education:** Master's degree (M.S. / M.Tech) in Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, or Microelectronics.
  
  
•
  
**Experience:** 12-15+ years of ASIC/SoC physical implementation experience with multiple successful tape-outs in ground-breaking process nodes (sub-5nm, 3nm, or 2nm GAA/nanosheet).
  
  
•
  
**Technical Team Leadership:** Consistent record of leading physical design project execution, defining schedules, conducting design reviews, and driving tapeout readiness for a team of PD engineers.
  
  
•
  
**Mixed-Signal& High-Speed IP Integration:** Strong experience handling floorplanning and noise isolation for sensitive mixed-signal macros, high-speed SerDes, Die-to-Die (D2D / UCIe) interfaces, CPU subsystems, and 2.5D/3D packaging environments.
  
  
•
  
**Front-End / Equivalence Flows:** Familiarity with logic synthesis (Cadence Genus / Synopsys Design Compiler) and formal equivalence checking (Cadence LEC / Synopsys Formality).
  
  
•
  
**Post-Silicon Correlation:** Experience supporting silicon bring-up and correlating pre-silicon timing/power models with post-silicon lab measurements.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR
description:
### **Description**

  

* The Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR is the service owner and senior technical authority for enterprise backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience across the Davies Group estate. Reporting to the Manager - Security, Resilience and DR, the role leads the strategy, governance, engineering direction and operational assurance required to protect critical services and data across on-premises, cloud and SaaS environments.
* The role works across Hosting, Cloud, Network, Security Operations, IAM, Digital Workplace, Service Management, Architecture, Applications, Data, Risk, Compliance, Business Continuity, Procurement and third-party providers. It translates business impact and risk requirements into tested recovery capabilities, clear recovery objectives, measurable controls and leadership-level assurance.
* This is a senior individual-contributor / technical-lead role that may or may not have direct reports. Irrespective of line-management responsibility, the postholder is expected to lead through influence, set standards, coordinate delivery across multiple teams, challenge weak controls and provide clear updates to senior leadership.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy, ownership and governance**

* Own the group-wide backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience service roadmap, operating model, standards and control framework.
* Define target-state capabilities, service tiers and improvement priorities aligned to business criticality, risk appetite, architecture standards and regulatory obligations.
* Establish clear accountability across infrastructure, application and business service owners for backup coverage, recovery design, testing, evidence and remediation.
* Chair or lead resilience governance forums, track decisions and exceptions, and escalate material risks with clear options and recommended actions.

**Backup and recovery leadership**

* Provide technical and service leadership for enterprise backup platforms across on-premises, Azure and other approved cloud or SaaS environments.
* Govern backup policies, schedules, retention, encryption, immutability, access controls, capacity, performance and secure off-site or isolated recovery copies.
* Ensure critical workloads, databases, virtual platforms, file services, cloud resources and relevant SaaS data are identified, protected and recoverable.
* Lead restoration assurance through risk-based restore testing, integrity validation and evidence that recovery outcomes meet approved requirements.
* Drive remediation of failed, missed or degraded backups and recurring defects, with root-cause analysis, ownership and prevention actions.

**Disaster recovery and resilience**

* Own the technology DR lifecycle, including service dependency mapping, recovery strategies, DR plans, runbooks, exercise schedules, test scenarios, evidence and post-exercise improvement plans.
* Partner with Business Continuity, service owners and application teams to translate business impact analysis into achievable recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Lead tabletop, component, application and end-to-end recovery exercises, including cyber-recovery and loss-of-platform scenarios where applicable.
* Coordinate technical recovery during major incidents or declared disasters, providing decision support, status reporting, risk escalation and recovery sequencing.
* Validate resilience for new services, major changes, acquisitions and migrations before production acceptance.

**Security, risk and compliance**

* Work with Security Operations and IAM to protect backup administration, credentials and recovery environments using least privilege, segregation of duties and strong authentication.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence for backup execution, restore results, DR tests, exceptions, risk acceptance and remediation.
* Assess resilience risks arising from ransomware, platform concentration, third-party dependency, data corruption, regional outage, capacity constraint and technology obsolescence.
* Ensure control gaps and overdue remediation are visible through the appropriate risk, change and service-governance processes.

**Service performance and continual improvement**

* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs, including backup success, restore success, protection coverage, recovery objective attainment, test completion, open risks and remediation ageing.
* Use trend analysis, automation and monitoring to reduce manual effort, improve early warning and prevent repeat failures.
* Maintain service documentation, architectural records, policy standards, support models, recovery runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Govern supplier performance, licensing, support arrangements, lifecycle plans and commercial inputs for resilience platforms and services.

**Stakeholder and leadership communication**

* Provide concise, evidence-based updates to senior leadership on resilience posture, test outcomes, material risks, incidents, investment needs and delivery progress.
* Build effective working relationships across Davies Group technology and business teams, external suppliers and assurance functions.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads, promote standardisation and strengthen recovery ownership across delivery teams.
* Support recruitment, objective setting and performance direction for team members if direct reports are assigned.

**Experience & Education\***  
  
**Essential**

* 9-15 years of relevant experience in enterprise infrastructure, backup, recovery, disaster recovery or technology resilience, including significant senior technical-lead or service-owner responsibility.
* Proven track record of leading backup, resilience and DR capabilities in a large, complex or global organisation.
* Demonstrable experience defining and governing enterprise backup and recovery strategies across hybrid environments.
* Demonstrable experience planning and leading DR exercises, coordinating multi-team recovery activity and driving closure of test findings.
* Experience communicating service posture, risks, incidents, investment needs and remediation progress to senior leadership.
* Experience working across infrastructure, application, security, architecture, service management, business continuity, risk and supplier teams.
* Experience producing governance documentation, service roadmaps, technical standards, recovery playbooks, dashboards and audit evidence.
* Bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Desirable**

* Experience within insurance, financial services, professional services or another regulated environment.
* Experience supporting organisational integrations, acquisitions, data-centre exits, cloud transformation or major resilience uplift programmes.
* Prior people-leadership, matrix-leadership or supplier-management experience.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**Essential**

* Deep knowledge of enterprise backup architecture, recovery patterns, retention, encryption, immutability, air-gapped or isolated recovery, replication and capacity management.
* Strong working knowledge of Commvault Cloud / Backup & Recovery for Azure, Veeam and Metallic, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure, Windows Server, Linux, VMware or other virtualisation, storage, databases, networking, identity and cloud-native protection patterns.
* Expert understanding of RPO, RTO, service criticality, dependency mapping, recovery sequencing, DR testing and cyber-recovery principles.
* Ability to convert business and regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering controls, service levels, test plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong governance, risk management, problem management, change control and major-incident leadership capability.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify systemic weaknesses from operational data and drive sustainable corrective action.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leadership and explain complex resilience risks in business terms.
* Ability to lead through influence across geographically dispersed teams and competing priorities.
* Strong documentation discipline and commitment to accurate, audit-ready evidence.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of Azure Site Recovery, cloud-native backup services and recovery automation.
* Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST guidance and relevant resilience or operational-risk expectations.
* Understanding of AIOps, anomaly detection and predictive analytics for backup and resilience monitoring.

**Essential requirement (non-negotiable) \***

* Proven ability to own enterprise backup, recovery, DR and resilience outcomes across a complex, multi-team technology estate.
* 9-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of resilience or recovery services for a large organisation.
* Availability to support planned DR exercises, major incidents and critical recovery activity outside normal working hours when required.
* Ability to communicate confidently with senior leadership, auditors, risk stakeholders and technical teams.
* Willingness to challenge control weaknesses, maintain clear accountability and escalate material risk appropriately.
* Strong commitment to data protection, service reliability, security and continual improvement.

**Essential / preferred**

* Relevant enterprise backup certification, such as Commvault Certified Professional or Veeam Certified Engineer / Architect, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.

**Desirable**

* Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* Business continuity or resilience certification such as CBCI or CBCP.
* Security or governance certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or ISO 22301 / ISO 27001 practitioner or lead implementer / auditor.

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Support Engineer (L1)**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Full-time - Permanent / On-site**

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer- reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

title: Service Manager - EV DC Fast Chargers
description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Service Manager to build and lead the after-sales service function for our DC fast chargers (60 kW and above) across North India. Based in Delhi NCR, you will own field service delivery end-to-end — from first-level troubleshooting at customer sites to setting up the SOPs, KPIs and team that keep our chargers running at high uptime for CPOs, fleet operators and site owners.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will diagnose field issues yourself when needed, while coaching and growing a team of service engineers and partner technicians. The role will initially report to the Head of Sales.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Service Leadership:** Build, lead and grow the after-sales service team (service engineers and partner technicians) across North India — plan manpower, allocate field visits, set priorities and own team performance.

* **SOPs & Process Set-up:** Establish the service function's standard operating procedures from the ground up: installation and commissioning checklists, preventive maintenance schedules, ticketing and escalation workflows, spares and RMA handling, site safety (LOTO, PPE) and field reporting formats.

* **First-Level Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve field issues on DC chargers, on-site or remotely — power module and rectifier faults, contactor/relay and protection device trips, auxiliary SMPS failures, input supply and earthing issues, connector/cable faults, communication failures (CAN, RS-485, Ethernet/4G) and vehicle–charger handshake errors.

* **Escalation & Root Cause Analysis:** Capture structured fault data (logs, error codes, measurements, photos), escalate to engineering and firmware teams with clear evidence, and drive RCA and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) to closure.

* **Uptime & SLAs:** Own charger uptime, response and resolution time (MTTR) and first-time-fix rate against warranty and AMC commitments; publish service dashboards and reports to management.

* **Installation & Commissioning:** Oversee site readiness checks, installation quality, commissioning and handover of new chargers, working closely with EPC contractors and electrical partners.

* **Preventive Maintenance & AMC:** Plan and execute preventive maintenance schedules, and support the sales team on AMC proposals, renewals and service pricing.

* **Spares & RMA:** Plan spares requirements and regional inventory, manage warranty claims and the repair/return cycle with the factory.

* **Customer Interface:** Act as the primary service contact for CPOs, fleet operators and site owners — handle escalations calmly and professionally, and build long-term customer confidence.

* **Coaching & Training:** Coach and mentor service engineers; run technical training for the team, installation partners and customer site staff on operation, safety and basic troubleshooting.

* **Field-to-Product Feedback:** Feed recurring field failures, site conditions and customer feedback back to product, quality and NPD teams to improve reliability.

**A NOTE ON REQUIREMENTS**

We value hands-on problem solvers who can lead from the field. If you match most of the core requirements below and are excited to build a service function from the ground up at a fast-growing company, we strongly encourage you to apply.

**CORE REQUIREMENTS (WHAT YOU BRING DAY 1)**

* **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

* **Experience:** 8–10 years in after-sales / field service, with a proven track record of managing after-sales support for EV DC chargers.

* **Team Leadership:** Experience leading a field service team — allocating work, tracking performance, and coaching engineers and technicians.

* **Electrical & Electronics Troubleshooting:** Working understanding of three-phase AC input, rectifier and DC-DC power modules, contactors, MCB/MCCB, SPD, RCD/insulation monitoring and earthing; able to read wiring diagrams and electrical schematics to fault-find on field chargers.

* **Test Equipment:** Confident use of multimeter, clamp meter, insulation resistance tester (megger) and earth tester, plus laptop-based diagnostics and log retrieval.

* **Charging Communication Basics:** Basic understanding of CCS2 charging, OCPP backend connectivity and CAN/RS-485/Modbus, enough to isolate communication and network faults.

* **Process & SOP Discipline:** Hands-on experience writing and running SOPs, ticketing/CRM tools and service KPIs (uptime, MTTR, first-time-fix rate).

* **Electrical Safety:** Sound knowledge of safe working practices on high-voltage AC/DC equipment (LOTO, PPE, earthing and isolation checks).

* **Languages:** Fluent spoken and written Hindi and English — critical for working with customers, site teams and partner technicians.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel extensively across Delhi NCR, North, Est & West India for site visits and escalations.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE (OR WHAT YOU CAN LEARN WITH US)**

* Prior service experience with a DC charger OEM or a charge point operator (CPO) in India.

* Exposure to EV charging standards (IEC 61851, DIN 70121, ISO 15118) and OCPP 1.6J / 2.0.1 backend diagnostics.

* Background in adjacent power electronics service — UPS, solar inverters, industrial drives (VFDs) or telecom power systems.

* Electrical Supervisor competency certificate or equivalent electrical safety certification.

* Familiarity with field service / CRM tools (e.g., Zoho, Salesforce Field Service, Freshdesk) and remote monitoring dashboards.

* Experience setting up a service function or regional service hub at a growth-stage company.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Bash,Python,Splunk

The primary focus for this position is assisting users through resolving their queries or issues, raised using the organization’s ticketing platform or other supported channels.

For issues that require deeper technical knowledge or access to code, this role will initially escalate the tickets to higher levels of support but is expected to acquire technical skills and be able to support at all levels in due course. · Receive issues and requests through the organization’s ticketing system.

o (Log tickets when issues are reported through alternate supported channels).

Inject malicious code, abuse runner configurations, exploit infrastructure-as-code (IaC) misconfigurations and hijack software supply chains to pivot into production environments.
* **IoT :** Perform physical and logical security assessments on enterprise IoT devices, embedded systems and proprietary hardware. Execute firmware reverse engineering, extract cryptographic keys and abuse hardware communication protocols (e.g., UART, JTAG, SPI) to gain network footholds.
* **Custom Infrastructure & C2 Construction:** Architect, deploy and manage highly resilient, covert Command-and-Control (C2) infrastructure using advanced redirectors, domain fronting and custom C2 frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3–8 years of dedicated experience in offensive security roles, with a proven track record of leading complex Red Team operations or advanced adversary emulation engagements.
* **DevSecOps & Supply Chain Mastery:** Deep understanding of modern software development life cycles (SDLC). Proven ability to compromise secrets management vaults (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), poison build environments and abuse container orchestrators (Kubernetes, Docker).

* Work with functional teams to identify process bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

* Experience in managing cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders, departments and deliverables.

title: SAP FICO Functional Tester
description:
**SAP FI FUNCTIONAL TESTER**

**Exp : 2 + Years**

**Location : Bangalore**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled SAP FI Functional Tester with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Finance testing.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Financial Accounting processes, experience in functional and

regression testing, and the ability to validate end-to-end financial transactions. The role includes preparing and

executing test scenarios, analyzing defects, validating financial postings, and ensuring the quality of SAP FI solutions

across business processes and system integrations. Experience in SAP S/4HANA, retail finance, and testing custom

SAP programs and interfaces is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

SAP FI Functional Testing

o Test SAP FI processes including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset

Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.

o Validate end-to-end financial transactions and accounting entries, including document types, posting keys, GL

accounts, company codes, and fiscal periods.

o Verify account determination, tax postings, exchange-rate differences, and financial document splitting.

o Execute positive, negative, boundary, and exception-based test scenarios.

Test Planning and Execution

o Analyze functional specifications, business requirements, and Jira user stories.

o Prepare detailed test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts; execute functional, integration, regression, and UAT

testing.

o Maintain execution status, evidence, and defect documentation; identify test coverage gaps.

o Support test planning, estimation, and regression suite preparation.

End-to-End Integration Testing

o Test integration between SAP FI and MM, SD, and CO.

o Validate Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R) processes.

o Test financial impacts of goods receipts, invoice receipts, sales transactions, and inventory movements.

o Validate 3-way matching involving Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and Vendor Invoices, as well as inbound

interfaces and IDocs.

SAP Data Validation and Defect Analysis

o Validate SAP financial documents using relevant transactions and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, BSIK,

BSAK, and applicable MM tables.

o Analyze posting discrepancies, identify root causes, and validate debit/credit balances, currencies, and

controlling assignments.

o Collaborate with functional consultants, ABAP developers, and business analysts to resolve defects; retest fixes

and perform impact analysis.

Custom Program and Interface Testing

o Test custom SAP developments, Z-programs, reports, enhancements, and interfaces.

o Validate custom financial posting logic, business rules, error handling, exception scenarios, and reconciliation

logic.

o Perform regression testing after configuration changes, code fixes, and enhancements.

Test Documentation and Reporting

o Maintain test scripts, execution results, defect logs, and regression suites.

o Prepare test execution summaries and defect status reports; communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

o Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects; support release readiness.

**Required Skills and Experience**

o 4-5 years of hands-on SAP FI functional testing experience.

o Strong understanding of SAP FI business processes and accounting fundamentals.

o Experience with GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.

o Knowledge of document posting, document types, posting keys, GL account determination, and tax postings.

o Experience in integration testing across SAP FI, MM, SD, and CO.

o Hands-on experience preparing and executing test cases and managing defects using Jira, ALM, or similar tools.

o Working knowledge of SAP tables and transaction codes for financial data validation.

o Ability to interpret functional specifications and translate requirements into test scenarios.

o Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

o Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA).

o Experience in SAP retail or high-volume transaction environments.

o Knowledge of SAP MM invoice verification and 3-way matching.

o Experience testing IDocs, inbound interfaces, and external system integrations.

o Exposure to custom SAP Z-programs and enhancements.

o Knowledge of CO-PA, cost centers, profit centers, internal orders, financial reconciliation, and month-end close.

o Basic understanding of SAP configuration and identifying configuration-related issues.

**Educational Qualification**

o Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

o SAP FI certification or relevant SAP Finance training is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on SAP FI tester who understands both test execution and the underlying accounting

impact of SAP transactions. They should be able to independently prepare scenarios, execute end-to-end testing,

validate financial postings, identify defects, and work closely with functional and development teams to ensure high

quality SAP releases.

Candidates with strong SAP FI testing experience and a good understanding of financial accounting processes

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Work with Data Stewards across R&D and Global Medical to profile data, clarify requirements and document proposed quality rules, thresholds and severity for business approval.
* Develop, configure and maintain automated validations using SQL, Python and the approved data quality tools. Search the shared rule registry first and reuse or adapt approved rules where appropriate.
* Implement field-level, cross-system and business-process validations, as well as expected-versus-actual load and freshness validations. Ensure each validation produces dependable measurements (records evaluated, passed and failed, or expected and actual loads) and that failed records are easy for the business to understand.
* Test rules with pass/fail scenarios, then review the results with the Data Steward, refining the logic until the Data Steward confirms the results reflect the business intent. Prepare test evidence and obtain the required business approval before the platform team releases a rule; a rule is complete when it is approved and launched into production.
* Monitor data quality results over time, maintain scorecards and reporting, then support regular reviews with business owners and Stewards. Use these reviews to identify recurring data issues and recommend tuning rules, adjusting thresholds, or retiring rules that no longer add value.
* Support data remediation by investigating validation rule and monitoring failures. Help Data Stewards decide whether the cause is the rule, the source data or the data flow; route issues to the responsible team; and confirm fixes through re-testing.
* Manage new rules, changes, enhancements and retirements through an agreed intake process and work queue. Maintain specifications, test evidence, approval references and change history, raise blockers early and coordinate production handoffs with DD&T and the platform teams.
* Maintain the team's data quality playbook, including reusable rule patterns, templates, and testing and documentation standards, so new datasets, systems and business groups are onboarded the same way each time.
* Train and mentor new analysts and other team members on the tools, standards and ways of working, and review their rules and test evidence. Help Data Stewards learn how to request rules, read the results and act on them.
* Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of data quality tools, platforms and methods, including automation and AI-assisted rule development, and help move rules and evidence when tools or platforms change.

**Accountability and Decision Rights :**
The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for the quality of the technical rules, tests, documentation and results within their assigned work and, when reviewing the work of others, for applying the team's standards including solutioning and implementation of validations within the pipeline. This requires an understanding of the architecture and technology stack within Takeda. Data Stewards and Trustees retain responsibility for business definitions, thresholds, risk decisions and approvals. DD&T and the designated platform teams own production deployment and platform operations; source and technical owners remain responsible for correcting defects in their systems. The R&D Data Governance lead sets priorities and resolves escalations.
  
  
**Education :**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics or a related field.
* Preferred Master’s degree in a related field.

**Experience :**

* Minimum 8+ years in data quality, data engineering or technical data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise data quality, data integration or business rules tool (such as Informatica), and the ability to learn new tools as the platform changes.
* Experience in data profiling, reconciliation, automated validation, testing and investigation of data quality issues.

**Skills :**
**Required**

* Solid understanding of data quality dimensions (such as completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency and timeliness) and how to measure them.
* Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical rules and explain methods, standards and findings clearly to nontechnical stakeholders and new team members.
* Sound troubleshooting, documentation, collaboration and work-prioritization skills.
* Willingness to coach others, share knowledge and review colleagues' work constructively.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with cloud data platforms (such as Databricks and Spark), work-management tools (such as ServiceNow) and reporting tools (such as Power BI).
* Experience with pharmaceutical, clinical or GxP-related data and applicable quality requirements.
* Experience training, mentoring or leading the work of other analysts.
* Familiarity with automation or AI-assisted approaches to data quality.

IND - Bengaluru

Employee

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:

**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.

title: Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential. Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use.  
  
This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed.

### **Job Description: Scrum Master (SAFe)**

**Location:** India

**Team:** IT Department

**Reports to:** Ralph Michelot

### **Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and passionate **Scrum Master** to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential.

Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use. This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed.

### **What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities**

* **Facilitate Agile Ceremonies:** Lead all SAFe and Scrum events, including Program Increment (PI) Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Iteration Planning, Iteration Reviews, and Retrospectives, ensuring they are productive and stay within their timebox.
* **Coach and Mentor:** Act as an Agile coach for the team, providing guidance on SAFe, Scrum, and Lean principles. Help the team embrace a mindset of relentless improvement.
* **Remove Impediments:** Proactively identify and remove blockers or obstacles that are preventing the team from achieving its goals. Shield the team from external distractions.

* **Support the Product Owner:** Assist the Product Owner with backlog management, ensuring that goals, scope, and product domain are understood by everyone on the team.
* **Foster a Collaborative Culture:** Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, and there is an emphasis on collaboration and problem-solving.
* **Track and Radiate Information:** Utilize tools like Jira to track team progress, manage metrics (like velocity and cycle time), and communicate this information to stakeholders to ensure transparency.
* **Drive SAFe Adoption:** Guide the team in its role within the Agile Release Train (ART) and ensure its alignment with the overall program objectives.

### **What You'll Bring: Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 2-5+ years of experience in a Scrum Master role for a software development team.
* **SAFe Experience:** At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working in a SAFe environment.
* **Certification:** Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification is required.
* **Agile Tools:** Proficiency with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar platform.
* **Excellent Skills:** Strong communication, facilitation, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.
* **Servant Leadership:** A deep understanding of the servant-leader role and a passion for empowering teams.

### **Nice-to-Haves: Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience participating in a large-scale Agile transformation.
* Advanced SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Advanced Scrum Master - SASM).
* Knowledge of other Agile approaches like Kanban and XP.
* Previous experience as a software developer, QA engineer, or business analyst.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

TruePrivacy helps enterprises operationalize GDPR, DPDP, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other evolving global privacy requirements across data, vendors, products, and customer journeys. The platform centralizes privacy workflows, streamlines compliance activities, and automates the collection of compliance evidence. By enabling continuous readiness, TruePrivacy supports organizations in moving away from last-minute audits and toward proactive privacy management. The company is built by the team behind LowerPlane, bringing proven expertise in privacy and compliance technology to its solutions. Team members join a mission-driven environment focused on responsible data practices and regulatory trust.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Software Test Engineer role based in Chennai. The Software Test Engineer will design, develop, and maintain test cases and test plans to validate product functionality and performance. The role involves executing manual and automated tests, identifying defects, documenting issues, and collaborating closely with software development teams to ensure high-quality releases. The Software Test Engineer will participate in requirement analysis, contribute to test strategy and test coverage, and support regression, integration, and system testing activities. The position also includes working with cross-functional stakeholders to improve testing processes, tools, and quality standards in line with privacy and compliance requirements.

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Software Testing and Testing, with experience validating web-based and backend systems.
* Candidates should possess skills in Test Execution and Test Cases, including writing, maintaining, and executing detailed test scenarios.
* Candidates should possess foundational skills in Software Development to collaborate effectively with engineers and understand technical specifications.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of test management tools, bug tracking systems, and version control platforms.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and clear documentation practices.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work in cross-functional engineering and product teams.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks, scripting languages, and CI/CD pipelines is beneficial.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

title: Sr. Assoc, Prod Specialist - MSD, WRB TechRB Tech
description:
**Job Summary**

* App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
* Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
* Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
* Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**

* Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
* Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
* Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
* Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
* Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**

* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
* Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
* Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Software Engineering
* Programming Principles
* Application Programming Interface
* Database Development
* Distributed Systems
* DevOps
* Software Testing
* Secure Coding
* Web Application Security
* Mobile Security

**Other Skills**

* Platform Management
* Operating Systems
* Computer Network
* Database Administration
* Functional Writing

**Motivations**

* Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.
* Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.
* Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.

**Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.
* Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.
* Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.
* Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.
* Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.
* Business English

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.

* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines

* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***

title: System Engineer-Rail
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a competent and motivated Railway System Engineer to contribute to the delivery and integration of railway systems across international projects. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of railway systems engineering, system architecture, requirements management, interfaces, verification and validation, safety, and systems integration across disciplines such as Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, and Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage railway system requirements, system architecture, functional specifications, and technical documentation in accordance with applicable project and national standards.
* Support system engineering activities across the project lifecycle, from bid/tender and concept/design through integration, testing, commissioning, and project closure.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces and system integration between Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, Civil, and Operations.
* Prepare and maintain System Requirement Specifications (SRS), Interface Control Documents (ICD), System Architecture documents, compliance matrices, verification and validation plans, and other system engineering deliverables.
* Perform requirements analysis, traceability, allocation, impact assessment, and verification to ensure that system requirements are correctly implemented and demonstrated.
* Support RAMS and safety engineering activities in accordance with applicable standards, including CENELEC EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 where applicable.
* Contribute to technical reviews, design assurance, compliance assessments, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of system engineering processes and workflows.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Systems, Railway, Control & Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline (Master’s preferred).
* 6–10 years of professional experience in railway systems engineering, systems integration, railway design, or a related discipline.
* Good understanding of railway system lifecycle, system engineering processes, requirements management, interface management, verification & validation, and configuration/change management.
* Experience working across one or more railway disciplines such as Signalling/ERTMS, Telecom, SCADA/OCC, Electrical/OLE, Rolling Stock, Track, or Operations.
* Exposure to international railway standards and client requirements, particularly Australia (ARTC/MTM), UK (Network Rail), and Sweden (Trafikverket).
* Understanding of ERTMS/ETCS, conventional signalling, railway telecom, SCADA/OCC, traction power/OLE, or other railway subsystems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with engineering and documentation tools such as MicroStation, AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, requirements-management tools, interface-management tools, or project collaboration platforms.
* Good understanding of safety-critical engineering, RAMS, hazard management, and regulatory/compliance requirements for railway systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* IRSE License or equivalent national/international railway certification.
* Certification or training in Systems Engineering, Requirements Engineering, RAMS, or Functional Safety.
* Knowledge or training in CENELEC railway standards (EN 50126/8/9).
* OEM-specific railway systems training (e.g., Siemens, Alstom, Hitachi, Thales, or equivalent).
* Relevant rail safety worker certifications such as RIW (Australia) or Sentinel (UK) are a plus.

description:

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

7–8 Years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control.


Experience in EPC, industrial equipment manufacturing, process plants, skid packages, instrumentation systems or power/chemical/oil & gas industries.

: B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical & Instrumentation / Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering

Operations / Operations & Projects

Vasai, Andheri-Mumbai
