- Full Time

**Gende**

r-Male/Female.

We are looking for the experienced and motivated
**Lead-Quality Assurance having 07-08 years of work experience**

preferably from Boiler Industry, Process Industry, Chemical, Oil & Ga and Power Industry.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**1. Role Objective**

The Lead – Quality Assurance & Quality Control will be responsible for establishing, implementing and maintaining the company's overall Quality Management System and ensuring quality compliance across all project activities, including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, assembly, inspection, testing and project execution. The position will act as the primary quality coordination interface between internal departments, vendors, third-party inspection agencies and clients.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

Prepare, review and implement project-specific Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection procedures.

Develop QAPs covering mechanical skids, piping, structural fabrication, electrical panels, instrumentation, cabling and control systems.

Review client specifications, purchase orders, approved drawings and applicable quality requirements before initiating project activities.

Ensure compliance with applicable EN standards, CE requirements and other relevant international codes.

**3. Vendor Quality Management & Inspection Coordination**

Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for quality requirements, inspections and documentation.

Review vendor quality plans, inspection procedures, material test certificates and technical documentation.

Plan and coordinate vendor inspections, stage inspections, pre-dispatch inspections and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs).

Ensure inspection requests are raised on time, and inspections are completed as per approved QAPs and project schedules.

Monitor vendor quality performance and initiate corrective actions wherever required.

**4. Inspection, Testing & FAT**

Coordinate and witness mechanical, electrical and instrumentation inspections and testing activities.

Ensure inspection and testing of fabricated skids, piping, pressure components, electrical panels, instruments and control systems as per QAPs.

Verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and applicable standards.

Coordinate FAT activities for electrical panels, PLC/control systems, instrumentation and complete skid packages.

Ensure proper recording of inspection observations, test results and client approvals.

Ensure timely closure of client and third-party inspection observations


before material dispatch
**.**

**5. Quality Documentation & Project Quality Dossier**

Prepare, compile, review and maintain complete project-specific Quality Documentation Dossiers

Ensure dossiers are prepared in accordance with client specifications and contractual requirements.

Ensure final quality dossiers are submitted to clients within agreed project timelines.

**6. Non-Conformance Management & CAPA**

Identify, document and manage internal and external Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

Coordinate with concerned departments and vendors for root cause analysis.

Prepare and implement Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.

**7. ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management System**

Maintain and continuously improve the company's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

Ensure proper control of documents and records across departments.

Coordinate internal quality audits, external audits and surveillance audits.

**Knowledge of applicable European and international standards-**

EN standards relevant to mechanical and electrical equipment.

CE marking requirements and applicable EU directives/regulations.

EN 60204-1 – Safety of Machinery: Electrical Equipment of Machines.

IEC 61439 – Low-voltage switchgear and control gear assemblies.

Relevant ISO standards and project-specific codes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

Strong technical understanding of electrical and instrumentation systems.

Good understanding of mechanical fabrication, piping, skid manufacturing and assembly processes.

Hands-on experience in preparation of QAPs, ITPs and quality documentation.

Experience in coordinating client inspections, vendor inspections and FATs.

Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 implementation and audit requirements.

Understanding EN standards, IEC codes and CE compliance requirements.

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs and technical specifications.

Good communication and coordination skills to interact with international clients, vendors and inspection agencies.

title: Senior Executive
description:
Shop-Floor QA / GMP Compliance
  
  
Perform routine QA oversight of API manufacturing and packaging operations.
  
  
Ensure manufacturing activities are performed according to approved SOPs, BMR/BPR, specifications, and GMP requirements.
  
  
Conduct line clearance and area/equipment verification before commencement of manufacturing activities.
  
  
Monitor critical manufacturing activities and ensure compliance with approved process parameters.
  
  
Verify equipment status, cleaning status, calibration status, and area conditions.
  
  
Ensure proper identification and status labeling of raw materials, intermediates, solvents, finished products, and equipment.
  
  
Raise and document GMP observations and ensure timely corrective actions.
  
  

* Batch Documentation & Review

Review Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Batch Packaging Records (BPR), equipment logbooks, and associated GMP documents.
  
  
Ensure entries are complete, accurate, traceable, and contemporaneous.
  
  
Review manufacturing yields, reconciliation, process parameters, IPC results, and deviations.
  
  
Ensure batch documentation is completed and reviewed within the defined timelines.
  
  
Support batch disposition/release activities in coordination with QA management.
  
  

* Deviation, Investigation & CAPA

Initiate, review, and support investigation of deviations, incidents, OOS/OOT, process failures, and market complaints, as applicable.
  
  
Participate in root-cause analysis using appropriate investigation tools.
  
  
Prepare and monitor CAPA plans and verify effectiveness.
  
  
Ensure investigations are scientifically sound, properly documented, and completed within timelines.
  
  

* Change Control

Review and assess change controls related to manufacturing processes, equipment, facilities, materials, analytical methods, documents, and utilities.
  
  
Coordinate with Production, QC, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions for impact assessment.
  
  
Monitor implementation of approved changes and ensure required documentation is completed.
  
  

* SOP & Quality System

Prepare, review, and revise SOPs, specifications, formats, protocols, and other quality documents.
  
  
Ensure implementation of the site Quality Management System.
  
  
Support periodic review of SOPs and controlled documents.
  
  
Ensure training is completed before implementation of new or revised procedures.
  
  

* Audit & Inspection Readiness

Support internal audits, customer audits, regulatory inspections, and GMP audits.
  
  
Prepare documents and records required for audits and inspections.
  
  
Track audit observations and support timely implementation and closure of commitments.
  
  
Maintain the assigned areas in an inspection-ready condition.
  
  

* Training & Compliance

Provide GMP and quality-system training to Production, QC, Warehouse, Engineering, and other relevant personnel.
  
  
Monitor compliance with data integrity and good documentation practices.
  
  
Promote a strong quality culture throughout the manufacturing area.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate with Production, QC, Warehouse, Engineering, EHS, and Regulatory Affairs to resolve quality-related issues.
  
  
Provide QA guidance during manufacturing process deviations and abnormal events.
  
  
Support continuous improvement and risk-reduction initiatives.
  
  
Required Knowledge
  
  
Strong knowledge of ICH Q7, GMP, GDP, data integrity, and API manufacturing requirements.
  
  
Knowledge of BMR/BPR review and shop-floor QA activities.
  
  
Good understanding of deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT, investigations, and risk assessment.
  
  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for API manufacturing.
  
  
Understanding of documentation practices and traceability requirements.
  
  
Key Skills
  
  
GMP and regulatory compliance
  
  
Batch record review
  
  
Deviation investigation
  
  
CAPA and change control
  
  
Root-cause analysis
  
  
Audit/inspection handling
  
  
Documentation and data integrity
  
  
Problem-solving and decision-making
  
  
Cross-functional coordination
  
  
Team leadership and communication
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Timely and accurate batch record review
  
  
GMP compliance and reduction in recurring observations
  
  
Timely closure of deviations, CAPA, and change controls
  
  
Audit/inspection readiness and compliance
  
  
Effectiveness of investigations and CAPA
  
  
Training compliance
  
  
Data integrity and documentation compliance
  
  
Reduction in repeat deviations and quality incidents

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Corporate Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Sr.Technical Analyst – Process Mining and Modeling is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the technical delivery and lifecycle management of global process-mining and process-modeling solutions from technical intake through operational adoption. Working from defined business problems and requirements established with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role, this position translates business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions using SAP Signavio, SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning systems, and related data platforms. The analyst owns the technical data foundation, solution design, configuration, technical validation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of process-mining and process-modeling solutions. The role partners closely with process owners, the business-facing process-mining role, and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, actionable, secure, and sustainable, while the business-facing role owns business interpretation, improvement action planning, and value realization across General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical intake, solution design, estimation, and delivery planning for global process-mining and process-modeling initiatives, building on business opportunities and requirements defined with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role.
* Partner with the business-facing process-mining role, Process Owners, and data owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements, data definitions, KPI logic, analytical acceptance criteria, and traceable solution designs.
* Design, build, and validate the data foundation required for process mining, including source-data preparation, event logs, connectors, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls across SAP S/4HANA, ERP, and related data platforms.
* Configure and deliver SAP Signavio process-mining and process-modeling solutions, including process discovery, process analysis, and BPMN-based modeling where applicable, to produce reliable and actionable insights from approved business requirements.
* Provide strong technical leadership for workstreams and delivery partners by making solution decisions, setting technical direction, managing technical risks and dependencies, and ensuring quality across implementation activities.
* Lead technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement across the solution lifecycle; coordinate business validation and user acceptance with the business-facing process-mining role and Process Owners.
* Enable adoption through clear technical documentation, solution walkthroughs, capability guidance, and operational support. Partner with the business-facing process-mining role to support improvement outcomes, while maintaining clear D&T ownership of technical readiness, reliability, and sustainability.
* Establish and apply reusable technical standards, delivery practices, architecture principles, data-quality controls, release practices, and governance expectations for process-mining and modeling solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.
* Global Collaboration: Experience delivering global solutions with teams across regions and time zones.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and partner effectively with process owners, business-facing process-mining practitioners, data owners, and technical delivery partners while maintaining clear technical ownership

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:

Position Overview

* **Job Title:**
  Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst
* **Company:**
  EisnerAmper
* **Department:**
  Growth Team
* **Business Groups:**
  Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group
* **Experience:**
  2+ years
* **Primary Focus:**
  CRM Data Management, Sales Pipeline Data Quality, and Reporting
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* **Work Schedule:**
  Must maintain 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.
* **Work Arrangement:**
  Hybrid.
* **Location**
  : Mumbai

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.
* Document recurring data issues and recommend process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting workflows.
* Support consistent CRM practices across NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other approved platforms.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with Growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership.
* Communicate data quality issues and follow up on corrective actions.
* Guide CRM users on data entry standards and opportunity management procedures.
* Ensure stakeholders follow established CRM data quality requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales Operations, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of experience working with CRM systems.
* Experience in CRM data entry, cleanup, auditing, or quality assurance.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on corrective actions.
* Availability for at least 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

Desired Qualifications

* Experience with NetSuite CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including:
* Filtering and sorting large datasets.
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and other lookup functions.
* Pivot tables.
* Data validation and cleanup.
* Understanding of sales pipeline stages, forecasting, lead attribution, and opportunity ownership.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, accounting, or advisory organizations.
* Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and reporting tools.
* Experience using AI, automation, or data analysis tools to improve data quality and operational workflows.

We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
* Support business readiness, change management, and operational transition activities.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Analyze and document Front-to-Back trade lifecycle processes across Capital Markets and Treasury functions.
* Support initiatives involving trade capture, lifecycle management, confirmations, settlements, securities processing, reconciliations, collateral management, corporate actions, accounting, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

**Domain Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Treasury, or Financial Markets.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
* Good knowledge of:

+ Trade Capture & Processing
+ Confirmations
+ Settlements
+ Securities Processing
+ Reconciliations
+ Collateral Management
+ Corporate Actions
+ Regulatory & Operational Controls

* Exposure to Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, or Operations functions.

**Asset Class Knowledge**
Experience in one or more:
  
  

* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Money Markets
* Interest Rate Products
* Credit Products
* Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps)

**Platforms & Technology**

* Experience working on Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, enhancement, migration, or support programs.
* Exposure to platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+
+ Finastra Solutions
+ FIS Quantum
+ Broadridge
+ MarkitSERV
+ Front Arena
+ Other Capital Markets, Treasury, or Post-Trade platforms

* Experience supporting integration, data migration, and platform modernization initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies.
* Experience performing data mapping, reconciliation, and data validation activities.
* Understanding of APIs, interfaces, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience reviewing system impacts across multiple applications and data sources.
* Familiarity with Jira, Agile, Scrum, and related delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting reporting solutions and business data validation

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and project deliverables.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently drive requirements and solution discussions.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience supporting Capital Markets platform implementation, consolidation, or migration programs.
* Exposure to regulatory transformation initiatives and reporting requirements.
* Knowledge of financial market interfaces and messaging standards including SWIFT, FIX, MQ, XML, APIs, and ISO 20022.
* Experience working with investment banks, broker-dealers, custodians, exchanges, asset managers, or financial market infrastructures.
* Familiarity with trade and reference data management, reconciliation processes, and operational controls.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant Capital Markets certification is advantageous.
* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, Financial Services Technology, or related consulting environments.
* Proven experience supporting business analysis, platform implementation, transformation, migration, or regulatory change programs.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, Capital Markets, or Project Delivery are desirable.
* Experience working with global banks, broker-dealers, custodians, asset managers, exchanges, or financial institutions is preferred.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical SAP Consultant Integration
description:
We’re a game changer that optimizes supply chains of the world’s leading companies with our very own smart software and services.
  
  
To fuel its supply chain planning solution with data, we have developed an integration platform, including a specialized SAP integration solution.
  
  
Are you driven to deliver high-quality and well-tested software solutions to customers? Do you get a kick from technical analysis and developing integration solutions? Ready to join a place where smart solutions meet human collaboration?
  
  
Look no further and become our new Technical SAP Integration Consultant! Read on to learn more.
  
  
**Your challenge**
As a Technical SAP Integration Consultant, your main focus is the
**technical analysis and development of our integration solutions**
. You ensure that high-quality, well-tested, and documented solutions are delivered to our customers.
  
  
**You Are Responsible For**

* Providing implementation support to customer solution project teams on our bi-directional integration solutions. You work in a multi-disciplinary (C++, ABAP, …) global team where every discipline provides a piece of the complete integration solution.
* Dealing with questions and issues related to the integration solutions which require technical knowledge and specific expertise.
* Building and maintaining expertise by fulfilling an implementation consultant role in customer projects focused on integration solutions.
* Delivering expert knowledge in customer projects.

**Your team**
As our new Technical SAP Integration Consultant, you’ll be part of the Product Design team. Product Design drives our product road map, based on a strong future vision and deep technologic overview. We make the blueprints for our solution’s functionality and share OMP’s vision and expertise with customers and colleagues alike.
  
  
**About You**
Essential talents and qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, mathematics, industrial engineering, or similar.
* A solid background in IT.
* 1 - 3 years of experience in software implementation, troubleshooting, or a support role. Experience can be substituted for a degree.
* Great analytical skills and problem-solving abilities complemented with a passion for complex software design and development.
* A customer-oriented and results-committed attitude.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* A creative way of working, both as a team player and independently.
* A passion to keep improving their skills.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Knowledge of or experience with:
* SAP (PP and MM).
* Macro language coding (Visual Basic, C, or similar).
* Web services technology, such as REST.
* Active knowledge of a version management system.
* Proficiency in data communication or transformation techniques.
* A willingness to travel for training purposes.

**Your future**
We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions.
  
  
Many of our team members who start as Technical SAP Integration Consultants grow into roles in project management, solution architecture, or people management.
  
  
**Our offer**
At OMP, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Access customized training, coaching programs, and on-the-job development opportunities.
* Flexibility: Flex your schedule with working from home, adaptable hours, and the autonomy to shape your routine.
* Collaborative culture: Cross-team collaboration and creative challenges that encourage you to share knowledge, celebrate wins, and grow together.
* Benefits: An attractive salary package including additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.
* Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.
* Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking.

**Our Company**
We’re a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1,400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world’s largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L’Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble.
  
  
Ready to be smart with heart? Join our team where technical expertise and human connection create solutions that scale globally and make a lasting impression.
  
  
Want to learn more? Visit careers.omp.com/life-at-omp.

title: QA Lead -Salesforce Automation
description:
**Job Description:**
**Senior QA Engineer (Salesforce Test Automation)**
**Experience:**
7–10 Years
  
  
**Role:**
Senior QA Engineer
  
  
**Work Model:**
Agile Delivery Pod (client-facing)
  
  
**Focus:**
Salesforce Automation Testing, Playwright, Selenium, Copado, Test Strategy & Documentation, Client Engagement
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a
**Senior QA Engineer**
with 7–10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on
**Salesforce testing and test automation**
. The candidate will define and execute test strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, and uphold quality standards across the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
The role requires direct engagement with clients. The candidate will take part in requirement discussions, present quality status and risks to client stakeholders, and propose practical suggestions to improve quality and test coverage. The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Architects, Scrum Masters and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Must Have Skills**
**Technical Skills**

* MANDATORY: Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce automation testing across Lightning Experience, Apex, flows, and integrated business processes.
* MANDATORY: Strong hands-on expertise in Playwright for end-to-end test automation (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and Copado for Salesforce release testing and CI/CD-integrated deployments.
* Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks (Page Object Model, data-driven and keyword-driven approaches).
* Experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and UAT support testing, and with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
* Working knowledge of Git and of integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail or Xray.

**Quality Practices & Documentation**

* Ability to set up the complete testing lifecycle, including test strategy, test plans, environment and test data setup, entry and exit criteria, and traceability matrices.
* Proven adherence to QA best practices such as risk-based testing, shift-left testing, root cause analysis and defect lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation skills, including test strategies, test reports, automation framework guides and runbooks.

**Communication & Client Engagement**

* Ability to communicate directly with clients, presenting test progress, quality metrics, risks and dependencies in a clear and professional manner.
* Ability to ideate with clients and provide well-reasoned suggestions on automation coverage, quality improvements and process optimization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort in requirement discussions, estimation, and sprint ceremonies within an Agile pod.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Salesforce Core experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Financial Services Cloud testing experience, including household and financial account management, relationship management, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Other automation and testing tools such as Provar, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Appium, JMeter or Gearset.
* Experience with Apex unit test validation, SOQL and data validation, and sandbox or environment management strategies.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Financial Services Cloud.
* Experience working with global teams and offshore–onshore delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for Salesforce and web applications using Playwright, Selenium and Copado.
* Set up and govern the testing process from project inception, including test environments, test data, tooling and quality gates.
* Define test strategies, test plans and test cases aligned to business requirements and process flows.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and smoke testing, and integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Engage directly with clients to clarify requirements, present quality status, and ideate on improvements to coverage and process.
* Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including test reports, defect reports, traceability matrices and automation guides.
* Perform defect triage and root cause analysis, and drive resolution with development teams.
* Support release activities, UAT and production validation, and mentor junior QA engineers on best practices.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce quality assurance and test automation may also be considered. Relevant certifications are preferred.

title: AdvaRisk - QA Lead - Automation Testing
description:
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the end-to-end test automation strategy, defining the roadmap, frameworks, tooling and standards for UI, API, backend and integration testing.
* Lead, mentor and manage the QA team, owning delivery, prioritization, test coverage and quality outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering, product, data science/ML and client service teams to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test data, traceability and release-level quality reports.
* Triage defects, assess business and customer impact, and coordinate defect prioritization with relevant teams.
* Test AI/ML model integrations end to end, including request/response contracts, preprocessing and post-processing, timeout/retry behavior, failure handling and fallback paths.
* Build model-focused test suites using representative and edge-case datasets; assess output correctness against agreed reference labels or acceptance criteria, and track metrics such as precision/recall where applicable.
* Validate LLM-enabled workflows for groundedness, consistency, hallucination risks, prompt/input sensitivity and regression when prompts, models or versions change; use defined evaluation criteria rather than subjective checks alone.
* Check model-service latency, throughput, rate limits, availability, version compatibility and behavior under malformed, incomplete or unexpected inputs.
* Perform end-to-end, system integration and regression testing across UI, backend services, APIs, databases and third party/model services.
* Establish performance baselines and report findings with actionable recommendations for capacity and scalability improvements.
* Plan and execute performance, load, stress, spike and endurance tests; analyze throughput, latency, concurrency, resource utilization and bottlenecks.
* Work with developers to reproduce issues, verify fixes and prevent regressions throughout the release cycle.
* Own test-suite execution in non-production environments and integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience testing web applications across UI, backend services, APIs, databases and end-to-end workflows.
* Strong QA fundamentals with substantial hands-on automation experience using Python; able to design, build, maintain and scale automation frameworks rather than only execute existing scripts.
* People leadership experience, including leading, mentoring and driving the output of a team of 3 or more QA engineers.
* Strong API testing and debugging skills, including REST APIs, response/schema validation, authentication, error handling and service-to-service integration.
* Experience with performance-testing tools such as JMeter, Locust, k6 or equivalent, and ability to interpret results and identify bottlenecks.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML model evaluation and integration testing; able to define test datasets, expected outcomes, thresholds and regression checks in collaboration with data science/ML engineers.
* Familiarity with testing LLM-based features, including prompt/version regression, groundedness and response-quality evaluation, structured-output validation and safe failure handling.
* Comfortable validating data and service behavior using SQL, logs, metrics and traces; familiarity with CI/CD-based automated test execution is an advantage.
* Good understanding of front-end technologies and browser-based testing, including JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Pytest, Robot Framework, Selenium, Cypress or equivalent; experience with API automation is essential.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and participating in sprint planning, refinement, reviews and release readiness.
* A strong quality mindset and a track record of promoting automation-first, risk-based testing and continuous quality improvement.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work across engineering, product, QA and AI/ML teams to define and deliver quality outcomes.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Be excited by and have a positive outlook to navigate ambiguity.
* Passion for results and excellence.
* Team player.
* Must be able to get the job done by working collaboratively with others.
* Inquisitive and analytical mind; out-of-the-box thinking.
* Prioritize among competing opportunities, balancing consumer needs with business and product priorities, and clearly articulate the rationale behind product decisions.
* Straightforward and professional.
* Good communicator.
* Maintain high energy and motivate the team.
* A do-it-yourself orientation, consistent with the company's "roll-up-the-sleeves" culture.
* Proactive.

* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 1 to 3 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:


+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:

**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
**# AI Evaluation Engineer**

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(890)
* Experience:\*\* 9–12 Years
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days
* Preferred Candidates:\*\* Local candidates based in Pune

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**AI Solutions Engineer**
to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations
  
  

* Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows.
* Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
* Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses.
* Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control
  
  

* Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab.
* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security
  
  

* Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.
* Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep.
* Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls.

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly.
* Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions.
* Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams.

**## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves**
**The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position**

* Python
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* OpenAI
* Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Digital Platform Engineer**
We're looking for a Senior Digital Platform Engineer to join a team that keeps our digital pricing and quoting landscape running, evolving and improving it. You will work across multiple applications rather than living in just one stack, which means real variety. The core system is Conga Smart CPQ which aid our business counterparts in building solutions for our customers, thus the role has a tangible impact on how well we are doing as a company.
  
  
This role sits deliberately at the intersection of support and configuration. You'll need to be equally comfortable troubleshooting a live issue under pressure and having a structured approach to configuring/extending the applications capability. Good teamwork and clear communication are central to how this team works. The team is a bridge for business ideas/needs, translated into high performance processes in the CPQ journey.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Own day-to-day support, testing and validation across the CPQ business applications, both vendor-supplied and in-house data exchange.
* Design, build, configure and maintain application features and fixes, to support business requests and platform enhancements.
* Diagnose and resolve incidents, balancing speed for urgent issues with rigor for root-cause fixes.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements, working closely with both technical and business-facing colleagues.
* Maintain clear documentation and structured ways of working so knowledge doesn't live only in your head.
* Continuously look for ways to improve reliability, performance and maintainability across the application landscape and connected processes.
* Bring your ideas to the table, on technical approach, how we work, what we should fix or build next, to help grow our consolidated knowledge and expertise.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business administration or a comparable field
* Typically 6 to 9 years of relevant experience, of which several years in a senior or lead specialist capacity within a business application, CPQ, pricing or quoting environment
* Hands-on experience administering and configuring a CPQ, pricing or quoting platform.
* Direct experience with Conga CPQ (formerly PROS Smart CPQ) is a strong advantage
* Demonstrated ability to own a functional area end to end, from clarifying the business need to designing, configuring, testing and documenting the solution
* Proven ability to translate functional business requirements into concrete technical configuration and solution designs and to explain the reasoning back to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience as an escalation point for complex functional and technical issues, including root cause analysis, workaround design and permanent fix recommendations
* Experience in coordinating across system and team boundaries to maintain processes that span multiple applications
* Experience working with globally distributed stakeholders and being effective in a setup with colleagues and business users in other time zones and regions

**Preferred Experience**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM, particularly around the sales and quoting process
* Solid understanding of integration patterns and technologies, for example REST APIs and file-based data exchange, including the ability to read API documentation and challenge integration designs
* Data modelling skills, including the ability to reason about data structures, their relationships and the downstream impact of changes
* Familiarity with pricing concepts such as price lists, discount structures, approval flows, and rule-based product configuration
* Experience working with external vendors or system integrators and guiding them to provide quality services
* Experience guiding or mentoring less experienced colleagues, without formal line management responsibility and ability to generate reusable documentation
* Background from a global product organisation or a consulting and systems integration environment

Personal capabilities
  
  

* Strong analytical problem solver who breaks ambiguous business challenges into clear, workable solutions
* Confident communicator who engages business users on their terms and technical colleagues on theirs.
* Structured and self-driven, able to extract potential decisions from incomplete information in a landscape with multiple stakeholders.
* Takes ownership beyond the immediate task and raises risks and process gaps proactively
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

Team and culture
  
  
You'll be part of a team of internal and external colleagues with a mix of technical and business backgrounds and clear line of sight to your manager. We run a flat hierarchy, where everyone is expected to speak up, challenge and contribute their ideas regardless of title or seniority. I would rather hear a half-formed idea early than a polished one too late. The expectation is that you bring your thinking, put it on the table and let's grow and learn together.

We are looking for a UAV Systems Engineer cum System Integrator to take prototypes from system requirements through assembly, integration, and flight validation. You will define how the airframe, propulsion, avionics, communications, ground control station, and payloads work together, then verify the performance of the complete aircraft.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Lead Engineer-Hardware Validation: Coexistence (AI Glasses)
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a Lead Hardware Validation Engineer to lead the AI Glasses System Coexistence validation team. You'll set the technical direction, lead a team of validation engineers, and be the main technical contact for customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Your team will make sure that the main subsystems in our wearable devices (Camera, Audio, Wi-Fi/BT, Display, Sensors, Memory and Power) work together without one disrupting another. You'll also lead the team in using AI tools to speed up scripting, log analysis and failure triage.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and grow a team of validation engineers: assign work, set priorities, review their output and support their careers.
* Plan the team's resources and staffing across several programs and build phases (EVT, DVT and PVT).
* Run regular team syncs, technical reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Build a team culture of ownership, technical rigor and continuous improvement.
* Help hire and onboard new team members.

**Customer & Stakeholder Communication**

* Be the main technical contact with customers, program managers and engineering leadership for coexistence validation.
* Present validation plans, status, risks and results clearly in program reviews and customer meetings.
* Turn customer requirements and feedback into validation strategies and test plans.
* Manage expectations, escalations and trade-offs on schedule, coverage and quality.
* Write high-quality reports, executive summaries and closure documents for issues.

**Technical Ownership**

* Set the overall coexistence validation strategy for AI Glasses programs.
* Define aggressor/victim test matrices and stress scenarios that reflect real use, such as camera capture during Wi-Fi streaming, or speaker playback during captouch use.
* Oversee concurrency testing and logging of victim-subsystem metrics (camera image quality, captouch false or missed touches, eMMC throughput and errors, RF sensitivity and desense, audio noise floor).
* Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of complex EMI, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and vibration issues, working with the EE, RF, antenna, mechanical, firmware and software teams.
* Work with ODM and contract manufacturer partners on test setup, failure analysis and design changes.
* Review schematics and layouts to find coexistence risks early.

**AI-Driven Validation**

* Lead the team's use of AI tools such as Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini for writing and debugging test automation scripts.
* Lead AI-assisted analysis of large device logs (logcat, dmesg/kernel, firmware and RF logs) to find failures, anomalies and coexistence patterns.
* Build AI-powered workflows that summarize test results, sort failures into categories, suggest likely root causes and draft bug reports.
* Set team standards for checking AI-generated output and for responsible data handling.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day.
  
  
Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
  
  
We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.
  
  
**Work Experience**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in hardware, system or platform validation for consumer electronics, mobile or wearable devices.
* 3+ years of experience leading engineers in a technical lead or people lead role.
* Proven experience communicating directly with customers or external partners, including presenting technical results and handling escalations.
* Strong practical knowledge of EMI/EMC, RF desense, signal integrity and power integrity testing.
* Expert use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, signal generators and protocol analyzers.
* Python scripting for test automation and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini for scripting and log analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in EE or a related field.
* Experience with wearables, AR/VR, smart glasses or other small, highly integrated devices.
* Familiarity with wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, GNSS, NFC) and coexistence between them.
* Knowledge of camera, audio, display, touch and storage (eMMC/UFS) subsystems.
* Experience with Android or Linux-based embedded platforms, ADB and firmware debug tools.
* Experience building custom LLM workflows through APIs (for example, the Claude or OpenAI APIs) or with agent-style tools such as Claude Code or Cursor agent mode.
* Experience leading teams spread across sites or time zones, and managing ODM or vendor relationships through new product introduction.
* Experience setting up validation processes, metrics and dashboards for a whole team.

**Key Competencies**

* Leads people and builds a strong team
* Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and executives
* Takes a systematic, data-driven approach to solving problems
* Owns problems from first detection to fix
* Looks for ways to use AI to make validation more productive
* Stays effective while schedules and priorities change

**Benefits**

* Work on cutting-edge Next-generation consumer electronics hardware
* Work on High-bandwidth data streaming solutions
* Automated hardware validation and test infrastructure
* Collaborate with world-class engineers and product teams.
* Opportunity to grow as a technical leader in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
