title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**
:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions.
  
  
You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:

+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:

+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:

+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):

+ Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:

+ tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including:

+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go.

**Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification:**

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:

+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).

**Additional skills requirements:**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Product Manager, PV Commerce & Int'l Product
description:
**Description**
Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. We work in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. You will build a deep understanding of local customers, including how they discover content, choose plans and pay. You will turn those insights into products that grow and retain Prime Video customers. You will define what we build and why, write the documents that earn alignment, and partner with regional business teams and worldwide product and engineering teams to launch and scale features. We are looking for a customer-obsessed product manager with a strong track record of shipping products, using data to make decisions, and leading across teams without direct authority.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for India and other emerging priority countries, and prioritize investments by customer and business impact.
  
  
Write PRFAQs, product requirements and business cases that define the customer problem, the solution and the success metrics.
  
  
Partner with engineering, UX, science, and the worldwide Payments, Subscriptions, Personalization and App Experience teams to deliver local features on global platforms.
  
  
Design and read experiments (weblabs), and use the results to decide what to launch, iterate on or stop.
  
  
Build products that fit local needs, such as local payment methods, plans and pricing, partner bundles and local content discovery.
  
  
Report progress, risks and results to senior leadership through regular business reviews.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Yulu**

Yulu is India’s leading shared micro-mobility platform, revolutionizing urban transportation through smart, sustainable, and electric-first mobility solutions. With a rapidly growing fleet of tech-enabled electric two-wheelers and a robust battery-swapping infrastructure, Yulu makes last-mile commutes not only efficient but also planet-friendly.

Our IoT-driven platform and smart electric vehicles are helping cities reduce traffic congestion and carbon emissions while empowering millions with affordable and reliable transportation.

Backed by industry giants like Bajaj Auto and Magna International, Yulu operates at the intersection of mobility, technology, and sustainability. Our mission is to reduce congestion, cut emissions, and transform how India moves — one ride at a time.

With millions of rides completed, thousands of EVs on the road, and a rapidly expanding footprint, we’re not just building EVs — we’re building the future of urban mobility in India.

🔗 Learn more: www.yulu.bike

**Role Summary**

As a Product Manager at Yulu, you will own the product experience for gig workers who rely on Yulu for their daily mobility, from the rental journey to battery swaps. Your goal is to make every ride seamless, reliable, and cost-efficient so gig workers can maximize their earnings. Working with engineering, data science, business, and operations, you will use user insights, real-time analytics, and AI-driven optimization to improve gig worker satisfaction and retention.

If you thrive on solving real-world user pain points, improving financial outcomes for gig workers, and building scalable mobility solutions, join us in shaping the future of electric last-mile mobility!

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the gig worker journey end-to-end, from rental to battery swaps, removing friction at every step.
* Define the product vision and strategy for the gig worker experience, grounded in user insights and business goals.
* Build and prioritize the roadmap around measurable outcomes: gig worker earnings, satisfaction, and retention.
* Drive products from ideation to launch and scale, iterating continuously on what the data and the field show.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Own Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), integrating insights from engineering, business, and customer support, and socialize them to align teams on scope and expectations.
* Work with founders and cross-functional teams in a matrix setup, balancing stakeholder needs to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Act as a product advocate, articulating product value and upcoming enhancements, and run demos to drive adoption and gather feedback.
* Proactively address roadmap bottlenecks, working with the team to ensure seamless execution and the achievement of product goals.

**Innovation & Growth**

* Identify and drive new product ideas and enhancements from user and stakeholder insights.
* Scale the gig worker experience as Yulu expands into new cities and markets.

**Metrics & Insights**

* Set OKRs and success metrics for the gig worker experience, and review them regularly with the team.
* Measure the impact of every launch, using experiments and funnel analysis across the rental and battery swap journeys to decide what to build next.
* Spend regular time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, combining what you see with support and usage data to find the biggest pain points.
* Flag risks early and drive solutions to complex problems.

**Key Requirements**

* B.Tech / MBA or equivalent practical experience in product management.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of delivering impactful products.
* Experience building consumer-facing mobile products used daily at scale, ideally in mobility, logistics, quick-commerce, or on-demand delivery.
* Ability to define, track, and drive product outcomes through clear metrics, OKRs, and data-led decisions.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in daily product workflows, from input collection and research to documentation and prototyping.
* A habit of spending time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, turning direct user insights into product decisions.
* Deep ownership and a strong sense of urgency, with the ability to drive initiatives from ideation to execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative and open culture where your ideas and opinions are valued.
* Challenging and rewarding problem statements that deepen your understanding of Product Management.
* A dynamic and growth-driven journey that pushes you to learn, innovate, and excel.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

As a Product Manager – Rider Experience at Zepto, you will own the end-to-end rider app journey for order fulfilment. That journey runs from order pickup at the store to delivery at the customer's doorstep, and back. You will design and optimize the experience for thousands of delivery partners, improving rider productivity, delivery speed, and fulfilment cost. This role suits a product manager who thrives at the intersection of on-ground operations, user experience, and data-driven decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

● Own the product strategy and roadmap for the rider fulfilment journey. This spans order assignment, pickup and handshake at the store, navigation to customer addresses and inside societies, route handling, and the return journey to the store.

● Design journeys for complex order types such as batched, multi-store, same-society, multi-shipment, and relay deliveries.

● Build and improve special flows such as returns, replacements, open box delivery, pharma, and 3P delivery partner flows.

● Own proof of delivery flows to reduce order losses, customer complaints, and cost.

● Own the in-app guidance for new riders to drive engagement and retention.

● Work with control tower and operations teams on real-time fulfilment tooling, and drive special launches that need quick on-ground execution.

● Use data, experimentation, and on-ground research to improve delivery time, rider productivity, retention, and cost per order. Own outcomes beyond launch.

● Work closely with design, engineering, analytics, data science, and operations, and lead product planning, sprint execution, and release cycles with clarity and urgency.

**Qualifications:**

● 2–4 years of experience in product management, ideally in consumer tech, e-commerce, logistics, or mobile-first platforms.

● Proven track record of owning and delivering products at scale, preferably in supply-side, operations, or gig-workforce products.

● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

● Experience working with agile product development teams and shipping iteratively.

**Required Skills:**

● Strong product thinking and user empathy, with the ability to design for users in high-pressure, on-ground environments.

● Deep understanding of data and metrics, and comfort with SQL and product analytics tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Looker.

● Ability to identify problems through data and own outcomes after launch, not just delivery.

● Familiarity with user research, A/B testing, and experimentation frameworks.

● Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

● Strong execution rigour, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our
**Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition**
. This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.

title: BaNCS Product Manager
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Business Product Manager will act as the accountable business owner for the BaNCS platform within Entitlements and Trade & Settlements. The role is responsible for defining business strategy, prioritising product development, governing platform change, management of the application and all Data attributes, ensuring operational readiness and maximising business value from platform investments.
  
  
The role serves as the primary liaison between Operations, Product Management, Technology, vendors and business stakeholders while ensuring the platform supports strategic modernisation objectives, regulatory obligations, operational efficiency and client service requirements.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Product strategy and roadmap
* Own and maintain the multi-year BaNCS product roadmap.
* Define the platform vision, target state and measurable business outcomes.
* Prioritise demand, enhancements, regulatory change and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate business cases, benefits, risks, dependencies and investment opportunities.
* Align regional and functional requirements to the enterprise settlements strategy.
* Platform governance
* Act as Business Application Owner for BaNCS and provide clear business accountability.
* Chair or represent the business in product governance forums and working groups.
* Approve business requirements, operating-model decisions and solution designs within delegated authority.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions.
* Escalate strategic decisions, delivery risks and control concerns to the appropriate governance body.
* Requirements and change management
* Gather, challenge, document and prioritise business requirements.
* Translate operational and client needs into clear capabilities, outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the business backlog and recommend release priorities.
* Review impact assessments, change requests, sequencing options and implementation plans.
* Ensure changes transition successfully into the operating environment.
* Data and process ownership
* Own or coordinate ownership for the key business processes operating through BaNCS.
* Define data-accountability and stewardship arrangements for critical settlement data.
* Approve business data mappings, static-data requirements and interface requirements.
* Oversee data-quality issues, remediation priorities and governance upkeep.
* Ensure changes to data use are appropriately assessed and governed.
* Testing and implementation
* Sponsor business testing and secure appropriate operational SME participation.
* Agree UAT scope, test priorities and business acceptance criteria.
* Oversee review of test cases, outcomes, defects and residual risks.
* Coordinate business sign-off for requirements, data, testing and implementation readiness.
* Support go-live, migration, stabilisation and post-implementation review activities.
* Vendor and stakeholder management
* Act as the primary business contact across Operations, Product, Technology, change teams and TCS.
* Build alignment across legal entities, regions, processing teams and control functions.
* Manage vendor-related priorities, requirements, costs, dependencies and escalation paths.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Resolve competing priorities and facilitate timely business decisions.
* Risk, regulatory and control
* Ensure platform design and change reflect applicable regulatory and operational-control requirements.
* Assess impacts arising from market, legal-entity, client and custody-model change.
* Support audit, risk, compliance, resilience and control assessments.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access governance and maker-checker controls are reflected in the operating model.
* Maintain traceable approvals, decisions and governance evidence.
* Financial and portfolio management
* Support annual capital planning and funding submissions for BaNCS initiatives.
* Develop or coordinate business cases with clear scope, outcomes, benefits, risks and resource needs.
* Prioritise investments against strategic, regulatory, risk and operational criteria.
* Track delivery against approved scope, funding and roadmap commitments.
* Monitor benefits realisation and recommend corrective action where expected value is at risk.

**Experience**
For internal applications - 24 months as Senior Consultant
  
  
A College or University degree and/or data governance and quality work experience is required.
  
  
10+ years experience in financial services
  
  
Deep domain knowledge
  
  
Strong cross business unit experience leading enterprise initiatives
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Bangalore Office**
The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Senior Product Manager, CX Platforms
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to partner with business leaders to set systems strategy and own prioritization for the technology that powers our Customer Experience and Support teams. This role sits at the intersection of frontline support operations and enterprise technology, covering telephony, routing, case management, and identity verification. You’ll be the central point of intake, evaluation, and prioritization for CX platform requests, turning strategy from CX and Support leaders into clear product and process requirements and partnering with our Enterprise Systems team to deliver them.
  
  
This is a strong fit for a product manager who enjoys improving internal tools and business processes, and who is comfortable making and defending prioritization calls across competing stakeholders. It is not a customer-facing product role. You’ll report into the core CX leadership team and work with a high degree of autonomy.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Partner with CX leaders to establish systems and platforms strategy then turn that strategy into concrete product and process requirements, driving through to implementation
* Own prioritization and sequencing of the CX platform backlog, building a clear framework to evaluate competing requests from CX and Support leaders and frontline feedback, and explaining the tradeoffs behind each decision
* Partner with operational subject matter experts to understand current-state processes and what needs to change, then translate that into clear technical requirements and PRDs
* Partner with dedicated Enterprise Systems resources on workflow design, platform configuration, testing and QA, and launch across our core platforms, including Salesforce and Amazon Connect
* Represent CX and Support on enterprise infrastructure projects, ensuring queue, telephony, and case management infrastructure reflects how our teams are structured as that structure evolves
* Work within broader cross-functional programs as the owner of the requirements and infrastructure workstream
* Through in-depth data and product analysis, identify opportunities to improve existing tooling and ensure we’re fully using the capabilities of our existing platforms before recommending new tools or custom builds
* Define and track post-launch success metrics, such as handle time, transfer rates, and first-contact resolution, to evaluate impact and iterate
* Build deep knowledge of our support workflows, with room over time to take on a larger role in shaping strategy, not just executing it

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 6+ years of experience in product management, business systems, or CX platform roles, with hands-on experience building roadmaps, prioritizing backlogs, managing sprints, and writing PRDs or equivalent requirements
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize across competing requests from multiple leaders, using data and judgment to make decisions and hold a clear line when needed
* Strong understanding of support and CX operations, including routing logic, queue management, agent workflows, and telephony mechanics, and how platform changes affect agents and customers
* Ability to translate business needs into well-scoped requirements that platform developers and administrators can execute with minimal back-and-forth
* Experience partnering with technical teams through testing, QA, launch, and post-launch measurement
* Experience working with frontier AI models, Figma, Jira, and other product focused systems
* Comfort working in ambiguity, with the rigor to document current and future state clearly for technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust with frontline teams and senior leaders alike
* Experience with enterprise CX platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud or Amazon Connect (or comparable CRM, case management, and contact center platforms) is a plus

**#[LI-KP2**
**]**

title: Product Owner, India
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
Level: Early career (typically 1 to 5 years)
  
  
Team: Product Management, reporting to US-based product executive, working with our India-based engineering pods
  
  
Work mode: onsite in Bangalore
  
  
Employment: full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Owner who builds with AI every day to be the day-to-day product link to our engineering pods in India. At Emergence, engineers work with AI agents that do much of the building, testing and shipping. Your job is to make sure the pods build the right thing and that it works. You turn customer signals into clear specs, keep the evals and acceptance criteria that define "done", and check what the pods ship before it reaches customers. This is a role for someone at this experience level who wants to learn and apply product management in a team that works this way.
  
  
You will learn and practice product management the way it is done in AI-first teams, owning real product work from day one, with a senior product lead who mentors you and signs off releases. In your first months, success looks like running sprint planning and the demo review for your pods, every open item having an owner and a status that matches what is merged, and acceptance criteria and release evidence a senior lead can sign off without rework.
  
  
**You'll Be Doing**

* Turn customer requests, support tickets, notes from our Solutions team and usage data into short, clear briefs that say what to build and why, for engineers and their agents.
* Write and maintain eval sets and acceptance criteria that define "done", for features and for non-functional needs such as security, data handling and reliability, stated as outcomes rather than implementation, and help a senior product lead scope engineering studies.
* Test and verify what the pods ship against those criteria, and help gather the evidence a release needs before a senior product lead signs it off.
* Keep Jira and our Confluence pages accurate: check ticket status against what is actually merged, record decisions, risks and dependencies, and make sure every open item has an owner.
* Run sprint planning and the weekly demo review for your pods, and prepare short updates and presentations for stakeholders.
* Build quick prototypes with AI coding tools to show what a feature should do before the build starts.
* Work across time zones with product, design, engineering and solutions colleagues in India, the US and Europe.

**You'll Have**

* Typically 1 to 5 years of experience in product, engineering, data, QA or a technical consulting role; graduates with relevant project or internship work are welcome.
* You use AI tools daily (for example Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) to prototype, write, analyze and automate, and you can talk us through what you've built.
* Comfortable reading code and pull requests, and working with APIs, data, SQL and simple scripts (Python a plus).
* Clear written and spoken English; you write short, precise specs.
* Curious, structured and detail-minded; you check your own work and others'.
* Able to overlap a few hours a day with US and European colleagues within a normal working day ([typical IST window to confirm]); we shift hours rather than extend them.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* You take ownership: you follow through, raise problems early and help your teammates succeed.

**Bonus Points**

* Things you have built with AI, at work, in your studies or on your own (a description is fine where the work is confidential).
* Experience writing tests, evals or prompts for LLM-based applications.
* Exposure to manufacturing, semiconductors or industrial data (for example test, yield or wafer data).
* Experience with data science or multi-agent AI systems.
* Experience working with distributed teams or customers across countries and time zones.

**About Emergence**
Emergence AI is a frontier agentic AI lab advancing safe, autonomous AI through its pioneering Neuroformal architecture. We are building the next generation of enterprise AI: systems capable of understanding complex knowledge, reasoning across information, executing multi-step workflows, and taking action with the verifiability and reliability required for mission-critical environments.
  
  
Our Enterprise Agent Platform provides the foundation for building, deploying, and operating AI systems in production — from data connectivity and knowledge management to workflow orchestration, observability, evaluation, and governance. We partner with organizations in semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences, and other data-intensive industries to solve complex challenges that require trusted AI systems capable of operating in real-world environments.
  
  
Our team brings experience from leading AI research labs and technology companies, including IBM Research, The Allen Institute for AI, Amazon, and Broadcom. With headquarters in New York and offices across California, Spain, and India, we bring together diverse expertise and perspectives to tackle some of the most challenging problems in enterprise AI.
  
  
Emergence AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. We believe building trustworthy AI requires diverse ways of thinking, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
  
  
If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn just as much as matching every item on a job description.

title: Group Product Manager
description:
Botsync builds and deploys autonomous mobile robot systems for material movement in factories and warehouses across multiple geographies, for enterprise customers including Caterpillar, Ford, Nestlé and Coca-Cola. Our AMRs operate in live industrial environments where reliable autonomous navigation, localization, docking, coordination and charging must work — continuously and predictably.

Our product stack spans AMR hardware and onboard software that run on the robot, through to SyncOS, the software layer that orchestrates fleets, connects equipment, and integrates with enterprise systems. This gives our teams the chance to solve customer operational problems end-to-end: from motion and sensing on the robot, to fleet-level coordination, to the operational visibility and intelligence we bring to every deployment.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a senior robotics product leader who's passionate about pushing what a physical system can reliably do — and building the discipline to prove it before it ever reaches a customer site.

You will own hard product problems end to end: deciding which performance and operating limits are worth pushing, setting the bar a robot must clear before deployment, and turning every field failure into a sharper answer next time.

You will lead and grow the product team shaping our robotics platform — setting product direction and ensuring decisions across hardware, firmware and robot software add up to one coherent product.

**The Role**

* Expand the AMR operating envelope - Own the AMR product roadmap across hardware, firmware and robot software. Decide which performance and operating limits are worth pushing, set and defend targets across mobility, navigation, docking, material handling and fleet reliability, and quantify the engineering and vendor trade-offs behind each investment
* Prove reliability before deployment - Own how we establish confidence that a robot will perform under real operating conditions before it reaches a customer site. Turn recurring failures into permanent verification scenarios, and continuously raise the evidence bar a product or release must clear before deployment
* Learn from the fleet - Turn field performance into systematic product learning. Build the mechanisms to recognize known failure patterns from telemetry, errors and logs, automatically assemble the evidence engineers need to investigate them, and close the loop from field failure to root cause to product improvement to verification
* Lead the robotics product function - Lead and grow the PM team responsible for the robotics product. Translate customer needs, fleet evidence and technology opportunities into a prioritized roadmap; distinguish one-off customer requirements from reusable product investments; establish measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria; and partner across engineering and ops teams to deliver outcomes

**What are we looking for:**

**Essential-**

* 8–10 years across robotics, industrial automation or autonomous systems, combining hands-on engineering depth with real product ownership
* Has owned reliability, validation, deployment risk or field performance across multiple customer deployments
* Technically credible enough to challenge engineering and vendor trade-offs on their own terms: sensors, motion control, power systems, navigation-stack behaviour and system integration
* Comfortable refining a gated hardware development process — sharpening what each gate requires, tightening go/kill criteria, as the product and organization mature
* Able to specify what must be measured, then hold a release to that measurement when the ship date is under pressure
* Strong product judgement on what should become reusable platform capability versus what should remain bespoke
* Leads through influence: aligns engineering, deployment and customer teams, and other product managers, without owning them on an org chart

**Highly Desirable-**

* End-to-end system exposure spanning mechanical, electrical and software domains
* Experience operating across multiple customer geographies where site conditions and operating assumptions differ materially
* Exposure to AMR safety and functional-safety standards, and familiarity with what simulation and pre-deployment test infrastructure can't prove about physical systems before deployment
* Have working knowledge of ROS 1/ROS 2, and of the telemetry, logging and bag data a fleet emits
* Direct experience with AMR, AGV or autonomous-vehicle fleets in manufacturing, warehousing or intralogistics

title: Workforce Planning Systems Lead

title: Product Builder
description:
**Product Builder**

**Department:**
Product & Technology

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, behavioural analysis, data exploration and experimentation.
* Define clear objectives and success measures for every initiative, ensuring products deliver measurable business and customer value.
* Evaluate whether a new solution needs to be built or whether existing platforms, tools and capabilities can solve the problem.
* Identify and implement improvements across the products and systems you own.

**2. Product Design & User Experience**

* Translate complex business and advertising challenges into intuitive, user-friendly digital products and experiences.
* Lead the design process, from user journeys and wireframes through to polished interfaces and interactive prototypes.
* Apply strong UX and UI principles to create products that are simple, accessible and effective.
* Prototype and test ideas early, using feedback and evidence to validate solutions before investing in full development.
* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.
* Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving issues within your products and technical domain.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, machine learning and agentic technologies to improve products, services and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.
* Develop appropriate testing, evaluation and safeguards to ensure AI-powered solutions are reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and help colleagues understand how AI and automation can improve the way we work.

**5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively across product, design, engineering, data, media and client teams to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate product decisions, technical considerations, progress and potential challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.
* Take ownership of decisions within your area of responsibility, knowing when to act independently and when wider input is needed.
* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and encouraging best practice across product, design and engineering.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a naturally curious, commercially minded and technically strong individual who enjoys solving problems and building things.

**Product & Commercial Thinking**

* Experience taking digital products or technology initiatives from concept through to launch.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

**Design & User Experience**

* Experience designing digital products and intuitive user experiences.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and modern design tools.

**Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Strong software development experience and the ability to build and ship production-ready products.
* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Practical experience using AI tools, APIs, LLMs or agentic technologies to build products and automate workflows.
* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on with delivery.
* Curious, analytical and able to challenge assumptions.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* Enjoys learning, experimenting and continuously improving.

**How We'll Measure Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:

* **Build products that matter:**
  Deliver solutions that address genuine customer, client and business needs.
* **Create measurable impact:**
  Improve advertising performance, operational efficiency, user experience or commercial outcomes through the products you build.
* **Own delivery end to end:**
  Take initiatives from initial problem discovery through to successful production launch.
* **Raise the quality bar:**
  Deliver well-designed, reliable and scalable products that people enjoy using.
* **Make smart decisions:**
  Use evidence, commercial awareness and technical judgement to prioritise the right problems and solutions.
* **Drive innovation:**
  Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to create competitive advantage.
* **Improve how we work:**
  Help build a more effective, collaborative and innovative product and technology culture.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how an ambitious advertising technology business builds and uses technology.

You will have the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and take ideas from concept to reality. Rather than being restricted to one discipline, you will have the opportunity to work across product, design and engineering, building solutions that have a direct impact on our clients, our people and our business.

You'll be joining Navigator at an exciting stage of its growth, helping shape the technology, products and AI-powered capabilities that will define the future of travel advertising.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies and building products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Vice President – Enterprise Transformation, Product and Program Management

As a senior leader, you will align executives, business stakeholders, internal teams, and strategic vendors around shared outcomes. You will own program governance, stakeholder mapping and engagement, milestone delivery, and vendor workforce planning and management, ensuring that product priorities, delivery capacity, and business readiness remain aligned throughout the transformation lifecycle.

title: Product Head,Voice AI
description:
**About Exotel**

Exotel is a Customer Engagement Platform for businesses, built for interactions handled by both people and AI agents.

We provide the stack behind those interactions - voice, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and the telephony infrastructure underneath it. Our customers use Exotel to sell, support, collect payments, resolve issues and serve millions of their own customers.

Voice AI is a major part of where this is going.

Our Voice AI agents answer and place phone calls, reason with an LLM, integrate with customer systems and complete tasks. Customers are already running them in production and paying us by the minute.

The market is moving fast. Models are getting better and cheaper, latency is falling and new competitors appear constantly. We need someone who can build the business at that pace.

**Build and run Voice AI as a business**

Exotel is building the infrastructure behind customer conversations across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and AI agents.

Voice AI is becoming a major part of this business. Our AI agents answer and place calls, reason using LLMs, connect with customer systems and complete real-world tasks. Customers are already running these agents in production and paying us based on usage.

The market is moving extremely quickly. Models are getting better and cheaper, latency is falling, and competition is increasing.

We are looking for someone who can turn this technology into a large, profitable business.

This is not a traditional Product leadership role.

You will own where we play, what we build, who we sell to, how we price, how we scale, and ultimately whether the business wins.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Strategy – Decide Where We Win**

Build a clear view of:

* Which customer segments and use cases are worth pursuing.
* Where Voice AI can create meaningful business value.
* Where we have a genuine competitive advantage.
* Where we are behind the market.
* What we should build, buy, partner for or ignore.
* Which opportunities are attractive enough to invest in.

You will continuously test this thesis through customers, deals, product usage and losses.

The roadmap should be a consequence of this strategy — not the starting point.

**2. Product – Build What Customers Will Pay For**

Set the product direction for Voice AI.

Decide:

* Which workflows agents should handle end-to-end.
* Which capabilities should become core product features.
* What should remain customer-specific.
* How agents integrate with customer systems.
* When to use the best model versus the most economical model.
* What should be built internally versus sourced externally.

You own the customer experience.

If an agent is slow, unreliable, interrupts unnecessarily, makes mistakes or fails to complete a task — you own the problem.

**3. Business – Own the Number**

You will own the business outcome.

You will:

* Build the business plan with GTM and Finance.
* Determine where revenue should come from by segment, use case and account.
* Work directly with Sales on strategic opportunities.
* Set pricing and commercial guardrails.
* Decide which deals are worth pursuing.
* Understand why the business is ahead or behind plan.
* Balance growth with profitability.

You should be equally comfortable discussing product metrics and revenue numbers.

**4. Economics – Know What Every Interaction Costs**

Voice AI economics are fundamentally different from traditional SaaS.

Model choice, inference, routing, caching, infrastructure, latency and architecture directly impact margins.

You will:

* Build and own the unit-economic model.
* Define cost-per-minute targets.
* Understand contribution margin by use case/customer.
* Drive down inference and infrastructure costs.
* Make quality vs latency vs cost trade-offs.
* Decide when higher model cost is justified by higher customer value.

The cost of a minute is a product and business decision.

**5. Customers & GTM – Stay Close to the Market**

You will spend significant time with customers and prospects.

You should be comfortable:

* Joining strategic customer calls.
* Running important product demonstrations.
* Understanding customer workflows.
* Listening to successful and failed conversations.
* Working with Sales on important opportunities.
* Understanding why we win and lose.
* Turning market feedback into product, pricing and positioning decisions.

The expectation is not to sit behind the product team and wait for customer feedback.

You are expected to be in the market.

**6. Build a High-Agency Pod**

You will lead a self-contained Voice AI pod comprising:

* Product
* Engineering
* Delivery
* Forward-Deployed Engineering

The pod owns the journey from:

Customer problem → Solution → Production Voice Agent → Measurable outcome

Your job is to give the team direction, raise the quality of decision-making and remove dependencies that slow execution.

You should be comfortable operating with high autonomy and limited structure.

**7. Turn Customer Work Into Product**

Early customers will require significant hands-on implementation.

Your job is to continuously reduce this dependency.

You will decide:

* What FDEs should build for a customer.
* What should become a reusable product capability.
* What should never be built again.
* Which patterns across customers deserve product investment.

A key measure of success is:

Less custom work → Faster deployment → Better margins → More scalable growth.

**What We're Looking For**

We care more about what you have actually owned than your previous title.

**You have ideally:**

* Built and launched an AI product used by paying customers in production.
* Taken a product from 0→1 or early scale and materially influenced its direction.
* Owned revenue, gross margin, P&L or meaningful business metrics.
* Personally made pricing or commercial decisions.
* Built or deeply understood product unit economics.
* Worked directly with Sales and customers on important deals.
* Led cross-functional Product and Engineering teams.
* Operated with significant autonomy and incomplete information.
* Made difficult product/business trade-offs.
* Changed or killed initiatives when evidence showed they were not working.

**Particularly relevant experience**

* Voice AI / Conversational AI
* LLM applications
* Real-time AI systems
* Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech
* LLM inference economics
* Model routing/caching/optimisation
* CPaaS / Contact Centre / Telephony
* Enterprise SaaS
* AI products with usage-based pricing
* Working with Forward-Deployed Engineering / Delivery teams

**This Role May Be a Strong Fit If You Are**

* A Product leader who has genuinely owned a business, not just a roadmap.
* A GM / Business leader with deep product and technology understanding.
* A Founder / early-stage leader who has built an AI product and taken it to customers.
* An AI product leader who has worked closely with GTM, customers, pricing and unit economics.

**This is probably not the right role if:**

* Your experience is primarily roadmap execution.
* You have worked on AI technology but haven't shipped products to paying customers.
* You have limited exposure to revenue, pricing or business economics.
* You prefer large, well-defined organisations and established processes.
* You are primarily an engineering leader without product/customer/business ownership.

**What Success Looks Like After a Year**

Voice AI is a better business because you ran it.

* We know where to compete and where not to.
* The product strategy is clear, and the roadmap follows from it.
* Customers reach production faster.
* Agents complete more of the jobs they are given.
* Conversation quality, latency and reliability improve materially.
* Cost per minute falls, and gross margins improve.
* Custom work decreases as FDE learnings become product capabilities.
* The pod operates with high autonomy.
* Revenue grows, and customers continue to expand their usage.

The numbers should confirm the story:

Revenue growth | Gross margin | Cost per minute | NRR | Time to production | Task completion | FDE hours/customer

title: Lead I - Enterprise Solutions (SAP Project Manager)
description:
**Role Description**

The SAP Solution Architect is responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining state-of-the-art SAP solutions that meet business requirements and support sustainable, efficient, and compliant operations. The role works closely with business-facing organizations, business partners, process architects, project teams, implementation partners, and operational teams to plan, prepare, execute, and monitor projects and business enhancements. The role leads solution discussions, contributes to enterprise architecture decisions, ensures effective integration across ERP components, and remains accountable for solution quality throughout the application life cycle. \*Key responsibilities\* \* Lead the design and project delivery of SAP S/4HANA applications. \* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, compliant, maintainable, and supportable SAP solutions. \* Lead collaboration with business partners and process architects to identify suitable and sustainable solutions. \* Evaluate solution options, make architecture recommendations, and participate in design decisions affecting the SAP landscape. \* Ensure integration across SAP modules SD/LE, MM, EWM, TM, FI, CO, GTS, EH&S, and non SAP applications like OpenText, Loftware, 3PL systems, Tax applications. \* Provide technical leadership throughout project delivery, business enhancements, testing, deployment, go-live, stabilization, and operational handover. \* Ensure customer satisfaction through high-quality solution design, application life-cycle management, reliable project delivery, and effective service introduction. \* Maintain compliance with internal process and security requirements and external obligations, including GxP, GDPR, and software licensing requirements. \* Minimize business disruption during go-live through robust design, effective testing, cutover planning, operational readiness, and a formal project handover process. \*Project delivery\* \* Define solution scope, dependencies, interfaces, non-functional requirements, and technical acceptance criteria. \* Review and approve solution designs in accordance with architecture principles, development standards, and established guidelines. \* Support project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication. \* Ensure that solution documentation, test evidence, operational procedures, and handover materials are complete before production release. \* Support post-go-live stabilization and the transition of new or enhanced solutions into operational support. \*Change, release, and application life-cycle management\* \* Ensure adherence to change and release management processes in line with relevant standard operating procedures. \* Monitor execution of the application life-cycle management plan for applications in scope. \* Ensure complete and accurate handover documentation is created and approved before production release. \* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve the SAP application landscape. \*Education and professional experience\* \* Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline. \* Minimum of 12 years of professional experience with SAP applications. \* Minimum of 6 years of experience working in an international environment. \* Demonstrated experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation, project delivery and solution architecture. \* Experience leading technical discussions and coordinating internal teams, business stakeholders, and external delivery partners. \* Experience in regulated environments and with compliance-related requirements is an advantage. \*Skills and competencies\* \* Management and leadership experience in an international environment. \* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills. \* Excellent written and oral communication skills. \* Ability to establish trusted relationships with business partners, process architects, vendors, and technical teams. \* Ability to make difficult decisions, manage ambiguity, and act autonomously. \* Strong customer focus and a high level of ownership for ERP, Stakeholder Management, Project Management, SAP S/4HANA, SAP SD/LE, Change Management, Plan to Produce, Procure to Pay, SAP FI, SAP MM, Solutioning

title: NPI Material Program Manager, Sr
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**
As a NPI Materials Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of New product developement. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in Sourcing, Costing, Design change ideas and monitoring project schedule and budgets.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Costing:**

* Cost roll-ups using MPM cost tool
* Cost analysis to include identification and management of gaps to target cost: what changed from month-to-month in product costing

▪ Cost projection over time at different product run rates
  
  
▪ Standard cost analysis and request for cost updates
  
  

* Identify cost reduction opportunities through design and/or sourcing

**Sourcing**

* Work with Program MPM on sourcing strategy
* Work with purchasing to execute source changes based on aligned sourcing strategy
* Identify long lead parts and work with supply chain on strategies to mitigate LT
* Outsourcing: Host and/or Participate in supplier CFT’s to track outsourcing progress
* Track first article supplier submission to completion

**Mandatory Skills**

* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Power Point and SAP
* Ability to read and interpret product BOM's and engineering drawings
* Must be a self-starter and be able to operate independent of day to day supervision
* Direct experience leading cross-functional team meetings; Program Management experience required
* Ability to demonstrate problem solving and critical thinking skills
* Costing experience: needs to understand various costing models; and make vs buy analysis
* Excellent Excel skills required
* Good communicator to interface with suppliers and cross functional team members

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 7 to 9 years of industry experience in NPI supply chain, Program Management & Commodity management in a Manufacturing environment
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, (Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial)
* Master’s Degree in Engineering would be a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated leadership skills, strategic thinking and attention to details for everyday tactical execution
* Excellent people and presentation skills
* Knowledge of manufacturing methods and commodities as related to cost structure
* Supply chain knowledge, especially for critical commodities as related to sourcing decisions and cost strategies
* Technical background, preferably in semiconductor industry, WFE product knowledge is a plus

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Program Coordinator, Schools Program
description:
**Role Purpose**
Lead the implementation, adoption, and scale-up of Quest Alliance’s school transformation initiatives across the state by enabling teacher-led delivery, strengthening government partnerships, driving data-informed decision-making, and ensuring operational excellence. The role is accountable for achieving program outcomes, maintaining implementation quality, stewarding stakeholder relationships, and building a high-performing team aligned with Quest Alliance’s mission and values.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****1. Lead Program Delivery & Implementation Excellence****

* Drive end-to-end implementation of program activities, ensuring quality, timelines, and achievement of outcomes.
* Develop and monitor implementation plans, delivery milestones, and operational reviews.
* Ensure effective execution of teacher-facing interventions, including future skills programs, Ideathon, and digital engagement initiatives.
* Conduct regular field visits and implementation reviews to assess effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.

****2. Enable Teacher Adoption & Capacity Building****

* Strengthen teacher and Master Trainer (MT) engagement to ensure successful program adoption and scale.
* Design and facilitate capacity-building, mentoring, and support mechanisms for teachers, MTs, and team members.
* Ensure high-quality cascade implementation across schools and districts through ongoing coaching and handholding.
* Promote recognition, motivation, and evidence-based implementation practices among teachers.

****3. Build Government Partnerships & Drive Ecosystem Engagement****

* Develop and sustain strategic relationships with government education departments and key stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary liaison for district and state-level engagement, advocacy, and coordination.
* Represent Quest Alliance in education forums, collaborative platforms, and stakeholder meetings.
* Strengthen the organisation's visibility and influence by positioning Quest Alliance as a thought leader in future skills and school transformation.

****4. Drive Monitoring, Learning & Data-Informed Decision Making****

* Ensure robust monitoring systems, data quality, and adherence to program reporting frameworks.
* Analyse implementation data and insights to guide operational decisions and continuous improvement.
* Lead documentation of best practices, impact stories, and program learnings.
* Ensure timely and high-quality donor, government, and internal reporting.

****5. Ensure Operational & Financial Stewardship****

* Lead project planning, resource allocation, and execution to ensure operational effectiveness.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, expenditure tracking, and financial compliance.
* Ensure donor commitments, project deliverables, and reporting obligations are met.
* Strengthen coordination, review, and governance processes across program operations.

****6. Uphold Organisational Excellence & Team Growth****

* Ensure adherence to organisational policies, systems, processes, and compliance requirements.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Support performance management, employee engagement, and professional development.
* Take ownership of personal learning goals while fostering growth and capability development across the team.

**Required Experiences & Skills**

* 4-5 years’ experience in teaching, mentoring, or education program delivery
* Proven experience working with government stakeholders
* Strong skills in training delivery, communication, and report writing
* Willingness to travel frequently within districts
* Fluency in Kannada (spoken and written) is mandatory
* Prior exposure to or interest in STEM mindset, computational thinking or critical thinking approaches in education would be beneficial

**Salary**
The pay band for the position starts at Rs. 60,000/- per month (cost to company) (
*The salary offered will be commensurate with the experience and expertise of the candidate)*
**Benefits**
In addition to your compensation, you are also eligible for a suite of benefits designed to support your well-being and growth:
  
  

* Comprehensive Personal Accident Insurance covering up to ₹10,00,000 annually
* Mediclaim Insurance covering up to ₹3,00,000 annually, supported through our insurance partner, who also offer additional wellness benefits
* Reach for the Stars (RFS) amount of up to ₹5,000 to support your self-learning and knowledge-building efforts
* Internet allowance of up to ₹750/month, reimbursable based on actual usage to support flexible and hybrid working arrangements
* For employees with children under the age of 6 years, Quest offers childcare or day care fee support through a monthly matching contribution of up to ₹3,000, helping you create a supportive work-life balance
* Access to emotional health and wellbeing programs such as:
* Group sessions worth ₹7,500 per session fully covered by the organisation
* 1:1 counselling sessions (worth ₹1,800 per session), fully covered by the organisation

Interested candidates are requested to apply for the role by filling up the application form via the ATS (Zoho Recruit) platform:
  
  
**APPLY NOW**

Quest Alliance prepares young learners in India with the skills, mindsets, and support systems they need to thrive in life, learning, and work.
  
  
A social impact organization with close to two decades of experience, Quest Alliance works at the intersection of technology and future skills to make learning more equitable and relevant, especially for socially and economically vulnerable learners.
  
  
The organization influences systems to empower young learners in government high schools and trade and vocational institutes to holistically navigate their education to career transitions.
