title: Vice President – Transformation Project Manager
description:
**Position Purpose:**

As part of the Drive India business line—which manages the DRIVE Project Implementation practice for GM and ALMT business lines globally—Project Managers act as end-to-end architects of the GM/ALMT value chain, managing vertical or transversal projects through their entire implementation phase, including project framing, solution design, plan maintenance, team leadership, staffing, and retrospectives.

**Responsibilities:**

**Direct Responsibilities**

* **Project Framing:**
  Clarify objectives, scope, dependencies, risks, and business rationale (ROI); size effort and identify contributors.
* **Study / Design Phase:**
  Define business requirements, costs, and timelines; coordinate experts; establish financials and governance; design the roadmap and secure resource plans.
* **Execution Phase:**
  Drive roadmap execution; share project status; identify risks and propose mitigation; monitor budget and contributor feedback; chair governance bodies and produce reporting.
* **Completion Phase:**
  Collect participant feedback; identify best practices and areas for improvement; update the project management toolkit with lessons learned.
* **Solution Validation:**
  Ensure designed solutions align with sound IT architecture, Target Operating Model (TOM), strong controls frameworks, and operational efficiency.

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* Provide project progress KPIs to demonstrate adherence to the initial plan.
* Proactively propose and set up mitigation plans.
* Publish project highlights for review by the Team Leader.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies:**

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 15 years of experience.

**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

**Technical Skills:**

* Good knowledge of the environment (products, markets, practices, processes, systems, organisation, and people).
* Ability to deliver all project phases (framing, study/design, execution, completion/closure) for large/complex projects.
* Ability to manage indirect project resources.
* Ability to develop a planning culture and meet deadlines autonomously.
* Ability to make decisions within the PM mandate.

**Behavioral Skills:**

* Ability to deliver / Results driven.
* Personal Impact / Ability to influence.
* Decision Making.
* Critical thinking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong negotiation skills.
* Autonomy and self-driven mindset.
* Organised, delivery-focused, and detail-oriented.
* Effective communication (articulating messages clearly and tailoring style to audiences).
* Leadership and assertiveness.
* Team Player and Networking skills.
* Ability to navigate and address political situations.
* Analytical ability and ability to develop/adapt processes.
* Ability to understand, explain, and support change.

About BNP Paribas Group:

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions:

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

title: Agile Delivery
description:
**Agile Delivery Lead**

**Company:**
IRISS, Inc.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Required:**
5+ Years

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRISS

**About IRISS**

IRISS is a global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide.

Headquartered in the United States, with manufacturing operations in Bradenton, Florida, and a global presence across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS develops innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected.

Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, improve reliability, and protect their people.

At the heart of everything we do is our guiding principle:
**We Humanize Safety.**

We are committed to developing advanced, intuitive technologies that empower people and transform how industries approach safety and reliability.

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Agile Delivery Lead**
to join our team in Bengaluru, India.

This position is responsible for coordinating the end-to-end delivery of innovative Internet of Things (IoT) condition-monitoring solutions across software, hardware, firmware, cloud, on-premises, and data engineering teams.

The ideal candidate brings strong Agile delivery leadership, technical project management experience, and the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality technology solutions.

You will work closely with Product Managers, engineering leaders, quality assurance teams, and business stakeholders to establish realistic delivery plans, manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and support successful product releases and field deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Agile Delivery & Project Management**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of IoT condition-monitoring products across software, hardware, firmware, cloud, on-premises, and data workstreams.

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Apply Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid Agile delivery methodologies based on project requirements and team needs.

* Partner with Product Managers and engineering leads to establish priorities, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.

* Develop and maintain realistic delivery plans aligned with business objectives and technical requirements.

* Monitor project progress, identify risks, resolve blockers, and proactively communicate delivery challenges.

**Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, suppliers, external partners, and business stakeholders.

* Manage delivery considerations involving hardware lead times, firmware compatibility, system integration, and field-testing requirements.

* Facilitate communication between software, hardware, firmware, cloud, and quality assurance teams.

* Support alignment between product development priorities, engineering capacity, and customer delivery expectations.

* Resolve competing priorities and escalate risks or decisions requiring leadership involvement.

**Product Testing, Releases & Deployment**

* Coordinate integrated system testing, pilot deployments, production releases, and customer implementation activities.

* Work with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure products meet established acceptance criteria.

* Support release planning and coordination across software, firmware, hardware, and connected-device platforms.

* Ensure delivery plans address security, reliability, observability, and device lifecycle requirements.

* Identify opportunities to improve release quality, reduce deployment risks, and strengthen delivery consistency.

**Agile Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach teams on Agile principles, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Promote effective communication, transparency, and sustainable delivery practices.

* Monitor delivery performance using metrics such as cycle time, throughput, predictability, and escaped defects.

* Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements that strengthen team performance and product quality.

* Maintain accurate project documentation, delivery reporting, risk registers, and stakeholder communications.

* Provide leadership with clear updates on delivery progress, milestones, dependencies, and potential challenges.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5+ years of experience**
  in Agile delivery, technical project management, Scrum leadership, or a comparable technology delivery role.

* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams delivering complex technology products or solutions.

* Strong working knowledge of
  **Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery methodologies**
  , including approaches that integrate software development with hardware milestones.

* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies, project risks, competing priorities, and release schedules.

* Working understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), software testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.

* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and supporting engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

* Proficiency with
  **Jira, Confluence**
  , or comparable Agile project management and collaboration tools.

* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, conflict resolution, and communication skills.

* Ability to translate complex technical challenges into actionable business decisions and clear project updates.

* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting
  **IoT, industrial technology, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, or connected-device products**
  .

* Familiarity with embedded systems, sensors, edge computing, telemetry, and cloud-based platforms.

* Experience coordinating hardware validation, manufacturing readiness, device provisioning, or over-the-air (OTA) firmware updates.

* Exposure to time-series data, analytics platforms, or machine-learning-enabled products.

**Professional certifications such as:**

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

* Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

* PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)

* Equivalent Agile or project management certifications

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a delivery-focused professional who combines strong Agile leadership with a practical understanding of technology development.

The successful candidate should be comfortable coordinating multiple engineering disciplines, managing complex dependencies, and ensuring teams remain aligned on priorities, milestones, and deliverables.

You should be proactive in identifying challenges, confident in communicating with technical and business stakeholders, and committed to helping teams deliver high-quality products efficiently and consistently.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Engineering teams operate with clear priorities, realistic delivery plans, and transparent progress reporting.

* Project dependencies, technical challenges, and delivery risks are identified and addressed proactively.

* Software, firmware, hardware, and cloud releases are coordinated, tested, and validated before customer deployment.

* Delivery predictability, product quality, and cross-functional collaboration continuously improve.

* Stakeholders maintain a clear understanding of project timelines, deliverables, risks, and business outcomes.

**Why Join IRISS?**

At IRISS, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies that improve industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational performance worldwide.

You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and play an important role in delivering connected technologies that help customers protect critical assets and the people who maintain them.

We offer a collaborative, innovation-driven environment where technical expertise, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued.

**Join IRISS and help us advance our mission: We Humanize Safety.**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn by submitting an updated resume highlighting their Agile delivery leadership, technical project management experience, and involvement in multidisciplinary technology development.

**Candidates with experience coordinating IoT, hardware, firmware, cloud, or industrial technology projects are especially encouraged to apply.**

title: BaNCS Product Manager
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role purpose**

The Business Product Manager will act as the accountable business owner for the BaNCS platform within Entitlements and Trade & Settlements. The role is responsible for defining business strategy, prioritising product development, governing platform change, management of the application and all Data attributes, ensuring operational readiness and maximising business value from platform investments.

The role serves as the primary liaison between Operations, Product Management, Technology, vendors and business stakeholders while ensuring the platform supports strategic modernisation objectives, regulatory obligations, operational efficiency and client service requirements.

**Core responsibilities**

1. Product strategy and roadmap

* Own and maintain the multi-year BaNCS product roadmap.
* Define the platform vision, target state and measurable business outcomes.
* Prioritise demand, enhancements, regulatory change and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate business cases, benefits, risks, dependencies and investment opportunities.
* Align regional and functional requirements to the enterprise settlements strategy.

2. Platform governance

* Act as Business Application Owner for BaNCS and provide clear business accountability.
* Chair or represent the business in product governance forums and working groups.
* Approve business requirements, operating-model decisions and solution designs within delegated authority.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions.
* Escalate strategic decisions, delivery risks and control concerns to the appropriate governance body.

3. Requirements and change management

* Gather, challenge, document and prioritise business requirements.
* Translate operational and client needs into clear capabilities, outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the business backlog and recommend release priorities.
* Review impact assessments, change requests, sequencing options and implementation plans.
* Ensure changes transition successfully into the operating environment.

4. Data and process ownership

* Own or coordinate ownership for the key business processes operating through BaNCS.
* Define data-accountability and stewardship arrangements for critical settlement data.
* Approve business data mappings, static-data requirements and interface requirements.
* Oversee data-quality issues, remediation priorities and governance upkeep.
* Ensure changes to data use are appropriately assessed and governed.

5. Testing and implementation

* Sponsor business testing and secure appropriate operational SME participation.
* Agree UAT scope, test priorities and business acceptance criteria.
* Oversee review of test cases, outcomes, defects and residual risks.
* Coordinate business sign-off for requirements, data, testing and implementation readiness.
* Support go-live, migration, stabilisation and post-implementation review activities.

6. Vendor and stakeholder management

* Act as the primary business contact across Operations, Product, Technology, change teams and TCS.
* Build alignment across legal entities, regions, processing teams and control functions.
* Manage vendor-related priorities, requirements, costs, dependencies and escalation paths.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Resolve competing priorities and facilitate timely business decisions.

7. Risk, regulatory and control

* Ensure platform design and change reflect applicable regulatory and operational-control requirements.
* Assess impacts arising from market, legal-entity, client and custody-model change.
* Support audit, risk, compliance, resilience and control assessments.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access governance and maker-checker controls are reflected in the operating model.
* Maintain traceable approvals, decisions and governance evidence.

8. Financial and portfolio management

* Support annual capital planning and funding submissions for BaNCS initiatives.
* Develop or coordinate business cases with clear scope, outcomes, benefits, risks and resource needs.
* Prioritise investments against strategic, regulatory, risk and operational criteria.
* Track delivery against approved scope, funding and roadmap commitments.
* Monitor benefits realisation and recommend corrective action where expected value is at risk.

Experience :

For internal applications - 24 months as Senior Consultant

A College or University degree and/or data governance and quality work experience is required.  
10+ years experience in financial services  
Deep domain knowledge  
Strong cross business unit experience leading enterprise initiatives

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Reporting Analyst
description:
**Who Are We?**  
  
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. title: Software Development Manager
description:
**About the role**  

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead Tesco's Mobile Platform team. This team owns the React Native platform, the shared libraries and tooling, and the Mobile CI/CD behind our mobile estate, which serves millions of customers and colleagues every day. Product app teams across Tesco build on what you provide, so your success shows up in their work: a reliable, well-documented platform, shorter and safer release cycles, fewer inconsistencies between apps, and quicker onboarding.

As a Software Development Manager, you are a Senior Engineering Team Leader at Tesco. You balance delivery for customers with the needs of the business and the growth of your people, and you stay hands-on. Your proficiency with foundational computer science and software engineering is taken as a given, and you bring proven technical depth and breadth across teams. You will work closely with the Head of Software Development, the senior engineer (SDE3) who sets the platform's technical direction, Lead Product Managers, and Lead UI/UX Designers, turning platform strategy into dependable delivery.

Mobile experience is essential for this role. You must have built, shipped, and run native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) in production at real scale. React Native or JavaScript skill on its own is not enough. We need someone who knows the mobile platform properly: app lifecycle, on-device performance, release and signing, and the app store processes.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

What the team owns

The React Native mobile platform, built on the Expo ecosystem (EAS, Expo Router), with the shared libraries, common patterns, and app scaffolding that app teams depend on, including how Tesco Digital Design System (DDS) components are pulled in.

The model for scaling React Native across many teams, including micro-app and super-app patterns (for example Module Federation with Re.Pack) where they fit.

Mobile CI/CD and release infrastructure: build, signing, test automation, distribution, store deployment, and over-the-air updates (EAS Update) for iOS and Android.

Developer experience: documentation, examples, a contribution model, migration tooling, and support for the teams that consume the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery and platform

Lead the platform engineering team and own the processes and standards that help development succeed and keep improving.

Build and evolve the React Native platform and its shared libraries, and treat Mobile CI/CD as a product: fast, reliable pipelines, automated quality gates, application signing, and straightforward App Store and Google Play deployment.

Turn the platform direction you agree with the HOSD and the SDE3 into roadmaps, commitments, and shipped work, and make it easier for other teams to build on the platform through documentation, onboarding, and support.

Build platform capabilities for performance, scalability, accessibility (AA), and security from a single React Native codebase, and own incident response and root cause analysis.

Stakeholders and direction

Work with product stakeholders to turn their needs into platform features, and with the HOSD, the SDE3, Lead PMs, and Lead Designers to keep the roadmap aligned.

Build agreement within the team on how to approach a solution, and clear the blockers in its way.

Use agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) where they genuinely help, and expect the team to use specs, skills, and agents across development, documentation, and testing.

People and capability

Set clear objectives and career paths, review colleague performance, and act on it.

Build strong teams, spot and grow talent, and give the team room to innovate.

Raise the hiring bar through mentoring, interviewing, and sharing what you know with the wider engineering community.

 **You will need**  

Qualifications

Mobile engineering experience (essential): hands-on experience building and shipping native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) to the App Store and Google Play, and running them in production. This is a firm requirement. We want real mobile platform depth, not web engineers moving across through React Native.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.

At least 10 years in software engineering at enterprise or product companies, including time leading or managing engineers, with a good part of it spent on mobile.

A track record of building platforms, shared libraries, or developer tooling that other teams use (strongly preferred).

Technical Skills

Deep mobile platform fundamentals (essential): hands-on native iOS (Swift or Objective-C) and/or Android (Kotlin or Java), covering app lifecycle, on-device memory and performance, threading, and native module development, which underpin your React Native work.

Four or more years building React Native apps with the Expo ecosystem (Expo SDKs, Expo Router, EAS), with a solid grasp of JSI, native modules, and bridging to native iOS and Android.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript (modern ES6 and later), and strong React principles, Hooks, Context API, and component lifecycles.

Experience designing and building large front-end or platform systems and shared libraries used by many teams, with sound state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or MobX) and caching.

Mobile CI/CD depth: Git and GitHub, CI pipelines, EAS build and submit, application signing, over-the-air updates (EAS Update), and a thorough understanding of the iOS and Android deployment lifecycles and store guidelines (App Store, Google Play).

Performance profiling for production apps (Android and iOS profilers), packaging and build tooling (Webpack, Babel), and dependency and release management for shared libraries.

Integrating mobile apps with backend APIs (GraphQL or REST), and accessibility to AA standards.

Testing frameworks: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, and Appium.

Confident use of agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) across development, documentation, and testing, plus familiarity with MCP integrations and deep linking.

Process and Soft Skills

Comfortable with Agile methods (Scrum or Kanban), and with JIRA, Confluence, and well-formed epics, stories, and acceptance criteria.

Able to apply different delivery processes and knows when each one fits.

A self-starter who takes ownership, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Well organised, with good time management.

Clear written and verbal communication.

What we offer

Relocation help: a professional service to secure the work permits and other documents you need.

Learning opportunities: certified technical training and platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, and O'Reilly.

A learning culture, with good opportunities to develop your career in your chosen field or in something new.

Varied projects to work on, with something new always in the pipeline.

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

**Role**

**Lead Value Flow Engineer (Expert)**

  

**Visit our website** **bmwtechworks.in** **to know more.**

  
  

**About the UNIT/ Unit Overview**

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you build the core storage of AIRE, which keeps every version of every requirement and lets teams look back in time, branch and merge.

  

**Location**

Pune or Bangalore

  

**Experience**

  
  

**Number of openings**

1

  

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* Own the AIRE product vision, goals, non-goals and roadmap. Protect the agreed scope (for example read-only domain behaviour, no UI and no write-back to Codebeamer in the proof of concept) and steer explicit scope changes through the sponsor.

* Own and prioritise the backlog. Ensure every item is agent-ready: it has clear acceptance criteria, traces to the L0/L1/L2 requirements, and has a definition of done that includes tests, AI evaluations, audit evidence and required human approvals.

* Facilitate delivery in a deliberately lean, AI-native team. Remove impediments such as data approvals, Codebeamer access, IAM onboarding and masking clearance, and keep alignment overhead minimal.

* Partner with the Lead Software & Systems Architect and the Lead Agentic Engineering & AI Platform Engineer to balance value, feasibility, quality, security, operability and cost. Architecture decisions remain with the architect, and harness and AI-platform decisions remain with the agentic engineering lead.

* Organise discovery and domain validation with the pilot domain department. Plan and steer the read-only shadow run, and consolidate measurements into an evidence-based Go/No-Go recommendation for the sponsor.

* Define and track outcome, flow and AI-native delivery metrics. Examples include acceptance rate of agent-generated changes, rework rate, evaluation pass rate, defect escape rate and cost per delivered change. Use the findings to improve both the product and the delivery process.

* Own the product-level approval gates in the delivery process, such as release of increments, acceptance of measurement reports and approval of expensive load-test runs. Enforce separation of duties between requesters and approvers.

* Run reviews and demonstrations through the example agent, CLI and TRLC workflows instead of UI mock-ups, and keep stakeholders informed about progress, evidence and risks.

* Prepare the follow-on engagement, including productisation, the later UI phase, team scaling and the operating model, based on the evidence produced.

* Plan the path from the PoC to first production in 2028 Q3, including migration scenarios, cut-over planning, go-live readiness and hypercare.

* Plan the staffing and handover from the internal team to the new DevOps team that owns AIRE from the idea to operations.

  

**What should you bring along**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Informatics, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of eight years of relevant experience in software product development or delivery, including at least three years as a product owner, product manager or value-stream lead for technical platforms.

* Demonstrated track record of delivering complex software products with cross-functional teams and measurable outcomes, ideally in regulated or engineering-heavy domains.

* Proven ability to lead through influence, manage senior stakeholders and make evidence-based product decisions, without requiring prior line-management experience.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Proven product ownership or value-stream leadership for complex enterprise, engineering or developer platforms from discovery through production, beyond feature-factory delivery.

* Ability to translate stakeholder goals into measurable outcomes, hypotheses and success criteria. Examples include weighted benchmark matrices, service-level objectives, Go/No-Go criteria and adoption metrics. Protect scope through explicit goals and non-goals.

* Practical experience leading AI-native delivery: specification-driven development, agent-generated work products, bounded implementation and verification loops, human approval gates, and measuring flow when agents produce most of the code.

* Ability to write and curate machine-readable backlog items and specifications that agents can execute and humans can verify. These include user stories, acceptance criteria, BDD scenarios and traceable L0–L2 requirements.

* Strong flow and backlog management with the Agile Working Model, Kanban or Scrum, including WIP limits, flow metrics (lead time, throughput, flow efficiency) and dependency management across domain, platform and governance units.

* Stakeholder and expectation management with sponsors, domain departments, system owners of legacy tools, architecture, and data protection and information security functions, including timely escalation of blocking approvals.

* Sound understanding of the automotive requirements engineering and ALM landscape (for example Codebeamer, IBM DOORS, Polarion, ReqIF) and of the regulatory drivers Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262.

* Structured management of risks, assumptions and dependencies, including data approvals, masking, IP and NDA constraints, and the availability of interfaces to legacy systems.

* Excellent communication, facilitation and negotiation skills, with the ability to keep coordination overhead low so that AI-driven delivery speed is not lost in alignment meetings.

  

**Good to have technical skills**

* Prior experience with the BMW Agile Working Model, BMW BASE (BMW Agentic Software Engineering) and BMW-specific governance and release processes.

* Knowledge of product line engineering, feature models and variant management in automotive development.

* Experience with requirements-as-code and docs-as-code approaches such as TRLC (Treat Requirements Like Code), Git-based reviews and CI-driven validation.

* Experience introducing a successor solution alongside a leading legacy system, including shadow runs, co-existence and migration decision-making.

* Understanding of AI operating cost (LLM token and inference cost), FinOps and AI value measurement.

* German language skills for working with domain departments and source material.

title: Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst
description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog & Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment
* Data Catalog & Governance Platform Management
* Catalog Administration & Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata & Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies
* Domain Data Governance & Stewardship Enablement
* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

* Move beyond incremental continuous improvement to identify and execute larger, enterprise-level transformation opportunities.

* Partner closely with Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, and Audit to strengthen governance, issue management, and risk oversight.
* Embed risk awareness, control discipline, and accountability into day-to-day operational management and decision-making.

* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across businesses, functions, and geographies.
* Act as a connector across teams to remove barriers, accelerate execution, and deliver enterprise outcomes.
* Establish governance forums and operating routines that foster transparency, accountability, and collaboration.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing organization capable of supporting current and future business needs.
* Be a talent magnet who attracts, develops, and retains strong talent across operations, transformation, analytics, and leadership roles.
* Drive employee engagement and foster an inclusive culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Champion succession planning, leadership development, workforce capability building, and internal mobility.
* Serve as a cultural ambassador for U.S. Bank, ensuring its values, leadership expectations, and customer-focused culture are consistently reflected within USBIPL.

**Customer-Focused Leadership**

* Champion a customer-first mindset across all supported functions.
* Ensure operational strategies and decisions improve outcomes for customers and business partners.
* Drive measurable improvements in service quality, customer experience, and process effectiveness.
* Balance customer experience with operational efficiency, financial performance, risk management, and business growth objectives.

**Preferred Skills / Qualifications**

* Leadership experience managing large-scale banking operations.
* Deep experience in U.S. Consumer Lending and Operations.
* Demonstrated domain expertise in at least one major consumer product, such as mortgages, credit cards, auto lending.
* Proven experience leading multiple operational areas, including fulfillment; servicing, payments, fraud, lending operations or business banking.
* Experience working within a Banking GCC or Global Capability Center environment.
* Good understanding of banking regulations, operational risk frameworks, control environments, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated success identifying, transitioning, scaling, and transforming GCC capabilities through strategic stakeholder engagement.
* Experience leading large-scale transformation involving automation, AI, process reengineering, analytics, and digital modernization.
* Strong financial management experience, including budget ownership, workforce planning, headcount management, resource allocation, forecasting, and business case development.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and manage the key operational and financial drivers of performance while balancing growth, efficiency, customer experience, and risk outcomes.
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, influencing, and executive stakeholder management capabilities.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Enterprise leadership & strategic orientation: Creates and executes a long-term vision that positions USBIPL as a strategic extension of U.S. Bank while delivering measurable business value.
* Transformation leadership: Challenges conventional approaches and drives innovative solutions using automation, AI, analytics, process reengineering, and operating model redesign.
* Operational excellence & execution: Maintains a relentless focus on metrics, data-driven decision-making, performance management, operational discipline, accountability, and outcomes.
* Financial & business acumen: Uses financial insights, business metrics, and operational data to optimize headcount, budgets, investments, productivity, and resource allocation.
* Risk leadership: Balances growth and innovation with strong governance, controls, compliance, and risk management practices.
* Collaborative leadership: Builds partnerships across businesses, functions, and geographies to align priorities and achieve enterprise objectives.
* Talent builder: Attracts, develops, and inspires high-performing teams while creating an engaging and inclusive culture.
* Customer focus: Places the customer at the center of decisions and continuously improves outcomes through operational excellence and innovation.
* Cultural ambassador: Embodies and promotes U.S. Bank values and leadership expectations while strengthening engagement and organizational effectiveness within USBIPL.

**Executive Success Profile**
The ideal candidate combines deep consumer banking expertise, GCC leadership experience, strong financial acumen, operational excellence, transformation capability, customer focus, and exceptional people leadership. This individual will build USBIPL into a strategic growth engine for Consumer Business & Operations while delivering measurable impact across customer experience, operational performance, financial results, talent, transformation, and risk management.

description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Design Manager** to lead our **Shared Services & Experience Operations** team, responsible for driving service design strategy, journey architecture, design operations, governance, accessibility compliance, and experience measurement across the enterprise.

This role combines **people leadership, organizational leadership, and operational excellence**, with accountability for building and leading multidisciplinary teams focused on delivering exceptional customer and employee experiences.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in **Service Design, Design Thinking, UX Design, Customer Experience, Design Operations, Accessibility, and Experience Measurement**, along with a proven ability to influence strategic decisions, scale design capabilities, and lead high-performing teams.

This role will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX Design, Research, Customer Experience, and Business stakeholders to establish scalable processes, governance frameworks, and experience-driven outcomes that align with business objectives.

### **What You'll Do**

* Define and drive the organization’s Service Design strategy and practices.
* Lead the design and optimization of end-to-end customer and employee journeys across digital, physical, and human touchpoints.

  + Customer Journey Maps
  + Service Blueprints
  + Ecosystem Maps
  + Experience Frameworks

* + Service Design

* Establish operating models, processes, and governance frameworks that support experience teams at scale.
* Define team objectives, capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational priorities.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centric thinking.

**Design Operations & Experience Operations**

* Establish scalable processes, workflows, and standards across Design and Research organizations.
* Drive improvements in design efficiency, consistency, and team effectiveness.
* Manage tooling, workflow optimization, documentation, and operational processes.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled workflows and productivity practices within Design Operations.
* Enable effective collaboration across Product, Engineering, UX, Research, and Business teams.

**Governance & Accessibility**

* Establish and govern enterprise-wide accessibility standards and practices.
* Drive WCAG compliance initiatives across products and platforms.
* Create governance frameworks to ensure experience quality, consistency, and compliance.
* Facilitate design reviews and governance forums across multiple teams.
* Partner with UX, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure accessibility and usability standards are consistently applied.

**Experience Insights & Measurement**

* Establish frameworks for measuring customer and employee experiences.
* Define and track:
* + Customer Satisfaction Metrics
  + Experience KPIs
  + Service Adoption Metrics
  + Journey Performance Metrics
  + Accessibility Metrics

* Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms to provide actionable insights.
* Leverage customer feedback, analytics, and research findings to drive continuous improvement.
* Enable data-driven experience decisions across the organization.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategy**

* Partner with:
* + Product Management
  + Engineering Leadership
  + UX & Research Teams
  + Customer Experience Teams
  + Business Stakeholders

* Align experience initiatives with business goals and organizational priorities.
* Influence executive decision-making through customer insights and experience data.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on customer experience transformation and operational excellence.
* Drive organizational adoption of Design Thinking and customer-centered practices.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Hire, develop, and retain high-performing design and operations talent.
* Establish career growth plans and mentorship programs.
* Coach and develop leaders within Service Design, Design Operations, and Experience Operations functions.
* Build organizational capability and maturity across customer experience disciplines.
* Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, accountability, and innovation.

### **Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in Service Design, UX Design, Customer Experience, Design Operations, or related fields.
* 3+ years of experience managing multidisciplinary teams.
* Proven experience leading Service Design and customer experience transformation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in:
* + Service Design
  + Design Thinking
  + UX Design
  + Customer Journey Mapping
  + Service Blueprinting
  + Human-Centered Design

* Experience establishing governance frameworks, operational processes, and measurement systems.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and executive presentation capabilities.

### **Technical & Functional Competencies**

**Service Design & Experience Strategy**

* Service Blueprinting
* Customer Journey Mapping
* Ecosystem Mapping
* Systems Thinking
* Human-Centered Design
* Design Thinking

**Design Operations & Experience Operations**

* Strategic Planning

###

* Familiarity with Design Systems and Design Governance models.
* Experience with AI-powered design, research, or operational workflows.
* Certifications in:
* + Service Design

title: Director, UX Strategy
description:
About This Role

**13 to 20 years of experience**  
**Skills: UX Design**

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director, UX Design to define and drive the end-to-end user experience strategy for next-generation applications within the Consumer Business Unit. This role will work closely with business stakeholders and engineering teams to craft intuitive, scalable, and high-impact user experiences.

The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping agentic customer experiences and ai-native design delivery, ensuring that UX designs are intuitive, AI-aware, and seamlessly consumable by development teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and lead the UX strategy and vision across digital platforms (web, mobile, enterprise applications).

* Conduct baseline usability research, including customer interviews and usability testing, and synthesize into clear, actionable findings and recommendations.

* Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to inform design strategies, decisions, and measure impact and efficacy of designs.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable experience strategies.

* Drive experience design decisions balancing usability, accessibility, and conversion.

* Create scalable UX frameworks, design systems, component libraries, and governance standards.

* Ensure tight collaboration with engineering in an ai-native SDLC for smooth handoff and implementation.

* Champion AI-driven, agentic UX approaches for intelligent and adaptive user interactions.

* Lead, mentor, and manage junior designers, and oversee design execution and delivery on client work.

* Support pre-sales client engagement and internal coordination as needed

Required Skills & Experience

* 15+ years in UX Strategy, Experience Design, or related fields.

* Proven expertise in:

* Web and mobile UX/UI design for customer-facing, B2B and/or internal applications

* Conversion optimization, usability, and accessibility (WCAG standards)

* Strong experience working with clients, business stakeholders, product and engineering teams.

* Expertise in converting product requirements into UX strategies and design artifacts.

* Leadership experience managing and mentoring junior designers.

* Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX strategy and execution, including usability testing.

* Strong storytelling, communication, and presentation skills to articulate and advocate for design recommendations with teams and clients.

* Familiarity with core design concepts and practices, including IA/service design, omnichannel customer journeys, data-driven mindset, UX writing, Design Ops

* Experience designing customer experiences for retail, travel, hospitality, and dining preferred

* Experience with delivering design work within an AI-native SDLC preferred

Tools & Technologies

* Design & Prototyping Tools

* Figma Suite

* Claude Suite

* User Research & Analytics

* Optimal Workshop, UserTesting, Maze, Userlytics

* Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar

* Collaboration & Handoff

* Jira, Confluence, Miro, Lucid, Figma Dev Mode

* Design Systems & Documentation

* Storybook, Zeroheight, or similar platforms

* Figma

* Claude Design

* Accessibility Tools

* Axe, Wave, Lighthouse

AI & Emerging Capabilities

* Familiarity with AI-driven design workflows, including:

* Using AI tools (e.g., Figma Make, Claude Design/Claude Code, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, DALL·E) for rapid ideation and prototyping

* Leveraging LLMs (like GPT-based systems) for UX content creation, microcopy, and conversational flows

* Experience designing AI-first or agentic experiences, including:

* Conversational UX (chatbots, copilots, virtual assistants)

* Context-aware and adaptive interfaces

* Understanding of:

* Prompt design for UX workflows

* Human-AI interaction principles

* Ethical and responsible AI design considerations

* Ability to integrate AI capabilities into UX strategy for personalization, automation, and predictive experiences

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

* Experience in large-scale digital transformation programs.

* Exposure to Retail, Consumer Business, or Dining industries

* Experience with front-end frameworks (HTML/CSS basics, React understanding) and how design is translated within them

* Certifications in UX, HCI, or Design Thinking.

* Experience designing for common enterprise platforms like Adobe, Salesforce, and Shopify

* Exposure to voice UX, AR/VR, or multimodal interaction design.

* Strong grasp of personalization, behavioral economics, localization

What Success Looks Like

* Scalable and consistent UX strategy within omni-channel client programs

* Seamless collaboration between business, UX, product and engineering

* Adoption of AI-driven UX and agentic design principles in both design and delivery

* Improved user engagement, satisfaction, and business outcomes

* High-performing and motivated UX teams

Why Join Us

* Drive next-generation UX strategy in a high-impact business unit working with global clients

* Work at the intersection of UX, AI, and modern engineering practices

* Influence how agentic and intelligent systems are designed and delivered

* Opportunity to lead and scale UX maturity at an organizational level

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
TheSenior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Product Management& Technical Requirements Elicitation
  
  

* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog& Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment

2. Data Catalog& Governance Platform Management
  
  

* Catalog Administration& Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata& Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies

3. Domain Data Governance& Stewardship Enablement
  
  

* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms

4. Data Quality Specification& Rule Design
  
  

* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines

5. Business Interfacing& Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**  

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments.(Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory).
* Technical& Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation).
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality& Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic(preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking& Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal& Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

**Note:** Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)
  
  
Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

**What you’ll do**

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

**What success looks like**

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

**Who you are**

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

**Qualifications**

1. 2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.
2. A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.
3. Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).
4. Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.
5. Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.
6. Clear written and verbal communication.

**Strongly preferred**

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

**Good to have**

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Group Product Manager
description:
**Group Product Manager – Job Description**
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinbox is the fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900+ global enterprises to manage their 2.5 million+ employees across 116+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, Masafi, DIFC, Abu Dhabi Department of Finance, Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
****The Role****
You will own a group of product areas end to end and lead the Product Managers who run them: from the problem a client brings us, to the roadmap and requirements engineering builds from, to how 900+ enterprise clients adopt what ships. One change in your group can ripple across payroll, attendance, permissions, reports, integrations and mobile, across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and the US.
  
  
****What will you do on a day-to-day basis?****

* Get to the real problem. Start from wherever the signal comes from, whether market research, usage data, competitor benchmarking or a client request, and treat it as a hypothesis to test. Validate it with end users to decide whether existing configuration solves the need or something new must be built.
* Decide what earns a place in the product. Weigh value against effort and the long-term cost of maintaining a feature across hundreds of clients. Bring a business case tied to revenue, retention or adoption.
* Own the roadmap. Translate product strategy into a roadmap for your group, scoped and prioritised by business and customer impact.
* Think in platforms. Learn your modules end to end, including their implications across multiple geographies. Map each change's impact on connected modules, and turn repeated client asks into configurable capabilities rather than one-client fixes.
* Build with AI. Use AI tools every day to research, write requirements, prototype and automate recurring work.
* Lead your team. Coach and develop the Product Managers in your group, and hold their work to this same bar.
* Own the outcome. Work alongside engineering through build and QA, make informed technical trade-offs with Customer Success, track adoption and usage after launch, and partner with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success as the subject matter expert.

****We are looking for someone with****

* Good communication skills with the ability to influence and work with a cross-functional team.
* High levels of ownership and drive, and a high appetite for learning.
* A flair for logical reasoning and the habit of going deep: you can explain why a product works the way it does and where it breaks.
* Comfort with the technical side of product building, including discussing APIs, data flows and system dependencies with engineers.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to research, write or prototype.
* A proven track record of managing a successful product throughout its lifecycle.
* Strong team coordination and people management skills.

****Good to have****

* Exposure to B2B SaaS products.
* HR domain expertise.
* A strong design and UX orientation.

****What's in it for you?****

* High ownership role, with individual modules carved out instead of micro feature optimizations.
* A learning opportunity at the intersection of B2B and B2C: building a B2B-grade product that needs to provide a B2C-like experience.
* Direct customer touchpoints and high velocity in shipping products and features.
* Disproportionate rewards for top performance and accelerated advancement in a hyper-growth environment.

title: Workforce Planning Systems Lead

* Own the vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for the enterprise Workforce Planning product ecosystem, linking investment and release priorities to measurable workforce planning outcomes and business value.
