title: Associate - Product & AI Operations
description:
**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office, 5 days a week)

**Experience:**
1–2 Years

**Joining:**
Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred

**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Product

**About Amber**

Amber is a global student accommodation marketplace. Students use Amber to find and book housing in 80+ cities across 10 countries.

Our Product team comprises Product Managers, Designers, Analysts and AI Engineers. We want this team to operate at the level of the world's best AI-native product teams, leveraging technology, automation and AI to maximise productivity and impact.

**The Role**

You will own how the Amber Product team operates, with a clear mandate to increase team productivity and reduce the time lost to coordination, status updates and manual work.

You will own all aspects of Product Operations, including team cadences, sprint health, team rituals, onboarding and engagement.

However, you won't rely on manual processes to get things done. You will build and deploy AI-powered workflows, bots and scheduled agent runs to automate recurring work. You will remain accountable for the outcomes. If something slips, you take ownership and fix it.

We are looking for someone who thinks AI-first, takes complete ownership and enjoys building systems that make teams more effective.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Product Cadences & Processes**

* Run product cadences, including weekly product reviews, roadmap syncs, sprint reviews and Product team All Hands.
* Record decisions and action items from every meeting and track them to closure with clearly assigned owners.
* Conduct weekly sprint health checks across pods, tracking spillovers and their causes, ad-hoc work, delayed sprint closures and requirement documentation quality.
* Identify process gaps and bottlenecks, implement improvements and measure their effectiveness.

**2. AI Systems for the Product Team**

* Automate recurring operational activities, including meeting notes, action-item tracking, follow-ups, sprint health reports and reminders for delayed deliverables.
* Own the team's AI context, including shared instructions, skills, connectors and the index of product documentation used by AI agents across tools such as Claude, Notion, Jira, Slack and GitHub.
* Build AI-powered bots that can answer recurring questions such as "How does X work?" and "What is the status of Y?" with supporting evidence.
* Continuously improve these systems by identifying knowledge gaps and incorporating missing information into the bots' knowledge base.
* Drive AI adoption across the team by training members on new tools, identifying adoption gaps and addressing the underlying challenges.
* Partner with Engineering on infrastructure while owning the workflows and automations built on top of it.

**3. Productivity Metrics & Reporting**

* Define and report Product team productivity metrics on a weekly basis.
* Track metrics such as:
* Idea-to-release cycle time.
* Sprint spillover rate.
* PM hours spent on status updates and administrative work.
* Percentage of recurring queries resolved by AI bots.
* Adoption and usage of AI-powered workflows.
* Establish productivity targets in collaboration with leadership and continuously improve performance against them.

**4. People Operations for the Product Team**

* Own new-hire onboarding, including documentation, access provisioning, first-week plans and buddy assignments.
* Continuously improve the onboarding process to reduce time to productivity for new team members.
* Track team leave, holidays and availability.
* Plan team-building activities, offsites, rewards and recognition initiatives, and Product team contributions to All Hands.
* Ensure Product team SOPs and documentation in Notion remain accurate and up to date.

**5. Communication & Research Support**

* Publish Product release notes and communicate product updates across the organisation.
* Manage the administrative aspects of user interviews, including scheduling, recordings and insights documentation.
* Coordinate requests and dependencies across Product, Design, Engineering and Business teams.
* Ensure cross-functional action items are followed up and closed on time.

**What You Must Have**

* 1–2 years of experience in a Product-focused role, such as Product Operations, Associate Product Manager, Product Management or Program Management, preferably at a technology company or startup.
* Demonstrable experience automating your own work or building an internal tool using AI. You should be able to share a link or demo.
* Hands-on experience with AI agent and automation tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, Zapier or similar platforms.
* Basic understanding of APIs and scripting.
* Strong ownership mindset. You proactively follow through and close loops without needing reminders.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to create clear, concise and actionable updates.
* Comfortable working with senior Product Managers and Engineering leaders, driving accountability and following up on deadlines with tact.

**Good to Have**

* Experience working in a marketplace, consumer internet or technology-driven company.
* Familiarity with Jira, Notion, Slack automation, GitHub and Google Workspace.
* Experience organising team events, managing onboarding or building communities.
* Experience building AI-powered workflows, internal bots or agent-based automations.

**How We Will Measure Success (First 6 Months)**

* All Product team cadences run on schedule, with action items consistently tracked to closure.
* Weekly sprint health and productivity reports run with minimal manual intervention.
* At least three recurring manual processes are automated and actively used by the team.
* New hires become productive faster, with consistently positive onboarding feedback.
* Measurable improvement in Product team productivity and reduction in time spent on manual coordination and administrative work.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their CV along with either:

* A link to a workflow they have automated using AI, or
* A 2-minute video demonstrating an AI-powered workflow they have built.

Please explain what the workflow does, how you built it and how much time it saves each week.

**Email your application to:**
payal.vi@amberstudent.com

**Shortlisted candidates will be given a 48-hour take-home assignment to automate a real Product Operations workflow.**

title: Technical Analyst
description:
Join us as a Technical Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
**To Be Successful You Should Have Experience With**

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The location of the role is Pune.

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* Transformation and portfolio oversight: Drive delivery of assigned MarTech initiatives within the transformation portfolio, ensuring changes are adopted, embedded and deliver intended business outcomes.
* Stakeholder partnership: Work with senior business stakeholders within assigned domains to align expectations, manage change impact and resolve cross -functional dependencies.
* Teamwork: Coach and guide team members, contributing expertise and leadership within the MarTech team.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Data Science, Business, or related fields.
* Strong experience of owning and evolving marketing business processes enabled by MarTech in a B2B environment.
* Proven capability delivering complex, multi-market MarTech initiatives with a focus on adoption and sustained value realization.
* Deep understanding of how marketing processes map to MarTech capabilities, including data quality, compliance, and usage standards.

title: Senior Specialist, Salesforce (Techno-Functional)
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Senior Salesforce Techno-Functional Specialist will strengthen Avient's internal Salesforce capability by translating commercial needs into scalable CRM solutions that maximize business value. Working across Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Labs, IT, and delivery partners, this role will advance global Salesforce operations, simplification, integrations, automation, and AI-enabled modernization of Avient's Lead-to-Land processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines business analysis, creative problem-solving, and strategic foresight with hands-on expertise in Salesforce's declarative low-code/no-code tools, including Flow and Admin configuration. The role will also provide functional direction and solution oversight for Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and external development partners while promoting scalable standard solutions and avoiding unnecessary customization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as Avient’s Salesforce techno-functional subject matter expert and trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Labs, IT, global application leadership, Salesforce Product Owners, and external delivery partners.
* Own and support Salesforce platform enhancements and continuous improvement across Salesforce, ensuring solutions align with business needs and Avient's broader application strategy.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions, including process designs, user stories, functional specifications, configuration requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Design and configure Salesforce solutions using declarative low-code/no-code capabilities, including Salesforce Flow, validation rules, field dependencies, page layouts, permission sets, profiles, roles, reports, dashboards, and other Admin-managed functionality.
* Design and execute coded Salesforce solutions, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura, APIs, and integrations, or delegate development to partner resources and provide functional direction, technical oversight, and solution assurance to ensure business requirements are met without unnecessary customization.
* Advance Avient's AI-enabled and digital CRM roadmap by modernizing Lead-to-Land processes, simplifying the Salesforce user experience, reducing technical debt and unnecessary data capture, improving opportunity and pipeline management, automating commercial workflows, and supporting Salesforce AI and Agentforce use cases.
* Coordinate Salesforce integration requirements across the Avient application landscape, including SAP, BTP/middleware and other connected commercial applications as applicable.
* Improve Salesforce release management through solution impact analysis, sandbox testing, regression planning, deployment sequencing, business acceptance testing, documentation, and post-release validation.
* Drive Salesforce platform rationalization and technical-debt reduction by identifying opportunities to retire or simplify obsolete profiles, fields, objects, flows, applications, customizations, and unused platform capabilities.
* Support Salesforce platform governance and optimization, including security and access design, license utilization, evaluation of Salesforce-native applications such as Key Account Planning tools, configuration standards, documentation, and alignment with enterprise architecture and IT standards.
* Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability by independently driving work from problem identification through solution delivery, communicating risks and decisions clearly, following through on commitments, and escalating dependencies when appropriate.

**NOTE:**
The above stated duties are intended to outline those functions typically performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This description of duties is not intended to be all-inclusive or to limit the discretionary authority of supervisors to assign other tasks of a similar nature or level of responsibility.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelors of Science degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems or related business field, or equivalent experience required
* 5-8 years of Salesforce experience in expanded functional analyst roles and responsibilities
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud required; exposure to Agentforce/AI Force, Service Cloud, Pardot/Marketing Cloud, or CPQ strongly preferred.
* A proven record of accomplishment of working both independently and as a member of a team.
* Communicates effectively with both technical IT audiences, and non-technical business audiences.
* Strong ability to analyze both qualitative and quantitative data to support ideas and measure the impact of experiments
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and creativity applied to IT systems and business processes. A keen interest in and understanding of emerging technologies and their potential business applications.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
* Successful candidates will be driven to succeed while fostering a great place to work.

**About Us**
Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.
  
  
Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
  
  
Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
  
  
We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.
  
  
By
*playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself*
you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.
  
  
At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.
  
  
Avient is an equal opportunity employer. We maintain a policy of non-discrimination in providing equal employment to all qualified employees and candidates regardless of race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, color, religion, national origin, disability, genetic information, protected veteran’s status, or other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal, state and local law. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to complete an online application, please contact the Avient HR Team by emailing, ApplicationAccommodation@Avient.com .

title: Salesforce Architect -Financial Services Cloud
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
  
  
## Salesforce Architect – Sales, Service & Financial Services Cloud
  
  
### Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC). The candidate will be responsible for defining end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, guiding technical design, ensuring platform scalability and security, and aligning Salesforce solutions with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional knowledge, technical architecture, integration design, data architecture, security, and delivery leadership.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Own end-to-end solution design including:
* Application architecture
* Data architecture
* Integration architecture
* Security and sharing model
* Environment and deployment strategy
* Design Salesforce solutions using the right combination of configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, OmniStudio, and integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance to Salesforce Tech Leads, Senior Developers, Developers, QA, and integration teams.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical designs, and major customizations.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions follow platform best practices and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Define reusable architecture patterns and common components across Salesforce applications.
* Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and extensibility.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architects and other application architects to align Salesforce with the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support estimation, planning, technical risk assessment, and delivery governance.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, platform limitations, and technical debt and define mitigation plans.

### Sales Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Salesforce solutions for:
* Lead management
* Account and Contact management
* Opportunity management
* Sales processes and pipelines
* Forecasting
* Territory and account management
* Activities and customer interactions
* Reports and dashboards
* Define scalable sales-process models while balancing standard Salesforce capabilities with custom business requirements.
* Design integrations between Salesforce and external CRM, ERP, quoting, marketing, and customer-data platforms.

### Service Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect Service Cloud solutions covering:
* Case management
* Omni-Channel
* Entitlements and milestones
* Knowledge management
* Service Console
* Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
* Digital engagement and customer-service channels
* Service automation
* Design customer-service processes across multiple channels and applications.
* Define scalable routing, assignment, escalation, and service-level management solutions.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external contact-center, telephony, customer, and backend systems.

### Financial Services Cloud Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect FSC solutions for financial-services business processes including banking, insurance, wealth management, or lending.
* Strong understanding and application of the Financial Services Cloud data model.
* Design solutions using FSC capabilities including:
* Person Accounts
* Household and Group models
* Financial Accounts
* Financial Holdings
* Account-Contact Relationships
* Interaction Summaries
* Action Plans
* Relationship management
* Define appropriate extensions to the FSC data model while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Ensure FSC solutions align with financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Design integration patterns between FSC and systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan systems, customer master, payment, and financial platforms.

### Integration Architecture
  
  

* Define enterprise integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications.
* Design integrations using:
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Bulk APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Streaming APIs
* Middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
* Determine appropriate usage of synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Define API security, authentication, error handling, retry, logging, and monitoring standards.
* Ensure integration designs account for Salesforce API limits, transaction volumes, and performance constraints.

### Data Architecture
  
  

* Define Salesforce data models aligned with business and enterprise-data requirements.
* Design data structures, relationships, ownership, and sharing models.
* Support data migration, consolidation, and transformation strategies.
* Define strategies for large data volumes, data archival, retention, and performance optimization.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and appropriate data-governance controls.
* Work with data architects and integration teams to define source-of-truth and master-data responsibilities.

### Security & Governance
  
  

* Define Salesforce security architecture including:
* Profiles
* Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups
* Roles
* Sharing Rules
* Organization-Wide Defaults
* Field-Level Security
* Apex security
* Ensure solutions follow Salesforce secure-development practices.
* Define appropriate access controls for sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, compliance, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Establish Salesforce technical standards, architecture principles, and governance practices.

### DevOps & Environment Strategy
  
  

* Define Salesforce environment and deployment strategies.
* Provide architecture guidance for Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Support branching, release, and deployment strategies.
* Define approaches for sandbox management, refreshes, test environments, and release governance.
* Ensure appropriate separation of configuration, code, test data, and production deployment activities.

### Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong architecture experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Strong understanding of:
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce Flows
* SOQL/SOSL
* Salesforce configuration
* OmniStudio
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and design constraints.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data, security, and sharing models.
* Experience designing large-scale enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with MuleSoft or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing solutions for large data volumes and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of application, integration, data, and security architecture.
* Experience leading architecture and technical design discussions.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile and large enterprise delivery environments.

### Leadership Expectations
  
  
The Salesforce Architect should be able to:
  
  

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Provide clear technical direction to Tech Leads and development teams.
* Challenge designs that create unnecessary technical debt or customization.
* Define reusable patterns and architecture standards.
* Resolve complex cross-platform design issues.
* Identify architecture risks early and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Facilitate design decisions across Salesforce, integration, data, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Support customer stakeholders in understanding architecture choices and trade-offs.
* Ensure consistency of architecture across multiple Salesforce teams and vendors.

### Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, or Salesforce Industries.
* Strong hands-on experience with OmniStudio.
* Experience with complex org consolidation or Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience with multi-org Salesforce landscapes.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with enterprise API and integration governance.
* Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.
* Experience working in multi-vendor and globally distributed delivery environments.

### Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect – highly preferred
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
* Platform Developer I / II
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Integration Architect

### Experience
  
  
Typically 10–15+ years of overall IT experience, including:
  
  

* 7+ years of Salesforce experience
* Strong architecture experience across complex Salesforce implementations
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
* Strong implementation and architecture experience with Financial Services Cloud
* Experience leading architecture for medium to large enterprise Salesforce programs

description:
Job Location - Delhi
  
  
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Sarathi is a livelihood tech platform for implementing and monitoring Economic Inclusion Programs (EIP) based on the Graduation Approach. As a national gov tech initiative supporting tech for good, Sarathi enables real-time tracking and decision-making for grassroots programs.
  
  
As we scale nationally, we are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented Product Rollout specialist to manage rollout and adoption across centrally-supported programs and partner states. This role sits at the intersection of technology, program delivery, and government engagement - ideal for someone excited to help scale a national
**gov tech**
platform driving
**last-mile delivery**
.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Be part of The/Nudge’s tech team as an Associate Manager, supporting digital product adoption and field implementation to scale rural livelihood programs across India.
  
  

* Onboarding & Rollout: Ensure smooth and efficient rollout of Sarathi in all program states.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate with government stakeholders, program partners, and internal teams for alignment on adoption plans, program details and handholding.
* Training & Adoption: Spearhead product training sessions, demonstrations with all user groups, and provide continuous user support.
* Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first escalation point for field issues; work closely with the tech and support teams to ensure quick resolution.
* Documentation & Communication: Maintain rollout trackers, SOPs, and communicate implementation updates internally and externally.

With 5+ states live and plans for national rollout in next 1 year, this role will ensure that our product is ready for use, users are trained and seamlessly adopt Sarathi for program delivery at the last mile.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Min 5 years of experience in product operations, field-facing program roles, tech implementation in a development sector or public tech environment.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail – especially written communication and user empathy.
* Comfortable working across multiple communication platforms.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple moving parts.
* Language skills (Hindi and/or regional language) is a plus, given the field-facing nature of the role.
* Comfortable operating across teams and systems; a problem-solver with a strong bias for action.
* Able to make sense of programmatic processes and translate them into product features and workflows.
* Driven by impact, and able to work across ambiguity and scale.

title: Manager – Autonomy, Navigation
description:
**Position**

Manager – Autonomy, Navigation, Communications & Shore Control

**Programme**

Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV)

**Reports to**

Program Manager – ASV

**Location**

ARI, Okhla, New Delhi, with extended periods at shipyard and coastal trial sites in India

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Experience**

10–15 years, including at least 5 years hands-on with autonomous or unmanned systems

**Travel**

Frequent domestic travel to the build yard and trial sites; occasional travel to suppliers

**Role purpose**

The Manager – Autonomy, Navigation, Communications & Shore Control is responsible for the complete lifecycle of autonomy suite for the ASV, right from Concept Design and also responsible for finalization of Autonomy requirement for the ASV, selection of sensor suite, selection of OEMs/ suppliers, plan for installation, integration and trials. He/ she will be responsible for everything that makes the vessel autonomous: the navigation and perception sensors, the autonomy computer and software, the communication links, the shore control station and the safe conduct of autonomous trials. The role holder is the single technical authority for autonomy on the programme, works closely with ARI’s team, and holds technology partners to account where they supply parts of the autonomy solution.

**Key responsibilities**

* Define the autonomy, navigation, communications and shore-control architecture, including manual, remote and autonomous modes and the handover between them.
* Select and integrate navigation and perception sensors.
* Own the autonomy software: path planning, collision avoidance, mission management and fail-safe behaviour. Where a partner supplies it, own the partner technically.
* Design the communications architecture across line-of-sight radio, cellular and satellite links, including loss-of-link behaviour.
* Specify and deliver the shore control station for monitoring, mission planning, video and remote takeover.
* Agree command, feedback and failsafe interfaces for propulsion, steering and onboard systems with the Manager – Electrical, Controls & Systems Integration.
* Agree sensor and antenna placement, power and cooling with the Manager – Platform Integration.
* Test in simulation and hardware-in-the-loop, then plan and lead autonomy trials from harbour to coastal, including trial safety arrangements and emergency stop.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Robotics, Control or Aerospace Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  10–15 years in total, including at least 5 years hands-on with autonomous or unmanned systems (USV, UUV, UAV, UGV, autonomous vehicles or robotics), or with defence command-and-control and sensor systems.
* **Ownership:**
  Has personally owned at least one autonomy or navigation system from design through to field trials.
* **Technical knowledge:**
  Working knowledge of sensor fusion, GNSS/INS, radar and AIS, real-time embedded Linux or ROS/ROS 2, radio and network links, and CAN, Ethernet and NMEA 2000 interfaces.
* **Trials:**
  Has planned and taken part in field trials of autonomous or unmanned systems, including safety arrangements.

**Desirable**

* Experience with marine or maritime unmanned systems, and working knowledge of COLREGs.
* Experience with simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Exposure to functional safety, cyber security or classification society rules for autonomous vessels.
* Experience of managing technology partners or subcontractors on a development programme.
* Experience on defence or government development programmes.

**Skills and personal attributes**

* Systems thinker who can see the whole vessel, not only the autonomy software.
* Hands-on and comfortable working at the build yard, on the quayside and at sea.
* Takes safety seriously and makes sound go/no-go decisions under time pressure.
* Clear written and spoken communication with engineers, partners, management and customers.
* Plans and delivers to milestones in a fast-moving programme.

**Typical candidate backgrounds**

Unmanned-systems and drone companies; defence electronics and C4I organisations; autonomous-vehicle and robotics firms. Former service officers with relevant unmanned-systems or sensor-integration experience are also welcome to apply.

**Working conditions**

* Based in New Delhi, with frequent travel and extended stays at the build yard and coastal trial sites.
* Sea trials involve work on small craft, outdoors and sometimes outside normal working hours.

title: Calendar Lead
description:
**Role purpose**

The Calendar Lead will own the strategic development and execution of the dine-in commercial calendar, translating business priorities, consumer insights and category opportunities into integrated initiatives that drive sustainable revenue and transaction growth.

The role requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, category management, consumer understanding and through-the-line marketing capability. The individual will identify where the business can unlock growth, determine the right value propositions and commercial levers, and orchestrate their execution in partnership with Planning, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other cross-functional stakeholders.

This is an end-to-end role that balances near-term commercial delivery with brand strength, consumer relevance and long-term growth.

**1. Own the dine-in commercial calendar and growth agenda**

• Lead the development of the annual and rolling dine-in commercial calendar, aligned with business plans, revenue targets and category priorities.

• Translate business performance and consumer insights into a prioritised pipeline of commercial growth initiatives across value, core menu activation, occasions, promotional platforms and brand-led demand generation.

• Determine what initiatives should feature in the calendar, when they should be activated, which consumer missions they should address and what role each plays in delivering growth.

• Ensure the calendar balances immediate transaction delivery with sustainable revenue growth, brand equity and a consistent consumer experience.

• Establish clear planning rhythms, governance and accountability for calendar development and execution.

**2. Identify and unlock category growth opportunities**

• Diagnose business performance along with planning across dine-in occasions, dayparts, categories, products, consumer missions and relevant customer segments to identify growth gaps and opportunities.

• Develop a clear point of view on where the business should focus its efforts, which growth levers to activate and which opportunities merit investment.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen the core, increase dine-in frequency, improve traffic and transactions, build consideration and recruit or reactivate consumers.

• Translate category and consumer understanding into actionable commercial plans, with clear hypotheses and measurable business outcomes.

• Bring a category-management mindset to calendar decisions, connecting consumer demand, product propositions, price points, competitive context and business performance.

• Establish clear objectives, success metrics and measurement frameworks for each major calendar initiative.

• Monitor performance against business cases, including revenue, transactions, traffic, average order value, mix, frequency, profitability and return on investment, as appropriate.

**3. Lead value strategy and commercial initiative development**

• Partner with Planning and relevant franchisee stakeholders to identify opportunities across value architecture, price points, bundles, meal constructs, promotional mechanics and dine-in offers.

• Ensure value propositions are relevant to consumer needs and occasions while balancing transaction growth, average order value, product mix, profitability and brand positioning.

• Develop and evaluate business cases for proposed initiatives, including sales and transaction potential, investment requirements, margin impact, incrementality and cannibalisation risk.

• Identify the right role for value across different consumer missions, ensuring that value creation extends beyond discounting alone.

• Continuously assess the effectiveness of commercial levers and recommend improvements to maximise sustainable growth.

**4. Translate commercial priorities into integrated through-the-line plans**

• Convert category opportunities and commercial objectives into clear consumer propositions and integrated marketing plans for dine-in.

• Partner with brand, creative, media and relevant franchisee teams to ensure initiatives have a compelling consumer proposition and effective communication.

• Connect commercial mechanics with campaign messaging, restaurant-level communication and the in-restaurant consumer experience.

• Ensure alignment between the intended offer, consumer promise and actual restaurant execution.

• Challenge plans that are commercially attractive but lack consumer relevance, as well as creative ideas that lack a credible business rationale

5
**. Lead and develop the team**

• Lead and coach Senior Brand Managers responsible for delivering individual calendar initiatives and growth programmes.

• Build a team that combines category thinking, consumer-centricity, commercial rigour, creative judgement and execution excellence.

• Set clear standards for business-case quality, initiative prioritisation, performance evaluation and cross-functional collaboration.

• Develop team members into end-to-end business owners who understand both the commercial fundamentals and the consumer proposition.

• Development of a high-performing, commercially capable brand-management team.

**Candidate profile**

• Significant experience in category management, end-to-end brand management, commercial marketing or integrated business planning within QSR, food service or FMCG/CPG.

• Demonstrated ownership of category growth initiatives and through-the-line programmes, from opportunity identification and business-case development through activation and performance evaluation.

• Strong understanding of consumer occasions, value propositions, pricing, promotions, category performance and transaction drivers.

• Experience partnering closely with Planning, Finance and commercial stakeholders to translate business targets into actionable plans.

• Strong analytical capability, including the ability to assess incremental growth, profitability, investment effectiveness and cannibalisation.

• Proven ability to combine commercial decision-making with consumer insight, brand judgement and integrated marketing execution.

• Experience leading teams and influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders.

**Leadership attributes**

• Thinks like a category owner and acts like a business leader.

• Commercially rigorous, consumer-centric and brand-conscious.

• Comfortable making portfolio trade-offs and challenging established ways of working.

• Able to translate analysis into clear decisions and actionable plans.

• Takes end-to-end accountability for outcomes rather than just calendar delivery.

• Builds alignment across functions while maintaining clarity on business priorities.

description:

* A leadership seat in a growing online business, backed by a manufacturer that controls its own formulations, quality and supply.

Apply directly on LinkedIn

You will be responsible for defining and implementing Gen AI and agentic AI strategies for clients, ensuring successful delivery of large-scale AI initiatives. Your expertise will drive innovation, build client relationships, and shape the roadmap for autonomous AI-driven business transformation. Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
– Strategic Leadership & Project Delivery
  
  

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI projects, from requirements gathering and solution architecture to deployment and post-implementation support

* Define and communicate a strategic vision for AI agent solutions, ensuring alignment with client business objectives
* Client & Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, translating complex AI concepts into actionable business solutions

* Design and implement sophisticated AI agents using frameworks like AI Refinery, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and custom agentic architectures
* Develop multi-agent systems that can collaborate, negotiate, and execute complex workflows autonomously
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for seamless communication between AI systems and external tools/APIs
* Build and deploy Generative AI applications with advanced reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities

**– Leverage Advanced Data Science Techniques**

* Develop solutions using Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Define data requirements, clean, aggregate, analyze, and interpret data while conducting data quality assessments.

**– Develop And Implement AI Models**

* Build and deploy AI models and Generative AI applications.
* Train and fine-tune LLMs using large-scale datasets to optimize performance and accuracy.
* Evaluate model performance and implement iterative improvements.

**– Solution Integration And Deployment**

* Collaborate to integrate AI solutions into end-to-end workflows, ensuring scalability.
* Utilize cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP for model development and deployment.

**– Innovation And Knowledge Sharing**

* Stay updated on advancements in AI and Data Science, exploring innovative techniques and frameworks.
* Document methodologies and findings for effective knowledge sharing.

title: (Associate) Director, Expansion, AI Access Initiative (EAII)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
  
  
Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
  
  
We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.
  
  
**The Role**
2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 '26.
  
  
Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India. The next phase is to expand this work: deciding which countries we move into next and building what it takes to operate there. We are seeking a rigorous, high-ownership Associate Director or Director, Expansion to own that expansion end to end, including driving the geographic expansion roadmap and go-to-market in new countries, building government and telco partnerships, and standing up offices and teams in new markets.
  
  
This role is based in India and sits on 2AI's global team, reporting into the VP, Agriculture. It works alongside our Director, Program Strategy, who owns the product roadmap: what we build, test, and scale. It includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program. You will work closely with our India country team and other in-country team members to scope and expand programming.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Drive expansion: In conjunction with the VP, Agriculture, develop the criteria for market selection, prioritize countries to expand into, and set the go-to-market plan for each. This includes understanding the state of AI-enabled forecasts and other agriculture innovations in the region.
* Stand up new markets: Once a new market is confirmed, support the set-up of offices and the hiring of high-quality staff with the requisite skills to implement large-scale forecast delivery
* Lead telco partnerships: Build telco partnerships that extend our reach and strengthen what we deliver to farmers. Identify target telcos and lead engagement, negotiation, and relationship management to set up sustainable telco-based dissemination systems. Explore how telco data can help us improve reach, forecasts, messaging, and new advisory products
* Hire and manage in-country scoping support: Where staff on the ground are needed to determine whether there is an opportunity in a new market, hire and oversee them, for example short-term consultants
* Build and maintain government relationships: Create new and nurture existing relationships with the government bodies needed to operate and disseminate forecasts in a new market, including agriculture departments and meteorological agencies
* Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
* Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public-good resources

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.
  
  
We are still actively scoping our roles and structure, reflecting the dynamism of this fast-growing phase of the organization, both the fun and the realities that come with rapid growth. 2AI is open to candidates across a range of seniority levels for this role; title, scope, and compensation will be assessed candidly with each candidate throughout the process based on their experience and fit.
  
  
**You will likely have:**

* 7-10+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization
* Strong communication skills in English with experience working with international teams
* A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments. Direct experience taking a program or organization into a new region is a plus
* Demonstrated success building and negotiating partnerships with governments and the private sector. Experience with telcos, mobile network operators, or platform partners is a strong plus
* Training or early career experience in a high-rigor environment (e.g., top-tier management consulting, high-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts
* A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high-performance culture across distributed and field-based teams
* Experience working with Asian and/or African governments to drive large-scale change, with a strong preference for direct experience working with ministries of agriculture or national meteorological agencies
* High EQ and the ability to influence across diverse partners, from AI/forecasting researchers to frontline delivery staff to senior government officials
* Strong fluency with AI tools, and eager to experiment, learn, and adapt to emerging technologies
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; can define and test hypotheses, adapt quickly, and maintain focus on impact
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex technical ideas (e.g., AI/ML weather forecasting language) into crisp narratives for different audiences
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally (:50-70%) to prospective and current markets across low-and-middle income countries
* Passion for the mission of ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI reach the world's poorest populations, while mitigating its downside risks

**Position Location**
This role is based in India, with flexibility on location within the country. The role sits on 2AI's global team rather than within a single country program, and requires significant international travel to prospective and current markets. Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees . Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance,
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements,
* Generous leave,
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning & Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Compensation: Pay will be competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience and previous pay scale.
  
  
This role will initially be housed at EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, with the explicit plan to transfer with the AI Access Initiative as a founding member of the team when that project is spun out as a new entity later this year. At that point, benefits and policies may change.
  
  
Use of AI in our hiring process: We believe strongly in the importance of human judgment throughout hiring, from screening to final decisions. We use AI to support our team across the process, including application review, note-taking, scheduling, and project management. AI does not make hiring decisions or reject candidates. We do not use models that train on inputs or candidate data. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we will use your information for recruitment purposes, including through these AI-supported tools, as described in our privacy notice.

title: India Project Director, AFGHS-FHI 360
description:
FHI 360 is a nonprofit human development organization dedicated to improving lives in lasting ways by advancing integrated, locally driven solutions. Our staff includes experts in health, education, nutrition, environment, economic development, youth, research, technology, communication, and social marketing—creating a unique mix of capabilities to address today’s interrelated development challenges. FHI 360 serves more than 50 countries and all US states and territories.
  
  
**This position is contingent upon funding from the Department of State (DOS).**
**Project Description:**
The
**America First Global Health Strategy – FHI 360 (AFGHS-FHI 360)**
project is initially a 13-month project (2026 – 2027) with the ability to be extended for up to five years (though 2031). Funded by the United States (US) Department of State (DOS), AFGHS-FHI 360 is a global fixed amount award (FAA) and operates in approximately 50 countries, addressing key public health challenges such as HIV/AIDS, global health security (GHS), maternal and neonatal child health (MNCH), malaria, tuberculosis (TB), polio, supply chain (SC) and health systems strengthening (HSS). In India, AFGHS-FHI 360 builds off the country’s progress to date to future strengthen the country’s response to Polio and HIV. AFGHS-FHI 360 is recruiting a Project Director located in New Delhi, India. This position is open to Indian nationals only residing in India.
  
  
**Job Summary**
:
  
  
The AFGHS-FHI 360 Country Project Director serves as the senior strategic, technical, and external-facing leader for the program. The position is responsible for setting program vision, shaping technical strategy, cultivating executive-level partnerships, and positioning FHI 360 as a trusted partner to government and donor stakeholders. The role provides cross-portfolio leadership across vaccine preventable disease (VPD/polio and HIV prevention and control programming including public health surveillance, health security, disease prevention, health systems strengthening, and emerging public health priorities, promoting integration, innovation, and scalable solutions across technical domains. As the program’s principal senior representative, the Country Project Director cultivates and sustains high-level relationships with national and state government leadership, donor representatives, multilateral institutions, the private sector, technical agencies, civil society, academia, and private-sector partners. The position proactively identifies opportunities to influence policy and implementation priorities, strengthen institutional capacity, mobilize strategic partnerships, and align program investments with broader public health system objectives. While accountable for overall project performance, the role delegates routine operational management and focuses primarily on strategic leadership, technical excellence, stakeholder influence, and organizational positioning. They will be required to coordinate and work with a diverse group of organizations and stakeholders, such as the Ministry of Health, senior government officials of NCDC, IDSP and NACO/SACS, country health staff, international and national development partner organizations, and the United States Government (USG) donor representatives.
  
  
Reporting to the Program Director in HQ. The Project Director works in close collaboration with the AFGHS-FHI 360 headquarters (HQ) team, planning and directing project implementation, milestone success, and monitoring budget/spending from startup through closeout. Under a matrixed structure, they lead the country project team in the planning of project activities ensuring completion of the project on schedule and within budget constraints.
  
  
***Accountabilities:***

* Serve as FHI 360's principal representative with senior government officials, donors, and strategic partners.
* Define and periodically refine the program’s strategic vision, technical priorities, and implementation direction in response to evolving government priorities, donor expectations, epidemiological evidence, and the broader public health operating environment, with a specific focus on Polio and HIV in India.
* Translate national and state public health policies, strategic plans, and emerging priorities into actionable program strategies, investment priorities, and results-oriented implementation frameworks for HIV and Polio.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior policymakers and institutional decision-makers to advance program objectives, support evidence-informed policy development, and facilitate effective implementation of public health priorities.
* Advance innovative and sustainable approaches across HIV, Polio, health security, surveillance, and emerging public health priorities.
* Build and maintain relationships at national and state leadership levels to advance program objectives and implementation.
* Position FHI 360 as a thought leader and strategic partner within India's public health ecosystem.
* Ensure workshops, convenings, and partnership activities are strategically aligned and produce measurable outcomes.
* Strengthen collaboration between country operations and FHI 360's headquarters and global technical teams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, partnerships, and approaches that expand program impact and sustainability.

description:

**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Sarathi is a livelihood tech platform for implementing and monitoring Economic Inclusion Programs (EIP) based on the Graduation Approach. As a national gov tech initiative supporting tech for good, Sarathi enables real-time tracking and decision-making for grassroots programs.
  
  
As we scale nationally, we are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented Product Rollout specialist to manage rollout and adoption across centrally-supported programs and partner states. This role sits at the intersection of technology, program delivery, and government engagement - ideal for someone excited to help scale a national
**gov tech**
platform driving
**last-mile delivery**
.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Be part of The/Nudge’s tech team as an Associate Manager, supporting digital product adoption and field implementation to scale rural livelihood programs across India.
  
  

* Onboarding & Rollout: Ensure smooth and efficient rollout of Sarathi in all program states.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate with government stakeholders, program partners, and internal teams for alignment on adoption plans, program details and handholding.
* Training & Adoption: Spearhead product training sessions, demonstrations with all user groups, and provide continuous user support.
* Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first escalation point for field issues; work closely with the tech and support teams to ensure quick resolution.
* Documentation & Communication: Maintain rollout trackers, SOPs, and communicate implementation updates internally and externally.

With 5+ states live and plans for national rollout in next 1 year, this role will ensure that our product is ready for use, users are trained and seamlessly adopt Sarathi for program delivery at the last mile.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Min 5 years of experience in product operations, field-facing program roles, tech implementation in a development sector or public tech environment.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail – especially written communication and user empathy.
* Comfortable working across multiple communication platforms.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple moving parts.
* Language skills (Hindi and/or regional language) is a plus, given the field-facing nature of the role.
* Comfortable operating across teams and systems; a problem-solver with a strong bias for action.
* Able to make sense of programmatic processes and translate them into product features and workflows.
* Driven by impact, and able to work across ambiguity and scale.

* Compliance Programs

* Drive resolution of cross-functional issues and escalations.
* Monitor project health, milestones, deliverables, and overall portfolio performance.
* Ensure adherence to established project management methodologies and governance standards.

* Manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting across CIO programs.
* Track project spend, resource utilization, capital investments, and operating expenditures.

* Monitor budget versus actuals and support cost management initiatives.

title: Integrated Logistics Senior Continuous Improvement Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
Deploying and leading the CI service offering and owning the CI program for the customer, aiming achievement of cost and cash savings in KNIL customer’s supply chain. Leading business case development, providing status updates on CI program to Business Manager / customer, ensuring achievement of savings targets. Following approach to savings idea generation, validation and implementation based on KNIL experience and tailoring it to the specifics of the customer, as well as enrichment of the approach based on own best practices.
  
  
**How you create impact**

* Problem Solving Identifies supply chain inefficiencies, builds improvement business cases, and drives optimization initiatives to achieve cost savings.
* Savings Target Setting Maps value streams, performs loss analysis, and defines cost and cash-saving opportunities. Aligns savings targets, timelines, and resources with customers and Business Managers.
* Savings Pipeline Development Leads data-driven improvement by validating baselines, generating ideas with cross-functional teams, and building a multi-year portfolio of high-impact initiatives.
* Savings Status Tracking Aligns on savings calculation and reporting, maintains trackers and dashboards, and drives regular reviews to convert ideas into executable projects.
* Savings Delivery Oversees end-to-end execution, manages risks, and tracks actual savings to ensure benefits realization.

**What we would like you to bring**

* Proven track record in change management and/or project management (min. 8 years).
* Proven experience in all transportation modes.
* Proven experience in supply chain cost budgeting / optimization / value stream mapping.
* Proven experience in business case creation.
* Proven experience of cross regional or global collaboration in multinational environment.
* Preferred candidate to have Forwarding / Logistics background.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
  
  
**About The UK Business**
Fidelity’s Global Platform Services (GPS) business manages or administers c. £135bn of customers’ assets. The business supports the investment needs of more than one million UK customers across four channels: Personal Investing; Retail Funds; FundsNetwork and GPS. Already a leading provider in the mutual funds, advised platform, direct-to-consumer and DC pensions markets, the business has ambitious growth plans. By combining its distribution strengths with the investment expertise of the Fidelity group, the business is ideally positioned to fulfil its goal of becoming a leading UK provider of retirement solutions.
  
  
**About Your Team**
The primary purpose of the Global Transitions team is to ensure that new Fidelity Trust, Contract and Master Trust Pension Plans asset transfers into Fidelity are established to agreed timescales and also deal with relevant on going corporate actions.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The Global Transition Senior Associate should ensure that Asset Tansition (Corporate Actions and New Client Onboardings) projects meet Fidelity quality, efficiency and product definitions.
  
  
The role is focused on providing support for new and existing clients within GPS (Workplace Investing), whether it be the onboarding of new client assets as part of an Implmentation, or providing detailed analysis and execution of assets for existing client as part of a Corporate Action. There will also be the opportunity to be involved with all aspects of establishing DC Schemes within Fidelity for both investment only and full service relationships, from initial review and analysis of the DC product sold, undertaking a due diligence meeting with the clients, asset data collation, to ongoing asset re-engineering and support.
  
  
There will also be an opportunity to support a large project that Fidelity is currently going through to convert existing schemes already on our platform to Fidelity’s new MIFID entity, FPSL.
  
  
The Global Transition Senior Associate is responsible for all Fidelity services being delivered to the client during the Transition and will co-ordinate with the appropriate Fidelity departments to ensure services are delivered to the client in an agreed and timely manner e.g. legal, communications, administration and presentations.
  
  
They will identify any operational issues as they arise and make recommendations to Clients / Fidelity Management for any required changes. They will also be pro-active in determining any other needs or concerns of the client and Operations department and act on them accordingly.
  
  
During the Transition or Corporate Action phase the Global Transition Senior Associate will:
  
  

* Organise/Attend client/stakeholder meetings and update relevant documentation for the project
* Establish and maintain a project file including a project plan
* Ensure client deliverables are identified and relevant funding strategies are designed
* Execute designed strategies using internal procedures to fund client accounts
* Lead the execution of the asset movement as part of the onboarding or corporate action
* Liaise with all Fidelity departments, external market counterparties and fund providers when required
* Provide reports to senior management and external parties like Trustees, Investment Consultants as required
* Support and peer review other teams work as required

Additional:
  
  

* Develop, monitor and update a strategy throughout the Transition and corporate action process.
* Assist client in understanding the project delivery process and Fidelity procedures.
* Interface with client and/or internal associates to solve problems and resolve outstanding issues relating to plan administration or any of Fidelity’s products and services.
* Consult with direct reporting manager or appropriate parties on issues requiring additional attention or decision-making.

* Communicate scheme design features to all impacted Fidelity areas.
* Interact with the appropriate members of Admin and Financial Operations to ensure that all-proper controls are established.
* Initiate and participate in the process improvement initiative (new procedures and documenting procedures.)
* Provide management, sales, client management and admin with timely, concise status reports, as well as meeting notes for all client visits.
* Work with systems to identify, analyse, sponsor, and install any needed systems enhancements.
* Understand the market and its needs by keeping up with industry trends and developments in the market through regular client contact, trade press, and industry conferences.
* Understand the full array of Fidelity products and services, specifically, but not restricted to the Workplace Investing arena. Examples would be services related to all aspects of the defined contribution pension schemes and Fidelity funds offered to such schemes.
* Provide input in the decision making process to senior management when required.
* Help in the sales process for new prospects and client calls, as appropriate.
* To have a good understanding of the FSA’s Treating Customers Fairly regime to ensure that each customer receives the highest level of customer service and that this is applied on a consistent basis. In addition, it is essential that any TCF issues identified are fed back to line managers or TCF champions so the appropriate actions and decisions can be considered.
* Demonstrate strong presentation and interpersonal skills

* Experience in Defined Contributions operations administration & Asset Transition.
* Good level of Excel knowledge including data presentation.
* Basic knowledge of pooled fund operations and fund accounting.

**Feel rewarded**

It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.
