title: Merchant Onboarding Lead (SaaS, US)
description:
**About the role:**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own:**

**Onboarding Delivery and Governance:**

- Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.

- Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.

- Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

**Cross Functional Partnership:**

- Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.

- Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.

- Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.

- Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

**Process, Tooling and Reporting:**

- Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.

- Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.

- Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.

- Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

**Merchant Experience and Retention:**

- Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.

- Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.

- Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

**Team Leadership and Capacity:**

- Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions.

- Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.

- Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

**What we are looking for:**

- 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.

- Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.

- Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.

- Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.

- Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.

-Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Lead Strategic Sourcing Analyst- Systems Analyst- Procurement Operations
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
**Job Summary**
To help the Sourcing & Procurement organization maximize the value of its workflow, reporting, and procurement technology. Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will manage the intake, analysis, coordination, and delivery of system and process enhancements that improve procurement execution, visibility, compliance, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
The Senior Systems Analyst will serve as a connector between Procurement Operations, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders. The role will translate business needs into structured requirements, workflows, system changes, reports, automations, and operating procedures. Success requires strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, change leadership, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or fast-moving initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Portfolio, Intake, and Initiative Management
  
  

* Orchestrate the intake process for new Procurement Operations requests, system enhancements, reporting needs, process issues, and special projects.
* Maintain a structured portfolio of active and planned initiatives, including priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, and expected outcomes.
* Develop practical workflows and governance routines that improve transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and timely delivery of procurement initiatives.
* Prepare status updates, decision materials, action logs, and executive-ready communications for Procurement leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Facilitate recurring working sessions and follow up on decisions and actions to keep initiatives moving to completion.

Systems Analysis and Process Design
  
  

* Gather and document business requirements for procurement workflow, ERP, spend analytics, reporting, supplier, Accounts Payable, and related systems.
* Map current and future-state processes, identify pain points and control gaps, and recommend practical improvements to reduce cycle time, rework, and manual effort.
* Translate requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, process diagrams, and configuration or development requests.
* Partner with system owners and Technology to evaluate options, clarify feasibility, manage dependencies, and support prioritization decisions.
* Help ensure system design supports Procurement policies, approval requirements, category management, data quality, auditability, and the needs of global stakeholders.

Testing, Implementation, and Adoption
  
  

* Coordinate testing and UAT for system enhancements, workflow changes, integrations, reports, and automations.
* Develop test scenarios, expected results, defect logs, resolution tracking, and go-live readiness assessments.
* Support implementation planning, stakeholder communications, training materials, standard operating procedures, and post-implementation adoption.
* Monitor results after implementation and confirm that changes achieve expected outcomes without introducing new operational or control issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of system functionality, business rules, process ownership, and change history.

Automation and Operational Improvement
  
  

* Identify repeatable, manual, and error-prone activities that can be simplified or automated through workflow, integrations, reporting, or low-code solutions.
* Partner with Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, Finance, and Technology to design and implement practical automations that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify root causes of delays, duplicate work, missing information, approval bottlenecks, and compliance risk.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and help measure the impact of changes on cycle time, quality, adoption, workload, and stakeholder experience.

Stakeholder Partnership and Change Management
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with Category Managers, Procurement Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Explain system and process changes clearly, tailor communications to the audience, and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities.
* Raise risks and dependencies early, facilitate resolution across teams, and maintain momentum when priorities or requirements change.
* Support the rollout of workflow tools, reporting processes, procurement controls, and other initiatives that improve how the organization operates.

**Qualifications**

title: Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
**About Balaji Printing Solution**

Balaji Printing Solution is a growing company operating in the printing and packaging industry. We are looking for a creative, commercially minded and execution-driven Marketing Manager to establish, develop and lead our marketing function.

This role will involve working closely with company management, internal teams and key stakeholders to develop and implement marketing strategies that strengthen the company's brand presence, expand its market reach and support business growth.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the company's overall marketing activities, including brand development, digital marketing, social media, SEO, content creation, website management, campaigns and marketing communications.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically, bring fresh ideas to the table and, most importantly, take ownership of turning those ideas into measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Planning

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Work closely with management and key stakeholders to establish marketing priorities, objectives and growth strategies.
* Create structured marketing plans, campaign calendars, budgets and measurable KPIs.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, market positioning and customer acquisition.
* Conduct market research, industry analysis and competitor research.
* Develop strategies to position Balaji Printing Solution as a credible and competitive brand within the printing and packaging industry.

2. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

* Take ownership of the company's social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms.
* Develop and manage a consistent social media and digital content calendar.
* Plan, create and oversee engaging content that communicates the company's products, services, capabilities and industry expertise.
* Manage social media campaigns, audience engagement and brand communications.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all platforms.
* Plan and execute paid digital advertising campaigns where appropriate.
* Monitor social media performance, engagement, reach and audience growth.

3. SEO, Website & Online Presence

* Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve the company's organic search visibility.
* Conduct keyword research and optimise website content for search engines.
* Oversee website content, updates, landing pages and ongoing improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve website traffic, search rankings and inbound enquiries.
* Monitor website analytics and digital performance.
* Work towards strengthening the company's overall online visibility and digital presence.

4. Content Creation & Brand Development

* Develop high-quality marketing content, including articles, blogs, social media posts, newsletters and company updates.
* Create and oversee marketing collateral such as company profiles, brochures, presentations, product catalogues and case studies.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand identity, tone of voice and visual communication strategy.
* Coordinate graphic design, photography, videography and other creative requirements.
* Develop educational and thought-leadership content relevant to the printing and packaging industry.
* Identify opportunities to showcase the company's capabilities, projects, machinery, products and industry knowledge.

5. AI Integration & Digital Innovation

* Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini and other relevant AI-powered platforms.
* Actively incorporate AI into marketing workflows to improve productivity, efficiency and creative output.
* Use AI tools for content development, copywriting, research, competitor analysis, marketing strategy and campaign planning.
* Leverage AI for SEO research, keyword analysis and digital marketing optimisation.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and streamline internal processes.
* Stay updated on emerging AI technologies and digital marketing trends.

6. Campaign Management & Business Development Support

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns to generate business enquiries and support sales objectives.
* Work closely with the sales and business development team to align marketing activities with client acquisition goals.
* Develop targeted marketing initiatives for potential clients, industries and business segments.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, industry exhibitions, trade events and networking.
* Create marketing materials and campaigns that support lead generation and client retention.
* Track campaign performance and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing initiatives.

7. Stakeholder & Project Management

* Work directly with company management to develop, present and execute marketing strategies.
* Collaborate with internal departments and stakeholders to understand business requirements and marketing priorities.
* Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, designers, content creators and other service providers.
* Manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Take responsibility for ensuring that agreed marketing plans are implemented rather than remaining at the planning stage.
* Provide regular updates and performance reports to management.

**Qualifications & Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related field.
* Previous experience in marketing, digital marketing, brand management or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of marketing strategy, digital marketing, social media management and content development.
* Practical experience in SEO, website optimisation and digital advertising.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication, presentation and copywriting skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with management, clients, external agencies and stakeholders.
* Strong working knowledge of AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI-powered platforms.
* Ability to use AI effectively for research, content creation, marketing planning, creative development and workflow optimisation.
* Familiarity with graphic design and video-editing platforms such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of digital analytics and marketing performance measurement.
* Strong organisational, project management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.
* A combination of creative thinking, analytical ability and commercial awareness.

**Additional Advantage:** Experience working with B2B businesses, manufacturing companies, printing, packaging or industrial sectors will be an advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful, ambitious and comfortable taking ownership of an entire marketing function.

**The ideal candidate should be able to:**

* Develop a marketing strategy and translate it into a practical execution plan.
* Work closely with management and stakeholders, bringing ideas and recommendations to the table.
* Independently manage the company's marketing activities and ensure consistent execution.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Understand and actively use AI to improve the quality and efficiency of their work.
* Stay informed about evolving marketing technologies, industry developments and digital trends.
* Take initiative, identify problems and propose solutions without requiring constant supervision.
* Measure results, assess performance and continuously improve marketing activities.

This is an opportunity to build and shape the marketing function of a growing business, with significant scope to contribute to the company's long-term brand development and commercial growth.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are requested to submit the following:

* **Updated CV:** Including relevant qualifications and professional experience.
* **Cover Letter:** Briefly explaining your suitability for the role, relevant experience and approach to marketing.
* **Portfolio:** Showcasing previous marketing campaigns, social media accounts managed, content created, SEO projects, website work, branding or other relevant marketing initiatives.

Applications should be sent to:

**enquiries@balajiprintingsolution.com**

Please use **Marketing Manager – Application** as the subject line.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

description:

**Industry:**
Textile Manufacturing | Knitwear | Apparel & Garments

**Experience:**
15+ Years

Fractional / Virtual Chief Operating Officer (COO)

**Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu (Virtual Engagement)

Fractional

Immediate

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategically driven Fractional Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the operational transformation of an established textile manufacturing organisation with an annual revenue of approximately ₹65 Cr.

The company, based in Tirupur, has over 15 years of experience in knitted fabrics and garment manufacturing, along with its own apparel brand. As the organisation transitions from a small-scale to a medium-scale enterprise, it is looking to establish structured business systems, strengthen operational efficiency and develop a strong second line of leadership.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in scaling manufacturing businesses, building organisational structures, implementing systems and processes, and reducing founder dependency in day-to-day operations.

* Review and streamline end-to-end manufacturing operations, including production planning, quality control, inventory, supply chain and dispatch.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational frameworks and structured business processes.
* Develop and implement operational KPIs, performance dashboards and periodic review mechanisms.
* Design a clear organisational hierarchy with well-defined roles, responsibilities and reporting structures.
* Build and strengthen the second line of leadership to ensure independent functioning of key departments.
* Introduce effective management systems to reduce operational dependency on the founder.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, improve productivity and optimise resource utilisation.
* Drive process standardisation, cost optimisation and overall operational excellence.
* Develop succession planning frameworks for critical management and operational positions.
* Work closely with the founder to establish strategic priorities and prepare the organisation for its next phase of growth.
* Support the transition from a founder-dependent business into a professionally structured and scalable manufacturing organisation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* 15+ years of experience in operations management, business management or general management.
* Strong experience in textile manufacturing, knitwear, apparel or garment manufacturing.
* Prior experience as COO, Head of Operations, Plant Head, Business Head or equivalent leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling small or medium-sized manufacturing businesses.
* Proven track record of implementing business systems, SOPs and operational frameworks.
* Experience designing organisational structures, defining reporting hierarchies and developing leadership teams.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality management, supply chain and manufacturing operations.
* Experience in succession planning and reducing founder dependency.
* Strong strategic management, process improvement and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience working closely with founders and promoter-led organisations.

Key Leadership Qualities

* Strong strategic and business management fundamentals.
* Ability to transform unstructured operations into professionally managed systems.
* Excellent leadership and team-building capabilities.
* Strong decision-making and execution-oriented mindset.
* Ability to mentor functional heads and develop future leaders.
* Hands-on approach with the ability to drive change and ensure implementation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Entrepreneurial thinking with a strong focus on scalability and operational excellence.

Preferred Candidate Background

Candidates with prior experience in textile manufacturing, knitted fabrics, apparel and garment manufacturing organisations, particularly those who have worked with founder-led SMEs and successfully supported their transition into professionally managed medium-scale businesses.

Experience in the Tirupur and Coimbatore textile manufacturing ecosystem will be an added advantage.

**We are looking for a transformational operations leader who can build systems, establish a strong management hierarchy, develop the next line of leadership and enable the founder to move away from daily operations while preparing the business for sustainable growth.**

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Manager, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
*On engagements, you will:*

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Manager or Senior Manager in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

*Within the actuarial practice you will:*

* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, UK, US, Europe, etc.,
* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Risk analytics including development of analytical tools, analysis of insurance risk and general support for any risk analytics in the company
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Actuary with at least 6+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle CX Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The CX Oracle Apps Lead will provide day-to-day solution leadership and coordination for Oracle CX initiatives, guiding requirements, solution design, development, testing, issue resolution, and release activities. The individual will be expected to lead through expertise and influence, helping teams move work forward while ensuring solutions remain aligned with established CX architecture, standards, and product direction.
  
  
This is a hands-on lead position with no direct people-management responsibilities and requires a strong combination of Oracle CX application knowledge, analytical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and delivery experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Duties to include, but not limited to:
  
  

* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Oracle CX applications, including Oracle CPQ, PRM, and Subscription Management, that form an integral part of the NOV CX platform.
* Provide functional and technical leadership in the design and implementation of Oracle CX solutions, working within established CX architecture, standards, and product direction.
* Partner with the CX Product Manager – Oracle Apps and other CX SMEs to evaluate business requirements and develop scalable, supportable solutions that meet the needs of the global enterprise.
* Facilitate requirements and solution discussions with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, architects, and implementation partners to understand business needs and evaluate potential solutions.
* Translate business requirements into clear functional requirements, solution designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation guidance for delivery teams.
* Provide day-to-day guidance to AMS and delivery resources working on Oracle CX enhancements, defects, and project requirements.
* Support existing Oracle CX solutions, including analysis and resolution of production issues, working with AMS, technical teams, and other Enterprise Solutions teams as appropriate.
* Support monthly Oracle CX releases, including enhancements, and new requirements, and coordinate activities as needed with Oracle scheduled upgrades.
* Coordinate with functional and technical resources to identify dependencies, clarify requirements, resolve issues, and move work through the development and testing lifecycle.
* Maintain awareness of Oracle product releases, enhancements, and emerging capabilities and identify opportunities for consideration by the CX Product Manager and CX team.
* Promote reuse of existing capabilities and adherence to established Oracle CX configuration, integration, development, and support practices.
* Provide coaching and knowledge sharing to analysts, AMS resources, and other team members on Oracle CX functionality, established solution patterns, and NOV processes.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of related work experience, and must have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in systems design or information systems
* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle CPQ Cloud/BigMachines.
* Working knowledge and experience with Oracle PRM and/or Oracle Fusion CX applications.
* Experience with Oracle Subscription Management is preferred.
* Experience working with integrations between Oracle CX applications and enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Adobe/Magento eCommerce, JD Edwards, and Oracle ERP Cloud is a plus.
* Experience working in Agile and iterative delivery environments, including Sprints and Kanban.
* Experience supporting application releases, enhancements, defect resolution, testing, and production support.
* Understanding of typical sales processes, including product configuration, pricing, quoting, partner/channel processes, and related customer interactions.
* Experience working in the Oil & Gas industry is preferred.
* Oracle CPQ and/or Oracle Cloud certifications are preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
  
  
**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
  
  
**Global Family**
We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation**
Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
  
  
**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division
description:
Job Title: Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division

Company name : Vieroots Wellness Solutions Pvt Ltd

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Department: Product Management & R&D

**About Vieroots**

Vieroots is a pioneering health-tech and wellness company specializing in personalized, genomics-driven preventive healthcare. By combining epigenetic lifestyle modifications (EPLIMO) with targeted nutritional supplementation, we empower individuals to optimize their healthspan and prevent lifestyle diseases. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, end-to-end Product Manager to spearhead the entire product lifecycle for our Nutraceuticals Division.

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

**Qualifications & Experience**

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

**What We Offer**

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Marketing Manager – Brand & Digital
description:
**About Us**

Masrap Technologies is the R&D and Product Innovation Centre of ESCO Group, Australia, developing innovative technology products for global markets.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and independent Marketing Manager to take ownership of marketing activities across our group of companies.

You will work with international stakeholders, manage external freelancers and agencies, and ensure marketing initiatives are planned, executed and delivered effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently manage and coordinate marketing activities across multiple brands and businesses.
* Plan marketing campaigns, digital initiatives and brand activities.
* Identify, engage and manage freelancers, creative professionals and marketing agencies.
* Oversee social media, content creation, websites, SEO and digital marketing activities.
* Review creative deliverables and maintain brand consistency.
* Manage marketing calendars, project timelines and priorities.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Marketing PMO & Business Operations Manager to lead operational coordination, project governance, and business operations activities across our Global Marketing organization.

This individual will serve as the operational backbone of the marketing team, ensuring that projects, budgets, vendors, resources, processes, and logistics are managed efficiently and consistently.

Working closely with Marketing functional leaders, this individual will support cross-functional coordination and accountability while enabling teams to maintain ownership of their respective strategies, priorities, and deliverables.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on problem solver who takes ownership, works independently, embraces technology and automation, and helps the marketing organization operate with discipline, efficiency, and transparency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Project Management & Governance**

* Own and maintain the global marketing master calendar, project plans, milestones, and deliverable trackers.

* Monitor cross-functional dependencies, deadlines, competing priorities, resource constraints, and execution risks, escalating issues proactively.
* Maintain visibility into team workloads and project capacity to support informed prioritization and resource planning.
* Support quarterly and annual marketing planning processes, including timelines, resource requirements, and operational readiness.
* Ensure consistent project management practices across geographically distributed teams.

**Marketing Business Operations & Administration**

* Oversee day-to-day administrative and operational activities supporting the Global Marketing organization.
* Serve as the central point of coordination for marketing-related operational requests.
* Coordinate team meetings, leadership reviews, planning workshops, and cross-functional working sessions.
* Maintain centralized documentation, shared repositories, templates, process guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including access provisioning, tools, and operational orientation.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, IT, and other corporate functions to resolve operational requirements.
* Manage recurring administrative activities to minimize the operational burden on marketing functional leaders.
* Support the operational needs of Marketing functions without assuming ownership of functional strategy, campaign execution, or marketing technology platforms.

**Budget, Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Maintain and manage the consolidated global marketing budget tracker.
* Monitor budget allocations, committed spending, actual expenditures, accruals, and forecasts.
* Coordinate purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, vendor payments, and expense reconciliation.
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure accurate financial reporting and timely payment processing.
* Manage vendor onboarding, contract administration, renewals, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain a centralized repository of vendor contracts, statements of work, subscriptions, and renewal dates.
* Track marketing technology licenses, subscriptions, renewal schedules, and associated expenses in coordination with platform owners.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.

**Events, Travel & Logistics Support**

* Partner with the Marketing Event Manager to provide operational and administrative support for industry conferences, executive engagements, client meetings, and internal programs.
* Coordinate event-related procurement, registrations, shipping, branded merchandise, promotional materials, and vendor administration as needed.
* Support travel arrangements and logistical planning for marketing-related activities.
* Maintain event-related operational checklists, budget trackers, documentation, and administrative timelines in coordination with the Event Manager.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to support timely processing of event-related expenses and deliverables.
* Support post-event financial reconciliation, documentation, and administrative follow-through.
* **Event strategy, planning, program management, and execution remain the responsibility of the Marketing Event Manager.**

**Reporting & Operational Performance**

* Develop and maintain marketing operations dashboards covering project progress, budgets, workload and capacity, and operational KPIs.
* Consolidate inputs from marketing functional leaders for monthly, quarterly, and executive reporting.
* Support preparation of leadership presentations, operating reviews, and board-level reporting.
* Track outstanding actions, operational commitments, and organizational priorities.
* Provide regular visibility into marketing workload, project status, spending, and execution risks.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks, resource constraints, and process inefficiencies that may affect delivery.
* Ensure operational reporting is accurate, consistent, and delivered on schedule.

**Process Improvement, AI & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate marketing business operations.
* Develop scalable workflows for project intake, creative requests, approvals, procurement, reporting, and administrative processes in partnership with functional owners.
* Actively leverage AI-enabled productivity tools and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve reporting, and increase operational efficiency.
* Explore opportunities to automate recurring activities such as project status consolidation, action tracking, operational reporting, and documentation.
* Document and maintain standard operating procedures across marketing activities.
* Recommend improvements to project management tools, workflows, and collaboration practices.
* Partner with Marketing technology and functional teams where process improvements require integration with existing platforms or systems.
* Promote operational discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

BangaloreIndia

title: Tech Program / Project Manager
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Surfscan® division develops unpatterned wafer inspection systems that detect nanoscale particles and surface defects early in semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems monitor wafer quality across a wide range of applications, enabling faster issue identification and improved process control.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Program leadership:** Own the integrated program plan from definition through delivery, including scope, milestones, dependencies, critical path, decision points, and measurable outcomes.

* **Cross-functional execution:** Align software, systems, electrical, algorithms, applications, and hardware teams around priorities, commitments, and release readiness.

* **Product integration:** Coordinate integration across High-Performance Computing (HPC) software, tool software, hardware, and processing workflows to deliver a reliable bench solution.

* **Risk and issue management:** Identify technical, schedule, resource, and operational risks early; drive mitigation, escalation, and replanning when conditions change.

* **Product lifecycle governance:** Lead the team through KLA's Product Lifecycle process, ensuring plans, evidence, risks, and cross-functional readiness are clear at key decision points.

* **Release and operational readiness:** Partner with marketing, supply chain, manufacturing, install, and service teams to prepare solutions for deployment, support, and scale.

* **Customer readiness:** Work with marketing and global customers to understand operating environments and define site-preparation and IT requirements that support successful product adoption.

* **Executive communication:** Use relevant metrics and concise, objective updates to communicate progress, decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business impact.

* **Team leadership:** Build strong working relationships, encourage ownership, resolve ambiguity, and influence multidisciplinary teams without relying on direct authority.

  
  

**What You Bring**
==================

* Experience leading complex technical programs or new-product development from concept through integration, release, and customer adoption.

* Strong understanding of product architectures that combine software, computing infrastructure, hardware, processing workflows, and real-time analysis.

* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated schedules, dependencies, critical paths, risks, and mitigation plans.

* Technical judgment to ask the right questions, evaluate trade-offs, and ensure plans address performance, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and serviceability.

* Ability to translate business goals and customer needs into clear program priorities and execution plans.

* Strong leadership, critical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using meaningful indicators to communicate progress, readiness, quality, and program impact.

* Working knowledge of Agile, iterative, and waterfall development approaches, with the judgment to apply the right method to the work.

  
  

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Semiconductor equipment, industrial systems, scientific instrumentation, or another complex hardware-software product environment.

* Customer engagement, feedback analysis, deployment readiness, or product adoption planning.

* HPC platforms, data processing pipelines, software release systems, digital twins, replay or simulation environments.

Formal program or project management practices and tools; a PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent credential is helpful but not required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience; or

* Master's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience; or

* Bachelor's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

Relevant experience may come from technical program management, project management, systems engineering, product development, software or hardware delivery, or a closely related field.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. title: India Project Director, AFGHS-FHI 360
description:
FHI 360 is a nonprofit human development organization dedicated to improving lives in lasting ways by advancing integrated, locally driven solutions. Our staff includes experts in health, education, nutrition, environment, economic development, youth, research, technology, communication, and social marketing—creating a unique mix of capabilities to address today’s interrelated development challenges. FHI 360 serves more than 50 countries and all US states and territories.

  

**This position is contingent upon funding from the Department of State (DOS).**

**Project Description:**

The **America First Global Health Strategy – FHI 360 (AFGHS-FHI 360)** project is initially a 13-month project (2026 – 2027) with the ability to be extended for up to five years (though 2031). Funded by the United States (US) Department of State (DOS), AFGHS-FHI 360 is a global fixed amount award (FAA) and operates in approximately 50 countries, addressing key public health challenges such as HIV/AIDS, global health security (GHS), maternal and neonatal child health (MNCH), malaria, tuberculosis (TB), polio, supply chain (SC) and health systems strengthening (HSS). In India, AFGHS-FHI 360 builds off the country’s progress to date to future strengthen the country’s response to Polio and HIV. AFGHS-FHI 360 is recruiting a Project Director located in New Delhi, India. This position is open to Indian nationals only residing in India.

**Job Summary**:

The AFGHS-FHI 360 Country Project Director serves as the senior strategic, technical, and external-facing leader for the program. The position is responsible for setting program vision, shaping technical strategy, cultivating executive-level partnerships, and positioning FHI 360 as a trusted partner to government and donor stakeholders. The role provides cross-portfolio leadership across vaccine preventable disease (VPD/polio and HIV prevention and control programming including public health surveillance, health security, disease prevention, health systems strengthening, and emerging public health priorities, promoting integration, innovation, and scalable solutions across technical domains. As the program’s principal senior representative, the Country Project Director cultivates and sustains high-level relationships with national and state government leadership, donor representatives, multilateral institutions, the private sector, technical agencies, civil society, academia, and private-sector partners. The position proactively identifies opportunities to influence policy and implementation priorities, strengthen institutional capacity, mobilize strategic partnerships, and align program investments with broader public health system objectives. While accountable for overall project performance, the role delegates routine operational management and focuses primarily on strategic leadership, technical excellence, stakeholder influence, and organizational positioning. They will be required to coordinate and work with a diverse group of organizations and stakeholders, such as the Ministry of Health, senior government officials of NCDC, IDSP and NACO/SACS, country health staff, international and national development partner organizations, and the United States Government (USG) donor representatives.

Reporting to the Program Director in HQ. ***Applied Knowledge & Skills:***

**Engineering Schedule & Delivery Oversight:**

**Required Qualifications**
▪ 15+ years of extensive HVDC engineering experience across various disciplines.
  
  
▪ Proven experience working as Project Engineer Director or similar role, expertise in leading and managing complex project portfolios
  
  
▪ With a good understanding of all technical disciplines and their part in the overall HVDC solution. Demonstrated expertise in system integration, requirements management, and technical interface management. Commissioning experience is an added advantage.

description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
**Job Summary**
To help the Sourcing & Procurement organization maximize the value of its workflow, reporting, and procurement technology. Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will manage the intake, analysis, coordination, and delivery of system and process enhancements that improve procurement execution, visibility, compliance, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
The Senior Systems Analyst will serve as a connector between Procurement Operations, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders. The role will translate business needs into structured requirements, workflows, system changes, reports, automations, and operating procedures. Success requires strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, change leadership, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or fast-moving initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Portfolio, Intake, and Initiative Management
  
  

* Orchestrate the intake process for new Procurement Operations requests, system enhancements, reporting needs, process issues, and special projects.
* Maintain a structured portfolio of active and planned initiatives, including priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, and expected outcomes.
* Develop practical workflows and governance routines that improve transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and timely delivery of procurement initiatives.
* Prepare status updates, decision materials, action logs, and executive-ready communications for Procurement leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Facilitate recurring working sessions and follow up on decisions and actions to keep initiatives moving to completion.

Systems Analysis and Process Design
  
  

* Gather and document business requirements for procurement workflow, ERP, spend analytics, reporting, supplier, Accounts Payable, and related systems.
* Map current and future-state processes, identify pain points and control gaps, and recommend practical improvements to reduce cycle time, rework, and manual effort.
* Translate requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, process diagrams, and configuration or development requests.
* Partner with system owners and Technology to evaluate options, clarify feasibility, manage dependencies, and support prioritization decisions.
* Help ensure system design supports Procurement policies, approval requirements, category management, data quality, auditability, and the needs of global stakeholders.

Testing, Implementation, and Adoption
  
  

* Coordinate testing and UAT for system enhancements, workflow changes, integrations, reports, and automations.
* Develop test scenarios, expected results, defect logs, resolution tracking, and go-live readiness assessments.
* Support implementation planning, stakeholder communications, training materials, standard operating procedures, and post-implementation adoption.
* Monitor results after implementation and confirm that changes achieve expected outcomes without introducing new operational or control issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of system functionality, business rules, process ownership, and change history.

Automation and Operational Improvement
  
  

* Identify repeatable, manual, and error-prone activities that can be simplified or automated through workflow, integrations, reporting, or low-code solutions.
* Partner with Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, Finance, and Technology to design and implement practical automations that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify root causes of delays, duplicate work, missing information, approval bottlenecks, and compliance risk.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and help measure the impact of changes on cycle time, quality, adoption, workload, and stakeholder experience.

Stakeholder Partnership and Change Management
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with Category Managers, Procurement Operations, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Explain system and process changes clearly, tailor communications to the audience, and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities.
* Raise risks and dependencies early, facilitate resolution across teams, and maintain momentum when priorities or requirements change.
* Support the rollout of workflow tools, reporting processes, procurement controls, and other initiatives that improve how the organization operates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Process Improvement, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in Procurement Operations, Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Project Management, Change Management, Process Improvement, or a related role.
* Experience implementing or improving workflow tools, procurement systems, ERP processes, reporting solutions, or software used across multiple teams.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes, coordinating testing and UAT, managing defects, and supporting implementation and adoption.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to structure workflows, manage multiple priorities, and deliver work to defined timelines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data manipulation, and analysis of operational data.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, learn new systems quickly, and convert business problems into practical process or technology solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with procurement workflow orchestration, spend analytics, ERP, Accounts Payable, invoice automation, supplier management, or contract lifecycle systems.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SQL, APIs, or other automation and data tools.
* Experience supporting procurement compliance, SOX controls, audit remediation, Accounts Payable initiatives, or policy implementations.
* Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed stakeholders and shared-service operations.
* Lean Six Sigma, PMP, CIPS, APICS, business analysis, or other relevant certification.

**Company Overview**
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. description:

• Knowledge of FIX Protocol and FIX message validation.

• Understanding of Dealer-to-Client (D2C) and Dealer-to-Dealer (D2D) trading models.

• Experience working with Electronic Trading or Capital Markets platforms.

• Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, and defect management processes.

• Experience with test management and defect tracking tools. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

GOOD TO HAVE

• Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or other automation tools.

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks.

EDUCATION

• Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a relevant field.

* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.

* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.

The Project Manager will be responsible for end-to-end delivery of commercial interior fit-out projects for occupier clients. The individual will act as the primary point of accountability for project success.

* Ensure delivery within defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation plans.

* Act as the single point of contact for clients on project delivery.
* Manage senior-level client interactions and expectations.
* Lead project review meetings and ensure timely communication and reporting.
* Align all stakeholders including design consultants, contractors, and internal teams.

* Ensure timely closure of RFIs, design changes, and technical issues.

* Establish strong project governance and reporting frameworks.
* Provide accurate and timely MIS, dashboards, and progress reports.
* Maintain complete project documentation and audit trails.

* Commercial acumen with experience in budgeting and cost control
* Excellent stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong leadership and decision-making ability
* Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, and working knowledge of AutoCAD

* Ownership & accountability mindset

title: Manufacturing Excellence Specialist
description:
KOEL Fluid Dynamics Business Unit (earlier known as La-Gajjar Machineries Private Limited) , is a premier provider of water pumping solutions and now a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited (KOEL). Founded in 1935 in Ahmedabad by the visionary Mr. Laljibhai J. Gajjar, the company has evolved into an international leader through its renowned brand, Varuna Pumps. Our commitment to technical innovation led to the introduction of India's first oil-based submersible pumps in 1991, and we have since expanded our portfolio to include over 1,000 models of energy efficient submersible pumps and motors.

**Manufacturing Excellence Specialist-Sanand**

Job Summary: We are seeking a driven Manufacturing Excellence Specialist to lead operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and plant expansion initiatives at our Sanand pump manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, and Kaizen alongside hands-on project management experience across CapEx execution, machine/assembly layout design, and industrial civil projects to eliminate waste, optimize manpower, and elevate plant productivity across machining, winding, assembly, and testing operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Operational Excellence & Lean Transformation:

• Drive plant-wide continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma frameworks to eliminate non-value-added activities, reduce manufacturing lead times, and maximize Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

• Champion Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) pillars and shop-floor Kaizen events across core pump manufacturing cells—including CNC/VMC machining, rotor/stator winding, press shop, assembly lines, and hydraulic/electrical testing bays.

• Deploy lean tools such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), SMED (quick changeover), Poka-Yoke (mistake-proofing), Standardized Work, and Kanban/cellular flow to improve throughput and reduce internal rejection/rework.

CapEx Lifecycle & Equipment Project Management

• Manage the end-to-end CapEx lifecycle for capacity additions, new product introductions (NPI), and process automation—covering technical specification, CapEx requisition, vendor evaluation, procurement coordination, machine buy-off, installation, and commissioning.

• Track project budgets, schedules, and ROI milestones while ensuring strict adherence to ISO quality standards, safety norms, and Kirloskar Group EHS guidelines.

Facility Expansion, Layout Design & Civil Execution

• Play a direct role in brownfield and greenfield facility expansion plans, designing lean shop-floor layouts (using AutoCAD) that optimize material flow from raw castings/stampings to finished pump dispatch.

• Oversee industrial civil and infrastructure projects—including machine foundations, testing sump/pit construction, EOT crane installations, shop-floor flooring, and utility upgrades— coordinating closely with civil contractors, maintenance, and safety teams.

Manpower Optimization & Line Balancing

• Conduct time-and-motion studies, line balancing, and capacity analyses across assembly and machining lines to drive manpower optimization and improve output per person-hour. • Identify opportunities for low-cost automation (LCA), material-handling improvements, and ergonomic workstations to reduce operator fatigue and boost line efficiency.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Education: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Production Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.

• Experience: 8–10 years of proven experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Operational Excellence within pumps, electric motors, industrial machinery, or precision engineering/automotive component manufacturing.

**Core Competencies:**

• Strong command of Lean Manufacturing methodologies (5S, VSM, SMED, Poka-Yoke, Line Balancing) and Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred).

• Practical, hands-on experience implementing TPM and facilitating shop-floor Kaizen programs.

• Demonstrated track record in CapEx budgeting and procurement, plant layout engineering (AutoCAD proficiency), and industrial civil project execution.

• Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills (MS Excel, Minitab, MS Project).

• Effective cross-functional collaboration, contractor management, and shop-floor leadership skills.

Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
Position Overview:
  
  
The Manager – Regional Process Engineering & Productivity supports the execution of process engineering, productivity improvement, and standardization initiatives across regional operations. The role is execution-focused and works closely with operations teams to implement defined process improvements, productivity enhancements, and safety initiatives across hubs, delivery centres, and surface-linked operations.
  
  
Job Purpose:
  
  
To support regional operations by executing process engineering initiatives that improve productivity, service quality, safety, and operational consistency, using structured industrial engineering and data-driven improvement approaches.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Process Mapping & Standardization
  
  
  

* Support end-to-end process mapping across regional operational activities including first-mile, hub, surface interface, and last-mile operations.
* Assist in documenting and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure process uniformity across locations.
* Support identification of inefficiencies, rework, and non-value-added activities through structured observation and data collection.

Productivity & Workflow Optimization
  
  
  

* Assist in conducting time and motion studies to improve throughput and reduce handling time.
* Support implementation of optimized workflows, layouts, and manpower deployment models.
* Track productivity metrics at site level and support improvement initiatives.

Ergonomics, Safety & Service Quality
  
  
  

* Support ergonomic assessments and implementation of safer work practices across operational sites.
* Assist in safety audits, risk identification, and closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure process improvements are aligned to service quality, shipment integrity, and TAT requirements.

Cost Efficiency & Resource Optimization
  
  
  

* Support identification of cost-reduction opportunities through process simplification and productivity improvement.
* Assist in tracking benefits realization from implemented process changes.
* Support data collection for cost-to-serve and efficiency analysis.

Technology & Automation Enablement
  
  
  

* Support rollout and adoption of process improvement tools, automation aids, and digital solutions.
* Coordinate with IT, vendors, and operations teams during pilots and deployments.
* Assist in monitoring adoption effectiveness at site level.

Performance Monitoring & Governance
  
  
  

* Collect and maintain operational data related to productivity, efficiency, and safety.
* Support preparation of MIS, dashboards, and reports for regional reviews.
* Escalate deviations, execution gaps, and risks to the Manager for corrective action.

Capability Building & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
  

* Support training and awareness sessions on SOPs, productivity tools, and process changes.
* Act as a process support resource for site operations teams.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders for smooth execution of improvement initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:
  
  
Education:
  
  
  

* Essential: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management.
* Preferred: Postgraduate qualification or diploma in Operations, Industrial Engineering, or Logistics.

Experience:
  
  
  

* 5–7 years of experience in process engineering, productivity improvement, operations excellence, or similar roles.
* Exposure to express logistics, courier, e-commerce, or other high-volume, service-driven operational environments preferred.
* Hands-on experience supporting time & motion studies, SOP execution, and site-level productivity initiatives.

Skills & Capabilities:
  
  
Technical Skills:
  
  
  

* Process documentation and SOP execution
* Productivity and time-motion analysis support
* Operational data analysis and MIS
* Site-level process implementation and follow-through

Key Competencies:
  
  
  

* Strong execution discipline and attention to detail
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Effective coordination with site and regional teams
* Ability to work in field-intensive, fast-paced environments
