title: Manager - Production
description:
**Job Title:**
Manager - Production

**Location:**
Magma HQ, 2nd floor, 9th Avenue Sanganay, Rajpath Rangoli Rd, next to Rajpath Club, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380059 (with regular presence at the manufacturing facilities)

**Reports To:**
Head – Engineering & MRO

**About Us:**
Magma Group is a fast-growing industrial materials company building scalable businesses across recycling, engineering, and advanced materials. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Magma serves 250+ manufacturers with a strong focus on efficiency, reliability, and long-term value creation.

Magma Engineering delivers end-to-end solutions across precision engineering, machining, fabrication, and maintenance, from design to final delivery. Backed by captive control over advanced machining and fabrication facilities, we operate across CNC, VMC, deep-hole drilling, honing, turn-milling, heavy fabrication, and precision inspection systems.

Position Overview

The Production Manager will own day-to-day manufacturing execution across our machining, fabrication, and MRO operations. The role is accountable for converting engineering-released processes into on-time, right-first-time output, while driving productivity, safety, quality, and cost performance on the shop floor.

The individual will lead production supervisors, machine operators, and fabrication teams, and work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Purchase, Stores, and Business Development to deliver customer orders reliably in a high-mix, low-volume environment.

Key Responsibilities1. Production Planning & Scheduling

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans aligned with customer delivery commitments and order priorities.
* Manage machine loading and capacity allocation across CNC, VMC, turn-mill, deep-hole drilling, honing, and fabrication sections.
* Balance a high-mix, low-volume order book by sequencing jobs to minimise changeovers and idle time.
* Track work-in-progress and proactively flag delivery risks to Business Development and customers.

2. Shop Floor Execution & Delivery

* Own end-to-end execution of production orders from material issue through machining, fabrication, inspection, and dispatch.
* Ensure adherence to process sheets, setup instructions, and work instructions released by Manufacturing Engineering.
* Drive on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery performance and lead recovery plans for delayed orders.
* Conduct daily production review meetings and ensure quick closure of shop floor issues.

3. Productivity & Machine Utilization

* Monitor and improve OEE, machine utilization, spindle hours, cycle-time adherence, and labour productivity.
* Reduce setup and changeover time through SMED, standardised setups, and pre-staging of tools and fixtures.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective measures, including shift planning, load balancing, and outsourcing decisions where required.
* Establish production MIS and dashboards for output, efficiency, downtime, and delivery tracking.

4. Quality & Process Discipline

* Ensure first-time-right production and adherence to drawing specifications, GD&T, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Quality on first-article inspection, in-process inspection, and final inspection readiness.
* Drive root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D) for rejections, rework, and customer complaints, and implement CAPA.
* Reduce scrap, rework, and cost of poor quality across machining and fabrication operations.

5. Maintenance & Asset Reliability

* Coordinate with the maintenance team on preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for all machines and equipment.
* Minimise unplanned breakdowns and track MTBF and MTTR for critical machines.
* Ensure proper calibration and upkeep of tools, gauges, fixtures, and measuring instruments.

6. Materials, Tooling & Inventory Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores for timely availability of raw materials, cutting tools, inserts, consumables, and fixtures.
* Control tooling consumption and WIP inventory, and drive reduction in material wastage.
* Manage subcontracting and outsourced operations (heat treatment, plating, special processes) to meet schedule and quality.

7. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

* Build and enforce a strong safety culture, ensuring zero-accident operations.
* Ensure compliance with statutory, safety, and environmental requirements, including machine guarding, PPE, and safe material handling.
* Lead 5S, housekeeping, and visual management practices across the shop floor.

8. Team Leadership & Workforce Management

* Lead, mentor, and develop production supervisors, shift in-charges, machine operators, programmers on the floor, and fabricators.
* Plan manpower deployment, shifts, overtime, and skill matrices to match production needs.
* Drive multi-skilling and on-the-job training to build a flexible, capable workforce.
* Set KPIs, review team performance, and maintain discipline and healthy industrial relations.

9. Continuous Improvement & Cost Control

* Lead lean manufacturing, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives across production.
* Monitor production costs including labour, machine hours, tooling, power, and consumables, and drive cost-reduction actions.
* Support capacity expansion, new machine installation, and layout planning as business volumes grow.
* Work with Manufacturing Engineering to feed shop floor learnings back into process improvements.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong hands-on expertise in precision CNC machining, VMC, turning, and fabrication operations.
* Proven experience in production planning, machine loading, and scheduling in a high-mix, low-volume or job-shop environment.
* Working knowledge of multi-axis machining, tooling, fixtures, and work-holding systems.
* Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Sound understanding of OEE, cycle-time analysis, capacity planning, and production costing.
* Practical experience with lean tools: 5S, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and visual management.
* Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D, PDCA).
* Knowledge of quality systems (ISO 9001; AS9100 or IATF 16949 preferred) and inspection practices.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and production MIS reporting.
* Strong leadership, people management, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Commitment to safety, discipline, and a performance-driven shop floor culture.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on production leader who can turn engineering intent into reliable, on-time, and cost-effective output. They should be equally comfortable on the shop floor solving a machining issue and in a review meeting presenting delivery and productivity numbers.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 12–15+ years of experience in production or manufacturing operations, with at least 5 years in a managerial role leading shop floor teams.
* Prior experience running precision machining and/or heavy fabrication operations is essential.
* Experience in aerospace, defence, automotive, oil & gas, or industrial engineering sectors will be preferred.
* Experience in a job-shop, contract manufacturing, or MRO setup will be an added advantage.
* Certification in Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above), or TPM is desirable.

What We Offer

* Salary is negotiable for the right candidate.
* Opportunity to build and lead production for a high-impact vertical from the ground up.
* Access to captive, advanced machining and fabrication capabilities, not just vendor coordination.
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Magma is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Third Party Risk Manager, Ahmedabad (India)
description:
General Information
  
  
**Ref #**
238832
  
  
**Location:**
India-Ahmedabad CDC
  
  
**Job family:**
Corporate & Commercial
  
  
**Closing Date:**
2026-11-27
  
  
**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of Third-Party Risk Manager based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The position is primarily responsible for leading the central Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team with delivery of TPRM lifecycle across the in-scope third party population, with particular focus on Group’s most critical third-party relationships, covering inherent risk assessment, due diligence, onboarding, continuous monitoring and offboarding, and provides input to the scoping methodology. Also, have to play role of technical lead on the practical application of the TPRM Framework, sets the operating rhythm with User Departments and specialist functions, resolves technical and operational matters independently, and escalates contentious or high exposure matters to Head of QICA.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate TPRM Framework into operating procedures, templates and working instructions for the central TPRM team, and into practical guidance for User Departments where they have a role in the process,
* Provide expert advice to divisions and to first- and second-line functions on the practical application of third-party risk requirements, including assessment approach, evidence standards and risk disposition, and builds strong working relationships with User Departments and the relevant specialist functions
* Secure the engagement and commitment of divisional leadership to applying the TPRM Framework, building buy-in, addressing resistance and agreeing realistic timelines so that divisions complete the assessment of their critical third parties as planned, escalating to the Head of QICA where commitment cannot be secured,
* Act as a consulted party to the framework owner on the scoping methodology, providing subject matter input on scoping criteria, thresholds and auto-triggers, and using assessment outcomes to identify where the scoping rules may need recalibration,
* Provide structured, evidence-based feedback to the framework owner on the design, calibration and practicability of the TPRM Framework, drawing on the team’s operational experience.
* Drive the continuous improvement of the central TPRM operating approach and supports the progressive extension of coverage across the third-party population, adjusting ways of working as scope, volumes and risk exposure evolve,
* Lead the design, implementation and ongoing development of the technology solution supporting TPRM, working with the framework owner and IT, and identifies opportunities to simplify, automate and improve the efficiency of third-party risk activities,
* Prepare the analysis, evidence and reporting used by the Head of QICA to provide clarity and assurance to executive and governance stakeholders on the status of the third-party control environment, and attend such forums as subject matter expert where required,
* Plan and prioritize the team’s workload on a risk-based basis, set assessment standards, turnaround times and key performance indicators for the team, monitors performance against them and takes corrective action where required,
* Manage team capacity and resourcing against the assessment pipeline, flagging shortfalls and re-prioritizing where required,
* Provide technical coaching so that the team develops genuine depth in third party risk assessment and evidence evaluation,
* Ensure a complete and reconciled inventory of in-scope third parties is maintained, including risk classification, relationship owner, contract references and key dates,
* Direct the team’s execution of Inherent Risk Assessments for third parties handed over to the central team following scoping, obtaining operational input from User Departments and specialist input where required, raises the tier where the assessment warrants it, and submits the rationale to the framework owner for sign-off where the outcome supports a lower tier,
* Direct the execution of due diligence proportionate to the assessed level of risk, securing specialist input from functions such as, but not limited to, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, the Data Protection Office and Procurement where required, and personally leads the most complex or highest-exposure assessments,
* Determine from the outcome of the risk assessment and due diligence, which risk mitigations need to be secured contractually, and communicate these requirements to the User Department, Procurement and Legal, who remain responsible for drafting, negotiating and agreeing the contract terms
* Provide the final check that all prerequisite lifecycle stages are complete and formally closed before a third party is onboarded, and escalates deviations,
* Oversee the support provided to User Departments in performance review cycles and in the structured offboarding of third parties, including data return or destruction, access revocation and record closure,
* Ensure the TPRM system record is maintained so that assessments, evidence, approvals and decisions are complete, current and audit-ready,
* Direct the delivery of training and awareness for User Departments and relationship owners on their third-party risk responsibilities,
* Own the response to Internal Audit recommendations relating to third party management, ensuring they are addressed on time and to the required specification,
* Acts as the first escalation point for the team and for User Departments on complex or disputed third party matters, resolve these independently wherever possible, and escalate contentious, high-exposure or precedent-setting matters to the Head of QICA with a clear recommendation.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 5 years of job-related work experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 4 years of job-related work experience.

**Job Specific Skills/ Essentials**

* Working knowledge of third-party risk and risk management frameworks and standards, including but not limited to COSO, ISO 31000, ISO 27001, and recognized third party risk practices,
* Practical understanding of due diligence evidence (audited financials and credit reports, SOC 2 / ISO certifications, DPIAs and data processing agreements, sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, modern slavery and ESG disclosures).
* Experience in third party / vendor risk management, procurement risk, internal control, risk management, compliance or audit, with demonstrable depth in the execution and quality review of due diligence and risk assessments
* Experience of managing, coaching and quality assuring the work of others in a risk, control or assurance environment
* Professional certification in risk, audit, compliance or third party / vendor risk management (e.g. CRMA, CIA, CRISC, CTPRP) or qualified accountant with a Big 4 background and / or experience in a large, multinational organisation,
* Experience of operating or implementing a GRC / third party risk platform,
* Familiarity with contractual risk provisions, such as service levels, audit rights, liability, insurance, business continuity, termination and exit assistance, and the ability to work effectively with Legal and Procurement.

**About Qatar Airways Group**
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.

title: Aubergine Solutions - Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust**
We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?
  
  
In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines :
* Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
* Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
* Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.
* Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics :
* Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
* Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.
* Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data :
* Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
* Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.
* Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales :
* Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
* Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
* Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.
* Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar :
* Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

**What We Are Looking For**
**AI Evaluation Mastery :**

* Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
* Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
* Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

**Software Engineering & Backend Foundations**

* Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
* Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

**Consulting & Leadership**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
* A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
* A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

**Why This Role Matters**
The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Service Manager – Road Sweeping Machine Maintenance (Rental Division)
description:
Cleanland is a specialized manufacturer of road and industrial sweeping machines and operates as the hygiene division of Shaktiman (Tirth Agro Technology Pvt. Ltd.), a leading agricultural machinery brand in India and more than 70 countries.With experience in manufacturing and maintaining over 400 machines, Cleanland delivers high-efficiency cleaning solutions for roads, industrial sites, ports, mining and construction areas, public spaces, and large facilities.The company has built a strong reputation over the past decade for quality products, ethical practices, and reliable service. Guided by the principles of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan and Make in India, Cleanland focuses on sustainable, locally manufactured hygiene solutions.

Location: Nadiad/ GujaratBudgeted CTC: ₹07 LPAEmail: keith.foote@thtpl.com

ROLE: We are looking for a technically sound and service-oriented Field Service Manager to coordinate service operations for road sweeping machines deployed at approximately 50 customer locations across India. The candidate will be based at our Nadiad plant and will manage an existing team of 10+ field technicians deployed across various locations. The primary responsibility is to ensure maximum machine availability by providing technical guidance, monitoring breakdowns, coordinating repairs and ensuring timely resolution of service issues. The candidate may be required to travel to customer sites personally when field technicians are unable to resolve critical breakdowns.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee and coordinate service operations for road sweeping machines deployed at approximately 50 sites across India.
* Manage and coordinate an existing team of 10+ field technicians, providing technical guidance, training and support.
* Coordinate day-to-day maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs through field technicians.
* Monitor machine breakdowns and ensure timely resolution of service issues.
* Provide technical support to technicians for difficult or recurring breakdowns.
* Take ownership of critical breakdowns and personally visit customer sites when required to diagnose issues and supervise repairs.
* Coordinate with customers and site teams to ensure machine availability and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain service records, breakdown history and equipment performance records.
* Monitor machine downtime and follow up with technicians until machines are restored to operation.
* Handle service-related administrative activities, including preparation of quotations, expense sheets, payment follow-up and other service documentation.

**LOOKING FOR:**

* Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical, Automobile or Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5-7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in field service / after-sales service of machinery or vehicles.
* Practical understanding of hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical and electrical systems.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.
* Experience managing and guiding field technicians.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal teams.
* Willingness to relocate to Nadiad, Gujarat.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites across India when required.
* Strong ownership and a "get the machine running" attitude.

Experience in construction equipment, mining equipment, material handling equipment, road equipment, industrial cleaning equipment, commercial vehicles or other heavy machinery will be preferred.

title: US Mortgage
description:
**About us:**

Befree is a globally trusted provider of accounting and finance offshoring solutions. We blend

industry expertise with technology and automation to deliver customised, scalable support for

businesses worldwide.

Headquartered in Gandhinagar, with clients across Australia, the UK, the US, we help practices

and businesses enhance efficiency, productivity, and continuity through skilled and certified

professionals delivering world-class services. Our delivery centres across 10 cities in India

serve as the backbone of our global service delivery network.

**Role: US Mortgage Operations**

In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end processing support for Residential US

mortgage loans. You will work closely with brokers, lenders, and third-party vendors to

ensure timely, compliant, and accurate loan file processing through all stages of the

mortgage lifecycle.

**Responsibilities**

● Review and verify mortgage loan applications (1003 / URLA) and supporting

financial documents (W-2s, tax returns, pay stubs, bank statements, asset

documentation).

● Analyze Title Reports, Appraisals, Flood Certifications, Tax Transcripts (4506-C), VOE

(Verification of Employment), and Verification of Mortgage or Verification of Rent.

● Reconcile borrower income, assets, credit histories, and liabilities according to

Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines.

● Clear underwriting conditions and assist in resolving complex document

discrepancies or red flags.

● Ensure strict adherence to US mortgage regulatory compliance standards (TRID,

RESPA, TILA, CFPB, QM/ATR rules).

● Coordinate with settlement agents, title companies, and attorneys to gather closing

documents.

● Assist in post-closing reviews, trailing document management, and investor

delivery readiness.

● Maintain clear and direct communication with loan officers, processors, and

management regarding pipeline status and bottleneck resolution.

**Qualifications and Experience**

● Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Commerce,

or a related field.

● Exposure to NMLS guidelines, or coursework toward MBA-CMB or similar mortgage

banking certification.

● Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in US Residential Mortgage

Processing / Support. Prior experience working in a Global Capability Centre (GCC),

BPO, or shared services environment handling US mortgage operations.

● Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the end-to-end US mortgage

lifecycle (Origination, Processing, Underwriting Support, Closing, Post-Closing).

● Guidelines: Solid knowledge of Conventional (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) and

Government (FHA / VA / USDA) loan products.

● Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with modern Loan Origination Systems

(LOS) such as Encompass, Calyx Point, or BytePro.

Key Skills

● Regulations: Familiarity with federal mortgage regulations including TRID, RESPA,

ECOA, and TILA.

● Skills: Ability to independently identify discrepancies across income, asset, and

credit documentation under production deadlines; clear written and verbal

communication with US-based stakeholders; strong numerical accuracy in

reconciling borrower financials.

title: Lead Engineer-Hardware Validation: Coexistence (AI Glasses)
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a Lead Hardware Validation Engineer to lead the AI Glasses System Coexistence validation team. You'll set the technical direction, lead a team of validation engineers, and be the main technical contact for customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Your team will make sure that the main subsystems in our wearable devices (Camera, Audio, Wi-Fi/BT, Display, Sensors, Memory and Power) work together without one disrupting another. You'll also lead the team in using AI tools to speed up scripting, log analysis and failure triage.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and grow a team of validation engineers: assign work, set priorities, review their output and support their careers.
* Plan the team's resources and staffing across several programs and build phases (EVT, DVT and PVT).
* Run regular team syncs, technical reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Build a team culture of ownership, technical rigor and continuous improvement.
* Help hire and onboard new team members.

**Customer & Stakeholder Communication**

* Be the main technical contact with customers, program managers and engineering leadership for coexistence validation.
* Present validation plans, status, risks and results clearly in program reviews and customer meetings.
* Turn customer requirements and feedback into validation strategies and test plans.
* Manage expectations, escalations and trade-offs on schedule, coverage and quality.
* Write high-quality reports, executive summaries and closure documents for issues.

**Technical Ownership**

* Set the overall coexistence validation strategy for AI Glasses programs.
* Define aggressor/victim test matrices and stress scenarios that reflect real use, such as camera capture during Wi-Fi streaming, or speaker playback during captouch use.
* Oversee concurrency testing and logging of victim-subsystem metrics (camera image quality, captouch false or missed touches, eMMC throughput and errors, RF sensitivity and desense, audio noise floor).
* Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of complex EMI, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and vibration issues, working with the EE, RF, antenna, mechanical, firmware and software teams.
* Work with ODM and contract manufacturer partners on test setup, failure analysis and design changes.
* Review schematics and layouts to find coexistence risks early.

**AI-Driven Validation**

* Lead the team's use of AI tools such as Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini for writing and debugging test automation scripts.
* Lead AI-assisted analysis of large device logs (logcat, dmesg/kernel, firmware and RF logs) to find failures, anomalies and coexistence patterns.
* Build AI-powered workflows that summarize test results, sort failures into categories, suggest likely root causes and draft bug reports.
* Set team standards for checking AI-generated output and for responsible data handling.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day.
  
  
Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
  
  
We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.
  
  
**Work Experience**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in hardware, system or platform validation for consumer electronics, mobile or wearable devices.
* 3+ years of experience leading engineers in a technical lead or people lead role.
* Proven experience communicating directly with customers or external partners, including presenting technical results and handling escalations.
* Strong practical knowledge of EMI/EMC, RF desense, signal integrity and power integrity testing.
* Expert use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, signal generators and protocol analyzers.
* Python scripting for test automation and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini for scripting and log analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in EE or a related field.
* Experience with wearables, AR/VR, smart glasses or other small, highly integrated devices.
* Familiarity with wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, GNSS, NFC) and coexistence between them.
* Knowledge of camera, audio, display, touch and storage (eMMC/UFS) subsystems.
* Experience with Android or Linux-based embedded platforms, ADB and firmware debug tools.
* Experience building custom LLM workflows through APIs (for example, the Claude or OpenAI APIs) or with agent-style tools such as Claude Code or Cursor agent mode.
* Experience leading teams spread across sites or time zones, and managing ODM or vendor relationships through new product introduction.
* Experience setting up validation processes, metrics and dashboards for a whole team.

**Key Competencies**

* Leads people and builds a strong team
* Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and executives
* Takes a systematic, data-driven approach to solving problems
* Owns problems from first detection to fix
* Looks for ways to use AI to make validation more productive
* Stays effective while schedules and priorities change

**Benefits**

* Work on cutting-edge Next-generation consumer electronics hardware
* Work on High-bandwidth data streaming solutions
* Automated hardware validation and test infrastructure
* Collaborate with world-class engineers and product teams.
* Opportunity to grow as a technical leader in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
**About the role**  

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead Tesco's Mobile Platform team. This team owns the React Native platform, the shared libraries and tooling, and the Mobile CI/CD behind our mobile estate, which serves millions of customers and colleagues every day. Product app teams across Tesco build on what you provide, so your success shows up in their work: a reliable, well-documented platform, shorter and safer release cycles, fewer inconsistencies between apps, and quicker onboarding.

As a Software Development Manager, you are a Senior Engineering Team Leader at Tesco. You balance delivery for customers with the needs of the business and the growth of your people, and you stay hands-on. Your proficiency with foundational computer science and software engineering is taken as a given, and you bring proven technical depth and breadth across teams. You will work closely with the Head of Software Development, the senior engineer (SDE3) who sets the platform's technical direction, Lead Product Managers, and Lead UI/UX Designers, turning platform strategy into dependable delivery.

Mobile experience is essential for this role. You must have built, shipped, and run native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) in production at real scale. React Native or JavaScript skill on its own is not enough. We need someone who knows the mobile platform properly: app lifecycle, on-device performance, release and signing, and the app store processes.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

What the team owns

The React Native mobile platform, built on the Expo ecosystem (EAS, Expo Router), with the shared libraries, common patterns, and app scaffolding that app teams depend on, including how Tesco Digital Design System (DDS) components are pulled in.

The model for scaling React Native across many teams, including micro-app and super-app patterns (for example Module Federation with Re.Pack) where they fit.

Mobile CI/CD and release infrastructure: build, signing, test automation, distribution, store deployment, and over-the-air updates (EAS Update) for iOS and Android.

Developer experience: documentation, examples, a contribution model, migration tooling, and support for the teams that consume the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery and platform

Lead the platform engineering team and own the processes and standards that help development succeed and keep improving.

Build and evolve the React Native platform and its shared libraries, and treat Mobile CI/CD as a product: fast, reliable pipelines, automated quality gates, application signing, and straightforward App Store and Google Play deployment.

Turn the platform direction you agree with the HOSD and the SDE3 into roadmaps, commitments, and shipped work, and make it easier for other teams to build on the platform through documentation, onboarding, and support.

Build platform capabilities for performance, scalability, accessibility (AA), and security from a single React Native codebase, and own incident response and root cause analysis.

Stakeholders and direction

Work with product stakeholders to turn their needs into platform features, and with the HOSD, the SDE3, Lead PMs, and Lead Designers to keep the roadmap aligned.

Build agreement within the team on how to approach a solution, and clear the blockers in its way.

Use agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) where they genuinely help, and expect the team to use specs, skills, and agents across development, documentation, and testing.

People and capability

Set clear objectives and career paths, review colleague performance, and act on it.

Build strong teams, spot and grow talent, and give the team room to innovate.

Raise the hiring bar through mentoring, interviewing, and sharing what you know with the wider engineering community.

 **You will need**  

Qualifications

Mobile engineering experience (essential): hands-on experience building and shipping native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) to the App Store and Google Play, and running them in production. This is a firm requirement. We want real mobile platform depth, not web engineers moving across through React Native.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.

At least 10 years in software engineering at enterprise or product companies, including time leading or managing engineers, with a good part of it spent on mobile.

A track record of building platforms, shared libraries, or developer tooling that other teams use (strongly preferred).

Technical Skills

Deep mobile platform fundamentals (essential): hands-on native iOS (Swift or Objective-C) and/or Android (Kotlin or Java), covering app lifecycle, on-device memory and performance, threading, and native module development, which underpin your React Native work.

Four or more years building React Native apps with the Expo ecosystem (Expo SDKs, Expo Router, EAS), with a solid grasp of JSI, native modules, and bridging to native iOS and Android.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript (modern ES6 and later), and strong React principles, Hooks, Context API, and component lifecycles.

Experience designing and building large front-end or platform systems and shared libraries used by many teams, with sound state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or MobX) and caching.

Mobile CI/CD depth: Git and GitHub, CI pipelines, EAS build and submit, application signing, over-the-air updates (EAS Update), and a thorough understanding of the iOS and Android deployment lifecycles and store guidelines (App Store, Google Play).

Performance profiling for production apps (Android and iOS profilers), packaging and build tooling (Webpack, Babel), and dependency and release management for shared libraries.

Integrating mobile apps with backend APIs (GraphQL or REST), and accessibility to AA standards.

Testing frameworks: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, and Appium.

Confident use of agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) across development, documentation, and testing, plus familiarity with MCP integrations and deep linking.

Process and Soft Skills

Comfortable with Agile methods (Scrum or Kanban), and with JIRA, Confluence, and well-formed epics, stories, and acceptance criteria.

Able to apply different delivery processes and knows when each one fits.

A self-starter who takes ownership, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Well organised, with good time management.

Clear written and verbal communication.

What we offer

Relocation help: a professional service to secure the work permits and other documents you need.

Learning opportunities: certified technical training and platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, and O'Reilly.

A learning culture, with good opportunities to develop your career in your chosen field or in something new.

Varied projects to work on, with something new always in the pipeline.

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. description:
**Job Summary**

* App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
* Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.

* Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**

* Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
* Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
* Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
* Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
* Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**

* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
* Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
* Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

title: MCD - Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE
description:
Position Description
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Job Title: Manager Consulting Delivery (QA)
  
  
Position: Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE
  
  
Experience: 14+ Years (minimum 5+ years leading QA/QE teams, with hands-on technical depth)
  
  
Category: Quality Engineering / Test Automation / Delivery Management
  
  
Shift: General Shift, with overlap with US onsite counterparts as required
  
  
Location: Chennai
  
  
Position ID:
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
  
  
Education Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline
  
  
Position Description:
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Manager and People Manager to lead an enthusiastic QA/QE team with strong AI awareness. Our current model is automation-heavy but still involves a lot of manual intervention. The role requires a clear understanding of the team's current technical challenges and the ability to transform it into a modern, AI-first Quality Engineering team through smarter automation and better engineering practices.
  
  
Every Advantage release must go out on time and certified, with zero escaped regression defects and no last-minute surprises. The leader we want thinks like the client and acts like the client, holding quality to the standard the customer experiences in production, and treats customer delight as the measure of success.
  
  
You will own the transformation of the QA/QE function and treat quality as an engineering discipline, building it into the pipeline, the code and the environment rather than testing it in at the end. You will drive disciplined flaky test management, faster pipelines through test sharding, parallel execution and test impact analysis, ephemeral Cloud environments that are spun up on demand and destroyed once testing is done, and a shift-left and shift-right approach in which production monitoring feeds back into test strategy. You will also strengthen performance and regression engineering so that quality improves with every release.
  
  
You will make release and investment decisions from data such as flake rate, pipeline duration, defect leakage and DORA-style delivery metrics. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and the client, translating technical quality signals into business risk and release confidence, and balance speed, quality and cost, including cloud environment spend and automation maintenance effort. You will also bring the team along, building the skills, habits and confidence it needs to work this way.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Delivery and Release Ownership
  
  

* Own on-time, high-quality delivery of Advantage releases with zero regression issues, and be accountable for the quality outcome the customer experiences.
* Think like the client and act like the client: view quality from the customer's business perspective, anticipate what matters to them and make release decisions accordingly.
* Lead release certification end to end from the QA side, owning readiness assessment, quality gates, exit criteria, go/no-go inputs and sign-off. Step into an RTE-style role when required to coordinate across teams and keep releases on track.
* Own QA planning, capacity and delivery commitments across Agile sprints, Program Increments and feature releases, ensuring smooth delivery to UAT and Production and timely resolution of client issues.

Quality Strategy and Governance
  
  

* Own the regression and performance testing strategy and its outcomes, covering scope, coverage, risk-based prioritization and continuous optimization of suites to remove redundancy and improve effectiveness.
* Define quality standards, governance and a metrics-driven improvement framework (defect leakage, regression cycle time, automation reliability, pipeline duration, defect detection effectiveness, cost of quality), and use the data to drive decisions.
* Set the direction for performance engineering, ensuring workload models, benchmarks and bottleneck analysis give early confidence in scalability and stability before release.
* Maintain clear, current documentation in Confluence, including QA strategy, release certification records, runbooks, test environment guides and lessons learned, so knowledge is shared and not held by individuals.

Technical Leadership and Transformation
  
  

* Take ownership of chronic reliability and speed issues such as flaky tests, recurring suite failures and long-running pipelines. Diagnose systemic root causes, set stabilization and optimization priorities, and hold the team accountable for sustained improvement in reliability and execution time.
* Periodically audit the automation tech stack, frameworks and tooling, assess fitness, maintainability and cost, and set the direction to upgrade or transform when it is justified. Make these decisions based on value, not change for its own sake.
* Lead the transformation of test environments from PDC to Cloud (Azure/AWS), enabling on-demand environments that are spun up for testing and destroyed once done, in partnership with DevOps and with cost optimization in mind.
* Champion AI-driven Quality Engineering across test design, automation, failure triage and maintenance, with measurable productivity and cycle-time gains.
* Drive continuous testing and quality gates in CI/CD, working with DevOps to make releases faster and more predictable.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and practices and bringing in those that improve outcomes.

Stakeholder and People Leadership
  
  

* Partner with Product Engineering, Product Management, DevOps and onsite counterparts to surface quality risks early, and escalate risks to leadership with clear mitigation options.
* Communicate quality status, delivery risks and improvement plans to senior leadership and client stakeholders through clear presentations and dashboards.
* Build and lead a high-performing QA/QE team by setting goals, coaching, developing technical depth and succession, managing performance and fostering a quality-first culture of accountability and ownership.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must-Have Skills
  
  

* 14+ years of IT experience, with strong experience leading QA/QE teams and delivering large-scale programs (US state and local government experience preferred).
* Proven track record of release ownership and certification with consistently low regression leakage.
* Proven experience transforming a QA team into a modern, automation-first and AI-enabled Quality Engineering team.
* Strong people management skills, including team building, coaching, performance management, conflict resolution and capacity planning.
* Management skills: planning and forecasting, budgeting and cost control, risk and issue management, vendor and partner management, stakeholder and expectation management, and decision-making under pressure.
* Hands-on technical depth to guide the team on diagnosing and fixing flaky tests, unstable automation and slow CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience assessing automation tech stacks and frameworks and recommending upgrade or transformation paths.
* Large-scale test automation experience.
* Test Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright; programming and scripting in Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL.
* Test Management: Jira, Xray.
* Documentation and collaboration: Confluence, with strong skills in writing and maintaining QA strategies, process documents, runbooks, release certification records and knowledge-base content.
* CI/CD and DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub, Cloud (Azure/AWS) DevOps Pipelines.
* AI-assisted testing: GitHub Copilot, AI-powered test generation, self-healing and test optimization tools.
* Monitoring, observability and code coverage: Grafana, SigNoz, JaCoCo.
* Test data management, including data setup, masking and refresh strategies for reliable, repeatable regression runs.
* Azure fundamentals for testing environments: on-demand provisioning and teardown, and exposure to PDC-to-cloud migration.
* Performance testing: Apache JMeter, LoadRunner or Gatling, with the ability to interpret results and drive tuning recommendations.
* Regression strategy and optimization, risk-based testing and API testing (REST/SOAP).
* Agile/SAFe delivery experience, including RTE-style release coordination, risk management and stakeholder communication.
* Dashboarding and reporting tools: Power BI, Jira dashboards, for tracking quality, delivery and automation metrics.
* Presentation and reporting skills: building clear, executive-ready presentations (PowerPoint) and management reports that turn quality data into decisions.
* Excel proficiency: advanced Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charts, dashboards) for metrics analysis, capacity and cost tracking, and status reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; partner and multi-geography team management.

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Monitoring and observability: Splunk, Dynatrace.
* Infrastructure as Code and containers for test environments: Terraform/Bicep/ARM, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS.
* Code quality: SonarQube, CAST.
* Database testing: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, data validation.
* Accessibility testing: WCAG 2.1/2.2, AXE/Evinced Tools.
* Service virtualization.
* Leading innovation: participating in hackathons and encouraging and enabling the team to participate, turning ideas into practical improvements.
* Thought leadership: conference talks, blogs, internal communities of practice or patents.
* LLM and agentic testing, plus AI governance for data handling.
* Security testing awareness and compliance exposure (StateRAMP/NIST), since these separate government-experienced candidates.
* Contribution beyond delivery: experience with DEI practices and CSR initiatives, and similar organizational contributions.
* Cloud or testing certifications (Azure, ISTQB, SAFe).
* Experience with multi-location, multi-customer, multi-language delivery.
* Experience with enterprise ERP/government platforms (financial, procurement, HR systems), since Advantage is in that space.

description:
**Our Digital ambition at Sanofi**

We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Digital is at the heart of Sanofi: our ambition is to be the leading digital healthcare platform to develop & deliver medicine faster, enable healthcare professionals to improve treatments and help patients improve their health. At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. It’s about harnessing data insights and leveraging AI responsibly to search deeper and solve sooner than ever before.

**About the Job**

We are looking for an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) technical lead within the Digital Technology Enablement, Enterprise Access Management organization. **The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Saviynt configurations and implementations, with a focus on identity governance and administration**. This is a critical role in leading the development and implementation of centralized and harmonized enterprise user access management product for Sanofi business application. The objective is to develop a **Harmonized** and **Centralized Access Management** solution with robust **compliance** capabilities.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Saviynt workflows and platforms.

* Develop and maintain integrations and connectors including but not limited to Active Directory (AD) and Entra ID.
* Write and optimize SQL queries for system operations
* Oversee user identity lifecycle management
* Perform performance tuning and optimization of Saviynt systems
* Create and maintain technical specifications documentation in confluence.
* Utilize ISPM to manage reports, dashboards, and analytics
* Implement and manage access models (RBAC and ABAC) within Saviynt
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements (JIRA Enablers)
* Execute deployment and change management processes using both manual and automated DevOps tools (e.g., GitHub, Terraform)
* Ensures that Digital Product/computerized system meets all controls to address applicable quality, regulatory (Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, etc.) and cybersecurity requirements.

**About You**

**Skills and Qualifications**:

* **Experience:**

* 4-5 years of experience in Saviynt configurations and implementations
* Proficiency in SQL query writing and optimization.
* Management of Groups - Maintained security and distribution groups, including dynamic groups in Entra ID based on department and location attributes.
* Experience with APIs development for both master data sync for upstream systems (Active directory, workday, etc.) and automatic provisioning for target applications.
* Experience with ISPM for reporting, dashboard creation, and analytics
* Familiarity with DevOps tools such as GitHub and Terraform
* Strong working experience with regulated environment preferably in pharmaceutical industries.
* Good understanding of SOX and GxP.
* **Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Modeling or relevant field.
* Saviynt Advanced IGA certification (preferred)
* **Functional & Technical Knowledge:**

* Strong understanding of
  + User Access Management.
  + Role based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC).
  + User Access Review
  + Segregation of Duties (SOD).
  + Role Catalog
  + On-Off boarding of users.
* Integration of Saviynt with SAP for access management is a plus.
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks like Scrum and Kanban.
* Good understanding of Confluence, JIRA, & XRAY.
* **Business Acumen:**

* Strong understanding of IGA domain.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements.
* **Communication and Collaboration:**

* Fluent in English (French is a plus)
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail
* Experience working cross-functional teams to support solution of complex data architecture problems
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
* **Other Important Attributes:**

* Problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
* Customer-centric mindset.
* Proactive and self-motivated.

Why choose us?

  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

**Pursue** *Progress*. **Discover** *Extraordinary*.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue Progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**

You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**IN THIS ROLE** – Drive end-to-end data product delivery by combining Agile discipline with structured project management. Own sprint workflows, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment for timely data product delivery. Break through blockers and orchestrate cross-team dependencies across engineering, governance, data product and operations teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** — Strong servant leadership; exceptional facilitation skills; ability to balance agile flexibility with governance rigor; experience in both Scrum and structured project delivery. A passion for driving adoption of PMO standards and continuous improvement across delivery teams.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**:

* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned data products — plan, execute, and close projects within scope, time and budget
* Manage project teams, stakeholders and inter-team dependencies to ensure delivery aligns with product stream strategy and portfolio objectives
* Facilitate sprint ceremonies & ensure the agile methodology is consistently followed by all team members
* Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, manage team workflows, flag risks, and remove delivery blockers
* Develop and maintain project artefacts, including the project charter, work plan, RACI, and RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Decisions) across data product lifecycle phases.
* Track deliverable completion and sign-offs (HLD, DIF/DOF, STTM mapping, pipeline builds)
* Facilitate project meetings and ensure continuous, transparent communication across teams
* Escalate impediments to the Data Product Manager with clear impact assessment and recommended actions
* Coordinate test execution, track defects and resolution progress to meet the success criteria
* Provide proactive support during UAT, CAB preparation, hypercare phases, and ensure a smooth deployment workflow
* Drive adoption of PMO best practices, agile principles, retrospective outcomes, and process improvements to increase delivery efficiency and quality
* Maintain delivery metrics (velocity, burn-down/burn-up, cycle time, defect rates) and produce executive-level status updates for leadership and governance forums

**SPECIFIC SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or related field
* 7+ years as Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Project Manager
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II)
* Proven experience managing data engineering or data platform delivery programs end-to-end
* Strong proficiency in Agile methodology and experience with Agile/DevOps Tools: Jira Software, GitHub
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* PMP or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or SAF RAID loge Agilist (SA) certification
* Experience with scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe) and PI Planning
* Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines in a data delivery context
* Familiarity with DBx-based data platform delivery environments
* Background in FMCG/CPG enterprise environments

* Familiarity with AI-driven and agentic delivery models

* Knowledge of data governance processes
* Experience with ITIL change management frameworks

No Relocation support available

### **We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as** ***Oreo*****,** ***belVita*** **and** ***LU*** **biscuits;** ***Cadbury Dairy Milk*****,** ***Milka*** **and** ***Toblerone*** **chocolate;** ***Sour Patch Kids*** **candy and** ***Trident*** **gum. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**
