The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  
  

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**
----------------------------------------

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

title: Team Lead - Software Technology
description:

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.

* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.

* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.

* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.

* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.

* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.

* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.

* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.

* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.

* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

* Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes ...

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

* Company volunteer and donation matching program.

* Employee Assistance Program.

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.

* On-demand digital course library for professional development.

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.*

title: Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential. Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use.
  
  
This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**Job Description: Scrum Master (SAFe)**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Team:**
IT Department
  
  
**Reports to:**
Ralph Michelot
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and passionate
**Scrum Master**
to join our team in India and play a vital role in our Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) transformation. As a servant-leader, you will be responsible for guiding, coaching, and motivating our Agile development teams to reach their full potential.
  
  
Your primary goal is to ensure the teams live by Agile values and principles and follow the processes and practices they agree to use. This role is critical for fostering a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring our distributed teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality software. You will be a key player in removing impediments and empowering your teams to succeed. 🚀
  
  
**What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead all SAFe and Scrum events, including Program Increment (PI) Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Iteration Planning, Iteration Reviews, and Retrospectives, ensuring they are productive and stay within their timebox.
* Coach and Mentor: Act as an Agile coach for the team, providing guidance on SAFe, Scrum, and Lean principles. Help the team embrace a mindset of relentless improvement.
* Remove Impediments: Proactively identify and remove blockers or obstacles that are preventing the team from achieving its goals. Shield the team from external distractions.
* Support the Product Owner: Assist the Product Owner with backlog management, ensuring that goals, scope, and product domain are understood by everyone on the team.
* Foster a Collaborative Culture: Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, and there is an emphasis on collaboration and problem-solving.
* Track and Radiate Information: Utilize tools like Jira to track team progress, manage metrics (like velocity and cycle time), and communicate this information to stakeholders to ensure transparency.
* Drive SAFe Adoption: Guide the team in its role within the Agile Release Train (ART) and ensure its alignment with the overall program objectives.

**What You'll Bring: Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-5+ years of experience in a Scrum Master role for a software development team.
* SAFe Experience: At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Certification: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification is required.
* Agile Tools: Proficiency with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar platform.
* Excellent Skills: Strong communication, facilitation, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.
* Servant Leadership: A deep understanding of the servant-leader role and a passion for empowering teams.

**Nice-to-Haves: Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience participating in a large-scale Agile transformation.
* Advanced SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Advanced Scrum Master - SASM).
* Knowledge of other Agile approaches like Kanban and XP.
* Previous experience as a software developer, QA engineer, or business analyst.

description:

===================================

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: BCM-BA - TechnoFunctional-CapitalMarket-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
* Support business readiness, change management, and operational transition activities.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Analyze and document Front-to-Back trade lifecycle processes across Capital Markets and Treasury functions.
* Support initiatives involving trade capture, lifecycle management, confirmations, settlements, securities processing, reconciliations, collateral management, corporate actions, accounting, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

**Domain Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Treasury, or Financial Markets.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
* Good knowledge of:

+ Trade Capture & Processing
+ Confirmations
+ Settlements
+ Securities Processing
+ Reconciliations
+ Collateral Management
+ Corporate Actions
+ Regulatory & Operational Controls

* Exposure to Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, or Operations functions.

**Asset Class Knowledge**
Experience in one or more:
  
  

* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Money Markets
* Interest Rate Products
* Credit Products
* Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps)

**Platforms & Technology**

* Experience working on Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, enhancement, migration, or support programs.
* Exposure to platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+
+ Finastra Solutions
+ FIS Quantum
+ Broadridge
+ MarkitSERV
+ Front Arena
+ Other Capital Markets, Treasury, or Post-Trade platforms

* Experience supporting integration, data migration, and platform modernization initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies.
* Experience performing data mapping, reconciliation, and data validation activities.
* Understanding of APIs, interfaces, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience reviewing system impacts across multiple applications and data sources.
* Familiarity with Jira, Agile, Scrum, and related delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting reporting solutions and business data validation

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and project deliverables.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently drive requirements and solution discussions.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience supporting Capital Markets platform implementation, consolidation, or migration programs.
* Exposure to regulatory transformation initiatives and reporting requirements.
* Knowledge of financial market interfaces and messaging standards including SWIFT, FIX, MQ, XML, APIs, and ISO 20022.
* Experience working with investment banks, broker-dealers, custodians, exchanges, asset managers, or financial market infrastructures.
* Familiarity with trade and reference data management, reconciliation processes, and operational controls.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant Capital Markets certification is advantageous.
* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, Financial Services Technology, or related consulting environments.
* Proven experience supporting business analysis, platform implementation, transformation, migration, or regulatory change programs.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, Capital Markets, or Project Delivery are desirable.
* Experience working with global banks, broker-dealers, custodians, asset managers, exchanges, or financial institutions is preferred.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AVP, Web Engineer III - Apply and Buy Digital apps (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Web Engineer III - Apply and Buy Digital apps (L10)**
**Company Overview :**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
  
  

* We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.

**Organization Overview**
Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
  
  
The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
AVP, Web Engineer III will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform in micro services architecture using
**Spring Frameworks, in memory data grid, micro-front ends, React JS, responsive design**
etc leveraging latest AI tools and capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and delivery of new web solutions/platforms and enhancements, partnering with product/requirements analysts, QA, and customers within an Agile delivery model.
* Own technical solutioning: translate business requirements into architecture, functional flows, and technical specifications; ensure alignment with enterprise standards.
* Provide technical leadership for mission-critical web applications/services, including hands-on guidance for complex components and integration points.
* Drive estimation and delivery planning with the team; manage technical dependencies/risks and represent engineering in project meetings and solution discussions.
* Ensure engineering excellence: code quality, performance, security, resiliency, and maintainability through reviews, standards, and best practices.
* Establish and enforce engineering practices for documentation, code reuse, refactoring, and design patterns; govern adherence across the team.
* Ensure internally developed applications meet high standards for availability, scalability, extensibility, and operational readiness (monitoring, alerting, supportability).
* Lead and coordinate a blended team (Synchrony and vendor engineers), providing direction, mentoring, and alignment on ways of working.
* Define and track measurable team goals (delivery, quality, reliability, and productivity metrics) and drive continuous improvement.
* Communicate delivery status, technical decisions, and trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership; escalate risks with mitigation plans.
* Stay current on emerging technologies and evaluate adoption opportunities, while ensuring strong proficiency and stability in the existing stack.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 4+ years in software engineering and 2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role. or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and React JS, with proven ability to lead design and implementation for complex web applications.
* Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event-driven systems), and building mission-critical services with high availability and performance.
* Experience with Micro-Frontends (preferred) and front-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost-aware design.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts/on-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with
**4+ years**
in software engineering and
**2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role**
. or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of relevant experience
  
  
**Work Timings: 2PM - 11PM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L8+ Employees can apply.

**Grade / Level : 10**
**Job Family Group**
Information Technology

title: Software Development Manager
description:
**About the role**  

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead Tesco's Mobile Platform team. This team owns the React Native platform, the shared libraries and tooling, and the Mobile CI/CD behind our mobile estate, which serves millions of customers and colleagues every day. Product app teams across Tesco build on what you provide, so your success shows up in their work: a reliable, well-documented platform, shorter and safer release cycles, fewer inconsistencies between apps, and quicker onboarding.

As a Software Development Manager, you are a Senior Engineering Team Leader at Tesco. You balance delivery for customers with the needs of the business and the growth of your people, and you stay hands-on. Your proficiency with foundational computer science and software engineering is taken as a given, and you bring proven technical depth and breadth across teams. You will work closely with the Head of Software Development, the senior engineer (SDE3) who sets the platform's technical direction, Lead Product Managers, and Lead UI/UX Designers, turning platform strategy into dependable delivery.

Mobile experience is essential for this role. You must have built, shipped, and run native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) in production at real scale. React Native or JavaScript skill on its own is not enough. We need someone who knows the mobile platform properly: app lifecycle, on-device performance, release and signing, and the app store processes.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

What the team owns

The React Native mobile platform, built on the Expo ecosystem (EAS, Expo Router), with the shared libraries, common patterns, and app scaffolding that app teams depend on, including how Tesco Digital Design System (DDS) components are pulled in.

The model for scaling React Native across many teams, including micro-app and super-app patterns (for example Module Federation with Re.Pack) where they fit.

Mobile CI/CD and release infrastructure: build, signing, test automation, distribution, store deployment, and over-the-air updates (EAS Update) for iOS and Android.

Developer experience: documentation, examples, a contribution model, migration tooling, and support for the teams that consume the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery and platform

Lead the platform engineering team and own the processes and standards that help development succeed and keep improving.

Build and evolve the React Native platform and its shared libraries, and treat Mobile CI/CD as a product: fast, reliable pipelines, automated quality gates, application signing, and straightforward App Store and Google Play deployment.

Turn the platform direction you agree with the HOSD and the SDE3 into roadmaps, commitments, and shipped work, and make it easier for other teams to build on the platform through documentation, onboarding, and support.

Build platform capabilities for performance, scalability, accessibility (AA), and security from a single React Native codebase, and own incident response and root cause analysis.

Stakeholders and direction

Work with product stakeholders to turn their needs into platform features, and with the HOSD, the SDE3, Lead PMs, and Lead Designers to keep the roadmap aligned.

Build agreement within the team on how to approach a solution, and clear the blockers in its way.

Use agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) where they genuinely help, and expect the team to use specs, skills, and agents across development, documentation, and testing.

People and capability

Set clear objectives and career paths, review colleague performance, and act on it.

Build strong teams, spot and grow talent, and give the team room to innovate.

Raise the hiring bar through mentoring, interviewing, and sharing what you know with the wider engineering community.

 **You will need**  

Qualifications

Mobile engineering experience (essential): hands-on experience building and shipping native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) to the App Store and Google Play, and running them in production. This is a firm requirement. We want real mobile platform depth, not web engineers moving across through React Native.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.

At least 10 years in software engineering at enterprise or product companies, including time leading or managing engineers, with a good part of it spent on mobile.

A track record of building platforms, shared libraries, or developer tooling that other teams use (strongly preferred).

Technical Skills

Deep mobile platform fundamentals (essential): hands-on native iOS (Swift or Objective-C) and/or Android (Kotlin or Java), covering app lifecycle, on-device memory and performance, threading, and native module development, which underpin your React Native work.

Four or more years building React Native apps with the Expo ecosystem (Expo SDKs, Expo Router, EAS), with a solid grasp of JSI, native modules, and bridging to native iOS and Android.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript (modern ES6 and later), and strong React principles, Hooks, Context API, and component lifecycles.

Experience designing and building large front-end or platform systems and shared libraries used by many teams, with sound state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or MobX) and caching.

Mobile CI/CD depth: Git and GitHub, CI pipelines, EAS build and submit, application signing, over-the-air updates (EAS Update), and a thorough understanding of the iOS and Android deployment lifecycles and store guidelines (App Store, Google Play).

Performance profiling for production apps (Android and iOS profilers), packaging and build tooling (Webpack, Babel), and dependency and release management for shared libraries.

Integrating mobile apps with backend APIs (GraphQL or REST), and accessibility to AA standards.

Testing frameworks: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, and Appium.

Confident use of agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) across development, documentation, and testing, plus familiarity with MCP integrations and deep linking.

Process and Soft Skills

Comfortable with Agile methods (Scrum or Kanban), and with JIRA, Confluence, and well-formed epics, stories, and acceptance criteria.

Able to apply different delivery processes and knows when each one fits.

A self-starter who takes ownership, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Well organised, with good time management.

Clear written and verbal communication.

What we offer

Relocation help: a professional service to secure the work permits and other documents you need.

Learning opportunities: certified technical training and platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, and O'Reilly.

A learning culture, with good opportunities to develop your career in your chosen field or in something new.

Varied projects to work on, with something new always in the pipeline.

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Sr Product Designer
description:
**About Target**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win.

**About the Role**

Target is looking for a Senior UX Designer with deep expertise in designing complex enterprise applications and

internal business tools.

In this role, you will simplify sophisticated business processes, data-intensive workflows, and interconnected systems

into intuitive, efficient, and scalable user experiences. You will design products that enable Target team members to

analyze information, make critical decisions, manage operational workflows, and execute business processes

effectively.

As a senior individual contributor, you will independently own complex UX problems from discovery through

implementation, partnering with product managers, engineers, researchers, and business stakeholders across India

and the US.

We are looking for a designer who goes beyond creating intuitive interfaces - someone who understands how

enterprise systems work, can navigate complex business rules and operational dependencies, and has the interaction

design expertise to translate that complexity into effective user experiences.

**What You Will Own**

* Complex enterprise workflows: Analyze, model, simplify, and optimize multi-step business processes involving multiple

user roles, system dependencies, and exception scenarios.

* Data-intensive experiences: Design advanced tables, dashboards, filters, comparisons, bulk operations, and

decision-support interactions that help users work accurately and efficiently.

* End-to-end interaction design: Independently create information architectures, user flows, wireframes, detailed

interaction specifications, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes.

* Enterprise systems thinking: Understand how business rules, permissions, operational constraints, and interconnected

systems influence the user experience.

* Problem discovery and validation: Work with business users and subject-matter experts to uncover needs, validate

assumptions, evaluate designs, and identify opportunities for improvement.

* Product and engineering collaboration: Shape requirements, challenge assumptions, communicate trade-offs, and

partner with engineering to deliver high-quality solutions.

* Scalable UX patterns: Apply and contribute to enterprise design systems, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and reuse

across related products.

* Measurable experience improvement: Collaborate with product partners to identify and evaluate improvements in task

efficiency, accuracy, usability, and operational effectiveness.

* Emerging enterprise interactions: Explore AI-assisted decision support, intelligent automation, and human-in-the-loop

workflows where they provide meaningful user and business value.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience designing complex enterprise applications, internal operational tools, B2B SaaS products, or

similarly sophisticated workflow-driven systems.

* A strong portfolio showcasing complex workflows, data-intensive interactions, systems thinking, detailed design

execution, and the rationale behind key decisions.

Target India | Senior UX Designer (L5) - Enterprise Products 2

* Advanced interaction design skills, including information architecture, complex navigation, tables, forms, filtering, bulk

actions, states, and error recovery.

* Ability to understand and translate complicated business processes, rules, and user needs into clear, usable product

experiences.

* Strong proficiency with Figma, interactive prototyping, and component-based design systems.
* Experience independently owning complex UX problems through discovery, design, validation, and implementation.
* Practical knowledge of contextual research, usability evaluation, and evidence-based design decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including working with business stakeholders and

engineering teams.

* Working knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive interaction design.
* Experience navigating ambiguity and balancing user needs, operational requirements, technical constraints, and

business objectives.

Approximately 8+ years of relevant experience is preferred, with demonstrated enterprise UX expertise and scope of

ownership taking precedence over tenure alone.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing enterprise decision-support, analytics, pricing, merchandising, supply chain, finance, or

operations platforms.

* Experience with AI-enabled enterprise applications, workflow automation, or human-AI interaction patterns.
* Experience working on interconnected platforms with multiple user roles, complex permissions, and shared data.
* Understanding of front-end implementation considerations and technical constraints.
* Experience using workflow efficiency, task success, error rates, or adoption metrics

title: Senior UI/UX Designer – Medical Imaging Platform
description:
**About the Role**

We are building a cloud-native, AI-assisted radiology platform for CT and MRI, made up of a browser-based 3D viewer and the web application around it: worklists, study management, clinical workflows, administration, and an agentic AI assistant. The product is developed as a regulated medical device on the path to FDA 510(k) clearance.

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer with about five years of experience to own the design of this product end to end. You will design for radiologists and imaging staff who work for hours on dense, high-stakes images, and you will work side by side with our engineers, ML team, product, and QA to turn clinical needs into clear, safe, and efficient interfaces.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product and Interaction Design**

* Own UX and UI design across the web application: worklists, search and filters, study and series management, case assignment, review and approval queues, reporting, and administration.
* Design the 3D viewer experience: layouts and hanging protocols, MPR and volume views, windowing and transfer function controls, measurements, annotations, and segmentation editing tools.
* Design for expert, high-volume use: keyboard shortcuts, mouse and touch interaction, low-latency feedback, and information-dense screens that stay readable.
* Map clinical workflows through research, then turn them into user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

**AI-Assisted Workflow Design**

* Design how AI results (segmentations, findings, measurements) appear in the viewer and how clinicians review, edit, accept, or reject them.
* Design the interface for our agentic AI assistant: conversation, suggested actions, tool-use transparency, and clear confirmation steps before anything changes a case.
* Make AI output visibly distinct from clinician-entered content, and communicate confidence, provenance, and limitations without adding noise.

**Design System and Craft**

* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma: components, tokens, patterns, and documentation shared with the front-end team.
* Design dark-mode-first interfaces suited to reading rooms, with careful contrast, color use, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA).
* Produce precise specs and review implemented UI with engineers to make sure the final product matches the design.

  

**Research, Validation, and Compliance**

* Plan and run usability studies with radiologists and technologists, from early concept tests to formative and summative evaluations.
* Support usability engineering for regulatory submissions (IEC 62366-1, FDA human factors guidance): use specifications, use-related risk analysis, and evaluation reports.
* Turn research findings and usage feedback into clear, prioritized design improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional UI/UX or product design experience, with a portfolio showing complex, data-heavy web applications shipped to real users.
* Expert-level Figma: auto layout, variables and tokens, component libraries, and interactive prototyping.
* Proven experience building or evolving a design system used by engineering teams.
* Strong skills in user research and usability testing, and in turning findings into design decisions.
* Solid grasp of interaction design for expert tools: dense layouts, shortcuts, progressive disclosure, and error prevention.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA), color contrast, and dark UI design.
* Good understanding of front-end constraints (HTML/CSS, React component thinking) to design buildable solutions and work closely with developers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain and defend design decisions to engineers, clinicians, and leadership.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience designing healthcare, medical imaging, PACS, or clinical software; familiarity with radiology workflows and viewer conventions.
* Experience designing AI or LLM-based products, including human-in-the-loop review and trust and transparency patterns.
* Familiarity with 3D, scientific, or visualization interfaces, such as CAD, GIS, or imaging tools.
* Exposure to regulated product design: IEC 62366-1, ISO 14971 risk concepts, FDA human factors, or similar.
* Skills in motion and micro-interaction design for feedback and state changes.
* Comfort prototyping with code (HTML/CSS, Storybook, or Tailwind) or with AI-assisted design tools.
* A Master's degree or specialization in HCI, interaction design, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

* You understand our users' workflows through direct sessions with radiologists, and have documented the key flows and pain points.
* You have established the first version of our design system, adopted by the front-end team.
* You have designed and shipped at least one major workflow, such as the study worklist or AI result review, validated with real users.
* Your design documentation is traceable and ready to support usability engineering in regulatory submissions.

**What We Offer**

A chance to define the design language of an AI-enabled clinical imaging product used to improve patient care.

Real ownership and influence on product direction, working directly with engineering and clinical experts.

Direct access to radiologists and imaging specialists for research and feedback.

Competitive salary and benefits.

Flexible work arrangements and support for professional development.

description:

* Design high-quality social media creatives, banners, posters, brochures, presentations, and other marketing collaterals.

* Maintain consistency in branding, typography, colour schemes, and overall visual identity.
* Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing campaigns and business objectives.
* Prepare print-ready and digital design files as per project requirements.

* Design modern, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces for websites, landing pages, dashboards, and web applications.
* Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma or similar tools.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.
* Apply usability principles and responsive design standards to enhance user experience.
* Conduct competitor research and suggest design improvements to increase user engagement.

* Work closely with marketing, development, content, and product teams to deliver creative assets within deadlines.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute innovative design ideas.
* Maintain organised design files, reusable components, and project documentation.
* Handle multiple design projects while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and UI/UX best practices.

* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Canva, and other relevant design tools.
* Strong understanding of graphic design, UI/UX principles, wireframing, and prototyping.
* Knowledge of typography, colour theory, layout design, and branding.
* Understanding of responsive web design and user-centred design principles.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with their portfolio showcasing relevant graphic design and UI/UX projects on 8001871234/hr@webingo.in

* Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Good analytical, editing, and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Overview**
**About Business Unit:**
The Product team forms the crux of our pofwerful platforms and helps connect millions of customers worldwide with the brands that matter most to them. This team of innovative problem solvers develops and builds products that position Epsilon as a differentiator, encouraging an open and balanced marketplace built on respect for individuals, where every brand interaction holds value. Our full-cycle product engineering and data teams chart the future and set new benchmarks for our products, by using industry standard methodologies and sophisticated capabilities in data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Driven by a passion for delivering smart end-to-end solutions, this team plays a key role in Epsilon’s success story.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
We are looking for a technically curious and creative Senior Technical Writer who can transform complex enterprise SaaS products into clear, engaging, and useful content for customers, partners, and internal teams.
  
  
This is a modern technical writing role. Along with core product documentation, you will create release content, technical guides, interactive content, product walkthroughs, videos, AI-generated videos, and other formats that help users understand and adopt our products.
  
  
AI will be an important part of how you work, helping accelerate research, drafting, content creation, multimedia production, and repetitive tasks. We are looking for someone who understands this shift, is willing to unlearn traditional ways of working, actively learns new tools, and knows when human expertise, technical understanding, creativity, judgment, and validation are required.
  
  
You should be comfortable going beyond traditional technical writing when needed, acting as a knowledge curator who can discover, organize, connect, and communicate product knowledge for different projects and business needs.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end creation and maintenance of product documentation, user guides, API and integration documentation, implementation content, release notes, troubleshooting content, and knowledge articles.
* Investigate product capabilities, workflows, APIs, integrations, data, configuration, and backend concepts using Jira, Confluence, engineering artifacts, product demos, specifications, and hands-on product exploration.
* Work with Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Support, and other partners to identify SMEs, gather and validate information, resolve gaps, and drive content to completion.
* Plan and deliver content in alignment with Agile development and release cadences, including testing product features, workflows, APIs, and integrations to ensure accuracy.
* Create engaging content beyond traditional documentation, including interactive content, product walkthroughs, videos, AI-assisted videos, visual explainers, scenarios, and product stories.
* Use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, editing, content creation, transformation, multimedia production, and repetitive work while maintaining ownership of technical accuracy, context, relevance, and final quality.
* Curate and connect knowledge across products, releases, and strategic projects, and support content needs beyond traditional technical-writing duties when required by the business.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Technical Writing, Product Documentation, or similar roles supporting SaaS, Cloud, Data, or enterprise software.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex product and technical concepts into clear, audience-appropriate content.
* Strong product and technical understanding across enterprise applications, workflows, APIs, integrations, data, configuration, and related backend concepts.
* Experience working independently and collaboratively with cross-functional product, engineering, services, customer, and support teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, information-gathering, content organization, writing, editing, and quality-assurance skills.
* Experience working in Agile product-development environments and managing content across multiple priorities and release timelines.
* Ability to use AI and modern content tools effectively, with a willingness to learn, unlearn, experiment, and adapt as tools and practices evolve.
* Willingness and ability to collaborate with globally distributed teams, including regular overlap with US and India business hours when required.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Jira, Confluence, wikis, and modern documentation platforms.
* AI productivity and content-creation tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent.
* AI video and multimedia tools such as Synthesia, Camtasia, Storylane, or equivalent.
* Enterprise SaaS applications and frontend/backend concepts.
* REST APIs, integrations, and API documentation.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* SQL, data concepts, ETL, and related technologies.
* HTML, Markdown, and familiarity with documentation-as-code practices is a plus.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and engineering workflows is preferred.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Technical Communication, English, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Technical Writing, Cloud, AI, Data, or related certifications are a plus.

**Additional Information**
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.
  
  
Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.
  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.
  
  

* People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.
  
  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.
  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Technical Trainer II
description:
**Job Title:**
Power Systems Trainer
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The Power Systems Instructional Trainer designs and delivers technical learning programs to build engineering capability across power systems, products, tools, and digital solutions. The role develops effective learning solutions and collaborates with Experts and stakeholders to address business and technical needs.
  
  
**Department:**
Global Technology Alliance (GTA)
  
  
**Reporting Structure:**
Engineering Excellence Manager, GTA\*, Bangalore, India
  
  
Dotted line reports to: Global Training Leaders, NAM & Europe
  
  
**Work Details**
**Location**
: Schneider Electric GTA, Electronic City Phase II, Bangalore India Location
  
  
**Work Category**
: Hybrid (onsite initially for training & alignment), flexible hours
  
  
**Collaboration**
: 2-3 hours with North American teams after 5 PM IST
  
  
**Travel**
: Minimal; domestic and international travel for training/conferences
  
  
**Career Path:**

* DRDT3 - Technical Trainer II
* DRDT4 - Senior Technical Trainer I
* DRDT5 - Senior Technical Trainer II
* DRDT6 - Principal, Technical Trainer
* DRDT7 – Senior Principal Technical Trainer

**About GTA**

* GTA (Global Technology Alliance) is an engineering program under the Energy Management | Power Systems | ETO Business of Schneider Electric. GTA has ~400 Electrical & Mechanical Engineers that offer Engineering Services (Quotations, Order Engineering, Product enhancement/maintenance, Electrical CAD Content Creation etc.) to the ETO (Engineer to Order) plants of Schneider Electric in North America, Europe, India etc. The team continues to grow and expand its presence across multiple geographies, creating a strong need for dedicated trainers who possess deep technical expertise and are committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning.

**What do you get to do in this position?**

* Training Delivery:
* Deliver classroom, virtual, hands-on, and blended technical training.
* Conduct training on new products, engineering tools, applications, and emerging technologies.
* Use practical demonstrations, e-learning, videos, and plant/lab visits to enhance learning.
* Assist engineering tools, software, and product design training efforts.
* Coordinate global training needs and provide post-training technical support.
* Engage with the quality team to identify engineering design barrier opportunities and develop targeted training to address the knowledge gap.
* Curriculum Development:
* Develop and maintain technical training content, curricula, and assessments.
* Apply instructional design and adult-learning principles to create effective learning journeys.
* Structure and simplify existing technical content into engaging learning solutions.
* Collaborate with Experts to ensure technical accuracy and relevance.
* Create high-quality digital and e-learning content using appropriate authoring tools.
* Assessment & Evaluation:
* Evaluate learner performance through knowledge checks, practical assessments, assignments, observations, and feedback.
* Establish and track metrics for participation, completion, effectiveness, application, and business impact.
* Use feedback and performance data to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Connect learning outcomes to relevant engineering and business performance indicators where feasible.
* Technical Expertise:
* Maintain advanced knowledge within the relevant Engineer-to-Order product and engineering domain.
* Stay current with product developments, engineering practices, automation, digital solutions, and applicable standards.
* Support learning related to low- and medium-voltage equipment, engineering design, controls, communication systems, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance based on domain expertise.
* Maintain working knowledge of relevant engineering applications, product-data systems, CAD tools, productivity tools, and associated software.
* Stay updated with emerging trends in power systems, smart grids, renewable integration, and digital substations.
* Stakeholder Engagement:
* Collaborate with engineering teams, HR, quality teams, global training leaders, subject-matter experts, and business stakeholders.
* Represent the training function in audits, reviews, technical forums, and capability-development discussions.
* Manage multiple learning requirements and assignments while maintaining clear priorities.
* Support mentorship, buddy, and knowledge-sharing programs as required.

Promote a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, engineering excellence, and measurable improvement
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Bachelor’s/Master’s in Electrical, Mechanical, or relevant Engineering discipline.**

* Experience in engineering design, Power Systems, LV/MV equipment, ETO, automation, or manufacturing.
* Familiarity with engineering tools such as AutoCAD, EPlan, SEE XP, CREO, MCAD, or PDM.
* Experience in technical training, mentoring, or capability development.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

Rewards designed for you
  
  
Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.
  
  
Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries
  
  
You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values.
