title: ITSM Knowledge Manager
description:
Our client's software solutions aim to improve the lives of everyone in construction and the people within our entire organization are the driving force behind our innovative, top-rated global platform. We’re a customer-centric group that encompasses engineering, product, product design and data, security and business systems.

In this Knowledge Manager role, you are responsible for the IT knowledge base and Known Error Database (KEDB) that Service Desk, End User Services (EUS) and Infrastructure teams rely on to resolve incidents and requests faster. The role sets governance, drives content quality, connects knowledge to the ITSM platform, and makes it usable in self-service, and the chatbot.

Position reports to our Director-ITSM and End User Services based in our client's Bangalore office. Working hours 7:30PM-4:00AM India Time.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the quality of the IT Infrastructure and End User Services knowledge base. Audit it regularly for gaps, duplication, outdated content and unclear ownership, and use the findings to restructure its spaces.
* Maintain the space structure, hierarchy, taxonomy, labels and permissions. Tune search relevance through titles, metadata and tagging.
* Work with SMEs to define content ownership, review cadences and the article lifecycle, from creation through retirement.
* Run knowledge workflows, including intake, triage and closure of content feedback and documentation requests, so support content stays accurate, useful and current.
* Partner with analysts and SMEs (Service Desk, Cloud and Infrastructure, Network, MDM, Identity) to turn high-volume tickets into articles covering symptoms, resolution steps and escalation paths.
* Collaborate with Problem Management to turn root causes, workarounds and fixes from problems and major incidents into reusable knowledge.
* Own the Known Error Database (KEDB), ensuring each known error is fully documented, current and free of duplicates.
* Create, test and refine basic AI prompts and automations, using approved tools and practices, to improve knowledge workflows and content quality.
* Train/Coach analysts, team leads and SMEs on contributing, reviewing and keeping content accurate.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in knowledge management, technical writing, or content management, ideally in an IT service desk or ITSM environment.
* Experience in building, restructuring, or maintaining a knowledge base.
* Working knowledge of an ITSM platform (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) and ITIL concepts, including knowledge,incident and problem management.
* Hands-on experience administering and structuring a Confluence knowledge base, including spaces, templates, labels, and permissions is preferred
* Strong writing and editing skills, and the ability to explain technical topics plainly.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and stakeholders across teams.

title: Senior Analyst- Publication Writer
description:
Job Title: Senior Analyst-Publication Writer
  
  
Career Level:D1
  
  
****About AstraZeneca****
AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
  
  
****Introduction To Role:****
Are you ready to lead sophisticated, high-stakes scientific publications that shape clinical understanding and guide decision the role of Lead Publication Writer at Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru, you will create clear and compliant narratives from robust evidence. These narratives will support advancing patient outcomes and advise the scientific community.unity.
  
  
You will own the path from first outline to acceptance for priority scientific papers and presentation content, aligning contributors and navigating disclosure nuances with confidence. Collaborating alongside biostatistics, drug development, medical, and external author teams, you will drive publication delivery end-to-end, strengthening the visibility and impact of our therapies. We collaborate in person on average three days per week to connect, move at pace, and challenge perspectives—do you thrive on bringing diverse experts together to deliver publication excellence?
  
  
****Accountabilities**
:**
Publication leadership: Independently manage sophisticated articles and conference materials within assigned publication plans, from initial prioritisation and planning through submission and resubmission. Coordinate contributors, manage timelines and dependencies, and call out significant scientific, quality, or delivery risks appropriately.
  
  
Scientific writing, editing, and review: Author and critically review sophisticated manuscripts, structured abstracts, posters, and presentations, including publications based on clinical trials, subgroup analyses, real-world evidence, and health economics and outcomes research. Develop clear scientific narratives and ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with specifications for written and oral scientific forums.
  
  
Sophisticated disclosure management: Develop document outlines, figure and table shells, and evidence flow for sophisticated assigned deliverables. Manage publication systems, document versions, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs while maintaining alignment with the agreed publication strategy.
  
  
Data interpretation: Work with biostatistics, clinical, safety, and medical colleagues to interpret datasets and analytical outputs for assigned publications. Identify and reconcile inconsistencies across source documents and ensure that conclusions accurately reflect the available evidence.
  
  
Literature review and evidence synthesis: Plan and conduct literature searches and evidence reviews supporting assigned publications. Maintain methodological rigour, transparent search documentation, accurate reference libraries, and citation integrity.
  
  
Publication and conference presentation submissions: Prepare and coordinate complete submission packages, cover letters, and responses to reviewer comments. Manage author approvals, disclosures, and compliance checks, and resolve routine journal or congress queries.
  
  
Translate scientific data into detailed, clear, and suitably tailored figures and tables. Work with design partners to develop publication-ready visual assets that meet journal, congress, accessibility, and brand requirements.
  
  
Compliance and publication ethics: Apply Good Publication Practice, ICMJE recommendations, AstraZeneca policies, and relevant transparency requirements across assigned deliverables. Identify potential concerns and escalate sophisticated ethical or compliance questions to the appropriate experts.
  
  
Content strategy and stakeholder management: Contribute to asset publication strategies and lead author meetings and cross-functional reviews for assigned deliverables. Clarify expectations, consolidate feedback, and maintain alignment on scope, scientific narrative, and timelines.
  
  
Project delivery and documentation: Plan and manage schedules, dependencies, and documentation for multiple concurrent deliverables. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records in publication management systems and recommend practical improvements to quality, consistency, and efficiency.
  
  
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with clinical development, medical affairs, biostatistics, HEOR, safety, regulatory, external authors, and other publication stakeholders. Represent Publication Delivery in forums directly related to assigned deliverables and support congress planning activities as required.
  
  
Digital innovation: Use approved artificial intelligence, automation, and digital tools responsibly to improve publication quality and efficiency. Contribute user insight and participate in pilots, adoption activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
Quality and consistency: Apply established quality-control requirements, conduct peer reviews, and provide clear, actionable feedback. Ensure consistency across related deliverables and alignment with source materials, product information, and previous disclosures.
  
  
Capability building: Develop strong subject-matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas. Provide day-to-day coaching, peer review, and practical guidance to Publication Writers, and contribute to onboarding, training materials, and team learning activities.
  
  
****Essential Skills/Experience:****

* Master’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of experience in medical or scientific writing, including demonstrated leadership of complex manuscripts and congress disclosures; or, where industry experience is more limited, significant and credible academic research and publication experience, including authorship of complex original research published in highly reputed peer-reviewed journals.
* Advanced understanding of clinical research methods, biostatistics, scientific communication, and publication ethics, including Good Publication Practice and ICMJE recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate scientific evidence into accurate, clear, and audience-appropriate publications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and organisational skills, with the ability to lead multiple high-priority projects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reference management tools, and publication management platforms, together with familiarity with data visualisation standards.

****Desirable Skills/Experience:****

* Advanced degree such as PharmD, PhD, MD, or MPH, or a recognised qualification in medical writing or communications.
* Experience leading integrated disclosures involving pooled analyses, meta-analyses, HEOR, or epidemiology, and coordinating multi-author manuscripts through acceptance.
* Experience in one or more of the following therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism; Respiratory and Immunology; Vaccines and Immune Therapies.
* Experience collaborating with investigators, external experts, and cross-functional teams, including engagement with journal editors and congress secretariats.
* Strong working knowledge of authorship criteria, data transparency, data-sharing expectations, and journal and congress submission systems.

**Why AstraZeneca?**
At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
Also You can find alternative messaging to use in the ‘Global Talent Attraction Story messaging’ section of the Global Playbook on the Employer Brand Portal - try to use other examples in order to make it different for candidates!

The role focuses on the operational setup, data transfer, and continuous improvement of the portfolio representation in the tool, as well as on capturing, structuring, and transferring requirements into the internal repository for future reuse.

title: Content Marketer
description:
We are looking for a creative and research-oriented Content Marketer with strong writing and editing skills to develop engaging, SEO-optimised, business-focused content for our B2B engineering and technology services.

The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding engineering concepts, researching industry trends, and translating technical information into clear and compelling content that strengthens our brand presence and supports business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. B2B Content Writing & SEO**

* Create, write, edit and optimise website pages, service pages, landing pages, blogs, articles and industry-specific content.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent keywords.
* Optimise content using SEO best practices, including meta titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal linking.

**2. Technical Research & Content Development**

* Research engineering services, manufacturing processes, digital engineering, technology solutions and industry applications.
* Translate technical concepts into engaging, easy-to-understand and business-focused content.
* Develop case studies, project success stories, whitepapers, technical articles, solution briefs, industry reports and thought leadership content.
* Highlight engineering innovations, manufacturing trends and digital transformation initiatives.

**3. Digital & Social Media Content**

* Create LinkedIn posts and social media content while maintaining a consistent brand voice.
* Develop email newsletters and basic marketing campaign content.
* Support brand awareness and digital marketing initiatives through relevant content.

**4. Content Planning & Performance**

* Plan and maintain content calendars and ensure timely execution.
* Monitor content performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console (GSC).
* Track website traffic, keyword rankings and user engagement.
* Identify opportunities to improve content performance and SEO visibility.

**5. Collaboration**

* Work closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Designers, Developers, Sales and SEO teams.
* Gather technical inputs and convert them into relevant marketing content.
* Research unfamiliar technical topics independently and simplify them for the target audience.

Required Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong B2B content writing, editing and proofreading skills.
* Working knowledge of SEO and keyword research.
* B2B Social Media Content Strategy and Monitoring
* Understanding of website content optimisation and content marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of GA4 and Google Search Console.
* Ability to research and simplify technical and engineering-related subjects.
* Strong research, analytical and time-management skills.
* Digital Marketing working experience will be an added advantage

Experience & Qualification

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in Content Marketing, B2B Content Writing or Digital Content Development.
* Experience in engineering, manufacturing, industrial or technology-related content will be an added advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing or a relevant discipline is preferred.

title: Product Content Marketer
description:
**About SuperOps**

SuperOps is building AI native IT operations software for MSPs and internal IT teams and we want the market to know it. We are a fast growing, well funded SaaS company backed by world class investors including Addition, March Capital, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital and Tanglin Venture Partners.

We move fast, build with purpose and hire people who want to make a real impact. If you want to work on a product that matters with a team that pushes you, SuperOps is the place to be.

**About the Role [5 days In office]**

We’re looking for a product marketer who can learn a technical product deeply and turn what it does into content that helps customers understand it, see its value, and act on it.

This role pairs product marketing judgment with hands-on content creation, and video is the lead format. Your audience is prospects evaluating SuperOps and customers adopting new capabilities. You’ll report to the Head of Product Marketing and work closely with Product, Brand Marketing, and Demand Generation.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Turn product capabilities into customer-facing stories.**
  Work directly with Product to understand features, workflows, and use cases. Translate technical detail into clear content that shows why it matters.
* **Own content from idea to execution.**
  Take product inputs and shape the narrative yourself, from research and ideation through writing, scripting, and delivery.
* **Lead with video.**
  Script and produce product explainers, feature walkthroughs, demos, release roundups, and short-form videos. You’ll be in front of the camera bringing these stories to life.
* **Drive launches and adoption.**
  Create launch announcements, release updates, blogs, and product pages that help customers understand and adopt new capabilities.
* **Create content across the funnel.**
  Partner with Demand Generation on awareness, consideration, and conversion content, from educational pieces to assets that support buying decisions.
* **Learn, measure, and improve.**
  Stay close to customer questions and feedback, track how content performs, and use what you learn to sharpen the next piece.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4-6 years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including owning positioning and messaging for a technical product. You’ll bring that judgment straight into the content you create, so you won’t need a PMM to translate the product for you.
* Strong writing and storytelling, with the ability to simplify complex concepts without losing their meaning.
* Hands-on experience creating content across multiple formats and funnel stages.
* Confidence on camera, with experience scripting and presenting demos, explainers, or other video-first content.
* The curiosity and discipline to learn a product deeply, ask sharp questions, and turn product inputs into customer-ready content independently.
* The ability to run multiple projects in parallel across Product, PMM, Brand, and Demand Gen.

**Good to Have**

* Experience marketing IT, IT operations, MSP, cybersecurity, or other technical B2B software.
* Experience with video storyboarding, recording, or editing tools.
* Familiarity with content distribution, SEO, and using performance data to improve reach and engagement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers quickly understand what SuperOps does and why it matters.
* Every launch and release ships with clear, useful content.
* Video becomes a repeatable engine for product storytelling.
* Sales and Demand Gen have content they actually use across awareness, consideration, and buying decisions.

title: TENDER PROPOSAL ENGINEER
description:
**Position:**
Tender Proposal Engineer
  
  
**Department:**
Sales & Tendering
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Experience:**
1–4 Years
  
  
**Company Description**
VSAN Electricals and Sensors is an Indian manufacturer of industrial Flow Meters, Level Sensors, Pressure Transmitters, and Process Instrumentation solutions. We serve various government organizations, public sector undertakings, and private industrial customers.
  
  
We are looking for a technically skilled and proactive Tender Proposal Engineer to manage government tender participation, technical documentation, quotation preparation, and private-sector sales activities.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a detail-oriented Tender Proposal Engineer who can independently handle end-to-end tender activities through GeM and other government procurement portals, while also managing private-sector sales inquiries and business development activities.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable tender opportunities, preparing technical and commercial proposals, coordinating with customers, generating quotations, and developing new sales opportunities across government and private industrial sectors.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Government Tender & GeM Activities
* Identify and analyze relevant government tenders through GeM and other e-procurement portals.
* Handle complete tender participation activities, including tender document downloading, technical evaluation, and bid submission.
* Review tender specifications, eligibility criteria, pre-qualification requirements, and commercial terms.
* Prepare technical compliance sheets, deviation statements, model selection sheets, and other tender-related documents.
* Coordinate with internal departments to collect technical, commercial, and statutory documents.
* Prepare and submit technical and financial bids within the stipulated deadlines.
* Handle pre-bid queries, tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and customer communications.
* Manage GeM bidding, reverse auctions, order processing, and post-bid follow-ups.
* Maintain tender records, submission status, and upcoming tender opportunities.
* Private Sales & Business Development
* Handle private-sector customer inquiries received through emails, phone calls, websites, and other business channels.
* Identify new business opportunities in industrial and manufacturing sectors.
* Prepare technical and commercial quotations based on customer requirements.
* Understand customer specifications and coordinate for suitable product and model selection.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and convert inquiries into confirmed orders.
* Develop relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Conduct regular sales follow-ups and maintain inquiry and quotation tracking reports.
* Coordinate with technical and production teams to ensure proper customer support.

title: Technical Lead - Urban Planning and Sustainable Cooling Initiatives
description:
**Overview:**

The Technical Lead - Planning will spearhead urban planning initiatives under the Tamil Nadu Project Management Unit (PMU), supporting the implementation of the India Cooling Action Plan (ICAP). The role focuses on state-wide coordination, heat-resilient urban planning, financing thermally comfortable real estate projects, and introducing innovative cooling technologies such as district cooling and cooling as a service. This position requires a deep understanding of urban planning frameworks and strong collaboration with government departments, private sector entities, and other key stakeholders. Please read the full post carefully till the end before applying. Applications submitted via Easy Apply will not be vetted unless all additional requested information is provided.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Project Leadership and Coordination:Lead the implementation of ICAP initiatives across Tamil Nadu, ensuring alignment with state-specific priorities.
2. Develop strategies and provide advisory support for heat-resilient urban planning, integrating nature-based solutions and passive cooling technologies.
3. Coordinate project teams and ensure timely and high-quality outputs.
4. Identify business and financing opportunities for thermally comfortable and passively cooled real estate projects, collaborating with housing and urban development authorities.
5. Guide the implementation of district cooling systems, cooling-as-a-service models, and cold chain technologies to support energy-efficient cooling solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Building:**

1. Act as a liaison with state government agencies, including housing, urban planning, and environmental departments, to facilitate the adoption of sustainable cooling solutions.
2. Engage with real estate developers, financial institutions, and industry associations for capacity-building initiatives.
3. Organize workshops, training programs, and stakeholder consultations to raise awareness about heat-resilient planning and sustainable cooling
4. Coordinate with national and international experts to integrate global best practices into Tamil Nadu’s urban planning process.

**Research, Analysis, and Reporting:**

1. Prepare technical reports, policy briefs, and project proposals to support government decision-making.
2. Monitor project progress and document outcomes aligned with ICAP objectives and UNEP performance indicators.
3. Ensure timely reporting and knowledge dissemination through reports, presentations, and multilingual communication materials (English and Tamil).

**Policy and Financing Advisory:**

1. Support the development of policies and frameworks to encourage thermally comfortable, affordable, and energy-efficient housing
2. Collaborate with financial institutions and international agencies to unlock funding for passive cooling projects and cold chain infrastructure.
3. Advocate for and implement incentives for adopting district cooling systems and cooling-as-a-service solutions.

**Qualifications:**

**Educational Background:**

* Master’s degree or higher in Urban Planning, Urban Design, or related disciplines (e.g., Architecture, Environmental Planning).
* Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in urban planning, sustainable development, or related fields, with expertise in heat-resilient planning and cooling technologies.
* Proven track record of engaging with government departments, private developers, and financial institutions.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* In-depth understanding of urban planning frameworks and building energy efficiency standards.
* Proven ability to lead and manage teams effectively.
* Exceptional skills in stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and communication.
* Expertise in preparing technical documentation, drafting detailed reports, and presenting complex information clearly.
* Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with the India Cooling Action Plan (ICAP) and related national or state-level guidelines.
* Experience with district cooling systems, passive cooling strategies, or financing models for sustainable real estate is highly desirable
* Experience in integrating nature-based and passive cooling solutions into master plans and infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of international urban planning practices and tools for thermal comfort and energy efficiency.
* Fluency in Tamil

This is a full-time position, the person will need to work out of our Chennai office.

**About the Team**

The Global Alliances and Channels team at Appian is a fast-paced, dynamic organization that plays an integral role in driving Appian's growth globally. We are passionate about accelerating digital transformation by bringing enterprise solutions that provide the speed, agility, and efficiency needed for enterprises to compete and grow. Our team is dedicated to supporting an extraordinary global network, ensuring our partners are fully equipped to build, sell, and deliver AI-Powered Process Automation and Enterprise-Grade Orchestration at scale.

**The Opportunity**

As the Global Partner Enablement & Operations Specialist, you will join our central Global Partner Experience team as a versatile generalist in a high-impact and exciting new role. Reporting to the Director of Global Partner Experience, you will sit at the crossroads of front-end partner operations, community site administration, enablement orchestration, and operational reporting.

In this role, you will take functional ownership of daily execution, turning strategy into smooth operational workflows across various initiatives. You will bring an execution mentality and high degree of ownership to navigate ambiguity, establish foundational processes, and ensure our global partner network experiences a frictionless journey from initial onboarding to advanced competency across all global theaters.

**What You’ll Do**

**Partner Community Site Administration**

* Serve as a primary administrator for our partner-facing community platform (e.g. Gainsight).
* Conduct regular operational audits: inventory community spaces, identify broken links/elements, resolve technical glitches, and ensure content stays fresh and responsive.
* Troubleshoot partner user provisioning, access inquiries, and platform troubleshooting across multiple time zones.
* Support the rollout, change management, and user adoption of new community features and new  initiatives.

**Enablement Orchestration & Packaging**

* Coordinate cross-functional enablement initiatives by sourcing and packaging collateral originating across Sales, Product, and Delivery teams.
* Format, organize, and distribute enablement collateral through the partner community and targeted pilot programs (including upcoming AI-enabled enablement initiatives).
* Support the execution of core partner journeys, including the Global Partner Onboarding Curriculum and Certification Frameworks.
* Collaborate with channel leads to monitor partner progression, address operational bottlenecks, and drive program completion rates.

**Content Maintenance & Discoverability**

* Enforce centralized content taxonomy, folder structures, and version control across partner-facing systems and enablement repositories to guarantee all assets are accurate and easily discoverable.
* Coordinate publishing workflows with a focus on organization, quality assurance, formatting, and timely distribution rather than pure content creation from scratch.
* Perform routine content audits across community spaces to retire outdated collateral and streamline partner learning paths.

**Analytics & Operational Metrics**

* Extract, compile, and track performance data using Salesforce and community analytics to measure the reach and efficacy of enablement collateral and communications.
* Monitor operational adoption metrics across partner-facing systems (community visits, training completion, engagement drop-offs, certification volumes).
* Build structured monthly and quarterly dashboards to identify readiness gaps and inform leadership decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  5+ years of hands-on experience in partner operations, channel enablement coordination, customer success operations, or related B2B operational support roles within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
* **Channel & Ecosystem Fluency:**
  Prior experience operating within a partner or customer ecosystem and a clear understanding of front-end operational workflows.
* **Technical Systems:**
  Direct hands-on experience administering community platforms or partner-facing systems, alongside practical experience querying data and building reports in Salesforce.
* **Execution & Ownership:**
  Demonstrated self-starter mentality with the ability to take initiative, solve problems independently, and thrive in a role where processes are evolving.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with proven ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams in different time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Community Platforms:**
  Direct administrative experience with
  **Gainsight**
  (or equivalent community platforms) is strongly preferred.
* **Content Operations:**
  Background in technical content coordination, asset packaging, or structured document repository management.
* **Ecosystem Tooling:**
  Familiarity with modern enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, CMS platforms) and automated workflow tools.

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. description:

**About TNS India Foundation**

TNS India Foundation (TNSIF) is a non-profit development organisation with over 13 years of experience in

implementing robust, effective, and demand-driven programs focused on youth employability and national

economic development, with a special focus on women.

• We are looking for a Program Specialist – Training (EV Trainer) who is passionate about teaching and

mentoring students in Electric Vehicle technologies.

• This is primarily a trainer role, where the selected candidate will train students on Electric Vehicle (EV)

technologies, components, and industry practices. The trainer will conduct structured classroom and

practical training sessions to help students develop technical knowledge and industry readiness.

• The role requires frequent travel to partner colleges and training centres to conduct offline training

sessions and hands-on workshops.

• Since the role involves delivering training sessions and interacting with students, candidates must have very good English communication and presentation skills, along with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Deliver technical training sessions to students on Electric Vehicle technologies and systems.

• Conduct training on topics such as: Electric motors, Controllers, Battery systems, Power electronics,

Primary and secondary harness systems, Wiring and power distribution systems.

• Travel to partner colleges and training centres to conduct offline training and practical sessions.

• Design and develop training modules, presentations, manuals, and hands-on learning activities for students.

• Stay updated with the latest advancements in EV technology, charging infrastructure, and vehicle software.

• Work closely with industry professionals and technical teams to ensure training content is aligned with

current industry requirements.

• Create engaging and interactive learning experiences using lectures, demonstrations, simulations, and

practical sessions.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to students to improve their understanding of EV systems.

• Maintain training records, attendance, evaluations, and feedback reports.

• Support program teams in ensuring effective training delivery and student learning outcomes.

• Assist in program implementation, curriculum improvement, and industry-aligned training initiatives.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and cultivating a diverse, respectful, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued.

**Job Requirements**

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering

• Experience: 0–2 years (Freshers with strong technical knowledge can apply)

• Good understanding of: Electrical systems, Battery systems and EV components, Electric motor control and EV technology

• Excellent English communication and presentation skills (essential for delivering training sessions)

• Strong teaching, mentoring, and technical explanation abilities

• Comfortable travelling regularly to colleges and training centres for conducting training programs

• Ability to work with students from diverse backgrounds

• Willingness to learn, adapt, and work in dynamic training environments

title: Project Consultant – EdTech and AI
description:
**About Central Square Foundation**
About the job Project Consultant - EdTech and AI
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech; Early Childhood Education (ECE); and Schools Governance.
  
  
Read more about our work here: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech At CSF**
CSF's EdTech initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to implement EdTech solutions and influence policy.
* Funding public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching 2.5 million learners across India.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of learning for India's children and help build an EdTech ecosystem that is evidence-driven, tech-enabled, scalable and equitable.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Central Square Foundation aims to work closely with the Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu, by providing support for the adoption and implementation of EdTech programs for the K-12 schooling system in the state. This position is a
**full-time**
assignment as part of the CSF's EdTech and AI team for this purpose. The consultant will be expected to support the execution of live projects and help start new projects by working closely with senior and junior officers in the department towards commonly aligned milestones.
  
  
﻿

title: Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Data & Insights Enablement - Senior Analyst (Data Governance Product Management)**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The
**Senior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management**
acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
**You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management & Technical Requirements Elicitation
* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog & Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment
* Data Catalog & Governance Platform Management
* Catalog Administration & Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata & Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies
* Domain Data Governance & Stewardship Enablement
* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms
* Data Quality Specification & Rule Design
* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines
* Business Interfacing & Stakeholder Collaboration
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments. (Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory)
* Technical & Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation)
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality & Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic (preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking & Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal & Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

***Note: Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)***
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Whether you are a fresh graduate with strong Python skills and a few projects you are proud of, or an experienced engineer who has already put models into production, there is a clear place for you on this team. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) , NLP models, and other AI services into web applications and enterprise workflows. Document architecture, model designs, experiments, and APIs so others can build on your work. Freshers will start with well-scoped tasks within these areas and take on more ownership over time; experienced engineers will lead them. What We Are Looking For Everyone Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field (final-year students are welcome to apply). Strong programming skills in Python . Curiosity about AI and a habit of learning new tools quickly. Good problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud . CI/CD and MLOps practices. AI security, responsible AI principles, and model monitoring. Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We value potential and willingness to learn as much as a perfect match. Exposure to enterprise-scale AI products for clients across Europe, the UK, Asia, and MENA. Mentorship, code reviews, and continuous learning at every level. A clear path to grow from graduate to engineer to technical lead. Flexible remote / hybrid working. Competitive pay and performance-based incentives. title: Workplace Change Manager
description:
Job Summary JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way . Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. Role purpose: The Workplace Change Manager will establish and lead an APAC Workplace Change Management Center of Excellence (CoE) to standardize and enhance change enablement across APAC site moves. The objective of this role is to create a consistent experience, reduce duplicated effort, and clarify change ownership across projects. This role will lead a CoE that provides structure, methodology, templates, quality control, and oversight, while project and delivery teams execute implementation. The CoE will operate through two parallel workstreams: Build a controlled library of standardized change collateral within the first 90 days. Deliver change support mapped to each site s location, timeline, resource requirements, and language needs. At JLL, we are committed to helping our people achieve their ambitions by enabling them to explore new opportunities, build expertise, create long-term careers, and succeed through inclusion. We value what makes each of us unique and help our people find a place where they can belong. The Workplace Change Manager is accountable for the CoE methodology, governance, and execution support across six change management stage gates and tier-based engagement. The role will establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering, intake, stage gate governance, and quality control processes. It will also drive the creation and maintenance of a controlled collateral library and leadership cascade materials, while supporting project teams with scalable, high-quality change delivery across multiple locations and languages. This role requires a structured and process-minded leader who can standardize effectively without slowing delivery, and who can coach and enable local teams while maintaining strong quality oversight. Key responsibilities Establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering and the six-gate methodology, with clear intake, tiering, gate approvals, and quality control. Build and maintain the collateral library and leadership cascade pack by rebuilding existing APAC assets into a controlled library containing templates, worked examples, completion instructions, readiness checklists, and a lessons learned bank with quarterly updates. Deliver change support aligned to the project pipeline, including engagement planning, content production, cascade and readiness activities, runbook execution, hypercare, handover, and local translation and quality assurance. Provide daily communications enablement by standardizing event collateral, newsletter templates, workplace signage, and monthly reporting templates, while also providing oversight and quality control for employee-facing communications and campaigns. Lead stakeholder alignment and readiness cadence with WPx, PMO, and DC to help ensure leadership alignment and employee readiness are addressed consistently. Manage specialist or external SME engagement by exception where complexity requires additional support, such as high leadership visibility, phased moves, or compressed timelines, under central governance. Required qualifications Proven experience leading APAC regional change delivery and communications across workplace moves and multi-stakeholder programs. Strong experience operating in a model where a central CoE provides structure and projects execute delivery. Demonstrated capability in building reusable toolkits, templates, and structured approaches, and driving adoption across distributed teams. Strong communications capability, including employee-facing messaging, campaign support, senior stakeholder engagement, approval management, and quality control. Strong program management discipline, including intake management, tiering, gate-based governance, readiness checkpoints, and hypercare handover. Ability to work across multiple locations, timelines, and language requirements with a high level of consistency and control. Preferred qualifications Experience establishing or scaling a Center of Excellence in change management, communications, or transformation delivery. Experience supporting workplace transformation, relocation, or site move programs within a complex regional environment. Familiarity with structured governance models and quality assurance practices in change delivery. Ability to balance process discipline with practical execution in fast-moving environments. Proven experience developing, debugging, and stabilising multithreaded Linux userspace C++ applications. Solid experience with Linux IPC mechanisms like sockets, shared memory, pipes, message queues and designing reliable inter-process communication between concurrent applications. Strong debugging skills using GDB, strace, perf, core dump analysis with real production incident ownership, not just familiarity. Experience writing unit tests for C++ modules using Google Test (gtest) and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines. Experience in globally distributed development teams, particularly with European engineering counterparts. title: Data Architect
description:
Job Type: Permanent Title: Data Architect Department: Client Service Platform Location: Gurgaon/Bangalore Grade: 4 Reports To: Data Architecture Lead Were proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. We achieve this by working together and supporting one another across our global business. Join our team and be part of something bigger. Department Description 
 Platform Design & Solutions (PDS) is the architecture and technical governance body across Client Servicing Platforms (CSP). The Data Architecture and Ownership capability within PDS defines data models, migration architectures, certified data products, and data standards supporting client servicing, reporting, and investment operations globally. Purpose of the Role 
 The Data Architect (Grade 4) is a foundational data engineering and data modeling specialist responsible for translating business requirements and data domain definitions into physical and logical schema designs, Snowflake data pipelines, and certified Data Product interfaces. Working under the mentorship of the Data Architecture Lead and alongside senior data architects, you will play a crucial role in modernising CSP's data estate specifically supporting the strategic migration from the legacy on-premise Client Reporting Database onto Snowflake. You will map source-to-target data flows, author dimensional and relational data models, maintain technical data dictionaries, and validate data product contracts across client reporting, sales and assets, and distribution datasets. Key Responsibilities 
 Data Modeling & Schema Design Design and maintain logical and physical data models for CSP data domains using ERwin, ER/Studio, or dbt semantic models. Develop star-schema, snowflake-schema, and normalized table structures in Snowflake optimized for query performance and data sharing. Author comprehensive source-to-target mapping specifications, documenting transformation logic, business rules, and data cleansing requirements. Snowflake Data Migration & Pipeline Architecture Partner with delivery engineers to design ingestion and transformation pipelines moving data from legacy Oracle databases (CRDB) to target Snowflake tables. Write and optimize complex SQL transformations, views, and stored procedures in Snowflake. Assist in establishing data reconciliation, automated data validation checks, and regression scripts to guarantee zero data loss during cutover. Data Product Specification & Documentation Define technical specifications for certified Data Products: table schemas, JSON/Avro payloads, API contracts, and update cadences. Document detailed data dictionary entries, column definitions, and data lineage in enterprise catalogues (Collibra). Work with downstream consuming teams (reporting analysts, Salesforce developers, Tableau dashboard creators) to ensure data products meet functional requirements. Governance & Standards Compliance Ensure all database designs adhere to Fidelitys enterprise naming conventions, data classifications, and retention policies. Assist in classifying sensitive personal data (PII) and configuring masking policies or row-level access controls in Snowflake. 

 Experience and Qualifications Required 
 Knowledge: 36 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Senior Data Engineering in an enterprise data warehouse environment. Strong practical working knowledge of Snowflake (virtual warehouses, clustering, staging, zero-copy cloning, time travel). Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server). Solid understanding of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball dimensional modeling, Inmon relational modeling, Data Vault). Experience writing source-to-target mappings and participating in large-scale database migrations. Skills: Advanced SQL proficiency ability to write performant analytical queries, window functions, and complex joins. Familiarity with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, dbdiagram.io) and version control (Git). High attention to detail, structured thinking, and a passion for data accuracy and documentation. Excellent team collaboration skills, eager to learn and grow under senior architectural mentorship.

Key Skills: Requirements,Servicing,Data architecture,Architecture,Data Domain,Data dictionary,Reporting,Cloning

title: Sr. FinOps Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Summary As a Senior FinOps Engineer, you will serve as the technical backbone and subject matter expert for cloud financial operations across our global engineering organization. This role bridges deep cloud infrastructure mechanics with data engineering, algorithm design, and business economics. You will architect automated reporting pipelines, develop unit-cost metrics, govern procurement and operational policies, introduce FinOps practices for AI workloads, and partner closely with engineering squads, platform teams, and finance leaders to foster a culture of cost-aware engineering. Responsibilities Cloud Cost Visibility, Data Analytics Anomaly Detection Manage, curate, and normalize end-to-end cloud cost and usage datasets, ensuring high data fidelity, consistency, and standardized governance across multi-cloud environments. Define, build, and maintain automated cost, usage, and efficiency dashboards using Apache Superset, supported by SQL and data extraction pipelines. Design and deploy automated anomaly detection algorithms, statistical models, and alerting mechanisms to detect spending spikes, runaway workloads, and unexpected cost regressions in near real time. Benchmark, track, and report on cloud consumption, forecast variance, unit economics, and realized savings to engineering teams and leadership. Implement and refine tagging governance, business cost-allocation models, and unit economics metrics, such as cost per customer, cost per query, or cost per pipeline run. Architecture, Automation Spend Optimization Own and optimize cloud financial management platforms for reporting, cost optimization, and performance measurement. Our environment includes Cloudability, PointFive, ProsperOps, and Larridin; experience with comparable platforms is welcome. Design, build, and maintain automation workflows and scripts to identify and reclaim idle, underutilized, or orphaned resources, including compute instances, unattached volumes/IPs, outdated snapshots, and development/test environments. Lead enterprise-wide commitment strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP, managing portfolio coverage, risk, and utilization for Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and applicable provider-specific commitments. Partner with software, platform, and SRE teams to analyze utilization telemetry, implement rightsizing recommendations, and optimize compute and storage resources. FinOps for AI Emerging Technologies Introduce and establish FinOps frameworks tailored to AI, ML training pipelines, and LLM inference workloads. Establish Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI) models for AI infrastructure, including GPU clusters, vector databases, model hosting endpoints, and third-party AI APIs. Collaborate with AI/ML engineering teams to evaluate model inference performance against operational costs, improving token efficiency and hardware utilization. Governance, Procurement Cross-Functional Alignment Establish and enforce cloud cost and operational policies across accounts, subscriptions, regions, and resource configurations. Participate in architectural design and cloud capacity planning for new projects, services, and major infrastructure changes. Oversee third-party cloud marketplace software procurement, ensuring spending aligns with enterprise budgets and cloud discount commitments. Review production release schedules from a cost-impact perspective, incorporating pre-production load-testing analysis and cost guardrails. Partner with Financial Planning Analysis (FPA) and engineering leaders to track monthly variance, improve forecasting models, and translate technical decisions into business impact. Collaborate with engineering, platform, and finance teams across India and the United States. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, develop technical documentation, and promote FinOps best practices across engineering teams. Qualifications Required Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud financial management, with strong expertise in AWS and/or Google Cloud and familiarity with Azure. Proven experience applying FinOps principles (Inform, Optimize, Operate) in a modern cloud-native enterprise environment. Advanced SQL skills and experience building automated data workflows, metrics engines, and dashboards using BI tools such as Apache Superset. Experience creating or configuring automated alerting rules, statistical anomaly detection, or threshold-based algorithms for infrastructure telemetry. Direct experience managing cloud commitment portfolios, including Savings Plans and Reserved Instances, and optimizing effective savings rates. Strong scripting or coding skills in Python, Bash, or Go to build automated resource reclamation, API integrations, and policy enforcement tools. Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to contribute to architectural planning, implement governance policies, and explain trade-offs between cost, performance, reliability, and delivery speed. Preferred Qualifications FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional certification. Cloud Architect or SysOps certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience implementing FinOps practices for AI/ML workloads and GPU compute environments, including TCO/ROI analysis for LLMs and distributed training. Experience with cloud marketplace procurement workflows and private offer agreements. Experience with container cost allocation across Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, or AKS using tools such as Kubecost or OpenCost. Working knowledge of the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS), including its schema and taxonomy standards. What success looks like Within 3 Months Complete an assessment of existing multi-cloud accounts, commitment coverage portfolios, and FinOps tooling. Establish baseline dashboards for core services, identify idle-resource optimization opportunities, and improve commitment coverage. Participate in cloud architectural reviews and establish partnerships with AI/ML and platform engineering teams. Within 6-12 Months Deploy automated anomaly detection and idle-resource cleanup solutions into production workflows. Establish FinOps practices for AI workloads, providing TCO and ROI visibility into AI infrastructure and model inference. Formalize cloud marketplace procurement governance and cost reviews within operational release processes. Standardize multi-cloud cost allocation models and deliver trusted unit-cost KPIs across product lines. Long Term Build a proactive engineering culture where financial efficiency is incorporated into architecture and infrastructure decisions. Maintain scalable, automated cloud cost management and optimization capabilities that evolve with business and technology needs. Why This Role Matters As Alteryx continues to scale its platform and invest in AI capabilities, managing cloud infrastructure efficiently is essential to sustainable growth. In this role, you will go beyond monitoring cloud costs to build automation, improve financial visibility, influence architectural decisions, and establish meaningful metrics that connect engineering investments with business value.

Job Title - Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security SMTP) Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Email Security Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable. Key Responsibilities Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption. Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations. Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies. Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC Design and support SMTP relay and application email services Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented. title: Devops Lead
description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Full Stack / DevOps Lead to build and operate the application layer and delivery platform of our Data Quality Factory. The role covers the user-facing applications, APIs and integrations that let business users define rules, review data quality results and approve remediation, along with the CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure and operational practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and scalable. The Lead works closely with data engineers, AI engineers and business stakeholders, and manages a small engineering team. 
 Key Responsibilities Application development: Design and build full stack applications for the Data Quality Factory, such as rule management, data quality dashboards, remediation review and approval workflows, and exception handling. APIs and integrations: Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs; integrate with SAP and other enterprise systems, cloud data platforms (for example Databricks or Snowflake) and AI services. CI/CD: Set up and own build, test and deployment pipelines with automated testing, code quality checks and release management across environments. Infrastructure as code: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using tools such as Terraform or equivalent; manage environments, networking, secrets and access. Containers and orchestration: Containerize services and run them on orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or equivalent managed services. Monitoring and reliability: Implement logging, monitoring, alerting and observability; define SLAs, manage incidents and drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Security and compliance: Apply security best practices, including authentication and authorization, role-based access, secrets management, vulnerability scanning and audit logging; support data privacy and compliance requirements. Architecture and standards: Define engineering standards, reusable components, code review practices and documentation; make sound build-versus-buy decisions. Team and stakeholder management: Lead and mentor developers and DevOps engineers, plan sprints and delivery, and communicate status, risks and priorities to business and IT stakeholders. Support AI and data teams: Enable deployment of Python-based data quality jobs and AI or LLM-based remediation services into production in a repeatable, secure way. 
 Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. [X]+ years of software engineering experience, including [X–Y] years in full stack development and DevOps roles, with experience leading teams. Strong frontend experience with a modern framework such as React, Angular or Vue, along with HTML, CSS and TypeScript or JavaScript. Strong backend experience in Python, Java, Node.js or similar, with REST API design and SQL databases. Hands-on CI/CD experience (for example Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins). Experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and infrastructure as code. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent container platforms. Experience with monitoring and logging tools and with production support practices. Good understanding of application security and enterprise access management. Strong communication, stakeholder management and people leadership skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience working with data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake and with data pipelines. Familiarity with SAP data and integrations, and with data quality or data governance concepts. Experience deploying AI or LLM-based services, including model APIs and MLOps / LLMOps practices. Experience with workflow engines and orchestration tools. Relevant cloud or DevOps certifications. Experience in Agile or hybrid delivery models. 
 Key Skills and Competencies React / Angular, TypeScript, Python / Java / Node.js, REST APIs CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes Azure / AWS / GCP, monitoring and observability Application and cloud security Team leadership, stakeholder management and communication 
 Key Deliverables / Success Measures Production-ready Data Quality Factory applications and APIs delivered on schedule. Automated CI/CD pipelines and repeatable environments. Platform availability, performance and security targets met. Documented standards and a well-supported engineering team.

title: Endpoint Security & IT Operations Engineer
description:
Experience: 1-3 Years Location: Gurugram Employment Type: Full-time | Individual Contributor 
 About Infra360 Infra360 is a Managed Cloud Service Provider helping businesses build, secure and operate their cloud and technology environments. Our services span Cloud, DevOps, SRE, Security, FinOps and Managed Services . We are looking for a Security & IT Operations Engineer who can manage and secure the endpoint, identity and IT environment across Infra360 and its managed-service customers. 
 About the Role This is a hands-on role at the intersection of IT Operations and Cybersecurity . You will be responsible for managing endpoints, identity, access, security tools, device compliance, patching and vulnerability remediation. The ideal candidate is someone who can go beyond traditional IT support and understands how to build, manage and secure an organizations endpoint and user environment . You will work closely with the SOC/MDR, DevOps/SRE and Security teams to maintain a secure and reliable technology environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Endpoint & Device Management Manage Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints across multiple environments. Manage endpoint enrollment, configuration, application deployment and device lifecycle. Administer UEM/MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, JumpCloud, Kaseya/Datto or similar tools. Maintain accurate hardware and software inventory. Monitor endpoint health and resolve configuration or security issues. Ensure devices remain managed, updated and compliant. 2. Endpoint Security Deploy and administer EPP/EDR solutions such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Sophos, Wazuh or equivalent. Configure endpoint security policies, firewall, anti-malware, anti-ransomware and device-control policies. Ensure encryption and other endpoint security controls are enabled. Monitor EDR coverage and security posture. Work with the SOC team to support endpoint investigation and remediation. 3. Identity & Access Management Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning and access lifecycle. Administer MFA, SSO, groups, roles and access policies . Support Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes. Manage access revocation and account changes. Support privileged-access management and periodic access reviews. Work with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, JumpCloud, Okta, Google Workspace or similar. 4. Device Compliance & Security Baselines Define and monitor endpoint compliance requirements. Ensure devices meet requirements for patching, encryption, EDR, firewall, screen lock and other security controls. Implement and maintain security baselines based on CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft security baselines and customer requirements . Identify and remediate non-compliant devices. 5. Patch & Vulnerability Management Monitor endpoint vulnerabilities and prioritize critical/high-risk issues. Coordinate OS and third-party application patching. Track patch compliance and remediation. Identify unsupported or end-of-life software. Work with the SOC and DevOps/SRE teams to coordinate remediation where required. 6. IT Security Operations Maintain visibility of users, devices, applications, licenses and security controls. Support IT security configuration and operational processes. Manage security exceptions and remediation activities. Maintain documentation, configurations and operational runbooks. Support customer environments in accordance with defined SLAs. 7. Automation Automate repetitive IT and security tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python, UEM scripting or APIs . Automate activities such as software deployment, compliance checks, onboarding/offboarding, patch remediation and reporting. 8. Incident Remediation Support Support the SOC/MDR team during endpoint security incidents. Isolate or reconfigure compromised devices. Remove malicious software and apply required security controls. Patch vulnerable endpoints and validate remediation before returning devices to service. 
 What Were Looking For Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in IT Operations, Endpoint Management, UEM/MDM or IT Security . Strong Windows administration experience. Hands-on experience with UEM/MDM platforms. Experience administering EPP/EDR solutions. Good understanding of IAM, MFA, SSO and access controls . Experience with patch and vulnerability management. Good understanding of endpoint security. Working knowledge of macOS and Linux. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good documentation and operational discipline. Good to Have: MSP/MSSP or managed-services experience. Microsoft Intune and Entra ID experience. ManageEngine Endpoint Central, JumpCloud or Kaseya/Datto experience. PowerShell, Python or Bash scripting. Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks. DLP/device-control experience. Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2. 
 What Success Looks Like In this role, success means maintaining a secure, compliant and well-managed endpoint environment with strong device visibility, EDR coverage, patch compliance and controlled user access. You will help Infra360 build standardized, scalable and security-focused IT operations for both internal and customer environments. Required Skills Identity and access management IT security rule group device management policy review vulnerability management endpoint security IT operations

 Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced IT Security Compliance Lead to manage and strengthen the organizations endpoint security, vulnerability management, security compliance, audit readiness, and security operations. The role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with security policies and standards, managing security tools and controls, coordinating audits, addressing security findings, and providing technical leadership to the security support team.
