title: Senior Data Engineer I
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong Development DBA expertise to design, develop, implement, optimize, and support enterprise-scale database solutions across Relational and NoSQL database platforms. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience managing the end-to-end database development lifecycle , from requirements gathering, data modeling, and logical/physical database design through database development, deployment, performance tuning, optimization, and production implementation. This role requires deep technical expertise across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Cassandra, Couchbase, Microsoft SQL Server, and IBM Db2 LUW , along with experience designing and implementing database solutions in AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments. The candidate will collaborate closely with application development teams, solution architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing database solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of hands-on experience in database engineering, database development, or Development DBA roles within enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end database development activities, from requirements analysis and logical/physical design through deployment and performance optimization. Strong expertise in SQL development, query optimization, database schema design, indexing, and execution plan analysis. Hands-on engineering experience with multiple database technologies, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, IBM Db2 LUW, Cassandra, and Couchbase. Deep expertise in at least two relational database platforms, with the ability to work across additional database technologies. Practical experience designing and optimizing NoSQL database solutions. Hands-on experience with database services and engineering practices in AWS and/or GCP. Experience implementing database changes through automated DB CI/CD pipelines and schema migration frameworks. Strong understanding of database internals, transaction management, concurrency, locking, indexing, partitioning, and query optimization. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and cross-functional communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in large-scale enterprise, financial services, or other highly regulated environments. Experience with high-volume OLTP systems, mission-critical applications, and distributed database architectures. Experience with cloud database modernization, migration, and hybrid-cloud architectures. Knowledge of database replication, high availability, disaster recovery, and backup/recovery design principles. Experience with infrastructure automation using Terraform or similar tools. Familiarity with database observability and monitoring solutions. Experience with data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data engineering frameworks. Knowledge of data governance, data security, and regulatory compliance practices. Experience conducting database architecture assessments, performance benchmarking, and capacity planning. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Database Engineering Lifecycle Own and drive the complete database development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering through design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and ongoing enhancements. Collaborate with business stakeholders, application teams, and solution architects to translate functional and non-functional requirements into robust database solutions. Develop database architecture specifications, technical design documents, data models, and implementation strategies. Lead database design reviews, code reviews, and technical solution assessments. Ensure database solutions meet enterprise standards for scalability, availability, performance, security, and maintainability. 2. Data Modeling and Database Design Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for Relational and NoSQL database platforms. Apply appropriate data modeling methodologies, including normalization, denormalization, indexing, partitioning, and data distribution strategies. Design database objects including tables, relationships, constraints, views, indexes, and other database objects. Develop efficient data access patterns and storage models based on application workloads and business requirements. Evaluate database technology choices and recommend optimal relational or NoSQL solutions based on workload characteristics. Define database standards, naming conventions, data integrity controls, and design best practices. 3. Database Development and Engineering Implement database solutions across PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2 LUW, Cassandra, and Couchbase. Design and implement efficient transaction processing, concurrency handling, and data access mechanisms. Partner with application development teams to optimize database integration and application-to-database interactions. Build reusable database components, development frameworks, and automation utilities. 4. Database Performance Engineering and Optimization Perform proactive and reactive database performance tuning across relational and NoSQL platforms. Analyze SQL execution plans, query performance metrics, database statistics, and workload characteristics to identify performance bottlenecks. Optimize query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, memory utilization, concurrency, and database configurations. Diagnose and resolve issues involving locking, blocking, deadlocks, inefficient queries, and resource contention. Conduct database workload analysis, performance benchmarking, capacity planning, and scalability assessments. Collaborate with application teams to improve end-to-end application and database performance. 5. Database Deployment, DevOps, and Automation Design and implement automated database deployment and release management processes. Integrate database schema changes, SQL scripts, and configuration updates into CI/CD pipelines. Implement database version control, schema migration, release validation, and rollback strategies. Utilize tools including Liquibase, Git, GitHub Actions, or equivalent enterprise DevOps platforms. Develop automation using Python, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform. Establish repeatable, auditable, and reliable database deployment processes across development, testing, staging, and production environments. 6. Cloud Database Engineering - AWS / GCP Design, develop, deploy, and optimize database solutions hosted in AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform. Work with managed database services such as: AWS: Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, DynamoDB and applicable cloud-native database services. GCP: Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, and other relevant managed database offerings. Evaluate and implement cloud database architecture patterns for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. Support database modernization and migration initiatives from on-premises infrastructure to public cloud platforms. Implement cloud-native database monitoring, security, configuration management, and automation practices. Collaborate with cloud architecture and platform engineering teams to define database provisioning and operational standards. 7. NoSQL Database Engineering Design and optimize distributed NoSQL database solutions using Cassandra and Couchbase. Develop data models aligned with application access patterns, partitioning strategies, and distributed data architectures. Optimize Cassandra partition keys, clustering keys, replication strategies, and query patterns. Design Couchbase document structures, indexes, N1QL/SQL++ queries, and data access patterns. Understand distributed database concepts, including consistency models, replication, fault tolerance, and horizontal scalability. Diagnose and resolve NoSQL performance, data distribution, and application integration issues. 8. Database Reliability, Security, and Production Readiness Engineer database solutions with appropriate availability, recoverability, resiliency, and disaster recovery considerations. Incorporate security requirements such as encryption, access controls, least-privilege access, and sensitive data protection into database designs. Support database security and compliance requirements in regulated enterprise environments. Conduct database production readiness assessments, deployment risk reviews, and performance validations. Partner with Production DBA, SRE, and infrastructure teams on production implementation, incident resolution, and root cause analysis. Establish monitoring, observability, and operational handoff requirements for database solutions. 9. Technical Leadership and Collaboration Serve as a subject matter expert for database development DBA practices, and database performance optimization. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to database engineers and application development teams. Influence database architecture decisions, technology selection, and engineering best practices. Drive continuous improvements in database design, development standards, automation, and engineering productivity. Collaborate across architecture, application development, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, and production support teams.

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
Job Title - Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security SMTP) Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Email Security Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position. The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable. Key Responsibilities Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption. Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations. Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies. Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC Design and support SMTP relay and application email services Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented. Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response. Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting. Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling. Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes. Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles. Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers. Role Scope SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms. Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways. Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack. Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders. Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols. Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview. Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist. Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions. Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting. Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams. Skills & Experience Exchange Online Messaging Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise. Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways. Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations. Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation. Email Security Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Experience administering secure email gateway Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement. Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams. Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview. SMTP Application Email Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis. Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services. Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH. Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections. Identity, Automation Operations Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging. Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable. Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates. Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis. Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform. Communication Customer Support Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates. Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement. Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams. Personal Attributes Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure. Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made. Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages. Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape. Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists. Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams. Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer. Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues. Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team. Overall Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst. They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed. Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential. We achieve this by working together and supporting one another across our global business. Join our team and be part of something bigger. Department Description 
 Platform Design & Solutions (PDS) is the architecture and technical governance body across Client Servicing Platforms (CSP). The Data Architecture and Ownership capability within PDS defines data models, migration architectures, certified data products, and data standards supporting client servicing, reporting, and investment operations globally. Purpose of the Role 
 The Data Architect (Grade 4) is a foundational data engineering and data modeling specialist responsible for translating business requirements and data domain definitions into physical and logical schema designs, Snowflake data pipelines, and certified Data Product interfaces. Working under the mentorship of the Data Architecture Lead and alongside senior data architects, you will play a crucial role in modernising CSP's data estate specifically supporting the strategic migration from the legacy on-premise Client Reporting Database onto Snowflake. You will map source-to-target data flows, author dimensional and relational data models, maintain technical data dictionaries, and validate data product contracts across client reporting, sales and assets, and distribution datasets. Key Responsibilities

Develop star-schema, snowflake-schema, and normalized table structures in Snowflake optimized for query performance and data sharing. Author comprehensive source-to-target mapping specifications, documenting transformation logic, business rules, and data cleansing requirements. Write and optimize complex SQL transformations, views, and stored procedures in Snowflake. Assist in establishing data reconciliation, automated data validation checks, and regression scripts to guarantee zero data loss during cutover. Data Product Specification & Documentation Define technical specifications for certified Data Products: table schemas, JSON/Avro payloads, API contracts, and update cadences. Document detailed data dictionary entries, column definitions, and data lineage in enterprise catalogues (Collibra). Work with downstream consuming teams (reporting analysts, Salesforce developers, Tableau dashboard creators) to ensure data products meet functional requirements. Governance & Standards Compliance Ensure all database designs adhere to Fidelitys enterprise naming conventions, data classifications, and retention policies. Assist in classifying sensitive personal data (PII) and configuring masking policies or row-level access controls in Snowflake. 

 Experience and Qualifications Required

Strong practical working knowledge of Snowflake (virtual warehouses, clustering, staging, zero-copy cloning, time travel). Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server). Solid understanding of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball dimensional modeling, Inmon relational modeling, Data Vault). Experience writing source-to-target mappings and participating in large-scale database migrations. Skills: Advanced SQL proficiency ability to write performant analytical queries, window functions, and complex joins. Familiarity with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, dbdiagram.io) and version control (Git). High attention to detail, structured thinking, and a passion for data accuracy and documentation. Excellent team collaboration skills, eager to learn and grow under senior architectural mentorship.

title: Data Solution Architect
description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Solution Architecture Own solution architecture and design from source ingestion through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers to final consumption. Work with business and technical stakeholders to understand functional and non-functional requirements. Translate business requirements into scalable data architectures, implementation patterns and engineering designs. Determine the most appropriate architecture and technology based on performance, scalability, security, cost, maintainability and operational complexity. Evaluate alternative designs and determine the appropriate processing and orchestration approach across AWS, Snowflake, Apache Airflow and other approved platform components. Ensure solutions support current reporting and analytics requirements while also making enterprise data ready for scalable downstream AI consumption where required. Define reusable architecture patterns and avoid isolated solutions where common platform capabilities can be established. 2. Bronze, Silver & Gold Layer Ownership Define architecture, design principles and standards for Bronze, Silver and Gold layers. Determine what data should be captured, standardized, cleansed, transformed and modeled at each layer. Define appropriate patterns for full load, incremental load, CDC, MERGE, SCD, historization, deduplication, reconciliation and retention. Determine the appropriate consumption layer based on business and technical requirements rather than creating unnecessary Gold datasets. Ensure Silver and Gold datasets contain the appropriate business context, relationships, quality and history required by downstream consumers. 
 DATA SOLUTION ARCHITECT | JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Confidential • 2 
 Ensure datasets required for AI use cases are appropriately structured, standardized, contextualized, modeled and governed before being made available for downstream AI consumption. Design the layers to maximize reuse across reporting, analytics and AI requirements, minimizing duplicate processing and datasets. 3. Data Modeling Own conceptual, logical and physical data modeling for enterprise data solutions. Define the appropriate dimensional, relational and analytical modeling approach for each requirement. Establish standards for facts, dimensions, data grain, business keys, surrogate keys, relationships, common dimensions and historical tracking. Define appropriate SCD and historization approaches based on business requirements. Ensure consistent business definitions and reusable models across different solutions. Design models capable of serving reporting, analytics and AI consumption requirements without unnecessary duplication. Ensure consumption-ready datasets contain the necessary business context and relationships for reliable downstream usage. Review and approve data models produced by implementation teams before development and production deployment. 4. Engineering & Production Standards Ensure every solution appropriately addresses: Data quality and validation Schema-change management Source-to-target reconciliation Metadata and data lineage Record-count reconciliation Scheduling and dependency management Duplicate and rejected-record handling Security and role-based access Error and exception management SLA/SLO requirements Retry, restart and reprocessing mechanisms Performance and scalability Logging and auditability Automated testing Pipeline monitoring and alerting CI/CD and environment promotion Failure email/notification mechanisms Production support and operational 
 documentation 
 The Solution Architect will ensure these requirements are incorporated into the solution design from the beginning rather than being addressed after development. 5. Technology Selection & Architecture Optimization Evaluate and recommend the most appropriate technology and implementation approach for each requirement. Have strong architectural knowledge of Snowflake capabilities, including Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, stored procedures and Iceberg. Have strong knowledge of relevant AWS services, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lambda, IAM and Amazon MWAA/Apache Airflow. Determine where ingestion, storage, transformation and orchestration should occur across AWS, Snowflake and associated technologies based on architectural suitability. Consider downstream consumption through Snowflake Cortex and Azure-based data/AI capabilities when designing datasets expected to support AI use cases. Ensure these datasets are structured and modeled appropriately for scalable downstream AI consumption. 
 DATA SOLUTION ARCHITECT | JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Confidential • 3 
 Identify inefficient, overly complex or costly implementations and recommend improvements. Continuously optimize performance, compute utilization, data movement, storage, scalability and cost. Reduce unnecessary duplication and establish reusable platform capabilities wherever appropriate. Periodically review existing architecture to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification and optimization. 6. Architecture Governance & Design Review Act as the technical design authority for enterprise data solutions. Conduct architecture and solution-design reviews before implementation. Review designs created by engineering teams, implementation partners and other technology teams. Challenge solutions where scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, performance, cost or operational readiness have not been sufficiently addressed. Ensure designs comply with established architectural, data-modeling and engineering standards. Ensure major architecture decisions and deviations are appropriately documented. Maintain Architecture Decision Records for significant technical decisions. Provide architecture and design approval before major solutions move into production. 7. Stakeholder & Engineering Collaboration Conduct requirement and solutioning workshops with business and technology stakeholders. Understand how the data will ultimately be consumed before defining the underlying architecture. Work closely with Data Engineers throughout implementation to ensure approved designs are implemented correctly. Collaborate with business teams, application/source-system teams, reporting and analytics teams, AI teams, security, infrastructure and implementation partners. Ensure downstream requirements are understood early enough to influence ingestion, transformation and modeling decisions. Review implementations against the approved design and identify deviations or gaps. Communicate architecture decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills & Experience 812+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Data Architecture or related areas. Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end enterprise data solution architecture. Strong architectural and hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and AWS. Strong understanding of Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion Architecture. Advanced expertise in data modeling, including dimensional modeling, facts/dimensions, SCD, CDC and historization. Strong SQL skills and good working knowledge of Python. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, transformation frameworks and SQL-based data-processing patterns. Experience with Apache Airflow / Amazon MWAA or equivalent orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, error handling, observability, metadata and lineage. Understanding of designing governed and consumption-ready datasets for downstream reporting, analytics and AI workloads. Experience with enterprise security, RBAC, automated testing, CI/CD and production deployment controls. Strong understanding of cloud performance and cost optimization.

title: Sr. Network Engineer
description:
Job Summary Your work days are brighter here. We re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether youre building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you ll do meaningful work with Workmates who ve got your back. In return, we ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Workdays BT Cloud Engineering team is looking for a highly motivated technical lead to join our fun, innovative, and hardworking team. Working with an outstanding group of highly qualified IT professionals, you will be part of a special team that is building the cloud first approach for workmates. We are seeking a skilled and motivated hands on lead who can help BT continue to deliver secure services at scale.. This position is located in Pune, India About the Role Our organization is seeking a highly motivated, experienced, and communicative Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting complex network infrastructures. This role requires a strong background in enterprise-grade routing and switching (including extensive experience with Cisco IOS/IOS-XE/NX-OS operating systems), the comprehensive Juniper Mist AI-driven wireless platform, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, SD-WAN, advanced AWS cloud networking (including Gateway Load Balancer, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, and sophisticated traffic management techniques), and in-depth Zscaler Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions (including Zscaler Internet Access - ZIA and Zscaler Private Access - ZPA). You will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, security, and scalability of our enterprise network, including the physical infrastructure of our network distribution frames, and effectively communicating network strategies and issues across the organization. This role requires participation in an on-call rotation to provide 24x7 support. About You Basic Qualifications: 8+ years total experience Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise-level network infrastructure, including routers, switches (campus and data center), firewalls, wireless access points, and related services. Design, implement, and manage complex BGP routing solutions, including iBGP/eBGP peering, route reflectors, policy-based routing, traffic engineering using communities and other attributes, and troubleshooting complex BGP convergence and stability issues. Lead the design, build-out, and ongoing management of Main Distribution Frames (MDFs) and Intermediate Distribution Frames (IDFs), ensuring adherence to structured cabling standards, optimal cable management, power distribution, cooling, and physical security. Design, deploy, and manage the Juniper Mist AI-driven platform (including Mist Access Points, Mist Edge, and the Mist Cloud dashboard for AI-driven operations, Marvis Virtual Network Assistant, Wi-Fi Assurance, Wired Assurance, and WAN Assurance). Deploy, manage, and optimize Palo Alto Networks SD-WAN, firewalls, including policy creation, threat prevention, VPN configuration, and performance tuning. Architect, build, and manage secure and scalable network solutions within AWS cloud environments, including: Designing and implementing AWS Transit Gateway architectures for large-scale network connectivity (VPC attachments, Direct Connect Gateway, route propagation, network segmentation, and policy enforcement). Setting up and managing AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) for deploying and scaling third-party virtual appliances. Establishing and managing VPC Peering connections (intra-region and inter-region) ensuring secure and optimized communication paths. Implementing comprehensive AWS traffic management solutions using services like Route 53 (DNS, health checks, routing policies), Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB), and AWS Direct Connect for hybrid connectivity. Configuring and managing Security Groups, Network ACLs, and other AWS native security features. Implement, configure, and manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions, including: Setting up and managing identity provider (IdP) integrations (e.g., SAML, SCIM) for robust user authentication and the creation/management of identity-based security policies and access groups. Deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Zscaler Private Service Edges (PSEs) for optimized and secure access to internal applications via ZPA. Developing and contributing to Business Continuity Plans (BCP) for Zscaler services, ensuring resilient and continuous secure access for users. Configuring traffic forwarding, security policies, and application segments. Lead network infrastructure projects from conception to completion, including requirements gathering, design, planning, execution, and post-implementation support, ensuring clear communication with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Monitor network performance and integrity using tools like Marvis for proactive insights, identify and resolve complex network issues (leveraging deep troubleshooting skills for routing, switching, firewalling, cloud networking, and SASE solutions), and implement proactive measures to prevent outages and performance degradation. Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, IDF/MDF layouts, Zscaler policy and architecture details, operational procedures, and present technical information clearly to diverse audiences. Effectively collaborate and communicate with cross-functional teams (Security, Systems, Applications, DevOps, Facilities) to ensure network infrastructure supports business requirements and strategic initiatives. Perform network capacity planning and recommend upgrades and enhancements to meet evolving business needs, articulating justifications and benefits clearly. Participate in an on-call rotation for after-hours support and respond to critical network incidents, providing 24x7 operational support as needed, communicating status and resolution effectively.

A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. Job Description 
 The successful candidate will combine strong critical thinking, communication, and analytical skills with the ability to understand business, technology, data, and reporting processes and identify governance or control gaps. The role requires sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and disciplined attention to detail. The candidate must be able to work independently, provide constructive credible challenge, develop clear and defensible documentation, and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience Typically, 6 - 9 years of total experience Roles & Responsibilities Perform control design assessments, operating effectiveness reviews, and quality assurance testing; document procedures, evidence, results, and conclusions so they can be independently understood and reproduced. Support the design and enhancement of governance processes and controls, including clearly defined ownership, frequency, evidence, escalation, and approval requirements. Evaluate control mapping across business, data, and technology processes, including alignment to relevant IT controls and identification of gaps or duplication. Support periodic refreshes of EDG policies, standards, procedures, and supporting guidance; assess changes for consistency, clarity, and operational impact. Execute governance maturity assessments, validate supporting evidence, identify themes and gaps, and develop clear recommendations for accountable stakeholders. Prepare accurate, concise EDG reporting and executive-ready updates that highlight status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required actions. Maintain procedures, templates, job aids, and records of decision that translate policy requirements into clear, executable, and testable expectations. Ability to understand Business Line operations, products and services, systems, data flows, reporting processes, and associated risks and controls. description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Technical Lead to run the technical workstream of our Data Quality Factory. The role designs and delivers scalable data quality capabilities on cloud data platforms, using data from SAP and other financial applications. The Lead brings strong knowledge of SAP master tables, hands-on experience building DQ frameworks on platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake, and practical experience building agentic and LLM-based AI solutions for data quality detection and remediation. The Lead also manages a technical team and engages senior stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities Technical leadership: Own the architecture, design and delivery of the Data Quality Factory workstream, including standards, reusable components and engineering best practices. SAP and financial data: Extract, model and analyze data from SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and other financial applications; work with SAP master tables and their relationships and key fields. DQ framework on cloud: Set up and run a data quality framework on cloud platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar, covering rule definition, profiling, execution, scoring, monitoring and alerting. Agentic AI solutions: Design and build custom agentic AI solutions for data quality, such as agents that detect issues, propose fixes, validate results and route exceptions for human review. AI-led remediation: Perform data remediation using LLM-based approaches and external search or enrichment sources, with confidence scoring, validation and audit trails. AI platforms: Use platforms such as Mosaic AI, Snowflake Cortex AI, Azure AI Foundry or similar to build, evaluate and deploy AI solutions, with attention to cost, accuracy and governance. Automation and pipelines: Build Python-based pipelines and integrations, handling JSON and other semi-structured data, APIs and orchestration. Governance and quality: Work with data owners and stewards to define business rules and Critical Data Elements; maintain DQ metrics, scorecards and issue management. Team and stakeholder management: Lead and mentor engineers and analysts, plan and track delivery, and communicate progress, risks and outcomes to business and IT stakeholders. Security and compliance: Ensure data handling, including data sent to LLMs or external services, meets security, privacy and compliance requirements. 
 Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. 12+ years of total IT/data experience, of which 5–7 years are directly relevant to data quality, SAP/financial data and cloud or AI-based data solutions. Proven experience handling data from SAP and other financial applications. Clear understanding of SAP master tables (for example material, customer, vendor/business partner and finance master tables) and their relationships. Hands-on experience setting up a data quality framework on cloud platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar. Working knowledge of agentic AI and experience building custom AI solutions for data quality. Exposure to Mosaic AI, Cortex AI, Azure AI Foundry or similar AI platforms. Experience performing remediation using LLM-based methods and external searches or enrichment. Strong skills in Python, SQL and JSON; experience with APIs and data pipelines. Experience managing teams and stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience with SAP data extraction tools and SAP S/4HANA migration programs. Familiarity with data quality or governance tools and open-source DQ libraries. Experience with prompt engineering, RAG, evaluation of LLM outputs and agent frameworks. Knowledge of data governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK. Relevant cloud or AI certifications (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure). Experience in Agile or hybrid delivery models. 
 Key Skills and Competencies SAP master tables, SAP ECC and S/4HANA data Databricks, Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms Agentic AI, LLMs, Mosaic AI, Cortex AI, Azure AI Foundry Python, SQL, JSON, APIs Data quality rules, profiling, scorecards and remediation Team leadership, stakeholder management and communication 
 Key Deliverables / Success Measures Production-ready DQ framework running on the cloud platform. Working agentic AI and LLM-based remediation solutions with measured accuracy. ASU - Forensics - Investigations Compliance : Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks. Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues - including governance, controls, culture and data insights - to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. Your key responsibilities Clean, transform, analyze, and validate structured or unstructured datasets using Python and SQL. Write and optimize queries using joins, CTEs, subqueries, aggregations, CASE statements, and window functions. Use Pandas, NumPy, and OpenPyXL for analysis, reconciliation, automation, and Excel/CSV processing. Identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and inconsistencies; communicate findings clearly. Generative AI: Basic understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, limitations, hallucinations, and responsible usage. AI-Assisted Coding: Ability to convert requirements into prompts, assess generated logic, detect errors, debug, test, and improve solutions independently. Preferred Skills Power BI advanced Excel Git Jupyter Notebook REST APIs scikit-learn ETL pipelines Microsoft SQL Server/SSMS Azure cloud Desired Profile Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Success in this role: The candidate should use AI as a productivity accelerator, while retaining ownership of the logic, security, accuracy, testing and explainability of every output. title: Clinical Data Tagger (BDS)- Noida
description:
Cogito is currently working on Artificial Intelligence applications in Annotation work and is looking to engage with " Clinical Data Tagger " to participate in ongoing projects. 
 We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Data Tagger with a clinical background to support our AI development initiatives. The role involves reviewing audio transcripts and contextual information from senior care and senior living environments and applying clinical judgment to determine whether observed situations or events are clinically valid based on defined clinical criteria. 
 The Clinical Data Tagger will play an important role in developing and validating benchmark datasets used to train and evaluate clinical intelligence system . In addition to assigning the appropriate tag, the individual will be expected to clearly document the clinical reasoning behind each decision. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Review audio transcripts and relevant contextual data from senior living and senior care environments. Interpret the available information using appropriate clinical context and judgment . Tag each example as clinically valid or not clinically valid based on established clinical criteria and guidelines. Provide a clear, concise, and clinically sound rationale supporting each tagging decision. Distinguish between genuine clinical presentations and situations that may appear clinically relevant based only on isolated symptoms or phrases. Identify and flag ambiguous, unclear, or borderline cases for further review. Highlight recurring patterns, inconsistencies, potential data-quality issues, and areas where existing criteria may require clarification. Maintain a high level of accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail across assigned datasets. Work independently while following structured guidelines, workflows, and quality expectations. Collaborate with the project team and provide feedback that can help improve tagging guidelines and the overall data-quality process. Maintain appropriate confidentiality and professional standards when handling clinical and senior-care-related data. 

 Required Qualifications & Experience 
 Clinical background with an understanding of acute clinical presentations. Suitable backgrounds may include: Registered Nurse / Nursing professional Paramedic / Emergency Medical professional Medical Student Recent Clinical Graduate Other relevant healthcare or clinical backgrounds Ability to understand and apply clinical context , rather than simply identifying or matching individual symptoms or keywords. Good understanding of common acute presentations and their clinical relevance. Strong written English skills with the ability to document clear, precise, and logical clinical reasoning . Ability to independently interpret information and make decisions using predefined clinical criteria. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across a large volume of examples. Comfortable working with structured workflows, guidelines, and quality standards. Key Competencies Clinical Judgment Analytical Thinking Attention to Detail Written Communication Decision Making Consistency & Accuracy Ability to Identify Ambiguity Independent Working Process Adherence Data Quality Orientation 

 Role Expectations 
 The successful candidate should be able to go beyond simple symptom recognition and understand whether the available information supports a clinically meaningful interpretation . The quality of the role will be assessed not only by the accuracy of the tags but also by the clarity and clinical soundness of the reasoning provided for each decision . Experience in healthcare, senior care, emergency/acute care, clinical documentation, medical data review, or healthcare AI/data annotation would be advantageous.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Job Summary As an Agentic AI Engineer at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that do real work: researching cases, analysing data, calling tools and APIs, and automating multi-step workflows for our products and for lenders and fintech partners. You will own agents end to end, from prompt and tool design through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. You will work closely with our data science, data engineering, and product teams, and help set how Hudson Data builds with AI. This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India. Responsibilities Design and build LLM-based agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, call APIs and databases, and complete multi-step tasks reliably. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over structured and unstructured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking. Design clear tool interfaces (function calling, MCP servers) that connect agents to internal systems, data warehouses, and third-party services. Build evaluation harnesses: test sets, automated and LLM-as-judge evals, regression tests, and red-teaming, so agent quality is measured, not guessed. Take agents to production with solid engineering: APIs, background jobs, retries, cost and latency controls, logging, tracing, and monitoring. Put guardrails in place: permissions, human-in-the-loop review, prompt-injection defences, PII handling, and audit trails suitable for financial-services clients. Choose the right model for each job across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models), balancing quality, cost, and latency. Work with data scientists to combine agents with predictive models, for example agents that investigate fraud alerts or explain credit decisions. Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring the useful ideas into our stack. Required qualifications 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year building applications on top of LLMs. Strong Python, with experience building production backend services and APIs (FastAPI or similar). Hands-on experience building agents or LLM workflows: function/tool calling, structured outputs, prompt design, and at least one orchestration approach (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or your own). Experience with RAG and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant). Experience evaluating LLM systems and improving them based on measured results. Solid SQL and comfort working with real, messy business data. Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), Docker, Git, and CI/CD. Ability to own problems end to end and explain technical trade-offs clearly. Preferred qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or a related field. Experience building MCP servers or integrating agents with enterprise systems. Experience with observability tools for LLM apps (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, OpenTelemetry). Background in fintech, lending, credit risk, fraud, or another regulated industry. Experience fine-tuning or serving open-weight models. Open-source contributions or public projects with agents or LLMs.

title: AI Data Lead
description:
Sr Director - AI Data Leader Field Details Location Dubai Language Preference Arabic ,English Role Summary and Overview The AI Data Leader spearheads the organizations data and AI strategy, aligning it with business goals and product priorities in a player-coach capacity that blends technical depth with strategic vision while mentoring and developing teams. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, value-driven senior Data & AI executive with 15+ years leading Data and AI transformations across MENA, UK & Europe, proven in Data & AI practice pipeline forecasting, P&L ownership, Go-To-Market and Delivery Excellence, who builds high-performing diverse teams, delivers enterprise-scale data platforms, AI/ML Ops and responsible AI programs, and translates complex technical capability into measurable business outcomes as a trusted C-suite advisor and industry thought leader. Key Responsibilities Define and drive the organizations Data & AI strategy, covering data infrastructure, AI/ML models, partnerships and talent. Own P&L for Data & AI across MENA, setting the strategic growth path for transformation, sales growth and operational leadership. Establish and grow regional delivery centers serving MENA, UK & Europe. Lead the AI/ML lifecycle from research and prototyping through deployment and monitoring to improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives and uncover new use cases. Create and scale unified DataOps, BI/DW and AI teams for Advanced Analytics using agile practices across tools, code and cloud infrastructure. Define and execute enterprise Data & AI strategy covering architecture, data platform roadmaps and productization of AI models.
